verses.text: And he spoke to Him yet again, and said, Perhaps there shall be forty found there. And He said, I will not do <hi>it</hi> for forty's sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:30
verses.text: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak. Perhaps there shall be thirty found there. And He said, I will not do <hi>it</hi> if I find thirty there.

verses.name: Genesis 18:31
verses.text: And he said, Lo now, I have taken upon me to speak to the LORD. Perhaps there shall be twenty found there. And He said, I will not destroy <hi>it</hi> for twenty's sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:32
verses.text: And he said, Oh do not let the LORD be angry, and I will speak only once more. Perhaps ten shall be found there. And He said, I will not destroy <hi>it</hi> for ten's sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:33
verses.text: And the LORD went His way as soon as He had left off talking with Abraham. And Abraham returned to his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:1
verses.text: And there came two angels to Sodom at evening. And Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. And Lot rose up to meet them when he saw <hi>them</hi>. And he bowed himself with his face toward the ground,

verses.name: Genesis 19:2
verses.text: and said, Behold now, my lords, please turn into your servant's house and stay all night, and wash your feet, and <hi>you shall</hi> rise up early and go your way. And they said, No, but we will stay in the street.

verses.name: Genesis 19:3
verses.text: But he urgently pressed on them, and they turned in to him and entered into his house. And he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:4
verses.text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both old and young, all the people from every quarter.

verses.name: Genesis 19:5
verses.text: And they called to Lot, and said to him, Where are the men which came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may know them.

verses.name: Genesis 19:6
verses.text: And Lot went out to the door to them, and shut the door after him.

verses.name: Genesis 19:7
verses.text: And he said, I pray you, brothers, do not act evilly.

verses.name: Genesis 19:8
verses.text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man. I pray you, let me bring them out to you, and you do to them as you see fit. But do nothing to these men, for this is why they came under the shadow of my roof.

verses.name: Genesis 19:9
verses.text: And they said, Stand back! And they said, This one came in to stay, and must he judge always? Now we will deal worse with you than with them. And they pressed hard upon the man, Lot, and came near to breaking the door.

verses.name: Genesis 19:10
verses.text: But the men put out their hands and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

verses.name: Genesis 19:11
verses.text: And they smote the men that <hi>were</hi> at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:12
verses.text: And the men said to Lot, Have you anyone here besides yourself? Bring your sons-in-law, and your sons, and your daughters, and whatever <hi>you have</hi> in the city, bring <hi>them</hi> out of this place.

verses.name: Genesis 19:13
verses.text: For we will destroy this place because great is the cry of them before the face of the LORD. And the LORD has sent us to destroy it.

verses.name: Genesis 19:14
verses.text: And Lot went out and spoke with his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Get up and get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked to his sons-in-law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:15
verses.text: And when the dawn rose up, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, Rise up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

verses.name: Genesis 19:16
verses.text: And he lingered, the angel laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters (the LORD being merciful to him), and they brought him forth and set him outside the city.

verses.name: Genesis 19:17
verses.text: And it happened when they brought him outside, He said, Escape for your life! Do not look behind you, nor stay in all the plain. Escape to the mountain lest you be consumed.

verses.name: Genesis 19:18
verses.text: And Lot said to them, Oh no, Lord,

verses.name: Genesis 19:19
verses.text: behold now, Your servant has found grace in Your sight, and You have magnified Your mercy, which You have shown to me in saving my life. And I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me and I die.

verses.name: Genesis 19:20
verses.text: Behold now, this city <hi>is</hi> near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

verses.name: Genesis 19:21
verses.text: And He said to him, See, I have accepted you concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city for which you have spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 19:22
verses.text: Hurry and escape there! For I cannot do anything till you have come there. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

verses.name: Genesis 19:23
verses.text: The sun had risen upon the earth, and Lot entered into Zoar.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:24
verses.text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire, from the LORD out of the heavens.

verses.name: Genesis 19:25
verses.text: And He overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:26
verses.text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:27
verses.text: And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD.

verses.name: Genesis 19:28
verses.text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the lands of the plain, and saw, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

verses.name: Genesis 19:29
verses.text: And when God destroyed the cities of the plain, it happened that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:30
verses.text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him. For he feared to live in Zoar, and he and his two daughters lived in a cave.

verses.name: Genesis 19:31
verses.text: And the first-born said to the younger, Our father <hi>is</hi> old, and <hi>there is</hi> no man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 19:32
verses.text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, so that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:33
verses.text: And they made their father drink wine that night. And the first-born went in, and lay with her father. And he did not notice when she lay down nor when she arose.

verses.name: Genesis 19:34
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, the first-born said to the younger, Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine this night also, and you go in and lie down with him so that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:35
verses.text: And they made their father drink wine that night also, and the younger arose and lay with him. And he did not notice when she lay down nor when she arose.

verses.name: Genesis 19:36
verses.text: So both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.

verses.name: Genesis 19:37
verses.text: And the first-born bore a son, and called his name Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

verses.name: Genesis 19:38
verses.text: And the younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben-ammi; he is the father of the sons of Ammon to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:1
verses.text: And Abraham moved from there toward the south country, and lived between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.

verses.name: Genesis 20:2
verses.text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister. And Abimelech the king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:3
verses.text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, you <hi>are</hi> about to die, for the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man's wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:4
verses.text: But Abimelech had not come near her. And he said, Lord, will You also kill a righteous nation?

verses.name: Genesis 20:5
verses.text: Did he not say to me, She <hi>is</hi> my sister? And she, even she herself said, He <hi>is</hi> my brother. In the sincerity of my heart and innocency of my hands I have done this.

verses.name: Genesis 20:6
verses.text: And God said to him in a dream, Yes, I know that you did this in the sincerity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me. Therefore I did not allow you to touch her.

verses.name: Genesis 20:7
verses.text: Now therefore, restore his wife to the man. For he <hi>is</hi> a prophet, and he shall pray for you, and you shall live. And if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you, and all that are yours.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:8
verses.text: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears. And the men were greatly afraid.

verses.name: Genesis 20:9
verses.text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, What have you done to us? In what have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done.

verses.name: Genesis 20:10
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What did you see that you have done this thing?

verses.name: Genesis 20:11
verses.text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God <hi>is</hi> not in this place, and they will kill me for my wife's sake.

verses.name: Genesis 20:12
verses.text: And yet truly <hi>she is</hi> my sister. She <hi>is</hi> the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother. And she became my wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:13
verses.text: And it happened when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, This <hi>is</hi> your kindness which you show to me, at every place where we shall come, say of me, He <hi>is</hi> my brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:14
verses.text: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave <hi>them</hi> to Abraham. And he restored him Sarah his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 20:15
verses.text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land <hi>is</hi> before you. Live where it pleases you.

verses.name: Genesis 20:16
verses.text: And to Sarah he said, Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, he <hi>is</hi> to you a covering of the eyes, to all that <hi>are</hi> with you, and with all this, you are justified.

verses.name: Genesis 20:17
verses.text: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his slave women, and they gave birth.

verses.name: Genesis 20:18
verses.text: For the Lord had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:1
verses.text: And the LORD visited Sarah as He had said. And the LORD did to Sarah as He had spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 21:2
verses.text: For Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:3
verses.text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born to him (whom Sarah bore to him) Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 21:4
verses.text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:5
verses.text: And Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:6
verses.text: And Sarah said, God has made me laugh, so that all who hear will laugh with me.

verses.name: Genesis 21:7
verses.text: And she said, Who could have said to Abraham, will Sarah suckle children? For I have borne a son to him in his old age.

verses.name: Genesis 21:8
verses.text: And the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast the day that Isaac was weaned.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:9
verses.text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian (whom she had borne to Abraham) mocking.

verses.name: Genesis 21:10
verses.text: And she said to Abraham, Cast out this slave woman and her son. For the son of this slave woman shall not be heir with my son, with Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 21:11
verses.text: And the thing was very evil in Abraham's sight, because of his son.

verses.name: Genesis 21:12
verses.text: And God said to Abraham, Let it not be grievous in your sight because of the boy and because of your slave woman. In all that Sarah has said to you, listen to her voice. For in Isaac your Seed shall be called.

verses.name: Genesis 21:13
verses.text: And also, I will make a nation of the son of the slave woman, because he <hi>is</hi> your seed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:14
verses.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave <hi>it</hi> to Hagar, putting <hi>it</hi> on her shoulder. And he gave her the boy, and sent her away. And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

verses.name: Genesis 21:15
verses.text: And the water was gone in the bottle, and she cast the boy under one of the shrubs.

verses.name: Genesis 21:16
verses.text: And she went and sat down across from him, a good way off, about a bowshot. For she said, Let me not see the death of the boy. And she sat across from him, and lifted up her voice, and cried.

verses.name: Genesis 21:17
verses.text: And God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar out of the heavens, and said to her, What ails you, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

verses.name: Genesis 21:18
verses.text: Rise up, lift up the boy and hold him up with your hand, for I will make him a great nation.

verses.name: Genesis 21:19
verses.text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went and filled the bottle with water, and gave drink to the boy.

verses.name: Genesis 21:20
verses.text: And God was with the boy, and he grew, and lived in the wilderness, and became an archer.

verses.name: Genesis 21:21
verses.text: And he lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:22
verses.text: And it happened at that time, Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, God is with you in all that you do.

verses.name: Genesis 21:23
verses.text: Now therefore swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son. Do to me according to the kindness that I have sworn to you, and to the land in which you have lived.

verses.name: Genesis 21:24
verses.text: And Abraham said, I will swear.

verses.name: Genesis 21:25
verses.text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

verses.name: Genesis 21:26
verses.text: And Abimelech said, I do not know who has done this thing, neither did you tell me, neither have I even heard of it, except today.

verses.name: Genesis 21:27
verses.text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and both of them made a covenant.

verses.name: Genesis 21:28
verses.text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.name: Genesis 21:29
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What are these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves?

verses.name: Genesis 21:30
verses.text: And he said, For you shall take <hi>these</hi> seven ewe lambs from my hand, so that they may be a witness to me that I have dug this well.

verses.name: Genesis 21:31
verses.text: This is why he called that place Beer-sheba, because they swore, both of them, there.

verses.name: Genesis 21:32
verses.text: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba. Then Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, rose up. And they returned to the land of the Philistines.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:33
verses.text: And Abraham planted a tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

verses.name: Genesis 21:34
verses.text: And Abraham lived in the Philistines' land many days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:1
verses.text: And it happened after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, Abraham! And he said, Behold me.

verses.name: Genesis 22:2
verses.text: And He said, Take now your son, your only one, Isaac, whom you love. And go into the land of Moriah, and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will name to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:3
verses.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two <hi>of</hi> his young men with him, and Isaac his son. And he split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up and went to the place of which God had told him.

verses.name: Genesis 22:4
verses.text: Then on the third day, Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place afar off.

verses.name: Genesis 22:5
verses.text: And Abraham said to his young men, You stay here with the ass. And I and the boy will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

verses.name: Genesis 22:6
verses.text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. And he took the fire in his hand, and a knife. And they both went together.

verses.name: Genesis 22:7
verses.text: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, My father. And he said, Here <hi>am</hi> I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood. But where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

verses.name: Genesis 22:8
verses.text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide Himself a lamb for a burnt offering. So they both went together.

verses.name: Genesis 22:9
verses.text: And they came to the place which God had told him of. And Abraham built an altar there and laid the wood in order. And he bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

verses.name: Genesis 22:10
verses.text: And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:11
verses.text: And the Angel of Jehovah called to him from the heavens and said, Abraham! Abraham! And he said, Here <hi>am</hi> I.

verses.name: Genesis 22:12
verses.text: And He said, Do not lay your hand on the lad, nor do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only one, from Me.

verses.name: Genesis 22:13
verses.text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked. And, behold, a ram behind <hi>him</hi> was entangled in a thicket by its horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

verses.name: Genesis 22:14
verses.text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah Will See; so that it is said <hi>until</hi> this day, In the mount of Jehovah it will be seen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:15
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD called to Abraham out of the heavens the second time,

verses.name: Genesis 22:16
verses.text: and said, I have sworn by Myself, says the LORD; because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only one;

verses.name: Genesis 22:17
verses.text: that in blessing I will bless you, and in multiplying I will multiply your seed like the stars of the heavens, and as the sand which is upon the seashore. And your Seed shall possess the gate of His enemies.

verses.name: Genesis 22:18
verses.text: And in your Seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.

verses.name: Genesis 22:19
verses.text: Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba. And Abraham lived at Beer-sheba.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:20
verses.text: And it happened after these things that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold Milcah! She also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

verses.name: Genesis 22:21
verses.text: Huz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

verses.name: Genesis 22:22
verses.text: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

verses.name: Genesis 22:23
verses.text: And Bethuel fathered Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

verses.name: Genesis 22:24
verses.text: And his concubine, named Reumah, she also bore Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:1
verses.text: And Sarah was a hundred twenty seven years old, the years of the life of Sarah.

verses.name: Genesis 23:2
verses.text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same <hi>is</hi> Hebron in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:3
verses.text: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 23:4
verses.text: I am a stranger and a visitor with you. Give me a possession of a burying place with you, so that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

verses.name: Genesis 23:5
verses.text: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham saying to him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:6
verses.text: Hear us, my lord. You <hi>are</hi> a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choice of our burying places. None of us shall withhold from you his burying-place from burying your dead.

verses.name: Genesis 23:7
verses.text: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.

verses.name: Genesis 23:8
verses.text: And he spoke with them, saying, If it is your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and ask for me of Ephron the son of Zohar,

verses.name: Genesis 23:9
verses.text: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which <hi>is</hi> in the end of his field. For as much silver as it is worth he shall give it to me for a possession of a burying-place among you.

verses.name: Genesis 23:10
verses.text: And Ephron lived among the sons of Heth. And Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the ears of the sons of Heth, of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 23:11
verses.text: No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and the cave that <hi>is</hi> in it I give to you. In the presence of the sons of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.

verses.name: Genesis 23:12
verses.text: And Abraham bowed before the people of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 23:13
verses.text: And he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the land, saying, Only if you would hear me. I will give you silver for the field. Take <hi>it</hi> from me, and I will bury my dead there.

verses.name: Genesis 23:14
verses.text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:15
verses.text: My lord, listen to me. The land <hi>is worth</hi> four hundred shekels of silver; what is that between me and you? And bury your dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:16
verses.text: And Abraham listened to Ephron. And Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, which passes with the merchant.

verses.name: Genesis 23:17
verses.text: And the field of Ephron was certified, which was Machpelah, which <hi>was</hi> before Mamre; the field and the cave which <hi>was</hi> in it, and all the trees in the field, in all the borders round about,

verses.name: Genesis 23:18
verses.text: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

verses.name: Genesis 23:19
verses.text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave at the field of Machpelah before Mamre, which <hi>is</hi> Hebron, in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 23:20
verses.text: And the field, and the cave that <hi>is</hi> in it, were certified to Abraham for a possession of a burying place by the sons of Heth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:1
verses.text: And Abraham was old, going on in age. And the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

verses.name: Genesis 24:2
verses.text: And Abraham said to the oldest servant of his house, who ruled over all that he had, I pray you, put your hand under my thigh.

verses.name: Genesis 24:3
verses.text: And I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of Heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell.

verses.name: Genesis 24:4
verses.text: But you shall go to my country and to my kindred, and take a wife to my son Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 24:5
verses.text: And the servant said to him, Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I necessarily bring your son again to the land from which you came?

verses.name: Genesis 24:6
verses.text: And Abraham said to him, Take care that you do not bring my son there again.

verses.name: Genesis 24:7
verses.text: The LORD, the God of Heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my kindred, and who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, To your seed I will give this land: He shall send His Angel before you. And you shall take a wife to my son from there.

verses.name: Genesis 24:8
verses.text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath of mine. Only do not bring my son there again.

verses.name: Genesis 24:9
verses.text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master and swore to him concerning the matter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:10
verses.text: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed. For all the goods of his master were in his hand. And he arose, and went to Mesopotamia to the city of Nahor.

verses.name: Genesis 24:11
verses.text: And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, the time that women go out to draw.

verses.name: Genesis 24:12
verses.text: And he said, O LORD, God of my master Abraham, I pray You, send me good speed this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 24:13
verses.text: Behold, I stand by the well of water. And the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.

verses.name: Genesis 24:14
verses.text: And let it be that the young woman to whom I shall say, Let down your pitcher, please, so that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give your camels drink also. <hi>Let</hi> her <hi>be</hi> the one that You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. And by it I shall know that You have shown kindness to my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:15
verses.text: And before he had finished speaking, it happened, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, <hi>with</hi> her pitcher upon her shoulder.

verses.name: Genesis 24:16
verses.text: And the young woman <hi>was</hi> very beautiful to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her. And she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

verses.name: Genesis 24:17
verses.text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Please let me drink a little water of your pitcher.

verses.name: Genesis 24:18
verses.text: And she said, Drink, my lord. And she hurried and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave <hi>a</hi> drink to him.

verses.name: Genesis 24:19
verses.text: And when she had finished giving him drink, she said, I will draw <hi>water</hi> for your camels also, until they have finished drinking.

verses.name: Genesis 24:20
verses.text: And she hurried, and emptied her pitcher in the trough, and ran again to the well to draw <hi>water</hi>. And she drew for all his camels.

verses.name: Genesis 24:21
verses.text: And the man was watching her, keeping silent, in order to know whether the LORD had prospered his journey or not.

verses.name: Genesis 24:22
verses.text: And it happened, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hand, weighing ten shekels of gold.

verses.name: Genesis 24:23
verses.text: And he said, Whose daughter <hi>are</hi> you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father's house for us to stay?

verses.name: Genesis 24:24
verses.text: And she said to him, I <hi>am</hi> the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.

verses.name: Genesis 24:25
verses.text: And she said to him, We have both straw and fodder enough, and room to lodge in.

verses.name: Genesis 24:26
verses.text: And the man bowed down <hi>his head</hi>, and worshiped the Lord.

verses.name: Genesis 24:27
verses.text: And he said, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the LORD, God of my master Abraham, who has not left my master destitute of His mercy and His truth. The LORD led me, I <hi>being</hi> in the way to the house of my master's brothers.

verses.name: Genesis 24:28
verses.text: And the young woman ran and told her mother's house these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:29
verses.text: And Rebekah <hi>had</hi> a brother, and his name <hi>was</hi> Laban. And Laban ran out to the man, to the well.

verses.name: Genesis 24:30
verses.text: And it happened when he saw the earrings and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, So spoke the man to me, he came to the man. And behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

verses.name: Genesis 24:31
verses.text: And he said, Come in, blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

verses.name: Genesis 24:32
verses.text: And the man came into the house. And he unloaded his camels, and gave straw and fodder to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.

verses.name: Genesis 24:33
verses.text: And <hi>food</hi> was set before him to eat. But he said, I will not eat until I have told my errand. And he said, Speak on.

verses.name: Genesis 24:34
verses.text: And he said, I <hi>am</hi> Abraham's servant.

verses.name: Genesis 24:35
verses.text: And the LORD has blessed my master greatly, and he has become great. And He has given him flocks and herds and silver and gold, and male slaves and slave women, and camels and asses.

verses.name: Genesis 24:36
verses.text: And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old. And he has given to him all that he has.

verses.name: Genesis 24:37
verses.text: And my master made me swear, saying, You shall not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live.

verses.name: Genesis 24:38
verses.text: But you shall go to my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife to my son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:39
verses.text: And I said to my master, Perhaps the woman will not follow me.

verses.name: Genesis 24:40
verses.text: And he said to me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his Angel with you, and prosper your way. And you shall take a wife for my son from my kindred, and from my father's house.

verses.name: Genesis 24:41
verses.text: Then shall you be clear from my oath when you come to my kindred, and if they do not give you <hi>one</hi>, you shall be clear from my oath.

verses.name: Genesis 24:42
verses.text: And I came this day to the well, and said, O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if now You prosper my way in which I go,

verses.name: Genesis 24:43
verses.text: behold, I stand by the well of water. And it shall be when the virgin comes forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, please, a little water from your pitcher to drink,

verses.name: Genesis 24:44
verses.text: and she say to me, Both you drink, and I will also draw for your camels, may she be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master's son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:45
verses.text: And before I finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. And she went down to the well and drew water. And I said to her, Please let me drink.

verses.name: Genesis 24:46
verses.text: And she hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give drink to your camels also. So I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

verses.name: Genesis 24:47
verses.text: And I asked her and said, Whose daughter <hi>are</hi> you? And she said, The <hi>daughter</hi> of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him. And I put the earring upon her nose and the bracelets upon her hands.

verses.name: Genesis 24:48
verses.text: And I bowed my head and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter to his son.

verses.name: Genesis 24:49
verses.text: And now if you will deal kindly and truthfully with my master, tell me. And if not, tell me so that I may turn to the right hand or to the left.

verses.name: Genesis 24:50
verses.text: And Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing has come forth from the LORD. We cannot speak to you bad or good.

verses.name: Genesis 24:51
verses.text: Behold! Rebekah is before you; take <hi>her</hi> and go. And let her be the wife of your master's son, even as the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 24:52
verses.text: And it happened, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself to the earth to the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 24:53
verses.text: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave <hi>them</hi> to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and to her mother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:54
verses.text: And they ate and drank, he and the men with him, and stayed all night. And they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away to my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:55
verses.text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the young woman stay with us perhaps ten days. After that she shall go.

verses.name: Genesis 24:56
verses.text: And he said to them, Do not hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away, that I may go away to my master.

verses.name: Genesis 24:57
verses.text: And they said, We will call the young woman and inquire at her mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 24:58
verses.text: And they called Rebekah, and said to her, Will you go with this man? And she said, I will go.

verses.name: Genesis 24:59
verses.text: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

verses.name: Genesis 24:60
verses.text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said to her, Our sister, be the mother of thousands of millions, and let your seed possess the gate of those who hate them.

verses.name: Genesis 24:61
verses.text: And Rebekah rose up, and her young women, and they rode upon the camels and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah and went his way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:62
verses.text: And Isaac came from the way of the well, The Well of the Living One, my Beholder. For he lived in the south country.

verses.name: Genesis 24:63
verses.text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the beginning of the evening. And he lifted up his eyes, and looked. And behold, camels coming!

verses.name: Genesis 24:64
verses.text: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and she saw Isaac. And she dismounted from the camel.

verses.name: Genesis 24:65
verses.text: For she said to the servant, What man <hi>is</hi> this that walks in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master. Therefore she took a veil and covered herself.

verses.name: Genesis 24:66
verses.text: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

verses.name: Genesis 24:67
verses.text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. And he loved her. And Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:1
verses.text: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:2
verses.text: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:3
verses.text: And Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.

verses.name: Genesis 25:4
verses.text: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Keturah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:5
verses.text: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 25:6
verses.text: But to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts. And he sent them away from Isaac his son while he still lived, eastward to the east country.

verses.name: Genesis 25:7
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the days of the years of Abraham's life, which he lived: a hundred seventy-five years.

verses.name: Genesis 25:8
verses.text: And Abraham expired and died in a good old age, old and satisfied. And he was gathered to his people.

verses.name: Genesis 25:9
verses.text: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which <hi>is</hi> before Mamre,

verses.name: Genesis 25:10
verses.text: the field which Abraham bought from the sons of Heth. Abraham and Sarah his wife were buried there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:11
verses.text: And after the death of Abraham, it happened that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac lived by The Well of the Living One, My Beholder.

verses.name: Genesis 25:12
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore to Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 25:13
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations. The first-born of Ishmael was Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.name: Genesis 25:14
verses.text: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

verses.name: Genesis 25:15
verses.text: Hadad, and Tema and Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

verses.name: Genesis 25:16
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Ishmael, and these <hi>were</hi> their names, by their towns and by their settlements; <hi>twelve</hi> chiefs according to their nations.

verses.name: Genesis 25:17
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred thirty-seven years. And he expired and died, and was gathered to his people.

verses.name: Genesis 25:18
verses.text: And they lived from Havilah to Shur, which <hi>is</hi> before Egypt, <hi>as</hi> you go toward Assyria. And he died in the presence of all his brothers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:19
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham fathered Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 25:20
verses.text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.

verses.name: Genesis 25:21
verses.text: And Isaac prayed to the LORD for his wife, because she <hi>was</hi> barren. And the LORD heard him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

verses.name: Genesis 25:22
verses.text: And the sons struggled together within her. And she said, If <hi>it is</hi> so, why <hi>am</hi> I this way? And she went to inquire of the LORD.

verses.name: Genesis 25:23
verses.text: And the LORD said to her, Two nations <hi>are</hi> in your womb, and two kinds of people shall be separated from your bowels. And the one people shall be stronger than the other people, the older shall serve the younger.

verses.name: Genesis 25:24
verses.text: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, twins <hi>were</hi> in her womb!

verses.name: Genesis 25:25
verses.text: And the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment. And they called his name Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 25:26
verses.text: And after that his brother came out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel. And his name was called Jacob. And Isaac <hi>was</hi> sixty years old when she bore them.

verses.name: Genesis 25:27
verses.text: And the boys grew. And Esau was a man knowing hunting, and Jacob was a simple man, living in tents.

verses.name: Genesis 25:28
verses.text: And Isaac loved Esau, for game was in <hi>his</hi> mouth. But Rebekah loved Jacob.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:29
verses.text: And Jacob boiled soup. And Esau came from the field, and he was faint.

verses.name: Genesis 25:30
verses.text: And Esau said to Jacob, I beg you, Let me eat of the red, this red <hi>soup</hi>, for I am faint. Therefore his name was called Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 25:31
verses.text: And Jacob said, Sell me your birthright today.

verses.name: Genesis 25:32
verses.text: And Esau said, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> at the point of dying, and what <hi>profit shall</hi> this birthright be to me?

verses.name: Genesis 25:33
verses.text: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day. And he swore to him, and he sold his birthright to Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 25:34
verses.text: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and soup of lentils. And he ate and drank, and rose up and went his way. And Esau despised <hi>his</hi> birthright.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:1
verses.text: And there was a famine in the land, besides the famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines to Gerar.

verses.name: Genesis 26:2
verses.text: And the LORD appeared to him and said, Do not go down into Egypt. Live in the land which I shall tell you of.

verses.name: Genesis 26:3
verses.text: Stay in this land, and I will be with you and bless you. For to you and to your seed I will give all these lands; and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

verses.name: Genesis 26:4
verses.text: And I will make your seed to multiply as the stars of the heavens, and will give to your seed all these lands. And in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed,

verses.name: Genesis 26:5
verses.text: because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:6
verses.text: And Isaac lived in Gerar.

verses.name: Genesis 26:7
verses.text: And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, She is my sister. For he feared to say, My wife; lest the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah, because she was beautiful of form.

verses.name: Genesis 26:8
verses.text: And when he had been there a long time, it happened that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out through the window, and saw; and behold! Isaac <hi>was</hi> caressing Rebekah his wife.

verses.name: Genesis 26:9
verses.text: And Abimelech called Isaac and said, Behold! She surely <hi>is</hi> your wife. And why did you say, She <hi>is</hi> my sister? And Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I die on account of her.

verses.name: Genesis 26:10
verses.text: And Abimelech said, What <hi>is</hi> this you have done to us? One of the people might have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.

verses.name: Genesis 26:11
verses.text: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:12
verses.text: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:13
verses.text: And the man became great. And he went forward and grew until he grew very great.

verses.name: Genesis 26:14
verses.text: And he had possession of flocks and possession of herds, and many servants. And the Philistines envied him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:15
verses.text: For all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them and filled them with earth.

verses.name: Genesis 26:16
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are mightier than we are.

verses.name: Genesis 26:17
verses.text: And Isaac departed from there, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

verses.name: Genesis 26:18
verses.text: And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. And he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

verses.name: Genesis 26:19
verses.text: And Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

verses.name: Genesis 26:20
verses.text: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, The water is ours. And he called the name of the well Contention, because they strove with him.

verses.name: Genesis 26:21
verses.text: And they dug another well, and <hi>they</hi> strove for that also. And he called the name of it Opposition.

verses.name: Genesis 26:22
verses.text: And he moved from there, and dug another well, and they did not strive for that. And he called the name of it Broad Places. And he said, For now the LORD has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 26:23
verses.text: And he went from there to Beer-sheba.

verses.name: Genesis 26:24
verses.text: And the LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, I <hi>am</hi> the God of Abraham your father. Do not fear, for I <hi>am</hi> with you, and will bless you and multiply your seed for My servant Abraham's sake.

verses.name: Genesis 26:25
verses.text: And he built an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there. And Isaac's servants dug a well there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:26
verses.text: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath, one of his friends, and Phicol the commander of his army.

verses.name: Genesis 26:27
verses.text: And Isaac said to them, Why do you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?

verses.name: Genesis 26:28
verses.text: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with you. And we said, Let there be now an oath between us, between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you;

verses.name: Genesis 26:29
verses.text: that you will do us no harm since we have not touched you, and since we have done nothing but good to you, and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the LORD.

verses.name: Genesis 26:30
verses.text: And he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

verses.name: Genesis 26:31
verses.text: And they rose up early in the morning, and swore to one another. And Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

verses.name: Genesis 26:32
verses.text: And the same day it happened, Isaac's servants came and told him about the well which they had dug. And they said to him, We have found water.

verses.name: Genesis 26:33
verses.text: And he called it Shebah. Therefore the name of the city <hi>is</hi> The Well of Sheba to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:34
verses.text: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite;

verses.name: Genesis 26:35
verses.text: who were a grief of spirit to Isaac and to Rebekah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:1
verses.text: And it happened when Isaac <hi>was</hi> old and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called his oldest son Esau and said to him, My son. And he said to him, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> here.

verses.name: Genesis 27:2
verses.text: And he said to him, Behold, here am I. And he said, Behold now, I am old, I do not know the day of my death.

verses.name: Genesis 27:3
verses.text: And now please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt game for me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:4
verses.text: And make tasty meat for me, such as I love, and bring to me so that I may eat, that my soul may bless you before I die.

verses.name: Genesis 27:5
verses.text: And Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game in order to bring <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:6
verses.text: And Rebekah spoke to her son Jacob, saying, Behold, I heard your father speak to your brother Esau, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 27:7
verses.text: Bring me game, and make me delicious things so that I may eat and bless you before the LORD before my death.

verses.name: Genesis 27:8
verses.text: And now, my son, obey my voice according to what I command you.

verses.name: Genesis 27:9
verses.text: Go now to the flock, and bring me from there two good kids of the goats. And I will make them delicious things for your father, such as he loves.

verses.name: Genesis 27:10
verses.text: And you shall bring it to your father so that he may eat, and that he may bless you before his death.

verses.name: Genesis 27:11
verses.text: And Jacob said to his mother Rebekah, Behold, Esau my brother <hi>is</hi> a hairy man, and I <hi>am</hi> a smooth man.

verses.name: Genesis 27:12
verses.text: My father will perhaps feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver. And I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

verses.name: Genesis 27:13
verses.text: And his mother said to him, Your curse <hi>be</hi> upon me, my son, only obey my voice and go bring them to me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:14
verses.text: And he went. And he took them and brought to his mother. And his mother made delicious things such as his father loved.

verses.name: Genesis 27:15
verses.text: And Rebekah took the clothes of her older son Esau, the costly ones which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son.

verses.name: Genesis 27:16
verses.text: And she put the skins from the kids of the goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

verses.name: Genesis 27:17
verses.text: And she gave the delicious things and the bread which she had prepared into the hand of her son Jacob.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:18
verses.text: And he came to his father and said, My father! And he said, Here I <hi>am</hi>; who are you, my son?

verses.name: Genesis 27:19
verses.text: And Jacob said to his father, I <hi>am</hi> Esau your first-born. I have done as you asked me. Arise, I pray you, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:20
verses.text: And Isaac said to his son, How <hi>is it</hi> that you have found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD your God brought <hi>it</hi> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:21
verses.text: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near, I pray you, so that I may feel you, my son, whether you are truly my son Esau or not.

verses.name: Genesis 27:22
verses.text: And Jacob went near to Isaac his father. And he felt him and said, The voice <hi>is</hi> Jacob's voice, but the hands the hands of Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 27:23
verses.text: And he did not know him because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau's hands. And he blessed him.

verses.name: Genesis 27:24
verses.text: And he said, <hi>Are</hi> you truly my son Esau? And he said, I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:25
verses.text: And he said, Bring <hi>it</hi> to me, and I will eat of my son's game, so that my soul may bless you. And he brought <hi>it</hi> near to him, and he ate. And he brought him wine, and he drank.

verses.name: Genesis 27:26
verses.text: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now and kiss me, my son.

verses.name: Genesis 27:27
verses.text: And he came near and kissed him. And he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son <hi>is</hi> as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

verses.name: Genesis 27:28
verses.text: And may God give you of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and wine.

verses.name: Genesis 27:29
verses.text: Let people serve you, and let nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and let your mother's sons bow down to you. Cursed <hi>be</hi> everyone that curses you, and blessed <hi>be</hi> he that blesses you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:30
verses.text: And it happened, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was scarcely gone from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

verses.name: Genesis 27:31
verses.text: And he also had made tasty meat and brought to his father. And he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's game so that your soul may bless me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:32
verses.text: And his father Isaac said to him, Who <hi>are</hi> you? And he said, I <hi>am</hi> your son, your first-born, Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 27:33
verses.text: And Isaac trembled with a great trembling, and said, Who then <hi>was</hi> the one who has hunted deer and brought to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yea, he shall be blessed!

verses.name: Genesis 27:34
verses.text: And when Esau heard the voice of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said to his father, Bless me, me also, O my father!

verses.name: Genesis 27:35
verses.text: And he said, Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.

verses.name: Genesis 27:36
verses.text: And he said, <hi>It is</hi> because his name <hi>is</hi> called Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright, and behold, now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Have you not reserved a blessing for me?

verses.name: Genesis 27:37
verses.text: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, Behold! I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given him for servants. And with grain and wine I have supported him. And what shall I do now to you, my son?

verses.name: Genesis 27:38
verses.text: And Esau said to his father, Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, me also, my father. And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

verses.name: Genesis 27:39
verses.text: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold! Your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth and of the dew of heaven from above.

verses.name: Genesis 27:40
verses.text: And by your sword you shall live, and shall serve your brother. And it shall be when you shall have the dominion, you shall break his yoke from off your neck.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:41
verses.text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him. And Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning <hi>for</hi> my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 27:42
verses.text: And these words of her older son Esau were told to Rebekah. And she sent and called her younger son Jacob, and said to him, Behold, your brother Esau is going to ease himself on you, to kill you.

verses.name: Genesis 27:43
verses.text: And now, my son, obey my voice and arise. Flee for yourself to my brother Laban, to Haran,

verses.name: Genesis 27:44
verses.text: and stay with him a few days until your brother's fury turns away,

verses.name: Genesis 27:45
verses.text: until your brother's anger turns away from you and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I also be bereaved of both of you <hi>in</hi> one day?

verses.name: Genesis 27:46
verses.text: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these of the daughters of the land, what good is <hi>my</hi> life to me?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:1
verses.text: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and commanded him. And he said to him, You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 28:2
verses.text: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother's father. And take a wife from there of the daughters of Laban your mother's brother.

verses.name: Genesis 28:3
verses.text: And may God almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, so that you may be a multitude of peoples.

verses.name: Genesis 28:4
verses.text: And may He give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed with you, so that you may inherit the land in which you are a stranger, which God gave to Abraham.

verses.name: Genesis 28:5
verses.text: And Isaac sent Jacob away. And he went to Padan-aram, to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:6
verses.text: And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him away to Padan-aram in order to take a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

verses.name: Genesis 28:7
verses.text: and Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and had gone to Padan-aram;

verses.name: Genesis 28:8
verses.text: and when Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan did not please Isaac his father;

verses.name: Genesis 28:9
verses.text: then Esau went to Ishmael, and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to the wives <hi>which</hi> he <hi>had</hi> for his wife.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:10
verses.text: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 28:11
verses.text: And he came on a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. And he took of the stones of that place, and placed <hi>them</hi> at his head. And he lay down in that place to sleep.

verses.name: Genesis 28:12
verses.text: And he dreamed. And behold! A ladder was set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to Heaven! And behold! The angels of God <hi>were</hi> ascending and descending on it!

verses.name: Genesis 28:13
verses.text: And behold! The LORD stood above it, and said, I <hi>am</hi> Jehovah, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac! The land on which you lie I will give to you and to your seed.

verses.name: Genesis 28:14
verses.text: And your seed shall be like the dust of the earth, and you shall spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. And in you and in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

verses.name: Genesis 28:15
verses.text: And, behold, I <hi>am</hi> with you, and will keep you in every <hi>place</hi> where you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:16
verses.text: And Jacob awakened from his sleep. And he said, Surely the LORD is in this place, and I did not know.

verses.name: Genesis 28:17
verses.text: And he was afraid, and said, How fearful <hi>is</hi> this place! This <hi>is</hi> nothing but the house of God, and this <hi>is</hi> the gate of Heaven!

verses.name: Genesis 28:18
verses.text: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone which he had put at his head, and set it <hi>as</hi> a memorial pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

verses.name: Genesis 28:19
verses.text: And he called the name of that place The House of God. But the name of that city <hi>was</hi> Luz at first.

verses.name: Genesis 28:20
verses.text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat and clothing to put on,

verses.name: Genesis 28:21
verses.text: and I come again to my father's house in peace, then shall the Jehovah be my God.

verses.name: Genesis 28:22
verses.text: And this stone which I have set for a pillar shall be God's house. And of all that You shall give me, I will surely give the tenth to You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:1
verses.text: And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the sons of the east.

verses.name: Genesis 29:2
verses.text: And he looked, and behold, a well <hi>was</hi> in the field! And, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it, for they watered the flocks out of that well. And a great stone <hi>was</hi> upon the well's mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 29:3
verses.text: And all the flocks were gathered there. And they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in its place.

verses.name: Genesis 29:4
verses.text: And Jacob said to them, My brothers, where <hi>are</hi> you from? And they said, We <hi>are</hi> from Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 29:5
verses.text: And he said to them, Do you know Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know <hi>him</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:6
verses.text: And he said to them, <hi>Is</hi> he well? And they said, He <hi>is</hi> well. And, behold, his daughter Rachel comes with the sheep.

verses.name: Genesis 29:7
verses.text: And he said, Lo, the day <hi>is</hi> yet high. <hi>It is</hi> not yet time for gathering the cattle together. Water the sheep, and go feed <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:8
verses.text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered together. And they roll the stone from the well's mouth, then we water the sheep.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:9
verses.text: While he still spoke with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she kept them.

verses.name: Genesis 29:10
verses.text: And it happened when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, then Jacob went near and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flocks of Laban his mother's brother.

verses.name: Genesis 29:11
verses.text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice and wept.

verses.name: Genesis 29:12
verses.text: And Jacob told Rachel that he <hi>was</hi> her father's brother, and that he <hi>was</hi> Rebekah's son. And she ran and told her father.

verses.name: Genesis 29:13
verses.text: And it happened when Laban heard the news of Jacob his sister's son, he ran to meet him and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

verses.name: Genesis 29:14
verses.text: And Laban said to him, Surely you <hi>are</hi> my bone and my flesh. And he stayed with him for a month.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:15
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, Because you <hi>are</hi> my brother, should you then serve me for nothing? Tell me, what <hi>shall be</hi> your wages?

verses.name: Genesis 29:16
verses.text: And Laban had two daughters. The name of the oldest was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

verses.name: Genesis 29:17
verses.text: And Leah was weak of eyes, but Rachel was beautiful and well-favored.

verses.name: Genesis 29:18
verses.text: And Jacob loved Rachel, and said, I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter.

verses.name: Genesis 29:19
verses.text: And Laban said, <hi>It is</hi> better that I give her to you than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.

verses.name: Genesis 29:20
verses.text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him a few days, for the love he had for her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:21
verses.text: And Jacob said to Laban, Give <hi>me</hi> my wife, for my days are fulfilled, so that I may go in to her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:22
verses.text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

verses.name: Genesis 29:23
verses.text: And it happened in the evening, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to him. And he went in to her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:24
verses.text: And Laban gave Zilpah his slave woman to his daughter Leah for a handmaid.

verses.name: Genesis 29:25
verses.text: And it happened in the morning, behold, it <hi>was</hi> Leah! And he said to Laban, What <hi>is</hi> this you have done to me? Did I not serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you tricked me?

verses.name: Genesis 29:26
verses.text: And Laban said, It must not be done so in our country, to give the younger before the first-born.

verses.name: Genesis 29:27
verses.text: Fulfill her week, and we will give you this one also for the service which you shall serve with me still another seven years.

verses.name: Genesis 29:28
verses.text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. And he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

verses.name: Genesis 29:29
verses.text: And Laban gave Bilhah his slave woman to his daughter Rachel, to be her handmaid.

verses.name: Genesis 29:30
verses.text: And he also went in to Rachel. He also loved Rachel more than Leah, and served with him still seven more years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:31
verses.text: And when the LORD saw that Leah <hi>was</hi> hated, even He opened her womb. But Rachel <hi>was</hi> barren.

verses.name: Genesis 29:32
verses.text: And Leah conceived and bore a son. And she called his name Reuben, for she said, Surely the LORD has looked upon my afflictions. Now therefore my husband will love me.

verses.name: Genesis 29:33
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bore a son, and said, Because the LORD has heard that I was hated, He has therefore given me this <hi>son</hi> also. And she called his name Simeon.

verses.name: Genesis 29:34
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bore a son, and said, Now this time my husband will return to me, because I have borne him three sons. Therefore his name was called Levi.

verses.name: Genesis 29:35
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she said, This time I will praise the LORD. Therefore she called his name Judah, and quit bearing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:1
verses.text: And when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. And she said to Jacob, Give me sons, or else I will die.

verses.name: Genesis 30:2
verses.text: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel. And he said, Am I in God's stead, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?

verses.name: Genesis 30:3
verses.text: And she said, Behold my slave woman Bilhah; go in to her, and she shall bear upon my knees, and yea, let me be built up from her, me also.

verses.name: Genesis 30:4
verses.text: And she gave him her slave woman Bilhah to wife. And Jacob went in to her.

verses.name: Genesis 30:5
verses.text: And Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:6
verses.text: And Rachel said, God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son. Therefore she called his name Dan.

verses.name: Genesis 30:7
verses.text: And Rachel's slave woman Bilhah conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:8
verses.text: And Rachel said, With the wrestlings of God I have wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed. And she called his name Naphtali.

verses.name: Genesis 30:9
verses.text: When Leah saw that she had quit bearing, she took her slave woman Zilpah and gave her to Jacob to wife.

verses.name: Genesis 30:10
verses.text: And Leah's slave woman Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:11
verses.text: And Leah said, With fortune. And she called his name Gad.

verses.name: Genesis 30:12
verses.text: And Leah's slave woman Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:13
verses.text: And Leah said, I am happy, for the daughters will call me blessed. And she called his name Asher.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:14
verses.text: And Reuben went out the days of the wheat harvest, and found love-apples in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to Leah, please give me some of your son's love-apples.

verses.name: Genesis 30:15
verses.text: And she said to her, <hi>Is it</hi> a small matter that you have taken my husband? And would you also take my son's love-apples? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with you tonight for your son's love-apples.

verses.name: Genesis 30:16
verses.text: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening. And Leah went out to meet him, and said, You must come in to me, for I have surely hired you with my son's love-apples. And he lay with her that night.

verses.name: Genesis 30:17
verses.text: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob the fifth son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:18
verses.text: And Leah said, God has given me my hire, because I gave my slave to my husband. And she called his name Issachar.

verses.name: Genesis 30:19
verses.text: And Leah conceived again, and bore Jacob the sixth son.

verses.name: Genesis 30:20
verses.text: And Leah said, God has given me a good present. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons. And she called his name Zebulun.

verses.name: Genesis 30:21
verses.text: And afterward she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

verses.name: Genesis 30:22
verses.text: And God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.

verses.name: Genesis 30:23
verses.text: And she conceived and bore a son, and she said, God has taken away my reproach.

verses.name: Genesis 30:24
verses.text: And she called his name Joseph. And she said, May the LORD add another son to me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:25
verses.text: And when Rachel had borne Joseph, it happened that Jacob said to Laban, Send me away so that I may go into my own place and to my country.

verses.name: Genesis 30:26
verses.text: Give me my wives and my children, <hi>for</hi> whom I have served you, and let me go. For you know my service which I have done you.

verses.name: Genesis 30:27
verses.text: And Laban said to him, I pray you, if I have found favor in your eyes, stay. For I have seen omens, that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.

verses.name: Genesis 30:28
verses.text: And he said, Appoint your wages and I will give.

verses.name: Genesis 30:29
verses.text: He said to him, You know how I have served you, and what your cattle has become with me.

verses.name: Genesis 30:30
verses.text: For you had little before I <hi>came</hi>, and it has now increased to a multitude. And the LORD has blessed you since my coming. And now when shall I provide for my own house also?

verses.name: Genesis 30:31
verses.text: And he said, What shall I give you? And Jacob said, You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep your flock.

verses.name: Genesis 30:32
verses.text: I will pass through all the flocks today, taking out all the speckled and spotted sheep, and all of the black sheep among the lambs, and the spotted and the speckled among the goats. And these shall be my hire.

verses.name: Genesis 30:33
verses.text: And shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, and it shall come for my hire before your face. Every one that <hi>is</hi> not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, shall be counted stolen with me.

verses.name: Genesis 30:34
verses.text: And Laban said, Yes, truly let it be according to your word.

verses.name: Genesis 30:35
verses.text: And that day he took out the he-goats that were striped and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black from among the lambs, and gave <hi>them</hi> into the hand of his sons.

verses.name: Genesis 30:36
verses.text: And he set three days' journey between himself and Jacob. And Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:37
verses.text: And Jacob took rods of green poplar, and of a fresh tree, and the almond and plane tree. And he peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

verses.name: Genesis 30:38
verses.text: And he set the rods which he had peeled by the troughs, by the water troughs, where the flocks came to drink, across from the flocks, and the flocks were in heat when they came to drink.

verses.name: Genesis 30:39
verses.text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth striped cattle, speckled, and spotted.

verses.name: Genesis 30:40
verses.text: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the striped, and all the black in the flock of Laban. And he put his own flocks by themselves, and did not put them with the flock of Laban.

verses.name: Genesis 30:41
verses.text: And it happened when the stronger flocks conceived, Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flocks in the troughs, so that they might conceive among the rods.

verses.name: Genesis 30:42
verses.text: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put <hi>them</hi> in. And usually it came to be, the weak ones were Laban's and the stronger ones Jacob's.

verses.name: Genesis 30:43
verses.text: And the man increased exceedingly, and <hi>had</hi> many flocks, and maidservants, and male servants, and camels, and asses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:1
verses.text: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that <hi>was</hi> our father's, and he has gotten all this glory from that which was our father's.

verses.name: Genesis 31:2
verses.text: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

verses.name: Genesis 31:3
verses.text: And the LORD said to Jacob, Return to the land of your fathers, and to your kindred, and I will be with you.

verses.name: Genesis 31:4
verses.text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flocks.

verses.name: Genesis 31:5
verses.text: And he said to them, I see your father's face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:6
verses.text: And you know that with all my power I have served your father,

verses.name: Genesis 31:7
verses.text: and your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times. But God did not allow him to hurt me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:8
verses.text: If he said this, The speckled shall be your wages, then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said this, The striped shall be your hire, then all the flocks bore striped.

verses.name: Genesis 31:9
verses.text: And God has taken away the flocks of your father, and has given them to me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:10
verses.text: And at the time the cattle conceived, I lifted up my eyes and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were striped, speckled, and mottled.

verses.name: Genesis 31:11
verses.text: And the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, Jacob! And I said, Here I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:12
verses.text: And He said, Lift up your eyes and see all the rams which leap upon the cattle, that they <hi>are</hi> striped, speckled, and mottled. For I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.

verses.name: Genesis 31:13
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar, where you vowed a vow to Me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your kindred.

verses.name: Genesis 31:14
verses.text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, <hi>Is there</hi> yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

verses.name: Genesis 31:15
verses.text: Are we not counted strangers by him? For he has sold us, and has also entirely devoured our silver.

verses.name: Genesis 31:16
verses.text: For all the riches which God has taken from our father, that <hi>is</hi> for us and for our sons. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:17
verses.text: Then Jacob rose up and set his sons and wives upon camels.

verses.name: Genesis 31:18
verses.text: And he drove away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his property, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, in order to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 31:19
verses.text: And Laban went to shear his sheep. And Rachel had stolen the images which were her father's.

verses.name: Genesis 31:20
verses.text: And Jacob deceived the heart of Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he fled.

verses.name: Genesis 31:21
verses.text: And he fled with all that was his. And he rose up and passed over the river, and set his face toward Mount Gilead.

verses.name: Genesis 31:22
verses.text: It was told Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.

verses.name: Genesis 31:23
verses.text: And he took his brothers with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey. And they overtook him in Mount Gilead.

verses.name: Genesis 31:24
verses.text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, Take heed that you do not speak either good or bad to Jacob.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:25
verses.text: Then Laban overtook Jacob. And Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount. And Laban with his brothers pitched in Mount Gilead.

verses.name: Genesis 31:26
