verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, What have you done, that you have deceived my heart and carried away my daughters as captives <hi>taken</hi> with the sword?

verses.name: Genesis 31:27
verses.text: Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and did not tell me so that I might have sent you away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret and with harp?

verses.name: Genesis 31:28
verses.text: And why have you not allowed me to kiss my sons and my daughters? You have done foolishly in so doing.

verses.name: Genesis 31:29
verses.text: It is in the power of my hand to do you harm. But the God of your fathers spoke to me last night, saying, Take heed that you do not speak either good or bad to Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 31:30
verses.text: And now you have gone because you longed after your father's house. Why have you stolen my gods?

verses.name: Genesis 31:31
verses.text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I <hi>was</hi> afraid, for I said, Perhaps you would take your daughters away from me by force.

verses.name: Genesis 31:32
verses.text: With whomever you find your gods, let him not live. Before our brothers, choose what <hi>is</hi> yours with me, and take <hi>it</hi> to you. For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

verses.name: Genesis 31:33
verses.text: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tents of the two slave women, and he did not find. And he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

verses.name: Genesis 31:34
verses.text: And Rachel had taken the images and put them into the camel's saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all the tent, but did not find them.

verses.name: Genesis 31:35
verses.text: But she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before you. For the custom of women <hi>is</hi> upon me. And he searched, but did not find the images.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:36
verses.text: And Jacob was angry, and rebuked Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban, What <hi>is</hi> my trespass? What <hi>is</hi> my sin, that you have so hotly pursued after me?

verses.name: Genesis 31:37
verses.text: For you have searched all my stuff; what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my brothers and your brothers, that they may judge between us both.

verses.name: Genesis 31:38
verses.text: I <hi>was</hi> with you these twenty years. Your ewes and she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of your flock I have not eaten.

verses.name: Genesis 31:39
verses.text: That which was mangled I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it at my hand, <hi>whether</hi> stolen by day, or stolen by night.

verses.name: Genesis 31:40
verses.text: I was there; in the day the heat consumed me, and the frost by night. And my sleep departed from my eyes.

verses.name: Genesis 31:41
verses.text: And I have been twenty years in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six for your flocks. And you have changed my wages ten times.

verses.name: Genesis 31:42
verses.text: Unless the God of my fathers, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac had been with me, surely you would have sent me away now empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked <hi>you last</hi> night.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:43
verses.text: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, The daughters <hi>are</hi> my daughters, and the sons my sons, and the flocks my flocks. All that you see <hi>is</hi> mine. And what can I do this day to these my daughters, or to their sons which they have borne?

verses.name: Genesis 31:44
verses.text: And come now, let us make a covenant, you and I. And let it be for a witness between you and me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:45
verses.text: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a memorial pillar.

verses.name: Genesis 31:46
verses.text: And Jacob said to his brothers, Gather stones. And they took stones and made a heap. And they ate there upon the heap.

verses.name: Genesis 31:47
verses.text: And Laban called it in <hi>Syrian</hi>, Heap of the Testimony, and Jacob called it in Hebrew, Heap of Testimony.

verses.name: Genesis 31:48
verses.text: And Laban said, This heap <hi>is</hi> a witness between you and me this day. Therefore the name of it was called Heap of Testimony,

verses.name: Genesis 31:49
verses.text: and Watchtower, for he said, The LORD watch between you and me when we are absent from one another.

verses.name: Genesis 31:50
verses.text: If you shall afflict my daughters, or if you shall take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us. See! God is witness between you and me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:51
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar which I have set up between you and me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:52
verses.text: This heap <hi>is</hi> a witness, and the pillar <hi>is</hi> a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you shall not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

verses.name: Genesis 31:53
verses.text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 31:54
verses.text: And Jacob offered sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brothers to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night in the mountain.

verses.name: Genesis 31:55
verses.text: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. And Laban departed and returned to his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:1
verses.text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:2
verses.text: And when Jacob saw them he said, This <hi>is</hi> God's camp. And he called the name of that place Refuge.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:3
verses.text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother, to the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 32:4
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, So shall you speak to my lord Esau: Your servant Jacob says thus, I have lived with Laban and stayed until now.

verses.name: Genesis 32:5
verses.text: And I <hi>have</hi> oxen and asses, flocks, and menservants, and slave women. And I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in your sight.

verses.name: Genesis 32:6
verses.text: And the messengers returned to Jacob saying, We came to your brother Esau, and also he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:7
verses.text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed, and he divided the people with him, and the flocks and herds, and the camels, into two bands.

verses.name: Genesis 32:8
verses.text: And he said, If Esau comes to the one company and strikes it, then the other company which is left shall escape.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:9
verses.text: And Jacob said, Oh God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Jehovah, who said to me, Return to your country and to your kindred, and I will deal well with you:

verses.name: Genesis 32:10
verses.text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies and of all the truth which You have done to Your servant. For with my staff I passed over this Jordan, and now I have become two bands.

verses.name: Genesis 32:11
verses.text: Deliver me, I pray You, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau. For I fear him, lest he come and strike me, from mother to sons.

verses.name: Genesis 32:12
verses.text: And You said, I will surely do you good, and make your seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:13
verses.text: And he lodged there that night. And he took of that which came to his hand, a present for Esau his brother

verses.name: Genesis 32:14
verses.text: two hundred she-goats, twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

verses.name: Genesis 32:15
verses.text: thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.

verses.name: Genesis 32:16
verses.text: And he delivered into the hands of his servants, every drove by themselves. And he said to his servants, Pass over in front of me and put a space between drove and drove.

verses.name: Genesis 32:17
verses.text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meets you, and asks you saying, To whom do you belong? and, Where do you go? And whose these before you?

verses.name: Genesis 32:18
verses.text: Then you shall say, Your servant Jacob's. It <hi>is</hi> a present sent to my lord Esau. And, behold, he also <hi>is</hi> behind us.

verses.name: Genesis 32:19
verses.text: And so he commanded the second and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, In this way you shall speak to Esau when you find him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:20
verses.text: And also you shall say, Behold, your servant Jacob <hi>is</hi> behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.

verses.name: Genesis 32:21
verses.text: And the present went over before him. And he himself lodged that night in the camp.

verses.name: Genesis 32:22
verses.text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two slave women, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

verses.name: Genesis 32:23
verses.text: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over what he had.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:24
verses.text: And Jacob was left alone. And a Man wrestled there with him until the breaking of the day.

verses.name: Genesis 32:25
verses.text: And when He saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the hollow of his thigh. And the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint as he wrestled with Him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:26
verses.text: And He said, Let Me go, for the day breaks. And he said, I will not let You go except You bless me.

verses.name: Genesis 32:27
verses.text: And He said to him, What <hi>is</hi> your name? And he said, Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 32:28
verses.text: And He said, Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for like a prince you have power with God and with men, and have prevailed.

verses.name: Genesis 32:29
verses.text: And Jacob asked and said, I pray You, reveal Your name. And He said, Why do you ask after My name? And He blessed him there.

verses.name: Genesis 32:30
verses.text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

verses.name: Genesis 32:31
verses.text: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he limped upon his thigh.

verses.name: Genesis 32:32
verses.text: Therefore the sons of Israel do not eat of the sinew of the thigh, which is on the hip-socket, until this day, because He touched Jacob's hip-socket, the sinew of the thigh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:1
verses.text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked. And behold, Esau came, and four hundred men with him. And he divided the children to Leah, and to Rachel, and to the two handmaids.

verses.name: Genesis 33:2
verses.text: And he put the slave women and their children first, and Leah and her children afterward, and Rachel and Joseph last.

verses.name: Genesis 33:3
verses.text: And he passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.name: Genesis 33:4
verses.text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell upon his neck and kissed him. And they wept.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:5
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the boys, and said, Who <hi>are</hi> these <hi>with</hi> you? And he said, The boys which God has favored your servant.

verses.name: Genesis 33:6
verses.text: Then the slave women came near, they and their boys, and they bowed themselves.

verses.name: Genesis 33:7
verses.text: And Leah also, and her children, came near and bowed themselves. And afterward Joseph and Rachel came near and bowed.

verses.name: Genesis 33:8
verses.text: He asked, Whose <hi>is</hi> all this camp which I met? And he said, To find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.name: Genesis 33:9
verses.text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother. Keep what you have yourself.

verses.name: Genesis 33:10
verses.text: And Jacob said, No, please, if now I have found grace in your sight, then receive my present at my hand. For therefore have I seen your face, as though I had seen the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

verses.name: Genesis 33:11
verses.text: Please take my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he accepted.

verses.name: Genesis 33:12
verses.text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.

verses.name: Genesis 33:13
verses.text: And he said to him, My lord knows that the boys are tender, and the flocks and herds with me <hi>are</hi> suckling. And if the men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

verses.name: Genesis 33:14
verses.text: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on softly, according as the flocks that go before me, and the boys, are able to endure, until I come to my lord to Seir.

verses.name: Genesis 33:15
verses.text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with you <hi>some</hi> of the people with me. And he said, Why this? Let me find grace in the sight of my lord.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:16
verses.text: And Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

verses.name: Genesis 33:17
verses.text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth and built himself a house, and made booths for his cattle. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.name: Genesis 33:18
verses.text: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which <hi>is</hi> in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram. And he pitched his tent in front of the city.

verses.name: Genesis 33:19
verses.text: And he bought a piece of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the sons of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of silver.

verses.name: Genesis 33:20
verses.text: And he erected there an altar, and called it El, the God of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:1
verses.text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 34:2
verses.text: And when Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her and lay with her, and defiled her.

verses.name: Genesis 34:3
verses.text: And his soul clung to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke to the heart of the girl.

verses.name: Genesis 34:4
verses.text: And Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, Get me this girl for a wife.

verses.name: Genesis 34:5
verses.text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter. And his sons were with his cattle in the field. And Jacob kept silent until they had come.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:6
verses.text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.

verses.name: Genesis 34:7
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard. And the men were furious, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel, in lying with the daughter of Jacob. And it ought not to be done so.

verses.name: Genesis 34:8
verses.text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him for a wife.

verses.name: Genesis 34:9
verses.text: And you make marriages with us, giving your daughters to us, and taking our daughters to you.

verses.name: Genesis 34:10
verses.text: And you shall live with us. And the land shall be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.

verses.name: Genesis 34:11
verses.text: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, Let me find grace in your eyes, and whatever you shall say to me I will give.

verses.name: Genesis 34:12
verses.text: Heap upon me ever so much price and dowry, and I will give according as you shall say to me. But give me the girl for a wife.

verses.name: Genesis 34:13
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father, speaking with deceit because he had defiled Dinah their sister.

verses.name: Genesis 34:14
verses.text: And they said to them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised. For it <hi>is</hi> a reproach to us.

verses.name: Genesis 34:15
verses.text: But in this we will agree with you, if you will be as we <hi>are</hi>, that every male of you be circumcised,

verses.name: Genesis 34:16
verses.text: then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will live with you, and we will become one people.

verses.name: Genesis 34:17
verses.text: But if you will not listen to us, to be circumcised, then we will take our daughter, and we will go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:18
verses.text: And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.

verses.name: Genesis 34:19
verses.text: And the young man did not hesitate to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter. And he <hi>was</hi> more honorable than all the house of his father.

verses.name: Genesis 34:20
verses.text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 34:21
verses.text: These men <hi>are</hi> at peace with us. Therefore let them live in the land, and trade in it. For behold, the land <hi>is</hi> large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

verses.name: Genesis 34:22
verses.text: Only on this <hi>condition</hi> will the men agree to us, to live with us, to be one people, if every male among us is circumcised as they <hi>are</hi> circumcised.

verses.name: Genesis 34:23
verses.text: <hi> Shall</hi> not their cattle and their substance and every animal of theirs be ours? Only let us agree with them, and they will live with us.

verses.name: Genesis 34:24
verses.text: And all that went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and to Shechem his son. And every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:25
verses.text: And it happened on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took each his sword and came upon the city boldly, and killed all the males.

verses.name: Genesis 34:26
verses.text: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

verses.name: Genesis 34:27
verses.text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

verses.name: Genesis 34:28
verses.text: They took their sheep and their oxen, and their asses, and that which <hi>was</hi> in the city and that which <hi>was</hi> in the field.

verses.name: Genesis 34:29
verses.text: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives, they took captive, and plundered even all that <hi>was</hi> in the house.

verses.name: Genesis 34:30
verses.text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have troubled me, to make me stink among those who live in the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. And I, <hi>being</hi> few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and kill me. And I shall be destroyed, my house and I.

verses.name: Genesis 34:31
verses.text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:1
verses.text: And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. And make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.

verses.name: Genesis 35:2
verses.text: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods among you, and be clean, and change your garments.

verses.name: Genesis 35:3
verses.text: And let us arise and go up to Bethel, and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

verses.name: Genesis 35:4
verses.text: And they gave all the strange gods which <hi>were</hi> in their hands to Jacob, and the earrings in their ears. And Jacob hid them under the oak which <hi>was</hi> by Shechem.

verses.name: Genesis 35:5
verses.text: And they moved. And the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:6
verses.text: And Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people with him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:7
verses.text: And he built an altar there and called the place El-bethel, because God appeared to him there when he fled from the face of his brother.

verses.name: Genesis 35:8
verses.text: But Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried beneath Bethel, under an oak. And the name of it was called Oak of Weeping.

verses.name: Genesis 35:9
verses.text: And God appeared to Jacob again when he came out of Padan-aram and blessed him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:10
verses.text: And God said to him, Your name <hi>is</hi> Jacob. Your name shall not be called Jacob any more, but Israel shall be your name. And He called his name Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 35:11
verses.text: And God said to him, I <hi>am</hi> God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations shall be from you, and kings shall come out of your loins.

verses.name: Genesis 35:12
verses.text: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you, and to your seed after you I will give the land.

verses.name: Genesis 35:13
verses.text: And God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:14
verses.text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone. And he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.

verses.name: Genesis 35:15
verses.text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:16
verses.text: And they moved from Bethel. And there was only a length of land to come to Ephrath. And Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor in her bearing.

verses.name: Genesis 35:17
verses.text: And it happened when she was in hard labor in her bearing, the midwife said to her, Do not fear, you shall have this son also.

verses.name: Genesis 35:18
verses.text: And it happened as her soul was departing (for she died) that she called his name Benoni. But his father called him Benjamin.

verses.name: Genesis 35:19
verses.text: And Rachel died and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

verses.name: Genesis 35:20
verses.text: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave. That is the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:21
verses.text: And Israel moved, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

verses.name: Genesis 35:22
verses.text: And it happened when Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine. And Israel heard it. And the sons of Jacob were twelve:

verses.name: Genesis 35:23
verses.text: The sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun.

verses.name: Genesis 35:24
verses.text: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.name: Genesis 35:25
verses.text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's slave woman: Dan and Naphtali.

verses.name: Genesis 35:26
verses.text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's slave woman: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob born to him in Padan-aram.

verses.name: Genesis 35:27
verses.text: And Jacob came to his father Isaac, to Mamre, to the city of Arba, which <hi>is</hi> Hebron, where Abraham had lived, and Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 35:28
verses.text: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.

verses.name: Genesis 35:29
verses.text: And Isaac expired and died, and was gathered to his people, old and satisfied of days. And his sons, Esau and Jacob, buried him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:1
verses.text: And these are the generations of Esau, that is Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 36:2
verses.text: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan, Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

verses.name: Genesis 36:3
verses.text: And Basemath the daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebajoth.

verses.name: Genesis 36:4
verses.text: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau. And Basemath bore Reuel.

verses.name: Genesis 36:5
verses.text: And Oholibamah bore Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 36:6
verses.text: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance which he had gotten in the land of Canaan, and went into the country away from the face of his brother Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 36:7
verses.text: For their riches were more than <hi>that</hi> they might dwell together. And the land of their travels could not bear them because of their cattle.

verses.name: Genesis 36:8
verses.text: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau <hi>is</hi> Edom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:9
verses.text: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in Mount Seir.

verses.name: Genesis 36:10
verses.text: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau; Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

verses.name: Genesis 36:11
verses.text: And the sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.name: Genesis 36:12
verses.text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau's son. And she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

verses.name: Genesis 36:13
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

verses.name: Genesis 36:14
verses.text: And these were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife. And she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.name: Genesis 36:15
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,

verses.name: Genesis 36:16
verses.text: Chief Korah, Chiefs Gatam, Chief Amalek. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these the sons of Adah.

verses.name: Genesis 36:17
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chief Nahath, and Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, Chief Mizzah. These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

verses.name: Genesis 36:18
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, Chief Korah. These were the chiefs of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

verses.name: Genesis 36:19
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Esau, and these their chiefs. He <hi>is</hi> Edom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:20
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Seir the Horite living in the land: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

verses.name: Genesis 36:21
verses.text: and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan. These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 36:22
verses.text: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Heman; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

verses.name: Genesis 36:23
verses.text: And these were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.name: Genesis 36:24
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Zibeon: both Aiah and Anah (he is Anah that found the hot springs in the desert as he fed the asses of Zibeon, his father).

verses.name: Genesis 36:25
verses.text: And the sons of Anah <hi>were</hi> these: Dishon. And Oholibamah <hi>was</hi> the daughter of Anah.

verses.name: Genesis 36:26
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> sons of Dishon: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.name: Genesis 36:27
verses.text: The sons of Ezer <hi>were</hi> these: Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.name: Genesis 36:28
verses.text: The sons of Dishan <hi>were</hi> these: Uz and Aran.

verses.name: Genesis 36:29
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,

verses.name: Genesis 36:30
verses.text: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, Chief Dishan. These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:31
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before the reigning of a king over the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 36:32
verses.text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom. And the name of his city <hi>was</hi> Dinhabah.

verses.name: Genesis 36:33
verses.text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah, from Bozrah, reigned in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 36:34
verses.text: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 36:35
verses.text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab reigned in his place. And the name of his city <hi>was</hi> Avith.

verses.name: Genesis 36:36
verses.text: And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 36:37
verses.text: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth <hi>by</hi> the river reigned in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 36:38
verses.text: And Shaul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

verses.name: Genesis 36:39
verses.text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Pau. And his wife's name <hi>was</hi> Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.name: Genesis 36:40
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,

verses.name: Genesis 36:41
verses.text: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

verses.name: Genesis 36:42
verses.text: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

verses.name: Genesis 36:43
verses.text: Chief Magdiel, Chief Iram. These <hi>were</hi> the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwellings in the land of their possession; he <hi>is</hi> Esau the father of the Edomites.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:1
verses.text: And Jacob lived in the land of the travels of his father, in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 37:2
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a son of seventeen years, came tending the flock with his brothers. And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought to his father an evil report of them.

verses.name: Genesis 37:3
verses.text: And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was the son of his old age. And he made him a tunic <hi>reaching to</hi> the soles <hi>of his</hi> feet.

verses.name: Genesis 37:4
verses.text: And when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:5
verses.text: And Joseph dreamed a dream and told <hi>it</hi> to his brothers. And they hated him still more.

verses.name: Genesis 37:6
verses.text: And he said to them, I pray you, Hear this dream which I have dreamed.

verses.name: Genesis 37:7
verses.text: For behold! We <hi>were</hi> binding sheaves in the middle of the field, and lo, my sheaf arose and also stood upright. And behold, your sheaves stood around and bowed down to my sheaf.

verses.name: Genesis 37:8
verses.text: And his brothers said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have the rule over us? And they hated him still more for his dreams and for his words.

verses.name: Genesis 37:9
verses.text: And he dreamed still another dream, and told it to his brothers. And he said, Behold, I have dreamed another dream. And behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars bowed down to me.

verses.name: Genesis 37:10
verses.text: And he told <hi>it</hi> to his father and to his brothers. And his father rebuked him and said to him, What <hi>is</hi> this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I, and your mother, and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves to the earth before you?

verses.name: Genesis 37:11
verses.text: And his brothers were jealous of him. But his father observed the saying.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:12
verses.text: And his brothers went to feed his father's flock in Shechem.

verses.name: Genesis 37:13
verses.text: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not your brothers feed the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:14
verses.text: And he said to him, please go see whether it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks. And bring me word again. And he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

verses.name: Genesis 37:15
verses.text: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, What are you looking for?

verses.name: Genesis 37:16
verses.text: And he said, I <hi>am</hi> seeking for my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding?

verses.name: Genesis 37:17
verses.text: And the man said, They are gone from here, for I heard <hi>them</hi> say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

verses.name: Genesis 37:18
verses.text: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:19
verses.text: And they said to one another, Behold, this dreamer comes.

verses.name: Genesis 37:20
verses.text: Therefore come now, and let us kill him, and throw him into some pit, and we will say some evil beast has devoured him. And we shall see what will become of his dreams.

verses.name: Genesis 37:21
verses.text: And Reuben heard, and <hi>he</hi> delivered him out of their hands and said, Let us not kill him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:22
verses.text: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him (in order to rescue him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again).  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:23
verses.text: And it happened when Joseph had come to his brothers, they stripped Joseph out of his tunic, the tunic reaching to the soles <hi>of his</hi> feet that was on him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:24
verses.text: And they took him and threw him into a pit. And the pit <hi>was</hi> empty, with no water in it.

verses.name: Genesis 37:25
verses.text: And they sat down to eat bread. And they lifted up their eyes, and looked. And behold, a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 37:26
verses.text: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit <hi>is it</hi> if we should kill our brother and hide his blood?

verses.name: Genesis 37:27
verses.text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him. For he <hi>is</hi> our brother, and our flesh. And his brothers listened.

verses.name: Genesis 37:28
verses.text: And men, Midianites traders, came by. And they drew up Joseph and took him out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty <hi>pieces</hi> of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 37:29
verses.text: And Reuben returned to the pit. And behold! Joseph <hi>was</hi> not in the pit! And he tore his clothes.

verses.name: Genesis 37:30
verses.text: And he returned to his brothers and said, The child, he is not. And I, where shall I go?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:31
verses.text: And they took Joseph's tunic, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

verses.name: Genesis 37:32
verses.text: And they sent the tunic <hi>reaching to</hi> the soles of the feet, and they brought it to their father. And they said, We have found this. Do you know whether it <hi>is</hi> your son's coat or not?

verses.name: Genesis 37:33
verses.text: And he knew it, and said, <hi>It is</hi> my son's tunic. An evil beast has eaten him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.

verses.name: Genesis 37:34
verses.text: And Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

verses.name: Genesis 37:35
verses.text: And all his sons, and all his daughters, rose up to comfort him. But he refused to be comforted. And he said, For I will go down into the grave to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:36
verses.text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, a eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the executioners.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:1
verses.text: And it happened at that time Judah went down from his brothers and turned in to a certain Adullamite, named Hirah.

verses.name: Genesis 38:2
verses.text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shuah. And he took her and went in to her.

verses.name: Genesis 38:3
verses.text: And she conceived and bore a son. And he called his name Er.

verses.name: Genesis 38:4
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.

verses.name: Genesis 38:5
verses.text: And she yet again conceived and bore a son. And she called his name Shelah. And she was at Chezib when she bore him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:6
verses.text: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, whose name <hi>was</hi> Tamar.

verses.name: Genesis 38:7
verses.text: And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD killed him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:8
verses.text: And Judah said to Onan, Go in to your brother's wife, and marry <hi>her</hi>, and raise up seed to your brother.

verses.name: Genesis 38:9
verses.text: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it happened when he went in to his brother's wife, that he spilled on the ground, not giving seed to his brother.

verses.name: Genesis 38:10
verses.text: And what he did was evil in the eyes of the LORD. Therefore He killed him also.

verses.name: Genesis 38:11
verses.text: Then said Judah to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow at your father's house until Shelah my son is grown. For he said, Lest perhaps he die also, as his brothers <hi>did</hi>. And Tamar went and lived in her father's house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:12
verses.text: And the days were many, and Judah's wife, the daughter of Shuah, died. And Judah was comforted, and went up to shearers of his sheep, he and his friend Hiram of Adullam, to Timnah.

verses.name: Genesis 38:13
verses.text: And it was told to Tamar, saying, Behold, your father-in-law goes up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

verses.name: Genesis 38:14
verses.text: And she put off her widow's clothes, and covered herself with a veil, and wrapped herself. And <hi>she</hi> sat in an open place, which <hi>is</hi> by the way to Timnah. For she saw that Shelah was grown and she was not given to him as wife.

verses.name: Genesis 38:15
verses.text: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a harlot, because she had covered her face.

verses.name: Genesis 38:16
verses.text: And he turned aside to her by the wayside, and said, Come now, let me come in to you. For he did not know that she <hi>was</hi> his daughter-in-law. And she said, What will you give me, so that you may come in to me?

verses.name: Genesis 38:17
verses.text: And he said, I will send a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Will you give me a pledge until you send <hi>it</hi>?

verses.name: Genesis 38:18
verses.text: And he said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, Your signet, and your bracelet, and your staff that <hi>is</hi> in your hand. And he gave to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:19
verses.text: And she arose, and went away, and laid away her veil from her, and put on the clothes of her widowhood.

verses.name: Genesis 38:20
verses.text: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive <hi>his</hi> pledge from the woman's hand. But he did not find her.

verses.name: Genesis 38:21
verses.text: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where <hi>is</hi> the harlot who was by the wayside? And they said, There <hi>was</hi> no harlot here.

verses.name: Genesis 38:22
verses.text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her. And also the men of the place said, There <hi>was</hi> no harlot here.

verses.name: Genesis 38:23
verses.text: And Judah said, Let her take <hi>it</hi> to her, lest we be ashamed. Behold, I sent this kid, and you have not found her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:24
verses.text: And it happened, about three months afterward, that it was told Judah, saying, Your daughter-in-law Tamar has played the harlot, and also, behold, she <hi>is</hi> with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burned.

verses.name: Genesis 38:25
verses.text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, I am with child by the man whose things these <hi>are</hi>. And she said, Please observe. Whose things are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff?

verses.name: Genesis 38:26
verses.text: And Judah acknowledged <hi>them</hi>, and said, She has been more righteous than I have, because I did not give her to my son Shelah. And he never knew her again.

verses.name: Genesis 38:27
verses.text: And it happened, in the time of her travail, behold, twins <hi>were</hi> in her womb.

verses.name: Genesis 38:28
verses.text: And when she travailed, it happened that <hi>one</hi> put out a hand. And the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This one came out first.

verses.name: Genesis 38:29
verses.text: And it happened as he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out. And she said, How have you broken a break for yourself? And his name was called Pharez.

verses.name: Genesis 38:30
verses.text: And afterwards his brother came out, on whose hand was the scarlet thread. And his name was called Zarah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:1
verses.text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt. And Potiphar, a eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the executioners, an Egyptian man, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

verses.name: Genesis 39:2
verses.text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. And he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

verses.name: Genesis 39:3
verses.text: And his master saw that the LORD <hi>was</hi> with him, and that the LORD made all he did to prosper in his hand.

verses.name: Genesis 39:4
verses.text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him. And he made him overseer over his house, and he put into his hand all he had.

verses.name: Genesis 39:5
verses.text: And it happened from the time he had made him overseer in his house, and over all he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake. And the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.

verses.name: Genesis 39:6
verses.text: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand. And he did not know anything that he had, except the bread which he ate. And Joseph was beautiful in form and beautiful in appearance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:7
verses.text: And after these things it happened that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph. And she said, Lie with me.

verses.name: Genesis 39:8
verses.text: But he refused and said to his master's wife, Behold, my master does not know what <hi>is</hi> in the house with me, and he has given all that he has into my hand.

verses.name: Genesis 39:9
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> none greater in this house than I. Neither has he kept back anything from me except you, because you <hi>are</hi> his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

verses.name: Genesis 39:10
verses.text: And it happened as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he did not listen to her to lie with her, <hi>or</hi> to be with her.

verses.name: Genesis 39:11
verses.text: And it happened about this time that he came into the house to do his work. And none of the men of the house <hi>were</hi> inside.

verses.name: Genesis 39:12
verses.text: And she caught him by his robe, saying, Lie with me. And he left his robe in her hand and fled, and got out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:13
verses.text: And it happened when she saw that he had left his robe in her hand, and had fled,

verses.name: Genesis 39:14
verses.text: she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, See, he has brought in a Hebrew to us to mock us. He came in to me, to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

verses.name: Genesis 39:15
verses.text: And it happened when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his robe with me, and fled, and got out.

verses.name: Genesis 39:16
verses.text: And she laid up his robe beside her until his lord came home.

verses.name: Genesis 39:17
verses.text: And she spoke to him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant which you have brought to us came in to me to mock me.

verses.name: Genesis 39:18
verses.text: And it happened as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his robe with me and ran out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:19
verses.text: And it happened when his master heard the words of his wife which she spoke to him, saying, Your servant did this to me, his wrath was kindled.

verses.name: Genesis 39:20
verses.text: And Joseph's master took him and put him in the prison, a place where the king's prisoners <hi>were</hi> bound. And he was there in the prison.

verses.name: Genesis 39:21
verses.text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed him mercy, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

verses.name: Genesis 39:22
verses.text: And the keeper of the prison gave all the prisoners in the prison into Joseph's hand. And whatever they did there, he was the doer of it.

verses.name: Genesis 39:23
verses.text: The keeper of the prison did not look to anything under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and whatever he did, the LORD made <hi>it</hi> to prosper.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:1
verses.text: And after these things it happened that the cupbearer of the king of Egypt, and his baker, had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 40:2
verses.text: And Pharaoh was angry against two of his eunuchs, against the chief of the cupbearers and against the chief of the bakers.

verses.name: Genesis 40:3
verses.text: And he put them under guard in the house of the chief of the executioners, into the prison, the place where Joseph <hi>was</hi> bound.

verses.name: Genesis 40:4
verses.text: And the chief of the executioners charged Joseph with them, and he served them. And they continued for a time under guard.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:5
verses.text: And they dreamed a dream, both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who <hi>were</hi> bound in the prison.

verses.name: Genesis 40:6
verses.text: And Joseph came in to them in the morning, and looked upon them, and behold, they <hi>were</hi> sad.

verses.name: Genesis 40:7
verses.text: And he asked Pharaoh's eunuchs who <hi>were</hi> with him under guard in his lord's house, saying, Why are your faces sad today?

verses.name: Genesis 40:8
verses.text: And they said to him, We have dreamed a dream, and <hi>there is</hi> no interpreter of it. And Joseph said to them, Do not interpretations <hi>belong</hi> to God? Now tell it to me.

verses.name: Genesis 40:9
verses.text: And the chief cupbearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine <hi>was</hi> before me.

verses.name: Genesis 40:10
verses.text: And in the vine <hi>were</hi> three branches. And it was as if it budded, and its blossom shot up. And the clusters of it brought forth ripe grapes.

verses.name: Genesis 40:11
verses.text: And Pharaoh's cup <hi>was</hi> in my hand. And I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

verses.name: Genesis 40:12
verses.text: And Joseph said to him, This <hi>is</hi> the interpretation of it. The three branches are three days.

verses.name: Genesis 40:13
verses.text: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head and restore you to your place. And you shall deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.

verses.name: Genesis 40:14
verses.text: But remember me when it is well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

verses.name: Genesis 40:15
verses.text: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

verses.name: Genesis 40:16
verses.text: When the chief baker saw the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, I also <hi>saw</hi> in my dream, and three baskets of white bread <hi>were</hi> on my head.

verses.name: Genesis 40:17
verses.text: And in the top basket <hi>were</hi> all kinds of baked foods for Pharaoh. And the birds ate them out of the basket upon my head.

verses.name: Genesis 40:18
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, This <hi>is</hi> the interpretation of it. The three baskets are three days.

verses.name: Genesis 40:19
verses.text: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head from off you, and shall hang you on a tree. And the birds shall eat your flesh from off you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:20
verses.text: And it happened on the third day, Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast to all his servants. And he lifted up the head of the chief cupbearer, and of the chief baker, among his servants.

verses.name: Genesis 40:21
verses.text: And he restored the chief cupbearer back into his cupbearer office again. And he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

verses.name: Genesis 40:22
verses.text: But he hanged the chief baker, even as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.name: Genesis 40:23
verses.text: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:1
verses.text: And it happened at the end of two years of days, Pharaoh dreamed. And behold, he stood by the River.

verses.name: Genesis 41:2
verses.text: And behold! There came up out of the river seven cows beautiful of form, and fat of flesh. And they fed in the reeds!

verses.name: Genesis 41:3
verses.text: And behold! Seven other cows came up after them out of the River, evil in appearance, and lean of flesh! And they stood by the other cows on the river bank.

verses.name: Genesis 41:4
verses.text: And the evil-appearing and lean-fleshed cows ate up the seven beautifully formed and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.

verses.name: Genesis 41:5
verses.text: And he slept and dreamed the second time. And behold! Seven ears of grain came up on one stock, fat and good!

verses.name: Genesis 41:6
verses.text: And behold! Seven thin ears, and blasted with the east <hi>wind</hi>, sprang up after them!

verses.name: Genesis 41:7
verses.text: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven fat and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and behold, <hi>it was</hi> a dream.

verses.name: Genesis 41:8
verses.text: And it happened in the morning that his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men of it. And Pharaoh told them his dream, but <hi>there was</hi> none who could interpret them to Pharaoh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:9
verses.text: Then the chief cupbearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, I remember my sin this day.

verses.name: Genesis 41:10
verses.text: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me under guard in the chief of the executioner's house, me and the chief baker.

verses.name: Genesis 41:11
verses.text: And we dreamed a dream one night, he and I. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

verses.name: Genesis 41:12
verses.text: And there was there with us a young man, a Hebrew, a slave to the chief of the executioners. And we told him, and he interpreted our dreams to us. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

verses.name: Genesis 41:13
verses.text: And it happened, as he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.

verses.name: Genesis 41:14
verses.text: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph. And they hurried him out of the dungeon. And he shaved and changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 41:15
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and none can interpret it. And I have heard it about you, saying, you can understand a dream to interpret it.

verses.name: Genesis 41:16
verses.text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, Not I. God shall give answer the welfare of Pharaoh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:17
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, In my dream, behold! I stood upon the bank of the river.

verses.name: Genesis 41:18
verses.text: And behold, there came up out of the river seven cows, beautiful in appearance and fat of flesh. And they fed in the reeds.

verses.name: Genesis 41:19
verses.text: And behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and evil of appearance, and lean of flesh, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness.

verses.name: Genesis 41:20
verses.text: And the lean and the evil-appearing cows ate up the first seven fat cows.

verses.name: Genesis 41:21
verses.text: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be seen that they had eaten them; but they <hi>were</hi> still evil of appearance, as at the beginning. And I awoke.

verses.name: Genesis 41:22
verses.text: And I saw in my dream, and behold, seven ears came up in one stock, full and good.

verses.name: Genesis 41:23
verses.text: And behold, seven ears, withered, thin, blasted <hi>by</hi> the east <hi>wind</hi>, sprang up after them.

verses.name: Genesis 41:24
verses.text: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears. And I spoke to the magicians, but there was none that could open <hi>it</hi> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 41:25
verses.text: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one. God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.

verses.name: Genesis 41:26
verses.text: The seven good cows <hi>are</hi> seven years. And the seven good ears <hi>are</hi> seven years. The dream <hi>is</hi> one.

verses.name: Genesis 41:27
verses.text: And the seven thin and evil-appearing cows that came up after them <hi>are</hi> seven years. And the seven empty ears blasted <hi>with</hi> the east <hi>wind</hi> shall be seven years of famine.

verses.name: Genesis 41:28
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the thing which God has spoken to Pharaoh; what God is about to do, He shows to Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 41:29
verses.text: Behold, <hi>there are</hi> coming seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:30
verses.text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine. And all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt, and the famine shall consume the land.

verses.name: Genesis 41:31
verses.text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land because of the famine following; for it <hi>shall be</hi> very grievous.

verses.name: Genesis 41:32
verses.text: And since the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice, it is because the thing <hi>is</hi> established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:33
verses.text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a man who is discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:34
verses.text: Let Pharaoh act, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

verses.name: Genesis 41:35
verses.text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

verses.name: Genesis 41:36
verses.text: That food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt, so that the land does not perish through the famine.

verses.name: Genesis 41:37
verses.text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

verses.name: Genesis 41:38
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to his servants, Can we find any man like this, <hi>in</hi> whom the Spirit of God <hi>is</hi>?

verses.name: Genesis 41:39
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since God has shown you all this, no one <hi>is</hi> as discreet and wise as you.

verses.name: Genesis 41:40
verses.text: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall kiss <hi>the hand</hi> at your word. Only in the throne will I be greater than you.

verses.name: Genesis 41:41
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:42
verses.text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand. And he dressed him with fine linen robes, and put a gold chain around his neck.

verses.name: Genesis 41:43
verses.text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had, and they cried before him, Bow the knee! And he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:44
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I <hi>am</hi> Pharaoh, and without <hi>a word</hi> from you, no man shall lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:45
verses.text: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah. And he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah, priest of On, for his wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:46
verses.text: And Joseph <hi>was</hi> thirty years <hi>old</hi> when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from before Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:47
verses.text: And in the seven years of plenty, the earth brought forth by handfuls.

verses.name: Genesis 41:48
verses.text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which <hi>were</hi> in the land of Egypt, and he put food in the cities. He put the food of the field which <hi>was</hi> around every city; he put it in among it.

verses.name: Genesis 41:49
verses.text: And Joseph gathered grain like the sand of the sea, very much, until he quit numbering it; for it was without number.

verses.name: Genesis 41:50
verses.text: And two sons were born to Joseph before the years of famine came, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bore to him.

verses.name: Genesis 41:51
verses.text: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh, saying, For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father's house.

verses.name: Genesis 41:52
verses.text: And the name of the second he called Ephraim, saying, For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

verses.name: Genesis 41:53
verses.text: And the seven years of plenty that was in the land of Egypt ended.

verses.name: Genesis 41:54
verses.text: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said. And the famine was in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.name: Genesis 41:55
verses.text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. And Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.

verses.name: Genesis 41:56
verses.text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth. And Joseph opened all <hi>the storehouses</hi>, and sold to the Egyptians. And the famine was severe on the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 41:57
verses.text: And all the earth came into Egypt to buy, to Joseph, because the famine was severe in all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:1
verses.text: And when Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, Why do you look upon one another?

verses.name: Genesis 42:2
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us from there, so that we may live and not die.

verses.name: Genesis 42:3
verses.text: And Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 42:4
verses.text: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob did not send with his brothers. For he said, Lest perhaps mischief happen to him.

verses.name: Genesis 42:5
verses.text: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 42:6
verses.text: And Joseph <hi>was</hi> the potentate over the land. He selling to all the people of the earth. And Joseph's brothers came and bowed down themselves before him, their faces to the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:7
verses.text: And Joseph saw his brothers, and he knew them, but remained a stranger to them, and spoke roughly to them. And he said to them, Where do you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

verses.name: Genesis 42:8
verses.text: And Joseph knew his brothers, but they did not know him.

verses.name: Genesis 42:9
verses.text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said to them, You <hi>are</hi> spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 42:10
verses.text: And they said to him, No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

verses.name: Genesis 42:11
verses.text: We <hi>are</hi> all one man's sons. We are honest; your servants are not spies.

verses.name: Genesis 42:12
verses.text: And he said to them, No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 42:13
verses.text: And they said, Your servants <hi>are</hi> twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. And behold, the youngest <hi>is</hi> this day with our father, and one <hi>is</hi> not.

verses.name: Genesis 42:14
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, That <hi>is</hi> what I spoke to you, saying, You <hi>are</hi> spies!

verses.name: Genesis 42:15
verses.text: By this you shall be proved; <hi>as</hi> Pharaoh lives you shall not go forth from here unless your youngest brother comes here.

verses.name: Genesis 42:16
verses.text: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother, and you shall be kept in prison so that your words may be proved, whether <hi>any</hi> truth <hi>is</hi> in you. Or else, <hi>as</hi> Pharaoh lives, surely you <hi>are</hi> spies.

verses.name: Genesis 42:17
verses.text: And he put them together into custody three days.

verses.name: Genesis 42:18
verses.text: And Joseph said to them the third day, Do <hi>this</hi> and live. I fear God.

verses.name: Genesis 42:19
verses.text: If you <hi>are</hi> honest, let one of your brothers be bound in the house of your prison. You go carry grain <hi>for</hi> the famine of your houses.

verses.name: Genesis 42:20
verses.text: But bring your youngest brother to me, and let your words confirmed, be proved true, and you shall not die. And they did so.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:21
verses.text: And they said one to another, We <hi>are</hi> truly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul when he begged us, and we would not hear. Therefore this distress has come upon us.

verses.name: Genesis 42:22
verses.text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Did I not speak to you saying, Do not sin against the youth? And you would not hear. Therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

verses.name: Genesis 42:23
verses.text: And they did not know that Joseph understood, for the interpreter was between them.

verses.name: Genesis 42:24
verses.text: And he turned from them, and wept. And he returned to them again and talked with them, and took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.

verses.name: Genesis 42:25
verses.text: Then Joseph commanded their sacks to be filled <hi>with</hi> grain, and returned their silver, each into his sack, and to give them provision for the way. And so he did to them.

verses.name: Genesis 42:26
verses.text: And they loaded their asses with grain, and departed from there.

verses.name: Genesis 42:27
verses.text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass fodder in the inn, he saw his silver. For, behold, it <hi>was</hi> in the mouth of the sack.

verses.name: Genesis 42:28
verses.text: And he said to his brothers, My silver has been put back. And, also look in my sack. And their hearts failed, and they each were afraid, saying to one another, What <hi>is</hi> this God has done to us?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:29
verses.text: And they came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that happened to them, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 42:30
verses.text: The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

verses.name: Genesis 42:31
verses.text: And we said to him, We <hi>are</hi> honest, we <hi>are</hi> not spies.

verses.name: Genesis 42:32
verses.text: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father. One <hi>is</hi> not, and the youngest <hi>is</hi> this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 42:33
verses.text: And the man, the lord of the country, said to us, By this I shall know that you <hi>are</hi> honest. Leave one, your brother, with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and go.

verses.name: Genesis 42:34
verses.text: And bring your youngest brother to me. Then I shall know that you <hi>are</hi> not spies, but that you <hi>are</hi> honest. And I will deliver you your brother, and you shall trade in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 42:35
verses.text: And it happened they emptied their sacks, behold, every man's bundle of silver <hi>was</hi> in his sack. And when they and their father saw the bundles of silver, they were afraid.

verses.name: Genesis 42:36
verses.text: And Jacob their father said to them, You have bereaved me. Joseph <hi>is</hi> not, and Simeon <hi>is</hi> not, and you will take Benjamin. All these things are against me.

verses.name: Genesis 42:37
verses.text: And Reuben spoke to his father, saying, Kill my two sons if I do not bring him to you. Deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to you again.

verses.name: Genesis 42:38
verses.text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you. For his brother is dead, and he is left alone. And <hi>if</hi> mischief should happen to him by the way you go, then you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:1
verses.text: And the famine <hi>was</hi> severe in the land.

verses.name: Genesis 43:2
verses.text: And it happened, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, Go again, buy us a little food.

verses.name: Genesis 43:3
verses.text: And Judah spoke to him, saying, The man solemnly protested to us, saying, You shall not see my face unless your brother <hi>is</hi> with you.

verses.name: Genesis 43:4
verses.text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.

verses.name: Genesis 43:5
verses.text: But if you will not send <hi>him</hi>, we will not go down. For the man said to us, You shall not see my face unless your brother <hi>is</hi> with you.

verses.name: Genesis 43:6
verses.text: And Israel said, Why have you dealt ill with me, to tell the man whether you <hi>had</hi> yet a brother?

verses.name: Genesis 43:7
verses.text: And they said, The man asked us strictly of our state and of our kindred, saying, <hi>Is</hi> your father still alive? Have you yet <hi>another</hi> brother? And we told him according to the tenor of these words. Could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.name: Genesis 43:8
verses.text: And Judah said to Israel his father, Send the boy with me, and we will arise and go, so that we may live and not die, both we and you, also our little ones.

verses.name: Genesis 43:9
verses.text: I will be surety for him. You shall require him of my hand. If I do not bring him to you and set him before you, I shall be a sinner against you all the days.

verses.name: Genesis 43:10
verses.text: For unless we had lingered, surely now we would have returned the second time.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:11
verses.text: And their father Israel said to them, If <hi>it be</hi> so now, do this. Take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels, and bring a present down to the man, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds.

verses.name: Genesis 43:12
verses.text: And take double silver in your hand, and the silver that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand. Perhaps it <hi>was</hi> an oversight.

verses.name: Genesis 43:13
verses.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again to the man.

verses.name: Genesis 43:14
verses.text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, so that he may send away your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved, I am bereaved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:15
verses.text: And the men took that present, and they took double silver in their hand, and Benjamin. And they rose up and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.name: Genesis 43:16
verses.text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring the men into the house, and kill an animal and make ready. For the men shall dine with me at noon.

verses.name: Genesis 43:17
verses.text: And the man did as Joseph said. And the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

verses.name: Genesis 43:18
verses.text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house. And they said, Because of the silver that was returned in our sacks at the first time we are brought in, to throw himself on us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

verses.name: Genesis 43:19
verses.text: And they came near to the man over Joseph's house, and they talked with him at the door of the house,

verses.name: Genesis 43:20
verses.text: and said, Oh sir, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

verses.name: Genesis 43:21
verses.text: And it happened, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, <hi>every</hi> man's silver <hi>was</hi> in the mouth of his sack, our silver in full weight. And we have brought it again in our hands.

verses.name: Genesis 43:22
verses.text: And we have brought down other silver in our hands to buy food. We cannot tell who put our silver in our sacks.

verses.name: Genesis 43:23
verses.text: And he said, Peace to you, do not fear. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I had your silver. And he brought Simeon out to them.

verses.name: Genesis 43:24
verses.text: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave <hi>them</hi> water, and they washed their feet. And he gave fodder to their asses.

verses.name: Genesis 43:25
verses.text: And they made ready the presents for the coming of Joseph at noon. For they heard that they should eat bread there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:26
verses.text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 43:27
verses.text: And he asked them as to <hi>their</hi> welfare, and said, <hi>Is</hi> your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? <hi>Is</hi> he still alive?

verses.name: Genesis 43:28
verses.text: And they answered, Your servant, our father, <hi>is</hi> in good health. He <hi>is</hi> still alive. And they bowed down their heads and fell before him.

verses.name: Genesis 43:29
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, <hi>Is</hi> this your younger brother of whom you spoke to me? And he said, God bless you, my son.

verses.name: Genesis 43:30
verses.text: And Joseph made haste, for his bowels yearned toward his brother. And he sought a <hi>place</hi> to weep. And he entered into his room and wept there.

verses.name: Genesis 43:31
verses.text: And he washed his face, and went out, and controlled himself, and said, Set the bread on.

verses.name: Genesis 43:32
verses.text: And they set it on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians may not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

verses.name: Genesis 43:33
verses.text: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth. And the men marveled at one another.

verses.name: Genesis 43:34
verses.text: And one took portions to them from before him. But Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:1
verses.text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks <hi>with</hi> food, as much as they can carry, and put each one's silver in his sack's mouth.

verses.name: Genesis 44:2
verses.text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain silver. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.name: Genesis 44:3
verses.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.name: Genesis 44:4
verses.text: They had gone out of the city, not having gone far. And Joseph said to his steward, Rise up, follow after the men and overtake them, and say to them, Why have you rewarded evil for good?

verses.name: Genesis 44:5
verses.text: Is this not <hi>that</hi> in which my lord drinks, and by which indeed he divines? You have done evil in so doing.

verses.name: Genesis 44:6
verses.text: And he overtook them, and he spoke to them these words.

verses.name: Genesis 44:7
verses.text: And they said to him, Why does your lord say these words? Far be it that your servants should do according to this thing.

verses.name: Genesis 44:8
verses.text: Behold, the silver which we found in our sack's mouth, we brought it in to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal out of your lord's house silver or gold?

verses.name: Genesis 44:9
verses.text: <hi> With</hi> whomever of your servants it may be found, both let him die, and we all will be my lord's bondmen.

verses.name: Genesis 44:10
verses.text: And he said, Now also <hi>let</hi> it <hi>be</hi> according to your word. He with whom it is found shall be my servant, and you shall be blameless.

verses.name: Genesis 44:11
verses.text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and each one opened his sack.

verses.name: Genesis 44:12
verses.text: And he searched first at the oldest and with the youngest last. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

verses.name: Genesis 44:13
verses.text: Then they tore their clothes, and each one loaded his ass and returned to the city.

verses.name: Genesis 44:14
verses.text: And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, for he <hi>was</hi> still there. And they fell before him to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 44:15
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, What deed is this that you have done? Do you not know that one like me can certainly divine?

verses.name: Genesis 44:16
verses.text: And Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we <hi>are</hi> my lord's servants, both we and he also with whom the cup is found.

verses.name: Genesis 44:17
verses.text: And he said, Be it far from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant. And as for you, you go in peace to your father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:18
verses.text: And Judah came near him and said, O my lord, pray let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears, and do not let your anger burn against your servant, for you <hi>are</hi> even as Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 44:19
verses.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Do you have a father or a brother?

verses.name: Genesis 44:20
verses.text: And we said to my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one. And his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:21
verses.text: And you said to your servants, Bring him down to me, and let me see him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:22
verses.text: And we said to my lord, The boy cannot leave his father, for <hi>if</hi> he should leave <hi>his father</hi>, he would die.
