verses.name: Genesis 44:23
verses.text: And you said to your servants, Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.

verses.name: Genesis 44:24
verses.text: And it happened when we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.name: Genesis 44:25
verses.text: And our father said, Go again. Buy us a little food.

verses.name: Genesis 44:26
verses.text: And we said, We cannot go down. If our youngest brother is with us, we will go down, for we may not see the man's face unless our youngest brother <hi>is</hi> with us.

verses.name: Genesis 44:27
verses.text: And your servant my father said to us, You know that my wife bore me two <hi>sons</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:28
verses.text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces. And I never saw him since.

verses.name: Genesis 44:29
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> you take this one also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.name: Genesis 44:30
verses.text: And now when I come to your servant my father, and the boy <hi>is</hi> not with us, since his life is bound up in his life,

verses.name: Genesis 44:31
verses.text: it shall be, when he sees that the boy <hi>is</hi> not <hi>with us</hi>, he will die. And your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.name: Genesis 44:32
verses.text: For your servant became surety for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not bring him to you, then I shall bear the blame to my father forever.

verses.name: Genesis 44:33
verses.text: And now please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a slave to my lord. And let the boy go up with his brothers.

verses.name: Genesis 44:34
verses.text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the boy <hi>is</hi> not with me lest perhaps I see the evil that will find my father?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:1
verses.text: Then Joseph could not control himself before all those who stood by him. And he cried, Cause every man to go out from me! And no man stood before him <hi>while</hi> Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

verses.name: Genesis 45:2
verses.text: And he wept aloud. And the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.name: Genesis 45:3
verses.text: And Joseph said to his brothers, I <hi>am</hi> Joseph. Is my father still live? And his brothers could not answer him, for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.name: Genesis 45:4
verses.text: And Joseph said to his brothers, Please come near me. And they came near. And he said, I <hi>am</hi> Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 45:5
verses.text: And now do not be grieved, nor angry with yourselves that you sold me here. For God sent me before you to preserve life.

verses.name: Genesis 45:6
verses.text: For these two years the famine <hi>has been</hi> in the land, and <hi>there are</hi> still five years in which there <hi>will be</hi> no plowing nor harvest.

verses.name: Genesis 45:7
verses.text: And God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.name: Genesis 45:8
verses.text: And now you did not send me here, but God. And He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 45:9
verses.text: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, So says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me, do not wait.

verses.name: Genesis 45:10
verses.text: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your sons and your sons' sons, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have.

verses.name: Genesis 45:11
verses.text: And I will nourish you there, for <hi>there are</hi> still five years of famine, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.

verses.name: Genesis 45:12
verses.text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that <hi>it is</hi> my mouth that speaks to you.

verses.name: Genesis 45:13
verses.text: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. And you shall hurry and bring down my father here.

verses.name: Genesis 45:14
verses.text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck and wept. And Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.name: Genesis 45:15
verses.text: And he kissed all his brothers, and wept upon them. And afterwards his brothers talked with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:16
verses.text: And the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brothers have come. And it was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and of his servants.

verses.name: Genesis 45:17
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Do this; load your beasts and go into the land of Canaan,

verses.name: Genesis 45:18
verses.text: and take your father and your households and come to me. And I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.name: Genesis 45:19
verses.text: Now you are commanded; do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.name: Genesis 45:20
verses.text: And do not regard your stuff, for the good of all the land of Egypt <hi>is</hi> yours.

verses.name: Genesis 45:21
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them wagons according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.name: Genesis 45:22
verses.text: To all of them he gave each man changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred <hi>pieces</hi> of silver, and five changes of clothing.

verses.name: Genesis 45:23
verses.text: And to his father he sent this: ten asses loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses loaded with grain and bread and food for his father by the way.

verses.name: Genesis 45:24
verses.text: And he sent his brothers away, and they departed. And he said to them, Do not quarrel along the way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:25
verses.text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came <hi>to</hi> the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

verses.name: Genesis 45:26
verses.text: And they told him, saying, Joseph <hi>is</hi> still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he did not believe them.

verses.name: Genesis 45:27
verses.text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. And when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

verses.name: Genesis 45:28
verses.text: And Israel said, <hi>It is</hi> enough. Joseph my son <hi>is</hi> still alive. I will go and see him before I die.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:1
verses.text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

verses.name: Genesis 46:2
verses.text: And God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob! And he said, Here I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:3
verses.text: And He said, I <hi>am</hi> God, the God of your fathers. Do not fear to go down into Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation.

verses.name: Genesis 46:4
verses.text: I will go down with you into Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again. And Joseph shall put his hand on your eyes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:5
verses.text: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba. And the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:6
verses.text: And they took their cattle, and their goods which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:7
verses.text: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed, he brought with him into Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 46:8
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.

verses.name: Genesis 46:9
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.name: Genesis 46:10
verses.text: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 46:11
verses.text: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: Genesis 46:12
verses.text: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah. But Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.name: Genesis 46:13
verses.text: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

verses.name: Genesis 46:14
verses.text: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

verses.name: Genesis 46:15
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

verses.name: Genesis 46:16
verses.text: And the sons of Gad <hi>were</hi> Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

verses.name: Genesis 46:17
verses.text: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and their sister Serah. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

verses.name: Genesis 46:18
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these whom she bore to Jacob, sixteen souls.

verses.name: Genesis 46:19
verses.text: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.name: Genesis 46:20
verses.text: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah the priest of On bore him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:21
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin: Belah and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

verses.name: Genesis 46:22
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob. All the souls <hi>were</hi> fourteen.

verses.name: Genesis 46:23
verses.text: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

verses.name: Genesis 46:24
verses.text: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.name: Genesis 46:25
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob. All the souls <hi>were</hi> seven.

verses.name: Genesis 46:26
verses.text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, who came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls <hi>were</hi> sixty-six.

verses.name: Genesis 46:27
verses.text: And the sons of Joseph, who <hi>were</hi> born to him in Egypt, <hi>were</hi> two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, <hi>were</hi> seventy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:28
verses.text: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to direct his face to Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 46:29
verses.text: And Joseph made his chariot ready, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself to him. And he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.name: Genesis 46:30
verses.text: And Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you <hi>are</hi> still alive.

verses.name: Genesis 46:31
verses.text: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's house, I will go up and show Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

verses.name: Genesis 46:32
verses.text: And the men <hi>are</hi> shepherds, for they have been men of cattle. And they have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.

verses.name: Genesis 46:33
verses.text: And it shall be when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What <hi>is</hi> your occupation?

verses.name: Genesis 46:34
verses.text: Then you shall say, Your servants have been men of cattle from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers, so that you may live in the land of Goshen, for every shepherd <hi>is</hi> an abomination to the Egyptians.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:1
verses.text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brothers, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, have come out of the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Genesis 47:2
verses.text: And behold, they <hi>are</hi> in the land of Goshen. And he took some of his brothers, five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:3
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to his brothers, What <hi>is</hi> your occupation? And they said to Pharaoh, Your servants <hi>are</hi> shepherds, both we and our fathers.

verses.name: Genesis 47:4
verses.text: And they said to Pharaoh, For we have come to live in the land. For your servants have no pasture left for their flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. And now please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 47:5
verses.text: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, Your father and your brothers have come to you.

verses.name: Genesis 47:6
verses.text: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and brothers to live in the best of the land; in the land of Goshen let them live. And if you know men of ability among them, then make them overseers of livestock, over what is mine.

verses.name: Genesis 47:7
verses.text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:8
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, How many are the days of the years of your life?

verses.name: Genesis 47:9
verses.text: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage <hi>are</hi> a hundred and thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and I have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

verses.name: Genesis 47:10
verses.text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

verses.name: Genesis 47:11
verses.text: And Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh commanded.

verses.name: Genesis 47:12
verses.text: And Joseph nourished his father and his brothers, and all his father's household, <hi>with</hi> bread, for the mouth of the little ones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:13
verses.text: And no bread <hi>was</hi> in all the land, for the famine <hi>was</hi> very severe, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted because of the famine.

verses.name: Genesis 47:14
verses.text: And Joseph gathered up all the silver found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought. And Joseph brought the silver into Pharaoh's house.

verses.name: Genesis 47:15
verses.text: And when silver failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For the silver has failed.

verses.name: Genesis 47:16
verses.text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle, and I will give you for your cattle, if silver has failed.

verses.name: Genesis 47:17
verses.text: And they brought their cattle to Joseph. And Joseph gave them bread for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses. And he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

verses.name: Genesis 47:18
verses.text: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year and said, We will not hide <hi>it</hi> from my lord, that our silver has failed, also our herds of cattle, <hi>going</hi> to my lord. Nothing is left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies and our lands.

verses.name: Genesis 47:19
verses.text: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants for Pharaoh. And give <hi>us</hi> seed, that we may live and not die, that the land be not desolate.

verses.name: Genesis 47:20
verses.text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them and the land became Pharaoh's.

verses.name: Genesis 47:21
verses.text: And as for the people, he caused them to go into the cities, from <hi>one</hi> end of the borders of Egypt even to the <hi>other</hi> end of it.

verses.name: Genesis 47:22
verses.text: Only he did not buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. Therefore they did not sell their land.

verses.name: Genesis 47:23
verses.text: And Joseph said to the people, Behold, I have bought you this day, and your land, for Pharaoh. Lo, <hi>here is</hi> seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

verses.name: Genesis 47:24
verses.text: And it shall be, as you gather you shall give the fifth <hi>part</hi> to Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for those of your household, and for food for your little ones.

verses.name: Genesis 47:25
verses.text: And they said, You have saved our lives. Let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

verses.name: Genesis 47:26
verses.text: And Joseph made it a law of the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth <hi>part</hi>, excepting only the land of the priests, which did not become Pharaoh's.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:27
verses.text: And Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen. And they had possession in it, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

verses.name: Genesis 47:28
verses.text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. And the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty-seven years.

verses.name: Genesis 47:29
verses.text: And the days of Israel to die drew near. And he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If now I have found grace in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh and deal kindly and truly with me. Please do not bury me in Egypt.

verses.name: Genesis 47:30
verses.text: But I will lie with my fathers. You shall carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burying-place. And he said, I will do according to your words.

verses.name: Genesis 47:31
verses.text: And he said, Swear to me. And he swore to him. And Israel bowed on the head of the bed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:1
verses.text: And it happened after these things, that <hi>one</hi> told Joseph, Behold, your father <hi>is</hi> sick. And he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.name: Genesis 48:2
verses.text: And <hi>one</hi> spoke to Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes to you. And Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

verses.name: Genesis 48:3
verses.text: And Jacob said to Joseph, God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me.

verses.name: Genesis 48:4
verses.text: And He said to me, Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you. And I will make of you a multitude of people, and will give this land to your seed after you <hi>for</hi> an everlasting possession.

verses.name: Genesis 48:5
verses.text: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who are born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, <hi>are</hi> mine; like Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.name: Genesis 48:6
verses.text: And your issue, which you father after them, shall be yours, and shall be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

verses.name: Genesis 48:7
verses.text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan in the way, when <hi>there was</hi> still but a little way to come to Ephrath. And I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; it <hi>is</hi> Bethlehem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:8
verses.text: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who <hi>are</hi> these?

verses.name: Genesis 48:9
verses.text: And Joseph said to his father, They <hi>are</hi> my sons, whom God has given me in this <hi>place</hi>. And he said, please bring them to me, and I will bless them.

verses.name: Genesis 48:10
verses.text: And the eyes of Israel were dim for age; he could not see. And he brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.

verses.name: Genesis 48:11
verses.text: And Israel said to Joseph, I had not thought I would see your face, and, lo, God has showed me also your seed.

verses.name: Genesis 48:12
verses.text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed his face to the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 48:13
verses.text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left, and Manasseh in his left toward Israel's right hand. And he brought <hi>them</hi> near to him.

verses.name: Genesis 48:14
verses.text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid <hi>it</hi> on Ephraim's head, who <hi>was</hi> the younger, and his left on Manasseh's head, crossing his hands. For Manasseh <hi>was</hi> the first-born.

verses.name: Genesis 48:15
verses.text: And he blessed Joseph and said, May God, <hi>before</hi> whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who fed me all my life to this day,

verses.name: Genesis 48:16
verses.text: the Angel who redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads. And let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and let them grow like the fishes into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.name: Genesis 48:17
verses.text: And Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, and it was evil in his eyes. And he held up his father's hand to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

verses.name: Genesis 48:18
verses.text: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father. For this <hi>is</hi> the first-born. Put your right hand on his head.

verses.name: Genesis 48:19
verses.text: And his father refused and said, I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great, but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he is, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.name: Genesis 48:20
verses.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Israel bless, saying, God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh. And he put Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.name: Genesis 48:21
verses.text: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die. But God shall be with you, and bring you again into the land of your fathers.

verses.name: Genesis 48:22
verses.text: And I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:1
verses.text: And Jacob called to his sons and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the days to come.

verses.name: Genesis 49:2
verses.text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel your father.

verses.name: Genesis 49:3
verses.text: Reuben, you <hi>are</hi> my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.

verses.name: Genesis 49:4
verses.text: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father's bed; then you defiled it. He went up to my couch.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:5
verses.text: Simeon and Levi <hi>are</hi> brothers; tools of violence <hi>are</hi> their weapons.

verses.name: Genesis 49:6
verses.text: Oh my soul, do not come into their secret. Let not my honor be united with their assembly. For in their anger they killed a man, and in their self-will they hamstrung a bull.

verses.name: Genesis 49:7
verses.text: Let their anger be cursed, for <hi>it was</hi> fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:8
verses.text: Judah, may your brothers praise you. May your hand <hi>be</hi> in the neck of your enemies. May your father's sons bow before you.

verses.name: Genesis 49:9
verses.text: Judah <hi>is</hi> a lion's whelp. My son, you have gone up from the prey. He stooped, he crouched like a lion; and like a lioness, who shall rouse him?

verses.name: Genesis 49:10
verses.text: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor a Lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come. And the obedience of the peoples to him.

verses.name: Genesis 49:11
verses.text: Binding his foal to the vine, and his ass's colt to the choice vine, he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes.

verses.name: Genesis 49:12
verses.text: His eyes <hi>shall be</hi> sparkling with wine, and his teeth white from milk.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:13
verses.text: Zebulun shall live at the sea shore. And he <hi>shall be</hi> a haven for ships, and his border beside Sidon.

verses.name: Genesis 49:14
verses.text: Issachar <hi>is</hi> a strong ass crouching down between the sheepfolds.

verses.name: Genesis 49:15
verses.text: And he saw that rest <hi>was</hi> good and that the land was pleasant. And he bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a tribute-slave.

verses.name: Genesis 49:16
verses.text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 49:17
verses.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse's heels, so that its rider shall fall backward.

verses.name: Genesis 49:18
verses.text: I have waited for Your salvation, O LORD.

verses.name: Genesis 49:19
verses.text: Gad, raiders shall attack him, and he shall attack <hi>their</hi> heel.

verses.name: Genesis 49:20
verses.text: Out of Asher his bread <hi>shall be</hi> fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

verses.name: Genesis 49:21
verses.text: Naphtali <hi>is</hi> a deer let loose. He gives goodly words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:22
verses.text: Joseph <hi>is</hi> a fruitful son, a fruitful son by a well, whose branches run over the wall.

verses.name: Genesis 49:23
verses.text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot <hi>at him</hi>, and an archer lurks for him.

verses.name: Genesis 49:24
verses.text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob (from the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel);

verses.name: Genesis 49:25
verses.text: by the God of your father, who shall help you. And may the Almighty bless you with blessings of Heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

verses.name: Genesis 49:26
verses.text: The blessings of your father are above the blessings of my ancestors, to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him, the ruler, the leader of his brothers.

verses.name: Genesis 49:27
verses.text: Benjamin is a wolf that tears in pieces. In the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:28
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> the twelve tribes of Israel. And this <hi>is</hi> what their father spoke to them, and blessed them; everyone according to his blessing he blessed them.

verses.name: Genesis 49:29
verses.text: And he charged them and said to them, I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.name: Genesis 49:30
verses.text: in the cave that <hi>is</hi> in the field of Machpelah, which <hi>is</hi> before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, the field which Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite for a burying-place.

verses.name: Genesis 49:31
verses.text: They buried Abraham and his wife Sarah there, and they buried Isaac and his wife Rebekah. And I buried Leah there;

verses.name: Genesis 49:32
verses.text: the purchase of the field and the cave in it, from the sons of Heth.

verses.name: Genesis 49:33
verses.text: And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed. And he expired, and was gathered to his people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:1
verses.text: And Joseph fell on his father's face, and wept on him, and kissed him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:2
verses.text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel.

verses.name: Genesis 50:3
verses.text: And forty days were fulfilled for him, for so are fulfilled the days of those who are embalmed. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

verses.name: Genesis 50:4
verses.text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, I pray you speak in the ears of Pharaoh saying,

verses.name: Genesis 50:5
verses.text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die. You shall bury me in my grave which I have dug for me in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, I pray you, let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.

verses.name: Genesis 50:6
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Go up and bury your father, according as he made you swear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:7
verses.text: And Joseph went up to bury his father. And all the servants of Pharaoh went up with him, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.name: Genesis 50:8
verses.text: and all the house of Joseph, and his brothers, and his father's house. They left only their little ones and their flocks and their herds in the land of Goshen.

verses.name: Genesis 50:9
verses.text: And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. And it was a very great company.

verses.name: Genesis 50:10
verses.text: And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation. And he made a mourning for his father seven days.

verses.name: Genesis 50:11
verses.text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the grain floor of thorns, and they said, This <hi>is</hi> a grievous mourning to the Egyptians. Therefore they called its name, Meadow of Egypt, which <hi>is</hi> beyond Jordan.

verses.name: Genesis 50:12
verses.text: And his sons did to him according as he commanded them.

verses.name: Genesis 50:13
verses.text: For his sons carried him to the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a burying place from Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

verses.name: Genesis 50:14
verses.text: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:15
verses.text: And when Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will perhaps hate us, and will certainly repay us all the evil which we did to him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:16
verses.text: And they sent a message to Joseph, saying, Your father commanded before he died, saying,

verses.name: Genesis 50:17
verses.text: So shall you say to Joseph, please lift up the rebellion of your brothers, and their sin. For they did evil to you. And please now lift up the rebellion of the servants of the God of your father. And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:18
verses.text: And his brothers also went and fell down before his face. And they said, Behold, we <hi>are</hi> your servants.

verses.name: Genesis 50:19
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, Do not fear. For <hi>am</hi> I in the place of God?

verses.name: Genesis 50:20
verses.text: But as for you, you thought evil against me, <hi>but</hi> God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as <hi>it is</hi> this day, to save a great many people alive.

verses.name: Genesis 50:21
verses.text: And now do not fear. I will nourish you and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spoke to their hearts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:22
verses.text: And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father's house. And Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

verses.name: Genesis 50:23
verses.text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's sons of the third <hi>generation</hi>. Also the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh were born on Joseph's knees.

verses.name: Genesis 50:24
verses.text: And Joseph said to his brothers, I die. And God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land into the land which He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.name: Genesis 50:25
verses.text: And Joseph took an oath of the sons of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.

verses.name: Genesis 50:26
verses.text: So Joseph died, <hi>being</hi> a hundred and ten years old. And they embalmed him, and put him in a coffin in Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:1
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt. Every man and his household came with Jacob:

verses.name: Exodus 1:2
verses.text: Reuben; Simeon; Levi; and Judah;

verses.name: Exodus 1:3
verses.text: Issachar; Zebulun; and Benjamin,

verses.name: Exodus 1:4
verses.text: Dan; and Naphtali; Gad; and Asher.

verses.name: Exodus 1:5
verses.text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls, for Joseph was <hi>already</hi> in Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 1:6
verses.text: And Joseph died, and all his brothers, and all that generation.

verses.name: Exodus 1:7
verses.text: And the sons of Israel were fruitful, and increased very much, and multiplied, and became exceedingly mighty. And the land was filled <hi>with</hi> them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:8
verses.text: And there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.

verses.name: Exodus 1:9
verses.text: And he said to his people, Behold, the people of the sons of Israel <hi>are</hi> many and mightier than we.

verses.name: Exodus 1:10
verses.text: Come, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it will be when there comes a war, they join also to our enemies, and fight against us, and get out of the land.

verses.name: Exodus 1:11
verses.text: And they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. And they built treasure cities for Pharaoh, Pithon and Raamses.

verses.name: Exodus 1:12
verses.text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 1:13
verses.text: And the Egyptians made the sons of Israel serve with harshness.

verses.name: Exodus 1:14
verses.text: And they made their lives bitter with hard work in mortar and in bricks, and in all <hi>kinds of</hi> work in the field; all their work in which they made them do <hi>was</hi> with harshness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:15
verses.text: And the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one <hi>was</hi> Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah.

verses.name: Exodus 1:16
verses.text: And he said, When you midwife the Hebrew women, and look on the birth stools, if it <hi>is</hi> a son, then you shall kill him. But if it <hi>is</hi> a daughter, then she shall live.

verses.name: Exodus 1:17
verses.text: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved alive the male children.

verses.name: Exodus 1:18
verses.text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, Why have you done this thing, and have saved the male children alive?

verses.name: Exodus 1:19
verses.text: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women <hi>are</hi> not like the Egyptian women. For they <hi>are</hi> lively, and are delivered before the midwives come in to them.

verses.name: Exodus 1:20
verses.text: And God dealt well with the midwives. And the people multiplied and became very mighty.

verses.name: Exodus 1:21
verses.text: And it happened, because the midwives feared God, <hi>that</hi> He made them houses.

verses.name: Exodus 1:22
verses.text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:1
verses.text: And a man went from the house of Levi and took a daughter of Levi <hi>as his wife</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:2
verses.text: And the woman conceived and bore a son. And when she saw him, that he was beautiful, she hid him three months.

verses.name: Exodus 2:3
verses.text: But when she could no longer hide him, she took an ark of papyrus for him, and daubed it with bitumen and with pitch, and put the child in it. And she laid <hi>it</hi> in the reeds by the river's edge.

verses.name: Exodus 2:4
verses.text: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:5
verses.text: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river. And her maidens walked along by the riverside. And when she saw the ark among the reeds, she sent her slave-girl to bring it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:6
verses.text: And she opened <hi>it</hi>, and she saw the child. And behold, a boy wept. And she had pity on him, and said, This <hi>is</hi> one of the Hebrews' sons.

verses.name: Exodus 2:7
verses.text: And his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call a woman, a nurse of the Hebrew women for you, that she may nurse the child for you?

verses.name: Exodus 2:8
verses.text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the girl went and called <hi>the</hi> child's mother.

verses.name: Exodus 2:9
verses.text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take this child away and nurse it for me, and I will give your wages. And the woman took the child and nursed it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:10
verses.text: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses. And she said, Because I took him out of the water.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:11
verses.text: And it happened in those days, when Moses was grown, he went out to his brothers and looked upon their burdens. And he saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

verses.name: Exodus 2:12
verses.text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he did not see anyone, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

verses.name: Exodus 2:13
verses.text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together. And he said to the guilty one, Why do you strike your neighbor?

verses.name: Exodus 2:14
verses.text: And he said, Who made you as a man, a ruler and a judge over us? Do you intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

verses.name: Exodus 2:15
verses.text: And when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian. And <hi>he</hi> sat down by a well.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:16
verses.text: And the priest of Midian <hi>had</hi> seven daughters. And they came and drew, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:17
verses.text: And the shepherds came and drove them away. But Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:18
verses.text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, Why have you hurried to come today?

verses.name: Exodus 2:19
verses.text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew for us and watered the flock.

verses.name: Exodus 2:20
verses.text: And he said to his daughters, And where <hi>is</hi> he? Why then have you left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.

verses.name: Exodus 2:21
verses.text: And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah.

verses.name: Exodus 2:22
verses.text: And she bore a son, and he called his name Gershom. For he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:23
verses.text: And it happened after many days the king of Egypt died. And the sons of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

verses.name: Exodus 2:24
verses.text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.name: Exodus 2:25
verses.text: And God looked upon the sons of Israel, and God knew <hi>them</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:1
verses.text: And Moses kept the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. And he led the flock to the back side of the desert. And he came to the mountain of God, to Horeb.

verses.name: Exodus 3:2
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to him in a flame of fire, out of the midst of a thorn bush. And he looked. And behold! The thorn bush burned with fire! And the thorn bush <hi>was</hi> not burned up.

verses.name: Exodus 3:3
verses.text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside and see this great sight, why the thorn bush is not burned up.

verses.name: Exodus 3:4
verses.text: And the LORD saw that he had turned aside to see, God called to him out of the midst of the thorn bush, and said, Moses! Moses! And he said, Here I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:5
verses.text: And He said, Do not come near here. Put off your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you stand <hi>is</hi> holy ground.

verses.name: Exodus 3:6
verses.text: And He said, I <hi>am</hi> the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look upon God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:7
verses.text: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of My people who <hi>are</hi> in Egypt; I have heard their cry because of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows.

verses.name: Exodus 3:8
verses.text: And I am coming down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, to bring them up out of that land, to a good land, a large land, to a land flowing <hi>with</hi> milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites and the Jebusites.

verses.name: Exodus 3:9
verses.text: And now behold, the cry of the sons of Israel has come to Me. And I have also seen the oppression <hi>with</hi> which the Egyptians oppress them.

verses.name: Exodus 3:10
verses.text: And now go, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring forth My people, the sons of Israel, out of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:11
verses.text: And Moses said to God, Who <hi>am</hi> I that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the sons of Israel out of Egypt?

verses.name: Exodus 3:12
verses.text: And He said, I will be with you. And this <hi>shall be</hi> the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought forth the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God upon this mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 3:13
verses.text: And Moses said to God, Behold, <hi>when</hi> I come to the sons of Israel, and shall say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you, and they shall say to me, What <hi>is</hi> His name? What shall I say to them?

verses.name: Exodus 3:14
verses.text: And God said to Moses, I AM THAT I AM. And He said, So you shall say to the sons of Israel, I AM has sent me to you.

verses.name: Exodus 3:15
verses.text: And God said to Moses again, You shall say this to the sons of Israel, Jehovah the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you. This <hi>is</hi> My name forever, and this <hi>is</hi> My title from generation to generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:16
verses.text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel and say to them, Jehovah the God of your fathers has appeared to me, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I have surely visited you and <hi>have seen what</hi> is done to you in Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 3:17
verses.text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Exodus 3:18
verses.text: And they shall listen to your voice. And you shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt. And you shall say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews has met with us. And now let us go, we beseech you, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

verses.name: Exodus 3:19
verses.text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

verses.name: Exodus 3:20
verses.text: And I will stretch out My hand and smite Egypt with all My wonders which I will do in the midst of it. And after that he will let you go.

verses.name: Exodus 3:21
verses.text: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. And it shall be that when you go, you shall not go empty.

verses.name: Exodus 3:22
verses.text: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her that stays in her house, jewels of silver and jewels of gold and clothing. And you shall put <hi>them</hi> upon your sons and upon your daughters. And you shall plunder the Egyptians.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:1
verses.text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me nor listen to my voice. For they will say, The LORD has not appeared to you.

verses.name: Exodus 4:2
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, What <hi>is</hi> this in your hand? And he said, A staff.

verses.name: Exodus 4:3
verses.text: And He said, Throw it on the ground. And he threw it on the ground. And it became a serpent. And Moses ran from it.

verses.name: Exodus 4:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Put forth your hand and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand and caught it, and it became a staff in his hand, --

verses.name: Exodus 4:5
verses.text: so that they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.

verses.name: Exodus 4:6
verses.text: And the LORD said to him again, Now put your hand in your bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom. And when he took it out, behold, his hand <hi>was</hi> as leprous as snow.

verses.name: Exodus 4:7
verses.text: And He said, Put your hand into your bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again. And he brought it out of his bosom, and behold, it was turned again like his <hi>other</hi> flesh.

verses.name: Exodus 4:8
verses.text: And it will be, if they will not believe you, neither listen to the voice of the first sign, then they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

verses.name: Exodus 4:9
verses.text: And also it will be, if they will not believe these two signs, neither listen to your voice, then you shall take from the water of the river and pour <hi>it</hi> upon the dry land. And the water which you take out of the river shall become blood on the dry land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:10
verses.text: And Moses said to the LORD, O my Lord, I <hi>am</hi> not a man of words now, nor since You have spoken to Your servant, but I <hi>am</hi> slow of speech and of a slow tongue.

verses.name: Exodus 4:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Who has made man's mouth? Or who makes the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? Have not I, the LORD?

verses.name: Exodus 4:12
verses.text: And now go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you shall say.

verses.name: Exodus 4:13
verses.text: And he said, O my Lord, I pray You, send by the hand <hi>of him whom</hi> You will send.

verses.name: Exodus 4:14
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses. And He said, Do I not know Aaron the Levite, your brother that he can speak well? And also, behold, he comes forth to meet you. And when he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

verses.name: Exodus 4:15
verses.text: And you shall speak to him, and you shall put words in his mouth. And I will be with your mouth and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

verses.name: Exodus 4:16
verses.text: And it will be, he shall speak for you to the people, and he shall be for a mouth to you. And you shall be to him a god.

verses.name: Exodus 4:17
verses.text: And you shall take this rod in your hand, <hi>with</hi> which you shall do signs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:18
verses.text: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, Please let me go and return to my brothers who <hi>are</hi> in Egypt and see if they <hi>are</hi> still alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

verses.name: Exodus 4:19
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses in Midian, Go! Return to Egypt, for all the men who sought your life are dead.

verses.name: Exodus 4:20
verses.text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt. And Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

verses.name: Exodus 4:21
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, When you go to return into Egypt, see that you do all those wonders which I have put in your hand before Pharaoh; but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

verses.name: Exodus 4:22
verses.text: And you shall say to Pharaoh, Thus says the Lord: Israel <hi>is</hi> My son, My first-born.

verses.name: Exodus 4:23
verses.text: And I say to you, Let My son go, that he may serve Me. And if you refuse to let him go, behold, I <hi>am</hi> going to kill your son, your first-born.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:24
verses.text: And it happened by the way, in the inn, that the LORD met him and sought to kill him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:25
verses.text: And Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and threw <hi>it</hi> at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband you <hi>are</hi> to me.

verses.name: Exodus 4:26
verses.text: So He let him go. Then she said, <hi>You are</hi> a bloody husband, because of the circumcision.

verses.name: Exodus 4:27
verses.text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:28
verses.text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which He had commanded him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:29
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 4:30
verses.text: And Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

verses.name: Exodus 4:31
verses.text: And the people believed. And when they heard that the LORD had visited the sons of Israel, and that He had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed and worshiped.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:1
verses.text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in and told Pharaoh, Thus says Jehovah, God of Israel: Let My people go, that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.

verses.name: Exodus 5:2
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Who <hi>is</hi> Jehovah, that I should obey His voice to let Israel go? I do not know Jehovah, neither will I let Israel go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:3
verses.text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Let us go, we pray you, three days' journey into the desert and sacrifice to the LORD our God, lest He fall upon us with plague or with the sword.

verses.name: Exodus 5:4
verses.text: And the king of Egypt said to them, Moses and Aaron, why do you keep the people from their work? Get to your burdens!

verses.name: Exodus 5:5
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now <hi>are</hi> many, and you make them rest from their burdens.

verses.name: Exodus 5:6
verses.text: And Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers the same day, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 5:7
verses.text: You shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 5:8
verses.text: And you shall lay upon them the number of bricks which they have made before now. You shall not take away from it. For they are idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go sacrifice to our God.

verses.name: Exodus 5:9
verses.text: Let more work be laid upon the men, and let them labor in it. And do not let them regard vain words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:10
verses.text: And the taskmasters of the people and their officers went out. And they spoke to the people, saying, So says Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:11
verses.text: Go and get straw where you can find it, yet not any of your work shall be taken away.

verses.name: Exodus 5:12
verses.text: So the people were scattered through all the land of Egypt, to gather stubble for straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:13
verses.text: And the taskmasters hurried <hi>them</hi>, saying, Finish your works, the thing of a day, just as when there was straw.

verses.name: Exodus 5:14
verses.text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel, whom Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten. <hi>And they</hi> demanded, Why have you not completed your task in making brick, both yesterday and today, as you did before?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:15
verses.text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, Why do you deal so with your servants?

verses.name: Exodus 5:16
verses.text: There is no straw given to your servants, and they say to us, Make bricks! And behold, your servants <hi>are</hi> beaten, but the fault is in your own people.

verses.name: Exodus 5:17
verses.text: But he said, You <hi>are</hi> idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, Let us go, let us sacrifice to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 5:18
verses.text: Therefore go now <hi>and</hi> work, for there shall be no straw given to you; yet you shall deliver the number of bricks.

verses.name: Exodus 5:19
verses.text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel saw themselves in affliction, after it was said, You shall not take away from your bricks of your daily task.

verses.name: Exodus 5:20
verses.text: And they met Moses and Aaron standing in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh.

verses.name: Exodus 5:21
verses.text: And they said to them, The LORD look upon you and judge, because you have made our smell to stink in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hands to kill us.

verses.name: Exodus 5:22
verses.text: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, Lord, why have You treated this people ill? Why then have you sent me?

verses.name: Exodus 5:23
verses.text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has done evil to this people. Neither have You delivered Your people at all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand he shall let them go, and with a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 6:2
verses.text: And God spoke to Moses, and said to him, I am Jehovah.

verses.name: Exodus 6:3
verses.text: And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob <hi>as</hi> God Almighty. But I was not known to them <hi>by</hi> the name JEHOVAH.

verses.name: Exodus 6:4
verses.text: And I also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.

verses.name: Exodus 6:5
verses.text: And I have also heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, those whom the Egyptians are keeping in bondage. And I have remembered My covenant.

verses.name: Exodus 6:6
verses.text: Therefore say to the sons of Israel, I <hi>am</hi> Jehovah, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rescue you out of their bondage. And I will redeem you with a stretched-out arm, and with great judgments.

verses.name: Exodus 6:7
verses.text: And I will take you to Me for a people, and I will be to you a God. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 6:8
verses.text: And I will bring you in to the land concerning which I lifted up My hand to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. And I will give it to you for a heritage. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD!

verses.name: Exodus 6:9
verses.text: And Moses said so to the sons of Israel. But they did not listen to Moses through shortness of spirit and through cruel bondage.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:10
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 6:11
verses.text: Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the sons of Israel go out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 6:12
verses.text: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, Behold, the sons of Israel have not listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh hear me, since I have lips that are not circumcised?

verses.name: Exodus 6:13
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a charge to the sons of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:14
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These <hi>were</hi> the families of Reuben.

verses.name: Exodus 6:15
verses.text: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanitess. These <hi>were</hi> the families of Simeon.

verses.name: Exodus 6:16
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the names of the sons of Levi, according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi <hi>were</hi> a hundred and thirty-seven years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:17
verses.text: The sons of Gershon: Libni, and Shimei, by their families.

verses.name: Exodus 6:18
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath <hi>were</hi> a hundred and thirty-three years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:19
verses.text: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These <hi>were</hi> the families of Levi according to their generations.

verses.name: Exodus 6:20
verses.text: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, for his wife. And she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram <hi>were</hi> a hundred and thirty-seven years.

verses.name: Exodus 6:21
verses.text: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

verses.name: Exodus 6:22
verses.text: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

verses.name: Exodus 6:23
verses.text: And Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, for his wife. And she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.name: Exodus 6:24
verses.text: And the sons of Korah <hi>were</hi> Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These <hi>were</hi> the families of the Korahites.

verses.name: Exodus 6:25
verses.text: And Aaron's son Eleazar took his wife of the daughters of Putiel. And she bore him Phinehas. These <hi>were</hi> the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

verses.name: Exodus 6:26
verses.text: It <hi>was</hi> Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

verses.name: Exodus 6:27
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt. It was Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Exodus 6:28
verses.text: And it happened on the day the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt:

verses.name: Exodus 6:29
verses.text: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD. You speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you.

verses.name: Exodus 6:30
verses.text: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> of uncircumcised lips, and how <hi>shall</hi> Pharaoh listen to me?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, See, I have made you a god to Pharaoh. And Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

verses.name: Exodus 7:2
verses.text: You shall speak all that I command you. And Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, he will send the sons of Israel out of his land.

verses.name: Exodus 7:3
verses.text: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart and multiply My signs and My wonders in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 7:4
verses.text: But Pharaoh shall not listen to you, and I will lay My hand upon Egypt, and bring My armies, My people the sons of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

verses.name: Exodus 7:5
verses.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD when I stretch forth My hand upon Egypt, and bring out the sons of Israel from among them.

verses.name: Exodus 7:6
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them; so they did.

verses.name: Exodus 7:7
verses.text: And Moses <hi>was</hi> eighty years old, and Aaron <hi>was</hi> eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:8
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:

verses.name: Exodus 7:9
verses.text: When Pharaoh shall speak to you saying, Give a miracle for yourselves, you shall say to Aaron, Take your rod, and throw <hi>it</hi> in front of Pharaoh. It shall become a snake.

verses.name: Exodus 7:10
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh. And they did so, as the LORD had commanded. And Aaron threw down his rod in front of Pharaoh and in front of his servants, and it became a snake.

verses.name: Exodus 7:11
verses.text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers. And they, the priests of Egypt, did the same with their secret arts.

verses.name: Exodus 7:12
verses.text: For each man threw down his rod, and they became snakes. But Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

verses.name: Exodus 7:13
verses.text: And He hardened Pharaoh's heart so that he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh's heart <hi>is</hi> hardened. He refuses to let the people go.

verses.name: Exodus 7:15
verses.text: You go to Pharaoh in the morning. Lo, he goes out to the water. And you shall stand by the river's brink until he comes. And you shall take in your hand the rod which was turned to a snake.

verses.name: Exodus 7:16
verses.text: And you shall say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews has sent me to you, saying, Let My people go so that they may serve Me in the wilderness. And, behold, until now you would not hear.

verses.name: Exodus 7:17
verses.text: Thus says the LORD, In this you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD. Behold! I will smite with the rod that <hi>is</hi> in my hand upon the waters in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

verses.name: Exodus 7:18
verses.text: And the fish in the river shall die, and the river shall stink. And the Egyptians shall hate to drink of the water of the river.

verses.name: Exodus 7:19
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron, Take your rod, and stretch out your hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their canals, and upon their pools, and upon every reservoir of their waters, <hi>that</hi> they may become blood. And blood shall be throughout all the land of Egypt, both in wooden and in stone <hi>vessels</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:20
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded. And he lifted up the rod and struck the waters that <hi>were</hi> in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants. And all the waters in the river were turned to blood.

verses.name: Exodus 7:21
verses.text: And the fish in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river. And there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 7:22
verses.text: And the priests of Egypt did so with their secret arts. And Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.

verses.name: Exodus 7:23
verses.text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house; And he did not set his heart to this also.

verses.name: Exodus 7:24
verses.text: And all the Egyptians dug all around the river for water to drink, for they could not drink of the water of the river.

verses.name: Exodus 7:25
verses.text: And seven days were completed after the LORD had stricken the river.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Go to Pharaoh, and say to him: Thus says the LORD, Let my people go so that they may serve Me.

verses.name: Exodus 8:2
verses.text: And if you refuse to let <hi>them</hi> go, behold, I <hi>am</hi> going to strike all your borders <hi>with</hi> frogs.

verses.name: Exodus 8:3
verses.text: And the river shall bring forth frogs plentifully, which shall go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and upon your bed, and into the house of your servants, and upon your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

verses.name: Exodus 8:4
verses.text: And the frogs shall come upon you, and upon your people, and upon all your servants.

verses.name: Exodus 8:5
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron: Stretch out your hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 8:6
verses.text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 8:7
verses.text: And the priests did so with their secret arts, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 8:8
verses.text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Pray to the LORD that He may take away the frogs from me and from my people. And I will let the people go, so that they may sacrifice to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 8:9
verses.text: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Glory over me! When shall I pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, to destroy the frogs from you and your houses, so <hi>that</hi> they may remain in the river only?

verses.name: Exodus 8:10
verses.text: And he said, Tomorrow. And he said, It shall be according to your word, so that you may know that <hi>there is</hi> none like the LORD our God.

verses.name: Exodus 8:11
verses.text: And the frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.

verses.name: Exodus 8:12
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh. And Moses cried to the LORD because of the frogs which He had brought against Pharaoh.

verses.name: Exodus 8:13
verses.text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses. And the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

verses.name: Exodus 8:14
verses.text: And they gathered them in heaps <hi>and</hi> heaps. And the land stank.

verses.name: Exodus 8:15
verses.text: But Pharaoh saw that <hi>there</hi> was relief, and he hardened his heart, and did not listen to them, even as the LORD had said.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:16
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Say to Aaron: Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the land, so that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 8:17
verses.text: And they did so. For Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod and struck the dust of the earth. And it became lice in man and in beast. All the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 8:18
verses.text: And the priests did so with their secret arts to bring forth lice, but they could not. So there were lice upon man and upon beast.

verses.name: Exodus 8:19
verses.text: And the priests said to Pharaoh, This <hi>is</hi> the finger of God. And Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:20
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise up early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh. Lo, he comes forth to the water. And say to him, Thus says the LORD: Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

verses.name: Exodus 8:21
verses.text: And if you will not let My people go, behold, I will send swarms <hi>of flies</hi> on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your house. And the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms <hi>of flies</hi>, and also the ground on which they <hi>are</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:22
verses.text: And in that day I will cut off the land of Goshen, in which My people live, so that no swarms <hi>of flies</hi> shall be there, so that you may know that I <hi>am</hi> Jehovah in the midst of the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 8:23
verses.text: And I will put a dividing line between My people and your people. This miracle shall be tomorrow.

verses.name: Exodus 8:24
verses.text: And the LORD did so. And teeming swarms <hi>of flies</hi> came into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt. The land was destroyed because of the swarms.

verses.name: Exodus 8:25
verses.text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go sacrifice to your God in the land.

verses.name: Exodus 8:26
verses.text: And Moses said, It is not right to do so, for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

verses.name: Exodus 8:27
verses.text: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and. sacrifice to the LORD our God, as He shall command us.

verses.name: Exodus 8:28
verses.text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go so that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness. Only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.

verses.name: Exodus 8:29
verses.text: And Moses said, Behold, I will go out from you, and I will pray to the LORD that the swarms <hi>of flies</hi> may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow. But do not let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 8:30
verses.text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 8:31
verses.text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses. And He removed the swarms from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

verses.name: Exodus 8:32
verses.text: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh and tell him, Thus says the LORD God of the Hebrews: Let My people go so that they may serve Me.

verses.name: Exodus 9:2
verses.text: For if you refuse to let <hi>them</hi> go, and will hold them still,

verses.name: Exodus 9:3
verses.text: behold, the hand of the LORD is upon your cattle in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep, a very grievous plague.

verses.name: Exodus 9:4
verses.text: And the LORD shall separate between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt. And there shall nothing die of all <hi>that belongs</hi> to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 9:5
verses.text: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

verses.name: Exodus 9:6
verses.text: And the LORD did that thing on the next day, and all the cattle of Egypt died. But of the cattle of the sons of Israel, not one died.

verses.name: Exodus 9:7
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:8
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, Take to yourselves handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

verses.name: Exodus 9:9
verses.text: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth <hi>with</hi> sores upon man and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 9:10
verses.text: And they took ashes of the furnace and stood before Pharaoh. And Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky, and it became a boil breaking forth <hi>with</hi> sores upon man and upon beast.

verses.name: Exodus 9:11
verses.text: And the priests could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boil was upon the priests and upon all the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 9:12
verses.text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he did not listen to them, even as the LORD had spoken to Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:13
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say to him, So says the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

verses.name: Exodus 9:14
verses.text: For I <hi>am</hi> going to send at this time all My plagues upon your heart, and upon your servants, and upon your people, so that you may know that <hi>there is</hi> none like Me in all the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 9:15
verses.text: For now I will stretch out My hand, that I may strike you and your people with plagues, and you shall be cut off from the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 9:16
verses.text: And for this I have made you stand, to make you see My power, to declare My name in all the land.

verses.name: Exodus 9:17
verses.text: Do you still exalt yourself against My people, that you will not let them go?

verses.name: Exodus 9:18
verses.text: Behold! Tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, <hi>such as</hi> has not been in Egypt since the foundation of it even until now!

verses.name: Exodus 9:19
verses.text: And now send out, gather your cattle, and all that you have in the field. Upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

verses.name: Exodus 9:20
verses.text: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle to flee into the houses.

verses.name: Exodus 9:21
verses.text: And he that did not regard the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:22
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch forth your hand toward heaven, so that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 9:23
verses.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heavens. And the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire came down to the ground. And the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 9:24
verses.text: And <hi>there</hi> was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

verses.name: Exodus 9:25
verses.text: And the hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that <hi>was</hi> in the field, both man and beast. And the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

verses.name: Exodus 9:26
verses.text: Only in the land of Goshen, where the sons of Israel <hi>were</hi>, was there no hail.

verses.name: Exodus 9:27
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, I have sinned <hi>this</hi> time. Jehovah <hi>is</hi> righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

verses.name: Exodus 9:28
verses.text: Pray to the LORD, <hi>for it is</hi> enough. Let there be no mighty thunderings and hail. And I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.

verses.name: Exodus 9:29
verses.text: And Moses said to him, as soon as I go out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands to the LORD. The thunder shall stop, and the hail will not be any more, so that you may know that the earth is the LORD's.

verses.name: Exodus 9:30
verses.text: But <hi>as for</hi> you and your servants, I know that you will not yet fear the LORD God.

verses.name: Exodus 9:31
verses.text: And the flax and the barley <hi>were</hi> stricken, for the barley was in the head, and the flax was in bud.

verses.name: Exodus 9:32
verses.text: But the wheat and the rye were not stricken, for they had not grown up.

verses.name: Exodus 9:33
verses.text: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands to the LORD. And the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 9:34
verses.text: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned still more and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

verses.name: Exodus 9:35
verses.text: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the sons of Israel go, even as the LORD had spoken by Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:1
