verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, so that I might show these My signs before him,

verses.name: Exodus 10:2
verses.text: and so that you may tell in the ears of your son, and of your son's sons, what things I have worked in Egypt, and My signs which I have done among them, so that you may know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 10:3
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron came in to Pharaoh and said to him, So says the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long will you refuse to humble yourself before Me? Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

verses.name: Exodus 10:4
verses.text: For if you refuse to let My people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring the locusts into your coast.

verses.name: Exodus 10:5
verses.text: And they shall cover the face of the land, so that one cannot be able to see the earth. And they shall eat the rest of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

verses.name: Exodus 10:6
verses.text: And they shall fill your houses, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, which neither your fathers, nor your fathers' fathers have seen, since the day they were upon the earth until this day. And he turned himself and went out from Pharaoh.

verses.name: Exodus 10:7
verses.text: And Pharaoh's servants said to him, How long shall this man be a snare to us? Let the men go so that they may serve the LORD their God. Do you not yet know that Egypt is destroyed?

verses.name: Exodus 10:8
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, Go! Serve the LORD your God. Who <hi>are</hi> the ones that shall go?

verses.name: Exodus 10:9
verses.text: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters. We will go with our flocks and with our herds. For we <hi>must hold</hi> a feast to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 10:10
verses.text: And he said to them, May the LORD be so with you, as I send you and your little ones away. Watch out, for evil <hi>is</hi> before you.

verses.name: Exodus 10:11
verses.text: Not so! You men go now and serve the LORD, for it is you who did desire it. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:12
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt and eat every herb of the land, all that the hail has left.

verses.name: Exodus 10:13
verses.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day and all the night. When it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

verses.name: Exodus 10:14
verses.text: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt and rested in all the coasts of Egypt, very numerous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

verses.name: Exodus 10:15
verses.text: For they covered the face of the whole earth so that the land was darkened. And they ate every herb of the land and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. And there did not remain any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 10:16
verses.text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste. And he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

verses.name: Exodus 10:17
verses.text: And now please, forgive my sin only this once, and pray to the LORD your God, that He may take away from me this death only.

verses.name: Exodus 10:18
verses.text: And he went out from Pharaoh, and prayed <hi>to</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 10:19
verses.text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts and threw them into the Red Sea. There did not remain one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 10:20
verses.text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he did not let the sons of Israel go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:21
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand toward the heavens, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, so that one may even feel the darkness.

verses.name: Exodus 10:22
verses.text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven. And there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days.

verses.name: Exodus 10:23
verses.text: They did not see one another, nor did any rise from his place, <hi>for</hi> three days. But all the sons of Israel had light in their dwellings.

verses.name: Exodus 10:24
verses.text: And Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, You go serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds be left. Let your little ones also go with you.

verses.name: Exodus 10:25
verses.text: And Moses said, You must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

verses.name: Exodus 10:26
verses.text: Our cattle also shall go with us. There shall not be a hoof left behind. For we must take from them to serve the LORD our God. And we do not know <hi>with</hi> what we must serve the LORD until we come there.

verses.name: Exodus 10:27
verses.text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

verses.name: Exodus 10:28
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to him, Go away from me! Take heed to yourself; see my face no more. For in the day you see my face you shall die.

verses.name: Exodus 10:29
verses.text: And Moses said, You have spoken well. I will never see your face again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, I will still bring one plague yet on Pharaoh and on Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out from here altogether.

verses.name: Exodus 11:2
verses.text: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow from his neighbor, and every woman from her neighbor, articles of silver and jewels of gold.

verses.name: Exodus 11:3
verses.text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. And the man Moses <hi>was</hi> very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:4
verses.text: And Moses said, Thus says the LORD: About midnight I will go out into the midst of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 11:5
verses.text: And all the first-born in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first-born of Pharaoh that sits upon his throne, even to the first-born of the slave-girl that <hi>is</hi> behind the mill; also the first-born of beasts.

verses.name: Exodus 11:6
verses.text: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

verses.name: Exodus 11:7
verses.text: But against any of the sons of Israel not even a dog shall move his tongue, against man or beast, so that you may know that the LORD puts a difference <hi>between</hi> the Egyptians and Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 11:8
verses.text: And all these, your servants, shall come down to me and bow themselves down to me, saying, You and all the people that follow you get out. And after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

verses.name: Exodus 11:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh shall not listen to you, so that My wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 11:10
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh. And the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart so that he would not let the sons of Israel go out of his land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 12:2
verses.text: This month <hi>shall be</hi> to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:3
verses.text: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth of this month they shall take to them each man a lamb for a father's house, a lamb for a house.

verses.name: Exodus 12:4
verses.text: And if the household is too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbor next to his house take according to the number of the souls, each one, according to the eating of his mouth, you shall count concerning the lamb.

verses.name: Exodus 12:5
verses.text: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year. You shall take from the sheep or from the goats.

verses.name: Exodus 12:6
verses.text: And you shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month. And the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

verses.name: Exodus 12:7
verses.text: And they shall take of the blood and strike on the two side posts and upon the upper door post of the houses <hi>in</hi> which they shall eat it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:8
verses.text: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened <hi>bread</hi>. They shall eat it with <hi>bitter</hi> herbs.

verses.name: Exodus 12:9
verses.text: Do not eat of it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted <hi>with</hi> fire, its head with its legs, and with its inward parts.

verses.name: Exodus 12:10
verses.text: And you shall not let any of it remain until the morning. And that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

verses.name: Exodus 12:11
verses.text: And you shall eat of it this way, <hi>with</hi> your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. And you shall eat it in a hurry. It <hi>is</hi> the LORD's passover.

verses.name: Exodus 12:12
verses.text: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the first-born in the land of Egypt, both man and beast. And I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 12:13
verses.text: And the blood shall be a sign to you upon the houses where you <hi>are</hi>. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you. And the plague shall not be upon you for a destruction when I smite in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 12:14
verses.text: And this day shall be a memorial to you. And you shall keep it as a feast to the LORD throughout your generations. You shall keep it <hi>as</hi> a feast by a law forever.

verses.name: Exodus 12:15
verses.text: You shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi> seven days; even the first day you shall put away leaven out of your houses. For whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 12:16
verses.text: And on the first day <hi>shall be</hi> a holy gathering, and in the seventh day there shall be a holy gathering for you. No manner of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, that only may be done by you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:17
verses.text: And you shall keep the <hi>Feast of</hi> Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>. For in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall keep this day in your generations by a law forever.

verses.name: Exodus 12:18
verses.text: In the first <hi>month</hi>, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi>, until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.

verses.name: Exodus 12:19
verses.text: Seven days there shall be no leaven found in your houses. For whoever eats that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, among the aliens and among the natives of the land.

verses.name: Exodus 12:20
verses.text: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your dwelling-places you shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:21
verses.text: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel and said to them, Draw out and take a lamb for yourselves according to your families, and kill the passover.

verses.name: Exodus 12:22
verses.text: And you shall take a bunch of hyssop and dip in the blood in the bowl, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood in the bowl. And none of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 12:23
verses.text: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians. And when He sees the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come into your houses to strike you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:24
verses.text: And you shall observe this thing for a law to you and to your sons forever.

verses.name: Exodus 12:25
verses.text: And it shall be, when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as He has promised, that you shall keep this service.

verses.name: Exodus 12:26
verses.text: And it will be, when your sons shall say to you, What is this service to you?

verses.name: Exodus 12:27
verses.text: Then you shall say, It <hi>is</hi> the sacrifice of the LORD's passover, who passed over the houses of the sons of Israel in Egypt, when He struck the Egyptians and delivered our houses. And the people bowed and worshiped.

verses.name: Exodus 12:28
verses.text: And the sons of Israel went away and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron; so they did.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:29
verses.text: And it happened at midnight the LORD struck all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the first-born of Pharaoh that sat on his throne to the first-born of the captive that <hi>was</hi> in the prison; also all the first-born of cattle.

verses.name: Exodus 12:30
verses.text: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants, and all the Egyptians. And there was a great cry in Egypt, for <hi>there was</hi> not a house where there was not one dead.

verses.name: Exodus 12:31
verses.text: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up! Get away from my people, both you and the sons of Israel! And go serve the LORD, as you have said.

verses.name: Exodus 12:32
verses.text: Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and go. And bless me also.

verses.name: Exodus 12:33
verses.text: And the Egyptians were urging the people, that they might send them out of the land in a hurry. For they said, We <hi>are</hi> all dead.

verses.name: Exodus 12:34
verses.text: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading-troughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

verses.name: Exodus 12:35
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did according to the word of Moses. And they borrowed articles of silver, and articles of gold, and clothing from the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 12:36
verses.text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and they granted their request, and they plundered the Egyptians.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:37
verses.text: And the sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, the men being about six hundred thousand men on foot, apart from little ones.

verses.name: Exodus 12:38
verses.text: And also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks, and herds, very much cattle.

verses.name: Exodus 12:39
verses.text: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt, for it was not leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt and could not stay, neither had they prepared any food for a journey for themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 12:40
verses.text: And the time that the sons of Israel lived in Egypt <hi>was</hi> four hundred and thirty years.

verses.name: Exodus 12:41
verses.text: And it happened at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even it was on this very day, all the armies of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 12:42
verses.text: It <hi>is</hi> a night to be much kept to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This <hi>is</hi> that night of the LORD to be kept by all the sons of Israel in their generations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:43
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, This <hi>is</hi> the ordinance of the Passover. No stranger shall eat of it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:44
verses.text: But every man's servant that is bought for silver, when you have circumcised him, then he shall eat of it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:45
verses.text: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:46
verses.text: It shall be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the flesh out of the house. Neither shall you break a bone of it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:47
verses.text: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:48
verses.text: And when a stranger shall stay with you, and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. And he shall be as one that is born in the land. And no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:49
verses.text: There shall be one law to the native, and to the visitor that stays among you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:50
verses.text: So all the sons of Israel did. Even as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

verses.name: Exodus 12:51
verses.text: And it happened the very same day, <hi>that</hi> the LORD brought the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 13:2
verses.text: Sanctify all the first-born to Me, whatever opens the womb among the sons of Israel, of man and of beast. It <hi>is</hi> Mine.

verses.name: Exodus 13:3
verses.text: And Moses said to the people, Remember this day <hi>in</hi> which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. For the LORD brought you out from this place by the strength of His hand. There shall be no leavened bread eaten.

verses.name: Exodus 13:4
verses.text: You are going out this day in the month Abib.

verses.name: Exodus 13:5
verses.text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

verses.name: Exodus 13:6
verses.text: You shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi> seven days, and in the seventh day <hi>shall be</hi> a feast to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 13:7
verses.text: Unleavened <hi>bread</hi> shall be eaten seven days. And there shall be no leavened <hi>bread</hi> seen with you, nor shall there be leaven seen with you in all your borders.

verses.name: Exodus 13:8
verses.text: And you shall tell your son in that day, saying, This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out from Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 13:9
verses.text: And it shall be a sign to you upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD's law may be in your mouth. For the Lord has brought you out of Egypt with a strong hand.

verses.name: Exodus 13:10
verses.text: You shall therefore keep this law in its season from year to year.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:11
verses.text: And it will be, when the LORD shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, as He swore to you and to your fathers, and shall give it to you,

verses.name: Exodus 13:12
verses.text: you shall set apart to the LORD every one that opens the womb, and every first-born that comes of any animal which you have; the males <hi>shall be</hi> the LORD's.

verses.name: Exodus 13:13
verses.text: And every first-born of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb. And if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. And all the first-born of man among your sons you shall redeem.

verses.name: Exodus 13:14
verses.text: And it shall be when your sons asks you in time to come, saying, What <hi>is</hi> this? you shall say to him, The LORD brought us out of Egypt by the strength of <hi>His</hi> hand, from the house of bondage.

verses.name: Exodus 13:15
verses.text: And it happened when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, the LORD killed all the first-born of the land of Egypt, both the first-born of man, and the first-born of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, that are males. But all the first-born of my sons I redeem.

verses.name: Exodus 13:16
verses.text: And it shall be for a token upon your hand, and for frontlets between your eyes. For the LORD brought us out from Egypt by strength of <hi>His</hi> hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:17
verses.text: And it happened, when Pharaoh had let the people go, God did not lead them <hi>by</hi> the way of the land of the Philistines although that <hi>was</hi> near. For God said, Lest the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 13:18
verses.text: But God led the people around, <hi>by</hi> the way of the wilderness of the Red Sea. And the sons of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 13:19
verses.text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him. For he had strictly sworn the sons of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and you shall carry my bones away from here with you.

verses.name: Exodus 13:20
verses.text: And they moved from Succoth and camped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.name: Exodus 13:21
verses.text: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the right away, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, to go by day and night.

verses.name: Exodus 13:22
verses.text: He did not take away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, <hi>from</hi> before the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 14:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel that they turn and camp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon. You shall camp before <hi>it</hi>, by the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 14:3
verses.text: For Pharaoh will say of the sons of Israel, They <hi>are</hi> tangled in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.

verses.name: Exodus 14:4
verses.text: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he will follow them. And I will be honored upon Pharaoh, and upon all his army, so that the Egyptians may know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD. And they did so.

verses.name: Exodus 14:5
verses.text: And the king of Egypt was told that the people fled. And the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people. And they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

verses.name: Exodus 14:6
verses.text: And he made his chariot ready, and took his people with him.

verses.name: Exodus 14:7
verses.text: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

verses.name: Exodus 14:8
verses.text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And he pursued the sons of Israel, and the sons of Israel went out with a high hand.

verses.name: Exodus 14:9
verses.text: But the Egyptians pursued them, all the horses <hi>and</hi> chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army. And they overtook them camping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal-zephon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:10
verses.text: And Pharaoh drew near, the sons of Israel lifted up their eyes. And, behold, the Egyptians marched after them. And they were very afraid. And the sons of Israel cried out to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 14:11
verses.text: And they said to Moses, Have you taken us away to die in the wilderness because <hi>there were</hi> no graves in Egypt? Why have you dealt this way with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

verses.name: Exodus 14:12
verses.text: Did we not tell you this word in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, so that we may serve the Egyptians? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

verses.name: Exodus 14:13
verses.text: And Moses said to the people, Do not fear. Stand still and see the salvation of the LORD, which He will prepare for you this day. For the Egyptians whom you have seen today, you shall never see them anymore.

verses.name: Exodus 14:14
verses.text: The LORD shall fight for you, and you shall be silent.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:15
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Why do you cry to Me? Speak to the sons of Israel, that they go forward.

verses.name: Exodus 14:16
verses.text: But lift up your rod and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it. And the sons of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 14:17
verses.text: And behold! I <hi>am</hi> about to harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them. And I will get honor for Me upon Pharaoh, and upon all his army, upon his chariots and upon his horsemen.

verses.name: Exodus 14:18
verses.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD when I have gotten honor for Me upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

verses.name: Exodus 14:19
verses.text: And the Angel of God, the one who went before the camp of Israel, moved. And he went to the rear of them. And the pillar of the cloud went from in front of their face and it stood behind them.

verses.name: Exodus 14:20
verses.text: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel. And it was a cloudy and dark night, but it gave light to the night, so that the one did not come near the other all night.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:21
verses.text: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea. And the LORD caused the sea to recede by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

verses.name: Exodus 14:22
verses.text: And the sons of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground. And the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

verses.name: Exodus 14:23
verses.text: And the Egyptians pursued and went after them to the middle of the sea, all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.name: Exodus 14:24
verses.text: And in the morning watch it happened that the LORD looked to the army of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the army of the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 14:25
verses.text: And He took off their chariot wheels, and made them go heavily, so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 14:26
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

verses.name: Exodus 14:27
verses.text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea. And the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared. And the Egyptians fled against it. And the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 14:28
verses.text: And the waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen, all the army of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them. There did not remain so much as one of them.

verses.name: Exodus 14:29
verses.text: But the sons of Israel walked upon dry land in the middle of the sea. And the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

verses.name: Exodus 14:30
verses.text: So the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians. And Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the seashore.

verses.name: Exodus 14:31
verses.text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians. And the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD and His servant Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:1
verses.text: Then the sons of Moses and Israel sang this song to the LORD, and spoke, saying, I will sing to the LORD, for He has triumphed gloriously; <hi>the</hi> horse and his rider He has thrown into the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 15:2
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> my strength and song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will glorify Him, my father's God, and I will exalt Him.

verses.name: Exodus 15:3
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> a Man of war; Jehovah <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Exodus 15:4
verses.text: Pharaoh's chariots and his army He has thrown into the sea; his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.

verses.name: Exodus 15:5
verses.text: The depths have covered them; they sank into the bottom like a stone.

verses.name: Exodus 15:6
verses.text: Your right hand, O LORD, has become glorious in power. Your right hand, O LORD, has dashed the enemy in pieces.

verses.name: Exodus 15:7
verses.text: And in the greatness of Your excellency You have overthrown them that rose up against You. You sent forth Your wrath, consuming them like stubble.

verses.name: Exodus 15:8
verses.text: And with the blast of Your nostrils the waters were gathered together; the floods stood upright like a heap; the depths were curdled in the heart of the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 15:9
verses.text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them, I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

verses.name: Exodus 15:10
verses.text: You blew with Your wind; the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

verses.name: Exodus 15:11
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> like You, O LORD, among the gods? Who <hi>is</hi> like You, glorious in holiness, fearful <hi>in</hi> praises, doing wonders?

verses.name: Exodus 15:12
verses.text: You stretched out Your right hand, the earth swallowed them.

verses.name: Exodus 15:13
verses.text: You in Your mercy have led forth the people <hi>which</hi> You have redeemed. You have guided them in Your strength to Your holy habitation.

verses.name: Exodus 15:14
verses.text: The people shall hear, being afraid. Sorrow shall take hold on the people of Philistia.

verses.name: Exodus 15:15
verses.text: Then the princes of Edom <hi>were</hi> terrified. Trembling seized upon the mighty men of Moab. All the people of Canaan shall melt away.

verses.name: Exodus 15:16
verses.text: Fear and dread shall fall upon them. By the greatness of Your arm they shall be still as a stone, until Your people pass over, O LORD; until the people <hi>whom</hi> You have purchased pass over.

verses.name: Exodus 15:17
verses.text: You shall bring them and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance, the place, O LORD, You have made for You to dwell in; the Sanctuary, O LORD, <hi>which</hi> Your hands have established.

verses.name: Exodus 15:18
verses.text: The LORD shall reign forever and ever.

verses.name: Exodus 15:19
verses.text: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them. But the sons of Israel went on dry land in the middle of the sea.

verses.name: Exodus 15:20
verses.text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand. And all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

verses.name: Exodus 15:21
verses.text: And Miriam answered them, Sing to the LORD, for He has triumphed gloriously. The horse and his rider He has thrown into the sea.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:22
verses.text: And Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

verses.name: Exodus 15:23
verses.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, because it <hi>was</hi> bitter. Therefore the name of it was called Marah.

verses.name: Exodus 15:24
verses.text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

verses.name: Exodus 15:25
verses.text: And he cried to the LORD. And the LORD showed him a tree. And when he had cast it into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There He made a decree and a law for them, and there He tested them.

verses.name: Exodus 15:26
verses.text: And he said, If you will carefully listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and will do that which is right in His sight, and will give ear to His commandments, and keep all His laws, I will put none of these diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians; for I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who heals you.

verses.name: Exodus 15:27
verses.text: And they came to Elim, where <hi>there were</hi> twelve wells of water, and seventy palm trees. And they camped there by the waters.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:1
verses.text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel came into the wilderness of Sin, which <hi>is</hi> between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month <hi>after</hi> their departing out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 16:2
verses.text: And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

verses.name: Exodus 16:3
verses.text: And the sons of Israel said to them, O that we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh-pots, when we ate bread to the full! For you have brought us forth into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

verses.name: Exodus 16:4
verses.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from the heavens for you. And the people shall go out and gather a certain amount every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in My law or not.

verses.name: Exodus 16:5
verses.text: And on the sixth day it shall happen, they shall prepare what they bring in. And it shall be twice as much as they gather day by day.

verses.name: Exodus 16:6
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron said to all the sons of Israel, At evening, then you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 16:7
verses.text: And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of the LORD. For He hears your murmurings against the LORD. And what <hi>are</hi> we, that you murmur against us?

verses.name: Exodus 16:8
verses.text: And Moses said, You will see when the LORD shall give you flesh to eat in the evening and bread to the full in the morning, when the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against Him. And what are we? Your murmurings <hi>are</hi> not against us, but against the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 16:9
verses.text: And Moses spoke to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, Come near before the LORD. For He has heard your murmurings.

verses.name: Exodus 16:10
verses.text: And it happened as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, they turned toward the wilderness. And behold! The glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud!

verses.name: Exodus 16:11
verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 16:12
verses.text: I have heard the murmurings of the sons of Israel. Speak to them, saying, You shall eat flesh at evening, and in the morning you shall be filled <hi>with</hi> bread. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:13
verses.text: And it happened at evening, the quails came up and covered the camp. And in the morning the dew lay all around the host.

verses.name: Exodus 16:14
verses.text: And when the layer of dew had gone up, behold, <hi>there was</hi> a small round thing upon the face of the wilderness, small as the hoar-frost upon the ground.

verses.name: Exodus 16:15
verses.text: And when the sons of Israel saw, they said each one to his brother, What <hi>is</hi> that? For they did not know what it <hi>was</hi>. And Moses said to them, This <hi>is</hi> the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

verses.name: Exodus 16:16
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD has commanded: Each man gather of it according to his eating, an omer for a head, according to the number of your souls. Each one shall take for those who <hi>are</hi> in his camp.

verses.name: Exodus 16:17
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, and some less.

verses.name: Exodus 16:18
verses.text: And when they measured with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little lacked nothing. They gathered each one according to his eating.

verses.name: Exodus 16:19
verses.text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it until the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 16:20
verses.text: But they did not listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning. And it became rotten <hi>with</hi> maggots, and stank. And Moses was angry with them.

verses.name: Exodus 16:21
verses.text: And they gathered it every morning, each man according to his eating. And when the sun became hot, it melted.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:22
verses.text: And it happened, on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one. And all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 16:23
verses.text: And he said to them, This <hi>is that</hi> which the LORD has said, Tomorrow is the rest of the holy sabbath to the LORD. Bake what you will bake <hi>today</hi>, and boil what you will boil. And that which remains over, lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 16:24
verses.text: And they laid it up until the morning, as Moses said. And it did not stink, neither was there any worm in it.

verses.name: Exodus 16:25
verses.text: And Moses said, Eat that today. For today <hi>is</hi> a sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.

verses.name: Exodus 16:26
verses.text: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

verses.name: Exodus 16:27
verses.text: And it happened <hi>some</hi> of the people went out on the seventh day in order to gather. And they did not find <hi>any</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:28
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, How long do you refuse to keep My commandments and My laws?

verses.name: Exodus 16:29
verses.text: See, because the LORD has given you the sabbath, therefore He gives you the bread of two days on the sixth day. Each one stay in his place. Let not any one go out of his place on the seventh day.

verses.name: Exodus 16:30
verses.text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

verses.name: Exodus 16:31
verses.text: And the house of Israel called the name of it Manna. And it <hi>was</hi> like coriander seed, white. And the taste of it <hi>was</hi> like wafers with honey.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:32
verses.text: And Moses said, This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD has commanded: Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations, so that you may see the bread with which I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 16:33
verses.text: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a pot and put an omer full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

verses.name: Exodus 16:34
verses.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

verses.name: Exodus 16:35
verses.text: And the sons of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to a land in which people lived. They ate manna until they came into the borders of the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Exodus 16:36
verses.text: And an omer <hi>is</hi> the tenth part of an ephah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:1
verses.text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the command of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim. And <hi>there was</hi> no water for the people to drink.

verses.name: Exodus 17:2
verses.text: And the people wrangled with Moses and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said to them, Why do you wrangle with me? Why do you tempt the LORD?

verses.name: Exodus 17:3
verses.text: And the people thirsted there for water. And the people murmured against Moses and said, Why <hi>is</hi> this, <hi>that</hi> You brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our sons and our cattle with thirst?

verses.name: Exodus 17:4
verses.text: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, What shall I do to this people? They are almost ready to stone me.

verses.name: Exodus 17:5
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go on in front of the people, and take with you the elders of Israel. And take your rod with which you struck the river, in your hand, and go.

verses.name: Exodus 17:6
verses.text: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb. And you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, so that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 17:7
verses.text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the wrangling of the sons of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us or not?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:8
verses.text: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.name: Exodus 17:9
verses.text: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

verses.name: Exodus 17:10
verses.text: And Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek. And Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.name: Exodus 17:11
verses.text: And it happened when Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. And when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

verses.name: Exodus 17:12
verses.text: But Moses' hands <hi>became</hi> heavy. And they took a stone and put <hi>it</hi> under him, and he sat on it. And Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. And his hands were steady until the going of the sun.

verses.name: Exodus 17:13
verses.text: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people by the mouth of the sword.

verses.name: Exodus 17:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this, a memorial in a book, and set <hi>it</hi> in the ears of Joshua, that I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heavens.

verses.name: Exodus 17:15
verses.text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah My Banner.

verses.name: Exodus 17:16
verses.text: And he said, A hand <hi>is</hi> on the throne of the LORD; war is to the LORD with Amalek from generation to generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:1
verses.text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt,

verses.name: Exodus 18:2
verses.text: then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

verses.name: Exodus 18:3
verses.text: and her two sons, of which the name of the one <hi>was</hi> Gershom (for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land),

verses.name: Exodus 18:4
verses.text: and the name of the other <hi>was</hi> Eliezer (for the God of my father, my help, delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.)

verses.name: Exodus 18:5
verses.text: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness, where he camped at the mount of God.

verses.name: Exodus 18:6
verses.text: And he said to Moses, I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you, and your wife and her two sons with her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:7
verses.text: And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed down to him, and kissed him. And they asked each other of <hi>their</hi> welfare. And they came into the tent.

verses.name: Exodus 18:8
verses.text: And Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and <hi>how</hi> the LORD delivered them.

verses.name: Exodus 18:9
verses.text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom He had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 18:10
verses.text: And Jethro said, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.name: Exodus 18:11
verses.text: Now I know that Jehovah <hi>is</hi> greater than all gods; for in the thing in which they were proved against them.

verses.name: Exodus 18:12
verses.text: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. And Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:13
verses.text: And on the next day it happened that Moses sat to judge the people. And the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.

verses.name: Exodus 18:14
verses.text: And when Moses' father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What <hi>is</hi> this thing which you do to the people? Why do you sit alone by yourself, and all the people stand by you from morning to evening?

verses.name: Exodus 18:15
verses.text: And Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

verses.name: Exodus 18:16
verses.text: When they have a matter, they come to me. And I judge between one and another, and I make known the statutes of God and His laws.

verses.name: Exodus 18:17
verses.text: And Moses' father-in-law said to him, The thing that you do <hi>is</hi> not good.

verses.name: Exodus 18:18
verses.text: You will surely wear away, both you and this people that <hi>is</hi> with you. For this thing <hi>is</hi> too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it alone.

verses.name: Exodus 18:19
verses.text: Listen now to my voice; I will give you counsel, and God will be with you. You be for the people toward God, that you may bring the causes to God.

verses.name: Exodus 18:20
verses.text: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall make them know the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

verses.name: Exodus 18:21
verses.text: And you shall look out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness. And place <hi>such</hi> over them to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

verses.name: Exodus 18:22
verses.text: And let them judge the people at all times. And it shall be, every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge. And make it easier for yourself, and they shall bear with you.

verses.name: Exodus 18:23
verses.text: If you will do this thing, and God command you, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

verses.name: Exodus 18:24
verses.text: And Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

verses.name: Exodus 18:25
verses.text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

verses.name: Exodus 18:26
verses.text: And they judged the people at all times. The hard causes they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 18:27
verses.text: And Moses let his father-in-law depart. And he went his way into his own land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:1
verses.text: In the third month when the sons of Israel had gone forth out of the land of Egypt, on this day they came <hi>to</hi> the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.name: Exodus 19:2
verses.text: And they journeyed from Rephidim, and came <hi>to</hi> the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness. And Israel camped there in front of the mount.

verses.name: Exodus 19:3
verses.text: And Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, You shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the sons of Israel:

verses.name: Exodus 19:4
verses.text: You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to Myself.

verses.name: Exodus 19:5
verses.text: And now if you will obey My voice indeed, and keep My covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure to Me above all the nations; for all the earth <hi>is</hi> Mine.

verses.name: Exodus 19:6
verses.text: And you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. These <hi>are</hi> the words which you shall speak to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 19:7
verses.text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

verses.name: Exodus 19:8
verses.text: And all the people answered together and said, All that the LORD has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Lo, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you forever. And Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 19:10
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go to the people and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their clothes.

verses.name: Exodus 19:11
verses.text: And be ready for the third day. For the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon Mount Sinai.

verses.name: Exodus 19:12
verses.text: And you shall set bounds to the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves. Do not go up into the mountain, or touch the border of it. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 19:13
verses.text: There shall not be a hand to touch it, but that he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether beast or man, it shall not live. When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 19:14
verses.text: And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people. And they washed their clothes.

verses.name: Exodus 19:15
verses.text: And he said to the people, Be ready for the third day. Do not approach a woman.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:16
verses.text: And it happened on the third day in the morning, that there <hi>were</hi> thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mountain. And the voice of the trumpet was exceedingly loud, so that all the people in the camp trembled.

verses.name: Exodus 19:17
verses.text: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God. And they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 19:18
verses.text: And Mount Sinai was smoking, all of it, because the LORD came down upon it in fire. And the smoke of it went up like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

verses.name: Exodus 19:19
verses.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and became very strong, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

verses.name: Exodus 19:20
verses.text: And the LORD came down upon Mount Sinai, on the top of the mountain. And the LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

verses.name: Exodus 19:21
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go down. Command the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.name: Exodus 19:22
verses.text: And let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 19:23
verses.text: And Moses said to the LORD, The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai. For You commanded us, saying, Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.

verses.name: Exodus 19:24
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Away! You go down, and you shall come up, you and Aaron with you. But do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest He break forth upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 19:25
verses.text: And Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:1
verses.text: And God spoke all these words, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 20:2
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who has brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

verses.name: Exodus 20:3
verses.text: You shall have no other gods before Me.

verses.name: Exodus 20:4
verses.text: You shall not make to yourselves any graven image, or any likeness of <hi>anything</hi> that <hi>is</hi> in the heavens above, or that <hi>is</hi> in the earth beneath, or that <hi>is</hi> in the water under the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 20:5
verses.text: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them. For I the LORD your God <hi>am</hi> a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and fourth <hi>generation</hi> of those that hate me,

verses.name: Exodus 20:6
verses.text: and showing mercy to thousands of those that love Me and keep My commandments.

verses.name: Exodus 20:7
verses.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain. For the LORD will not hold him guiltless that takes His name in vain.

verses.name: Exodus 20:8
verses.text: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.name: Exodus 20:9
verses.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.

verses.name: Exodus 20:10
verses.text: But the seventh day <hi>is</hi> the Sabbath of the LORD your God. You shall not do any work, you nor your son, nor your daughter, your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger within your gates.

verses.name: Exodus 20:11
verses.text: For <hi>in</hi> six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that <hi>is</hi> in them, and rested the seventh day. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and sanctified it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:12
verses.text: Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long upon the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Exodus 20:13
verses.text: You shall not kill.

verses.name: Exodus 20:14
verses.text: You shall not commit adultery.

verses.name: Exodus 20:15
verses.text: You shall not steal.

verses.name: Exodus 20:16
verses.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

verses.name: Exodus 20:17
verses.text: You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that <hi>is</hi> your neighbor's.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:18
verses.text: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. And when the people saw, they trembled, and stood afar off.

verses.name: Exodus 20:19
verses.text: And they said to Moses, You speak with us, and we will hear. But let not God speak with us, lest we die.

verses.name: Exodus 20:20
verses.text: And Moses said to the people, Do not fear, for God has come to test you, and so that His fear may be before your faces, so that you may not sin.

verses.name: Exodus 20:21
verses.text: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God <hi>was</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:22
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, So you shall say to the sons of Israel, You have seen that I have talked with you from the heavens.

verses.name: Exodus 20:23
verses.text: You shall not make with Me gods of silver, neither shall you make to you gods of gold.

verses.name: Exodus 20:24
verses.text: You shall make an altar of earth to Me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In all places where I record My name I will come to you, and I will bless you.

verses.name: Exodus 20:25
verses.text: And if you will make Me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stone. For if you lift up your tool upon it, you have defiled it.

verses.name: Exodus 20:26
verses.text: And you shall not go up by steps to My altar, that your nakedness be not uncovered on it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the judgments which you shall set before them.

verses.name: Exodus 21:2
verses.text: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years. And in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

verses.name: Exodus 21:3
verses.text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he <hi>was</hi> married, then his wife shall go out with him.

verses.name: Exodus 21:4
verses.text: If his master has given him a wife, and she has borne him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

verses.name: Exodus 21:5
verses.text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my sons. I do not want to go out free

verses.name: Exodus 21:6
verses.text: his master shall bring him to the judges. He shall also bring him to the door or to the door-post. And his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

verses.name: Exodus 21:7
verses.text: And if a man sells his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

verses.name: Exodus 21:8
verses.text: If she does not please her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no power to sell her to a strange nation, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

verses.name: Exodus 21:9
verses.text: And if he has betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her as with daughters.

verses.name: Exodus 21:10
verses.text: If he takes himself another <hi>wife</hi>, her food, her clothing, and her duty of marriage shall not be lessened.

verses.name: Exodus 21:11
verses.text: And if he does not do these three to her, then she shall go out free without money.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:12
verses.text: He that strikes a man, so that he dies, shall be surely put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 21:13
verses.text: And if a man does not lie in wait, but God delivers <hi>him</hi> into his hand, then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

verses.name: Exodus 21:14
verses.text: But if a man comes presumptuously upon his neighbor to slay him with guile, you shall take him from My altar, so that he may die.

verses.name: Exodus 21:15
verses.text: And he that strikes his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 21:16
verses.text: And he that steals a man and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 21:17
verses.text: And he that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 21:18
verses.text: And if men strive together, and one strikes another with a stone, or with <hi>his</hi> fist, and he does not die, but keeps his bed;

verses.name: Exodus 21:19
verses.text: if he rises again and walks abroad upon his staff, then he that struck him shall be set free. Only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause <hi>him</hi> to be completely healed.

verses.name: Exodus 21:20
verses.text: And if a man strikes his servant, or his maidservant, with a rod, and he dies under his hand, he shall surely be punished.

verses.name: Exodus 21:21
verses.text: But if he continues a day or two, he shall not be punished. For he <hi>is</hi> his money.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:22
verses.text: If men strive and strike a pregnant woman, so that her child comes out, and there is no injury, he shall surely be punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him. And he shall pay as the judges <hi>say</hi>

verses.name: Exodus 21:23
verses.text: And if <hi>any</hi> injury occurs, then you shall give life for life,

verses.name: Exodus 21:24
verses.text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.name: Exodus 21:25
verses.text: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.name: Exodus 21:26
verses.text: And if a man strike the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, so that it perishes, he shall let him go free on account of his eye.

verses.name: Exodus 21:27
verses.text: And if he strikes out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth, he shall let him go free on account of his tooth.

verses.name: Exodus 21:28
verses.text: If an ox gores a man or woman so that they die, then the ox shall surely be stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten. But the owner of the ox <hi>shall be</hi> set free.

verses.name: Exodus 21:29
verses.text: But if the ox was apt to gore in time past, and his owner has been told, and he has not kept him in, but that he has killed a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 21:30
verses.text: If there is laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatever is laid upon him.

verses.name: Exodus 21:31
verses.text: Whether he has gored a son, or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

verses.name: Exodus 21:32
verses.text: If the ox shall gore a manservant or a maidservant, he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.name: Exodus 21:33
verses.text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass falls in it,

verses.name: Exodus 21:34
verses.text: the owner of the pit shall make <hi>it</hi> good and give silver to its owner. And the dead shall be his.

verses.name: Exodus 21:35
verses.text: And in the event the ox of a man damages the ox of a neighbor, so that it dies, then they shall sell the living ox, and they shall divide the money of it. And they shall also divide the dead <hi>ox</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:36
verses.text: Or if it is known that the ox has been apt to gore in time past, and his owner has not kept him in, he shall surely pay ox for ox. And the dead shall be his own.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:1
verses.text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it or sell it, he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.name: Exodus 22:2
verses.text: If a thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, no blood <hi>shall be</hi> shed for him.

verses.name: Exodus 22:3
verses.text: If the sun is risen upon him, blood is due for him. He should repay in full. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.name: Exodus 22:4
verses.text: If the theft is certainly found in his hand alive, whether it is an ox, or an ass, or a sheep, he shall restore double.

verses.name: Exodus 22:5
verses.text: If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his animal, and shall feed in another man's field; he shall repay from the best of his own field, and the best of his own vineyard.

verses.name: Exodus 22:6
verses.text: If fire breaks out and catches in thorns, so that the stacks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field, is burned up, he who kindled the fire shall surely repay in full.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:7
verses.text: If a man shall deliver to his neighbor silver or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man's house; if the thief is found, let him pay double.

verses.name: Exodus 22:8
verses.text: If the thief is not found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, whether he has put his hand to his neighbor's goods.

verses.name: Exodus 22:9
verses.text: For every case of trespass, for ox, for ass, for sheep, for clothing, for any kind of lost thing, which <hi>another</hi> claims to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges. Whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double to his neighbor.

verses.name: Exodus 22:10
verses.text: If a man delivers to his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies, or is hurt, or driven away, no one seeing,

verses.name: Exodus 22:11
verses.text: an oath of the LORD shall be between them both, that he has not put his hand to his neighbor's goods. And the owner of it shall accept it, and he shall not make <hi>it</hi> good.

verses.name: Exodus 22:12
verses.text: And if it is stolen from him, he shall fully repay the owner of it.

verses.name: Exodus 22:13
verses.text: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for witness, <hi>and</hi> he shall not make good that which was torn.

verses.name: Exodus 22:14
verses.text: And if a man borrows from his neighbor, and it is hurt, or dies, and the owner of it not with it, he shall surely make <hi>it</hi> good.

verses.name: Exodus 22:15
verses.text: If the owner of it <hi>is</hi> with it, he shall not make <hi>it</hi> good. If it is hired, it came for its hire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:16
verses.text: And if a man lures a virgin who is not promised, and lies with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

verses.name: Exodus 22:17
verses.text: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

verses.name: Exodus 22:18
verses.text: You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

verses.name: Exodus 22:19
verses.text: Anyone lying with an animal shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 22:20
verses.text: One sacrificing to a god, except it is to Jehovah only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

verses.name: Exodus 22:21
verses.text: You shall neither vex a stranger nor oppress him, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 22:22
verses.text: You shall not afflict any widow or fatherless child.

verses.name: Exodus 22:23
verses.text: If you afflict them in any way, and they cry at all to Me, I will surely hear their cry.

verses.name: Exodus 22:24
verses.text: And My wrath shall become hot, and I will kill you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows, and your sons fatherless.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:25
verses.text: If you lend money to one of My people who <hi>is</hi> poor beside you, you shall not be to him as a money-lender, neither shall you lay upon him interest.

verses.name: Exodus 22:26
verses.text: If you at all take your neighbor's clothing as a pledge, you shall deliver it to him by the time the sun goes down.

verses.name: Exodus 22:27
verses.text: For that <hi>is</hi> his covering only, it is his clothing for his skin. In what shall he sleep? And it will be, when he cries to Me, I will hear, for I <hi>am</hi> gracious.

verses.name: Exodus 22:28
verses.text: You shall not revile God, nor curse the ruler of your people.

verses.name: Exodus 22:29
verses.text: You shall not delay <hi>to offer</hi> the first of your ripe fruits and of your sap. You shall give the first-born of your sons to Me.

verses.name: Exodus 22:30
verses.text: Likewise you shall do with your oxen <hi>and</hi> with your sheep; it shall be with its dam seven days. On the eighth day you shall give it to Me.

verses.name: Exodus 22:31
verses.text: And you shall be holy men to Me. Neither shall you eat flesh torn by beasts in the field. You shall throw it to the dogs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:1
verses.text: You shall not raise a false report. Do not put your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

verses.name: Exodus 23:2
verses.text: You shall not follow a multitude to do evil. Neither shall you speak in a cause in order to follow many in order to wrest <hi>judgment</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:3
verses.text: And you should not favor a poor man in his cause.

verses.name: Exodus 23:4
verses.text: If you meet your enemy's ox or his ass going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

verses.name: Exodus 23:5
verses.text: If you see the ass of him who hates you lying under his burden, and would hold back from helping him, you shall surely help him.

verses.name: Exodus 23:6
verses.text: You shall not pervert the judgment of your poor in his cause.

verses.name: Exodus 23:7
verses.text: Keep far from a false matter, and do not kill the innocent and righteous. For I will not justify the wicked.

verses.name: Exodus 23:8
verses.text: And you shall take no bribe, for the bribe blinds the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

verses.name: Exodus 23:9
verses.text: Also you shall not oppress a stranger. For you know the heart of a stranger, since you were strangers in the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:10
verses.text: And you shall sow your land six years, and shall gather in the fruits of it.

verses.name: Exodus 23:11
verses.text: But the seventh <hi>year</hi> you shall let it rest and lie still, so that the poor of your people may eat. And what they leave, the animals of the field shall eat. In the same way you shall deal with your vineyard <hi>and</hi> with your oliveyard.

verses.name: Exodus 23:12
verses.text: You shall do your work six days, and on the seventh day you shall rest, so that your ox and your ass may rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

verses.name: Exodus 23:13
verses.text: And be watchful in all that I have said to you. And make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of your mouth.

verses.name: Exodus 23:14
verses.text: You shall keep a feast to Me three times in the year.

verses.name: Exodus 23:15
verses.text: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>. You shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi> seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed of the month Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. And no one shall appear before Me empty.

verses.name: Exodus 23:16
verses.text: Also the Feast of Harvest, the first-fruits of your labors, which you have sown in the field. Also the Feast of Ingathering, in the end of the year, when you have gathered in your labors out of the field.

verses.name: Exodus 23:17
verses.text: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord God.

verses.name: Exodus 23:18
verses.text: You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread, neither shall the fat of My sacrifice remain until the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 23:19
verses.text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring <hi>into</hi> the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:20
verses.text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you to the place which I have prepared.

verses.name: Exodus 23:21
verses.text: Be on guard before Him, and obey His voice. Do not provoke Him, for He will not pardon your transgressions. For My name <hi>is</hi> in Him.

verses.name: Exodus 23:22
verses.text: But if you shall indeed obey His voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and a foe to your foes.

verses.name: Exodus 23:23
verses.text: For My Angel shall go before you and bring you in to the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites. And I will cut them off.

verses.name: Exodus 23:24
verses.text: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them. And you shall not do according to their works. But you shall surely pull them down, and surely you shall smash their images.

verses.name: Exodus 23:25
verses.text: And you shall serve the LORD your God, and He shall bless your bread and your water. And I will take sickness away from the midst of you.

verses.name: Exodus 23:26
verses.text: Nothing shall cast their young, nor be barren in your land. The number of your days I will fulfill.

verses.name: Exodus 23:27
verses.text: I will send My fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come. And I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

verses.name: Exodus 23:28
verses.text: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite before you.

verses.name: Exodus 23:29
verses.text: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become a waste, and the beast of the field multiply against you.

verses.name: Exodus 23:30
verses.text: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased, and inherit the land.

verses.name: Exodus 23:31
verses.text: And I will stretch your bounds from the Red Sea even to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the river. For I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

verses.name: Exodus 23:32
verses.text: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.

verses.name: Exodus 23:33
verses.text: They shall not dwell in your land lest they make you sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it surely will be a snare to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:1
verses.text: And He said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. And bow yourselves afar off.

verses.name: Exodus 24:2
verses.text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD, but they shall not come near. Neither shall the people go up with him.

verses.name: Exodus 24:3
verses.text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments. And all the people answered with one voice and said, All the words which the LORD has said, we will do.

verses.name: Exodus 24:4
verses.text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar below the mountain and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 24:5
verses.text: And he sent young men of the sons of Israel who offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of bullocks to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 24:6
verses.text: And Moses took half of the blood, and put <hi>it</hi> in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 24:7
verses.text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the ears of the people. And they said, All that the LORD has said we will do, and be obedient.

verses.name: Exodus 24:8
verses.text: And Moses took the blood and sprinkled <hi>it</hi> on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:9
verses.text: And Moses went up, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 24:10
verses.text: And they saw the God of Israel. And <hi>there was</hi> under His feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the heavens in clearness.

verses.name: Exodus 24:11
verses.text: And upon the nobles of the sons of Israel He did not lay his hands. Also they saw God, and ate and drank.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:12
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to Me in the mountain, and be there. And I will give you tablets of stone, and the law, and commandments which I have written, so that you may teach them.

verses.name: Exodus 24:13
verses.text: And Moses rose up, and his attendant Joshua. And Moses went up into the mountain of God.

verses.name: Exodus 24:14
verses.text: And he said to the elders, You stay here for us until we come again to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur <hi>are</hi> with you. If any man has any matters to do, let him come to them.

verses.name: Exodus 24:15
verses.text: And Moses went up into the mountain, and a cloud covered the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 24:16
verses.text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And the seventh day He called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

verses.name: Exodus 24:17
verses.text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD <hi>was</hi> like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 24:18
verses.text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mountain. And Moses was in the mountain forty days and forty nights.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 25:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring Me an offering. You shall take an offering from every man that gives it willingly with his heart.

verses.name: Exodus 25:3
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the offering which you shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.name: Exodus 25:4
verses.text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and goats' <hi>hair</hi>,

verses.name: Exodus 25:5
verses.text: and rams' skins dyed red, and dugong skins, and acacia-wood,

verses.name: Exodus 25:6
verses.text: oil for the light, spices for anointing oil and for sweet incense,

verses.name: Exodus 25:7
verses.text: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breast-pocket.

verses.name: Exodus 25:8
verses.text: And let them make Me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:9
verses.text: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments of it, even so you shall make <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:10
verses.text: And they shall make an ark <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood. Two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high.

verses.name: Exodus 25:11
verses.text: And you shall overlay it <hi>with</hi> pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and out, and shall make on it a crown of gold all around.

verses.name: Exodus 25:12
