verses.text: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and shall put <hi>it</hi> on its four feet. And two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:13
verses.text: And you shall make staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, and overlay them <hi>with</hi> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 25:14
verses.text: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, so that the ark may be carried with them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:15
verses.text: And the staves shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:16
verses.text: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.

verses.name: Exodus 25:17
verses.text: And you shall make a mercy-seat <hi>of</hi> pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:18
verses.text: And you shall make two cherubs <hi>of</hi> gold; of beaten work you shall make them, in the two ends of the mercy-seat.

verses.name: Exodus 25:19
verses.text: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end. From the mercy-seat you shall make the cherubs, on the two ends of it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:20
verses.text: And the cherubs shall stretch forth <hi>their</hi> wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces each toward the other; toward the mercy-seat shall the cherubs' faces be.

verses.name: Exodus 25:21
verses.text: And you shall put the mercy-seat above, upon the ark. And in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.

verses.name: Exodus 25:22
verses.text: And I will meet with you there, and I will talk with you from above the mercy-seat, from between the two cherubs on the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment to the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:23
verses.text: You shall also make a table <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, its length two cubits, and its breadth a cubit, and its height a cubit and a half.

verses.name: Exodus 25:24
verses.text: And you shall overlay it <hi>with</hi> pure gold, and make to this a crown of gold all around.

verses.name: Exodus 25:25
verses.text: And you shall make to it a border of a hand's breadth round about. And you shall make a golden crown to the border of it, all around.

verses.name: Exodus 25:26
verses.text: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that <hi>are</hi> on the four feet of it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:27
verses.text: The rings shall be adjoining the border as housings for the staves to carry the table.

verses.name: Exodus 25:28
verses.text: And you shall make the staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:29
verses.text: And you shall make its dishes, and its spoons, and its pitchers, and its sacrificial cups <hi>with</hi> which a drink-offering is made. You shall make them <hi>of</hi> pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 25:30
verses.text: And you shall set upon the table showbread before Me always.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:31
verses.text: And you shall make a lampstand <hi>of</hi> pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of beaten work; its shaft, and its branches, its cups, its knobs, and its blossoms, shall be from it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:32
verses.text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it-- three branches of the lampstand out of the one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.

verses.name: Exodus 25:33
verses.text: Three almond-like cups on the one branch, <hi>with</hi> knob and blossom; and three almond-like cups on the one branch, <hi>with</hi> knob and blossom, so for the six branches, those going out of the lampstand.

verses.name: Exodus 25:34
verses.text: And in the lampstand <hi>shall be</hi> four almond-like cups, <hi>with</hi> their knobs and their blossoms;

verses.name: Exodus 25:35
verses.text: and a knob under two branches of it, and a knob under two branches of it, and a knob under two branches of it, according to the six branches, those going out of the lampstand.

verses.name: Exodus 25:36
verses.text: Their knobs and their branches <hi>shall be</hi> of it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 25:37
verses.text: And you shall make the seven lamps of it. And one shall light the lamps of it, so that they may give light on its face.

verses.name: Exodus 25:38
verses.text: And the tongs of it, and its pans <hi>shall be</hi> of pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 25:39
verses.text: One shall make it <hi>of</hi> a talent of pure gold, with all these vessels.

verses.name: Exodus 25:40
verses.text: And see that you make them after their pattern, which was shown you in the mountain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:1
verses.text: And you shall make the tabernacle <hi>with</hi> ten curtains of fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and blue, and purple, and scarlet. You shall make them with cherubs, of the work of a cunning workman.

verses.name: Exodus 26:2
verses.text: The length of one curtain <hi>shall be</hi> twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits. And every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

verses.name: Exodus 26:3
verses.text: The five curtains shall be coupled together, each to its sister. And five curtains shall be coupled together, each to its sister.

verses.name: Exodus 26:4
verses.text: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of one curtain, from the end at the juncture; and so you shall do at the edge of the last curtain, at the second juncture.

verses.name: Exodus 26:5
verses.text: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the end of the curtain which <hi>is</hi> at second juncture, the corresponding loops each to her sister.

verses.name: Exodus 26:6
verses.text: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and you shall join the curtains each to her sister by the clasps. And it shall be one tabernacle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:7
verses.text: And you shall make curtains <hi>of</hi> goats' <hi>hair</hi> to be a tent over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 26:8
verses.text: The length of one curtain <hi>shall be</hi> thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits, one measure to the eleven curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 26:9
verses.text: And you shall join five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves. And you shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 26:10
verses.text: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of one curtain, the last at the juncture, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that joins second.

verses.name: Exodus 26:11
verses.text: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, so that it may be one.

verses.name: Exodus 26:12
verses.text: And the rest that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 26:13
verses.text: And the cubit from this side, and the cubit from that side that remains in the length of the curtains of the tent shall be hung over the sides of the tabernacle, from this and from that side, to cover it.

verses.name: Exodus 26:14
verses.text: And you shall make a covering for the tent <hi>of</hi> rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of dugong skins.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:15
verses.text: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood standing up.

verses.name: Exodus 26:16
verses.text: Ten cubits <hi>shall be</hi> the length of one board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

verses.name: Exodus 26:17
verses.text: There <hi>shall be</hi> two pins in one board, each connected to its sister-piece. So you shall do for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 26:18
verses.text: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

verses.name: Exodus 26:19
verses.text: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards-- two sockets under one board for its two pins, and two sockets under another board for its two pins.

verses.name: Exodus 26:20
verses.text: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side <hi>shall be</hi> twenty boards,

verses.name: Exodus 26:21
verses.text: and their forty sockets <hi>of</hi> silver, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.name: Exodus 26:22
verses.text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

verses.name: Exodus 26:23
verses.text: And you shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the sides.

verses.name: Exodus 26:24
verses.text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it to one ring. So it shall be for them both. They shall be for the two corners.

verses.name: Exodus 26:25
verses.text: And <hi>there</hi> shall be eight boards, and their sockets <hi>of</hi> silver, sixteen sockets, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.name: Exodus 26:26
verses.text: And you shall make bars <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.name: Exodus 26:27
verses.text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle; and five bars for the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

verses.name: Exodus 26:28
verses.text: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

verses.name: Exodus 26:29
verses.text: And you shall overlay the boards <hi>with</hi> gold, and you shall make their rings <hi>of</hi> gold, housings for the bars. And you shall overlay the bars with gold.

verses.name: Exodus 26:30
verses.text: And you shall rear up the tabernacle according to the pattern of it which was shown you in the mountain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:31
verses.text: And you shall make a veil <hi>of</hi> blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi> of embroidered work. It shall be made <hi>with</hi> cherubs.

verses.name: Exodus 26:32
verses.text: And you shall hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid <hi>with</hi> gold. Their hooks <hi>shall be</hi> of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 26:33
verses.text: And you shall hang up the veil under the clasps, that you may bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil. And the veil shall divide for you between the holy <hi>place</hi> and the Holy of Holies.

verses.name: Exodus 26:34
verses.text: And you shall put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies.

verses.name: Exodus 26:35
verses.text: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. And you shall put the table on the north side.

verses.name: Exodus 26:36
verses.text: And you shall make a screen for the door of the tent, <hi>of</hi> blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, worked with needlework.

verses.name: Exodus 26:37
verses.text: And you shall make five pillars of acacia-wood for the screen, and overlay them <hi>with</hi> gold; their hooks <hi>shall be</hi> of gold. And you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:1
verses.text: And you shall make an altar of acacia-wood, five cubits long and five cubits broad. The altar shall be square. And the height of it <hi>shall be</hi> three cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 27:2
verses.text: And you shall make the horns of it upon the four corners of it. Its horns shall be of the same, and you shall overlay it <hi>with</hi> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:3
verses.text: And you shall make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pans. All the vessels of it you shall make <hi>of</hi> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:4
verses.text: And you shall make for it a grate of network <hi>of</hi> bronze. And upon the net you shall make four bronze rings in the four corners of it.

verses.name: Exodus 27:5
verses.text: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar beneath, so that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 27:6
verses.text: And you shall make staves for the altar, staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, and overlay them <hi>with</hi> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:7
verses.text: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to carry it.

verses.name: Exodus 27:8
verses.text: You shall make it hollow <hi>with</hi> boards; as it was shown you in the mountain, so shall they make <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:9
verses.text: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle. For the south side southward there <hi>shall be</hi> hangings for the court <hi>of</hi> fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, of a hundred cubits long for one side.

verses.name: Exodus 27:10
verses.text: And the twenty pillars of it, and their twenty sockets, <hi>shall be</hi> of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.

verses.name: Exodus 27:11
verses.text: And so for the north side in length, hangings of a hundred cubits long. And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shall be <hi>of</hi> bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands <hi>of</hi> silver.

verses.name: Exodus 27:12
verses.text: And <hi>for</hi> the breadth of the court on the west side <hi>shall be</hi> hangings of fifty cubits. Their pillars <hi>shall be</hi> ten, and their sockets ten.

verses.name: Exodus 27:13
verses.text: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward <hi>shall be</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 27:14
verses.text: The hangings of one side <hi>of the gate shall be</hi> fifteen cubits. Their pillars shall be three, and their sockets three;

verses.name: Exodus 27:15
verses.text: and on the other side hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.name: Exodus 27:16
verses.text: And for the gate of the court <hi>shall be</hi> a screen of twenty cubits, <hi>of</hi> blue and purple and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, worked with needlework; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

verses.name: Exodus 27:17
verses.text: All the pillars around the court <hi>shall be</hi> banded <hi>with</hi> silver; their hooks silver, and their sockets <hi>of</hi> bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:18
verses.text: The length of the court <hi>shall be</hi> a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty cubits <hi>of</hi> everywhere, and the height five cubits of fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and their sockets bronze.

verses.name: Exodus 27:19
verses.text: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service of it, and all the pins of it, and all the pins of the court, <hi>shall be</hi> bronze.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:20
verses.text: And you shall command the sons of Israel that they bring you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always

verses.name: Exodus 27:21
verses.text: in the tabernacle of the congregation, outside the veil which <hi>is</hi> before the testimony. Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever to their generations on behalf of the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:1
verses.text: And you shall take to yourself Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the sons of Israel, so that he may minister to Me in the priest's office: Aaron and Aaron's sons, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.name: Exodus 28:2
verses.text: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

verses.name: Exodus 28:3
verses.text: And you shall speak to all the wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, so that he may minister to Me in the priest's office.

verses.name: Exodus 28:4
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the garments which they shall make: a breast-pocket, and an ephod, and a robe, and an embroidered coat, a miter, and a girdle. And they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, so that he may minister to Me in the priest's office.

verses.name: Exodus 28:5
verses.text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached <hi>linen</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:6
verses.text: And they shall make the ephod <hi>of</hi> gold, blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, skilled work.

verses.name: Exodus 28:7
verses.text: It shall have the two shoulder-pieces of it joined at the two edges of it. And so it shall be joined together.

verses.name: Exodus 28:8
verses.text: And the embroidered girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work of it: <hi>of</hi> gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:9
verses.text: And you shall take two onyx stones, and you shall engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 28:10
verses.text: Six of their names <hi>shall be</hi> on one stone, and six of the remaining names on the other stone, according to their birth.

verses.name: Exodus 28:11
verses.text: With the work of an engraver in stone, <hi>like</hi> the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel. You shall make them to be set <hi>in</hi> settings of gold.

verses.name: Exodus 28:12
verses.text: And you shall put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod <hi>for</hi> stones of memorial to the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

verses.name: Exodus 28:13
verses.text: And you shall make plaited work <hi>of</hi> gold,

verses.name: Exodus 28:14
verses.text: and two chains <hi>of</hi> pure gold at the ends. You shall make them <hi>of</hi> woven work, a work of cord, and fasten the woven chains to the plaited work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:15
verses.text: And you shall make the breast-pocket of judgment with embroidered work. After the work of the ephod you shall make it; <hi>of</hi> gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, you shall make it.

verses.name: Exodus 28:16
verses.text: It shall be square, doubled; a span the length of it, and a span the breadth of it.

verses.name: Exodus 28:17
verses.text: And you shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones. The first row shall be a sardius, topaz, and carbuncle in the row.

verses.name: Exodus 28:18
verses.text: And the second row: an emerald, a sapphire. and a diamond.

verses.name: Exodus 28:19
verses.text: And the third row: an opal, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.name: Exodus 28:20
verses.text: And the fourth row: a chrysolite, and an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be set in gold in their fillings.

verses.name: Exodus 28:21
verses.text: And the stones shall be with the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, <hi>like</hi> the engravings of a signet. They shall be each one with his name according to the twelve tribes.

verses.name: Exodus 28:22
verses.text: And you shall make chains upon the breast-pocket, work of cords, in pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 28:23
verses.text: And you shall make upon the breast-pocket two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breast-pocket.

verses.name: Exodus 28:24
verses.text: And you shall put the two woven <hi>chains</hi> of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breast-pocket.

verses.name: Exodus 28:25
verses.text: And the two ends of the two cords you shall fasten on the two plaitings, and put <hi>them</hi> on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod before it.

verses.name: Exodus 28:26
verses.text: And you shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them upon the two ends of the breast-pocket in the border of it, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

verses.name: Exodus 28:27
verses.text: And you shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the front of it, near its joining, above the band of the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 28:28
verses.text: And they shall bind the breast-pocket by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that <hi>it</hi> may be above the band of the ephod, and so that the breast-pocket may not be loosed from the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 28:29
verses.text: And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breast-pocket of judgment upon his heart, when he goes in to the holy <hi>place</hi>, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

verses.name: Exodus 28:30
verses.text: And you shall put in the breast-pocket of judgment the Urim and the Thummim. And they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goes in before the LORD. And Aaron shall bear the judgment of the sons of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:31
verses.text: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all <hi>of</hi> blue.

verses.name: Exodus 28:32
verses.text: And there shall be a hole in the top of it, in its middle; a binding shall be all around its mouth, of woven work. It shall be like the mouth of a corselet; it may not be torn.

verses.name: Exodus 28:33
verses.text: And on its hem you shall make pomegranates <hi>of</hi> blue, and purple, and scarlet, all around its hem. And bells of gold <hi>shall be</hi> amidst them all around.

verses.name: Exodus 28:34
verses.text: There shall be a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe all around.

verses.name: Exodus 28:35
verses.text: And it shall be on Aaron to serve. And his sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy <hi>place</hi> before the LORD, and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

verses.name: Exodus 28:36
verses.text: And you shall make a plate <hi>of</hi> pure gold, and carve on it, <hi>like</hi> the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO JEHOVAH.

verses.name: Exodus 28:37
verses.text: And you shall put it on a blue lace, so that it may be on the miter; on the front of the miter it shall be.

verses.name: Exodus 28:38
verses.text: And it shall be on Aaron's forehead, so that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things which will sanctify the sons of Israel in all their holy gifts. And it shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be accepted before the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 28:39
verses.text: And you shall weave the tunic <hi>of</hi> bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and you shall make the miter of bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and you shall make the girdle of needlework.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:40
verses.text: And you shall make tunics for Aaron's sons, and you shall make for them girdles, and turbans you shall make for them, for glory and for beauty.

verses.name: Exodus 28:41
verses.text: And you shall clothe Aaron your brother <hi>with</hi> them, and his sons with him. And you shall anoint them, and you shall consecrate them, and you shall sanctify them, so that they may minister to Me in the priest's office.

verses.name: Exodus 28:42
verses.text: And you shall make them linen breeches to cover the naked flesh; from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach.

verses.name: Exodus 28:43
verses.text: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in to the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near the altar to minister in the holy <hi>place</hi>; so that they do not bear iniquity, and die. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever to him and his seed after him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:1
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the thing that you shall do to them, to sanctify them to minister to Me in the priest's office. Take one bull, the son of the herd, and two rams without blemish,

verses.name: Exodus 29:2
verses.text: and unleavened <hi>bread</hi>, and cakes unleavened mixed with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil. You shall make them <hi>of</hi> wheat flour.

verses.name: Exodus 29:3
verses.text: And you shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

verses.name: Exodus 29:4
verses.text: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall wash them with water.

verses.name: Exodus 29:5
verses.text: And you shall take the garments, and clothe Aaron with the tunic, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breast-pocket, and bind it to him with the band of the ephod.

verses.name: Exodus 29:6
verses.text: And you shall put the miter upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the miter.

verses.name: Exodus 29:7
verses.text: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour on his head, and anoint him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:8
verses.text: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them <hi>with</hi> tunics.

verses.name: Exodus 29:9
verses.text: And you shall gird them <hi>with</hi> girdles, Aaron and his sons, and bind turbans on them. And the priest's office shall be theirs for an everlasting statute. And you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

verses.name: Exodus 29:10
verses.text: And you shall cause a bull to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation. And Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bull.

verses.name: Exodus 29:11
verses.text: And you shall kill the bull before the LORD, <hi>by</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Exodus 29:12
verses.text: And you shall take of the blood of the bull, and put <hi>it</hi> on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 29:13
verses.text: And you shall take all the fat that covers the inward parts, and the lobe on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat on them, and burn <hi>them</hi> upon the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 29:14
verses.text: But the flesh of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside the camp. It <hi>is</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Exodus 29:15
verses.text: And you shall also take one ram. And Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.name: Exodus 29:16
verses.text: And you shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood and sprinkle all round upon the altar.

verses.name: Exodus 29:17
verses.text: And you shall cut the ram in pieces, and you shall wash its inward parts and its legs, and put <hi>them</hi> with its pieces and with its head.

verses.name: Exodus 29:18
verses.text: And you shall burn the whole ram upon the altar. It <hi>is</hi> a burnt offering to the LORD. It <hi>is</hi> a sweet savor, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:19
verses.text: And you shall take the other ram. And Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.name: Exodus 29:20
verses.text: Then you shall kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put <hi>it</hi> upon the tip of the ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar all around.

verses.name: Exodus 29:21
verses.text: And you shall take of the blood on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him. And he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:22
verses.text: Also you shall take from the ram the fat and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the inward parts, and the lobe on the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat on them, and the right shoulder, for it is a ram of consecration;

verses.name: Exodus 29:23
verses.text: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened <hi>bread</hi> that <hi>is</hi> before the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:24
verses.text: And you shall put all in the hands of Aaron and in the hands of his sons, and shall wave them <hi>for</hi> a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:25
verses.text: And you shall take them from their hands, and burn <hi>them</hi> upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savor before the LORD. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:26
verses.text: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration and wave it <hi>for</hi> a wave offering before the LORD. And it shall be your portion.

verses.name: Exodus 29:27
verses.text: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the thigh of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is lifted from the ram of the consecration, from what <hi>is</hi> Aaron's, and from what is for his sons.

verses.name: Exodus 29:28
verses.text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute forever from the sons of Israel. For it <hi>is</hi> a heave offering. And it shall be a heave offering from the sons of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their heave offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:29
verses.text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed in them and consecrated in them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:30
verses.text: The one of his sons that is priest in his place shall put them on seven days, when he comes into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy <hi>place</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:31
verses.text: And you shall take the ram of the consecration, and boil its flesh in the holy place.

verses.name: Exodus 29:32
verses.text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that <hi>is</hi> in the basket, <hi>by</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Exodus 29:33
verses.text: And they shall eat those things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them. But a stranger shall not eat because they <hi>are</hi> holy.

verses.name: Exodus 29:34
verses.text: And if any of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remains until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it <hi>is</hi> holy.

verses.name: Exodus 29:35
verses.text: And so you shall do to Aaron and to his sons according to all things which I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

verses.name: Exodus 29:36
verses.text: And you shall offer every day a bull, a sin offering for atonement. And you shall cleanse the altar when you have made an atonement for it, and you shall anoint it to sanctify it.

verses.name: Exodus 29:37
verses.text: You shall make an atonement for the altar seven days, and sanctify it. And it shall be a most holy altar. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:38
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> what you shall offer upon the altar: two lambs of the first year day by day forever.

verses.name: Exodus 29:39
verses.text: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at evening.

verses.name: Exodus 29:40
verses.text: And with the one lamb a tenth part of flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin <hi>of</hi> wine, a drink offering.

verses.name: Exodus 29:41
verses.text: And you shall offer the other lamb at evening; you shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning, and according to its drink offering, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 29:42
verses.text: <hi> This shall be</hi> a burnt offering forever throughout your generations, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD, where I will meet you, to speak there to you.

verses.name: Exodus 29:43
verses.text: And there I will meet with the sons of Israel, and Israel shall be sanctified by My glory.

verses.name: Exodus 29:44
verses.text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar. I will also sanctify both Aaron and his sons to minister to Me in the priest's office.

verses.name: Exodus 29:45
verses.text: And I will dwell among the sons of Israel, and will be their God.

verses.name: Exodus 29:46
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD their God, who brought them forth out of the land of Egypt so that I may dwell among them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD their God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:1
verses.text: And you shall make an altar to burn incense upon. You shall make it <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood.

verses.name: Exodus 30:2
verses.text: A cubit <hi>shall be</hi> its length, and a cubit its breadth. It shall be square. And two cubits <hi>shall be</hi> the height of it, its horns from itself.

verses.name: Exodus 30:3
verses.text: And you shall overlay it <hi>with</hi> pure gold, its top, and its sides all around, and its horns. And you shall make to it a crown of gold all around.

verses.name: Exodus 30:4
verses.text: And you shall make two golden rings to it under the crown of it, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides of it you shall make it. And they shall be housings for the staves to bear it with.

verses.name: Exodus 30:5
verses.text: And you shall make the staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood and overlay them <hi>with</hi> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 30:6
verses.text: And you shall put it before the veil that <hi>is</hi> by the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy-seat that is beside the testimony, where I will meet with you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:7
verses.text: And Aaron shall burn sweet incense on it every morning; when he dresses the lamps he shall burn it.

verses.name: Exodus 30:8
verses.text: And when Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

verses.name: Exodus 30:9
verses.text: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meal offering. Neither shall you pour drink offering on it.

verses.name: Exodus 30:10
verses.text: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offerings of atonement. He shall. make atonement on it once in the year throughout your generations. It <hi>is</hi> most holy to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:11
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:12
verses.text: When you count the sons of Israel, of those who are to be counted, then they shall each man give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when <hi>you</hi> number them, so that there may be no plague among them when you number them.

verses.name: Exodus 30:13
verses.text: They shall give this, every one that passes among those who are counted, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary (a shekel <hi>is</hi> twenty gerahs); a half shekel <hi>shall be</hi> the offering of the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 30:14
verses.text: Everyone that passes among those who are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 30:15
verses.text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than half a shekel, when <hi>they</hi> give an offering to the LORD to make an atonement for your souls.

verses.name: Exodus 30:16
verses.text: And you shall take the atonement silver of the sons of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, so that it may be a memorial to the sons of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:17
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:18
verses.text: You shall also make a laver <hi>of</hi> bronze and its foot also of bronze, for washing. And you shall put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar. And you shall put water in it,

verses.name: Exodus 30:19
verses.text: for Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet there.

verses.name: Exodus 30:20
verses.text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash <hi>with</hi> water so that they do not die. Or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD,

verses.name: Exodus 30:21
verses.text: they shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they do not die. And it shall be a statute forever to them, to him and to his seed throughout their generations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:22
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 30:23
verses.text: Take also to you principal spices, five hundred <hi>shekels</hi> of pure myrrh, and half as much of sweet cinnamon, even two hundred and fifty <hi>shekels</hi>, and two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet calamus,

verses.name: Exodus 30:24
verses.text: and five hundred of cassia, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.

verses.name: Exodus 30:25
verses.text: And you shall make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the perfumer. It shall be a holy anointing oil.

verses.name: Exodus 30:26
verses.text: And you shall anoint the tabernacle of the congregation with it, and the ark of the testimony,

verses.name: Exodus 30:27
verses.text: and the table and all its vessels, and the lampstand and its vessels, and the altar of incense,

verses.name: Exodus 30:28
verses.text: and the altar of burnt offerings with all its vessels, and the laver and its foot.

verses.name: Exodus 30:29
verses.text: And you shall sanctify them so that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

verses.name: Exodus 30:30
verses.text: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them, so that <hi>they</hi> may minister to Me in the priest's office.

verses.name: Exodus 30:31
verses.text: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.

verses.name: Exodus 30:32
verses.text: It shall not be poured upon man's flesh, neither shall you make <hi>any other</hi> like it, according to the way it is made. It is holy, and it shall be holy to you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:33
verses.text: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts <hi>any</hi> of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

verses.name: Exodus 30:34
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to yourself sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense, a part of each one.

verses.name: Exodus 30:35
verses.text: And you shall make it a perfume, an incense according to the art of the perfumer, salted, pure <hi>and</hi> holy.

verses.name: Exodus 30:36
verses.text: And you shall beat <hi>some</hi> of it very small, and put it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:37
verses.text: And the perfume which you shall make, you shall not make any for yourselves according to the way it is made. It shall be holy to you for the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 30:38
verses.text: Whoever shall make <hi>any</hi> like that, to smell of it, shall even be cut off from his people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Exodus 31:2
verses.text: Behold, I, I have called by name Bezaleel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

verses.name: Exodus 31:3
verses.text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all workmanship,

verses.name: Exodus 31:4
verses.text: to devise designs; to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 31:5
verses.text: and in cutting of stones, to set <hi>them</hi>, and in carving of timber, to work in all workmanship.

verses.name: Exodus 31:6
verses.text: And behold, I have given to him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And I have put wisdom in the hearts of all the wise-hearted, so that they may make all that I have commanded you:

verses.name: Exodus 31:7
verses.text: the tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy-seat that <hi>is</hi> upon it, and all the vessels of the tabernacle,

verses.name: Exodus 31:8
verses.text: and the table and its vessels, and the pure lampstand with all its vessels, and the altar of incense,

verses.name: Exodus 31:9
verses.text: and the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its base,

verses.name: Exodus 31:10
verses.text: and the woven garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

verses.name: Exodus 31:11
verses.text: and the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy <hi>place</hi>. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:12
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Exodus 31:13
verses.text: Speak also to the sons of Israel, saying, Truly you shall keep My sabbaths. For it <hi>is</hi> a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, to know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who sanctifies you.

verses.name: Exodus 31:14
verses.text: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it <hi>is</hi> holy to you. Everyone that defiles it shall surely be put to death. For whoever does <hi>any</hi> work in it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Exodus 31:15
verses.text: Six days may work be done, but on the seventh <hi>is</hi> the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does <hi>any</hi> work in the Sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 31:16
verses.text: Therefore the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, <hi>for</hi> an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Exodus 31:17
verses.text: It <hi>is</hi> a sign between Me and the sons of Israel forever. For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested, and was refreshed.

verses.name: Exodus 31:18
verses.text: And He gave to Moses, when He had made an end of speaking with him upon Mount Sinai, two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:1
verses.text: And the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, and the people gathered themselves to Aaron. And they said to him, Up! Make us gods who shall go before us. For this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:2
verses.text: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden earrings which <hi>are</hi> in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring <hi>them</hi> to me.

verses.name: Exodus 32:3
verses.text: And all the people broke off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought <hi>them</hi> to Aaron.

verses.name: Exodus 32:4
verses.text: And he took <hi>them</hi> from their hand, and fashioned it with an engraving tool. And he made it a molten calf. And they said, These <hi>are</hi> your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 32:5
verses.text: And when Aaron saw, he built an altar before it. And Aaron made proclamation and said, Tomorrow <hi>is</hi> a feast to Jehovah.

verses.name: Exodus 32:6
verses.text: And they rose up early on the next day and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:7
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go! Get down, for your people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, are corrupted.

verses.name: Exodus 32:8
verses.text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made them a molten calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, These <hi>are</hi> your gods, O Israel, who have brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 32:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, I have seen this people, and behold, it <hi>is</hi> a stiff-necked people.

verses.name: Exodus 32:10
verses.text: And now leave Me alone, so that My wrath may become hot against them and so that I may consume them. And I will make of you a great nation.

verses.name: Exodus 32:11
verses.text: And Moses prayed to the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why does Your wrath become hot against Your people whom You have brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

verses.name: Exodus 32:12
verses.text: Why should the Egyptians speak and say, He brought them out for harm, to kill them in the mountains and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from Your fierce wrath, and be moved to pity as to this evil against Your people.

verses.name: Exodus 32:13
verses.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants, to whom You swore by Your own self, and said to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of the heavens, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall inherit <hi>it</hi> forever.

verses.name: Exodus 32:14
verses.text: And the LORD was moved to pity as to the evil which He spoke of doing to His people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:15
verses.text: And Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the testimony <hi>were</hi> in his hand. The tablets were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other.

verses.name: Exodus 32:16
verses.text: And the tablets <hi>were</hi> the work of God, and the writing <hi>was</hi> the writing of God. It <hi>was</hi> engraved on the tablets.

verses.name: Exodus 32:17
verses.text: And Joshua heard the voice of the people in their shouting. And he said to Moses, A sound of war in the camp!

verses.name: Exodus 32:18
verses.text: And he said, <hi>It is</hi> not a sound of a cry of victory, nor a sound of the cry of defeat. I <hi>am</hi> hearing the sound of singing.

verses.name: Exodus 32:19
verses.text: And it happened, as he came near to the camp and saw the calf and dances, the anger of Moses became hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them at the bottom of the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 32:20
verses.text: And he took the calf which they had made and burned <hi>it</hi> in the fire, and ground <hi>it</hi> to powder, and dropped <hi>it</hi> upon the water, and made the sons of Israel drink <hi>of it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:21
verses.text: And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people do to you, that you have brought so great a sin upon them?

verses.name: Exodus 32:22
verses.text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord become hot. You know the people, that they <hi>are set</hi> on mischief.

verses.name: Exodus 32:23
verses.text: For they said to me, Make us gods who shall go before us. For this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:24
verses.text: And I said to them, Whoever has any gold, let them break <hi>it</hi> off. And they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

verses.name: Exodus 32:25
verses.text: And when Moses saw that the people were naked, (for Aaron had made them naked to <hi>their</hi> shame among their enemies,)

verses.name: Exodus 32:26
verses.text: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, Who <hi>is</hi> on the LORD's side? <hi>Come</hi> to me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves to him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:27
verses.text: And he said to them, Thus says the LORD God of Israel: Each man put his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and kill each one his brother, and each one his neighbor, and each one his kindred.

verses.name: Exodus 32:28
verses.text: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. And there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

verses.name: Exodus 32:29
verses.text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, since each one <hi>has been</hi> against his son, and against his brother, and in order to give you a blessing today.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:30
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, Moses said to the people, You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make an atonement for your sin.

verses.name: Exodus 32:31
verses.text: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

verses.name: Exodus 32:32
verses.text: And now will You forgive their sin! And if not, I pray You, blot me out of Your book which You have written.

verses.name: Exodus 32:33
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot him out of My book.

verses.name: Exodus 32:34
verses.text: And now go, lead the people to <hi>the place</hi> of which I have spoken to you. Behold, My Angel shall go before you. And in the day of My visitation I will visit their sin upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 32:35
verses.text: And the LORD plagued the people because they made the calf, which Aaron made.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Come, go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To your seed I will give it.

verses.name: Exodus 33:2
verses.text: And I will send an angel before you. And I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite;

verses.name: Exodus 33:3
verses.text: to a land flowing <hi>with</hi> milk and honey. For I will not go up in the midst of you, for you <hi>are</hi> a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you in the way.

verses.name: Exodus 33:4
verses.text: And the people heard these evil tidings, and they mourned, and put no ornaments on themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 33:5
verses.text: And the LORD had said to Moses, Say to the sons of Israel, You <hi>are</hi> a stiff-necked people. I will come up into the midst of you in a moment, and I will consume you. And now put off your ornaments from you, that I may know what to do with you.

verses.name: Exodus 33:6
verses.text: And the sons of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by Mount Horeb.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:7
verses.text: And Moses took the tabernacle and pitched it outside the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the tabernacle of the congregation. And it happened, everyone who sought the LORD went out to the tabernacle of the congregation, which <hi>was</hi> outside the camp.

verses.name: Exodus 33:8
verses.text: And it happened as Moses went out to the tabernacle, all the people rose up, and each man stood <hi>at</hi> his tent door and looked after Moses until he had gone into the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 33:9
verses.text: And it happened as Moses went into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended and stood <hi>at</hi> the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD spoke with Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 33:10
verses.text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand <hi>at</hi> the tabernacle door. And all the people rose up and worshiped, each man in his tent door.

verses.name: Exodus 33:11
verses.text: And the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. And he turned again to the camp. But his servant, Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, did not leave the middle of the tabernacle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:12
verses.text: And Moses said to the LORD, Behold, You say to me, Bring up this people. And You have not told me whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, I know you by name, and you have also found grace in My sight.

verses.name: Exodus 33:13
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray You, if I have found grace in Your sight, make me see now Your ways, that I may know You, that I may find grace in Your sight. And consider that this nation <hi>is</hi> Your people.

verses.name: Exodus 33:14
verses.text: And He said, My presence shall go <hi>with you</hi>, and I will give you rest.

verses.name: Exodus 33:15
verses.text: And he said to Him, If Your presence does not go <hi>with me</hi>, do not carry us up from here.

verses.name: Exodus 33:16
verses.text: For in what shall it be known that I and Your people have found grace in Your sight? <hi>Is it</hi> not in that You go with us? So we shall be separated, I and Your people, from all the people that <hi>are</hi> upon the face of the earth.

verses.name: Exodus 33:17
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, I will do this thing also that you have spoken. For you have found grace in My sight, and I know you by name.

verses.name: Exodus 33:18
verses.text: And he said, I beseech You, let me see Your glory.

verses.name: Exodus 33:19
verses.text: And He said, I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before you. And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will have mercy on whom I will have mercy.

verses.name: Exodus 33:20
verses.text: And He said, You cannot see My face. For there no man can see Me and live.

verses.name: Exodus 33:21
verses.text: And the LORD said, Behold! <hi>There is</hi> a place by Me, and you shall stand upon a rock.

verses.name: Exodus 33:22
verses.text: And it will be, while My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with My hand while I pass by.

verses.name: Exodus 33:23
verses.text: And I will take away My hand, and you shall see My back parts. But My face shall not be seen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, cut out two tablets of stone like the first. And I will write upon the tablets the words that were in the first tablets which you broke.

verses.name: Exodus 34:2
verses.text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to Me in the top of the mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 34:3
verses.text: And no man shall come up with you, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mountain. Also do not let the flocks nor herds feed before that mountain.

verses.name: Exodus 34:4
verses.text: And he cut out two tablets of stone like the first. And Moses rose up early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tablets of stone.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:5
verses.text: And the LORD came down in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 34:6
verses.text: And the LORD passed by before him and proclaimed, Jehovah! Jehovah God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

verses.name: Exodus 34:7
verses.text: keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and who will by no means clear <hi>the guilty</hi>, visiting the iniquity of fathers on the sons, and on the sons of sons, to the third and to the fourth generation.

verses.name: Exodus 34:8
verses.text: And Moses made haste and bowed toward the earth, and worshiped.

verses.name: Exodus 34:9
verses.text: And he said, If now I have found grace in Your sight, O LORD, I pray You, let my Lord go among us. For it <hi>is</hi> a stiff-necked people. And pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Your inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:10
verses.text: And He said, Behold! I make a covenant. Before all your people I will do marvels such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation. And all the people in whose midst you <hi>are</hi> shall see the work of the LORD, for it <hi>is</hi> an awesome thing that I will do with you.

verses.name: Exodus 34:11
verses.text: Observe that which I command you this day. Behold! I drive out before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

verses.name: Exodus 34:12
verses.text: Take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the people of the land where you go, lest it be for a snare in the midst of you.

verses.name: Exodus 34:13
verses.text: But you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves.

verses.name: Exodus 34:14
verses.text: For you shall worship no other god. For the LORD, whose name is Jealous, <hi>is</hi> a jealous God;

verses.name: Exodus 34:15
verses.text: lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice to their gods, and call you, and you eat of his sacrifice;

verses.name: Exodus 34:16
verses.text: and lest you take from their daughters for your sons, and their daughters go whoring after their gods and make your sons go whoring after their gods.

verses.name: Exodus 34:17
verses.text: You shall make you no molten gods.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:18
verses.text: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>. You shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi> seven days, as I commanded you, in the time of the month Abib. For in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.

verses.name: Exodus 34:19
verses.text: All that opens the womb <hi>is</hi> Mine; and all yours male livestock, a firstling of ox or sheep.

verses.name: Exodus 34:20
verses.text: But the firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb. And if you do not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. All the first-born of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before Me empty.

verses.name: Exodus 34:21
verses.text: You shall work six days, but on the seventh day you shall rest. In plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

verses.name: Exodus 34:22
verses.text: And you shall observe the Feast of Weeks, of the first-fruits of wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the year's end.

verses.name: Exodus 34:23
verses.text: Three times in the year your men shall appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.

verses.name: Exodus 34:24
verses.text: For I will cast out the nations before you and enlarge your borders. Neither shall any man desire your land when you shall go up to appear before the LORD your God three times in the year.

verses.name: Exodus 34:25
verses.text: You shall not slaughter the blood of My sacrifice on leavened <hi>bread</hi>. Neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the Passover be left to the morning.

verses.name: Exodus 34:26
verses.text: The first of the first-fruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

verses.name: Exodus 34:27
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Write these words for yourself; for on the mouth of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:28
verses.text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights. He neither ate bread, nor drank water. And He wrote upon the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

verses.name: Exodus 34:29
verses.text: And it happened as Moses was going down from the mountain of Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony being in Moses' hand as he went down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the skin of his face had become luminous through His speaking with him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:30
verses.text: And Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face had become luminous. And they were afraid to come near him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:31
verses.text: And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him, and Moses talked with them.

verses.name: Exodus 34:32
verses.text: And afterward all the sons of Israel came near. And he commanded them all that the LORD had spoken with him in Mount Sinai.

verses.name: Exodus 34:33
verses.text: And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil on his face.

verses.name: Exodus 34:34
verses.text: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he took the veil off until he came out. And he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel that which he was commanded.

verses.name: Exodus 34:35
verses.text: And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face had become luminous. And Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:1
verses.text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the sons of Israel together and said to them, These <hi>are</hi> the words which the LORD has commanded, to do them.

verses.name: Exodus 35:2
verses.text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does work in it shall be put to death.

verses.name: Exodus 35:3
verses.text: You shall kindle no fire throughout your living places upon the Sabbath day.

verses.name: Exodus 35:4
verses.text: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel saying, This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD commanded. He said,

verses.name: Exodus 35:5
verses.text: Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever <hi>is</hi> of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD: gold, and silver, and bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 35:6
verses.text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and goats' <hi>hair</hi>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:7
verses.text: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and acacia-wood,

verses.name: Exodus 35:8
verses.text: and oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

verses.name: Exodus 35:9
verses.text: and onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

verses.name: Exodus 35:10
verses.text: And every wise-hearted one among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

verses.name: Exodus 35:11
verses.text: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets.

verses.name: Exodus 35:12
verses.text: And make the ark and the staves of it, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the covering,

verses.name: Exodus 35:13
verses.text: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and showbread,

verses.name: Exodus 35:14
verses.text: also the lampstand for the light, and its vessels, and its lamp, with the oil for the light,

verses.name: Exodus 35:15
verses.text: and the incense altar, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging of the door at the entering in of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 35:16
verses.text: And make the altar of burnt offering, with its bronze grate, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,

verses.name: Exodus 35:17
verses.text: the hangings of the court, its pillars and their sockets, and the hanging, for the door of the court,

verses.name: Exodus 35:18
verses.text: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

verses.name: Exodus 35:19
verses.text: the woven garments to do service in the holy <hi>place</hi>, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:20
verses.text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

verses.name: Exodus 35:21
verses.text: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom His spirit made willing. They brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all His service, and for the holy garments.

verses.name: Exodus 35:22
verses.text: And the men came in together with the women, as many as were willing-hearted, bringing bracelets and earrings, and rings and ornaments, all jewels of gold. And everyone who offered waved a wave offering of gold to the LORD.

verses.name: Exodus 35:23
verses.text: And everyone <hi>with</hi> whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and goats' <hi>hair</hi>, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

verses.name: Exodus 35:24
verses.text: Everyone lifting up an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD's offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia-wood for any work of the service, brought <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:25
verses.text: And every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands. And they brought spun yarn, blue, and purple, scarlet, and bleached <hi>linen</hi>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:26
verses.text: And all the women whose hearts were lifted up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

verses.name: Exodus 35:27
verses.text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

verses.name: Exodus 35:28
verses.text: And they brought spice and oil, for the light and for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense.

verses.name: Exodus 35:29
verses.text: The sons of Israel brought a willing offering to the LORD, every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all kinds of work which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:30
verses.text: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, See, the LORD has called the son of Uri the son of Hur, by the name Bezaleel, of the tribe of Judah.

verses.name: Exodus 35:31
verses.text: And He has filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of work,

verses.name: Exodus 35:32
verses.text: and to devise designs, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

verses.name: Exodus 35:33
verses.text: and in the cutting of stones to set, and in carving of wood, to make any kind of skillful work.

verses.name: Exodus 35:34
verses.text: And He has put in his heart that he may teach, he and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.name: Exodus 35:35
verses.text: He has filled them <hi>with</hi> wisdom of heart to work all kinds of work; of the smith, and of the skillful worker, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and of the weaver, of those who do any work, and of those who work out artful work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:1
verses.text: And Bezaleel and Aholiab shall work with everyone wise of heart to whom the LORD has given wisdom and intelligence, to know how to do every work of the service of the sanctuary, concerning all which the LORD had commanded.

verses.name: Exodus 36:2
verses.text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come, to do the work.

verses.name: Exodus 36:3
verses.text: And they received all the offerings from Moses, the offering which the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it. And they still brought to him free offerings every morning.

verses.name: Exodus 36:4
verses.text: And all the wise men who worked all the work of the sanctuary came, every man from his work which they made.

verses.name: Exodus 36:5
verses.text: And they spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough <hi>for</hi> the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.

verses.name: Exodus 36:6
verses.text: And Moses commanded, and they caused it to be known throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. And the people were kept from bringing.

verses.name: Exodus 36:7
verses.text: For the stuff which they had was enough for all the work to make it, and too much.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:8
verses.text: And every wise-hearted one among them that worked the work of the tabernacle, made ten curtains <hi>of</hi> fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, and blue, and purple, and scarlet. He made them with cherubs of skillful work.

verses.name: Exodus 36:9
verses.text: The length of one curtain <hi>was</hi> twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain was four cubits. The curtains were all of one size.

verses.name: Exodus 36:10
verses.text: And he coupled the five curtains to one another, and he coupled <hi>the other</hi> five curtains to one another.

verses.name: Exodus 36:11
verses.text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made loops in the outermost side, in the coupling of the second curtain.

verses.name: Exodus 36:12
verses.text: He made fifty loops in one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which <hi>was</hi> in the coupling of the second. The loops held one to another.

verses.name: Exodus 36:13
verses.text: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps. And it became one tabernacle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:14
verses.text: And he made curtains <hi>of</hi> goats' <hi>hair</hi> for the tent over the tabernacle. He made eleven curtains.

verses.name: Exodus 36:15
verses.text: The length of one curtain <hi>was</hi> thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of one curtain. The eleven curtains were of one size.

verses.name: Exodus 36:16
verses.text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 36:17
verses.text: And he made fifty loops on the outermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and he made fifty loops upon the edge of the curtains which coupled the second.

verses.name: Exodus 36:18
verses.text: And he made fifty clasps <hi>of</hi> bronze to couple the tent together, so that it might be one.

verses.name: Exodus 36:19
verses.text: And he made a covering for the tent <hi>of</hi> rams' skins dyed red, and a covering <hi>of</hi> dugong skins above.

verses.name: Exodus 36:20
verses.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, standing up.

verses.name: Exodus 36:21
verses.text: The length of a board <hi>was</hi> ten cubits, and the breadth of a board was one and a half cubits.

verses.name: Exodus 36:22
verses.text: By two pins the one board was connected, one to another. So he made for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Exodus 36:23
verses.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

verses.name: Exodus 36:24
verses.text: And he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two pins, and two sockets under another board for its two pins.

verses.name: Exodus 36:25
verses.text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, toward the north, he made twenty boards,

verses.name: Exodus 36:26
verses.text: and their forty sockets were of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.name: Exodus 36:27
verses.text: And he made six boards for the sides of the tabernacle westward.

verses.name: Exodus 36:28
verses.text: And he made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the sides.

verses.name: Exodus 36:29
verses.text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head of it, to one ring. So he did to both of them in both the corners.

verses.name: Exodus 36:30
verses.text: And there were eight boards. And their sockets <hi>were</hi> sixteen sockets of silver, two sockets under every board.

verses.name: Exodus 36:31
verses.text: And he made bars of acacia-wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.name: Exodus 36:32
verses.text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the westward sides.

verses.name: Exodus 36:33
verses.text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

verses.name: Exodus 36:34
verses.text: And he overlaid the boards <hi>with</hi> gold, and made their rings <hi>of</hi> gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars <hi>with</hi> gold.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:35
verses.text: And he made a veil <hi>of</hi> blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>. He made it the work of an artisan, with cherubs.

verses.name: Exodus 36:36
verses.text: And he made for it four pillars <hi>of</hi> acacia. And he overlaid them <hi>with</hi> gold. Their hooks <hi>were of</hi> gold, and he cast four sockets of silver for them.

verses.name: Exodus 36:37
verses.text: And he made a screen for the tabernacle door, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached <hi>linen</hi>, of needlework;

verses.name: Exodus 36:38
verses.text: and the five pillars of it, and their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their fillets <hi>with</hi> gold, but their five sockets <hi>were of</hi> bronze.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:1
verses.text: And Bezaleel made the ark <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood: two cubits and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.name: Exodus 37:2
verses.text: And he overlaid it <hi>with</hi> pure gold inside and out, and made a crown of gold around it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:3
verses.text: And he cast four rings of gold for it, for the corners of it, even two rings on the one side of it and two rings on the other side of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:4
verses.text: And he made staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood and overlaid them <hi>with</hi> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:5
verses.text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, in order to bear the ark.

verses.name: Exodus 37:6
verses.text: And he made the mercy-seat <hi>of</hi> pure gold. Two cubits and a half long, and one cubit and a half wide.

verses.name: Exodus 37:7
verses.text: And he made two cherubs <hi>of</hi> gold on the two ends of the mercy-seat. He made them of beaten work,

verses.name: Exodus 37:8
verses.text: one cherub here at one end, and one cherub there at the <hi>other</hi> end. He made the cherubs out of the mercy-seat on the two ends of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:9
verses.text: And the cherubs were spreading out <hi>their</hi> wings above, covering the mercy-seat <hi>with</hi> their wings, their faces each toward the other. The faces of the cherubs were toward the mercy-seat.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:10
verses.text: And he made the table <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood. Two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.name: Exodus 37:11
verses.text: And he overlaid it <hi>with</hi> pure gold, and made for it a crown of gold all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:12
verses.text: Also he made for it a border all around, of a hand's breadth. And he made a crown of gold for the border of it all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:13
verses.text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that <hi>were</hi> in the four feet of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:14
verses.text: The rings were near the border, the housings for the staves to carry the table.

verses.name: Exodus 37:15
verses.text: And he made the staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, and overlaid them <hi>with</hi> gold, to carry the table.

verses.name: Exodus 37:16
verses.text: And he made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes and its spoons, and its bowls, and its pitchers by which a drink offering is made, <hi>of</hi> pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:17
verses.text: And he made the lampstand <hi>of</hi> pure gold. He made the lampstand <hi>of</hi> beaten work; its shaft and its branch, its cups, its knobs, and its blossoms, were of the same.

verses.name: Exodus 37:18
verses.text: And six branches went out of the sides of it; three branches of the lampstand out of the one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:19
verses.text: Three almond-like cups <hi>were</hi> on the one branch, a knob and a blossom; and three almond-like cups on the one branch, a knob and a blossom. So throughout the six branches going out of the lampstand.

verses.name: Exodus 37:20
verses.text: And on the lampstand <hi>were</hi> four almond-like cups, its knobs and its blossoms.

verses.name: Exodus 37:21
verses.text: And a knob was under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, to the six branches going out of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:22
verses.text: Their knobs and their branches were of the same; all of it was one beaten work <hi>of</hi> pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:23
verses.text: And he made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, <hi>of</hi> pure gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:24
verses.text: He made it of a talent <hi>of</hi> pure gold, and all the vessels of it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:25
verses.text: And he made the incense altar <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood. Its length was a cubit, and its breadth a cubit, square. And its height was two cubits. Its horns were of the same.

verses.name: Exodus 37:26
verses.text: And he overlaid it <hi>with</hi> pure gold, the top of it and the sides of it all around, and the horns of it. Also he made for it a crown of gold all around.

verses.name: Exodus 37:27
verses.text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown of it, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides of it, to be places for the staves to bear it with.

verses.name: Exodus 37:28
verses.text: And he made the staves <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, and overlaid them <hi>with</hi> gold.

verses.name: Exodus 37:29
verses.text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, the work of the perfumer.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:1
