verses.text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtle-dove, for a sin offering to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:7
verses.text: And he shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her. And she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This <hi>is</hi> the law for her that has borne a male or a female.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:8
verses.text: And if her hand cannot reach to a lamb, then she shall bring two turtle-doves or two young pigeons. The one shall be for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. And the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:2
verses.text: When a man has a rising in the skin of his flesh, or a scab or bright spot, and it is in the skin of his flesh <hi>like</hi> the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons the priests.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:3
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh. And <hi>if</hi> the hair in the plague has turned white, and the plague in sight <hi>is</hi> deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy. And the priest shall look on him and shall pronounce him unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:4
verses.text: And if the bright spot <hi>is</hi> white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight is not deeper than the skin, and the hair of it has not turned white, then the priest shall shut up the plague seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:5
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague in his sight is stayed; the plague has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:6
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him again in the seventh day. And, behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague <hi>is</hi> somewhat dark; the plague has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean. It <hi>is</hi> a scab. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:7
verses.text: But if the scab spreads greatly in the skin after he has been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:8
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> the priest sees that, behold, the scab spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> a leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:9
verses.text: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:10
verses.text: And the priest shall look. And, behold, if the rising is white in the skin, and it has turned the hair white and <hi>there is</hi> live raw flesh in the rising,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:11
verses.text: it <hi>is</hi> an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh. And the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:12
verses.text: And if a leprosy breaks out greatly on the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the <hi>one who has</hi> the plague from his head even to his foot, to all that appears to the eyes of the priest,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:13
verses.text: then the priest shall look. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce the plagued one clean. It has all turned white. He is clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:14
verses.text: But when raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:15
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean. The raw flesh <hi>is</hi> unclean; it <hi>is</hi> a leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:16
verses.text: Or if the raw flesh turns again and is changed to white, he shall come to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:17
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him. And, behold, the plague has turned to white, then the priest shall pronounce the plagued one clean. He <hi>is</hi> clean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:18
verses.text: And when the flesh has a boil in his skin, and it has healed,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:19
verses.text: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising or a bright spot, a reddish white, it shall be shown to the priest;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:20
verses.text: and if the priest sees it, and behold, it <hi>is</hi> in sight lower than the skin, and the hair of it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> a plague of leprosy broken out in a boil.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:21
verses.text: But if the priest looks on it, and, behold, <hi>there are</hi> no white hairs in it, and it <hi>is</hi> not lower than the skin, but has become dark, then the priest shall shut him up seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:22
verses.text: And if it spreads greatly in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> a plague.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:23
verses.text: But if the bright spot stays in its place, not spreading, it <hi>is</hi> a burning boil. And the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:24
verses.text: Or if there is flesh in which the skin has a hot burning, and the raw <hi>flesh</hi> of the burning <hi>becomes</hi> a white bright spot, reddish or white,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:25
verses.text: then the priest shall look on it. And behold, the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and <hi>it is</hi> in sight deeper than the skin, it <hi>is</hi> leprosy broken out of the burning. Therefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> the plague of leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:26
verses.text: But if the priest looks on it, and behold, there <hi>is</hi> no white hair in the bright spot, and it <hi>is</hi> no lower than the <hi>other</hi> skin, but is somewhat dark, then the priest shall shut him up seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:27
verses.text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day. If it spreads farther in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> the plague of leprosy.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:28
verses.text: And if the bright spot stays in its place, and does not spread in the skin, but <hi>is</hi> somewhat faded, it <hi>is</hi> a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it <hi>is</hi> a scar of the burning.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:29
verses.text: If a man or woman has in them a plague on the head or the beard,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:30
verses.text: then the priest shall see the plague. And behold, if it <hi>is</hi> in sight deeper than the skin, and a yellow thin hair <hi>is</hi> in it, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It <hi>is</hi> a dry scab, a leprosy on the head or beard.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:31
verses.text: And if the priest looks on the plague of the scab, and behold, it <hi>is</hi> not in sight deeper than the skin, and no black hair <hi>is</hi> in it, then the priest shall shut him up the plagued one <hi>with</hi> the scab seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:32
verses.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the scab does not spread, and no yellow hair <hi>is</hi> in it, and the scab <hi>is</hi> not in sight deeper than the skin,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:33
verses.text: he shall be shaven, but shall not shave the scab. And the priest shall shut up <hi>the one who has</hi> the scab seven days more.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:34
verses.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scab. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the scab has not spread in the skin, nor <hi>is</hi> in sight deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:35
verses.text: But if the scab spreads very much in the skin after his cleansing,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:36
verses.text: then the priest shall look on him, and behold, if the scab is spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for shining yellow hair. He <hi>is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:37
verses.text: But if in his eyes the scab is stabilized, and black hair is growing up in it, the scab is healed. He <hi>is</hi> clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:38
verses.text: Also if a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of their flesh, white bright spots,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:39
verses.text: then the priest shall look. And behold, <hi>if</hi> pale white bright spots <hi>are</hi> in the skin of their flesh, it <hi>is</hi> a pale spot springing up in the skin. He <hi>is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:40
verses.text: And when a man's head grows bald; he <hi>is</hi> bald. He <hi>is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:41
verses.text: And if his head grows bald from the edge of his face, he <hi>is</hi> forehead bald. He <hi>is</hi> clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:42
verses.text: And if there is in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore, it <hi>is</hi> a leprosy sprung up in his bald head or his bald forehead.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:43
verses.text: And the priest shall look on it. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the rising of the sore is reddish white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appears in the skin of the flesh,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:44
verses.text: he <hi>is</hi> a man with leprosy. He <hi>is</hi> unclean. The priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean. His plague <hi>is</hi> in his head.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:45
verses.text: And as for the leper in whom the plague <hi>is</hi>, his clothes shall be torn, and his head shall be bare, and he shall put a covering on his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean! Unclean!

verses.name: Leviticus 13:46
verses.text: All the days in which the plague <hi>is</hi> in him he shall be defiled. He is unclean. He shall live alone. His dwelling <hi>shall be</hi> outside the camp.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:47
verses.text: And if there is any garment that has the plague of leprosy in it, in a wool garment or a linen garment,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:48
verses.text: or in the warp or in the woof, of linen or of wool, or in a skin or in anything of skin,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:49
verses.text: and if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it <hi>is</hi> a plague of leprosy. And it shall be shown to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:50
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the plague, and shut up <hi>that which has</hi> the plague seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:51
verses.text: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day. If the plague is spread in the garment, either in the warp or in the woof, or in any skin <hi>or</hi> in any work that is made of skin, the plague <hi>is</hi> a fretting leprosy. It <hi> is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:52
verses.text: And he shall burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of skin in which the plague is. For it <hi>is</hi> a fretting leprosy. It shall be burned in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:53
verses.text: And if the priest shall look, and behold, the plague has not spread in the garment, either in the warp or the woof, or anything of skin,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:54
verses.text: then the priest shall command that they wash <hi>the thing</hi> in which the plague is. And he shall shut it up seven days more.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:55
verses.text: And the priest shall look on the plague after it is washed, and behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague has not changed its color and the plague has not spread; it <hi>is</hi> unclean. You shall burn it in the fire. It <hi>is</hi> eaten away in its inside or in its outside.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:56
verses.text: And if the priest looks, and behold, the plague <hi>is</hi> somewhat dark after the washing of it, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:57
verses.text: And if it appears still in the garment, or in the warp or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it <hi>is</hi> a spreading <hi>plague</hi>. You shall burn that which <hi>is</hi> in it <hi>is</hi> the plague <hi>is</hi> with fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:58
verses.text: And the garment which you shall wash, either warp or woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed a second time, and shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:59
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woolen or linen, either in the warp or woof or anything of skins, to pronounce it clean or to pronounce it unclean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:2
verses.text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing. He shall be brought to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:3
verses.text: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp. And the priest shall look, and behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:4
verses.text: then the priest shall command to take two clean live birds for him that is to be cleansed, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:5
verses.text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:6
verses.text: He shall take the living bird, and the cedar wood and the scarlet and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the slain bird, over the running water.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:7
verses.text: And he shall sprinkle on him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:8
verses.text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water so that he may be clean. And after that he shall come into the camp, and shall stay outside his tent seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:9
verses.text: But on the seventh day he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eye-brows; even all his hair shall he shave off. And he shall wash his clothes. He also shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:10
verses.text: And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three-tenth parts of fine flour <hi>for</hi> a food offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:11
verses.text: And the priest who is cleansing, and the man who is to be cleansed, shall stand with them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:12
verses.text: And the priest shall take one male lamb and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them <hi>for</hi> a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:13
verses.text: And he shall kill the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place. For as the sin offering <hi>is</hi> the priest's, so is the trespass offering. It <hi>is</hi> most holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:14
verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:15
verses.text: And the priest shall take from the log of oil and pour into the palm of his own left hand.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:16
verses.text: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil in his left hand and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:17
verses.text: And of the rest of the oil in his hand, the priest shall put on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, on the blood of the trespass offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:18
verses.text: And the rest of the oil in the priest's palm he shall pour on the head of him that is to be cleansed. And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:19
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness. And afterward he shall kill the burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:20
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the food offering on the altar. And the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:21
verses.text: And if he <hi>is</hi> poor and his hand cannot reach <hi>so much</hi>, then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one-tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering, and a log of oil,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:22
verses.text: and two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, such as his hand can reach. And the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:23
verses.text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:24
verses.text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them <hi>for</hi> a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:25
verses.text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. And the priest shall take from the blood of the trespass offering, and put it on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:26
verses.text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:27
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:28
verses.text: And the priest shall put of the oil in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:29
verses.text: And the rest of the oil in the priest's hand he shall put on the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:30
verses.text: And he shall offer the one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to get,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:31
verses.text: even such as he is able to reach, the one <hi>for</hi> a sin offering and the other <hi>for</hi> a burnt offering, with the food offering. And the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:32
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law of him in whom <hi>is</hi> the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to reach in his cleansing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:33
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:34
verses.text: When you come into the land of Canaan which I give you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house in the land of your possession,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:35
verses.text: and if he that owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, A plague <hi>is</hi> seen by me in the house;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:36
verses.text: then the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest goes to see the plague, so that all that <hi>is</hi> in the house may not become unclean. And afterwards the priest shall go in to see the house.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:37
verses.text: And he shall look on the plague. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague <hi>is</hi> in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:38
verses.text: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:39
verses.text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day and shall look. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:40
verses.text: then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague <hi>is</hi>, and they shall throw them into an unclean place outside the city.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:41
verses.text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped inside all around, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off outside the city in an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:42
verses.text: And they shall take other stones and put <hi>them</hi> in the place of those stones. And he shall take other mortar and shall plaster the house.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:43
verses.text: And if the plague comes again and breaks out in the house after he has taken away the stones and after he has scraped the house, and after it is plastered,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:44
verses.text: then the priest shall come and look. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the plague has spread in the house, it <hi>is</hi> a fretting leprosy in the house. It <hi>is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:45
verses.text: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber of it, and all the mortar of the house, and he shall carry <hi>them</hi> out of the city into an unclean place.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:46
verses.text: And he that goes into the house all the days that it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:47
verses.text: And he that lies in the house shall wash his clothes. And he that eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:48
verses.text: And if the priest shall come in and look, and, behold, the plague has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean because the plague is healed.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:49
verses.text: And he shall take two birds to cleanse the house, and cedar-wood, and scarlet <hi>dye</hi>, and hyssop.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:50
verses.text: And he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:51
verses.text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet dye, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:52
verses.text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:53
verses.text: But he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field, and make an atonement for the house. And it shall be clean.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:54
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law for all kinds of plague of leprosy and scab,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:55
verses.text: and for the leprosy of a garment and of a house,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:56
verses.text: and for a rising and for a scab and for a bright spot,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:57
verses.text: to teach when <hi>it is</hi> unclean and when it is clean. This <hi>is</hi> the law of leprosy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 15:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When any man has a discharge from his flesh; he is unclean <hi>because of</hi> his discharge.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:3
verses.text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his discharge. His flesh has run with his discharge, or his flesh <hi>is</hi> ceased from his discharge, it <hi>is</hi> his uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:4
verses.text: Every bed on which he who discharges lies is unclean. And everything on which he sits shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:5
verses.text: And whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:6
verses.text: And he that sits on <hi>any</hi> thing on which he who discharges sat shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:7
verses.text: And he that touches the flesh of him who discharges shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:8
verses.text: And if he who discharges spits on him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:9
verses.text: And whatever saddle he who discharges rides on shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:10
verses.text: And whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. And he that carries <hi>any of</hi> those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:11
verses.text: And whomever he who discharges touches, and has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:12
verses.text: And the earthen vessel that he who discharges touches shall be broken. And every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:13
verses.text: And when he who discharges is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall number seven days to himself for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:14
verses.text: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtle-doves to himself, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:15
verses.text: And the priest shall offer them, the one <hi>for</hi> a sin offering and the other <hi>for</hi> a burnt offering. And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:16
verses.text: And if any man's semen goes from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:17
verses.text: And every garment and every skin on which the semen shall be, it shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:18
verses.text: And the woman with whom a man shall lie <hi>with</hi> emission of semen shall both bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:19
verses.text: And if a woman has a discharge, <hi>and</hi> her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. And whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:20
verses.text: And everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:21
verses.text: And whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:22
verses.text: And whoever touches anything that she sat on, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:23
verses.text: And if it <hi>is</hi> on the bed or on anything on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:24
verses.text: And if any man lies with her at all, and her impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days. And every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:25
verses.text: And if a woman has a discharge of her blood many days outside of the time of her impurity, or if she discharges it beyond the time of her impurity, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her impurity. She <hi>is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:26
verses.text: Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her impurity. And whatever she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:27
verses.text: And whoever touches those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:28
verses.text: But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:29
verses.text: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtle-doves to her, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:30
verses.text: And the priest shall offer the one <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the discharge of her uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:31
verses.text: So you shall separate the sons of Israel from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness when they defile My tabernacle that <hi>is</hi> among them.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:32
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law of him that has an discharge, and of him whose semen goes from him and is defiled with it,

verses.name: Leviticus 15:33
verses.text: and of her that is menstruating, and of him that has an discharge, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lies with an unclean woman.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD and they died.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:2
verses.text: and the LORD said to Moses, Speak to Aaron your brother, that he does not come at all times into the sanctuary within the veil before the mercy-seat, which is on the Ark, so that he will not die. For I will appear in the cloud on the mercy-seat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:3
verses.text: Aaron shall come into the sanctuary this way: with a bull, a son of the herd, for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:4
verses.text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches on his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen miter he shall be dressed. <hi>These are</hi> holy garments. And he shall wash his flesh in water and put them on.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:5
verses.text: And he shall take from the congregation of the sons of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:6
verses.text: And Aaron shall offer his young bull of the sin offering which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself and for his house.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:7
verses.text: And he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD <hi>at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:8
verses.text: And Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats; one lot for the LORD and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:9
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the goat on which the LORD's lot fell, and offer it for a sin offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:10
verses.text: But the goat on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:11
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the young bull of the sin offering which is for himself, and shall atone for himself and for his house, and shall kill the young bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:12
verses.text: And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and his hands full of fragrant perfumes beaten small, and bring <hi>it</hi> within the veil.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:13
verses.text: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD. And the cloud of the incense shall cover the mercy-seat that is on the Testimony. And he shall not die.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:14
verses.text: And he shall take of the blood of the young bull and shall sprinkle with his finger on the front of the mercy-seat eastward. And he shall sprinkle at the front of the mercy-seat seven times from the blood with his finger.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:15
verses.text: Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil. And he shall do with that blood as he did with the blood of the young bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy-seat and before the mercy-seat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:16
verses.text: And he shall atone for the sanctuary, because of the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins. And so he shall do for the tabernacle of the congregation which remains with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:17
verses.text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goes in to make an atonement in the sanctuary, until he comes out and has made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:18
verses.text: And he shall go out to the altar that <hi>is</hi> before the LORD and make an atonement for it. And he shall take of the blood of the young bull, and of the blood of the goat, and put <hi>it</hi> on the horns of the altar all around.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:19
verses.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood on it with his finger seven times and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:20
verses.text: And when he has made an end of reconciling the sanctuary and the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, he shall bring the live goat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:21
verses.text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the sins of the sons of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them on the head of the goat, and shall send away by the hand of a chosen man into the wilderness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:22
verses.text: And the goat shall bear on him all their sins to a land in which no one lives. And he shall let the goat go in the wilderness.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:23
verses.text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall strip off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the sanctuary, and shall leave them there.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:24
verses.text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself and for the people.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:25
verses.text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn on the altar.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:26
verses.text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:27
verses.text: And the young bull <hi>for</hi> the sin offering, and the goat <hi>for</hi> the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy <hi>place</hi>, shall they carry forth outside the camp. And they shall burn their skins in the fire, and their flesh and their dung.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:28
verses.text: And he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:29
verses.text: And it shall be a statute forever to you: in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, you shall afflict your souls and do no work at all, the native and the alien who is staying among you.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:30
verses.text: For on that day an atonement shall be made for you, to cleanse you, so that you may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:31
verses.text: It <hi>shall be</hi> a sabbath of rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls, by a statute forever.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:32
verses.text: And the priest whom He shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement and shall put on the linen clothes, the holy garments.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:33
verses.text: And he shall make an atonement <hi>for</hi> the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar; and he shall make an atonement for the priests and for all the people of the congregation.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:34
verses.text: And this shall be an everlasting statute to you, to make an atonement for the sons of Israel for their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:2
verses.text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD has commanded, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:3
verses.text: Any man of the house of Israel who kills an ox or lamb or goat in the camp, or kills it out of the camp,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:4
verses.text: and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer as offering to the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD, blood shall be charged to that man; he has shed blood. And that man shall be cut off from among his people,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:5
verses.text: so that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to the priest, and offer them <hi>for</hi> peace offerings to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:6
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of the LORD <hi>at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:7
verses.text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices to goats, after whom they have gone whoring. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:8
verses.text: And you shall say to them, Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who are staying among you, offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:9
verses.text: and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation to offer it to the LORD, even that man shall be cut off from among his people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:10
verses.text: And any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that are staying among you, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:11
verses.text: For the life of the flesh <hi>is</hi> in the blood. And I have given it to you on the altar to make an atonement for your souls. For it <hi>is</hi> the blood that makes an atonement for the soul.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:12
verses.text: Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that is staying among you eat blood.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:13
verses.text: And any man of the sons of Israel, or of the strangers that are staying among you, who hunts game, beast or fowl, that may be eaten, he shall even pour out its blood and cover it with dust.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:14
verses.text: For <hi>it is</hi> the life of all flesh. Its blood is for the life of it. Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, You shall eat the blood of any flesh. For the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:15
verses.text: And any soul that eats a dead body, or a torn thing, whether a native or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:16
verses.text: But if he does not wash, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 18:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:3
verses.text: You shall not do like the doings of the land of Egypt in which you lived. And you shall not do like the doings of the land of Canaan, where I bring you. Neither shall you walk in their ordinances.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:4
verses.text: You shall do My judgments and keep My ordinances, to walk in them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:5
verses.text: And you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:6
verses.text: None of you shall approach to any who are near of kin to him, to uncover <hi>their</hi> nakedness. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:7
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother. She <hi>is</hi> your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:8
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife. It <hi>is</hi> your father's nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:9
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother, born at home or born away. Their nakedness you shall not uncover.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:10
verses.text: The nakedness of your son's daughter, or of your daughter's daughter, you shall not uncover their nakedness. For theirs <hi>is</hi> your own nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:11
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife, begotten of your father. She <hi>is</hi> your sister.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:12
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister. She <hi>is</hi> your father's near kinswoman.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:13
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister. For she <hi>is</hi> your mother's near kinswoman.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:14
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother. You shall not approach his wife. She <hi>is</hi> your aunt.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:15
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She <hi>is</hi> your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:16
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife. It <hi>is</hi> your brother's nakedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:17
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shall you undertake to uncover her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter. They <hi>are</hi> her near kinswomen; it <hi>is</hi> wickedness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:18
verses.text: And you shall not take a wife to her sister, to vex <hi>her</hi>, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:19
verses.text: Also you shall not approach to a woman to uncover her nakedness in the impurity of her uncleanness.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:20
verses.text: And you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife, to defile yourself with her.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:21
verses.text: And you shall not let any of your seed pass through <hi>the fire</hi> to Molech, neither shall you profane the name of your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:22
verses.text: You shall not lie with mankind as with womankind. It <hi>is</hi> abomination <hi>to God</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:23
verses.text: And you shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. And a woman shall not stand before an animal to lie down to it. It <hi>is</hi> a <hi>shameful</hi> mixing.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:24
verses.text: Do not defile yourselves in any of these things. For in all these the nations are defiled, which I cast out before you.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:25
verses.text: And the land is defiled. Therefore I visit its wickedness on it, and the land itself vomits out those who live in it.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:26
verses.text: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, and shall not commit <hi>any</hi> of these abominations, <hi>neither</hi> the native, nor any stranger that lives among you.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:27
verses.text: For the men of the land who <hi>were</hi> before you have done all these abominations, and the land is defiled.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:28
verses.text: <hi> You shall not do these</hi> so that the land may not spew you out also when you defile it, as it spewed out the nations that <hi>were</hi> before you.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:29
verses.text: For whoever shall commit <hi>any</hi> of these abominations, even the souls who commit <hi>them</hi> shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:30
verses.text: And you shall keep My ordinance, so as not to do <hi>any</hi> of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and that you do not defile yourselves in them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 19:2
verses.text: Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them, You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God <hi>am</hi> holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:3
verses.text: You shall each man revere his mother and his father, and keep My sabbaths. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:4
verses.text: Do not turn to idols, nor make molten gods to yourselves. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:5
verses.text: And if you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it of your own free will.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:6
verses.text: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. And if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned in the fire.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:7
verses.text: And if it is eaten at all on the third day, it <hi>is</hi> abominable. It shall not be accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:8
verses.text: And anyone that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD. And that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:9
verses.text: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corner of your field. And you shall not gather the gleaning of your harvest.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:10
verses.text: And you shall not glean your vineyard. And you shall not gather the leavings of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and the stranger. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:11
verses.text: You shall not steal, nor lie, nor be deceitful to one another.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:12
verses.text: And you shall not swear by My name falsely; nor shall you profane the name of your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:13
verses.text: You shall not defraud your neighbor nor rob <hi>him</hi>. The wages of him who is hired shall not stay with you until the morning.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:14
verses.text: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling-block before the blind, but shall fear your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:15
verses.text: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment. You shall not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; <hi>but</hi> you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:16
verses.text: You shall not go <hi>as</hi> a slanderer among your people; you shall not stand against the blood of your neighbor. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:17
verses.text: You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall always rebuke your neighbor, and not allow sin on him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:18
verses.text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the sons of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:19
verses.text: You shall keep My statutes. You shall not let your cattle breed with different kinds. You shall not sow your field with two kinds <hi>of</hi> seed. And you shall not allow clothing mixed of linen and wool to come on you.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:20
verses.text: And whoever lies with a woman with semen, and she is a slave-girl, betrothed to a husband and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her, there shall be an inquest. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:21
verses.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:22
verses.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has done. And the sin which he has done shall be forgiven him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:23
verses.text: And when you shall come into the land, and shall have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count the fruit of them as uncircumcised. It shall be uncircumcised three years to you. It shall not be eaten.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:24
verses.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit of them shall be holy to praise the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:25
verses.text: And in the fifth year you shall eat of the fruit of it, so that it may yield to you its increase. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:26
verses.text: You shall not eat <hi>anything</hi> with the blood. You shall not divine, nor conjure <hi>spirits</hi>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:27
verses.text: You shall not round the side of your head, nor mar the edge of your beard.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:28
verses.text: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks on you. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:29
verses.text: You shall not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a whore, lest the land go whoring, and the land become full of wickedness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:30
verses.text: You shall keep My sabbaths and revere My sanctuary. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:31
verses.text: You shall not turn to those that have familiar spirits, nor seek to spiritists to be defiled by them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:32
verses.text: You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the old man, and fear your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:33
verses.text: And if a stranger lives with you in your land, you shall not oppress him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:34
verses.text: The stranger that dwells with you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself. For you were strangers in the land of Egypt. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:35
verses.text: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures and weights, or in quantity.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:36
verses.text: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:37
verses.text: And you shall observe all My statutes and all My judgments, and do them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:2
verses.text: Again you shall say to the sons of Israel, Any man of the sons of Israel or of the strangers who live in Israel, that gives any of his seed to Molech, he shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:3
verses.text: And I will set My face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his seed to Molech, to defile My sanctuary, and to profane My holy name.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:4
verses.text: And if the people of the land in any way hide their eyes from the man when he gives of his seed to Molech, and do not kill him,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:5
verses.text: then I will set My face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go lusting after him to commit adultery with Molech, from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:6
verses.text: And the soul that turns to those who have familiar spirits, and to spiritists, to go lusting after them, I will even set My face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:7
verses.text: And you shall sanctify yourselves, and be holy. For I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:8
verses.text: And you shall keep My statutes and do them. I the LORD sanctify you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:9
verses.text: And any man who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother; his blood <hi>shall be</hi> on him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:10
verses.text: And a man who commits adultery with a man's wife, who commits adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:11
verses.text: And the man who lies with his father's wife has uncovered his father's nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be on them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:12
verses.text: And if a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have made a <hi>shameful</hi> mixture; their blood <hi>shall be</hi> on them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:13
verses.text: If a man also lies with mankind, as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood <hi>shall be</hi> on them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:14
verses.text: And if a man takes a wife and her mother, it <hi>is</hi> wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, so that there may be no wickedness among you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:15
verses.text: And if a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death. And you shall kill the animal.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:16
verses.text: And if a woman goes up to any animal and lies down with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death; their blood <hi>shall be</hi> on them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:17
verses.text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness, it <hi>is</hi> a wicked thing. And they shall be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:18
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with a menstruous woman, and shall uncover her nakedness, he has discovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. And both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:19
verses.text: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, nor of your father's sister. For he uncovers his near kin. They shall bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:20
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he has uncovered his uncle's nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:21
verses.text: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it <hi>is</hi> an unclean thing. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:22
verses.text: You shall therefore keep all My statutes and all My judgments, and do them, so that the land where I bring you to live shall not spit you out.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:23
verses.text: And you shall not walk in the ways of the nation which I cast out before you. For they committed all these things, and therefore I loathed them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:24
verses.text: But I have said to you, You shall inherit their land, and I, I am giving it to you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who has separated you from the nations.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:25
verses.text: And you shall make a difference between clean animals and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean. And you shall not defile your souls by beast, or by fowl, or by any kind of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:26
verses.text: And you shall be holy to Me. For I, the LORD, am holy, and have severed you from the nations, so that you should be Mine.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:27
verses.text: A man also or woman that has a medium or that is a familiar spirit, shall surely be put to death. They shall stone them with stones. Their blood <hi>is</hi> on them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:2
verses.text: But for his kin that is near him, for his mother and for his father and for his son and for his daughter and for his brother

verses.name: Leviticus 21:3
verses.text: and for his sister, a virgin, who is near to him, who has had no husband, for her he may be defiled.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:4
verses.text: A leader shall not defile himself among his people, to pollute himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:5
verses.text: They shall not make baldness on their head, nor shall they shave the corner of their beard, nor make any cutting in their flesh.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:6
verses.text: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. For they offer the fire offerings of the LORD, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:7
verses.text: They shall not take a wife <hi>who is</hi> a whore, or defiled. Neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband. For he <hi>is</hi> holy to his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:8
verses.text: And you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you. For I <hi>am</hi> holy, the LORD who sanctifies you.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:9
verses.text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by going whoring, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:10
verses.text: And the high priest among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil was poured and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head nor tear his clothes.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:11
verses.text: Neither shall he come near to any dead person, nor defile himself for his father nor for his mother.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:12
verses.text: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God <hi>is</hi> on him. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:13
verses.text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:14
verses.text: He shall not take a widow or a divorced woman, or profane, <hi>or</hi> a harlot, but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:15
verses.text: And he shall not defile his seed among his people. For I the LORD do sanctify him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:16
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:17
verses.text: Speak to Aaron, saying, No man of your seed in their generations shall draw near to offer the bread of his God if there is a blemish in him.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:18
verses.text: For no man in whom <hi>there is</hi> a blemish shall draw near, a blind man, or a lame man, or disfigured, or deformed,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:19
verses.text: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:20
verses.text: or crook-backed, or a crushed one, or who has a blemish in his eye, or a scurvy or scabbed person, or one with crushed testicles.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:21
verses.text: No man of the seed of Aaron, the priest, in whom there is a blemish shall come near to offer the fire offerings of the LORD. He has a blemish; he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:22
verses.text: He shall eat the bread of his God, of the most holy and of the holy.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:23
verses.text: Only he shall not go in to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a blemish; so that he does not profane My sanctuaries. For I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:24
verses.text: And Moses told Aaron and his sons, and all the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:2
verses.text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, that they set themselves apart from the holy things of the sons of Israel, and that they do not profane My holy name <hi>in what</hi> they devote to Me. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:3
verses.text: Say to them, Any man of all your seed among your generations who draws near to the holy things, which the sons of Israel set apart to the Lord, if he has his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from My presence. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:4
verses.text: Any man of the seed of Aaron who <hi>is</hi> leprous, or has a discharge, he shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. And he who touches any uncleanness of a person, or a man whose semen has gone out from him,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:5
verses.text: or a man who touches any swarming thing by which he may be made unclean, or touches a man who is unclean to him, by any uncleanness he has,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:6
verses.text: the soul which has touched it shall be unclean until evening. And he shall not eat of the holy things unless he washes his flesh with water.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:7
verses.text: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things, because it <hi>is</hi> his food.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:8
verses.text: He shall not eat a dead body or one torn, to defile himself with them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:9
verses.text: And they shall keep My ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, that they may not die for it when they defile it. I the LORD sanctify them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:10
verses.text: There shall no stranger eat <hi>of</hi> the holy things. A tenant of a priest, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:11
verses.text: But if the priest buys a soul with his silver, he shall eat of it. And one born in his house shall eat of his food.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:12
verses.text: And a priest's daughter, when she belongs to a man, a stranger, she may not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:13
verses.text: But if the priest's daughter is a widow, or put away, and has no child, and has returned to her father's house, as <hi>in</hi> her youth, she shall eat of her father's food. But no stranger shall eat of it.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:14
verses.text: And if a man eats a holy thing without knowing it, then he shall put the fifth part to it, and shall give to the priest with the holy thing.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:15
verses.text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel which they offer to the LORD,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:16
verses.text: and so load on them the iniquity of the guilt offering in their eating of their holy things. For I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who sanctifies them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:17
verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:18
verses.text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them: Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, who offers his sacrifices for his vows, for all his free-will offerings, which they will offer to the LORD for a burnt offering,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:19
verses.text: <hi> you shall offer</hi> at your own will a male without blemish, of the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:20
verses.text: You shall not offer that which has a blemish. For it shall not be acceptable for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:21
verses.text: And when a man offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to carry out <hi>his</hi> vow, or a free-will offering in cattle or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted. There shall be no blemish in them.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:22
verses.text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a flow, or having scurvy, or scabbed, you shall not offer these to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:23
verses.text: As to a young bull or a sheep that is deformed or dwarfed, you may offer that <hi>for</hi> a free-will offering. But for a vow it shall not be accepted.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:24
verses.text: You shall not offer to the LORD that which is bruised or crushed, or broken or cut. You shall not make <hi>any offering</hi> of it in your land.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:25
verses.text: And you shall not offer the bread of your God out of the hand of a son of a stranger, or any of these, because their uncleanness <hi>is</hi> in them, and blemishes are in them. They shall not be accepted for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:26
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:27
verses.text: When a bull or a lamb or a goat is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam. And from the eighth day and from then on, it shall be accepted for a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:28
verses.text: But a bull or sheep, it and its young one, you shall not kill it in one day.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:29
verses.text: And when you will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, offer <hi>it</hi> at your own will.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:30
verses.text: On the same day it shall be eaten up. You shall leave none of it until morning. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:31
verses.text: And you shall keep My commandments, and do them. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:32
verses.text: And you shall not profane My holy name. But I will be holy among the sons of Israel. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who is sanctifying you,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:33
verses.text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, The feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim, holy convocations, even these are My appointed feasts.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:3
verses.text: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day <hi>is</hi> the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation. You shall not do any work. It <hi>is</hi> a sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:4
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the appointed feasts of the LORD, holy convocations which you shall proclaim in their appointed seasons.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:5
verses.text: In the fourteenth <hi>day</hi> of the first month, between the evenings, is the LORD's Passover,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:6
verses.text: and on the fifteenth day of the same month <hi>is</hi> the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi> to the LORD. You must eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi> seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:7
verses.text: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:8
verses.text: but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day <hi>is</hi> a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:9
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:10
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap the harvest of it, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:11
verses.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD to be received for you. On the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:12
verses.text: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf, a male lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:13
verses.text: And its food offering <hi>shall be</hi> two-tenth parts of fine flour mixed with oil, a fire offering to the LORD for a sweet savor. And the drink offering of it <hi>shall be</hi> of wine, the fourth <hi>part</hi> of a hin.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:14
verses.text: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor green ears, until the same day, until you have brought an offering to your God. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:15
verses.text: And you shall count to you from the next day after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:16
verses.text: To the next day after the seventh sabbath you shall number fifty days. And you shall offer a new food offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:17
verses.text: You shall bring out of your homes two wave loaves of two-tenth parts. They shall be of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, firstfruits to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:18
verses.text: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bull, and two rams. They shall be <hi>for</hi> a burnt offering to the LORD, with their food offering, and their drink offerings, a fire offering of sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:19
verses.text: Then you shall sacrifice one he-goat for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:20
verses.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits, a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:21
verses.text: And you shall proclaim on the same day <hi>that</hi> it may be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no work of labor. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:22
verses.text: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the corner of your field. When you reap the gleaning of your harvest, you shall not gather. You shall leave them to the poor and to the stranger. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:23
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:24
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel saying: In the seventh month, in the first <hi>day</hi> of the month, you shall have a sabbath, a memorial summons, a holy convocation.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:25
verses.text: You shall do no work of labor but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:26
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:27
verses.text: Also, on the tenth of this seventh month, this is a day of atonement. <hi>It shall be</hi> a holy convocation to you. And you shall afflict your souls and offer a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:28
verses.text: And you shall do no work in that same day, for it <hi>is</hi> a day of atonement, in order to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:29
verses.text: For any soul who is not humbled in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:30
verses.text: And any soul who does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:31
verses.text: You shall do no kind of work. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:32
verses.text: It <hi>shall be</hi> to you a sabbath of rest, and you shall humble your souls. In the ninth of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your sabbath.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:33
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:34
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month <hi>shall be</hi> the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:35
verses.text: On the first day <hi>shall be</hi> a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:36
verses.text: Seven days you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. And you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. It <hi>is</hi> a solemn assembly. And you shall do no work of labor.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:37
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer a fire offering to the LORD, a burnt offering and a food offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, everything on its day;

verses.name: Leviticus 23:38
verses.text: besides the sabbath of the LORD, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your free-will offerings which you give to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:39
verses.text: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days. On the first day <hi>shall be</hi> a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:40
verses.text: And you shall take the fruit of majestic trees for yourselves on the first day, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook. And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:41
verses.text: And you shall keep it a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever in your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:42
verses.text: You shall live in booths seven days. All that are born Israelites shall live in booths,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:43
verses.text: so that your generations may know that I made the sons of Israel live in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:44
verses.text: And Moses declared the feasts of the LORD to the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:2
verses.text: Command the sons of Israel that they bring to you pure olive oil, beaten, for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:3
verses.text: Aaron shall order it from evening until the morning before the LORD forever outside the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation. <hi>It shall be</hi> a statute forever in your generations.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:4
verses.text: He shall order the lamps on the pure lampstand before the LORD forever.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:5
verses.text: And you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes of it. Two-tenth parts shall be in one cake.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:6
verses.text: And you shall set them in two rows, six <hi>on</hi> a row, on the pure table before the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:7
verses.text: And you shall put pure frankincense on <hi>each</hi> row, so that it may be on the bread for a memorial, a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:8
verses.text: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD forever, from the sons of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:9
verses.text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'. And they shall eat it in the holy place, for it <hi>is</hi> most holy to him of the fire offerings of the LORD, by a never-ending statute.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:10
verses.text: And the son of a woman of Israel, whose father <hi>was</hi> an Egyptian, went out among the sons of Israel. And this son of the woman of Israel and a man of Israel struggled together in the camp.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:11
