verses.name: Numbers 7:44
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:45
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:46
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:47
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

verses.name: Numbers 7:48
verses.text: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, ruler of the sons of Ephraim, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:49
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:50
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:51
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:52
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:53
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.name: Numbers 7:54
verses.text: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, ruler of the sons of Manasseh, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:55
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:56
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:57
verses.text: one young bull; one ram; one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:58
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:59
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.name: Numbers 7:60
verses.text: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, ruler of the sons of Benjamin, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:61
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:62
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:63
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:64
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:65
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.name: Numbers 7:66
verses.text: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, ruler of the sons of Dan, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:67
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:68
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:69
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:70
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:71
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 7:72
verses.text: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, ruler of the sons of Asher, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:73
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:74
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:75
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:76
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:77
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.name: Numbers 7:78
verses.text: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, ruler of the sons of Naphtali, <hi>offered</hi>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:79
verses.text: His offering <hi>was</hi> one silver dish, its weight a hundred thirty <hi>shekels</hi> according to the sanctuary shekel; one silver basin <hi>of</hi> seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:80
verses.text: one golden pan of ten <hi>shekels</hi>, full of incense;

verses.name: Numbers 7:81
verses.text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:82
verses.text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

verses.name: Numbers 7:83
verses.text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This <hi>was</hi> the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.name: Numbers 7:84
verses.text: This <hi>was</hi> the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the rulers of Israel: twelve platters of silver, twelve silver basins, twelve golden pans.

verses.name: Numbers 7:85
verses.text: Each silver dish weighed a hundred and thirty <hi>shekels</hi>, each basin seventy. All the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred <hi>shekels</hi>, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.name: Numbers 7:86
verses.text: twelve golden pans, full of incense, ten <hi>shekels</hi> each, according to the sanctuary shekel. All the gold of the pans <hi>was</hi> a hundred and twenty <hi>shekels</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:87
verses.text: All the animals for the burnt offerings were twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their food offering. And the males of the goats for a sin offering twelve.

verses.name: Numbers 7:88
verses.text: And all the animals for the sacrifice of the peace offerings <hi>were</hi> twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This <hi>was</hi> the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

verses.name: Numbers 7:89
verses.text: And when Moses had gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with Him, then he heard the voice of One speaking to him from the mercy-seat on the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubs. And He spoke to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:2
verses.text: Speak to Aaron, and say to him, When you bring the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.

verses.name: Numbers 8:3
verses.text: And Aaron did so. He lighted its lamps in front of the lampstand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 8:4
verses.text: And this work of the lampstand <hi>was of</hi> beaten gold, to its base and to its blossoms; it was beaten work. According to the pattern which the LORD had showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:5
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:6
verses.text: Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and purify them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:7
verses.text: And in this way shall you do to them to purify them. Sprinkle water of sin-offering on them, and let them shave all their flesh and wash their clothes, and make themselves clean.

verses.name: Numbers 8:8
verses.text: Then let them take a young bull with its food offering, fine flour mixed with oil, and another young bull shall you take for a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 8:9
verses.text: And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation. And you shall gather the whole assembly of the sons of Israel together.

verses.name: Numbers 8:10
verses.text: And you shall bring the Levites before the LORD. And the sons of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 8:11
verses.text: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD <hi>for</hi> an offering of the sons of Israel, so that they may do the service of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 8:12
verses.text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls. And you shall offer the one <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, to the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

verses.name: Numbers 8:13
verses.text: And you shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them <hi>for</hi> an offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 8:14
verses.text: So you shall separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel. And the Levites shall be Mine.

verses.name: Numbers 8:15
verses.text: And after that the Levites shall go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation. And you shall purify them and offer them <hi>for</hi> a wave offering.

verses.name: Numbers 8:16
verses.text: For they <hi>are</hi> wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel, instead of those that open every womb. The first-born of all the sons of Israel, I have taken them to Me.

verses.name: Numbers 8:17
verses.text: For all the first-born of the sons of Israel <hi>are</hi> Mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck every first-born in the land of Egypt I set them apart for Myself.

verses.name: Numbers 8:18
verses.text: And I have taken the Levites for all the first-born of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 8:19
verses.text: And I have given the Levites <hi>as</hi> a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the sons of Israel, to do the service of the sons of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the sons of Israel, so that there may be no plague among the sons of Israel when the sons of Israel come near the sanctuary.

verses.name: Numbers 8:20
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites according to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites. So the sons of Israel did to them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:21
verses.text: And the Levites purified themselves, and they washed their clothes. And Aaron offered them, an offering before the LORD. And Aaron made an atonement for them to purify them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:22
verses.text: And after that the Levites went in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron and before his sons. Even as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:23
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 8:24
verses.text: This <hi>is that</hi> which <hi>pertains</hi> to the Levites. From twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 8:25
verses.text: And from the age of fifty years they shall stop waiting upon the service, and shall serve no more.

verses.name: Numbers 8:26
verses.text: But they shall minister with their brothers in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge; only he shall not serve <hi>at</hi> a service. So you shall do to the Levites as to their duties.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 9:2
verses.text: Let the sons of Israel also keep the Passover at its appointed time.

verses.name: Numbers 9:3
verses.text: In the fourteenth day of this month, between the evenings, you shall keep it in its appointed time. You shall keep it according to all its statutes, and according to all the ceremonies of it.

verses.name: Numbers 9:4
verses.text: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to prepare the Passover.

verses.name: Numbers 9:5
verses.text: And they prepared the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month between the evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so all the sons of Israel did.

verses.name: Numbers 9:6
verses.text: And there were certain men who were defiled by the dead body of a man, so that they could not prepare the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.

verses.name: Numbers 9:7
verses.text: And those men said to him, We <hi>are</hi> defiled by the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in its appointed time among the sons of Israel?

verses.name: Numbers 9:8
verses.text: And Moses said to them, You wait, and I will hear what the LORD will command about you.

verses.name: Numbers 9:9
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 9:10
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your generations shall be unclean because of a dead body, or in a journey afar off, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 9:11
verses.text: They shall keep it the fourteenth day of the second month at evening, eating it with unleavened cakes and bitter <hi>herbs</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:12
verses.text: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break any bone of it. According to all the ordinances of the Passover they shall keep it.

verses.name: Numbers 9:13
verses.text: But the man that <hi>is</hi> clean, and is not in a journey, and holds back from preparing the Passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people. Because he did not bring the offering of the LORD in His appointed time, that man shall bear his sin.

verses.name: Numbers 9:14
verses.text: And if a stranger shall live among you, and prepares the Passover to the LORD, he shall do according to the ordinance of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger and for him that was born in the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:15
verses.text: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony. And at evening it was upon the tabernacle, looking like fire, until the morning.

verses.name: Numbers 9:16
verses.text: So it was always. The cloud covered it, and it looked like fire by night.

verses.name: Numbers 9:17
verses.text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the sons of Israel pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>. And in the place where the cloud stayed, there the sons of Israel pitched their tents.

verses.name: Numbers 9:18
verses.text: At the command of the LORD the sons of Israel pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>, and at the command of the LORD they pitched. As long as the cloud stayed upon the tabernacle they rested in camp.

verses.name: Numbers 9:19
verses.text: And when the cloud stayed long upon the tabernacle many days, then the sons of Israel kept the charge of the LORD and did not journey.

verses.name: Numbers 9:20
verses.text: And so when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle, according to the command of the LORD they remained in their tents, and according to the command of the LORD they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:21
verses.text: And so when the cloud stayed from evening to the morning, and the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>. Whether by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:22
verses.text: Whether <hi>it was</hi> two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud stayed upon the tabernacle, remaining on it, the sons of Israel stayed in their tents and did not journey. But when it was taken up, they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:23
verses.text: At the command of the LORD they encamped, and at the command of the LORD they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>. They kept the charge of the LORD at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 10:2
verses.text: Make two trumpets of silver for yourself. You shall make them of beaten work. And they shall be used for the calling of the assembly and for causing the camps to go forward.

verses.name: Numbers 10:3
verses.text: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall gather themselves to you at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 10:4
verses.text: And if they blow with one, then the rulers <hi>who are</hi> heads of the thousands of Israel shall gather themselves to you.

verses.name: Numbers 10:5
verses.text: When you blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall pull up.

verses.name: Numbers 10:6
verses.text: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall pull up. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

verses.name: Numbers 10:7
verses.text: But when the congregation is to be gathered, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

verses.name: Numbers 10:8
verses.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets. And they shall be to you for an ordinance forever throughout your generations.

verses.name: Numbers 10:9
verses.text: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy who fights against you, then you shall blow with the trumpets. And you shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.

verses.name: Numbers 10:10
verses.text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings, so that they may be to you for a memorial before your GOD. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:11
verses.text: And on the twentieth of the second month, in the second year, the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle of the testimony.

verses.name: Numbers 10:12
verses.text: And the sons of Israel pulled up in their journeyings out of the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.name: Numbers 10:13
verses.text: And at the mouth of Jehovah they first pulled up <hi>stakes</hi>, by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 10:14
verses.text: And at the front the sons of Judah pulled up the standard of the camp by their armies. And over his army <hi>was</hi> Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.name: Numbers 10:15
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Issachar <hi>was</hi> Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.name: Numbers 10:16
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun <hi>was</hi> Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.name: Numbers 10:17
verses.text: And the tabernacle was taken down. And the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari pulled up, carrying the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 10:18
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben pulled up according to their armies. And over his army <hi>was</hi> Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.name: Numbers 10:19
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Simeon <hi>was</hi> Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 10:20
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Gad <hi>was</hi> Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

verses.name: Numbers 10:21
verses.text: And the Kohathites pulled up carrying the sanctuary. And the tabernacle was set up before they came.

verses.name: Numbers 10:22
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Ephraim pulled up according to their armies. And over his army <hi>was</hi> Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.name: Numbers 10:23
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh <hi>was</hi> Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.name: Numbers 10:24
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin <hi>was</hi> Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.name: Numbers 10:25
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Dan set forward, the rear guard of all the camps throughout their army. And over his army <hi>was</hi> Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.name: Numbers 10:26
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Asher <hi>was</hi> Pagiel, the son of Ocran.

verses.name: Numbers 10:27
verses.text: And over the army of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali <hi>was</hi> Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.name: Numbers 10:28
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the journeyings of the sons of Israel according to their armies when they pulled up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:29
verses.text: And Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law: We are going to the place of which the LORD said, I will give it to you. Come with us, and we will do you good. For the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 10:30
verses.text: And he said to him, I will not go, but I will go to my own land and to my kindred.

verses.name: Numbers 10:31
verses.text: And he said, Please do not leave us, because you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and so you may be to us for eyes.

verses.name: Numbers 10:32
verses.text: And it shall be, if you go with us, then it shall be, whatever goodness the LORD shall do to us, the same will we do to you.

verses.name: Numbers 10:33
verses.text: And they moved three days' journey from the mountain of the LORD. And the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to look for a resting-place for them.

verses.name: Numbers 10:34
verses.text: And the cloud of the LORD <hi>was</hi> upon them by day, when they pulled up out of the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 10:35
verses.text: And it happened when the ark pulled up, Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee before You.

verses.name: Numbers 10:36
verses.text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, to the many thousands of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:1
verses.text: And the people <hi>were</hi> evil, as those complaining in the ears of the LORD. And the LORD heard, and His anger was kindled. And the fire of the LORD burned among them and burned up in the outermost parts of the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:2
verses.text: And the people cried to Moses. And when Moses prayed to the LORD, the fire was put out.

verses.name: Numbers 11:3
verses.text: And he called the name of the place Taberah, because the fire of the LORD burned among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:4
verses.text: And the mixed multitude in their midst lusted with <hi>great</hi> lust. And the sons of Israel also turned and wept, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

verses.name: Numbers 11:5
verses.text: We remember the fish which we ate freely in Egypt, the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic.

verses.name: Numbers 11:6
verses.text: But now our soul <hi>is</hi> dried away; there is nothing at all besides this manna <hi>before our</hi> eyes.

verses.name: Numbers 11:7
verses.text: And the manna <hi>was</hi> like coriander seed, and the color of it was like the color of bdellium.

verses.name: Numbers 11:8
verses.text: The people went around and gathered, and ground it in mills, or beat <hi>it</hi> in a mortar, and baked in pans, and made cakes of it. And the taste of it was like the taste of fresh oil.

verses.name: Numbers 11:9
verses.text: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

verses.name: Numbers 11:10
verses.text: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent. And the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly. Moses also was displeased.

verses.name: Numbers 11:11
verses.text: And Moses said to the LORD, Why have You afflicted Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, so that You lay the burden of all this people upon me?

verses.name: Numbers 11:12
verses.text: Have I conceived all this people? Did I bring them forth, that You should say to me, Carry them in your bosom like a nursing father carries the sucking child, to the land which You swore to their fathers?

verses.name: Numbers 11:13
verses.text: From where should I get flesh to give to all this people? For they weep to me, saying, Give us flesh that we may eat.

verses.name: Numbers 11:14
verses.text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because <hi>it is</hi> too heavy for me.

verses.name: Numbers 11:15
verses.text: And if You are going to part this way with me, I beg You to kill me at once, if I have found favor in Your sight, and let me not see my misery.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:16
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and the officers over them. And bring them to the tabernacle of the congregation so that they may stand there with you.

verses.name: Numbers 11:17
verses.text: And I will come down and talk with you there. And I will take of the spirit on you, and will put <hi>it</hi> on them, and they shall bear the burden of the people with you so that you do not bear <hi>it</hi> yourself alone.

verses.name: Numbers 11:18
verses.text: And say to the people, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat flesh. For you have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat, for <hi>it was</hi> well with us in Egypt? Therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and you shall eat.

verses.name: Numbers 11:19
verses.text: You shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days.

verses.name: Numbers 11:20
verses.text: Even a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is hateful to you, because you have despised the LORD among you, and have wept before Him, saying, Why did we come out of Egypt?

verses.name: Numbers 11:21
verses.text: And Moses said, The people among whom I <hi>am</hi> <hi>are</hi> six hundred thousand footmen. And You have said, I will give them flesh so that they may eat a whole month!

verses.name: Numbers 11:22
verses.text: Shall the flocks and the herds be killed for them, to be enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be enough for them?

verses.name: Numbers 11:23
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Has the LORD's hand become short? You shall see now whether or not My word shall come to pass to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:24
verses.text: And Moses went out and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them all around the tabernacle.

verses.name: Numbers 11:25
verses.text: And the LORD came down in a cloud and spoke to him, and took of the spirit on him and gave <hi>it</hi> to the seventy elders. And it happened when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied. But they never did so again.

verses.name: Numbers 11:26
verses.text: But two of the men stayed in the camp; the name of the one <hi>was</hi> Eldad, and the name of the other was Medad. And the Spirit rested upon them. And they <hi>were</hi> of those who were written, but did not go out to the tabernacle. And they prophesied in the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:27
verses.text: And a young man ran and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:28
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, <hi>one</hi> of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, make them cease.

verses.name: Numbers 11:29
verses.text: And Moses said to him, Are you jealous for my sake? Would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, that the LORD would put His Spirit upon them!

verses.name: Numbers 11:30
verses.text: And Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:31
verses.text: And a wind went forth from the LORD. And it cut off quails from the sea and let them fall by the camp, about a day's journey on this side, and about a day's journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about two cubits <hi> high</hi> upon the face of the earth.

verses.name: Numbers 11:32
verses.text: And the people stood up all that day and all night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails. And he that gathered least gathered ten homers. And they spread <hi>them</hi> out for themselves all around the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 11:33
verses.text: And while the flesh <hi>was</hi> yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.

verses.name: Numbers 11:34
verses.text: And he called the name of that place Graves of Lust, because there they buried the people that lusted.

verses.name: Numbers 11:35
verses.text: <hi> And</hi> the people pulled up from the Graves of Lust to Hazeroth, and stayed at Hazeroth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:1
verses.text: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had taken. For he had taken a Cushite woman.

verses.name: Numbers 12:2
verses.text: And they said, Has the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? Has He not also spoken by us? And the LORD heard.

verses.name: Numbers 12:3
verses.text: (Now the man Moses <hi>was</hi> very meek, more than all the men on the face of the earth.)  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:4
verses.text: And the LORD spoke suddenly to Moses and to Aaron and to Miriam, You three come out to the tabernacle of the congregation. And the three came out.

verses.name: Numbers 12:5
verses.text: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud and stood <hi>in</hi> the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both came forth.

verses.name: Numbers 12:6
verses.text: And He said, Hear now My words. If there is a prophet among you, <hi>I</hi> the LORD will make Myself known to him in a vision, and will speak to him in a dream.

verses.name: Numbers 12:7
verses.text: Not so, My servant Moses. He <hi>is</hi> faithful in all My house.

verses.name: Numbers 12:8
verses.text: I will speak with him mouth to mouth, even clearly, and not in dark speeches. And he shall behold the likeness of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?

verses.name: Numbers 12:9
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them, and He moved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:10
verses.text: And the cloud moved from the tabernacle. And behold! Miriam <hi>became</hi> leprous, as snow. And Aaron looked on Miriam, and behold, <hi>she was</hi> leprous.

verses.name: Numbers 12:11
verses.text: And Aaron said to Moses, Oh, my lord, I beg you, do not lay upon us the sin in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

verses.name: Numbers 12:12
verses.text: Let her not be like one dead, of whom the flesh is half gone when he comes out of his mother's womb.

verses.name: Numbers 12:13
verses.text: And Moses cried to the LORD saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech You.

verses.name: Numbers 12:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received.

verses.name: Numbers 12:15
verses.text: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days. And the people did not pull up until Miriam was brought in.

verses.name: Numbers 12:16
verses.text: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 13:2
verses.text: Send men so that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give to the sons of Israel. You shall send a man from every tribe of their fathers, everyone a ruler among them.

verses.name: Numbers 13:3
verses.text: And Moses by the command of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran. All those men <hi>were</hi> heads of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 13:4
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

verses.name: Numbers 13:5
verses.text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

verses.name: Numbers 13:6
verses.text: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.name: Numbers 13:7
verses.text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

verses.name: Numbers 13:8
verses.text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

verses.name: Numbers 13:9
verses.text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

verses.name: Numbers 13:10
verses.text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

verses.name: Numbers 13:11
verses.text: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

verses.name: Numbers 13:12
verses.text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

verses.name: Numbers 13:13
verses.text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

verses.name: Numbers 13:14
verses.text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

verses.name: Numbers 13:15
verses.text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

verses.name: Numbers 13:16
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Joshua.

verses.name: Numbers 13:17
verses.text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up this <hi>way</hi>, southward, and go up <hi>into</hi> the mountain.

verses.name: Numbers 13:18
verses.text: And see the land, what it <hi>is</hi>, and the people that live in it, whether it is strong or weak, few or many.

verses.name: Numbers 13:19
verses.text: And see what the land <hi>is</hi> that they live in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they dwell in, whether in tents or in strongholds;

verses.name: Numbers 13:20
verses.text: and what the land <hi>is</hi>, whether fat or lean, whether there is wood in it or not. And be of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time <hi>was</hi> the time of first ripe grapes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:21
verses.text: So they went up and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

verses.name: Numbers 13:22
verses.text: And they went up by the south and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the sons of Anak <hi>were</hi>. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.name: Numbers 13:23
verses.text: And they came to the valley of Eshcol and cut from there a branch with one cluster of grapes. And they carried it between two men upon a staff, and some of the pomegranates and of the figs.

verses.name: Numbers 13:24
verses.text: The place was called the valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes which the sons of Israel cut down from there.

verses.name: Numbers 13:25
verses.text: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:26
verses.text: And they left and came to Moses and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh. And they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

verses.name: Numbers 13:27
verses.text: And they told him and said, We came to the land where you sent us, and surely it flows with milk and honey. And this <hi>is</hi> the fruit of it.

verses.name: Numbers 13:28
verses.text: However, the people that dwell in the land <hi>are</hi> strong, and the cities <hi>are</hi> walled, very great. And also we saw the children of Anak there.

verses.name: Numbers 13:29
verses.text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south, and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains. And the Canaanites dwell by the sea and by the coast of Jordan.

verses.name: Numbers 13:30
verses.text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses and said, Let us go up at once and possess it. For we are well able to overcome it.

verses.name: Numbers 13:31
verses.text: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they <hi>are</hi> stronger than we.

verses.name: Numbers 13:32
verses.text: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched to the sons of Israel, saying, The land through which we have gone to search it, <hi>is</hi> a land that eats up those who live in it. And all the people whom we saw in it were men of stature.

verses.name: Numbers 13:33
verses.text: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, of the giants. And we were in our own sight like grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:1
verses.text: And all the congregation lifted up their voice and cried. And the people wept that night.

verses.name: Numbers 14:2
verses.text: And all the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. And the whole congregation said to them, Oh that we had died in the land of Egypt! Or, Oh that we had died in the wilderness!

verses.name: Numbers 14:3
verses.text: And why has the LORD brought us into this land to fall by the sword, so that our wives and our sons should be a prey? Would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?

verses.name: Numbers 14:4
verses.text: And they said to one another, Let us make a leader, and let us return to Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:5
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 14:6
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of those that searched the land, tore their clothes.

verses.name: Numbers 14:7
verses.text: And they spoke to all the company of the <hi>sons</hi> of Israel saying, The land which we passed through to search is an exceedingly good land.

verses.name: Numbers 14:8
verses.text: If the LORD delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land which flows with milk and honey.

verses.name: Numbers 14:9
verses.text: Only do not rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land. For they <hi>are</hi> bread for us. Their protection has moved from them, and the LORD <hi>is</hi> with us. Do not fear them.

verses.name: Numbers 14:10
verses.text: But all the congregation said to stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, How long will this people provoke Me? And how long will it be before they believe Me, for all the signs which I have shown among them?

verses.name: Numbers 14:12
verses.text: I will strike them with the pestilence and will disinherit them, and will make of you a greater nation and mightier than they.

verses.name: Numbers 14:13
verses.text: And Moses said to the LORD, Then the Egyptians will hear, for You have brought up this people in Your might from among them.

verses.name: Numbers 14:14
verses.text: And they will say to the inhabitant of this land. They have heard that You, LORD, <hi>are</hi> among this people, who is seen eye to eye. You <hi>are</hi> the LORD, and Your cloud stands over them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.name: Numbers 14:15
verses.text: And will you kill this people as one man? Then the nations who have heard Your fame will speak, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 14:16
verses.text: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which He swore to them, therefore He has slain them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Numbers 14:17
verses.text: And now, I beseech You, let the power of my Lord be great, according as You have spoken, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 14:18
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> long-suffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing <hi>the guilty</hi>, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and fourth <hi>generation</hi>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:19
verses.text: I beseech You, pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your mercy, and as You have forgiven this people from Egypt even until now.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:20
verses.text: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to your word.

verses.name: Numbers 14:21
verses.text: But truly, <hi>as</hi> I live, all the earth shall be filled <hi>with</hi> the glory of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 14:22
verses.text: Because all those men who have seen My glory and My miracles which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted Me now these ten times, and have not listened to My voice,

verses.name: Numbers 14:23
verses.text: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked Me see it.

verses.name: Numbers 14:24
verses.text: But My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land into which he went. And his seed shall possess it.

verses.name: Numbers 14:25
verses.text: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites lived in the valley.) Tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.

verses.name: Numbers 14:26
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 14:27
verses.text: How long <hi>shall I bear with</hi> this evil congregation, which murmurs against Me? I have heard the murmurings of the sons of Israel which they murmur against Me.

verses.name: Numbers 14:28
verses.text: Say to them, <hi>As</hi> I live, says the LORD, as you have spoken in My ears, so I will do to you.

verses.name: Numbers 14:29
verses.text: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness, and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against Me,

verses.name: Numbers 14:30
verses.text: you shall certainly not come into the land which I swore to make you live in, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.name: Numbers 14:31
verses.text: But your little ones, which you said should be a prey, I will bring them in and they shall know the land which you have despised.

verses.name: Numbers 14:32
verses.text: But <hi>as for</hi> you, your bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

verses.name: Numbers 14:33
verses.text: And your sons shall feed in the wilderness forty years and bear your fornications, until your dead bodies have wasted in the wilderness.

verses.name: Numbers 14:34
verses.text: According to the number of the days in which you searched the land-- forty days-- each day for a year you shall bear your iniquities, forty years; and you shall know my alienation.

verses.name: Numbers 14:35
verses.text: I the LORD have spoken; I will surely do it to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against Me. They shall be destroyed in this wilderness, and there they shall die.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:36
verses.text: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report upon the land,

verses.name: Numbers 14:37
verses.text: even those men that brought up the evil report upon the land died by the plague before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 14:38
verses.text: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of the men that went to spy out the land, lived.

verses.name: Numbers 14:39
verses.text: And Moses told these sayings to all the sons of Israel. And the people mourned greatly.

verses.name: Numbers 14:40
verses.text: And they rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised, for we have sinned.

verses.name: Numbers 14:41
verses.text: And Moses said, Why do you now go beyond the command of the LORD, since it shall not be blessed?

verses.name: Numbers 14:42
verses.text: Do not go up, for the LORD <hi>is</hi> not among you. And shall you not be beaten before your enemies?

verses.name: Numbers 14:43
verses.text: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites <hi>are</hi> there before you, and you shall fall by the sword. Because you have turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

verses.name: Numbers 14:44
verses.text: But they presumed to go up to the hill top. But the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, did not leave the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 14:45
verses.text: And the Amalekites and the Canaanites who were living in that mountain came down and struck them, and beat them down, to Hormah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have come into the land of your dwelling places, which I give to you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:3
verses.text: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a free-will offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savor to the LORD, from the herd or from the flock,

verses.name: Numbers 15:4
verses.text: then he who offers his offering to the LORD shall bring a food offering of a tenth part of flour mixed with the fourth of a hin of oil.

verses.name: Numbers 15:5
verses.text: And the fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering shall you prepare with the burnt offering, or sacrifice, for one lamb.

verses.name: Numbers 15:6
verses.text: Or for a ram, you shall prepare a food offering, two-tenth parts of flour mixed with the third of a hin of oil.

verses.name: Numbers 15:7
verses.text: And for a drink offering you shall offer the third of a hin of wine <hi>for</hi> a sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 15:8
verses.text: And when you prepare a bull, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings to the LORD,

verses.name: Numbers 15:9
verses.text: then he shall bring with the bull, a food offering of three-tenth parts of flour mixed with half a hin of oil.

verses.name: Numbers 15:10
verses.text: And you shall bring for a drink offering half a hin of wine, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 15:11
verses.text: So it shall be done for one bull, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

verses.name: Numbers 15:12
verses.text: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

verses.name: Numbers 15:13
verses.text: All that are born of the country shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 15:14
verses.text: And if a stranger stays with you, or whoever <hi>is</hi> among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire of a sweet savor to the LORD; as you do, so he shall do.

verses.name: Numbers 15:15
verses.text: One ordinance for you of the congregation and also for the stranger that resides <hi>with you</hi>, an ordinance forever in your generations. As you are, so the stranger shall be before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 15:16
verses.text: One law and one way shall be for you and for the stranger that lives with you.

verses.name: Numbers 15:17
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:18
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land where I bring you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:19
verses.text: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a heave offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 15:20
verses.text: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough, a heave offering, as the heave offering of the threshing-floor, so you shall lift it up.

verses.name: Numbers 15:21
verses.text: Of the first of your dough you shall give to the LORD a heave offering in your generations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:22
verses.text: And if you have erred and have not done all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses,

verses.name: Numbers 15:23
verses.text: all that the LORD has commanded you by the hand of Moses from the day that the LORD commanded, and onward in your generations,

verses.name: Numbers 15:24
verses.text: then it shall be if it is committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, all the congregation shall offer up one young bull for a burnt offering, for a sweet savor to the LORD, with its food offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 15:25
verses.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it <hi>is</hi> ignorance. And they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance.

verses.name: Numbers 15:26
verses.text: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the sons of Israel and the stranger that lives among them, since all the people <hi>were</hi> in ignorance.

verses.name: Numbers 15:27
verses.text: And if one soul sins through ignorance, then he shall bring a female goat of the first year for a sin offering.

verses.name: Numbers 15:28
verses.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul, when he sins through error before the LORD, to make an atonement for him. And it shall be forgiven him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:29
verses.text: And you shall have one law for him who acts through ignorance; <hi>for</hi> him that is native among the sons of Israel and for the alien that resides among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:30
verses.text: But the soul who acts with a high hand, <hi>whether</hi> of the native or of the alien, the same blasphemes the LORD. And that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.name: Numbers 15:31
verses.text: Because he has despised the word of the LORD and has broken His commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity <hi>shall be</hi> upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:32
verses.text: And while the sons of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the sabbath day.

verses.name: Numbers 15:33
verses.text: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 15:34
verses.text: And they put him under guard because it had not been clearly said what should be done to him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:35
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 15:36
verses.text: And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died, even as the LORD commanded Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:37
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 15:38
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and command them that they make fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribbon of blue.

verses.name: Numbers 15:39
verses.text: And it shall be to you for a fringe, that you may look upon it and remember all the commands of the LORD, and do them; and so that you do not seek after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you prostitute yourself,

verses.name: Numbers 15:40
verses.text: that you may remember and do all My commands, and be holy to your God.

verses.name: Numbers 15:41
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:1
verses.text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, took both Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben;

verses.name: Numbers 16:2
verses.text: even they rose up before Moses with some of the sons of Israel, two hundred and fifty rulers of the assembly, elect men in the congregation, men who were well-known.

verses.name: Numbers 16:3
verses.text: And they gathered themselves against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, <hi>You take</hi> too much upon you, since all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them. Why then do you lift yourselves up above the congregation of the LORD?

verses.name: Numbers 16:4
verses.text: And Moses heard and fell on his face.

verses.name: Numbers 16:5
verses.text: And he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, Even tomorrow the LORD will show <hi>who are</hi> His, and him who is holy, and will cause him to come near to Him; even him whom He has chosen, He will cause to come near to Him.

verses.name: Numbers 16:6
verses.text: Do this. Take fire-pans, Korah and all his company,

verses.name: Numbers 16:7
verses.text: and put fire in them, and put incense in them before the LORD tomorrow. And it shall be the man whom the LORD chooses, he <hi>shall be</hi> holy. You take too much upon you, sons of Levi!

verses.name: Numbers 16:8
verses.text: And Moses said to Korah, Hear now you sons of Levi;

verses.name: Numbers 16:9
verses.text: <hi> is it</hi> only a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near Himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?

verses.name: Numbers 16:10
verses.text: And He has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you. And do you seek the priesthood also?

verses.name: Numbers 16:11
verses.text: For this cause you and all your company <hi>are</hi> gathered against the LORD. And what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:12
verses.text: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. And they said, We will not come up.

verses.name: Numbers 16:13
verses.text: <hi> Is it</hi> a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land that flows with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but must you also seize dominion over us?

verses.name: Numbers 16:14
verses.text: Besides, you have not brought us into a land that flows with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance in fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up.

verses.name: Numbers 16:15
verses.text: And Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

verses.name: Numbers 16:16
verses.text: And Moses said to Korah, Stand before the LORD, you and all your company-- you and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

verses.name: Numbers 16:17
verses.text: And every man take his fire-pan and put incense in them, and let every man bring his fire-pan before the LORD, two hundred and fifty fire-pans, you also, and Aaron, each with his fire-pan.

verses.name: Numbers 16:18
verses.text: And every man took his fire-pan and put fire in them, and laid incense on it, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 16:19
verses.text: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And the glory of the LORD appeared to all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 16:20
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:21
verses.text: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, so that I may devour them in a moment.

verses.name: Numbers 16:22
verses.text: And they fell upon their faces and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin and will You be angry with all the congregation?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:23
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:24
verses.text: Speak to the congregation saying, Get away from the tent of Korah and Dathan and Abiram.

verses.name: Numbers 16:25
verses.text: And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram. And the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.name: Numbers 16:26
verses.text: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, I pray you, get away from the tents of these wicked men. And touch nothing of theirs lest you be destroyed in all their sins.

verses.name: Numbers 16:27
verses.text: So they got away from the tent of Korah, Dathan and Abiram, on every side. And Dathan and Abiram came out and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little sons.

verses.name: Numbers 16:28
verses.text: And Moses said, By this you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works, <hi>and</hi> that not from my own heart.

verses.name: Numbers 16:29
verses.text: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they are visited according to the examination of all men, the LORD has not sent me.

verses.name: Numbers 16:30
verses.text: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the earth opens her mouth and swallows them up with all that they have, and they go down alive into the pit, then you shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 16:31
verses.text: And it happened, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, the ground under them split apart.

verses.name: Numbers 16:32
verses.text: And the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who <hi>were</hi> for Korah, and all <hi>their</hi> goods.

verses.name: Numbers 16:33
verses.text: They and all that they had went down alive into Sheol, and the earth closed upon them. And they perished from among the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 16:34
verses.text: And all Israel around them fled at their cry. For they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:35
verses.text: And there came out a fire from the LORD and burned up the two hundred and fifty men who offered incense.

verses.name: Numbers 16:36
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:37
verses.text: Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the fire-pans out of the burning, and scatter the fire yonder. For they are holy.

verses.name: Numbers 16:38
verses.text: The fire-pans of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them into broad plates, a covering for the altar; for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are made holy. And they shall be a sign to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 16:39
verses.text: And Eleazar the priest took the bronze fire-pans, the ones with which those who had been burned up had offered, and they were made into broad <hi>plates</hi>, a covering of the altar,

verses.name: Numbers 16:40
verses.text: a memorial to the sons of Israel, that no stranger not of the seed of Aaron may come near to offer incense before the LORD, so that he may not be as Korah and as his company-- as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:41
verses.text: But on the next day all the congregation of the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron saying, You have killed the people of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 16:42
verses.text: And it happened when the congregation was gathered together against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation. And behold! The cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

verses.name: Numbers 16:43
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 16:44
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 16:45
verses.text: Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

verses.name: Numbers 16:46
verses.text: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a fire-pan, and put fire in it from the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly to the congregation and make an atonement for them. For wrath has gone out from the LORD. The plague has begun.

verses.name: Numbers 16:47
verses.text: And Aaron did as Moses commanded and ran into the midst of the congregation. And behold! The plague had begun among the people. And he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

verses.name: Numbers 16:48
verses.text: And he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stayed.

verses.name: Numbers 16:49
verses.text: And those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand, seven hundred, besides the ones who died about the matter of Korah.

verses.name: Numbers 16:50
verses.text: And Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the plague was stayed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 17:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel, and take a rod from each of them for a father's house, of all their rulers, for their fathers' house, twelve rods. Write every man's name upon his rod.

verses.name: Numbers 17:3
verses.text: And you shall write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi. For one rod <hi>shall be</hi> for the head of the house of their fathers.

verses.name: Numbers 17:4
verses.text: And you shall lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

verses.name: Numbers 17:5
verses.text: And it shall be, the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall blossom. And I will make to cease from Me the murmurings of the sons of Israel by which they murmur against you.

verses.name: Numbers 17:6
verses.text: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their rulers gave to him a rod, for each ruler, one rod for each ruler, for their father's house, twelve rods. And the rod of Aaron <hi>was</hi> among their rods.

verses.name: Numbers 17:7
verses.text: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:8
verses.text: And it happened on the next day Moses went into the tabernacle of witness. And behold! The rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had budded and had brought forth buds, and had bloomed blossoms, and had yielded almonds.

verses.name: Numbers 17:9
verses.text: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the sons of Israel. And they looked, and each one took his rod.

verses.name: Numbers 17:10
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept as a token against the rebels. And you shall completely take away their murmurings from Me so that they do not die.

verses.name: Numbers 17:11
verses.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him, so he did.

verses.name: Numbers 17:12
verses.text: And the sons of Israel spoke to Moses saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

verses.name: Numbers 17:13
verses.text: Whoever comes near the tabernacle of the LORD shall die. Shall we be consumed to die?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Aaron, You and your sons, and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary. And you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

verses.name: Numbers 18:2
verses.text: And bring your brothers also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father with you, so that they may be joined to you and minister to you, you and your sons with you, before the tabernacle of witness.

verses.name: Numbers 18:3
verses.text: And they shall keep your charge and the charge of all the tabernacle. Only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, so that neither they nor you also may die.

verses.name: Numbers 18:4
verses.text: And they shall be joined to you, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle. And a stranger shall not come near you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:5
verses.text: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, so that there may be no wrath any more upon the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 18:6
verses.text: And I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the sons of Israel. <hi>They are</hi> given to you <hi>as</hi> a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 18:7
verses.text: Therefore you and your sons with you shall keep your priests' office for everything of the altar and inside the veil. And you shall serve. I have given your priest's office as a service of gift. And the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:8
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, Behold, I have also given you the charge of My heave offerings of all the holy things of the sons of Israel. I have given them to you for the anointing, and to your sons, by an ordinance forever.

verses.name: Numbers 18:9
verses.text: This shall be yours of the most holy things, <hi>reserved</hi> from the fire, every sacrifice of theirs, every food offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give Me. These <hi>are</hi> most holy for you and for your sons.

verses.name: Numbers 18:10
verses.text: You shall eat it in the Holy of Holies. Every male shall eat it. It shall be holy to you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:11
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> yours, the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the sons of Israel. I have given them to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, by a statute forever. Everyone that is clean in your house shall eat it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:12
verses.text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the first-fruits of them which they shall offer to the LORD, I have given them to you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:13
verses.text: The first fruits of all that is in the land, which they shall bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone that is clean in your house shall eat <hi>of</hi> it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:14
verses.text: Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

verses.name: Numbers 18:15
verses.text: Everything that opens the womb in all flesh, which they bring to the LORD, of men or animals, shall be yours. Nevertheless, the first-born of man you shall surely redeem, and the first-born of unclean animals you shall redeem.

verses.name: Numbers 18:16
verses.text: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old you shall redeem, according to your judgment for the silver of five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which <hi>is</hi> twenty gerahs.

verses.name: Numbers 18:17
verses.text: But the first-born of a cow, or the first-born of a sheep, or the first-born of a goat, you shall not redeem. They <hi>are</hi> holy. You shall sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shall burn their fat, an offering made by fire, for a sweet savor to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 18:18
verses.text: And their flesh shall be yours, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are yours.

verses.name: Numbers 18:19
verses.text: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the sons of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, by a law forever. It <hi>is</hi> a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your seed with you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:20
verses.text: And the LORD said to Aaron, You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any part among them. I <hi>am</hi> your part and your inheritance among the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 18:21
verses.text: And behold, I have given the sons of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 18:22
verses.text: Neither must the sons of Israel come near the tabernacle of the congregation from now on, lest they bear sin and die.

verses.name: Numbers 18:23
verses.text: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity, a statute forever throughout your generations, that among the sons of Israel they have no inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 18:24
verses.text: But the tithes of the sons of Israel, which they offer <hi>as</hi> a heave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit. Therefore I have said to them, Among the sons of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 18:25
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 18:26
verses.text: And you shall speak to the Levites, and you shall say to them, When you take tithes from the sons of Israel, which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a heave offering of it for the LORD, a tenth of the tithe.

verses.name: Numbers 18:27
verses.text: And your heave offering shall be credited to you as grain of the threshing-floor, and as the fullness of the winepress.

verses.name: Numbers 18:28
verses.text: So you also shall offer a heave offering to the LORD of all your tithes which you receive from the sons of Israel. And you shall give from it the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.

verses.name: Numbers 18:29
verses.text: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all its fat, the holy part of it out of it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:30
verses.text: And you shall say to them, When you have lifted up its fat, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing-floor, and as the increase of the winepress.

verses.name: Numbers 18:31
verses.text: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households. For it <hi>is</hi> your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 18:32
verses.text: And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have lifted up the fat of it. Neither shall you defile the holy things of the sons of Israel, lest you die.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 19:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron saying,

verses.name: Numbers 19:2
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the ordinance of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying, Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring you a red heifer, a perfect one, in which there is no blemish, on which no yoke ever came.

verses.name: Numbers 19:3
verses.text: And you shall give her to Eleazar the priest that he may bring her forth outside the camp. And he shall kill her before his face.

verses.name: Numbers 19:4
verses.text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times.

verses.name: Numbers 19:5
verses.text: And he shall burn the heifer in his sight, her skin and her flesh and her blood with her dung, he shall burn.

verses.name: Numbers 19:6
verses.text: And the priest shall take cedar-wood and hyssop and scarlet, and throw <hi>it</hi> into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

verses.name: Numbers 19:7
verses.text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water. And afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Numbers 19:8
verses.text: And he who burns her shall wash his clothes in water and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.name: Numbers 19:9
verses.text: And a man <hi>that is</hi> clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay up outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the sons of Israel for a water of separation. It is a cleansing for sin.

verses.name: Numbers 19:10
verses.text: And he who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening. And it shall be to the sons of Israel, and to the stranger that lives among them, for a statute forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 19:11
verses.text: He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 19:12
verses.text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean. But if he does not purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

verses.name: Numbers 19:13
verses.text: Whoever touches the dead body of any man that is dead, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. And that soul shall be cut off from Israel. Because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness <hi>is</hi> still upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 19:14
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law when a man dies in a tent. All that come into the tent, and all in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 19:15
verses.text: And every open vessel which has no covering bound upon it, it <hi>is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Numbers 19:16
verses.text: And whoever touches one that is killed with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 19:17
verses.text: And for the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of cleansing for sin, and running water shall be put to it in a vessel.

verses.name: Numbers 19:18
verses.text: And a clean person shall take hyssop and dip in the water, and sprinkle upon the tent and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one killed, or one dead, or a grave.

verses.name: Numbers 19:19
verses.text: And the clean <hi>person</hi> shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. And on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water. And he shall be clean at evening.

verses.name: Numbers 19:20
verses.text: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of separation has not been sprinkled upon him. He <hi> is</hi> unclean.

verses.name: Numbers 19:21
verses.text: And it shall be a perpetual law to them, that he who sprinkles the water of separation shall wash his clothes. And he that touches the water of separation shall be unclean until evening.

verses.name: Numbers 19:22
verses.text: And whatever the unclean touches shall be unclean. And the soul who touches shall be unclean until evening.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 20:1
verses.text: Then the sons of Israel came, the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month. And the people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was buried there.

verses.name: Numbers 20:2
verses.text: And there was no water for the congregation. And they gathered themselves against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 20:3
verses.text: And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying, Oh that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!

verses.name: Numbers 20:4
verses.text: And why have you brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, so that we and our cattle should die there?

verses.name: Numbers 20:5
verses.text: And why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us into this evil place? It <hi>is</hi> no place of seed or of figs or of vines or of pomegranates. And there is no water to drink.

verses.name: Numbers 20:6
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

verses.name: Numbers 20:7
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 20:8
verses.text: Take the rod, and gather the assembly, you and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes. And it shall give forth its water, and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock. So you shall give the congregation and their animals drink.

verses.name: Numbers 20:9
verses.text: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD as He commanded him.

verses.name: Numbers 20:10
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now you rebels. Must we bring water for you out of this rock?

verses.name: Numbers 20:11
verses.text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he struck the rock twice. And the water came out plentifully, and the congregation and their animals drank.

verses.name: Numbers 20:12
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, Because you did not believe Me, to sanctify Me in the eyes of the sons of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

verses.name: Numbers 20:13
