verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the Waters of Strife, because the sons of Israel fought with the LORD, and He showed Himself holy among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 20:14
verses.text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, so says your brother Israel, You know all the trouble that has happened to us,

verses.name: Numbers 20:15
verses.text: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have lived in Egypt a long time. And the Egyptians troubled us and our fathers.

verses.name: Numbers 20:16
verses.text: And when we cried to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent an Angel, and has brought us forth out of Egypt. And behold! We <hi>are</hi> in Kadesh, a city in the outermost part of your border.

verses.name: Numbers 20:17
verses.text: Let us pass, I pray you, through your country. We will not pass through a field, nor through a vineyard, neither will we drink <hi>of</hi> the water of a well. We will go by the king's highway. We will not turn to the right hand nor to the left until we have passed your borders.

verses.name: Numbers 20:18
verses.text: And Edom said to him, You shall not pass by me, lest I come out against you with the sword.

verses.name: Numbers 20:19
verses.text: And the sons of Israel said to him, We will go by the highway. And if I and my cattle drink of your water, then I will pay for it. Without <hi>doing</hi> anything, I will only go through on my feet.

verses.name: Numbers 20:20
verses.text: And he said, You shall not go through. And Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

verses.name: Numbers 20:21
verses.text: So Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border. Therefore Israel turned away from him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 20:22
verses.text: And the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, pulled up from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.

verses.name: Numbers 20:23
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 20:24
verses.text: Aaron shall be gathered to his people. For he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the Waters of Strife.

verses.name: Numbers 20:25
verses.text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor.

verses.name: Numbers 20:26
verses.text: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son. And Aaron shall be gathered <hi>to his people</hi>, and shall die there.

verses.name: Numbers 20:27
verses.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded. And they went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 20:28
verses.text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son. And Aaron died there in the top of the mount. And Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

verses.name: Numbers 20:29
verses.text: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, all the house of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 21:1
verses.text: And king Arad the Canaanite, who lived in the south, heard that Israel came by the Way of the Spies, then he fought against Israel and took prisoners of them.

verses.name: Numbers 21:2
verses.text: And Israel vowed a vow to the LORD and said, If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will completely destroy their cities.

verses.name: Numbers 21:3
verses.text: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites. And they completely destroyed them and their cities. And he called the name of the place Hormah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 21:4
verses.text: And they pulled up from Mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. And the soul of the people was very discouraged because of the way.

verses.name: Numbers 21:5
verses.text: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For <hi>there is</hi> no bread, neither is there any water. And our soul hates this light bread.

verses.name: Numbers 21:6
verses.text: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people. And many people of Israel died.

verses.name: Numbers 21:7
verses.text: And the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD that He take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.name: Numbers 21:8
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Make a fiery serpent and set it on a pole. And it shall be when everyone that is bitten, when he looks upon it, he shall live.

verses.name: Numbers 21:9
verses.text: And Moses made a serpent of bronze, and put it upon a pole. And it happened that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked upon the serpent of brass, he lived.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 21:10
verses.text: And the sons of Israel pulled up and pitched in Oboth.

verses.name: Numbers 21:11
verses.text: And they pulled up from Oboth and pitched at Ije-abarim in the wilderness before Moab, toward the sunrising.

verses.name: Numbers 21:12
verses.text: From there they pulled up and pitched in the valley of Zered.

verses.name: Numbers 21:13
verses.text: From there they pulled up and pitched on the other side of Arnon, in the wilderness that comes out of the borders of the Amorites; for Arnon <hi>is</hi> in the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.name: Numbers 21:14
verses.text: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD, Waheb in Suphah, and in the torrents of Arnon,

verses.name: Numbers 21:15
verses.text: and at the stream of the torrents that goes down to the dwelling of Ar and lies upon the border of Moab.

verses.name: Numbers 21:16
verses.text: And from there <hi>they went</hi> to Beer. That is the well of which the LORD spoke to Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

verses.name: Numbers 21:17
verses.text: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well. Sing to it.

verses.name: Numbers 21:18
verses.text: The well which the rulers dug, which the nobles of the people dug with their staves by <hi>the word</hi> of the Lawgiver. And from the wilderness <hi>they went</hi> to Mattanah,

verses.name: Numbers 21:19
verses.text: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

verses.name: Numbers 21:20
verses.text: and from Bamoth <hi>in</hi> the valley, in the country of Moab, <hi>they worked</hi> to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward the wilderness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 21:21
verses.text: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 21:22
verses.text: Let me pass through your land. We will not turn into the fields or into the vineyards. We will not drink the waters of the well. We will go along by the king's highway until we are past your borders.

verses.name: Numbers 21:23
verses.text: And Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border. But Sihon gathered all his people, and went out against Israel in the wilderness. And he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 21:24
verses.text: And Israel struck him with the edge of the sword and possessed his land from Arnon to Jabbok, even to the sons of Ammon. For the border of the sons of Ammon <hi>was</hi> strong.

verses.name: Numbers 21:25
verses.text: And Israel took all these cities. And Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

verses.name: Numbers 21:26
verses.text: For Heshbon <hi>was</hi> the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken all his land out of his hand, even to Arnon.

verses.name: Numbers 21:27
verses.text: Therefore they who speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and prepared.

verses.name: Numbers 21:28
verses.text: For there has gone out a fire from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of Arnon.

verses.name: Numbers 21:29
verses.text: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! He has given his sons to be runaways, and his daughters to go into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.name: Numbers 21:30
verses.text: We have cast them down. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon, and we have laid them waste even to Nophah which <hi>is</hi> to Medeba.

verses.name: Numbers 21:31
verses.text: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

verses.name: Numbers 21:32
verses.text: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its villages and drove out the Amorites who <hi>were</hi> there.

verses.name: Numbers 21:33
verses.text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

verses.name: Numbers 21:34
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people and his land. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites who lived at Heshbon.

verses.name: Numbers 21:35
verses.text: So they struck him and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him alive. And they possessed his land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 22:1
verses.text: And the sons of Israel pulled up and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan <hi>by</hi> Jericho.

verses.name: Numbers 22:2
verses.text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.name: Numbers 22:3
verses.text: And Moab was much afraid of the people because they <hi>were</hi> many. And Moab was worried because of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 22:4
verses.text: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now this company is licking up all around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor <hi>was</hi> king of the Moabites at that time.

verses.name: Numbers 22:5
verses.text: He sent messengers therefore to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, by the river of the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying, Behold! A people come out from Egypt. Behold! They cover the face of the earth, and they are staying across from me.

verses.name: Numbers 22:6
verses.text: Therefore, I pray you, come now and curse this people for me. For they <hi>are</hi> too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail so that we may strike them, and so that I may drive them out of the land. For I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.

verses.name: Numbers 22:7
verses.text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian pulled up with the rewards of divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam and spoke the words of Balak to him.

verses.name: Numbers 22:8
verses.text: And he said to them, stay here tonight, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me. And the leaders of Moab stayed with Balaam.

verses.name: Numbers 22:9
verses.text: And God came to Balaam and said, What men <hi>are</hi> these with you?

verses.name: Numbers 22:10
verses.text: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, <hi>saying</hi>,

verses.name: Numbers 22:11
verses.text: Behold! A people has come out of Egypt which covers the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me. Perhaps, I shall be able to overcome them and drive them out.

verses.name: Numbers 22:12
verses.text: And God said to Balaam, You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they <hi>are</hi> blessed.

verses.name: Numbers 22:13
verses.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning and said to the leaders of Balak, Go into your land, for the LORD refuses to let me go with you.

verses.name: Numbers 22:14
verses.text: And the leaders of Moab rose up. And they went to Balak and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 22:15
verses.text: And Balak sent leaders again, more and more honorable than those.

verses.name: Numbers 22:16
verses.text: And they came to Balaam and said to him, So says Balak the son of Zippor, Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me.

verses.name: Numbers 22:17
verses.text: For I will raise you up to very great honor, and I will do whatever you say to me. Please come then and curse this people for me.

verses.name: Numbers 22:18
verses.text: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

verses.name: Numbers 22:19
verses.text: But please now stay here also this night so that I may know what more the LORD will say to me.

verses.name: Numbers 22:20
verses.text: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, If the men come to call you, rise up, go with them. But still, the word which I shall say to you, that you shall do.

verses.name: Numbers 22:21
verses.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning and saddled his ass, and went with the rulers of Moab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 22:22
verses.text: And God's anger was kindled because he went. And the Angel of the LORD stood in the way as an enemy against him. And he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants with him.

verses.name: Numbers 22:23
verses.text: And the ass saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way, and His sword drawn in His hand. And the ass turned aside out of the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the ass, to turn her into the way.

verses.name: Numbers 22:24
verses.text: But the Angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall on this side, and a wall on that side.

verses.name: Numbers 22:25
verses.text: And when the ass saw the Angel of the LORD, she pushed herself into the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall. And he struck her again.

verses.name: Numbers 22:26
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD went further and stood in a narrow place, where <hi>there was</hi> no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

verses.name: Numbers 22:27
verses.text: And when the ass saw the Angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam. And Balaam's anger was kindled, and he struck the ass with a staff.

verses.name: Numbers 22:28
verses.text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to you, that you have beaten me these three times?

verses.name: Numbers 22:29
verses.text: And Balaam said to the ass, Because you have mocked me. I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you.

verses.name: Numbers 22:30
verses.text: And the ass said to Balaam, <hi>Am</hi> I not your ass, upon which you have ridden ever since <hi>I was</hi> yours, to this day? Was I ever known to do so to you? And he said, No.

verses.name: Numbers 22:31
verses.text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way, and His sword drawn in His hand. And he bowed down his head, and fell on his face.

verses.name: Numbers 22:32
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to him, Why have you beaten your ass these three times? Behold! I went out to be an enemy to you, because your <hi>way</hi> is perverse before Me.

verses.name: Numbers 22:33
verses.text: And the ass saw Me and turned from Me these three times. Unless she had turned from Me, surely now I also would have killed you and saved her alive.

verses.name: Numbers 22:34
verses.text: And Balaam said to the Angel of the LORD, I have sinned. For I did not know that You stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases You, I will go back again.

verses.name: Numbers 22:35
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Balaam, Go with the men. But only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak. So Balaam went with the leaders of Balak.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 22:36
verses.text: And when Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him, to a city of Moab, in the border of Arnon, which <hi>is</hi> in the outermost border.

verses.name: Numbers 22:37
verses.text: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able indeed to lift you up to honor?

verses.name: Numbers 22:38
verses.text: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to say anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I shall speak.

verses.name: Numbers 22:39
verses.text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath-huzoth.

verses.name: Numbers 22:40
verses.text: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and to the leaders <hi>that were</hi> with him.

verses.name: Numbers 22:41
verses.text: And it happened on the next day Balak took Balaam and brought him up into the high places of Baal, so that from there he might see the edge of the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 23:1
verses.text: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare here seven oxen and seven rams for me.

verses.name: Numbers 23:2
verses.text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken. And Balak and Balaam offered on the altar a bull and a ram.

verses.name: Numbers 23:3
verses.text: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. And whatever He reveals to me I will tell you. And he went to a high place.

verses.name: Numbers 23:4
verses.text: And God met Balaam. And he said to Him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon the altar a bull and a ram.

verses.name: Numbers 23:5
verses.text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth and said, Return to Balak, and so you shall speak.

verses.name: Numbers 23:6
verses.text: And he returned to him. And lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he and all the leaders of Moab.

verses.name: Numbers 23:7
verses.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, <hi>saying</hi>, Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, defy Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 23:8
verses.text: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? Or how shall I defy <hi>whom</hi> the LORD has not defied?

verses.name: Numbers 23:9
verses.text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him. Lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be counted among the nations.

verses.name: Numbers 23:10
verses.text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

verses.name: Numbers 23:11
verses.text: And Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have kept on blessing <hi>them</hi>!

verses.name: Numbers 23:12
verses.text: And he answered and said, Must I not be careful to speak that which the LORD has put in my mouth?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 23:13
verses.text: And Balak said to him, Please come with me to another place from where you may see them. You shall see only their edge, and shall not see them all. And curse them from there for me.

verses.name: Numbers 23:14
verses.text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on <hi>every</hi> altar.

verses.name: Numbers 23:15
verses.text: And he said to Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering while I meet Him yonder.

verses.name: Numbers 23:16
verses.text: And the LORD met Balaam and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again to Balak and say this.

verses.name: Numbers 23:17
verses.text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the leaders of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, What has the LORD spoken?

verses.name: Numbers 23:18
verses.text: And he took up his parable and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear. Listen to me, son of Zippor.

verses.name: Numbers 23:19
verses.text: God <hi>is</hi> not a man that He should lie, neither the son of man that He should repent. Has He said, and shall He not do it? Or has He spoken, and shall He not make it good?

verses.name: Numbers 23:20
verses.text: Behold, I have received word to bless. And He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it.

verses.name: Numbers 23:21
verses.text: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob, neither has He seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God <hi>is</hi> with him, and the shout of a king among them.

verses.name: Numbers 23:22
verses.text: God brought them out of Egypt. He has, as it were, the strength of an ox.

verses.name: Numbers 23:23
verses.text: Surely, <hi>there is</hi> no spell against Jacob, nor any fortune-telling against Israel. According to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What God has worked!

verses.name: Numbers 23:24
verses.text: Behold, the people shall rise up like a great lion, and lift up himself like a young lion. He shall not lie down until he eats <hi>of</hi> the prey and drinks the blood of the slain.

verses.name: Numbers 23:25
verses.text: And Balak said to Balaam, Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all.

verses.name: Numbers 23:26
verses.text: But Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did I not tell you, saying, All that the LORD speaks, that I must do?

verses.name: Numbers 23:27
verses.text: And Balak said to Balaam, Please, come. I will bring you into another place. Perhaps it will please God that you will curse them for me from there.

verses.name: Numbers 23:28
verses.text: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor that looks toward Jeshimon.

verses.name: Numbers 23:29
verses.text: And Balaam said to Balak, Build seven altars here for me, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams here for me.

verses.name: Numbers 23:30
verses.text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on the altar.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 24:1
verses.text: And Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, and he did not go, as at other times, to seek for secret arts, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

verses.name: Numbers 24:2
verses.text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel pitched, according to their tribes. And the Spirit of God came upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 24:3
verses.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor has said, and the man whose eyes are open has said;

verses.name: Numbers 24:4
verses.text: he has said; he who heard the words of God, who saw the vision of the Almighty, falling down but having his eyes open;

verses.name: Numbers 24:5
verses.text: How goodly are your tents, O Jacob, your tabernacles, O Israel!

verses.name: Numbers 24:6
verses.text: They are spread forth like the valleys, like gardens by the river's side, like the trees of aloes which the LORD has planted, like cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.name: Numbers 24:7
verses.text: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters. And his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.name: Numbers 24:8
verses.text: God brought him forth out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of an ox. He shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through <hi>with</hi> his arrows.

verses.name: Numbers 24:9
verses.text: He crouched. He lay down as a lion, and as a great lion. Who shall stir him up? Blessed is he who blesses you, and curses he who curses you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 24:10
verses.text: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam. And he struck his hands together. And Balak said to Balaam, I called you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have kept on blessing these three times.

verses.name: Numbers 24:11
verses.text: Therefore now flee to your place. I thought to lift you up to great honor, but lo, the LORD has kept you back from honor.

verses.name: Numbers 24:12
verses.text: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not speak also to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 24:13
verses.text: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the mouth of the LORD, to do good or bad of my own mind. What the LORD said, that I will speak.

verses.name: Numbers 24:14
verses.text: And now, behold, I go to my people. Come! I will make known to you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 24:15
verses.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor has said, and the man whose eyes <hi>are</hi> open has said;

verses.name: Numbers 24:16
verses.text: he has said, he who heard the words of God and knew the knowledge of the Most High, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down but having his eyes open;

verses.name: Numbers 24:17
verses.text: I shall see him, but not now. I shall behold him, but not near. There shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Scepter shall rise out of Israel. and shall strike the corners of Moab, and destroy all the sons of tumult.

verses.name: Numbers 24:18
verses.text: And Edom shall be a possession. Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies. And Israel shall do valiantly.

verses.name: Numbers 24:19
verses.text: Out of Jacob shall come He who shall have dominion and shall destroy him who remains of the city.

verses.name: Numbers 24:20
verses.text: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable and said, Amalek <hi>was</hi> the first of the nations. But his latter end <hi>is</hi> to destruction.

verses.name: Numbers 24:21
verses.text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable and said, Strong is your dwelling-place, and you put your nest in a rock.

verses.name: Numbers 24:22
verses.text: But the Kenites shall be wasted until Assyria shall carry you away captive.

verses.name: Numbers 24:23
verses.text: And he took up his parable and said, Alas, who shall live when God puts out!

verses.name: Numbers 24:24
verses.text: And ships shall come from the coast of Cyprus, and shall afflict Assyria and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish forever.

verses.name: Numbers 24:25
verses.text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place. And Balak also went his way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 25:1
verses.text: And Israel lived in Shittim, and the people began to fornicate with the daughters of Moab.

verses.name: Numbers 25:2
verses.text: And they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to their gods.

verses.name: Numbers 25:3
verses.text: And Israel joined himself to Baal-peor. And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 25:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Take all the heads of the people and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, so that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 25:5
verses.text: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Every one of you kill his men who were joined to Baal-peor.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 25:6
verses.text: And behold! One of the sons of Israel came and brought to his brothers a woman of Midian, before the eyes of Moses, and before all the congregation of the sons of Israel, who <hi>were</hi> weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 25:7
verses.text: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw <hi>it</hi>, he rose up from among the congregation and took a spear in his hand.

verses.name: Numbers 25:8
verses.text: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and pierced both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman, through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 25:9
verses.text: And those that died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: Numbers 25:10
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 25:11
verses.text: Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the sons of Israel while he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not destroy the sons of Israel in My jealousy.

verses.name: Numbers 25:12
verses.text: Therefore say, Behold! I give him My covenant of peace.

verses.name: Numbers 25:13
verses.text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 25:14
verses.text: And the name of the Israelite who was killed, he who was struck with the woman of Midian, <hi>was</hi> Zimri, the son of Salu, ruler of a chief house of the Simeonites.

verses.name: Numbers 25:15
verses.text: And the Midianite woman's name who was killed <hi>was</hi> Cosbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 25:16
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 25:17
verses.text: Trouble the Midianites and strike them.

verses.name: Numbers 25:18
verses.text: For they trouble you with their lies, with which they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi the daughter of a ruler of Midian, their sister, who was stricken in the day of the plague because of Peor.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:1
verses.text: And it happened after the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 26:2
verses.text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 26:3
verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab beside Jordan <hi>at</hi> Jericho, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 26:4
verses.text: <hi> Count</hi> the people from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the sons of Israel, who came out of the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:5
verses.text: Reuben, the first-born of Israel, the sons of Reuben, of Hanoch who <hi>came</hi> of the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu the family of the Palluites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:6
verses.text: of Hezron the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:7
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of the Reubenites. And their numbered ones <hi>were</hi> forty-three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

verses.name: Numbers 26:8
verses.text: And the sons of Pallu were Eliab.

verses.name: Numbers 26:9
verses.text: And the sons of Eliab, Nemuel, and Dathan and Abiram. This <hi>is</hi> that Dathan and Abiram <hi>who were</hi> famous in the congregation, who fought against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they fought against the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 26:10
verses.text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men. And they became a sign.

verses.name: Numbers 26:11
verses.text: However the sons of Korah did not die.

verses.name: Numbers 26:12
verses.text: The sons of Simeon according to their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:13
verses.text: of Zerah, the family of the Zarchites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites--

verses.name: Numbers 26:14
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand, two hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:15
verses.text: The sons of Gad according to their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:16
verses.text: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:17
verses.text: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:18
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of the sons of Gad by their numbered ones, forty thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:19
verses.text: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Numbers 26:20
verses.text: And the sons of Judah according to their families: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahite.

verses.name: Numbers 26:21
verses.text: And the sons of Pharez: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:22
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of Judah by their numbered ones, seventy-six thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:23
verses.text: The sons of Issachar, according to their families: <hi>of</hi> Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Pua, the family of the Punites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:24
verses.text: of Jashub the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites--

verses.name: Numbers 26:25
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of Issachar by their numbered ones, sixty-four thousand and three hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:26
verses.text: The sons of Zebulun according to their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites--

verses.name: Numbers 26:27
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of the Zebulunites by their numbered ones, sixty thousand, five hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:28
verses.text: The sons of Joseph according to their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.name: Numbers 26:29
verses.text: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites. And Machir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:30
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:31
verses.text: And <hi>of</hi> Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:32
verses.text: and <hi>of</hi> Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:33
verses.text: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters. And the names of the daughters of Zelophehad: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah--

verses.name: Numbers 26:34
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of Manasseh, by their numbered ones, fifty-two thousand, seven hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:35
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Ephraim according to their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:36
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:37
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the families of the sons of Ephraim by their numbered ones, thirty-two thousand, five hundred. These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Joseph according to their families.

verses.name: Numbers 26:38
verses.text: The sons of Benjamin according to their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:39
verses.text: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:40
verses.text: And the sons of Bela <hi>were</hi> Ard and Naaman. <hi>Of Ard</hi>, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:41
verses.text: these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Benjamin according to their families, and their numbered ones, forty-five thousand, six hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:42
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuham, the families of the Shuhamites. These <hi>are</hi> the families of Dan according to their families.

verses.name: Numbers 26:43
verses.text: All the families of the Shuhamites, by their numbered ones, sixty-four thousand, four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:44
verses.text: <hi> Of</hi> the sons of Asher according to their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites; of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:45
verses.text: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:46
verses.text: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

verses.name: Numbers 26:47
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the families of the sons of Asher by their numbered ones, fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:48
verses.text: The sons of Naphtali according to their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

verses.name: Numbers 26:49
verses.text: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:50
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the families of Naphtali according to their families, by their numbered ones, forty-five thousand, four hundred.

verses.name: Numbers 26:51
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the numbered ones of the sons of Israel, six hundred one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:52
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 26:53
verses.text: To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.name: Numbers 26:54
verses.text: To many you shall give the more inheritance, and to few you shall give the less inheritance; each by the mouth of his numbered ones shall be given his inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 26:55
verses.text: But the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

verses.name: Numbers 26:56
verses.text: According to the lot shall the possession of it be divided between many and few.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:57
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the numbered ones of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.name: Numbers 26:58
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Korah fathered Amram.

verses.name: Numbers 26:59
verses.text: And the name of Amram's wife <hi>was</hi> Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom one bore to Levi in Egypt. And she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

verses.name: Numbers 26:60
verses.text: And to Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: Numbers 26:61
verses.text: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 26:62
verses.text: And their numbered ones, twenty-three thousand, all males from a month old and upward. For they were not numbered among the sons of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:63
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> those numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab beside Jordan <hi>at</hi> Jericho.

verses.name: Numbers 26:64
verses.text: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 26:65
verses.text: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:1
verses.text: And the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh, the son of Joseph came. And these <hi>are</hi> the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Numbers 27:2
verses.text: And they stood before Moses and before Eleazar the priest, and before the rulers and all the congregation, <hi>by</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:3
verses.text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of those who gathered themselves against the LORD in the company of Korah, but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

verses.name: Numbers 27:4
verses.text: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he has no son? Therefore give us a possession among the brothers of our father.

verses.name: Numbers 27:5
verses.text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 27:6
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:7
verses.text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers. And you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

verses.name: Numbers 27:8
verses.text: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, When a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

verses.name: Numbers 27:9
verses.text: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

verses.name: Numbers 27:10
verses.text: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

verses.name: Numbers 27:11
verses.text: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative, of his family, and he shall possess it. And it shall be to the sons of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:12
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Get up into this Mount Abarim and see the land which I have given to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 27:13
verses.text: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people as Aaron your brother was gathered.

verses.name: Numbers 27:14
verses.text: For you rebelled against My command in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify Me at the water before their eyes; they <hi>were</hi> the Waters of Strife in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:15
verses.text: And Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 27:16
verses.text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation

verses.name: Numbers 27:17
verses.text: who may go out before them, and who may go in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.

verses.name: Numbers 27:18
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom <hi>is</hi> the Spirit, and lay your hand upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 27:19
verses.text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation, and give him a charge in their sight.

verses.name: Numbers 27:20
verses.text: And you shall put of your honor on him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel may be obedient.

verses.name: Numbers 27:21
verses.text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask for him according to the judgment of Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the sons of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 27:22
verses.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him. And he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 27:23
verses.text: And he laid his hands upon him and gave him a charge, even as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 28:2
verses.text: Command the sons of Israel, and say to them, My offering <hi>and</hi> My bread for My sacrifices made by fire, a sweet savor to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me in their due season.

verses.name: Numbers 28:3
verses.text: And you shall say to them, This <hi>is</hi> the fire offering which you shall offer to the LORD: two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, a continual burnt offering.

verses.name: Numbers 28:4
verses.text: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer between the evenings.

verses.name: Numbers 28:5
verses.text: And a tenth of an ephah of flour for a food offering, mixed with the fourth of a hin of beaten oil.

verses.name: Numbers 28:6
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD,

verses.name: Numbers 28:7
verses.text: and its drink offering <hi>shall be</hi> the fourth of a hin for the one lamb. Pour a drink offering <hi>of</hi> strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

verses.name: Numbers 28:8
verses.text: And the other lamb you shall offer between the evenings, even as the food offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer <hi>it</hi>, a fire offering, a sweet savor to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:9
verses.text: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two-tenth parts of flour <hi>for</hi> a food offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering;

verses.name: Numbers 28:10
verses.text: <hi> this is</hi> the burnt offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 28:11
verses.text: And in the beginning of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot,

verses.name: Numbers 28:12
verses.text: and three tenth parts of flour <hi>for</hi> a food offering, mixed with oil, for one bull, and two-tenth parts of flour <hi>for</hi> a food offering, mixed with oil, for one ram;

verses.name: Numbers 28:13
verses.text: and a separate tenth part of flour mixed with oil <hi>for</hi> a food offering to one lamb, for a burnt offering of a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 28:14
verses.text: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine to a bull, and the third of a hin to a ram, and a fourth a hin to a lamb. This <hi>is</hi> the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

verses.name: Numbers 28:15
verses.text: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering to the LORD shall be prepared, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:16
verses.text: And in the fourteenth day of the first month <hi>is</hi> the Passover of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 28:17
verses.text: And in the fifteenth day of this month <hi>is</hi> the feast. Seven days shall unleavened <hi>bread</hi> be eaten.

verses.name: Numbers 28:18
verses.text: In the first day <hi>shall be</hi> a holy convocation. You shall do no kind of laboring work.

verses.name: Numbers 28:19
verses.text: But you shall offer a fire offering <hi>for</hi> a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year. They shall be to you without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 28:20
verses.text: And their food offering <hi>shall be</hi> of flour mixed with oil: three tenth parts you shall prepare for a bull, and two tenth parts for a ram.

verses.name: Numbers 28:21
verses.text: You shall prepare one tenth part for the one lamb, and for the seven lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 28:22
verses.text: and one goat, a sin offering to make an atonement for you.

verses.name: Numbers 28:23
verses.text: You shall prepare these besides the burnt offering in the morning, which <hi>is</hi> for a continual burnt offering.

verses.name: Numbers 28:24
verses.text: In this way you shall offer daily, seven days, the bread of the fire offering, a sweet savor to the LORD. It shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 28:25
verses.text: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work.

verses.name: Numbers 28:26
verses.text: And in the day of the first-fruits, when you bring a new food offering to the LORD in your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work.

verses.name: Numbers 28:27
verses.text: And you shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savor to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs of the first year

verses.name: Numbers 28:28
verses.text: and their food offering of flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to one bull, two tenth parts to one ram,

verses.name: Numbers 28:29
verses.text: one tenth part to one lamb, for the seven lambs,

verses.name: Numbers 28:30
verses.text: one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

verses.name: Numbers 28:31
verses.text: You shall offer <hi>them</hi> besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and their drink offerings. They shall be to you without blemish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:1
verses.text: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work. It is a day of blowing the trumpets to you.

verses.name: Numbers 29:2
verses.text: And you shall prepare a burnt offering for a sweet savor to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 29:3
verses.text: And their food offering <hi>shall be</hi> flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for a bull, two tenth parts for a ram,

verses.name: Numbers 29:4
verses.text: and one tenth part for one lamb, for the seven lambs,

verses.name: Numbers 29:5
verses.text: and one kid of the goats <hi>for</hi> a sin offering to make an atonement for you;

verses.name: Numbers 29:6
verses.text: besides the burnt offering of the month, and its food offering, and the daily burnt offering, and its food offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 29:7
verses.text: And you shall have a holy convocation on the tenth of this seventh month. And you shall afflict your souls. You shall not do any work.

verses.name: Numbers 29:8
verses.text: But you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD <hi>for</hi> a sweet savor: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year. They shall be to you without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 29:9
verses.text: And their food offering <hi>shall be</hi> flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to a bull, two tenth parts to one ram,

verses.name: Numbers 29:10
verses.text: one tenth part for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 29:11
verses.text: one kid of the goats <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering and the food offering of it, and their drink offerings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 29:12
verses.text: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work, and you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

verses.name: Numbers 29:13
verses.text: And you shall offer a burnt offering, a fire offering, of a sweet savor to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year. They shall be without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 29:14
verses.text: And their food offering <hi>shall be</hi> flour, mixed with oil, three tenth parts to every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts to each ram of the two rams,

verses.name: Numbers 29:15
verses.text: and one tenth part to each lamb of the fourteen lambs;

verses.name: Numbers 29:16
verses.text: and one kid of the goats <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:17
verses.text: And on the second day <hi>you shall offer</hi> twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot;

verses.name: Numbers 29:18
verses.text: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:19
verses.text: and one kid of the goats <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.name: Numbers 29:20
verses.text: And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 29:21
verses.text: And their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:22
verses.text: and one goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:23
verses.text: And on the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish.

verses.name: Numbers 29:24
verses.text: Their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:25
verses.text: and one kid of the goats <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:26
verses.text: And on the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot.

verses.name: Numbers 29:27
verses.text: And their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:28
verses.text: and one goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:29
verses.text: And on the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

verses.name: Numbers 29:30
verses.text: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:31
verses.text: and one goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:32
verses.text: And on the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

verses.name: Numbers 29:33
verses.text: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, <hi>shall be</hi> according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:34
verses.text: and one goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:35
verses.text: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no laboring work.

verses.name: Numbers 29:36
verses.text: But you shall offer a burnt offering, a fire offering of a sweet savor to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish;

verses.name: Numbers 29:37
verses.text: their food offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the law;

verses.name: Numbers 29:38
verses.text: and one goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its food offering and its drink offering.

verses.name: Numbers 29:39
verses.text: You shall prepare these to the LORD in your appointed seasons, besides your vows and your free-will offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your food offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

verses.name: Numbers 29:40
verses.text: And Moses told the sons of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:1
verses.text: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the sons of Israel, saying, This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD has commanded:

verses.name: Numbers 30:2
verses.text: If a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that comes out of his mouth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:3
verses.text: <hi> If</hi> a woman also vows a vow to the LORD, and binds herself by a bond, <hi>being</hi> in her father's house in her youth,

verses.name: Numbers 30:4
verses.text: and <hi>if</hi> her father hears her vow and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and <hi>if</hi> her father is silent as to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:5
verses.text: But <hi>if</hi> her father does not allow her in the day that he hears, not any of her vows or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand. And the LORD shall forgive her because her father did not allow her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:6
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> she had a husband when she vowed, or if she said anything rash out of her lips with which she bound her soul,

verses.name: Numbers 30:7
verses.text: and <hi>if</hi> her husband heard and is silent as to her in the day that he heard, then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she bound her soul shall stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:8
verses.text: But <hi>if</hi> her husband did not allow her on the day that he heard it, then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, with which she bound her soul, of no effect. And the LORD shall forgive her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:9
verses.text: But every vow of a widow and of her who is divorced, all which she has bound on her soul shall stand against her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:10
verses.text: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

verses.name: Numbers 30:11
verses.text: and <hi>if</hi> her husband heard and is silent as to her, and did not forbid her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.

verses.name: Numbers 30:12
verses.text: But if her husband has certainly broken them on the day he heard, whatever comes out of her lips concerning her vows or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has broken them. And the LORD shall forgive her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:13
verses.text: Every vow and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may break it.

verses.name: Numbers 30:14
verses.text: But <hi>if</hi> her husband is altogether silent as to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her bonds which <hi>are</hi> on her. He confirms them, because he was silent as to her in the day that he heard.

verses.name: Numbers 30:15
verses.text: But <hi>if</hi> he at all breaks them after he has heard, then he has borne her iniquity.

verses.name: Numbers 30:16
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter in her youth in her father's house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 31:2
verses.text: Avenge the sons of Israel from the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.

verses.name: Numbers 31:3
verses.text: And Moses spoke to the people saying, Arm some of yourselves to the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD on Midian.

verses.name: Numbers 31:4
verses.text: You shall send to the war a thousand from every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 31:5
verses.text: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of <hi>every</hi> tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

verses.name: Numbers 31:6
verses.text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of <hi>every</hi> tribe. He sent them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments and the trumpets to blow in his hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:7
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses. And <hi>they</hi> killed all the males.

verses.name: Numbers 31:8
verses.text: And they killed the kings of Midian, besides the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

verses.name: Numbers 31:9
verses.text: And the sons of Israel took <hi>all</hi> the women of Midian captive, and their little ones, and the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

verses.name: Numbers 31:10
verses.text: And they burned with fire all their cities, their homes, and all their towers.

verses.name: Numbers 31:11
verses.text: And they took all the spoil and all the prey of men and animals.

verses.name: Numbers 31:12
verses.text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which <hi>are</hi> beside Jordan, <hi>at</hi> Jericho.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:13
verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest, and all the rulers of the congregation, went forth to meet them outside the camp.

verses.name: Numbers 31:14
verses.text: And Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, who came from the battle.

verses.name: Numbers 31:15
verses.text: And Moses said to them, Have you saved all the women alive?

verses.name: Numbers 31:16
verses.text: Behold, these caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit sin against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and the plague was on the congregation of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 31:17
verses.text: And now kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that has known man by lying with him.

verses.name: Numbers 31:18
verses.text: But all the female children that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.name: Numbers 31:19
verses.text: And stay outside the camp seven days. Whosoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any dead one, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.

verses.name: Numbers 31:20
verses.text: And purify all clothing, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats' <hi>hair</hi>, and all things made of wood.

verses.name: Numbers 31:21
verses.text: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to battle, This <hi>is</hi> the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 31:22
verses.text: Only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

verses.name: Numbers 31:23
verses.text: everything that can stand the fire, you shall make go through the fire, and it shall be clean. Only it shall be purified with the water of separation. And all that cannot stand the fire you shall make go through the water.

verses.name: Numbers 31:24
verses.text: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean, and afterwards you shall come into the camp.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:25
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 31:26
verses.text: Count the prey that was taken of man and of animal, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 31:27
verses.text: And divide the prey into two parts: between those skilled in the battle, who went out to war, and between all the congregation.

verses.name: Numbers 31:28
verses.text: And levy a tax for the LORD from the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, of the persons and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the flock.

verses.name: Numbers 31:29
verses.text: Take from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest, a heave offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 31:30
verses.text: And from the sons of Israel's half you shall take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, of the flocks, of all kinds of animals, and give them to the Levites who keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 31:31
verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 31:32
verses.text: And the prize, the rest of the spoil which the men of war had captured, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,

verses.name: Numbers 31:33
verses.text: seventy-two thousand beef cattle,

verses.name: Numbers 31:34
verses.text: sixty-one thousand asses,

verses.name: Numbers 31:35
verses.text: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known <hi>a man</hi> by lying <hi>with</hi> a male.

verses.name: Numbers 31:36
verses.text: And the half, the portion of those who went out to war, the number of the flock <hi>was</hi> three hundred thirty-seven thousand, five hundred;

verses.name: Numbers 31:37
verses.text: and the LORD's tax of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.

verses.name: Numbers 31:38
verses.text: And the beef cattle <hi>were</hi> thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD's tax <hi>was</hi> seventy-two.

verses.name: Numbers 31:39
verses.text: And the asses, thirty thousand, five hundred, of which the LORD's tax <hi>was</hi> sixty-one.

verses.name: Numbers 31:40
verses.text: And the persons <hi>were</hi> sixteen thousand, of which the LORD's tax <hi>was</hi> thirty-two persons.

verses.name: Numbers 31:41
verses.text: And Moses gave the tax, the LORD's heave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 31:42
verses.text: And of the sons of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men who warred;

verses.name: Numbers 31:43
verses.text: even the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

verses.name: Numbers 31:44
verses.text: and thirty-six thousand beef cattle,

verses.name: Numbers 31:45
verses.text: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,

verses.name: Numbers 31:46
verses.text: and sixteen thousand persons;

verses.name: Numbers 31:47
verses.text: even of the sons of Israel's half, Moses took one portion in fifty, of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites who kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, --even as the LORD commanded Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:48
verses.text: And the officers who <hi>were</hi> over thousands of the army, over the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came near Moses.

verses.name: Numbers 31:49
verses.text: And they said to Moses, Your servants have counted the men of war who <hi>are</hi> under our charge, and there is not one man of us lacking.

verses.name: Numbers 31:50
verses.text: And we bring an offering for the LORD, what every man has found, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 31:51
verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, all crafted things.

verses.name: Numbers 31:52
verses.text: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the commanders of thousands, and of the commanders of hundreds, was sixteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.name: Numbers 31:53
verses.text: <hi> For</hi> the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.

verses.name: Numbers 31:54
verses.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, <hi>for</hi> a memorial for the sons of Israel before the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:1
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle. And when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, behold, the place <hi>was</hi> a place for cattle.

verses.name: Numbers 32:2
verses.text: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, and to the rulers of the congregation, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 32:3
verses.text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

verses.name: Numbers 32:4
verses.text: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, <hi>is</hi> a land for cattle, and your servants <hi>have</hi> cattle.

verses.name: Numbers 32:5
verses.text: And, they said, If we have found grace in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; do not bring us over Jordan.

verses.name: Numbers 32:6
verses.text: And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, Shall your brothers go to war, and shall you sit here?

verses.name: Numbers 32:7
verses.text: And why do you break the heart of the sons of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

verses.name: Numbers 32:8
verses.text: So your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

verses.name: Numbers 32:9
verses.text: For when they went up into the valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they broke the hearts of the sons of Israel, so that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

verses.name: Numbers 32:10
verses.text: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and He swore, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 32:11
verses.text: Surely, none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and up, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they have not fully followed Me,

verses.name: Numbers 32:12
verses.text: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun, for they have fully followed the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 32:13
verses.text: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years until all the generation which had done evil in the sight of the LORD was destroyed.

verses.name: Numbers 32:14
verses.text: And behold, you are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to add still more to the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 32:15
verses.text: For if you turn away from after Him, He will yet again leave them in the wilderness. And you shall destroy all this people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:16
verses.text: And they came near to him and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones,

verses.name: Numbers 32:17
verses.text: but we ourselves will go ready armed before the sons of Israel until we have brought them to their place. And our little ones shall live in the fenced cities because of those who live in the land.

verses.name: Numbers 32:18
verses.text: We will not return to our houses until the sons of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 32:19
verses.text: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of Jordan, or forward, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this side of Jordan, eastward.

verses.name: Numbers 32:20
verses.text: And Moses said to them, If you will do this thing, if you will go armed before the LORD to war,

verses.name: Numbers 32:21
verses.text: and all of you will go armed over Jordan before the LORD until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,

verses.name: Numbers 32:22
verses.text: and the land is subdued before the LORD, then afterwards you shall return and be guiltless before the LORD and before Israel. And this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

verses.name: Numbers 32:23
verses.text: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD. And be sure your sin will find you out.

verses.name: Numbers 32:24
verses.text: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do that which has come out of your mouth.

verses.name: Numbers 32:25
verses.text: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben spoke to Moses saying, Your servants will do as my lord commands.

verses.name: Numbers 32:26
verses.text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead.

verses.name: Numbers 32:27
verses.text: But your servants will go over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:28
verses.text: So regarding them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 32:29
verses.text: And Moses said to them, If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben will go with you over Jordan, each armed to battle before the LORD, and the land shall be humbled before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.

verses.name: Numbers 32:30
verses.text: But if they will not go over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Numbers 32:31
verses.text: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD has said to your servants, so we will do.

verses.name: Numbers 32:32
verses.text: We will go over armed before the LORD <hi>into</hi> the land of Canaan, so that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan <hi>may be</hi> ours.

verses.name: Numbers 32:33
verses.text: And Moses gave to them, to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, and to the half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land with its cities in the borders, the cities of the land all around.

verses.name: Numbers 32:34
verses.text: And the sons of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer,

verses.name: Numbers 32:35
verses.text: and Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

verses.name: Numbers 32:36
verses.text: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities. And they built folds for sheep.

verses.name: Numbers 32:37
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjath-aim,

verses.name: Numbers 32:38
verses.text: and Nebo, and Baal-meon (their names being changed) and Sibmah, and they gave other names to the cities which they built.

verses.name: Numbers 32:39
verses.text: And the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and put out the Amorite who <hi>was</hi> in it.

verses.name: Numbers 32:40
verses.text: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he lived in it.

verses.name: Numbers 32:41
verses.text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns of it, and called them Havoth-jair.

verses.name: Numbers 32:42
verses.text: And Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah after his own name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:1
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the journeys of the sons of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.name: Numbers 33:2
verses.text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the command of the LORD. And these <hi>are</hi> their journeys according to their starting-places.

verses.name: Numbers 33:3
verses.text: And they pulled up from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the next day after the Passover the sons of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

verses.name: Numbers 33:4
verses.text: For the Egyptians buried all <hi>their</hi> first-born whom the LORD had stricken among them. The LORD also executed judgments upon their gods.

verses.name: Numbers 33:5
verses.text: And the sons of Israel pulled up from Rameses and pitched in Succoth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:6
verses.text: And they pulled up from Succoth and pitched in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.name: Numbers 33:7
verses.text: And they pulled up from Etham and turned again to Pihahiroth which <hi>is</hi> in front of Baal-zephon. And they pitched in front of Migdol.

verses.name: Numbers 33:8
verses.text: And they pulled up from before Pihahiroth and passed through the middle of the Sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:9
verses.text: And they pulled up from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim <hi>were</hi> twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm trees. And they pitched there.

verses.name: Numbers 33:10
verses.text: And they pulled up from Elim and pitched by the Red Sea.

verses.name: Numbers 33:11
verses.text: And they pulled up from the Red Sea and pitched in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.name: Numbers 33:12
verses.text: And they pulled up from of the wilderness of Sin and pitched in Dophkah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:13
verses.text: And they pulled up from Dophkah and pitched in Alush.

verses.name: Numbers 33:14
verses.text: And they pulled up from Alush and pitched at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.name: Numbers 33:15
verses.text: And they pulled up from Rephidim and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.name: Numbers 33:16
verses.text: And they pulled up from the wilderness of Sinai and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:17
verses.text: And they pulled up from Kibroth-hattaavah and pitched at Hazeroth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:18
verses.text: And they pulled up from Hazeroth and pitched in Rithmah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:19
verses.text: And they pulled up from Rithmah and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

verses.name: Numbers 33:20
verses.text: And they pulled up from Rimmon-parez and pitched in Libnah.
