verses.name: Numbers 33:21
verses.text: And they pulled up from Libnah and pitched at Rissah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:22
verses.text: And they pulled up <hi>stakes</hi> from Rissah and pitched in the Meeting Place.

verses.name: Numbers 33:23
verses.text: And they pulled up from Kehelathah and pitched in Mount Shapher.

verses.name: Numbers 33:24
verses.text: And they pulled up from Mount Shapher and pitched in Haradah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:25
verses.text: And they pulled up from Haradah and pitched in Makheloth

verses.name: Numbers 33:26
verses.text: And they pulled up from Makheloth and pitched at Tahath.

verses.name: Numbers 33:27
verses.text: And they pulled up from Tahath and pitched at Tarah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:28
verses.text: And they pulled up from Tarah and pitched in Mithcah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:29
verses.text: And they pulled up from Mithcah and pitched in Hashmonah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:30
verses.text: And they pulled up from Hashmonah and pitched at Moseroth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:31
verses.text: And they pulled up from Moseroth and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

verses.name: Numbers 33:32
verses.text: And they pulled up from Bene-jaakan and pitched at the Hole of the Cleft.

verses.name: Numbers 33:33
verses.text: And they pulled up from the Hole of the Cleft and pitched in Jotbathah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:34
verses.text: And they pulled up from Jotbathah and pitched at Ebronah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:35
verses.text: And they pulled up from Ebronah and pitched at Ezion-geber.

verses.name: Numbers 33:36
verses.text: And they pulled up from Ezion-geber and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which <hi>is</hi> Kadesh.

verses.name: Numbers 33:37
verses.text: And they pulled up from Kadesh and pitched in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

verses.name: Numbers 33:38
verses.text: And Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel had come up out of the land of Egypt, in the first of the fifth month.

verses.name: Numbers 33:39
verses.text: And Aaron <hi>was</hi> a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

verses.name: Numbers 33:40
verses.text: And king Arad the Canaanite, who lived in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 33:41
verses.text: And they pulled up from Mount Hor and pitched in Zalmonah.

verses.name: Numbers 33:42
verses.text: And they pulled up from Zalmonah and pitched in Punon.

verses.name: Numbers 33:43
verses.text: And they pulled up from Punon and pitched in Oboth.

verses.name: Numbers 33:44
verses.text: And they pulled up from Oboth and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

verses.name: Numbers 33:45
verses.text: And they pulled up from Iim and pitched in Dibon-gad.

verses.name: Numbers 33:46
verses.text: And they pulled up from Dibon-gad and pitched in Almon-diblathaim.

verses.name: Numbers 33:47
verses.text: And they pulled up from Almon-diblathaim and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.name: Numbers 33:48
verses.text: And they pulled up from the mountains of Abarim and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan <hi>at</hi> Jericho.

verses.name: Numbers 33:49
verses.text: And they pitched by Jordan, from The House of Deserts to The Meadow of Acacias in the plains of Moab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:50
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab beside Jordan, <hi>at</hi> Jericho, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 33:51
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.name: Numbers 33:52
verses.text: then you shall drive out all those who live in the land from before you, and destroy all their carved images, and destroy all their molded images and pluck down all their high places.

verses.name: Numbers 33:53
verses.text: And you shall possess the land, and live in it. For I have given you the land to possess it.

verses.name: Numbers 33:54
verses.text: And you shall divide the land by lot by your families. And you shall give the more inheritance to the many; to the few you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls out to him; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.

verses.name: Numbers 33:55
verses.text: But if you will not drive out the people of the land from before you, then it will be, those of them whom you let remain <hi>shall</hi> be goads in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land in which you live.

verses.name: Numbers 33:56
verses.text: And it shall be, as I thought to do to them, so I shall do to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 34:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 34:2
verses.text: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: When you come into the land of Canaan, this <hi>is</hi> the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan with its borders.

verses.name: Numbers 34:3
verses.text: And your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the border of Edom, and your south border shall be the furthest coast of the Salt Sea eastward.

verses.name: Numbers 34:4
verses.text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim and pass on to Zin. And its limit shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon.

verses.name: Numbers 34:5
verses.text: And the border shall turn from Azmon to the torrent of Egypt, and the end of it shall be at the sea.

verses.name: Numbers 34:6
verses.text: And <hi>for</hi> the western border, you shall even have the Great Sea for a border. This shall be your west border.

verses.name: Numbers 34:7
verses.text: And this shall be your northern border. From the Great Sea you shall point out for you Mount Hor.

verses.name: Numbers 34:8
verses.text: From Mount Hor you shall <hi>point</hi> your border to the entrance of Hamath. And the end of the border shall be at Zedad.

verses.name: Numbers 34:9
verses.text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the end of it shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your north border.

verses.name: Numbers 34:10
verses.text: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.

verses.name: Numbers 34:11
verses.text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. And the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the Sea of Chinnereth eastward.

verses.name: Numbers 34:12
verses.text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the end of it shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land with the borders of it all around.

verses.name: Numbers 34:13
verses.text: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel saying, This <hi>is</hi> the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half tribe.

verses.name: Numbers 34:14
verses.text: For the tribe of the sons of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to the house of their fathers. And half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 34:15
verses.text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan <hi>at</hi> Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 34:16
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 34:17
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the names of the men who shall divide the land to you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.name: Numbers 34:18
verses.text: And you shall take one ruler from every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 34:19
verses.text: And the names of the men <hi>are</hi> these. Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.name: Numbers 34:20
verses.text: And of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

verses.name: Numbers 34:21
verses.text: And of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

verses.name: Numbers 34:22
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

verses.name: Numbers 34:23
verses.text: The ruler of the sons of Joseph, for the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

verses.name: Numbers 34:24
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

verses.name: Numbers 34:25
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

verses.name: Numbers 34:26
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Issachar, Paltiel, the son of Azzan.

verses.name: Numbers 34:27
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

verses.name: Numbers 34:28
verses.text: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

verses.name: Numbers 34:29
verses.text: These <hi>are the ones</hi> to whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 35:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab beside Jordan, <hi>at</hi> Jericho, saying,

verses.name: Numbers 35:2
verses.text: Command the sons of Israel that they give to the Levites, from the land of their possessions cities to live in. And you shall give to the Levites suburbs for the cities all around them.

verses.name: Numbers 35:3
verses.text: And they shall have the cities to live in. And their open lands shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their animals.

verses.name: Numbers 35:4
verses.text: And the open lands of the cities which you shall give to the Levites <hi>shall reach</hi> from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits all around.

verses.name: Numbers 35:5
verses.text: And you shall measure from outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits. And the city <hi>shall be</hi> in the middle. This shall be to them the open land of the cities.

verses.name: Numbers 35:6
verses.text: And among the cities which you shall give to the Levites there <hi>shall be</hi> six cities for refuge, which you shall appoint for the manslayer, so that he may flee there. And you shall add forty-two cities to them.

verses.name: Numbers 35:7
verses.text: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites, forty-eight cities. You shall give them with their open land.

verses.name: Numbers 35:8
verses.text: And the cities which you shall give <hi>shall be</hi> of the possessions of the sons of Israel. You shall give many from those who have many. But from those who have few you shall give few. Everyone shall give of his cities to the Levites according to his inheritance which he inherits.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 35:9
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

verses.name: Numbers 35:10
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have come over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.name: Numbers 35:11
verses.text: then you shall choose cities to be cities of refuge for you, so that the slayer who kills any person through error may flee there.

verses.name: Numbers 35:12
verses.text: And they shall be to you cities for refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer does not die until he stands before the congregation in judgment.

verses.name: Numbers 35:13
verses.text: And of those cities which you shall give, you shall have six cities for refuge.

verses.name: Numbers 35:14
verses.text: You shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan to be cities of refuge.

verses.name: Numbers 35:15
verses.text: These six cities shall be a refuge for the sons of Israel, and for the stranger, and for anyone who stays among them, so that everyone who kills any person through error may flee there.

verses.name: Numbers 35:16
verses.text: And if he strikes him with an instrument of iron, so that he dies, he <hi>is</hi> a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 35:17
verses.text: And if he strikes him by throwing a stone, with which he may die, and if he dies, he <hi>is</hi> a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 35:18
verses.text: Or <hi>if</hi> he strikes him with a hand weapon of wood, with which he may die, and if he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 35:19
verses.text: The revenger of blood himself shall kill the murderer. When he meets him, he shall kill him.

verses.name: Numbers 35:20
verses.text: And if he stabs him from hatred, or hurls at him by lying in wait, so that he dies,

verses.name: Numbers 35:21
verses.text: or in hatred strikes him with his hand so that he dies, he who struck <hi>him</hi> shall surely he put to death. He <hi>is</hi> a murderer. The revenger of blood will kill the murderer when he meets him.

verses.name: Numbers 35:22
verses.text: But if he thrusts him suddenly without hatred, or has thrown something on him without lying in wait,

verses.name: Numbers 35:23
verses.text: or with any stone with which a man may die if he does not see, and throws <hi>it</hi> upon him so that he dies, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm,

verses.name: Numbers 35:24
verses.text: then the congregation shall judge between the one who kills and the revenger of blood according to these judgments.

verses.name: Numbers 35:25
verses.text: And the congregation shall deliver the one who kills out of the hand of the revenger of blood. And the congregation shall send him back to the city of his refuge, to which he had fled. And he shall stay in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.name: Numbers 35:26
verses.text: But if the one who killed shall at any time come outside the border of the city of his refuge to which he had fled,

verses.name: Numbers 35:27
verses.text: and if the avenger of blood finds him outside the borders of the city of his refuge, and if the avenger of blood kills the slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

verses.name: Numbers 35:28
verses.text: because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest the one who killed shall return to the land of his possession.

verses.name: Numbers 35:29
verses.text: So these <hi>things</hi> shall be for a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.name: Numbers 35:30
verses.text: Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses. But one witness shall not testify against any person <hi>to cause him</hi> to die.

verses.name: Numbers 35:31
verses.text: And you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who <hi>is</hi> guilty of death. But he shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Numbers 35:32
verses.text: And you shall take no ransom <hi>for him</hi> who has fled to the city of his refuge, to return to live in the land until the death of the <hi>high</hi> priest.

verses.name: Numbers 35:33
verses.text: So you shall not defile the land in which you <hi>are</hi>. For blood defiles the land. And the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed in it, except by the blood of him that shed it.

verses.name: Numbers 35:34
verses.text: So do not defile the land which you shall inhabit, in which I dwell. For I the LORD dwell among the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 36:1
verses.text: And the chief fathers of the families of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses, and before the rulers, the chief fathers of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Numbers 36:2
verses.text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel. And my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

verses.name: Numbers 36:3
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> they are married to any of the sons of the tribes of the sons of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe to which they are received. So it shall be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 36:4
verses.text: And when the jubilee of the sons of Israel shall come, then their inheritance shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received. So their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Numbers 36:5
verses.text: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel according to the word of the LORD saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.

verses.name: Numbers 36:6
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best. Only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

verses.name: Numbers 36:7
verses.text: So the inheritance of the sons of Israel shall not be moved from tribe to tribe. For every one of the sons of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

verses.name: Numbers 36:8
verses.text: And every daughter that possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the sons of Israel shall become a wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, so that the sons of Israel may each one enjoy the inheritance of his fathers.

verses.name: Numbers 36:9
verses.text: And the inheritance shall not move from <hi>one</hi> tribe to another tribe. But every one of the tribes of the sons of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

verses.name: Numbers 36:10
verses.text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so the daughters of Zelophehad did.

verses.name: Numbers 36:11
verses.text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, <hi>were</hi> married to their father's brothers' sons.

verses.name: Numbers 36:12
verses.text: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.name: Numbers 36:13
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the commandments and the judgments which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab beside Jordan, at Jericho.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:1
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite the Red Sea, between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and Dizahab,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:2
verses.text: eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:3
verses.text: And it happened, in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah had commanded him concerning them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:4
verses.text: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth in Edrei,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:5
verses.text: beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:6
verses.text: Jehovah our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, You have had enough of dwelling in this mountain.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:7
verses.text: Turn and pull up <hi>stakes</hi>, and enter the hill-country of the Amorites, and to all <hi>its</hi> neighboring places, in the Arabah in the hill-country, and in the low country, and in the south, and in the shore of the sea, the land of the Canaanites and of Lebanon, to the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:8
verses.text: Behold, I have set before you the land; go in and possess the land which the LORD has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:9
verses.text: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you by myself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:10
verses.text: Jehovah your God has multiplied you, and, behold, today you <hi>are</hi> as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:11
verses.text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times more than you <hi>are</hi>, and bless you as He has said to you!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:12
verses.text: How can I by myself bear your pressure and your burden and your strife?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:13
verses.text: Give wise and understanding men, and <hi>those</hi> known to your tribes, and I will appoint them rulers over you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:14
verses.text: And you answered me and said, The thing which you have spoken <hi>is</hi> good to do.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:15
verses.text: And I took the chiefs of your tribes, wise and noted men, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:16
verses.text: And I commanded your judges at that time saying, Hear <hi>the causes</hi> between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the stranger with him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:17
verses.text: You shall not respect persons in judgment. You shall hear the small as well as the great. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment <hi>is</hi> God's. And the cause that is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:18
verses.text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:19
verses.text: And when we pulled up from Horeb, we went <hi>through</hi> all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us. And we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:20
verses.text: And I said to you, You have come to the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God has given unto us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:21
verses.text: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up. Possess <hi>it</hi>, even as the LORD God of your fathers has said to you. Do not fear, neither be troubled.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:22
verses.text: And you came near to me, every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search out the land and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:23
verses.text: And the saying pleased me very much. And I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:24
verses.text: And they turned and went up into the mountain and came to the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:25
verses.text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought <hi>it</hi> down to us, and brought us word again and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God gives us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:26
verses.text: But you would not go up, but rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:27
verses.text: And you murmured in your tents and said, Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:28
verses.text: Where <hi>shall</hi> we go up? Our brothers have broken our heart, saying, We have seen there a people greater and taller than we <hi>are</hi>. The cities are great and walled up to the heavens, also the sons of the giants.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:29
verses.text: Then I said to you, Do not dread them nor be afraid of them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:30
verses.text: The LORD your God who goes before you shall fight for you, according to all that He did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:31
verses.text: and in the wilderness where you have seen how the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went until you came into this place.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:32
verses.text: Yet in this thing you did not believe the LORD your God,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:33
verses.text: who went in the way before you to search you out a place to pitch your tents, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:34
verses.text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was angry and swore, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:35
verses.text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:36
verses.text: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him I will give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his sons, because he has fully followed the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:37
verses.text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, You also shall not go in there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:38
verses.text: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall go in there. Make him strong, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:39
verses.text: And your little ones, who you said would be a prey, and your sons who in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in there. And I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:40
verses.text: But you turn and pull up into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:41
verses.text: And you answered and said to me, We have sinned against the LORD; we will go up and fight according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when each one of you had buckled on his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:42
verses.text: But the LORD said to me, Say to them, Do not go up, nor fight, for I <hi>am</hi> not among you, you will be beaten by your enemies.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:43
verses.text: So I spoke to you. And you would not hear, but rebelled against the command of the LORD, and went presumptuously into the hill.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:44
verses.text: And the Amorites who lived in that mountain came out against you and chased you, even as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, to Hormah.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:45
verses.text: And you returned and wept before the LORD. But the LORD would not listen to your voice, nor give ear to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:46
verses.text: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:1
verses.text: Then we turned and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me. And we went around Mount Seir many days.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:2
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:3
verses.text: You have gone around this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:4
verses.text: And command the people saying, You <hi>are</hi> to pass through the border of your brothers, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir. And they shall be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:5
verses.text: Do not meddle with them, for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau <hi>for</hi> a possession.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:6
verses.text: You shall buy food from them for silver, so that you may eat. And you shall also buy water from them for silver, so that you may drink.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:7
verses.text: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the works of your hand. He knows your walking <hi>through</hi> this great wilderness. The LORD your God <hi>has been</hi> with you these forty years. You have lacked nothing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:8
verses.text: And when we left our brothers the sons of Esau who lived in Seir, through the way of the Arabah from Elath, and from Ezion-geber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Do not besiege Moab, nor fight with them in battle. For I will not give you any of their land <hi>for</hi> a possession. Because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot <hi>for</hi> a possession.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:10
verses.text: The Emim lived there in times past, a great people, who were many and tall like the Anakim.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:11
verses.text: And they were known as giants, like the sons of Anak, but the Moabites called them Emim.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:12
verses.text: The Horim also lived in Seir in times past. But the sons of Esau took their place when they had destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:13
verses.text: Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:14
verses.text: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we had come over the brook Zered <hi>were</hi> thirty-eight years; until the end of all the generation. The men of war <hi>were</hi> destroyed from the midst of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:15
verses.text: And the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the camp, until they were consumed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:16
verses.text: And it happened, when all the men of war had finished dying from among the people,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:17
verses.text: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:18
verses.text: today you are to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:19
verses.text: And when you come near, across from the sons of Ammon, do not trouble them nor be stirred up against them. For I will not give you <hi>any</hi> possessions from the land of the sons of Ammon, because I have given it to the sons of Lot <hi>for</hi> a possession.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:20
verses.text: It also was known to be a land of giants. Giants lived there in past times. And the Ammonites call them Zamzumim,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:21
verses.text: a great and plentiful people, and tall, like the sons of Anak, but the LORD destroyed them before them. And they expelled them and lived in their place,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:22
verses.text: as He did to the sons of Esau who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horim from before them. And they expelled them and lived in their place even to this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:23
verses.text: And the Avvim who lived in villages as far as Azzah, the Caphtorites, who came forth out of Caphtor destroyed them, and lived in their place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:24
verses.text: Rise up, set out and cross over the river Arnon. Behold! I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to possess, and fight with him in battle.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:25
verses.text: Today, I will begin to put your dread and your fear upon the nations under the whole heavens; who shall hear report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:26
verses.text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon <hi>with</hi> words of peace, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:27
verses.text: Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will neither turn <hi>to</hi> the right hand nor to the left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:28
verses.text: You shall sell me food for silver, so that I may eat, and give me water for silver so that I may drink. Only I will pass through on my feet,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:29
verses.text: as the sons of Esau who live in Seir, and the Moabites who live in Ar, did to me, until I shall cross over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:30
verses.text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him. For the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart stubborn so that He might deliver him into your hand, as <hi>it is</hi> this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:31
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess it so that you may inherit his land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:32
verses.text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:33
verses.text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us. And we struck him and his sons and all his people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:34
verses.text: And we took all his cities at that time and completely destroyed the men and the women and the little ones of every city. We left none to remain.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:35
verses.text: Only we plundered the cattle for ourselves, and we took the spoil of the cities.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:36
verses.text: From Aroer, by the brink of the river of Arnon, and the city by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us. The LORD our God delivered all to us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:37
verses.text: Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not come, to any place of the river Jabbok, nor to the cities in the mountains, nor to whatever the LORD our God denied us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:1
verses.text: And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle <hi>at</hi> Edrei.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:2
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Do not fear him, for I will deliver him and all his people, and his land, into your hand. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:3
verses.text: So the LORD our God delivered Og into our hands also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. And we struck him until none <hi>was</hi> left remaining to him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:4
verses.text: And we took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we did not take from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:5
verses.text: All these cities <hi>were</hi> fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides a good many unwalled towns.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:6
verses.text: And we completely destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, completely destroying the men, women, and children of every city.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:7
verses.text: But we took the cattle and the spoil of the cities as a prize for ourselves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:8
verses.text: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon to Mount Hermon,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:9
verses.text: (the Hermon <hi>which</hi> the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir).

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:10
verses.text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, and Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan <hi>were taken</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:11
verses.text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the rest of the giants. Behold! His bedstead <hi>was</hi> a bedstead of iron. Is it not in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? Nine cubits <hi>was</hi> its length, and four cubits its width, according to the cubit of a man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:12
verses.text: And this is the land <hi>which</hi> we possessed at that time, from Aroer by the river Arnon, and half of Mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the men of Reuben and of Gad.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:13
verses.text: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh, all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:14
verses.text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob to the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi. And he called them after his own name, Bashan (Towns of Jair) to this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:15
verses.text: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:16
verses.text: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the river Arnon, half the valley, and the border even to the river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:17
verses.text: the plain also, and Jordan, and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea, under The Slopes of Pisgah eastward.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:18
verses.text: And I commanded you at that time saying, The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. You shall pass over armed before your brothers the sons of Israel, all the sons of might.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:19
verses.text: But your wives and your little ones, and your cattle, (I know that you have much cattle), shall stay in your cities which I have given you

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:20
verses.text: until the LORD has given rest to your brothers, as well as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God <hi>has</hi> given them beyond Jordan. And then you shall each one return to his possessions which I have given you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:21
verses.text: And I commanded Joshua at that time saying, Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So the LORD shall do to all the kingdoms where you pass.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:22
verses.text: You shall not fear them. For the LORD your God shall fight for you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:23
verses.text: And I begged the LORD at that time saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:24
verses.text: O, LORD God, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness, and Your mighty hand. For what God <hi>is there</hi> in heaven or in earth who can do according to Your works, and according to Your might?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:25
verses.text: I pray you, let me go over and see the good land beyond Jordan, this good hill-country and Lebanon.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:26
verses.text: But the LORD was angry with me because of you and would not hear me. And the LORD said to me, <hi>Let it be</hi> enough for you. Speak no more to Me of this matter.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:27
verses.text: Go up into the top of Pisgah and lift up your eyes westward and northward and southward and eastward, and behold <hi>it</hi> with your eyes. For you shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:28
verses.text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him. For he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:29
verses.text: So we stayed in the valley over against Beth-peor.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:1
verses.text: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments which I teach you, in order to do them, so that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:2
verses.text: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, so that you may keep the commands of the LORD your God which I command you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:3
verses.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor. For the LORD your God has destroyed from among you all the men that followed Baal-peor.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:4
verses.text: And you who held fast to the LORD your God <hi>are</hi> alive, every one of you, this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:5
verses.text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, so that you should do so in the land where you go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:6
verses.text: And you shall keep and do <hi>them</hi>, for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes and say, Surely this great nation <hi>is</hi> a wise and understanding people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:7
verses.text: For who is a great nation whose God <hi>is</hi> coming near to them, as Jehovah our God <hi>is</hi>, in all our calling on him?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:8
verses.text: And who is a great nation whose statutes and judgments <hi>are so</hi> righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:9
verses.text: Only take heed to yourself and keep your soul carefully, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. But teach them to your sons, and your sons' sons.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:10
verses.text: Remember the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, Gather the people to Me, and I will make them hear My words so that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and they may teach their sons.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:11
verses.text: And you came near and stood under the mountain. And the mountain burned with fire to the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:12
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard the voice of the words, but saw no likeness, only a voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:13
verses.text: And He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, ten commandments. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:14
verses.text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments so that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:15
verses.text: Therefore take good heed to yourselves, for you saw no kind of likeness on the day the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:16
verses.text: lest you act corruptly and make yourselves a graven image, the likeness of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:17
verses.text: the likeness of any beast on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flies in the air,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:18
verses.text: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish in the waters beneath the earth;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:19
verses.text: and lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, lest you should be driven to worship them and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all nations under all the heavens.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:20
verses.text: But the LORD has taken you and brought you out from the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to Him a people of inheritance, as <hi>you are</hi> today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:21
verses.text: And the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:22
verses.text: But I must die in this land; I must not go over Jordan. But you <hi>shall</hi> go over and possess that good land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:23
verses.text: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which He made with you, and make you a graven image, a likeness of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:24
verses.text: For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> a consuming fire, a jealous God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:25
verses.text: When you father sons and sons of sons, and when you shall have remained long in the land and have dealt corruptly by making a graven image, the likeness of any, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD your God, to provoke Him to anger,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:26
verses.text: I call Heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land which you are crossing over Jordan to possess. You shall not prolong <hi>your</hi> days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:27
verses.text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations where the LORD shall drive you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:28
verses.text: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:29
verses.text: But if you shall seek the LORD your God from there, you shall find <hi>Him</hi>, if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:30
verses.text: When you are in trouble and when all these things have found you in the latter days, then you shall return to the LORD your God and shall be obedient to His voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:31
verses.text: For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> a merciful God; He will not forsake you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:32
verses.text: For ask now of the days past which were before you, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens, where there has been a thing as great as this, or has been heard any like it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:33
verses.text: Did people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire as you have heard and live?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:34
verses.text: Or has God gone forth to take a nation for himself from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:35
verses.text: It was shown to you so that you might know that Jehovah <hi>is</hi> God, <hi>and</hi> no one else beside Him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:36
verses.text: He made you hear His voice out of Heaven so that He might teach you. And He showed you His great fire upon earth. And you heard His words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:37
verses.text: And because He loved your fathers, therefore He chose their seed after them, and brought you out in His sight with His mighty power out of Egypt,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:38
verses.text: in order to drive out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as <hi>it is</hi> this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:39
verses.text: Therefore, know this day and consider within your heart, that the LORD <hi>is</hi> God in Heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no other.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:40
verses.text: Therefore, you shall keep His statutes and His commandments which I command you this day, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, and so that you may make your days longer upon the earth which the LORD your God gives you forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:41
verses.text: Then Moses separated three cities on this side Jordan towards the sunrise,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:42
verses.text: so that the slayer might flee there, he who should kill his neighbor through error and who did not hate him <hi>in</hi> times past, and he fleeing to one of these cities might live.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:43
verses.text: They were Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:44
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the law which Moses set before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:45
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel after they came forth out of Egypt,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:46
verses.text: beyond Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel killed, after they had come forth out of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:47
verses.text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who <hi>were</hi> on this side Jordan toward the sunrise,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:48
verses.text: from Aroer, on the edge of the river Arnon, even to Mount Zion, which <hi>is</hi> Hermon,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:49
verses.text: and all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the plain, under the Slopes of Pisgah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:1
verses.text: And Moses called all Israel and said to them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, so that you may learn them and keep and do them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:2
verses.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:3
verses.text: The LORD did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, all of us here, alive today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:4
verses.text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mountain out of the midst of the fire;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:5
verses.text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the word of the LORD, for you were afraid because of the fire, and did not go up into the mountain,) saying,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:6
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:7
verses.text: You shall have no other gods besides Me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:8
verses.text: You shall not make a graven image for you, any likeness <hi>of anything</hi> that is in the heavens above, or in the earth beneath, or in the waters beneath the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:9
verses.text: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them. For I the LORD your God <hi>am</hi> a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and fourth <hi>generation</hi> of those who hate Me,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:10
verses.text: and doing mercy to thousands of those who love Me and keep My commandments.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:11
verses.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not acquit <hi>the one</hi> who takes His name in vain.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:12
verses.text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:13
verses.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:14
verses.text: But the seventh day <hi>shall be</hi> the sabbath of the LORD your God. <hi>In it</hi> you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger inside your gates, so that your manservant and your maidservant may rest like yourself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:15
verses.text: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and with a stretched-out arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the sabbath day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:16
verses.text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be made longer, and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:17
verses.text: You shall not kill.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:18
verses.text: And you shall not commit adultery.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:19
verses.text: And you shall not steal.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:20
verses.text: And you shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:21
verses.text: And you shall not lust after your neighbor's wife, nor shall you covet your neighbor's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any <hi>thing</hi> that is your neighbor's.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:22
verses.text: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly in the mountain out of the midst of the fire of the cloud and of the thick darkness with a great voice. And He added no more. And He wrote them in two tablets of stone and delivered them to me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:23
verses.text: And it happened when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, for the mountain burned with fire, you came near me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:24
verses.text: and you said, Behold! The LORD our God has revealed His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire. We have seen today that God talks with man yet he <hi>still</hi> lives.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:25
verses.text: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:26
verses.text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we <hi>have</hi>, and lived?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:27
verses.text: You go near and hear all that the LORD our God shall say. And you speak to us all that the LORD our God shall speak to you, and we will hear and act.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:28
verses.text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me. And the LORD said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well <hi>said</hi> all that they have spoken.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:29
verses.text: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their sons forever!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:30
verses.text: Go say to them, Go into your tents again.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:31
verses.text: But as for you, you stand here by Me, and I will speak to you all the commandments and the statutes and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may do <hi>them</hi> in the land which I am giving them, to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:32
verses.text: And you shall be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:33
verses.text: You shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God has commanded you so that you may live and that good <hi>may be</hi> to you, and you may make <hi>your</hi> days longer in the land which you shall possess.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God commanded to teach you so that you might do <hi>them</hi> in the land where you go, to possess it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:2
verses.text: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, you, and your son, and your son's son, all the days of your life, and so that your days may be prolonged.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:3
verses.text: Then hear, O, Israel, and be careful to <hi>do</hi> it, so that it may be well with you, and that you may greatly multiply, as the LORD God of our fathers has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:4
verses.text: Hear, O, Israel. The LORD our God <hi>is</hi> one LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:5
verses.text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:6
verses.text: And these words which I command you this day shall be in your heart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:7
verses.text: And you shall carefully teach them to your sons, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:8
verses.text: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:9
verses.text: And you shall write them upon the posts of your house, and on your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:10
verses.text: And it shall be when the LORD your God has brought you into the land which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and good cities which you did not build,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:11
verses.text: and houses full of every good <hi>thing</hi> which you did not fill, and wells which are dug, but which you did not dig, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, and you shall eat and be full,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:12
verses.text: you shall be on guard lest you forget the LORD who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:13
verses.text: You shall fear the LORD your God and serve Him, and shall swear by His name.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:14
verses.text: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people all around you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:15
verses.text: for the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> a jealous God among you, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you and destroy you from off the face of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:16
verses.text: You shall not tempt the LORD your God as you tempted in Massah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:17
verses.text: You shall carefully keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:18
verses.text: And you shall do the right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you, and so that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:19
verses.text: to cast out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:20
verses.text: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, What are the testimonies, and the statutes and the judgments which the LORD our God has commanded you?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:21
verses.text: Then you shall say to your son, We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt, and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:22
verses.text: And the LORD gave signs and wonders, great and evil signs, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his household, before our eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:23
verses.text: And He brought us out from there so that He might bring us in to give us the land which He swore to our fathers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:24
verses.text: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, so that He might preserve us alive, as <hi>it is</hi> today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:25
verses.text: And if we are careful to do all this commandment before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, it shall be our righteousness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:1
verses.text: When the LORD your God shall bring you into the land where you go to possess it, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:2
verses.text: and the LORD your God shall deliver them before you, you shall crush them, completely destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them nor show mercy to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:3
verses.text: Nor shall you make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter to your son.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:4
verses.text: For they will turn away your son from following Me, so that they may serve other gods. So the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you and will destroy you suddenly.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:5
verses.text: But you shall deal with them in this way: you shall destroy their altars and break down their images, and cut down their groves and burn their graven images with fire.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:6
verses.text: For you <hi>are</hi> a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a special people to Himself above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:7
verses.text: The LORD did not set His love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people, for you <hi>were</hi> the fewest of all people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:8
verses.text: But because the LORD loved you, and because He would keep the oath which He had sworn to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:9
verses.text: Therefore, know that the LORD your God, He <hi>is</hi> God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments, to a thousand generations.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:10
verses.text: And he repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slow to repay him who hates Him. He will repay him to his face.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:11
verses.text: And you shall keep the commandments and the statutes and the judgments which I command you today, to do them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:12
verses.text: And it shall be, because you listen to these judgments and keep and do them, the LORD your God shall keep to you the covenant and the mercy which He swore to your fathers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:13
verses.text: And He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your grain, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which He swore to your fathers to give you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:14
verses.text: You shall be blessed above all people. There shall not be male or female barren among you or among your cattle.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:15
verses.text: And the LORD will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt which you know upon you. But He will lay them upon all who hate you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:16
verses.text: And you shall destroy all the people which the LORD your God shall deliver you. Your eye shall have no pity upon them, neither shall you serve their gods, for <hi>they will be</hi> a snare to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:17
verses.text: If you shall say in your heart, These nations <hi>are</hi> more than I; how can I throw them out?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:18
verses.text: You shall not be afraid of them, <hi>but</hi> shall well remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:19
verses.text: <hi> Remember</hi> the great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched-out arm by which the Lord your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the people of whom you are afraid.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:20
verses.text: And the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until the ones who are left, and who hide themselves from you, are destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:21
verses.text: You shall not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> among you, a mighty and terrible God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:22
verses.text: And the LORD your God will put out those nations before you by little and little. You may not destroy them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:23
verses.text: And the LORD your God shall deliver them to you, and shall destroy them with a mighty ruin until they are destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:24
verses.text: And He shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under the heavens. No man shall be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:25
verses.text: You shall burn the graven images of their gods with fire. You shall not desire the silver or gold on them, nor take <hi>it</hi> for yourself, so that you may not be snared in it. For it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:26
verses.text: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it. You shall utterly hate it, and you shall utterly despise it. For it <hi>is</hi> a cursed thing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:1
verses.text: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you be careful to do, that you may live and multiply and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:2
verses.text: And you shall remember all the way which the LORD your God led you these forty years in the wilderness in order to humble you, to prove you, to know what is in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:3
verses.text: And He humbled you and allowed you to hunger, and then He fed you with manna, which you did not know, neither did your fathers know <hi>it</hi>, so that He might make you know that man shall not live by bread alone. But every <hi>word</hi> that comes out of the mouth of the LORD man shall live.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:4
verses.text: Your clothing did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell, these forty years.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:5
verses.text: And you have known with your heart that as a man chastens his son, <hi>so</hi> the LORD your God chastens you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:6
verses.text: And you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to fear him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:7
verses.text: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:8
verses.text: a land of wheat and barley and vines and fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:9
verses.text: a land in which you shall eat bread without want. You shall not lack any <hi>thing</hi> in it. <hi>It is</hi> a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:10
verses.text: And you shall eat and be satisfied, then you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which He has given you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:11
verses.text: Beware that you do not forget the LORD your God, in not keeping His commandments, and His judgments, and His statutes, which I command you today,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:12
verses.text: lest <hi>when</hi> you have eaten and are full and have built good houses and lived in <hi>them,</hi>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:13
verses.text: and <hi>when</hi> your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:14
verses.text: then your heart might be lifted up, and you might forget the LORD your God who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:15
verses.text: He led you through the great and terrible wilderness, <hi>with</hi> fiery serpents and scorpions and thirsty ground, where <hi>there was</hi> no water, who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:16
verses.text: who fed you in the wilderness with manna which your fathers did not know, so that He might humble you and so that He might prove you, to do you good in your latter end,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:17
verses.text: and so that you might not say in your heart, My power and the might of <hi>my</hi> hand has gotten me this wealth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:18
verses.text: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for <hi>it is</hi> He who gives you power to get wealth, so that He may confirm His covenant which He has sworn to your fathers, as it is today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:19
verses.text: And it shall be if you do at all forget the LORD your God and walk after other gods and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:20
verses.text: As the nations whom the LORD destroys before your face, so you shall perish because you would not listen to the voice of the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:1
verses.text: Hear, O, Israel! You <hi>are</hi> to pass over Jordan today, to go in to expel nations greater and mightier than you, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:2
verses.text: a people great and tall, the sons of the giants, whom you know and have heard it said, Who can stand before the sons of Anak!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:3
verses.text: Therefore, understand today that the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> He who goes over before you. <hi>Like</hi> a consuming fire, He shall destroy them, and He shall bring them down before your face. So you shall drive them out and destroy them quickly, as the LORD has said to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:4
verses.text: Do not speak in your heart, after the LORD your God has cast them out from before you, saying: For my righteousness, the LORD has brought me in to possess this land. But for the wickedness of these nations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:5
verses.text: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land. But for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God drives them out from before you, so that He may perform the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:6
verses.text: Therefore, understand that the LORD your God does not give you this good land, to possess it, for your righteousness. For you <hi>are</hi> a stiff-necked people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:7
verses.text: Remember, <hi>and</hi> do not forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day you departed out of the land of Egypt, until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:8
verses.text: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:9
verses.text: When I had gone up into the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:10
verses.text: And the LORD delivered to me two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them according to all the words which the LORD spoke with you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:11
verses.text: And it happened, at the end of forty days and forty nights the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:12
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Arise! Get down quickly from here, for your people whom you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted. They have quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them. They have made them a molten image.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:13
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to me saying: I have seen this people, and, behold, it <hi>is</hi> a stiff-necked people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:14
verses.text: Let Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under the heavens. And I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:15
verses.text: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire. And the two tables of the covenant <hi>were</hi> in my two hands.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:16
verses.text: And I looked, and behold! You had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:17
verses.text: And I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands and broke them before your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:18
verses.text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sins which you sinned in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:19
verses.text: For I was afraid of the anger and fury with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me at that time also.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:20
verses.text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him. And I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:21
verses.text: And I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and stamped it, grinding <hi>it</hi> very small, until it was as small as dust. And I threw the dust of it into the torrent that descended out of the mountain.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:22
verses.text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at the Graves of Lust, you provoked the LORD to anger.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:23
verses.text: And when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying: Go up and possess the land which I have given you, then you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you did not believe Him, nor listened to His voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:24
verses.text: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:25
verses.text: And I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down <hi>before</hi>, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:26
verses.text: I prayed therefore to the LORD and said, O, Lord God, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance which You have redeemed through Your greatness, which You have brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:27
verses.text: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:28
verses.text: lest the land from where You bring us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which He promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:29
verses.text: Yet they <hi>are</hi> Your people and Your inheritance which You brought out by Your mighty power and by Your stretched-out arm.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:1
verses.text: At that time the LORD said to me: Cut out two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me into the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:2
verses.text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were in the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:3
verses.text: And I made an ark <hi>of</hi> acacia-wood, and cut out two tablets of stone like the first, and went up into the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:4
verses.text: And He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the Ten Commandments which the LORD spoke to you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly. And the LORD gave them to me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:5
verses.text: And I turned myself and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made. And there they are, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:6
verses.text: And the sons of Israel pulled up <hi>stakes</hi> from Beeroth of the sons of Jaakan to Mosera. There Aaron died, and there he was buried. And Eleazar his son served in the priest's office in his place.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:7
verses.text: From there they pulled up to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of water brooks.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:8
verses.text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him, and to bless in His name, until today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:9
verses.text: Therefore Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brothers. The LORD <hi>is</hi> his inheritance, according as the LORD your God promised him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:10
verses.text: And I stayed in the mountain, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights. And the LORD listened to me at that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Arise, Go before the people, causing them to go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:12
verses.text: And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:13
verses.text: to keep the commandments of the LORD, and His statutes, which I command you today for your good?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:14
verses.text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens <hi>belong</hi> to the LORD your God, the earth also, with all in it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:15
verses.text: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and He chose their seed after them, you above all people, as <hi>it is</hi> today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:16
