verses.text: Therefore, circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and be no longer stiff-necked.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:17
verses.text: For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, the mighty, and a terrible God, who does not respect persons nor take a bribe.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:18
verses.text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the stranger in giving him food and clothing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:19
verses.text: Therefore love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:20
verses.text: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve Him, and you shall hold fast to Him, and swear by His name.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:21
verses.text: He <hi>is</hi> your praise, and He <hi>is</hi> your God, who has done for you these great and terrible things which your eyes have seen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:22
verses.text: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons. And now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the heavens for multitude.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:1
verses.text: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep His charge and His statutes and His judgments and His commandments always.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:2
verses.text: And you know today, for <hi>I do</hi> not <hi>speak</hi> with your sons who have not known and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, His greatness, His mighty hand, and His stretched-out arm,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:3
verses.text: and His miracles, and His acts which He did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:4
verses.text: And <hi>you know</hi> what He did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and to their chariots, how He made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and the LORD has destroyed them to today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:5
verses.text: And you <hi>know what</hi> He did to you in the wilderness until you came into this place,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:6
verses.text: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab the son of Reuben, how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance in their possession, in the midst of all Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:7
verses.text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which He did.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:8
verses.text: Therefore you shall keep all the commandments which I command you today, so that you may be strong and go in and possess the land where you go to possess it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:9
verses.text: and so that you may make <hi>your</hi> days longer in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:10
verses.text: For the land into which you go to possess it, <hi>is</hi> not as the land of Egypt from which you came out, where you sowed your seed and watered <hi>it</hi> with your foot, like a garden of herbs.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:11
verses.text: But the land which you are entering to possess it <hi>is</hi> a land of hills and valleys, drinking water from the rain of heavens.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:12
verses.text: It is a land which the LORD your God cares for. The eyes of the LORD your God <hi>are</hi> always upon it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:13
verses.text: And it will be, if you will listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:14
verses.text: I will give the rain of your land in its due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain and your wine and your oil.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:15
verses.text: And I will send grass in your fields for your cattle so that you may eat and be full.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:16
verses.text: Take heed to yourselves that your heart may not be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods, and worship them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:17
verses.text: and the LORD's wrath be kindled against you, and He shut up the heavens so that there will be no rain, and so that the land will not yield her fruit, and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:18
verses.text: Therefore you shall lay up these my words in your hearts and in your souls, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, so that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:19
verses.text: And you shall teach them to your sons, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:20
verses.text: And <hi>you</hi> shall write them upon the door posts of your house, and upon your gates,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:21
verses.text: so that your days and the days of your sons may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to give to your fathers, like the days of the heavens upon the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:22
verses.text: For if you will carefully keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:23
verses.text: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall possess greater and mightier nations than you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:24
verses.text: Every place on which the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours, from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the furthest sea shall your border be.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:25
verses.text: There shall no man stand before you, <hi>for</hi> the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon the face of all the land that you shall tread upon, as He has said to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:26
verses.text: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:27
verses.text: A blessing if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:28
verses.text: and a curse if you will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but will turn aside out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:29
verses.text: And it will be, when the LORD your God has brought you into the land where you go to possess it, you shall set the blessing upon Mount Gerizim, and the curse upon Mount Ebal.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:30
verses.text: <hi> Are</hi> they not on the other side Jordan, by the way of the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites, who dwell in the plain across from Gilgal beside the plains of Moreh?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:31
verses.text: For you shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:32
verses.text: And you shall be careful to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you today.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:1
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the statutes and judgments which you shall be careful to do in the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives you to possess it, all the days that you live upon the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:2
verses.text: You shall completely destroy all the places in which the nations which you shall possess served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:3
verses.text: And you shall overthrow their altars and break their pillars, and burn their pillars with fire. And you shall cut down the carved images of their gods, and destroy their names out of that place.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:4
verses.text: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:5
verses.text: But you shall seek to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put His name there, even to His dwelling place you shall seek, and there you shall come.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:6
verses.text: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offering of your hand, and your vows, and your free-will offerings, and the first-born of your herds and of your flocks.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:7
verses.text: And there you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:8
verses.text: You shall not do according to all that we do here today, each doing whatever <hi>is</hi> right in his own eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:9
verses.text: For you have not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:10
verses.text: But <hi>when</hi> you go over Jordan and live in the land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, and He gives you rest from all your enemies all around, so that you live in safety,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:11
verses.text: then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell there. There you shall bring all that I command you, your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:12
verses.text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your sons, your daughters, your men-servants, your female-servants, and the Levite that <hi>is</hi> within your gates (because he has no part nor inheritance with you).

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:13
verses.text: Take heed to yourself that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:14
verses.text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:15
verses.text: However, with all your soul's desire you shall sacrifice and eat flesh in all your gates, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which He has given you, the unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle, and as of the hart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:16
verses.text: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it on the earth like water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:17
verses.text: You may not eat inside your gates the tithe of your grain or of your wine or of your oil, or the first-born of your herds or of your flock, or any of your vows which you vow, or your free-will offerings or the heave offering of your hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:18
verses.text: But you must eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite within your gates. And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand <hi>to</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:19
verses.text: Take heed to yourself that you do not forsake the Levite as long as you live on the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:20
verses.text: When the LORD your God shall make your border larger, as He has promised you, and you shall say, I will eat flesh, because your soul longs to eat flesh; you may eat flesh, whatever your soul desires.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:21
verses.text: If the place which the LORD your God has chosen to put his name there is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat in your gates whatever your soul desires.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:22
verses.text: Even as the gazelle and the hart is eaten, so you shall eat them. The unclean and the clean shall eat <hi>of</hi> them alike.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:23
verses.text: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood. For the blood <hi>is</hi> the life. And you may not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:24
verses.text: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it on the earth like water.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:25
verses.text: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, when you shall do what <hi>is</hi> right in the sight of the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:26
verses.text: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:27
verses.text: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. And the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall eat the flesh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:28
verses.text: Be careful to hear all these words which I command you, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you forever, when you do the good and right in the sight of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:29
verses.text: When the LORD your God shall cut off the nations before you, where you go to possess them, and you take their place and dwell in their land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:30
verses.text: take heed to yourself that you do not become snared by following them, after they are destroyed from before you, and that you do not ask about their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods that I too may do likewise?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:31
verses.text: You shall not do so to the LORD your God. For every abomination to the LORD, which He hates, they have done to their gods; even their sons and their daughters they have burned in the fire to their gods.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:32
verses.text: All the things I command you, be careful to do it. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:1
verses.text: If a prophet rises among you, or a dreamer of dreams, and gives you a sign or a wonder,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:2
verses.text: and the sign or the wonder which he foretold to you occurs, saying, Let us go after other gods which you have not known, and let us serve them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:3
verses.text: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> testing you to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:4
verses.text: You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments, and obey His voice, and you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:5
verses.text: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken to turn <hi>you</hi> away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, to thrust you out of the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall put the evil away from the midst of you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:6
verses.text: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who <hi>is</hi> like your own soul, lures you secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:7
verses.text: that is, of the gods of the people who <hi>are</hi> around you, near you or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:8
verses.text: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him. Nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare, nor shall you hide him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:9
verses.text: But you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:10
verses.text: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he has sought to drive you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:11
verses.text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this among you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:12
verses.text: If, in one of your cities which the LORD your God has given you to dwell in, you shall hear <hi>one</hi> saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:13
verses.text: Men, the sons of Belial, have gone out from among you and have drawn away those who live in their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:14
verses.text: then you shall inquire and make search, and ask carefully. And behold, <hi>if it is true</hi>, and the thing is certain, <hi>that</hi> such an abomination is done among you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:15
verses.text: you shall surely strike those who live in that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it completely, and all that <hi>is</hi> in it, and all the cattle of it, with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:16
verses.text: And you shall gather all its spoil into the middle of its street, and shall burn the city with fire, and all its spoil, every bit of it, for the LORD your God. And it shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:17
verses.text: And let nothing of the cursed thing cling to your hand, so that the LORD may turn from the heat of his anger and show you mercy, and give mercies to you, and multiply you as He has sworn to your fathers,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:18
verses.text: when you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you today, to do the right in the eyes of the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:1
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> the sons of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves nor make <hi>any</hi> baldness between your eyes for the dead.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:2
verses.text: For you <hi>are</hi> a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a peculiar people to Himself, above all the nations that are on the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:3
verses.text: You shall not eat any hateful thing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:4
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the animals which you shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:5
verses.text: the hart, and the gazelle, and the roe deer, and the wild goat, and the mountain goat, and the wild ox, and the mountain-sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:6
verses.text: And every animal that divides the hoof, and divides it into two hooves, <hi>and</hi> chews the cud among the animals, that you shall eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:7
verses.text: But these you shall not eat, of those which chew the cud, or of those that divide the cloven hoof: the camel, and the hare, and the rock badger, for they chew the cud, but do not divide the hoof. They <hi>are</hi> unclean to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:8
verses.text: And the swine, because it divides the hoof but does not chew the cud; it <hi>is</hi> unclean to you. You shall not eat of their flesh nor touch their dead body.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:9
verses.text: These you shall eat of all that <hi>are</hi> in the waters: all that have fins and scales you shall eat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:10
verses.text: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat. It <hi>is</hi> unclean to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:11
verses.text: You shall eat all clean birds.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:12
verses.text: But you shall not eat of these: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the osprey,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:13
verses.text: and the hawk, and the falcon, and the vulture after its kind,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:14
verses.text: and every raven after its kind,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:15
verses.text: and the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckoo, and the hawk after its kind,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:16
verses.text: the little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:17
verses.text: and the pelican, and the owl, and the cormorant,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:18
verses.text: and the stork, and the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:19
verses.text: And every creeping thing that flies <hi>is</hi> unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:20
verses.text: You may eat all clean fowls.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:21
verses.text: You shall not eat anything that dies of itself. You shall give it to the stranger that <hi>is</hi> in your gates, so that he may eat it. Or you may sell <hi>it</hi> to a stranger. For you <hi>are</hi> a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:22
verses.text: You shall truly tithe all the increase of your seed that the field brings forth year by year.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:23
verses.text: And you shall eat before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose to place His name there, the tithe of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first-born of your herds and of your flocks, so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:24
verses.text: And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, <hi>or</hi> if the place is too far from you, which the LORD your God shall choose to set His name there, when the LORD your God has blessed you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:25
verses.text: then you shall turn <hi>it</hi> into silver and bind up the silver in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:26
verses.text: And you shall pay that silver for whatever your soul desires, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul desires. And you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:27
verses.text: and the Levite within your gates, you shall not forsake him, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:28
verses.text: At the end of three years you shall bring forth all the tithe of your increase the same year, and shall lay <hi>it</hi> up inside your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:29
verses.text: And the Levite, because he has no part nor inheritance with you, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, who <hi>are</hi> inside your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:1
verses.text: At the end of <hi>every</hi> seven years you shall make a release.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:2
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the manner of the release. Every man who has a loan to his neighbor shall release it. He shall not exact <hi>it</hi> from his neighbor, or from his brother, because it is called the LORD's release.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:3
verses.text: You may exact <hi>it</hi> from a foreigner, but your hand shall release that which is yours with your brother,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:4
verses.text: except when there shall be no poor among you. For the LORD shall greatly bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance to possess it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:5
verses.text: only if you carefully listen to the voice of the LORD your God to be careful to do all these commandments which I command you today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:6
verses.text: For the LORD your God blesses you as He promised you. And you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow. And you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:7
verses.text: If there is among you a poor man of one of your brothers inside any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart nor shut your hand from your poor brother.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:8
verses.text: But you shall open your hand wide to him, and shall surely lend him enough for his need, that which he lacks.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:9
verses.text: Beware that there is not a thought in your wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand, and your eye may be evil against your poor brother, and you give him nothing. And he may cry to the LORD against you, and it is sin to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:10
verses.text: You shall surely give to him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because for this thing the LORD your God shall bless you in all your works, and in all that you put your hand to.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:11
verses.text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land. Therefore, I command you saying, You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor, and to your needy, in your land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:12
verses.text: If your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:13
verses.text: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not let him go away empty.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:14
verses.text: You shall richly bestow on him from your flock, and from your grain floor, and from your winepress; with what the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:15
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:16
verses.text: And if he says to you, I will not go away from you, because he loves you and your house, because it <hi>has been</hi> good for him with you;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:17
verses.text: then you shall take an awl and put <hi>it</hi> through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. And also to your slave-girl you shall do so.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:18
verses.text: It shall not seem hard to you when you send him away from you free, for he has been worth a double hired servant in serving you six years. And the LORD your God shall bless you in all that you do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:19
verses.text: All the first-born males that come from your herd and from your flock, you shall set apart to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the first-born of your bull, nor shear the first-born of your sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:20
verses.text: You shall eat before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:21
verses.text: And if there is a blemish in it, lame, or blindness, or any ill blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:22
verses.text: You shall eat it inside your gates. The unclean and the clean shall <hi>eat it</hi> alike, as the gazelle, and as the hart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:23
verses.text: Only you shall not eat the blood of it. You shall pour it on the ground like water.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:1
verses.text: Observe the month Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God. For in the month of Abib, the LORD your God brought you forth out of Egypt by night.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:2
verses.text: And you shall therefore sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place His name there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:3
verses.text: You shall eat no leavened <hi>bread</hi> with it. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction, for you came forth out of the land of Egypt in haste, so that you may remember the day that you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:4
verses.text: And there shall be no leavened <hi>bread</hi> seen with you in all your borders for seven days. Nor shall <hi>any</hi> of the flesh which you sacrificed in the first day at evening remain all night until the morning.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:5
verses.text: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates, which the LORD your God gives you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:6
verses.text: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to place His name in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going of the sun, at the time that you came out of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:7
verses.text: And you shall roast and eat in the place which the LORD your God shall choose. And in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:8
verses.text: Six days you shall eat unleavened <hi>bread</hi>. And on the seventh day <hi>shall be</hi> a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:9
verses.text: You shall count seven weeks to yourselves. Begin to count the seven weeks from the time you began <hi>to put</hi> the sickle to the grain.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:10
verses.text: And you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a measure of a free-will offering of your hand, which you shall give according as the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:11
verses.text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male servant, and your slave-girl, and the Levite inside your gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, those among you, in the place which the LORD your God has chosen to place His name there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:12
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. And you shall be careful to do these statutes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:13
verses.text: You shall keep the Feast of Tabernacles seven days after you have gathered in your grain flour and your wine press.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:14
verses.text: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your slave-girl, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow inside your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:15
verses.text: Seven days you shall keep a solemn feast to the LORD your God in the place which the LORD shall choose. Because the LORD your God shall bless you in all your increase, and in all the works of your hands, therefore you shall surely rejoice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:16
verses.text: Three times in a year shall all your males appear before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose: in the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>, and in the Feast of Weeks, and in the Feast of Tabernacles. And they shall not appear before the LORD empty,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:17
verses.text: <hi> but</hi> each with his gift in his hand, according to the blessing of the LORD your God, which He has given you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:18
verses.text: You shall appoint judges and officers for yourself in all your gates which the LORD your God gives you, tribe by tribe. And they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:19
verses.text: You shall not pervert judgment; you shall not respect persons, nor take a gift. For a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:20
verses.text: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:21
verses.text: You shall not set up for yourself pillars of any trees near the altar of the LORD your God which you shall make for yourself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:22
verses.text: Nor shall you set up an image, which the LORD your God hates.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:1
verses.text: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God <hi>any</hi> bull or sheep in which there is a blemish, any evil thing, for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:2
verses.text: If there is found among you, inside any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God, in breaking His covenant,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:3
verses.text: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, either the sun, or moon, or any <hi>of</hi> the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:4
verses.text: and if it is told you, and you have heard and inquired carefully, and, behold, it is true and the thing is certain, such abomination is done in Israel;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:5
verses.text: then you shall bring forth that man or that woman who has committed that evil thing, to your gates, even that man or that woman, and shall stone them with stones until they die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:6
verses.text: At the mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall he that is worthy of death be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:7
verses.text: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people. So you shall put the evil away from among you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:8
verses.text: If a matter <hi>is</hi> too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, matters of strife within your gates, then you shall arise and go up to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:9
verses.text: And <hi>you</hi> shall come to the priests of the Levites, and to the judge that shall be in those days, and ask. And they shall declare to you the sentence of judgment.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:10
verses.text: And you shall do according to the sentence which they declare to you from that place which the LORD shall choose. And you shall be careful to do according to all that they tell you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:11
verses.text: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach you and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the sentence which they shall show you, to the right hand or the left.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:12
verses.text: And the man that acts proudly and will not listen to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. And you shall put away the evil from Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:13
verses.text: And all the people shall hear and fear, and not be presumptuous any more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:14
verses.text: When you come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and shall possess it and shall live in it and shall say, I will set a king over me, like all the nations around me,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:15
verses.text: you shall surely set a king over you, whom the LORD your God shall choose. You shall set a king over you from among your brothers. You may not set a stranger over you, who is not your brother.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:16
verses.text: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, so as to multiply horses, because the LORD has said to you, You shall return no more that way from now on.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:17
verses.text: Nor shall he multiply wives to himself, so that his heart does not turn away. Nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold to himself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:18
verses.text: And it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write a copy of this law in a book from before the priests the Levites.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:19
verses.text: And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law, and these statutes, to do them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:20
verses.text: so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he does not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or the left, so that he may make his days longer in his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:1
verses.text: The priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, <hi>shall have</hi> no part nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and His inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:2
verses.text: Therefore they shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The LORD <hi>is</hi> their inheritance, as He has said to them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:3
verses.text: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from those that offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep. And they shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks, and the stomach.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:4
verses.text: You shall give him the first-fruit of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:5
verses.text: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons forever.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:6
verses.text: And if a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel, where he lived, and come with all the desire of his mind to the place which the LORD shall choose,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:7
verses.text: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers and Levites who stand there before the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:8
verses.text: They shall have the same portions to eat, besides that of the sales of <hi>the inheritance from</hi> his father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:9
verses.text: When you come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:10
verses.text: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, <hi>or</hi> that uses divination, an observer of clouds, or a fortune-teller, or a witch,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:11
verses.text: or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or one who calls to the dead.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:12
verses.text: For all that do these things <hi>are</hi> an abomination to the LORD. And because of these abominations the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:13
verses.text: You shall be perfect with the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:14
verses.text: For these nations whom you shall possess listened to observers of clouds and to diviners. But as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you <hi>to do</hi> so.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:15
verses.text: The LORD your God will raise up to you a Prophet from the midst of you, of your brothers, One like me. To Him you shall listen,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:16
verses.text: according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying: Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, so that I do not die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:17
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, They have spoken well what they have spoken.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:18
verses.text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brothers, <hi>one</hi> like you, and will put My words in His mouth. And He shall speak to them all that I shall command Him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:19
verses.text: And it shall happen, whatever man will not listen to My words which He shall speak in My name, I will require <hi>it</hi> of him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:20
verses.text: But the prophet who shall presume to speak a word in My name which I have not commanded him to speak or who shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:21
verses.text: And if you say in your heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:22
verses.text: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD, if the thing does not follow nor come to pass, that <hi>is</hi> the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:1
verses.text: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and when you take their place and live in their cities and in their houses,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:2
verses.text: you shall separate three cities for you in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:3
verses.text: You shall prepare you a way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, into three parts, so that every slayer may flee there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:4
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the case of the slayer who shall flee there that he may live: whoever in error kills his neighbor whom he did not hate him before,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:5
verses.text: even he who goes into the wood with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand brings a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the wood and lights on his neighbor so that he dies; he shall flee to one of those cities and live,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:6
verses.text: so that the avenger of the blood may not pursue the slayer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the way is long, and kill him, and he had no sentence worthy of death, for he did not hate him in time past.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:7
verses.text: Therefore I command you saying, You shall separate three cities for you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:8
verses.text: And if the LORD your God makes your border larger, as He has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which He promised to give to your fathers;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:9
verses.text: if you will keep all these commandments which I command you today, to do them, to love the LORD your God, and to walk always in His ways, then you shall add to yourself three more cities to these three,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:10
verses.text: so that innocent blood may not be shed in your land which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance and blood may not be on you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:11
verses.text: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him and rises up against him and strikes his life from him, so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:12
verses.text: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him away from there and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood so that he may die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:13
verses.text: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall put away innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:14
verses.text: You may not remove your neighbor's landmark, which those in the past have set in your inheritance, which you shall inherit in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:15
verses.text: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be made sure.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:16
verses.text: If a false witness rises up against any man to testify a falling away against him,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:17
verses.text: then both the men who are disagreeing shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges which shall be in those days.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:18
verses.text: And the judges shall make careful inquiry. And behold, <hi>if</hi> the witness <hi>is</hi> a false witness <hi>and</hi> has testified falsely against his brother,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:19
verses.text: then you shall do to him as he had thought to have done to his brother. So you shall put the evil away from among you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:20
verses.text: And those who remain shall hear and fear, and shall commit from then on no such evil among you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:21
verses.text: And your eye shall not pity. Life <hi>shall go</hi> for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:1
verses.text: When you go out to battle against your enemies and see horses and chariots, a people more than you, do not be afraid of them. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:2
verses.text: And it shall be, when you come near to the battle, the priest shall go up and speak to the people,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:3
verses.text: and shall say to them, Hear, O, Israel, today you go up to battle against your enemies. Do not let your hearts faint, do not fear, and do not tremble, neither be terrified before their faces.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:4
verses.text: For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> He who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:5
verses.text: And the officers shall speak to the people saying, Who <hi>is</hi> the man that has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:6
verses.text: And who <hi>is</hi> the man that has planted a vineyard and has not used its fruits? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man use its fruits.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:7
verses.text: And who <hi>is</hi> the man that has become engaged to a wife and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man take her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:8
verses.text: And the officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, Who <hi>is</hi> the man that is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brothers' heart faint as well as his heart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:9
verses.text: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking to the people, they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:10
verses.text: When you come near a city to fight against it, then shout peace to it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:11
verses.text: And it shall be, if it makes the answer of peace and opens to you, then all the people found in it shall be forced laborers to you, and they shall serve you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:12
verses.text: But if it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:13
verses.text: And when the LORD your God has delivered it into your hands, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:14
verses.text: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that it is in the city, all the spoil of it, you shall take to yourself. And you shall eat the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:15
verses.text: So you shall do to all the cities <hi>which are</hi> very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:16
verses.text: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:17
verses.text: But you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; as the LORD your God has commanded you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:18
verses.text: so that they may not teach you to do according to all their abominations which they have done to their gods. So you would sin against the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:19
verses.text: When you shall besiege a city a long time in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by forcing an axe against them. For you may eat of them, and you shall not cut them down. For <hi>is</hi> the tree of the field a man that it should go before you to lay siege?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:20
verses.text: Only the trees which you know that they <hi>are</hi> not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. And you shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it is subdued.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:1
verses.text: If <hi>one</hi> is found dead in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it, lying in the field, and it is not known who has killed him,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:2
verses.text: then your elders and your judges shall come forth. And they shall measure to the cities which <hi>are</hi> around him who is dead.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:3
verses.text: And it shall be, the city nearest to the slain one, even the elders of that city shall take a heifer which has not been worked with, which has not drawn in the yoke.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:4
verses.text: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer to an ever-flowing stream, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the stream.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:5
verses.text: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come near. For the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to him, and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be <hi>tried</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:6
verses.text: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain one, shall wash their hands over the heifer that has been beheaded in the stream.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:7
verses.text: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:8
verses.text: Be merciful, O LORD, to Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, and do not lay innocent blood to the charge of Your people Israel. And the blood shall be forgiven them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:9
verses.text: So you shall put away innocent blood from among you, when you do the right in the sight of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:10
verses.text: When you go forth to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God has delivered them into your hands and you have taken them captive,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:11
verses.text: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and have a desire to her, that you would take <hi>her</hi> for your wife,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:12
verses.text: then you shall bring her home to your house. And she shall shave her head and dress her nails.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:13
verses.text: And she shall put off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and shall sorrow for her father and her mother a full month. And after that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:14
verses.text: And it shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she will. But you shall not sell her at all for silver, you shall not make a slave of her, because you have humbled her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:15
verses.text: If a man has two wives, one beloved and another hated, and they have borne him sons, the beloved and the hated; and <hi>if</hi> the first-born son was of her that was hated,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:16
verses.text: then it shall be in the day when he makes his sons to inherit what he has, he may not cause to <hi>inherit</hi> the son of the beloved first-born before the son of the hated one, he who <hi>is truly</hi> the first-born.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:17
verses.text: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated as the first-born by giving him a double portion of all that he has. For he <hi>is</hi> the beginning of his strength. The right of the first-born is his.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:18
verses.text: If a man has a son who is stubborn and rebels, who will not obey his fathers voice or his mothers voice, even when they have chastened him <hi>he</hi> will not listen to them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:19
verses.text: then his father and his mother shall lay hold on him and bring him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:20
verses.text: And they shall say to the elders of his city, this son of ours <hi>is</hi> stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. <hi>He is</hi> a glutton and a drunkard.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:21
verses.text: And all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies. So shall you put evil away from you, and all Israel shall hear and fear.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:22
verses.text: And if a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and if he is put to death and you hang him on a tree,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:23
verses.text: his body shall not remain all night on the tree. But you shall surely bury him that day (for he that <hi>is</hi> hanged is accursed of God), so that your land may not be defiled, which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:1
verses.text: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:2
verses.text: And if your brother <hi>is</hi> not near you, or if you do not know him, then you shall bring <hi>it</hi> into your own house, and it shall be with you until your brother seeks after it, and you shall give it back to him again.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:3
verses.text: In the same way you shall do with his ass. And so shall you do with his clothing. And with any lost thing of your brother's, which he has lost and you have found, you shall do the same. You may not hide yourself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:4
verses.text: You shall not see your brother's ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely <hi>help</hi> him to lift <hi>it</hi> up again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:5
verses.text: There shall not be the thing of a man on a woman, neither shall a man put a woman's garment on. For all that do so <hi>are</hi> abominable to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:6
verses.text: If a bird's nest happens to be before you in the way in any tree, or on the ground, <hi>with</hi> young ones or eggs, and the dam sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:7
verses.text: You shall in every case let the mother go and take the young for yourself, so that it may be well with you, and you may make <hi>your</hi> days longer.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:8
verses.text: When you build a new house, then you shall make a guard rail for your roof, so that you do not bring blood on your house, if one falls from it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:9
verses.text: You shall not sow your vineyard with different kinds of seeds, lest the fruit of your seed which you have sown and the fruit of your vineyard be defiled.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:10
verses.text: You shall not plow with an ox and an ass together.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:11
verses.text: You shall not wear a garment of different kinds, of wool and linen together.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:12
verses.text: You shall make for yourself tassels on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:13
verses.text: If any man takes a wife and goes in to her, and hates her,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:14
verses.text: and makes shameful charges against her, and brings up an evil name on her, and says, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I did not find in her the tokens of virginity,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:15
verses.text: then shall the father of the girl, and her mother, take and bring tokens of the girl's virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:16
verses.text: And the girl's father shall say to the elders, I gave my daughter to this man to wife, and he hates her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:17
verses.text: And, lo, he has made shameful charges <hi>against her</hi>, saying, I have not found in your daughter the tokens of virginity. And yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:18
verses.text: And the elders of that city shall take that man and punish him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:19
verses.text: And they shall fine him a hundred <hi>shekels</hi> of silver, and give them to the father of the girl, because he has brought an evil name on a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:20
verses.text: But if this thing is true and tokens of virginity are not found for the girl,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:21
verses.text: then they shall bring the girl out to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones so that she dies because she has done foolishness in Israel to play the harlot in her father's house. So you shall put evil away from among you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:22
verses.text: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both of them die, the man that lay with the woman, and the woman. So you shall put away evil from Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:23
verses.text: If a girl <hi>who is</hi> a virgin is engaged to a husband, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:24
verses.text: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them with stones that they die; the girl because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he has humbled his neighbor's wife. So you shall put away evil from among you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:25
verses.text: But if a man finds an engaged girl in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man that lay with her shall die.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:26
verses.text: But you shall do nothing to the girl. No sin <hi>worthy</hi> of death <hi>is</hi> in the girl; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and slays him, even so is this matter.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:27
verses.text: For he found her in the field, the engaged girl cried out, but <hi>there was</hi> none to save her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:28
verses.text: If a man finds a girl, a virgin not engaged, and lays hold on her, and lies with her, and they are found,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:29
verses.text: then the man who lay with her shall give to the girl's father fifty <hi>shekels</hi> of silver, and she shall be his wife. Because he has humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:30
verses.text: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor uncover his father's skirt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:1
verses.text: He who is wounded, crushed, or who has his male member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:2
verses.text: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD. Even to his tenth generation he shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:3
verses.text: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD. Even to their tenth generation they shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD forever,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:4
verses.text: because they did not meet you with bread and with water in the way when you came forth out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor, of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:5
verses.text: But the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse to a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:6
verses.text: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:7
verses.text: You shall not despise an Edomite, for he <hi>is</hi> your brother. You shall not despise an Egyptian, because you were a stranger in his land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:8
verses.text: The sons that are born to them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:9
verses.text: When the army goes forth against your enemies, then keep yourself from every wicked thing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:10
verses.text: If there is among you any man who is not clean because of an accident at night, then he shall go outside the camp. He shall not come inside the camp.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:11
verses.text: And it shall be as evening turns, he shall wash with water. And when the sun is down, he shall come into the the middle of the camp.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:12
verses.text: You shall also have a place outside the camp where you shall go forth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:13
verses.text: And you shall have a paddle on your weapon. And it shall be, when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover that which comes from you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:14
verses.text: For the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, so that He may see no unclean thing in you and turn away from you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:15
verses.text: You shall not deliver to his master the servant who has escaped from his master to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:16
verses.text: He shall live with you, among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of your gates, where it seems good to him. You shall not oppress him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:17
verses.text: There shall be no harlot of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:18
verses.text: You shall not bring the hire of a harlot, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow. For even both these <hi>are</hi> hateful to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:19
verses.text: You shall not lend for interest to your brother, interest of silver, interest of food, interest of anything that is loaned on interest.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:20
verses.text: You may lend on interest to a stranger, but you shall not lend on interest to your brother, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you set your hand to in the land where you go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:21
verses.text: When you shall vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not wait to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin in you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:22
verses.text: But if you shall cease to vow, it shall be no sin in you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:23
verses.text: That which has gone out of your lips you shall keep and perform, even a free-will offering, according as you have vowed to the LORD your God, which you have promised with your mouth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:24
verses.text: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, then you may eat grapes to your fill at your own pleasure, but you shall not put <hi>any</hi> in your vessel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:25
verses.text: When you come into the standing grain of your neighbor, then you may pluck the heads with your hand, but you shall not move a sickle into your neighbor's standing grain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:1
verses.text: When a man has taken a wife and married her, and it happens that she finds no favor in his eyes, because he has found some uncleanness in her, then let him write her a bill of divorce and put <hi>it</hi> in her hand, and send her out of his house.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:2
verses.text: And when she has departed from his house, she goes and becomes another man's;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:3
verses.text: and the latter husband hates her and writes her a bill of divorce and puts <hi>it</hi> in her hand and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, he who took her to be his wife

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:4
verses.text: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled. For that <hi>is</hi> hateful before the LORD. And you shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:5
verses.text: When a man has taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any duty. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife whom he has taken.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:6
verses.text: No man shall take the lower or the upper millstone to pledge, for he takes <hi>a man's</hi> life to pledge.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:7
verses.text: If a man is found stealing a person of his brothers, the sons of Israel, and makes a slave of him, or sells him, then that thief shall die. And you shall put evil away from among you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:8
verses.text: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you watch carefully and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you. As I commanded them, you shall be careful to do.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:9
verses.text: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam by the wayside, after you had come forth out of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:10
verses.text: When you loan a loan of any kind to your brother, you shall not go into his house to bring forth his pledge.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:11
verses.text: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you loan shall bring the pledge outside to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:12
verses.text: And if the man <hi>is</hi> poor, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:13
verses.text: You shall certainly give back to him the pledge at sundown, that he may sleep in his own clothing, and bless you. And it shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:14
verses.text: You shall not oppress a hired servant who <hi>is</hi> poor and needy, of your brothers, or of your strangers that <hi>are</hi> in your land within your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:15
verses.text: At his day you shall give <hi>him</hi> his hire, neither shall the sun go down on it. For he <hi>is</hi> poor and sets his heart on it; lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it shall be sin to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:16
verses.text: The fathers shall not be put to death for the sons, neither shall the sons be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:17
verses.text: You shall not pervert the rightful judgment of the stranger <hi>nor</hi> of the fatherless; nor take a widow's clothing to pledge.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:18
verses.text: But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:19
verses.text: When you cut down your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to bring it. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow; so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:20
verses.text: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:21
verses.text: When you gather the grapes from your vineyard, you shall not glean afterward. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:22
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:1
verses.text: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment, and they have been judged, and the righteous one is declared righteous, and the wrongdoer declared guilty,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:2
verses.text: then it shall be, if the wrongdoer <hi>is</hi> worthy to be beaten, the judge shall cause him to fall down. And one shall strike him in his presence, enough for his wrong, by a certain number.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:3
verses.text: He may give him forty stripes, no more, lest he should exceed and beat him above these <hi>with</hi> many stripes, then your brother would be dishonored before your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:4
verses.text: You shall not muzzle an ox when he treads out <hi>the grain</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:5
verses.text: If brothers live together, and one of them dies and has no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry outside to a stranger. Her husband's brother shall go in to her and take her as a wife for himself, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:6
verses.text: And it shall be, the first-born whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his dead brother, so that his name may not be put out of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:7
verses.text: And if the man does not want to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate to the elders and say, My husband's brother refuses to raise up a name in Israel to his brother. He will not perform my levirate.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:8
verses.text: Then the elders of his city shall call him and speak to him. And <hi>if</hi> he stands and says, I do not desire to take her,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:9
verses.text: then his brother's wife shall come to him in the presence of his elders, and take off his shoe from his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done to that man who will not build up his brother's house.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:10
verses.text: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him who has his shoe taken off.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:11
verses.text: When men strive together with one another, and the wife of the one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts forth her hand and takes him by the secret parts,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:12
verses.text: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:13
verses.text: You shall not have in your bag two kinds of weights, a great stone and a small.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:14
verses.text: You shall not have in your house two kinds of measures, a great ephah and a small.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:15
verses.text: You shall have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure you shall have, so that your days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:16
verses.text: For all that do such things, all that do unrighteousness, <hi>are</hi> hateful to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:17
verses.text: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way, when you came forth out of Egypt,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:18
verses.text: how he met you by the way and struck those of you who were behind, all the feeble behind you, when you <hi>were</hi> faint and weary. And he did not fear God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:19
verses.text: And it shall be when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around in the land which the LORD your God gives you <hi>for</hi> an inheritance to possess it, you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heavens. You shall not forget.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:1
verses.text: And it shall be, when you come into the land which the LORD you God gives you for an inheritance, and possess it, and live in it,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:2
verses.text: you shall take of the first of all the fruit of the earth which you shall bring of your land that the LORD your God gives you, and you shall put <hi>it</hi> in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to place His name there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:3
verses.text: And you shall go to the priest in those days, and say to him, I profess today to the LORD your God that I have come into the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:4
verses.text: And the priest shall take the basket out of your hand and set it down before the altar of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:5
verses.text: And you shall speak and say before the LORD your God, My father <hi>was</hi> a Syrian ready to perish. And he went down to Egypt, and stayed there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and many.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:6
verses.text: And the Egyptians ill-treated us, and afflicted us, and laid hard bondage on us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:7
verses.text: And when we cried to the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice and looked on our afflictions and our labor and our oppression.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:8
verses.text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fearful might, and with miracles and with wonders.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:9
verses.text: And He has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:10
verses.text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land which You, O LORD, have given me. And you shall set it before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:11
verses.text: And <hi>you shall</hi> rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house; you, and the Levite, and the stranger in your midst.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:12
verses.text: When you have made an end of tithing all the tithes of your increase the third year, the year of tithing, and have given <hi>it</hi> to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow (that they may eat inside your gates and be filled),

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:13
verses.text: then you shall say before the LORD your God, I have brought away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, and to the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all Your commandments which You have commanded me. I have not broken Your commandments, neither have I forgotten.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:14
verses.text: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I put <hi>any</hi> of it away for unclean <hi>use</hi>, nor have I given of it for the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that You have commanded me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:15
verses.text: Look down from Your holy dwelling, from Heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land which You have given us, as You swore to our fathers, a land that flows with milk and honey.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:16
verses.text: Today the LORD your God has commanded you to do these statutes and judgments. You therefore shall keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:17
verses.text: You have today said that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in His ways, and keep His statutes and His commandments and His judgments, and listen to His voice.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:18
verses.text: And the LORD has taken you today to be His peculiar people, as He has promised you, and to keep all His commandments,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:19
verses.text: and to make you high above all nations which he has made, in praise and in name and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, even as He has spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:1
verses.text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:2
verses.text: And it will be, on the day when you shall pass over Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall set up great stones and plaster them with plaster.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:3
verses.text: And you shall write on them all the words of the law when you have passed over, so that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land that flows <hi>with</hi> milk and honey, as the LORD God of your fathers has promised you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:4
verses.text: Therefore it shall be when you have gone over Jordan, you shall set up these stones which I command you today, in Mount Ebal. And you shall plaster them with plaster.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:5
verses.text: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not lift up <hi>any</hi> iron <hi>tool</hi> on them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:6
