verses.text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God <hi>of</hi> uncut stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:7
verses.text: And you shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:8
verses.text: And you shall write all the words of this law very plainly on the stones.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:9
verses.text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying: Take heed and listen, O Israel. Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:10
verses.text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God, and do His commandments and His statutes which I command you today.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:11
verses.text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:12
verses.text: These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you have come over Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:13
verses.text: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:14
verses.text: And the Levites shall speak and say to all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:15
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man that makes any graven or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and puts <hi>it</hi> in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:16
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who thinks lightly of his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:17
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who removes his neighbor's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:18
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who makes the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:19
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who perverts the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:20
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who lies with his father's wife, because he uncovers his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:21
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who lies with any kind of animal. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:22
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:23
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who lies with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:24
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who strikes his neighbor secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:25
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who takes reward to kill an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:26
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who does not confirm <hi>all</hi> the words of this law, to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:1
verses.text: And it will be, if you shall listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God, to observe <hi>and</hi> to do all His commandments which I command you today, the LORD your God will set you on high above all nations of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:2
verses.text: And all these blessings shall come on you and overtake you, if you will listen to the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:3
verses.text: You <hi>shall be</hi> blessed in the city, and be blessed in the field.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:4
verses.text: The fruit of your body <hi>shall be</hi> blessed, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:5
verses.text: Your basket and your store <hi>shall be</hi> blessed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:6
verses.text: You <hi>shall be</hi> blessed when you come in, and blessed when you go out.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:7
verses.text: The LORD shall cause your enemies that rise up against you to be stricken before your face. They shall come out against you one way, and flee before you seven ways.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:8
verses.text: The LORD shall command the blessing on you in your storehouses, and all that you set your hand to. And He shall bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:9
verses.text: The LORD shall establish you a holy people to Himself, as He has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:10
verses.text: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they shall be afraid of you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:11
verses.text: And the LORD shall prosper you in goods, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:12
verses.text: The LORD shall open to you His good treasure, the heaven to give the rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. And you shall loan to many nations, and you shall not borrow.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:13
verses.text: And the LORD shall make you the head, and not the tail. And you shall be always above, and you shall not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today, to observe and to do them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:14
verses.text: And you shall not go aside from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or the left, to go after other gods to serve them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:15
verses.text: And it shall be, if you will not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to observe and to do all His commandments and His statutes which I command you today, all these curses shall come on you and overtake you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:16
verses.text: You <hi>shall be</hi> cursed in the city, and cursed in the field.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:17
verses.text: Your basket and your store <hi>shall be</hi> cursed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:18
verses.text: The fruit of your body <hi>shall be</hi> cursed, and the fruit of your land, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:19
verses.text: You <hi>shall be</hi> cursed when you come in, and cursed when you go out.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:20
verses.text: The LORD shall send on you cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that you set your hand to do, until you are destroyed, and until you perish quickly, because of the wickedness of your doings <hi>by</hi> which you have forsaken Me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:21
verses.text: The LORD shall make the plague cling to you until He has consumed you from off the land where you go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:22
verses.text: The LORD shall strike you with lung disease and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew. And they shall pursue you until you perish.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:23
verses.text: And your heavens over your head shall be bronze, and the earth that is under you iron.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:24
verses.text: The LORD shall make the rain of your land powder and dust. It shall come down from the heavens on you until you are destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:25
verses.text: The LORD shall cause you to be stricken before your enemies. You shall go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them. And you shall be a trembling to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:26
verses.text: And your body shall be food to all birds of the air, and to the beasts of the earth. And no man shall frighten <hi>them</hi> away.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:27
verses.text: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with the hemorrhoids, and with the scab, and with the itch, of which you cannot be healed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:28
verses.text: The LORD shall strike you with madness and blindness, and astonishment of heart.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:29
verses.text: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. And you shall always be pressed down and spoiled forever, and no man shall save you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:30
verses.text: You shall become engaged to a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You shall build a house, and you shall not live in it. You shall plant a vineyard, and you shall not gather the grapes of it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:31
verses.text: Your ox <hi>shall be</hi> slain before your eyes, and you shall not eat of it. Your ass <hi>shall be</hi> violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you, your sheep given to your enemies, and you <hi>shall have</hi> none to rescue them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:32
verses.text: Your sons and your daughters <hi>shall be</hi> given to another people, and your eyes shall look and fail for them all the day long. And <hi>there shall be</hi> no power in your hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:33
verses.text: The fruit of your land, and all your labors, shall be eaten up by a nation which you do not know. And you shall always be oppressed and crushed,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:34
verses.text: and you shall be mad because of that which you shall see with the sight of your eyes.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:35
verses.text: The LORD shall strike you in the knees and in the legs with an evil ulcer that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:36
verses.text: The LORD shall bring you, and your king which you shall set over you, to a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known. And there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:37
verses.text: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a by-word among all nations where the LORD shall lead you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:38
verses.text: You shall carry much seed out into the field, and shall gather little in, for the locust shall eat it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:39
verses.text: You shall plant vineyards and dress <hi>them</hi>, but shall neither drink the wine nor gather, for the worm shall eat them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:40
verses.text: You shall have olive trees throughout all your coasts, but you shall not anoint <hi>with</hi> the oil, for your olive shall drop off <hi>its fruit</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:41
verses.text: You shall father sons and daughters, but you shall not enjoy them, for they shall go into captivity.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:42
verses.text: All your trees and the fruit of your land the locust shall possess.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:43
verses.text: The stranger within you shall get up above you very high, and you shall come down very low.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:44
verses.text: He shall loan to you, and you shall not loan to him. He shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:45
verses.text: And all these curses shall come on you, and shall pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which He commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:46
verses.text: And they shall be on you for a sign and for a wonder, and on your seed forever.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:47
verses.text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart for the abundance of all <hi>things</hi>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:48
verses.text: therefore you shall serve your enemies which the LORD shall send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the lack of all <hi>things</hi>. And he shall put a yoke of iron on your neck until he has destroyed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:49
verses.text: The LORD shall bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies; a nation whose tongue you shall not understand,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:50
verses.text: a nation fierce of face who shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favor to the young.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:51
verses.text: And he shall eat the fruit of your cattle and the fruit of your land, until you are destroyed. He shall not leave you grain, wine, or oil, the increase of your livestock, or flocks of your sheep, until he has destroyed you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:52
verses.text: And he shall besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down, throughout all the land. And he shall besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:53
verses.text: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the anguish with which your enemies shall distress you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:54
verses.text: The man <hi>that is</hi> tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the rest of his sons which he has left;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:55
verses.text: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his sons whom he shall eat, because he has nothing left to him in the siege and in the anguish with which your enemies shall distress you in all your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:56
verses.text: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not have ventured to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:57
verses.text: and toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her sons whom she shall bear. For she shall eat them secretly for lack of all <hi>things</hi>, in the siege and anguish with which your enemies shall distress you in your gates.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:58
verses.text: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD YOUR GOD,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:59
verses.text: then the LORD will make your plagues remarkable, and the plagues of your seed great and persistent plagues; with evil and long-lasting sicknesses.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:60
verses.text: Also, He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt of which you were afraid. And they shall cling to you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:61
verses.text: Also, every sickness and every plague which <hi>is</hi> not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:62
verses.text: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of the heavens for multitude, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:63
verses.text: And it shall be, as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you and to bring you to nothing. And you shall be plucked from off the land where you go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:64
verses.text: And the LORD shall scatter you among all people, from the <hi>one</hi> end of the earth even to the <hi>other</hi>, and you shall serve other gods there, which neither you nor your fathers have known, wood and stone.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:65
verses.text: And among these nations you shall find no ease, neither shall the sole of your foot have rest. But the LORD shall give you there a trembling heart and failing of eyes and sorrow of mind.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:66
verses.text: And your life shall hang in doubt before you, and you shall fear day and night, and shall have no assurance of your life.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:67
verses.text: In the morning you shall say, Oh that it were evening! And at evening you shall say, Oh that it were morning, for the fear of your heart with which you shall fear, and for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:68
verses.text: And the LORD shall bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I said to you, You shall see it no more again. And there you shall be sold to your enemies for men-slaves and women-slaves, and no man shall buy <hi>you</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:1
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:2
verses.text: And Moses called to all Israel and said to them, You have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants, and to all his land.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:3
verses.text: Your eyes have seen the great trials, the signs, and those great miracles.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:4
verses.text: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:5
verses.text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not become old on you, and your shoe has not become old on your foot.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:6
verses.text: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:7
verses.text: And when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:8
verses.text: And we took their land and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites and to the Gadites and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:9
verses.text: Therefore, keep the words of this covenant and do them, so that you may act wisely in all that you do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:10
verses.text: You stand today, all of you, before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:11
verses.text: your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that <hi>is</hi> in your camp, from the cutter of your wood to the drawer of your water;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:12
verses.text: so that you should enter into covenant with the LORD your God, and into His oath, which the LORD your God makes you today;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:13
verses.text: that He may establish you today for a people to Himself, and <hi>that</hi> He may be a God to you, as He has said to you, and as He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:14
verses.text: Nor do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:15
verses.text: but with <hi>him</hi> who stands here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:16
verses.text: (For you know how we have lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the nations which you passed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:17
verses.text: And you have seen their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which <hi>were</hi> among them)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:18
verses.text: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:19
verses.text: and it happens when he hears the words of this curse, that he shall bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to snatch away the drunken with the thirsty.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:20
verses.text: The LORD will not be willing to forgive him, but then the anger of the LORD and His jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie on him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heavens.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:21
verses.text: And the LORD shall set him apart to evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:22
verses.text: so that the generation to come of your sons that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say (when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD has laid on it)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:23
verses.text: the whole land shall be burned <hi>with</hi> brimstone, and salt; it shall not be sown; nor shall it sprout; nor shall there be any grass in it. It <hi>shall be</hi> like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger, and in His wrath,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:24
verses.text: even all nations shall say, Why has the LORD done this to this land? <hi>For</hi> what <hi>is</hi> the heat of this great anger?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:25
verses.text: Then <hi>men</hi> shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:26
verses.text: For they went and served other gods, and worshiped them, gods whom they did not know, and who had not given to them any portion.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:27
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:28
verses.text: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger and wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as <hi>it is</hi> today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:29
verses.text: The secret things <hi>belong</hi> to the LORD our God, but the revealed things <hi>belong</hi> to us and to our sons forever, so that we may do all the words of this law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:1
verses.text: And it shall be when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before you, and when you shall call <hi>them</hi> to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:2
verses.text: and shall return to the LORD your God and shall obey His voice according to all that I command you today, you and your sons, with all your heart, and with all your soul,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:3
verses.text: then the LORD your God will turn your captivity. And He will have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the nations where the LORD your God has scattered you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:4
verses.text: If you are driven out into the outermost <hi>parts</hi> of the heavens, the LORD your God will gather you from there, and He will bring you from there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:5
verses.text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it. And He will do you good, and multiply you above your fathers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:6
verses.text: And the LORD your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:7
verses.text: And the LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies, and on those that hate you, who persecuted you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:8
verses.text: And you shall return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all His commandments which I command you today.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:9
verses.text: And the LORD your God will make you have plenty in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your land, for good. For the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as He rejoiced over your fathers;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:10
verses.text: for you shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this book of the law, <hi>and</hi> if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:11
verses.text: For this commandment which I command you today <hi>is</hi> not hidden from you, neither is it far off.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:12
verses.text: It <hi>is</hi> not in Heaven, <hi>that you should</hi> say, Who shall go up for us to Heaven, and bring it to us, so that we may hear it and do it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:13
verses.text: Nor <hi>is</hi> it beyond the sea, <hi>that you should</hi> say, Who shall go over the sea for us to the region beyond the sea, and bring it to us, so that we may hear it and do it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:14
verses.text: But the word <hi>is</hi> very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:15
verses.text: Behold! I have set before you today life and good, and death and evil,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:16
verses.text: in that I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, so that you may live and multiply. And the LORD your God shall bless you in the land where you go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:17
verses.text: But if you turn away your heart, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away and worship other gods and serve them,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:18
verses.text: I declare to you today that you shall surely perish; you shall not prolong <hi>your</hi> days on the land where you pass over Jordan to go to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:19
verses.text: I call Heaven and earth to record today against you. I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore, choose life, so that both you and your seed may live,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:20
verses.text: so that you may love the LORD your God, <hi>and</hi> that you may obey His voice, and that you may cling to Him. For He is your life and the length of your days, so that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:1
verses.text: And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:2
verses.text: And he said to them, I <hi>am</hi> a hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Also the LORD has said to me, You shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:3
verses.text: The LORD your God will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them. Joshua <hi>is</hi> the one crossing shall go over before you, as the LORD has said.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:4
verses.text: And the LORD shall do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to the land of those whom He destroyed.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:5
verses.text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, so that you may do to them according to all the commandments which I have commanded you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:6
verses.text: Be strong and of a good courage. Do not fear nor be afraid of them. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> He who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:7
verses.text: And Moses called to Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage. For you must go with this people to the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give <hi>it to</hi> them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:8
verses.text: And the LORD <hi>is</hi> He who goes before you. He will be with you; He will not fail you nor forsake you. Do not fear; nor be dismayed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:9
verses.text: And Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:10
verses.text: And Moses commanded them, saying: At the end of seven years, at the set time of the year of release, in the Feast of Tabernacles,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:11
verses.text: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:12
verses.text: Gather the people, men and women and the little ones, and your stranger who <hi>is</hi> within your gates, so that they may hear and that they may learn and fear the LORD your God, and be careful to do all the words of this law,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:13
verses.text: and <hi>that</hi> their sons who have not known may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over Jordan to possess it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, your days are coming near to die. Call Joshua and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, and that I shall charge him. And Moses and Joshua went. And they presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:15
verses.text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud. And the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:16
verses.text: And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. And this people shall rise up and go lusting after the gods of the strangers of the land into which they are going, into their midst. And they will forsake Me and break My covenant which I made with them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:17
verses.text: Then My anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them. And I will hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them, so that they will say in that day, Have not these evils come on us because our God <hi>is</hi> not among us?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:18
verses.text: And I will surely hide My face in that day for all the evils which they have done, for they shall turn to other gods.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:19
verses.text: Now, therefore, write this song for you, and teach it to the sons of Israel. Put it in their mouths, so that this song may be a witness for Me against the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:20
verses.text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, the land that flows <hi>with</hi> milk and honey, and they shall have eat and be satisfied, and become fat, then turn to other gods and serve them, and provoke Me and break My covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:21
verses.text: And it shall be when many evils and troubles have found them, this song shall testify against them as a witness. For it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed. For I know their imagination which they do, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I swore.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:22
verses.text: And Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:23
verses.text: And he commanded Joshua the son of Nun, and said: Be strong and of a good courage. For you shall bring the sons of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:24
verses.text: And it happened when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:25
verses.text: Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:26
verses.text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may be there for a witness against you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:27
verses.text: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am still alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. And how much more after my death?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:28
verses.text: Gather to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, so that I may speak these words in their ears, and call Heaven and earth to record against them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:29
verses.text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you. And evil will happen to you in the latter end of the days, because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him to anger through the work of your hands.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:30
verses.text: And Moses spoke in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until their conclusion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:1
verses.text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:2
verses.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; my speech shall drop down as the dew, as the small rain on the tender plant, and as the showers on the grass;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:3
verses.text: because I will proclaim the name of the LORD, ascribe greatness to our God.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:4
verses.text: <hi> He is</hi> the Rock; His work <hi>is</hi> perfect. For all His ways <hi>are</hi> just, a God of faithfulness, and without evil; just and upright is He.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:5
verses.text: They have corrupted themselves: <hi>they are</hi> not His sons; <hi>it is</hi> their blemish; <hi>they are</hi> a crooked and perverse generation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:6
verses.text: Do you thus give back to the LORD, Oh foolish and unwise people? <hi>Is</hi> He not your Father who bought you? <hi>Has</hi> He <hi>not</hi> made you and established you?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:7
verses.text: Remember the days of old; consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:8
verses.text: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when He separated the sons of Adam, He set the bounds of the people according to the number of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:9
verses.text: For the LORD's portion <hi>is</hi> His people. Jacob <hi>is</hi> the lot of His inheritance.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:10
verses.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the deserted, howling wilderness. He led him about, He cared for him, He kept him as the pupil of His eye.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:11
verses.text: As an eagle stirs up her nest, flutters over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them and bears them on her wing,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:12
verses.text: the LORD alone led him, and <hi>there was</hi> no strange god with him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:13
verses.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, so that he might eat the increase of the fields. And He made him suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:14
verses.text: butter from cows, and milk from sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the sons of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat. And you drank the blood of the grape.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:15
verses.text: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked. You grew fat, thick, <hi>and</hi> satisfied. Then he forsook God who made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:16
verses.text: They provoked Him to jealousy with strange <hi>gods</hi>; with abominations they provoked Him to anger.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:17
verses.text: They sacrificed to devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new ones newly come up, whom your fathers did not fear.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:18
verses.text: You forgot the Rock <hi>who</hi> brought you forth, and ceased to care for God who formed you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:19
verses.text: And the LORD saw, and despised <hi>them</hi> because of the provoking of His sons and of His daughters.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:20
verses.text: And He said, I will hide My face from them; I will see what their end <hi>shall be</hi>. For they <hi>are</hi> a very perverse generation, sons in whom <hi>is</hi> no faithfulness.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:21
verses.text: They have moved Me to jealousy with a no-god. They have provoked Me to anger with their vanities. And I will move them to jealousy with a no-people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:22
verses.text: For a fire is kindled in My anger, and shall burn to the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with its increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:23
verses.text: I will heap evils on them. I will spend My arrows on them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:24
verses.text: Exhaustion by famine, and consumption by burning heat, and bitter destruction, and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of crawling things of the dust.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:25
verses.text: The sword outside, and the terror inside, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling <hi>also</hi> with the man of grey hairs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:26
verses.text: I said I would dash them to pieces; I would make the memory of them to cease from among men,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:27
verses.text: were it not the provocation of an enemy I feared, lest their enemies should misconstrue; lest they should say, Our hand <hi>is</hi> high and the LORD has not done all this.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:28
verses.text: For they <hi>are</hi> a nation without wisdom, neither is there any understanding in them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:29
verses.text: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would consider their latter end!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:30
verses.text: How shall one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them and the LORD had shut them up?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:31
verses.text: For their rock <hi>is</hi> not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:32
verses.text: For their vine <hi>is</hi> of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are grapes of gall. Their clusters <hi>are</hi> bitter.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:33
verses.text: Their wine <hi>is</hi> the poison of serpents, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:34
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> not this laid up in store with Me and sealed up among My treasures?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:35
verses.text: Vengeance and retribution <hi>belong</hi> to Me. Their foot shall slide in time, for the day of their calamity <hi>is</hi> at hand, and the things that shall come on them make haste.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:36
verses.text: For the LORD will bring His people justice; and He shall have compassion on His servants, for He sees that <hi>their</hi> power is gone, and only the imprisoned and abandoned <hi>remain</hi>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:37
verses.text: And He shall say, Where <hi>are</hi> their gods, <hi>their</hi> rock in whom they trusted?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:38
verses.text: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices <hi>and</hi> drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let it be your hiding place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:39
verses.text: See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with me. I kill, and I make alive; I wound and I heal; and there is no deliverer of My hand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:40
verses.text: For I lift up My hand to Heaven and say, I live forever!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:41
verses.text: If I sharpen My glittering sword, and if My hand takes hold in judgment, I will give vengeance to My enemies and will reward those that hate Me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:42
verses.text: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the hairy scalp of the enemy.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:43
verses.text: Rejoice, O, nations, <hi>with</hi> His people; for He will avenge the blood of His servants, and will render vengeance to His foes and will be merciful to His land, to His people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:44
verses.text: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:45
verses.text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:46
verses.text: And he said to them, Set your hearts to all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your sons to observe and to do, all the words of this law.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:47
verses.text: For it <hi>is</hi> not a vain thing for you, because it is your life. And by this word you shall prolong <hi>your</hi> days in the land where you go over Jordan, there to possess it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:48
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:49
verses.text: Go up into Mount Abarim, <hi>to</hi> Mount Nebo in the land of Moab, which is opposite Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:50
verses.text: And die in the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died in Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:51
verses.text: because you sinned against Me among the sons of Israel at the Waters of Strife in Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not sanctify Me in the midst of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:52
verses.text: Yet you shall see the land before <hi>you</hi>, but you shall not go there to the land which I <hi>am</hi> giving to the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:1
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the blessing <hi>with</hi> which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his death.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:2
verses.text: And he said: The LORD came from Sinai and rose up from Seir to them. He shone forth from Mount Paran, and He came with ten thousands of saints. From His right went a fiery law for them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:3
verses.text: Yea, He loved the people. All His saints <hi>are</hi> in Your hand, and they sat down at Your feet. Everyone shall receive of Your words.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:4
verses.text: Moses commanded us a law, the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:5
verses.text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people <hi>and</hi> the tribes of Israel were gathered.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:6
verses.text: Let Reuben live and not die, and let <hi>not</hi> his men be few.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:7
verses.text: And this for Judah: And he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him to his people. Let his hands be sufficient for him, and You shall be a help <hi>to him</hi> from his enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:8
verses.text: And of Levi he said, <hi>Let</hi> Your Thummim and Your Urim <hi>be</hi> with Your holy one whom You proved at Massah; You strove with him at the Waters of Strife,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:9
verses.text: who said to his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; and he has not acknowledged his brothers, nor knew his own son, for they have observed Your word and kept Your covenant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:10
verses.text: Let them teach Jacob Your judgments, and Israel Your law. Let them put incense before You and whole burnt sacrifice on Your altar.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:11
verses.text: O, LORD, bless his strength, and accept the work of his hands. Strike through the loins of those who rise against him, and <hi>of those</hi> who hate him, that they should not rise again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:12
verses.text: Of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall live in safety beside Him, <hi>and</hi> shall cover him all the day long, yea he shall dwell between His shoulders.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:13
verses.text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD <hi>be</hi> his land, with the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, and for the deep that crouches beneath,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:14
verses.text: and for the precious fruits of by the sun, and with the best yield of <hi>the</hi> months.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:15
verses.text: And with the first of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:16
verses.text: and for the precious things of the earth and fullness of it, and <hi>for</hi> the good will of Him who lived in the Bush. Let the blessing come on the head of Joseph, and on the top of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:17
verses.text: His glory <hi>is like</hi> the first-born of his bull, and his horns are like the horns of the wild ox. With them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth. And they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:18
verses.text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar in your tents.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:19
verses.text: They shall call the peoples to the mountain. There they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they shall suck the bounty of the seas and treasures hidden in the sand.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:20
verses.text: And of Gad he said, Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who makes Gad greater. He lives as a lion and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:21
verses.text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there was the portion of the lawgiver hidden. And he came <hi>with</hi> the heads of the people. He executed the justice of the LORD, and His judgments with Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:22
verses.text: And of Dan he said, Dan <hi>is</hi> a lion's whelp. He shall leap from Bashan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:23
verses.text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, and full with the blessing of the LORD, possess the west and the south.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:24
verses.text: And of Asher he said, Asher <hi>shall be</hi> blessed with sons, let him be pleasing to his brothers, and let him dip his foot in oil.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:25
verses.text: Your shoes <hi>shall be</hi> iron and bronze. And as your days, so shall your strength be.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:26
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides on the heaven to your help, and in His majesty on the clouds.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:27
verses.text: The eternal God <hi>is your</hi> refuge, and underneath <hi>are</hi> the everlasting arms. And He shall throw the enemy out from before you, and shall say, Destroy!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:28
verses.text: And Israel shall dwell in safety alone; the fountain of Jacob in a land of grain and wine; and his heavens shall drop down dew.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:29
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> you, O Israel! Who <hi>is</hi> like you, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, and who <hi>is</hi> the sword of your excellency! And your enemies shall be found liars to you, and you shall tread on their high places.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:1
verses.text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah that <hi>is</hi> opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land of Gilead, to Dan,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:2
verses.text: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the furthest sea,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:3
verses.text: and the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, This <hi>is</hi> the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed. I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:5
verses.text: And Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:6
verses.text: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor. But no man knows of his grave this day.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:7
verses.text: And Moses <hi>was</hi> a hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor had he lost any of his natural strength.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:8
verses.text: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. And the days of weeping <hi>and</hi> mourning for Moses were ended.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:9
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. And the sons of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:10
verses.text: And never since has a prophet like Moses arisen in Israel, whom the LORD knew face to face,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:11
verses.text: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:12
verses.text: and in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses showed in the eyes of all Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:1
verses.text: And it happened after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:2
verses.text: My servant Moses is dead. Now, therefore, arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people to the land which I give to them, to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 1:3
verses.text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, I have given that to you, as I said to Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:4
verses.text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

verses.name: Joshua 1:5
verses.text: No man shall be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, <hi>so</hi> I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

verses.name: Joshua 1:6
verses.text: Be strong and of good courage. For you shall divide for an inheritance to this people, the land which I swore to their fathers, to give it to them.

verses.name: Joshua 1:7
verses.text: Only be strong and very courageous so that you may be careful to do according to all the law which My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may act wisely wherever you go.

verses.name: Joshua 1:8
verses.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth, but you shall meditate on it by day and by night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall act wisely.

verses.name: Joshua 1:9
verses.text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage. Do not be afraid, neither be dismayed. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> with you in all places where you go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:10
verses.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people saying,

verses.name: Joshua 1:11
verses.text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare food for yourselves, for within three days you are crossing over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess it.

verses.name: Joshua 1:12
verses.text: And Joshua spoke to the Reubenites and to the Gadites and to half the tribe of Manasseh, saying:

verses.name: Joshua 1:13
verses.text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you saying, The LORD your God has given you rest and has given you this land.

verses.name: Joshua 1:14
verses.text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan. But you shall go armed before your brothers, all the mighty men of valor, and help them

verses.name: Joshua 1:15
verses.text: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, even as you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them; and you shall return to the land of your possession and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD's servant gave you on this side Jordan, towards the sunrise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:16
verses.text: And they answered Joshua, saying: We will do all that you command us, and wherever you send us we will go.

verses.name: Joshua 1:17
verses.text: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so we will listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as He was with Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 1:18
verses.text: Whoever rebels against your command and will not listen to your words in all that you command him, he shall be put to death. Only be strong and of a good courage.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:1
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go look over the land, even Jericho. And they went and came to the house of a harlot named Rahab. And they stayed there.

verses.name: Joshua 2:2
verses.text: And the king of Jericho was told about it, saying, Behold, men from the sons of Israel came in here tonight, to search out the country.

verses.name: Joshua 2:3
verses.text: And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, Bring out the men that have come to you, those who have entered into your house. For they have come to search out all the country.

verses.name: Joshua 2:4
verses.text: And the woman took the two men and hid them. And she said, Two men came to me, but I did not know from where they came.

verses.name: Joshua 2:5
verses.text: And it happened when it was dark, <hi>at the time of</hi> shutting the gate, the men went out. Where the men went I do not know. Go after them quickly, for you shall overtake them.

verses.name: Joshua 2:6
verses.text: But she had brought them up on the roof, and had hidden them with the stalks of flax which she had laid in order upon the roof.

verses.name: Joshua 2:7
verses.text: And the men went after them on the way to Jordan, to the fords. And when they who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:8
verses.text: And before they had laid down, she came up to them on the roof.

verses.name: Joshua 2:9
verses.text: And she said to the men, I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that your terror has fallen on us, and that all those who live in the land faint because of you.

verses.name: Joshua 2:10
verses.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

verses.name: Joshua 2:11
verses.text: And we had heard, and our hearts melted, nor did any more spirit remain in any man, because of you. For the LORD your God, He is God in Heaven above and in earth beneath.

verses.name: Joshua 2:12
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt with you in kindness, that you will also deal with kindness to my father's house. And give me a true token,

verses.name: Joshua 2:13
verses.text: and shall save alive my father and my mother, and my brothers and my sisters, and all that they <hi>have</hi>, and deliver our lives from death.

verses.name: Joshua 2:14
verses.text: And the men answered her, Our life shall be for yours, if you do not tell our business. And when the LORD has given us the land, we will deal kindly and truly with you.

verses.name: Joshua 2:15
verses.text: Then she let them go down by a cord through the window. For her house <hi>was</hi> on the town wall, and she lived on the wall.

verses.name: Joshua 2:16
verses.text: And she said to them, Get up into the mountain lest the pursuers meet you. And hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers have returned. And afterward you may go your way.

verses.name: Joshua 2:17
verses.text: And the men said to her, We <hi>will be</hi> blameless of this oath to you which you have made us swear.

verses.name: Joshua 2:18
verses.text: Behold, <hi>when</hi> we come into the land, you shall set this line of scarlet thread in the window from which you let us down. And you shall bring your father and your mother, and your brothers, and all your father's household, home to you.

verses.name: Joshua 2:19
verses.text: And it shall be, whoever shall go out of the doors of your house, his blood <hi>shall be</hi> on his head, and we <hi>will be</hi> blameless. And whoever shall be with you in the house, his blood <hi>shall be</hi> on our head if a hand is on him.

verses.name: Joshua 2:20
verses.text: And if you tell our business, then we will be free of the oath which you have made us swear to you.

verses.name: Joshua 2:21
verses.text: And she said, Let <hi>it be</hi> according to your word. And she sent them away, and they departed. And she set the scarlet line in the window.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:22
verses.text: And they went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers them had returned. And the pursuers looked for <hi>them</hi> throughout all the way, but did not find <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:23
verses.text: And the two men returned. And came down from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. And they told him all that happened to them.

verses.name: Joshua 2:24
verses.text: And they said to Joshua, Truly the LORD has delivered all the land into our hands, for even all those who live in the country faint because of us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:1
verses.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning. And they moved from Shittim and came to Jordan, he and all the sons of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.name: Joshua 3:2
verses.text: And it happened after three days the officers went through the host.

verses.name: Joshua 3:3
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> commanded the people saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then you shall move from your place and go after it.

verses.name: Joshua 3:4
verses.text: Yet keep a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you must go. For you have not passed <hi>this</hi> way before now.

verses.name: Joshua 3:5
verses.text: And Joshua said to the people, Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

verses.name: Joshua 3:6
verses.text: And Joshua spoke to the priests saying, Take up the ark of the covenant and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:7
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Today, I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel so that they may know that I will be with you, as I was with Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 3:8
verses.text: And you shall command the priests that carry the ark of the covenant, saying, When you have come to the brink of the water of Jordan, you shall stand still in Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 3:9
verses.text: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, Come here and hear the words of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Joshua 3:10
verses.text: And Joshua said, By this you shall know that the living God <hi>is</hi> among you, and He will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.name: Joshua 3:11
verses.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 3:12
verses.text: And now take yourselves twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

verses.name: Joshua 3:13
verses.text: And it shall be, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that carry the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, the waters of Jordan shall be cut off <hi>from</hi> the waters that come down from above. And they shall stand all in a heap.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:14
verses.text: And it happened, when the people moved from their tents to pass over Jordan, and as the priests carried the ark of the covenant before the people,

verses.name: Joshua 3:15
verses.text: and as those who bore the ark had come to Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bore the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (for Jordan overflows all its banks, all the time of harvest);

verses.name: Joshua 3:16
verses.text: that the waters which came down from above stopped <hi>and</hi> rose up all in a heap, very far from the city Adam that <hi>is</hi> beside Zaretan. And those that came down toward the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. And the people passed over across from Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 3:17
verses.text: And the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of Jordan. And all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people had passed completely over Jordan.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:1
verses.text: And it happened when all the people had completely passed over the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua saying,

verses.name: Joshua 4:2
verses.text: Take twelve men for you out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

verses.name: Joshua 4:3
verses.text: and command them saying, Take twelve stones from here, out of the middle of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm. And you shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the place where you shall stay tonight.

verses.name: Joshua 4:4
verses.text: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared from the sons of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

verses.name: Joshua 4:5
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, Pass over in front of the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. And every man take a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

verses.name: Joshua 4:6
verses.text: so that this may be a sign to you when your sons ask in time to come, saying, What do you <hi>mean</hi> by these stones?

verses.name: Joshua 4:7
verses.text: Then you shall answer them, The waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off, and these stones shall be for a memorial to the sons of Israel forever.

verses.name: Joshua 4:8
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did as Joshua commanded. And they took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and carried them over with them to the place where they stayed, and laid them down there;

verses.name: Joshua 4:9
verses.text: even the twelve stones Joshua lifted up in the middle of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant, stood. And they are there to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:10
verses.text: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished, all that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and passed over.

verses.name: Joshua 4:11
verses.text: And it happened, when all the people had finished passing over, the ark of the LORD and the priests passed over before the people.

verses.name: Joshua 4:12
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben, and the sons of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed in front of the sons of Israel, as Moses spoke to them;

verses.name: Joshua 4:13
verses.text: about forty thousand armed men of the army passed over before the LORD to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:14
verses.text: On that day the LORD made Joshua great in the sight of all Israel. And they feared him, even as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

verses.name: Joshua 4:15
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 4:16
verses.text: Command the priests who bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 4:17
verses.text: Joshua, therefore, commanded the priests saying, Come up out of the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 4:18
verses.text: And it happened, when the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD had come up out of the midst of the Jordan, the soles of the feet of the priests were lifted up to the dry land, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks, as before.

verses.name: Joshua 4:19
verses.text: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and camped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:20
verses.text: And those twelve stones which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua were raised in Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 4:21
verses.text: And he spoke to the sons of Israel saying, When your sons shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What do these stones <hi>mean</hi>?

verses.name: Joshua 4:22
verses.text: Then you shall let your sons know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

verses.name: Joshua 4:23
verses.text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you until you had passed over, even as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea which He dried up from before us until we had gone over;

verses.name: Joshua 4:24
verses.text: so that all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, <hi>is</hi> mighty and so that you might fear the LORD your God forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:1
verses.text: And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who <hi>were</hi> on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who <hi>were</hi> by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan in front of the sons of Israel until we had passed over, that their hearts melted. Neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 5:2
verses.text: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, Make sharp knives for yourselves and circumcise the sons of Israel again, the second time.

verses.name: Joshua 5:3
verses.text: And Joshua made sharp knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

verses.name: Joshua 5:4
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the reason why Joshua circumcised. All the people that came out of Egypt, the males, all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the wayside, after they came out of Egypt.

verses.name: Joshua 5:5
verses.text: For all the people who came out were circumcised. But all the people born in the wilderness by the wayside, as they came forth out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.

verses.name: Joshua 5:6
verses.text: For the sons of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the people, the men of war, who came out of Egypt, were destroyed, because they did not obey the voice of the LORD. To them the LORD swore that He would not show them the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that He would give us, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.name: Joshua 5:7
verses.text: And Joshua circumcised their sons, <hi>whom</hi> He raised up in their place. For they were not circumcised, because they had not been circumcised by the wayside.

verses.name: Joshua 5:8
verses.text: And it happened when they had finished circumcising all the people, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were well.

verses.name: Joshua 5:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you. Therefore, the name of the place is called Gilgal to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:10
verses.text: And the sons of Israel camped in Gilgal and kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 5:11
verses.text: And they ate of the old grain of the land on the next day after the Passover, unleavened cakes and roasted grain in the same day.

verses.name: Joshua 5:12
verses.text: And the manna stopped on the next day after they had eaten the old grain of the land. And there was no more manna to the sons of Israel, but they ate the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:13
verses.text: And it happened, when Joshua was beside Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked. And, behold, there stood a Man in front of him with His sword drawn in His hand. And Joshua went to Him and said to Him, <hi>Are</hi> You for us, or for our foes?

verses.name: Joshua 5:14
verses.text: And He said, No, but I have come <hi>as</hi> the Commander of the army of the LORD. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth. And he worshiped and said to Him, What does my Lord say to His servant?

verses.name: Joshua 5:15
verses.text: And the Commander of the LORD's army said to Joshua, Take your shoe off your foot, for the place on which you stand <hi>is</hi> holy. And Joshua did so.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:1
verses.text: And Jericho was completely shut up because of the sons of Israel. None went out and none came in.

verses.name: Joshua 6:2
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, See, I have given Jericho into your hand, and its king, <hi>and</hi> the mighty men of war.

verses.name: Joshua 6:3
verses.text: And you shall go around the city, all the men of war. Go around the city once. So you shall do for six days.

verses.name: Joshua 6:4
verses.text: And seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of ram's horns in front of the ark. And the seventh day you shall go around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

verses.name: Joshua 6:5
verses.text: And it shall be when they make a long <hi>blast</hi> with the ram's horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout. And the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall go up, each man straight before him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:6
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven ram's horns in front of the ark of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 6:7
verses.text: And he said to the people, Pass on, and go around the city. And let him who is armed pass on in front of the ark of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 6:8
verses.text: And it happened when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven ram's horns passed on before the LORD and blew the ram's horns. And the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

verses.name: Joshua 6:9
verses.text: And the armed men went before the priests who blew with the ram's horns. And the gathering army came after the ark, as <hi>the priests</hi> were going on and blowing with the ram's horns.

verses.name: Joshua 6:10
verses.text: And Joshua had commanded the people saying, You shall not shout nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall <hi>any</hi> word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.

verses.name: Joshua 6:11
verses.text: And the ark of the LORD went around the city, going around <hi>it</hi> once. And they came into the camp and stayed in the camp.

verses.name: Joshua 6:12
verses.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 6:13
verses.text: And seven priests carrying seven ram's horns before the ark of the LORD went on without stopping and blew with the ram's horns. And the armed men went in front of them. But the rear guard came after the ark of the LORD as <hi>the priests</hi> were going on and blowing with the ram's horns.

verses.name: Joshua 6:14
verses.text: And the second day they went around the city once, and returned to the camp. So they did six days.

verses.name: Joshua 6:15
verses.text: And it happened on the seventh day they rose early, at the dawning of the day, and circled the city in the same way seven times. Only on that day did they go around the city seven times.

verses.name: Joshua 6:16
verses.text: And it happened, at the seventh time, when the priest blew with the ram's horns, Joshua said to the people, Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:17
verses.text: And the city shall be devoted to the LORD, it and all in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

verses.name: Joshua 6:18
verses.text: And you surely shall keep <hi>clear of</hi> from the cursed thing, lest you make yourselves cursed when you take of the cursed things, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:19
verses.text: But all the silver and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, <hi>are</hi> devoted to the LORD. They shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 6:20
verses.text: And the people shouted when <hi>the priests</hi> blew with the ram's horns. And it happened when the people heard the sound of the ram's horns, and the people shouted with a great shout, the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, each man straight before him. And they took the city.

verses.name: Joshua 6:21
verses.text: And they completely destroyed all in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 6:22
verses.text: And Joshua had said to the two men who had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring the woman out from there, and all that she has, as you swore to her.

verses.name: Joshua 6:23
verses.text: And the young men who were spies went in and brought Rahab out, and her father and her mother, and her brothers, and all that she had. And they brought out all her kindred and set them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 6:24
verses.text: And they burned the city with fire, and all that <hi>was</hi> in it. Only the silver and the gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 6:25
verses.text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had. And she lives in Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 6:26
verses.text: And Joshua charged <hi>them</hi> at that time, saying, Cursed before the LORD <hi>is</hi> the man who rises up and builds this city of Jericho. He shall lay the foundation of it in his first-born, and in his youngest <hi>son</hi> he shall set up the gates of it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:27
verses.text: And the LORD was with Joshua. And his fame was in all the country.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:1
verses.text: But the sons of Israel committed a sin in the cursed thing. For Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the thing which was cursed. And the anger of the LORD was kindled against the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 7:2
verses.text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which <hi>is</hi> beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel. And he spoke to them, saying, Go up and look over the country. And the men went up and spied out Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:3
verses.text: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, Let not all the people go up. But let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Do not make all the people labor there, for they <hi>are</hi> few.

verses.name: Joshua 7:4
verses.text: And about three thousand men of the people went up there. And they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:5
verses.text: And the men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them, for they chased them <hi>from</hi> before the gate to Shebarim, and struck them in the road going down. Therefore the hearts of the people melted and became as water.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:6
