verses.text: And Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust on their heads.

verses.name: Joshua 7:7
verses.text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord God, why have You at all brought this people over Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to destroy us? And, oh that we had been content and lived on the other side Jordan!

verses.name: Joshua 7:8
verses.text: O, Lord, what shall I say when Israel turns their backs before their enemies?

verses.name: Joshua 7:9
verses.text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear, and shall surround us, and shall cut off our name from the earth. And what will You do for Your great name?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:10
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Get up! Why do you lie on your face this way?

verses.name: Joshua 7:11
verses.text: Israel has sinned, and they have also broken My covenant which I commanded them, and have even taken of the cursed things, and have also stolen and pretended falsely. And they have even put <hi>it</hi> among their own stuff.

verses.name: Joshua 7:12
verses.text: And the sons of Israel could not stand before their enemies. They will turn <hi>their</hi> backs before their enemies, because they have become cursed. I will not be with you again, unless you destroy the one who is cursed from among you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:13
verses.text: Up! Sanctify the people and say, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow. For thus says the LORD God of Israel, A cursed thing {is} in the midst of you, O Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the cursed thing from among you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:14
verses.text: And in the morning, you shall be brought according to your tribes. And it shall be, the tribe which the LORD takes shall come, according to its families. And the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households. And the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

verses.name: Joshua 7:15
verses.text: And it shall be, he who is taken with the cursed thing shall be burned with fire, he and all he has, because he has broken the covenant of the LORD, and because he has done wickedness in Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:16
verses.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes. And the tribe of Judah was taken.

verses.name: Joshua 7:17
verses.text: And he brought the families of Judah. And he took the family of the Zerahites. And he took the family of the Zerahites man by man. And Zabdi was taken.

verses.name: Joshua 7:18
verses.text: And he brought his household man by man. And Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

verses.name: Joshua 7:19
verses.text: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, I pray you, give glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession to Him. And tell me now what you have done. Do not hide <hi>it</hi> from me.

verses.name: Joshua 7:20
verses.text: And Achan answered Joshua and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and this I have done.

verses.name: Joshua 7:21
verses.text: When I saw among the spoil a goodly robe of Shinar, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, I coveted them and took them. And behold, they <hi>are</hi> hidden in the earth in the middle of my tent, and the silver under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:22
verses.text: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran into the tent. And behold, <hi>it was hidden</hi> in his tent, and the silver under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:23
verses.text: And they took them out of the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua, and to all the sons of Israel. And they laid them out before the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 7:24
verses.text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had. And they brought them to the valley of Achor.

verses.name: Joshua 7:25
verses.text: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? The LORD shall trouble you this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

verses.name: Joshua 7:26
verses.text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones to this day. And the LORD turned from the greatness of His anger. Therefore, the name of that valley is called, The Valley of Grief, to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not fear, nor be dismayed. Take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land.

verses.name: Joshua 8:2
verses.text: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king. Only its spoil and its cattle you shall take for a prize for yourselves. Lay an ambush for the city behind it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:3
verses.text: So Joshua and all the people of war arose to go up against Ai. And Joshua chose out thirty thousand men, mighty warriors, and sent them away by night.

verses.name: Joshua 8:4
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you <hi>will be</hi> an ambush against the city, behind the city. You shall not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

verses.name: Joshua 8:5
verses.text: And I, and all the people with me, shall go toward the city. And it shall be, when they come out against us, as at the first, we will flee before them,

verses.name: Joshua 8:6
verses.text: (for they will come out after us,) until we have drawn them out of the city. For they will say, They flee before us, even as at the first. And we will flee before them.

verses.name: Joshua 8:7
verses.text: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and seize on the city; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 8:8
verses.text: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, you shall set the city on fire, according to the command of the LORD you shall do. See, I have commanded you.

verses.name: Joshua 8:9
verses.text: And Joshua sent them out. And they went to lie in ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai. But Joshua stayed that night among the people.

verses.name: Joshua 8:10
verses.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning and called up the people. And <hi>they</hi> went up, he and the elders of Israel, in the sight of the people of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:11
verses.text: And all the people of war with him went up and drew near. And they came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai. And a valley <hi>was</hi> between them and Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:12
verses.text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:13
verses.text: And when they had set the people, all the army that <hi>was</hi> on the north of the city, and its rear <hi>ambush</hi> on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

verses.name: Joshua 8:14
verses.text: And it happened, when the king of Ai saw, they hurried and rose up early. And the men of the city went out to do battle against Israel, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the plain. <hi>But</hi> he did not know that <hi>there were</hi> some lying in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:15
verses.text: And Joshua and all Israel acted as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.name: Joshua 8:16
verses.text: And all the people in Ai were called together to run after them. And they ran after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:17
verses.text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, who did not go after Israel. And they left the city open, and ran after Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:18
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Stretch out the spear in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear in his hand toward the city.

verses.name: Joshua 8:19
verses.text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand. And they entered into the city, and took it, and hurried and set the city on fire.

verses.name: Joshua 8:20
verses.text: And the men of Ai looked behind them and saw. And, behold, the smoke of the city went up into the sky, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. And the people who fled to the wilderness turned back against the pursuers.

verses.name: Joshua 8:21
verses.text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city went up, then they turned again and killed the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:22
verses.text: And the others came out of the city against them. So they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. And they struck them so that they let none of them remain or escape.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:23
verses.text: And they took the king of Ai, and brought him alive to Joshua.

verses.name: Joshua 8:24
verses.text: And it happened, when Israel had made an end of killing all those who lived in Ai, in the field and in the wilderness where they chased them, and when they had all fallen on the edge of the sword until they were gone, all the Israelites returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 8:25
verses.text: And all who fell that day, both of men and women, <hi>were</hi> twelve thousand, all the men of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:26
verses.text: For Joshua did not draw his hand back, with which he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the people of Ai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:27
verses.text: Only, Israel took the cattle and the spoil of that city for a prize for themselves, according to the word of the LORD which He commanded Joshua.

verses.name: Joshua 8:28
verses.text: And Joshua burned Ai, and made it a heap forever, a ruin to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 8:29
verses.text: And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening. And as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his body down from the tree and throw it down at the entrance to the gate of the city, and raise on it a great heap of stones, to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:30
verses.text: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD God of Israel in Mount Ebal,

verses.name: Joshua 8:31
verses.text: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones over which no man has lifted <hi>any</hi> iron. And they offered on it burnt offerings to the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.name: Joshua 8:32
verses.text: And he wrote there on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:33
verses.text: And all Israel, and their elders and officers, and their judges, stood on this side of the ark, and on that side, before the priests the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, the stranger as well as the homeborn among them, half of them over against Mount Gerizim, and half of them over against Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before that they should bless all the people of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 8:34
verses.text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.name: Joshua 8:35
verses.text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua did not read before all the congregation of Israel, with the women and the little ones, and the strangers that walked among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:1
verses.text: And it happened, when all the kings who <hi>were</hi> on this side Jordan, in the hills and in the valleys, and in all the coast of the great sea over against Lebanon heard, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,

verses.name: Joshua 9:2
verses.text: they all, with one mind, gathered themselves to fight with Joshua and with Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:3
verses.text: And when those who lived in Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

verses.name: Joshua 9:4
verses.text: they worked slyly. For they came and acted as if they were ambassadors. And they took old sacks on their asses, and old and torn and bound up wineskins,

verses.name: Joshua 9:5
verses.text: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and old clothes on them. And all the bread they had taken was dry <hi>and</hi> moldy.

verses.name: Joshua 9:6
verses.text: And they went to Joshua to the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a far country. Now therefore, make a treaty with us.

verses.name: Joshua 9:7
verses.text: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, Perhaps you are living among us, and how shall we make a treaty with you?

verses.name: Joshua 9:8
verses.text: And they said to Joshua, We <hi>are</hi> your servants. And Joshua said to them, Who <hi>are</hi> you, and from where do you come?

verses.name: Joshua 9:9
verses.text: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the LORD your God. For we have heard of His fame and all that He did in Egypt,

verses.name: Joshua 9:10
verses.text: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who <hi>were</hi> beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

verses.name: Joshua 9:11
verses.text: And our elders and all those who live in our country spoke to us saying, Take provisions with you for the journey, and go to meet them. Say to them, We <hi>are</hi> your servants. And now make a treaty with us.

verses.name: Joshua 9:12
verses.text: We took this bread hot <hi>for</hi> our provision out of our houses on the day we came out to go to you. But now, see, <hi>it is</hi> dry, and it is moldy.

verses.name: Joshua 9:13
verses.text: And these wineskins which we filled <hi>were</hi> new. And, see, they are torn. And these clothes and shoes of ours have become old because of the very long journey.

verses.name: Joshua 9:14
verses.text: And they received the men because of their provisions, and did not ask at the mouth of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:15
verses.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a treaty with them, to let them live. And the rulers of the congregation swore to them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:16
verses.text: And it happened at the end of three days after they had made a treaty with them, they heard that they <hi>were</hi> their neighbors and that they lived among them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:17
verses.text: And the sons of Israel journeyed and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities <hi>were</hi> Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: Joshua 9:18
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did not strike them, because the rulers of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the rulers.

verses.name: Joshua 9:19
verses.text: But all the rulers said to the congregation, We have sworn to them by the LORD God of Israel. Now, therefore, we may not touch them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:20
verses.text: This we will do to them. We will even let them live, lest wrath be on us because of the oath which we swore to them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:21
verses.text: And the rulers said to them, Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and drawers of water to all the congregation, as the rulers had promised them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:22
verses.text: And Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, Why have you fooled us saying, We <hi>are</hi> very far from you, when you dwell among us?

verses.name: Joshua 9:23
verses.text: And now you <hi>are</hi> cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being slaves and woodcutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.

verses.name: Joshua 9:24
verses.text: And they answered Joshua and said, Because it was certainly told your servants how the LORD your God commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all those who lived in the land from before you; therefore, we were very much afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.name: Joshua 9:25
verses.text: And now, behold, we <hi>are</hi> in your hand. As it seems good and right to you to do to us, do it.

verses.name: Joshua 9:26
verses.text: And so he did to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the sons of Israel, so that they did not kill them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:27
verses.text: And Joshua made them that day woodcutters and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even to this day, in the place which He should choose.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:1
verses.text: And it happened, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai and had utterly destroyed it (as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king) and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,

verses.name: Joshua 10:2
verses.text: they feared greatly, because Gibeon <hi>was</hi> a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it <hi>was</hi> greater than Ai, and all of its men were mighty.

verses.name: Joshua 10:3
verses.text: And Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 10:4
verses.text: Come up to me, and help me, so that we may strike Gibeon. For it has made peace with Joshua and with the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:5
verses.text: And the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves. And they went up, they and all their armies, and camped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:6
verses.text: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Do not withhold your hand from your servants. Come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us. For all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have gathered against us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:7
verses.text: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of war.

verses.name: Joshua 10:8
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. There shall not a man of them stand before you.

verses.name: Joshua 10:9
verses.text: And Joshua came to them suddenly, coming up from Gilgal all night.

verses.name: Joshua 10:10
verses.text: And the LORD troubled them before Israel, and killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Bethhoron, and struck them to Azekah, and to Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:11
verses.text: And it happened, as they fled from before Israel, and <hi>were</hi> in the descent of Bethhoron, the LORD cast down great stones from the heavens on them to Azekah, and they died. The many who died from hailstones were more than the sons of Israel killed with the sword.

verses.name: Joshua 10:12
verses.text: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun! Stand still on Gibeon! And, moon, <hi>stand still</hi> in the valley of Aijalon!

verses.name: Joshua 10:13
verses.text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stood <hi>still</hi>, until the people <hi>had</hi> avenged themselves on their enemies. <hi>Is</hi> this not written in the Book of Jasher? And the sun stood <hi>still</hi> in the midst of the heavens, and did not hasten to go down about a whole day.

verses.name: Joshua 10:14
verses.text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD listened to the voice of a man. For the LORD fought for Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:15
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

verses.name: Joshua 10:16
verses.text: But these five kings fled and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:17
verses.text: And it was told to Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hidden in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:18
verses.text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones on the mouth of the cave, and set men by it in order to keep them.

verses.name: Joshua 10:19
verses.text: And do not stay. Pursue your enemies and strike the ones who are behind. Do not allow them to enter into their cities. For the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 10:20
verses.text: And it happened, when Joshua and the sons of Israel had made an end of killing them <hi>with</hi> a very great slaughter until they were gone, the rest of those <hi>who</hi> remained entered into fortified cities.

verses.name: Joshua 10:21
verses.text: And all the people returned in peace to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah. None moved his tongue against any of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:22
verses.text: And Joshua said, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.

verses.name: Joshua 10:23
verses.text: And they did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:24
verses.text: And it happened, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel. And he said to the commanders of the men of war who had gone with him, Draw near, set your feet on the necks of these kings. And they drew near and put their feet on their necks.

verses.name: Joshua 10:25
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, Do not fear nor be dismayed. Be strong and of good courage. For so shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom you fight.

verses.name: Joshua 10:26
verses.text: And afterward Joshua struck them and killed them, and hanged them on five trees. And they were hanging on the trees until the evening.

verses.name: Joshua 10:27
verses.text: And it happened at the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees and threw them into the cave in which they had been hidden, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, <hi>which remain</hi> until this very day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:28
verses.text: And that day Joshua took Makkedah and struck it with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed the king of it, them, and every soul in it. He let none remain. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he did to the king of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 10:29
verses.text: And Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:30
verses.text: And the LORD delivered it also, and its king, into the hand of Israel. And <hi>he</hi> struck it with the edge of the sword, and every soul in it. He let none remain in it, but did to its king as he did to the king of Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 10:31
verses.text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and camped against it, and fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:32
verses.text: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, who took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every soul in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

verses.name: Joshua 10:33
verses.text: Then Horam, king of Gezer, came up to help Lachish. And Joshua struck him and his people until he had left him none remaining.

verses.name: Joshua 10:34
verses.text: And from Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him. And they camped against it and fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:35
verses.text: And they took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword; and every soul in it he completely destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

verses.name: Joshua 10:36
verses.text: And Joshua went on from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron. And they fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:37
verses.text: And they took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king, and all its cities, and every soul in it. He left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon, but destroyed it, and all the souls that were in it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:38
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:39
verses.text: And he took it, and its king, and all its cities. And they struck them with the edge of the sword, and destroyed every soul in it. He left none remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king, as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

verses.name: Joshua 10:40
verses.text: And Joshua struck all the land, the hills, and the south, and the valley, and the springs, and all their kings. He left none remaining, but destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 10:41
verses.text: And Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea even to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

verses.name: Joshua 10:42
verses.text: And Joshua took all these kings and their land <hi>at</hi> one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 10:43
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:1
verses.text: And it happened when Jabin, king of Hazor, had heard, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 11:2
verses.text: and to the kings on the north of the mountains, and on the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.name: Joshua 11:3
verses.text: <hi> and to</hi> the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon, in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.name: Joshua 11:4
verses.text: And they went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

verses.name: Joshua 11:5
verses.text: And when all these kings had met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 11:6
verses.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver them up, all killed before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:7
verses.text: And Joshua came suddenly, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom. And they fell on them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:8
verses.text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them and chased them to great Sidon, and to the salt pits, and to the valley of Mizpeh eastward. And they struck them until they left them none remaining.

verses.name: Joshua 11:9
verses.text: And Joshua did to them as the LORD commanded him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:10
verses.text: And Joshua at that time turned back and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword. For Hazor formerly <hi>was</hi> the head of all those kingdoms.

verses.name: Joshua 11:11
verses.text: And they struck every soul in it with the edge of the sword, destroying <hi>them</hi>. And he left none breathing. And he burned Hazor with fire.

verses.name: Joshua 11:12
verses.text: And Joshua took all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them. And he struck them with the edge of the sword. He destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

verses.name: Joshua 11:13
verses.text: But Israel did not burn any of them, the cities that stood in their strength, except Hazor only. Joshua did burn it.

verses.name: Joshua 11:14
verses.text: And all the spoil of these cities and the cattle the sons of Israel took for a prize to themselves. But they struck every man with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They left none breathing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:15
verses.text: As the LORD commanded Moses His servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so Joshua did. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 11:16
verses.text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountains of Israel, and its lowlands,

verses.name: Joshua 11:17
verses.text: from mount Halak that goes up to Seir, even to Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. And he took all their kings, and struck them and killed them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:18
verses.text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.name: Joshua 11:19
verses.text: There was not a city that made peace with the sons of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. All <hi>others</hi> they took in battle.

verses.name: Joshua 11:20
verses.text: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts so that they should come against Israel in battle, so that they might be destroyed, so that they might have no favor, but that He might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.name: Joshua 11:21
verses.text: At that time Joshua came and cut off the giants from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel. Joshua destroyed them with their cities.

verses.name: Joshua 11:22
verses.text: There were none of the giants left in the land of the sons of Israel; only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod there remained some.

verses.name: Joshua 11:23
verses.text: And Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. And Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the kings of the land, whom the sons of Israel struck and whose land they possessed on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon to mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.name: Joshua 12:2
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon <hi>and</hi> ruled from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;

verses.name: Joshua 12:3
verses.text: and from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth, and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah.

verses.name: Joshua 12:4
verses.text: And they struck the coast of Og king of Bashan, of the rest of the giants, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.name: Joshua 12:5
verses.text: and reigned in mount Hermon and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.name: Joshua 12:6
verses.text: Moses the servant of the LORD and the sons of Israel struck them. And Moses the servant of the LORD gave it <hi>for</hi> a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:7
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the kings of the land which Joshua and the sons of Israel struck on this side Jordan, on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even to the mount Halak that goes up to Seir, which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

verses.name: Joshua 12:8
verses.text: in the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country--the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

verses.name: Joshua 12:9
verses.text: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which <hi>is</hi> beside Bethel, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:10
verses.text: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:11
verses.text: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:12
verses.text: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:13
verses.text: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:14
verses.text: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:15
verses.text: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:16
verses.text: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:17
verses.text: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:18
verses.text: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:19
verses.text: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:20
verses.text: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:21
verses.text: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:22
verses.text: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:23
verses.text: the king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

verses.name: Joshua 12:24
verses.text: the king of Tirzah, one. All the kings were thirty-one.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:1
verses.text: Now Joshua <hi>was</hi> old, going on <hi>in</hi> days. And the LORD said to him, You are old, far along in days, <hi>and</hi> there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

verses.name: Joshua 13:2
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the land that still remains: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

verses.name: Joshua 13:3
verses.text: from Shihor, which <hi>is</hi> before Egypt, even to the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite, five lords of the Philistines: of Gaza, of Ashdod, of Ashkelon, of Gath, and of Ekron; also the Avim.

verses.name: Joshua 13:4
verses.text: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which <hi>belongs</hi> to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites.

verses.name: Joshua 13:5
verses.text: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon to the border of Hamath,

verses.name: Joshua 13:6
verses.text: all the inhabitants from the hills; from Lebanon to the Burning Waters, <hi>and</hi> all the Sidonians, I will expel them before the sons of Israel. Only you divide it by lot to the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:7
verses.text: And, therefore, divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.name: Joshua 13:8
verses.text: with whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance which Moses gave them beyond Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them,

verses.name: Joshua 13:9
verses.text: from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba, to Dibon;

verses.name: Joshua 13:10
verses.text: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the sons of Ammon;

verses.name: Joshua 13:11
verses.text: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salcah,

verses.name: Joshua 13:12
verses.text: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan (who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei; he remained of the rest of the giants), even Moses struck them and expelled them.

verses.name: Joshua 13:13
verses.text: But the sons of Israel did not put out the Geshurites and the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

verses.name: Joshua 13:14
verses.text: Only, he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire <hi>are</hi> their inheritance, as He said to them.

verses.name: Joshua 13:15
verses.text: And Moses gave to the tribe of the sons of Reuben <hi>inheritance</hi> according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:16
verses.text: And their coast was from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba.

verses.name: Joshua 13:17
verses.text: He gave them Heshbon and all its cities in the plain, Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

verses.name: Joshua 13:18
verses.text: and Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.name: Joshua 13:19
verses.text: and Kirjath-aim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mountain of the valley,

verses.name: Joshua 13:20
verses.text: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.name: Joshua 13:21
verses.text: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon (whom Moses struck with the rulers of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, rulers of Sihon, the inhabitants of the land).

verses.name: Joshua 13:22
verses.text: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword, among their slain.

verses.name: Joshua 13:23
verses.text: And the border of the sons of Reuben was Jordan, and <hi>its</hi> border. This <hi>was</hi> the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

verses.name: Joshua 13:24
verses.text: And Moses gave <hi>inheritance</hi> to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:25
verses.text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, to Aroer, before Rabbah,

verses.name: Joshua 13:26
verses.text: and from Heshbon to Ramoth-mizpeh, and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir.

verses.name: Joshua 13:27
verses.text: And in the valley he gave them Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and <hi>its</hi> border, even to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth on the east side Jordan eastward.

verses.name: Joshua 13:28
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their families, the cities, and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 13:29
verses.text: And Moses gave <hi>inheritance</hi> to the half tribe of Manasseh, and this was of the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:30
verses.text: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which <hi>are</hi> in Bashan, sixty cities.

verses.name: Joshua 13:31
verses.text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, <hi>were given</hi> to the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to their half of the sons of Machir by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 13:32
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> they whom Moses caused to inherit in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan by Jericho, eastward.

verses.name: Joshua 13:33
verses.text: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance. The LORD God of Israel <hi>was</hi> their inheritance, as He said to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> they <hi>of</hi> the sons of Israel who inherited in the land of Canaan, whom Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel, gave out for inheritance to them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:2
verses.text: Their inheritance <hi>was</hi> by lot, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

verses.name: Joshua 14:3
verses.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and a half tribe on the other side Jordan. But to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:4
verses.text: For the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to live <hi>in</hi>, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

verses.name: Joshua 14:5
verses.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:6
verses.text: Then the sons of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal. And Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, said to him, You know the thing that the LORD said to Moses the man of God in Kadesh-barnea regarding you and me.

verses.name: Joshua 14:7
verses.text: I <hi>was</hi> forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. And I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

verses.name: Joshua 14:8
verses.text: But my brothers that went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I fully followed the LORD my God.

verses.name: Joshua 14:9
verses.text: And Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely the land on which your feet have trodden shall be your inheritance, and your sons' forever because you have fully followed the LORD my God.

verses.name: Joshua 14:10
verses.text: And now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive these forty-five years as He said, even since the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. And now, lo, I am eighty-five years old today.

verses.name: Joshua 14:11
verses.text: As yet I <hi>am as</hi> strong today as <hi>I was</hi> in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength <hi>was</hi> then, even so <hi>is</hi> my strength now, for war, both to go out and to come in.

verses.name: Joshua 14:12
verses.text: And now give me this mountain of which the LORD spoke on that day. For you heard in that day <hi>how</hi> the giants <hi>were</hi> there, and that the cities were great and fortified. If the LORD will be with me, then I will be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

verses.name: Joshua 14:13
verses.text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 14:14
verses.text: And Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, to this day, because he fully followed the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 14:15
verses.text: And the name of Hebron before <hi>was</hi> Kirjath-arba; that one <hi>was</hi> a great man among the giants. And the land had rest from war.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:1
verses.text: <hi> This</hi> then was the lot of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their families: to the border of Edom, the wilderness of Zin southward, in the extreme south.

verses.name: Joshua 15:2
verses.text: And their south border was from the end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward.

verses.name: Joshua 15:3
verses.text: And it went out southward to the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed on to Zin, and went up on the south of Kadesh-barnea, and went on to Hezron, and went up toward Adar, and turned toward Karkaa,

verses.name: Joshua 15:4
verses.text: and passed on to Azmon, and went out by the torrent of Egypt. And the boundary line was at the Sea. This shall be your south border.

verses.name: Joshua 15:5
verses.text: And the east border, the Salt Sea to the end of Jordan, and <hi>their</hi> border in the north quarter <hi>was</hi> from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 15:6
verses.text: And the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah. And the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;

verses.name: Joshua 15:7
verses.text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, before the going up to Adummim, which <hi>is</hi> on the south side of the river. And the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and its boundary was at En-rogel.

verses.name: Joshua 15:8
verses.text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite. It <hi>is</hi> Jerusalem. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, at the end of the Valley of the Giants northward.

verses.name: Joshua 15:9
verses.text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron. And the border was drawn to Baalah; it <hi>is</hi> Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: Joshua 15:10
verses.text: And the border went around from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of mount Jearim; it is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

verses.name: Joshua 15:11
verses.text: And the border went to the side of Ekron northward, and the border was drawn <hi>to</hi> Shikkeron and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel. And the boundary line was at the Sea.

verses.name: Joshua 15:12
verses.text: And the west border <hi>was</hi> to the Great Sea, and the coast. This is the border of the sons of Judah all around according to their families.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:13
verses.text: And he gave a part among the sons of Judah to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, according to the command of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak; it <hi>is</hi> Hebron.

verses.name: Joshua 15:14
verses.text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

verses.name: Joshua 15:15
verses.text: And he went up from there to those who lived in Debir. And the name of Debir before <hi>was</hi> Kirjath-sepher.

verses.name: Joshua 15:16
verses.text: And Caleb said, He who smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, I will give my daughter Achsah to him for a wife.

verses.name: Joshua 15:17
verses.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

verses.name: Joshua 15:18
verses.text: And it happened as she came, she moved him to ask a field from her father. And she dismounted from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What do you <hi>desire</hi>?

verses.name: Joshua 15:19
verses.text: She answered, Give me a blessing, for you have given me a south land. Give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:20
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 15:21
verses.text: And the furthest cities of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

verses.name: Joshua 15:22
verses.text: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:23
verses.text: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:24
verses.text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

verses.name: Joshua 15:25
verses.text: and Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, <hi>and</hi> Hezron, which is Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 15:26
verses.text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:27
verses.text: and Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

verses.name: Joshua 15:28
verses.text: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:29
verses.text: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

verses.name: Joshua 15:30
verses.text: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:31
verses.text: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:32
verses.text: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities <hi>are</hi> twenty-nine, with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 15:33
verses.text: In the low country <hi>were</hi> Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:34
verses.text: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

verses.name: Joshua 15:35
verses.text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:36
verses.text: and Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages--

verses.name: Joshua 15:37
verses.text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

verses.name: Joshua 15:38
verses.text: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

verses.name: Joshua 15:39
verses.text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

verses.name: Joshua 15:40
verses.text: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

verses.name: Joshua 15:41
verses.text: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages--

verses.name: Joshua 15:42
verses.text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

verses.name: Joshua 15:43
verses.text: and Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

verses.name: Joshua 15:44
verses.text: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities and their villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:45
verses.text: Ekron with its town and its villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:46
verses.text: from Ekron even to the Sea, all that were at hand by Ashdod, and their villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:47
verses.text: Ashdod with its towns and its villages; Gaza with its towns and its villages, to the river of Egypt, and the Great Sea, and <hi>its</hi> coast.

verses.name: Joshua 15:48
verses.text: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

verses.name: Joshua 15:49
verses.text: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah (which is Debir);

verses.name: Joshua 15:50
verses.text: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

verses.name: Joshua 15:51
verses.text: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities and their villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:52
verses.text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

verses.name: Joshua 15:53
verses.text: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:54
verses.text: and Humtah, and Kirjath-arba; it <hi>is</hi> Hebron; and Zior; nine cities and their villages--

verses.name: Joshua 15:55
verses.text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:56
verses.text: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:57
verses.text: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities and their villages;

verses.name: Joshua 15:58
verses.text: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

verses.name: Joshua 15:59
verses.text: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities and their villages--

verses.name: Joshua 15:60
verses.text: Kirjath-baal; it <hi>is</hi> Kirjath-jearim; and Rabbah; two cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 15:61
verses.text: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

verses.name: Joshua 15:62
verses.text: and Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 15:63
verses.text: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not drive them out. But the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:1
verses.text: And the lot of the sons of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, to the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho through Mount Bethel,

verses.name: Joshua 16:2
verses.text: and goes out from Bethel to Luz, and passes along to the borders of the Archites, to Ataroth;

verses.name: Joshua 16:3
verses.text: and it goes down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth-horon the lower, and to Gezer. And its boundary was at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 16:4
verses.text: And the sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:5
verses.text: And the border of the sons of Ephraim was by their families: the border of their inheritance on the east side <hi>was</hi> Ataroth-addar, to Beth-horon the upper.

verses.name: Joshua 16:6
verses.text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side. And the border went about eastward to Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah.

verses.name: Joshua 16:7
verses.text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came again to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 16:8
verses.text: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the river Kanah. And the boundary was at the sea. This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 16:9
verses.text: And the separate cities for the sons of Ephraim <hi>were</hi> among the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 16:10
verses.text: And they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. But the Canaanites live among the Ephraimites until this day, and serve under tribute.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:1
verses.text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh (for he <hi>was</hi> the first-born of Joseph); for Machir, the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

verses.name: Joshua 17:2
verses.text: There was also <hi>a lot</hi> for the rest of the sons of Manasseh by their families: for the sons of Abiezer, and for the sons of Helek, and for the sons of Asriel, and for the sons of Shechem, and for the sons of Hepher, and for the sons of Shemida; these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, by their families.

verses.name: Joshua 17:3
verses.text: But Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. And these <hi>were</hi> the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:4
verses.text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers. And according to the command of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

verses.name: Joshua 17:5
verses.text: And there fell ten portions <hi>to</hi> Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which <hi>were</hi> on the other side Jordan;

verses.name: Joshua 17:6
verses.text: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. And the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:7
verses.text: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah before Shechem. And the border went up to the right to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

verses.name: Joshua 17:8
verses.text: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh <hi>belonged</hi> to the sons of Ephraim.

verses.name: Joshua 17:9
verses.text: And the border went down to the river Kanah, southward of the river. These cities of Ephraim <hi>are</hi> among the cities of Manasseh. And the border of Manasseh <hi>was</hi> on the north of the river, and the boundary was at the sea.

verses.name: Joshua 17:10
verses.text: Southward <hi>it was</hi> Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's. And the sea is its border. And they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

verses.name: Joshua 17:11
verses.text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and those who lived in Dor and its towns, and those who lived in Endor and its towns, and those who lived in Taanach and its towns, and those who lived in Megiddo and its towns, even three regions.

verses.name: Joshua 17:12
verses.text: Yet the sons of Manasseh were not able to occupy these cities, but the Canaanites wanted to live in that land.

verses.name: Joshua 17:13
verses.text: And it happened when the sons of Israel had become strong, they put the Canaanites to tribute. But they did not completely drive them out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:14
verses.text: The sons of Joseph spoke to Joshua saying, Why have you given me one lot and one portion to inherit, since I <hi>am</hi> a great people, because the LORD has blessed me until now?

verses.name: Joshua 17:15
verses.text: And Joshua answered them, If you <hi>are</hi> a great people, and if mount Ephraim is too narrow for you, get up to the forest and cut down more for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants.

verses.name: Joshua 17:16
verses.text: And the sons of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us. And all the Canaanites who live in the land of the valley <hi>have</hi> chariots of iron, those who <hi>are</hi> of Beth-shean and its towns, and those who <hi>are</hi> of the valley of Jezreel.

verses.name: Joshua 17:17
verses.text: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, You <hi>are</hi> a great people and have great power. You shall not have one lot.

verses.name: Joshua 17:18
verses.text: But the mountain shall be yours, for it <hi>is</hi> a forest, and you shall cut it down. And the outer limits of it shall be yours. For you shall drive out the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and though they <hi>are</hi> strong.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:1
verses.text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel gathered at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:2
verses.text: And there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes which had not yet received their inheritance.

verses.name: Joshua 18:3
verses.text: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will you fail to go in to possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers has given you?

verses.name: Joshua 18:4
verses.text: Give from among you three men for <hi>each</hi> tribe. And I will send them, and they shall rise and go through the land and map it according to the inheritance of them. And they shall come to me.

verses.name: Joshua 18:5
verses.text: And they shall divide it into seven parts. Judah shall stay within their border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stay within their borders on the north.

verses.name: Joshua 18:6
verses.text: And you shall map the land <hi>into</hi> seven parts and bring it here to me, so that I may cast lots here for you before the LORD our God.

verses.name: Joshua 18:7
verses.text: But the Levites have no part among you. For the priesthood of the LORD <hi>is</hi> their inheritance. And Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

verses.name: Joshua 18:8
verses.text: And the men arose and went away. And Joshua charged those who went to map the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and map it, and come again to me so that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

verses.name: Joshua 18:9
verses.text: And the men went and passed through the land, and mapped it by cities into seven parts in a book, and they came to Joshua, to the host at Shiloh.

verses.name: Joshua 18:10
verses.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. And Joshua divided the land to the sons of Israel there, according to their divisions.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:11
verses.text: And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up by their families. And the border of their lot came forth between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 18:12
verses.text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan. And the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward. And their boundary was at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.name: Joshua 18:13
verses.text: And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which <hi>is</hi> Bethel, southward. And the border went down to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the lower Beth-horon.

verses.name: Joshua 18:14
verses.text: And the border was drawn <hi>from there</hi>, and went around the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that <hi>is</hi> in front of Beth-horon southward. And its boundary was at Kirjath-baal; it <hi>is</hi> Kirjath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah. This <hi>was</hi> the west quarter.

verses.name: Joshua 18:15
verses.text: And the south quarter <hi>was</hi> from the end of Kirjath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah;

verses.name: Joshua 18:16
verses.text: and the border went down to the end of the mountain that <hi>is</hi> before the valley of the sons of Hinnom, which <hi>is</hi> the Valley of the Giants northward, and went down the valley of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite on the south, and went down to En-rogel.

verses.name: Joshua 18:17
verses.text: And it was drawn from the north and went out to En-shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which <hi>is</hi> across from the ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

verses.name: Joshua 18:18
verses.text: and passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

verses.name: Joshua 18:19
verses.text: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward. And the boundary was at the north tongue of the Salt Sea, at the south end of Jordan. This <hi>was</hi> the south border.

verses.name: Joshua 18:20
verses.text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This <hi>was</hi> the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, according to its borders all around, according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 18:21
verses.text: And the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

verses.name: Joshua 18:22
verses.text: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

verses.name: Joshua 18:23
verses.text: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:24
verses.text: and Chephar-haam-monai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities and their villages;

verses.name: Joshua 18:25
verses.text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

verses.name: Joshua 18:26
verses.text: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:27
verses.text: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

verses.name: Joshua 18:28
verses.text: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which <hi>is</hi> Jerusalem; Gibeath, Kirjath; fourteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:1
verses.text: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was inside the inheritance of the sons of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 19:2
verses.text: And they <hi>had</hi> in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:3
verses.text: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:4
verses.text: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:5
verses.text: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:6
verses.text: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages--

verses.name: Joshua 19:7
verses.text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages,

verses.name: Joshua 19:8
verses.text: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the south. This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:9
verses.text: The inheritance of the sons of Simeon <hi>was</hi> out of the portion of the sons of Judah. For the part of the sons of Judah <hi>was</hi> too much for them; therefore the sons of Simeon had their inheritance within their inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:10
verses.text: And the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their families. And the border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

verses.name: Joshua 19:11
verses.text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that <hi>is</hi> before Jokneam,

verses.name: Joshua 19:12
verses.text: and turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of The Flames of Tabor, and then goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia,

verses.name: Joshua 19:13
verses.text: and from there it passes on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon-methoar, to Neah.

verses.name: Joshua 19:14
verses.text: And the border compasses it on the north side to Hannathon. And its edges were <hi>in</hi> the valley of Jiphthahel,

verses.name: Joshua 19:15
verses.text: and Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:16
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:17
verses.text: The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the sons of Issachar according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:18
verses.text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

verses.name: Joshua 19:19
verses.text: and Hapharaim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:20
verses.text: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

verses.name: Joshua 19:21
verses.text: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

verses.name: Joshua 19:22
verses.text: And the border reaches to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh. And the edges of their border were at Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:23
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:24
verses.text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:25
verses.text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

verses.name: Joshua 19:26
verses.text: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reaches to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

verses.name: Joshua 19:27
verses.text: and turns toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reaches to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left hand,

verses.name: Joshua 19:28
verses.text: and Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, to great Sidon;

verses.name: Joshua 19:29
verses.text: and the border turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre. And the border turns to Hosah, and the boundaries of it are at the sea from the line to Achzib,

verses.name: Joshua 19:30
verses.text: and Ummah, and Aphek, and Rehob; twenty-two cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:31
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:32
verses.text: The sixth lot came out to the sons of Naphtali, for the sons of Naphtali according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:33
verses.text: And their border was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakum. And its boundaries were at Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 19:34
verses.text: And the border turns west toward Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from there to Hukkok, and reached to Zebulun on the south side, and reaches to Asher on the west side, and to Judah on Jordan toward the sunrise.

verses.name: Joshua 19:35
verses.text: And the fortified cities <hi>are</hi> Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

verses.name: Joshua 19:36
verses.text: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:37
verses.text: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

verses.name: Joshua 19:38
verses.text: and Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities and their villages.

verses.name: Joshua 19:39
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:40
verses.text: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families.

verses.name: Joshua 19:41
verses.text: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

verses.name: Joshua 19:42
verses.text: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

verses.name: Joshua 19:43
verses.text: and Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,

verses.name: Joshua 19:44
verses.text: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

verses.name: Joshua 19:45
verses.text: and Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gath-rimmon,

verses.name: Joshua 19:46
verses.text: and Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

verses.name: Joshua 19:47
verses.text: And the border of the sons of Dan came out <hi>too little</hi> for them. And the sons of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived in it. And <hi>they</hi> called Leshem Dan, after the name of their father Dan.

verses.name: Joshua 19:48
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, by their families, these cities and their villages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:49
verses.text: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

verses.name: Joshua 19:50
verses.text: According to the command of Jehovah they gave him the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim. And he built the city and lived in it.

verses.name: Joshua 19:51
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Jehovah, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And they finished dividing the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:1
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

verses.name: Joshua 20:2
verses.text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Appoint cities of refuge for you, as I have spoken to you by the hand of Moses;

verses.name: Joshua 20:3
verses.text: that the manslayer who in innocence strikes <hi>anyone</hi> mortally, without knowing, may flee there. And they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.name: Joshua 20:4
verses.text: And he shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city. And they shall take him into the city to themselves and make him a place, and he shall live with them.

verses.name: Joshua 20:5
verses.text: And if the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver the manslayer into his hand, for he has struck his neighbor without knowing, and did not hate him in past time.

verses.name: Joshua 20:6
verses.text: And he shall live in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest who is in those days. Then the manslayer shall return and come to his city, and to his house, to the city from where he fled.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:7
verses.text: And they set apart Kadesh in Galilee, in the hills of Naphtali; and Shechem in the hills of Ephraim; and Kirjath-arba (it <hi>is</hi> Hebron) in the hills of Judah.

verses.name: Joshua 20:8
verses.text: And beyond the Jordan, <hi>at</hi> Jericho eastward, they gave Bezer in the wilderness, on the tableland out of the tribe of Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.name: Joshua 20:9
verses.text: These were the appointed cities for all the sons of Israel, and for the alien who was living in their midst, that he who had killed <hi>anyone</hi> without knowing might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:1
verses.text: And the heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 21:2
verses.text: And they spoke to them in Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, saying, the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give cities to us to live in, and their open lands for our cattle.

verses.name: Joshua 21:3
verses.text: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance these cities and their open lands, at the command of the LORD:

verses.name: Joshua 21:4
verses.text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And the sons of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:5
verses.text: And the rest of the sons of Kohath <hi>had</hi> by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:6
verses.text: And the sons of Gershon <hi>had</hi> by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:7
verses.text: The sons of Merari by their families <hi>had</hi> out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun. twelve cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:8
verses.text: And the sons of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their open lands, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:9
verses.text: And they gave out of the tribe of the sons of Judah, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, these cities which are called by name,

verses.name: Joshua 21:10
verses.text: which the sons of Aaron had, <hi>being</hi> of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the sons of Levi, for theirs was the first lot.

verses.name: Joshua 21:11
verses.text: And they gave them the city of Arba, the father of Anak (it <hi>is</hi> Hebron) in the hills of Judah, with its open lands around it.

verses.name: Joshua 21:12
verses.text: But the fields of the city of Arba and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his own.

verses.name: Joshua 21:13
verses.text: And to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron and its open lands <hi>as</hi> a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:14
verses.text: and Jattir and its open lands, and Eshtemoa and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:15
verses.text: and Holon and its open lands, and Debir and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:16
verses.text: and Ain and its open lands, and Juttah and its open lands, and Beth-shemesh and its open lands, nine cities from these two tribes.

verses.name: Joshua 21:17
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon and its open lands, Geba and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:18
verses.text: Anathoth and its open lands, and Almon and its open lands; four cities and their open lands.

verses.name: Joshua 21:19
verses.text: And all the cities of the sons of Aaron the priest <hi>were</hi> thirteen cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:20
verses.text: And the families of the sons of Kohath, the Levites who were left of the sons of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe Ephraim.

verses.name: Joshua 21:21
verses.text: And they gave them Shechem and its open lands in mount Ephraim as a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Gezer and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:22
verses.text: and Kibzaim and its open lands, and Beth-horon and its open lands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:23
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and open lands, Gibbethon and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:24
verses.text: Aijalon and its open lands, Gath-rimmon and its open lands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:25
verses.text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach and its open lands, and Gath-rimmon and its open lands; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:26
verses.text: All the cities <hi>were</hi> ten, and their open lands, for the families of the sons of Kohath that were left.

verses.name: Joshua 21:27
verses.text: And to the sons of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its open lands <hi>as</hi> a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beesh-terah and its open lands; two cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:28
verses.text: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishon and its open lands, and Daberath and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:29
verses.text: Jarmuth and its open lands, En-gannim and its open lands, four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:30
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its open lands, and Abdon and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:31
verses.text: Helkath and its open lands, and Rehob and its open lands, four cities

verses.name: Joshua 21:32
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee and its open lands <hi>as</hi> a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Hammoth-dor and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands; three cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:33
verses.text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families <hi>were</hi> thirteen cities and their open lands.

verses.name: Joshua 21:34
