verses.text: And to the families of the sons of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:35
verses.text: Dimnah and its open lands, Nahalal and its open lands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:36
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and its open lands, and Jahazah and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:37
verses.text: Kedemoth and its open lands, and Mephaath and its open lands; four cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:38
verses.text: And out of tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead and its open lands <hi>as</hi> a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Mahanaim and its open lands,

verses.name: Joshua 21:39
verses.text: Heshbon and its open lands, Jazer and its open lands; four cities in all.

verses.name: Joshua 21:40
verses.text: All the cities for the sons of Merari by their families which were left of the families of the Levites, were <hi>by</hi> their lot twelve cities.

verses.name: Joshua 21:41
verses.text: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the sons of Israel <hi>were</hi> forty-eight cities and their open lands.

verses.name: Joshua 21:42
verses.text: These cities <hi>were</hi> each one with their open lands around them. So it was to all these cities.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:43
verses.text: And the LORD gave to Israel all the land which He swore to give to their fathers. And they possessed it, and lived in it.

verses.name: Joshua 21:44
verses.text: And Jehovah gave them rest round about, according to all that He swore to their fathers. And not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Jehovah delivered all their enemies into their hand.

verses.name: Joshua 21:45
verses.text: Not a word failed from any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:1
verses.text: Then Joshua called for the Reubenites and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.name: Joshua 22:2
verses.text: and said to them, You have done all that which Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you. And you have listened to my voice, to all that I have commanded you.

verses.name: Joshua 22:3
verses.text: You have not left your brothers these many days until today, and have kept the observance of the command of the LORD your God.

verses.name: Joshua 22:4
verses.text: And now Jehovah your God has given rest to your brothers, as He spoke to them. And now turn and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD has given to you beyond the Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 22:5
verses.text: Only, diligently take heed to do the commands and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments, and to cleave to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.name: Joshua 22:6
verses.text: And Joshua blessed them and sent them away. And they went to their tents.

verses.name: Joshua 22:7
verses.text: And to the half tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given <hi>possession</hi> in Bashan. And to its <hi>other</hi> half Joshua had given <hi>possession</hi> with their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. And also when Joshua had sent them away to their tents, then he blessed them.

verses.name: Joshua 22:8
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> spoke to them, saying, You are returning to your tents with your great treasures, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with bronze, and with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers.

verses.name: Joshua 22:9
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned. And they departed from the sons of Israel out of Shiloh, which <hi>is</hi> in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, of which they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:10
verses.text: And when they came to the borders of Jordan in the land of Canaan, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built an altar of grand appearance there by Jordan.

verses.name: Joshua 22:11
verses.text: And the sons of Israel heard, Behold, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 22:12
verses.text: And when the sons of Israel heard, the whole congregation of the sons of Israel gathered themselves at Shiloh to go to war against them.

verses.name: Joshua 22:13
verses.text: And the sons of Israel sent Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest to the sons of Reuben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead,

verses.name: Joshua 22:14
verses.text: and with him ten rulers, a ruler from each of the chief houses throughout all the tribes of Israel. And each one <hi>was</hi> a head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 22:15
verses.text: And they came to the sons of Reuben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them saying,

verses.name: Joshua 22:16
verses.text: So says all the congregation of the LORD: What trespass <hi>is</hi> this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in <hi>that</hi> you have built an altar for you so that you might rebel this day against the LORD?

verses.name: Joshua 22:17
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> the iniquity of Peor <hi>too</hi> little for us, from which we have not been made clean until today? Yea, a plague came on the congregation of the LORD!

verses.name: Joshua 22:18
verses.text: But must you turn away today from following the LORD? It shall be, you rebel today against the LORD, and tomorrow He will be angry with all the congregation of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 22:19
verses.text: But surely if the land of your possession <hi>is</hi> unclean, pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD in which the LORD's tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us. But do not rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us in building an altar for yourselves besides the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.name: Joshua 22:20
verses.text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a sin in the cursed thing, and did not wrath fall on all the congregation of Israel? And that man did not perish alone in his iniquity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:21
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and said to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

verses.name: Joshua 22:22
verses.text: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods knows, and Israel shall know if <hi>it is</hi> in rebellion or in transgression against the LORD (you shall not save us alive today),

verses.name: Joshua 22:23
verses.text: that we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD. Or if we have built an altar to offer on it burnt offering or food offering, or if to offer peace offerings on it, let the LORD Himself require <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:24
verses.text: And if we have not done it for fear of <hi>this</hi> thing, saying, In time to come your sons might speak to our sons, saying, What have you to do with the LORD God of Israel?

verses.name: Joshua 22:25
verses.text: For the LORD has made Jordan a border between us and you, sons of Reuben and sons of Gad. You have no part in the LORD. And your sons shall make our sons stop fearing the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 22:26
verses.text: And we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice,

verses.name: Joshua 22:27
verses.text: but it shall be a witness between us and you, and our generations after us, so that we might do the service of the LORD before Him with our burnt offerings and with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings; so that your sons may not say to our sons in time to come, You have no part in the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 22:28
verses.text: And we said that when they should say so to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings nor for sacrifices, but it <hi>is</hi> a witness between us and you.

verses.name: Joshua 22:29
verses.text: Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for food offerings, or for sacrifices, besides the altar of the LORD our God that <hi>is</hi> before His tabernacle!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:30
verses.text: And Phinehas the priest, and the rulers of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel with him, heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.

verses.name: Joshua 22:31
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh, Today we see that the LORD <hi>is</hi> among us, because you have not committed this sin against the LORD. Now you have delivered the sons of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 22:32
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the rulers, returned from the sons of Reuben, and from the sons of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel, and brought them word again.

verses.name: Joshua 22:33
verses.text: And the thing pleased the sons of Israel. And the sons of Israel blessed God and no more said to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land in which the sons of Reuben and Gad lived.

verses.name: Joshua 22:34
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad proclaimed regarding the altar, that it <hi>was</hi> a witness between us that Jehovah <hi>is</hi> God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 23:1
verses.text: And it happened many days after the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies all around, Joshua became old, far along in days.

verses.name: Joshua 23:2
verses.text: And Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them, I am old, far along in days.

verses.name: Joshua 23:3
verses.text: And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> He who has fought for you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:4
verses.text: Behold, I have divided to you by lot these nations that are left to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the Great Sea westward.

verses.name: Joshua 23:5
verses.text: And the LORD your God shall put them out from before you, and drive them out of your sight. And you shall possess their land, as the LORD your God has promised to you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:6
verses.text: And be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside from it <hi>to</hi> the right or to the left;

verses.name: Joshua 23:7
verses.text: so that you do not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear <hi>by them</hi>, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves to them.

verses.name: Joshua 23:8
verses.text: But cleave to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 23:9
verses.text: For the LORD has driven out from before you great and strong nations. But <hi>as for</hi> you, no one has been able to stand before you to this day.

verses.name: Joshua 23:10
verses.text: One man of you shall chase a thousand. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> He who fights for you, as He has promised you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 23:11
verses.text: And take good heed to yourselves that you love the LORD your God.

verses.name: Joshua 23:12
verses.text: Otherwise, if you go back in any way, and hold to those left of these nations, these that remain among you, and shall marry them and go in to them and they to you,

verses.name: Joshua 23:13
verses.text: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out these nations from before you. But they shall be snares and traps to you, and whips in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:14
verses.text: And behold, today I <hi>am</hi> going the way of all the earth. And you know in all your heart and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have come to pass to you. Not one thing of it has failed.

verses.name: Joshua 23:15
verses.text: And it shall be, as comes to you every good thing which the LORD your God has spoken to you has come to you, so shall the LORD bring on you every evil thing until He has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,

verses.name: Joshua 23:16
verses.text: when you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them, then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which He has given to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:1
verses.text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers. And they presented themselves before God.

verses.name: Joshua 24:2
verses.text: And Joshua said to all the people, So says the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers lived Beyond the River in times past, Terah the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.

verses.name: Joshua 24:3
verses.text: And I took your father Abraham from Beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.

verses.name: Joshua 24:4
verses.text: And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau. And I gave Esau Mount Seir for his own, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

verses.name: Joshua 24:5
verses.text: I sent Moses also, and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them. And afterward I brought you out.

verses.name: Joshua 24:6
verses.text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt. And you came to the sea, and the Egyptians followed after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.

verses.name: Joshua 24:7
verses.text: And they cried to the LORD, He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them and covered them. And your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt. And you lived in the wilderness a long time.

verses.name: Joshua 24:8
verses.text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites who lived on the other side Jordan. And they fought with you, and I gave them into your hand so that you might possess their land. And I destroyed them from before you.

verses.name: Joshua 24:9
verses.text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.

verses.name: Joshua 24:10
verses.text: But I would not listen to Balaam. And he still blessed you. And I delivered you out of his hand.

verses.name: Joshua 24:11
verses.text: And you went over Jordan and came to Jericho. And the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. And I delivered them into your hand.

verses.name: Joshua 24:12
verses.text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, the two kings of the Amorites, not with your sword, nor with your bow.

verses.name: Joshua 24:13
verses.text: And I have given you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build, and you live in them. You now eat of the vineyards and olive-yards which you did not plant.

verses.name: Joshua 24:14
verses.text: Now, then, fear the LORD, and serve Him in sincerity and truth. And put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:15
verses.text: And if it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served Beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you live. But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 24:16
verses.text: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods.

verses.name: Joshua 24:17
verses.text: For the LORD our God <hi>is</hi> He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage. And He did those great wonders in our sight, and kept us in all our way in which we went and among all the people through whom we passed.

verses.name: Joshua 24:18
verses.text: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites who lived in the land. We will also serve the LORD, for He <hi>is</hi> our God.

verses.name: Joshua 24:19
verses.text: And Joshua said to the people, You cannot serve the LORD, for He <hi>is</hi> a holy God. He <hi>is</hi> a jealous God. He will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

verses.name: Joshua 24:20
verses.text: If you forsake the LORD and serve strange gods, then He will turn and do you harm, and destroy you after He has done you good.

verses.name: Joshua 24:21
verses.text: And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 24:22
verses.text: And Joshua said to the people, You <hi>are</hi> witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD, to serve Him. And they said, <hi>We are</hi> witnesses.

verses.name: Joshua 24:23
verses.text: And now put away the strange gods among you, and incline your heart to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 24:24
verses.text: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the LORD our God, and His voice we will obey.

verses.name: Joshua 24:25
verses.text: And Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

verses.name: Joshua 24:26
verses.text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone and set it up there under an oak by the sanctuary of the LORD.

verses.name: Joshua 24:27
verses.text: And Joshua said to all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of the LORD which He spoke to us. It shall therefore be a witness to you, lest you deny your God.

verses.name: Joshua 24:28
verses.text: And Joshua sent away the people, each man to his inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:29
verses.text: And it happened after these things, Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, <hi>being</hi> a hundred and ten years old.

verses.name: Joshua 24:30
verses.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.name: Joshua 24:31
verses.text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and who had known all the works of the LORD that He had done for Israel.

verses.name: Joshua 24:32
verses.text: And the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in a piece of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. And it became the inheritance of the sons of Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 24:33
verses.text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died. And they buried him in a hill <hi>belonging</hi> to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:1
verses.text: And it happened after the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites to fight against them?

verses.name: Judges 1:2
verses.text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

verses.name: Judges 1:3
verses.text: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot so that we may fight against the Canaanites. And I likewise will go with you into your lot. So Simeon went with him.

verses.name: Judges 1:4
verses.text: And Judah went up. And the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. And they killed ten thousand men of them in Bezek.

verses.name: Judges 1:5
verses.text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek. And, they fought against him, and they killed the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.name: Judges 1:6
verses.text: And Adoni-bezek fled. And they ran after him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

verses.name: Judges 1:7
verses.text: And Adoni-bezek said, Seventy kings <hi>with</hi> their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered under my table. As I have done, so God has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

verses.name: Judges 1:8
verses.text: And the sons of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and had struck it with the edge of the sword, and had set the city on fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:9
verses.text: And afterward the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

verses.name: Judges 1:10
verses.text: And Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron; (and the name of Hebron before <hi>was</hi> Kirjath-arba). And they killed Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

verses.name: Judges 1:11
verses.text: And from there he went against those who lived in Debir. And the name of Debir before <hi>was</hi> Kirjath-sepher.

verses.name: Judges 1:12
verses.text: And Caleb said, He who strikes Kirjath-sepher and takes it, I will give Achsah my daughter to him for a wife.

verses.name: Judges 1:13
verses.text: And Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz, took it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

verses.name: Judges 1:14
verses.text: And it happened when she came, she moved him to ask for a field from her father. And she dismounted from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What do you desire?

verses.name: Judges 1:15
verses.text: And she said to him, Give me a blessing. For you have given me a south land. Give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

verses.name: Judges 1:16
verses.text: And the sons of the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the sons of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which <hi>is</hi> in the south of Arad. And they went and lived among the people.

verses.name: Judges 1:17
verses.text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they killed the Canaanites who lived in Zephath and destroyed it. And the name of the city <hi>was called</hi> Hormah.

verses.name: Judges 1:18
verses.text: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Askelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

verses.name: Judges 1:19
verses.text: And the LORD was with Judah. And he took possession of the mountain. But he could not drive out those who lived in the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

verses.name: Judges 1:20
verses.text: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses said. And he expelled the three sons of Anak from there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:21
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin did not expel the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem. But the Jebusites live with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

verses.name: Judges 1:22
verses.text: And the house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD <hi>was</hi> with them.

verses.name: Judges 1:23
verses.text: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. And the name of the city before <hi>was</hi> Luz.

verses.name: Judges 1:24
verses.text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said to him, Please show us the gate into the city, and we will show you mercy.

verses.name: Judges 1:25
verses.text: And when he showed them the gate into the city, they struck the city with the edge of the sword. But they let the man and all his family go.

verses.name: Judges 1:26
verses.text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites and built a city, and called the name of it Luz, which <hi>is</hi> the name of it to this day.

verses.name: Judges 1:27
verses.text: And Manasseh had not taken possession of Beth-shean and its daughter-<hi> villages</hi>, nor Taanach and its daughter-<hi> villages</hi>, nor <hi>struck</hi> the inhabitants of Dor and its daughter-<hi> villages</hi>, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its daughter-<hi> villages</hi>, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its daughter-<hi> villages</hi>. For the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

verses.name: Judges 1:28
verses.text: And it happened, when Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not completely expel them.

verses.name: Judges 1:29
verses.text: And Ephraim did not expel the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

verses.name: Judges 1:30
verses.text: And Zebulun did not expel those who lived in Kitron, nor those who lived in Nahalol. But the Canaanites lived among them and became tributaries.

verses.name: Judges 1:31
verses.text: And Asher did not expel those who lived in Accho, and the inhabitants of Sidon, and Ahlab, and Achzib, and Helbah, and Aphik, and Rehob.

verses.name: Judges 1:32
verses.text: But the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, those who lived in the land, for they did not expel them.

verses.name: Judges 1:33
verses.text: And Naphtali did not expel those who lived in Beth-shemesh, and the inhabitants of Beth-anath, and they lived among the Canaanites, those who lived in the land. But those who lived in Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became tributaries to them

verses.name: Judges 1:34
verses.text: And the Amorites forced the sons of Dan into the mountain. For they would not allow them to come down to the valley.

verses.name: Judges 1:35
verses.text: But the Amorites desired to stay in Mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph won out so that they became tributaries.

verses.name: Judges 1:36
verses.text: And the border of the Amorites <hi>was</hi> from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock and upward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:1
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you go up out of Egypt, and have brought you into the land which I swore to your fathers. And I said, I will never break My covenant with you.

verses.name: Judges 2:2
verses.text: And you shall make no treaty with those who live in this land. You shall throw down their altars. But you have not obeyed My voice. What <hi>is</hi> this that you have done?

verses.name: Judges 2:3
verses.text: And I also said, I will not drive them out from before you, but they shall be thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare to you.

verses.name: Judges 2:4
verses.text: And it happened when the Angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, the people lifted up their voices and wept.

verses.name: Judges 2:5
verses.text: And they called the name of that place Bochim. And they sacrificed there to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:6
verses.text: And when Joshua had let the people go, the sons of Israel left, each man to his inheritance, to possess the land.

verses.name: Judges 2:7
verses.text: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD that He did for Israel.

verses.name: Judges 2:8
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being a hundred and ten years old.

verses.name: Judges 2:9
verses.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

verses.name: Judges 2:10
verses.text: And also all that generation were gathered to their fathers. And there arose another generation after them who did not know the LORD, nor even the works which He had done for Israel.

verses.name: Judges 2:11
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baals.

verses.name: Judges 2:12
verses.text: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt. And they followed other gods of the gods of the people who were around them, and bowed themselves to them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

verses.name: Judges 2:13
verses.text: And they forsook the LORD and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

verses.name: Judges 2:14
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He delivered them into the hand of spoilers who spoiled them. And He sold them into the hand of their enemies all around, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

verses.name: Judges 2:15
verses.text: Wherever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn to them. And they were greatly distressed.

verses.name: Judges 2:16
verses.text: But the LORD raised up judges who delivered them out of the hand of those who spoiled them.

verses.name: Judges 2:17
verses.text: And yet they would not listen to their judges, but they went lusting after other gods, and bowed themselves to them. They turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, for they had obeyed the commandments of the LORD; these did not do so.

verses.name: Judges 2:18
verses.text: And when the LORD raised judges up for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge. For the LORD took pity because of their groanings before their oppressors and their crushers.

verses.name: Judges 2:19
verses.text: And it happened when the judge was dead, they returned and made themselves more rotten than their fathers in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down to them. They did not cease from their own doings nor from their stubborn way.

verses.name: Judges 2:20
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD glowed against Israel. And He said, Because this nation has transgressed My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to My voice,

verses.name: Judges 2:21
verses.text: I also from now on will not expel any from before them of the nations that Joshua left when he died;

verses.name: Judges 2:22
verses.text: so that by them I may test Israel, whether they are keeping the way of the LORD, to go in it, as their fathers kept it, or not.

verses.name: Judges 2:23
verses.text: And the LORD left those nations, without driving them out quickly. And He did not deliver them into the hand of Joshua.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:1
verses.text: And these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

verses.name: Judges 3:2
verses.text: only that the generations of the sons of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least those who before knew nothing of it:

verses.name: Judges 3:3
verses.text: five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that lived in Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon to the border of Hamath.

verses.name: Judges 3:4
verses.text: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commands of the LORD, which He commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: Judges 3:5
verses.text: And the sons of Israel lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites.

verses.name: Judges 3:6
verses.text: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

verses.name: Judges 3:7
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD and forgot the LORD their God, and served Baals and the Asherahs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:8
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia. And the sons of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

verses.name: Judges 3:9
verses.text: And when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the sons of Israel, who delivered them, Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.

verses.name: Judges 3:10
verses.text: And the spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel and went out to war. And the LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, into his hand. And his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

verses.name: Judges 3:11
verses.text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:12
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD made Eglon the king of Moab strong against Israel because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.name: Judges 3:13
verses.text: And he gathered to him the sons of Ammon and Amalek. And he went forth and struck Israel, and took the city of palm trees.

verses.name: Judges 3:14
verses.text: So the sons of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

verses.name: Judges 3:15
verses.text: But when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a left-handed man. And the sons of Israel sent a present to Eglon the king of Moab by him.

verses.name: Judges 3:16
verses.text: But Ehud made himself a dagger which had two edges, a cubit long. And he tied it under his clothing upon his right thigh.

verses.name: Judges 3:17
verses.text: And he brought the present to Eglon king of Moab. And Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.name: Judges 3:18
verses.text: And when he had finished offering the present, he sent away the people who carried the present.

verses.name: Judges 3:19
verses.text: But he himself turned again from the graven images by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret message for you, O, king. And he said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

verses.name: Judges 3:20
verses.text: And Ehud came to him. And he was sitting <hi>in</hi> the cool roof room which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God to you. And he rose out of his seat.

verses.name: Judges 3:21
verses.text: And Ehud put forth his left hand and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.

verses.name: Judges 3:22
verses.text: And the haft also went in after the blade. And the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly. And the dung came out.

verses.name: Judges 3:23
verses.text: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the room upon him, and locked them.

verses.name: Judges 3:24
verses.text: And when he had gone out, his servants came. And they looked, and, behold, the doors of the roof room were locked, they said, Surely he <hi>is</hi> covering his feet in his cool roof room.

verses.name: Judges 3:25
verses.text: And they waited until they were ashamed. And, behold, he did not open the doors of the room. And they took a key and opened them. And behold, their lord <hi>had</hi> fallen down dead on the earth.

verses.name: Judges 3:26
verses.text: And Ehud escaped while they waited, and passed beyond the graven images, and escaped to Seirath.

verses.name: Judges 3:27
verses.text: And it happened, when he had come, he blew a ram's horn in the mountain of Ephraim, and the sons of Israel went down with him from the mountain, and he before them.

verses.name: Judges 3:28
verses.text: And he said to them, Follow after me. For the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and did not allow a man to pass over.

verses.name: Judges 3:29
verses.text: And they killed about ten thousand of the men of Moab at that time, all lusty, and all men of might. And there did not escape a man.

verses.name: Judges 3:30
verses.text: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day. And the land had rest eighty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:31
verses.text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. And he also delivered Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:1
verses.text: And the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD when Ehud was dead.

verses.name: Judges 4:2
verses.text: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who ruled in Hazor. The captain of his host was Sisera who lived in Harosheth of the nations.

verses.name: Judges 4:3
verses.text: And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron. And he mightily oppressed the sons of Israel twenty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:4
verses.text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, judged Israel at that time.

verses.name: Judges 4:5
verses.text: And she lived under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim. And the sons of Israel came up to her for judgment.

verses.name: Judges 4:6
verses.text: And she sent and called for Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said to him, Has not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the sons of Naphtali and of the sons of Zebulun?

verses.name: Judges 4:7
verses.text: And I will draw Sisera to you, the captain of Jabin's army, at the river Kishon, together with his chariots and his multitude. And I will deliver him into your hands.

verses.name: Judges 4:8
verses.text: And Barak said to her, If you will go with me, then I will go. But if you will not go with me, I will not go.

verses.name: Judges 4:9
verses.text: And she said, I will surely go with you. But the journey that you take shall not be for your honor, for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:10
verses.text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh. And he went up with ten thousand men at his feet. And Deborah went up with him.

verses.name: Judges 4:11
verses.text: And Heber the Kenite, of the sons of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, had separated himself from the Kenites and pitched his tent toward the plain of Zaanaim, near Kedesh.

verses.name: Judges 4:12
verses.text: And they told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

verses.name: Judges 4:13
verses.text: And Sisera gathered all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people with him, from Harosheth of the nations to the river of Kishon.

verses.name: Judges 4:14
verses.text: And Deborah said to Barak, Up! For this <hi>is</hi> the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone out before you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

verses.name: Judges 4:15
verses.text: And the LORD struck Sisera, and all the chariots, and all the army, with the edge of the sword in front of Barak, so that Sisera got down from the chariot and fled on his feet.

verses.name: Judges 4:16
verses.text: But Barak pursued the chariots and after the army, to Harosheth of the nations. And all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:17
verses.text: And Sisera fled on his feet to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite. For <hi>there was</hi> peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

verses.name: Judges 4:18
verses.text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, Turn in my lord, turn in to me. Do not fear. When he had turned in to her into the tent, she covered him with a rug.

verses.name: Judges 4:19
verses.text: And he said to her, Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty. And she opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink, and covered him.

verses.name: Judges 4:20
verses.text: Again he said to her, Stand <hi>in</hi> the door of the tent, and it shall be when any man comes asking of you, saying, Is there any man here? You shall say, No.

verses.name: Judges 4:21
verses.text: Then Jael, Heber's wife, took a peg of the tent and put a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the peg into his temple, and beat it into the ground. For he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

verses.name: Judges 4:22
verses.text: And behold, as Barak followed Sisera, Jael came out to meet him and said to him, Come and I will show you the man whom you seek. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the peg was in his temple.

verses.name: Judges 4:23
verses.text: And on that day God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 4:24
verses.text: And the hand of the sons of Israel went on, and pressed hard against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:1
verses.text: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

verses.name: Judges 5:2
verses.text: Praise the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

verses.name: Judges 5:3
verses.text: Hear, O, kings. Give ear, O, princes. I, <hi>even</hi> I, will sing to the LORD, I will sing to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 5:4
verses.text: LORD, when You went out of Seir, when You marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

verses.name: Judges 5:5
verses.text: The mountains quaked from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:6
verses.text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were empty, and the travelers walked through crooked ways.

verses.name: Judges 5:7
verses.text: The leaders ceased in Israel, they ceased until I, Deborah, arose; until I arose, a mother in Israel.

verses.name: Judges 5:8
verses.text: They chose new gods; then war <hi>was</hi> in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.name: Judges 5:9
verses.text: My heart <hi>is</hi> toward the lawgivers of Israel who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD.

verses.name: Judges 5:10
verses.text: Speak, you who ride on white asses, you who sit in judgment and walk by the way.

verses.name: Judges 5:11
verses.text: <hi> Louder</hi> than the voice of the dividers between the watering places, there shall they tell again the righteous acts of the LORD, the righteous acts of His leaders in Israel. Then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:12
verses.text: Awake, awake, Deborah. Awake, awake, sing a song. Arise, Barak, lead your captivity captive, son of Abinoam.

verses.name: Judges 5:13
verses.text: Then He <hi>made me</hi> tread on the remnant of the nobles among the people. The LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

verses.name: Judges 5:14
verses.text: Out of Ephraim there was a root of them <hi>against</hi> Amalek; after you, Benjamin, with your peoples. Out of Machir came down commanders, and out of Zebulun came they who handle the pen of the writer.

verses.name: Judges 5:15
verses.text: And the rulers of Issachar <hi>were</hi> with Deborah, even Issachar, and also Barak. He was sent on foot into the valley. There were great thoughts of heart for the divisions of Reuben.

verses.name: Judges 5:16
verses.text: Why did you stay among the sheepfolds to hear the bleating of the flocks? For in the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

verses.name: Judges 5:17
verses.text: Gilead stayed beyond Jordan. And why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the seashore and remained in his havens.

verses.name: Judges 5:18
verses.text: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people who put their lives in danger of death in the high places of the field.

verses.name: Judges 5:19
verses.text: Kings came and fought. Then the kings of Canaan fought in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no gain of silver.

verses.name: Judges 5:20
verses.text: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

verses.name: Judges 5:21
verses.text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, you trampled in strength.

verses.name: Judges 5:22
verses.text: Then did the hooves of horses beat, from the galloping, the galloping of their mighty ones.

verses.name: Judges 5:23
verses.text: Curse Meroz, said the Angel of the LORD; curse the people of it bitterly, because they did not come to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:24
verses.text: Blessed among women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be. She shall be blessed above women in the tent.

verses.name: Judges 5:25
verses.text: He asked for water, and she gave <hi>him</hi> milk. She brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

verses.name: Judges 5:26
verses.text: She put her hand to the peg, and her right hand to the workman's hammer; she hammered Sisera; she smashed his head, she pierced and struck through his temple.

verses.name: Judges 5:27
verses.text: He bowed between her feet, he fell, he lay down. Between her feet he bowed; he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

verses.name: Judges 5:28
verses.text: The mother of Sisera looked out a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariot wait?

verses.name: Judges 5:29
verses.text: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

verses.name: Judges 5:30
verses.text: Do they not find and divide the spoil? A womb, two wombs to a man's head, to Sisera a prize of dyed garments, a prize of embroidered dyed <hi>garments</hi> for the necks of those that take the spoil.

verses.name: Judges 5:31
verses.text: So let all Your enemies perish, O LORD. But let them that love Him be like the sun when He goes forth in His might. And the land had rest forty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:1
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

verses.name: Judges 6:2
verses.text: And the hand of Midian was strong against Israel. Before the faces of Midian, the sons of Israel made themselves dens in the mountains, and caves and strongholds.

verses.name: Judges 6:3
verses.text: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the sons of the east, even they came up against them.

verses.name: Judges 6:4
verses.text: And they camped against them and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. And they left no food for Israel, neither sheep nor ox nor ass.

verses.name: Judges 6:5
verses.text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as locusts for multitude, both they and their camels were without number. And they entered into the land to destroy it.

verses.name: Judges 6:6
verses.text: And Israel was made very poor because of the Midianites. And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:7
verses.text: And it happened, when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD because of the Midianites,

verses.name: Judges 6:8
verses.text: the LORD sent a man, a prophet to the sons of Israel, who said to them, So says the LORD God of Israel: I brought you up from Egypt and brought you forth out of the house of bondage.

verses.name: Judges 6:9
verses.text: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you and gave you their land.

verses.name: Judges 6:10
verses.text: And I said to you, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God. Do not fear the gods of the Amorites in whose land you live. But you have not obeyed My voice.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:11
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD came and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, which <hi>belonged</hi> to Joash the Abiezrite. And his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

verses.name: Judges 6:12
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to him, and said to him, The LORD <hi>is</hi> with you, mighty warrior.

verses.name: Judges 6:13
verses.text: And Gideon said to Him, O, my Lord, if the LORD is with us, why then has all this happened to us? And where are all His miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? But now the LORD has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

verses.name: Judges 6:14
verses.text: And the LORD looked upon him and said, Go in your might, and you shall save Israel from the hand of the Midianites. Have I not sent you?

verses.name: Judges 6:15
verses.text: And he said to him, O, my Lord, with what shall I save Israel? Behold, my family <hi>is</hi> poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

verses.name: Judges 6:16
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Surely, I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.

verses.name: Judges 6:17
verses.text: And he said to Him, If now I have found grace in Your sight, then show me a sign that You talk with me.

verses.name: Judges 6:18
verses.text: Do not depart from here, I pray, until I come to You, and bring forth my food offering and set it before You. And He said, I will stay until you come again.

verses.name: Judges 6:19
verses.text: And Gideon went in and made ready a kid and unleavened <hi>cakes</hi> of an ephah of flour. He put the flesh in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to Him to the oak, and offered <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 6:20
verses.text: And the Angel of God said to him, Take the flesh and the unleavened <hi>cakes</hi> and lay on this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

verses.name: Judges 6:21
verses.text: Then the Angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in His hand and touched the flesh and the unleavened <hi>cakes</hi>. And there rose up fire out of the rock and burned up the flesh and the unleavened <hi>cakes</hi>. Then the Angel of the LORD went away out of his sight.

verses.name: Judges 6:22
verses.text: And when Gideon saw that He was the Angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! Because I have seen the Angel of the LORD face to face.

verses.name: Judges 6:23
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Peace to you. Do not fear. You shall not die.

verses.name: Judges 6:24
verses.text: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom. It <hi>is</hi> yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:25
verses.text: And it happened on that night the LORD said to him, Take your father's young bull, even the second bull of seven years, and throw down the altar of Baal which your father <hi>has</hi>, and cut down the pillar by it.

verses.name: Judges 6:26
verses.text: And build an altar to the LORD your God upon the top of this rock, in an orderly manner, and take the second bull and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which you shall cut down.

verses.name: Judges 6:27
verses.text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said to him. And so it was, because he feared his father's household and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day. So he did it by night.

verses.name: Judges 6:28
verses.text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the pillar which was by it was cut down, and the second bull had been offered upon the altar that was built.

verses.name: Judges 6:29
verses.text: And they said to one another, Who has done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.

verses.name: Judges 6:30
verses.text: Then the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out your son so that he may die (because he had cast down the altar of Baal, and because he had cut down the pillar by it).

verses.name: Judges 6:31
verses.text: And Joash said to all that stood against him, Will you plead for Baal? Will you save him? He who contends for him shall be killed by the morning. If he is a god, let him plead for himself, because one has cast down his altar.

verses.name: Judges 6:32
verses.text: And on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal contend against him because he has thrown down his altar.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:33
verses.text: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites, and the sons of the east were gathered together, and went over and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.name: Judges 6:34
verses.text: But the spirit of the LORD came to Gideon, and he blew a ram's horn. And he called the Abiezrites after him.

verses.name: Judges 6:35
verses.text: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, who also were gathered after him. And he sent messengers to Asher, and to Zebulun, and to Naphtali. And they came up to meet them.

verses.name: Judges 6:36
verses.text: And Gideon said to God, If You will save Israel by my hand, as You have said,

verses.name: Judges 6:37
verses.text: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the grain-floor. And if the dew is on the fleece only, and dry upon all the ground, then I shall know that You will save Israel by my hand, as You have said.

verses.name: Judges 6:38
verses.text: And it was so. For he rose up early in the morning and gathered the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

verses.name: Judges 6:39
verses.text: And Gideon said to God, Let not Your anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once. I pray You, let me test but this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

verses.name: Judges 6:40
verses.text: And God did so that night. For it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:1
verses.text: And Jerubbaal (he <hi>is</hi> Gideon) and all the people that were with him, rose up early and pitched beside the well of Harod, so that the army of the Midianites was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

verses.name: Judges 7:2
verses.text: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people with you <hi>are</hi> too many for Me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel boast themselves against Me, saying, My own hand has saved me.

verses.name: Judges 7:3
verses.text: Now, therefore, speak in the ears of the people, saying, Whoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and go away early from Mount Gilead. And twenty-two thousand of the people returned. And there remained ten thousand.

verses.name: Judges 7:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people are still <hi>too</hi> many. Bring them down to the water, and I will separate them for you there. It shall be <hi>that of</hi> whom I say to you, This shall go with you, the same shall go with you. And of whomever I say to you, This shall not go with you, the same shall not go.

verses.name: Judges 7:5
verses.text: And he brought down the people to the water. And the LORD said to Gideon, Everyone who laps the water with his tongue, as a dog laps, you shall set him apart; also everyone who bows down upon his knees to drink.

verses.name: Judges 7:6
verses.text: And the number of them who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, <hi>was</hi> three hundred men. But all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

verses.name: Judges 7:7
verses.text: And the LORD said to Gideon, I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and will deliver the Midianites into your hand. And let all the other people go, each man to his place.

verses.name: Judges 7:8
verses.text: And the people took provisions in their hand, and their ram's horns. And he sent away all the rest of Israel, each man to his tent, and kept those three hundred men. And the army of Midian was below him in the valley.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:9
verses.text: And it happened on that night, the LORD said to him, Arise, go down to the army, for I have delivered it into your hand.

verses.name: Judges 7:10
verses.text: But if you fear to go down, go with Phurah your servant down to the army.

verses.name: Judges 7:11
verses.text: And you shall hear what they shall say. And afterward your hands shall be strengthened to go down to the army. Then he went down with Phurah his servant to the edge of the ranks in the army.

verses.name: Judges 7:12
verses.text: And the Midianites and the Amalekites, and all the sons of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude, and their camels without number, like the sand by the seaside for multitude.

verses.name: Judges 7:13
verses.text: And when Gideon had come, behold, a man told a dream to his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came to a tent, and struck it so that it fell, and overturned it, so that the tent lay along.

verses.name: Judges 7:14
verses.text: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else except the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. For into his hand God has delivered Midian and all the army.

verses.name: Judges 7:15
verses.text: And it happened, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and the meaning of it, he worshiped. And <hi>he</hi> returned to the army of Israel, and said, Arise! For the LORD has delivered the host of Midian into your hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:16
verses.text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies. And he put a ram's horn in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and torches inside the pitchers.

verses.name: Judges 7:17
verses.text: And he said to them, Look on me, and do likewise. And, behold, when I come to the edge of the camp, it shall be, as I do, so you shall do.

verses.name: Judges 7:18
verses.text: When I blow with a ram's horn, I and all who are with me, then you blow the ram's horns also on every side of all the camp, and shout, For Jehovah and for Gideon!

verses.name: Judges 7:19
verses.text: So Gideon and the hundred men with him came to the edge of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch. And they had but newly set the watch. And they blew the ram's horns and broke the pitchers that were in their hands.

verses.name: Judges 7:20
verses.text: And the three companies blew the ram's horns and broke the pitchers and held the torches in their left hands and the ram's horns in their right hands to blow. And they cried, A sword for Jehovah and for Gideon!

verses.name: Judges 7:21
verses.text: And they stood, each man in his place, all around the camp. And all the army ran, and cried, and fled.

verses.name: Judges 7:22
verses.text: And the three hundred blew the ram's horns. And the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the army. And the army fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, to the border of Abel-meholah, to Tabbath.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:23
verses.text: And the men of Israel were called out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and ran after the Midianites.

verses.name: Judges 7:24
verses.text: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take the waters to Beth-barah and Jordan before them. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves. And they captured the waters to Beth-barah and Jordan.

verses.name: Judges 7:25
verses.text: Then they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb. And they killed Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and they killed Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. And they pursued Midian and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:1
verses.text: And the men of Ephraim said to him, What <hi>is</hi> this thing you have done to us, not to call us when you went to fight with the Midianites? And they rebuked him sharply.

verses.name: Judges 8:2
verses.text: And he said to them, What have I done now in comparison to you? <hi>Is</hi> not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

verses.name: Judges 8:3
verses.text: God has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. And what was I able to do in comparison to you? Then their spirits toward him went away when he had said that.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:4
verses.text: And Gideon came to Jordan, crossing over, he and the three hundred men with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

verses.name: Judges 8:5
verses.text: And he said to the men of Succoth, I pray you, give loaves of bread to the people who follow me. For they are tired, and I <hi>am</hi> chasing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

verses.name: Judges 8:6
verses.text: And the rulers of Succoth said, <hi>Are</hi> the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, so that we should give bread to your army?

verses.name: Judges 8:7
verses.text: And Gideon said, Therefore, when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

verses.name: Judges 8:8
verses.text: And he went up from there to Penuel, and spoke to them likewise. And the men of Penuel answered him like the men of Succoth had answered.

verses.name: Judges 8:9
verses.text: And he spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

verses.name: Judges 8:10
verses.text: And Zebah and Zalmunna <hi>were</hi> in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand, all who were left of all the armies of the sons of the east. For a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword fell.

verses.name: Judges 8:11
verses.text: And Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army. For the army was at ease.

verses.name: Judges 8:12
verses.text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and destroyed all the army.

verses.name: Judges 8:13
verses.text: And Gideon the son of Joash turned back from battle before Mount Heres.

verses.name: Judges 8:14
verses.text: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth and asked of him. And he described to him the rulers of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

verses.name: Judges 8:15
verses.text: And he came to the men of Succoth and said, Behold, Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom you rebuked me, saying, <hi>Are</hi> the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand so that we should give bread to your men who are weary?

verses.name: Judges 8:16
verses.text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

verses.name: Judges 8:17
verses.text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:18
verses.text: And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, How were the men whom you killed in Tabor? And they answered, As you <hi>are</hi>, so they. <hi>Each</hi> one resembled the sons of a king.

verses.name: Judges 8:19
verses.text: And he said, They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.

verses.name: Judges 8:20
verses.text: And he said to Jether his first-born, Up! Kill them! But the youth did not draw his sword, for he feared, because he <hi>was</hi> still a youth.

verses.name: Judges 8:21
verses.text: And Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise and fall upon us. For as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments on their camels' necks.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:22
verses.text: And the men of Israel said to Gideon, Rule over us, both you and your son, and your son's son also. For you have delivered us from the hand of Midian.

verses.name: Judges 8:23
verses.text: And Gideon said to them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. The LORD shall rule over you.

verses.name: Judges 8:24
verses.text: And Gideon said to them, I would desire a favor of you, that each man of you would give me the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they <hi>were</hi> Ishmaelites.)

verses.name: Judges 8:25
verses.text: And they answered, We will gladly give. And they spread a cloth, and each man threw the earrings of his prey in it.

verses.name: Judges 8:26
verses.text: And the weight of the golden earrings which he asked for was seventeen hundred of gold, besides ornaments, and pendants, and purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains around their camels' necks.

verses.name: Judges 8:27
verses.text: And Gideon made an ephod of it, and put it in his city, in Ophrah. And all Israel went there lusting after it, which thing became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

verses.name: Judges 8:28
verses.text: And Midian was subdued before the sons of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:29
verses.text: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

verses.name: Judges 8:30
verses.text: And Gideon had seventy sons, begotten of his body. For he had many wives.

verses.name: Judges 8:31
verses.text: And his concubine, who was in Shechem, also bore him a son whose name he called Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 8:32
verses.text: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah <hi>of</hi> the Abiezrites.

verses.name: Judges 8:33
verses.text: And it happened as soon as Gideon was dead, the sons of Israel turned again and went lusting after the Baals, and made Baal-berith their god.

verses.name: Judges 8:34
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did not remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side.

verses.name: Judges 8:35
verses.text: Neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:1
verses.text: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem, to his mother's brothers. And he talked with them and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

verses.name: Judges 9:2
verses.text: I pray you, speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem: Which is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? Remember also that I <hi>am</hi> your bone and your flesh.

verses.name: Judges 9:3
verses.text: And his mother's brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem with all these words. And their hearts were bent toward Abimelech, for they said, He is our brother.

verses.name: Judges 9:4
verses.text: And they gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless persons who followed him.

verses.name: Judges 9:5
verses.text: And he went to his father's house at Ophrah and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy persons, upon one stone. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, was still left; for he hid himself.

verses.name: Judges 9:6
verses.text: And all the leaders of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo. And <hi>they</hi> came and made Abimelech king beside the plain of the pillar in Shechem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:7
verses.text: And when they told Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim. And he lifted up his voice and cried, and said to them, Listen to me, leaders of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.

verses.name: Judges 9:8
verses.text: The trees went forth to anoint a king over them. And they said to the olive tree, Reign over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:9
verses.text: But the olive tree said to them, Should I leave my fatness with which they honor God and man by me, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.name: Judges 9:10
verses.text: And the trees said to the fig tree, You come and reign over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:11
verses.text: But the fig tree said to them, Should I forsake my sweetness and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.name: Judges 9:12
verses.text: Then the trees said to the vine, You come and reign over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:13
verses.text: And the vine said to them, Should I leave my wine, which cheers God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.name: Judges 9:14
verses.text: Then all the trees said to the bramble-bush, You come and reign over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:15
verses.text: And the bramble-bush said to the trees, If you truly anoint me king over you, come put your trust in my shadow. And if not, let fire come out of the bramble and burn up the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.name: Judges 9:16
verses.text: And now, if you have done truly and sincerely in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to what his hands did,

verses.name: Judges 9:17
verses.text: <hi> in</hi> which my father fought for you and much endangered his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian.

verses.name: Judges 9:18
verses.text: And you have risen up against my father's house today, and have killed his sons, seventy persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his slave woman, king over the men of Shechem, because he <hi>is</hi> your brother;

verses.name: Judges 9:19
verses.text: if then you have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house today, rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.

verses.name: Judges 9:20
verses.text: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and burn up the men of Shechem and the house of Millo. And let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and burn up Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:21
verses.text: And Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer, and lived there for fear of Abimelech his brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:22
verses.text: And Abimelech reigned three years over Israel.

verses.name: Judges 9:23
verses.text: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem. And the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

verses.name: Judges 9:24
verses.text: so that the cruelty to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and upon the men of Shechem who helped him in the killing of his brothers.

verses.name: Judges 9:25
verses.text: And the men of Shechem set men lying in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that passed by. And it was told to Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:26
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers, and went over to Shechem. And the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

verses.name: Judges 9:27
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> went out into the fields and gathered their vineyards and trod the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:28
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who <hi>is</hi> Abimelech, and who <hi>is</hi> Shechem, that we should serve him? Is <hi>he</hi> not the son of Jerubbaal, and Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

verses.name: Judges 9:29
verses.text: And I wish this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase your army, and come out!

verses.name: Judges 9:30
verses.text: And Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, and his anger was kindled.

verses.name: Judges 9:31
verses.text: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem. And behold, they fortify the city against you.

verses.name: Judges 9:32
verses.text: And now come up by night, you and the people with you, and lie in wait in the field.

verses.name: Judges 9:33
verses.text: And it shall be in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, it shall be that you shall rise early and set upon the city. And behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may do to them as you desire.

verses.name: Judges 9:34
verses.text: And Abimelech rose up by night, and all the people with him, and they lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.

verses.name: Judges 9:35
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. And Abimelech rose up, and the people with him, from lying in wait.

verses.name: Judges 9:36
verses.text: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, people are coming down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, You are seeing the shadow of the mountains like men.

verses.name: Judges 9:37
verses.text: And Gaal spoke again and said, See, people <hi>are</hi> coming by the middle of the land, and another company coming along by way of the Sorcerers' Oak.

verses.name: Judges 9:38
verses.text: And Zebul said to him, Where is your mouth now, <hi>with</hi> which you said, Who <hi>is</hi> Abimelech, that we should serve him? Is not this the people whom you have despised? I pray you, go out now and fight with them.

verses.name: Judges 9:39
verses.text: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:40
verses.text: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, to the entrance of the gate.

verses.name: Judges 9:41
verses.text: And Abimelech lived at Arumah. And Zebul put Gaal and his brothers out, so that they should not live in Shechem.

verses.name: Judges 9:42
verses.text: And it happened on the next day the people went out into the field. And they told Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:43
verses.text: And he took the people and divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the field. And they looked, and behold, the people came forth out of the city. And he rose up against them, and struck them.

verses.name: Judges 9:44
verses.text: And Abimelech and the company with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. And the two companies ran upon all the people in the field, and killed them.

verses.name: Judges 9:45
verses.text: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day. And he took the city and killed the people in it. And he beat down the city and sowed it <hi>with</hi> salt.

verses.name: Judges 9:46
verses.text: And all the men of the tower of Shechem heard, and entered into a stronghold of the house of the god Berith.

verses.name: Judges 9:47
verses.text: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

verses.name: Judges 9:48
verses.text: And Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people with him. And Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a limb from the trees, and took it and laid it on his shoulder, and said to the people who were with him, What you have seen me do, hurry and do likewise.

verses.name: Judges 9:49
verses.text: And all the people also, each man, cut down a limb for themselves, and followed Abimelech, and set <hi>them</hi> at the stronghold, and set on fire the stronghold. And about a thousand men and women, all the men of the tower of Shechem, died also.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:50
verses.text: And Abimelech went to Thebez, and camped against Thebez, and took it.

verses.name: Judges 9:51
verses.text: But there was a strong tower in the middle of the city, and all the men and women, and all the leaders of the city, fled there, and shut <hi>it</hi> behind them, and got up to the top of the tower.

verses.name: Judges 9:52
verses.text: And Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and went hard to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.name: Judges 9:53
verses.text: And a certain woman threw a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head and crushed his skull.

verses.name: Judges 9:54
verses.text: Then he called hastily to the young man who was his armor-bearer, and said to him, Draw your sword and kill me, so that men may not say of me, A woman killed him! And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

verses.name: Judges 9:55
verses.text: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, each one of them left to go to his place.

verses.name: Judges 9:56
verses.text: And God repaid the evil of Abimelech, that which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers.

verses.name: Judges 9:57
verses.text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem God sent back upon their heads. And upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:1
