verses.text: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar. And he lived in Shamir in Mount Ephraim.

verses.name: Judges 10:2
verses.text: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.name: Judges 10:3
verses.text: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty-two years.

verses.name: Judges 10:4
verses.text: And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities which are called Havoth-jair to this day in the land of Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 10:5
verses.text: And Jair died and was buried in Kamon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:6
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served the Baals and Ashtoreths, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the sons of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. And they left the LORD, and did not serve Him.

verses.name: Judges 10:7
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 10:8
verses.text: And that year they troubled and oppressed the sons of Israel; all the sons of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites, which <hi>is</hi> in Gilead, for eighteen years.

verses.name: Judges 10:9
verses.text: And the sons of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:10
verses.text: And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, We have sinned against You, both because we have forsaken our God and also have served the Baals.

verses.name: Judges 10:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to the sons of Israel, Did not <hi>I deliver you</hi> from Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.name: Judges 10:12
verses.text: And the Sidonians and the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you. And you cried to Me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

verses.name: Judges 10:13
verses.text: Yet you have forsaken Me and served other gods; therefore, I will deliver you no more.

verses.name: Judges 10:14
verses.text: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

verses.name: Judges 10:15
verses.text: And the sons of Israel said to the LORD, We have sinned. Do You to us whatever <hi>is</hi> good in Your eyes; only deliver us, we pray You, today.

verses.name: Judges 10:16
verses.text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD. And His soul was moved by the misery of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 10:17
verses.text: Then the sons of Ammon were gathered and camped in Gilead. And the sons of Israel assembled themselves together and camped in Mizpeh.

verses.name: Judges 10:18
verses.text: And the people and rulers of Gilead said to one another, What man <hi>is</hi> there who will begin to fight against the sons of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:1
verses.text: Now Jephthah, the Gileadite, was a mighty man of war. And he <hi>was</hi> the son of a harlot. And Gilead fathered Jephthah.

verses.name: Judges 11:2
verses.text: And Gilead's wife bore him sons. And his wife's sons grew up, and <hi>they</hi> threw Jephthah out and said to him, You shall not inherit in our father's house. For you <hi>are</hi> the son of another woman.

verses.name: Judges 11:3
verses.text: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. And worthless men were gathered to Jephthah, and went out with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:4
verses.text: And it happened after some time the sons of Ammon made war against Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:5
verses.text: And when the sons of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

verses.name: Judges 11:6
verses.text: And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our commander, so that we may fight with the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:7
verses.text: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Have you not hated me and thrown me out of my father's house? Why have you come to me now when you <hi>are</hi> in trouble?

verses.name: Judges 11:8
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, For this reason we turn again to you now, so that you may go with us and fight against the sons of Ammon, and be our head over all the people of Gilead.

verses.name: Judges 11:9
verses.text: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If you bring me home again to fight against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them before me, shall I be your head?

verses.name: Judges 11:10
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, The LORD is witness between us if we do not do so according to your word.

verses.name: Judges 11:11
verses.text: And Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:12
verses.text: And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon, saying, What have you to do with me, that you have come against me to fight in my land?

verses.name: Judges 11:13
verses.text: And the king of the sons of Ammon answered to the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and to Jordan. Now therefore restore those lands peaceably.

verses.name: Judges 11:14
verses.text: And Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:15
verses.text: And he said to him, So says Jephthah, Israel did not take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:16
verses.text: But when they came up from Egypt, Israel walked through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh.

verses.name: Judges 11:17
verses.text: And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, I pray you, let me pass through your land. But the king of Edom would not listen. And in the same way they sent to the king of Moab, but he would not. And Israel stayed in Kadesh.

verses.name: Judges 11:18
verses.text: And they went along through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but they did not come within the border of Moab; for Arnon was the border of Moab.

verses.name: Judges 11:19
verses.text: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon. And Israel said to him, We pray you, let us pass through your land to my place.

verses.name: Judges 11:20
verses.text: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his border. But Sihon gathered all his people together and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:21
verses.text: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, who lived in that country.

verses.name: Judges 11:22
verses.text: And they possessed all the borders of the Amorites, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to Jordan.

verses.name: Judges 11:23
verses.text: So now the LORD God of Israel has put out the Amorites before His people Israel, and should you possess it?

verses.name: Judges 11:24
verses.text: Will you not possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whomever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, we will possess them.

verses.name: Judges 11:25
verses.text: And now <hi>are</hi> you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them

verses.name: Judges 11:26
verses.text: when Israel lived in Heshbon and its villages, and Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities which <hi>are</hi> along by the borders of Arnon, for three hundred years? Why then did you not deliver them in that time?

verses.name: Judges 11:27
verses.text: So I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. The LORD, the Judge, will judge this day between the sons of Israel and the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:28
verses.text: And the king of the sons of Ammon did not listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:29
verses.text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead passed over <hi>to</hi> the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:30
verses.text: And Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, If You will indeed give the sons of Ammon into my hand,

verses.name: Judges 11:31
verses.text: then it shall be that whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the sons of Ammon, surely it shall belong to the LORD, or I will offer it up <hi>instead of</hi> a burnt offering.

verses.name: Judges 11:32
verses.text: And Jephthah passed over to the sons of Ammon to fight against them. And the LORD delivered them into his hand.

verses.name: Judges 11:33
verses.text: And he struck them from Aroer even until you come to Minnith, twenty cities, and to the meadow of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. So were the sons of Ammon subdued before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 11:34
verses.text: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh to his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances. And she <hi>was his</hi> only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.name: Judges 11:35
verses.text: And it happened when he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me. For I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I cannot go back.

verses.name: Judges 11:36
verses.text: And she said to him, My father, you have opened your mouth to the Lord; do to me according to that which has come out of your mouth, because the LORD has taken vengeance for you upon your enemies, even of the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:37
verses.text: And she said to her father, Let this thing be done for me. Let me alone two months, so that I may go up and down upon the mountains and weep for my virginity, I and my companions.

verses.name: Judges 11:38
verses.text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away <hi>for</hi> two months. And she went with her companions and wept for her virginity upon the mountains.

verses.name: Judges 11:39
verses.text: And it happened at the end of two months she returned to her father, who did to her his vow which he had vowed. And she knew no man. And it is a custom in Israel,

verses.name: Judges 11:40
verses.text: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to tell again of the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite, four days in a year.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:1
verses.text: And the men of Ephraim were called together and went northward, and said to Jephthah, Why did you go over to fight against the sons of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house upon you with fire.

verses.name: Judges 12:2
verses.text: And Jephthah said to them, My people and I were at great strife <hi>with</hi> the sons of Ammon. And when I called you, you did not deliver me out of their hands.

verses.name: Judges 12:3
verses.text: When I saw that you did not deliver me, I took my life in my hand and passed over against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand, and why have you come up against me, to fight against me today?

verses.name: Judges 12:4
verses.text: And Jephthah called up all the men of Gilead and fought with Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, You Gileadites <hi>are</hi> fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites.

verses.name: Judges 12:5
verses.text: And the Gileadites took the fords of Jordan before the Ephraimites. And it happened that when one of those Ephraimites who had escaped said, Let me go over, the men of Gilead said to him, Are you an Ephraimite? And he said, No.

verses.name: Judges 12:6
verses.text: And they said to him, Please say Shibboleth. And he said, Sibboleth, for he could not manage to pronounce <hi>it</hi> right. Then they took him and killed him at the passages of Jordan. And there fell at that time forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites.

verses.name: Judges 12:7
verses.text: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. And Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in <hi>one of</hi> the cities of Gilead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:8
verses.text: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

verses.name: Judges 12:9
verses.text: And he had thirty sons and thirty daughters <hi>whom</hi> he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

verses.name: Judges 12:10
verses.text: Then Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

verses.name: Judges 12:11
verses.text: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel. And he judged Israel ten years.

verses.name: Judges 12:12
verses.text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon, the land of Zebulun.

verses.name: Judges 12:13
verses.text: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

verses.name: Judges 12:14
verses.text: And he had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy ass colts. And he judged Israel eight years.

verses.name: Judges 12:15
verses.text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:1
verses.text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD delivered them into the hands of the Philistines forty years.

verses.name: Judges 13:2
verses.text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name <hi>was</hi> Manoah. And his wife was barren and did not bear.

verses.name: Judges 13:3
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, Behold now, you <hi>are</hi> barren and do not bear. But you shall conceive and bear a son.

verses.name: Judges 13:4
verses.text: And now, please take heed, and do not drink wine nor strong drink, and do not eat any unclean <hi>thing</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 13:5
verses.text: For lo, you shall conceive and bear a son. And no razor shall come upon his head. For the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb. And he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: Judges 13:6
verses.text: And the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and His face <hi>was</hi> like the face of an Angel of God, very terrifying. But I did not ask Him where He came from, neither did He tell me His name.

verses.name: Judges 13:7
verses.text: But He said to me, Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. And now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean <hi>thing</hi>, for the boy shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:8
verses.text: And Manoah prayed to the LORD and said, O, my Lord, let the Man of God, whom You sent, come again to us and teach us what we shall do to the boy that shall be born.

verses.name: Judges 13:9
verses.text: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the Angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field. But Manoah her husband <hi>was</hi> not with her.

verses.name: Judges 13:10
verses.text: And the woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, and said to him, Behold, the Man has appeared to Me, the one who came to me the <hi>other</hi> day.

verses.name: Judges 13:11
verses.text: And Manoah arose and went after his wife, and came to the Man, and said to Him, <hi>Are</hi> You the Man who spoke to the woman? And He said, I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 13:12
verses.text: And Manoah said, Now let Your words come to pass. <hi>How</hi> shall we order the child, and what shall we do to him?

verses.name: Judges 13:13
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.

verses.name: Judges 13:14
verses.text: She may not eat of all that comes from the vine, neither let her drink wine nor strong drink, nor eat any unclean <hi>thing</hi>. Let her do all that I commanded her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:15
verses.text: And Manoah said to the Angel of the LORD, I pray You, let us keep You until we have made a kid ready for You.

verses.name: Judges 13:16
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Though you keep Me, I will not eat of your bread. And if you will offer a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD. For Manoah did not know that He <hi>was</hi> the Angel of the LORD.

verses.name: Judges 13:17
verses.text: And Manoah said to the Angel of the LORD, What <hi>is</hi> Your name, so that when Your sayings come to pass we may do You honor?

verses.name: Judges 13:18
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to him, Why do you ask after My name in this way? Yea, it <hi>is</hi> Wonderful.

verses.name: Judges 13:19
verses.text: And Manoah took a kid with a food offering, and offered <hi>it</hi> upon a rock to the LORD, and did wonderfully. And Manoah and his wife looked on.

verses.name: Judges 13:20
verses.text: For it happened when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, the Angel of the LORD went up in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on <hi>it</hi> and fell on their faces to. the ground.

verses.name: Judges 13:21
verses.text: But the Angel of the LORD did not appear any more to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that He <hi>was</hi> an Angel of the LORD.

verses.name: Judges 13:22
verses.text: And Manoah said to his wife, We shall surely die because we have seen God.

verses.name: Judges 13:23
verses.text: But his wife said to him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, He would not have received a burnt offering and a food offering at our hands, neither would He have showed us all these <hi>things</hi>, nor have told us <hi>such things</hi> as these at this time.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:24
verses.text: And the woman bore a son and called his name Samson. And the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

verses.name: Judges 13:25
verses.text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:1
verses.text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.name: Judges 14:2
verses.text: And he came up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines. And now get her for me for a wife.

verses.name: Judges 14:3
verses.text: And his father and his mother said to him, <hi>Is there</hi> no woman among the daughters of your brothers, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said to his father, Get her for me, for she pleases me very much.

verses.name: Judges 14:4
verses.text: But his father and his mother did not know that it <hi>was</hi> from the LORD, that He <hi>was</hi> looking for an occasion against the Philistines. For at that time the Philistines had the rule over Israel.

verses.name: Judges 14:5
verses.text: And Samson and his father and his mother went down to Timnath. And they came to the vineyards of Timnath. And, behold, a young lion roared to meet him.

verses.name: Judges 14:6
verses.text: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he tore it as he would have torn a kid; and nothing was in his hand. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.name: Judges 14:7
verses.text: And he went down and talked with the woman. And she pleased Samson very much.

verses.name: Judges 14:8
verses.text: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the dead body of the lion. And behold! A swarm of bees and honey <hi>was</hi> in the dead body of the lion.

verses.name: Judges 14:9
verses.text: And he took some of it in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother. And he gave to them, and they ate. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the dead body of the lion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:10
verses.text: And his father went down to the woman. And Samson made a feast there, for so the young men used to do.

verses.name: Judges 14:11
verses.text: And it happened when they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.name: Judges 14:12
verses.text: And Samson said to them, I will now put forth a riddle to you. If you certainly tell it to me <hi>within</hi> the seven days of the feast, and find <hi>it</hi> out, then I will give you thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments.

verses.name: Judges 14:13
verses.text: But if you cannot tell me, then you shall give me thirty linen blouses and thirty changes of garments. And they said to him, Put forth your riddle so that we may hear it.

verses.name: Judges 14:14
verses.text: And he said to them, Out of the eater came forth food, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And in three days they could not tell what the riddle.

verses.name: Judges 14:15
verses.text: And it happened on the seventh day they said to Samson's wife, Lure your husband so that he may tell the riddle to us, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire. Have you called us to take what we have? <hi>Is it</hi> not <hi> so</hi>?

verses.name: Judges 14:16
verses.text: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, You only hate me, and do not love <hi>me</hi>. You have put forth a riddle to the sons of my people, and have not told <hi>it</hi> to me. And he said to her, Behold, I have not told my father nor to my mother, and shall I tell you?

verses.name: Judges 14:17
verses.text: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted. And on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed hard upon him. And she told the riddle to the sons of her people.

verses.name: Judges 14:18
verses.text: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What <hi>is</hi> sweeter than honey, and what stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found <hi> out</hi> my riddle.

verses.name: Judges 14:19
verses.text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave changes of garments to them who told what the riddle meant. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

verses.name: Judges 14:20
verses.text: But Samson's wife was <hi>given</hi> to his companion, who had served as his friend.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:1
verses.text: And it happened afterward, in the days of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a kid. And <hi>he</hi> said, I will go in to my wife into the room. But her father would not allow him to go in.

verses.name: Judges 15:2
verses.text: And her father said, I truly thought that you utterly hated her, and I gave her to your companion. <hi>Is</hi> not her younger sister fairer than she is? Please, let her be for you instead of her.

verses.name: Judges 15:3
verses.text: And Samson said concerning them, Now I shall be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do evil with them.

verses.name: Judges 15:4
verses.text: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes and took fire brands, and turned tail to tail, and put a fire brand in the middle between two tails.

verses.name: Judges 15:5
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> set the brands on fire, he let <hi>them</hi> go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and also the standing grain, with the vineyards and olives.

verses.name: Judges 15:6
verses.text: And the Philistines said, Who has done this? And they answered, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.

verses.name: Judges 15:7
verses.text: And Samson said to them, Though you have done this, yet I will be avenged of you, and after that I will stop.

verses.name: Judges 15:8
verses.text: And he struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter. And he went down and lived in the top of the rock Etam.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:9
verses.text: And the Philistines went up and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

verses.name: Judges 15:10
verses.text: And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up against us? And they answered, We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.

verses.name: Judges 15:11
verses.text: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Do you not know that the Philistines <hi>are</hi> rulers over us? What have you done to us? And he said to them, As they have done to me, so I have done to them.

verses.name: Judges 15:12
verses.text: And they said to him, We have come to bind you so that we may deliver you into the hands of the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Swear to me that you will not fall upon me yourselves.

verses.name: Judges 15:13
verses.text: And they spoke to him, saying, No, but we will tie you up and deliver you into their hand. But surely we will not kill you. And they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the rock.

verses.name: Judges 15:14
verses.text: He came to Lehi, and the Philistines shouted against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords on his arms became as flax that has been burned with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

verses.name: Judges 15:15
verses.text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand and took it, and killed a thousand men with it.

verses.name: Judges 15:16
verses.text: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jawbone of an ass I have killed a thousand men.

verses.name: Judges 15:17
verses.text: And it happened when he had made an end of speaking, he threw away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Hill of the Jawbone.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:18
verses.text: And he was very thirsty and called upon the LORD and said, You have given this great deliverance into the hand of Your servant. And now shall I die with thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

verses.name: Judges 15:19
verses.text: But God cut open a hollow place and water came out there. And he drank, and his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore, its name <hi>is</hi> called Fountain of the Praying One, which is in Lehi to this day.

verses.name: Judges 15:20
verses.text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:1
verses.text: Then Samson went to Gaza. And he saw a harlot there, and went in to her.

verses.name: Judges 16:2
verses.text: The Gazites <hi>were told</hi>, saying, Samson has come here. And they surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, Until the light of the morning, then we shall kill him.

verses.name: Judges 16:3
verses.text: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took hold of the leaves of the gate of the city and the two posts, and picked them up, with the bar, and put <hi>them</hi> on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of a hill that <hi>is</hi> before Hebron.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:4
verses.text: And it happened afterwards, he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name <hi>was</hi> Delilah.

verses.name: Judges 16:5
verses.text: And the lords of the Philistines came up to her, and said to her, Lure him and see where his great strength <hi>lies</hi>, and by what means we may prevail against him, so that we may tie him to afflict him. And each one of us will give you eleven hundred pieces <hi>of</hi> silver.

verses.name: Judges 16:6
verses.text: And Delilah said to Samson, Please tell me where your great strength <hi>lies</hi>, and with what you may be bound to afflict you.

verses.name: Judges 16:7
verses.text: And Samson said to her, If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then I shall be weak and be as another man.

verses.name: Judges 16:8
verses.text: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

verses.name: Judges 16:9
verses.text: And the ambush <hi>was</hi> sitting for her in the inner room. And she said to him, The Philistines <hi>are</hi> upon you, Samson! And he broke the cords like a thread of tow when it smells fire. And his strength was not known.

verses.name: Judges 16:10
verses.text: And Delilah said to Samson, Behold, you have mocked me and told me lies. Now, please, tell me with what you may be bound.

verses.name: Judges 16:11
verses.text: And he said to her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that have never been used, then I shall be weak and be as another man.

verses.name: Judges 16:12
verses.text: And Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, and said to him, The Philistines <hi>are</hi> upon you, Samson! And the ambush <hi>was</hi> sitting for her in the inner room. And he broke them from off his arms like a thread.

verses.name: Judges 16:13
verses.text: And Delilah said to Samson, You have mocked me until now, and told me lies. Tell me with what you may be bound. And he said to her, If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web.

verses.name: Judges 16:14
verses.text: And she fastened <hi>it</hi> with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines are upon you, Samson! And He awakened out of his sleep, and pulled out the pin, the hand-loom and the web.

verses.name: Judges 16:15
verses.text: And she said to him, How can you say, I love you, and your heart <hi>is</hi> not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me in what your great strength <hi>lies</hi>.

verses.name: Judges 16:16
verses.text: And it happened because she distressed him with her words daily, and urged him; and his soul was grieved to death.

verses.name: Judges 16:17
verses.text: And he told her all his heart, and said to her, A razor has not come on my hair, for I <hi>am</hi> a Nazirite to God from my mother's womb. If I am shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I will become weak and be like any man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:18
verses.text: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come this once, for he has showed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her, and brought silver in their hand.

verses.name: Judges 16:19
verses.text: And she made him sleep upon her knees. And she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head. And she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:20
verses.text: And she said, The Philistines <hi>are</hi> upon you, Samson! And he awoke out of his sleep and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he did not know that the LORD had departed from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:21
verses.text: And the Philistines took him and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass. And he ground in the prison house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:22
verses.text: However the hair of his head began to grow again after he had been shaven.

verses.name: Judges 16:23
verses.text: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered in order to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice. For they said, Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

verses.name: Judges 16:24
verses.text: And the people saw him and praised their god. For they said, Our god has delivered our enemy into our hand, and the destroyer of our country, who killed many of us.

verses.name: Judges 16:25
verses.text: And when their hearts were merry, it happened that they said, Call for Samson and he will make sport for us. And they called for Samson out of the prison house. And he made sport for them, and they set him between the pillars.

verses.name: Judges 16:26
verses.text: And Samson said to the lad who held him by the hand, Allow me to feel the pillars upon which the house stands, so that I may lean upon them.

verses.name: Judges 16:27
verses.text: Now the house was full of men and women. And all the lords of the Philistines <hi>were</hi> there. And on the roof were about three thousand men and women who watched while Samson made sport.

verses.name: Judges 16:28
verses.text: And Samson called to the LORD and said, O, Lord GOD, remember me, I pray You, and strengthen me, I pray You, only this once, O God, so that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

verses.name: Judges 16:29
verses.text: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was held up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

verses.name: Judges 16:30
verses.text: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself mightily, and the house fell upon the lords and upon all the people in it. So the dead whom he killed at his death <hi>were</hi> more than those he killed in his life.

verses.name: Judges 16:31
verses.text: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought <hi>him</hi> up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burying-place of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 17:1
verses.text: And there was a man of Mount Ephraim, and his name <hi>was</hi> Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:2
verses.text: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred <hi>shekels</hi> of silver which were taken from you, about which you cursed, and spoke of also in my ears, behold, the silver <hi>is</hi> with me. Behold, I took it. And his mother said, Be blessed of the LORD, my son.

verses.name: Judges 17:3
verses.text: And when he had given back the eleven hundred of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly given the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son to make a graven image and a molten image. And now I am giving it to you.

verses.name: Judges 17:4
verses.text: And he gave the money back to his mother. And his mother took two hundred <hi>shekels</hi> of silver and gave them to a refiner, who made of it an engraved image and a molten image. And they were in the house of Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:5
verses.text: And the man Micah had a house of gods, and made an ephod and household gods, and anointed one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.name: Judges 17:6
verses.text: In those days <hi>there was</hi> no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his eyes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 17:7
verses.text: And there was a young man out of Bethlehem-judah of the family of Judah, and he <hi>was</hi> a Levite. And he stayed there.

verses.name: Judges 17:8
verses.text: And the man went out of the city from Bethlehem-judah to live where he could find <hi>a place</hi>. And he came to Mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

verses.name: Judges 17:9
verses.text: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I <hi>am</hi> a Levite of Bethlehem-judah, and I go to live where I may find a place.

verses.name: Judges 17:10
verses.text: And Micah said to him, Live with me and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten <hi>shekels</hi> of silver by the year, and a suit of clothes, and your food. And the Levite went in.

verses.name: Judges 17:11
verses.text: And the Levite was content to live with the man, and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

verses.name: Judges 17:12
verses.text: And Micah consecrated the Levite. And the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

verses.name: Judges 17:13
verses.text: Then Micah said, Now I know that the LORD will do me good, since I have a Levite as <hi>my</hi> priest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:1
verses.text: In those days no king <hi>was</hi> in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the Danites looked for an inheritance for them to live in. For to that day it had not fallen to them by inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 18:2
verses.text: And the sons of Dan sent from their family five men from their borders, men of war, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. And they said to them, Go, search the land. And when they came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, they stayed there.

verses.name: Judges 18:3
verses.text: When they <hi>were</hi> at the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite. And they turned in there, and said to him, Who brought you here? And what are you doing in this <hi>place</hi>? And what have you here?

verses.name: Judges 18:4
verses.text: And he said to them, This is how Micah deals with me, and has hired me, and I am his priest.

verses.name: Judges 18:5
verses.text: And they said to him, We pray you, Ask counsel of God so that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

verses.name: Judges 18:6
verses.text: And the priest said to them, Go in peace. Your way in which you go <hi>is</hi> before the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:7
verses.text: And the five men departed and came to Laish, and saw the people in it, how they lived carelessly, as the Sidonians do, quiet and secure. And there <hi>was</hi> no judge in the land who might put them to shame in a thing. And they were far from the Sidonians, and had no business with <hi>any</hi> man.

verses.name: Judges 18:8
verses.text: And they came to their brothers, to Zorah and Eshtaol. And their brothers said to them, What do you <hi>say</hi>?

verses.name: Judges 18:9
verses.text: And they said, Arise, so that we may go up against them. For we have seen the land, and, behold, <hi>it is</hi> very good. And will you sit quietly? Do not be too lazy to go; enter to possess the land.

verses.name: Judges 18:10
verses.text: When you go, you shall come to a people feeling safe, and to a large land. For God has given it into your hands, a place where <hi>there is</hi> no lack of anything in the earth.

verses.name: Judges 18:11
verses.text: And six hundred men of the family of the Danites moved from there, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, girded with weapons of war.

verses.name: Judges 18:12
verses.text: And they went up and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah. Therefore, they called that place A Camp of Dan to this day. Behold, <hi>it is</hi> behind Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: Judges 18:13
verses.text: And they passed from there to mount Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:14
verses.text: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, Did you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and household gods, and an engraved image and a molten image? And now consider what you have to do.

verses.name: Judges 18:15
verses.text: And they turned in that way, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, to the house of Micah, and greeted him.

verses.name: Judges 18:16
verses.text: And the six hundred men of the sons of Dan, girded with their weapons of war, stood by the entrance of the gate.

verses.name: Judges 18:17
verses.text: And the five men who went up to spy out the land came in there, and took the engraved image and the ephod and the household gods, and the molten image. And the priest stood the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men who <hi> were</hi> dressed with weapons of war.

verses.name: Judges 18:18
verses.text: And these went into Micah's house and brought out <hi>the</hi> carved image, the ephod, and the household gods, and the molten image. And the priest said to them, What are you doing?

verses.name: Judges 18:19
verses.text: And they said to him, Be quiet, lay your hand on your mouth and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest. <hi>Is it</hi> better for you to be a priest to the house of one man, or that you be a priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?

verses.name: Judges 18:20
verses.text: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the household gods, and the carved image, and went in the midst of the people.

verses.name: Judges 18:21
verses.text: And they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the valuables before them.

verses.name: Judges 18:22
verses.text: They had gone far away from the house of Micah, and the men in the houses near Micah's house had been called together and had overtaken the sons of Dan.

verses.name: Judges 18:23
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> cried to the sons of Dan. And they turned their faces and said to Micah, What <hi>ails</hi> you, that you have been called together?

verses.name: Judges 18:24
verses.text: And he said, You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you have gone away. And what more do I have? And what <hi>is</hi> this you say to me, What <hi>ails</hi> you?

verses.name: Judges 18:25
verses.text: And the sons of Dan said to him, Do not let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon you and you lose your life with the lives of your household.

verses.name: Judges 18:26
verses.text: And the sons of Dan went their way. And when Micah saw that they <hi>were</hi> too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:27
verses.text: And they took <hi>the things</hi> which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and feeling safe. And <hi>they</hi> struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.

verses.name: Judges 18:28
verses.text: And <hi>there was</hi> no deliverer, because it <hi>was</hi> far from Sidon, and they had no business with <hi>any</hi> man. And it <hi>was</hi> in the valley that lies by Beth-rehob. And they built a city and lived in it.

verses.name: Judges 18:29
verses.text: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel. However the name of the city <hi>was</hi> Laish at the first.

verses.name: Judges 18:30
verses.text: And the sons of Dan set up the engraved image. And Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

verses.name: Judges 18:31
verses.text: And they set up Micah's engraved image for themselves, the image which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 19:1
verses.text: And it happened in those days, no king being in Israel, there was a certain Levite residing on the far side of Mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehem-judah.

verses.name: Judges 19:2
verses.text: And his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him to her father's house to Bethlehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

verses.name: Judges 19:3
verses.text: And her husband arose and went after her, to speak friendly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of asses. And she brought him into her father's house. And when the father of the girl saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

verses.name: Judges 19:4
verses.text: And his father-in-law, the girl's father, kept him. And he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank and stayed there.

verses.name: Judges 19:5
verses.text: And it happened on the fourth day when they arose early in the morning, he rose up to leave. And the girl's father said to his son-in-law, Comfort your heart <hi>with</hi> a piece of bread, and afterward go your way.

verses.name: Judges 19:6
verses.text: And they sat down and ate and drank, both of them together, for the girl's father had said to the man, Please be content, and stay all night, and let your heart be merry.

verses.name: Judges 19:7
verses.text: And when the man rose up to leave, his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

verses.name: Judges 19:8
verses.text: And he rose early in the morning on the fifth day to leave. And the girl's father said, Please comfort your heart. And they stayed till afternoon, and both of them ate.

verses.name: Judges 19:9
verses.text: And when the man rose up to leave, he and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the girl's father said to him, Behold, now the day draws toward evening. Please stay all night. Behold, the day grows to an end. Stay here so that your heart may be merry. And tomorrow go early on your way, so that you may go to your tent.

verses.name: Judges 19:10
verses.text: But the man would not stay that night, but he rose up and left, and came over against Jebus, which <hi>is</hi> Jerusalem. And there were with him two saddled asses. His concubine also was with him.

verses.name: Judges 19:11
verses.text: They <hi>were</hi> beside Jebus, and the day was far gone. And the servant said to his master, Please come, and let us turn in to this city of the Jebusites and stay in it.

verses.name: Judges 19:12
verses.text: And his master said to him, We will not turn aside here into the city of a stranger that <hi>is</hi> not of the sons of Israel. We will pass over to Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 19:13
verses.text: And he said to his servant, Come and let us draw near one of these places to stay all night, in Gibeah or in Ramah.

verses.name: Judges 19:14
verses.text: And they passed on and went their way. And the sun went <hi>down</hi> on them beside Gibeah, which <hi>is</hi> of Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 19:15
verses.text: And they turned aside there, to go in <hi>and</hi> to lodge in Gibeah. And he went in and sat down in a street of the city. For no man took them into his house to stay the night.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 19:16
verses.text: And behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at evening, who <hi>was</hi> also from mount Ephraim. And he lived in Gibeah, but the men of the place <hi>were</hi> of Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 19:17
verses.text: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a traveler in the streets of the city. And the old man said, Where do you go, and where do you come from?

verses.name: Judges 19:18
verses.text: And he said to him, We <hi>are</hi> passing from Bethlehem-judah to the side of mount Ephraim. I <hi>am</hi> from there, and I went to Bethlehem-judah, but I am going to the house of the LORD. And there is no man who receives me into his house.

verses.name: Judges 19:19
verses.text: Yet here is both straw and food for our asses. And there is bread and wine also for me, and for your slave woman, and for the young man <hi>who is</hi> with your servants. There is no lack of anything.

verses.name: Judges 19:20
verses.text: And the old man said, Peace <hi>be</hi> with you. Yet all that you lack <hi>shall be</hi> on me. Only do not stay in the street.

verses.name: Judges 19:21
verses.text: And he brought him into his house and mixed <hi>fodder</hi> for the asses. And they washed their feet, and ate and drank.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 19:22
verses.text: They were making their hearts merry. And, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, set upon the house all around <hi>and</hi> beat at the door and spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring out the man that came to your house so that we may know him.

verses.name: Judges 19:23
verses.text: And the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, No, my brothers, I pray you, do not do evil, since this man has come into my house. Do not do this foolish sin.

verses.name: Judges 19:24
verses.text: Behold, my daughter, a virgin, and his concubine. I will bring them out now, and you humble them and do with them what seems good to you. But do not do so vile a thing to this man.

verses.name: Judges 19:25
verses.text: But the men would not listen to him. And the man took his concubine and brought <hi>her</hi> out to them. And they knew her and rolled themselves on her all night until the morning. And they sent her away at the dawning of the day.

verses.name: Judges 19:26
verses.text: And the woman came, in the dawning of the day, and fell down <hi>at</hi> the door of the man's house where her lord <hi>was</hi>, until it was light.

verses.name: Judges 19:27
verses.text: And her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house and went out to go his way. And behold, the woman, his concubine, had fallen down <hi>at</hi> the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

verses.name: Judges 19:28
verses.text: And he said to her, Up, and let us be going. But there was no answer. Then the man took her on an ass, and the man rose up and went to his place.

verses.name: Judges 19:29
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> came into his house, <hi>he</hi> took a knife and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, with her bones, into twelve pieces and sent her into all the borders of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 19:30
verses.text: And it was so that all that saw <hi>it</hi> said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the sons of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day. Think of it, take advice and speak.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:1
verses.text: Then all the sons of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, to the LORD in Mizpeh.

verses.name: Judges 20:2
verses.text: And the leader of all the people, of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:3
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to Mizpeh. And the sons of Israel said, Speak. How did this evil happen?

verses.name: Judges 20:4
verses.text: And the Levite, the husband of the woman who was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah of Benjamin to stay the night, my concubine and I.

verses.name: Judges 20:5
verses.text: And the men of Gibeah rose against me and set upon the house all around me at night. They intended to kill me. And they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

verses.name: Judges 20:6
verses.text: And I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the land of the inheritance of Israel. For they have committed evil and folly in Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:7
verses.text: Behold, you <hi>are</hi> all sons of Israel. Give here your advice and counsel.

verses.name: Judges 20:8
verses.text: And all people rose as one man, saying, Let no man go to his tent, and do not let any of us turn to his house.

verses.name: Judges 20:9
verses.text: And now this <hi>is</hi> the thing which we will do to Gibeah, <hi>going</hi> against it by lot.

verses.name: Judges 20:10
verses.text: and we will take ten men of a hundred of all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to bring food for the people, so that when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, they may do according to all the folly which they have done in Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:11
verses.text: And every man of Israel was gathered against the city, all together as one man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:12
verses.text: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin saying, What wickedness <hi>is</hi> this that is done among you?

verses.name: Judges 20:13
verses.text: Now, therefore, deliver the men, the sons of Belial, who <hi>are</hi> in Gibeah, so that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel. But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:14
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin gathered out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:15
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin were numbered on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

verses.name: Judges 20:16
verses.text: Among all this people <hi>were</hi> seven hundred chosen men, left-handed. Every one could sling stones at a hair's breadth, and not miss.

verses.name: Judges 20:17
verses.text: And the men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these <hi>were</hi> men of war.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:18
verses.text: And the sons of Israel rose and went up to the house of God and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us <hi>shall go up</hi> first to the battle against the sons of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah first.

verses.name: Judges 20:19
verses.text: And the sons of Israel rose up early in the morning, and camped against Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:20
verses.text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin. And the men of Israel put themselves in order, ready to fight against them at Gibeah

verses.name: Judges 20:21
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah and destroyed to the earth twenty-two thousand men of the Israelites that day.

verses.name: Judges 20:22
verses.text: And the people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves and set their battle in order again in the place where they put themselves in order the first day.

verses.name: Judges 20:23
verses.text: And the sons of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and asked counsel from the LORD saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the sons of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.

verses.name: Judges 20:24
verses.text: And the sons of Israel came near against the sons of Benjamin the second day.

verses.name: Judges 20:25
verses.text: And Benjamin went forth to meet them again from Gibeah the second day and again destroyed to the earth eighteen thousand men of the sons of Israel. All these drew the sword.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:26
verses.text: And all the sons of Israel, and all the people, went up and came into the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD and fasted that day until evening, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

verses.name: Judges 20:27
verses.text: And the sons of Israel inquired of the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God <hi>was</hi> there in those days,

verses.name: Judges 20:28
verses.text: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the sons of Benjamin my brother, or shall I stop? And the LORD said, Go up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand.

verses.name: Judges 20:29
verses.text: And Israel set ambushers all around Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:30
verses.text: And the sons of Israel went up against the sons of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in order against Gibeah, as at other times.

verses.name: Judges 20:31
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin went out against the people, <hi>and</hi> were drawn away from the city. <hi>And they</hi> began to strike some of the people and to kill, as at other times, in the highways-- one of which goes up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field-- about thirty men of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 20:32
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin said, They <hi>are</hi> beaten before us as at the first. But the sons of Israel said, Let us flee and draw them from the city to the highways.

verses.name: Judges 20:33
verses.text: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place and marshalled at Baal-tamar. And the ambush of Israel broke forth from their place, from the plains of Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:34
verses.text: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was heavy. But they did not know that evil <hi>was</hi> near them.

verses.name: Judges 20:35
verses.text: And the LORD struck Benjamin before Israel. And the sons of Israel destroyed in Benjamin twenty-five thousand and a hundred men that day. All these drew the sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:36
verses.text: So the sons of Benjamin saw that they were beaten. For the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin because they trusted to the ambush which they had set against Gibeah.

verses.name: Judges 20:37
verses.text: And the ambush hurried and rushed against Gibeah. And the ambush marched and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: Judges 20:38
verses.text: And a sign was set between the men of Israel and the ambush, caused go up a great smoke rising up from the city.

verses.name: Judges 20:39
verses.text: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to strike <hi>and</hi> kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons. For they said, Surely they are stricken down before us as <hi>in</hi> the first battle.

verses.name: Judges 20:40
verses.text: And the rising of a pillar <hi>of smoke</hi> began to go up out of the city. And Benjamin turned behind them, and behold, the whole city had gone up toward the heavens.

verses.name: Judges 20:41
verses.text: And the men of Israel turned again, and the men of Benjamin were amazed. For they saw that evil had touched them.

verses.name: Judges 20:42
verses.text: And they turned before the men of Israel, to the way of the wilderness. But the battle overtook them. And those who <hi>came</hi> out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:43
verses.text: They encircled Benjamin <hi>and</hi> they chased them without rest, <hi>and</hi> trod them down until <hi>they were</hi> against Gibeah toward the sunrise.

verses.name: Judges 20:44
verses.text: And there fell from Benjamin eighteen thousand. All these <hi>were</hi> men of war.

verses.name: Judges 20:45
verses.text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. And they gleaned of <hi>them</hi> in the highways five thousand men, and pursued hard after them to Gidom and killed two thousand men of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:46
verses.text: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All of these <hi>were</hi> men of war.

verses.name: Judges 20:47
verses.text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the rock Rimmon, and they stayed in the rock Rimmon four months.

verses.name: Judges 20:48
verses.text: And the sons of Israel turned again to the sons of Benjamin and struck them with the edge of the sword, from the entire city to livestock, to all that was found. Also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 21:1
verses.text: And the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, Not one of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin for a wife.

verses.name: Judges 21:2
verses.text: And the people came to the house of God and stayed there until evening before God, and lifted up their voice and wept grievously,

verses.name: Judges 21:3
verses.text: and said, O, LORD God of Israel, Why has this happened in Israel, that there should be today one tribe lacking in Israel?

verses.name: Judges 21:4
verses.text: And it happened on the next day the people rose early and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.name: Judges 21:5
verses.text: And the sons of Israel said, Who <hi>is there</hi> among all the tribes of Israel that did not come up with the congregation to the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him who did not come up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

verses.name: Judges 21:6
verses.text: And the sons of Israel repented themselves for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

verses.name: Judges 21:7
verses.text: What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters for wives?

verses.name: Judges 21:8
verses.text: And they said, What one <hi>is there</hi> of the tribes of Israel that did not come up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

verses.name: Judges 21:9
verses.text: For the people were numbered, and behold, none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead <hi>were there.</hi>

verses.name: Judges 21:10
verses.text: And the congregation sent there twelve thousand men of the most valiant, and commanded them, saying, Go, and you shall strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the sword, with the women and the sons.

verses.name: Judges 21:11
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the thing that you shall do. You shall utterly destroy every male and every woman who has lain with man.

verses.name: Judges 21:12
verses.text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had known no man by lying with any male. And they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which <hi>is</hi> in the land of Canaan.

verses.name: Judges 21:13
verses.text: And the whole congregation sent to speak to the sons of Benjamin who were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably to them.

verses.name: Judges 21:14
verses.text: And Benjamin came again at that time. And they gave them wives whom they had saved alive, of the women of Jabesh-gilead. And yet so they were not enough for them.

verses.name: Judges 21:15
verses.text: And the people repented themselves for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a break in the tribes of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 21:16
verses.text: And the elders of the congregation said, What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

verses.name: Judges 21:17
verses.text: And they said, <hi>There must be</hi> an inheritance for those of Benjamin who have escaped, so that a tribe may not be destroyed out of Israel.

verses.name: Judges 21:18
verses.text: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters. For the sons of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who gives a wife to Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 21:19
verses.text: Then they said, Behold, <hi>there is</hi> a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.name: Judges 21:20
verses.text: And they commanded the sons of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

verses.name: Judges 21:21
verses.text: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then you come out of the vineyards and catch you a wife for every man from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.name: Judges 21:22
verses.text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to us to complain, we will say to them, Be favorable to them for our sakes, because we did not reserve each man a wife in the war. For if you did not give to them at this time, you would be guilty.

verses.name: Judges 21:23
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin did so, and took wives according to their number, from those that danced, whom they caught. And they went and returned to their inheritance, and repaired the cities and lived in them.

verses.name: Judges 21:24
verses.text: And the sons of Israel departed from there at that time, each man to his tribe and to his family. And they went out from there every man to his inheritance.

verses.name: Judges 21:25
verses.text: In those days <hi>there was</hi> no king in Israel. Every man did the right in his own eyes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:1
verses.text: And it happened in the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehem-judah went to live in the country of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.

verses.name: Ruth 1:2
verses.text: And the name of the man <hi>was</hi> Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem-judah. And they came to the fields of Moab and stayed there.

verses.name: Ruth 1:3
verses.text: And Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died. And she was left, and her two sons.

verses.name: Ruth 1:4
verses.text: And they took wives for themselves from the women of Moab. The name of the one <hi>was</hi> Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth. And they lived there about ten years.

verses.name: Ruth 1:5
verses.text: And Mahlon and Chilion also died, both of them. And the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:6
verses.text: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law so that she might return from the fields of Moab. For she had heard in the fields of Moab how the LORD had visited His people in giving them bread.

verses.name: Ruth 1:7
verses.text: And she went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her, and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

verses.name: Ruth 1:8
verses.text: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, Go, return each one to her mother's house. May the LORD deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:9
verses.text: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest, each in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voice and wept.

verses.name: Ruth 1:10
verses.text: And they said to her, Surely we will return with you to your people.

verses.name: Ruth 1:11
verses.text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters. Why will you go with me? <hi>Are</hi> there yet sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

verses.name: Ruth 1:12
verses.text: Turn again, my daughters, go. For I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, I have hope, <hi>if</hi> I should have a husband also tonight, and should also bear sons,

verses.name: Ruth 1:13
verses.text: would you wait for them until they were grown? Will you shut yourselves up, not to have a husband? No, my daughters, for it makes me very sad for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:14
verses.text: And they lifted up their voice and wept again. And Orpah kissed her mother-in-law. But Ruth clung to her.

verses.name: Ruth 1:15
verses.text: And she said, Behold, Your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods. Return after your sister-in-law.

verses.name: Ruth 1:16
verses.text: And Ruth said, Do not beg me to leave you, to return from following after you. For where you go, I will go. Where you stay, I will stay. Your people <hi>shall be</hi> my people, and your God my God.

verses.name: Ruth 1:17
verses.text: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD do so to me, and more also, <hi>if anything</hi> but death parts you and me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:18
verses.text: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, then she quit speaking to her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:19
verses.text: And both of them went until they came to Bethlehem. And it happened when they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was moved about them, and they said, <hi>Is</hi> this Naomi?

verses.name: Ruth 1:20
verses.text: And she said to them, Do not call me Naomi, call me Mara. For the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:21
verses.text: I went out full, and the LORD has brought me back empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?

verses.name: Ruth 1:22
verses.text: And Naomi returned; and Ruth, who was of Moab, her daughter-in-law, was with her, returning out of the fields of Moab. And they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:1
verses.text: And Naomi <hi>had</hi> a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech. And his name <hi>was</hi> Boaz.

verses.name: Ruth 2:2
verses.text: And Ruth of Moab said to Naomi, Let me now go to the field and glean ears of grain after <hi>him</hi> in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said to her, Go, my daughter.

verses.name: Ruth 2:3
verses.text: And she went. And she came and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And she happened to come upon a part of the field of Boaz, who <hi>was</hi> of the kindred of Elimelech.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:4
verses.text: And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem and said to the reapers, The LORD <hi>be</hi> with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless you.

verses.name: Ruth 2:5
verses.text: And Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, Whose girl <hi>is</hi> this?

verses.name: Ruth 2:6
verses.text: And the servant who was set over the reapers answered and said, It <hi>is</hi> the girl from Moab who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

verses.name: Ruth 2:7
verses.text: And she said, Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves. And she came, and has kept on from the morning until now, but that she stayed a little in the house.

verses.name: Ruth 2:8
verses.text: And Boaz said to Ruth, Do you not hear, my daughter? Do not go to glean in another field, neither go away from here, but stay here close by my maidens.

verses.name: Ruth 2:9
verses.text: <hi> Let</hi> your eyes <hi>be</hi> on the field that they reap, and go after them. Have I not commanded the young men that they shall not touch you? And when you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

verses.name: Ruth 2:10
verses.text: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, Why have I found grace in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, since I <hi>am</hi> a stranger?

verses.name: Ruth 2:11
verses.text: And Boaz answered and said to her, It has been fully shown to me all that you have done to your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, And you left your father and your mother and the land of your birth, and have come to a people whom you did not know before now.

verses.name: Ruth 2:12
verses.text: May the LORD repay your work, and may a full reward be given you from the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to trust.

verses.name: Ruth 2:13
verses.text: Then she said, Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, for you have comforted me; for you have spoken kindly to your handmaid, though I am not like one of your handmaidens.

verses.name: Ruth 2:14
verses.text: And Boaz said to her, At mealtime come here and eat of the bread and dip your bit in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers. And he handed her roasted <hi>grain</hi>, and she ate and was satisfied, and left.

verses.name: Ruth 2:15
verses.text: And when she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not rebuke her.

verses.name: Ruth 2:16
verses.text: And also let fall of the handfuls on purpose for her, and leave them so that she may glean <hi>them</hi>, and do not rebuke her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:17
verses.text: And she gleaned in the field until the evening, and beat out what she had gleaned. And it was about an ephah of barley.

verses.name: Ruth 2:18
verses.text: And she took <hi>it</hi> up and went into the city. And her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And she brought it forth, and gave to her what she had kept after she was satisfied.

verses.name: Ruth 2:19
verses.text: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where have you gleaned today? And where did you work? Blessed is he who took notice of you. And she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, and said, The man's name with whom I worked today <hi>is</hi> Boaz.

verses.name: Ruth 2:20
verses.text: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, Blessed <hi>is</hi> he of the LORD, who has not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said to her, The man <hi>is</hi> near of kin to us, he is of our redeemers.

verses.name: Ruth 2:21
verses.text: And Ruth of Moab said, He said to me also, You shall keep close by my young men whom I have until they have ended all my harvest.

verses.name: Ruth 2:22
verses.text: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, Good, my daughter. You go out with his maidens so that they do not fall upon you in any other field.

verses.name: Ruth 2:23
verses.text: And she kept close by the maidens of Boaz to glean until the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest. And she lived with her mother-in-law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:1
verses.text: And her mother-in-law Naomi said to her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you so that it may be well with you?

verses.name: Ruth 3:2
verses.text: And now <hi>is</hi> not Boaz of our kindred, he with whose maidens you were? Behold, he winnows barley tonight in the threshing-floor.

verses.name: Ruth 3:3
verses.text: Therefore wash yourself, and anoint yourself, and put your clothing upon you, and go down to the floor. Do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

verses.name: Ruth 3:4
verses.text: And when he lies down, you mark the place where he lies, and you shall go in and uncover his feet and lie down. And he will tell you what you shall do.

verses.name: Ruth 3:5
verses.text: And she said to her, All that you say, I will do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:6
verses.text: And she went down to the grain floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law had told her.

verses.name: Ruth 3:7
verses.text: And when Boaz had eaten and had drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap. And she came softly and uncovered his feet, and lay down.

verses.name: Ruth 3:8
verses.text: And it happened at midnight, the man trembled and turned himself. And, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

verses.name: Ruth 3:9
verses.text: And he said, Who <hi>are</hi> you? And she answered, I <hi>am</hi> your handmaid Ruth. And you shall spread your skirt over your handmaid, for you <hi>are</hi> a kinsman-redeemer.

verses.name: Ruth 3:10
verses.text: And He said, Blessed <hi>be</hi> you of the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, in that you did not follow young men, whether poor or rich.

verses.name: Ruth 3:11
verses.text: And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do to you all that you ask. For all the city of my people knows that you <hi>are</hi> a woman of virtue.

verses.name: Ruth 3:12
verses.text: And now it is true that I <hi>am</hi> your kinsman-redeemer. But there is also a kinsman nearer than I.

verses.name: Ruth 3:13
verses.text: Stay tonight, and it shall be in the morning, if he will redeem you, well; he will redeem. And if he does not delight to redeem you, <hi>as</hi> the LORD lives, then I will redeem you. Lie down until the morning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:14
verses.text: And she lay at his feet until the morning. And she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Do not let it be known that a woman came to the floor.

verses.name: Ruth 3:15
verses.text: Also, he said, Bring the veil on you, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six <hi>measures</hi> of barley and laid it on her. And she went to the city.

verses.name: Ruth 3:16
verses.text: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, Who <hi>are</hi> you, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

verses.name: Ruth 3:17
verses.text: And she said, These six <hi>measures</hi> of barley he gave to me. For he said to me, Do not go empty to your mother-in-law.

verses.name: Ruth 3:18
verses.text: And she said, Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will fall. For the man will not rest until he has finished the thing today.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:1
verses.text: And Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. And behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. And he said, Such a one! Turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside and sat down.

verses.name: Ruth 4:2
verses.text: And he took ten men of the elders of the city and said, Come sit down here. And they sat down.

verses.name: Ruth 4:3
verses.text: And he said to the kinsman, Naomi, who has come again out of the country of Moab, sells a parcel of land which <hi>was</hi> our brother Elimelech's.

verses.name: Ruth 4:4
verses.text: And I said I will tell it in your ear, saying, Buy <hi>it</hi> before those who live here, and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem, redeem <hi>it</hi>. But if you will not redeem, tell me so that I may know. For there is none to redeem besides you. And I am after you. And he said, I will redeem.

verses.name: Ruth 4:5
verses.text: And Boaz said, In the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy also from the hand of Ruth of Moab, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

verses.name: Ruth 4:6
verses.text: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance. You redeem my right to yourself, for I cannot redeem.

verses.name: Ruth 4:7
verses.text: And this <hi>was the custom</hi> in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, to confirm everything. A man plucked off his sandal and gave it to his neighbor. And this was a testimony in Israel.

verses.name: Ruth 4:8
