verses.text: Therefore the kinsman said to Boaz, Buy <hi>it</hi> for yourself. So he drew off his sandal.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:9
verses.text: And Boaz said to the elders and all the people, You <hi>are</hi> witnesses this day that I have bought all that <hi>was</hi> Elimelech's and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, from the hand of Naomi.

verses.name: Ruth 4:10
verses.text: And also Ruth of Moab, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, so that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You <hi>are</hi> witnesses this day.

verses.name: Ruth 4:11
verses.text: And all the people in the gate, and the elders, said, We <hi>are</hi> witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, for these two built the house of Israel. And may you be blessed in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

verses.name: Ruth 4:12
verses.text: And let your house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give you of this young woman.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:13
verses.text: And Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife. And when he went in to her, the LORD made her conceive. And she bore a son.

verses.name: Ruth 4:14
verses.text: And the women said to Naomi, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the LORD, who has not left you this day without a redeemer, so that his name may be famous in Israel.

verses.name: Ruth 4:15
verses.text: And he shall be to you as a restorer of life, and one who cheers your old age. For your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, she who is better to you than seven sons.

verses.name: Ruth 4:16
verses.text: And Naomi took the child and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse to it.

verses.name: Ruth 4:17
verses.text: And the women, her neighbors, gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi. And they called his name Obed. He <hi>is</hi> the father of Jesse, the father of David.

verses.name: Ruth 4:18
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the generations of Pharez. Pharez fathered Hezron,

verses.name: Ruth 4:19
verses.text: and Hezron fathered Ram, and Ram fathered Amminadab,

verses.name: Ruth 4:20
verses.text: and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon,

verses.name: Ruth 4:21
verses.text: and Salmon fathered Boaz, and Boaz fathered Obed,

verses.name: Ruth 4:22
verses.text: and Obed fathered Jesse, and Jesse fathered David.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:1
verses.text: And there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim from the hills of Ephraim, and his name <hi>was</hi> Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:2
verses.text: And he had two wives, the name of the one <hi>was</hi> Hannah, and the name of the second, Peninnah. And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:3
verses.text: And this man went up out of his city from year to year, to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, <hi>were</hi> there.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:4
verses.text: And the time came that Elkanah offered, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:5
verses.text: But to Hannah he gave one double portion, for he loved Hannah. But the LORD had shut up her womb.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:6
verses.text: And her foe also provoked her grievously, in order to make her tremble, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:7
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her. And she wept and did not eat.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:8
verses.text: And Elkanah her husband said to her, Hannah, why do you weep? And why do you not eat? And why is your heart grieved? <hi>Am</hi> I not better to you than ten sons?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:9
verses.text: And Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh and after they had drunk. And Eli the priest sat on the seat by the side post of the temple of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:10
verses.text: And she <hi>was</hi> in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept sorely.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:11
verses.text: And she vowed a vow and said, O, Lord of hosts, if You will indeed look upon the affliction of Your handmaid and remember me, and not forget Your handmaid, but will give to Your handmaid a man-child, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:12
verses.text: And it happened as she continued praying before the LORD, Eli noticed her mouth.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:13
verses.text: Now Hannah spoke in her heart, only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. And Eli thought she had become drunk.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:14
verses.text: And Eli said to her, How long will you be drunken? Put away your wine from you!

verses.name: I Samuel 1:15
verses.text: And Hannah answered, No, my lord, I <hi>am</hi> a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have neither drunk wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:16
verses.text: Do not count your handmaid for a daughter of wickedness, for out of the abundance of my meditation and grief I have spoken until now.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:17
verses.text: And Eli answered and said, Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant <hi>to you</hi> your petition that you have asked of Him.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:18
verses.text: And she said, Let your handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer <hi>sad</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:19
verses.text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshiped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the LORD remembered her.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:20
verses.text: And it happened when the time had come around, Hannah conceived and bore a son and called his name Samuel, <hi>saying</hi>, Because I have asked him of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:21
verses.text: And the man Elkanah and all his house went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:22
verses.text: But Hannah did not go up. For she said to her husband, Until the child is weaned, and then I will bring him so that he may appear before the LORD and stay there forever.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:23
verses.text: And Elkanah her husband said to her, Do what seems good to you. Stay until you have weaned him. Only may the LORD establish His word. So the woman stayed and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:24
verses.text: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls and one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh. And the child <hi>was</hi> young.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:25
verses.text: And they killed a bull, and brought the child to Eli.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:26
verses.text: And she said, O, my lord, <hi>as</hi> your soul lives, my lord, I <hi>am</hi> the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:27
verses.text: For this boy I was praying, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of Him.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:28
verses.text: And I have returned him to the LORD. As long as he lives, he shall be given to the LORD. And he worshiped the LORD there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:1
verses.text: And Hannah prayed and said, My heart rejoices in the LORD, my horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies because I rejoice in Your salvation.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:2
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> none holy as the LORD, for there is none beside You. Neither <hi>is there</hi> any rock like our God.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:3
verses.text: Talk no more so very proudly. Remove arrogance out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by Him actions are weighed.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:4
verses.text: The bows of the mighty <hi>are</hi> broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:5
verses.text: <hi> They that were</hi> full have hired themselves out for bread, and they that were hungry ceased; yea, while the barren has borne seven, and she who had many sons has languished.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:6
verses.text: The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol, and brings up.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:7
verses.text: The LORD takes away, and He gives riches; He brings low; yea, He lifts up high.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:8
verses.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust; He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to set <hi>them</hi> among princes; yea, He causes them to inherit a throne of honor; for to the LORD <hi>are</hi> the pillars of the earth; and He sets the habitable world on them.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:9
verses.text: He keeps the feet of his saints, and the wicked are silenced in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:10
verses.text: The foes of the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He thunders in the heavens upon them. The LORD shall judge the ends of the earth. And He shall give strength to His king, and exalts the horn of His anointed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:11
verses.text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child served the LORD before Eli the priest.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:12
verses.text: And the sons of Eli <hi>were</hi> sons of Belial. They did not know the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:13
verses.text: And the priests' custom with the people <hi>was</hi>: If any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came while the flesh was boiling, with a flesh-hook of three teeth in his hand.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:14
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> stuck <hi>it</hi> into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. All that the flesh-hook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites that came there.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:15
verses.text: Yea, before they burned the fat, the priest's servant came and said to the man who sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest. For he will not have boiled flesh from you, but raw!

verses.name: I Samuel 2:16
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> any man said to him, Let them not fail to burn the fat at once, and then take as your soul desires, then he would answer him, No! But you shall give now! And if not, I will take it by force.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:17
verses.text: And the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD. For men despised the offering of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:18
verses.text: And Samuel served before the LORD, a child girded <hi>with</hi> a linen ephod.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:19
verses.text: And his mother made him a little coat, and brought <hi>it</hi> to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:20
verses.text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, May the LORD give you seed of this woman for the loan which is loaned to the LORD. And they went to their own home.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:21
verses.text: And the LORD visited Hannah so that she conceived, and she bore three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:22
verses.text: And Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who gathered <hi>at</hi> the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:23
verses.text: And he said to them, Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings by all the people.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:24
verses.text: No, my sons, for <hi>it is</hi> no good report that I hear. You make the LORD's people to transgress.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:25
verses.text: If one man sins against another, the judge shall judge him. But if a man sins against the LORD, who shall plead for him? But they did not listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD desired to kill them.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:26
verses.text: And the child Samuel went on <hi>growing</hi> both in stature and in good <hi>looks</hi>, both with the LORD and also with men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:27
verses.text: And there came a man of God to Eli, and said to him, So says the LORD: Did I plainly appear to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:28
verses.text: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel <hi>to be</hi> My priest, to offer upon My altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before Me? And did I give to the house of your father all the offerings made by fire from the sons of Israel?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:29
verses.text: Why do you kick at My sacrifice and My offering, which I have commanded <hi>in My</hi> house? <hi>Do you</hi> honor your sons above Me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel My people?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:30
verses.text: And the LORD God of Israel says, I said indeed, Your house and the house of your father should walk before Me forever. But now the LORD says, Be it far from Me! For those who honor Me I will honor, and those that think little of Me shall be lightly regarded.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:31
verses.text: Behold, the days come when I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father's house, so that no old man shall be in your house.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:32
verses.text: And you shall see an adversary <hi>in My</hi> house, in all the good which he does with Israel. And there shall not be an old man in your house forever.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:33
verses.text: And that man of yours <hi>whom</hi> I shall not cut off from My altar, shall be left in order to make your eyes fail, and to grieve your heart. And all the increase of your house shall die <hi>young</hi> men.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:34
verses.text: And this <hi>shall be</hi> a sign to you, which shall come upon your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day both of them shall die.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:35
verses.text: And I will raise up a faithful priest to Myself, one who shall do according to what <hi>is</hi> in My heart and in My mind. And I will build him a sure house, and he shall walk before My anointed forever.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:36
verses.text: And it shall be that everyone who is left in your house shall come <hi>and</hi> bow down to him for a piece of silver and a piece of bread. And <hi>they</hi> shall say, Please put me into one of the priests' offices so that I may eat a piece of bread.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:1
verses.text: And the child Samuel served the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days. <hi>There was</hi> no open vision.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:2
verses.text: And it happened at that time, when Eli <hi>was</hi> lying down in his place, and his eyes began to become dim so that he could not see.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:3
verses.text: And the lamp of God had not gone out. And Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God <hi>was</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:4
verses.text: And the LORD called Samuel. And he answered, Here <hi>am</hi> I.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:5
verses.text: And he ran to Eli, and said, Here <hi>am</hi> I. For you called me. And he said, I did not call. Go and lie down again. And he went to lie down.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:6
verses.text: And the LORD called again, Samuel! And Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, Here <hi>am</hi> I, for you called me. And he answered, I did not call, my son. Go back, lie down.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:7
verses.text: And Samuel did not yet know the LORD, and the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:8
verses.text: And the LORD called Samuel again, the third time. And he arose and went to Eli and said, Here <hi>am</hi> I, for you called me. And Eli saw that the LORD had called the child.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:9
verses.text: And Eli said to Samuel, Go, lie down; and it shall be, if <hi>One</hi> calls you, you shall say, Speak, LORD, for Your servant hears. And Samuel went to lie down in his place.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:10
verses.text: And the LORD came and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel! Then Samuel answered, Speak, for Your servant hears.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it shall tingle.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:12
verses.text: In that day I will confirm to Eli all that which I have spoken as to his house, beginning and making an end.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:13
verses.text: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile and he did not restrain them.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:14
verses.text: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering forever.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:15
verses.text: And Samuel lay until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:16
verses.text: And Eli called Samuel and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here <hi>am</hi> I.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:17
verses.text: And he said, What <hi>is</hi> the word which He has said to you? Please do not hide <hi>it</hi> from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide a thing from me of all the words that He said to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:18
verses.text: And Samuel told him all the words, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It <hi>is</hi> the LORD; let Him do what seems good to Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:19
verses.text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:20
verses.text: And all Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel <hi>was</hi> established to be a prophet of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:21
verses.text: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh. For the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:1
verses.text: And the word of Samuel was <hi>revealed</hi> to all Israel. And Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Ebenezer. And the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:2
verses.text: And the Philistines put themselves in order against Israel. And the battle was joined. And Israel was beaten before the Philistines. And they killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:3
verses.text: And when the people had come to the camp, the elders of Israel said, Why has the LORD beaten us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh to us, so that when it comes among us it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:4
verses.text: And the people sent to Shiloh in order to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts from there, <hi>the ark</hi> which dwells <hi>between</hi> the cherubs. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:5
verses.text: And it happened when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:6
verses.text: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What is the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they saw that the ark of the LORD had come into the camp.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:7
verses.text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God has come into the camp, And they said, Woe to us! For there has not been a thing like this before.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:8
verses.text: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These <hi>are</hi> the gods that struck the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:9
verses.text: Be strong and fight like men, O, Philistines, so that you may not be servants to the Hebrews, <hi>as</hi> they have been to you. Be men and fight!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:10
verses.text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was beaten, and each one of them fled into his tent. And there was a very great slaughter, for there fell thirty thousand footmen of Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:11
verses.text: And the ark of God was taken. And Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were slain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:12
verses.text: And a man of Benjamin ran out of the army. And he came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes torn and with earth upon his head.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:13
verses.text: And he came in, and behold, Eli sat on a seat by the wayside watching. For his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city and told <hi>it</hi>, all the city cried out.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:14
verses.text: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What <hi>is</hi> the noise of this tumult? And the man hurried in and told Eli.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:15
verses.text: And Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were set so that he could not see.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:16
verses.text: And the man said to Eli, I <hi>am</hi> he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army. And he said, How did the matter go, my son?

verses.name: I Samuel 4:17
verses.text: And the messenger answered and said, Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people also. And also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:18
verses.text: And it happened when he spoke of the ark of God, he fell backward off the seat, by the side of the gate. And his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:19
verses.text: And his daughter-in-law, Phinehas' wife, was with child, ready to be delivered. And when she heard the report that the ark of God was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed, for her pains came upon her.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:20
verses.text: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said to her, Do not fear, for you have borne a son. But she did not answer, nor set her heart.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:21
verses.text: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory has departed from Israel, because the ark of God had been taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:22
verses.text: And she said, The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God is taken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:1
verses.text: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:2
verses.text: And the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it beside Dagon.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:3
verses.text: And when those of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon <hi>had</hi> fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon and set him in his place again.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:4
verses.text: And when they arose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon <hi>had</hi> fallen on his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And the head of Dagon, and both the palms of his hands, <hi>were</hi> cut off upon the threshold. Only the stump of Dagon was left to him.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:5
verses.text: And neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:6
verses.text: And the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and He destroyed them and struck them with hemorrhoids, Ashdod and its borders.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:7
verses.text: And the men of Ashdod saw that <hi>it was</hi> so. And they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us. For His hand is sore upon us and upon Dagon our god.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:8
verses.text: And they sent and gathered all the lords of the Philistines to them. And they said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried around to Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel around.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:9
verses.text: And it happened after they had carried it around, the hand of the LORD was against the city <hi>with</hi> a very great destruction. And He struck the men of the city, both small and great, and hemorrhoids broke forth in them.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:10
verses.text: And it happened that they sent the ark of God <hi>to</hi> Ekron. And it happened as the ark of God came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought around the ark of the God of Israel to us in order to kill us and our people.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:11
verses.text: And they sent and gathered all the lords of the Philistines, and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to its own place, so that it does not kill us and our people. For there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:12
verses.text: And the men that did not die were stricken with the hemorrhoids. And the cry of the city went up to the heavens.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:1
verses.text: And the ark of the LORD was in the field of the Philistines seven months.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:2
verses.text: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the LORD? Tell us with what we shall send with it to its place.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:3
verses.text: And they said, If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it empty. For you shall certainly send a guilt offering to him. Then you shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why His hand is not removed from you.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:4
verses.text: And they said, What <hi>shall be</hi> the guilt offering which we shall return to Him? And they answered, Five golden hemorrhoids, and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines. For one plague <hi>was</hi> on you all, and on your lords.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:5
verses.text: And you shall make images of your hemorrhoids, and images of your mice which mar the land. And you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps He will lighten His hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:6
verses.text: And why do you harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When He had worked wonderfully among them, did they not let the people go, and did they not depart?

verses.name: I Samuel 6:7
verses.text: And now make a new cart, and take two milk cows on which there has come no yoke, and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:8
verses.text: And take the ark of the LORD and lay it on the cart. And put the jewels of gold which you return to Him <hi>for</hi> a trespass offering in a box in its side. And send it away so that it may go.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:9
verses.text: And watch. If it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth-shemesh, He has done us this great evil. But if not, then we shall know that <hi>it is</hi> not His hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:10
verses.text: And the men did so. And they took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:11
verses.text: And they laid the ark of the LORD on the cart, and the box <hi>with</hi> the mice of gold and the images of their hemorrhoids.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:12
verses.text: And the cows took the straight way to the way of Beth-shemesh, going along the highway, lowing as they went. And they did not turn aside <hi>to</hi> the right or to the left. And the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth-shemesh.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:13
verses.text: And <hi>the people</hi> of Beth-shemesh <hi>were</hi> reaping their wheat harvest in the valley. And they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:14
verses.text: And the cart came into the field of Joshua, a Bethshemite, and stood there and there was a great stone. And they cut the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:15
verses.text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the box in it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put <hi>them</hi> on the great stone. And the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:16
verses.text: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen, they returned <hi>to</hi> Ekron on that day.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:17
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the golden hemorrhoids which the Philistines returned <hi>for</hi> a guilt offering to the LORD: for Ashdod, one; for Gaza, one; for Askelon one; for Gath, one; for Ekron, one.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:18
verses.text: And the golden mice were <hi>according to</hi> the number of all the cities of the Philistines for the five lords, of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great meadow on which they set down the ark of the LORD to this day, in the field of Joshua the Bethshemite.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:19
verses.text: And He struck the men of Beth-shemesh because they had looked into the ark of the LORD. He even struck seventy among the people, <hi>including</hi> fifty chief men. And the people lamented because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:20
verses.text: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? And to whom shall He go up from us?

verses.name: I Samuel 6:21
verses.text: And they sent messengers to the people of Kirjath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD. Come down <hi>and</hi> bring it up to yourselves.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:1
verses.text: And the men of Kirjath-jearim came and brought up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill. And they sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:2
verses.text: And it happened from the day the ark <hi>began</hi> to dwell in Kirjath-jearim, the days became many; yea, they were twenty years. And all the house of Israel yearned after the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:3
verses.text: And Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel saying, If you return to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts to the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:4
verses.text: And the sons of Israel put away the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:5
verses.text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you to the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:6
verses.text: And they were gathered to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the sons of Israel in Mizpeh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:7
verses.text: And the Philistines heard that the sons of Israel had come together to Mizpeh. And the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And the sons of Israel heard, and they were afraid of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:8
verses.text: And the sons of Israel said to Samuel, Do not cease from crying to the LORD our God for us, so that He will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:9
verses.text: And Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered a whole burnt offering to the LORD. And Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:10
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel. But the LORD thundered with a great noise on that day on the Philistines, and troubled them. And they were beaten before Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:11
verses.text: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them as far as below Beth-car.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:12
verses.text: And Samuel took a stone and set <hi>it</hi> between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, The LORD has helped us until now.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:13
verses.text: And the Philistines were beaten, and they did not come any more into the border of Israel. And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:14
verses.text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were given back to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath. And Israel delivered its borders out of the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:15
verses.text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:16
verses.text: And he went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel and Gilgal and Mizpeh, and judged Israel <hi>in</hi> all those places.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:17
verses.text: And his return <hi>was</hi> to Ramah, for his house <hi>was</hi> there. And he judged Israel there. And he built an altar there to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:1
verses.text: And it happened when Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:2
verses.text: And the name of his first-born was Joel, and the name of his second was Abiah, judges in Beer-sheba.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:3
verses.text: And his sons did not walk in his ways, but turned aside after ill gain and took bribes and perverted judgment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:4
verses.text: And all the elders of Israel gathered themselves and came to Samuel to Ramah.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:5
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> said to him, Behold, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:6
verses.text: But the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed to the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:7
verses.text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you. For they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:8
verses.text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even until this day--<hi> works</hi> with which they have forsaken Me and served other gods-- so they do also to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:9
verses.text: And now listen to their voice. Only, you shall surely protest solemnly to them, and show them the kind of king who shall reign over them.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:10
verses.text: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who asked a king of him.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:11
verses.text: And he said, This will be the privilege of the king who shall reign over you. He shall take your sons and appoint <hi>them</hi> for himself, for his chariots, and his horsemen. And they shall run before his chariots.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:12
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> will appoint commanders over thousands, and commanders over fifties, and some to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and make his weapons of war and weapons for his chariots.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:13
verses.text: And he will take your daughters <hi>to be</hi> perfumers and cooks and bakers.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:14
verses.text: And he will take your fields and your vineyards and your olive-yards, the best, and give <hi>them</hi> to his servants.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:15
verses.text: And he will take the tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give <hi>it</hi> to his eunuchs and to his servants.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:16
verses.text: And he will take your male slaves and your slave girls, and your finest young men, and your asses, and put <hi>them</hi> to his work.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:17
verses.text: He will take the tenth of your sheep, and you shall be his servants.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:18
verses.text: And you shall cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and the LORD will not answer you in that day.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:19
verses.text: But the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel. And they said, No, but we will have a king over us.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:20
verses.text: And we shall be, also we, like all the nations, so that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:21
verses.text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he repeated them in the ears of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:22
verses.text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Listen to their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Every man go to his city.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:1
verses.text: And there was a man of Benjamin, and his name <hi>was</hi> Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:2
verses.text: And he had a son named Saul, a young and handsome one. And there was not a man among the sons of Israel more handsome than he, being taller than any of the people from his shoulder and upward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:3
verses.text: And the asses of Kish, Saul's father, were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Please take one of the servants with you and rise, and go look for the asses.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:4
verses.text: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they did not find <hi>them</hi>. And they passed through the land of Shaalim, and nothing there. And he passed through the land of Benjamin, but they did not find <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:5
verses.text: And they came to the land of Zuph, and Saul said to his servant who <hi>was</hi> with him, Come and let us return lest my father quit <hi>caring</hi> for the asses, and be anxious about us.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:6
verses.text: And he said to him, Behold now, in this city <hi>is</hi> a man of God, and an honorable man. All that he says surely comes to pass. Now let us go there. Perhaps he can declare our way to us, how to go.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:7
verses.text: Then Saul said to his young man, But behold, <hi>if</hi> we go, what shall we bring the man? For the bread in our vessels is gone, and <hi>there is</hi> no present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?

verses.name: I Samuel 9:8
verses.text: And the young man answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have found the fourth of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God to tell us our way.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:9
verses.text: (In the old days in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said this: Come, let us go to the seer, for the prophet of today was before called a seer.)

verses.name: I Samuel 9:10
verses.text: And Saul said to his young man, Your word is good. Come, let us go. So they went into the city where the man of God <hi>was</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:11
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> they went up the hill to the city, they found young women going out to draw water, and said to them, Is the seer here?

verses.name: I Samuel 9:12
verses.text: And they answered them and said, He is. Behold, <hi>he is</hi> before you. Hurry now, for he came today to the city, for <hi>there is</hi> a feast of the people today in the high place.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:13
verses.text: As you come to the city, you shall immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. For the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the feast. Afterwards those who have been invited eat. And now go up, for about this time you shall find him.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:14
verses.text: And they went up into the city. When they had come into the middle of the city, behold, Samuel came out to meet them, to go up to the high place.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:15
verses.text: And the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,

verses.name: I Samuel 9:16
verses.text: Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin. And you shall anoint him <hi>to be</hi> leader over My people Israel, so that he may save My people out of the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked on My people because their cry has come to Me.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:17
verses.text: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, Behold the man of whom I spoke to you! This <hi>one</hi> shall reign over My people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:18
verses.text: And Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate and said, Please tell me where the seer's house <hi>is</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:19
verses.text: And Samuel answered Saul and said, I <hi>am</hi> the seer. Go up before me to the high place. For you shall eat with me today, and tomorrow I will let you go, and will tell you all that is in your heart.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:20
verses.text: And as to the asses <hi>which were</hi> lost to you three days ago, do not set your mind on them. For they are found. And on whom <hi>is</hi> all the desire of Israel? Is it not on you and on all your father's house?

verses.name: I Samuel 9:21
verses.text: And Saul answered and said, <hi>Am</hi> I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And <hi>is</hi> not my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak so to me?

verses.name: I Samuel 9:22
verses.text: And Samuel took Saul and his young man and brought them into the room, and gave them a place at the head of the invited ones, about thirty persons.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:23
verses.text: And Samuel said to the cook, Bring that part which I gave you, <hi>of</hi> which I said to you, Set it beside you.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:24
verses.text: And the cook took up the shoulder and that on it, and set <hi>it</hi> before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is reserved! Set <hi>it</hi> before you <hi>and</hi> eat. For until this set time it has been kept for you, since I said, I have invited the people. And Saul ate with Samuel that day.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:25
verses.text: And they came down from the high place into the city, and he spoke with Saul on the top of the house.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:26
verses.text: And they arose early. And it happened about the spring of the day that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, so that I may send you away. And Saul arose, and both of them went out, he and Samuel outside.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:27
verses.text: They were going down to the end of the city, and Samuel said to Saul, Tell the servant to pass on before us and pass on. And you stand still awhile, so that I may cause you to hear the word of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:1
verses.text: And Samuel took a vial of oil and poured on his head, and kissed him, and said, <hi>Is it</hi> not because the LORD has anointed you for a leader over His inheritance?

verses.name: I Samuel 10:2
verses.text: When you have departed from me today, then you shall find two men by Rachel's tomb in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. And they will say to you, The asses which you went to seek are found. And, lo, your father has quit caring for the asses and sorrows for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

verses.name: I Samuel 10:3
verses.text: And you shall go forward from there, and you shall come to the great tree of Tabor. And there you shall meet three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:4
verses.text: And they will greet you and give you two <hi>loaves</hi> of bread, which you shall take from their hand.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:5
verses.text: After that you shall come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines <hi>is</hi>. And it will happen to you when you come there to the city, even you shall meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a harp and a tambourine and a flute and a lyre before them. And they shall prophesy.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:6
verses.text: And the spirit of the LORD will come powerfully on you, and you shall prophesy with them, and shall be turned into another man.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:7
verses.text: And it will be when these signs have come to you, you will do for yourself what your hand finds; for God <hi>is</hi> with you.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:8
verses.text: And you shall go down before me to Gilgal. And, behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings <hi>and</hi> to sacrifice peace offerings. You shall stay seven days until I come to you and make known to you what you shall do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:9
verses.text: And it happened when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God changed him with another heart. And all those signs came on that day.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:10
verses.text: And they came there to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him. And the Spirit of God came on him, and he prophesied among them.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:11
verses.text: And it happened when all who knew him before saw him, behold, he prophesied among the prophets. And the people said to one another, What <hi>is</hi> this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.name: I Samuel 10:12
verses.text: And a man from there answered and said, And who <hi>is</hi> their father? Therefore it became a proverb, <hi>Is</hi> Saul also among the prophets?

verses.name: I Samuel 10:13
verses.text: And he finished from prophesying, and he came to the high place.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:14
verses.text: And Saul's uncle said to him and to his young man, Where did you go? And he said, To look for the asses. And when we saw that <hi>they were</hi> nowhere, we came to Samuel.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:15
verses.text: And Saul's uncle said, Please tell me, what Samuel said to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:16
verses.text: And Saul said to his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But he did not tell him of the matter of the kingdom of which Samuel spoke.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:17
verses.text: And Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpeh.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:18
verses.text: And he said to the sons of Israel, So says the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, of those who oppressed you.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:19
verses.text: And you have this day rejected your God who Himself saved you out of all your calamities and your tribulations. And you have said to Him, But set a king over us. And now present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:20
verses.text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:21
verses.text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken. And they looked for him, but he could not be found.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:22
verses.text: And they inquired of the LORD further, Has the man yet come here? And the LORD answered, Behold, he is hiding himself among the baggage.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:23
verses.text: And they ran and brought him from there. And when he stood among the people, he was taller than all of the people from the shoulders and upward.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:24
verses.text: And Samuel said to all the people, Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that <hi>there is</hi> none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, Let the king live!

verses.name: I Samuel 10:25
verses.text: Then Samuel told the people the duties of the kingdom, and wrote in a book and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his house.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:26
verses.text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah. And a band of men went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:27
verses.text: But the sons of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him and brought him no present. But he was silent.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:1
verses.text: And Nahash the Ammonite came up and camped against Jabesh-gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:2
verses.text: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, With this I will make a covenant with you, when all your right eyes are dug out and I will make it a reproach on all Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:3
verses.text: And the elders of Jabesh said to him, Bear with us seven days, so that we may send messengers to all the territory of Israel. And then if <hi>there is</hi> no man to save us, we will come out to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:4
verses.text: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and told the news in ears of the people. And all the people lifted up their voices and wept.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:5
verses.text: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field. And Saul said, What <hi>is wrong</hi> with the people that they weep? And they told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:6
verses.text: And the Spirit of God came powerfully on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:7
verses.text: And he took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, and sent throughout all the territory of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whoever does not come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:8
verses.text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the sons of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:9
verses.text: And they said to the messengers that came, So shall you say to the men of Jabesh-gilead, Tomorrow by <hi>the time</hi> the sun is hot, you shall have help. And the messengers came and told the men of Jabesh, and they were glad.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:10
verses.text: And the men of Jabesh said, Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:11
verses.text: And it was <hi>so</hi> on the next day, Saul put the people in three companies, and they came into the middle of the army at the morning watch. And they killed the Ammonites until the heat of the day. And the ones who remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:12
verses.text: And the people said to Samuel, Who <hi>is</hi> he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? Bring the men so that we may put them to death.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:13
verses.text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:14
verses.text: Then Samuel said to the people, Come and let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingdom there.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:15
verses.text: And all the people went <hi>to</hi> Gilgal, and made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal, and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD. And there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:1
verses.text: And Samuel said to all Israel, Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:2
verses.text: And now, behold, the king walks before you. And I am old and gray-headed, and, behold, my sons <hi>are</hi> with you. And I have walked before you from my childhood to this day.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:3
verses.text: Behold, here I <hi>am</hi>. Witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Or whose ass have I taken? Or whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Or from whose hand have I received a bribe, to blind my eyes with it? And I will restore it to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:4
verses.text: And they said, You have not defrauded us nor oppressed us, neither have you taken from any man's hand.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:5
verses.text: And he said to them, The LORD <hi>is</hi> witness against you, and His anointed <hi>is</hi> witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:6
verses.text: And Samuel said to the people, <hi>It is</hi> the LORD who made Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:7
verses.text: And now stand still, so that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD which He did to you and to your fathers.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:8
verses.text: When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and made them live in this place.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:9
verses.text: And they forgot the LORD their God. And He sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:10
verses.text: And they cried to the LORD, and said, We have sinned because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served the Baals and Ashtoreths. But now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve You.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:11
verses.text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and you lived safely.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:12
verses.text: And when you saw that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon came against you, you said to me, No, but a king shall reign over us, even though the LORD your God <hi>was</hi> your King.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:13
verses.text: And now, behold the king whom you have chosen, whom you have desired! And behold, the LORD has set a king over you!

verses.name: I Samuel 12:14
verses.text: If you will fear the LORD, and serve Him, and listen to His voice, and not rebel against the command of the LORD, then both you and also the king who reigns over you shall continue following the LORD your God.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:15
verses.text: But if you will not listen to the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the command of the LORD, then the hand of the LORD shall be against you as <hi>it was</hi> against your fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:16
verses.text: Also, now stand and see this great thing which the LORD shall do before your eyes.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:17
verses.text: <hi> Is it</hi> not wheat harvest today? I will call to the LORD, and He shall send thunder and rain, so that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, that which you have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking a king for you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:18
verses.text: And Samuel called to the LORD, And the LORD sent thunder and rain that day. And all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:19
verses.text: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray for your servants to the LORD your God, so that we will not die. For we have added evil to all our sins, to ask a king for us.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:20
verses.text: And Samuel said to the people, Do not fear. You have done all this wickedness. Yet do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:21
verses.text: And do not turn aside to go after vanities, which cannot profit nor deliver. For they <hi>are</hi> vain.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:22
verses.text: For the LORD will not forsake His people for His great name's sake, because it has pleased the LORD to make you His people.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:23
verses.text: Also, I, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD from ceasing to pray for you. But I will teach you the good and the right way.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:24
verses.text: Only fear the LORD, and serve Him in truth with all your heart. For consider what great <hi>things</hi> He has done for you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:25
verses.text: But if you shall still do wickedly, both you and your king, will be swept away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:1
verses.text: Saul reigned one year, and when he had reigned two more years over Israel,

verses.name: I Samuel 13:2
verses.text: then Saul chose for himself three thousand from Israel. Two thousand of these were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. And of the rest of the people he sent each man to his tent.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:3
verses.text: And Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines in Geba, and the Philistines heard. And Saul blew the ram's horn throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:4
verses.text: And all Israel heard, saying, Saul has struck a garrison of the Philistines, and also Israel has made himself stink to the Philistines. And the people were called to Gilgal after Saul.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:5
verses.text: And the Philistines gathered to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people like the sand on the seashore in multitude. And they came up and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:6
verses.text: And the men of Israel saw that they were in a tight place (for the people were distressed). And the people hid themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:7
verses.text: And the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. And Saul <hi>was</hi> still in Gilgal, and all the people followed him, trembling.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:8
verses.text: And he waited seven days, according to the set time with Samuel. But Samuel did not come to Gilgal. And the people were scattered from him.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:9
verses.text: And Saul said, Bring a burnt offering here to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:10
verses.text: And it happened as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came. And Saul went out to meet him and to kneel to him.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:11
verses.text: And Samuel said, What have you done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and you did not come in the days appointed, and the Philistines gathered themselves at Michmash,

verses.name: I Samuel 13:12
verses.text: and I said, The Philistines will come down now on me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to the LORD. And I forced myself and offered a burnt offering.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:13
verses.text: And Samuel said to Saul, You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which He commanded you. For now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:14
verses.text: But now your kingdom shall not stand. The LORD has sought Him a man after His own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be leader over His people, because you have not kept what the LORD commanded you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:15
verses.text: And Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people present with him, about six hundred men.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:16
verses.text: And Saul, and his son Jonathan, and the people present with them, stayed in Gibeah of Benjamin. But the Philistines camped in Michmash.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:17
verses.text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies. One company turned to the way <hi>to</hi> Ophrah, to the land of Shual.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:18
verses.text: And another company turned the way <hi>to</hi> Beth-horon. And one company turned the way of the border that looks toward the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:19
verses.text: And there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel. For the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make swords or spears.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:20
verses.text: But all the Israelites went down <hi>to</hi> the Philistines, each man to sharpen his plowshare, and his mattock, and his axe, and his coulter.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:21
verses.text: And there was the <hi>charge</hi> of a pim for the plowshares, and for the mattocks, and for the three-pronged forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the plowshares.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:22
verses.text: And it happened in the day of battle there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people with Saul and Jonathan. But with Saul and with his son Jonathan there <hi>was</hi> found <hi>sword and spear</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:23
verses.text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:1
verses.text: And the day came that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, Come and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison which <hi>is</hi> on the other side. But he did not tell his father.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:2
verses.text: And Saul stayed in the edge of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree in Migron. And the people who were with him were about six hundred men.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:3
verses.text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. And the people did not know that Jonathan was gone.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:4
verses.text: And between the passages by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines' garrison <hi>there was</hi> a rocky crag on the one <hi>side</hi> and a rocky crag on the other <hi>side</hi>. And the name of the one <hi>was</hi> Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:5
verses.text: The one crag <hi>was</hi> a pillar on the north in front of Michmash, and the other southward in front of Gibeah.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:6
verses.text: And Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, Come, and let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised ones. It may be that the LORD will work for us. For <hi>there is</hi> no restraint to the LORD, to save by many or by few.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:7
verses.text: And his armor-bearer said to him, Do all that <hi>is</hi> in your heart. Turn, for behold, I am with you according to your heart.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:8
verses.text: And Jonathan said, Behold, we will go over to <hi>these</hi> men, and we will show ourselves to them.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:9
verses.text: If they say this to us, Stand still until we come to you, then we will stand still <hi>in</hi> our place and will not go up to them.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:10
verses.text: But if they say this, Come up to us, then we will go up, for the LORD has delivered them up into our hand. And this <hi>shall be</hi> a sign to us.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:11
verses.text: And both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come out of the holes where they have hidden themselves.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:12
verses.text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor-bearer and said, Come up to us, and we will teach you a thing. And Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:13
verses.text: And Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, and his armor-bearer after him. And they fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer killed after him.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:14
verses.text: And this <hi>was</hi> the first blow, when Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck about twenty men in about half of a furrow of an acre of a field.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:15
verses.text: And there was trembling in the army, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and the spoilers also trembled, and the earth quaked, and it was a very great trembling.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:16
verses.text: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and behold, the multitude had melted away and went on here and there.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:17
verses.text: And Saul said to the people with him, Number now and see who is gone from us. And when they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor-bearer <hi>were</hi> not <hi>there.</hi>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:18
verses.text: And Saul said to Ahiah, Bring the ark of God here. For the ark of God was at that time with the sons of Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:19
verses.text: And it happened, while Saul talked to the priest, the noise in the army of the Philistines went on and grew greater. And Saul said to the priest, Withdraw your hand.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:20
verses.text: And Saul and all the people with him gathered, and they went to the battle. And, behold, every man's sword <hi>was</hi> against his fellow, a very great panic.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:21
verses.text: And the Hebrews that <hi>were</hi> with the Philistines before, who had gone up with them into the camp all around, even they also <hi>turned</hi> to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:22
verses.text: And all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in mount Ephraim heard that the Philistines had fled, even they also followed them in the battle.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:23
verses.text: And the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle passed over to Beth-aven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:24
verses.text: And the men of Israel were distressed on that day. For Saul had commanded the people, saying, Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man that eats food until evening, so that I may be avenged on my enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:25
verses.text: And all the <hi>men of</hi> the land came into a forest, and there was honey on the ground.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:26
verses.text: And when the people had come into the woods, behold, a flow of honey! But no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:27
verses.text: But Jonathan did not hear when his father made the people swear. And <hi>he</hi> put forth the end of the rod in his hand and dipped it in a honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth. And his eyes were lightened.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:28
verses.text: And one from the people answered and said, Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man who eats food this day. And the people were weary.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:29
verses.text: Then Jonathan said, My father has troubled the land. Please see how my eyes have been lightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:30
verses.text: How much more if the people had happened to eat freely today of the spoil of their enemies which they found? For would not there have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

verses.name: I Samuel 14:31
verses.text: And they struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon, and the people were very faint.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:32
verses.text: And the people flew on the spoil, and took sheep and oxen and calves, and killed <hi>them</hi> on the ground. And the people ate with the blood.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:33
verses.text: And they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD in that they eat with the blood. And he said, You have transgressed. Roll a great stone to me today.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:34
verses.text: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people and say to them, Let each one bring his ox here, and each man his sheep, and kill <hi>them</hi> here, and eat. And do not sin against the LORD in eating with the blood. And each man of all the people brought his ox in his hand that night, and killed them there.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:35
verses.text: And Saul built an altar to the LORD. The same was the first altar that he built to the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:36
verses.text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do all that seems good to you. Then the priest said, Let us draw near here to God.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:37
verses.text: And Saul asked counsel of God: Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You deliver them into the hand of Israel? But He answered him not that day.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:38
verses.text: And Saul said, Draw near here, all the chief of the people, and know and see what this sin has been today.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:39
verses.text: For, <hi>as</hi> the LORD lives, He who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people answered.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:40
verses.text: Then he said to all Israel, You be on one side, and Jonathan my son and I will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do what seems good to you.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:41
verses.text: And Saul said to the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect <hi>lot</hi>. And Saul and Jonathan were taken, but the people escaped.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:42
verses.text: And Saul said, Cast <hi>lots</hi> between me and my son Jonathan. And Jonathan was taken.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:43
verses.text: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what you have done. And Jonathan told him and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod in my hand. Behold me, I must die.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:44
verses.text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also, for you shall surely die, Jonathan.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:45
verses.text: And the people said to Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who has worked out this great salvation in Israel? Far be it! <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, so that he did not die.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:46
verses.text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines. And the Philistines went to their own place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:47
verses.text: And Saul took the kingdom over Israel and fought against all his enemies on every side, with Moab, and with the sons of Ammon, and with Edom, and with the kings of Zobah, and with the Philistines. And wherever he turned himself, he troubled <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:48
verses.text: And he gathered an army and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who spoiled them.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:49
verses.text: And the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua. And the names of his two daughters: the first-born's name <hi>was</hi> Merab, and the name of the younger, Michal.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:50
verses.text: And the name of Saul's wife <hi>was</hi> Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army <hi>was</hi> Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:51
verses.text: And Kish <hi>was</hi> the father of Saul. And Ner the father of Abner <hi>was</hi> the son of Abiel.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:52
verses.text: And the war was heavy against the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man, or any brave man, he took him to himself.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:1
verses.text: And Samuel said to Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over His people, over Israel. And now listen to the voice of the words of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:2
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, I will visit Amalek with what he did to Israel, how he set against him in the way when he came up from Egypt.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:3
verses.text: Now go and strike Amalek, and completely destroy all that they have, and do not spare them. But kill both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:4
verses.text: And Saul gathered the people together and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:5
verses.text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:6
verses.text: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go! Depart! Get down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them. For you showed kindness to all the sons of Israel when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:7
verses.text: And Saul struck the Amalekites from Havilah, as you come to Shur, which <hi>is</hi> over across from Egypt.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:8
verses.text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive. And he completely destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:9
verses.text: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep and of the oxen and of the fatlings and the lambs, and all <hi>that was</hi> good, and would not completely destroy them. But everything <hi>that was</hi> vile and feeble they completely destroyed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:10
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Samuel saying,

verses.name: I Samuel 15:11
verses.text: It repents Me that I have set up Saul <hi>to be</hi> king. For he has turned back from following Me and has not done My commands. And it grieved Samuel, and he cried <hi>out to</hi> the LORD all night.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:12
verses.text: And when Samuel rose up early in the morning to meet Saul, it was told to Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a place for himself, and has gone around and passed on and gone down to Gilgal.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:13
verses.text: And Samuel came to Saul. And Saul said to him, You <hi>are</hi> blessed of the LORD. I have done the command of the LORD.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:14
verses.text: And Samuel said, What then <hi>is</hi> this bleating of the flock in my ears? And <hi>what is</hi> the sound of the herd which I hear?

verses.name: I Samuel 15:15
verses.text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites. For the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen to sacrifice to the LORD your God. And the rest we have completely destroyed.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:16
verses.text: And Samuel said to Saul, Stop! And I will tell you what the LORD has said to me tonight. And he said to him, Speak.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:17
verses.text: And Samuel said, When you <hi>were</hi> little in your own sight, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? And the LORD anointed you king over Israel.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:18
verses.text: And the LORD sent you on the way and said, Go and completely destroy the sinners, Amalek, and fight against them until you destroy them.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:19
verses.text: Why then did you not obey the voice of the LORD? Why did you fly on the spoil and do evil in the sight of the LORD?

verses.name: I Samuel 15:20
verses.text: And Saul said to Samuel, Yes, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have completely destroyed the Amalekites.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:21
verses.text: But the people took from the spoil, of <hi>the</hi> flocks and herd, <hi>the</hi> best of the things devoted to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:22
verses.text: And Samuel said, Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey <hi>is</hi> better than sacrifice! To listen <hi>is</hi> better than the fat of rams!

verses.name: I Samuel 15:23
verses.text: For rebellion <hi>is as</hi> the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idol-worship. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, He has also rejected you from being king!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:24
verses.text: And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned. For I have disobeyed the command of the LORD, and your word, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:25
