verses.text: And king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who <hi>was</hi> over the tribute. And all Israel stoned him with stones so that he died. And king Rehoboam made haste to go up to get into a chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Kings 12:19
verses.text: And Israel rebelled against the house of David to this day.

verses.name: I Kings 12:20
verses.text: And it happened when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come again, they sent and called him to the company, and made him king over all Israel. There was none who followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.name: I Kings 12:21
verses.text: And when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and he gathered all the house of Judah with the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

verses.name: I Kings 12:22
verses.text: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 12:23
verses.text: Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 12:24
verses.text: So says the LORD, You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers the sons of Israel. Each man return to his house. For this thing is from Me. And they listened to the word of the LORD and turned to go back, according to the word of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 12:25
verses.text: And Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim and lived in it, and went out from there and built Penuel.

verses.name: I Kings 12:26
verses.text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now the kingdom shall return to the house of David!

verses.name: I Kings 12:27
verses.text: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

verses.name: I Kings 12:28
verses.text: And the king took counsel, and made two calves <hi>of</hi> gold and said to them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Behold your gods, O, Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

verses.name: I Kings 12:29
verses.text: And he set the one in Bethel, and he put the other in Dan.

verses.name: I Kings 12:30
verses.text: And this thing became a sin, for the people went to worship before the one, even to Dan.

verses.name: I Kings 12:31
verses.text: And he made a house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, who were not the sons of Levi.

verses.name: I Kings 12:32
verses.text: And Jeroboam ordered a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that <hi>is</hi> in Judah. And he offered on the altar. So he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made. And he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

verses.name: I Kings 12:33
verses.text: And he offered on the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised out of his own heart. And he ordered a feast for the sons of Israel. And he offered on the altar, and burned incense.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 13:1
verses.text: And behold, a man of God came out of Judah, by the word of the LORD, to Bethel. And Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

verses.name: I Kings 13:2
verses.text: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD and said, O, altar, altar, so says the LORD. Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name, and on you he shall offer the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and men's bones shall be burned on you.

verses.name: I Kings 13:3
verses.text: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This <hi>is</hi> the sign which the LORD has spoken. Behold, the altar shall be torn apart, and the ashes that <hi>are</hi> on it shall be poured out.

verses.name: I Kings 13:4
verses.text: And it happened when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God who had cried against the altar in Bethel, he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him! And his hand, which he put forth against him withered up so that he could not pull it in again to himself.

verses.name: I Kings 13:5
verses.text: The altar also was torn apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.

verses.name: I Kings 13:6
verses.text: And the king answered and said to the man of God, Seek now the face of the LORD your God, and pray for me, and my hand may be given back to me again. And the man of God prayed to the LORD, and the king's hand was given back to him again, and became as at the beginning.

verses.name: I Kings 13:7
verses.text: And the king said to the man of God, Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.

verses.name: I Kings 13:8
verses.text: And the man of God said to the king, If you will give me half your house, I will not go in with you, nor will I eat bread nor drink water in this place.

verses.name: I Kings 13:9
verses.text: For so was it commanded me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread nor drink water, nor return again by the same way that you came.

verses.name: I Kings 13:10
verses.text: And he went another way, and did not return by the way he came to Bethel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 13:11
verses.text: And a certain old prophet was living in Bethel, and his son came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. The words which he had spoken to the king they also told to their father.

verses.name: I Kings 13:12
verses.text: And their father said to them, Where <hi>is</hi> this <hi>man</hi>? What way did he go? For his sons had seen what way the man of God, who came from Judah, had gone.

verses.name: I Kings 13:13
verses.text: And he said to his sons, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled the ass for him, and he rode on it,

verses.name: I Kings 13:14
verses.text: and went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. And he said to him, <hi>Are</hi> you the man of God who came from Judah? And he said, I <hi>am</hi>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:15
verses.text: And he said to him, Come home with me and eat bread.

verses.name: I Kings 13:16
verses.text: And he said, I may not return with you nor go in with you, nor will I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

verses.name: I Kings 13:17
verses.text: For a word was to me by the word of the LORD, You shall eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that you came.

verses.name: I Kings 13:18
verses.text: And he said to him, I <hi>am</hi> a prophet also as you are. And an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with you into your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied to him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:19
verses.text: So he went back with him and ate bread in his house, and drank water.

verses.name: I Kings 13:20
verses.text: And it happened as they sat at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who brought him back.

verses.name: I Kings 13:21
verses.text: And he cried to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, So says the LORD, Because you have not obeyed the mouth of the LORD and have not kept the command which the LORD your God commanded you,

verses.name: I Kings 13:22
verses.text: but came back and have eaten bread and have drunk water in the place which He said to you, You shall not eat bread nor drink water, your body shall not come to the tomb of your fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 13:23
verses.text: And after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, it happened that he saddled the ass for him, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.name: I Kings 13:24
verses.text: And he left, and a lion met him by the way and killed him. And his dead body was thrown in the highway, and the ass stood by it, and the lion also stood by the body.

verses.name: I Kings 13:25
verses.text: And behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown in the way, and the lion standing by the body. And they came and told <hi>it</hi> in the city where the old prophet lived.

verses.name: I Kings 13:26
verses.text: And when the prophet who brought him back from the way heard, he said, It <hi>is</hi> the man of God who did not obey the word of the LORD. And the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke to him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:27
verses.text: And he spoke to his sons, saying, Saddle the ass for me. And they saddled it.

verses.name: I Kings 13:28
verses.text: And he went and found his body thrown in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor torn the ass.

verses.name: I Kings 13:29
verses.text: And the prophet took up the dead body of the man of God, and laid it on the ass and brought it back. And the prophet came to the city to mourn and to bury him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:30
verses.text: And he laid his body in his own grave. And they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

verses.name: I Kings 13:31
verses.text: And it happened after he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the tomb in which the man of God <hi>is</hi> buried. Lay my bones beside his bones,

verses.name: I Kings 13:32
verses.text: for the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

verses.name: I Kings 13:33
verses.text: After this thing Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but turned and made priests of the high places from the lowest of the people. He who desired, he consecrated him, and he became <hi>one</hi> of the priests of the high places.

verses.name: I Kings 13:34
verses.text: And this thing is the sin of the house of Jeroboam, even to blot <hi>it</hi> from off the face of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 14:1
verses.text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

verses.name: I Kings 14:2
verses.text: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, please, and disguise yourself so that you will not be known to be the wife of Jeroboam. And go to Shiloh. Behold, there <hi>is</hi> Ahijah the prophet, who told me about <hi>being</hi> king over this people.

verses.name: I Kings 14:3
verses.text: And take ten loaves, and cakes, and a jar of honey with you, and go to him. And he will tell you what shall become of the boy.

verses.name: I Kings 14:4
verses.text: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh. And she came to the house of Ahijah. And Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set because of his age.

verses.name: I Kings 14:5
verses.text: And the LORD said to Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam comes to ask a thing of you for her son, for he <hi>is</hi> sick. This and this you shall say to her, for when she comes in, she shall act as a stranger.

verses.name: I Kings 14:6
verses.text: And it happened when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, Come in, wife of Jeroboam! Why are you acting as a stranger? For I <hi>am</hi> sent to you <hi>with</hi> a hard thing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 14:7
verses.text: Go tell Jeroboam, So says the LORD God of Israel, I lifted you up from among the people, and made you ruler over My people Israel,

verses.name: I Kings 14:8
verses.text: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you. And you have not been as My servant David who kept My commandments, and who followed Me with all his heart, to do only <hi>what was</hi> right in My eyes.

verses.name: I Kings 14:9
verses.text: But you have done evil above all who were before you, for you have gone and made yourself other gods, and molded images, to provoke Me to anger, and have cast Me behind your back;

verses.name: I Kings 14:10
verses.text: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates against the wall, bound and free in Israel, and will sweep away the rest of the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away the dung, until it is all gone.

verses.name: I Kings 14:11
verses.text: Those of Jeroboam who die in the city, the dogs shall eat. And those who die in the field, the fowls of the air shall eat. For the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: I Kings 14:12
verses.text: And arise, get down to your own house. When your feet enter into the city, the boy shall die.

verses.name: I Kings 14:13
verses.text: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him. For he only of Jeroboam shall come down to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.name: I Kings 14:14
verses.text: And the LORD shall raise up a king over Israel for Himself, a king who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day. And what? Even now!

verses.name: I Kings 14:15
verses.text: For the LORD shall strike Israel as the reed waves in the water, and He shall root up Israel out of this good land which He gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherahs, provoking the LORD to anger.

verses.name: I Kings 14:16
verses.text: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned, and that he made Israel to sin.

verses.name: I Kings 14:17
verses.text: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and left, and came to Tirzah. When she came to the doorsill the boy died.

verses.name: I Kings 14:18
verses.text: And they buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke by the hand of His servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.name: I Kings 14:19
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred and how he reigned, behold, <hi>they</hi> are written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 14:20
verses.text: And the days which Jeroboam reigned <hi>were</hi> twenty-two years. And he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 14:21
verses.text: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam <hi>was</hi> forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD chose out of all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Naamah, an Ammonitess.

verses.name: I Kings 14:22
verses.text: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked Him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

verses.name: I Kings 14:23
verses.text: For they also built high places for themselves, and images, and Asherahs, on every high hill and under every green tree.

verses.name: I Kings 14:24
verses.text: And also the sodomite was in the land. They did according to all the hateful things of the nations which the LORD cast out before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 14:25
verses.text: And it happened in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt, he came up against Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Kings 14:26
verses.text: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house. He took all away. And he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.name: I Kings 14:27
verses.text: And king Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place, and committed <hi>them</hi> to the hands of the chief of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

verses.name: I Kings 14:28
verses.text: And it happened when the king went into the house of the LORD, the guard carried them and brought them back into the guard chamber.

verses.name: I Kings 14:29
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

verses.name: I Kings 14:30
verses.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all <hi>their</hi> days.

verses.name: I Kings 14:31
verses.text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Naamah, an Ammonitess. And his son Abijam reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 15:1
verses.text: And in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam reigned over Judah.

verses.name: I Kings 15:2
verses.text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.name: I Kings 15:3
verses.text: And he walked in all the sins of his father which he had done before him. And his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

verses.name: I Kings 15:4
verses.text: But for David's sake the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem,

verses.name: I Kings 15:5
verses.text: because David did <hi>what was</hi> right in the eyes of the LORD, and did not turn aside from all that He commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.name: I Kings 15:6
verses.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

verses.name: I Kings 15:7
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.name: I Kings 15:8
verses.text: And Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And his son Asa reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 15:9
verses.text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa reigned over Judah.

verses.name: I Kings 15:10
verses.text: And he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. And his grandmother's name <hi>was</hi> Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.name: I Kings 15:11
verses.text: And Asa did <hi>what was</hi> right in the eyes of the LORD, as David his father did.

verses.name: I Kings 15:12
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> took away the sodomites out of the land and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

verses.name: I Kings 15:13
verses.text: And also he even removed his mother Maachah from <hi>being</hi> queen because she had made an idol in a grove. And Asa destroyed her idol and burned it by the brook Kidron.

verses.name: I Kings 15:14
verses.text: But the high places were not removed. But Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

verses.name: I Kings 15:15
verses.text: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which he himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver and gold and vessels.

verses.name: I Kings 15:16
verses.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.name: I Kings 15:17
verses.text: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and built Ramah, so that he might not allow any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.name: I Kings 15:18
verses.text: And Asa took all the silver and the gold left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants. And king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 15:19
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> a treaty between you and me, between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Come and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he may depart from me.

verses.name: I Kings 15:20
verses.text: And Ben-hadad listened to king Asa, and sent the commanders of the armies which he had against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

verses.name: I Kings 15:21
verses.text: And it happened when Baasha heard, he left off building Ramah and lived in Tirzah.

verses.name: I Kings 15:22
verses.text: And king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah. None <hi>was</hi> free from it. And they took away the stones of Ramah, and its timber with which Baasha had built. And king Asa built Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah with them.

verses.name: I Kings 15:23
verses.text: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

verses.name: I Kings 15:24
verses.text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father. And his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 15:25
verses.text: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

verses.name: I Kings 15:26
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

verses.name: I Kings 15:27
verses.text: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him. And Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which <hi>was</hi> to the Philistines. For Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

verses.name: I Kings 15:28
verses.text: And in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Kings 15:29
verses.text: And it happened when he reigned, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He did not leave Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD which He spoke by His servant Ahijah the man of Shiloh,

verses.name: I Kings 15:30
verses.text: because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation with which he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

verses.name: I Kings 15:31
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 15:32
verses.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.name: I Kings 15:33
verses.text: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty-four years.

verses.name: I Kings 15:34
verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 16:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 16:2
verses.text: Since I exalted you out of the dust, and made you ruler over My people Israel, and since you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made My people Israel to sin, to provoke Me to anger with their sins,

verses.name: I Kings 16:3
verses.text: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house. And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.name: I Kings 16:4
verses.text: Those of Baasha who die in the city shall the dogs eat. And those of his who die in the fields, the birds of the air shall eat.

verses.name: I Kings 16:5
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Baasha and what he did, and his might, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 16:6
verses.text: And Baasha lay with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Kings 16:7
verses.text: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he killed him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:8
verses.text: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned two years.

verses.name: I Kings 16:9
verses.text: And his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, plotted against him; and he <hi>was</hi> in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza the steward of <hi>his</hi> house in Tirzah.

verses.name: I Kings 16:10
verses.text: And Zimri went in and struck him, and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Kings 16:11
verses.text: And it happened when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he killed all the house of Baasha. He did not leave him one who urinated against a wall, nor of his kinsmen, nor of his friends.

verses.name: I Kings 16:12
verses.text: And Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

verses.name: I Kings 16:13
verses.text: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned and that they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.name: I Kings 16:14
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 16:15
verses.text: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. And the people <hi>were</hi> camped against Gibbethon which <hi>was</hi> to the Philistines.

verses.name: I Kings 16:16
verses.text: And the people <hi>that were</hi> camped heard it said that Zimri had plotted and had also slain the king. And all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.name: I Kings 16:17
verses.text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they laid siege to Tirzah.

verses.name: I Kings 16:18
verses.text: And it happened when Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the palace of the king's house and burned the king's house over him with fire, and died,

verses.name: I Kings 16:19
verses.text: for his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel sin.

verses.name: I Kings 16:20
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason which he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 16:21
verses.text: And the people of Israel were divided into two parts. Half the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king. And half followed Omri.

verses.name: I Kings 16:22
verses.text: But the people who followed Omri were stronger than the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. And Tibni died and Omri reigned.

verses.name: I Kings 16:23
verses.text: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel. He reigned twelve years, six years in Tirzah.

verses.name: I Kings 16:24
verses.text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill, Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 16:25
verses.text: And Omri did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all who <hi>were</hi> before him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:26
verses.text: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.name: I Kings 16:27
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 16:28
verses.text: And Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 16:29
verses.text: And in the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. And Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

verses.name: I Kings 16:30
verses.text: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all who <hi>were</hi> before him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:31
verses.text: And as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he also took Jezebel, the daughter of Eth-baal king of the Sidonians, for a wife. And he went and served Baal, and worshiped him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:32
verses.text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 16:33
verses.text: And Ahab made an Asherah. And Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:34
verses.text: In his days Hiel the man of Bethel built Jericho. He laid the foundation of it in Abiram his first-born, and set up the gates of it in his youngest <hi>son</hi> Segub, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 17:1
verses.text: And Elijah the Tishbite, of the sojourners of Gilead, said to Ahab, <hi>As</hi> the LORD God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, except according to my word.

verses.name: I Kings 17:2
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 17:3
verses.text: Go away from here and turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, before Jordan.

verses.name: I Kings 17:4
verses.text: And it shall be, you shall drink of the brook. And I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.

verses.name: I Kings 17:5
verses.text: So he went and did according to the word of the LORD. For he went and lived by the torrent Cherith, before Jordan.

verses.name: I Kings 17:6
verses.text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the torrent.

verses.name: I Kings 17:7
verses.text: And it happened after a while, the torrent dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 17:8
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 17:9
verses.text: Arise, go to Zarephath which <hi>belongs</hi> to Sidon, and live there. Behold, I have commanded a widow to keep you there.

verses.name: I Kings 17:10
verses.text: And he arose and went to Zarephath, and came in to the entrance of the city, and, behold, the widow was gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, Please, bring me a little water in a vessel so that I may drink.

verses.name: I Kings 17:11
verses.text: And as she was going to bring <hi>it</hi>, he called to her and said, Please, bring me a piece of bread in your hand.

verses.name: I Kings 17:12
verses.text: And she said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD your God lives, I do not have a cake, but only a handful of meal in a pitcher and a little oil in a jar. And behold, I <hi>am</hi> gathering two sticks, so that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, so that we may eat it and die.

verses.name: I Kings 17:13
verses.text: And Elijah said to her, Do not fear, go. Do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it, and bring <hi>it</hi> to me. And then make for you and for your son.

verses.name: I Kings 17:14
verses.text: For so says the LORD God of Israel, The pitcher of meal shall not be emptied, nor shall the jar of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.

verses.name: I Kings 17:15
verses.text: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah. And she and he and her house ate <hi>many</hi> days;

verses.name: I Kings 17:16
verses.text: the pitcher of meal was not consumed, and the jar of oil did not fail, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke by Elijah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 17:17
verses.text: And it happened after these things the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick. And his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

verses.name: I Kings 17:18
verses.text: And she said to Elijah, What do I have to do with you, O man of God? Have you come to me to call my sin to remembrance and to kill my son?

verses.name: I Kings 17:19
verses.text: And he said to her, Give me your son. And he took him out of her bosom and carried him up into a loft, where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

verses.name: I Kings 17:20
verses.text: And he cried to the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, have You also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by slaying her son?

verses.name: I Kings 17:21
verses.text: And he stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, please let this child's soul come to him again.

verses.name: I Kings 17:22
verses.text: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah, and the soul of the child came into him again, and he lived.

verses.name: I Kings 17:23
verses.text: And Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house and delivered him to his mother. And Elijah said, See! Your son lives!

verses.name: I Kings 17:24
verses.text: And the woman said to Elijah, Now I know this, that you <hi>are</hi> a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth <hi>is</hi> truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 18:1
verses.text: And it happened <hi>after</hi> many days the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year saying, Go, show yourself to Ahab. And I will send rain on the earth.

verses.name: I Kings 18:2
verses.text: And Elijah went to be seen himself to Ahab. And <hi>there was</hi> a great famine in Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 18:3
verses.text: And Ahab called Obadiah, who <hi>was</hi> over the house. (And Obadiah feared the LORD greatly,

verses.name: I Kings 18:4
verses.text: for it happened when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

verses.name: I Kings 18:5
verses.text: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Go into the land, to all fountains of water, and to all the torrents. Perhaps we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, so that we do not lose all the animals.

verses.name: I Kings 18:6
verses.text: And they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

verses.name: I Kings 18:7
verses.text: And as Obadiah was in the way, and behold! Elijah met him. And he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, <hi>Are</hi> you my lord Elijah?

verses.name: I Kings 18:8
verses.text: and he answered him, I <hi>am</hi>. Go, tell your lord, behold, Elijah <hi>is here</hi>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:9
verses.text: And he said, What have I sinned that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab to kill me?

verses.name: I Kings 18:10
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> the LORD your God lives, there is no nation nor kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. And when they said, He is not there, he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they did not find you.

verses.name: I Kings 18:11
verses.text: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah <hi>is here</hi>!

verses.name: I Kings 18:12
verses.text: And it will be as soon as I have gone from you, the Spirit of the LORD shall carry you where I know not. And when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.

verses.name: I Kings 18:13
verses.text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, how I hid a hundred men of the LORD's prophets by fifty in a cave and fed them with bread and water?

verses.name: I Kings 18:14
verses.text: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah! And he will kill me!

verses.name: I Kings 18:15
verses.text: And Elijah said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely be seen by him today.

verses.name: I Kings 18:16
verses.text: And Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him. And Ahab went to meet Elijah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 18:17
verses.text: And it happened when Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, <hi>Are</hi> you he that troubles Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 18:18
verses.text: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father's house have, in that you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and you have followed the Baals.

verses.name: I Kings 18:19
verses.text: And now send <hi>and</hi> gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel, and four hundred and fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel's table.

verses.name: I Kings 18:20
verses.text: And Ahab sent to all the sons of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to mount Carmel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 18:21
verses.text: And Elijah came to all the people and said, How long are you limping over two opinions? If Jehovah <hi>is</hi> God, follow Him. But if Baal is God, <hi>then</hi> follow him. And the people did not answer him a word.

verses.name: I Kings 18:22
verses.text: And Elijah said to the people, I, I alone, remain a prophet of Jehovah. But Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.name: I Kings 18:23
verses.text: And let them give us two bulls, and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces and lay <hi>it</hi> on wood. But place no fire. And I will dress the other bull and lay it on wood, and place no fire.

verses.name: I Kings 18:24
verses.text: And you call on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of Jehovah. And it shall be, the god that answers by fire, He is God. And all the people answered and said, The word <hi>is</hi> good.

verses.name: I Kings 18:25
verses.text: And Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose one bull for yourselves, and prepare first, for you <hi>are</hi> many. And call on the name of your god, but place no fire.

verses.name: I Kings 18:26
verses.text: And they took the bull which was given them, and they dressed, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any who answered. And they leaped on the altar which was made.

verses.name: I Kings 18:27
verses.text: And it happened at noon Elijah mocked them and said, Cry with a great voice, for he <hi>is</hi> a god. Either he is meditating, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey; perhaps he is asleep and must be awakened!

verses.name: I Kings 18:28
verses.text: And they cried with a loud voice and cut themselves with knives and spears until the blood gushed out on them, as is their way.

verses.name: I Kings 18:29
verses.text: And it happened when midday was past, and when they prophesied until the <hi>time</hi> of the offering of the evening sacrifice, there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor anyone who paid attention.

verses.name: I Kings 18:30
verses.text: And Elijah said to all the people, Come near to me. And all the people came near him. And he repaired the broken down altar of the LORD.

verses.name: I Kings 18:31
verses.text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be your name.

verses.name: I Kings 18:32
verses.text: And with stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD. And he made a trench around the altar big enough to contain two measures of seed.

verses.name: I Kings 18:33
verses.text: And he arranged the wood, and cut the bull in pieces, and placed <hi>it</hi> on the wood, and said, Fill four water jars with water and pour on the burnt sacrifice and on the wood.

verses.name: I Kings 18:34
verses.text: And he said, Do <hi>it</hi> the second time. And they did <hi>it</hi> the second time. And he said, Do <hi>it</hi> the third time. And they did <hi>it</hi> the third time.

verses.name: I Kings 18:35
verses.text: And the water ran all around the altar. And he filled the trench also with water.

verses.name: I Kings 18:36
verses.text: And it happened at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet came near and said, LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that You <hi>are</hi> God in Israel, and that I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.

verses.name: I Kings 18:37
verses.text: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that You <hi>are</hi> Jehovah God, and that You have turned their heart back again.

verses.name: I Kings 18:38
verses.text: And the fire of the LORD fell and burned up the burnt sacrifice and the wood, and the stones and the dust, and licked up the water that <hi>was</hi> in the trench.

verses.name: I Kings 18:39
verses.text: And when all the people saw, they fell on their faces. And they said, Jehovah, He <hi>is</hi> the God! Jehovah, He <hi>is</hi> the God!

verses.name: I Kings 18:40
verses.text: And Elijah said to them, Take the prophets of Baal. Do not let one of them escape. And they took them. And Elijah brought them down to the torrent Kishon and killed them there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 18:41
verses.text: And Elijah said to Ahab, Go up, eat and drink, because of the <hi>sound of</hi> plenty of rain.

verses.name: I Kings 18:42
verses.text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel. And he threw himself down on the earth and put his face between his knees.

verses.name: I Kings 18:43
verses.text: And he said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up and looked and said, Nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

verses.name: I Kings 18:44
verses.text: And it happened at the seventh <hi>time,</hi> he said, Behold, there arises a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up and say to Ahab, Bind up and go down, so that the rain does not stop you.

verses.name: I Kings 18:45
verses.text: And it happened in the meantime the heaven was black <hi>with</hi> clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rose and went to Jezreel.

verses.name: I Kings 18:46
verses.text: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah. And he girded up his loins and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 19:1
verses.text: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and all that he killed, all the prophets with the sword.

verses.name: I Kings 19:2
verses.text: And Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah saying, So let the gods do <hi>to me</hi>, and more also, if I do not make your life like the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time.

verses.name: I Kings 19:3
verses.text: And he saw, he rose and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba of Judah, and left his servant there.

verses.name: I Kings 19:4
verses.text: And he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a broom tree. And he begged for his life, that he might die. And he said, It is enough. O LORD, take away my life. For I <hi>am</hi> no better than my fathers.

verses.name: I Kings 19:5
verses.text: And as he lay and slept under a broom tree, behold, then an angel touched him and said to him, Arise, eat.

verses.name: I Kings 19:6
verses.text: And he looked, and, behold, a cake <hi>was</hi> baked on the coals, and a jug of water at his head. And he ate and drank, and lay down again.

verses.name: I Kings 19:7
verses.text: And the angel of the LORD came to him the second time and touched him, and said, Arise, eat, because the journey <hi>is</hi> too great for you.

verses.name: I Kings 19:8
verses.text: And he arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb the mount of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 19:9
verses.text: And he came there to a cave and stayed there. And behold, the word of the LORD <hi>came</hi> to him, and He said to him, What <hi>are</hi> you <hi>doing</hi> here, Elijah?

verses.name: I Kings 19:10
verses.text: And he said, I have been very zealous for Jehovah the God of Hosts. For the sons of Israel have forsaken Your covenant, thrown down Your altars, and have slain Your prophets with the sword. And I, I alone, am left. And they seek to take my life away.

verses.name: I Kings 19:11
verses.text: And He said, Go forth and stand on the mountain before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains, and broke the rocks in pieces before the LORD. <hi>But</hi> the LORD <hi>was</hi> not in the wind. And after the wind was an earthquake, <hi>but</hi> the LORD was not in the earthquake.

verses.name: I Kings 19:12
verses.text: And after the earthquake was a fire, <hi>but</hi> the LORD <hi>was</hi> not in the fire. And after the fire <hi>was</hi> a still, small voice.

verses.name: I Kings 19:13
verses.text: And it happened when Elijah heard, he wrapped his face in his mantle and went out, and stood at the cave entrance. And behold, a voice <hi>came</hi> to him and said, What <hi>are</hi> you <hi>doing</hi> here, Elijah?

verses.name: I Kings 19:14
verses.text: And he said, I have been very zealous for Jehovah, God of Hosts, because the sons of Israel have forsaken Your covenant, have thrown down Your altars, and have slain Your prophets with the sword. And I, I alone, am left. And they seek to take my life away.

verses.name: I Kings 19:15
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. And when you come, anoint Hazael <hi>to be</hi> king over Syria.

verses.name: I Kings 19:16
verses.text: And you shall anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi <hi>to be</hi> king over Israel. And Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah you shall anoint <hi>to be</hi> prophet in your place.

verses.name: I Kings 19:17
verses.text: And it will be, whoever escapes the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill. And whoever escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

verses.name: I Kings 19:18
verses.text: Yet I have left seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 19:19
verses.text: And he left there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, and he <hi>was</hi> plowing; twelve pairs <hi>of oxen were</hi> before him, and he <hi>was</hi> with the twelfth. And Elijah passed by him and threw his mantle on him.

verses.name: I Kings 19:20
verses.text: And he left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, please, let me kiss my father and my mother, and I will follow you. And he said to him, Go back again, for what have I done to you?

verses.name: I Kings 19:21
verses.text: And he turned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen and killed them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave it to the people, and they ate. And he arose and went after Elijah, and ministered to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 20:1
verses.text: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together. And thirty-two kings <hi>were</hi> with him, and horses and chariots. And he went up and laid siege to Samaria, and warred against it.

verses.name: I Kings 20:2
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel, and to the city, and said to him, Ben-hadad says this:

verses.name: I Kings 20:3
verses.text: Your silver and your gold <hi>are</hi> mine, your wives also and your sons, the best are mine.

verses.name: I Kings 20:4
verses.text: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O King, according to your saying I <hi>am</hi> yours and all that I have.

verses.name: I Kings 20:5
verses.text: And the messengers came again and said, Ben-hadad speaks in this way, saying, Although I have sent to you saying, You shall deliver me your silver and your gold and your wives and your sons,

verses.name: I Kings 20:6
verses.text: yet I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they shall search your house and the houses of your servants. And it shall be, whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put <hi>it</hi> in their hand and take it away.

verses.name: I Kings 20:7
verses.text: And the king of Israel called all the elders of the land and said, Please mark and see how this one seeks mischief. For he sent to me for my wives and for my sons, and for my silver and for my gold. And I did not keep them back from him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:8
verses.text: And all the elders and all the people said to him, Do not listen nor consent!

verses.name: I Kings 20:9
verses.text: And he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I may not do. And the messengers left and brought him word again.

verses.name: I Kings 20:10
verses.text: And Ben-hadad sent to him and said, May the gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.

verses.name: I Kings 20:11
verses.text: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell <hi>him</hi>, Do not let him who girds on boast himself like the one who loosens <hi>his armor</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 20:12
verses.text: And it happened he heard this word, and he <hi>was</hi> drinking, he and the kings in the booths, he said to his servants, Set <hi>in order</hi>, and they set in order against the city. And they placed the engines against the city.

verses.name: I Kings 20:13
verses.text: And behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, saying, So says the LORD, Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: I Kings 20:14
verses.text: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, So says the LORD, By the young men of the rulers of the provinces. And he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, You.

verses.name: I Kings 20:15
verses.text: And he numbered the young men of the rulers of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. And after them he numbered all the people, all the sons of Israel, seven thousand.

verses.name: I Kings 20:16
verses.text: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad <hi>was</hi> drinking himself drunk in the booths, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:17
verses.text: And the young men of the rulers of the provinces went out first. And Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men coming out of Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 20:18
verses.text: And he said, If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.

verses.name: I Kings 20:19
verses.text: So these young men of the rulers of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

verses.name: I Kings 20:20
verses.text: And they each one killed his man. And the Syrians fled. And Israel pursued them. And Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with the horsemen.

verses.name: I Kings 20:21
verses.text: And the king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 20:22
verses.text: And the prophet came to the king of Israel and said to him, Go, strengthen yourself, and watch and see what you do. For at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against you.

verses.name: I Kings 20:23
verses.text: And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, Their gods <hi>are</hi> gods of the hills. On account of this they were stronger than we were. But let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

verses.name: I Kings 20:24
verses.text: And do this thing, take the kings away, each man out of his place, and put commanders in their places,

verses.name: I Kings 20:25
verses.text: and number an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. And we will fight against them in the plain. Are we not stronger than they? And he listened to their voice and did so.

verses.name: I Kings 20:26
verses.text: And it happened at the return of the year Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians that went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 20:27
verses.text: And the sons of Israel were numbered, and were fed, and went to meet them. And the sons of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of goats. And the Syrians filled the country.

verses.name: I Kings 20:28
verses.text: And a man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, So says the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, Jehovah <hi>is</hi> God of the hills, but He is not God of the valleys, therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: I Kings 20:29
verses.text: And they pitched over against one another seven days. And it happened in the seventh day, and the battle came up. And the sons of Israel struck Syria, a hundred thousand footmen in one day.

verses.name: I Kings 20:30
verses.text: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city. And <hi>there</hi> a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of those remaining. And Ben-hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 20:31
verses.text: And his servants said to him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel <hi>are</hi> merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our loins and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Perhaps he will save your life.

verses.name: I Kings 20:32
verses.text: And they bound sackcloth on their loins and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, Your servant Ben-hadad says, Please let me live. And he said, <hi>Is</hi> he still alive? He <hi>is</hi> my brother.

verses.name: I Kings 20:33
verses.text: And the men carefully observed, and quickly caught <hi>it</hi> from him, and said, And they said, Your brother Ben-hadad. And he said, Go and bring him. And Ben-hadad came out to him, and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

verses.name: I Kings 20:34
verses.text: And <hi>Ben-hadad</hi> said to him, The cities which my father took from your father, I will restore. And you shall make streets for you in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. And <hi>Ahab</hi> said, I will send you away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him and sent him away.

verses.name: I Kings 20:35
verses.text: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his neighbor, By the word of the LORD, please strike me! And the man refused to strike him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:36
verses.text: And he said to him, Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion shall kill you. And as soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:37
verses.text: And he found another man and said, Please strike me. And the man struck him, so that he wounded <hi>him</hi> in striking him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:38
verses.text: And the prophet went and waited for the king by the wayside, and disguised himself with ashes on his face.

verses.name: I Kings 20:39
verses.text: And as the king passed by, it happened he cried to the king. And he said, Your servant went out into the middle of the battle, and, behold, a man turned aside and brought a man to me and said, Keep this man. If he is missing by any means, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.

verses.name: I Kings 20:40
verses.text: And it happened as your servant was busy here and there, he was gone! And the king of Israel said to him, So <hi>shall</hi> your judgment be; you yourself have decided <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:41
verses.text: And he hurried and took the ashes away from his face. And the king of Israel saw that he <hi>was</hi> one of the prophets.

verses.name: I Kings 20:42
verses.text: And he said to him, So says the LORD, Because you have let go out of <hi>your</hi> hand a man whom I devoted <hi>to destruction</hi>, therefore your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people.

verses.name: I Kings 20:43
verses.text: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 21:1
verses.text: And it happened after these things, Naboth of Jezreel had a vineyard in Jezreel, near the place of Ahab king of Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 21:2
verses.text: And Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, Give me your vineyard so that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it <hi>is</hi> near my house. And I will give you a better vineyard than it. Or, if <hi>it seems</hi> good to you, I will give you the worth of it in silver.

verses.name: I Kings 21:3
verses.text: And Naboth said to Ahab, Far be it from me, by Jehovah, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you.

verses.name: I Kings 21:4
verses.text: And Ahab came to his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him. For he had said, I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers. And he lay on his bed and turned away his face, and would not eat food.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 21:5
verses.text: And his wife Jezebel came to him and said to him, Why is your spirit so sad that you are not eating food?

verses.name: I Kings 21:6
verses.text: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Naboth of Jezreel and said to him, Give me your vineyard for silver. Or else, if it pleases you, I will give you <hi>another</hi> vineyard for it. And he answered, I will not give you my vineyard.

verses.name: I Kings 21:7
verses.text: And his wife Jezebel said to him, Do you now rule over Israel? Rise up, eat food, and let your heart be good. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth of Jezreel.

verses.name: I Kings 21:8
verses.text: And she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed <hi>them</hi> with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

verses.name: I Kings 21:9
verses.text: And she wrote in the letter, saying, Proclaim a fast and set Naboth on high among the people.

verses.name: I Kings 21:10
verses.text: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him to bear witness against him, saying, You blasphemed God and the king. And carry him out and stone him so that he may die.

verses.name: I Kings 21:11
verses.text: And the men of his city, the elders and the nobles who lived in his city did as Jezebel had sent to them, as it <hi>was</hi> written in the letters which she had sent to them.

verses.name: I Kings 21:12
verses.text: They proclaimed a fast and set Naboth on high among the people.

verses.name: I Kings 21:13
verses.text: And there came in two men, sons of Belial, and sat before him. And the men of Belial witnessed against him, against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth blasphemed God and the king. And they carried him out of the city and stoned him with stones so that he died.

verses.name: I Kings 21:14
verses.text: And they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned and is dead.

verses.name: I Kings 21:15
verses.text: And it happened when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth of Jezreel, which he refused to give you for silver. For Naboth is not alive, but dead.

verses.name: I Kings 21:16
verses.text: And it happened when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth of Jezreel, to take possession of it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 21:17
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 21:18
verses.text: Arise, go down to meet Ahab the king of Israel in Samaria. Behold, <hi>he is</hi> in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to possess it.

verses.name: I Kings 21:19
verses.text: And you shall speak to him, saying, So says the LORD, Have you killed and also taken possession? And you shall speak to him saying, So says the LORD, In the place where the dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs shall lick your blood, even yours.

verses.name: I Kings 21:20
verses.text: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you found me, O my enemy? And he answered, I have found <hi>you</hi> because you have sold yourself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.name: I Kings 21:21
verses.text: Behold, I will bring evil on you and will take away those after you, and will cut off from Ahab him who urinates against the wall, both bond and free in Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 21:22
verses.text: And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked <hi>Me</hi> to anger, and made Israel to sin.

verses.name: I Kings 21:23
verses.text: And the LORD also spoke of Jezebel saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

verses.name: I Kings 21:24
verses.text: He who dies of Ahab in the city, the dogs shall eat. And he who dies in the field, the birds of the air shall eat.

verses.name: I Kings 21:25
verses.text: But there was none like Ahab, who sold himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

verses.name: I Kings 21:26
verses.text: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 21:27
verses.text: And it happened when Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth and walked softly.

verses.name: I Kings 21:28
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.name: I Kings 21:29
verses.text: Do you see how Ahab humbles himself before Me? Because he humbles himself before Me, I will not bring the evil in his days. <hi>But</hi> in his son's days I will bring the evil on his house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 22:1
verses.text: And they continued three years; there <hi>was</hi> no war between Syria and Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:2
verses.text: And it happened in the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to see the king of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:3
verses.text: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do you not know that Ramoth in Gilead <hi>is</hi> ours, and we are quiet and do not take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?

verses.name: I Kings 22:4
verses.text: And he said to Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth in Gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I <hi>am</hi> as you; my people as your people, my horses as your horses.

verses.name: I Kings 22:5
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Please inquire at the word of the LORD today.

verses.name: I Kings 22:6
verses.text: And the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go against Ramoth in Gilead to battle, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up! For the LORD shall deliver <hi>it</hi> into the hand of the king.

verses.name: I Kings 22:7
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat said, <hi>Is there</hi> not here a prophet of Jehovah besides, that we might inquire of Him?

verses.name: I Kings 22:8
verses.text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, <hi>There is</hi> still one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may inquire of Jehovah. But I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.name: I Kings 22:9
verses.text: And the king of Israel called an officer and said, Hurry and bring Micaiah the son of Imlah to hurry.

verses.name: I Kings 22:10
verses.text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, having put on their robes, in a floor in the entrance of the gate of Samaria. And all the prophets prophesied before them.

verses.name: I Kings 22:11
verses.text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made horns of iron for himself. And he said, So says Jehovah, With these you shall push the Syrians until you have crushed them.

verses.name: I Kings 22:12
verses.text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth in Gilead and prosper, for the LORD shall deliver <hi>it</hi> into the king's hands.

verses.name: I Kings 22:13
verses.text: And the messenger that had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets <hi>are</hi> good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.

verses.name: I Kings 22:14
verses.text: And Micaiah said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 22:15
verses.text: So he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micaiah, Shall we go against Ramoth in Gilead to battle, or shall we hold off? And he answered him, Go and prosper. For the LORD shall deliver <hi>it</hi> into the hand of the king.

verses.name: I Kings 22:16
verses.text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure you that you tell me nothing but <hi>what is</hi> true, in the name of Jehovah?

verses.name: I Kings 22:17
verses.text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered on the hills, like sheep that have no shepherd. And the LORD said, These have no master. Let each man return to his house in peace.

verses.name: I Kings 22:18
verses.text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

verses.name: I Kings 22:19
verses.text: And he said, Hear therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right hand and on His left.

verses.name: I Kings 22:20
verses.text: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab that he may go up and fall at Ramoth in Gilead? And one said this way, and another said that way.

verses.name: I Kings 22:21
verses.text: And there came forth a spirit and stood before the LORD and said, I will entice him.

verses.name: I Kings 22:22
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, With what? And he said, I will go forth and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And He said, You shall entice <hi>him</hi> and succeed also. Go forth and do so.

verses.name: I Kings 22:23
verses.text: And now, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets, and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.

verses.name: I Kings 22:24
verses.text: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go from me to speak to you?

verses.name: I Kings 22:25
verses.text: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day when you shall go into an inner room to hide yourself.

verses.name: I Kings 22:26
verses.text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son,

verses.name: I Kings 22:27
verses.text: and say, so says the king, Put this one in the prison and feed him with bread of affliction and the water of affliction, until I come in peace.

verses.name: I Kings 22:28
verses.text: And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me. And he said, Listen, O people, all of them!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 22:29
verses.text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth in Gilead.

verses.name: I Kings 22:30
verses.text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I <hi>will</hi> disguise myself and enter into the battle. But you put on your robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

verses.name: I Kings 22:31
verses.text: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty-two commanders of the chariots, saying, Do not fight with small nor great, but with the king of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:32
verses.text: And it happened when the commanders of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, Surely it <hi>is</hi> the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him. And Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.name: I Kings 22:33
verses.text: And it happened when the commanders of the chariots saw that it <hi>was</hi> not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.name: I Kings 22:34
verses.text: And a man drew a bow in his simplicity and struck the king of Israel between the joints and the breastplate. And he said to the driver of his chariot, Turn your hand and carry me out of the army, for I am wounded.

verses.name: I Kings 22:35
verses.text: And the battle increased that day. And the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at evening. And the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

verses.name: I Kings 22:36
verses.text: And there went a cry throughout the army when the sun went, saying, Each to his city, and each to his land.

verses.name: I Kings 22:37
verses.text: And the king died and came to Samaria. And they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.name: I Kings 22:38
verses.text: And <hi>one</hi> washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood, and they washed his armor, according to the word of the LORD which He spoke.

verses.name: I Kings 22:39
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?

verses.name: I Kings 22:40
verses.text: And Ahab lay with his fathers. And his son Ahaziah reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Kings 22:41
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat, the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:42
verses.text: Jehoshaphat <hi>was</hi> thirty-five years old when he began to reign. And he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.name: I Kings 22:43
verses.text: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father. He did not turn aside from it, doing right in the eyes of the LORD. But the high places were not taken away, for the people offered and burned incense yet in the high places.

verses.name: I Kings 22:44
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the kings of Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:45
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might which he showed, and how he warred, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Judah?

verses.name: I Kings 22:46
verses.text: And the rest of the sodomites which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

verses.name: I Kings 22:47
verses.text: There <hi>was</hi> then no king in Edom, a deputy <hi>was</hi> king.

verses.name: I Kings 22:48
verses.text: Jehoshaphat <hi>had</hi> ten ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold. But they did not go, for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

verses.name: I Kings 22:49
verses.text: And Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with your servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

verses.name: I Kings 22:50
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat lay with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father. And his son Jehoram reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Kings 22:51
verses.text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah. And he reigned two years over Israel.

verses.name: I Kings 22:52
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.name: I Kings 22:53
verses.text: For he served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger, according to all that his father had done.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Kings 1:1
verses.text: And Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

verses.name: II Kings 1:2
verses.text: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper room in Samaria, and was sick. And <hi>he</hi> sent messengers and said to them, Go, ask of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

verses.name: II Kings 1:3
verses.text: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise! Go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and say to them, <hi>Is it</hi> not because no God is in Israel <hi>that</hi> you go to ask of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

verses.name: II Kings 1:4
verses.text: And therefore so says the LORD, You shall not come from that bed on which you have gone up, but shall surely die. And Elijah left.

verses.name: II Kings 1:5
verses.text: And the messengers turned back to him. And he said, Why have you now turned back?

verses.name: II Kings 1:6
verses.text: And they said to him, A man came up to meet us and said to us, Go, turn again to the king who sent you, and say to him, So says the LORD, <hi>Is it</hi> not because no God <hi>is</hi> in Israel <hi>that</hi> you go to ask of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? Therefore, you shall not come down from that bed on which you have gone up, but shall surely die.

verses.name: II Kings 1:7
verses.text: And he said to them, What kind of man <hi>was he</hi> who came up to meet you and told you these words?

verses.name: II Kings 1:8
verses.text: And they answered him, <hi>He was</hi> a hairy man and was bound with a girdle of leather around his loins. And he said, He <hi>is</hi> Elijah the Tishbite.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Kings 1:9
verses.text: And he sent to him a commander of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him. And, behold, he sat on the top of a hill. And he spoke to him, Man of God! The king has said, Come down.

verses.name: II Kings 1:10
verses.text: And Elijah answered and said to the commander of fifty, If I <hi>am</hi> a man of God, then let fire come down from the heavens and burn up you and your fifty. And there came down fire from the heavens and burned up him and his fifty.

verses.name: II Kings 1:11
verses.text: And he turned and he sent to him another commander of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said to him, Man of God! So says the king, Come down quickly.

verses.name: II Kings 1:12
verses.text: And Elijah answered and said to him, If I <hi>am</hi> a man of God, let fire come down from the heavens and burn up you and your fifty. And the fire of God came down from the heavens and burned up him and his fifty.

verses.name: II Kings 1:13
verses.text: And he turned and sent again a third commander of fifty and his fifty. And the third commander of fifty came up and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, Man of God, Please let my life and the life of these fifty, your servants, be precious in your sight.

verses.name: II Kings 1:14
verses.text: Behold, fire has come down from the heavens and burned up the two commanders of the former fifties with their fifties. And now let my life be precious in your sight.

verses.name: II Kings 1:15
verses.text: And the Angel of the LORD said to Elijah, Go down with him. Do not be afraid of him. And he arose and went down with him to the king.

verses.name: II Kings 1:16
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> said to him, So says the LORD, Because you have sent messengers to ask of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, <hi>Is it</hi> not because no God <hi>is</hi> in Israel to seek His word? Therefore you shall not come down off that bed on which you have gone up, but shall surely die.

verses.name: II Kings 1:17
verses.text: And he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his place, in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

verses.name: II Kings 1:18
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Matters of the Days of the Kings of Israel?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Kings 2:1
verses.text: And it happened when the LORD was to take Elijah up into Heaven by a whirlwind, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

verses.name: II Kings 2:2
verses.text: And Elijah said to Elisha, Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they went down to Bethel.

verses.name: II Kings 2:3
verses.text: And the sons of the prophets at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said to him, Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from your head today? And he said, Yes, I know. Keep silent.

verses.name: II Kings 2:4
verses.text: And Elijah said to him, Elisha, please stay here. For the LORD has sent me to Jericho. And he said, <hi>As</hi> the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they came to Jericho.

verses.name: II Kings 2:5
verses.text: And the sons of the prophets at Jericho came to Elisha and said to him, Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from your head today? And he answered, Yes, I know. Keep silent.

verses.name: II Kings 2:6
verses.text: And Elijah said to him, Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me to Jordan. And he said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And the two of them went on.

verses.name: II Kings 2:7
verses.text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went on and stood afar off across <hi>from them</hi>. And both them stood by the Jordan.

verses.name: II Kings 2:8
verses.text: And Elijah took his mantle and rolled <hi>it</hi> up, and struck the waters. And they were divided here and there, so that both of them crossed over on dry ground.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Kings 2:9
