verses.text: And Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha for a wife, and she bore him Attai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:36
verses.text: And Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:37
verses.text: and Zabad fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:38
verses.text: and Obed fathered Jehu, and Jehu fathered Azariah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:39
verses.text: and Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:40
verses.text: and Eleasah fathered Sisamai, and Sisamai fathered Shallum,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:41
verses.text: and Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:42
verses.text: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his first-born, the father of Ziph. And the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:43
verses.text: And the sons of Hebron <hi>were</hi> Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:44
verses.text: And Shema fathered Raham, the father of Jorkoam. And Rekem fathered Shammai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:45
verses.text: And the son of Shammai <hi>was</hi> Maon. And Maon <hi>was</hi> the father of Beth-zur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:46
verses.text: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez. And Haran fathered Gazez.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:47
verses.text: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:48
verses.text: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber, and Tirhanah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:49
verses.text: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea. And Caleb's daughter <hi>was</hi> Achsah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:50
verses.text: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur. The first-born of Ephratah <hi>was</hi> Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim;

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:51
verses.text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:52
verses.text: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahethites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:53
verses.text: And the families of Kirjath-jearim <hi>were</hi> the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:54
verses.text: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half the Manahethites, the Zorites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:55
verses.text: And the families of the scribes who lived at Jabez <hi>were</hi> the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These <hi>are</hi> the Kenites who came from Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: And these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron. The first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel. The second, Daniel, of Abigail of Carmel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur. The fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital. The sixth was Ithream by Eglah his wife.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: <hi> These</hi> six were born to him in Hebron. And there he reigned seven years and six months. And he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: And these were born to him in Jerusalem Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four of Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: <hi> These were</hi> all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: And Solomon's son <hi>was</hi> Rehoboam, and Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: And the sons of Josiah: Johanan the first-born, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: And the sons of Jeconiah: Assir, and Shealtiel his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:18
verses.text: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:19
verses.text: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:20
verses.text: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:21
verses.text: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jesaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:22
verses.text: And the son of Shechaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:23
verses.text: And the sons of Neariah <hi>were</hi> Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:24
verses.text: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: The sons of Judah <hi>were</hi> Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath. And Jahath fathered Ahumai, and Lahad. These <hi>are</hi> the families of the Zorathites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash, and the name of their sister <hi>was</hi> Hazelelponi

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Naarah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:7
verses.text: And the sons of Helah: Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:8
verses.text: And Coz fathered Anub, and Zobebah, and the families Aharhel, the son of Harum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:9
verses.text: And Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. And his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore <hi>him</hi> with sorrow.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:10
verses.text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that You would bless me indeed, and make my border larger, and that Your hand might be with me, and that You would keep me from evil, so that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he asked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:11
verses.text: And Chelub the brother of Shuah fathered Mehir; he <hi>was</hi> the father of Eshton.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:12
verses.text: And Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These <hi>are</hi> the men of Rechah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:13
verses.text: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. And the son of Othniel <hi>was</hi> Hathath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:14
verses.text: And Meonothai fathered Ophrah. And Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of the Valley of the Craftsmen. For they <hi>were</hi> craftsmen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:15
verses.text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. And the son of Elah <hi>was</hi> Kenaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:16
verses.text: And the sons of Jehaleleel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:17
verses.text: And the sons of Ezra: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon. And she bore Miriam and Shammai, and Ishbah, Eshtemoa's father.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:18
verses.text: And his wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:19
verses.text: And the sons of his wife <hi>were</hi> Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:20
verses.text: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:21
verses.text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, from the house of Ashbea,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:22
verses.text: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the rule over Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And <hi>these are</hi> ancient things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:23
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the potters and those who lived among plants and hedges. They lived there with the king for his work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:24
verses.text: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:25
verses.text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:26
verses.text: And the sons of Mishma: Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:27
verses.text: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters. But his brothers did not have many sons, and all their family did not multiply like the sons of Judah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:28
verses.text: And they lived at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:29
verses.text: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:30
verses.text: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:31
verses.text: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These <hi>were</hi> their cities until the reign of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:32
verses.text: And their villages <hi>were</hi> Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:33
verses.text: and all their villages <hi>were</hi> around these cities, to Baal. These <hi>were</hi> their homes and their family line.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:34
verses.text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:35
verses.text: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:36
verses.text: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:37
verses.text: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:38
verses.text: These going by name <hi>were</hi> rulers in their families. And the house of their fathers increased greatly.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:39
verses.text: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, to look for pasture for their flocks.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:40
verses.text: And they found fertile and good pasture, for the land <hi>was</hi> wide and quiet and peaceable. For some of the sons of Ham had lived there of old.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:41
verses.text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents, and the homes that were found there, and completely destroyed them until this day, and lived in their places, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:42
verses.text: And <hi>some</hi> of them, of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:43
verses.text: And they struck the rest which escaped to Amalek, and lived there until this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:1
verses.text: And the sons of Reuben, the first-born of Israel (for he <hi>was</hi> the first-born; but since he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, and the genealogy is not to be counted according to the birthright;

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:2
verses.text: For Judah prevailed among his brothers, and from him <hi>came</hi> the chief ruler, but the birthright <hi>was</hi> Joseph's);

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:3
verses.text: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:4
verses.text: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:5
verses.text: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:6
verses.text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away. He <hi>was</hi> ruler of the men of Reuben.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:7
verses.text: And his brothers by their families, in the genealogy of their generations: Jeiel the chief, and Zechariah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:8
verses.text: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal-meon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:9
verses.text: And he lived as far to the east as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:10
verses.text: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand. And they lived in their tents throughout all the east <hi>land</hi> of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:11
verses.text: And the sons of Gad lived opposite them, in the land of Bashan to Salchah

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:12
verses.text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:13
verses.text: And their brothers from the house of their fathers: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:14
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:15
verses.text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:16
verses.text: And they lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the open lands of Sharon, on their borders.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:17
verses.text: All these were counted by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:18
verses.text: The sons of Reuben, and the sons of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, (sons of valor, men lifting up shield and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skillful in war), <hi>were</hi> forty-four thousand, seven hundred and sixty who went out to the war.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:19
verses.text: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:20
verses.text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all who <hi>were</hi> with them. For they cried to God in the battle, and He was pleased to hear them, because they put their trust in Him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:21
verses.text: And they took away their cattle: of their camels, fifty thousand; and of sheep, two hundred fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:22
verses.text: For many fell down slain, because the war <hi>was</hi> of God. And they lived in their places until the captivity.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:23
verses.text: And the sons of the half tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir, and to Mount Hermon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:24
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of war, famous men, heads of the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:25
verses.text: And they sinned against the God of their fathers, and went lusting after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:26
verses.text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria. And he exiled them, the people of Reuben and the people of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:2
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:3
verses.text: And the sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and <hi>their sister</hi> Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:4
verses.text: Eleazar fathered Phinehas. Phinehas fathered Abishua.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:5
verses.text: And Abishua fathered Bukki. And Bukki fathered Uzzi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:6
verses.text: And Uzzi fathered Zerahiah. And Zerahiah fathered Meraioth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:7
verses.text: Meraioth fathered Amariah. And Amariah fathered Ahitub.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:8
verses.text: And Ahitub fathered Zadok. And Zadok fathered Ahimaaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:9
verses.text: And Ahimaaz fathered Azariah. And Azariah fathered Johanan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:10
verses.text: And Johanan fathered Azariah, he who acted in the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:11
verses.text: And Azariah fathered Amariah. And Amariah fathered Ahitub.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:12
verses.text: And Ahitub fathered Zadok. And Zadok fathered Shallum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:13
verses.text: And Shallum fathered Hilkiah. And Hilkiah fathered Azariah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:14
verses.text: And Azariah fathered Seraiah. And Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:15
verses.text: And Jehozadak went away when the LORD exiled Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:16
verses.text: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:17
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:18
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:19
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these <hi>are</hi> the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:20
verses.text: The sons of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:21
verses.text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:22
verses.text: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:23
verses.text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:24
verses.text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:25
verses.text: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:26
verses.text: Elkanah; the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:27
verses.text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: And the sons of Samuel: Joel, Vashni, the first-born, and Abijah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzziah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:30
verses.text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the men whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after the ark had rest.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: And they ministered before the dwelling-place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they waited on their office according to their order.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:33
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the ones who waited with their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:34
verses.text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:35
verses.text: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:36
verses.text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:37
verses.text: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:38
verses.text: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:39
verses.text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:40
verses.text: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:41
verses.text: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:42
verses.text: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:43
verses.text: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:44
verses.text: And their brothers the sons of Merari <hi>stood</hi> on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:45
verses.text: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:46
verses.text: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:47
verses.text: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:48
verses.text: And their brothers, the Levites, <hi>were</hi> appointed for all kinds of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:49
verses.text: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:50
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:51
verses.text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:52
verses.text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:53
verses.text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:54
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> their dwelling-places throughout their camps, within their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, for the lot was theirs.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:55
verses.text: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its open lands all around it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:56
verses.text: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:57
verses.text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah with its open lands, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with their open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:58
verses.text: and Hilen with its open lands, Debir with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:59
verses.text: and Ashan with its open lands, and Beth-shemesh with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:60
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its open lands, and Alemeth with its open lands, and Anathoth with its open lands. All their cities throughout their families <hi>were</hi> thirteen cities.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:61
verses.text: And to the sons of Kohath left of the family of that tribe, cities were given out of the half tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:62
verses.text: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:63
verses.text: And to the sons of Merari <hi>were given</hi> by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:64
verses.text: And the sons of Israel gave these cities to the Levites, with their open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:65
verses.text: And they gave these cities which are called by their names, out of the tribe of the sons of Judah, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:66
verses.text: And <hi>some</hi> of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:67
verses.text: And they gave to them for the cities of refuge, Shechem in Mount Ephraim, with its open lands, also Gezer with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:68
verses.text: and Jokmeam with its open lands, and Beth-horon with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:69
verses.text: and Aijalon with its open lands, and Gath-rimmon with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:70
verses.text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its open lands, and Bileam with its open lands, for the family of the rest of the sons of Kohath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:71
verses.text: To the sons of Gershom <hi>were given</hi> out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its open lands, and Ashtaroth with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:72
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its open lands, Daberath with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:73
verses.text: and Ramoth with its open lands, and Anem with its open lands were given.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:74
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its open lands, and Abdon with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:75
verses.text: and Hukok with its open lands, and Rehob with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:76
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its open lands, and Hammon with its open lands, and Kirjath-aim with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:77
verses.text: To the rest of the sons of Merari <hi>were given</hi> out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with its open lands, Tabor with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:78
verses.text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan: out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness, with its open lands, and Jahzah with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:79
verses.text: and Kedemoth with its open lands, and Mephaath with its open lands.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:80
verses.text: And out of the tribe of Gad they gave Ramoth in Gilead with its open lands, and Mahanaim with its open lands,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:81
verses.text: and Heshbon with its open lands, and Jazer with its open lands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:1
verses.text: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, and Jashub, and Shimron, four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:2
verses.text: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers house, <hi>these</hi> to Tola, great men of might in their generations. Their number in the days of David <hi>was</hi> twenty-two thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:3
verses.text: And the son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five. All of them chiefs.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:4
verses.text: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, <hi>were</hi> bands of soldiers for war, thirty-six thousand men. For they had many wives and sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:5
verses.text: And their brothers among all the families of Issachar <hi>were</hi> great men of might, being in all, by their genealogies, eighty-seven thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:6
verses.text: <hi> The sons</hi> of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:7
verses.text: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five heads of their fathers' house, mighty men of valor. And their genealogy, twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:8
verses.text: And the sons of Becher: Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Becher.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:9
verses.text: And their genealogy by their generations, heads of their fathers' house, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:10
verses.text: And the son of Jediael was Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:11
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred men, going out to war for battle.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:12
verses.text: And Shuppim, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:13
verses.text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:14
verses.text: The sons of Manasseh: Ashriel, the son born to his Syrian concubine with Machir the father of Gilead,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:15
verses.text: and Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim; and the name of his sister <hi>was</hi> Maachah. And the name of the second <hi>was</hi> Zelophehad. And Zelophehad had daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:16
verses.text: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh. And the name of his brother <hi>was</hi> Sheresh, and his sons <hi>were</hi> Ulam and Rakem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:17
verses.text: And the son of Ulam was Bedan. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:18
verses.text: And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:19
verses.text: And the sons of Shemida: Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Ahiam.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:20
verses.text: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:21
verses.text: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead. And the men of Gath, natives in the land, killed them because they came down to take away their cattle.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:22
verses.text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:23
verses.text: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:24
verses.text: And his daughter <hi>was</hi> Sherah, who built Beth-horon the lower, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:25
verses.text: And Rephah <hi>was</hi> his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:26
verses.text: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:27
verses.text: Non his son; Jehoshua his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:28
verses.text: And their possessions and habitations: Bethel and its towns, and eastward to Naaran, and westward to Gezer, with its towns; and Shechem and its towns, to Gaza and its towns.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:29
verses.text: And by the borders of the sons of Manasseh: Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:30
verses.text: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah; and Serah their sister.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:31
verses.text: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel; he <hi>is</hi> the father of Birzavith.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:32
verses.text: And Heber fathered Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:33
verses.text: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These <hi>are</hi> the sons of Japhlet.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:34
verses.text: And the sons of Shamer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:35
verses.text: And the sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:36
verses.text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:37
verses.text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:38
verses.text: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:39
verses.text: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:40
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Asher, heads of their fathers' house, choice, mighty warriors, heads of the rulers. And their enrollment in the warfare in the battle, their number <hi>was</hi> twenty-six thousand men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:1
verses.text: And Benjamin fathered Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:2
verses.text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:3
verses.text: And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:4
verses.text: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:5
verses.text: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:6
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Ehud, these are the heads of the fathers of the people of Geba; and they exiled them to Manahath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:7
verses.text: And Naaman and Ahiah and Gera, he exiled them. And Ehud fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:8
verses.text: And Shaharaim fathered <hi>sons</hi> in the land of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara <hi>were</hi> his wives.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:9
verses.text: And by his wife Hodesh, <hi>were</hi> Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:10
verses.text: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These <hi>were</hi> his sons, heads of the fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:11
verses.text: And by Hushim he had Abitub, and Elpaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:12
verses.text: The sons of Elpaal <hi>were</hi> Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono and Lod, with their towns.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:13
verses.text: And Beriah and Shema <hi>were</hi> heads of the fathers of the people of Aijalon, who drove away the people of Gath;

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:14
verses.text: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:15
verses.text: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:16
verses.text: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:17
verses.text: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:18
verses.text: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab <hi>were</hi> the sons of Elpaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:19
verses.text: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:20
verses.text: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:21
verses.text: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath <hi>were</hi> the sons of Shimhi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:22
verses.text: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:23
verses.text: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:24
verses.text: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:25
verses.text: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel <hi>were</hi> the sons of Shashak.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:26
verses.text: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:27
verses.text: and Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri <hi>were</hi> the sons of Jeroham.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:28
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> heads of the fathers, by their generations, chiefs. These lived in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:29
verses.text: And at Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, whose wife's name <hi>was</hi> Maachah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:30
verses.text: And his first-born son <hi>was</hi> Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:31
verses.text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:32
verses.text: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And these also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, across from them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:33
verses.text: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:34
verses.text: And the son of Jonathan <hi>was</hi> Meribbaal. And Meribbaal fathered Micah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:35
verses.text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:36
verses.text: And Ahaz fathered Jehoadah. And Jehoadah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:37
verses.text: And Moza fathered Binea; Rapha <hi>was</hi> his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:38
verses.text: And Azel <hi>had</hi> six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Azel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:39
verses.text: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born; Jehush, the second; and Eliphelet, the third.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:40
verses.text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Benjamin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:1
verses.text: So all Israel enrolled themselves. And behold, they <hi>were</hi> written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was exiled to Babylon for their sins.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:2
verses.text: And the first people in their possessions in their cities <hi>were</hi> the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the temple slaves.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:3
verses.text: And in Jerusalem lived of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim, and Manasseh:

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:4
verses.text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Pharez the son of Judah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:5
verses.text: And of the Shilonites, Asaiah the first-born and his sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:6
verses.text: And of the sons of Zerah, Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:7
verses.text: And of the sons of Benjamin, Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:8
verses.text: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:9
verses.text: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men <hi>were</hi> chief of the fathers to their fathers' house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:10
verses.text: And of the priests, Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:11
verses.text: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:12
verses.text: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:13
verses.text: and their brothers, heads of their fathers' house, seventeen hundred and sixty very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:14
verses.text: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:15
verses.text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:16
verses.text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:17
verses.text: And the gatekeepers <hi>were</hi> Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman; and their brothers, Shallum <hi>was</hi> the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:18
verses.text: And before they <hi>were</hi> at the king's gate eastward, they <hi>were</hi> gatekeepers in the companies of the sons of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:19
verses.text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of the house of his father, the Korahites, <hi>were</hi> over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle. And their fathers <hi> were</hi> over the army of the LORD, keepers of the entry.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:20
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar <hi>was</hi> the ruler over them in time past, <hi>and</hi> the LORD <hi>was</hi> with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:21
verses.text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah <hi>was</hi> gatekeeper of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:22
verses.text: All these chosen for gatekeepers in the gates <hi>were</hi> two hundred and twelve. These by their genealogies, in their villages, <hi>were</hi> the ones David and Samuel the seer ordained in their set office.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:23
verses.text: So they and their sons <hi>were</hi> over the gates of the house of the LORD, the house of the tabernacle, by watches.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:24
verses.text: The gatekeepers <hi>were</hi> to the four quarters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:25
verses.text: And their brothers in their villages, <hi>were</hi> to come in for seven days from time to time with them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:26
verses.text: For they <hi>were</hi> in faithfulness, the four chief gatekeepers; they <hi>were</hi> Levites, and were over the rooms, and over the treasuries of the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:27
verses.text: And they lived around the house of God, because the duty <hi>was</hi> on them. And they <hi>were</hi> to open it morning by morning.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:28
verses.text: And <hi>certain</hi> of them <hi>were</hi> over the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by count.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:29
verses.text: Some of them also <hi>were</hi> appointed to oversee the vessels and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:30
verses.text: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:31
verses.text: And Mattithiah, of the Levites, who <hi>was</hi> the first-born of Shallum the Korahite, <hi>was</hi> faithful over the work of the pans.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:32
verses.text: And others of the sons of the Kohathites, from among their brothers, <hi>were</hi> over the showbread, to prepare sabbath by sabbath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:33
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites in the chambers, they <hi>were</hi> free of duty, for they were employed in that work day and night.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:34
verses.text: These chief fathers of the Levites <hi>were</hi> chief throughout their generations. These lived at Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:35
verses.text: And Jehiel, the father of Gibeon, lived in Gibeon. His wife's name <hi>was</hi> Maachah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:36
verses.text: And his first-born son <hi>was</hi> Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:37
verses.text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:38
verses.text: And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brothers at Jerusalem, across from their brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:39
verses.text: And Ner fathered Kish. And Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:40
verses.text: And the son of Jonathan <hi>was</hi> Meribbaal. And Meribbaal fathered Micah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:41
verses.text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:42
verses.text: and Ahaz; fathered Jarah. And Jarah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:43
verses.text: And Moza fathered Binea; and Rephaiah was his son; Eleasah, his son; Azel his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:44
verses.text: And to Azel <hi>were</hi> six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Azel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:1
verses.text: And the Philistines fought with Israel. And the men of Israel fled from the face of the Philistines, and fell down dead in Mount Gilboa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:2
verses.text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:3
verses.text: And the battle went sorely against Saul. And the archers hit him, and he was wounded by the archers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:4
verses.text: And Saul said to his armor-bearer, Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised ones come and abuse me. But his armor-bearer would not, for he was very much afraid. So Saul took a sword and fell on it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:5
verses.text: And his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he also fell on the sword and died.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:6
verses.text: And Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:7
verses.text: And all the men of Israel in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons had died. And they left their cities and fled. And the Philistines came and lived in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:8
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, and they found Saul and his sons fallen in Mount Gilboa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:9
verses.text: And they stripped him, and carried his head and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry news to their idols and to the people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:10
verses.text: And they put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his skull in the temple of Dagon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:11
verses.text: And all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:12
verses.text: And all the mighty men arose and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:13
verses.text: And Saul died for his sin which he committed against the LORD, against the word of the LORD, which he did not keep, and also for seeking of a medium, to inquire, and

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:14
verses.text: inquired not of the LORD. And He killed him and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:1
verses.text: And all Israel gathered to David, to Hebron, saying, Behold, we <hi>are</hi> your bone and your flesh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:2
verses.text: And also in time past, even when Saul was king, you <hi>were</hi> the one who led out and brought in Israel. And the LORD your God said to you, You shall feed My people Israel, and you shall be ruler over My people Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:3
verses.text: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron. And David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:4
verses.text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, where the Jebusites <hi>were</hi> the people of the land.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:5
verses.text: And the people of Jebus said to David, You shall not come in here. But David took the stronghold of Zion, which <hi>is</hi> the city of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:6
verses.text: And David said, Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and was chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:7
verses.text: And David lived in the stronghold. Therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:8
verses.text: And he built the city all around, even from Millo all around. And Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:9
verses.text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of hosts <hi>was</hi> with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:10
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the chief of the mighty men whom David <hi>had</hi>, making themselves strong with him in his kingdom, with all Israel to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:11
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the number of the mighty men whom David <hi>had</hi>: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains. He lifted up his spear against three hundred, who were killed by him at one time.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:12
verses.text: And after him <hi>was</hi> Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, he was one of the three mighty ones.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:13
verses.text: He was with David at Pas-dammim. And there the Philistines were gathered together to battle and a portion of the field was full of barley. And the people fled from before the Philistines.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:14
verses.text: And they set themselves in the midst of that place, and delivered it, and killed the Philistines. And the LORD saved <hi>them</hi> by a great deliverance.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:15
verses.text: And three of the mighty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam. And the Philistine army camped in the Valley of the Giants.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:16
verses.text: And David <hi>was</hi> then in the stronghold, and the Philistines garrison <hi>was</hi> then at Bethlehem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:17
verses.text: And David longed and said, Oh that someone would give me drink from the water of the well of Bethlehem, which <hi>was</hi> by the gate!

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:18
verses.text: And the three broke through the Philistine army and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem by the gate, and took <hi>it</hi>, and brought <hi>it</hi> to David. But David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:19
verses.text: And he said, May my God forbid me to do this thing. Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in danger? For they brought it with their lives. And he <hi>was</hi> not willing to drink it. These three mighty ones did these things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:20
verses.text: And Abishai the brother of Joab <hi>was</hi> chief of the three. For lifting up his spear against three hundred, he killed them, and had a name among the three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:21
verses.text: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two for he was their captain. However, he did not attain the first three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:22
verses.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a mighty man of Kabzeel, had done many acts. He killed two lion-like men of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in a pit on a snowy day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:23
verses.text: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits high. And in the Egyptian's hand <hi>was</hi> a spear like a weaver's beam. And he went down to him with a staff and wrenched the spear out of the Egyptians hand, and killed him with his own spear.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:24
verses.text: These <hi>things</hi> Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and had the name among the three mighty ones.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:25
verses.text: Behold, he was honorable among the thirty, but did not attain the <hi>first</hi> three. And David set him over his court.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:26
verses.text: And the mighty ones of the army: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:27
verses.text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:28
verses.text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Ahiezer the Anathothite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:29
verses.text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:30
verses.text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:31
verses.text: Ithai a son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:32
verses.text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:33
verses.text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:34
verses.text: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:35
verses.text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:36
verses.text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:37
verses.text: Hezro of Carmel, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:38
verses.text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:39
verses.text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:40
verses.text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:41
verses.text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:42
verses.text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:43
verses.text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:44
verses.text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:45
verses.text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:46
verses.text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:47
verses.text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:1
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the ones who came to David to Ziklag, while banned from the face of Saul the son of Kish. And they <hi>were</hi> among the mighty men, helpers of the war,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:2
verses.text: right and left-handed, armed with bows, with stones, and with arrows, with the bow from the brothers of Saul, of Benjamin

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:3
verses.text: The chief <hi>was</hi> Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jehu of Anathoth

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:4
verses.text: and Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:5
verses.text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:6
verses.text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:7
verses.text: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:8
verses.text: And of the Gadites mighty men separated themselves to David into the stronghold in the wilderness, men of the army for battle, setting in order shield and buckler, and their faces <hi>were</hi> the faces of a lion, and as gazelles on the heights for swiftness:

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:9
verses.text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:10
verses.text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:11
verses.text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:12
verses.text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:13
verses.text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:14
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Gad, captains of the army. One of the least <hi>was</hi> over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:15
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> they who went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks. And they put all those of the valleys to flight, toward the east and toward the west.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:16
verses.text: And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:17
verses.text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, to help me, my heart shall be knit to you. But if you come to betray me to my enemies, since there is no wrong in my hands, let the God of our fathers look on it and rebuke it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:18
verses.text: And the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty. <hi>And he said</hi>, We <hi>are</hi> yours, David, and on your side, son of Jesse. Peace, peace be on you, and peace on your helpers. For your God has helped you. And David received them and made them captains of the band.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:19
verses.text: And <hi>some</hi> from Manasseh fell to David when he came with the Philistines to battle against Saul. (But they did not help them. For the lords of the Philistines sent him away on advice, saying, He will fall to his master Saul with our heads.)

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:20
verses.text: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him these from Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who <hi>were</hi> from Manasseh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:21
verses.text: And they helped David against the band, for they <hi>were</hi> all mighty men of power, and <hi>were</hi> commanders in the army.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:22
verses.text: For at <hi>that</hi> time they came to David day by day to help him, until <hi>it was</hi> a great army, like an army of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:23
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the numbers of the chiefs of those armed for war who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:24
verses.text: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear <hi>were</hi> six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:25
verses.text: From the sons of Simeon the mighty men of power for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:26
verses.text: From the sons of Levi <hi>were</hi> four thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:27
verses.text: And Jehoiada <hi>was</hi> the leader of the Aaronites, and with him <hi>were</hi> three thousand and seven hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:28
verses.text: And Zadok, a young man mighty in power, and of his fathers' house <hi>were</hi> twenty-two captains.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:29
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul <hi>were</hi> three thousand. And before, the most of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:30
verses.text: And of the sons of Ephraim <hi>were</hi> twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:31
verses.text: And from the half tribe of Manasseh <hi>were</hi> eighteen thousand, who <hi>were</hi> chosen by name to come and make David king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:32
verses.text: And from the sons of Issachar, <hi>men</hi> who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them <hi>were</hi> two hundred. And all their brothers <hi>were</hi> at their command.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:33
verses.text: From Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all the weapons of war, fifty thousand who could keep rank. <hi>They were</hi> not of a double heart.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:34
verses.text: And from Naphtali, a thousand captains; and with them with shield and spear <hi>were</hi> thirty-seven thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:35
verses.text: And of the Danites, expert in war, <hi>were</hi> twenty-eight thousand, six hundred.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:36
verses.text: And of Asher, going out to the army to set in order the battle <hi>were</hi> forty thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:37
verses.text: And on the other side of Jordan, from the Reubenites, and of the Gadites, and from the half tribe of Manasseh, with all of the weapons of war for battle <hi>were</hi> a hundred and twenty thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:38
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> men of war, keeping rank, they came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over Israel. And also all the rest of Israel <hi>was</hi> of one heart to make David king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:39
verses.text: And they <hi>were</hi> with David three days, eating and drinking. For their brothers had prepared food for them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:40
verses.text: And also those who were near them, even to Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen. And they brought food, meal, cakes of figs and bunches of raisins, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep abundantly. For there <hi>was</hi> joy in Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:1
verses.text: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, with every leader.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:2
verses.text: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If it is good to you, and if it has broken forth from the LORD our God, let us send to our brothers, those remaining in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites in their cities that they be gathered to us.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:3
verses.text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us. For we did not inquire at it in the days of Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:4
verses.text: And all the congregation said to do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:5
verses.text: And David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even to the entering of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:6
verses.text: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kirjath-jearim of Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, He who dwells between the cherubs, whose name is called on it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:7
verses.text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab. And Uzza and Ahio led the cart.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:8
verses.text: And David and all Israel played before God with all <hi>their</hi> might, and with singing, and with lyres, and with harps, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:9
verses.text: And when they came to the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark for the oxen stumbled.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:10
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark. And he died there before the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:11
verses.text: And David was displeased because the LORD had made a break on Uzza. And he called that place The Breach of Uzza to this day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:12
verses.text: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to me?

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:13
verses.text: And David did not bring the ark to himself to the City of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:14
verses.text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that he had.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:1
verses.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timbers of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:2
verses.text: And David saw that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted on high, because of His people Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:3
verses.text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem. And David fathered more sons and daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:4
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> the names of the children whom he <hi>had</hi> in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:5
verses.text: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:6
verses.text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:7
verses.text: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:8
verses.text: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard, and went out against them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:9
verses.text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the Valley of the Giants.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:10
verses.text: And David asked of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And will You deliver them into my hand? And the LORD said to him, Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:11
verses.text: And they came up to Baal-perazim. And David struck them there. Then David said, God has broken in on my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place The Breaking of Baal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:12
verses.text: And they left their gods there. And David commanded, and they were burned with fire.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:13
verses.text: And the Philistines still again made a raid in the valley.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:14
verses.text: And David asked again of God. And God said to him, Do not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them over against the weeping trees.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:15
verses.text: And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the weeping trees, then you shall go out to battle. For God has gone forth before you to strike the army of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:16
verses.text: And David did as God commanded him. And they struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:17
verses.text: And the name of David went out into all lands. And the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:1
verses.text: And <hi>David</hi> made houses for himself in the City of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:2
verses.text: Then David said, No one ought to carry the ark of God except the Levites, for God has chosen them to carry the ark of God, and to minister to Him forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:3
verses.text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place which He had prepared for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:4
verses.text: And David gathered the sons of Aaron, and the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:5
verses.text: From the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and a hundred and twenty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:6
verses.text: From the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:7
verses.text: From the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and a hundred and thirty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:8
verses.text: From the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief and two hundred of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:9
verses.text: From the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief and eighty of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:10
verses.text: From the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief and a hundred and twelve of his brothers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:11
verses.text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:12
verses.text: And he said to them, You <hi>are</hi> the heads of the fathers of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, you and your brothers, so that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place which I have prepared for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:13
verses.text: For because you did not do it at the first, the LORD our God made a break on us, since we did not seek Him in due order.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:14
verses.text: And the priests and the Levites made themselves pure in order to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:15
verses.text: And the sons of the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders, with the staves on it, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:16
verses.text: And David spoke to the chief of the Levites to choose their brothers to be the singers with instruments of music, lyres, and harps, and cymbals, sounding by lifting the voice with joy.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:17
verses.text: And the Levites chose Heman the son of Joel, and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah. And from the sons of Merari their brothers, was Ethan the son of Kushaiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:18
verses.text: And with them <hi>were</hi> their brothers of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:19
verses.text: And the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan <hi>were chosen</hi> to sound with cymbals of bronze;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:20
verses.text: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with harps <hi>set</hi> to Alamoth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:21
verses.text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, <hi>were</hi> to lead with lyres on the octave.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:22
verses.text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, <hi>was</hi> for song. He instructed about the song, because he <hi>was</hi> skillful.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:23
verses.text: And Berechiah and Elkanah <hi>were</hi> gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:24
verses.text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew with the trumpets before the ark of God. And Obed-edom and Jehiah <hi>were</hi> gatekeepers for the ark.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:25
verses.text: And it happened, David and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:26
verses.text: And it happened as God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they offered seven bulls and seven rams.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:27
verses.text: And David <hi>was</hi> clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who carried the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers. David also had on him an ephod of linen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:28
verses.text: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:29
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David, Michal the daughter of Saul, looking out a window, saw king David dancing and playing. And she despised him in her heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:1
verses.text: And they brought the ark of God and set it in the middle of the tent which David had pitched for it. And they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:2
verses.text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:3
verses.text: And he divided to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread and a portion, and a raisin cake.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:4
verses.text: And he appointed <hi>certain</hi> of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:5
verses.text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom. And Jeiel praised with instruments of harps and with lyres; and Asaph made a sound with cymbals.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:6
verses.text: Also Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests <hi>praised</hi> with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:7
verses.text: Then on that day David first delivered <hi>this psalm</hi> into the hand of Asaph and his brothers in order to thank the LORD:

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:8
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call on His name, make known His deeds among the people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:9
verses.text: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him, talk of all His wondrous works.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:10
verses.text: Glory in His holy name, let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:11
verses.text: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face continually.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:12
verses.text: Remember His marvelous works which He had done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:13
verses.text: O seed of Israel His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:14
verses.text: He <hi>is</hi> the LORD our God. His judgments <hi>are</hi> in all the earth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:15
verses.text: Be always mindful of His covenant, the word He commanded to a thousand generations,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:16
verses.text: which He made with Abraham, and of His oath to Isaac.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:17
verses.text: And He has confirmed the saying to Jacob for a law, to Israel <hi>for</hi> an everlasting covenant,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:18
verses.text: saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:19
verses.text: when you were but few, even a few, and strangers in it,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:20
verses.text: and they went from nation to nation, and from <hi>one</hi> kingdom to another people,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:21
verses.text: He did not allow any man to do them wrong. Yea, He reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:22
verses.text: saying, Touch not My anointed, and do My prophets no harm.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:23
verses.text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Show forth from day to day His salvation.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:24
verses.text: Declare His glory among the heathen, His marvelous works among all nations.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:25
