verses.text: For great <hi>is</hi> the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also <hi>is</hi> to be feared above all gods.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:26
verses.text: For all the gods of the peoples <hi>are</hi> idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:27
verses.text: Glory and honor <hi>are</hi> in His presence, strength and gladness in His place.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:28
verses.text: Give to the LORD, O kindred of the people, give to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:29
verses.text: Give to the LORD the glory of His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:30
verses.text: Tremble before Him, all the earth. Yea, the earth is established, it shall not be moved.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:31
verses.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. And let them say among the nations, The LORD reigns.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:32
verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fullness of it. Let the fields rejoice, and all <hi>that is</hi> in them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:33
verses.text: Then shall the trees of the forest sing out at the presence of the LORD, because He comes to judge the earth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:34
verses.text: O give thanks to the LORD, for <hi>He is</hi> good, for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:35
verses.text: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us, and deliver us from the nations, so that we may give thanks to Your holy name, <hi>and</hi> glory in Your praise.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:36
verses.text: Blessed <hi>be</hi> the LORD God of Israel forever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:37
verses.text: And he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, for Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:38
verses.text: also Obed-edom, with their brothers, sixty-eight; and Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun and Hosah <hi>to be</hi> gatekeepers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:39
verses.text: And he left Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place at Gibeon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:40
verses.text: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the burnt offering morning and evening without end, and <hi>to do</hi> according to all that is written in the law of the LORD which He commanded Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:41
verses.text: And <hi>he left</hi> with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were called by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:42
verses.text: And with them were Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those making a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun <hi>were</hi> gatekeepers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:43
verses.text: And all the people departed, each man to his house. And David returned to bless his house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:1
verses.text: And it happened as David sat in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in a house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD <hi>is</hi> under curtains.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:2
verses.text: And Nathan said to David, Do all that <hi>is</hi> in your heart, for God <hi>is</hi> with you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:3
verses.text: And it happened the same night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:4
verses.text: Go and tell David My servant, So says the LORD, You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:5
verses.text: For I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel until today, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle <hi>to another.</hi>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:6
verses.text: Wherever I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed My people, saying, Why have you not built Me a house of cedars?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:7
verses.text: And now you shall say this to My servant David, So says the LORD of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, so that you should be ruler over My people Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:8
verses.text: And I have been with you wherever you have walked, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men in the earth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:9
verses.text: And I will set a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall live in their place and shall be moved no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:10
verses.text: and since the time that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. And I declare to you that the LORD will build you a house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:11
verses.text: And it will be, when your days have ended so that you must go <hi>to be</hi> with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your sons. And I will make his kingdom sure.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:12
verses.text: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:13
verses.text: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. And I will not take My mercy away from him as I took <hi>it</hi> from him who was before you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:14
verses.text: And I will settle him in My house, and in My kingdom forever. And his throne shall be established forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:15
verses.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:16
verses.text: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who <hi>am</hi> I, O, LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me here?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:17
verses.text: And this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, for You have also spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:18
verses.text: What can David <hi>say</hi> more to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant!

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:19
verses.text: O LORD, for Your servant's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all <hi>these</hi> great things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:20
verses.text: O LORD, <hi>there is</hi> none like You, neither <hi>any</hi> God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:21
verses.text: And what one nation in the earth <hi>is</hi> like Your people Israel, whom God went to redeem <hi>to be</hi> His own people, to make You a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You have redeemed out of Egypt?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:22
verses.text: And You have chosen Your people Israel for Yourself, for a people forever. And You, LORD, became their God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:23
verses.text: And now, O LORD, let the thing which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do as You have said.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:24
verses.text: Let it even be established, so that Your name may be magnified forever, saying, The LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> the God of Israel, a God to Israel. And <hi>let</hi> the house of David Your servant be established before You.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:25
verses.text: For You, O my God, have told Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found <hi>in his heart</hi> to pray before You.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:26
verses.text: And now, LORD, You <hi>are</hi> God, and have promised this goodness to Your servant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:27
verses.text: And now let it please You to bless the house of Your servant so that it may be before You forever. For You have blessed, O LORD, and it <hi>is</hi> blessed forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:1
verses.text: And it happened after this, David struck the Philistines and humbled them. And he took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:2
verses.text: And he struck Moab. And the people of Moab became David's servants and brought gifts.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:3
verses.text: And David struck Hadarezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:4
verses.text: And David took from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen. David also hamstrung all the chariot <hi>horses</hi>, but kept from them a hundred chariots.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:5
verses.text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:6
verses.text: Then David placed <hi>troops</hi> in Syria, <hi>in</hi> Damascus. And the Syrians became David's servants, bringing gifts. And the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:7
verses.text: And David took the shields of gold which <hi>were</hi> on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:8
verses.text: And David brought very much bronze from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:9
verses.text: And Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadarezer king of Zobah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:10
verses.text: he sent Hadoram his son to king David to ask of his welfare, and to praise him because he had fought against Hadarezer and had beaten him. For Hadarezer had war with Tou. And <hi>he sent</hi> all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:11
verses.text: And king David dedicated them to the LORD, with the silver and the gold which he brought from all the nations, from Edom, and from Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:12
verses.text: And Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand of the men of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:13
verses.text: And he put guards in Edom. And all the men of Edom <hi>became</hi> David's servants. And the LORD kept David safe wherever he went.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:14
verses.text: And David reigned over all Israel, and did judgment and justice among all his people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:15
verses.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah <hi>was</hi> over the army. And Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud <hi>was</hi> recorder.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:16
verses.text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar <hi>were</hi> the priests. And Shavsha <hi>was</hi> scribe.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:17
verses.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada <hi>was</hi> over the Cherethites and the Pelethites. And the sons of David <hi>were</hi> first ones at the hand of the king.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:1
verses.text: And it happened after this, Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died. And his son reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:2
verses.text: And David said, I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon to Hanun, in order to comfort him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:3
verses.text: But the rulers of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, Is David honoring your father in your eyes, because he has sent comforters to you? Have not his servants come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:4
verses.text: And Hanun took David's servants and shaved them, and cut off their garments in half, to the buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:5
verses.text: And <hi>some</hi> came and told David how the men were treated. And he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Stay at Jericho until your beards are grown, and <hi>then</hi> return.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:6
verses.text: And the Ammonites saw that they had made themselves stink before David, and Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia and out of Maachah of Syria, and out of Zobah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:7
verses.text: And they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people, who came and pitched before Medeba. And the Ammonites gathered themselves from their cities and came to battle.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:8
verses.text: And David heard, and he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:9
verses.text: And the sons of Ammon came out and put the battle in order before the gate of the city. And the kings who had come <hi>were</hi> by themselves in the field.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:10
verses.text: And Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, and he chose out of all the choice young men of Israel and set in order against the Syrians.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:11
verses.text: And he delivered the rest of the people into the hand of his brother Abishai. And they set in order against the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:12
verses.text: And he said, If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me. But if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:13
verses.text: Be of good courage and let us behave ourselves bravely for our people, and for the cities of our God. And let the LORD do what is good in His sight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:14
verses.text: And Joab and the people with him drew near before the Syrians to the battle. And they fled before him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:15
verses.text: And when the sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they also fled before his brother Abishai. And they entered into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:16
verses.text: And the Syrians saw that they were beaten before Israel, and sent messengers and drew forth the Syrians who <hi>were</hi> beyond the river. And Shophach the captain of the army of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:17
verses.text: And it was told to David. And he gathered all Israel and passed over Jordan and came on them. And he set in order against them. And David set in order against the Syrians, and they fought with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:18
verses.text: But the Syrians fled before Israel. And David killed seven thousand of the Syrians <hi>in</hi> chariots, and forty thousand footmen; and he killed Shophach the commander of the army.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:19
verses.text: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were beaten before Israel, and they made peace with David and became his servants. And Syria was not willing to help the sons of Ammon any more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:1
verses.text: And it happened after the year had ended, at the time kings go forth, Joab led out the power of the army and wasted the country of the sons of Ammon. And he came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and destroyed it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:2
verses.text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head and found its weight a talent of gold. And precious stones <hi>were</hi> in it. And it was set on David's head, and he also brought exceeding much spoil out of the city.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:3
verses.text: And he brought out the people who <hi>were</hi> in it. And <hi>they</hi> sawed with saws and with sharp tools of iron, and with the axes. And so David did with the cities of the sons of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:4
verses.text: And it happened after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the children of the giant. And they were humbled.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:5
verses.text: And there was war again with the Philistines. And Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear <hi>was</hi> like a weavers' beam.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:6
verses.text: And again there was a battle in Gath, and a man of stature was there, and his fingers and toes <hi>were</hi> twenty-four, six <hi>on each hand</hi> and six <hi>on each foot</hi>. And he also had been born son of the giant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:7
verses.text: But he cursed Israel, and Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:8
verses.text: These were born to the giant in Gath. And they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:1
verses.text: And Satan stood up against Israel and provoked David to take a census of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:2
verses.text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go number Israel from Beer-sheba to Dan. And bring the number of them to me so that I may know.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:3
verses.text: And Joab answered, May the LORD add to His people a hundred times, but my lord the king, <hi>are</hi> they not all my lord's servants? Why then does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:4
verses.text: But the king's word prevailed against Joab. And Joab departed and went up and down all Israel, and came again to Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:5
verses.text: And Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. And in all Israel there were one million and a hundred thousand men who drew sword. And in Judah <hi>were</hi> four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew sword.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:6
verses.text: But Levi and Benjamin he did not count among them; for the king's word was evil to Joab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:7
verses.text: And it was evil in the eyes of God as to this thing. And He struck Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:8
verses.text: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. But now, I beseech You, remove the iniquity of Your servant for I have done very foolishly.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:9
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:10
verses.text: Go and speak to David, saying, So says the LORD: I offer you three <hi>things</hi>. Choose one of them so that I may do it to you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:11
verses.text: And Gad came to David and said to him, So says the LORD, Choose for yourself:

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:12
verses.text: either three years of famine, or three months to be swept away before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtake you, or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even the plague in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the border of Israel. And now say what word I shall bring again to Him who sent me.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: And David said to Gad, I am in great distress. Let me fall now into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies <hi>are</hi> very great. But do not let me fall into the hand of man.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: And the LORD sent a plague on Israel. And there fell seventy thousand men of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. And as he was destroying, the LORD looked. And He repented of the evil and said to the angel who destroyed, Enough! Stay your hand now! And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: And David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: And David said to God, Did not I command to number the people? I am the one who has sinned and done evil indeed. But these sheep, what have they done? I pray You, let Your hand be on me, O LORD my God, and on my father's house, but not on Your people, that they should be plagued.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: And the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David that David should go up and set up an altar to the LORD in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: And David went up at the word of Gad which he spoke in the name of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: And Ornan turned back and saw the angel. And his four sons with him hid themselves. And Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:21
verses.text: And David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David. And he went out of the threshing-floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:22
verses.text: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place of this threshing-floor, so that I may build an altar in it to the LORD. You shall give it to me for the full price, so that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:23
verses.text: And Ornan said to David, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do what is good in his eyes. Lo, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the food offering. I give it all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:24
verses.text: And king David said to Ornan, No, but I will truly buy it for the full silver. For I will not take what <hi>is</hi> yours for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:25
verses.text: And David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:26
verses.text: And David built an altar there to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD. And He answered him from Heaven by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:27
verses.text: And the LORD commanded the angel, and he put up his sword again into its sheath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:28
verses.text: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:29
verses.text: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, <hi>were</hi> at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:30
verses.text: But David could not go before it to ask of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: Then David said, This <hi>is</hi> the house of the LORD God, and this <hi>is</hi> the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: And David commanded the strangers in the land of Israel to be gathered. And he set masons to cut squared stones to build the house of God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: and also cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought in cedar trees in abundance to David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: And David said, Solomon my son <hi>is</hi> young and tender, and the house to be built for the LORD is to be highly magnificent, for a name and for beauty to all the lands. I will now prepare for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: And he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:8
verses.text: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, You have shed much blood and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to My name because you have shed much blood on the earth in My sight.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: Behold, a son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest. And I will give him rest from all his enemies all around. For his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: He shall build a house for My name. And he shall be My son, and I <hi>will be</hi> his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and bless you, and build the house of the LORD your God as He has said of you.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: Only may the LORD give you wisdom and understanding, and direct you concerning Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:13
verses.text: Then you shall prosper, if you take heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments with which the LORD charged Moses, concerning Israel. Be strong and of good courage. Do not fear, nor be dismayed.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:14
verses.text: And, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver, and of bronze and iron without weight, for it is in abundance. I have prepared timber also, and stone, and you may add to them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:15
verses.text: And there <hi>are</hi> many workmen with you, cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of skillful men for every kind of work.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:16
verses.text: Of the gold, the silver, and the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:17
verses.text: And David commanded all the rulers of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:18
verses.text: Is not the LORD your God with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has given the people of the land into my hand. And the land is humbled before the LORD and before His people.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:19
verses.text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God. Arise therefore and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: And David was old and full of days, and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> gathered all the rulers of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward. And their number by their heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: Of these, twenty-four thousand <hi>were</hi> to set forward the work of the house of the LORD, and six thousand officers and judges.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: And four thousand <hi>were</hi> gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which <hi>David</hi> made for praising.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: Of the men of Gershon <hi>were</hi> Laadan and Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: The sons of Laadan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These <hi>were</hi> the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four <hi>were</hi> the sons of Shimei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: And Jahath <hi>was</hi> the chief, and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons. Therefore they were in one roster, according to <hi>their</hi> father's house.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was separated so that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to Him, and to bless in His name forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: And <hi>as to</hi> Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel <hi>was</hi> the chief.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith <hi>was</hi> the chief;

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:22
verses.text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but had daughters. And their brothers, the sons of Kish, took them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:23
verses.text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:24
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers, the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their heads, the ones who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:25
verses.text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel has given rest to His people so that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:26
verses.text: and also to the Levites, so that they shall no <hi>more</hi> carry the tabernacle, nor any of its vessels for its service.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:27
verses.text: For by the last words of David the Levites <hi>were</hi> numbered from twenty years old and above,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:28
verses.text: because their office <hi>was</hi> to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:29
verses.text: both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for food offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all kinds of measure and size,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:30
verses.text: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at evening.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:31
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> were to offer all burnt sacrifices to the LORD in the sabbath, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded to them, continually before the LORD,

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:32
verses.text: and that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the Holy Place, and the charge of their brothers, the sons of Aaron, in the service of the house of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: And the divisions of the sons of Aaron <hi>were</hi>: The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. And Eleazar and Ithamar were priests.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: And David distributed them according to their offices in their service, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar. And so they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar <hi>were</hi> sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: So they divided them by lot, one sort with another. For the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and <hi>before</hi> the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites. One principal household was taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:16
verses.text: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:17
verses.text: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:18
verses.text: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:19
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> their orderings in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, to Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:20
verses.text: And the rest of the sons of Levi: Of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:21
verses.text: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first <hi>was</hi> Isshiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:22
verses.text: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:23
verses.text: And the sons <hi>of Hebron</hi>: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:24
verses.text: <hi> Of</hi> the sons of Uzziel, Michah. Of the sons of Michah, Shamir.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:25
verses.text: The brother of Michah <hi>was</hi> Isshiah. Of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:26
verses.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah, Beno.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:27
verses.text: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:28
verses.text: Of Mahli <hi>was</hi> Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:29
verses.text: Of Kish, the son of Kish <hi>was</hi> Jerahmeel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:30
verses.text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These <hi>were</hi> the sons of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:31
verses.text: And they also cast lots along with their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, the head of the fathers, as well as his younger brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:1
verses.text: And David and the army commanders separated to the service those of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who <hi>were</hi> prophets with lyres and with cymbals. And the number of the workmen according to their service was:

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:2
verses.text: of the sons of Asaph, Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:3
verses.text: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, <hi>and Shimei</hi>, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:4
verses.text: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Josh-bekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:5
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:6
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:7
verses.text: So the number of them, with their brothers who <hi>were</hi> instructed in the songs of the LORD, all that <hi>were</hi> skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:8
verses.text: And they cast lots, for duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher as the pupil.

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:9
verses.text: And the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second was to Gedaliah, with his brothers and sons, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:10
verses.text: the third <hi>was</hi> to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve men;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:11
verses.text: the fourth <hi>was</hi> to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:12
verses.text: the fifth <hi>was</hi> to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:13
verses.text: the sixth <hi>was</hi> to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:14
verses.text: the seventh <hi>was</hi> to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:15
verses.text: the eighth <hi>was</hi> to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:16
verses.text: the ninth <hi>was</hi> to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:17
verses.text: the tenth <hi>was</hi> to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:18
verses.text: the eleventh <hi>was</hi> to Azareel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:19
verses.text: the twelfth <hi>was</hi> to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:20
verses.text: the thirteenth <hi>was</hi> to Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:21
verses.text: the fourteenth <hi>was</hi> to Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:22
verses.text: the fifteenth <hi>was</hi> to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve,

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:23
verses.text: the sixteenth <hi>was</hi> to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:24
verses.text: the seventeenth <hi>was</hi> to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:25
verses.text: the eighteenth <hi>was</hi> to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:26
verses.text: the nineteenth <hi>was</hi> to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:27
verses.text: the twentieth <hi>was</hi> to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:28
verses.text: the twenty-first <hi>was</hi> to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:29
verses.text: the twenty-second <hi>was</hi> to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:30
verses.text: the twenty-third <hi>was</hi> to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.name: I Chronicles 25:31
verses.text: the twenty-fourth <hi>was</hi> to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:1
verses.text: For the divisions of the gatekeepers: Of the Korhites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: And the sons of Meshelemiah: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: And the sons of Obed-edom: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth-- for God blessed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: Also sons <hi>were</hi> born to his son Shemaiah, who ruled for the house of their father, for they <hi>were</hi> mighty men of valor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers <hi>were</hi> strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: All these <hi>were</hi> the sons of Obed-edom. They and their sons and their brothers <hi>were</hi> able men for strength for the service, and there <hi>were</hi> sixty-two of Obed-edom.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, strong men, eighteen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: Also to Hosah, of the sons of Merari, <hi>were</hi> sons: Simri was the chief (<hi> though</hi> not the first-born, yet his father made him the chief),

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah <hi>were</hi> thirteen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: among these <hi>were</hi> the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having charges like their brothers, to minister in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah; then Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots. And his lot came out northward.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse;

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: to Shuppim and Hosah westward, with the gate of Shallecheth, by the highway going up, guard corresponding to guard.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: Eastward <hi>were</hi> six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward the storehouse, two by two.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: At the Parbar, westward, four at the highway, two at the Parbar.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: These are the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: And of the Levites, Ahijah <hi>was</hi> over the treasures of the house of God and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: The sons of Laadan, sons of the Gershonites; chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli;

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: the sons of Jehieli: Zetham and Joel his brother, <hi>who were</hi> over the treasures of the house of the LORD,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: for the Amramites, <hi>and</hi> the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:24
verses.text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, <hi>was</hi> ruler of the treasures.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:25
verses.text: And his brothers by Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:26
verses.text: This Shelomith and his brothers <hi>were</hi> over all the treasures of the holy things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the commanders over thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had given.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:27
verses.text: They dedicated <hi>part of</hi> the spoils won in battles, to maintain the house of the LORD,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:28
verses.text: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated. Whoever had dedicated <hi>anything, it was</hi> at the hand of Shelomith and of his brothers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:29
verses.text: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons <hi>were</hi> for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:30
verses.text: Of the men of Hebron, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, <hi>were</hi> officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:31
verses.text: Jerijah <hi>was</hi> the chief among the men of Hebron. He was of the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:32
verses.text: And his brothers, mighty men, <hi>were</hi> two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers whom king David made rulers over the men of Reuben, of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter having to do with God and the affairs of the king.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:1
verses.text: And the sons of Israel according to their number, the chief fathers and commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions, who came in and went out month by month for all the months of the year, <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand of every division.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:2
verses.text: Over the first division for the first month <hi>was</hi> Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:3
verses.text: Of the sons of Perez <hi>was</hi> the chief of all the commanders of the army for the first month.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:4
verses.text: And over the division of the second month <hi>was</hi> Dodai the Ahohite, and of his division Mikloth <hi>was</hi> also the ruler. In his division also <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:5
verses.text: The third commander of the army for the third month <hi>was</hi> Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:6
verses.text: This <hi>is that</hi> Benaiah who <hi>was</hi> mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty. And in his division <hi>was</hi> Ammizabad his son.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:7
verses.text: The fourth for the fourth month <hi>was</hi> Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:8
verses.text: The fifth commander for the fifth month <hi>was</hi> Shamhuth the Izrahite. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:9
verses.text: The sixth for the sixth month <hi>was</hi> Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:10
verses.text: The seventh for the seventh month <hi>was</hi> Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:11
verses.text: The eighth for the eighth month <hi>was</hi> Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:12
verses.text: The ninth for the ninth month <hi>was</hi> Abiezer the Anethothite, of the Benjamites. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:13
verses.text: The tenth for the tenth month <hi>was</hi> Maharai of Netopha, of the Zerahites. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:14
verses.text: The eleventh for the eleventh month <hi>was</hi> Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:15
verses.text: The twelfth for the twelfth month <hi>was</hi> Heldai of Netopha, of Othniel. And in his division <hi>were</hi> twenty-four thousand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:16
verses.text: And over the tribes of Israel, the ruler of the Reubenites <hi>was</hi> Eliezer the son of Zichri. The ruler of the Simeonites <hi>was</hi> Shephatiah the son of Maachah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:17
verses.text: The ruler of the Levites was Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; over the Aaronites <hi>was</hi> Zadok.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:18
verses.text: Over Judah <hi>was</hi> Elihu, of the brothers of David. The ruler of Issachar <hi>was</hi> Omri the son of Michael.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:19
verses.text: The ruler of Zebulun <hi>was</hi> Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah. The ruler of Naphtali <hi>was</hi> Jerimoth the son of Azriel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:20
verses.text: The ruler of the sons of Ephraim <hi>was</hi> Hoshea the son of Azaziah. The ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh <hi>was</hi> Joel the son of Pedaiah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:21
verses.text: The ruler of the <hi>half</hi> tribe of Manasseh in Gilead <hi>was</hi> Iddo the son of Zechariah. The ruler of Benjamin <hi>was</hi> Jaasiel the son of Abner.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:22
verses.text: <hi> The ruler</hi> of Dan <hi>was</hi> Azareel the son of Jeroham. These <hi>were</hi> the rulers of the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:23
verses.text: But David did not take the number of those from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said <hi>He would</hi> increase Israel like the stars of the heavens.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:24
verses.text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he did not finish because wrath fell against the sons of Israel for this. And the number did not go up in the account of the chronicles of king David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:25
verses.text: And over the king's treasures <hi>was</hi> Azmaveth the son of Adiel. And over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the strongholds, <hi>was</hi> Jehonathan the son of Uzziah.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:26
verses.text: Ezri the son of Chelub <hi>was</hi> over the work of the field for farming the ground.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:27
verses.text: And over the vineyards <hi>was</hi> Shimei of Ramah. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars <hi>was</hi> Zabdi the Shiphmite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:28
verses.text: And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that <hi>were</hi> in the low plains <hi>was</hi> Baal-hanan of Geder. And over the cellars of oil <hi>was</hi> Joash.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:29
verses.text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon <hi>was</hi> Shitrai of Sharon. And over the herds in the valleys <hi>was</hi> Shaphat the son of Adlai.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:30
verses.text: Over the camels also <hi>was</hi> Obil the Ishmaelite. And over the asses <hi>was</hi> Jehdeiah the Meronothite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:31
verses.text: And over the flocks <hi>was</hi> Jaziz the son of Hagar. All these <hi>were</hi> the rulers of the substance which <hi>was</hi> king David's.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:32
verses.text: And Jonathan, David's uncle, <hi>was</hi> an adviser, a wise man and a scribe. And Jehiel the son of Hachmoni <hi>was</hi> with the king's sons.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:33
verses.text: And Ahithophel <hi>was</hi> the king's counselor. And Hushai the Archite <hi>was</hi> the king's companion.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:34
verses.text: And after Ahithophel <hi>was</hi> Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. And the general of the king's army <hi>was</hi> Joab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:1
verses.text: And David gathered to Jerusalem all the rulers of Israel, the rulers of the tribes, and the commanders of the divisions that ministered to the king by division, and the commanders over the thousands, and commanders over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the eunuchs and the mighty ones, even to every mighty one of valor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:2
verses.text: And David the king stood up on his feet and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. I <hi>had</hi> in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:3
verses.text: But God said to me, You shall not build a house for My name, because you <hi>have been</hi> a man of war and have shed blood.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:4
verses.text: But the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For He has chosen Judah to be the ruler, and of the house of Judah the house of my father. And in my father's house He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:5
verses.text: And of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:6
verses.text: And He said to me, Solomon your son shall build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him <hi>to be</hi> My son, and I will be his Father.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:7
verses.text: And I will establish his kingdom forever if he will always do My commandments and My judgments, as at this day.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:8
verses.text: And now in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave <hi>it</hi> for an inheritance for your sons after you forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:9
verses.text: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind. For the LORD searches all hearts and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you. But if you forsake Him, He will cast you off forever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:10
verses.text: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:11
verses.text: And David gave to his son Solomon the pattern of the porch, and of its houses, and of its treasuries, and of its upper rooms, and of its innermost rooms, and of the place of the mercy-seat,

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:12
verses.text: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the rooms all around the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the holy things;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:13
verses.text: And for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:14
verses.text: even gold by weight for <hi>things</hi> of gold, for all instruments of every kind of service; silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels every kind of service;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:15
verses.text: and by weight for the lampstands of gold, and for their lamps of gold, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps. And he gave for the lampstands of silver by weight, for the lampstand and for its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:16
verses.text: and by weight gold for the tables of the showbread, for every table; silver for the tables of silver;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:17
verses.text: and pure gold for the flesh-hooks, and the bowls, and the cups; and for the golden basins by weight for each basin, and by weight for each basin of silver;

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:18
verses.text: and the altar of incense refined gold by weight, and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubs, who spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:19
verses.text: All <hi>was</hi> in writing from the hand of the LORD. He made me understand all the work of this pattern.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:20
verses.text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do <hi>it</hi>. Do not fear, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, my God, <hi>will be</hi> with you. He will not fail you nor leave you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:21
verses.text: And, behold, the divisions of the priests and the Levites are for all the service of the house of God. And <hi>there shall be</hi> with you every willing skillful man for every kind of workmanship, for any kind of service. Also the rulers and all the people will be according to all your words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:1
verses.text: And David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, <hi>is</hi> young and tender, and the work <hi>is</hi> great. For the palace <hi>is</hi> not for man, but for the LORD God.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:2
verses.text: And I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for <hi>things of</hi> gold, and the silver for <hi>things</hi> of silver, and the bronze for <hi>things</hi> of bronze, the iron for <hi>things</hi> of iron, and wood for <hi>things</hi> of wood, onyx stones, and <hi>stones to</hi> be set, and also stones of antimony, and stones of many colors, and every precious stone, and stones of alabaster, in abundance.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:3
verses.text: And also, because I have delighted in the house of my God, out of my own treasure of gold and silver I have given to the house of my God over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:4
verses.text: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:5
verses.text: the gold for <hi>things</hi> of gold, and the silver for <hi>things</hi> of silver, and for all kinds of work by the hands of skillful workers. And who <hi>is</hi> willing to consecrate his service this day to the LORD?

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:6
verses.text: And the chiefs of the fathers, and the rulers of the tribes of Israel, and the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:7
verses.text: And they gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:8
verses.text: And he <hi>who had</hi> precious stones gave to the treasury of the house of the LORD by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:9
verses.text: And the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD. And David the king also rejoiced with great joy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:10
verses.text: And David blessed the LORD before all the congregation. And David said, Blessed <hi>are</hi> You, LORD God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:11
verses.text: O LORD, Yours <hi>is</hi> the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and, the majesty. For all in the heavens and in the earth <hi>is Yours</hi>. Yours <hi>is</hi> the kingdom, O LORD, and You lift up <hi>Yourself</hi> to all as Head.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:12
verses.text: And the riches and the honor <hi>are</hi> from You, and You reign over all. And in Your hand <hi>is</hi> power and might. And <hi>it is</hi> in Your hand to make great and to give strength to all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:13
verses.text: And now, our God, we thank You and praise Your glorious name.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:14
verses.text: But who <hi>am</hi> I, and who my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? For all things <hi>are</hi> from You, and we have given to You that which is Yours.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:15
verses.text: For we <hi>are</hi> strangers before You, and pilgrims, as our fathers <hi>were</hi>. Our days on the earth <hi>are</hi> like a shadow, and none abides.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:16
verses.text: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name <hi>comes</hi> from Your hand, and is all Your own.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:17
verses.text: I know also, my God, that You try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. I, in the uprightness of my heart, have willingly offered all these things. And now I have seen with joy Your people who are present here to offer willingly to You.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:18
verses.text: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and prepare their heart to You.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:19
verses.text: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep Your commandments, Your testimonies, and Your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the magnificent house <hi>for</hi> which I have made ready.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:20
verses.text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God! And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed and worshiped the LORD, and <hi>bowed</hi> to the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:21
verses.text: And they sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:22
verses.text: And they ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed <hi>him</hi> before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok <hi>to be</hi> as priest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:23
verses.text: And Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of David his father. And he was blessed, and all Israel obeyed him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:24
verses.text: And all the rulers and the mighty men, and also all the sons of king David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:25
verses.text: And the LORD made Solomon very great in the sight of all Israel, and placed on him <hi>such</hi> royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:26
verses.text: And David, the son of Jesse, reigned over all Israel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:27
verses.text: And the time that he reigned over Israel <hi>was</hi> forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron, and thirty-three <hi>years</hi> in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:28
verses.text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor. And Solomon his son reigned in his place.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:29
verses.text: And the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:30
verses.text: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the lands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:1
verses.text: And Solomon the son of David was made strong in his kingdom, and the LORD his God <hi>was</hi> with him and made him very great.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:2
verses.text: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:3
verses.text: And Solomon and all the congregation with him went to the high place at Gibeon. For there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:4
verses.text: But the ark of God David had brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:5
verses.text: And he put the bronze altar which Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made before the tabernacle of the LORD. And Solomon and the congregation of the LORD sought to it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:6
verses.text: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which <hi>was</hi> at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:7
verses.text: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, Ask what I shall give you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:8
verses.text: And Solomon said to God, You have shown great mercy to David my father, and have made me to reign in his stead.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:9
verses.text: Now, O LORD God, Your promise to David my father has been fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:10
verses.text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge that I may go out and come in before this people. For who can judge this Your great people?

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:11
verses.text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, nor honor, nor the life of your enemies, nor yet have asked for long life but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may judge My people, over whom I have made you king.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:12
verses.text: wisdom and knowledge <hi>is</hi> granted to you. And I will give you riches and wealth and honor, such as none of the kings have had that have been before you, nor shall any after you have the like.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:13
verses.text: And Solomon came <hi>from</hi> the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:14
verses.text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. And he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:15
verses.text: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem like stones, and he made cedar trees as plentiful as the sycamore trees in the valley.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:16
verses.text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt and Kue. The king's merchants received <hi>them</hi> from Kue at a price.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:17
verses.text: And they carried up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred <hi>shekels</hi> of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. And so they brought out <hi>horses</hi> for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their hands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:1
verses.text: And Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:2
verses.text: And Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand as cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:3
verses.text: And Solomon sent to Hiram the king of Tyre, saying, As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house to dwell in, <hi>so deal with me.</hi>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:4
verses.text: Behold, I am building a house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate <hi>it</hi> to Him, and to burn before Him sweet incense, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:5
verses.text: And the house which I am building <hi>is</hi> great. For our God is great above all gods.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:6
verses.text: But who is able to build Him a house, since the heavens and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Him? Who <hi>am</hi> I then, that I should build Him a house, except only to burn sacrifice before Him?

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:7
verses.text: And now send me a man skillful to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and one who is skillful to engrave with the skillful men who <hi>are</hi> with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:8
verses.text: And send me cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon. For I know that your servants are skillful to cut timber in Lebanon. And, behold, my servants <hi>shall be</hi> with your servants

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:9
verses.text: in order to prepare plenty of timber for me. For the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:10
verses.text: And behold, I will give to the hewers, those who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:11
verses.text: And Hiram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD has loved His people, He has made you king over them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:12
verses.text: And Hiram said, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the LORD God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son blessed with judgment and understanding, who might build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:13
verses.text: And now I have sent a skillful man blessed with understanding, of Hiram my father,

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:14
verses.text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father <hi>was</hi> a man of Tyre, skillful to work in gold, and in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson. He also can engrave any kind of engraving, and can invent every device which shall be put to him, with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:15
verses.text: And now the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:16
verses.text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you shall need. And we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa. And you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:17
verses.text: And Solomon numbered all the aliens in the land of Israel, according to the numbering with which David his father had numbered them. And they <hi>were</hi> found to be a hundred and fifty-three thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:18
verses.text: And he set seventy thousand of them <hi>to be</hi> bearers of burdens, and eighty thousand to be cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people to work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: And Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in Mount Moriah, where He appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: And he began to build in the second <hi>day</hi> of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: Now these <hi>are</hi> the foundations Solomon <hi>laid</hi>, to build the house of God. The length <hi>by</hi> cubits according to the first measure, sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: And the porch on the front, the length according to the breadth of the house, <hi>was</hi> twenty cubits, and the height a hundred and twenty. And he overlaid it inside with pure gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: And he made the ceiling of the greater house with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold. And he set palm trees and chains on it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: And he covered the house with precious stones for beauty. And the gold <hi>was</hi> gold of Parvaim.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the posts, and its walls, and its doors, with gold. And he engraved cherubs on the walls.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: And he made the Most Holy Place. Its length <hi>was</hi> by the front, of the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and its breadth, twenty cubits. And he overlaid it with fine gold, to six hundred talents.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: And the weight of the nails <hi>was</hi> fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper rooms with gold.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubs of carved work, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: And the wings of the cherubs <hi>were</hi> twenty cubits long. One wing <hi>was</hi> five cubits, touching to the wall of the house; and the other wing five cubits, touching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: And <hi>one</hi> wing of the other cherub <hi>was</hi> five cubits, touching to the wall of the house; and the other wing five cubits, touching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits. And they stood on their feet, and their faces <hi>were</hi> inward.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: And he made the veil <hi>of</hi> blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and worked cherubs on it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: He also made two pillars of thirty-five cubits high in front of the house, and the capital on the tops of each of them <hi>was</hi> five cubits.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: And he made chains, <hi>as</hi> in the holy place, and put them on the tops of the pillars. And he made a hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left. And he called the name of the one on the right Jachin, and the name of the one on the left Boaz.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: And he made an altar of bronze. Twenty cubits <hi>was</hi> the length of it, and twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: And He cast a sea of melted bronze, ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, and five cubits <hi>was</hi> its height. And a line of thirty cubits went around it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And under it was the shape of oxen, under it and all around it for ten cubits, going all around the sea. Two rows of oxen <hi>were</hi> cast when it was cast.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing the north, and three facing the west, and three facing the south, and three facing the east. And the sea <hi>was</hi> set above on them, and all their hinder parts <hi>were</hi> inward.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: And its thickness <hi>was</hi> a handbreadth, and its brim like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies. It received <hi>and</hi> held three thousand baths.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: He also made ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them. They washed in them such things as they offered for the burnt offering. But the sea <hi>was</hi> for the priests to wash in.
