verses.text: And a writing came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, So says the LORD God of David your father, Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the people of Jerusalem to go lusting like the fornications of the house of Ahab, and also have killed your brothers of your fathers house (<hi> who were</hi> better than you),

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, and your sons, and your wives, and all your goods.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: And you <hi>shall have</hi> great sickness by disease in your bowels, until your bowels fall out because of the sickness day by day.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of the Philistines against Jehoram, and of the Arabians who <hi>were</hi> near the Ethiopians.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: And they came up into Judah and broke into it, and carried away all the stuff that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives, so that there was not a son left with him except Ahaziah, the youngest of his sons.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: And after this the LORD struck him in his bowels with a disease that could not be cured.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: And it happened as days and as the time went out, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out because of his sickness. And he died of painful diseases. And his people made no burning for him like the burning of his fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. And they buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: And the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place. For the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had killed all the older ones. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: Ahaziah's <hi>dynasty was</hi> forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name <hi>was</hi> Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab. For his mother was his counselor to do wickedly.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab. For they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his ruin.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: He also walked after their advice and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead. And the Syrians struck Jehoram.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel, because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: And by coming to Jehoram, the destruction of Ahaziah was of God. He went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:8
verses.text: And it happened when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, and found the rulers of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah, the servants of Ahaziah, he killed them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: And he looked for Ahaziah. And they caught him (for he was hidden in Samaria), and brought him to Jehu. And when they had killed him, they buried him because they said, He <hi>is</hi> the son of Jehoshaphat who looked to the LORD with all his heart. And the house of Ahaziah had no power still to keep the kingdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: And Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, and she arose and spoke to <hi>destroy</hi> all the royal seed of the house of Judah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: But Jehoshabeath the daughter of the king took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons who were killed. And she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. And Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah) hid him from Athaliah so that she did not kill him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: And he was with them six years, hidden in the house of God. And Athaliah reigned over the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada made himself strong. And he took the commanders of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri into covenant with him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: And they went about in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD has said of the sons of David.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the thing that you shall do. A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, <hi>shall be</hi> keepers of the doors.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: And a third part <hi>shall be</hi> at the king's house. And a third part shall be at the gate of the foundation. And all the people <hi>shall be</hi> in the courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: But let none come into the house of the LORD except the priests, and those of the Levites who minister. They shall go in, for they <hi>are</hi> holy. But all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: And the Levites shall surround the king, each man with his weapons in his hand. And whoever comes into the house, he shall be put to death. But you be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: And the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded. And every man took his men who were to come in on the sabbath, with the ones who were to go <hi>out</hi> on the sabbath. For Jehoiada the priest did not dismiss the divisions.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: And Jehoiada the priest delivered to the commanders of hundreds king David's spears and bucklers and shields, which <hi>were</hi> in the house of God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: And he set all the people, each man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: And they brought out the king's son and put the crown on him, and <hi>gave him</hi> the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, Let the king live!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: And Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, and she came to the people into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: And she looked, and behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entrance, and the rulers and the trumpets by the king. And all the people of the land <hi>were</hi> rejoicing and sounding with trumpets, and the singers with instruments of music, and giving signals to praise. And Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, Treason! Treason!

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: And Jehoiada the priest brought out the commanders of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, Take her out of the ranks. And whoever follows her shall be killed with the sword. For the priest said, Do not kill her <hi> in</hi> the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: And they laid hands on her; and she came to the entrance of the Gate of the Horses, beside the king's house, and they executed her there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people and between the king, that they should be the LORD's people.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: And all the people went to the house of Baal and broke it down, and smashed his altars and his images. And they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: And Jehoiada chose the officers of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as <hi>it is</hi> written in the law of Moses, with joy and with singing, by the hands of David.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: And he set the gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the LORD, so that the unclean in any way could not go in.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: And he took the commanders of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the LORD. And they came through the Upper Gate into the king's house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: And all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet after they had killed Athaliah with the sword.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: Joash <hi>was</hi> seven years old when he began to reign. And he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also <hi>was</hi> Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: And Joash did the right in the eyes of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: And Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he fathered sons and daughters

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: And it happened after this, it had been in the mind of Joash to repair the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites and said to them, Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather silver from all Israel to repair the house of your God from year to year. And see that you hasten the matter. And the Levites did not hasten <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: And the king called for Jehoiada and said to him, Why have you not made the Levites bring in the collection out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, according to Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, have broken up the house of God. And also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD they have given to Baals.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: And the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: And they gave a call in Judah and in Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection <hi>that</hi> Moses the servant of God <hi>laid</hi> on Israel in the wilderness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: And all the rulers and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and threw into the chests until <hi>it was</hi> finished.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: And it happened at the time the chest was brought into the king's office by the Levites, and when they saw that the silver <hi>was</hi> abundant, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it and carried it to its place again. So they did day by day, and gathered a great amount of silver.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the house of the LORD. And they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also artisans in iron and bronze, to mend the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: And the workmen worked, and the work was completed by them, and they set the house of God in its proper state and made it strong.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: And when they had finished, they brought the rest of the silver before the king and Jehoiada. Of this silver were made vessels for the house of the LORD, vessels to minister and to offer, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they continually offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: But Jehoiada became old, and was full of days when he died. He <hi>was</hi> a hundred and thirty years old when he died.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:16
verses.text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God and toward His house.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:17
verses.text: And after the death of Jehoiada the rulers of Judah came and bowed down to the king. And the king listened to them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:18
verses.text: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served Asherahs and idols. And wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guilt.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:19
verses.text: Yet He sent prophets to them to bring them again to the LORD. And they testified against them. But they would not listen.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:20
verses.text: And the Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people and said to them, So says God, Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot be blessed? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has also forsaken you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:21
verses.text: And they conspired against him and stoned him <hi>with</hi> stones at the command of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:22
verses.text: And Joash the king did not remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD will seek <hi>you out</hi>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:23
verses.text: And it happened at the end of the year the army of Syria came up against him. And they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the rulers of the people from among the people, and sent all the plunder of them to the king of Damascus.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:24
verses.text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the God of the fathers. And they executed judgment against Joash.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:25
verses.text: And when they had departed from him (for they left him in great diseases), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:26
verses.text: And these are the ones who conspired against him Zabad the son of Shimeath of Ammon, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:27
verses.text: And <hi>as to</hi> his sons, and the greatness of the burdens on him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the Book of the Kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:1
verses.text: Amaziah <hi>was</hi> twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:2
verses.text: And he did the right in the eyes of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:3
verses.text: And it happened when the kingdom was made sure to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father, the king.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:4
verses.text: But he did not kill their sons, but as <hi>it is</hi> written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The father shall not die for the sons, nor shall the sons die for <hi>the</hi> fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:5
verses.text: And Amaziah gathered Judah and made them commanders over thousands and commanders over hundreds, according to the houses of the fathers, for all Judah and Benjamin. And he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice <hi>men, able</hi> to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:6
verses.text: And he hired a hundred thousand mighty men of war out of Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:7
verses.text: But a man of God came to him saying, O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD <hi>is</hi> not with Israel, with all the sons of Ephraim.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:8
verses.text: But if you will go, do <hi>it</hi>! Be strong for the battle, for God shall make you fall before the enemy, for God has power to help and to throw down.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:9
verses.text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what <hi>shall we</hi> do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give you much more than this.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:10
verses.text: And Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. And their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:11
verses.text: And Amaziah made himself strong, and led forth his people, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the sons of Seir.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:12
verses.text: And the sons of Judah carried away captive ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock so they were all broken in pieces.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:13
verses.text: And the sons of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth-horon, and struck three thousand of them and took much plunder.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:14
verses.text: And it happened after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the sons of Seir and set them up <hi>to be</hi> his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:15
verses.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and He sent to him a prophet who said to him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people which could not deliver their own people out of your hand?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:16
verses.text: And it happened as he talked with him, <hi>the king</hi> said to him, Have we made you of the king's counsel? Stop! Why should you be stricken? And the prophet stopped. And he said, I know that God has determined to destroy you because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:17
verses.text: And Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come let us look one another in the face.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:18
verses.text: And Jehoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah saying, The thistle that <hi>was</hi> in Lebanon sent to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife. <hi>And</hi> a beast of the field in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle down.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:19
verses.text: You have said, Lo, I have stricken the Edomites, and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home why should you meddle to <hi>your</hi> hurt, so that you should fall, you and Judah with you?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:20
verses.text: But Amaziah would not hear, for it <hi>was</hi> from God so that He might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:21
verses.text: And Jehoash the king of Israel went up. And they saw one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh of Judah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:22
verses.text: And Judah was beaten before Israel, and each man fled to his tent.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:23
verses.text: And Jehoash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:24
verses.text: And <hi>he took</hi> all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels which were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:25
verses.text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:26
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, <hi>are</hi> they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:27
verses.text: And after the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a plot against him in Jerusalem. And he fled to Lachish. But they sent to Lachish after him and killed him there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:28
verses.text: And they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:1
verses.text: And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, and he <hi>was</hi> sixteen years old, and made him king in his father Amaziah's place.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after the king lay with his fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: Uzziah <hi>was</hi> sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also <hi>was</hi> Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God. As long as he sought the LORD, God blessed him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: And he went out and warred against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities around Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gurbaal, and the Meunites.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: And the Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah. And his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he was made very strong.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: And, Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate and at the Valley Gate, and at the Turning, and fortified them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: And he built towers in the desert, and dug many wells. For he had many cattle, both in the low country and in the plains. He <hi>also</hi> had husbandmen and vinedressers in the mountains, and in Carmel. For he loved the earth.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: And, Uzziah had an army of making war, going out to war by troops, according to the number of their oversight by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, <hi>one</hi> of the king's leaders.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: The whole number of the heads of the fathers of the mighty men of power <hi>was</hi> two thousand and six hundred.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: And under their hand <hi>was</hi> an army of three hundred and seven thousand, five hundred, that made war with mighty power to help the king against the enemy.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: And Uzziah prepared for them, for all the army, shields and spears and helmets and coats of armor and bows and stones for the slings.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: And he made engines in Jerusalem, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the corners, to shoot arrows and great stones with. And his name spread far abroad. For he was wonderfully helped until he was strong.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin. For he sinned against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, mighty men.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: And they withstood Uzziah the king and said to him, <hi>It is</hi> not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but to the priests, the sons of Aaron who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the temple, for you have sinned. Nor shall it be for your honor from the LORD God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: And Uzziah was angry. And he <hi>had</hi> a censer in his hand to burn incense. And while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked on him. And, behold, he <hi>was</hi> leprous in his forehead! And they thrust him out from there. Yes, he himself hurried to go out also, because the LORD had stricken him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: And Uzziah the king was a leper until the day of his death, and lived in a separate house a leper. For he was cut off from the house of the LORD. And Jotham his son <hi>was</hi> over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: And Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial of the kings. For they said, He <hi>is</hi> a leper. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:1
verses.text: Jotham <hi>was</hi> twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:2
verses.text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did. Only, he did not enter into the temple of the LORD. And the people still did evilly.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:3
verses.text: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:4
verses.text: And he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built palaces and towers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:5
verses.text: And He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed over them. And the sons of Ammon gave him the same year a hundred talents of silver and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. This the sons of Ammon paid to him, both the second year and the third.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:6
verses.text: And Jotham became mighty because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:7
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they <hi>are</hi> written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:8
verses.text: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:9
verses.text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:1
verses.text: Ahaz <hi>was</hi> twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. But he did not do the right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:2
verses.text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molded images for Baals.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:3
verses.text: And he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD had cast out before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:4
verses.text: And He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:5
verses.text: And the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. And they struck him and carried away a great captivity, and brought <hi>them</hi> to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:6
verses.text: And Pekah the son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand in Judah in one day, all mighty men, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:7
verses.text: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah <hi>who was</hi> next to the king.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:8
verses.text: And the sons of Israel carried away captive two hundred thousand of their brothers, women, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them and brought the plunder to Samaria.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:9
verses.text: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name <hi>was</hi> Oded. And he went out before the army that came to Samaria and said to them, Behold, because the Lord God of your fathers was angry with Judah, He has delivered them into your hands, and you have killed them in a rage which reaches up to Heaven.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:10
verses.text: And now you intend to keep under the sons of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen to you. <hi>Are there</hi> not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:11
verses.text: And now hear me, and deliver again the captives which you have taken captive of your brothers. For the fierce wrath of the LORD <hi>is</hi> on you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:12
verses.text: And certain of the heads of the sons of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them who came from the war.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:13
verses.text: And they said to them, You shall not bring the captives here. For we have offended the LORD, and you intend to add to our sins and to our trespass. For our trespass is great, and <hi>there is</hi> fierce wrath against Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:14
verses.text: And the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the rulers and all the congregation.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:15
verses.text: And the men who were called by name rose up and took the captives and clothed all that were naked among them with the plunder, and dressed them, and shod them, and made them eat and drink, and anointed them, and led the feeble ones on asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. And they returned to Samaria.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:16
verses.text: At that time king Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:17
verses.text: For again the Edomites had come and had beaten Judah and had carried away captives.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:18
verses.text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with its villages, and Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo and its villages. And they lived there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:19
verses.text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel. For he loosed <hi>immorality</hi> in Judah, and sinned grievously against the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:20
verses.text: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and troubled him, but did not strengthen him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:21
verses.text: For Ahaz took away a portion <hi>of</hi> the house of the LORD, and <hi>of</hi> the house of the king, and <hi>of</hi> the rulers, and gave <hi>it</hi> to the king of Assyria. But <hi>it was</hi> no help to him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:22
verses.text: And in the time of his distress he trespassed even more against the LORD, this king Ahaz.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:23
verses.text: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus who struck him. And he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them so that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:24
verses.text: And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD. And <hi>he</hi> made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:25
verses.text: And in each separate city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:26
verses.text: And the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they <hi>are</hi> written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:27
verses.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem. But they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:1
verses.text: Hezekiah began to reign <hi>being</hi> twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name <hi>was</hi> Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:2
verses.text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:3
verses.text: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:4
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them into the east street.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:5
verses.text: And he said to them, Hear me, Levites, now sanctify yourselves and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry out the filthiness out of the holy <hi>place</hi>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:6
verses.text: For our fathers have sinned and did the evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken Him, and have turned away their faces from the house of the LORD, and have turned <hi>their</hi> backs.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:7
verses.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:8
verses.text: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was on Judah and Jerusalem, and He has delivered them to trouble, to ruin, and to hissing as you see with your eyes.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:9
verses.text: For lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives <hi>are</hi> in captivity for this.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:10
verses.text: And <hi>it is</hi> in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:11
verses.text: My sons, do not be negligent now. For the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:12
verses.text: And the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites. And of the sons of Merari arose Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel. And of the Gershonites: Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:13
verses.text: And of the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel. And of the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:14
verses.text: And of the sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei. And of the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:15
verses.text: And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the command of the king, by the words of the LORD, to clean the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:16
verses.text: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to clean <hi>it</hi>. And they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took <hi> it</hi> out to the brook Kidron.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:17
verses.text: And they began to sanctify on the first of the first month. And on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of the LORD. And they made the house of the LORD pure in eight days, and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:18
verses.text: And they went in to Hezekiah the king and said, We have cleaned all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and the showbread table, and all its vessels.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:19
verses.text: And we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which king Ahaz in his reign cast away in his sin. And behold, they <hi>are</hi> before the altar of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:20
verses.text: And Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:21
verses.text: And they brought seven bulls and seven rams and seven lambs and seven he-goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer <hi>them</hi> on the altar of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:22
verses.text: And they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled <hi>it</hi> on the altar. And they killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood on the altar.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:23
verses.text: And they brought out the he-goats <hi>for</hi> the sin offering before the king and the congregation. And they laid their hands on them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:24
verses.text: And the priest killed them, and they made atonement with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel. For the king commanded the burnt offering and the sin offering <hi>to be made</hi> for all Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:25
verses.text: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with harps, and with lyres, according to the command of David, and of Gad the king's seer and Nathan the prophet. For the commandment <hi>was</hi> by the hand of the LORD by His prophets.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:26
verses.text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:27
verses.text: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began with the trumpets and with the instruments <hi>ordained</hi> by David king of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:28
verses.text: And all the congregation worshiped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this <hi>went on</hi> until the burnt offering was finished.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:29
verses.text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:30
verses.text: And Hezekiah the king and the rulers commanded the Levites to sing praise to the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:31
verses.text: And Hezekiah answered and said, And you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings. And as many as were of a free heart <hi>brought</hi> burnt offerings.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:32
verses.text: And the number of the burnt offerings which the congregation brought was seventy oxen, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these <hi>were</hi> for a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:33
verses.text: And the things consecrated <hi>were</hi> six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:34
verses.text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. And their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves. For the Levites <hi>were</hi> more upright of heart to make themselves pure than the priests.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:35
verses.text: And also the burnt offerings <hi>were</hi> in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for <hi>every</hi> burnt offering. And the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:36
verses.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people. For the thing happened suddenly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:1
verses.text: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:2
verses.text: And the king and his leaders, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, took counsel to keep the Passover in the second month.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:3
verses.text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not made themselves pure enough, nor had the people gathered to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:4
verses.text: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:5
verses.text: And they established a decree to send a notice throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem. For not many <hi>of them</hi> had done as it was written.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:6
verses.text: And the runners went with the letters from the king and his rulers to Israel and Judah, and according to the command of the king, saying, O sons of Israel, turn again to the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and He will return to the remnant of you who have escaped out of the hands of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:7
verses.text: And do not be like your fathers and like your brothers who sinned against the LORD God of their fathers, and He made them for a horror, as you see.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:8
verses.text: And do not be stiffnecked like your fathers. Yield yourselves to the LORD and enter into His temple which He has sanctified forever. And serve the LORD your God, so that the fierceness of His wrath may turn away from you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:9
verses.text: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your sons will have mercies before those who lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land. For the LORD your God <hi>is</hi> gracious and merciful, and will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:10
verses.text: And the runners passed from city to city in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun. But they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:11
verses.text: However, men from Asher and Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:12
verses.text: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the command of the king and of the rulers, by the word of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:13
verses.text: And many people gathered at Jerusalem to keep the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi> in the second month, a very great congregation.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:14
verses.text: And they arose and took away the altars in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense they took away, and threw <hi>them</hi> into the brook Kidron.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:15
verses.text: And they killed the Passover on the fourteenth of the second month. And the priests and the Levites were ashamed and made themselves pure, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:16
verses.text: And they stood in their place in their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood from the hand of the Levites.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:17
verses.text: For many in the congregation <hi>were</hi> not sanctified. And the Levites were over the killing of the passovers for every one <hi>who was</hi> not clean, to sanctify them to the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:18
verses.text: For many of the people, many from Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, had not been cleansed, but ate the Passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, May the good LORD pardon everyone

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:19
verses.text: <hi> who</hi> prepares his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though not <hi>cleansed</hi> according to the purification of the sanctuary.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:20
verses.text: And the LORD listened to Hezekiah and healed the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:21
verses.text: And the sons of Israel found at Jerusalem kept the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi> seven days with great gladness. And the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day with loud instruments to the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:22
verses.text: And Hezekiah spoke comfortably to all the Levites who taught the good knowledge of the LORD. And they ate the appointed things seven days, offering peace offerings and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:23
verses.text: And the whole gathering agreed to keep another seven days. And they kept <hi>another</hi> seven days with gladness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:24
verses.text: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep. And the rulers gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep. And a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:25
verses.text: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:26
verses.text: And there was great joy in Jerusalem. For from the days of Solomon the son of David the king of Israel <hi>there was</hi> nothing like this in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:27
verses.text: And the priests, the Levites, arose and blessed the people. And their voice was heard, and their prayer came to His holy dwelling-place, to Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:1
verses.text: And when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the images in pieces, and cut down the Asherahs, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, even to the end. And all the sons of Israel returned, each to his possession, into their own cities.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:2
verses.text: And Hezekiah set the courses of the priests and the Levites according to their divisions, each according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:3
verses.text: And the king's portion from his goods <hi>was</hi> for burnt offerings, and for burnt offerings, of the morning and the evening and the burnt offerings of the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as <hi>it is</hi> written in the law of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:4
verses.text: And he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites so that they might be strong in the law of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:5
verses.text: And as the command spread, the sons of Israel brought plentifully of the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field. And the tithe of all <hi>things</hi> they brought in abundance.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:6
verses.text: And the sons of Israel and Judah who lived in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid it up by heaps.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:7
verses.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished in the seventh month.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:8
verses.text: And Hezekiah and the rulers came and saw the heaps, and they blessed the LORD and His people Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:9
verses.text: And Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:10
verses.text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him and said, Since <hi>the people</hi> began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and have plenty left. For the LORD has blessed His people, and this great store is left.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:11
verses.text: And Hezekiah commanded storehouses to be prepared in the house of the LORD. And they prepared,

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:12
verses.text: and brought in the offerings and the tithes and the <hi>things</hi> dedicated to God faithfully. And over them <hi>was</hi> Cononiah the Levite ruler, and Shimei his brother the next.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:13
verses.text: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, <hi>were</hi> overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the command of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:14
verses.text: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper toward the east, <hi>was</hi> over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the sacrifices of the LORD and the most holy things.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:15
verses.text: And next to him Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in <hi>their</hi> set office, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small,

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:16
verses.text: besides registering the males from three years and upward, to everyone who enters into the house of the LORD, giving his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their divisions

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:17
verses.text: both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, and their charges by their divisions,

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:18
verses.text: and to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation. For in their set office they set themselves apart in holiness.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:19
verses.text: And to the sons of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of the open lands of their cities, in each separate city <hi>were</hi> the men who were named by name, to give shares to all the males among the priests, and to all who were counted by genealogies among the Levites.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:20
verses.text: And Hezekiah did throughout all Judah, and did the good and the right and the true before the LORD his God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:21
verses.text: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did <hi>it</hi> with all his heart, and prospered.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:1
verses.text: After these things done in faithfulness, Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, came and entered into Judah, and camped against the fortified cities, and commanded to break them open to himself.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:2
verses.text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he <hi>had set</hi> his face to fight against Jerusalem,

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:3
verses.text: he took counsel with his rulers and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains outside the city. And they helped him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:4
verses.text: And there were gathered many people, who stopped all the fountains, and the torrent which ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the king of Assyria come and find much water?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:5
verses.text: And he made himself strong and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised <hi>it</hi> up to the towers, and another wall outside, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:6
verses.text: And he set commanders of war over the people and gathered them to himself in the street of the gate of the city. And he spoke to their heart, saying,

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:7
verses.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of the king of Assyria, or for all the multitude with him. For <hi>there are</hi> more with us than with him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:8
verses.text: With him <hi>is</hi> an arm of flesh, but with us <hi>is</hi> the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:9
verses.text: After this Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem; and he <hi>was</hi> against Lachish, and all his forces with him against Hezekiah king of Judah, and against all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:10
verses.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria says this, On what do you trust that you sit under siege in Jerusalem?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:11
verses.text: Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give yourselves over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Jehovah our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:12
verses.text: Has not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar and burn incense on it?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:13
verses.text: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the people of other lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their lands out of my hands?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:14
verses.text: Who among all the gods of those nations that my fathers completely destroyed <hi>is</hi> able to deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:15
verses.text: And now do not let Hezekiah deceive you or persuade you in this way, nor yet believe him. For no god of any nation was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less shall your god deliver you out of my hand?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:16
verses.text: And his servants spoke still <hi>more</hi> against the LORD God, and against His servant Hezekiah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:17
verses.text: He also wrote letters to revile the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying, As the gods of the nations of <hi>other</hi> lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver His people out of my hand.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:18
verses.text: And they cried out with a loud voice <hi>in</hi> Jewish to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, in order to frighten them and to trouble them, so that they might take the city.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:19
verses.text: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of the hands of man.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:20
verses.text: And for this <hi>reason</hi> Hezekiah the king and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz prayed and cried to Heaven.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:21
verses.text: And the LORD sent an angel to cut off all the mighty men of power, and the leaders and commanders in the camp of the king of Assyria. And he returned with shame of face to his own land. And he came into the house of his god, and those from his own bowels killed him there with the sword.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:22
verses.text: And the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all <hi>others</hi>, and guided them on every side.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:23
verses.text: And many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from that time on.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:24
verses.text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to death, and prayed to the LORD. And He spoke to him, and He gave him a sign.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:25
verses.text: But Hezekiah did not give again according to the good <hi>done</hi> to him, for his heart was lifted up. And there was wrath on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:26
verses.text: And Hezekiah was humbled for the pride of his heart, he and the people of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD did not come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:27
verses.text: And Hezekiah had exceedingly much riches and honor. And he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all kinds of pleasant jewels.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:28
verses.text: And he made storehouses for the increase of grain and wine and oil, and stalls for all kinds of animals, and stalls for flocks.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:29
verses.text: And he provided himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds, in abundance. For God had given him very many things.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:30
verses.text: And Hezekiah himself stopped the upper water courses of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah was blessed in all his works.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:31
verses.text: But, in <hi>regard to</hi> the ambassadors of the rulers of Babylon who sent to him to ask about the wonder that was done in the land, God left him in order to try him, to know all that was in his heart.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:32
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they <hi>are</hi> written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:33
verses.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the highest of the tombs of the sons of David. And all Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him at his death. And his son Manasseh reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:1
verses.text: Manasseh <hi>was</hi> twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:2
verses.text: But he did the evil in the sight of the LORD, like the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:3
verses.text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for the Baals, and made Asherahs, and worshiped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:4
verses.text: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall My name be forever.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:5
verses.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:6
verses.text: And he caused his sons to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He also practiced secret arts, and used fortune-telling, and used witchcraft, and dealt with mediums, and with soothsayers. He did much evil in the sight of the LORD in order to provoke Him to anger.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:7
verses.text: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:8
verses.text: Nor will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have set apart for your fathers; only if they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:9
verses.text: And Manasseh made Judah and the people of Jerusalem to err, to do worse than the nations whom the LORD had destroyed before the sons of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:10
verses.text: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh and to His people, but they would not listen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:11
verses.text: And the LORD brought on them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh among the thorns and bound him with chains and carried him to Babylon.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:12
verses.text: And when he was in affliction, he sought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:13
verses.text: And he prayed to Him, and He was entreated of him, and heard his prayer, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. And Manasseh knew that Jehovah <hi>is</hi> God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:14
verses.text: And after this he built a wall outside the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance of the Fish Gate, and went around Ophel, and raised it to a very great height. And he put army commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:15
verses.text: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and threw <hi>them</hi> out of the city.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:16
verses.text: And he repaired the altar of the LORD and sacrificed on it peace offerings and thank-offerings. And he commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:17
verses.text: But the people still sacrificed in the high places, <hi>but only</hi> to the LORD their God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:18
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they <hi>are written</hi> in the Book of the Kings of Israel;

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:19
verses.text: and his prayer, and his entreaty, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up Asherahs and graven images, before he was humbled, behold, they <hi>are</hi> written among the Matters of the Seers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:20
verses.text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house. And his son Amon reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:21
verses.text: Amon <hi>was</hi> twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:22
verses.text: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did; and to all the graven images that his father Manasseh had made, Amon sacrificed, and served them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:23
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> did not bow before the LORD, like the humbling of his father Manasseh. For Amon himself multiplied guilt.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:24
verses.text: And his servants conspired against him and killed him in his own house.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:25
verses.text: And the people of the land killed all those who conspired against king Amon. And the people of the land made his son Josiah to reign in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:1
verses.text: Josiah <hi>was</hi> eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:2
verses.text: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and did not turn aside to the right nor to the left.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:3
verses.text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek after the God of David his father. And in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherahs, and the carved images, and the molten images.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:4
verses.text: And they broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence. And he cut down the images which <hi>were</hi> on high above them, and the Asherahs. And the carved images and the molten images he also broke in pieces and made dust <hi>from them</hi>, and scattered on the graves of the ones who had sacrificed to them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:5
verses.text: And he burned the bones of the priests on their altars and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:6
verses.text: And <hi>so he did</hi> in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even to Naphtali, with their tools round about.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:7
verses.text: And he broke down the altars and the Asherahs, and had beaten the carved images into powder, and cut down all the idols in all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:8
verses.text: And in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:9
verses.text: And they came to Hilkiah the high priest, and they delivered the silver that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, and from all Judah and Benjamin, and they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:10
verses.text: And they put <hi>it</hi> in the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the house of the LORD. And they gave it <hi>to</hi> the workmen who worked in the house of the LORD, to repair and mend the house.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:11
verses.text: They gave to the artisans and builders, to buy cut stone and timber for joints, and beams to build up the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:12
verses.text: And the men did the work faithfully. And the overseers of them <hi>were</hi> Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, and of the Levites, all who <hi>were</hi> skillful with instruments of music;

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:13
verses.text: and over the bearers of burdens, and overseers of all who worked the work in any manner of service. And of the Levites <hi>were</hi> scribes and officers and gatekeepers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:14
verses.text: And when they brought out the silver that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD by Moses.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:15
verses.text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:16
verses.text: And Shaphan carried the Book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was given into the hands of your servants, they are doing.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:17
verses.text: And they poured out the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:18
verses.text: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:19
verses.text: And it happened when the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his garments.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:20
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan. and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:21
verses.text: Go inquire of the LORD for me and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found. For great <hi>is</hi> the wrath of the LORD that is poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD to do according to all that is written in this Book.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:22
verses.text: And Hilkiah, and those of the king, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the robes. (And she lived in Jerusalem in the second <hi>part</hi>.) And they spoke to her about this.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:23
verses.text: And she answered them, So says the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:24
verses.text: So says the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil on this place and upon its people, all the curses that are written in the Book which they have read before the king of Judah,

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:25
verses.text: because they have forsaken Me, and have burned incense to other gods, so that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. And My wrath shall be poured out on this place and shall not be quenched.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:26
verses.text: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, so shall you say to him, So says the LORD God of Israel whose words you have heard,

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:27
verses.text: Because your heart <hi>was</hi> tender and you humbled yourself before your God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and humbled yourself before Me, and tore your garments and wept before Me, I have even heard also, says the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:28
verses.text: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, nor shall your eyes see all the evil which I will bring on this place and upon its people. And they brought the king word again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:29
verses.text: And the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:30
verses.text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the people of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people from the great to <hi>the</hi> small. And he read in their ears all the words of the Book of the Covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:31
verses.text: And the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD and to keep His commandments and His testimonies, and His statutes, with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:32
verses.text: And he caused all who were found in Jerusalem and in Benjamin, and the people of Jerusalem, to stand to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:33
verses.text: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the territories that <hi>belonged</hi> to the sons of Israel. And he made all that were present in Israel to serve, to serve the LORD their God. All his days they did not depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:1
verses.text: And Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem. And they killed the passover lamb on the fourteenth of the first month.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:2
verses.text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:3
verses.text: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, built. <hi>It shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> a burden on your shoulders. And serve the LORD your God and His people Israel,

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:4
verses.text: and prepare by the houses of your fathers, according to your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:5
verses.text: And stand in the holy <hi>place</hi> according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brothers, the sons of the people, and the division of the families of the Levites.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:6
verses.text: And kill the passover lamb, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brothers so that <hi>they</hi> may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:7
verses.text: And Josiah gave to the people from the flock, lambs and kids, all for the Passover offerings, for all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand oxen. These <hi>were</hi> from what the king owned.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:8
verses.text: And his rulers offered to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand, six hundred <hi>sheep</hi>, and three hundred oxen.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:9
verses.text: And Conaniah, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for Passover offerings five thousand <hi>sheep</hi> and five hundred oxen.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:10
verses.text: And the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the king's command.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:11
verses.text: And they killed the passover lamb, and the priests sprinkled from their hands, and the Levites skinned <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:12
verses.text: And they removed the burnt offerings so that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer to the LORD, as <hi>it is</hi> written in the book of Moses; and so they did to the oxen.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:13
verses.text: And they roasted the passover lamb with fire according to the law. But the holy <hi>offerings</hi> they boiled in pots, and in kettles, and in pans, and carried to all the sons of the people.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:14
verses.text: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were offering up the burnt offerings and the fat until nightfall. And the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:15
verses.text: And the singers, the sons of Asaph <hi>were</hi> in their place, according to the command of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun, the king's seer. And the gatekeepers <hi>were</hi> at every gate. It was not for them to depart from their service; for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:16
verses.text: And all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, according to the command of king Josiah.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:17
verses.text: And the sons of Israel present kept the Passover at that time, and the Feast of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi> seven days.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:18
verses.text: And there was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet. Yea, none of the kings of Israel kept such a Passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were found, and the people of Jerusalem.
