verses.text: And I also kept on in the work of this wall. Nor did we buy any land. And all my servants gathered there to the work.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:17
verses.text: And at my table <hi>were</hi> a hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, besides those who came to us from among the nations around us.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:18
verses.text: And that which <hi>was</hi> prepared daily <hi>was</hi> one ox and six choice sheep; and birds were prepared; and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this I did not seek the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:19
verses.text: Think upon me, my God, for good, <hi>according</hi> to all that I have done for this people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:1
verses.text: And it happened, when Sanballat, and Tobiah and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no break left in it (though at that time I had not set the doors on the gates),

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:2
verses.text: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me harm.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:3
verses.text: And I sent messengers to them, saying, I <hi>am</hi> doing a great work, so I cannot come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:4
verses.text: And they sent to me four times in this way. And I answered them in the same way.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:5
verses.text: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand, in which was written,

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:6
verses.text: It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says <hi>it</hi>, that you and the Jews are thinking of rebelling, for this reason you build the wall, so that you may be their king, according to these words.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:7
verses.text: And you have also set up prophets to preach about you at Jerusalem, saying, <hi>There is</hi> a king in Judah. And now it shall be reported to the king according to these words. And now come and let us talk it over together.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:8
verses.text: And I sent to him saying, These things which you are saying are not happening, but you pretend them out of your own heart.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:9
verses.text: For they all were alarmers of us, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work so that it may not be done. And now, <hi>O God</hi>, make my hands strong.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:10
verses.text: And I came to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who <hi>was</hi> shut up. And he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple. For they will come to kill you. Yea, in the night they will come to kill you.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:11
verses.text: And I said, Should <hi>such</hi> a man as I flee? And who, <hi>being</hi> as I <hi>am</hi>, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:12
verses.text: And, behold, I understood that God had not sent him, but that he said this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:13
verses.text: Therefore he <hi>was</hi> hired that I should be afraid, and do so, and I should sin, and be for them an evil name, with which they might reproach me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:14
verses.text: My God, think upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these works of theirs, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets who would have made me afraid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:15
verses.text: And the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth <hi>day</hi> of Elul, in fifty-two days.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:16
verses.text: And it happened when all our enemies heard, and all the nations around us saw, they were very much lowered in their own eyes. For they saw that this work was done by our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:17
verses.text: And in those days the nobles of Judah were increasing their letters going to Tobiah; and Tobiah's came to them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:18
verses.text: For many in Judah <hi>were</hi> sworn to him because he <hi>was</hi> the son-in-law of Shechaniah the son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:19
verses.text: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and told my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to make me afraid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:1
verses.text: And it happened when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were chosen,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:2
verses.text: I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem. For he <hi>was</hi> a faithful man, and feared God above many.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:3
verses.text: And I said to them, Do not let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot. And while they stand by, let them shut and bar the doors. And set guards from the people of Jerusalem, each one in his watch, and each one <hi>to be</hi> across from his house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:4
verses.text: And the city <hi>was</hi> large and great, but the people in it <hi>were</hi> few, and the houses not built.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:5
verses.text: And my God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, so that they might be counted by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of those who came up at the first. And I found written in it:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:6
verses.text: These <hi>are</hi> the sons of the province who went up out of the captivity, of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away. And they came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one to his city,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:7
verses.text: and came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:8
verses.text: The sons of Parosh, two thousand and seventy-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:9
verses.text: The sons of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:10
verses.text: The sons of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:11
verses.text: The sons of Pahath-moab, of the sons of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand, eight hundred and eighteen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:12
verses.text: The sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:13
verses.text: The sons of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:14
verses.text: The sons of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:15
verses.text: The sons of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:16
verses.text: The sons of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:17
verses.text: The sons of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:18
verses.text: The sons of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:19
verses.text: The sons of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:20
verses.text: The sons of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:21
verses.text: The sons of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:22
verses.text: The sons of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:23
verses.text: The sons of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:24
verses.text: The sons of Hariph, a hundred and twelve.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:25
verses.text: The sons of Gibeon, ninety-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:26
verses.text: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, a hundred and eighty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:27
verses.text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:28
verses.text: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:29
verses.text: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:30
verses.text: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:31
verses.text: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:32
verses.text: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred and twenty-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:33
verses.text: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:34
verses.text: The sons of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:35
verses.text: The sons of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:36
verses.text: The sons of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:37
verses.text: The sons of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:38
verses.text: The sons of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:39
verses.text: The priests: the sons of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:40
verses.text: The sons of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:41
verses.text: The sons of Pashur, a thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:42
verses.text: The sons of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:43
verses.text: The Levites: the sons of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, <hi>and</hi> of the sons of Hodevah, seventy-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:44
verses.text: The singers: the sons of Asaph, a hundred and forty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:45
verses.text: The gatekeepers: the sons of Shallum, the sons of Ater, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akkub, the sons of Hatita, and the sons of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:46
verses.text: The temple slaves: the sons of Ziha, the sons of Hashupha, the sons of Tabbaoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:47
verses.text: the sons of Keros, the sons of Sia, the sons of Padon,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:48
verses.text: the sons of Lebana, the sons of Hagaba, the sons of Shalmai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:49
verses.text: the sons of Hanan, the sons of Giddel, the sons of Gahar,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:50
verses.text: the sons of Reaiah, the sons of Rezin, the sons of Nekoda,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:51
verses.text: the sons of Gazzam, the sons of Uzza, the sons of Paseah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:52
verses.text: the sons of Besai, the sons of Meunim, the sons of Nephishesim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:53
verses.text: the sons of Bakbuk, the sons of Hakupha, the sons of Harhur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:54
verses.text: the sons of Bazlith, the sons of Mehida, the sons of Harsha,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:55
verses.text: the sons of Barkos, the sons of Sisera, the sons of Tamah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:56
verses.text: the sons of Neziah, the sons of Hatipha.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:57
verses.text: The sons of Solomon's servants: the sons of Sotai, the sons of Sophereth, the sons of Perida,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:58
verses.text: the sons of Jaala, the sons of Darkon, the sons of Giddel,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:59
verses.text: the sons of Shephatiah, the sons of Hattil, the sons of Pochereth of Zebaim, the sons of Amon.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:60
verses.text: All the temple-slaves, and the sons of Solomon's servants, three hundred and ninety-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:61
verses.text: And these <hi>were</hi> they who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer. But they could not show their father's house, nor their seed, whether they <hi>were</hi> of Israel:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:62
verses.text: The sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, the sons of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:63
verses.text: And of the priests: the sons of Habaiah, the sons of Koz, the sons of Barzillai, who took <hi>one</hi> of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:64
verses.text: These sought their register <hi>among</hi> those who were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found. Therefore they were put out, as defiled from the priesthood.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:65
verses.text: And the governor said to them that they should not eat of the holy things until there stood <hi>up</hi> a priest with Urim and Thummim.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:66
verses.text: All the congregation together <hi>was</hi> forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:67
verses.text: besides their manservants and their maidservants; these <hi>were</hi> seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven. And they had two hundred and forty-five singing men and singing women.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:68
verses.text: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules, two hundred and forty-five;

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:69
verses.text: camels, four hundred and thirty-five; and six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:70
verses.text: And some of the chiefs of the fathers gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury a thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred and thirty priest's garments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:71
verses.text: And <hi>some</hi> of the chiefs of the fathers gave to the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:72
verses.text: And what the rest of the people gave <hi>was</hi> twenty thousand darics of gold and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests' garments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:73
verses.text: And the priests, and the Levites, and the gatekeepers, and the singers, and <hi>some</hi> of the people, and the temple slaves, and all Israel, lived in their cities. And when the seventh month came, the sons of Israel <hi>were</hi> in their cities.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:1
verses.text: And all the people gathered themselves as one man into the street before the water gate. And they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:2
verses.text: And Ezra the priest brought the Law before the congregation, both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:3
verses.text: And he read in it before the street in front of the Water Gate from the morning until noon, in front of the men and the women, and those who could understand. And the ears of all the people <hi>listened</hi> to the Book of the Law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:4
verses.text: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood which they had made for the purpose. And beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:5
verses.text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was above all the people. And when he opened it, all the people stood up.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:6
verses.text: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, amen, amen, lifting up their hands. And they bowed their heads and worshiped the LORD with <hi>their</hi> faces to the ground.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:7
verses.text: And Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law. And the people <hi>were</hi> in their place.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:8
verses.text: And they read in the Book of the Law of God, clearly. And they gave the sense, and caused <hi>them</hi> to understand the reading.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:9
verses.text: And Nehemiah, the governor, and Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people, said to all the people, This day <hi>is</hi> holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep. For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:10
verses.text: Then he said to them, Go eat the fat and drink the sweet, and send portions to him for <hi>whom</hi> nothing is prepared. For <hi>this</hi> day <hi>is</hi> holy to our LORD. And do not be sorry, for the joy of the LORD <hi>is</hi> your strength.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:11
verses.text: And the Levites quieted all the people, saying, Be quiet, for the day <hi>is</hi> holy. And do not be grieved.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:12
verses.text: And all the people went to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great rejoicing, because they had understood the words which were declared to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:13
verses.text: And on the second day the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, were gathered to Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:14
verses.text: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the sons of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month,

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:15
verses.text: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth to the mountain and bring olive branches and pine branches and myrtle branches and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as <hi>it is</hi> written.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:16
verses.text: And the people went out and brought in, and made themselves booths, each one upon his roof, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the Water Gate, and in the street of the Gate of Ephraim.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:17
verses.text: And all the congregation of those who had come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths. For since the days of Joshua the son of Nun until that day, the sons of Israel had not done so. And there was very great gladness.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:18
verses.text: Also day by day, from the first day until the last day, he read in the Book of the Law of God. And they kept the feast seven days, and on the eighth <hi>was</hi> an assembly, according to the law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:1
verses.text: And in the twenty-fourth day of this month, the sons of Israel were gathered with fasting and with sackcloth, and with earth upon them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:2
verses.text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins and the sins of their fathers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:3
verses.text: And they stood up in their place, and read in the Book of the Law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day. And <hi>another</hi> fourth part they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:4
verses.text: And stood upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani <hi>and</hi> Chenani, and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:5
verses.text: And the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, <hi>and</hi> Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God forever and ever. And blessed be Your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:6
verses.text: You, even You, <hi>are</hi> LORD alone. You have made the heavens, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things on it, the seas, and all in them, and You preserve them all. And the host of the heavens worships You.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:7
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> the LORD, the God who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:8
verses.text: and found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give <hi>it</hi> to his seed. And You have performed Your words, for You are righteous.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:9
verses.text: And You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:10
verses.text: and gave out signs and wonders upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants and upon all the people of his land. For You knew that they were acting proudly against them. So You got Yourself a name, as today.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:11
verses.text: And You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land. And their pursuers You threw into the deep, like a stone into the mighty waters.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:12
verses.text: And You led them in the day by a cloudy pillar, and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:13
verses.text: And You came down on mount Sinai, and spoke with them from Heaven, and gave them right judgments and true laws, good statutes and commandments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:14
verses.text: And You made known to them Your holy sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses Your servant.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:15
verses.text: And You gave them bread from the heavens for their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst. And You promised them that they should go in to possess the land which You had sworn to give them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:16
verses.text: But they and our fathers acted proudly and hardened their necks, and did not listen to Your commandments.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:17
verses.text: And they refused to obey, neither were they mindful of Your wonders which You did among them. But they hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But You <hi>are</hi> a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and did not forsake them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:18
verses.text: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This <hi>is</hi> your God who brought you up out of Egypt, and had worked great blasphemies,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:19
verses.text: yet You in Your great mercies did not forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of the cloud did not depart from them by day to lead them in the way, nor the pillar of fire by night, to show them light and the way in which they should go.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:20
verses.text: You also gave Your good Spirit to teach them, and did not withhold Your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:21
verses.text: And forty years You sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing; their clothes did not become old, and their feet did not swell.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:22
verses.text: And You gave them kingdoms and nations, and divided them into corners. And they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:23
verses.text: And You multiplied their sons like the stars of the heavens, and brought them into the land concerning which You had promised to their fathers that they should go in to possess <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:24
verses.text: And the sons went in and possessed the land, and You humbled the people of the land before them, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the people of the land, so that they might do with them as they would.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:25
verses.text: And they took strong cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards and olive-yards, and fruit trees in abundance. And they ate and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in Your great goodness.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:26
verses.text: But they were disobedient and rebelled against You, and cast Your law behind their backs. And they killed Your prophets who testified against them to turn them to You, and they worked great blasphemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:27
verses.text: And You delivered them into the hand of their enemies, who troubled them. And in the time of their trouble, they cried to You, and You heard from Heaven. And according to Your manifold mercies, You gave them deliverers, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:28
verses.text: But after they had rest, they did evil again before You, and You left them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the rule over them. But they returned and cried to You, and You heard from Heaven. And many times You delivered them according to Your mercies,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:29
verses.text: and testified against them that You might bring them again to Your law. But they acted proudly and did not listen to Your commandments, but sinned against Your judgments (which if a man do, he shall live in them), and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:30
verses.text: And many years You had patience with them, and testified against them by Your Spirit, by Your prophets, but they would not give ear. And You gave them into the hand of the people of the lands.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:31
verses.text: But for Your great mercies, You did not completely destroy them nor forsake them. For You <hi>are</hi> a gracious and merciful God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:32
verses.text: And now, our God, the great, the mighty, and the fearful God, who keeps covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble that has come upon us, on our kings, on our rulers, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all Your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day, seem little before You.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:33
verses.text: But You <hi>are</hi> just in all that is brought upon us, for You have done right, but we have done wickedly.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:34
verses.text: And our kings, our rulers, our priests, and our fathers, have not kept Your law, nor listened to Your commandments and Your words with which You testified against them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:35
verses.text: For they have not served You in their kingdom, and in Your great goodness which You gave them, and in the large and rich land which You gave before them, and they did not turn from their wicked works.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:36
verses.text: Behold, we <hi>are</hi> servants today. And the land that You gave to our fathers to eat its fruit, and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:37
verses.text: And it yields much increase to the kings whom You have set over us because of our sins. And they rule over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we <hi>are</hi> in great distress.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:38
verses.text: And because of all this we <hi>are</hi> cutting a sure <hi>covenant</hi>, and write <hi>it</hi>, and our princes, Levites, <hi>and</hi> priests are sealing it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:1
verses.text: And those who sealed <hi>were</hi>, Nehemiah, the governor, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:2
verses.text: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:3
verses.text: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:4
verses.text: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:5
verses.text: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:6
verses.text: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:7
verses.text: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:8
verses.text: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah. These <hi>were</hi> the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:9
verses.text: And the Levites <hi>were</hi> both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:10
verses.text: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:11
verses.text: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:12
verses.text: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:13
verses.text: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:14
verses.text: The chief of the people <hi>were</hi> Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:15
verses.text: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:16
verses.text: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:17
verses.text: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:18
verses.text: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:19
verses.text: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:20
verses.text: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:21
verses.text: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:22
verses.text: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:23
verses.text: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:24
verses.text: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:25
verses.text: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:26
verses.text: and Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:27
verses.text: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:28
verses.text: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple-slaves, and all those who had separated from the people of the lands to the Law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters (everyone who had knowledge, and who had understanding),

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:29
verses.text: <hi> were</hi> holding fast to their brothers, their honored ones. And they entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God's law which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to be careful to do all the commandments of Jehovah our Lord, and His judgments and His statutes.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:30
verses.text: And we swore that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land nor take their daughters for our sons.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:31
verses.text: And <hi>if</hi> the people of the land should bring goods or any food on the Sabbath day to sell it, that we would not buy it from them on the Sabbath or on the holy day, and that we would leave the seventh year, and the interest of every debt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:32
verses.text: Also we put commands upon ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God,

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:33
verses.text: for the showbread, and for the continual meal offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy <hi>things</hi>, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:34
verses.text: And we cast the lots among the priests, and the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring into the house of our God, according to the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as <hi>it is</hi> written in the Law

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:35
verses.text: and to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, to the house of the LORD;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:36
verses.text: and to bring the first-born of our sons, and of our cattle, as <hi>it is</hi> written in the Law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:37
verses.text: and that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all kinds of trees, of wine and of oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites, and they, the Levites, might have the tithes in all the cities we farmed.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:38
verses.text: And the priest, the son of Aaron, shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes, and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:39
verses.text: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the offering of the grain, of the new wine, and the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary <hi>are</hi>, and the priests who minister, and the gatekeepers and the singers. And we will not forsake the house of our God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:1
verses.text: And the rulers of the people lived at Jerusalem. And the rest of the people cast lots, to bring one of every ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in <hi>other</hi> cities.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:2
verses.text: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to live at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:3
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the rulers of the province who lived in Jerusalem. But in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the temple-slaves, and the sons of Solomon's servants.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:4
verses.text: And at Jerusalem lived <hi>certain</hi> of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin. From the sons of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the sons of Perez,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:5
verses.text: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:6
verses.text: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem <hi>were</hi> four hundred and sixty-eight mighty men.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:7
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:8
verses.text: and after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:9
verses.text: And Joel the son of Zichri <hi>was</hi> their overseer. And Judah the son of Senuah <hi>was</hi> second over the city.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:10
verses.text: From the priests <hi>were</hi> Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:11
verses.text: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:12
verses.text: And their brothers who did the work of the house <hi>were</hi> eight hundred and twenty-two. And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:13
verses.text: and his brothers, chief of the fathers, two hundred and forty-two. And Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:14
verses.text: and their brothers, mighty men of power, <hi>were</hi> a hundred and twenty-eight. And their overseer <hi>was</hi> Zabdiel, the son of <hi>one of</hi> the great men.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:15
verses.text: And from the Levites <hi>were</hi> Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:16
verses.text: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, <hi>were over</hi> the outward business of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:17
verses.text: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, <hi>was</hi> the leader to begin the thanksgiving in prayer. And Bakbukiah was second among his brothers, and then Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:18
verses.text: All the Levites in the holy city <hi>were</hi> two hundred and eighty-four.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:19
verses.text: And the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers who kept the gates, <hi>were</hi> a hundred and seventy-two.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:20
verses.text: And the rest of Israel, of the priests <hi>and</hi> the Levites, <hi>were</hi> in all the cities of Judah, each one in his inheritance.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:21
verses.text: But the temple-slaves lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gispa <hi>were</hi> over the temple-slaves.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:22
verses.text: And the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem <hi>was</hi> Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers <hi>were</hi> over the business of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:23
verses.text: For <hi>it was</hi> the king's commandment concerning them that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:24
verses.text: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, <hi>was</hi> at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:25
verses.text: And for the villages, with their fields, <hi>some</hi> of the sons of Judah lived at Kirjath-arba, and in its villages, and at Dibon, and in its villages, and at Jekabzeel, and its villages,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:26
verses.text: and at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:27
verses.text: and at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and <hi>in</hi> its villages,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:28
verses.text: and at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in its villages,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:29
verses.text: and at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:30
verses.text: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, at Lachish, and the fields of it, at Azekah, and <hi>in</hi> its villages. And they lived from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:31
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin from Geba <hi>lived</hi> at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and their villages,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:32
verses.text: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:33
verses.text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:34
verses.text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:35
verses.text: Lod, and Ono, the Valley of Craftsmen.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:36
verses.text: And divisions of the Levites <hi>were</hi> <hi>in</hi> Judah and for Benjamin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:2
verses.text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:3
verses.text: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:4
verses.text: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:5
verses.text: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:6
verses.text: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:7
verses.text: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These <hi>were</hi> the chief of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:8
verses.text: And the Levites <hi>were</hi> Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah. Mattaniah <hi>was</hi> over the thanksgiving, he and his brothers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:9
verses.text: And Bakbukiah and Unni, their brothers, <hi>were</hi> next to them in the watches.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:10
verses.text: And Jeshua fathered Joiakim, and Joiakim fathered Eliashib, and Eliashib fathered Joiada,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:11
verses.text: and Joiada fathered Jonathan, and Jonathan fathered Jaddua.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:12
verses.text: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: from <hi>the house of</hi> Seraiah was Meraiah; from Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:13
verses.text: from Ezra, Meshullam; from Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:14
verses.text: from Melicu, Jonathan; from Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:15
verses.text: from Harim, Adna; from Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:16
verses.text: from Iddo, Zechariah; from Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:17
verses.text: from Abijah, Zichri; from Miniamin of Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:18
verses.text: from Bilgah, Shammua; from Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:19
verses.text: and from Joiarib, Mattenai; from Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:20
verses.text: from Sallai, Kallai; from Amok, Eber;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:21
verses.text: from Hilkiah, Hashabiah; from Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:22
verses.text: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, <hi>were</hi> recorded chief of the fathers and the priests, until the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:23
verses.text: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, <hi>were</hi> written in the Book of the Chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:24
verses.text: And the chief of the Levites <hi>were</hi> Hashabiah, Sherebiah; and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers next to them, to praise <hi>and</hi> to give thanks, according to the command of David the man of God, watch by watch.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:25
verses.text: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub, <hi>were</hi> guarding the gates, the guard at the thresholds of the gates.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:26
verses.text: These <hi>were</hi> in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:27
verses.text: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, and with thanksgiving, and with singing, <hi>with</hi> cymbals, harps and with lyres.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:28
verses.text: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves, both out of the plain country around Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathi;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:29
verses.text: and from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth (for the singers had built themselves villages all around Jerusalem.)

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:30
verses.text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves. And they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:31
verses.text: Then I brought up the rulers of Judah on the wall, and chose two great choirs of praise. One went to the right upon the wall toward the Dung Gate.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:32
verses.text: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half the rulers of Judah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:33
verses.text: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:34
verses.text: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:35
verses.text: and <hi>many</hi> of the priests' sons with trumpets; Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:36
verses.text: and his brothers, Shemaiah, and Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and with Ezra the scribe before them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:37
verses.text: And at the Fountain Gate, across from them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even to the Water Gate eastward.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:38
verses.text: And the other choirs of praise went across from <hi>them</hi>, and I after them, and half of the people on the wall, from beyond the Tower of the Furnaces even to the Broad Wall,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:39
verses.text: and from above the Gate of Ephraim, and above the Old Gate, and above the Fish Gate, and the Tower of Hananeel, and the Tower of Meah, even to the Sheep Gate. And they stood still in the Prison Gate.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:40
verses.text: And stood the two praise choirs to give thanks in the house of God, and I, and half of the rulers with me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:41
verses.text: And the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, <hi>and</hi> Hananiah, <hi>were</hi> with trumpets,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:42
verses.text: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah <hi>their</hi> overseer.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:43
verses.text: And that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced. For God had made them rejoice with great joy. And the wives and the sons rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:44
verses.text: And at that time some were chosen over the rooms for the treasuries, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather to them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the Law for the priests and Levites. For Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who waited.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:45
verses.text: And both the singers and the gatekeepers kept the charge of their God, and the charge of the cleansing, according to the command of David <hi>and</hi> of Solomon his son.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:46
verses.text: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there <hi>were</hi> chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:47
verses.text: And all Israel gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, every day its portion, in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah. And they set the <hi>holy things</hi> apart for the Levites, and the Levites set them apart for the sons of Aaron.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:1
verses.text: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the ears of the people. And in it was found written that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God forever,

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:2
verses.text: because they did not meet the sons of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them so that he should curse them. But our God turned the curse into a blessing.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:3
verses.text: And it happened when they had heard the Law, they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:4
verses.text: And before this, Eliashib the priest, who was set over the rooms of the house of our God, and who <hi>was</hi> related to Tobiah.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:5
verses.text: and he had prepared for himself a large room where they had in days of old laid the food offering, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded <hi>to be given</hi> to the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the offerings of the priests.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:6
verses.text: But in all this <hi>time</hi> I was not at Jerusalem. For in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon, I came to the king. And after some days I was given permission to leave the king.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:7
verses.text: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil which Eliashib did for Tobiah in preparing him a room in the courts of the house of God.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:8
verses.text: And it grieved me very much. And I threw all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the room.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:9
verses.text: Then I commanded, and they purified the rooms. And I brought there again the vessels of the house of God, with the food offering and the frankincense.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:10
verses.text: And I saw that the portions of the Levites had not been given <hi>to them</hi>; for the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had fled each one to his field.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:11
verses.text: And I contended with the rulers and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together and set them in their place.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:12
verses.text: And all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil into the treasuries.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:13
verses.text: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah. And next to them <hi>was</hi> Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah. For they <hi>were</hi> counted faithful, and their office <hi>was</hi> to distribute to their brothers.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:14
verses.text: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my good deeds which I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices of it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:15
verses.text: In those days I saw in Judah <hi>some</hi> treading winepresses on the Sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and loading asses and also wine, grapes, and figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. And I testified <hi>against them</hi> in the day in which they sold food.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:16
verses.text: And men of Tyre lived in it, who brought fish and all kinds of goods, and sold on the Sabbath to the sons of Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:17
verses.text: And I contended with the nobles of Judah and said to them, What evil thing <hi>is</hi> this that you do, and defile the Sabbath day?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:18
verses.text: Did not your fathers do this, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us and upon this city? Yet you bring more wrath upon Israel by defiling the Sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:19
verses.text: And it happened when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. And I set <hi>some</hi> of my servants at the gates, so that there should be no burden brought in on the Sabbath day.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:20
verses.text: And the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods stayed the night outside Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:21
verses.text: And I testified against them, and said to them, Why do you stay around the wall? If you do <hi>so</hi> again, I will lay hands on you. From that time on they did not come on the Sabbath.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:22
verses.text: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come <hi>and</hi> keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of Your mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:23
verses.text: In those days I also saw Jews who lived with women <hi>from</hi> Ashdod, Ammon, <hi>and</hi> from Moab.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:24
verses.text: And their sons spoke half Ashdod's speech, and there was no caring to speak Jewish, but according to the language of each people.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:25
verses.text: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and struck <hi>certain</hi> of them, and plucked off their hair. And I made them swear by the name of God, <hi>saying</hi>, You shall not give your daughters to their sons, or take their daughters to your sons, or for yourselves.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:26
verses.text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, who was beloved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. But women from other lands caused even him to sin.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:27
verses.text: Shall we then listen to you, to do all this great evil, to sin against our God in living with foreign women?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:28
verses.text: And <hi>one</hi> of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, <hi>was</hi> son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; and I chased him from me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:29
verses.text: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:30
verses.text: So I cleansed them from all strangers, and appointed charges to the priests and the Levites, every one in his business,

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:31
verses.text: and for the wood offering, at chosen times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:1
verses.text: And it happened in the days of Ahasuerus (this <hi>is</hi> the Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, <hi>over</hi> a hundred and twenty-seven provinces).

verses.name: Esther 1:2
verses.text: in those days, when king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom in Shushan the palace,

verses.name: Esther 1:3
verses.text: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast to all his princes and his servants. The power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, <hi>were</hi> before him.

verses.name: Esther 1:4
verses.text: And he showed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, a hundred and eighty days.

verses.name: Esther 1:5
verses.text: And when these days had expired, the king made a feast to all the people who were present in Shushan the palace, both to great and small, for seven days in the court of the garden of the king's palace.

verses.name: Esther 1:6
verses.text: White, green, and blue hangings were fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble. The beds <hi>were of</hi> gold and silver, on a pavement of <hi>red</hi> and white, and pearl, and black marble.

verses.name: Esther 1:7
verses.text: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, the vessels being different from one another, and royal wine in abundance, according to the hand of the king.

verses.name: Esther 1:8
verses.text: And the drinking <hi>was</hi> according to the law, no one compelling, for so the king had commanded every chief of his house that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

verses.name: Esther 1:9
verses.text: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women <hi>in</hi> the royal house which <hi>belonged</hi> to king Ahasuerus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:10
verses.text: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

verses.name: Esther 1:11
verses.text: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown, in order to show the people and the princes her beauty, for she <hi>was</hi> beautiful to look on.

verses.name: Esther 1:12
verses.text: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's command by <hi>his</hi> eunuchs. And the king <hi>was</hi> very angry, and his anger burned within him.

verses.name: Esther 1:13
verses.text: And the king said to the wise men who knew the times (for so <hi>was</hi> the king's manner toward all who knew law and judgment;

verses.name: Esther 1:14
verses.text: and the next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media who saw the king's face, who sat first in the kingdom),

verses.name: Esther 1:15
verses.text: What shall we do with queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the command of the king Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?

verses.name: Esther 1:16
verses.text: And Memucan answered before the king and princes, Vashti the queen has not only done wrong to the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who <hi>are</hi> in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 1:17
verses.text: For the matter of the queen shall go out to all women, so that their husbands shall be despised in their eyes, and it shall be reported that king Ahasuerus commanded to bring Vashti the queen in before him, but she did not come.

verses.name: Esther 1:18
verses.text: And this day the princesses of Persia and Media shall say the same to all the king's princes who have heard of the deed of the queen. And there <hi>will be</hi> contempt and strife.

verses.name: Esther 1:19
verses.text: If it please the king, let there be a royal command from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it may not be changed, that Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus. And let the king give her royal state to another who is better than she is.

verses.name: Esther 1:20
verses.text: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire (for it is great), all the wives shall give their husbands honor, both the great and small.

verses.name: Esther 1:21
verses.text: And the saying pleased the king and the princes. And the king did according to the word of Memucan.

verses.name: Esther 1:22
verses.text: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing of it, and to every people in their language, so that every man should bear rule in his own house, and published according to the language of every people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:1
verses.text: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus had calmed down, he remembered Vashti and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

verses.name: Esther 2:2
verses.text: And the king's servants who served him said, Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.

verses.name: Esther 2:3
verses.text: And let the king choose officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, so that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, to the hand of Hegai the king's eunuch, keeper of the women. And let their ointments be given.

verses.name: Esther 2:4
verses.text: And let the young woman who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king, and he did so.

verses.name: Esther 2:5
verses.text: In Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew whose name <hi>was</hi> Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite

verses.name: Esther 2:6
verses.text: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away.

verses.name: Esther 2:7
verses.text: And he brought up Hadassah, that <hi>is</hi>, Esther, his uncle's daughter. For she had neither father nor mother, and the young woman <hi>was</hi> fair and beautiful, whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

verses.name: Esther 2:8
verses.text: And it happened when the king's command and his order was heard, and when many young women had been gathered to Shushan the palace, into the hand of Hegai, Esther was also brought to the king's house, into the hand of Hegai, keeper of the women.

verses.name: Esther 2:9
verses.text: And the young woman pleased him, and she received kindness from him. And he quickly gave to her purifiers and her portion. And seven young women <hi>who were</hi> fit to be given her, out of the king's house. And he moved her and her servant women to the best place in the house of the women.

verses.name: Esther 2:10
verses.text: Esther had not revealed her people nor her kindred, for Mordecai had commanded her that she should not show <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Esther 2:11
verses.text: And Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women's house in order to know how Esther did and what was to become of her.

verses.name: Esther 2:12
verses.text: And when the turn of each young woman had come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after she had been purified twelve months, according to the law of the women (for so the days of their anointing were done, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odors, and with the perfumes of the women).

verses.name: Esther 2:13
verses.text: And in this way the young woman came to the king. Whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women to the king's house.

verses.name: Esther 2:14
verses.text: She went in the evening, and on the next day she returned to the second house of the women, into the hand of Shaashgaz, the king's officer who kept the concubines. She did not come in to the king any more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

verses.name: Esther 2:15
verses.text: And when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai who had taken her for his daughter, had come to go in to the king, she asked nothing but what was chosen by Hegai the king's officer, the keeper of the women. And Esther had favor in the sight of all who looked on her.

verses.name: Esther 2:16
verses.text: And Esther was taken to king Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which <hi>is</hi> the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.name: Esther 2:17
verses.text: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she rose in grace and favor in his sight more than all the virgins. And he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.name: Esther 2:18
verses.text: And the king made a great feast to all his princes and his servants, Esther's feast. And he ordered a release for the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

verses.name: Esther 2:19
verses.text: And when the virgins were gathered the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

verses.name: Esther 2:20
verses.text: Esther had not yet revealed her kindred nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her. For Esther obeyed the command of Mordecai as she did when she was brought up with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:21
verses.text: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, of those who kept the door, were angry and tried to lay a hand on king Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 2:22
verses.text: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told Esther the queen. And Esther told the king in Mordecai's name.

verses.name: Esther 2:23
verses.text: And when the matter was searched into, it was found out, and the two of them were hanged on a tree. And it was written in the Book of the Matters of the Days before the king.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:1
verses.text: After these things king Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who <hi>were</hi> with him.

verses.name: Esther 3:2
verses.text: And all the king's servants in the king's gate bowed and worshiped Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai did not bow nor worship.

verses.name: Esther 3:3
verses.text: And the king's servants in the king's gate said to Mordecai, Why do you transgress the king's command?

verses.name: Esther 3:4
verses.text: And it happened when they spoke daily to him, and when he did not listen to them, they told Haman, to see if Mordecai's matters would stand. For he had told them that he <hi>was</hi> a Jew.

verses.name: Esther 3:5
verses.text: And when Haman saw that Mordecai did not bow nor worship him, then Haman was full of wrath.

verses.name: Esther 3:6
verses.text: And he scorned to lay hands only on Mordecai, for they had revealed to him the people of Mordecai. And Haman sought to destroy all the Jews throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, the people of Mordecai.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:7
verses.text: In the first month, that <hi>is</hi>, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth <hi>month</hi>, the month Adar.

verses.name: Esther 3:8
verses.text: And Haman said to king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people, in all the provinces of your kingdom. And their laws <hi>are</hi> different from all people, neither do they keep the king's laws. And it is not for the king's gain to allow them to live.

verses.name: Esther 3:9
verses.text: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed. And I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those who have charge of the business, to bring <hi>it</hi> into the king's treasuries.

verses.name: Esther 3:10
verses.text: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

verses.name: Esther 3:11
verses.text: And the king said to Haman, The silver <hi>is</hi> given to you, the people also, to do with them as seems good to you.

verses.name: Esther 3:12
verses.text: Then the king's scribes were called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded to the king's lieutenants, and to the governors <hi>who were</hi> over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province, according to the writing of it, and to every people according to their language. It was written in the name of king Ahasuerus and sealed with the king's ring.

verses.name: Esther 3:13
verses.text: And the letters were sent by postal riders into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and <hi>to take</hi> what they owned for a prize.

verses.name: Esther 3:14
verses.text: The copy of the writing, for a command to be given in every province, was published to all people, to be ready for that day.

verses.name: Esther 3:15
verses.text: The posts went out, being hurried by the king's command, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city Shushan was perplexed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:1
verses.text: And Mordecai understood all that was done, and Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes and went out into the middle of the city, and cried with a loud and bitter cry.

verses.name: Esther 4:2
verses.text: And he even came before the king's gate for none <hi>might</hi> enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

verses.name: Esther 4:3
verses.text: And in every province, wherever the king's command and his decree came, there <hi>was</hi> great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping and wailing. And many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.name: Esther 4:4
verses.text: And Esther's servant women and her eunuchs came and told her. And the queen was exceedingly grieved, and she sent clothing to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him. But he did not receive <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:5
verses.text: And Esther called for Hatach, <hi>one</hi> of the king's eunuchs whom he had appointed to attend on her, and gave him a command to Mordecai to know what it <hi>was</hi> and why it <hi>was</hi>.

verses.name: Esther 4:6
verses.text: And Hatach went forth to Mordecai, to the street of the city in front of the king's gate.

verses.name: Esther 4:7
verses.text: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and of the sum of the silver which Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews in order to destroy them.

verses.name: Esther 4:8
verses.text: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree which <hi>was</hi> given at Shushan in order to destroy them, to show <hi>it</hi> to Esther and to declare it to her, and to command her that she should go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to seek help for her people.

verses.name: Esther 4:9
verses.text: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

verses.name: Esther 4:10
verses.text: Again Esther spoke to Hatach, and gave him command to Mordecai.

verses.name: Esther 4:11
verses.text: And the king's servants and the people of the king's provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, shall come to the king into the inner court, who is not called, <hi>there is</hi> one law of his, execution, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden scepter so that he may live. But I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.

verses.name: Esther 4:12
verses.text: And they told Mordecai Esther's words.

verses.name: Esther 4:13
verses.text: And Mordecai commanded them to answer Esther, Do not think within yourself that you shall escape in the king's house more than all the Jews.

verses.name: Esther 4:14
verses.text: For if you are completely silent at this time, relief and deliverance shall arise to the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house shall be destroyed. And who knows whether you have come to the kingdom for a time like this?

verses.name: Esther 4:15
verses.text: And Esther said to return to Mordecai <hi>this answer</hi>,

verses.name: Esther 4:16
verses.text: Go, gather all the Jews who are present in Shushan, and fast for me, and do not eat nor drink three days, night or day. My maidservants and I will also fast in the same way. And so I will go in to the king, which <hi>is</hi> not according to the law. And if I perish, I perish.

verses.name: Esther 4:17
verses.text: And Mordecai passed over and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:1
verses.text: And it happened on the third day, Esther put on royal <hi>clothing</hi>, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, across from the king's house. And the king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, across from the gate of the house.

verses.name: Esther 5:2
verses.text: And it happened when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she received favor <hi>in</hi> his sight. And the king held out to Esther the golden scepter in his hand. And Esther drew near and touched the top of the scepter.

verses.name: Esther 5:3
verses.text: And the king said to her, What do you <hi>desire</hi>, queen Esther? And what <hi>is</hi> your wish? It shall be given to you even to half of the kingdom.

verses.name: Esther 5:4
verses.text: And Esther answered, If <hi>it is</hi> good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet which I have prepared for him.

verses.name: Esther 5:5
verses.text: And the king said, Cause Haman to hurry so that he may do as Esther has said. And the king and Haman came to the banquet which Esther had prepared.

verses.name: Esther 5:6
verses.text: And the king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, What <hi>is</hi> your petition that it shall be granted to you? And what <hi>is</hi> your request? It shall be performed even to half of the kingdom.

verses.name: Esther 5:7
verses.text: And Esther answered and said, <hi>As to</hi> my petition and my request,

verses.name: Esther 5:8
verses.text: if I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet which I shall prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:9
verses.text: And Haman went forth that day joyful and with a glad heart. But when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he did not stand up nor move for him, he was full of fury against Mordecai.

verses.name: Esther 5:10
verses.text: But Haman held himself in. And when he came home, he sent and called <hi>for</hi> his friends and Zeresh his wife.

verses.name: Esther 5:11
verses.text: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and his many sons, and all to which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

verses.name: Esther 5:12
verses.text: And Haman said, Yes, Esther the queen let <hi>no man</hi> but me come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared. And also tomorrow I am invited to <hi>her banquet</hi>, with the king.

verses.name: Esther 5:13
verses.text: Yet all this avails me nothing as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

verses.name: Esther 5:14
verses.text: And Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, Make a wooden <hi>gallows</hi>, fifty cubits high and tomorrow speak to the king that Mordecai may be hanged on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman, and he caused the wooden <hi>gallows</hi> to be made.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:1
verses.text: On that night the king could not sleep, and he commanded to bring the Book of the Records of the Matter of the Days. And they were read before the king.

verses.name: Esther 6:2
verses.text: And it was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's eunuchs, the keepers of the door who tried to lay a hand on king Ahasuerus.

verses.name: Esther 6:3
verses.text: And the king said, What honor and dignity has been done to Mordecai for this? And the king's servants who served him said, Nothing has been done for him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:4
verses.text: And the king said, Who <hi>is</hi> in the court? And Haman had come into the outer court of the king's house to speak to the king to hang Mordecai on the wooden <hi>gallows</hi> which he had prepared for him.

verses.name: Esther 6:5
verses.text: And the king's servants said to him, Behold, Haman stands in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

verses.name: Esther 6:6
verses.text: So Haman came in. And the king said to him, What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor? And Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honor more than to myself?

verses.name: Esther 6:7
verses.text: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delights to honor,

verses.name: Esther 6:8
verses.text: let the royal clothing be brought, which the king wears, and the horse that the king rides on, and the royal crown which is set on his head.

verses.name: Esther 6:9
verses.text: And let this clothing and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes so that they may dress the man whom the king delights to honor, and bring him on horseback through the streets of the city, and proclaim before him, This is what shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor.

verses.name: Esther 6:10
verses.text: And the king said to Haman, Make haste! Take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king's gate. Do not fail to do any of all the things you have spoken.

verses.name: Esther 6:11
verses.text: And Haman took the clothing and the horse and dressed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, This is what shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:12
verses.text: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hurried to his house mourning, and having <hi>his</hi> head covered.

verses.name: Esther 6:13
verses.text: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every <hi>thing</hi> that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, If Mordecai is of the seed of the Jews, before whom you have begun to fall, you shall not prevail against him but shall surely fall before him.

verses.name: Esther 6:14
verses.text: And while they <hi>were</hi> still talking with him, the king's eunuchs came. And they hurried to bring Haman to the banquet which Esther had prepared.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:1
verses.text: And the king and Haman came to the banquet of Esther the queen.

verses.name: Esther 7:2
verses.text: And the king said again to Esther on the second day of the banquet of wine, What <hi>is</hi> your petition, queen Esther, that it may be granted you? And what <hi>is</hi> your request? And it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

verses.name: Esther 7:3
verses.text: And Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

verses.name: Esther 7:4
verses.text: For we are sold, my people and I, to be destroyed, to be killed, and to perish. But if we had been sold for men-slaves and women-slaves, I would have held my tongue, although the enemy could not make up for the king's damage.

verses.name: Esther 7:5
verses.text: And king Ahasuerus answered and said to Esther the queen, Who <hi>is</hi> he, and where <hi>is</hi> the one who dares presume in his heart to do so?

verses.name: Esther 7:6
verses.text: And Esther said, The man who is our adversary and enemy <hi>is</hi> this wicked Haman. And Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:7
verses.text: And the king, arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath, <hi>went</hi> into the palace garden. And Haman stood up to beg for his life from Esther the queen, for he saw that evil was determined against him by the king.

verses.name: Esther 7:8
verses.text: And the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine. And Haman had fallen on the bed on which Esther <hi>was</hi>. And the king said, Will he also force the queen before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

verses.name: Esther 7:9
verses.text: And Harbonah, one of the eunuchs, said before the king, Also look! the wooden <hi>gallows</hi> fifty cubits high which Haman made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, stands in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him on it!

verses.name: Esther 7:10
verses.text: And they hanged Haman on the wooden <hi>gallows</hi> that he had prepared for Mordecai. And the king's wrath lay down.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:1
verses.text: On that day king Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews' enemy, to Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king, for Esther had told what he <hi>was</hi> to her.

verses.name: Esther 8:2
