verses.text: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not hidden Your loving-kindness and Your truth from the great congregation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, O LORD; let Your loving-kindness and Your truth always watch over me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: For evils without number have hemmed me in; my sins have taken hold on me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and humbled together, those who seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame, those who wish me evil.

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: Let them be desolate as a reward for their shame, those who say to me, Aha, aha!

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You, and the ones loving your salvation always say, Let the LORD be magnified.

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> poor and needy; the LORD will care for me; You <hi>are</hi> my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not wait.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who acts wisely toward the poor; the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: The LORD will watch over him and keep him alive; <hi>and</hi> he shall be blessed on the earth; and You will not deliver him to the soul of his enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: The LORD will hold him up on the bed of sickness; You will change all his bed in his illness.

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: I said, LORD, be merciful to me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: My enemies speak evil of me, <hi>saying</hi>, When will he die, and his name perish?

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: And when he comes to see <hi>me</hi>, he speaks vanity; his heart gathers iniquity to itself; he goes out and speaks of it.

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: All my haters me whisper against me; they plot evil against me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: They say, a wicked thing is poured out on him, and he who lies down shall rise no more.

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: Even a man, my friend, in whom I trusted, who ate of my bread, has lifted up <hi>his</hi> heel against me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: But You, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, so that I may repay them.

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: By this I know that You delight in me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: And I, in my integrity You uphold me; and You set me before Your face forever.

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD God of Israel, from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen and Amen!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A contemplation; for the sons of Korah. As the hart pants after the water brooks, so my soul pants after You, O God.

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God; when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say to me all the day, Where <hi>is</hi> your God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: When I remember these <hi>things</hi>, I pour out my soul on me; for I had gone with the multitude; I went with them to the house of God with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping the feast.

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and moan within me? Hope in God; for I shall praise Him <hi>for</hi> the salvation of His face.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore I will remember You from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermons, from mount Mizar.

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: Deep calls to deep at the noise of Your waterfalls; all Your waves and Your billows have gone over me.

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: The LORD will command His loving-kindness in the daytime, and in the night His song <hi>shall be</hi> with me, my prayer to the God of my life.

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: I will say to God my rock, Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the cruelty of the enemy?

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> with a sword in my bones, my enemies shame me; while they say daily to me, Where <hi>is</hi> your God?

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why do you moan within me? Hope in God; for I still praise Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: For You <hi>are</hi> the God of my strength; why do You cast me off? Why do I go mourning under the affliction of the enemy?

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: Oh send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to Your holy hill, and to Your tabernacles.

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy; yea, on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God.

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why do you moan within me? Hope in God; for I still praise Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah, a contemplation. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work which You did in their days, in the days of old.

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: You drove out the nations <hi>with</hi> Your hand, and planted them; You brought evil on peoples and cast them out.

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but <hi>it was</hi> Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> my king, O God; command victories for Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: Through You we will push our enemies; through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: But You have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame, those who hated us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise Your name forever. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: Now You have cast us off, and have shamed us, and You do not go forth with our armies.

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: You make us turn back from the adversary; and our haters plunder for themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: You have given us like sheep <hi>for</hi> food, and have scattered us among the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: You have sold Your people for nothing, and You did not increase by their price.

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: You make us a curse to our neighbors, a scorn and a mockery to those who are round about us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: My shame <hi>is</hi> always before me, and the shame of my face has covered me:

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: because of the voice of the slanderer and the blasphemer; before the enemy and avenger.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: All this has come on us; yet we have not forgotten You nor dealt falsely in Your covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps turned aside from Your way,

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: though You have crushed us in the place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god,

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: shall not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: Yea, for Your sake we are put to death all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: Awaken! Why do You sleep, O LORD? Arise! Do not cast <hi>us</hi> off forever.

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: Why do You hide Your face, <hi>and</hi> forget our affliction and distress?

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly holds fast to the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: Arise <hi>for</hi> our help, and redeem us for the sake of Your mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the Lilies, for the sons of Korah, a contemplation; A Song of Loves. My heart is overflowing <hi>with</hi> a good matter; I speak of my works to the King; my tongue <hi>is</hi> the pen of a ready writer.

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: You are the fairest of the sons of men; grace is poured into Your lips; therefore God has blessed You forever.

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: Gird Your sword on <hi>Your</hi> thigh, O mighty one, <hi>with</hi> Your glory and Your majesty.

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: And ride prosperously <hi>in</hi> Your majesty, because of truth and meekness <hi>and</hi> righteousness; and Your right hand shall teach You fearful things.

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: Your arrows <hi>are</hi> sharp in the heart of the King's enemies; peoples fall under You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: Your throne, O God, <hi>is</hi> forever and ever; the staff of Your kingdom <hi>is</hi> a staff of righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows.

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: All Your garments <hi>smell</hi> of myrrh, and aloes <hi>and</hi> cassia, out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: Kings' daughters <hi>are</hi> among Your precious ones; on Your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: Listen, O daughter, and look; and bow down your ear; and forget your own people and your father's house.

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: And cause the King greatly to desire your beauty, for He <hi>is</hi> your Lord, and you shall worship Him.

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: And the daughter of Tyre <hi>shall be there</hi> with a gift; even the rich among the peoples shall stroke your face.

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: The king's daughter <hi>is</hi> all glorious within; her clothing <hi>is</hi> trimmed with gold.

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: She shall be brought to the king in clothing of needlework; the virgins, her companions after her, shall be brought to You.

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: They shall be led with joy and gladness; they shall enter into the King's palace.

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: Your sons shall be in the place of your fathers; you will make them princes in all the land.

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah. A Song "For the Virgins." God <hi>is</hi> our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes, and when mountains <hi>are</hi> slipping into the heart of the seas.

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: Let its waters roar and foam; let the mountains shake with the swelling of it. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> a river, its channels gladden the city of God glad, the holy <hi>place</hi> of the tabernacles of the Most High.

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: God <hi>is</hi> in the midst of her; she shall not be moved; God shall help her at the turning of the morning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were shaken; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: The LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> with us; the God of Jacob <hi>is</hi> our refuge. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, who makes ruins on the earth;

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: who makes wars to cease to the ends of the earth; He breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariots in the fire.

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: Be still, and know that I <hi>am</hi> God! I will be praised among the nations, I will be praised in the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: The LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> with us; the God of Jacob <hi>is</hi> our refuge. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Clap your hand, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: For the LORD Most High <hi>is</hi> awesome, a great king over all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: He shall humble the peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the majesty of Jacob whom He loved. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: Sing praise to God, sing praise; sing praise to our King, sing praise.

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: For God <hi>is</hi> King of all the earth; sing praises with understanding.

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: God reigns over the nations, God sits on the throne of His holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: The rulers of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth <hi>are</hi> God's; He is lifted up on high.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: A Song and Psalm for the Sons of Korah. Great <hi>is</hi> the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness.

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: Beautiful on high, the joy of the whole earth, <hi>is</hi> mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: God is known in her strongholds for a refuge.

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: For, lo, the kings were gathered; they passed by together.

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: They saw, so they marvelled; they were troubled, <hi>and</hi> hurried away.

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: Fear took hold on them there, <hi>and</hi> pain, like a woman in labor.

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: You break the ships of Tarshish with an east wind;  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: as we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: We have thought of Your loving-kindness, O God, in the midst of Your temple.

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: According to Your name, O God, so <hi>is</hi> Your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness; let mount Zion rejoice!

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: Let the daughters of Judah shout for joy because of Your judgments!

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: Walk around Zion, and go all around it; count the towers of it,

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: Set your heart on its ramparts, pass between its strongholds; so that you may tell <hi>it</hi> to the coming generation.

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: For this God <hi>is</hi> our God forever and ever; He will be <hi>our</hi> guide <hi>even</hi> to death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world;

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: both sons of mankind, and sons of man, rich and poor together;

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: my mouth shall speak of wise things; and the thoughts of my heart <hi>shall be</hi> of understanding.

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: I will bow down my ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying on the harp.

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, <hi>when</hi> the perversity of my ambushers will surround me?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: Those who trust in their wealth, and their many riches, boast themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: A man cannot at all redeem a brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: for the redemption of their soul <hi>is</hi> precious, and it ceases forever,

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: yea, he shall yet live forever; he shall never see corruption.

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: For he sees wise men die; likewise the fool and the animal-like ones perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: Their inward <hi>thought is that</hi> their houses shall <hi>go on</hi> forever, and their dwelling-places to all generations; they call <hi>their</hi> lands after their own names.

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: But man, though high in honor, does not remain; he is like the animals <hi>that</hi> perish.

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: This way of theirs <hi>is</hi> their foolishness; yet their followers delight in their sayings. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: Like sheep they are appointed to the grave; death shall reign <hi>for</hi> them; and the upright shall have the rule over them in the morning; and their form <hi>is</hi> for rotting; the grave <hi>is</hi> their home.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of the grave; for He will take me. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: Be not afraid when one becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases;

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: for when he dies he shall take nothing away; his glory shall not go down after him.

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: For in his life he blessed his soul; yea, they praise you when you do well to yourself.

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: Man in honor, but without understanding, is like the animals; they shall perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. The mighty God, the LORD, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to <hi>its</hi> going down.

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone.

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: Our God comes, and He is not silent; a fire shall devour before Him, and it shall be very stormy all around Him.

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, so that He may judge His people.

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: Gather My saints to Me; and those who cut My covenant by sacrifice.

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: And the heavens shall declare His righteousness; for God Himself <hi>is</hi> judge. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: Hear, My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you; I <hi>am</hi> God, your God.

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices; yea, your burnt offerings <hi>are</hi> continually before Me.

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: I will take no bull out of your house, <hi>nor</hi> he-goats out of your folds.

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: For every beast of the forest <hi>is</hi> Mine, <hi>and</hi> the cattle on a thousand hills.

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: I know all the birds of the mountains; and the wild beasts of the field <hi>are</hi> Mine.

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world <hi>is</hi> Mine, and the fullness of it.

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: Will I eat the flesh of the mighty, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: Offer to God thanksgiving; and pay your vows to the Most High;

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: and call on Me in the day of trouble; and I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: But to the wicked, God says, What <hi>is it</hi> to you, to declare My statutes, and to take up My covenant in your mouth?

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: Yea, you hate to be taught, and you toss My words behind you.

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: When you saw a thief, then you were pleased to be with him, and you <hi>have taken</hi> part with adulterers.

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: You give your mouth to evil, and your tongue frames deceit.

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: You sit; you speak against your brother; you slander your own mother's son.

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: These <hi>things</hi> you have done, and I have kept silence; you thought <hi>that</hi> I was like yourself, <hi>but</hi> I will rebuke you, and set in order before your eyes.

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: Now think of this, you who forget God, lest I tear <hi>you</hi> in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; and he who sets a way, I will show him the salvation of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving-kindness; according to the multitude of Your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: Wash me completely from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: For I confess my transgressions; and my sin <hi>is</hi> ever before me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: Against You, You only, have I sinned, and done evil in Your sight; that You might be justified when You speak, <hi>and</hi> be clear when You judge.

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden <hi>part</hi> You shall make me to know wisdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness; <hi>that</hi> the bones <hi>which</hi> You have broken may rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: Hide Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: Cast me not away from Your presence, and take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me <hi>with</hi> a willing spirit.

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: <hi> Then</hi> I will teach transgressors Your ways; and sinners shall be converted to You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: Deliver me from the guilt of shedding blood, O God, O God of my salvation, <hi>and</hi> my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: O LORD, open my lips, and my mouth shall show forth Your praise.

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: For You do not desire sacrifice; or else I would give <hi>it</hi>; You do not delight in burnt offering.

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: The sacrifices of God <hi>are</hi> a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: Then shall You be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering; then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A contemplation. A Psalm of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, David has come to the house of Ahimelech. Why do you boast yourself in evil, O mighty man? The mercy of God <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: Your tongue devises evil, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: You love evil more than good, <hi>and</hi> lying more than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: You love all devouring words, O deceitful tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: God will likewise destroy you forever; He shall take you away, and pluck you out of <hi>your</hi> tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: And the righteous shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, <hi>saying</hi>,

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: Behold, the man <hi>who</hi> did not make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, he was strong in his wickedness.

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: I will praise You forever, because You have done <hi>it</hi>; and I will wait <hi>on</hi> Your name; for <hi>it is</hi> good before Your saints.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician on Mahalath. A contemplation. A Psalm of David. The fool has said in his heart, <hi>There is</hi> no God. They acted corruptly, and have worked out abominable wickedness; <hi>there is</hi> not one doing good.

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: God looked down from Heaven on the sons of mankind to see if <hi>any</hi> was discerning, who was seeking God.

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: Every one has turned away; they have altogether become filthy; not one is doing good, no, not even one.

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? They eat up my people <hi>as</hi> they eat bread; they have not called on God.

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: There they dreaded <hi>with</hi> dread, <hi>where</hi> no dread was; for God has scattered the bones of him who camps against you; you have put <hi>them</hi> to shame because God rejects them.

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God brings back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation. A Psalm of David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Does not David hide himself among us? Save me, O God, by Your name, and judge me by Your strength.

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: For strangers have risen up against me, and cruel men seek after my soul; they have not set God before them. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: Behold, God <hi>is</hi> my helper; the LORD <hi>is</hi> with those who uphold my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: He shall reward evil to my enemies; cut them off in Your truth.

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: I will freely sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for <hi>it is</hi> good.

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: For He has delivered me out of all trouble; and my eye has seen <hi>its desire</hi> on my enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. For stringed instruments. A contemplation. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not Yourself from my cry.

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: Attend to me, and hear me; I wander and I moan in my complaint,

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: from the voice of the enemy, from the oppression of the wicked, for they shake trouble over me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: My heart is pained within me; and the terrors of death have fallen on me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: Fear and trembling have come on me, and horror has covered me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: And I said, Who will give to me wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: Lo, I would wander far off; I would lodge in the desert. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm <hi>and</hi> tempest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: Swallow up, O LORD, <hi>and</hi> divide their tongues; for I have seen violence and fighting in the city.

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: They go around her on her walls by day and night; and evil and sorrow <hi>are</hi> in her midst.

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: Covetings <hi>are</hi> in her midst; oppression and guile will not depart from her streets.

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: For <hi>it is</hi> not an enemy <hi>who</hi> reviled me; then I could have borne <hi>it</hi>; <hi>it is</hi> not one who hates me <hi>who</hi> magnified <hi>himself</hi> against me; or I would hide myself from him;

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: but <hi>it is</hi> you, a man my rank, my guide and my friend.

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, <hi>and</hi> walked to the house of God in company.

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: Let desolation take hold on them, <hi>and</hi> let them go down alive <hi>into</hi> hell; for evils <hi>are</hi> among them in their dwellings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: I, <hi>even</hi> I, will call to God, and the LORD will save me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: Evening and morning, and at noon, I will pray and cry aloud; and He shall hear my voice.

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle <hi>that was</hi> against me; for there were many with me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: God shall hear and answer them, even He who is enthroned of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they do not fear God.

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; he has broken his covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: The butterings of his mouth <hi>were</hi> forked, but war <hi>was</hi> in his heart; his words were softer than oil, yet they <hi>were</hi> drawn swords.

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: Cast your burden on the LORD, and He will keep you; He will never allow the righteous to waver.

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: But You, O God, will bring them down into the pit of ruin; bloody and deceitful men shall not <hi>live</hi> half their days; but I will trust in You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the silent dove-- those far off. Of David, a secret treasure--when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; fighting daily, he presses me down.

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: My watchers panted for me daily; for many <hi>are</hi> they who proudly fight against me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: When I am afraid I will trust in You.

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: In God I will praise His word; in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: All day long they pervert my words; all their thoughts <hi>are</hi> against me for evil.

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: They stir up strife; they hide themselves; they watch my steps as they wait for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: You number my wandering; O put my tears into Your bottle; <hi>are they</hi> not in Your Book?

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: When I cry, then my enemies will be turned back. This I know, for God <hi>is</hi> with me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: In God I will praise <hi>His</hi> word; in the LORD will I praise <hi>His</hi> word.

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: In God I have put my trust; I will not be afraid of what man can do to me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: Your vows <hi>are</hi> on me, O God; I will give praises to You.

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: For You have delivered my soul from death; <hi>have You</hi> not <hi>kept</hi> my feet from falling, <hi>so that</hi> I may walk before God in the light of the living?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave. Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me; for my soul trusts in You; yea, in the shadow of Your wings I will make my hiding-place, until <hi>these</hi> great troubles pass by.

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: I will cry to God most high, to God who does all <hi>things</hi> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: He shall send from Heaven, and save me <hi>from</hi> the scorn of him who would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: My soul <hi>is</hi> among lions; I lie <hi>among</hi> those on fire, the sons of men whose teeth <hi>are</hi> spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: Be praised above the heavens, O God; <hi>let</hi> Your glory <hi>be</hi> above all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down; <hi>they have</hi> dug a pit before me, they have fallen into it. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise.

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: Wake up, my soul! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn.

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples; I will sing to You among the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: For Your mercy <hi>is</hi> great to the heavens, and Your truth to the clouds.

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; <hi>let</hi> Your glory <hi>be</hi> above all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David. Will you indeed speak righteousness in silence? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: Yes, in heart you work the evil, you weigh the violence of your hands in the land.

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb; <hi>they go</hi> astray from the womb, speaking lies.

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: Their poison <hi>is</hi> like the poison of a snake; like the deaf adder, he stops his ear,

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: which will not listen to the charmer's voice, a skillful caster of spells.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: O God, break their teeth in their mouth; break out the big teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: Let them melt away like waters; they run off to them; he bends his arrows, <hi>let them be</hi> as though <hi>they were</hi> cut off.

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: <hi> Let them be</hi> as a snail goes <hi>into</hi> melting; <hi>as</hi> a miscarriage of a woman, they do not see the sun.

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, whether green or glowing, He shall sweep it away.

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance; he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: And man shall say, Truly, <hi>there is</hi> a reward for the righteous; truly, <hi>there is</hi> a God judging in the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; defend me from those who rise up against me.

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: Deliver me from the workers of evil and save me from bloody men.

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the mighty are gathered against me; not <hi>for</hi> my transgression, nor <hi>for</hi> my sin, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: Without <hi>my</hi> fault they run and prepare themselves; awaken to help me, and look <hi>on me</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: And You, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the nations; do not be merciful to any plotting evil. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: They return at evening; they make a noise like a dog, and go around the city.

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: Behold, they bellow out with their mouth; swords <hi>are</hi> in their lips; for <hi>they say</hi>, Who hears?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: But You, O Jehovah, shall laugh at them; You will mock at all the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: O my Strength, let me look to You, for God <hi>is</hi> my strong tower.

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: The God of my mercy shall go before me; God shall let me see <hi>my desire</hi> on my enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: Do not kill them, lest my people forget; scatter them by Your power and bring them down, O LORD our shield.

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <hi> For</hi> the sin of their mouth <hi>is</hi> the word of their lips, even let them even be taken in their pride; and for cursing and the lying <hi>which</hi> they speak.

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: Consume <hi>them</hi> in wrath; consume, so that they may not be; and let them know that God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: And at evening they shall return; let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
verses.text: Let them wander up and down for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: But I will sing of Your power; yes, I will sing aloud of Your mercy in the morning; for You have been my strong tower and hiding-place in the day of my trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
verses.text: To You, O my strength, I will sing; for God <hi>is</hi> my strong tower <hi>and</hi> the God of my mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On the Lily of Testimony. A secret treasure of David, to teach; when he struggled with Aram-naharaim and with Aram of Zobah, when Joab returned and struck twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. O God, You have cast us off, You have scattered us, You were angry; take us back.

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: You made the earth tremble; You tore it; heal the breaks of it, for it is shaking.

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: You have shown Your people hard things; You have made us to drink the wine of trembling.

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: You have given a banner to those who fear You, to lift it up because of the truth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: Save <hi>with</hi> Your right hand and answer me, that Your beloved may be delivered.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: God has spoken in His holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: Gilead <hi>is</hi> Mine, and Manasseh <hi>is</hi> Mine; and Ephraim <hi>is</hi> the strength of My head, Judah <hi>is</hi> My lawgiver;

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: Moab <hi>is</hi> My washpot; over Edom I will cast out My shoe; over Philistia I cry in triumph.

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: Who will bring me <hi>into</hi> the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: Have not You, O God, cast us off? And will You, O God, not go out with our armies?

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: Give us help against <hi>our</hi> foe; for vain <hi>is</hi> the help of man.

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: Through God we shall do great things; for <hi>it is</hi> He who shall trample our enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: From the end of the earth I cry to You when my heart is faint; Lead me to the Rock higher than I.

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: For You have been a shelter for me, a strong tower before the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: I will dwell in Your tabernacle forever; I will trust in the hiding place of Your wings. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given an inheritance to those who fear Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: You will add to the days of the king's life; his years will be for many generations.

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: He shall abide before God forever; prepare mercy and truth to preserve him.

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, so that I may daily pay my vows.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. Only to God is my soul in silence; from Him <hi>comes</hi> my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: He only <hi>is</hi> my rock and my salvation; <hi>He is</hi> my tower; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: How long will you imagine mischief against a man? You will shatter him, all of you; you shall be like a bowing wall and a tottering fence.

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: Surely they have plotted to cast <hi>him</hi> down from his great height; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouth, but they curse in their heart. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: My soul, be silent only to God; for my hope <hi>is</hi> from Him.

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: He only <hi>is</hi> my rock and my salvation; He <hi>is</hi> my strong tower; I shall not be shaken.

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: In God <hi>is</hi> my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength; my hiding-place <hi>is</hi> in God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: Trust in Him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before Him; God <hi>is</hi> a hiding-place for us. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: Surely the sons of men <hi>are</hi> vanity; the sons of men <hi>are</hi> a lie; they go up in the scales; they <hi>are</hi> altogether <hi>lighter</hi> than vanity.

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery; if riches increase, do not set your heart <hi>on</hi> them.

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power <hi>belongs</hi> to God.

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: Also to You, O LORD, <hi>belongs</hi> mercy; for You give to every man according to his work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You <hi>are</hi> my God; I will seek You earnestly; my soul thirsts for You; my flesh longs for You, as in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: so I have seen You in the holy place, seeing Your power and Your glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: Because Your loving-kindness <hi>is</hi> better than life, my lips shall praise You.

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: So I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: My soul shall be satisfied as <hi>with</hi> marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise <hi>You</hi> with joyful lips,

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: when I remember You on my bed and think of You in the night watches.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: Because You have been my help, therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: My soul follows hard after You; Your right hand upholds me.

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: But those <hi>who</hi> seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the depths of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: They shall fall by the sword; they shall be a serving for jackals.

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by Him shall glory; but the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; guard my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: Hide me from the council of those who injure, from the rebelling of the workers of iniquity,

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, they tread their arrows, <hi>even</hi> a bitter word,

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: so that they may shoot at the blameless one from a lurking place; suddenly they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: They encourage themselves <hi>in</hi> an evil plan; they talk of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: They search out injustice, <hi>saying</hi>, We have finished hiding a hidden plot. Yea, the inward part of man and <hi>the</hi> heart <hi>are</hi> deep.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly they shall be wounded.

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: So they shall be confounded; their tongue <hi>falls</hi> on themselves; everyone seeing them shall flee.

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall in wisdom think of His doing.

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm and Song of David. To You silence is praise, O God, in Zion; and to You is a vow paid.

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: To You who hears prayer, all flesh comes.

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: Things of iniquity are mightier than I; <hi>as for</hi> our transgressions, You shall purge them away.

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the <hi>one</hi> whom You choose, and cause to come near You. He shall dwell <hi>in</hi> Your courts; we shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, of Your holy temple.

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <hi> By</hi> awesome things in righteousness You will answer us, O God of our salvation; who are the hope of all the ends of the earth and the sea, of <hi>those</hi> far away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: The mountains are established by Your strength, banded together with might,

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: who stills the noise of the sea, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: And the inhabitants of the furthermost places are afraid of Your signs; You make the beginning of the morning and the evening rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: You visit the earth and water it; You greatly enrich it; the river of God is full of water; You provide their grain, for in this way You have prepared it.

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: You fill its terraces with water; You deepen its furrows; You make it soft with showers; You bless the sprouting of it.

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: You crown the year with Your goodness, and Your paths drop fatness.

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: They drop <hi>on</hi> the pastures of the wilderness; and the little hills gird themselves <hi>with</hi> joy.

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with grain; they shout for joy and sing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: Sing forth the honor of His name; make His praise glorious.

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: Say to God, How awesome <hi>are</hi> Your works! Through the greatness of Your power, Your enemies pretend obedience to You.

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: All the earth shall worship You, and shall sing <hi>to</hi> You; they praise Your name. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: Come and see the works of God; <hi>He is</hi> awesome in His deeds toward the sons of men.

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: He turns the sea into dry <hi>land</hi>; they went through the flood on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: He rules by His power forever; His eyes behold the nations; let not the rebels lift themselves up. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: O bless our God, O peoples, and make the voice of His praise to be heard;

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: who holds our soul in life, and does not allow our feet to slide.

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: For You have proved us, O God; You have tested us, as silver is refined.

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: You have brought us into the net; You have laid affliction on our loins.

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: You have allowed men to ride at our head; we have gone through fire and through water, but You have brought us out to plenty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: I will go into Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: <hi> those</hi> which my lips have uttered and my mouth has spoken in my trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: I will offer to You burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: Come <hi>and</hi> hear, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: I cried to Him with my mouth, and exaltations <hi>were</hi> under my tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the LORD will not hear;

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: Surely God has heard; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. May God be merciful to us, and bless us, and cause His face to shine on us. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: So that Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples thank You.

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; for You shall judge the peoples righteously and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: Let the peoples give thanks to You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: The earth shall yield its increase; <hi>and</hi> God, our own God, shall bless us.

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song. Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; also let those who hate Him flee before Him.

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: As smoke is driven away, You drive <hi>them</hi> away; as wax melts before the fire, let the wicked perish in the presence of God.

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: But the righteous are glad; they rejoice before God. Yes, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; praise Him who rides on the heavens by His name JEHOVAH, and rejoice before Him.

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: In His holy dwelling God <hi>is</hi> the father of the fatherless, and the judge of the widows.

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: God causes the lonely to live at home; He brings out those who are bound with chains; but the rebellious dwell in a dry <hi>land</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: O God, when You marched before Your people, when You walked through the wilderness; Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Sinai itself <hi>was moved</hi> at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, by which You upheld Your inheritance when it was weary.

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: Your flock has dwelt in it; You, O God, have prepared in Your goodness for the poor.

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: The Lord gave the word; the bearers of it <hi>were</hi> a great army.

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: Kings of armies fled away; and she who stayed at home divided the plunder.

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: When you lie among the sheepfolds, the wings of a dove <hi>are</hi> covered with silver, and its pinions with the shimmer of gold.

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, it snows on Salmon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: The mountain of Bashan <hi>is</hi> God's mountain; the Bashan range <hi>is</hi> a mountain of peaks.

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountain range, <hi>at the</hi> mountain God has chosen for His resting place? Yes, the LORD will dwell <hi>in it</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: The chariots of God <hi>are</hi> myriads, thousands of thousands; the Lord <hi>is</hi> among them, in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: You have gone up on high; You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts for men, yes, <hi>for</hi> the rebellious also, that <hi>You</hi> might dwell among them, O Jehovah God.

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD; He daily bears burdens for us, the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: Our God <hi>is</hi> the God of salvation; and to the LORD <hi>are</hi> the issues of death.

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: Yea, God shall wound the head of His enemies, <hi>and</hi> the hairy crown of him who walks on in his guilt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan; I will bring back <hi>My people</hi> from the depths of the sea;

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: so that your foot may be dipped in the blood of <hi>your</hi> enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in it.

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: They have seen Your goings, O God; the goings of my God, my King, in the holy place.

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: The singers went before, then the musicians came; among <hi>them were</hi> the virgins playing the timbrels.

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: O bless God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: There <hi>is</hi> little Benjamin <hi>with</hi> their ruler, the leaders of Judah and their multitude, the leaders of Zebulun, and the leaders of Naphtali.

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: Your God has commanded your strength; O God, be strong <hi>in</hi> that which You have worked out for us.

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings shall bring a present to You.

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, the herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples, trampling down with the pieces of silver. He scatters the people <hi>who</hi> delight in war.

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall stretch out her hands to God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises to the Lord. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: To Him who rides on the heavens of heavens of old; lo, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: Give strength to God over Israel; His majesty and His strength in the skies.

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: O God, You <hi>are</hi> overwhelming out of Your holy places; the God of Israel <hi>is</hi> He who gives strength and powers to the people. Blessed <hi>is</hi> God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of David. Save me, O God! for the waters have come in on <hi>my</hi> soul.

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: I sink in deep mire, where <hi>there is</hi> no standing; I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: I am weary from my crying; my throat is dried; my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: They who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they who would destroy me are mighty, my lying enemies. Then I restored <hi>what</hi> I did not take away.

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: O God, You know my foolishness, and my guiltiness <hi>is</hi> not hidden from You.

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: Do not let those who wait on You, O LORD God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake; let not the ones who seek You be ashamed for my sake, O God of Israel,

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: because I have borne reproach for Your sake, shame has covered my face.

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: I have become a stranger to My brothers, and a foreigner to My mother's children.

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: For the zeal of Your house has eaten Me up; and the reproaches of those who reproached You have fallen on Me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: When I humbled my soul with fasting, it turned to my reproach.

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: I also made sackcloth my clothing, and I became a proverb to them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: They who sit in the gate speak against me; and I <hi>was</hi> the song of the drunkards.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: But <hi>as for</hi> me, my prayer <hi>is</hi> to You, O LORD, <hi>in</hi> a pleasing time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy hear me, in the truth of Your salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: Do not let the flood of waters overflow me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut its mouth on me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: Hear me, O LORD, for Your loving-kindness <hi>is</hi> good; turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: And hide not Your face from Your servant; for I am in trouble; hear me quickly.

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: Draw near my soul, and redeem it; deliver me because of my enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor; my enemies <hi>are</hi> all before You.

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness; and I looked <hi>for some</hi> to mourn with me, but <hi>there was</hi> none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: They also gave Me gall for my food; and in My thirst they gave Me vinegar to drink.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: Let their table become a snare before them; and to those at ease a trap.

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; and make their loins shake without ceasing.

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: Pour out Your wrath on them, and let the glow of Your anger take hold of them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: Let their dwelling be wasted; let none dwell in their tents.

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: For they persecute <hi>him</hi> whom You have stricken, and they talk to the grief of those You pierced.

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not come into Your righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: Let them be blotted out of the Book of Life, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> poor and sorrowful; let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify Him with thanksgiving.

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: <hi> This</hi> also shall please the LORD better than an ox, <hi>or</hi> a bull that has horns and hoofs.

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
verses.text: The humble shall see <hi>and</hi> be glad; and your heart shall live, you who seek God.

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: For the LORD hears the needy, and does not despise His prisoners.

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: Let the heavens and earth praise Him, the seas, and everything that moves in them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; so that they may dwell there, and possess it.

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: And the seed of His servants shall inherit it, and they who love His name shall dwell in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. <hi>Make haste</hi>, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and turned pale, those who seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and blush, those who desire my hurt.

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame, those who say, Aha, aha!

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; and let those who love Your salvation say without ending, Let God be magnified.

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> poor and needy; make haste to me, O God; You <hi>are</hi> my help and my deliverer; O LORD, wait no longer!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: In You, O LORD, I put my trust; let me never be put to shame.

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape; bow down Your ear to me, and save me.

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: Be a rock of refuge for me, to which I may always go; You have commanded to save me; for You <hi>are</hi> my Rock and my Fortress.

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel <hi>man</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: For You <hi>are</hi> my hope, O Lord God, my trust from my youth.

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: On You I have rested from the womb; You are He who took me out of my mother's bowels; my praise always <hi>shall be</hi> of You.

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: I am like a wonder to many, but You <hi>are</hi> my strong tower.

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: Let my mouth be filled <hi>with</hi> Your praise, <hi>with</hi> Your honor all the day.

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: For my enemies speak against me; and those who watch for my soul plot together,

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: saying, God has forsaken him; pursue and take him, for <hi>there is</hi> none to deliver <hi>him</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: Let them be ashamed; let those who are enemies of my soul be consumed; let them be covered <hi>with</hi> reproach and dishonor, those who seek my hurt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: But I will hope without ceasing, and I will add more in all Your praise.

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: My mouth shall show forth Your righteousness <hi>and</hi> Your salvation all the day; for I do not know how many they are.

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will speak of Your righteousness, of Yours alone.

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: O God, You have taught me from my youth; and before now I have declared Your wonderful works.

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: And now when I am old and gray-headed, O God, do not leave me; until I have declared Your strength to <hi>this</hi> generation, and Your power to everyone who is to come.

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: And Your righteousness, O God, <hi>is</hi> very high, who have done great things. O God, who <hi>is</hi> like You,

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: who has shown me great and evil distresses; You will turn <hi>me</hi>; You will make me live. You will turn me from the depths of the earth, You will bring me up.

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: You will increase my greatness and surround <hi>and</hi> comfort me on every side.

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: I will also praise You with a harp. O my God, I will sing Your truth; to You I will sing with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to You, and my soul, which You have redeemed.

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: My tongue also shall muse on Your righteousness all the day long; for those who seek my evil have turned pale, they are brought to shame.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: A Psalm of Solomon. Give the King Your judgments, O God, and Your righteousness to the King's son.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: He will judge Your people in righteousness, and Your poor with judgment.

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills by righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: He shall judge the poor of the people; He shall save the children of the needy, and shall crush in pieces the cruel one.

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: They shall fear You <hi>as long as</hi> the sun and moon <hi>endure</hi>, throughout all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, like showers <hi>that</hi> water the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: In His days the righteous shall flourish; and abundance of peace, until the moon <hi>is</hi> not.

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: He shall also have the rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before Him; and His enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; all nations shall serve Him.

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: For He shall deliver the needy when he cries; and the poor <hi>with</hi> no helper.

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: He shall have pity on the poor and needy and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence; and their blood shall be precious in His sight.

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: And He shall live, and to Him shall be given the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall always be made for Him; He shall bless Him all the day long.

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: There shall be a fullness of grain in the earth on the top of the mountains; its fruit shall shake like Lebanon, and <hi>they</hi> of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: His name shall endure forever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun; and <hi>men</hi> shall be blessed in Him; all nations shall call Him blessed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonderful things.

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: And blessed <hi>be</hi> His glorious name forever; and all the earth is filled <hi>with</hi> His glory! Amen and Amen.

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God <hi>is</hi> good to Israel, to the pure of heart.

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: And I, my foot had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: For I was jealous of the proud, <hi>when</hi> I saw the peace of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: For <hi>there are</hi> no bands in their death; but their strength <hi>is</hi> fat.

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> not in trouble <hi>like other</hi> men; neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: Therefore pride enchains them; violence covers them <hi>like</hi> a robe.

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: Their eyes stand out with fatness; they have more than the heart could imagine.

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: They scoff and speak in malice of cruelty; from on high they speak.

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: Therefore His people return here, and waters of a full <hi>cup are</hi> wrung out to them.

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: And they say, How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: Behold, these <hi>are</hi> the ungodly, who are at ease in the world; they increase <hi>in</hi> riches.

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: Surely I have made my heart pure <hi>in</hi> vain, and washed my hands in innocence.

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: For all the day long I have been plagued, and chastened every morning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I would deceive a generation of Your sons.

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: When I thought deeply in order to understand this, it <hi>was</hi> painful for me,

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: until I went into the sanctuary of God; <hi>then</hi> I understood their end.

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down into ruin.

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: How have they been <hi>brought</hi> into grief, as in a moment! They are fully eaten up with terrors,

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: like a dream when <hi>one</hi> awakens; so, O LORD, when You awake, You shall despise their image.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: For my heart was grieved and I was pricked <hi>in</hi> my reins.

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: So foolish <hi>was</hi> I, and I did not know; I was <hi>like</hi> a beast before You.

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> always with You; You have held <hi>me</hi> by my right hand.

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: You shall lead me with Your counsel, and afterward receive me <hi>to</hi> glory.

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: Whom have I in Heaven? And besides You I desire none on earth.

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
verses.text: My flesh and my heart fail; <hi>but</hi> God <hi>is</hi> the strength of my heart, and my part forever.

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: For lo, those who are far from You shall perish; You have destroyed all who go lusting away from You.

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: And I, <hi>it is</hi> good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the LORD God, to declare all Your works.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: An Instruction of Asaph. O God, have You cast <hi>us</hi> off forever? Will Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: Remember Your congregation, <hi>which</hi> You have purchased of old, the rod of Your inheritance which You have redeemed; this mount Zion in <hi>which</hi> You have dwelt.

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: Lift up Your feet to the never-ending ruins, even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: Your enemies roar in the midst of Your congregation; they set up their own banners <hi>for</hi> signs.

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: He is known as one bringing axes on high, on the thick trees.

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: And now all its carvings too, they break down with axes and hammers.

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: They have cast fire into Your sanctuary; they have defiled the dwelling-place of Your name to the ground.

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: They said in their hearts, Together let us rage against them; they have burned up all God's meeting-places in the land.

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: We did not see our signs; <hi>there is</hi> no prophet any more; neither <hi>is there</hi> among us any who knows how long.

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: O God, how long shall the enemy speak evil? Shall the enemy blaspheme Your name forever?

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Draw <hi>it</hi> out of Your bosom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: For God <hi>is</hi> my king of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth,

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: You divide the sea by Your strength; You break the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: You cracked open the heads of leviathan, and gave him to <hi>be food</hi> to the people living in the wilderness.

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: You divide the fountain and the flood; You dry up mighty rivers.

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: The day <hi>is</hi> Yours, the night also <hi>is</hi> Yours; You have prepared the light and the sun.

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: You have set all the borders of the earth; You have made summer and winter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: Remember this, the enemy has cursed, O LORD, and the foolish people have blasphemed Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: Do not deliver the soul of Your turtle dove to the multitude; forget not the congregation of Your poor forever.

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: Look to the covenant; for the dark places of the earth are full of the houses of evil.
