verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: Oh let not the ill-treated ones return ashamed; let the poor and needy praise Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; remember how the foolish man curses You daily.

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: Forget not the voice of Your enemies; the noise of those who rise up against You keeps on increasing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. To You, O God, we have given thanks, to You we have given thanks; for Your name is near, Your wonderful works declared.

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: When I take the appointed time, I will judge uprightly.

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: The earth and all its people are melting away; I hold up its pillars. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: I said to the proud, Do not boast; and to the wicked, Do not lift up the horn;

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: do not lift up your horn on high; <hi>nor</hi> speak <hi>with</hi> a stiff neck.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: For lifting up <hi>comes</hi> neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: But God <hi>is</hi> the judge; <hi>He</hi> puts down one and sets up another.

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: For in the hand of the LORD <hi>there is</hi> a cup, and the wine is red; it is fully mixed; and He pours out from it; but the dregs of it, all the wicked of the earth shall drain its dregs <hi>and</hi> drink.

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: But I will declare forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: Also I will cut off all the horns of the wicked; <hi>but</hi> the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. For stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. God <hi>is</hi> known in Judah, His name is great in Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: And His abode is in Salem; and His dwelling-place in Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: There He broke the fiery arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> more glorious <hi>and</hi> excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: The stouthearted have been stripped; they slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: By Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the horse and the chariot have sunk into a sleep.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: You, <hi>even</hi> You, <hi>are</hi> terrifying, and who can stand when once You are angry?

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: You cause judgment to be heard from Heaven; the earth feared and was still,

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: when God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; the wrath that is left, You shall bind up.

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: Vow, and pay to the LORD your God; let all that are around Him bring presents to the Fearful One.

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: He shall cut off the spirit in princes; <hi>He is</hi> feared by the kings of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried to God with my voice, to God <hi>is</hi> my voice; and He gave ear to me.

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the LORD; my hand was poured in the night, and ceased not; my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit fainted. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: You keep my eyes awake; I am troubled and I cannot speak.

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: I have thought on the days of old, the years of ages <hi>past</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: I remember my song in the night; I speak with my own heart, and my spirit carefully searches.

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: Is His mercy gone forever? Has <hi>His</hi> word failed for all generations?

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies? Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: And I said, This <hi>is</hi> my weakness, the years of the right hand of the Most High.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: I will remember the works of the LORD; surely I will remember Your wonders of old.

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: I will also think on all Your work, and talk of Your doings.

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: Your way, O God, <hi>is</hi> in holiness; who <hi>is</hi> so great a God as our God?

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the people.

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: You have with <hi>Your</hi> arm redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: The waters saw You, O God, the waters saw You; they were afraid; the depths also were troubled.

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: The clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flew here and there.

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: The voice of Your thunder <hi>was</hi> in the sky; the lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: Your way <hi>is</hi> in the sea, and Your path in the great waters, and Your footsteps are not known.

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: An instruction of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, <hi>to</hi> my law; bow down your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will speak dark sayings of old,

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: We will not hide <hi>them</hi> from their sons, showing to the generations to come the praises of the LORD, and His strength, and His wonderful works that He has done.

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: For He set up a testimony in Jacob, and ordered a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should teach them to their sons;

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: so that the generation to come might know; sons shall be born, and they shall arise <hi>and</hi> tell their sons,

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: so that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep His commandments;

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: and might not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation <hi>that</hi> did not set their heart aright, and whose spirit was not faithful with God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: The sons of Ephraim, armed shooters of bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: They did not keep the covenant of God, and refused to walk in His law.

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: And they forgot His works and His wonders which He had shown them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, <hi>in</hi> the field of Zoan.

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; and He made the waters to stand in a heap.

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: And in the daytime He led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: He split the rocks in the wilderness, and let <hi>them</hi> drink, as <hi>from</hi> the great depths.

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
verses.text: And they sinned still more against Him, by provoking the Most High in the wilderness.

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: And they tempted God in their heart by asking food for their lust.

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: And they spoke against God; they said, Can God set a table in the wilderness?

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: Behold! He struck the rock so that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed. Can He also give bread? Can He provide flesh for His people?

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: Therefore the LORD heard, and was made furious; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel,

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: because they did not believe in God, and did not trust in His salvation;

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: though He had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens;

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: and had rained down manna on them to eat, and He gave them of the grain of the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: Man ate the food of the mighty; He sent them meat to the full.

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: He caused an east <hi>wind</hi> to blow in the sky; and by His power He brought in the south <hi>wind</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: and He also rained flesh on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea;

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: and He let <hi>them</hi> fall in the middle of their camp, all around their tents.

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: So they ate, and were filled to the full; for He gave them their own desire.

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: They were not turned away from their lust, but while their food <hi>was</hi> still in their mouths,

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: the wrath of God came on them and killed the fattest of them, and struck down the chosen of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: For all this they still sinned, and did not believe because of His wonderful works.

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: Therefore He ended their days in vanity and their years in trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: When He killed them, then they looked for Him; and they turned back and sought after God.

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: And they remembered that God <hi>was</hi> their rock, and the Most High God was their redeemer.

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: But they flattered Him with their mouths, and they lied to Him with their tongues.

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: For their heart was not right with Him, neither were they faithful in His covenant.

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: But He, full of pity, forgave their iniquity, and did not destroy <hi>them</hi>; yea, many times He turned His anger away, and did not stir up all His wrath.

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: For He remembered that they <hi>were but</hi> flesh, a wind that passes away and does not come again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the desert!

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and pained to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: They did not remember His hand, the day when He delivered them from the enemy;

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: how He had set His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: He turned their rivers into blood, and their floods, <hi>so that</hi> they could not drink.

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: He sent different kinds of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: He also gave their crops to the stripping locust, and their labor to the locust.

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with sleet.

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: He gave up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to bolts of fire.

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: He sent on them the heat of His anger, wrath and fury and trouble, by sending evil angels.

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: He made a way to His anger; He did not save their soul from death, but gave their life over to the plague,

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: and struck all the first-born in Egypt, the first of the strong in the tents of Ham;

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: and led His people forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; but the sea flooded over their enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: And He brought them within His own holy border, this mountain, <hi>which</hi> His right hand had bought.

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: He also cast out the nations before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: Yet they tempted and provoked the Most High God, and kept not His testimonies;

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: but they turned back, and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; they were turned aside like a deceiving bow.

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, and moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: When God heard, He was angry, and turned away from Israel;

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: so that He left the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent <hi>which</hi> He placed among men,

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: and delivered His strength into captivity, and His glory into the enemy's hands.

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: He also gave His people over to the sword, and was angry with His inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: The fire burned up their young men; and their maidens were not given in marriage.

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows were not able to weep.

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: Then the Lord awakened like one out of sleep, like a mighty man rejoicing with wine.

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: And He drove His enemies backward; He put them to a never-ending shame.

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: And He refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: but chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which He loved.

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: And He built His holy place like high <hi>palaces</hi>, like the earth which He has founded forever.

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: He also chose David His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: from following the ewes great with young He brought him to feed Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: And he fed them according to the pureness of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants <hi>as</hi> food for the birds of the heavens, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: They have shed their blood like water round about Jerusalem, and none to bury.

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: We have become a shame to our neighbors, a scorn and mockery to those who are around us.

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Shall Your jealousy burn like fire?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations who have not known You, and on the kingdoms who have not called on Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: For <hi>they have</hi> eaten up Jacob, and wasted his dwelling-place.

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: O do not remember against us our former sins; let Your tender mercies meet us quickly; for we are brought very low.

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; and deliver us, and atone for our sins, for Your name's sake.

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: Why should the nations say, Where <hi>is</hi> their God? Let Him be known among the nations before our eyes <hi>by</hi> the revenging of the blood of Your servants <hi>which is</hi> shed.

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; according to the greatness of Your power, leave a remnant of those who are to die,

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: and give to our neighbors their curse sevenfold into their bosom, the curse with which they have cursed You, O Lord.

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: Then we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, will give You thanks forever; we will show forth Your praise to all generations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Testimony Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You dwelling between the cherubs, shine forth.

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: Stir up Your strength before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, and come, save us.

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: Turn us again, O God, and cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your people?

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: You feed them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: You make us a strife for our neighbors; and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause Your face to shine; and we shall be saved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; You have cast out the nations and planted it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: You cleared before it, and caused it to take deep root; and it filled the land.

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: The hills were covered <hi>with</hi> its shadow, and its boughs <hi>were as</hi> the great cedars.

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: It sent out its boughs to the sea, and its branches to the river.

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: Why have You broken down its hedges, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: The boar out of the wood wastes it, and the wild beast of the field eats it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: Return, we beg You, O God of hosts; look down from Heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: and the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, and the Son <hi>that</hi> You make strong for Yourself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> burned with fire, and cut down; they perish at the rebuke of Your holy face.

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: Let Your hand be on the Man of Your right hand, on the Son of man <hi>whom</hi> You have made strong for Yourself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: So we will not go back from You; make us live, and we will call on Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: Turn us again, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: Lift up a psalm, and bring the timbrel here, the pleasing lyre and harp.

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: Blow the ram's horn in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: For this <hi>was</hi> a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: This He ordained in Joseph <hi>for</hi> a testimony, when He went out over the land of Egypt; I heard a language I understood not.

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were delivered from the pots.

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: Hear, O My people, and I will testify to you; O Israel, if you will listen to Me,

verses.name: Psalms 81:9
verses.text: there shall be no strange god in you; nor shall you worship any strange god.

verses.name: Psalms 81:10
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.name: Psalms 81:11
verses.text: But My people would not listen to My voice, and Israel would have none of Me.

verses.name: Psalms 81:12
verses.text: So I gave them up to the stubbornness of their own hearts; <hi>and</hi> they walked in their own conceits.

verses.name: Psalms 81:13
verses.text: Oh that My people had listened to Me, <hi>and</hi> Israel had walked in My ways!

verses.name: Psalms 81:14
verses.text: I would soon have humbled their enemies, and would have turned My hand against their foes.

verses.name: Psalms 81:15
verses.text: The haters of the LORD would have been found liars to Him, and their time would have lasted forever.

verses.name: Psalms 81:16
verses.text: And He would have fed them also with the finest of the wheat; and <hi>with</hi> honey out of the rock I would have satisfied you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. God stands in the congregation of God; in the midst of the gods He judges.

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: How long will you judge unjustly and lift up the faces of the wicked? Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: Defend the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and needy.

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: Deliver the poor and needy; save <hi>them</hi> out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: They neither know nor will understand; they walk on in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: I have said, You <hi>are</hi> gods; and all of you sons of the Most High.

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
verses.text: But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for You shall inherit in all nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: A Song. A Psalm of Asaph. Keep not silence, O God; do not be speechless, and be not still, O God.

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: For lo, Your enemies roar; and those who hate You have lifted up their head.

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: They take shrewd counsel against Your people, and plot against Your hidden ones.

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from <hi>being</hi> a nation, so that the name Israel may be remembered no more.

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: For with one heart they have plotted together; they have made a covenant against You--

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: the tents of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarites;

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the people of Tyre;

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
verses.text: and Assyria has joined with them; they have helped the sons of Lot. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: Do to them as <hi>to</hi> Midian, as <hi>to</hi> Sisera, as <hi>to</hi> Jabin at the torrent Kishon;

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: who perished at Endor; they became <hi>as</hi> dung for the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb; yea, all their princes like Zebah, and like Zalmunna;

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: who said, Let us take possession for ourselves of the houses of God.

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: O my God, make them like a wheel; like the stubble before the wind.

verses.name: Psalms 83:14
verses.text: As the fire burns a forest, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire,

verses.name: Psalms 83:15
verses.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and make them afraid with Your storm.

verses.name: Psalms 83:16
verses.text: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 83:17
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and troubled forever; yea, let them be put to shame, and lost;

verses.name: Psalms 83:18
verses.text: so that <hi>men</hi> may know that Your name is JEHOVAH, that You alone <hi>are</hi> the Most High over all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. On Gittith. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. How lovely <hi>are</hi> Your tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: My soul longs, yea, even faints for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh shout for joy to the living God.

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: Even the sparrow has found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself where she may lay her young, Your altars, O LORD of hosts, my king and my God.

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who dwell in Your house; they will still praise You. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man <hi>whose</hi> strength <hi>is</hi> in You; <hi>Your</hi> ways <hi>are</hi> in their hearts.

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: Passing through the valley of weeping, they will make it a fountain; the early rain also covers <hi>it with</hi> blessings.

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: They go from strength to strength, appearing in Zion before God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: Behold, O God, our shield, and look on the face of Your anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: For a day in Your courts <hi>is</hi> better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: For the LORD God <hi>is</hi> a sun and shield; the LORD will give grace and glory; no good <hi>thing</hi> will He withhold from those who walk uprightly.

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: O LORD of hosts, blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who trusts in You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O LORD, You have been gracious to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sins. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the heat of Your anger.

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause Your anger toward us to cease.

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: Will You not give us life again, so that Your people may rejoice in You?

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: Show us Your mercy, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; for He will speak peace to His people, and to His saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: Surely His salvation <hi>is</hi> near those that fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: Mercy and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed <hi>each other</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from Heaven.

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: Yea, the LORD shall give good; and our land shall yield its increase.

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: Righteousness shall go before Him and shall set <hi>us</hi> in the way of His steps.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: A Prayer of David. Bow down Your ear, O LORD, hear me; for I <hi>am</hi> poor and needy.

verses.name: Psalms 86:2
verses.text: Preserve my soul; for I <hi>am</hi> holy; O You my God, save Your servant who trusts in You.

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord; for I cry to You daily.

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: Give joy to the soul of Your servant; for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: For You, Lord, <hi>are</hi> good and ready to forgive, and rich in mercy to all those who call on You.

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my prayers.

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I will call on You; for You will answer me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:8
verses.text: Among the gods <hi>there is</hi> none like You, O Lord; non <hi>are</hi> like Your works.

verses.name: Psalms 86:9
verses.text: All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord, and shall glorify Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 86:10
verses.text: For You <hi>are</hi> great and do wonderful things; You alone <hi>are</hi> God.

verses.name: Psalms 86:11
verses.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD; I will walk in Your truth; my heart rejoices to fear Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 86:12
verses.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forevermore.

verses.name: Psalms 86:13
verses.text: For great <hi>is</hi> Your mercy toward me; and You have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.name: Psalms 86:14
verses.text: O God, the proud have risen against me, and the company of violent <hi>men</hi> have sought after my life, and have not set You before them.

verses.name: Psalms 86:15
verses.text: But You, O God, <hi>are</hi> God full of pity, and gracious, long-suffering, and rich in mercy and truth.

verses.name: Psalms 86:16
verses.text: Oh turn to me, and have mercy on me; give Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your handmaid.

verses.name: Psalms 86:17
verses.text: Show me a token for good, so that they who hate me may see and be ashamed; because You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: A Psalm for the sons of Korah, A Song. His foundation <hi>is</hi> in the holy mountains.

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: Glorious things <hi>are</hi> spoken of you, O city of God. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: I will mention Rahab and Babylon to those who know me; behold, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this <hi>man</hi> was born there.

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: And to Zion it shall be said, <hi>This</hi> man and <hi>that</hi> man was born in her; and the Highest shall establish her.

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
verses.text: The LORD shall count, in recording the peoples, <hi>that</hi> this <hi>man</hi> was born there. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: And the singers, the players of the pipe: all my springs <hi>are</hi> in You!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: A Song. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician. On Mahalath, to make humble. A Poem of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before You.

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: Let my prayer come before You; bow down Your ear to my cry.

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near the grave.

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: I am counted with those who go down to the Pit; I am like a feeble man;

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom You remember no more; and by Your hand they are cut off.

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: Your wrath lies hard on me, and You have afflicted <hi>me</hi> with all Your waves. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: You have taken my friends away from me; You have made me a hateful thing to them. <hi>I am</hi> shut up, and I cannot go out.

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: My eye mourns because of affliction; O LORD, I have called daily on You; I have stretched out my hands to You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: For will You do wonders to the dead? Shall the dead rise <hi>and</hi> praise You? Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: Shall Your loving-kindness be declared in the grave? <hi>Or</hi> Your faithfulness in ruin?

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: But to You I have cried, O LORD; and in the morning my prayer shall go before You.

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: O LORD, why do You cast off my soul? <hi>Why</hi> do You hide Your face from me?

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> afflicted and ready to die from my youth up; while I suffer Your terrors, I pine away.

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: Your fierce wrath goes over me; Your terrors have cut me off.

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: They surrounded me like waters all the day long; they have come together around me.

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: You have taken lover and friend far from me, <hi>and</hi> those who know me into darkness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: A Poem of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will make known Your faithfulness to all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up forever; You shall establish Your faithfulness in the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: I have cut a covenant with My chosen; I have sworn to David My servant,

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: Your seed will I establish forever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: And the heavens shall praise Your wonders, O LORD, Your faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: For who in the sky <hi>or</hi> can be ranked <hi>with</hi> the LORD? Who among the mighty is like the LORD?

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: God is greatly to be feared in the congregation of the saints, and to be adored by all around Him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, who <hi>is</hi> a strong LORD like You? And Your faithfulness is round about You?

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves arise, You still them.

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your strong arm.

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: The heavens <hi>are</hi> Yours, the earth also <hi>is</hi> Yours; You have founded the world and its fullness.

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: You have a mighty arm; Your hand is strong, <hi>and</hi> Your right hand is high.

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: Justice and judgment <hi>are</hi> the foundation of Your throne; mercy and truth shall go before Your face.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the people that knows the joyful sound; they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of Your face.

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: In Your name they shall rejoice all the day; and in Your righteousness they shall be lifted up.

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: For You <hi>are</hi> the glory of their strength; and in Your favor our horn shall be lifted up.

verses.name: Psalms 89:18
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> our shield; yea, our king <hi>is</hi> the Holy One of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:19
verses.text: Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, and You said, I have laid help on a mighty one; I have lifted up a chosen one out of the people.

verses.name: Psalms 89:20
verses.text: I have found David, My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:21
verses.text: My hand shall be always with him; My arm also shall make him strong.

verses.name: Psalms 89:22
verses.text: The enemy shall not use force on him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:23
verses.text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague those who hate him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:24
verses.text: But My faithfulness and My mercy <hi>shall be</hi> with him; and in My name his horn <hi>shall be</hi> lifted up.

verses.name: Psalms 89:25
verses.text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.name: Psalms 89:26
verses.text: He shall cry to Me, My Father, You <hi>are</hi> my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 89:27
verses.text: And I will make him <hi>My</hi> first-born, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 89:28
verses.text: I will keep My mercy for him forever, and My covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:29
verses.text: Also I have set his seed forever, and his throne as the days of the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 89:30
verses.text: If his children forsake My law, and do not walk in My judgments;

verses.name: Psalms 89:31
verses.text: if they profane My statutes, and do not keep My commandments;

verses.name: Psalms 89:32
verses.text: then I will visit their wickedness with the rod, and their sin with stripes.

verses.name: Psalms 89:33
verses.text: But I will not completely take My loving-kindness from him, and I will not be false in My faithfulness.

verses.name: Psalms 89:34
verses.text: I will not break My covenant, nor change the thing that has gone out of My lips.

verses.name: Psalms 89:35
verses.text: Once I have sworn by My holiness that I will not lie to David.

verses.name: Psalms 89:36
verses.text: His seed shall endure forever, and his throne as the sun before Me.

verses.name: Psalms 89:37
verses.text: It shall be established forever like the moon, and <hi>like</hi> a faithful witness in the heavens. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:38
verses.text: But You have cast off and rejected <hi>us</hi>; You have been angry with Your anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 89:39
verses.text: You have turned away from the covenant of Your servant; You have defiled his crown to the ground.

verses.name: Psalms 89:40
verses.text: You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

verses.name: Psalms 89:41
verses.text: All who pass by the way plunder him; he is a curse to his neighbors.

verses.name: Psalms 89:42
verses.text: You have set up the right hand of his enemies; You have made all <hi>his</hi> enemies rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 89:43
verses.text: You also have turned back the edge of his sword and have not made him stand in the battle.

verses.name: Psalms 89:44
verses.text: You have made his glory to cease, and have thrown his throne down to the ground.

verses.name: Psalms 89:45
verses.text: The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him <hi>with</hi> shame. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 89:46
verses.text: How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Shall Your wrath burn like fire?

verses.name: Psalms 89:47
verses.text: Remember, I pray, how short my time is; why have You made all men in vain?

verses.name: Psalms 89:48
verses.text: What man lives and never sees death? Shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 89:49
verses.text: O Lord, where <hi>are</hi> Your former loving-kindnesses <hi>which</hi> You swore to David in Your truth?

verses.name: Psalms 89:50
verses.text: Remember, Lord, the scorn of Your servants; <hi>how</hi> I bear in my bosom the insult of all the mighty people,

verses.name: Psalms 89:51
verses.text: <hi> with</hi> which Your enemies have cursed, O LORD; <hi>with</hi> which they have cursed the footsteps of Your anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 89:52
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD forevermore. Amen and Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. O LORD, You have been our dwelling-place in all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
verses.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever You had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting You <hi>are</hi> God.

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: You turn man to dust, and say, Return, sons of men.

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: For a thousand years in Your sight <hi>are</hi> as yesterday when it is past, and <hi>as</hi> a watch in the night.

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: You carry them away as with a flood; they are <hi>as</hi> a sleep; in the morning <hi>they are</hi> like grass which grows up.

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: In the morning it sprouts and shoots up; in the evening it is cut down, and dries up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: For we are burned up by Your anger, and by Your wrath we are troubled.

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret <hi>sins</hi> in the light of Your face.

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: For all our days pass away in Your wrath; we finish our years like a murmur.

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: The days of our years <hi>are</hi> threescore years and ten; and if by strength they <hi>are</hi> fourscore years, yet their pride <hi>is</hi> labor and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: Who knows the power of Your anger? And as Your fear <hi>is, so is</hi> Your wrath.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: So teach us to number our days, so that we may bring a heart of wisdom.

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: Return, O LORD! How long? And give pity to Your servants.

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: Satisfy us early with Your mercy, so that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: Make us glad according to the days of our affliction, the years <hi>in which</hi> we have seen evil.

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: Let Your work appear to Your servants, and Your glory to their sons.

verses.name: Psalms 90:17
verses.text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be on us; and establish the work of our hands on us; yea, the work of our hands, establish it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall rest <hi>under</hi> the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: I will say of the LORD, my refuge and my fortress; my God; in Him I will trust.

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: Surely He will deliver you from the fowler's trap <hi>and</hi> from the destroying plague.

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: He shall cover you with His feathers, and under His wings you shall trust. His truth <hi>shall be your</hi> shield, and buckler.

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: You shall not fear the terror by night; nor because of the arrow <hi>that</hi> flies by day;

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: <hi> nor</hi> for the plague <hi>that</hi> walks in darkness, of the destruction laying waste at noonday.

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; it shall not come near you.

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: Only with your eyes you shall look and see the reward of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: Because You, O LORD, <hi>are</hi> My refuge; <hi>if</hi> you have made the Most High Your dwelling-place,

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: no evil shall befall You, nor shall any plague come near Your dwelling.

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: For He shall give His angels charge over You, to keep You in all Your ways.

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: They shall bear You up in <hi>their</hi> hands, lest You dash your foot against a stone.

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: You shall tread on the lion and adder; the young lion and the jackal You shall trample underfoot.

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: Because He has set His love on Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set Him on high, because He has known My name.

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: He shall call on Me, and I will answer Him; I <hi>will be</hi> with Him in trouble; I will deliver Him, and honor Him.

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. <hi>It is</hi> good to give thanks to the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: to show forth Your loving-kindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness every night;

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: on the ten <hi>strings</hi>, and on the harp, with sounding music on the lyre.

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: For You, LORD, have made Me glad with Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: O LORD, how great are Your works; Your purposes are very deep.

verses.name: Psalms 92:6
verses.text: A beastly man does not know; nor does a fool understand this.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:7
verses.text: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity blossom, <hi>it is</hi> that they shall be destroyed forever;

verses.name: Psalms 92:8
verses.text: but You, LORD, are high forever.

verses.name: Psalms 92:9
verses.text: For, lo, Your enemies, O LORD; for lo, Your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.name: Psalms 92:10
verses.text: But You shall lift up my horn as the wild ox; and I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.name: Psalms 92:11
verses.text: Also my eye shall see <hi>my desire</hi> on my enemies, and my ears shall hear the wicked who rise up against me.

verses.name: Psalms 92:12
verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.name: Psalms 92:13
verses.text: Those that are planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.name: Psalms 92:14
verses.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flowering;

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: to show that the LORD <hi>is</hi> upright; <hi>He is</hi> my rock, and no unrighteousness <hi>is</hi> in Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: The LORD reigns, He is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength. He clothed Himself and the world is established; it shall not be shaken.

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: Your throne <hi>is</hi> established of old; You <hi>are</hi> from everlasting.

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voices; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: The LORD on high <hi>is</hi> mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: Your testimonies are very sure; holiness becomes Your house forever, O LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: O God of vengeance, Jehovah, God of vengeance, shine forth!

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: Lift up Yourself, Judge of the earth; give a just repayment to the proud.

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: How long <hi>shall</hi> the wicked, O LORD, how long shall the wicked exult?

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: They gush; they speak impudent things; all the workers of iniquity speak proudly.

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: They crush Your people, O LORD, and afflict Your inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: They kill the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, nor shall the God of Jacob observe <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: Understand, you beastly ones among the people; and fools, when will you be wise?

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: He who chastens the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they <hi>are</hi> vain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man whom You chasten, O LORD, to teach him out of Your law;

verses.name: Psalms 94:13
verses.text: that You may give him rest from the days of trouble, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 94:14
verses.text: For the LORD will not cast off His people, nor will He forsake His inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 94:15
verses.text: But judgment shall return to righteousness; and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.name: Psalms 94:16
verses.text: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.name: Psalms 94:17
verses.text: Unless the LORD <hi>had been</hi> my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.name: Psalms 94:18
verses.text: When I said, My foot slips; Your mercy, O LORD, held me up.

verses.name: Psalms 94:19
verses.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Your comforts delight my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 94:20
verses.text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship <hi>with</hi> You, which frames mischief by a law?

verses.name: Psalms 94:21
verses.text: They gather themselves against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.name: Psalms 94:22
verses.text: But the LORD is my defense; and my God <hi>is</hi> the rock of my refuge.

verses.name: Psalms 94:23
verses.text: And He will bring on them their own iniquity, and He will cut them off in their evil. The LORD our God shall cut them off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: Oh come, let us sing to the LORD; let us make a joyful noise to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to Him with psalms.

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: In His hand <hi>are</hi> the deep places of the earth; the strength of the hills <hi>is</hi> also His.

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: The sea <hi>is</hi> His, and He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our maker.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: For He <hi>is</hi> our God, and we <hi>are</hi> the people of His pasture, and the sheep of His hand. Today if you will hear His voice,

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: harden not your heart, as <hi>in the day</hi> of strife, as <hi>in the day</hi> of testing in the wilderness;

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: when your fathers tempted Me, tested Me, and saw My work.

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: For forty years I was grieved with <hi>this</hi> generation, and said, It <hi>is</hi> a people who go astray in their hearts, and they have not known My ways;

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: to whom I swore in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: Oh sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; show forth His salvation from day to day.

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all people.

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> great, and greatly to be praised; He <hi>is</hi> to be feared above all gods.

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: For all the gods of the nations <hi>are</hi> idols; but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: Honor and majesty <hi>are</hi> before Him; strength and beauty <hi>are</hi> in His sanctuary.

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: Give to the LORD, O families of the people; give to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: Give to the LORD the glory <hi>due to</hi> His name; bring an offering, and come into His courts.

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; fear before Him, all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: Say among the nations, the LORD reigns; and the world shall be established; it shall not be moved; He shall judge the peoples in uprightness.

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fullness of it.

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: Let the field be joyful, and all that <hi>is</hi> in it; then shall all the trees of the forest rejoice

verses.name: Psalms 96:13
verses.text: before the LORD; for He comes, for He comes to judge the earth; He shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with His truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of islands be glad.

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: Clouds and darkness <hi>are</hi> all around Him; righteousness and judgment <hi>are</hi> the foundation of His throne.

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: A fire goes before Him and burns up His enemies round about.

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: His lightnings lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the LORD of the whole earth.

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the people see His glory.

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: All those who serve graven images <hi>are</hi> ashamed, those who boast themselves in idols; all gods bow down before Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: Zion heard and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of Your judgments, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: For You, LORD, <hi>are</hi> high above all the earth; You are lifted on high far above all gods.

verses.name: Psalms 97:10
verses.text: You who love the LORD, hate evil; He keeps the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 97:11
verses.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.name: Psalms 97:12
verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, righteous ones; and give thanks at the memory of His holiness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: A Psalm. O sing to the LORD a new song; for He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have saved for Him.

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: The LORD has made known His salvation; His righteousness He has unveiled to the eyes of the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: He has remembered His mercy and His truth toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our. GOD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; breakout, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: Sing to the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: With trumpets and sound of a horn make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fullness of it; the world, and those who live in it.

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: Let the floods clap <hi>their</hi> hands; let the hills be joyful together

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: before the LORD; for He comes to judge the earth; with righteousness He shall judge the world, and the peoples in uprightness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. <hi>He</hi> sits <hi>between</hi> the cherubs; let the earth quake.

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> great in Zion; and He <hi>is</hi> high above all the peoples.

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: Let them praise Your great and fearful name; it <hi>is</hi> holy.

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: The king's strength also loved judgment; You established uprightness; You worked judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He <hi>is</hi> holy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:6
verses.text: Moses and Aaron <hi>were</hi> among His priests, and Samuel among those who called on His name; they called on the LORD, and He answered them.

verses.name: Psalms 99:7
verses.text: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; they kept His testimonies and the ordinance <hi>that</hi> He gave them.

verses.name: Psalms 99:8
verses.text: You answered them, O LORD our God; You were a God who forgave them, though You take vengeance for their deeds.

verses.name: Psalms 99:9
verses.text: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His holy hill; for the LORD our God <hi>is</hi> holy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all you lands.

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: Know that the LORD, He <hi>is</hi> God. He has made us, and not we ourselves; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, <hi>and</hi> into His courts with praise; be thankful to Him, <hi>and</hi> bless His name.

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> good; His mercy <hi>is</hi> everlasting; and His truth <hi>endures</hi> to all generations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment; to You, O LORD, I will sing praise.

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes. I have hated the work of those who turn aside; it shall not hold on to me.

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: A perverse heart will depart from me; I will not know the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: <hi> Whoever</hi> secretly slanders his neighbor, I will cut him off; him who has a high look and a proud heart, I will not allow.

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: My eyes <hi>shall be</hi> on the faithful of the land, so that they may dwell with me; he who walks in a perfect way, he shall serve Me.

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> who works falsely shall not dwell within my house; he who tells lies shall not stay in my sight.

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
verses.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land, so that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: A prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come to You.

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: Hide not Your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; bow down Your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: For my days go up like smoke, and my bones glow like a firebrand.

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: My heart is stricken, and dried like grass, so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: Because of the voice of my groaning, my bones hold fast to my skin.

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone on the house top.

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: My enemies curse me all the day; and they who are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and have mixed my drink with weeping,

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: because of Your anger and Your wrath; for You have lifted me up and cast me down.

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: My days <hi>are</hi> like a shadow stretched out; and I wither like grass.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: But You, O LORD, shall endure forever; and Your memory to all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: You shall arise, <hi>and</hi> have mercy on Zion; for the time to pity her, yea, the set time, has come.

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: For Your servants take pleasure in its stones, and pity its dust.

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: So the nations shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Your glory.

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, He shall appear in His glory.

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: He will turn to the prayer of the forsaken and not despise their prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: This shall be written for the generation to come; and the people who shall be created shall praise the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: For He has looked down from the height of His sanctuary; from Heaven the LORD beheld the earth;

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free the sons of death;

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: to declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem;

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: when the peoples and the kingdoms have gathered together to serve the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:23
verses.text: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

verses.name: Psalms 102:24
verses.text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days; Your years <hi>are</hi> through the generation of generations.

verses.name: Psalms 102:25
verses.text: Of old You have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens <hi>are</hi> the work of Your hands.

verses.name: Psalms 102:26
verses.text: They shall perish, but You shall endure; yea, all of them shall become old like a garment; like a robe You shall change them, and they shall be changed;

verses.name: Psalms 102:27
verses.text: but You <hi>are</hi> He, and Your years shall have no end.

verses.name: Psalms 102:28
verses.text: The sons of Your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: <hi> A Psalm</hi> of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; and all that is within me, <hi>bless</hi> His holy name.

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits;

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: who forgives all your iniquities; who heals all your diseases;

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: who redeems your life from ruin; who crowns you <hi>with</hi> loving-kindness and tender mercies;

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: who satisfies your mouth with good; your youth is renewed like the eagle's.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: The LORD works righteousness and judgment for all who are pressed down.

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and rich in mercy.

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: He will not always chasten, nor will He keep His <hi>anger</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: For as the heavens <hi>are</hi> high above the earth, <hi>so</hi> is His mercy toward those who fear Him.

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: As far as the east <hi>is</hi> from the west, <hi>so</hi> far has He removed our transgressions from us.

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: As a father pities his children, the LORD pities those who fear Him.

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: For He knows our form; He remembers that we <hi>are</hi> dust.

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: <hi> As for</hi> man, his days <hi>are</hi> as grass; as a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and its place shall know it no more.

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: But the mercy of the LORD <hi>is</hi> from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear Him, and His righteousness <hi>is</hi> to sons of sons;

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: to those who keep His covenant, and to those who remember to do His commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: The LORD has prepared His throne in the heavens; and His kingdom rules over all.

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O angels of His, who excel in strength, who do His command, listening to the voice of His word.

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, ministers of His who do His pleasure.

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His rule; bless the LORD, O my soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, You are very great; You have put on honor and majesty,

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: covering Yourself <hi>with</hi> light as with a robe; and stretching out the heavens like a curtain;

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: He lays the beams <hi>of</hi> His upper rooms in the waters. He sets the clouds <hi>as</hi> His chariots; He walks on the wings of the wind;

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: He makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flaming fire.

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: He laid the earth on its foundations; it shall not be shaken forever.

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: You covered the deep as with a robe; the waters stand above the mountains.

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: At Your rebuke they flee; at the voice of Your thunder they hurry away.

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys to the place which You have founded for them.

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: You have set a bound that they may not pass over, so that they do not turn again to cover the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses break their thirst.

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: By them the birds of the heavens will have their place of rest; they sing among the branches.

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> waters the hills from His upper rooms; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of man, to bring forth food out of the earth,

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: and wine cheers the heart of man, and oil makes his face shine, and bread sustains the heart of man.

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: The trees of the LORD <hi>are</hi> full, the cedars of Lebanon which He has planted;

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: where the birds make their nests; the fir trees <hi>are</hi> the house of the stork.

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: The high hills <hi>are</hi> for the wild goats, and the rocks <hi>are</hi> a refuge for the badgers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: He appointed the moon for seasons; the sun knows its going down.

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: The sun rises; they are gathered, and go to their dens to lie down.

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: O LORD, how many are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your riches.

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the great and wide sea, in which <hi>are</hi> creeping things without number, both small and great animals.

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: There the ships go; You made this great sea animal to play in it.

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: These all wait on You, that You may give them their food in due season.

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: You give to them, they gather; You open Your hand; they <hi>are</hi> filled with good.

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: You hide Your face, they <hi>are</hi> troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; and You renew the face of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: The glory of the LORD shall endure forever; the LORD shall rejoice in His works.

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: My thoughts of Him shall be sweet; I will be glad in the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: Let the sinners perish from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: O give thanks to the LORD; call on His name; make known His deeds among the people.

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; talk of all His wonderful works.

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: Glory in His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face evermore.

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

verses.name: Psalms 105:6
verses.text: seed of His servant Abraham, sons of Jacob His chosen.

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: He <hi>is</hi> the LORD our God; His judgments <hi>are</hi> in all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: He has remembered His covenant forever, the word <hi>which</hi> He commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: the covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac;

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: and He confirmed it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel <hi>for</hi> an everlasting covenant,

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: when they were <hi>a few</hi> men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: When they went from one nation to another, from a kingdom to another people,

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: He allowed no man to do them wrong; yea, He reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: <hi> saying</hi>, Touch not my anointed, and do My prophets no harm.

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: And He called for a famine on the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: He sent a man before them, Joseph, <hi>being</hi> sold for a servant;

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: whose feet they hurt with chains; he was laid in iron,

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: until the time that his word came, the word of the LORD refined him.

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
verses.text: The king sent and set him free; the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all he owned,

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: to chain his leaders at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: Israel also came <hi>into</hi> Egypt, and Jacob resided in the land of Ham.

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: And He increased His people greatly and made them stronger than their enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: He sent Moses His servant, <hi>and</hi> Aaron whom He had chosen.

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: They showed His signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they did not rebel against His word.

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: Their land swarmed with frogs in the rooms of their kings.

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: He spoke, and there came <hi>fly</hi> swarms and gnats in all their borders.

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: He gave them hail <hi>for</hi> rain <hi>and</hi> flaming fire in their land.

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: He struck their vines also and their fig trees, and broke the trees of their borders.

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> spoke, and locusts came, and larvae without number;

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: and they ate up all the plants in their land, and ate the fruit of their ground.

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: He also struck all the first-born in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: He also brought them out with silver and gold; and there <hi>was</hi> not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: Egypt was glad when they departed; for the fear of them had fallen on them.

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light <hi>in</hi> the night.

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: <hi> They</hi> asked, and He brought quail, and satisfied them <hi>with</hi> the food of heaven.

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places <hi>like</hi> a river.

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: For He remembered His holy promise <hi>and</hi> Abraham His servant.

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: And He brought forth His people with joy, and His chosen with gladness,

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: and gave them the lands of the nations; and they inherited the labor of the people,

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: so that they might take heed to His statutes and keep His laws. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD. O give thanks to the LORD; for <hi>He is</hi> good; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 106:2
verses.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or cause all His praise to be heard?

verses.name: Psalms 106:3
