verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> those who keep judgment, he who does righteousness at all times.

verses.name: Psalms 106:4
verses.text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor of Your people; O visit me with Your salvation,

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: that I may see the good of Your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, to glory with Your inheritance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: Our fathers did not understand Your wonders in Egypt; they did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, but rebelled at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: But He saved them for His name's sake, to make His mighty power known.

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; so He led them through the depths, <hi>as</hi> through the wilderness.

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: And He saved them from the hand of the hater, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: And the waters covered their enemies; there was not one of them left.

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: Then they believed His words; they sang His praise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: They hurried <hi>and</hi> forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel;

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: but they lusted greedily in the wilderness, and tested God in the desert.

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: And He gave them what they asked, but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: And they were jealous of Moses in the camp, <hi>and</hi> Aaron the saint of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped the melted image.

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: And they changed their Glory into the likeness of an ox that eats grass.

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: They forgot God their Deliverer, who had done great things in Egypt;

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: wonderful works in the land of Ham, fearful things by the Red Sea.

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
verses.text: And He said that He would destroy them, if Moses His chosen had not stood before Him in the breach, to turn away His wrath, so that He should not destroy <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: And they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His word,

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: but murmured in their tents, <hi>and</hi> did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: And He lifted up His hand to them, to overthrow them in the wilderness;

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: to overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: And they joined themselves to Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead,

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: and provoked <hi>Him</hi> to anger with their doings; and the plague broke in on them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: Then Phinehas stood and interceded, and the plague was stayed.

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: And it was counted to him for righteousness to all generations forevermore.

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: And they angered <hi>Him</hi> at the waters of strife so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: because they provoked his spirit so that he spoke rashly with his lips.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
verses.text: They did not destroy the nations <hi>as</hi> the LORD commanded them;

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: but were mixed among the nations, and learned their works.

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: And they served their idols, which were a snare to them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: and shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was defiled with blood.

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: And they were defiled with their works, and went lusting in their doings.

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: And the wrath of the LORD was kindled against His people, and He detested His inheritance.

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; and those who hated them ruled over them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: Many times He delivered them, but they rebelled in their counsel and sank in their iniquities.

verses.name: Psalms 106:44
verses.text: And He looked on their affliction when He heard their cry;

verses.name: Psalms 106:45
verses.text: and He remembered <hi>His</hi> covenant for them, and was moved to pity, according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.name: Psalms 106:46
verses.text: And He gave them to tender mercies before the face of all their captors.

verses.name: Psalms 106:47
verses.text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name <hi>and</hi> to triumph in Your praise.

verses.name: Psalms 106:48
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting; and let all the people say, Amen. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: O give thanks to the LORD, for <hi>He is</hi> good; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say <hi>so</hi>, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: and gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: They wandered in the wilderness, in a desert by the way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, and He delivered them out of their troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: And He guided them by the right way, so as to go to a city to live in.

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: Oh that men would praise the LORD <hi>for</hi> His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: For He satisfies the thirsty soul, and fills the hungry soul <hi>with</hi> good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: Those who sit in the darkness and in the shadow of death, <hi>being</hi> chained in affliction and iron;

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and despised the advice of the Most High.

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: and He humbled their heart with labor; they fell down, and none <hi>was</hi> helping.

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, <hi>and</hi> He saved them out of their troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in two.

verses.name: Psalms 107:15
verses.text: Let them praise the LORD <hi>for</hi> His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

verses.name: Psalms 107:16
verses.text: For He has broken the gates of bronze, and cut the bars of iron in two.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:17
verses.text: Fools are afflicted because of their rebellion, and because of their iniquities.

verses.name: Psalms 107:18
verses.text: Their soul hates all kinds of food; and they draw near the gates of death.

verses.name: Psalms 107:19
verses.text: Then they cry to the LORD in their distress, <hi>and</hi> He saves them out of their troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 107:20
verses.text: He sent His word and heals them, and delivers <hi>them</hi> from their pitfalls.

verses.name: Psalms 107:21
verses.text: Let them praise the LORD <hi>for</hi> His goodness, and <hi>for</hi> His wonderful works to the sons of man!

verses.name: Psalms 107:22
verses.text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare His works with rejoicing!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:23
verses.text: They who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

verses.name: Psalms 107:24
verses.text: these see the works of the LORD and His wonders in the deep.

verses.name: Psalms 107:25
verses.text: For He commands and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

verses.name: Psalms 107:26
verses.text: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again <hi>to</hi> the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 107:27
verses.text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

verses.name: Psalms 107:28
verses.text: And they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and He brings them out of their troubles.

verses.name: Psalms 107:29
verses.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

verses.name: Psalms 107:30
verses.text: And they are glad because they are quiet; so He brings them to their desired haven.

verses.name: Psalms 107:31
verses.text: Let them praise the LORD <hi>for</hi> His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

verses.name: Psalms 107:32
verses.text: And let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people, and praise Him in the gathering of the elders.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:33
verses.text: He sets rivers to a wilderness and water-springs to thirsty ground;

verses.name: Psalms 107:34
verses.text: a fruitful land to a salty desert, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

verses.name: Psalms 107:35
verses.text: He turns the wilderness into a water-ponds, and dry ground into water-springs.

verses.name: Psalms 107:36
verses.text: And He makes the hungry dwell there, so that they may prepare a city to live in;

verses.name: Psalms 107:37
verses.text: and sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.name: Psalms 107:38
verses.text: He also blesses them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not allow their cattle to become few.

verses.name: Psalms 107:39
verses.text: Again, they have become few, and humbled through harshness, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.name: Psalms 107:40
verses.text: He pours scorn on nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, <hi>where there is</hi> no path.

verses.name: Psalms 107:41
verses.text: But He raises up the poor from affliction and sets families like a flock.

verses.name: Psalms 107:42
verses.text: The upright shall see and rejoice; and all iniquity shall stop its mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 107:43
verses.text: Whoever <hi>is</hi> wise, and will observe these <hi>things</hi>, they shall understand the mercies of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: A Song, A Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and I will give praise, even <hi>with</hi> my glory.

verses.name: Psalms 108:2
verses.text: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awake early.

verses.name: Psalms 108:3
verses.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples; and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 108:4
verses.text: For Your mercy <hi>is</hi> great above the heavens; and Your truth <hi>reaches</hi> to the clouds.

verses.name: Psalms 108:5
verses.text: Be lifted up, O God, above the heavens; and Your glory above all the earth;  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: so that Your beloved may be delivered; save <hi>with</hi> Your right hand, and answer me.

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: God has spoken in His holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: Gilead <hi>is</hi> Mine; Manasseh <hi>is</hi> Mine and Ephraim <hi>is</hi> the strength <hi>of</hi> My head; Judah <hi>is</hi> My lawgiver;

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: Moab <hi>is</hi> My washpot; I will cast out My shoe over Edom; I will triumph over Philistia.

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: O God, have You not cast us off? And, O God, will You not go out with our armies?

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: Give us help from trouble; for vain <hi>is</hi> the deliverance of man.

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: Through God we shall do mighty things; for He shall trample our enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not be silent;

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me; they spoke against me <hi>with</hi> a lying tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: And they surrounded me <hi>with</hi> words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: For my love they are my foes; but I <hi>am in</hi> prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: Set a wicked man over him; and let an adversary stand at his right hand,

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: when he is judged, let him be condemned; and let his prayer become sin.

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: Let his days be few; let another take his office.

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: Let his sons always beg and be vagabonds, and seek <hi>food</hi> out of their ruins.

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: Let the money-lender lay a snare for all that <hi>is</hi> his; and let strangers take the fruit of his labor.

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: Let there be none to give mercy to him; nor <hi>any</hi> to favor his fatherless children.

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; <hi>and</hi> in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: Let them be always before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth,

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: because he did not remember to do mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, and sought to kill the broken-hearted.

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: Yea, he loved cursing, so let it come to him; he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: As he clothed himself with cursing, as with his robe, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: Let it be to him as the robe <hi>which</hi> covers him, and for a girdle with which he is always clothed.

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the reward of my foes from the LORD, and <hi>of</hi> them who speak evil against my soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: But You, Lord Jehovah, deal kindly with me for Your name's sake; because Your mercy <hi>is</hi> good, deliver me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: For I <hi>am</hi> poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: As a shadow when it is stretched out, I am gone; I am shaken off like the locust.

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: My knees stumble from fasting; and my flesh is losing its fatness.

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: And I became a shame to them; they looked on me; they shook their heads.

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your mercy;

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: and they will know that this <hi>is</hi> Your hand; that You, LORD, have done it.

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: They will curse, but You will bless; they arise, and are ashamed; but let Your servant rejoice.

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: Let my foes be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own shame, as with a cloak.

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise Him among the multitude.

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save <hi>him</hi> from those who condemn his soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as Your footstool.

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: The LORD shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion; rule in the midst of Your enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: Your people <hi>shall be</hi> willing in the day of Your power, in holy adornment from the womb of the morning: You <hi>have</hi> the dew of Your youth.

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: The LORD has sworn, and will not repent, You <hi>are</hi> a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: The Lord at Your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of His wrath.

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill them with dead bodies; He shall shatter heads over much of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore He shall lift up the head.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! I will praise the LORD with all <hi>my</hi> heart, in the council of the upright, and of the congregation.

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: The works of the LORD <hi>are</hi> great, sought out by all those who have pleasure in them.

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: His work <hi>is</hi> honorable and glorious; and His righteousness <hi>is</hi> standing forever.

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: He has made His wonderful works to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and full of pity.

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will always be mindful of His covenant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: He has shown His people the power of His works, to give to them the inheritance of the nations.

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: The works of His hands <hi>are</hi> truth and judgment; all His commands <hi>are</hi> true,

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: standing fast forever and ever; <hi>they are</hi> done in truth and uprightness.

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: He sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: The fear of the LORD <hi>is</hi> the beginning of wisdom; all practicing them <hi>have</hi> good understanding; His praise stands forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in His commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: His seed shall be mighty on earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: Wealth and riches <hi>shall be</hi> in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: To the upright there arises light in the darkness; <hi>he is</hi> gracious and full of pity and righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: A good man shows favor, and lends; he will guide his business with fairness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: Surely he shall not be moved forever; the righteous shall be remembered forever.

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: He shall not be afraid of bad news; his heart <hi>is</hi> fixed, trusting in the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: His heart <hi>is</hi> sure; he shall not be afraid <hi>though</hi> he sees his oppressors.

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: He has scattered abroad; he has given to the poor; his righteousness <hi>endures</hi> forever; his horn shall be lifted up with honor.

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: The wicked shall see and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise, O servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the name of the LORD from this time forth and forevermore.

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD's name <hi>is</hi> to be praised.

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> high above all nations, and His glory above the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> like the LORD our God, who dwells on high,

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: who humbles <hi>Himself</hi> to behold <hi>the</hi> <hi>things</hi> in the heavens and in the earth!

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust, <hi>and</hi> lifts the needy out of the dunghill,

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: in order to make him sit with nobles, with the nobles of his people.

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: He causes the barren to dwell in the house <hi>as</hi> a joyful mother of sons. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: Judah was His sanctuary, <hi>and</hi> Israel was His kingdom.

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: The sea saw <hi>it</hi> and fled; Jordan was driven back.

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, <hi>and</hi> the little hills like lambs.

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: What <hi>ailed</hi> you, O sea, <hi>that</hi> you fled? O Jordan, that you turned back,

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: O mountains <hi>that</hi> skipped like rams, O little hills like lambs?

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: Earth, tremble at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: who turned the rock <hi>into</hi> a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for Your mercy <hi>and</hi> for Your truth's sake.

verses.name: Psalms 115:2
verses.text: Why should the nations say, Where now <hi>is</hi> their God?

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: But our God <hi>is</hi> in Heaven; He has done whatever He has pleased.

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: Their idols <hi>are</hi> silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: They <hi>have</hi> mouths, but they do not speak; they <hi>have</hi> eyes, but they do not see;

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: they <hi>have</hi> ears, but they do not hear; they <hi>have</hi> noses, but they do not smell;

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: they have hands, but they do not handle; they have feet, but they do not walk; they do not mutter through their throat.

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: The ones who make them are like them, <hi>and</hi> everyone who trusts in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD; He <hi>is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He <hi>is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:11
verses.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He <hi>is</hi> their help and their shield.

verses.name: Psalms 115:12
verses.text: The LORD has been mindful of us; He will bless <hi>us</hi>; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.name: Psalms 115:13
verses.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, <hi>both</hi> small and great.

verses.name: Psalms 115:14
verses.text: The LORD shall add on to you, even on you and on your sons.

verses.name: Psalms 115:15
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> blessed of the LORD who made the heavens and the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 115:16
verses.text: The heavens, <hi>even</hi> the heavens, <hi>are</hi> the LORD's; but the earth He has given to the sons of men.

verses.name: Psalms 115:17
verses.text: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.

verses.name: Psalms 115:18
verses.text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: I love the LORD because He hears my voice <hi>and</hi> my prayers.

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: Because He has bowed down His ear to me, therefore I will call on <hi>Him</hi> in my days.

verses.name: Psalms 116:3
verses.text: The sorrows of death hemmed me in, and the pains of hell took hold on me; I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.name: Psalms 116:4
verses.text: Then I called on the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech You, deliver my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 116:5
verses.text: Gracious <hi>is</hi> the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God <hi>is</hi> merciful.

verses.name: Psalms 116:6
verses.text: The LORD keeps the simple; I was brought low, and He helped me.

verses.name: Psalms 116:7
verses.text: Return to your rest, O my soul; for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

verses.name: Psalms 116:8
verses.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

verses.name: Psalms 116:9
verses.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:10
verses.text: I believed, therefore I have spoken; I was greatly afflicted;

verses.name: Psalms 116:11
verses.text: I said in my haste, All men <hi>are</hi> liars.

verses.name: Psalms 116:12
verses.text: What shall I give to the LORD <hi>for</hi> all His benefits toward me?

verses.name: Psalms 116:13
verses.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 116:14
verses.text: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all His people.

verses.name: Psalms 116:15
verses.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD <hi>is</hi> the death of His saints.

verses.name: Psalms 116:16
verses.text: O LORD, truly I <hi>am</hi> Your servant; I <hi>am</hi> Your servant, and the son of Your handmaid; You have loosed my bonds.

verses.name: Psalms 116:17
verses.text: I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 116:18
verses.text: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all His people,

verses.name: Psalms 116:19
verses.text: in the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: O praise the LORD, all nations; praise Him, all peoples.

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: For His merciful kindness is great toward us; and the truth of the LORD <hi>endures</hi> forever. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: O give thanks to the LORD; for <hi>He is</hi> good; because His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: Let Israel now say that His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now say that His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: Let those who fear the LORD now say that His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: I called on the LORD in distress; the LORD answered me, and <hi>set me</hi> in a large place.

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> for me, I will not fear; what can man do to me?

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> for me among those who help me; and I will see <hi>my desire</hi> on those who hate me.

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> better to trust in the LORD than to trust in man.

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> better to trust in the LORD than to trust in princes.

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: All the nations surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: They surround me; yea, they surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: They surround me like bees; they are put out like the fire of thorns; for in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: You have thrust hard at me so that I might fall; but the LORD helped me.

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> my strength and song, and He is my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation <hi>is</hi> in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: The right hand of the LORD is lifted up; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: The LORD has sorely chastened me; but He has not given me over to death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go into them, <hi>and</hi> I will praise the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the gate of the LORD into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: I will praise You; for You have heard me, and are my salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: The Stone <hi>which</hi> the builders refused has become the Head of the corner.

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: This is from the LORD; it <hi>is</hi> marvelous in our eyes.

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the day <hi>which</hi> the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: Save now, I beseech You, O LORD; O LORD, I beseech You, cause <hi>us</hi> to prosper now.

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> He coming in the name of the LORD; we have blessed You out of the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: God <hi>is</hi> the LORD, who gives light to us. Tie the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> my God, and I will exalt You; You <hi>are</hi> my God, I will praise You.

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: Oh give thanks to the LORD; for <hi>He is</hi> good; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: ALEPH. Blessed <hi>are</hi> the upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who keep His testimonies, and who seek Him with all the heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: They also do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: You have commanded <hi>us</hi> to keep Your commandments carefully.

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: O that my ways were fixed to keep Your statutes!

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: Then I shall not be ashamed, when I have respect to all Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: I will praise You with uprightness of heart when I have learned Your righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me completely.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: BETH. With what shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me wander from Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart, so that I might not sin against You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Your mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, <hi>as much as</hi> in all riches.

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: I will think on Your commandments and have respect to Your ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Your servant, <hi>that</hi> I may live and keep Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: Open my eyes, so that I may behold wonderful things out of Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> a stranger in the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: My soul breaks for the longing that it has to Your judgments at all times.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: You have rebuked the proud <hi>who are</hi> cursed, who go astray from Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: Remove cursing and scorn from me; for I have kept Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: Princes also sat and spoke against me; <hi>but</hi> Your servant thought on Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: Your testimonies also <hi>are</hi> my delight <hi>and</hi> my advisers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: DALETH. My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: I have declared my ways, and You hear me; teach me Your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: Make me to understand the way of Your commandments, and I will speak of Your wonderful works.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: My soul weeps <hi>for</hi> grief; strengthen me according to Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: Remove from me the way of lying; and grant me Your law graciously.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: I have chosen the way of truth; I have laid Your judgments <hi>before me</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: I have stuck to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame.

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: I will run the way of Your commandments, when You shall enlarge my heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: HE. O LORD, teach me the way of Your statutes, and I shall keep it <hi>to</hi> the end.

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; yea, I shall observe it with all <hi>my</hi> heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: Cause me to walk in the path of Your commandments; for I delight in them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: Bow my heart to Your testimonies, and not to unjust gain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in Your way give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: Make Your word sure to Your servant, who <hi>is devoted</hi> to Your fear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: Turn away my shame which I fear; for Your judgments <hi>are</hi> good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: Behold, I have longed after Your commandments; in Your righteousness give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: VAU. Let Your mercies come to me, O LORD, even according to Your salvation, according to Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: And I shall have something to answer him who mocks me; for I trust in Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in Your judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: And I shall keep Your law continually forever and ever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: And I will always walk in a broad place; for I seek Your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, which I have loved.

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: And I will lift up my hands to Your commandments which I have loved; and I will think on Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: ZAYIN. Remember the word to Your servant, on which You have caused me to hope.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> my comfort in my affliction; for Your word has given me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: The proud have utterly scorned me; yet I have not turned aside from Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: I remembered Your judgments of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: Horror has taken hold on me because of the wicked who forsake Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: I have remembered Your name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept Your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: This was done to me, because I kept Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: CHETH. <hi>You are</hi> my portion, O LORD; I have said that I would keep Your words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: I looked for Your favor with all <hi>my</hi> heart; be merciful to me according to Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to Your testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: I made haste and did not delay to keep Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me; <hi>but</hi> I have not forgotten Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You because of Your righteous judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> a companion of all who fear You, and of those who keep Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: O LORD, the earth is full of Your mercy; teach me Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: TETH. You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; for I have believed Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray; but now I have kept Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> good, and do good; teach me Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: The proud have forged a lie against me; I will keep Your commandments with all <hi>my</hi> heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: Their heart is without feeling, like fat; <hi>but</hi> I delight in Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> good for me that I have been afflicted, so that I might learn Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: The law of Your mouth <hi>is</hi> better to me than thousands of gold and silver.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: JOD. Your hands have made me and formed me; give me understanding so that I may learn Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: They who fear You will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments <hi>are</hi> right, and that You have afflicted me in faithfulness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: I beseech You, let Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to Your word to Your servant.

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: Let Your tender mercies come to me so that I may live; for Your law <hi>is</hi> my delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they perverted my cause with lying; I will think on Your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: Let those who fear You turn to me, and those who have known Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: Let my heart be sound in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: KAPH. My soul faints for Your salvation; I hope in Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: My eyes fail for Your word, saying, When will You comfort me?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: For I am like a wineskin in the smoke; I do not forget Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: How many <hi>are</hi> the days of Your servant? When will You carry out judgment on my persecutors?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: The proud have dug pits for me, which <hi>are</hi> not according to Your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: All Your commandments <hi>are</hi> faithful; they persecute me <hi>with</hi> lying; help me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: They had almost finished me on earth; but I did not forsake Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: According to Your loving-kindness give me life; so shall I keep the testimony of Your mouth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: LAMED. Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: Your faithfulness <hi>is</hi> to all generations; You have founded the earth, and it remains.

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: They stand to this day according to Your ordinances; for all <hi>are</hi> Your servants.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: Unless Your law <hi>had been</hi> my delight, I should then have perished in my affliction.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: I will never forget Your commandments; for with them You have given me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> Yours, save me; for I have sought Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; <hi>but</hi> I will think on Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: I have seen an end to all perfection; Your commandment <hi>is</hi> exceedingly broad.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: MEM. Oh how I love Your law! It <hi>is</hi> my meditation all the day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: Through Your commandments You make me wiser than my enemies, for they <hi>are</hi> ever with me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for Your testimonies <hi>are</hi> my prayer.

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: I understand more than the old men, because I keep Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: I have not departed from Your judgments; for You have taught me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste! More than honey to my mouth!

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: Through Your commandments I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: NUN. Your word <hi>is</hi> a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: I have sworn, and I raised <hi>it</hi>, that I will keep Your righteous judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: I am afflicted very much; O LORD, give me life according to Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: I pray You, take the free-will offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: My life <hi>is</hi> in my hand daily; yet I do not forget Your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet I do not go astray from Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: I have taken Your testimonies as an inheritance forever; for they <hi>are</hi> the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: I have bowed down my heart to do Your statutes always to the end.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: SAMECH. I hate half-hearted <hi>thoughts</hi>; but Your law do I love.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> my hiding-place and my shield; I hope in Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: Depart from me, you evil-doers, for I will keep the commandments of my God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: Hold me up, and I shall be safe; and I will always have respect to Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: You have trampled all those who go astray from Your statutes; for their deceit <hi>is</hi> falsehood.

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: You put away all the wicked of the earth <hi>like</hi> waste; therefore I love Your testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: My flesh trembles in fear of You; and I am afraid of Your judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: AYIN. I have done the just and right <hi>thing</hi>; leave me not to those who crush me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: Be surety for Your servant for good; let not the proud press me down.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: My eyes fail for Your salvation, and for the word of Your righteousness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, and teach me Your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> time for the LORD to work; for they have broken Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: Therefore I love Your commandments above gold; yea, even fine gold.

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: Therefore I count all <hi>Your</hi> commandments concerning all things to be right; I hate every false way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: PE. Your testimonies <hi>are</hi> wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: The entrance of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: I opened my mouth and panted; for I longed for Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: Look on me, and be merciful to me, as You usually do to those who love Your name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: Order my steps in Your word; and do not let any iniquity rule over me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; and teach me Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: Rivers of water run down my eyes, because they do not keep Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: TZADDI. You are righteous, O LORD, and Your judgments <hi>are</hi> right.

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: In Your testimonies You have commanded righteousness and faithfulness exceedingly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: My zeal has eaten me up, because my enemies have forgotten Your words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: Your word <hi>is</hi> very pure; therefore Your servant loves it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> small and despised; <hi>yet</hi> I do not forget Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: Your righteousness <hi>is</hi> an everlasting righteousness, and Your law <hi>is</hi> the truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; <hi>yet</hi> Your commandments <hi>are</hi> my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: The righteousness of Your testimonies <hi>is</hi> everlasting; give me understanding, and I shall live.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: QOPH. I cried with <hi>my</hi> whole heart; hear me, O LORD; I will keep Your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: I cried to You; save me, and I shall keep Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: I went before the dawning of the morning and cried; I hoped in Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: My eyes go before the <hi>night</hi> watches, so that I might think on Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: Hear my voice according to Your loving-kindness; O LORD, according to Your judgment give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: They draw near, those who follow after wickedness; they are far from Your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> near, O LORD, and all Your commandments <hi>are</hi> truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: RESH. Look on my affliction, and deliver me; for I do not forget Your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: Plead my cause, and deliver me; according to Your word give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: Salvation <hi>is</hi> far from the wicked, for they do not seek Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: Great <hi>are</hi> Your tender mercies, O LORD; according to Your judgments give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: Many <hi>are</hi> my persecutors and my enemies, yet I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: I saw the traitors, and was grieved because they did not keep Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: See how I love Your commandments; O LORD, according to Your loving-kindness give me life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: Your word <hi>is</hi> true from the beginning; and every one of Your righteous judgments <hi>endures</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in fear of Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: I rejoice at Your word, as one who finds great spoil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: I hate and despise lying; <hi>but</hi> I love Your law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: I praise You seven <hi>times</hi> a day because of Your righteous judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: Great peace <hi>is to</hi> those who love Your law, and <hi>there is</hi> no stumbling block for them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: LORD, I have hoped for Your salvation, and have done Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: My soul has kept Your testimonies; and I love them very much.

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies; for all my ways <hi>are</hi> before You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: TAU. Let my cry come near to You, O LORD; give me wisdom according to Your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: Let my prayer come before You; deliver me according to Your word.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: My lips shall utter praise, when You have taught me Your statutes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: My tongue shall speak Your word, for all Your commandments <hi>are</hi> righteousness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: Let Your hand help me; for I have chosen Your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: I have longed for Your salvation, O LORD; and Your law <hi>is</hi> my delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and let Your judgments help me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Your servant; for I do not forget Your commandments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. In my trouble I cried to the LORD, and He heard me.

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: What shall be given to you? Or what shall be done to you, O false tongue?

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of broom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: Woe is me, that I live in Mesech; I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: My soul has long dwelt with a hater of peace.

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> for peace; but when I speak, they <hi>are</hi> for war.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where shall my help come from?

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: My help <hi>comes</hi> from the LORD, who made Heaven and earth.

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: He will not allow your foot to be moved; He who keeps you will not slumber.

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: Behold, He who keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> your keeper; the LORD <hi>is</hi> your shade on your right hand.

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: The LORD shall keep you from all evil; He shall keep your soul.

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: The LORD shall keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth, and even forevermore.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees; of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: Jerusalem is built like a city that <hi>is</hi> all joined together as one;

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to the testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: For there were set the thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; those who love you shall be blessed.

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: Peace <hi>be</hi> within your walls, blessings within your palaces.

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: For my brothers and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace <hi>be</hi> within you.

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. To You I lift up my eyes, O Dweller in Heaven.

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants <hi>look</hi> to the hand of their masters; as the eyes of a maiden to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait on the LORD our God, until He shall have mercy on us.

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us; for we are exceedingly filled with scorn.

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled <hi>with</hi> the contempt of those who are at ease, with the scorn of the proud.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees; of David. Except that <hi>it was</hi> the LORD who was for us, O may Israel say;

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: Except that <hi>it was</hi> the LORD who was for us when men rose up against us,

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: then the waters would have flowed over us, the stream would have gone over our soul;

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD, who has not given us <hi>as</hi> a prey to their teeth.

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: Our help <hi>is</hi> in the name of the LORD, who made the heavens and earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. They who trust in the LORD <hi>shall be</hi> like Mount Zion; it is not shaken, but remains forever.

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: As the mountains <hi>are</hi> all around Jerusalem, so the LORD <hi>is</hi> all around His people from this time and forever.

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest on the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to iniquity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: Do good, O LORD, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts.

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: And those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity; peace <hi>shall be</hi> on Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like those who dream.

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue <hi>with</hi> singing; then they said among the nations, The LORD has done great <hi>things</hi> with them.

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: Great things <hi>did</hi> the LORD to work with us <hi>and</hi> we are glad.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
verses.text: <hi> He who</hi> goes forth and weeps, bearing <hi>precious</hi> seed, shall <hi>doubtless</hi> come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves <hi>with him</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they labor in vain who build it; unless the LORD keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows; <hi>for</hi> so He gives His beloved sleep.

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: Lo, children <hi>are</hi> the inheritance of the LORD; the fruit of the womb <hi>is</hi> a reward.

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so <hi>are</hi> the sons of the young.

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who has his quiver full of them; they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Blessed <hi>is</hi> everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in His ways.

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: For you shall surely eat the labor of your hands; you <hi>shall be</hi> happy, and all <hi>is</hi> well with you.

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: Your wife <hi>shall be</hi> like a fruitful vine by the sides of your house; your sons <hi>shall be</hi> like olive plants around your table.

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: Behold! So shall the man be blessed who fears the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: The LORD shall bless you out of Zion; and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: Yea, you shall see the sons of your sons. Peace <hi>be</hi> on Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth, Israel may now say;

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: many times they have afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed over me.

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: The plowers plowed on my back; they made their furrows long.

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> righteous; He cuts off the cords of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: Let them all be ashamed and turned back, those who hate Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: Let them be like the grass <hi>on</hi> the housetops, which dries up before it grows up,

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: with which the reaper does not fill his hand, nor the binder of sheaves his bosom.

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: And those who pass by have never said, The blessing of the LORD <hi>be</hi> on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: Lord, hear my voice, and let Your ears listen to the voice of My prayers.

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: If You will keep <hi>in mind</hi> iniquities, O Jehovah, who shall stand, O Lord?

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: But <hi>there is</hi> forgiveness with You, that You may be feared.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
verses.text: I wait <hi>for</hi> the LORD, my soul waits, and in His word I hope.

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: My soul <hi>waits</hi> for the LORD more than morning-watchers who are watching for the morning.

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD; for with the LORD <hi>there is</hi> mercy, and with Him <hi>is</hi> plentiful redemption.

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: And He shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees; of David. O LORD, my heart is not proud, nor my eyes lofty; nor have I walked in great things, nor in things too wondrous for me.

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: Surely I have behaved and have quieted my soul, as one weaned by its mother; my soul on me <hi>is</hi> like one weaned.

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from this moment and forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. O LORD, remember David <hi>and</hi> all his afflictions,

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: how he swore to the LORD; he vowed to the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, <hi>nor</hi> slumber to my eyelids,

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah; we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: We will go into His dwellings; we will worship at His footstool.

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: Arise, O LORD, into Your rest; You, and the ark of Your strength.

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: For Your servant David's sake, turn not away the face of Your anointed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: The LORD has sworn to David <hi>in</hi> truth; He will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body I will set on the throne for you.

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: If your sons will keep My covenant and My testimonies which I shall teach them, their sons shall also sit on your throne forever.

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: The LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired <hi>it</hi> for His dwelling-place.

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> My rest forever; here I will dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: I will greatly bless her food; I will satisfy her poor <hi>with</hi> bread.

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: I also will clothe her priests <hi>with</hi> salvation; and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: There I will make the horn of David to bud; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: I will clothe his enemies <hi>with</hi> shame; but his crown shall shine on him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant <hi>it is</hi> for brothers to dwell together in unity!

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> like the precious ointment on the head that ran down on the beard, Aaron's beard, that went down to the mouth of his garments;

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: like the dew of Hermon that came down on the mountains of Zion; for there the LORD commanded the blessing, life forevermore.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless the LORD, all servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: Lift up your hands <hi>in</hi> the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: <hi> May</hi> the LORD, who made the heavens and earth, bless you out of Zion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; praise Him, servants of the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: <hi> Those</hi> who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: praise the LORD; for the LORD <hi>is</hi> good; sing praises to His name, for <hi>it is</hi> full of delight.

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to Himself, <hi>and</hi> Israel for His peculiar treasure.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: For I know that the LORD <hi>is</hi> great, and our LORD <hi>is</hi> above all gods.

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: Every thing the LORD pleased, He did in the heavens and in earth, and in the seas and all deep places.

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: He causes the vapors to rise from the end of the earth; He makes lightnings for the rain; He brings wind out of His storehouses.

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> who struck the first-born of Egypt, both of man and animal;

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <hi> who</hi> sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all his servants;

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: who struck great nations and killed mighty kings,

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: and gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: Your name, O LORD, <hi>endures</hi> forever, and Your memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: For the LORD will judge His people, and He will have pity on His servants.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: The idols of the nations <hi>are</hi> silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: They <hi>have</hi> mouths, but they do not speak; they <hi>have</hi> eyes, but they do not see;

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: they <hi>have</hi> ears, but they do not hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: Those who make them are like them, everyone who trusts in them.

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; bless the LORD, O house of Aaron;

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: bless the LORD, O house of Levi; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD out of Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: Oh give thanks to the LORD; for <hi>He is</hi> good; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: Oh give thanks to the God of gods; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: Oh give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: To Him who alone does great wonders; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: To Him who by wisdom made the heavens; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: To Him who stretched out the earth above the waters; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: To Him who made great lights; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: The sun to rule by day; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: the moon and stars to rule by night; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: To Him who struck Egypt in their first-born; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: and brought Israel out from among them, for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: with a strong hand, and a stretched out arm; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: To Him who divided the Red Sea into parts; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
