verses.text: but threw Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: To Him who led His people through the wilderness; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: To Him who struck great kings; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: and killed famous kings; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever:

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: and Og the king of Bashan; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: and gave their land for an inheritance; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: an inheritance to Israel His servant; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: Who remembered us in our low estate; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever;

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: and has redeemed us from our enemies; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: Who gives food to all flesh; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: Oh give thanks to the God of Heaven; for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: There we sat down by the rivers of Babylon; also, we wept when we remembered Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: We hung our lyres on the willows in its midst.

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: For there our captors demanded a song from us; and our plunderers <hi>demanded</hi> gladness, <hi>saying</hi>, Sing us <hi>one</hi> of the songs of Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a foreign land?

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget.

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth; if I do not prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Make <hi>it</hi> bare! Make <hi>it</hi> bare, even to the foundation of <hi>it</hi>!

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one! Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who will repay to <hi>you</hi> your reward which you rewarded to us.

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who seizes and dashes your little ones against the stones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. I will praise You with my whole heart; before the gods I will sing praise to You.

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: I will worship toward Your holy temple, and praise Your name for Your loving-kindness and for Your truth's sake; for You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: In the day when I cried You answered me <hi>and</hi> made me bold <hi>with</hi> strength in my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD; for great <hi>is</hi> the glory of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: Though the LORD <hi>is</hi> high, yet He has respect to the lowly; but the proud He knows afar off.

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You will give me life; You shall stretch forth Your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Your right hand shall save me.

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: The LORD will perfect <hi>His work</hi> in me; Your mercy, O LORD, <hi>endures</hi> forever; do not forsake the work of Your own hands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and have known <hi>me</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thought afar off.

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: You search my path and my lying down, and are acquainted <hi>with</hi> all my ways.

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: For <hi>there is</hi> not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, You know it altogether.

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: You have closed me in behind and in front, and laid Your hand on me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: Such knowledge <hi>is</hi> too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot go up to it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: Where shall I go from Your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from Your presence?

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: If I go up into Heaven, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, You <hi>are there</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <hi> If</hi> I take the wings of the morning <hi>and</hi> dwell in the furthest parts of the sea;

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: even there shall Your hand lead me, and Your right hand shall hold me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me, even the night <hi>shall be</hi> light around me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: Yea, the darkness does not hide from You; but the night shines as the day; as <hi>is</hi> the darkness, so is the light to You.

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: For You have possessed my inward parts; You have covered me in my mother's womb.

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: I will praise You; for I am fearfully <hi>and</hi> wonderfully made; Your works <hi>are</hi> marvelous and my soul knows <hi>it</hi> very well.

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: My bones were not hidden from You when I was made in secret <hi>and</hi> skillfully formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: Your eyes saw my embryo; and in Your book all <hi>my members</hi> were written, the days they were formed, and not one <hi>was</hi> among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: <hi> If</hi> I should count them, they are more than the sand; when I awake, I am still with You.

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: Surely You will slay the wicked, O God; and bloody men, depart from me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: Who will speak against You maliciously? Your enemies are lifted up with vanity.

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: O LORD, do I not hate those who hate You? And am I <hi>not</hi> grieved with those who rise up against You?

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: I hate them <hi>with</hi> perfect hatred; I count them my enemies.

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; try me, and know my thoughts,

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: and see if <hi>any</hi> wicked way <hi>is</hi> in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: To the Chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; keep me from the violent man,

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: who devised evil things in the heart; they are always gathered for war.

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison <hi>is</hi> under their lips. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: O LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked; keep me from the violent man who purposed to trip up my steps.

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: The proud have hidden cords and a trap for me; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set snares for me. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: I said to the LORD, You <hi>are</hi> my God; O LORD, hear the voice of my prayers.

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: O Lord Jehovah, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: O LORD, do not grant the desires of the wicked; do not help his wicked plans, <hi>lest</hi> they praise themselves. Selah.

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: <hi> As for</hi> the head of those around me, let the evil of their own lips cover them.

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: Let burning coals fall on them; let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, so that they do not rise up again.

verses.name: Psalms 140:11
verses.text: Do not let an evil speaker be established in the earth; evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow <hi>him</hi>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:12
verses.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted <hi>and</hi> the right of the poor.

verses.name: Psalms 140:13
verses.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name; the upright shall dwell in Your presence.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, I cry to You; make haste to me, give ear to my voice when I cry to You.

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: Let my prayer be set forth before You <hi>as</hi> incense, <hi>and</hi> the lifting up of my hands <hi>as</hi> the evening sacrifice.

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: Let not my heart turn aside to <hi>any</hi> evil thing, to practice wicked works with men who work iniquity; and let me not eat of their delicacies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: Let the righteous strike me; <hi>it shall be</hi> a kindness; and let him correct me, <hi>it is</hi> oil on my head, let not my head refuse <hi>it</hi>; for still my prayer also <hi>shall be</hi> against their wickedness.

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cuts and splits <hi>wood</hi> on the earth.

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: But my eyes <hi>are</hi> on You, O Lord Jehovah; in You I take refuge, do not leave my soul naked.

verses.name: Psalms 141:9
verses.text: Keep me from the traps which they have laid for me, and the snares of the workers of evil.

verses.name: Psalms 141:10
verses.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I escape.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: An Instruction of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried to the LORD <hi>with</hi> my voice; with my voice I prayed to the LORD.

verses.name: Psalms 142:2
verses.text: I poured out my prayer before Him; I declared my trouble before Him.

verses.name: Psalms 142:3
verses.text: When my spirit fainted within me, then You knew my path. In the way <hi>in</hi> which I walked they have secretly laid a snare for me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:4
verses.text: I looked on <hi>my</hi> right hand, and I watched, but no one recognized me; escape was lost to me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 142:5
verses.text: I cried to You, O LORD; I said, You <hi>are</hi> my refuge <hi>and</hi> my portion in the land of the living.

verses.name: Psalms 142:6
verses.text: Hear my cry; for I am brought very low; deliver me from my pursuers; for they are stronger than I.

verses.name: Psalms 142:7
verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison that I may praise Your name; the righteous shall gather around me; for You shall reward me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer O LORD; give ear to my supplications; in Your faithfulness <hi>and</hi> in Your righteousness answer me.

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for in Your sight no one living is just.

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has beaten my life down to the ground; he has made me dwell in darkness, as those long dead.

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: And my spirit has fainted within me; my heart has become weary within me.

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: I remember the days of old; I think on all Your works; I muse on the work of Your hands.

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: I stretch forth my hands to You; my soul <hi>thirsts</hi> after You like a thirsty land. Selah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: Hear me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails; do not hide Your face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the Pit.

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: Cause me to hear Your loving-kindness in the morning, for I do trust in You; cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to You.

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies; I flee to You to hide me.

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: Teach me to do Your will; for You <hi>are</hi> my God; Your Spirit <hi>is</hi> good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: O LORD, for Your name's sake enliven me; for Your righteousness' sake, bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: And out of Your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul; for I <hi>am</hi> Your servant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: A Psalm of David. Blessed <hi>is</hi> the LORD my Rock, who teaches My hands for war, my fingers for battle.

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: <hi> He is</hi> my goodness and my fortress; my high tower and my deliverer; my shield and <hi>He</hi> in whom I trust; who humbles my people under me.

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: O LORD, what <hi>is</hi> man that You take knowledge of him! Or the son of man, that You esteem him?

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: Man <hi>is</hi> like vanity; his days <hi>are</hi> like a shadow that passes away.

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: Bow down Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: Cast forth lightning and scatter them; shoot out Your arrows and destroy them.

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: Send Your hand from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of a foreigner's sons;

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: because their mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of lies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: I will sing a new song to You, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to You.

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> You who gives salvation to kings; who delivers David His servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of foreigners' sons, because their mouth has spoken vanity, and their right <hi>hand is</hi> a right hand of falsehood;

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: so that our sons <hi>may be</hi> like plants grown up in their youth; and our daughters <hi>may be</hi> like corner-stones, polished like a palace building;

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
verses.text: and our storehouses <hi>may be</hi> full, furnishing kind to kind; and our flocks may breed thousands and ten thousands outside;

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: and our oxen <hi>may be</hi> loaded; <hi>there is</hi> no break in nor going out and no crying in our streets.

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the peoples who are so; blessed <hi>are</hi> the peoples <hi>to</hi> whom Jehovah <hi>is</hi> his God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: Praise. Of David. I will lift You up, my God, O King; and I will bless Your name forever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: Every day I will bless You; and I will praise Your name forever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: Great <hi>is</hi> the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and <hi>there is</hi> no searching out His greatness.

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: One generation shall praise Your works to another, and shall declare Your mighty acts.

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: I will speak of the glorious honor of Your majesty, and of Your wonderful works.

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: And <hi>men</hi> shall speak of the might of Your awesome works; and I will declare Your greatness.

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: They shall pour forth the memory of Your great goodness, and shall sing of Your righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> gracious and full of pity; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> good to all; and His tender mercies <hi>are</hi> over all His works.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: All Your works shall praise You, O LORD; and Your saints shall bless You.

verses.name: Psalms 145:11
verses.text: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom and talk of Your power,

verses.name: Psalms 145:12
verses.text: to make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of His kingdom.

verses.name: Psalms 145:13
verses.text: Your kingdom <hi>is</hi> an everlasting kingdom, and Your rule <hi>endures</hi> throughout all generations.

verses.name: Psalms 145:14
verses.text: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all <hi>those</hi> bowed down.

verses.name: Psalms 145:15
verses.text: The eyes of all wait on You; and You give them their food in due season.

verses.name: Psalms 145:16
verses.text: <hi> You</hi> open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

verses.name: Psalms 145:17
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> righteous in all His ways and holy in all His works.

verses.name: Psalms 145:18
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> near all those who call on Him, all those who call on Him in truth.

verses.name: Psalms 145:19
verses.text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.name: Psalms 145:20
verses.text: The LORD watches over all those who love Him; but all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.name: Psalms 145:21
verses.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; and let all flesh bless His holy name forever and ever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: While I live I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have any being.

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: Do not put your trust in princes, <hi>nor</hi> in the son of man in whom <hi>there is</hi> no salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: His breath goes forth; he returns to the earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who <hi>has</hi> the God of Jacob for his help, whose help <hi>is</hi> in the LORD his God,

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: who made the heavens and earth, the sea and all that <hi>is</hi> in it; who keeps truth forever;

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: who carries out judgment for the mistreated; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD lets the prisoners loose;

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: the Lord opens <hi>the eyes of</hi> the blind; the LORD raises those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous;

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: the LORD preserves the strangers; He relieves the orphan and widow, but the way of the wicked He turns upside down.

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: The LORD shall reign forever, even your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD; for <hi>it is</hi> good to sing praises to our God; for praise <hi>is</hi> delightful <hi>and</hi> becoming.

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: He heals the broken-hearted, and binds up their wounds.

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: He appoints the number of the stars; He calls them all by <hi>their</hi> names.

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: Great <hi>is</hi> our LORD, and of great power; <hi>There is</hi> no limit to His understanding.

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: The LORD lifts up the meek; He throws the wicked down to the ground.

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise on the harp to our God,

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: who covers the heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow <hi>on</hi> the mountains.

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: He gives the beasts its food, <hi>and</hi> to the young ravens which cry.

verses.name: Psalms 147:10
verses.text: He delights not in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.name: Psalms 147:11
verses.text: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear Him, who hope in His mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:12
verses.text: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion.

verses.name: Psalms 147:13
verses.text: For He has made the bars of your gates strong; He has blessed your sons within you.

verses.name: Psalms 147:14
verses.text: He makes peace <hi>in</hi> your borders <hi>and</hi> fills you with the finest of the wheat.

verses.name: Psalms 147:15
verses.text: He sends forth His commandment <hi>on</hi> earth; His word runs very swiftly.

verses.name: Psalms 147:16
verses.text: He gives snow like wool; He scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.

verses.name: Psalms 147:17
verses.text: He casts forth His ice like crumbs; who can stand before His cold?

verses.name: Psalms 147:18
verses.text: He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, <hi>and</hi> the waters flow.

verses.name: Psalms 147:19
verses.text: He shows His word to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

verses.name: Psalms 147:20
verses.text: He has not done so with any nation; and they have not known <hi>His</hi> judgments. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the heights.

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts.

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light.

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and waters that <hi>are</hi> above the heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD; for He commanded, and they were created.

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: He has also settled them forever and ever; He has made a decree which shall not pass away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: Let praise <hi>be to</hi> the LORD from the earth, the sea-monsters, and all deeps;

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: fire and hail, snow and vapor, stormy wind fulfilling His word,

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: mountains and all hills, fruitful trees and all cedars,

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: beasts and all cattle, creeping things and birds of the wing,

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: kings of the earth and all people, princes and all judges of the earth,

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: both young men and maidens, old men and children;

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: let them praise the name of the LORD; for His name alone is excellent; His glory <hi>is</hi> above the earth and heavens.

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: He also lifts up the horn of His people, the praise of all His saints, even of the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise in the congregation of saints.

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in his Makers; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their Kings.

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: Let them praise His name in the dance; let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the meek with salvation.

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: Let the saints be joyful in glory; let them sing aloud on their beds.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: <hi> Let</hi> the high praises of God <hi>be</hi> in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: to carry out vengeance on the nations <hi>and</hi> punishments on the peoples,

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with iron-bands,

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: to carry out on them the judgment written; this <hi>is an</hi> honor for all His saints. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: Praise the LORD. Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the expanse of His power.

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His excellent greatness.

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; praise Him with stringed instruments and pipes.

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: Praise Him on the sounding cymbals; praise Him with the resounding cymbals.

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:1
verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:2
verses.text: to know wisdom and instruction; to recognize the words of understanding;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:3
verses.text: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and uprightness;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:4
verses.text: to give sense to the simple, knowledge and judgment to the young man;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:5
verses.text: the wise hears and increases learning; and understanding ones gets wisdom;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:6
verses.text: to understand a proverb and its meaning; the words of the wise, and their acute sayings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:7
verses.text: The fear of the LORD <hi>is</hi> the beginning of knowledge; but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:8
verses.text: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:9
verses.text: for they <hi>shall be</hi> an ornament of grace to your head and chains around your neck.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:10
verses.text: My son, if sinners lure you, do not be willing.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:11
verses.text: If they say, Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, we will watch secretly for the innocent without cause;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:12
verses.text: let us swallow them up alive as the grave, and whole, as those who go down into the pit;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:13
verses.text: we shall find all precious goods; we shall fill our houses <hi>with</hi> plunder;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:14
verses.text: cast in your lot among us, and let us have one purse.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:15
verses.text: My son, do not walk in the way with them! Keep back your foot from their path,

verses.name: Proverbs 1:16
verses.text: for their feet run to evil and make haste to shed blood.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:17
verses.text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird,

verses.name: Proverbs 1:18
verses.text: And they lie in wait for their <hi>own</hi> blood; they watch secretly for their own lives.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:19
verses.text: So <hi>are</hi> the ways of everyone who gains unjust gain; it takes away its owners' life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:20
verses.text: Wisdom cries outside; she utters her voice in the streets;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:21
verses.text: she cries in the chief place of gathering, in the openings of the gates; in the city she utters her words, <hi>saying</hi>,

verses.name: Proverbs 1:22
verses.text: How long will you love simplicity, simple ones? And will scorners delight in their scorning? And will fools hate knowledge?

verses.name: Proverbs 1:23
verses.text: Turn at my warning; behold, I will pour out my Spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:24
verses.text: Because I called, and you refused; I stretched out my hand, and no one paid attention;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:25
verses.text: but you have despised all my advice, and would have none of my warning.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:26
verses.text: I also will laugh at your trouble; I will mock when your fear comes;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:27
verses.text: when your fear comes as a wasting away, and your ruin comes like a tempest when trouble and pain come upon you.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:28
verses.text: Then they shall call upon me, and I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:29
verses.text: instead they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:30
verses.text: They would have none of my counsel; they despised all my correction,

verses.name: Proverbs 1:31
verses.text: and they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own desires.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:32
verses.text: For the turning away of the simple kills them, and the ease of fools destroys them.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:33
verses.text: But whoever listens to me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:1
verses.text: My son, if you will receive My words and hide My commandments with you,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:2
verses.text: so that you attend to wisdom, you shall extend your heart to understanding;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:3
verses.text: yea, if you cry after knowledge <hi>and</hi> lift up your voice for understanding;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:4
verses.text: if you seek her as silver, and search <hi>for</hi> her as for hidden treasures,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:5
verses.text: then you shall understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:6
verses.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; out of His mouth <hi>come</hi> knowledge and understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:7
verses.text: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous; <hi>He is</hi> a shield to those who walk uprightly.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:8
verses.text: He keeps the paths of judgment, and guards the way of His saints.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:9
verses.text: Then you shall understand righteousness and judgment and honesty, every good path.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:10
verses.text: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasing to your soul;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:11
verses.text: judgment shall keep you, understanding shall keep you,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:12
verses.text: to deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks wicked things;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:13
verses.text: those who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:14
verses.text: who rejoice to do evil <hi>and</hi> delight in the perversities of the wicked;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:15
verses.text: whose ways <hi>are</hi> crooked, and <hi>are</hi> devious in their paths.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:16
verses.text: <hi> They</hi> will deliver you from the strange woman, the stranger <hi>who</hi> flatters <hi>with</hi> her words,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:17
verses.text: who forsakes the guide of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:18
verses.text: For her house bows down to death, and her paths to the dead.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:19
verses.text: All who go in to her do not return, nor do they take hold of the paths of life,

verses.name: Proverbs 2:20
verses.text: in order that you may walk in the way of good and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:21
verses.text: For the upright shall dwell <hi>in</hi> the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:22
verses.text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:1
verses.text: My son, forget not My law; but let your heart keep My commandments;

verses.name: Proverbs 3:2
verses.text: for they shall add length of days, and long life, and peace, to you.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:3
verses.text: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; tie them around your neck; write them upon the tablet of your heart;

verses.name: Proverbs 3:4
verses.text: and you shall find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:5
verses.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not to your own understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:6
verses.text: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:7
verses.text: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and depart from evil.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:8
verses.text: Healing shall be to your navel and marrow to your bones.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:9
verses.text: Honor the LORD with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase;

verses.name: Proverbs 3:10
verses.text: and your barns shall be filled <hi>with</hi> plenty, and your presses shall burst <hi>with</hi> new wine.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:11
verses.text: My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD; nor be weary with His correction;

verses.name: Proverbs 3:12
verses.text: for whom the LORD loves He corrects, even as a father <hi>corrects</hi> the son <hi>in whom</hi> he delights.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:13
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:14
verses.text: For the profit from it <hi>is</hi> better than the gain from silver, and its produce more than fine gold;

verses.name: Proverbs 3:15
verses.text: she <hi>is</hi> more precious than rubies; and all the things you can desire are not to be compared with her.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:16
verses.text: Length of days <hi>is</hi> in her right hand; and in her left hand, riches and honor.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:17
verses.text: Her ways <hi>are</hi> ways of pleasantness, and all her paths <hi>are</hi> peace.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:18
verses.text: She <hi>is</hi> a tree of life to those who lay hold upon her; and happy <hi>is</hi> everyone who keeps her.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:19
verses.text: The LORD has founded the earth by wisdom; by understanding He has founded the heavens.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:20
verses.text: By His knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:21
verses.text: My son, do not let them depart from your eyes; keep sound wisdom and judgment,

verses.name: Proverbs 3:22
verses.text: and they shall be life to your soul and grace to your neck.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:23
verses.text: Then you shall walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not stumble.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:24
verses.text: When you lie down, you shall not be afraid; yea, you shall lie down, and your sleep shall be sweet.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:25
verses.text: Do not be afraid of sudden fear, nor of the destroying of the wicked, when it comes.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:26
verses.text: For the LORD shall be your hope, and shall keep your foot from being taken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:27
verses.text: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:28
verses.text: Do not say to your neighbor, Go and come back again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it beside you:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:29
verses.text: Do not plan evil against your neighbor, since he dwells trustingly by you.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:30
verses.text: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:31
verses.text: Do not envy the cruel man, and choose none of his ways.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:32
verses.text: For the crooked man <hi>is</hi> hateful to the LORD, but His secret <hi>is</hi> with the righteous.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:33
verses.text: The curse of the LORD <hi>is</hi> in the house of the wicked; but He blesses the home of the just.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:34
verses.text: Surely He scorns the scorners; but He gives grace to the lowly.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:35
verses.text: The wise shall inherit glory; but shame shall be the promotion of fools.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:1
verses.text: Sons, hear the instruction of a father, and listen in order to know understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:2
verses.text: For I give you good teaching; do not forsake my law.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:3
verses.text: For I was my father's son, tender and only <hi>beloved</hi> in the sight of my mother.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:4
verses.text: He also taught me, and said to me, Let your heart hold fast my words, keep my commandments and live.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:5
verses.text: Get wisdom, get understanding; forget not; nor turn away from the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:6
verses.text: Do not forsake her, and she shall keep you; love her, and she shall keep you.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:7
verses.text: Wisdom <hi>is</hi> the main thing; get wisdom; and with all your getting get understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:8
verses.text: Prize her, and she shall lift you up; she shall bring you to honor when you embrace her.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:9
verses.text: She shall give to your hand an ornament of grace; she shall shield you with a crown of glory.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:10
verses.text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of your life <hi>shall be</hi> many.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:11
verses.text: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in the right paths.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:12
verses.text: When you go, your steps shall not be narrowed, and when you run, you shall not stumble.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:13
verses.text: Take fast hold of instruction; do not let go; keep her; for she <hi>is</hi> your life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:14
verses.text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not into the way of evil.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:15
verses.text: Avoid it; do not pass by it; turn from it, and pass on!

verses.name: Proverbs 4:16
verses.text: For they do not sleep, except when they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away unless they cause <hi>some</hi> to fall.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:17
verses.text: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:18
verses.text: But the path of the just <hi>is</hi> as the shining light, that shines more and more to the perfect day.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:19
verses.text: The way of the wicked <hi>is</hi> as darkness; they know not at what they stumble.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:20
verses.text: My son, listen to my words; bow down your ear to my sayings.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:21
verses.text: Let them not depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:22
verses.text: For they <hi>are</hi> life to those who find them, and health to all his flesh.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:23
verses.text: Keep your heart with all diligence; for out of it <hi>are</hi> the issues of life.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:24
verses.text: Put away from you a wicked mouth, and devious lips put far from you.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:25
verses.text: Let your eyes look right on, and let your eyelids look straight before you.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:26
verses.text: Ponder the path of your feet, and all your ways <hi>will be</hi> established.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:27
verses.text: Do not turn to the right hand nor to the left; remove your foot from evil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:1
verses.text: My son, listen to my wisdom; bow your ear to my understanding;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:2
verses.text: in order to keep discretion, <hi>that</hi> your lips may keep knowledge.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:3
verses.text: For the lips of a strange woman drip honey, and her palate <hi>is</hi> smoother than oil;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:4
verses.text: but afterward she <hi>is as</hi> bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:5
verses.text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell,

verses.name: Proverbs 5:6
verses.text: lest you should meditate on the path of life, her tracks are movable; you cannot know <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:7
verses.text: And now hear me, O sons, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:8
verses.text: Remove your ways far from her, and do not come near the door of her house,

verses.name: Proverbs 5:9
verses.text: lest you give your honor to others and your years to the cruel;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:10
verses.text: that strangers not be filled <hi>with</hi> your strength, and your labors <hi>be</hi> in the house of a stranger;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:11
verses.text: and you moan when your end <hi>comes</hi>, when your flesh and muscle are eaten away,

verses.name: Proverbs 5:12
verses.text: and say, How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised correction;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:13
verses.text: and I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor bowed down my ears to those who taught me!

verses.name: Proverbs 5:14
verses.text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:15
verses.text: Drink waters out of your own cistern, and running waters out of your own well.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:16
verses.text: Should your overflowing spring he scattered abroad <hi>as</hi> rivers of waters in the streets.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:17
verses.text: Let them be only your own, and not strangers' with you.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:18
verses.text: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:19
verses.text: <hi> Like</hi> the loving deer and pleasant doe, let her breasts satisfy you at all times, and be ravished always with her love.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:20
verses.text: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

verses.name: Proverbs 5:21
verses.text: For the ways of man <hi>are</hi> before the eyes of the LORD, and He watches all his paths.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:22
verses.text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be held with the cords of his sin.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:23
verses.text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:1
verses.text: My son, <hi>if</hi> you are surety for your friend, <hi>if</hi> you struck your palms with a stranger,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:2
verses.text: you are snared with the words of your mouth, you are taken with the words of your mouth.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:3
verses.text: My son, do this now, and deliver yourself when you have come into the hand of your friend; go, humble yourself and make your friend sure.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:4
verses.text: Do not give sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:5
verses.text: Deliver yourself as a gazelle from the <hi>hunter's</hi> hand, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:6
verses.text: Go to the ant, sluggard; consider her ways and be wise;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:7
verses.text: who, having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:8
verses.text: provides her food in the summer <hi>and</hi> gathers her food in the harvest.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:9
verses.text: How long will you sleep, O sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:10
verses.text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:11
verses.text: so shall your poverty come as one who travels, and your need like an armed man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:12
verses.text: A worthless person, a wicked man walks with a crooked mouth,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:13
verses.text: winking with his eyes, speaking with his feet, teaching with his fingers;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:14
verses.text: perversity <hi>is</hi> in his heart; he <hi>is</hi> always planning mischief; he causes fighting.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:15
verses.text: Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; he is quickly broken, and there is no healing.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:16
verses.text: These six the LORD hates; yea, seven <hi>are</hi> hateful to his soul:

verses.name: Proverbs 6:17
verses.text: a proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:18
verses.text: a heart that plots wicked plans, feet hurrying to run to evil,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:19
verses.text: a false witness <hi>who</hi> speaks lies, and he who causes fighting among brothers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:20
verses.text: My son, keep your father's commandments, and do not forsake the law of your mother;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:21
verses.text: bind them upon your heart forever, tie them around your neck.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:22
verses.text: When you go, it shall lead you; when you sleep, it shall keep you; and <hi>when</hi> you awake, it shall talk <hi>with</hi> you.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:23
verses.text: For the commandment <hi>is</hi> a lamp; and the law <hi>is</hi> light; and reproofs of instruction <hi>are</hi> the way of life;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:24
verses.text: to keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:25
verses.text: Do not lust after her beauty in your heart; nor let her take you with her eyelids.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:26
verses.text: For by means of a harlot <hi>a man comes</hi> to a piece of bread; and another man's wife will hunt for the precious life.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:27
verses.text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:28
verses.text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:29
verses.text: So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife; whoever touches her shall not be innocent.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:30
verses.text: They do not despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:31
verses.text: but <hi>if</hi> he is found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the goods of his house.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:32
verses.text: Whoever commits adultery <hi>with</hi> a woman lacks understanding; he <hi>who</hi> does it destroys his own soul.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:33
verses.text: He shall get a wound and dishonor; and his shame shall not he wiped away.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:34
verses.text: For jealousy <hi>is</hi> the rage of a man; therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:35
verses.text: He will not take any ransom; nor will he be willing if you multiply the gifts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:1
verses.text: My son, keep my words and store up my commandments within you.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:2
verses.text: Keep my commandments and live; and keep my law as the pupil of your eye.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:3
verses.text: Bind them upon your fingers; write them upon the tablet of your heart.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:4
verses.text: Say to wisdom, You <hi>are</hi> my sister; and call understanding <hi>your</hi> kinsman,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:5
verses.text: so that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger <hi>who</hi> flatters with her words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:6
verses.text: For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:7
verses.text: and I saw among the simple ones, among the youths, a young man with no understanding,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:8
verses.text: passing through the street near her corner. And he went the way to her house,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:9
verses.text: in the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:10
verses.text: And, behold, there a woman met him, <hi>with</hi> the dress of a harlot and a guarded heart.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:11
verses.text: She <hi>is</hi> loud and stubborn; her feet do not stay in her house;

verses.name: Proverbs 7:12
verses.text: now <hi>she is</hi> outside, now in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:13
verses.text: And she caught him and kissed him, <hi>and</hi> with a hard face she said to him,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:14
verses.text: <hi> I have</hi> peace offerings with me; today I have paid my vows.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:15
verses.text: so I came out to meet you, earnestly to seek your face, and I have found you.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:16
verses.text: I have decked my bed with coverings, with striped cloths of Egyptian linen.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:17
verses.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:18
verses.text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; let us delight ourselves with caresses.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:19
verses.text: For my husband <hi>is</hi> not at home, he has gone on a long journey;

verses.name: Proverbs 7:20
verses.text: he has taken a bag of silver with him <hi>and</hi> will come home at the day of the full moon.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:21
verses.text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:22
verses.text: He goes after her immediately, like an ox goes to the slaughter, or like a fool to the correction of the stocks;

verses.name: Proverbs 7:23
verses.text: until a dart strikes through his liver; as a bird hastens to the snare and does not know that it <hi>is</hi> for his soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:24
verses.text: And now listen to me, sons, and attend to the words of my mouth.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:25
verses.text: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, do not go astray in her paths.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:26
verses.text: For she has cast down many wounded; yea, many strong <hi>men</hi> have been slain by her.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:27
verses.text: Her house <hi>is</hi> the way to hell, going down to the rooms of death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:1
verses.text: Does not wisdom call? And does not understanding put forth her voice?

verses.name: Proverbs 8:2
verses.text: She stands in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the path.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:3
verses.text: She cries in the gates, before the entrance of the city, <hi>at</hi> the doors.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:4
verses.text: To you, O men, I call; and my voice <hi>is</hi> to the sons of man.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:5
verses.text: O simple ones understand wisdom; and, fools, be of an understanding heart.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:6
verses.text: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips <hi>shall be</hi> right things.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:7
verses.text: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness <hi>is</hi> hateful to my lips.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:8
verses.text: All the words of my mouth <hi>are</hi> in righteousness; nothing twisted or perverse <hi>is</hi> in them.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:9
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> all plain to him who understands, and right to those who find knowledge.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:10
verses.text: Receive my instruction and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:11
verses.text: For wisdom <hi>is</hi> better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:12
verses.text: I, wisdom, dwell with sense, and find out knowledge of discretions.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:13
verses.text: The fear of the LORD <hi>is</hi> to hate evil; I hate pride, and arrogance, and the evil way, and the wicked mouth.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:14
verses.text: Counsel and sound wisdom <hi>are</hi> Mine; I <hi>am</hi> understanding; I have strength.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:15
verses.text: By Me kings reign and princes decree justice.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:16
verses.text: Princes rule by Me, and nobles, all the judges of the earth.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:17
verses.text: I love those who love Me; and those who seek Me early shall find Me.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:18
verses.text: Riches and honor <hi>are</hi> with Me; enduring riches and righteousness.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:19
verses.text: My fruit <hi>is</hi> better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and what I give <hi>is better than</hi> choice silver.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:20
verses.text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:21
verses.text: I may cause those who love Me to inherit riches; and I will fill their treasuries.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:22
verses.text: The LORD possessed Me in the beginning of His way, before His works of old.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:23
verses.text: I was anointed from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth <hi>ever was</hi>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:24
verses.text: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when <hi>there were</hi> no springs heavy <hi>with</hi> water.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:25
verses.text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I travailed;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:26
verses.text: before He had made the earth, or the fields or the highest part of the dust of the world.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:27
verses.text: When He prepared the heavens, I <hi>was</hi> there; when He set a circle upon the face of the deep;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:28
verses.text: when He set the clouds above; when He made the strong fountains of the deep;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:29
verses.text: when He gave to the sea its limit that the waters should not pass His command; when He appointed the foundations of the earth;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:30
verses.text: and I was a workman at His side; and I was daily <hi>His</hi> delight, rejoicing always before Him;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:31
verses.text: rejoicing in the world, His earth; and My delight <hi>was</hi> with the sons of men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:32
verses.text: And now listen to Me, O sons; for blessed <hi>are those who</hi> keep My ways.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:33
verses.text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and do not refuse it.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:34
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who hears Me, watching daily at My gates, waiting at the posts of My doors.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:35
verses.text: For whoever finds Me finds life, and shall obtain favor from the LORD.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:36
verses.text: But he who sins against Me wrongs his own soul; all who hate Me love death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:1
verses.text: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars;

verses.name: Proverbs 9:2
verses.text: she has killed her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:3
verses.text: She has sent out her young women; she cries upon the highest places of the city,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:4
verses.text: The simple one, let him turn in here. <hi>To one</hi> lacking heart, she says to him,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:5
verses.text: Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:6
verses.text: Forsake the foolish and live; and go in the way of understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:7
verses.text: One rebuking a scorner gets shame to himself; and one rebuking a wicked one <hi>gets</hi> himself a blemish.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:8
verses.text: Do not reprove a scorner, lest he hate you; give to a wise man, and he will love you.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:9
verses.text: Give to a wise one, and he will be still wiser; teach a just one, and he will increase in learning.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:10
verses.text: The fear of the LORD <hi>is</hi> the beginning of wisdom; and the knowledge of the holy <hi>is</hi> understanding.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:11
verses.text: For by Me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life shall he increased.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:12
verses.text: If you are wise, you shall be wise for yourself; but <hi>if</hi> you scorn, you alone shall bear <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:13
verses.text: A foolish woman <hi>is</hi> noisy; she <hi>is</hi> simple and knows nothing.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:14
verses.text: For she sits at the door of her house, in a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:15
verses.text: to call those who pass by, who are going straight <hi>on</hi> their ways;

verses.name: Proverbs 9:16
verses.text: The simple one, let him turn in here. And to one lacking heart, she says to him,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:17
verses.text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread <hi>eaten</hi> in secret is pleasant.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:18
verses.text: But he does not know that the dead <hi>are</hi> there; her guests <hi>are</hi> in the depths of hell.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:1
verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son <hi>is</hi> the sorrow of his mother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:2
verses.text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:3
verses.text: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry; but He casts away the desire of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:4
verses.text: He who deals <hi>with</hi> a lazy hand becomes poor; but the hand of the hard worker makes rich.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:5
verses.text: He who gathers in summer <hi>is</hi> a wise son; but he who sleeps in harvest <hi>is</hi> a son who causes shame.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:6
verses.text: Blessings <hi>are</hi> on the head of the just; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:7
verses.text: The memory of the just <hi>is</hi> blessed; but the name of the wicked shall rot.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:8
verses.text: The wise in heart will receive commandments; but a babbling fool shall fall.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:9
verses.text: He who walks uprightly walks surely; but he who twists his ways shall be known.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:10
verses.text: He who winks the eye causes sorrow; but a babbling fool shall fall.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:11
verses.text: The mouth of a righteous one <hi>is</hi> a well of life; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:12
verses.text: Hatred stirs up fights, but love covers all sins.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:13
verses.text: In the lips of him who has understanding, wisdom is found; but a rod <hi>is</hi> for the back of him who is without understanding.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:14
verses.text: Wise ones store up knowledge; but the mouth of the foolish <hi>is</hi> near ruin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:15
verses.text: The rich man's wealth <hi>is</hi> his strong city; the ruin of the poor <hi>is</hi> their poverty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:16
verses.text: The labor of the righteous <hi>tends</hi> to life; the fruit of the wicked <hi>tends</hi> to sin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:17
verses.text: He who keeps instruction <hi>is</hi> in the way of life; but he who refuses reproof goes astray.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:18
verses.text: He who hides hatred <hi>with</hi> lying lips, and he who speaks a slander, <hi>is</hi> a fool.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:19
verses.text: In the multitude of words, sin is not lacking; but he who holds back his lips <hi>is</hi> wise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:20
verses.text: The tongue of the just <hi>is as</hi> choice silver; the heart of the wicked <hi>is</hi> worth little.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:21
verses.text: The lips of the righteous feed many; but fools die for lack of wisdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:22
verses.text: The blessing of the LORD itself makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:23
verses.text: To work out evil devices <hi>is as</hi> laughter to a fool; <hi>so</hi> wisdom <hi>is</hi> to a man of understanding.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:24
verses.text: What the wicked fears shall come upon him; but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:25
verses.text: As the storm passes, so the wicked is no more; but the righteous <hi>is</hi> an everlasting foundation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:26
verses.text: Like vinegar to the teeth, and like smoke to the eyes, so <hi>is</hi> the sluggard to those who send him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:27
verses.text: The fear of the LORD prolongs days; but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:28
verses.text: The hope of the righteous <hi>is</hi> gladness; but the hope of the wicked shall perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:29
verses.text: The way of the LORD <hi>is</hi> strength to the upright; but ruin <hi>is</hi> to the workers of iniquity.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:30
verses.text: The righteous shall never be moved; and the wicked shall not live in the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:31
verses.text: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom; but the perverse tongue shall be cut out.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:32
verses.text: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing; but the mouth of the wicked what <hi>is</hi> contrary.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:1
verses.text: False balances <hi>are</hi> hateful to the LORD; but a just weight <hi>is</hi> His delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:2
verses.text: Pride comes, then shame comes; but with the lowly <hi>is</hi> wisdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:3
verses.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; but the crookedness of traitors shall destroy them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:4
verses.text: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:5
verses.text: The righteousness of the perfect shall make his way right, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:6
verses.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but deceivers shall be taken in lust.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:7
verses.text: When a wicked man dies, his hope shall perish; and the hope of evil ones shall be lost.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:8
verses.text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes <hi>in</hi> his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:9
verses.text: A hypocrite corrupts <hi>his</hi> neighbor with <hi>his</hi> mouth; but through knowledge the just shall be delivered.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:10
verses.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked are destroyed, <hi>there is</hi> singing.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:11
verses.text: By the blessing of the upright the city is lifted up, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:12
verses.text: One despising his friend lacks heart, but a man of understanding remains silent.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:13
verses.text: One going with slander is a revealer of secrets, but the faithful of spirit keeps the matter hidden.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:14
verses.text: Where <hi>there is</hi> no wisdom, the people fall; but in the multitude of wise men <hi>there is</hi> safety.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:15
verses.text: He who is surety for a stranger shall be ruined; and he who hates suretyship is safe.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:16
verses.text: A gracious woman keeps honor, and the strong keep riches.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:17
verses.text: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but <hi>he who is</hi> cruel troubles his own flesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:18
verses.text: The wicked makes a deceitful wage; but one sowing righteousness <hi>has</hi> a sure reward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:19
verses.text: So righteousness <hi>tends</hi> to life; but one pursuing evil, <hi>it is</hi> to his own death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:20
verses.text: They who are of a perverse heart <hi>are</hi> hateful to the LORD, but the upright in the way <hi>are</hi> His delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:21
verses.text: <hi> Though</hi> hand <hi>join</hi> in hand, the wicked shall not be innocent; but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:22
verses.text: <hi> Like</hi> a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, <hi>so is</hi> a beautiful woman who turns aside discretion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:23
verses.text: The desire of the righteous <hi>is</hi> only good; the hope of the wicked <hi>is</hi> wrath.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:24
verses.text: There is one who scatters and yet increases; but one who withholds just due <hi>comes</hi> only to poverty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:25
verses.text: The soul who gives freely shall be made fat; and he who waters shall also be watered himself.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:26
verses.text: He who withholds grain, the people shall curse him; but blessing <hi>is</hi> on the head of him who sells.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:27
verses.text: He who carefully seeks good gets favor; but he who seeks mischief, it shall come to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:28
verses.text: He who trusts in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall blossom like a branch.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:29
verses.text: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool <hi>shall be</hi> servant to the wise in heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:30
verses.text: The fruit of the righteous <hi>is</hi> a tree of life; and he who wins souls <hi>is</hi> wise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:31
verses.text: Behold, the righteous shall be rewarded in the earth; much more the wicked and the sinner.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:1
verses.text: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge; but he who hates correction <hi>is</hi> like a brute <hi>animal</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:2
verses.text: The good gets grace from the LORD, but He will condemn a man of wicked thoughts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:3
verses.text: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:4
verses.text: A woman of virtue <hi>is</hi> a crown to her husband, but she who causes shame <hi>is</hi> like rottenness in his bones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:5
verses.text: The thoughts of the righteous <hi>are</hi> right; the counsels of the wicked <hi>are</hi> deceit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:6
verses.text: The words of the wicked <hi>are</hi> to lie in wait for blood; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:7
verses.text: The wicked are overthrown, and <hi>are</hi> gone; but the house of the righteous shall stand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:8
verses.text: A man shall be praised according to his wisdom, but he who is of a perverse heart shall be despised.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:9
verses.text: Better is a despised one, and having a servant, than he honoring himself and lacks bread.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:10
verses.text: A righteous one understands the soul of his animal; but the tender mercies of the wicked <hi>are</hi> cruel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:11
verses.text: He who tills his land shall be satisfied <hi>with</hi> bread; but he who follows vanities lacks heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:12
verses.text: The wicked desires the net of evils; but the root of the righteous yields <hi>fruit</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:13
verses.text: The wicked <hi>is</hi> snared by the transgression of <hi>his</hi> lips, but the just shall come out of trouble.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:14
verses.text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of <hi>his</hi> mouth, and the reward of a man's hands shall be given to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:15
verses.text: The way of a fool <hi>is</hi> right in his own eyes, hut he who listens to advice <hi>is</hi> wise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:16
verses.text: A fool's vexation is known in a day, but the astute one covers shame.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:17
verses.text: He who breathes truth shows forth righteousness, but a false witness deceit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:18
verses.text: There are those who speak like the thrusts of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:19
verses.text: The lips of truth shall be established forever, but only while I wink <hi>is</hi> a lying tongue.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:20
verses.text: Deceit <hi>is</hi> in the heart of those who imagine evil, but to counselors of peace <hi>there is</hi> joy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:21
verses.text: No evil shall happen to the just, but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:22
verses.text: Lying lips <hi>are</hi> hateful to the LORD, but those who deal truly <hi>are</hi> His delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:23
verses.text: A wise man conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools cries out foolishness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:24
verses.text: The hand of the hard worker shall bear rule, but the lazy shall be under service.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:25
verses.text: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop, but a good word makes it glad.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:26
verses.text: The righteous <hi>is</hi> more excellent than his neighbor, but the way of the wicked seduces them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:27
verses.text: The lazy one does not start after his game, but the wealth of a hard worker <hi>is</hi> precious.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:28
verses.text: In the way of righteousness <hi>is</hi> life, and in that pathway <hi>there is</hi> no death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:1
verses.text: A wise son <hi>heeds</hi> his father's instruction, but a scorner does not hear rebuke.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:2
verses.text: From the fruit of <hi>his</hi> mouth a man shall eat good, but the soul of the treacherous <hi>eats</hi> violence.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:3
verses.text: He who keeps his mouth keeps his life; he who opens his lips wide, <hi>it is</hi> ruin to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:4
verses.text: The soul of the sluggard desires and <hi>has</hi> nothing; but the soul of the hard worker shall be made fat.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:5
verses.text: The righteous hates lying, but the wicked one is odious and acts shamefully.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:6
verses.text: Righteousness guards the perfect of way, but wickedness subverts sin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:7
verses.text: There are <hi>those</hi> who act rich, yet have nothing; and those who act poor, yet <hi>have</hi> great riches.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:8
verses.text: The ransom of a man's life <hi>is</hi> his riches, but the poor does not hear rebuke.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:9
verses.text: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:10
verses.text: Only by pride comes argument, but with those who take advice <hi>is</hi> wisdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:11
verses.text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be taken away, but he who gathers by labor shall increase.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:12
verses.text: Hope put off makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled <hi>is</hi> a tree of life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:13
