verses.text: And I will drive you from your position, and he will pull you from your station.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:20
verses.text: And in that day it shall be, even I will call My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:21
verses.text: and I will clothe him with your robe, and will fasten your girdle on him, and I will give your authority into his hand. And he shall be a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:22
verses.text: And the key of the house of David I will lay on his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:23
verses.text: And I will fasten him <hi>as</hi> a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:24
verses.text: And they shall hang on him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the offshoots, all small vessels, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of jars.

verses.name: Isaiah 22:25
verses.text: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, the nail that is fastened in the sure place shall be removed, and be cut down, and fall. And the burden that <hi>was</hi> on it shall be cut off. The LORD has spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:1
verses.text: The burden against Tyre: Howl, ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:2
verses.text: Be still, inhabitants of the coast, merchant of Sidon, who pass over the sea. They have filled you.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:3
verses.text: And by great waters, the seed of Sihor and the harvest of the river Nile <hi>was</hi> her revenue; and she a mart of nations.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:4
verses.text: Be ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the strength of the sea, saying, I have not travailed nor brought forth. I have not nourished young men <hi>nor</hi> raised up virgins.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:5
verses.text: As the report comes to Egypt, <hi>so</hi> they shall be grieved at the report of Tyre.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:6
verses.text: Pass over Tarshish. Howl, inhabitants of the coast!

verses.name: Isaiah 23:7
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> this your joyous <hi>city</hi> from days of her old age? Her own feet carry it afar off to stay.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:8
verses.text: Who has purposed this against Tyre, the crowning <hi>city</hi>, whose merchants are rulers, whose merchants are the weighty of the earth?

verses.name: Isaiah 23:9
verses.text: The LORD of hosts has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory <hi>and</hi> to bring into contempt all the weighty of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:10
verses.text: Pass through your land like a river, O daughter of Tarshish; <hi>there is</hi> no more strength.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:11
verses.text: He stretched out His hand over the sea; He shook kingdoms. The LORD has made a decree against the merchant <hi>city</hi>, to destroy its forts.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:12
verses.text: And He said, You shall rejoice no more, O crushed one, virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Chittim; also there you shall have no rest.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:13
verses.text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans! This people did not exist. Assyria founded it for those who live in the desert. They set up their siege-towers; they stripped its palaces. They made it a ruin.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:14
verses.text: Howl, ships of Tarshish! For your strength is laid waste.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:15
verses.text: And in that day Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will be as the song of a harlot to Tyre.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:16
verses.text: Take a harp, go about the city, O harlot who has been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs so that you may be remembered.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:17
verses.text: And it will be, after the end of seventy years the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:18
verses.text: And her goods and her wages shall be holiness to the LORD. It shall not be treasured nor laid up, for her goods shall be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat enough, and for a choice covering.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:1
verses.text: Behold, the LORD empties the land and makes it bare, and distorts its face, and scatters its inhabitants.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:2
verses.text: And as <hi>it is</hi> with the people, so it shall be with the priest; as with the servant, so with the master; as with the handmaid, so it is with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the debtor.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:3
verses.text: The land shall be completely emptied, and utterly stripped; for the LORD has spoken this word.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:4
verses.text: The earth mourns <hi>and</hi> languishes; the world droops <hi>and</hi> languishes; the proud people of the earth droop.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:5
verses.text: And the land is defiled under its people; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, and have broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:6
verses.text: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and they who dwell in it are deserted; therefore the people of the earth are burned, and few men left.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:7
verses.text: The new wine mourns, the vine droops, all the merry-hearted sigh.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:8
verses.text: The gladness of tambourines ceases, the noise of those who rejoice ends; the joy of the harp ceases.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:9
verses.text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to those who drink it.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:10
verses.text: The city of shame is broken down; every house is shut up so that no one may come in.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:11
verses.text: A crying for wine is in the streets; all joy is darkened, the gladness in the land has gone.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:12
verses.text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is stricken with ruin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:13
verses.text: For so it is in the midst of the land among the people, <hi>it shall be</hi> like the shaking of an olive tree and as gleanings when the grape harvest is completed.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:14
verses.text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:15
verses.text: Therefore glorify the LORD in the flames, the name of the Lord Jehovah of Israel in the coasts of the sea.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:16
verses.text: From the ends of the earth we have heard songs, glory to the righteous. But I said, Leanness to me! Leanness to me! Woe to me! Deceivers deceive, even perfidy. Deceivers deceive!

verses.name: Isaiah 24:17
verses.text: Dread, and the pit, and the snare <hi>are</hi> on you, O dweller of the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:18
verses.text: And it shall be, he who flees from the sound of dread shall fall into the pit. And he who comes up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare. For the windows from on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth quake.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:19
verses.text: The earth is breaking, breaking! The earth is crashing, crashing! The earth is tottering, tottering!

verses.name: Isaiah 24:20
verses.text: Like a drunkard the earth is staggering, staggering! And it rocks to and fro like a tree-hut! And its sins heavy on it; and it shall fall and not rise again.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:21
verses.text: And it shall be in that day, the LORD shall punish the host of the high place on high, and on the kings of the earth on the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:22
verses.text: And they shall be gathered, <hi>as</hi> prisoners are gathered in a dungeon. And they shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days they shall be judged.

verses.name: Isaiah 24:23
verses.text: Then the moon shall blush, and the sun shall be ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in Mount Zion, in Jerusalem, and gloriously before His elders.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:1
verses.text: O LORD, You <hi>are</hi> my God; I will exalt You, I will praise Your name; for You have done a wonder; Counsels from afar; faithful faithfulness.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:2
verses.text: For You have made a heap from a city; a fortified city into a ruin; a citadel of foreigners to be no city; it shall never be built.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:3
verses.text: Therefore the strong people glorify You, the city of the fearful nations shall fear You.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:4
verses.text: For You are a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the fearful ones <hi>is</hi> like a storm <hi>against</hi> the wall.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:5
verses.text: You shalt bring down the noise of foreigners, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of cloud. The shouting of the terrifying ones shall be brought low.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:6
verses.text: And in this mountain the LORD of hosts shall make a feast of fat things for all the people, a feast of wine on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of refined wine on the lees.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:7
verses.text: And He will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering which covers all people, and the veil that is woven over all nations.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:8
verses.text: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from all faces. And He shall take away from all the earth the rebuke of His people. For the LORD has spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:9
verses.text: And one shall say in that day, Lo, this <hi>is</hi> our God. We have waited for Him, and He will save us. This <hi>is</hi> the LORD; we have waited for Him, we will be glad and rejoice in His salvation.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:10
verses.text: For the hand of the LORD shall rest in this mountain, and Moab shall be trampled under Him, even as straw <hi>is</hi> trampled in the water of a dung pit.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:11
verses.text: And He shall spread out His hands in their midst, as he who swims strokes to swim. And He shall bring down their pride with the skill of His hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 25:12
verses.text: And the fortress of the high fort of your walls <hi>He will</hi> lay low, bring to the ground, to the dust.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:1
verses.text: In that day this song shall be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; He sets up salvation <hi>as our</hi> walls and banks.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:2
verses.text: Open the gates, and the righteous nation shall enter in, keeping faithfulness.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:3
verses.text: You will keep <hi>him</hi> in perfect peace, whose mind <hi>is</hi> stayed on You; because he trusts in You.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:4
verses.text: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD JEHOVAH <hi>is</hi> everlasting strength.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:5
verses.text: For He brings down those who dwell on high; He lays low the lofty city; He lays it low, even to the ground; He brings it to the dust.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:6
verses.text: The foot shall trample it, the feet of the poor <hi>and</hi> the steps of the needy.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:7
verses.text: The way of the just <hi>is</hi> uprightness; O Upright One, weigh the path of the just.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:8
verses.text: Yea, <hi>in</hi> the way of Your judgments, O LORD, we awaited You; for Your name and for Your memory <hi>is</hi> the desire of <hi>our</hi> soul.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:9
verses.text: <hi> With</hi> my soul I desired You in the night; yea, <hi>with</hi> my spirit within me I will seek You early; for when Your judgments <hi>are</hi> in the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:10
verses.text: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:11
verses.text: LORD, Your hand is lifted up, they will not see; but they shall see and be ashamed for <hi>their</hi> envy toward Your people. Yes, the fire of Your enemies shall devour them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:12
verses.text: LORD, You will ordain peace for us; for You also have worked all our works in us.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:13
verses.text: O LORD our God, lords besides You have had the rule over us; <hi>but</hi> by You only will we make mention of Your name.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:14
verses.text: Dead ones do not live; departed spirits do not rise. Therefore You have visited and destroyed them, and made all memory of them to perish.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:15
verses.text: You have increased the nation, O LORD, You have increased the nation; You are glorified; You have extended all the ends of the land.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:16
verses.text: LORD, in trouble they have visited You; they poured out a prayer; Your chastening <hi>was</hi> on them.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:17
verses.text: As a woman with child draws near to bear, she is in pain <hi>and</hi> cries out in her pangs; so have we been in Your sight, O LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:18
verses.text: We conceived; we have been in pain, we gave birth <hi>to</hi> wind. We have not brought about any salvation in the earth; nor have the people of the world fallen.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:19
verses.text: Your dead ones shall live, <hi>together with</hi> my dead body they shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew <hi>is as</hi> the dew of lights, and the earth shall cast out the dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:20
verses.text: Come, my people, enter into your rooms and shut your doors around you; hide for a little moment, until the fury has passed by.

verses.name: Isaiah 26:21
verses.text: For behold, the LORD comes out of His place to punish the people of the earth for their iniquity; the earth also shall reveal her blood, and shall no more cover her dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:1
verses.text: In that day the LORD with His great and fierce and strong sword shall punish the sea-monster, the darting serpent, the sea-monster, that twisting serpent; and He shall kill the monster in the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:2
verses.text: In that day sing to her, a delightful vineyard.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:3
verses.text: I the LORD keep it; I will water it every moment; lest <hi>any</hi> hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:4
verses.text: Fury <hi>is</hi> not in Me; who would set the briers <hi>and</hi> thorns against Me in battle? I would step through it; I would burn it at once.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:5
verses.text: Or let them take hold of My strength, that he may make peace with Me; and he shall make peace with Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:6
verses.text: He shall cause those who come from Jacob to take root; Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world <hi>with</hi> fruit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:7
verses.text: Has He stricken him, as He struck those who struck Him? Is He slain according to the slaughter of the slain by Him?

verses.name: Isaiah 27:8
verses.text: By driving her away, you will contend with her; by sending her away, You punished her. He takes away by His rough wind, in the day of the east wind.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:9
verses.text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this <hi>is</hi> all the fruit to take away his sin; when he makes all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in pieces, the Asherahs and sun-pillars shall not stand up.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:10
verses.text: Yet the fortified city <hi>shall be</hi> wasted, and the dwelling forsaken and left like a wilderness; there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down and eat up its branches.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:11
verses.text: When its branches are dried up, they shall be broken off; the women come <hi>and</hi> set them on fire; for it is a people of no understanding. Therefore His Maker will not have mercy on them, and He who formed them will not favor them.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:12
verses.text: And it shall be, in that day the LORD shall thresh from the stream of the river Euphrates to the brook of Egypt, and you shall be gathered one by one, O sons of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 27:13
verses.text: And it shall be, in that day the great ram's horn shall be blown, and those perishing in the land of Assyria shall come, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt shall come and shall worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:1
verses.text: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty <hi>is</hi> a fading flower which is on the head of the fat valleys of those who are overcome with wine!

verses.name: Isaiah 28:2
verses.text: Behold, the Lord is a mighty and strong one, like a hailstorm, a destroying storm; like a flood of mighty waters overflowing, He casts down to the earth with the hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:3
verses.text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trampled under foot;

verses.name: Isaiah 28:4
verses.text: and the glorious beauty, on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, <hi>and</hi> as the first-ripe fruit before the summer; which the beholder of it swallows up while it is yet in his hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:5
verses.text: In that day the LORD of hosts shall be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, to the rest of His people,

verses.name: Isaiah 28:6
verses.text: and for a spirit of judgment to him who sits in judgment, and for strength to those who turn back the battle to the gate.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:7
verses.text: But they also have sinned through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way. The priest and the prophet have sinned through drink; they are swallowed up by wine; they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble <hi>in</hi> judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:8
verses.text: For all tables are full of vomit <hi>and</hi> filthiness; no place <hi>is clean</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:9
verses.text: Whom shall He teach knowledge? And whom shall He make to understand doctrine? <hi>Those</hi> weaned from the milk and drawn from the breasts.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:10
verses.text: For precept <hi>must be</hi> on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little;

verses.name: Isaiah 28:11
verses.text: for with stammering lips and another tongue He will speak to this people.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:12
verses.text: To whom He said, This <hi>is</hi> the rest; cause the weary to rest; and this <hi>is</hi> the refreshing. Yet they were not willing to hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:13
verses.text: But the word of the LORD was to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken and snared and taken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:14
verses.text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, scornful men who rule this people in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:15
verses.text: Because you have said, We have made a covenant with death, and we have made a vision with hell; when the overwhelming rod shall pass through, it shall not come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood,

verses.name: Isaiah 28:16
verses.text: therefore so says the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I place in Zion a Stone for a foundation, a tried Stone, a precious Cornerstone, a sure Foundation; he who believes shall not hurry.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:17
verses.text: Also I will lay judgment to the line, and righteousness to the plummet; and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:18
verses.text: And your covenant with death shall be wiped out, and your vision with hell shall not stand; when the overwhelming rod shall pass through, then you shall be beaten down by it.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:19
verses.text: From the time that it goes out it shall take you; for morning by morning it shall pass over, by day and by night; and it shall be nothing less than a terror to give ear to the message.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:20
verses.text: For the bed is shorter than one can stretch himself on, and the cover is narrower than one can wrap himself in.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:21
verses.text: For the LORD shall rise up as <hi>in</hi> Mount Perazim; He shall be angry as in the valley of Gibeon, so that He may do His work, His strange work; and bring to pass His act, His strange act.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:22
verses.text: So then do not be mockers, lest your bands be made strong; for I have heard from the Lord Jehovah of hosts that a full end is decreed on all the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:23
verses.text: Give ear and hear my voice; listen, and hear my speech.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:24
verses.text: Does the plowman plow all day to sow? Does he open and break the clods of his ground?

verses.name: Isaiah 28:25
verses.text: When he has made the face of it level, does he not cast out the dill and scatter the cummin, and throw in the choice wheat and the chosen barley and the spelt <hi>in</hi> its border?

verses.name: Isaiah 28:26
verses.text: For his God instructs him to do right; his God teaches him.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:27
verses.text: For the dill is not threshed with a threshing instrument, nor is a cart wheel turned on cummin; but the dill is beaten out with a staff and the cummin with a rod.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:28
verses.text: Bread grain is crushed, but not always does one thresh it <hi>with</hi> threshing. And he drives the wheel of his cart; and his horses do not beat it small.

verses.name: Isaiah 28:29
verses.text: This also comes out from the LORD of hosts, <hi>who</hi> is wonderful in wisdom, making sound wisdom great.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:1
verses.text: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city <hi>where</hi> David dwelt! Add year to year; let them kill their sacrifices.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:2
verses.text: Then I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow; and it shall be to me as Ariel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:3
verses.text: And I will camp against you all around, and will lay siege against you with a mount, and I will raise forts against you.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:4
verses.text: And you shall be brought down; you shall speak out of the ground, and your speech shall be low out of the dust, and your voice shall be like a spiritist, out of the ground, and your speech shall whisper out of the dust.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:5
verses.text: And the multitude of your strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones <hi>shall be</hi> as chaff that passes away; yea, it shall be at an instant, suddenly.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:6
verses.text: You shall be visited by the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake and great noise, with storm and whirlwind, and the flame of devouring fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:7
verses.text: And the multitude of all the nations who fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, shall be like a dream of a night vision.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:8
verses.text: It shall even be as when a hungry one dreams, and behold, he eats, but he wakes and his soul is empty; or as when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, <hi>he is</hi> faint and his soul is longing. So shall it be with the multitude of all the nations who fight against mount Zion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:9
verses.text: Stand still and wonder! Blind your eyes and be blind! They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not <hi>with</hi> strong drink.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:10
verses.text: For the LORD has poured out on you the spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes; He has covered the prophets and your heads, the seers.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:11
verses.text: And the vision of all has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which they give to one who knows books saying, Please read this; and he says, I cannot, for it is sealed.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:12
verses.text: And the book is delivered to him who does not know books, saying, Please read this; and he says, I do not know books.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:13
verses.text: And the LORD said, Because this people draw near <hi>Me</hi> with their mouth, and with their lips honor Me, but have removed their heart far from Me, and their fear toward Me is taught by the command of men;

verses.name: Isaiah 29:14
verses.text: therefore, behold, I will go on doing among this people, a wonder, even a wonder. For the wisdom of their wise ones shall perish, and the understanding of their intelligent ones shall be hidden.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:15
verses.text: Woe <hi>to</hi> those who go deep to hide <hi>their</hi> purpose from the LORD! And their works are in the dark, and they say, Who sees us? And who knows us?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:16
verses.text: O your perversity! Shall the former be counted as the potter's clay; for shall the work say of him who made it, He did not make me? Or shall the thing formed say to him who formed it, He had no understanding?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:17
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be counted as a forest?

verses.name: Isaiah 29:18
verses.text: And in that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of their gloom and darkness.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:19
verses.text: And the meek shall increase joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:20
verses.text: For the terrible one is brought to nothing, and the scorner is destroyed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off;

verses.name: Isaiah 29:21
verses.text: those who make a man guilty by a word, and lay a trap for the reprover in the gate, and turn aside the just for a worthless thing.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:22
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: Jacob shall not now be ashamed, nor shall his face now become pale.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:23
verses.text: But when he sees his children, the work of My hands, in his midst, they shall sanctify My name, and sanctify the Holy one of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 29:24
verses.text: Those who erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and those who murmured shall learn doctrine.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:1
verses.text: Woe <hi>to</hi> the rebellious sons, says the LORD, who make advice, but not of Me; and who cover with a covering, but not of My Spirit, that they add sin to sin;

verses.name: Isaiah 30:2
verses.text: those who set out to go down <hi>to</hi> Egypt and have not asked at My mouth; to take refuge in the strength of Pharaoh and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.name: Isaiah 30:3
verses.text: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh shall be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt shall be <hi>your</hi> curse.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:4
verses.text: For his rulers were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came <hi>to</hi> Hanes.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:5
verses.text: They were all ashamed of a people who could not profit them, nor be a help nor gain, but a shame and also a reproach.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:6
verses.text: The burden concerning the beasts of the south. Into the land of trouble and woe. The lioness and the lion <hi>are</hi> from them; the viper, and the fiery flying serpent. They carry their riches on the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people <hi>that</hi> cannot profit.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:7
verses.text: For Egypt helps vainly, and worthlessly. So I have cried concerning this, Their strength <hi>is</hi> to sit still.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:8
verses.text: Now go, write it before them in a tablet, and note it in a book, so that it may be for the time to come forever and ever,

verses.name: Isaiah 30:9
verses.text: that this <hi>is</hi> a rebellious people, lying sons. They are sons who will not hear the law of the LORD;

verses.name: Isaiah 30:10
verses.text: who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Do not prophesy to us right things, speak to us smooth things, prophesy falsehood;

verses.name: Isaiah 30:11
verses.text: go out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:12
verses.text: Therefore so says the Holy One of Israel, Because you have despised this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rest on them;

verses.name: Isaiah 30:13
verses.text: therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:14
verses.text: And He shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that <hi>is</hi> broken in pieces. He shall have no pity, so that there shall not be found in the breaking of it a shard to take fire from the hearth, or to take water out of the pit.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:15
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, In returning and rest you shall be saved; and in quietness and hope shall be your strength. And you were not willing.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:16
verses.text: But you said, No; for we will flee on a horse. Therefore you shall flee. And <hi>you said</hi>, We will ride on the swift; therefore those who pursue you shall be swift.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:17
verses.text: One thousand <hi>shall flee</hi> at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five you <hi>shall flee</hi>, until you are left as a pole on the top of a mountain, and as a sign on a hill.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:18
verses.text: And so the LORD waits to be gracious to you. And therefore He is exalted, that He may have mercy on you. For the LORD <hi>is</hi> a God of judgment; blessed <hi>are</hi> all those who wait for Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:19
verses.text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem; you shall weep no more; He will be very gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When He hears it, He will answer you.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:20
verses.text: And the LORD gives you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction; yet your teachers shall not be removed into a corner any more, but your eyes shall see your teachers.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:21
verses.text: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, This <hi>is</hi> the way, walk in it, when you turn to the right hand and when you turn to the left.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:22
verses.text: You shall also defile the covering of your graven images of silver, and the ornament of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away like a menstruous cloth. You shall say to it, Get away.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:23
verses.text: Then He shall give the rain <hi>for</hi> your seed, with which you sow the ground. And the bread of the produce of the earth also shall be fat and plentiful. In that day your cattle shall feed in large pastures.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:24
verses.text: Also the oxen and the young asses that plow the ground shall eat clean fodder, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:25
verses.text: And there shall be on every high mountain, and on every high hill, rivers, streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:26
verses.text: And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the break of His people and heals the stroke of their wound.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:27
verses.text: Behold, the name of the LORD comes from far, burning <hi>with</hi> His anger, and uplifting <hi>of smoke</hi>; His lips are full of fury, and His tongue like a devouring fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:28
verses.text: And like an overflowing stream, His breath shall reach to the middle of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity. And a bridle <hi>will be</hi> in the jaws of the people, causing <hi>them</hi> to go astray.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:29
verses.text: You shall have a song, as in the keeping of a holy feast night; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:30
verses.text: And the LORD shall cause His glorious voice to be heard, and the bringing down of His arm shall be seen with raging anger and flame of a devouring fire, cloudburst and storm and hailstones.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:31
verses.text: For through the voice of the LORD, the Assyrian shall be beaten down, <hi>who</hi> struck with a rod.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:32
verses.text: And <hi>in</hi> every place which the ordained staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay on him, <hi>it</hi> shall be with tambourines and harps; in battles of shaking He will fight with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:33
verses.text: For Tophet <hi>is</hi> ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared. He has made <hi>it</hi> deep and large. He makes great <hi>with</hi> fire and wood. The breath of the LORD kindles it, like a torrent of brimstone.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:1
verses.text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and lean on horses and trust in chariots, because <hi>it is</hi> great; and in horsemen, because they are so very strong, but they do not look to the Holy One of Israel, nor do they seek the LORD!

verses.name: Isaiah 31:2
verses.text: Yet He also <hi>is</hi> wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back His words, but will arise against the house of evil-doers and against the help of those who work iniquity.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:3
verses.text: And Egypt <hi>is</hi> a man, and not God; and their horses are flesh, and not Spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out His hand, both he who helps shall fall, and he who is helped shall fall down, and they shall all cease together.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:4
verses.text: For so has the LORD spoken to me: As the lion roars, even the young lion on his prey when a multitude of shepherds are gathered against him, <hi>he</hi> will not be afraid of their voice, nor fret himself because of their noise. So the LORD of hosts shall come down to fight for Mount Zion, and on its hill.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:5
verses.text: As birds flying, so the LORD of hosts will defend Jerusalem; also defending, He will deliver <hi>it</hi>; and passing over He will preserve <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:6
verses.text: Turn to <hi>Him from</hi> whom the sons of Israel have deeply revolted.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:7
verses.text: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your hands have made <hi>for</hi> you, a sin.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:8
verses.text: Then Assyria shall fall with the sword, not of <hi>great</hi> man; and the sword, not of <hi>lowly</hi> man, shall devour him. For he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall become forced labor.

verses.name: Isaiah 31:9
verses.text: And he shall pass over to his stronghold for fear, and his rulers shall be afraid of the banner, says the LORD, whose fire <hi>is</hi> in Zion, and His furnace in Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:1
verses.text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and rulers shall rule in judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:2
verses.text: And a man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a shelter from the tempest, like streams of water in a dry place, like the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:3
verses.text: And the eyes of those who see shall not be dim, and the ears of those who hear shall listen.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:4
verses.text: And the heart of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of those who stutter shall be ready to speak plainly.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:5
verses.text: The fool shall no more be called noble, nor the miser said <hi>to be</hi> bountiful.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:6
verses.text: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart work iniquity, to practice hypocrisy and to speak error against the LORD, to make the soul of the hungry empty, and he will take away the drink of the thirsty.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:7
verses.text: Also the weapons of the fool <hi>are</hi> evil; he thinks of wicked ways to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:8
verses.text: But the noble thinks noble things; and by noble things he shall stand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:9
verses.text: Rise up, women who are at ease; hear my voice, careless daughters; listen to my speech.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:10
verses.text: Many days and years you shall be troubled, careless women; for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:11
verses.text: Tremble, women at ease; be troubled, careless ones; strip yourselves and make yourselves bare, and bind <hi>sackcloth</hi> on your loins.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:12
verses.text: They shall mourn for the breasts, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:13
verses.text: On the land of my people shall come up thorns <hi>and</hi> briers; yea, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city;

verses.name: Isaiah 32:14
verses.text: because the palace shall be deserted, the multitude of the city shall be forsaken; instead the mound and tower shall be for dens forever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks

verses.name: Isaiah 32:15
verses.text: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is thought to be a forest.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:16
verses.text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:17
verses.text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the work of righteousness shall be quietness and hope forever.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:18
verses.text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable home, and in secure dwellings and quiet resting places

verses.name: Isaiah 32:19
verses.text: Though it hails, when the forest is felled, and the city laid low.

verses.name: Isaiah 32:20
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the ass.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:1
verses.text: Woe <hi>to</hi> the destroyer, and you who <hi>have</hi> not been destroyed; and betrayer, and they have not betrayed you. When you stop destroying, you shall be destroyed. When you stop betraying, they shall betray you.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:2
verses.text: O LORD, be gracious to us; we have waited for You; be their arm in the mornings; our salvation also in the time of trouble.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:3
verses.text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of Yourself the nations were scattered.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:4
verses.text: And your spoil shall be gathered <hi>as</hi> the stripping locust gathers; as the running to and fro of locusts he shall run on them.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:5
verses.text: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high. He has filled Zion <hi>with</hi> judgment and righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:6
verses.text: And He will be the security of your times, <hi>and</hi> strength of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; the fear of the LORD <hi>is</hi> his treasure.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:7
verses.text: Behold, their mighty ones shall cry outside; the messengers of peace shall weep bitterly.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:8
verses.text: The highways lie waste, the traveler ceases. He has broken the covenant. He has despised the cities. He cared for no man.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:9
verses.text: The earth mourns <hi>and</hi> droops. Lebanon is ashamed; Sharon withers like a wilderness; Bashan and Carmel are shaken out.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:10
verses.text: Now I will rise, says the LORD; now I will be exalted; now I will lift up Myself.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:11
verses.text: You shall conceive chaff, you shall bring out stubble; your breath, <hi>like</hi> fire, shall devour you.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:12
verses.text: And the people shall be <hi>like</hi> the burnings of lime; <hi>like</hi> thorns cut up, they shall be burned in the. fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:13
verses.text: You <hi>who are</hi> far off, hear what I have done; and you near ones, know My might.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:14
verses.text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; terror has surprised profane ones. Who among us shall dwell <hi>with</hi> the devouring fire? Who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

verses.name: Isaiah 33:15
verses.text: He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly; he who despises the gain of oppressions, who shakes his hands free from holding bribes, who stops his ear from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from seeing evil;

verses.name: Isaiah 33:16
verses.text: He shall dwell on high; his refuge <hi>shall be</hi> the strongholds of rocks; bread <hi>shall be</hi> given him; his waters shall be sure.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:17
verses.text: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty; they shall behold the land that is very far off.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:18
verses.text: Your heart shall dwell on terror. Where <hi>is</hi> the scribe? Where <hi>is</hi> the one weighing? Where <hi>is</hi> he who counting the towers?

verses.name: Isaiah 33:19
verses.text: You shall not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than you can understand; of a foreign tongue that no one understands.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:20
verses.text: Look on Zion, the city of our holy meetings; your eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet home, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of its stakes shall ever be removed, nor shall any of its cords be broken.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:21
verses.text: But there the glorious LORD <hi>will be</hi> to us a place of broad rivers <hi>and</hi> streams, in which no galley with oars shall go, nor shall mighty ship pass by it.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:22
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> our judge, the LORD <hi>is</hi> our lawgiver, the LORD <hi>is</hi> our king; He will save us.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:23
verses.text: Your ropes are loosened, they do not hold the base of the mast; they could not spread the sail. Then the prey of a great spoil shall be divided; the lame take the prey.

verses.name: Isaiah 33:24
verses.text: And an inhabitant, the people who live in it shall not say, I am sick; iniquity is taken away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:1
verses.text: Come near, nations, to hear; and, you people, listen; let the earth hear, and its fullness; the world, and its offspring.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:2
verses.text: For the anger of the LORD <hi>is</hi> on all nations, and His fury on all their armies. He has completely destroyed them, He has delivered them to the slaughter.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:3
verses.text: Also their dead shall be thrown out, and their stink shall come up out of their dead bodies, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:4
verses.text: And all the host of the heavens shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled like a scroll; and all their host shall droop, as a leaf falls off from the vine, and as the falling from the fig tree.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:5
verses.text: For My sword bathed in the heavens. Behold, it shall come down on Edom, and on the people of My curse for judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:6
verses.text: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood; it is made fat with fatness, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:7
verses.text: And the wild oxen shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:8
verses.text: For <hi>it is</hi> the day of the LORD's vengeance, the year to repay for the fighting against Zion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:9
verses.text: And its streams shall be turned into pitch, and its dust to brimstone, and its land shall become burning pitch.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:10
verses.text: It shall not be put out night or day; its smoke shall go up forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; none passes through it forever <hi>and</hi> forever.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:11
verses.text: But the pelican and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also, and the raven, shall dwell in it. And He shall stretch out on it the line of shame, and the stones of emptiness.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:12
verses.text: They shall call its nobles <hi>to</hi> the kingdom, but none <hi>shall be</hi> there, and all her rulers shall be nothing.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:13
verses.text: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it shall be a home of jackals <hi>and</hi> a court for ostriches.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:14
verses.text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the howling beasts; and the shaggy goat shall cry to his fellow. The screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:15
verses.text: There the snake shall nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow; there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:16
verses.text: Seek out of the book of the LORD, and read; not one of these shall fail, none shall lack its mate; for My mouth has commanded, and His Spirit has gathered them.

verses.name: Isaiah 34:17
verses.text: And He has cast the lot for them, and His hand has divided it to them by line; they shall possess it forever, from generation to generation they shall dwell in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:1
verses.text: The wilderness and the desert shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice and blossom as the crocus.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:2
verses.text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even <hi>with</hi> joy and singing; the glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the honor of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD <hi>and</hi> the majesty of our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:3
verses.text: Make the weak hands strong and make the feeble knees sure.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:4
verses.text: Say to those of a hasty heart, Be strong, fear not; behold, your God will come <hi>with</hi> vengeance, with the full dealing of God. He will come and save you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:5
verses.text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:6
verses.text: Then the lame shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the dumb shall sing; for in the wilderness waters shall break out, and streams in the desert.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:7
verses.text: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land shall become springs of water in the home of jackals, in its lair, and a place for the reed and rush.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:8
verses.text: And a highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called, The Way of Holiness. The unclean shall not pass over it. But He <hi>shall be</hi> with them; the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err <hi>in it</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:9
verses.text: No lion shall be there, nor <hi>any</hi> beast of prey shall go up on it; it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there.

verses.name: Isaiah 35:10
verses.text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy on their heads; they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:1
verses.text: And it happened in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:2
verses.text: And the king of Assyria sent the chief of the cupbearers from Lachish to Jerusalem, to king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the Fuller's Field.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:3
verses.text: Then Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Asaph's son Joah, the recorder, came out to him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:4
verses.text: And the chief of the cupbearers said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, So says the great king, the king of Assyria, What hope <hi>is</hi> this in which you trust?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:5
verses.text: I say, <hi>Are</hi> only words of the lips wisdom and strength for war? Now, in whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:6
verses.text: Lo, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; on which, <hi>if</hi> a man lean on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So <hi>is</hi> Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:7
verses.text: But if you say to me, We trust in Jehovah our God; <hi>is it</hi> not He whose high places and altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Judah and Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:8
verses.text: Now then, please exchange pledges with my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them for you.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:9
verses.text: How then will you turn away the face of one commander of the least of my master's servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:10
verses.text: Have I now come up without Jehovah against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land and destroy it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:11
verses.text: And Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the chief of the cupbearers, Please speak to your servants <hi>in</hi> Aramaic, for we understand <hi>it</hi>. But do not speak to us <hi>in</hi> Jewish in the ears of the people on the wall.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:12
verses.text: But the chief of the cupbearers said, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall? that they may eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:13
verses.text: Then the chief of the cupbearers stood and cried with a loud voice <hi>in</hi> Jewish, and said, Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:14
verses.text: So says the king, Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he shall not be able to deliver you.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:15
verses.text: Nor let Hezekiah make you trust in Jehovah, saying, Jehovah will surely deliver us; this city shall not be delivered into the hands of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:16
verses.text: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for so says the king of Assyria, Make a blessing with me by a present, and come out to me; and let everyone eat of his vine, and everyone of his fig tree, and everyone drink the waters <hi>of</hi> his own cistern,

verses.name: Isaiah 36:17
verses.text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:18
verses.text: <hi> Let</hi> not Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Jehovah will deliver us. Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:19
verses.text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where <hi>are</hi> the gods of Sepharvaim? And when have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:20
verses.text: Who among all the gods of these lands that have delivered their land out of my hand, that Jehovah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:21
verses.text: But they were silent and did not answer him a word, for the king's command, saying, Do not answer him.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:22
verses.text: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who <hi>was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah <hi>with their</hi> clothes torn and told him the words of the chief of the cupbearers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:1
verses.text: And it happened when king Hezekiah heard, he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:2
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, who <hi>was</hi> over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:3
verses.text: And they said to him, So says Hezekiah, This day <hi>is</hi> a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy! For the sons have come to the birth, and no strength to bring out.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:4
verses.text: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of the chief of the cupbearers, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD your God has heard. And you shall lift up <hi>your</hi> prayer for the remnant that is left.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:5
verses.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:6
verses.text: And Isaiah said to them, So you shall say to your master, So says the LORD, Do not be afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:7
verses.text: Behold, I will send a blast on him, and he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land. And I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:8
verses.text: So the chief of the cupbearers returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah. For he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:9
verses.text: And he heard concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He has come out to war with you. And he heard and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:10
verses.text: So you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:11
verses.text: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by completely destroying them. And shall you be delivered?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:12
verses.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers have destroyed: Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:13
verses.text: Where <hi>is</hi> the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:14
verses.text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the courier's hand, and read it. And Hezekiah went up <hi>into</hi> the house of the LORD and spread it before the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:15
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:16
verses.text: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, who dwells <hi>between</hi> the cherubs, You <hi>are</hi> He, God, You alone to all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made the heavens and the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:17
verses.text: Bow down Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib which he has sent to mock the living God.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:18
verses.text: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their land,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:19
verses.text: and have cast their gods into the fire, for they <hi>were</hi> no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone; so they have destroyed them.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:20
verses.text: And now, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You <hi>are</hi> the LORD, You alone.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:21
verses.text: And Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, So says the LORD God of Israel, Because you have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:22
verses.text: this <hi>is</hi> the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: The virgin, the daughter of Zion, has despised you <hi>and</hi> laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken <hi>her</hi> head behind you.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:23
verses.text: Whom have you mocked and blasphemed? And against whom have you raised <hi>your</hi> voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Even against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:24
verses.text: By your servants you have mocked the LORD and have said, by my many chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars of it, <hi>and</hi> its choice fir trees; and I will go to its greatest height, the forest of its Carmel.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:25
verses.text: I have dug and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:26
verses.text: Have you not heard from afar? I made it from days of old, even I have formed it? Now I have caused it to come, and you are to cause fortified cities to crash <hi>into</hi> heaps, ruins.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:27
verses.text: And their inhabitants <hi>were</hi> short of hand; dismayed and ashamed. They were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, <hi>as</hi> the grass on the housetops, even grain blasted before it has risen.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:28
verses.text: But I know your sitting down, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:29
verses.text: Because of your raging against Me, and your arrogance has come up into My ears, therefore I will put My hook in your nose, and My bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way which you came.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:30
verses.text: And this <hi>shall be</hi> a sign to you: You shall eat self-sown grain <hi>this</hi> year; and the second year that which springs of the same; and in the third year you shall sow, and reap, and plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:31
verses.text: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward;

verses.name: Isaiah 37:32
verses.text: for out of Jerusalem shall go out a remnant, and those who escape out of Mount Zion; the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:33
verses.text: So the LORD says this to the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it <hi>with</hi> shield, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:34
verses.text: By the way that he came, by the same he shall return, and shall not come into this city, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:35
verses.text: For I will defend this city to save it, for My own sake and for My servant David's sake.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:36
verses.text: Then the angel of the LORD went out and struck a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the camp of Assyria. And they rose early in the morning, and behold! They <hi>were</hi> all dead corpses.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:37
verses.text: And Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and lived at Nineveh.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:38
verses.text: And it happened as he was worshiping <hi>in</hi> the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword. And they escaped <hi>into</hi> the land of Ararat; and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:1
verses.text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him and said to him, So says the LORD, Set your house in order, for you shall die and not live.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:2
verses.text: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the LORD,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:3
verses.text: and said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech You, how I have walked before You in truth and with a whole heart, and have done the good in Your sight. And Hezekiah wept with a great weeping.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:4
verses.text: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:5
verses.text: Go and say to Hezekiah: So says the LORD, the God of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; behold, I will add to your days fifteen years.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:6
verses.text: And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. And I will defend this city.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:7
verses.text: And this <hi>shall be</hi> a sign to you from the LORD that the LORD will do this thing that He has spoken:

verses.name: Isaiah 38:8
verses.text: behold, I will bring again the shadow of the steps, which has gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten steps backward. So the sun returned ten steps, by which steps it had gone down.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:9
verses.text: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:

verses.name: Isaiah 38:10
verses.text: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave; I have numbered the rest of my years.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:11
verses.text: I said, I shall not see Jah, Jehovah, in the land of the living; I shall look on man no more with the people of the world.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:12
verses.text: My generation is departed and removed from me like a shepherd's tent; I have cut off my life like a weaver; He will cut me off from the loom; from day even to night You will make an end of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:13
verses.text: I place <hi>Him</hi> before me until morning, <hi>that</hi>, as a lion, so He breaks all my bones; from day even until night You make an end of me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:14
verses.text: Like a twittering swallow, so I chatter; I mourn as a dove; my eyes look weakly to the heights. O LORD, I am pressed down; be surety for me.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:15
verses.text: What shall I say? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has acted; I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:16
verses.text: O LORD, by these things men live, and in all these <hi>is</hi> the life of my spirit; so You will recover me, and make me to live.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:17
verses.text: Behold, I had great bitterness for peace; but You loved my soul from the pit of destruction. You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:18
verses.text: For the grave cannot praise You, death can <hi>not</hi> rejoice in You; they who go down into the pit cannot hope for Your truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:19
verses.text: The living, the living, he shall praise You, as I <hi>do</hi> this day; the father shall make Your truth known to the sons.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:20
verses.text: For the LORD <hi>is</hi> for my salvation; and we will sing my songs on the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:21
verses.text: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a cake of figs and rub <hi>it</hi> on the ulcer; and he will live.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:22
verses.text: And Hezekiah said, What <hi>is</hi> the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:1
verses.text: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah; for he had heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:2
verses.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and let them see the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not let them see.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:3
verses.text: Then Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah, and said to him, What did these men say? And where did they come from to you? And Hezekiah said, They have come from a far country to me, from Babylon.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:4
verses.text: Then he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All that <hi>is</hi> in my house they have seen; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not let them see.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:5
verses.text: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

verses.name: Isaiah 39:6
verses.text: Behold, the days come when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon. Nothing shall be left, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:7
verses.text: And of your sons which shall issue from you, which you shall bring out, they shall take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:8
verses.text: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good <hi>is</hi> the word of the LORD which you have spoken. And he said, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:1
verses.text: Comfort, O comfort my people, says your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:2
verses.text: Speak lovingly to the heart of Jerusalem, and cry to her that her warfare is done, that her iniquity is pardoned; for she has received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:3
verses.text: The voice of him who cries in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the LORD, make straight a highway in the desert for our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:4
verses.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low; and the crooked places shall be made level, and the rough places smooth;

verses.name: Isaiah 40:5
verses.text: and the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see <hi>it</hi> together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:6
verses.text: The voice said, Cry! And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh <hi>is</hi> grass, and all the beauty of it <hi>is</hi> as the flower of the field.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:7
verses.text: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the Spirit of the LORD blows on it; surely the people <hi>is</hi> grass.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:8
verses.text: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God shall stand forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:9
verses.text: Go up for yourself on the high mountain, bringer of good tidings to Zion. Lift up your voice with strength, O you who bring good tidings to Jerusalem; lift up, do not be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

verses.name: Isaiah 40:10
verses.text: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will come with a strong <hi>hand</hi>, and His arm shall rule for Him; behold, His reward <hi>is</hi> with Him, and His work before Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:11
verses.text: He shall feed His flock like a shepherd; He shall gather the lambs with His arm, and carry <hi>them</hi> in His bosom, <hi>and</hi> shall gently lead those with young.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:12
verses.text: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and measured out the heavens with a span? And who has shut up the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:13
verses.text: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, and what man taught Him counsel?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:14
verses.text: With whom did He take counsel, and <hi>who</hi> instructed Him and taught Him in the path of judgment, and taught Him knowledge, and made known the way of understanding to Him?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:15
verses.text: Behold, the nations <hi>are</hi> like a drop in a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the scales; behold, He takes up the coastlands as a very little thing.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:16
verses.text: And Lebanon <hi>is</hi> not enough to burn, nor the beasts of it enough <hi>for</hi> a burnt offering.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:17
verses.text: All nations before Him <hi>are</hi> as nothing; and to Him they are thought to be less than nothing, and vanity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:18
verses.text: To whom then will you compare God? Or what likeness will you compare to Him?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:19
verses.text: The workman melts a graven image, and the goldsmith spreads it over with gold, and casts silver chains.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:20
verses.text: He too poor for <hi>that</hi> offering chooses a tree that will not rot; he looks for a skillful workman to prepare a graven image that will not totter.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:21
verses.text: Have you not known? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood <hi>from</hi> the foundations of the earth?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:22
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> He who sits on the circle of the earth, and its people are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;

verses.name: Isaiah 40:23
verses.text: who brings the rulers to nothing; He makes the judges of the earth as vanity.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:24
verses.text: Yes, they shall not be planted; yes, they shall not be sown. Yes, their stump shall not take root in the earth. And He shall also blow on them, and they shall wither, and the tempest shall take them away like stubble.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:25
verses.text: To whom then will you compare Me, or <hi>am</hi> I equaled? says the Holy One.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:26
verses.text: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold, who has created these, who brings out their host by number? He calls them all by names by the greatness of His might, for He is strong in power; not one is lacking.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:27
verses.text: Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, My way is hidden from the LORD and my judgment has passed over from my God?

verses.name: Isaiah 40:28
verses.text: Have you not known? Have you not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, does not grow weak nor weary? <hi>There is</hi> no searching of His understanding.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:29
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> gives power to the weary; and to him with no vigor; He increases strength.

verses.name: Isaiah 40:30
verses.text: Even the young shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall;

verses.name: Isaiah 40:31
verses.text: but those who wait on the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up <hi>with</hi> wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:1
verses.text: Keep silence before Me, O coasts; and peoples shall renew strength; let them come near; then let them speak; let us come near together for judgment.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:2
verses.text: Who raised up the righteous one from the east, called him to His foot, gave the nations before him, and made <hi>him</hi> rule over kings? He gave them as the dust <hi>to</hi> his sword, <hi>and</hi> as driven stubble <hi>to</hi> his bow.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:3
verses.text: He pursued them; he passed on in peace. He does not go <hi>by</hi> the way of his feet.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:4
verses.text: Who has planned and done <hi>it</hi>, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I the LORD <hi>am</hi> the first and the last; I <hi>am</hi> He.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:5
verses.text: The coastlands saw and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, and drew near, and came.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:6
verses.text: They each one helped his neighbor, and said to his brother, Be strong.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:7
verses.text: So the artisan strengthens the refiner, and he smoothing <hi>with</hi> the hammer, him who struck the anvil, saying of soldering, It <hi>is</hi> good. And he made it strong with nails; it will not totter.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:8
verses.text: But you, Israel, <hi>are</hi> My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham, My friend;

verses.name: Isaiah 41:9
verses.text: whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you from its sides. And I said to you, You <hi>are</hi> My servant; I have chosen you, and not cast you away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:10
verses.text: Do not fear; for I <hi>am</hi> with you; be not dismayed; for I <hi>am</hi> your God. I will make you strong; yes, I will help you; yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of My righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:11
verses.text: Behold, all those who were angered against you shall be ashamed and confounded; they shall be as nothing. And those who fight with you shall perish.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:12
verses.text: You shall seek them, and shall not find them; men warring against you shall be as nothing, and as ceasing.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:13
verses.text: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:14
verses.text: Do not fear, worm of Jacob <hi>and</hi> men of Israel; I will help you, says the LORD, and your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:15
verses.text: Behold, I make you a new sharp threshing instrument, a master of teeth; you shall thresh the mountains, and beat <hi>them</hi> small, and shall make the hills like chaff.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:16
verses.text: You shall winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and a tempest shall scatter them. And you shall rejoice in the LORD <hi>and</hi> shall glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:17
verses.text: The poor and needy seek water, and <hi>there is</hi> none; their tongue fails for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not leave them.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:18
verses.text: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:19
verses.text: I will plant the cedar in the wilderness, the acacia tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree. I will set the fir tree in the desert, <hi>and</hi> the pine, and the box tree together;

verses.name: Isaiah 41:20
verses.text: so that they may see, and know, and look on, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:21
verses.text: Bring near your cause, says the LORD; bring out your strong <hi>reasons</hi>, says the King of Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:22
verses.text: Let them bring <hi>them</hi> out, and tell us what shall happen; let them reveal the former things, what they <hi>are</hi>, that we may look on them and know the final end of them; or declare to us things to come.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:23
verses.text: Reveal the near things after this, so that we may know that you <hi>are</hi> gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, so that we may be amazed and see together.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:24
verses.text: Behold, you <hi>are</hi> of nothing, and your work of nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:25
verses.text: I have raised up <hi>one</hi> from the north, and he shall come from the sunrise; he will call on My name. And he shall come <hi>on</hi> rulers as <hi>on</hi> mortar, and as the potter tramples clay.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:26
verses.text: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? And beforetime, that we may say, <hi>He is</hi> righteous? Yea, no one declares; yea, no one proclaims; yea, no one hears your words.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:27
verses.text: I first <hi>shall say</hi> to Zion, Behold! Behold them! and I will give to Jerusalem one who bears good news.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:28
verses.text: For I looked, and <hi>there was</hi> no man; and of these no counselor was, that I might ask and they could answer.

verses.name: Isaiah 41:29
verses.text: Behold, they <hi>are</hi> all evil; their works <hi>are</hi> nothing; their images <hi>are</hi> wind and vanity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:1
verses.text: Behold My Servant, whom I uphold; My Elect, <hi>in whom</hi> My soul delights. I have put My Spirit on Him; He shall bring out judgment to the nations.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:2
verses.text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause His voice to be heard in the street.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:3
verses.text: A bruised reed He shall not break, and a smoking wick He shall not quench; He shall bring out judgment to truth.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:4
verses.text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged until He has set judgment in the earth; and the coasts shall wait for His law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:5
