verses.text: So says Jehovah God, <hi>He</hi> who created the heavens and stretched them out, spreading out the earth and its offspring; He who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk in it.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:6
verses.text: I the LORD have called You in righteousness, and will hold Your hand, and will keep You, and give You for a covenant of the people, for a Light of the nations;

verses.name: Isaiah 42:7
verses.text: to open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, those who sit in darkness out of the prison house.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:8
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD; that <hi>is</hi> My name; and My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise to graven images.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:9
verses.text: Behold, the former things have come to pass, and new things I declare; before they happen, I cause you to hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:10
verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; His praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and its fullness; coasts and their peoples.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:11
verses.text: Let the wilderness and its cities lift up <hi>their voice</hi>, the villages where Kedar dwells. Let the dwellers of the rock sing, let them shout from the mountain tops.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:12
verses.text: Give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the coastlands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:13
verses.text: The LORD goes out as a warrior, He stirs up zeal like a man of wars; He shouts, yea, roars; He overcomes His enemies.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:14
verses.text: I have kept silence from forever; I have been still and refrained Myself. <hi>Now</hi> I will cry like a woman in pangs of labor, I will pant and gasp at once.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:15
verses.text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their plants. And I will make the rivers coastlands, and I will dry up the pools.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:16
verses.text: And I will bring the blind by a way they knew not; I will lead them in paths they have not known; I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. I will do these things to them, and not forsake them.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:17
verses.text: They are turned back, they are greatly ashamed, those who trust in graven images and who say to the images, You <hi>are</hi> our gods.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:18
verses.text: Hear, deaf ones; and blind ones look to see.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:19
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> blind but My servant? Or deaf, as My messenger whom I sent? Who <hi>is</hi> blind as he who is perfect, and blind as the LORD's servant?

verses.name: Isaiah 42:20
verses.text: You see many things, but do not pay attention. <hi>Your</hi> ears <hi>are</hi> open, but not any hears.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:21
verses.text: The LORD is well pleased for His righteousness sake; He will magnify the Law and make <hi>it</hi> honorable.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:22
verses.text: But this <hi>is</hi> a people robbed and spoiled; all of them snared in holes, and they are hidden in prison-houses; they have been taken, and none delivers them; a prize, and none says, Give back.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:23
verses.text: Who among you will hear this? He will listen and hear for the time to come?

verses.name: Isaiah 42:24
verses.text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to robbers? Did not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in His ways, nor did they obey His law.

verses.name: Isaiah 42:25
verses.text: So He has poured on him the fury of His anger, and the strength of battle. And it has set him on fire all around, yet he did not know; and it burned him, yet he did not lay <hi>it</hi> to heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:1
verses.text: But now so says the LORD who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel; Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called <hi>you</hi> by your name; you <hi>are</hi> Mine.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:2
verses.text: When you pass through the waters, I <hi>will be</hi> with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; nor shall the flame kindle on you.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:3
verses.text: For I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I gave Egypt <hi>for</hi> your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:4
verses.text: Since you were precious in My sight, you have been honored, and I have loved you; therefore I will give men for you, and people for your life.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:5
verses.text: Fear not; for I <hi>am</hi> with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:6
verses.text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Do not keep back; bring My sons from far and My daughters from the ends of the earth;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:7
verses.text: everyone who is called by My name; for I have created him for My glory, I have formed him; yea, <hi>I have</hi> made him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:8
verses.text: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:9
verses.text: Let all the nations be brought together, and let the people be gathered; who among them can declare this and make us hear former things? Let them bring out their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, <hi>It is</hi> true.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:10
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> My witnesses, says the LORD, and My servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe Me, and understand that I <hi>am</hi> He. Before Me no God was formed, nor shall there be after Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:11
verses.text: I, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD; and <hi>there is</hi> none to save besides Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:12
verses.text: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shown, when <hi>there was</hi> no strange <hi>god</hi> among you; therefore you <hi>are</hi> My witnesses, says the LORD, that I <hi>am</hi> God.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:13
verses.text: Yea, before the day <hi>was</hi>, I <hi>am</hi> He; and no one delivers out of My hand; I will work, and who will reverse it?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:14
verses.text: So says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all of them <hi>as</hi> fugitives, and the Chaldeans, whose shout <hi>is</hi> in the ships.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:15
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:16
verses.text: So says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters;

verses.name: Isaiah 43:17
verses.text: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise; they are put out, they are snuffed out like a wick.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:18
verses.text: Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:19
verses.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall sprout; shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, rivers in the desert.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:20
verses.text: The beasts of the field shall honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to My people, My chosen.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:21
verses.text: This people <hi>that</hi> I formed for Myself; they shall declare My praise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:22
verses.text: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of Me, O Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:23
verses.text: You have not brought Me the lamb of your burnt offerings; nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:24
verses.text: You have bought Me no sweet cane with silver, nor have you filled Me <hi>with</hi> the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:25
verses.text: I, I <hi>am</hi> He who blots out your sins for My own sake, and will not remember your sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:26
verses.text: Cause Me to remember; let us enter into judgment; declare yourself, that you may be justified.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:27
verses.text: Your first father has sinned, and your teachers have sinned against Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 43:28
verses.text: And I will defile rulers of the sanctuary, and will give Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:1
verses.text: Yet now hear, O Jacob My servant, and Israel whom I have chosen;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:2
verses.text: So says the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, <hi>who</hi> will help you; Fear not, O Jacob My servant, and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:3
verses.text: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and floods on the dry ground. I will pour My spirit on your seed, and My blessing on your offspring;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:4
verses.text: and they shall spring up <hi>as</hi> among the grass, as willows by the water-courses.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:5
verses.text: One shall say, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, For the LORD, and be named by the name of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:6
verses.text: So says the LORD, the King of Israel, and His redeemer the LORD of hosts; I <hi>am</hi> the first, and I <hi>am</hi> the last; and besides Me <hi>there is</hi> no God.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:7
verses.text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it and set it in order for Me, since I placed the people of old? And the things that are coming, and shall come, let them declares to them.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:8
verses.text: Fear not, nor be afraid; have I not told you and made you hear since then? So you <hi>are</hi> My witnesses. Is there a God besides Me? Yea, <hi>there is</hi> none. I have not known a Rock.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:9
verses.text: Those who make a graven image <hi>are</hi> all of them vanity; and the things in which they delight shall not help; and they <hi>are</hi> their own witnesses. They do not see nor know, that they may be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:10
verses.text: Who has formed a god, or melted a graven image that is good for nothing?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:11
verses.text: Behold, all his companions shall be ashamed; and the craftsmen; they <hi>are</hi> from men. They shall assemble; all of them shall stand; they shall dread; they shall be ashamed together.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:12
verses.text: He engraves iron with a tool. He works in the coals, and forms it with hammers, and works it with the strength of his arms. Then, he is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is weak.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:13
verses.text: He fashions wood, and stretches a line; he marks it out with a pencil; he shapes it with carving tools, and he marks it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, to sit <hi>in the</hi> house.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:14
verses.text: He cuts down cedars, and takes cypress and oak, which he makes the trees of the forest strong for him; he plants a tree, and the rain makes <hi>it</hi> grow.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:15
verses.text: And it shall be for a man to burn; for he will take some of it and warm himself. Yes, he kindles <hi>it</hi> and bakes bread; yes, he makes a god and worships; he makes it a graven image and falls down to it.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:16
verses.text: He burns part of it in the fire; with part of it he eats flesh; he roasts roast and is satisfied; yea, he warms <hi>himself</hi>, and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:17
verses.text: And the rest of it he makes into a god, his graven image; he falls down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, Deliver me! for you <hi>are</hi> my god.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:18
verses.text: They have not known nor understood; for He has shut their eyes so that they cannot see; <hi>and</hi> their hearts so that they cannot understand.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:19
verses.text: And none thinks within his heart, nor <hi>is there</hi> knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread on the coals of it; I have roasted flesh and eaten; and shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:20
verses.text: He feeds on ashes; a deceived heart has turned him aside, so that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, <hi>Is there</hi> not a lie in my right hand?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:21
verses.text: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for you <hi>are</hi> My servant; I have formed you; you <hi>are</hi> My servant; O Israel, you shall not be forgotten by Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:22
verses.text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins; return to Me; for I have redeemed you.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:23
verses.text: Sing, O heavens; for the LORD has done <hi>it</hi>. Shout, lower parts of the earth. Break out into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every tree in it. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and glorified Himself in Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 44:24
verses.text: So says the LORD, your Redeemer, and He who formed you from the womb, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who makes all things; who stretches out the heavens alone; who spreads out the earth; who <hi>was</hi> with Me?

verses.name: Isaiah 44:25
verses.text: who brings to nothing the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns the wise backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:26
verses.text: who makes the word of His servant sure, and makes good the counsel of His messengers; who says to Jerusalem, She shall have people; and to the cities of Judah, You shall be built, and I will raise up the waste places of it;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:27
verses.text: who says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers;

verses.name: Isaiah 44:28
verses.text: who says of Cyrus, <hi>He is</hi> My shepherd, and shall do all My pleasure; even saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built; and to the temple, Your foundation shall be laid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:1
verses.text: So says the LORD to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have made strong in order to humble nations before him. And I will loosen the loins of kings, to open before him the two-leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:2
verses.text: I will go before you, and make hills level. I will break in pieces the bronze gates, and cut the iron bars in two.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:3
verses.text: And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, who calls <hi>you</hi> by your name, the God of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:4
verses.text: For Jacob My servant's sake, and Israel My chosen, I have even called you by your name; I have named you, though you have not known me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:5
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, and <hi>there is</hi> none else, no God besides Me; I clothed you, though you have not known Me;

verses.name: Isaiah 45:6
verses.text: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and to the sunset, that <hi>there is</hi> none besides Me. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, and there is none else;

verses.name: Isaiah 45:7
verses.text: forming the light and creating darkness; making peace and creating evil. I the LORD do all these <hi>things</hi>.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:8
verses.text: Drop down from above, O heavens, and let the clouds pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, and let salvation bear fruit; and let righteousness spring up together. I the LORD have created it.'

verses.name: Isaiah 45:9
verses.text: Woe to him who fights with the One who formed him, a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to its former, What are you making? Or your work, He <hi>has</hi> no hands?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:10
verses.text: Woe to him who says to <hi>his</hi> father, What are you fathering? Or to the woman, What are you laboring over?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:11
verses.text: So says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and the One who formed him, Do you ask Me of things to come? Do you give command to Me about My sons, and about the work of My hands?

verses.name: Isaiah 45:12
verses.text: I have made the earth, and created man on it; I <hi>with</hi> My hands have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:13
verses.text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways; he shall build My city, and he shall let My captives go, not for price nor reward, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:14
verses.text: So says the LORD, The labor of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia, and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come to you, and they shall be yours. They shall come after you in chains; and they shall cross in chains and they shall fall down to you. They shall plead to you, <hi>saying</hi>, Surely God <hi>is</hi> in you; and none else, no <hi>other</hi> God.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:15
verses.text: Truly You <hi>are</hi> a God who hides Yourself, O God of Israel, the Savior.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:16
verses.text: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them; they <hi>who are</hi> makers of idols shall go into disgrace together.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:17
verses.text: <hi> But</hi> Israel shall be saved in the LORD <hi>with</hi> an everlasting salvation. You shall not be ashamed nor blush to the forevers of eternity.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:18
verses.text: For so says the LORD the Creator of the heavens, He <hi>is</hi> God, forming the earth and making it; He makes it stand, not creating it empty, <hi>but</hi> forming it to be inhabited. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, and <hi>there is</hi> no other.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:19
verses.text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth. I did not say to the seed of Jacob, Seek me in vain. I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:20
verses.text: Gather yourselves and come; draw near together, escaped ones of the nations; those who set up the wood of their graven image, and those that pray to a god <hi>that</hi> cannot save. They know nothing.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:21
verses.text: Declare and bring near; yea, let them take counsel together. Who has declared this of old? <hi>Who</hi> has told it from then? Is it not I, the LORD? And <hi>there is</hi> no other God besides Me; a just God and a Savior; there is none besides Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:22
verses.text: Turn to Me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I <hi>am</hi> God, and there <hi>is</hi> no other.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:23
verses.text: I have sworn by Myself, the word has gone out of My mouth <hi>in</hi> righteousness, and shall not return, that to Me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:24
verses.text: He says, Only in the LORD do I have righteousness and strength; even to Him he comes. And they are ashamed, all who are angry with Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 45:25
verses.text: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:1
verses.text: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops; their idols were on the beasts and on the cattle; the things you carried about have become a load, a burden for the weary.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:2
verses.text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but they themselves have gone into captivity.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:3
verses.text: Listen to me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, who are borne <hi>by Me</hi> from the belly, who are lifted from the womb;

verses.name: Isaiah 46:4
verses.text: <hi> even</hi> to old age I <hi>am</hi> He; and to gray hairs I will bear <hi>you</hi>. I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver <hi>you</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:5
verses.text: To whom will you compare Me, and make <hi>Me</hi> equal, and compare Me, that we may be alike?

verses.name: Isaiah 46:6
verses.text: They pour gold out of the bag, and weigh silver out of the measuring rod, <hi>and</hi> hire a goldsmith; and he makes it a god; they fall down, yea, they bow down.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:7
verses.text: They carry it on the shoulder, they carry it and set it in its place, and it stands; it shall not move from its place. Yes, <hi>one</hi> shall cry to it, yet it cannot answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:8
verses.text: Remember this, and be a man; return <hi>it</hi> on <hi>your</hi> heart, O sinners.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:9
verses.text: Remember former things from forever; for I <hi>am</hi> God, and no other <hi>is</hi> God, even none like Me,

verses.name: Isaiah 46:10
verses.text: declaring the end from the beginning, and from the past things which were not done, saying, My purpose shall stand, and I will do all My pleasure;

verses.name: Isaiah 46:11
verses.text: calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of my purpose from a far country. Yes, I have spoken, I will also cause it to come; I have formed; yes, I will do it.

verses.name: Isaiah 46:12
verses.text: Listen to me, stubborn-hearted who <hi>are</hi> far from righteousness;

verses.name: Isaiah 46:13
verses.text: I bring near My righteousness. It shall not be far off, and My salvation shall not wait; and I will place salvation in Zion, My glory for Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:1
verses.text: Come down, and sit on the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground. <hi>There is</hi> no throne <hi>for you</hi>, O daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no more be called tender and delicate.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:2
verses.text: Take the millstones and grind meal. Push back your veil, draw up your skirt, uncover your leg, pass over the rivers.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:3
verses.text: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, your shame shall be seen; I will take vengeance and I will not meet <hi>you as</hi> a man.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:4
verses.text: Our Redeemer, the LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:5
verses.text: Sit silent, and go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for you shall no more be called the mistress of kingdoms.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:6
verses.text: I was angry with My people, I have polluted My inheritance, and given them into your hand. You showed them no mercy; you have very heavily laid your yoke on the aged.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:7
verses.text: And you said, I shall be a mistress forever; so you did not lay these <hi>things</hi> to your heart, nor remembered the latter end of it.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:8
verses.text: Now then hear this, O pleasure seeker, who lives carelessly; who says in her heart, I <hi>am</hi>, and none else <hi>is</hi>; I shall not sit <hi>as</hi> a widow, nor shall I know the loss of children

verses.name: Isaiah 47:9
verses.text: But these two <hi>things</hi> shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood. They shall come on you in their fullness for the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great power of your enchantments.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:10
verses.text: For you have trusted in your wickedness; you have said, No one sees me. Your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you; and you have said in your heart, I <hi>am</hi>, and there is no one else.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:11
verses.text: But evil shall come on you; you shall not know its origin. And mischief shall fall on you; you shall not be able to put it off. And desolation shall come on you suddenly, you shall not know.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:12
verses.text: Stand now with your spells, and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have wearied yourself since your youth. Perhaps you will be able to profit; perhaps you may bring terror.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:13
verses.text: You are exhausted by your many plans; now let the astrologers, the stargazers, making known what is coming on you into the new moons.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:14
verses.text: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame; <hi>there shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> a coal to warm them; nor fire, to sit before it.

verses.name: Isaiah 47:15
verses.text: So they are to you with whom you labored, your merchants from your youth. Each one wanders to his own way; none shall save you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:1
verses.text: Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of the LORD and make mention of the God of Israel (<hi> but</hi> not in truth nor in righteousness).

verses.name: Isaiah 48:2
verses.text: For they call themselves of the holy city, and rest themselves on the God of Israel; the LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:3
verses.text: I have foretold the former things from the beginning; and they went out of My mouth; and I made them hear; I acted suddenly; and they came about.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:4
verses.text: Because I knew that you <hi>are</hi> obstinate, and your neck <hi>is</hi> an iron sinew and your brow bronze.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:5
verses.text: And I declared <hi>it</hi> to you from the beginning. Before it happened I revealed it to you; lest you should say, My idol has done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, has commanded them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:6
verses.text: You heard; see it all; and will you not declare? I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, and you did not know them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:7
verses.text: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when you did not hear them; lest you should say, Behold, I knew them.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:8
verses.text: Yea, you did not hear; yea, you did not know; yea, from the time that your ear was not opened; for I surely know that you will betray and trespass; from the womb it was called to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:9
verses.text: For My name's sake I will put off My anger, and for My praise I will hold back for you, that I do not cut you off.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:10
verses.text: Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:11
verses.text: For my sake, for My sake I will do it; for why should <hi>My name</hi> be defiled? And I will not give My glory to another.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:12
verses.text: Listen to me, O Jacob and Israel, My called; I <hi>am</hi> He; I <hi>am</hi> the first, I also <hi>am</hi> the last.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:13
verses.text: My hand also has laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand has stretched out the heavens. I called; they stood up together.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:14
verses.text: Let all of you gather and hear; who among them has declared these <hi>things</hi>? The LORD has loved him; He will do His pleasure on Babylon, and His arm <hi>shall be</hi> on the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:15
verses.text: I, I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I brought him and he makes his way succeed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:16
verses.text: Come near to me, hear this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning. From its being, I <hi>was</hi> there; and now the Lord Jehovah, and His Spirit, has sent me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:17
verses.text: So says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:18
verses.text: Oh that you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:19
verses.text: And your seed would have been like the sand, and the offspring of your bowels like its grain; his name would not have been cut off nor destroyed from before Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:20
verses.text: Go out of Babylon; flee from the Chaldeans. Tell it with a voice of singing, let this be heard, let it go out to the end of the earth; say, The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:21
verses.text: And they did not thirst <hi>when</hi> He led them through the deserts; He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; He cut open the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

verses.name: Isaiah 48:22
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> no peace, says the LORD, to the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:1
verses.text: Listen, O coastlands, to Me; and listen, <hi>lend your ear</hi>, peoples from afar; the LORD has called Me from the womb; He has made mention of My name from My mother's bowels.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:2
verses.text: And He has made My mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He has hidden Me, and made Me a polished shaft. He has hidden Me in His quiver,

verses.name: Isaiah 49:3
verses.text: and said to Me, You <hi>are</hi> My servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:4
verses.text: Then I said, I have labored in vain; I have spent My strength for nothing, and in vain; <hi>yet</hi> surely My judgment is with the LORD, and My work with My God.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:5
verses.text: And now, says the LORD who formed Me from the womb <hi>to be</hi> His servant, to bring Jacob again to Him, Though Israel is not gathered, yet I shall be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and My God shall be My strength.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:6
verses.text: And He said, It is but a little <hi>thing</hi> that You should be My servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to bring back the preserved ones of Israel; I will also give You for a light to the nations, to be My salvation to the end of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:7
verses.text: So says the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, His Holy One, <hi>to Him</hi> whom man despises, <hi>to Him</hi> whom the nation hates, the servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise, rulers also shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and He shall choose You.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:8
verses.text: So says the LORD, in a favorable time I replied to You, and in a day of salvation I have helped You; and I will preserve You, and give You for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause them to inherit the wasted inheritances;

verses.name: Isaiah 49:9
verses.text: that You may say to the prisoners, Go out! To those who <hi>are</hi> in darkness, Show yourselves! They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:10
verses.text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; nor shall the heat nor sun strike them; for He who has mercy on them shall lead them; even by the springs of water He shall guide them.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:11
verses.text: And I will make all My mountains a way, and My highways shall be set on high.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:12
verses.text: Behold, these shall come from far; and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:13
verses.text: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break out <hi>into</hi> singing, O mountains; for the Lord has comforted His people, and will have mercy on His afflicted.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:14
verses.text: But Zion said, The LORD has forsaken me, and my LORD has forgotten me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:15
verses.text: Can a woman forget her suckling child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, they may forget, yet I will not forget you.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:16
verses.text: Behold, I have carved you on the palms of <hi>My</hi> hands; your walls <hi>are</hi> forever before Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:17
verses.text: Your sons shall make haste; those destroying you and ruining you shall go out from you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:18
verses.text: Lift up your eyes all around and see; they all gather <hi>and</hi> come to you. <hi>As</hi> I live, says the LORD, you shall surely wear them as an ornament, and bind them <hi>on</hi> as a bride.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:19
verses.text: For your wastes and your deserted places, and your land of ruins, shall even now be too narrow to dwell there, and they who swallowed you up shall be far away.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:20
verses.text: The sons of your bereavement shall yet say in your ears, The place <hi>is</hi> too narrow for me; come near to me so that I may dwell.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:21
verses.text: Then you shall say in your heart, Who has borne me these, since I <hi>am</hi> bereaved, and desolate, turned aside and an exile, and who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where <hi>were</hi> they?

verses.name: Isaiah 49:22
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and have set up My banner to the people; and they shall bring your sons in <hi>their</hi> bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on <hi>their</hi> shoulders.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:23
verses.text: And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your nurses. They shall bow to you, faces to the earth, and lick up the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD; by whom they shall not be ashamed who wait for Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:24
verses.text: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

verses.name: Isaiah 49:25
verses.text: But so says the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the fearful ones shall escape. For I will contend with him who contends with you, and I will save your sons.

verses.name: Isaiah 49:26
verses.text: And I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they shall be drunk with their own blood, as with sweet wine; and all flesh shall know that I the LORD <hi>am</hi> your Savior and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:1
verses.text: So says the LORD, Where <hi>is</hi> your mother's bill of divorce, whom I have put away? Or to which of My creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother is put away for your sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:2
verses.text: Who knows why I have come, and no one <hi>is here</hi>? I called and no one answered. Is My hand shortened at all so that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness; their fish stink, because there is no water, and die for thirst.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:3
verses.text: I clothe the heavens <hi>with</hi> blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:4
verses.text: The Lord Jehovah has given Me the tongue of the learned, to know to help the weary <hi>with</hi> a word. He wakens morning by morning, He wakens the ear to hear as the learned.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:5
verses.text: The Lord Jehovah has opened My ear, and I was not rebellious, nor turned away backwards.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:6
verses.text: I gave My back to the strikers, and My cheeks to pluckers; I did not hide My face from shame and spitting.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:7
verses.text: For the Lord Jehovah will help Me; therefore I have not been ashamed. On account of this I have set My face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:8
verses.text: <hi> He is</hi> near who justifies Me; who will contend with Me? Let us stand together; who <hi>is</hi> master of My judgment? Let him come near Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:9
verses.text: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help Me; who <hi>is</hi> he <hi>who</hi> shall condemn Me? Lo, they all shall wear out like a garment; the moth shall eat them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:10
verses.text: Who among you fears the LORD, who obeys the voice of His servant, who walks <hi>in</hi> darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD and rest on his God.

verses.name: Isaiah 50:11
verses.text: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who are surrounded <hi>with</hi> sparks; walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks which you have kindled. This you shall have of My hand; you shall lie down in sorrow.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:1
verses.text: Listen to me, pursuers of righteousness; seekers of the LORD: Look to the rock <hi>from which</hi> you were cut, and to the hole of the pit <hi>from which</hi> you were dug.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:2
verses.text: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah <hi>who</hi> bore you; for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:3
verses.text: For the LORD shall comfort Zion; He will comfort all her waste places; and He will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness shall be found in it, thanksgiving and the voice of melody.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:4
verses.text: Listen to Me, My people; and give ear to Me, O My nation; for a law shall go out from Me, and I will make My judgment to rest for a light of peoples.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:5
verses.text: My righteousness <hi>is</hi> near; My salvation has gone out, and My arms shall judge peoples; the coastlands shall wait on Me, and on My arm they shall trust.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:6
verses.text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look on the earth beneath; for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall become old like a garment; and its inhabitants shall die in the same way. But My salvation shall be forever, and My righteousness shall not be broken.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:7
verses.text: Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart <hi>is</hi> My law; do not fear the reproach of men, nor be afraid of their revelings.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:8
verses.text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool; but My righteousness shall be forever, and My salvation from generation to generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:9
verses.text: Awake! awake! Put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Awake! as in the days of old, in the generations of old. Was it not You <hi>who</hi> cut Rahab into pieces, piercing the sea-monster?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:10
verses.text: Was it not You <hi>who</hi> dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:11
verses.text: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return and come with singing into Zion; and everlasting joy <hi>shall be</hi> on their head. Gladness and joy shall overtake <hi>them</hi>; sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:12
verses.text: I, I, <hi>am</hi> He who comforts you. Who <hi>are</hi> you, that you should fear a man. He shall die, or from the son of man? He shall be made <hi>as</hi> grass?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:13
verses.text: And you forget the LORD your Maker, who has stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. And you dread continually, every day, because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy. And where <hi>is</hi> the fury of the oppressor?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:14
verses.text: Bowed he hurries to be freed, and not <hi>that</hi> he should die in the pit, nor that he <hi>lack</hi> his bread.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:15
verses.text: But I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, who divided the sea, and its waves roared; the LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:16
verses.text: And I have put My words in your mouth, and I have covered you in the shadow of My hand, that I may plant the heavens and lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, You <hi>are</hi> My people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:17
verses.text: Awake! Awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, who drank the cup of His fury from the hand of the LORD; you have drunk the cup of reeling to the dregs, <hi>and</hi> wrung <hi>them</hi> out.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:18
verses.text: No guide <hi>is</hi> for her among all the sons she has borne; and none takes her by the hand of all the sons <hi>that</hi> she made to grow.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:19
verses.text: These two <hi>things</hi> have come to you, who shall be sorry for you? Desolation, and ruin, and the famine, and the sword. By whom shall I comfort you?

verses.name: Isaiah 51:20
verses.text: Your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the street like a wild antelope <hi>in</hi> a net, filled with the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:21
verses.text: So now hear this, afflicted one, and drunken, but not with wine.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:22
verses.text: So says your Lord Jehovah, and your God <hi>who</hi> strives <hi>for</hi> His people, Behold, I have taken the cup of reeling from your hand, even the dregs of the cup of My fury; you shall never drink it again.

verses.name: Isaiah 51:23
verses.text: But I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, Bow down so that we may cross; and put your back as the ground, even as the street to those who cross.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:1
verses.text: Awake! Awake! Put on your strength, Zion; put on your beautiful robes, O Jerusalem, the holy city. For never again shall come to you uncircumcised and unclean ones.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:2
verses.text: Shake yourself from the dust; rise up! Sit, Jerusalem! Free yourself from your neckbands, O captive daughter of Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:3
verses.text: For so says the LORD, You <hi>were</hi> sold for nothing; and you shall not be redeemed with silver.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:4
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah, My people went down before <hi>into</hi> Egypt to stay there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:5
verses.text: Now therefore, what have I here, says the LORD, that My people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule <hi>make them</hi> howl, says the LORD; and without ceasing My name is blasphemed every day.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:6
verses.text: Therefore My people shall know My name; So <hi>it shall be</hi> in that day, for I <hi>am</hi> He who speaks; behold, <hi>it is</hi> I.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:7
verses.text: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good tidings, making peace heard; who brings good news, making salvation heard; who says to Zion, Your God reigns!

verses.name: Isaiah 52:8
verses.text: The voice of Your watchmen shall lift up! They lift up the voice together; they sing aloud. For they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:9
verses.text: Break out, sing together, waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:10
verses.text: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:11
verses.text: Turn! Turn! Go out from there! Touch not the unclean. Go out of her midst; purify yourself, bearers of the vessels of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:12
verses.text: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight; for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel gathers you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:13
verses.text: Behold, My Servant shall rule well; He shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

verses.name: Isaiah 52:14
verses.text: Just as many were astonished at You (so <hi>much was</hi> the disfigurement from man, His appearance and His form from the sons of mankind);

verses.name: Isaiah 52:15
verses.text: so He sprinkles from many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at Him; for they will see <hi>that</hi> which <hi>was</hi> not told to them; yea, what they had not heard, nor understood.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:1
verses.text: Who has believed our report? And to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

verses.name: Isaiah 53:2
verses.text: For He comes up before Him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground; He has no form nor majesty that we should see Him, nor an appearance that we should desire Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:3
verses.text: <hi> He is</hi> despised and rejected of men; a Man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief; and as it were a hiding of faces from Him, He being despised, and we esteemed Him not.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:4
verses.text: Surely He has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows; yet we esteemed Him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:5
verses.text: But He <hi>was</hi> wounded for our transgressions; <hi>He was</hi> bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace <hi>was</hi> on Him; and with His stripes we ourselves are healed.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:6
verses.text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned, each one to his own way; and the LORD has laid on Him the iniquity of us all.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:7
verses.text: He was oppressed, and He was afflicted; yet He opened not His mouth. He is brought as a lamb to the slaughter; and as a sheep before its shearers is dumb, so He opened not His mouth.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:8
verses.text: He was taken from prison and from judgment; and who shall declare His generation? For He was cut off out of the land of the living; for the transgression of My people He <hi>was</hi> stricken.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:9
verses.text: And He put His grave with the wicked, and with a rich one in His death; although He had done no violence, nor <hi>was any</hi> deceit in His mouth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:10
verses.text: Yet it pleased the LORD to crush Him; to grieve Him; <hi>that</hi> He should put forth His soul as a guilt-offering. He shall see <hi>His</hi> seed, He shall prolong <hi>His</hi> days, and the will of the LORD shall prosper in His hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:11
verses.text: He shall see <hi>the fruit</hi> of the travail of His soul. He shall be fully satisfied. By His knowledge shall My righteous Servant justify for many; and He shall bear their iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 53:12
verses.text: Therefore I will divide to Him with the great, and He shall divide the spoil with the strong; because He has poured out His soul to death; and He was counted among the transgressors; and He bore the sin of many, and made intercession for transgressors.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:1
verses.text: Rejoice, O unfruitful one <hi>that</hi> never bore; break out a song and shout, <hi>you</hi> who never travailed. For more <hi>are</hi> the sons of the desolate than the sons of the married woman, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:2
verses.text: Make the place of your tent larger, and let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings. Do not spare, lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes;

verses.name: Isaiah 54:3
verses.text: for you shall break out <hi>on</hi> the right hand and on the left. And your seed shall inherit the nations, and people will inhabit ruined cities.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:4
verses.text: Do not fear; for you shall not be ashamed, nor shall you blush; for you shall not be put to shame; for you shall forget the shame of your youth, and shall not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:5
verses.text: For your Maker <hi>is</hi> your husband; the LORD of hosts is His name; and your Redeemer <hi>is</hi> the Holy One of Israel; the God of the whole earth shall He be called.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:6
verses.text: For the LORD has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when you were rejected, says your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:7
verses.text: For a little moment I have left you; but with great mercies I will gather you.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:8
verses.text: In a little wrath I hid My face from you <hi>for</hi> a moment; but with everlasting kindness I will have mercy on you, says the LORD your Redeemer.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:9
verses.text: For this <hi>is as</hi> the waters of Noah to Me; <hi>for as</hi> I swore that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth, so I have sworn from being angry with you and from rebuking you.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:10
verses.text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but My kindness shall not depart from you, nor shall the covenant of My peace be removed, says the LORD who has mercy on you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:11
verses.text: Afflicted one, storm-tossed <hi>and</hi> not comforted, behold, I will lay your stones among antimony, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:12
verses.text: And I will make your battlements of ruby, and your gates of carbuncles, and all your borders of pleasant stones.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:13
verses.text: And all your sons <hi>shall be</hi> taught of the LORD; and great <hi>shall be</hi> the peace of your sons.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:14
verses.text: In righteousness you shall be established; you shall be far from oppression; for you shall not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near you.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:15
verses.text: Behold, they shall surely gather together, not by Me; whoever shall gather against you, he shall fall by you.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:16
verses.text: Behold, I have created the smith who blows the coals in the fire, and who brings out a tool for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

verses.name: Isaiah 54:17
verses.text: No weapon that is formed against you shall be blessed; and every tongue that shall rise against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This <hi>is</hi> the inheritance of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness <hi>is</hi> from Me, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:1
verses.text: Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and he who <hi>has</hi> no money, come, buy and eat. Yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:2
verses.text: Why do you weigh silver for <hi>what is</hi> not bread? and your labor for <hi>what</hi> never satisfies? Listen carefully to Me, and eat <hi>what is</hi> good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:3
verses.text: Bow down your ear, and come to Me; hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:4
verses.text: Behold, I have given Him <hi>for</hi> a witness to the people, a Leader and Commander of peoples.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:5
verses.text: Behold, You shall call a nation that You do not know; a nation <hi>that</hi> did not know You shall run to You because of the LORD Your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for He has glorified You.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:6
verses.text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:7
verses.text: Let the wicked forsake His way, and the unrighteous man His thoughts; and let him return to the LORD, and He will have mercy on him; and to our God, for He will abundantly pardon.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:8
verses.text: For My thoughts <hi>are</hi> not your thoughts, nor your ways My ways, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:9
verses.text: For <hi>as</hi> the heavens are higher than the earth, so are My ways higher than your ways, and My thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:10
verses.text: For as the rain comes down, and the snow from the heavens, and does not return there, but waters the earth, and makes it bring out and bud, and give seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

verses.name: Isaiah 55:11
verses.text: so shall My word be, which goes out of My mouth; it shall not return to Me void, but it shall accomplish what I please, and it shall certainly do what I sent it to do.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:12
verses.text: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace; the mountains and the hills shall break out before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap <hi>their</hi> hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 55:13
verses.text: Instead of the thorn, the fir tree shall come up; and instead of the brier, the myrtle tree shall come up; and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign <hi>which</hi> shall not be cut off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:1
verses.text: So says the LORD, Keep judgment and do justice; for My salvation <hi>is</hi> near to come, and My righteousness to be revealed.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:2
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who does this, and the son of man who lays hold on it; keeping the sabbath, from defiling it; and keeping his hand from doing any evil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:3
verses.text: And do not let the son of the stranger, who has joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, the LORD has utterly separated me from His people. And do not let the eunuch say, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> a dry tree.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:4
verses.text: For so says the LORD to the eunuchs who keep My sabbath, and choose things that please Me, and take hold of My covenant;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:5
verses.text: even to them will I give within My house and within My walls a hand and a name better than of sons and of daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:6
verses.text: Also the sons of the stranger, who join themselves to the LORD to serve Him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be His servants, everyone who keeps from defiling the sabbath, and takes hold of My covenant;

verses.name: Isaiah 56:7
verses.text: even them I will bring to My holy mountain, and make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices <hi>shall be</hi> accepted on My altar; for My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples,

verses.name: Isaiah 56:8
verses.text: says the Lord Jehovah who gathers the outcasts of Israel, Yet I will gather beside him his gathered ones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:9
verses.text: All beasts of the field, come to devour, all beasts in the forest.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:10
verses.text: His watchmen <hi>are</hi> blind; they are all ignorant; they <hi>are</hi> all dumb dogs who cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:11
verses.text: Yea, <hi>they are</hi> greedy dogs which can never have enough; and they <hi>are</hi> shepherds <hi>who</hi> cannot understand. They all look to their own way, every one for his gain, to his own end.

verses.name: Isaiah 56:12
verses.text: <hi> They say</hi>, come, Let us take wine, and let us gulp strong drink; and tomorrow shall be like today, and much more abundant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:1
verses.text: The righteous one perishes, and no one lays <hi>it</hi> to heart, and merciful men <hi>are</hi> taken away; no one cares that the righteous is taken away from the face of evil.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:2
verses.text: He shall enter into peace; they shall rest in their beds, each one walking <hi>in</hi> his uprightness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:3
verses.text: But draw near here, sons of the sorceress, seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:4
verses.text: Of whom are you making sport? Against whom do you make a wide mouth <hi>and</hi> draw out the tongue? <hi>Are</hi> you not children of transgression, a lying seed,

verses.name: Isaiah 57:5
verses.text: being inflamed with idols under every green tree, killing the little sons in the valleys under the clefts of the rocks?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:6
verses.text: Among the smooth <hi>stones</hi> of the stream is your portion; they, <hi>even</hi> they, <hi>are</hi> your lot; even to them you have poured a drink offering, you have offered a food offering. Should I be consoled over these?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:7
verses.text: On a lofty and high mountain you have set your bed; even there you went up to offer sacrifice.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:8
verses.text: Also behind the door and the post you have set up your image; for you uncovered <hi>yourself</hi> and went up from Me. You spread your bed and cut <hi>a covenant</hi> with them; you loved their bed where you looked.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:9
verses.text: And you went to the king with ointment, and increased your perfumes, and sent your messengers far off, and lowered <hi>yourself even</hi> to hell.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:10
verses.text: You are wearied in the length of your way; you did not say, Despair! You found life in your hand; so you were not weak.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:11
verses.text: And of whom have you been afraid or feared, that you have lied and have not remembered Me, nor laid <hi>it</hi> to your heart? Have I not been silent, even from forever, and you did not fear Me?

verses.name: Isaiah 57:12
verses.text: I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall not do you any good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:13
verses.text: When you cry, let your gathering deliver you; but the wind shall carry them all away. Vanity shall take <hi>them</hi>; but he who puts his trust in Me shall possess the land, and shall inherit My holy mountain.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:14
verses.text: And He shall say, Raise up! Raise up! Clear the way! Make the stumbling-block rise out of the way of My people.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:15
verses.text: For so says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity; whose name <hi>is</hi> Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, even with the contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:16
verses.text: For I will not contend forever, nor will I be always angry; for the spirit should fail before Me, and the souls I have made.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:17
verses.text: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry and struck him; I hid Myself, and was angry, and he went on turning away in the way of his heart.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:18
verses.text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will also lead him, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:19
verses.text: <hi> I</hi> create the fruit of the lips; peace, peace, to him far off, and to him near, says the LORD; and I will heal him.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:20
verses.text: But the wicked <hi>are</hi> like the troubled sea, which cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.

verses.name: Isaiah 57:21
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> no peace, says my God, to the wicked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:1
verses.text: Cry aloud, do not spare, lift up your voice like a ram's horn, and show My people their rebellion, and the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:2
verses.text: Yet they seek Me daily, and delight to know My ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and one who did not forget the ordinance of their God. They ask of Me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in drawing near to God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:3
verses.text: <hi> They say</hi>, Why have we fasted, and You do not see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and You take no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and crush all your laborers.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:4
verses.text: Behold, you fast for strife and debate, and to strike with the fist of wickedness; you shall not fast as <hi>you do</hi> today, to make your voice to be heard on high.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:5
verses.text: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to afflict his soul? <hi>Is it</hi> to bow down his head like a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? Will you call this a fast and a day pleasing to the LORD?

verses.name: Isaiah 58:6
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> not this the fast that I have chosen? To loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed ones go free, and that you break every yoke?

verses.name: Isaiah 58:7
verses.text: <hi> Is it</hi> not to break your bread to the hungry, and that you should bring home the wandering poor? When will you see the naked and cover him; and you will not hide yourself from your own flesh?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:8
verses.text: Then shall your light break out as the dawn, and your health shall spring out quickly; and your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of the LORD shall gather you.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:9
verses.text: Then you shall call, and the LORD shall answer; you shall cry, and He shall say, Here I <hi>am</hi>. If you take the yoke away from among you, the pointing of the finger, and speaking vanity;

verses.name: Isaiah 58:10
verses.text: and <hi>if</hi> you draw out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light rise in darkness, and your darkness <hi>shall be</hi> as the noonday.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:11
verses.text: And the LORD shall always guide you and satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones fat; and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters fail not.

verses.name: Isaiah 58:12
verses.text: And <hi>those who</hi> come of you shall build the old ruins; you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; and you shall be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:13
verses.text: If you turn your foot because of the Sabbath, <hi>from</hi> doing what you please on My holy days, and call the Sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honorable; and shall honor Him, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking <hi>your own</hi> words,

verses.name: Isaiah 58:14
verses.text: then you shall delight yourself in the LORD; and I will cause you to ride on the high places of the earth, and feed yourself with the inheritance of Jacob your father. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:1
verses.text: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened so that it cannot save, nor is His ear heavy so that it cannot hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:2
verses.text: But your iniquities have come between you and your God, and your sins have hidden <hi>His</hi> face from you, from hearing.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:3
verses.text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue has muttered perverseness.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:4
verses.text: None calls for justice, nor does anyone plead for truth; they trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and bring out iniquity.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:5
verses.text: They hatch adders' eggs and weave the spider's web; he who eats their eggs dies, and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:6
verses.text: Their webs shall not become clothing, nor shall they cover themselves with their works; their works <hi>are</hi> works of iniquity, and the act of violence <hi>is</hi> in their hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:7
verses.text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood; their thoughts <hi>are</hi> thoughts of iniquity; wasting and ruin <hi>are</hi> in their paths.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:8
verses.text: They did not know the way of peace, and <hi>there is</hi> no judgment in their paths. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them shall not know peace.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:9
verses.text: Therefore judgment is far from us; nor does justice overtake us. We wait for light, but behold, dimness; for brightness, <hi>but</hi> we walk in darkness.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:10
verses.text: We grope <hi>for</hi> the wall like the blind, and we grope as if <hi>we had</hi> no eyes. We stumble at noonday as in the night; <hi>we are</hi> in deserted places like dead men.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:11
verses.text: We all roar like bears, and mourn grievously like doves; we look for judgment, but none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:12
verses.text: For our transgressions <hi>are</hi> multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. For our transgressions are with us; and <hi>as for</hi> our iniquities, we know them;

verses.name: Isaiah 59:13
verses.text: in transgressing and lying against the LORD, and going away from our God, talking cruelty and revolt, conceiving and speaking from the heart words of falsehood.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:14
verses.text: And justice is driven back, and justice stands afar off; for truth has fallen in the street, and right cannot enter.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:15
verses.text: Yea, truth fails; and he <hi>who</hi> departs from evil makes himself a prey. And the LORD saw, and it displeased Him that <hi>there was</hi> no judgment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:16
verses.text: And He saw that <hi>there was</hi> no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore His own arm brought salvation to Him; and His righteousness sustained Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:17
verses.text: For He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on His head. And He put on the garments of vengeance <hi>for</hi> clothing, and was covered with zeal like a cloak.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:18
verses.text: According to <hi>their</hi> deeds, accordingly He will repay; fury to His foes, deed for deed to His enemies. He will repay their deeds to the coastlands.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:19
verses.text: So they shall fear the name of the LORD from the west, and His glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall make him flee.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:20
verses.text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and to those who turn from transgression in Jacob, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 59:21
verses.text: As for Me, this <hi>is</hi> My covenant with them, says the LORD; My spirit that is on you, and My words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed's seed, says the LORD, from now on and forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:1
verses.text: Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen on you.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:2
verses.text: For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness <hi>the</hi> peoples; but the LORD shall rise on you, and His glory shall be seen on you.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:3
verses.text: And the nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawning.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:4
verses.text: Lift up your eyes all around, and see. All of them gather themselves; they come to you. Your sons shall come from far, and your daughters shall be nursed at <hi>your</hi> side.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:5
verses.text: Then you shall fear and become bright, and your heart shall throb and swell for joy; because the abundance of the sea shall turn to you, the wealth of the nations will come to you.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:6
verses.text: A host of camels shall cover you, the camels of Midian and Ephah. All of them from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall proclaim the praises of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:7
verses.text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you. They shall come up on My altar pleasing Me, and I will glorify the house of My glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:8
verses.text: Who <hi>are</hi> these <hi>who</hi> fly like a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:9
verses.text: Surely the coastlands shall wait for Me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, to the name of the LORD your God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because He has glorified you.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:10
verses.text: And the sons of strangers will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in My wrath I struck you, but in My favor I had mercy on you.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:11
verses.text: Therefore your gates will always be open; they will not be shut day nor night, to bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings may be led.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:12
verses.text: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you will perish. Yes, <hi>those</hi> nations will be completely wasted.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:13
verses.text: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of My sanctuary; and I will make the place of My feet glorious.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:14
verses.text: Also the sons of your afflicters shall come bowing to you; and all your despisers will bow down at the soles of your feet. And they will call you, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:15
verses.text: Instead of being forsaken and hated, so that no one passes through, I will make you for everlasting majesty, a joy of many generations.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:16
verses.text: You will also suck the milk of nations, and suck the breast of kings; and you will know that I the LORD <hi>am</hi> your Savior and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:17
verses.text: For bronze I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver; and for wood I will bring bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make your overseers to be peace, and your rulers to be righteousness.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:18
verses.text: Violence will no more be heard in your land, wasting nor ruin within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:19
verses.text: The sun will no more be your light by day; nor the brightness of the moon give light to you; but the LORD will be to you for everlasting light, and your God your glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:20
verses.text: Your sun will no more go down, nor your moon withdraw; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will be ended.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:21
verses.text: Your people also <hi>will</hi> all <hi>be</hi> righteous; they will inherit the land forever, the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.

verses.name: Isaiah 60:22
verses.text: A little one will become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in its time.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:1
verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah <hi>is</hi> on Me; because the LORD has anointed Me to preach the Gospel to the poor; He has sent Me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to those who are bound;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:2
verses.text: to preach the acceptable year of the LORD and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn;

verses.name: Isaiah 61:3
verses.text: to appoint to those who mourn in Zion, to give to them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the mantle of praise for the spirit of heaviness; so that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He might be glorified.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:4
verses.text: And they will build the old wastes, they will raise up the ruins of former times. And they will repair the waste cities, the ruins of many generations.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:5
verses.text: And strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the stranger <hi>will be</hi> your plowmen and your vinedressers.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:6
verses.text: But you will be named the priests of the LORD; it will be said of you, Ministers of our God; you will eat the riches of the nations, and you will revel in their glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:7
verses.text: For your shame <hi>you will have</hi> double; and for disgrace they will rejoice in their portion; therefore in their own land they will possess double; everlasting joy will be theirs.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:8
verses.text: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:9
verses.text: And their seed will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples; all who see them will acknowledge them, that they <hi>are</hi> the seed the LORD has blessed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:10
verses.text: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul will be joyful in my God; for He has clothed me <hi>with</hi> the robes of salvation, He covered me with the robe of righteousness like a bridegroom adorns <hi>himself</hi> with ornaments, and like a bride adorns <hi>herself</hi> with her jewels.

verses.name: Isaiah 61:11
verses.text: For as the earth comes out with its bud, and as the garden causes that which is sown to grow; so the Lord Jehovah will cause righteousness and praise to grow before all the nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:1
verses.text: For Zion's sake I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until its righteousness goes out as brightness, and her salvation as a burning lamp.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:2
verses.text: And the nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory; and you will be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD will name.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:3
verses.text: You also will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:4
verses.text: You will no more be called Forsaken; nor will your land any more be called Desolate; but you will be called My Delight, <hi>is</hi> in her, and your land, Married; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:5
verses.text: For <hi>as</hi> a young man marries a virgin, so will your sons marry you; and <hi>as</hi> the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, <hi>so</hi> will your God rejoice over you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:6
verses.text: I have set watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem, who will not always be silent all the day nor all the night; you who remember the LORD, do not be silent.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:7
verses.text: And give Him no rest until He establishes and makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:8
verses.text: The LORD has sworn by His right hand, and by the arm of His strength, Surely I will no more give your grain <hi>to be</hi> food for your enemies; and the sons of strangers will not drink your wine for which you have labored.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:9
verses.text: But its gatherers will eat it and praise the LORD; and they who collected it will drink it in My holy courts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:10
verses.text: Pass! Pass through the gates; prepare the way of the people. Raise up! Raise up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a banner for the peoples.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:11
verses.text: Behold, the LORD has sent a message to the end of the earth, Tell the daughter of Zion, Behold, your salvation comes. Behold, His reward <hi>is</hi> with Him, and His work before Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 62:12
verses.text: And they will call them, The Holy People, The Redeemed of the LORD; and you will be called, Sought out, a city not forsaken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:1
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> this who comes from Edom, <hi>with</hi> dyed garments from Bozrah, this One adorned in His clothing, bending down in His great power? I who speak in righteousness, great to save.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:2
verses.text: Why <hi>is Your</hi> clothing red, and Your garments like one who treads in the winepress?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:3
verses.text: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the peoples <hi>there was</hi> no man with Me; for I will tread them in My anger and trample them in My fury; and their blood will be sprinkled on My garments, and I will stain all My clothing.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:4
verses.text: For the day of vengeance <hi>is</hi> in My heart, and the year of My redeemed has come.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:5
verses.text: And I looked, and <hi>there was</hi> none to help; and I wondered that there <hi>was</hi> no one to uphold; therefore My own arm has saved for Me; and My fury upheld Me.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:6
