verses.text: And I will tread down the people in My anger, and make them drunk in My fury, and I will pour their juice to the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:7
verses.text: I will mention the loving-kindnesses of the LORD, the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has benefited for us, and the great good to the house of Israel <hi>by</hi> which He benefited them according to His mercies, and according to the multitude of His loving-kindnesses.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:8
verses.text: For He said, Surely they <hi>are</hi> My people, sons that will not lie; so He was their Savior.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:9
verses.text: In all their affliction He <hi>was</hi> afflicted, and the Angel of His presence saved them; in His love and in His pity He redeemed them; and He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:10
verses.text: But they rebelled, and troubled His Holy Spirit; therefore He was turned <hi>to be</hi> their enemy, <hi>and</hi> He fought against them.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:11
verses.text: Then He remembered the days of old, Moses <hi>and</hi> His people, <hi>saying</hi>, Where <hi>is</hi> He who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of His flock? Where <hi>is</hi> He who put His Holy Spirit within him?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:12
verses.text: He led <hi>them</hi> by the right <hi>hand</hi> of Moses with His glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make Himself an everlasting name?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:13
verses.text: He led them through the deep, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they would not stumble?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:14
verses.text: As a beast goes down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest. So You led Your people, to make Yourself a glorious name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:15
verses.text: Look down from Heaven, and look down from the place of Your holiness and of Your glory; where <hi>is</hi> Your zeal and Your strength, the multitude of Your tender affections and of Your mercies toward me? Are they withheld?

verses.name: Isaiah 63:16
verses.text: For You <hi>are</hi> our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does acknowledge us. You, O LORD, <hi>are</hi> our Father, our Redeemer; Your name is from everlasting.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:17
verses.text: O LORD, why have You made us wander from Your ways. You harden our heart from Your fear? For Your servants' sake, return the tribes of Your inheritance.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:18
verses.text: The people of Your holiness have possessed <hi>it</hi> but a little <hi>while</hi>; our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.

verses.name: Isaiah 63:19
verses.text: We are from forever; You never ruled over them; Your name was never called on them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:1
verses.text: Oh that You would tear the heavens <hi>and</hi> come down, <hi>that</hi> mountains would quake before You,

verses.name: Isaiah 64:2
verses.text: (<hi> as</hi> the brushwood fire burns, the fire causes water to boil), to make Your name known to Your foes, <hi>that</hi> the nations may tremble at Your presence!

verses.name: Isaiah 64:3
verses.text: When You did dreadful things <hi>which</hi> we did not look for, You came down, the mountains flowed down at Your presence.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:4
verses.text: And from forever they have not heard, nor did they listen. Eye has not seen a God except You, who works for him who waits for Him.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:5
verses.text: You meet him who rejoices and works righteousness, <hi>those who</hi> remember You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, for we sinned. In them <hi>is</hi> eternity, and we will be saved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:6
verses.text: But we are all as the unclean <hi>thing</hi>, and all our righteousnesses <hi>are</hi> as a menstruous cloth. And we all fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:7
verses.text: And <hi>there is</hi> no one who calls on Your name, who stirs up himself to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us, and have melted us away because of our iniquities.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:8
verses.text: But now, O LORD, You <hi>are</hi> our Father; we <hi>are</hi> the clay, and You <hi>are</hi> our Former; and we all <hi>are</hi> the work of Your hand.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:9
verses.text: Do not be grievously angry, O LORD, nor remember iniquity forever. Behold! Look, please; all of us <hi>are</hi> Your people.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:10
verses.text: Your holy cities are a wilderness; Zion <hi>is</hi> a wilderness, Jerusalem <hi>is</hi> a ruin.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:11
verses.text: The house of our holiness and our beauty, where our fathers praised You, has become a burning of fire; and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

verses.name: Isaiah 64:12
verses.text: Will You restrain Yourself over these <hi>things</hi>, O LORD? Will You be silent and sorely afflict us?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:1
verses.text: I am sought by those who asked not for Me; I am found by those who did not seek Me. I said, Behold Me, behold Me, to a nation not calling on My name.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:2
verses.text: I have spread out My hands all the day to a rebellious people who walk in the way not good, after their own thoughts;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:3
verses.text: a people who without ceasing provoke Me to anger to My face; who sacrifice in gardens, and burn incense on the bricks;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:4
verses.text: <hi> a people</hi> who remain among the graves, and sleep in the tombs, who eat swine's flesh, and broth from hateful <hi>things in</hi> their vessels;

verses.name: Isaiah 65:5
verses.text: who say, Keep to yourself, do not come near me; for I am holier than you. These <hi>are</hi> a smoke in My nose, a fire that burns all the day.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:6
verses.text: Behold, <hi>it is</hi> written before Me; I will not be silent, except I will repay; yea, I will repay into their bosom

verses.name: Isaiah 65:7
verses.text: your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, says the LORD, <hi>they</hi> that burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed Me on the hills. And I will measure their former work into their bosom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:8
verses.text: So says the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and <hi>one</hi> says, Do not destroy it, for a blessing <hi>is</hi> in it; so I will do to My servants, that I may not destroy them all.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:9
verses.text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah one who inherits My mountains; and My elect will inherit it, and My servants will dwell there.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:10
verses.text: And Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting-place of herds for My people who have sought Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:11
verses.text: But you <hi>are</hi> those who forsake the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who furnish the drink offering to Fate.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:12
verses.text: Therefore I will number you to the sword; and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because I called and you did not answer; when I spoke, you did not hear and did evil before My eyes, and chose <hi>that</hi> in which I did not delight.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:13
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says, Behold, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, My servants will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:14
verses.text: Behold,. My servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will howl because of a breaking of spirit.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:15
verses.text: And you will leave your name for a curse to My chosen; for the Lord Jehovah will kill you, and call His servants by another name.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:16
verses.text: <hi> He</hi> who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth. And he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from My eyes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:17
verses.text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth. And the things before will not be remembered, nor come to mind.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:18
verses.text: But be glad and rejoice forever <hi>in that</hi> which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:19
verses.text: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and I will rejoice in My people; and the voice of weeping will no more be heard in her, nor the voice of crying be heard in her.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:20
verses.text: There will not be an infant, nor an old man that has not filled his days. For the child will die a hundred years old; but the sinner <hi>who is</hi> a hundred years old will be despised.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:21
verses.text: And they will build houses and live <hi>in them</hi>; and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:22
verses.text: They will not build, and another live <hi>in them</hi>; they will not plant, and another eat. For like the days of a tree <hi>are</hi> the days of My people, and My elect will long enjoy the work of their hands.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:23
verses.text: They will not labor in vain, nor bring forth for terror. For they <hi>are</hi> the seed of the beloved of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:24
verses.text: And it will be, before they call I will answer; and while they are still speaking, I will hear.

verses.name: Isaiah 65:25
verses.text: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox; and dust <hi>will be</hi> the food of the snake. They will not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:1
verses.text: So says the LORD, Heaven <hi>is</hi> My throne, and earth My footstool. Where, then, <hi>is</hi> the house that you build for Me? And where <hi>is</hi> the place of My rest?

verses.name: Isaiah 66:2
verses.text: For all those My hand has made, and all those exist, says the LORD. But to this one I will look, to the afflicted and contrite spirit, and the one who trembles at My word.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:3
verses.text: He who kills an ox is <hi>is as if</hi> he killed a man; he who sacrifices a lamb <hi>is as if</hi> he broke a dog's neck; he who offers an offering <hi>is as if</hi> he offered swine's blood; he who burns incense <hi>is as if</hi> he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:4
verses.text: I also will choose the things that delude them, and I will bring their fears on them, because I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they did not hear. But they did evil before My eyes and chose <hi>that</hi> in which I did not delight.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:5
verses.text: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at His word; your brothers who hated you, who cast you out for My name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified. But He will appear to your joy, and they will be ashamed.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:6
verses.text: A sound of noise from the city, a sound from the temple, a sound of the LORD repaying His enemies.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:7
verses.text: Before she travailed, she gave birth; before her pain came, she delivered a man child.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:8
verses.text: Who has heard <hi>a thing</hi> like this? Who has seen <hi>things</hi> like these? Will the earth be brought forth <hi>in</hi> one day? <hi>Or</hi> will a nation be born at once? For Zion travailed and also brought forth her sons.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:9
verses.text: Will I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth, says the LORD? Surely I will cause birth and restrain, says your God.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:10
verses.text: Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all who mourn for her;

verses.name: Isaiah 66:11
verses.text: that you may suck and be satisfied with her comforting breasts; that you may milk out and be delighted with the fullness of her glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:12
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will hold out peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like a flowing stream. Then you will suck, you will be carried on <hi>her</hi> sides and be dandled upon <hi>her</hi> knees.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:13
verses.text: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; and you will be comforted in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:14
verses.text: And you will see, and your heart will rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the grass. And the hand of the LORD will be known toward His servants, and <hi>His</hi> fury toward His enemies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:15
verses.text: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with His chariots like a tempest, to refresh His anger with fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:16
verses.text: For by fire and by His sword the LORD will execute judgment with all flesh; and the slain of the LORD will be many.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:17
verses.text: Those who sanctify themselves, and purify themselves <hi>to go</hi> into the gardens, behind one <hi>tree</hi> in the middle, eating swine's flesh, and the hateful thing, and the mouse, will be cut off together, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:18
verses.text: For I <hi>know</hi> their works and their thoughts; it comes to gather all the nations and the tongues; and they will come and see My glory.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:19
verses.text: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape from them to the nations, <hi>to</hi> Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, drawers of the bow; <hi>to</hi> Tubal, and Javan, <hi>to</hi> the far away coasts that have not heard My fame, nor have seen My glory. And they will declare My glory among the nations.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:20
verses.text: And they will bring all your brothers <hi>for</hi> an offering to the LORD out of all nations on horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and on mules, and on camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the sons of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel <hi>into</hi> the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:21
verses.text: And I will also take some of them for priests <hi>and</hi> for Levites, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:22
verses.text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make stand before Me, says the LORD, so will your seed and your name stand.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:23
verses.text: And it will be, from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Isaiah 66:24
verses.text: And they will go out and see the dead bodies of the men who have sinned against Me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be put out; and they will be an object of disgust to all flesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:1
verses.text: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who <hi>were</hi> in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:2
verses.text: <hi> to</hi> whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:3
verses.text: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the exiling of Jerusalem in the fifth month.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:4
verses.text: And it happened, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:5
verses.text: Before I formed you in the belly I knew you; and before you came forth out of the womb I consecrated you, <hi>and</hi> I ordained you a prophet to the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:6
verses.text: Then I said, Alas, Lord Jehovah! Behold, I do not know to speak; for I <hi>am</hi> a boy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:7
verses.text: But the LORD said to me, Do not say, I <hi>am</hi> a boy; for you shall go to all that I shall send you, and whatever I command you, you shall speak.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:8
verses.text: Do not be afraid of their faces; for I <hi>am</hi> with you to deliver you, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:9
verses.text: And the LORD put forth His hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:10
verses.text: Behold! I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:11
verses.text: And the word of the LORD <hi>came</hi> to me, saying, Jeremiah, what do you see? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:12
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, You have seen well; for I will watch over My word to perform it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:13
verses.text: And the word of the LORD <hi>came</hi> to me the second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, I see a boiling pot; and its face <hi>is</hi> from the face of the north.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Out of the north an evil will be set loose on all the inhabitants of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:15
verses.text: For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says the LORD. And they shall come, and they shall each one set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its wall all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:16
verses.text: And I will pronounce My judgments against them regarding all their evil, <hi>those</hi> who have forsaken Me, and burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:17
verses.text: And you must gird up your loins, and arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Do not be terrified at their faces, lest I prostrate you before them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:18
verses.text: For, behold, I have made you a fortified city this day, and an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its rulers, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:19
verses.text: And they shall fight against you; but they shall not overcome you. For I <hi>am</hi> with you, says the LORD, to deliver you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:2
verses.text: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, So says the LORD, I remember you, the kindness of your youth, the love of your betrothals, when you went after Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:3
verses.text: Israel <hi>was</hi> holiness to the LORD, and the firstfruits of His increase. All that devour him shall offend; evil shall come on them, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:4
verses.text: Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:5
verses.text: So says the LORD, What injustice have your fathers found in Me, that they have gone far from Me and have walked after vanity, and have become vain?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:6
verses.text: Nor did they say, Where <hi>is</hi> the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of dry places, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man lived?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:7
verses.text: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled My land and made My inheritance an abomination.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:8
verses.text: The priests did not say, Where <hi>is</hi> the LORD? And they who handle the law did not know Me; the shepherds also rebelled against Me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things not profitable.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:9
verses.text: Therefore I will contend with you, says the LORD, and with your son's sons I will enter into judgment.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:10
verses.text: For pass over the coasts of Kittim, and see; and send to Kedar, and carefully consider, and see if there is <hi>such a</hi> thing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:11
verses.text: Has a nation changed <hi>their</hi> gods who are yet no gods? But My people have changed their Glory for that which does not profit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:12
verses.text: Be amazed, O heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid; be completely desolated, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:13
verses.text: For My people have committed two evils; they have forsaken Me, the Fountain of living waters, to hew out cisterns for themselves, broken cisterns that can hold no water.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:14
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> Israel a servant? Or <hi>is</hi> he a servant of the house? Why has he become a prey?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:15
verses.text: The young lions roared against him; they gave their voice. And they made his land a waste; his cities are burned without inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:16
verses.text: Also the sons of Noph and Tahapanes have fed on the crown of your head.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:17
verses.text: Have you not brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken the LORD your God, when He led you by the way?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:18
verses.text: And now what is for you toward the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? Or what for you toward Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:19
verses.text: Your own evil shall correct you, and your backslidings shall reprove you, therefore know and see that <hi>it is</hi> an evil and bitter <hi>thing</hi> that you have forsaken the LORD your God, and that My fear <hi>is</hi> not in you, says the Lord GOD of hosts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:20
verses.text: For long ago you broke your yoke <hi>and</hi> tore up your bonds; and you said, I will not transgress, when on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down <hi>like</hi> a harlot.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:21
verses.text: Yet I planted you a noble vine, wholly a true seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate <hi>shoots of</hi> an alien vine to Me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:22
verses.text: For though you wash yourself with potash, and multiply soap for yourself, <hi>yet</hi> your iniquity is marked before Me, says the Lord GOD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:23
verses.text: How can you say, I am not defiled; I have not gone after the Baals? See your way in the valley, know what you have done! <hi>You are</hi> a swift camel crossing its ways;

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:24
verses.text: a wild ass used to the wilderness; in the desire of her passion she snuffs at the wind; <hi>in</hi> her time who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not tire themselves; in her month they will find her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:25
verses.text: Withhold your foot from <hi>being</hi> bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, There is no hope; no; for I have loved strangers, and after them I will go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:26
verses.text: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their rulers, and their priests, and their prophets;

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:27
verses.text: saying to a tree, You <hi>are</hi> my father; and to a stone, You gave <hi>me</hi> birth. For they have turned <hi>their</hi> back to Me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise and save us!

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:28
verses.text: But where <hi>are</hi> your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble; for according to the number of your cities are your gods, O Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:29
verses.text: Why will you plead with Me? You all have sinned against Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:30
verses.text: In vain I have stricken your sons; they received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:31
verses.text: O generation, see the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of darkness? Why do My people say, We roam <hi>freely</hi>; we will come no more to You?

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:32
verses.text: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, <hi>or</hi> a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me days without number.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:33
verses.text: Why did you trim your way to seek love? Therefore you have also taught the evil women your ways.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:34
verses.text: Also in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents; you did not find them breaking in, but on all these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:35
verses.text: Yet you say, Because I am innocent, surely His anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with you, because you say, I have not sinned.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:36
verses.text: Why do you go about so much to change your way? You also shall be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:37
verses.text: Yes, you shall go out from this <hi>place</hi>, and your hands on your head. For the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust, and you will not prosper by them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:1
verses.text: <hi> They</hi> say, If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him and will be for another man, will he return to her again? Would not that land be greatly defiled? But you play the harlot with many lovers; yet come back to Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:2
verses.text: Lift up your eyes to the high places, and see. Where have you not been lain with? By the highways you have sat for them, like the Arabian in the wilderness; and you have defiled the land with your fornications and with your wickedness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:3
verses.text: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and there has been no latter rain; and you had a harlot's forehead, you refused to be ashamed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:4
verses.text: Will you not from this time cry to Me, My father, <hi>You are</hi> the guide of my youth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:5
verses.text: Will He keep <hi>His anger</hi> forever? Will He keep it to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done <hi>all</hi> the evil things you could do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:6
verses.text: The LORD also said to me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has fornicated there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:7
verses.text: And I said after she had done all these <hi>things</hi>, Turn to Me! But she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:8
verses.text: And I saw, when for all the causes <hi>for</hi> which backsliding Israel committed adultery, I sent her away and gave a bill of divorce to her, yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear, but she went and whored, she also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:9
verses.text: And it happened, from the folly of her whoredom, she defiled the land and fornicated with stones and stocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:10
verses.text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah has not turned to Me with her whole heart, but with falsehood, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:11
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, The backsliding Israel has justified herself more than treacherous Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:12
verses.text: Go and cry these words toward the north, and say, Return, O backsliding Israel, says the LORD; <hi>and</hi> I will not cause My anger to fall on you; for I <hi>am</hi> merciful, says the LORD, <hi>and</hi> I will not keep anger forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:13
verses.text: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have sinned against the LORD your God and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed My voice, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:14
verses.text: Turn, O backsliding sons, says the LORD; for I am married to you; and I will take you one from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:15
verses.text: And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, who shall feed you <hi>with</hi> knowledge and understanding.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:16
verses.text: And it will be when you have multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD! Nor shall it come to mind; nor shall they remember it; nor shall they visit <hi>it</hi>; nor shall it be made any more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:17
verses.text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem. Nor shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:18
verses.text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance to your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:19
verses.text: But I said, How shall I put you among the sons, and give you a pleasant land, a beautiful inheritance <hi>among</hi> the hosts of nations? And I said, You shall call Me, My Father, and shall not turn away from Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:20
verses.text: Surely <hi>as</hi> a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:21
verses.text: A voice was heard on the high places weeping, cryings of the sons of Israel; for they have perverted their way, <hi>and</hi> they have forgotten the LORD their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:22
verses.text: Return, O backsliding sons, <hi>and</hi> I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come to You; for You are the LORD our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:23
verses.text: Truly, for delusion <hi>comes</hi> from the high hills, tumult <hi>on</hi> the mountains. Truly, in the LORD our God <hi>is</hi> the salvation of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:24
verses.text: For shame has eaten up the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:25
verses.text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covers us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:1
verses.text: If you will return, O Israel, says the LORD, return to Me. And if you will put away your abominations out of your sight, then you shall not be moved.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:2
verses.text: And you shall swear, The LORD lives, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in Him, and in Him they shall glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:3
verses.text: For so says the LORD to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and do not sow among thorns.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:4
verses.text: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, men of Judah and people of Jerusalem; lest My fury come forth like fire, and burn so that none can put <hi>it</hi> out; because of the evil of your doings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:5
verses.text: Declare in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; and say, Blow the trumpet in the land; cry, gather together, and say, Gather yourselves and let us go into the fortified cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:6
verses.text: Set up the banner toward Zion; flee for safety and do not wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:7
verses.text: The lion has come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the nations has set out; he has left his place to make your land a waste. Your cities will fall into ruins without inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:8
verses.text: Put on sackcloth for this, wail and howl; for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:9
verses.text: And it shall be at that day, says the LORD, the king's heart will perish, and the heart of the rulers; and the priests will be amazed, and the prophets will be astounded.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:10
verses.text: Then I said, Ah, Lord GOD! Surely You have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, You shall have peace; but the sword reaches to the soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:11
verses.text: At that time it shall be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind <hi>from</hi> the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of My people, not to sift nor to cleanse.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:12
verses.text: A wind more full than these shall come for Me. Now also I will utter judgments against them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:13
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like clouds, and his chariots like a tempest. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are plundered!

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:14
verses.text: O Jerusalem, cleanse your heart from evil so that you may be saved. How long shall your vain thoughts lodge within you?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:15
verses.text: For a voice declares from Dan, and proclaims affliction from mount Ephraim.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:16
verses.text: Tell <hi>it</hi> to the nations: Behold! proclaim against Jerusalem! Besiegers are going to come from a distant land; and they will set their voice against the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:17
verses.text: Like watchmen of a field, they are against her all around; because she rebelled against Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:18
verses.text: Your way and your doings have brought these <hi>things</hi> on you; this is your evil, because it is bitter, because it reaches to your heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:19
verses.text: My bowels, my bowels! I convulse in pain. O walls of my heart! My heart is restless within me; I cannot be silent because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the ram's horn, the alarm of war.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:20
verses.text: Ruin on ruin is cried; for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are laid waste, my curtains in a moment.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:21
verses.text: How long shall I see the banner <hi>and</hi> hear the sound of the ram's horn?

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:22
verses.text: For My people <hi>are</hi> foolish; they have not known Me; they are stupid sons, and they have no understanding. They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:23
verses.text: I looked on the earth, and, lo, <hi>it was</hi> without form and void; and the heavens, and they <hi>had</hi> no light.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:24
verses.text: I looked on the mountains, and, lo, they quaked; and all the hills were shaken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:25
verses.text: I looked, and, lo, <hi>there was</hi> no man, and all the birds of the heavens had fled.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:26
verses.text: I looked, and, lo, the fruitful place <hi>was</hi> a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down before the face of the LORD, before His fierce anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:27
verses.text: For so the LORD has said, The whole land shall be desolate, yet I will not make a full end.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:28
verses.text: The earth shall mourn for this, and the heavens above shall be black, because I have spoken, I have purposed, and will not repent, nor will I turn back from it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:29
verses.text: Every city shall flee from the sound of the horsemen and bowmen. They shall go into thickets and climb up among the rocks. All the city is abandoned, and not a man shall live in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:30
verses.text: And you, O desolate one, what will you do? Though you dress with crimson, though you put on ornaments of gold, though you make your eyes large with paint, you shall make yourself beautiful in vain; your lovers will despise you; they will seek your life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:31
verses.text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in labor, the anguish as one bearing her first child, the voice of Zion's daughter, gasping and spreading her hands, <hi>saying</hi>, Woe to me now! For my soul faints because of murderers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:1
verses.text: Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in her open places, if you can find a man, if there is one who does justice, who seeks the truth; and I will pardon her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:2
verses.text: And though they say, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives; surely they swear falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:3
verses.text: O LORD, <hi>are</hi> not Your eyes on the truth? You have stricken them, but they have not grieved; You have destroyed them, but they have refused to receive correction; they have made their faces harder than rock; they have refused to return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:4
verses.text: So I said, Surely these <hi>are</hi> poor; they are foolish; for they do not know the way of the LORD, <hi>nor</hi> the judgment of their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:5
verses.text: I will go up for myself to the great men, and will speak to them; for they have known the way of the LORD <hi>and</hi> the judgment of their God. But these have broken the yoke together and have torn off the bonds!

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:6
verses.text: Therefore a lion out of the forest shall kill them, <hi>and</hi> a wolf of the deserts shall rob them; a leopard shall watch over their cities. Everyone who goes out from them shall be torn in pieces, because their sins are many <hi>and</hi> their backslidings are multiplied.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:7
verses.text: Why shall I pardon you for this? Your sons have forsaken Me, and have sworn by No-gods. When I adjured them, then they committed adultery, and gathered themselves by troops in a harlot's house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:8
verses.text: They were <hi>like</hi> lusty, well-fed stallions in the morning; every one neighing after his neighbor's wife.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:9
verses.text: Shall I not judge for these <hi>things</hi>? says the LORD. And shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:10
verses.text: Go up on her vine-rows and destroy; but do not make a full end; take away her branches, for they <hi>are</hi> not the LORD's.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:11
verses.text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very deceitfully against Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:12
verses.text: They have lied against the LORD and said, <hi>It is</hi> not He; neither shall evil come on us; nor shall we see sword nor famine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:13
verses.text: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word <hi>is</hi> not in them; so it shall be done to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:14
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD God of hosts, Because you spoke this word, behold, I will make My words in your mouth fire, and these people wood, and it shall devour them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:15
verses.text: Lo, I will bring a nation on you from afar, O house of Israel, says the LORD. It <hi>is</hi> an enduring nation, it <hi>is</hi> an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know, nor understand what they say.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:16
verses.text: Their quiver <hi>is</hi> as an open grave; they <hi>are</hi> all mighty men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:17
verses.text: And they shall eat up your harvest, and your bread. They will devour your sons and your daughters. They shall eat up your flocks and your herds; they shall eat up your vines and your fig-trees. One shall beat down your fortified cities with the sword, those in which you trust.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:18
verses.text: But even in those days, says the LORD, I will not make a complete end with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:19
verses.text: And it will be, when you shall say, Why does the LORD our God do all these {things} to us? Then You shall answer them, Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve strangers in a land {that is} not yours.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:20
verses.text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and cry it in Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:21
verses.text: Now hear this, O foolish people and without heart; who have eyes and see not; who have ears and hear not;

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:22
verses.text: Do you not fear Me? says the LORD. Will you not tremble at My presence, I who have placed the sand <hi>for</hi> the boundary of the sea <hi>by</hi> a never-ending decree, so that it cannot pass it? And though they toss themselves, yet they cannot prevail; though its waves roar, yet they cannot pass over it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:23
verses.text: But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they have revolted and are gone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:24
verses.text: And they do not say in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, who gives both the former and the latter rain in its season; He reserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:25
verses.text: Your iniquities have turned away these <hi>things</hi>, and your sins have withheld good from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:26
verses.text: For among My people are found wicked ones; they lie in wait, as one who sets snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:27
verses.text: Like a cage full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and grown rich.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:28
verses.text: They have become fat, they shine. Yes, they go past the deeds of the wicked; they do not judge the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may get rich; and they do not judge the right of the needy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:29
verses.text: Shall I not visit for these <hi>things</hi>? says the LORD. Shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:30
verses.text: An astounding and horrible thing has happened in the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:31
verses.text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love <hi>to have it</hi> so, and what will you do at the end of it?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:1
verses.text: O sons of Benjamin, take refuge out of the midst of Jerusalem. And blow the ram's horn in Tekoa, and set up a signal-fire over Beth-haccerem; for evil appears out of the north, and great ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:2
verses.text: I will destroy the daughter of Zion, the beautiful and tender one.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:3
verses.text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come to her; they shall pitch tents on her all around; they shall feed each one <hi>in</hi> his hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:4
verses.text: Prepare war against her; arise and let us go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:5
verses.text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:6
verses.text: For so has the LORD of hosts said, Cut down trees and cast a mound against Jerusalem! She <hi>is</hi> the city to be visited; <hi>there is</hi> nothing but oppression in her midst.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:7
verses.text: As a fountain keeps fresh her waters, so she keeps fresh her evil; violence and spoil is heard in her; always before Me <hi>are</hi> grief and wounds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:8
verses.text: O Jerusalem, you must be instructed, lest My soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land without people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:9
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine; turn back your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:10
verses.text: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? Behold, their ears <hi>are</hi> not circumcised, and they cannot listen. Behold, the word of the LORD is to them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:11
verses.text: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in; I will pour it out on the children in the street, and on the circle of young men together. For even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with fullness of days.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:12
verses.text: And their houses shall be turned to others, together <hi>with their</hi> fields and wives; for I will stretch out My hand on the people of the land, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:13
verses.text: For everyone from the least of them even to the greatest of them cuts off a profit; and from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:14
verses.text: They have also healed the hurt <hi>of the daughter</hi> of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace, when <hi>there is</hi> no peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:15
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, nor could they blush; therefore they shall fall among those who fall. At the time <hi>that</hi> I visit them they shall be cast down, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:16
verses.text: So says the LORD, Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths where the good way <hi>is</hi>, and walk in it, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk <hi>in it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:17
verses.text: Also I set watchmen over you, <hi>saying</hi>, Listen to the sound of the ram's horn. But they said, We will not listen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:18
verses.text: Therefore hear, nations, and know, O congregation, what <hi>is</hi> among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:19
verses.text: Hear, O earth; behold, I will bring evil on this people, the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to My words, nor to My law, but have rejected it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:20
verses.text: Why does frankincense come to me from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings <hi>are</hi> not pleasing, nor your sacrifices sweet to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:21
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall on them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:22
verses.text: So says the LORD, Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be stirred from the sides of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:23
verses.text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they <hi>are</hi> cruel and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea; and they ride on horses, set in order like a man for war against you, O daughter of Zion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:24
verses.text: We have heard the rumor of it; our hands become feeble; anguish has taken hold of us, {and} pain, like a woman in labor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:25
verses.text: Do not go out into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy <hi>and</hi> fear <hi>are</hi> on every side.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:26
verses.text: O daughter of my people, put on sackcloth, and wallow in ashes; make mourning for yourself, <hi>as for</hi> an only son, most bitter weeping; for the ravager shall suddenly come on us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:27
verses.text: I have set you up an assayer, an examiner among My people, that you may know and try their way.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:28
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> all grievous revolters, walking <hi>in</hi> slanders; they <hi>are</hi> bronze and iron; they <hi>are</hi> all corrupters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:29
verses.text: The bellows are burned, the lead is melted by the fire; the. refiner melts in vain; for the wicked are not plucked away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:30
verses.text: Reprobate silver they call them, because the LORD has rejected them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:2
verses.text: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and declare there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:3
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Make your ways and your doings good, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:4
verses.text: Do not trust in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD <hi>are</hi> these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:5
verses.text: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if you completely do judgment between a man and his neighbor;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:6
verses.text: <hi> if</hi> you do not oppress the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, nor walk after other gods to your hurt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:7
verses.text: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, forever and ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:8
verses.text: Behold, you trust in lying words that cannot do any good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:9
verses.text: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you do not know;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:10
verses.text: and then come and stand before Me in this house which is called by My name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:11
verses.text: Has this house, which is called by My name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I also have seen, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:12
verses.text: But go now to My place which <hi>was</hi> in Shiloh, where I set My name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of My people Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:13
verses.text: And now, because you have done all these works, says the LORD, and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you did not hear; and I called you, but you did not answer;

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:14
verses.text: therefore I will do to <hi>this</hi> house, which is called by My name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:15
verses.text: And I will cast you out of My sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, the whole seed of Ephraim.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:16
verses.text: Therefore do not pray for this people, nor lift up cry nor prayer for them, nor make intercession to Me; for I will not hear you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:17
verses.text: Do you not see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:18
verses.text: The sons gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke Me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:19
verses.text: Do they vex Me? says the LORD. <hi>Is it</hi> not themselves to the shame of their own faces?

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:20
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord GOD; Behold, My anger and My fury shall be poured out on this place, on man, and on animal, and on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be put out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:21
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Put your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:22
verses.text: For I did not speak to your fathers, nor command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:23
verses.text: But I commanded them this thing, saying, Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be My people; and walk in all the ways that I have commanded you, so that it may be well with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:24
verses.text: But they did not listen, nor bow their ear, but walked in <hi>their own</hi> plans, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward and not forward.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:25
verses.text: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day I have even sent to you all My servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:26
verses.text: Yet they did not listen to Me, nor bow down their ear, but hardened their neck. They did worse than their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:27
verses.text: So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; you shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:28
verses.text: But you shall say to them, This <hi>is</hi> a nation which does not obey the voice of the LORD their God, nor receives instruction; truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:29
verses.text: Cut off your hair and throw <hi>it</hi> away, and take up a weeping on the high places. For the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:30
verses.text: For the sons of Judah have done evil in My sight, says the LORD. They have set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, in order to defile it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:31
verses.text: They have built the high places of Tophet, which <hi>is</hi> in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I did not command <hi>them</hi>, nor did it come into My heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:32
verses.text: So, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they shall bury in Tophet, until there is no place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:33
verses.text: And the bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten <hi>them</hi> away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:34
verses.text: Then I will cause the voice of gladness to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride. For the land shall be desolate.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:1
verses.text: At that time, says the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:2
verses.text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of the heavens, whom they have loved and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshiped. They shall not be gathered nor buried; they shall be as dung on the face of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:3
verses.text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the rest of those who remain of this evil family, who remain in all the places where I have driven them, says the LORD of hosts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:4
verses.text: And you shall say to them, So says the LORD; shall they fall and not arise? Shall he turn away and not return?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:5
verses.text: Why has this people of Jerusalem slidden back <hi>by</hi> a never-ending backsliding? They hold fast to deceit; they refuse to return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:6
verses.text: I listened and heard, <hi>but</hi> they did not speak right; no man repented of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? Everyone turned to their own courses own way, as the horse rushes into the battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:7
verses.text: Yea, the stork in the heavens knows her seasons; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow watch the time of their coming; but my people do not know the judgment of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:8
verses.text: How do you say, We <hi>are</hi> wise, and the law of the LORD <hi>is</hi> with us? Lo, certainly the lying pen of the scribes has written falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:9
verses.text: The wise are ashamed, they are terrified, and are captured. Lo, they have turned away from the word of the LORD; and what wisdom <hi>is</hi> in them?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:10
verses.text: Therefore I will give their wives to others, <hi>and</hi> their fields to those who shall inherit <hi>them</hi>, for everyone from the least even to the greatest cuts off a profit. From the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:11
verses.text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of My people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when <hi>there is</hi> no peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:12
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had done an abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, nor could they blush; therefore they shall fall among those who fall; in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:13
verses.text: I will utterly consume them, says the LORD; <hi>there shall be</hi> no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them, <hi>those who</hi> pass over them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:14
verses.text: Why do we sit still? Gather yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there. For the LORD our God has put us to silence, and has given us poisonous water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:15
verses.text: We looked for peace, but no good <hi>came</hi>; <hi>and</hi> for a time of health, but behold, trouble!

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:16
verses.text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan; the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his stallions. For they have come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those who live in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:17
verses.text: For, behold, I will send serpents and adders among you, <hi>which will</hi> not <hi>be</hi> charmed; and they shall bite you, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:18
verses.text: <hi> When</hi> I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart <hi>is</hi> faint within me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:19
verses.text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people, from a far country. <hi>Is</hi> not the LORD in Zion? <hi>Is</hi> not her King in her? Why have they provoked Me with their graven images, with foreign vanities?

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:20
verses.text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:21
verses.text: For the breaking of the daughter of my people I am broken; I am in gloom; horror has seized me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:22
verses.text: <hi> Is there</hi> no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the healing of the daughter of My people not come?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:1
verses.text: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:2
verses.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place for traveling men, that I might leave my people and go away from them! For they <hi>are</hi> all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:3
verses.text: And they bend their tongues <hi>like</hi> their bow <hi>for</hi> lies. But they are not mighty for the truth on the earth; for they go from evil to evil, and they do not know Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:4
verses.text: Everyone beware of his neighbor, and do not trust any brother! For every brother will supplant his neighbor, and will walk with slanders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:5
verses.text: And everyone will deceive his neighbor and will not speak the truth; they have taught their tongue to speak lies, <hi>and</hi> they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:6
verses.text: Your dwelling <hi>is</hi> in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:7
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them and try them; for what <hi>else</hi> can I do for the daughter of My people?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:8
verses.text: Their tongue <hi>is</hi> a slaughtering arrow; it speaks deceit; <hi>one</hi> speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in heart he lies in ambush.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:9
verses.text: Shall I not visit them for these <hi>things</hi>? says the LORD; shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:10
verses.text: I will take up a weeping and a wailing for the mountains, and a mourning for the pastures of the wilderness; because they are burned up, so that none can pass through <hi>them</hi>; nor can men hear the voice of the cattle. Both the birds of the heavens and the beast have fled; they are gone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:11
verses.text: And I will make Jerusalem ruins, a den of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without a living soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:12
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> the wise man who may understand this? And who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why does the land perish <hi>and</hi> burn up like a wilderness, so that none passes through?

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:13
verses.text: And the LORD says, Because they have forsaken My law which I set before them, and have not obeyed My voice, and have not walked in it,

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:14
verses.text: but they have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:15
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and make them drink poisonous water.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:16
verses.text: I will also scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. And I will send a sword after them until I have consumed them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:17
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, Think carefully, and call for the wailers, that they may come. And send for the wise women, that they may come;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:18
verses.text: and let them make haste and take up a weeping for us, so that our eyes may run down with tears, and waters flow <hi>from</hi> our eyelids.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:19
verses.text: For a voice of weeping is heard out of Zion. How are we plundered! We are greatly ashamed, because we have forsaken the land, because they have thrown down our tents.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:20
verses.text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O women, and let your ear receive the word of His mouth, and teach your daughters to weep, and each one teach her neighbor to mourn.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:21
verses.text: For death has come up into our windows, <hi>and</hi> has entered into our houses, to cut off the children from outside <hi>and</hi> the young men from the streets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:22
verses.text: Speak, So says the LORD, Even the bodies of men shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the fallen grain after the reaper; and none shall gather <hi>them</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:23
verses.text: So says the LORD, Do not let the wise glory in his wisdom, nor let the mighty glory in his might; do not let the rich glory in his riches;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:24
verses.text: but let him who glories glory in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, doing kindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth; for in these I delight, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:25
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will punish all the circumcised with foreskin;

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:26
verses.text: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the sons of Ammon, and Moab, and all <hi>who are</hi> in the outermost corners, who dwell in the wilderness. For all <hi>these</hi> nations are not circumcised, and all the house of Israel, those not circumcised in heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:1
verses.text: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:2
verses.text: So says the LORD, Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be terrified at the signs of the heavens; for the nations are terrified at them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:3
verses.text: For the customs of the people <hi>are</hi> vain; for one cuts a tree out of the forest with the axe, the work of the hands of the workman.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:4
verses.text: They adorn it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and hammers, so that it will not wobble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:5
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> like a rounded post, and they cannot speak. They must surely be lifted, because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them; for they cannot do evil nor good, for it is not in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:6
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> none like You, O LORD; You <hi>are</hi> great, and Your name <hi>is</hi> great in might.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:7
verses.text: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? For fear belongs to You, because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, <hi>there is</hi> none like You.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:8
verses.text: But they are all at once foolish and animal-like; the tree <hi>is</hi> an example of vanities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:9
verses.text: Silver beaten into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the goldsmith. Violet and purple <hi>is</hi> their clothing; they <hi>are</hi> all the work of skillful ones.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:10
verses.text: But the LORD <hi>is</hi> the true God, He <hi>is</hi> the living God, and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to stand His fury.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:11
verses.text: So you shall say to them, The gods who have not made the heavens and the earth, they shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:12
verses.text: He has made the earth by His power; He has established the world by His wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by His judgment.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:13
verses.text: When He utters His voice, <hi>there is</hi> a noise of many waters in the heavens. He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of His treasures.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:14
verses.text: Every man is stupid for <hi>lack of</hi> knowledge; every refiner is put to shame by the graven image; for his molten image is a lie, and no breath is in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:15
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> vanity, the work of delusion; in the time of their judgment they shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:16
verses.text: The Portion of Jacob <hi>is</hi> not like them; for He <hi>is</hi> the Maker of all things; and Israel <hi>is</hi> the rod of His inheritance. The LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:17
verses.text: Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who live under the siege.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:18
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the people of the land at this time, and will distress them, so that they may find <hi>Me</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:19
verses.text: Woe <hi>to</hi> me for my breaking! My wound is grievous; but I said, Truly this <hi>is</hi> a malady, and I must bear it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:20
verses.text: My tabernacle is ravaged, and all my cords are broken; My sons went away from me, and they <hi>are</hi> not. <hi>There is</hi> none to stretch out My tabernacle any more, and to set up My curtains.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:21
verses.text: For the pastors have become stupid, and have not sought the LORD, therefore they shall not be blessed, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:22
verses.text: Behold, the noise of the rumor has come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a den of jackals.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:23
verses.text: O LORD, I know that the way of man does not <hi>belong</hi> to man; <hi>it is</hi> not in man who walks to direct his steps.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:24
verses.text: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:25
verses.text: Pour out Your fury on the nations who do not know You, and on the families who do not call on Your name; for they have eaten up Jacob and have devoured him, and have destroyed him, and have made his dwelling desolate.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:2
verses.text: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:3
verses.text: And say to them, So says the LORD God of Israel, Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:4
verses.text: which I commanded your fathers in the day <hi>that</hi> I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey My voice and do them according to all that I command you; so you shall be My people, and I will be your God;

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:5
verses.text: so that I may fulfil the oath which I have sworn to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as <hi>it is</hi> this day. Then I answered and said, Amen, O LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:6
verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, Declare all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:7
verses.text: For I earnestly testified to your fathers in the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and testifying, saying, Obey My voice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:8
verses.text: Yet they did not obey nor bow down their ear, but walked each one in the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I will bring on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded <hi>them</hi> to do; but they did not do them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:9
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, A plot is found among the men of Judah, and among the people of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:10
verses.text: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear My words. And they went after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:11
verses.text: So the LORD says this: Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry to Me, I will not listen to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:12
verses.text: Then shall the cities of Judah and the people of Jerusalem go and cry to the gods to whom they offer incense. But they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:13
verses.text: For <hi>according to</hi> the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah. And <hi>according to</hi> the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to <hi>that</hi> shameful thing, altars to burn incense to Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:14
verses.text: And you, do not pray for this people, nor lift up a cry or prayer for them. For I will not hear <hi>them</hi> in the time they cry to Me for their trouble.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:15
verses.text: What <hi>is to</hi> My beloved in My house, <hi>since</hi> she has committed her many evils? And has the holy flesh caused your evil to pass from you? <hi>How</hi> then do you exult?

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:16
verses.text: The LORD called your name, a green olive tree, fair, <hi>with</hi> fine fruit. With the sound of a great storm He has set fire to it, and its branches are worthless.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:17
verses.text: And the LORD of hosts who planted you has spoken evil against you, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves to provoke Me to anger by offering incense to Baal.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:18
verses.text: And the LORD made me know, and I knew. Then You showed me their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:19
verses.text: But I <hi>was</hi> like a docile lamb being brought to the slaughter. And I did not know that they had plotted evils against me, <hi>saying</hi>, Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, so that his name may be remembered no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:20
verses.text: But, O LORD of hosts who judges rightly, who tries the heart and the mind, let me see Your vengeance on them. For to You I have revealed my cause.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:21
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD of the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, that you do not die by our hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:22
verses.text: So says LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them. The young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:23
verses.text: and there shall be no remnant of them. For I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, the year of their judgment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:1
verses.text: Righteous <hi>are</hi> You, O LORD, that I might contend with You; yet let me speak with You about <hi>Your</hi> judgments. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? <hi>Why</hi> are all <hi>those</hi> happy who deal treacherously?

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:2
verses.text: You have planted them; yea, they take root. They grow, yea, they make fruit. You <hi>are</hi> near in their mouth and far from their reins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:3
verses.text: But You, O LORD, know me. You have seen me and tried my heart toward You. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and devote them for the day of slaughter.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:4
verses.text: How long shall the land mourn, and the grass of every field wither from the evil of those who dwell in it? The beasts and the birds have been destroyed, because they said, He shall not see our last end.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:5
verses.text: If you have run with footmen, and they wore you out, then how can you compete with horses? And <hi>if</hi> you feel secure in the land of peace, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:6
verses.text: For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you. Yea, they have called a multitude after you. Do not believe them, though they speak good things to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:7
verses.text: I have forsaken My house; I have left My inheritance. I have given the dearly beloved of My soul into the hand of her enemies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:8
verses.text: My inheritance is to Me as a lion in the forest; it cries out against Me; therefore I have hated it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:9
verses.text: My inheritance <hi>is like</hi> a speckled bird to Me; the birds all around <hi>are</hi> against her. Go, gather all the beasts of the field, bring them to devour.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:10
verses.text: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My portion under foot; they have made My pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:11
verses.text: One has made it a desolation, it mourns to Me. The whole land is made desolate because no man lays <hi>it</hi> to heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:12
verses.text: The ravagers have come on all high places through the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the <hi>one</hi> end of the land even to the <hi>other</hi> end of the land. No flesh shall have peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:13
verses.text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns. They are worn out, <hi>but</hi> they do not profit. And they shall be ashamed of your harvests because of the fierce anger of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:14
verses.text: So says the LORD against all My evil neighbors who touch the inheritance which I have caused My people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:15
verses.text: And it will be after I have plucked them out, I will return and have pity on them, and will bring them again, each man to his inheritance and each man to his land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:16
