verses.text: And it will be if they will carefully learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives; as they taught the people to swear by Baal; then they shall be built in the midst of My people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:17
verses.text: But if they will not obey, I will uproot and destroy that nation, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:1
verses.text: So says the LORD to me, Go and buy for yourself a linen girdle, and put it on your loins, and do not put <hi>it</hi> in water.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:2
verses.text: So I bought a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put <hi>it</hi> on my loins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:3
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:4
verses.text: Take the girdle that you bought, which <hi>is</hi> on your loins, and arise. Go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:5
verses.text: So I went and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:6
verses.text: And it happened at the end of many days the LORD said to me, Arise, go to Euphrates and take the girdle from there, which I commanded you to hide there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:7
verses.text: Then I went to Euphrates and dug, and took the girdle from the place where I had hidden it. And, behold, the girdle was rotted; it was not good for anything.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:8
verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:9
verses.text: So says the LORD, In this way I will spoil the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:10
verses.text: This evil people, who refuse to hear My words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart and walk after other gods to serve them and to worship them, shall even be like this girdle, which is good for nothing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:11
verses.text: For as the girdle holds fast to the loins of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to Me, says the LORD; so that they might be to Me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory; but they would not hear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:12
verses.text: So you will speak to them this word: So says the LORD God of Israel, Every skin shall be filled with wine. And they shall say to you, Do we not surely know that every skin shall be filled with wine?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:13
verses.text: Then you shall say to them, So says the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the people of this land, even the kings that sit on David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:14
verses.text: And I will smash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says the LORD. I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, <hi>to keep them</hi> from their destruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:15
verses.text: Hear and give ear; do not be proud; for the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:16
verses.text: Give glory to the LORD your God, before He causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, He turns it into the shadow of death, setting up deep gloom.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:17
verses.text: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for <hi>your</hi> pride. And my eye shall weep sore and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock was captured.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:18
verses.text: Say to the king and to the queen mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your greatness shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:19
verses.text: The cities of the south have been shut up, and none are opening; Judah has been exiled, all of it has been peacefully exiled.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:20
verses.text: Lift up your eyes and behold those who come from the north. Where <hi>is</hi> the flock <hi>that</hi> was given to you, your beautiful flock?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:21
verses.text: What will you say when he comes to punish you? For you have taught them <hi>to be</hi> rulers over you for a head. Do not pangs seize you, like a woman in travail?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:22
verses.text: And if you say in your heart, Why do these things come on me? <hi>It is</hi> because of the greatness of your iniquity; your skirts are bared, <hi>and</hi> your heels suffer violence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:23
verses.text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard its spots? <hi>Then</hi> you also may do good, who are accustomed to doing evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:24
verses.text: And I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:25
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> your lot, the share I have measured to you, says the LORD, because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:26
verses.text: So I also have stripped off your skirts over your face, that your shame may appear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:27
verses.text: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighings, the wickedness of your fornication, <hi>and</hi> your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! Will you not be made clean? How long <hi>will it</hi> still <hi>be</hi>?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the matter of droughts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:2
verses.text: Judah mourns, and its gates droop. They are black to the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:3
verses.text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters; they came to the cisterns, <hi>and</hi> found no water. They returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:4
verses.text: Because the ground was cracked, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed; they covered their heads.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:5
verses.text: Yea, the doe also calved in the field and forsook <hi>it</hi>, because <hi>there was</hi> no grass.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:6
verses.text: And the wild asses stood in the high places; they snuffed up the wind like jackals; their eyes failed because <hi>there was</hi> no grass.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:7
verses.text: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, act for Your name's sake; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against You.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:8
verses.text: O the Hope of Israel, its Savior in time of trouble, why should You be as a stranger in the land, and as a traveler turning in to lodge?

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:9
verses.text: Why should You be as a man stunned, as one mighty, <hi>yet</hi> who cannot save? Yet You, O LORD, <hi>are</hi> in our midst, and we are called by Your name. Do not leave us!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:10
verses.text: So says the LORD to this people; So they have loved to wander; they have not restrained their feet; therefore the LORD does not accept them. He will now remember their iniquity and visit their sins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:11
verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, Do not pray for this people for good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:12
verses.text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and a grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:13
verses.text: Then I said, Ah, O Lord Jehovah! Behold, the prophets are saying to them, You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine; but I will give you true peace in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:14
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in My name; I did not send them, nor have I commanded them, nor did I speak to them. They prophesy to you a false vision and a worthless divination, and a thing of no value, and the deceit of their heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:15
verses.text: So the LORD says this concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, and I did not send them; yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; by sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:16
verses.text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, <hi>either</hi> them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters. For I will pour their evil on them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:17
verses.text: And you shall speak this word to them: Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and do not let them cease. For the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great break, <hi>with</hi> a very grievous blow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:18
verses.text: If I go out into the field, then I see those killed with the sword! And if I enter into the city, then, behold, sicknesses of famine! Yes, both the prophet and the priest have gone up into a land that they do not know.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:19
verses.text: Have You utterly rejected Judah? Or has Your soul hated Zion? Why have You stricken us, and <hi>there is</hi> no healing for us? <hi>We</hi> looked for peace, but no good <hi>came</hi>; and for the time of healing, and behold, trouble!

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:20
verses.text: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against You.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:21
verses.text: Do not abhor <hi>us</hi> for Your name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of Your glory; remember, do not break Your covenant with us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:22
verses.text: Are there <hi>any</hi> among the vanities of the nations who make rain fall? Or can the heavens give showers? <hi>Is</hi> it not You, O LORD our God? Then we will wait on You; for You do all these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:1
verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before Me, My soul <hi>could</hi> not <hi>be</hi> toward this people. Send <hi>them</hi> out of My sight, and let them go out.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:2
verses.text: And it will be, if they say to you, Where shall we go? Then you shall tell them, So says the LORD: Those who <hi>are</hi> for death, go to death; and those for the sword, to the sword; and those for the famine, to the famine; and those for the captivity, to the captivity.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:3
verses.text: And I will set over them four kinds, says the LORD; the sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the heaven and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:4
verses.text: And I will make them a horror to all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:5
verses.text: For who shall have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Or who shall weep over you? Or who shall turn aside to ask your welfare?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:6
verses.text: You have forsaken Me, says the LORD; you have gone backward; therefore I will stretch out My hand against you, and destroy you; I am weary with repenting.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:7
verses.text: And I will winnow them with a fork in the gates of the land; I will bereave <hi>them</hi> of sons; I will destroy My people, since they do not turn from their ways.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:8
verses.text: Their widows are more numerous about Me than the sand of the seas; I have brought on them, against a mother of a young man, a ravager at noonday; I have caused anguish and terror to fall on her suddenly.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:9
verses.text: She who bore seven languishes; she has breathed out her life; her sun has gone down while <hi>it was</hi> yet day. She has been ashamed and humiliated; and I will deliver the rest of them to the sword before their enemies, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:10
verses.text: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not loaned, nor have men loaned to me; <hi>yet</hi> every one curses me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:11
verses.text: The LORD said, Truly I will free you for good. Truly I will cause the enemy to entreat you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:12
verses.text: Can one break iron, iron or bronze from the north?

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:13
verses.text: Your wealth and your treasures I will give for prey, not for price, <hi>but</hi> for all your sins, even in all your borders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:14
verses.text: And I will make <hi>you</hi> pass with your enemies into a land <hi>which</hi> you do not know. For a fire has been kindled in My anger; it shall burn against you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:15
verses.text: O LORD, You know; remember me and visit me, and take vengeance for me on those who seek to hurt me. Do not take me away in Your long-suffering; know that for Your sake I have suffered rebuke.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:16
verses.text: Your words were found, and I ate them; and Your Word was to me the joy and gladness of my heart; for I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:17
verses.text: I did not sit in the circle of mockers, nor rejoice; I sat alone because of Your hand; for You have filled me with indignation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:18
verses.text: Why has my pain been without end, and why is my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? You surely are to me like a deceitful brook, waters that cannot be trusted.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:19
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD, If you turn back, then I will bring you again; you shall stand before Me. And if you take the precious from the worthless, you shall be as My mouth. Let them turn back to you, but do not return to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:20
verses.text: And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; and they shall fight against you, but they shall not overcome you; for I <hi>am</hi> with you to save you and to deliver you, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:21
verses.text: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the evil ones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD was to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:2
verses.text: You shall not take a wife for yourself, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:3
verses.text: For so says the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who fathered them in this land:

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:4
verses.text: They shall die from deaths of diseases; they shall not be mourned, nor shall they be buried. <hi>But</hi> they shall be as dung on the face of the earth. And they shall be destroyed by the sword and by famine; and their bodies shall be food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:5
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Do not enter into the house of mourning; do not go to weep nor moan over them. For I have taken away My peace from this people, says the LORD, even loving-kindness and mercies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:6
verses.text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried, nor shall <hi>men</hi> mourn for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:7
verses.text: Nor shall <hi>anyone</hi> tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Nor shall <hi>anyone</hi> give them the cup of comfort to drink for their father or for their mother.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:8
verses.text: Also you shall not go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:9
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause the voice of mirth to cease out of this place <hi>before</hi> your eyes, and in your days, and the voice of gladness, and the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:10
verses.text: And it shall be, when you declare to this people all these words, and they shall say to you, Why has the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? Or what <hi>is</hi> our iniquity, or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:11
verses.text: Then you shall say to them, Because your fathers have forsaken Me, says the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshiped them, and have forsaken Me, and have not kept My law.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:12
verses.text: And you have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, you walk each one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, without listening to Me;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:13
verses.text: even I will cast you out of this land into a land that you do not know, <hi>neither</hi> you nor your fathers; and there you shall serve other gods day and night; where I will not grant you favor.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:14
verses.text: So, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that it shall no more be said, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:15
verses.text: but, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands where He had driven them. And I will bring them again into their lands that I gave to their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:16
verses.text: Behold, I will send for many fishermen, says the LORD, and they will fish them. And afterwards I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:17
verses.text: For My eyes <hi>are</hi> on all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, nor is their iniquity hidden from My eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:18
verses.text: And first I will twice repay their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land, they have filled My inheritance with the dead bodies of their abominable things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:19
verses.text: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations shall come to You from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and there is no profit in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:20
verses.text: Shall a man make gods to himself, and they <hi>are</hi> no gods?

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:21
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will make them know; this time I will cause them to know My hand and My might; and they shall know that My name <hi>is</hi> Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:1
verses.text: The sin of Judah <hi>is</hi> engraved with an iron stylus; <hi>it is</hi> carved on the tablet of the heart and on the horns of Your altar with the point of a diamond;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:2
verses.text: while their sons remember their altars and their Asherahs by the green trees on the high hills.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:3
verses.text: O My mountain in the field, I will give your wealth <hi>and</hi> all your treasures for prey, and your high places for sin, throughout all your borders.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:4
verses.text: And you, even through yourself, have let go of the inheritance which I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in a land which you do not know. For you have kindled a fire in My anger, <hi>which</hi> shall burn forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:5
verses.text: So says the LORD, Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man who trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:6
verses.text: For he shall be like a juniper in the desert, and shall not see when good comes. But he shall live in the parched places in the wilderness, <hi>in</hi> a salt land that is not inhabited.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:7
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> the man who trusts in the LORD, and Jehovah is his trust.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:8
verses.text: For he shall be like a tree planted by the waters; <hi>it</hi> sends out its roots by the river, and <hi>it</hi> shall not fear when the heat comes, but its foliage shall be green; and he is not worried in the year of drought, nor will it cease from yielding fruit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:9
verses.text: The heart <hi>is</hi> deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked; who can know it?

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:10
verses.text: I the LORD search the heart, <hi>I</hi> try the reins, even to give to each man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:11
verses.text: The quail sits <hi>on eggs</hi> and does not hatch <hi>them</hi>; in the same way he who gets riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the middle of his days, and in his end he shall be a fool.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:12
verses.text: A glorious high throne from the beginning <hi>is</hi> the place of our sanctuary.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:13
verses.text: O LORD, the Hope of Israel, all who forsake You shall be ashamed. Those who depart from Me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the Fountain of living waters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:14
verses.text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed, save me, and I shall be saved; for You <hi>are</hi> my praise.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:15
verses.text: Behold, they say to me, Where <hi>is</hi> the word of the LORD? Let it come now!

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:16
verses.text: I have not hurried away from shepherding after You; nor have I desired the woeful day; You surely know the going forth of my lips before Your face.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:17
verses.text: Do not be a terror to me; You <hi>are</hi> my hope in the day of evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:18
verses.text: Let those who persecute me be ashamed, but do not let me be ashamed; let them be afraid, but do not let me be afraid. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them <hi>with</hi> double breaking.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:19
verses.text: So the LORD said to me: Go and stand in the gates of the sons of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:20
verses.text: And say to them, Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the people of Jerusalem who enter in by these gates!

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:21
verses.text: So says the LORD, Take heed to yourselves, and carry no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring <hi>it</hi> in by the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:22
verses.text: Nor carry out a burden from your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:23
verses.text: But they did not obey, nor bowed down their ear, but made their neck stiff, so that they might not hear nor receive instruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:24
verses.text: And it shall be, if you carefully listen to Me, says the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but keep the Sabbath day holy, to do no work in it;

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:25
verses.text: then kings and rulers sitting on the throne of David shall enter into the gates of this city, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their rulers, the men of Judah, and the people of Jerusalem. And this city shall remain forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:26
verses.text: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and grain offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise to the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:27
verses.text: But if you will not listen to me to keep the Sabbath day holy, and not to carry a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it will not be put out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:1
verses.text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:2
verses.text: Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear My words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:3
verses.text: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he was working a work on the wheel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:4
verses.text: And the vessel that he made in clay was ruined in the hand of the potter; so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:5
verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:6
verses.text: O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter? says the LORD. Behold, As the clay in the potter's hands, <hi>so are</hi> you in My hand, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:7
verses.text: The instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck it up and to pull it down, and to destroy <hi>it</hi>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:8
verses.text: if that nation, against whom I have spoken, will turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:9
verses.text: And the instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build it and to plant <hi>it</hi>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:10
verses.text: if it does evil in My sight, not to obey My voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would do them good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:11
verses.text: Now then please, speak to the men of Judah, and to the people of Jerusalem, saying, So says the LORD: Behold, I am forming evil against you, and devising a plan against you. Return now, each one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:12
verses.text: And they said, There is no hope; but we will walk after our own ways, and we will each one do <hi>according to</hi> the stubbornness of his evil heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:13
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD, Ask now among the nations; who has heard the like of this? The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:14
verses.text: Does the snow of Lebanon forsake the rock of the field? <hi>Or</hi> shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:15
verses.text: Because My people have forgotten Me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused themselves to stumble in their ways <hi>from</hi> the old paths, to walk <hi>in</hi> by-paths, not <hi>in</hi> the highway,

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:16
verses.text: to make their land desolate <hi>and</hi> a hissing forever. Everyone who passes by will be amazed, and will wag his head.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:17
verses.text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:18
verses.text: Then they said, Come and let us plot schemes against Jeremiah. For the law shall not perish from the priest, nor wisdom from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:19
verses.text: Pay attention to me; O LORD, and attend to the voice of my foes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:20
verses.text: Should evil be repaid for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before You to do good for them, <hi>and</hi> to turn away Your wrath from them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:21
verses.text: Therefore deliver up their sons to the famine, and give them over to the hand of the sword. And let their wives be bereaved, and widows, and their men <hi>be</hi> slain of death; let their young men be struck by the sword in battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:22
verses.text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when You suddenly bring a raiding party on them. For they have dug a pit to take me, and have hidden snares for my feet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:23
verses.text: Yet, LORD, You know all their counsel against me to kill <hi>me</hi>. Do not forgive their iniquity, nor blot out their sin from Your sight, but let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:1
verses.text: So says the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen jar, and <hi>assemble</hi> from the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:2
verses.text: And go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom by the entry of Potsherd Gate. And there declare the words that I shall tell you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:3
verses.text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and people of Jerusalem. So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which shall cause the ears of him who hears it to tingle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:4
verses.text: Because they have forsaken Me, and have made this place <hi>famous</hi> and have burned incense in it to other gods whom they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:5
verses.text: They have also built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire <hi>for</hi> burnt offerings to Baal, which I never commanded nor spoke, nor did <hi>it</hi> come into My mind.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:6
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but, The Valley of Slaughter.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:7
verses.text: And I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem come to nothing in this place, and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of those who seek their lives. And I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the animals of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:8
verses.text: And I will make this city a waste and a hissing. Everyone who passes by shall be amazed and shall hiss because of all its plagues.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:9
verses.text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall each one eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and distress, with which their enemies and those who seek their lives shall distress them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:10
verses.text: Then you shall break the jar before the eyes of the men who go with you,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:11
verses.text: and shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, Even so I will break this people of this city, as <hi>one</hi> breaks a potter's vessel that cannot be made whole again. And they shall bury <hi>them</hi> in Tophet until there is no place <hi>left</hi> to bury.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:12
verses.text: I will do this to this place, says the LORD, and to its people, and make this city as Tophet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:13
verses.text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be as defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the host of the heavens, and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:14
verses.text: Then Jeremiah came from Tophet, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy. And he stood in the court of the LORD's house, and said to all the people,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:15
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their necks so that they might not hear My words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:1
verses.text: When Pashur the son of Immer the priest (he was chief officer in the house of the LORD) heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:2
verses.text: then Pashur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that <hi>were</hi> in the upper Benjamin Gate, which <hi>was</hi> by the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:3
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, Pashur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, The LORD has not called your name Pashur, but Terror from All Around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:4
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. And they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold <hi>it</hi>. And I will give all Judah into the king of Babylon's hand, and he will exile them into Babylon, and kill them with the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:5
verses.text: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and its produce, and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah, <hi>even</hi> I will give into the hand of their enemies; who will strip them and take them, and bring them to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:6
verses.text: And you, Pashur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. And you shall come to Babylon, and you shall die there, and shall be buried there; you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:7
verses.text: O LORD, You have deceived me, and I was deceived. You are stronger than I, and You have prevailed. I am in derision all the day; everyone laughs at me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:8
verses.text: For whenever I speak, I cry out, I cry violence and ruin; for the word of the LORD has been a reproach and a cause of mocking to me all day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:9
verses.text: Then I said, I will not mention Him, nor speak in His name any more. But <hi>His word</hi> was in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with holding in, and I could not stop.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:10
verses.text: For I heard the slanders of many, Terror is all around! Expose! Yea, let us expose him! Every man of my peace is watching for my fall, <hi>saying</hi>, Perhaps he will be lured away, and we shall prevail over him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:11
verses.text: But the LORD <hi>is</hi> with me like a mighty, awesome one. Therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not overcome me. They shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not be blessed. <hi>Their</hi> everlasting shame shall never be forgotten.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:12
verses.text: But, O LORD of hosts, who tries the righteous <hi>and</hi> sees the reins and the heart, let me see Your vengeance on them. For I have committed my cause to You.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:13
verses.text: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD; for He has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:14
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> the day in which I was born; let not the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:15
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> the man who brought news to my father, saying, A man child is born to you; making him very glad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:16
verses.text: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not; and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:17
verses.text: because he did not kill me from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb <hi>to be</hi> always great <hi>with me</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:18
verses.text: Why did I come forth from the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed in shame?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:1
verses.text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:2
verses.text: Please inquire of the LORD for us. For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is warring against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all His wonderful works, that he may go up from us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:3
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said to them, You shall say this to Zedekiah,

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:4
verses.text: So says the Jehovah, God of Israel: Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and <hi>against</hi> the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls. And I will gather them together in the middle of this city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:5
verses.text: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:6
verses.text: And I will strike the people of this city, both man and beast. They shall die of a great plague.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:7
verses.text: And afterward, says the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and those who are left in this city from the plague, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. And he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, nor have pity, nor have mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:8
verses.text: And to this people you shall say, So says the LORD, Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:9
verses.text: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague. But he who goes out and falls to the Chaldeans who are all around you, he shall live, and his life shall be his prize.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:10
verses.text: For I have set My face against this city for evil, and not for good, says the LORD. It shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:11
verses.text: And concerning the house of the king of Judah, <hi>say</hi>, Hear the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:12
verses.text: O house of David, so says the LORD: Do judgment in the morning, and deliver <hi>him who is</hi> robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest My fury go out like fire, and burn so that none can put <hi>it</hi> out, because of the evil of your doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:13
verses.text: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O dweller of the valley, rock of the plain, says the LORD; those who say, Who shall come down against us? Or who shall enter into our homes?

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:14
verses.text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says the LORD; and I will kindle a fire in the forest of it, and it shall devour all things around it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:1
verses.text: So says the LORD: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:2
verses.text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you and your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:3
verses.text: So says the LORD, Do judgment and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the oppressors's hand. And do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, or the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:4
verses.text: For if you do this thing indeed, then there shall enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:5
verses.text: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by Myself, says the LORD, that this house shall become a ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:6
verses.text: For so says the LORD to the king of Judah's house, You <hi>are</hi> Gilead to Me, <hi>and</hi> the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities with no people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:7
verses.text: And I will prepare destroyers against you, each one with his weapons. And they shall cut down your choice cedars, and throw <hi>them</hi> into the fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:8
verses.text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say each one to his neighbor, Why has the LORD done this to this great city?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:9
verses.text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshiped other gods, and served them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:10
verses.text: Weep not for the dead, nor moan for him; <hi>but</hi> weep bitterly for him who goes away. For he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:11
verses.text: For so says the LORD concerning Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, who reigned in the place of Josiah his father, who went forth out of this place; he shall not return there any more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:12
verses.text: But he shall die in the place where they have exiled him and shall see this land no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:13
verses.text: Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness and his upper rooms without justice; his neighbor serves without pay, and he does not give him his work;

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:14
verses.text: who says, I will build myself a wide house and large rooms, and cuts out windows for himself, and puts in a cedar ceiling, and paints it with vermilion.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:15
verses.text: Do you reign, because you lust to excel in cedar? Did not your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then <hi>it was</hi> well with him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:16
verses.text: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then <hi>it was</hi> well with him. Was this not to know Me? says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:17
verses.text: But your eyes and your heart <hi>are</hi> for nothing but your unjust gain, and to shed innocent blood, and for cruelty, and to do violence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:18
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, They shall not mourn for him, <hi>saying</hi>, Ah, my brother! or, Ah, sister! They shall not mourn for him, <hi>saying</hi>, Ah, lord! or, Ah, his glory!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:19
verses.text: He shall be buried <hi>with</hi> the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:20
verses.text: Go up to Lebanon, and cry. And lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim, for all your lovers are destroyed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:21
verses.text: I spoke to you in your prosperity; <hi>but</hi> you said, I will not hear. This <hi>has been</hi> your way from your youth, for you have not obeyed My voice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:22
verses.text: The wind shall eat up all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity; surely then you will be ashamed and humiliated for all your wickedness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:23
verses.text: O dweller in Lebanon, nested in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs come to you, the pain as one giving birth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:24
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on My right hand, yet I would pull you out of there!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:25
verses.text: And I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand <hi>of those</hi> whose face you fear, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:26
verses.text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into another country where you were not born. And there you shall die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:27
verses.text: But to the land to which they desire to return, there they shall not return.

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:28
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> this man Coniah a despised broken jar? <hi>Is he</hi> a vessel in which there <hi>is</hi> no pleasure? Why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they do not know?

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:29
verses.text: O earth, earth, earth! Hear the word of the LORD!

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:30
verses.text: So says the LORD, Write this man down as childless, a man who will not be blessed in his days. For no man of his seed shall be blessed, sitting on the throne of David and ruling any more in Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:1
verses.text: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:2
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD God of Israel against the shepherds who feed My people, You have scattered My flock, and have driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will bring on you the evil of your doings, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:3
verses.text: And I will gather the remnant of My flock out of all countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their fold. And they shall be fruitful and multiply.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:4
verses.text: And I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. And they shall fear no more, nor be afraid; nor shall they lack <hi>anything</hi>, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:5
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and act wisely, and shall do judgment and justice in the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:6
verses.text: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely. And this <hi>is</hi> His name by which He shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:7
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD lives, who brought the sons of Israel up out of the land of Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:8
verses.text: but, The LORD lives, who brought up and led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries where I have driven them. And they shall dwell in their own land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:9
verses.text: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of His holiness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:10
verses.text: For the land is full of adulterers. Yes, because of cursing the land mourns; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their power <hi>is</hi> not right.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:11
verses.text: For both prophet and priest are ungodly; yes, in My house I have found their evil, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:12
verses.text: So their way shall be to them as slippery <hi>ways</hi> in the darkness; they shall be driven on, and fall in them; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their judgment, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:13
verses.text: And I have seen frivolity in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied by Baal and caused My people Israel to go astray.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:14
verses.text: I have also seen in the prophets of Jerusalem a horrible thing; they commit adultery and walk in falsehood. They also strengthen to the hands of evildoers, so that none returns from his evil; they are all of them like Sodom to Me, and its inhabitants like Gomorrah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:15
verses.text: So the LORD of hosts says this concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them wormwood, and make them drink poisonous water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone forth into all the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:16
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They make you vain; they speak a vision from their own heart, not out of the mouth of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:17
verses.text: They still say to those who despise Me, The LORD has said, You shall have peace! And they say to everyone who walks after the stubbornness of his own heart, No evil shall come on you!

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:18
verses.text: For who has stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hears His word? Who has listened to His word and heard <hi>it</hi>?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:19
verses.text: Behold, the tempest of the LORD has gone forth in fury, a whirling tempest. It shall whirl on the head of the wicked.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:20
verses.text: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until He has done and until He has set up the purposes of His heart; in later days you shall understand it perfectly.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:21
verses.text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran; I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:22
verses.text: But if they had stood in My wisdom and had caused My people to hear My words, then they would have turned them from their evil way and from the evil of their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:23
verses.text: <hi> Am</hi> I a God near, says the LORD, and not a God afar off?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:24
verses.text: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? says the LORD. Do I not fill the heavens and earth? says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:25
verses.text: I have heard what the prophets said, who prophesy lies in My name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:26
verses.text: How long shall <hi>this</hi> be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies? But they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart,

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:27
verses.text: who plot to cause My people to forget My name by their dreams which they tell, each one to his neighbor, as their fathers have forgotten My name for Baal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:28
verses.text: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream. And he who has My word, let him speak My word faithfully. What <hi>is</hi> the chaff to the wheat? says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:29
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> not My word like a fire? says the LORD; and like a hammer <hi>that</hi> breaks the rock in pieces?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:30
verses.text: So the LORD says, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against the prophets who steal My words each one from his neighbor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:31
verses.text: The LORD says, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against the prophets who use their tongues and say, He says.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:32
verses.text: The LORD says, Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against those who prophesy false dreams and tell them, and cause My people to go astray by their lies and by their lightness. Yet I did not send them nor command them; therefore they shall not profit this people at all, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:33
verses.text: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What <hi>is</hi> the burden of the LORD? You shall then say to them, What burden? I will even forsake you, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:34
verses.text: And <hi>as for</hi> the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:35
verses.text: So you shall say each one to his neighbor, and each one to his brother, What has the LORD answered? And what has the LORD spoken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:36
verses.text: And you shall mention the burden of the LORD no more. For every man's word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:37
verses.text: So you shall say to the prophet, What has the LORD answered you? And what has the LORD spoken?

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:38
verses.text: But since you say, The burden of the LORD; therefore so says the LORD, Because you say this word; the burden of the LORD; and I have sent to you saying, You shall not say, The burden of the LORD;

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:39
verses.text: therefore, behold, I, even I, will completely forget you, and I will forsake you and the city that I gave you and your fathers, <hi>and cast you</hi> out of My presence.

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:40
verses.text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a never-ending shame, which shall not be forgotten.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:1
verses.text: The LORD caused me to see, and behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of the LORD (after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had exiled Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the rulers of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon);

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:2
verses.text: one basket <hi>had</hi> very good figs, like the first ripe figs. And the other basket <hi>had</hi> very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:3
verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so that they cannot be eaten, they are so bad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:4
verses.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:5
verses.text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place <hi>into</hi> the land of the Chaldeans for <hi>their</hi> good.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:6
verses.text: For I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. And I will build them and not pull <hi>them</hi> down; and I will plant them and not pluck them up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:7
verses.text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God. For they shall return to Me with their whole heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:8
verses.text: And like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad; surely so says the LORD, So I will give to Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his rulers, and the rest of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt;

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:9
verses.text: and I will even make them a horror for evil to all the kingdoms of the earth, for a reproach and a proverb, a gibe and a curse, there in all places where I shall drive them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:10
verses.text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the plague among them until they are destroyed from the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah. It <hi>was</hi> the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:2
verses.text: the word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the people of Jerusalem, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:3
verses.text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even to this day, that <hi>is</hi> the twenty-third year, the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking. But you have not listened.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:4
verses.text: And the LORD has sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but you have not listened nor bowed down your ear to hear.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:5
verses.text: They said, Turn again now, each one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers forever and ever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:6
verses.text: And do not go after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:7
verses.text: Yet you have not listened to Me, says the LORD, so that you might provoke Me with the works of your hands, for harm to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:8
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, Because you have not heard My words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:9
verses.text: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says the LORD, and Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant; and will bring them against this land, and against its people, and against all these nations all around. And I will completely destroy them, and make them a waste, and a hissing, and everlasting ruins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:10
verses.text: And I will take from them the voice of rejoicing and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the candle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:11
verses.text: And this whole land shall be a ruin <hi>and</hi> a waste. And these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:12
verses.text: And it shall be, when seventy years are fulfilled I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, and the land of the Chaldeans, says the LORD, for their iniquity, and I will make it an everlasting ruins.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:13
verses.text: And I will bring on that land all My words which I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:14
verses.text: For many nations and great kings shall lay service on them also. And I will repay them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:15
verses.text: For so says the LORD, the God of Israel, to me, Take the wine cup of this wrath at My hand, and cause all the nations to whom I shall send you to drink it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:16
verses.text: And they shall drink, and reel to and fro, and be maddened, because of the sword that I will send among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:17
verses.text: Then I took the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations drink, to whom the LORD had sent me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:18
verses.text: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings of them, and their rulers, to make them a ruin and a, a hissing, and a curse, (as <hi>it is</hi> today),

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:19
verses.text: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and his servants, and his rulers, and all his people,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:20
verses.text: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the rest of Ashdod;

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:21
verses.text: Edom, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:22
verses.text: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands beyond the sea,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:23
verses.text: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and trim the edges <hi>of their beards</hi>,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:24
verses.text: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the desert,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:25
verses.text: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:26
verses.text: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which <hi>are</hi> on the face of the earth; and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:27
verses.text: So you shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink and be drunk, and vomit, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:28
verses.text: And it shall be if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, You shall certainly drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:29
verses.text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by My name; and should you be found entirely without guilt? You shall not be without guilt. For I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of hosts.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:30
verses.text: And prophesy against them all these words, and say to them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter His voice from His holy habitation. He shall mightily roar over His dwelling place. He shall give a shout, like those who tread out <hi>grapes</hi>, against all the people of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:31
verses.text: A noise shall come to the ends of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations; He will enter into judgment with all flesh. He will give those <hi>who are</hi> wicked to the sword, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:32
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great tempest shall be stirred up from the corners of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:33
verses.text: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from <hi>one</hi> end of the earth even to the <hi>other</hi> end of the earth; they shall not be mourned, nor gathered, nor buried. They shall be <hi>as</hi> dung on the ground.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:34
verses.text: Howl, shepherds, and cry; and roll, leaders of the flock! For the days of your slaughter and of your scatterings are fulfilled; and you shall fall like a desirable vessel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:35
verses.text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the choice ones of the flock, to escape.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:36
verses.text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and a howling of the choice ones of the flock <hi>shall be heard</hi>; for the LORD has spoiled their pasture.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:37
verses.text: And the peaceful pastures are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:38
verses.text: Like the lion, He has left His den; for their land is wasted because of the oppressor's pressing fury, and because of His fierce anger.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:1
verses.text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:2
verses.text: So says the LORD: Stand in the court of the LORD's house and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; do not keep back a word.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:3
verses.text: It may be that they will listen, and each man turn from his evil way, that I may repent of the evil which I plan to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:4
verses.text: And you shall say to them, So says the LORD: If you will not listen to Me, to walk in My law which I have set before you,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:5
verses.text: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I am sending to you (both rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened);

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:6
verses.text: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:7
verses.text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:8
verses.text: And it happened when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded <hi>him</hi> to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die!

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:9
verses.text: Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be wasted, without inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:10
verses.text: When the rulers of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house to the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD's <hi>house</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:11
verses.text: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, <hi>Let</hi> a death sentence be for this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:12
verses.text: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the rulers and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:13
verses.text: So now make your ways and your doings good, and obey the voice of the LORD your God. And the LORD will repent of the evil that He has spoken against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:14
verses.text: As for me, behold, I <hi>am</hi> in your hand. Do with me as seems good and right to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:15
verses.text: But know for certain that if you put me to death you shall surely bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its people. For truly the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:16
verses.text: Then the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, There <hi>is</hi> not a sentence of death for this man; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:17
verses.text: Then some of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:18
verses.text: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: Zion shall be plowed <hi>like</hi> a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house like the high places of a forest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:19
verses.text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah indeed put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD, and pray to the LORD, and the LORD repented of the evil which He had spoken against them? So we are doing great evil against our souls.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:20
verses.text: And there was also a man who prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:21
verses.text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the rulers, heard his words, the king tried to put him to death. But when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled and went into Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:22
verses.text: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt; Elnathan the son of Achbor, and men with him into Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:23
verses.text: And they brought Urijah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and threw his dead body into the graves of the common people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:24
verses.text: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:1
verses.text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:2
verses.text: So says the LORD to me, Make bonds and yokes for yourself, and put them on your neck.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:3
verses.text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who came to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:4
verses.text: And command them to <hi>go to</hi> their masters, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: So you shall say to your masters,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:5
verses.text: I have made the earth, the man, and the animals on the face of the earth, by My great power and by My outstretched arm, and have given it to whom it seemed right to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:6
verses.text: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant. And I have also given him the beast of the field to serve him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:7
verses.text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes. And then many nations and great kings shall enslave him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:8
verses.text: And it shall be, the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation I will punish, says the LORD, with the sword and with the famine, and with the plague, until I have destroyed them by his hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:9
verses.text: As for you, do not listen to your prophets, nor to your fortune tellers, nor to your dreams, nor to your conjurers, nor to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:10
verses.text: For they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, and that I should drive you out and you should perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:11
verses.text: But the nations who bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those I will leave it on their own land, says the LORD. And <hi>they</hi> shall work it and dwell in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:12
verses.text: I also spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:13
verses.text: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, as the LORD has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:14
verses.text: Therefore do not listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon. For they prophesy a lie to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:15
verses.text: For I have not sent them, says the LORD; yet they prophesy a lie in My name, so that I might drive you out, and that you might perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:16
verses.text: Also I spoke to the priests and to all the people, saying, So says the LORD, Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon. For they prophesy a lie to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:17
verses.text: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live. For why should this city be laid waste?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:18
verses.text: But if they <hi>are</hi> prophets, and if the word of the LORD is with them, let them now pray to the LORD of hosts that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and <hi>in</hi> the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, may not go to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:19
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels which remain in this city,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:20
verses.text: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he exiled Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:21
verses.text: yes, so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain <hi>in</hi> the house of the LORD and <hi>in</hi> the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem:

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:22
verses.text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and they shall be there until the day that I visit them, says the LORD. Then I will bring them up and give them back to this place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:1
verses.text: And it happened in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:2
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:3
verses.text: Within two full years I will again bring into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried them to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:4
verses.text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah who went into Babylon, says the LORD. For I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:5
verses.text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence all the people who stood in the house of the LORD,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:6
verses.text: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen. May the LORD do <hi>so</hi>. May the LORD confirm your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is exiled from Babylon into this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:7
verses.text: But hear now this word that I speak in your ears and in the ears of all the people:

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:8
verses.text: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of plague.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:9
verses.text: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, <hi>then</hi> the prophet shall be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:10
verses.text: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck and broke it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:11
verses.text: And Hananiah spoke for the eyes of all the people, saying, So says the LORD, Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the time of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:12
verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:13
verses.text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, So says the LORD: You have broken the yokes of wood, but you shall make for them yokes of iron.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:14
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And they shall serve him. And I have given him the beasts of the field also.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:15
verses.text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah. The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people to trust in a lie.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:16
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will drive you from off the face of the earth. You shall die this year, because you have taught rebellion against the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:17
verses.text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders of the exile, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:2
verses.text: (After Jeconiah the king, and the queen mother, and the eunuchs, the rulers of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, had departed from Jerusalem.)

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:3
verses.text: The letter came by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah the king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:4
verses.text: So says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, to all the exiles whom I caused to be exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:5
verses.text: Build houses and live <hi>in them</hi>; and plant gardens and eat their fruit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:6
verses.text: Take wives and father sons and daughters. And take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may bear sons and daughters, that you may be multiplied there and not become few.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:7
verses.text: And seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be exiled, and pray to the LORD for it. For in its peace you shall have peace.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:8
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Do not let your prophets and your fortune-tellers in your midst deceive you, nor listen to your dreams which you dream.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:9
verses.text: For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:10
verses.text: For so says the LORD, When according to My word seventy years have been fulfilled for Babylon, I will visit you and confirm My good word to you, to bring you back to this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:11
