verses.text: For I know the purposes which I am purposing for you, says the LORD; purposes of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:12
verses.text: Then you shall call on Me, and you shall go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:13
verses.text: And you shall seek Me and find <hi>Me</hi>, when you search for Me with all your heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:14
verses.text: And I will be found by you, says the LORD; and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you, says the LORD. And I will bring you again into the place from where I caused you to be exiled.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:15
verses.text: Because you have said, The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:16
verses.text: so says the LORD of the king who sits on the throne of David, and of all the people who dwell in this city, <hi>and</hi> of your brothers who have not gone out with you into captivity;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:17
verses.text: so says the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the plague, and will make them like worthless figs which cannot be eaten from badness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:18
verses.text: And I will pursue them with the sword, with the famine, and with the plague, and will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and a waste, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations where I have driven them,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:19
verses.text: because they have not listened to My words, says the LORD, which I sent to them by My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending; but you would not hear, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:20
verses.text: And hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:21
verses.text: so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, about Ahab the son of Kolaiah and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in My name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall kill them before your eyes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:22
verses.text: And a curse shall be taken up from them by all the exiles of Judah who <hi>are</hi> in Babylon, saying, May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:23
verses.text: because they have committed evil in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives, and have spoken lying words in My name, which I have not commanded them; for I <hi>am</hi> He who knows and a witness, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:24
verses.text: You shall also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:25
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because you have sent letters in your name to all the people who <hi>are</hi> at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:26
verses.text: The LORD has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to be officers <hi>in</hi> the house of the LORD, over every madman who prophesies, that you should put him into the stocks and into the collar.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:27
verses.text: Now therefore why have you not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, who prophesies to you?

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:28
verses.text: For this cause he sent to us <hi>in</hi> Babylon, saying, This <hi>exile is</hi> long. Build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:29
verses.text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:30
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:31
verses.text: Send to all the exiles, saying, So says the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he caused you to trust in a lie,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:32
verses.text: therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his seed. He shall not have a man to dwell among this people; nor shall he behold the good which I shall do for My people, says the LORD, because he has taught rebellion against the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:2
verses.text: So speaks the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:3
verses.text: For, lo, the days come, says the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, says the LORD. And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave their fathers, and they shall possess it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:4
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:5
verses.text: For so says the LORD, We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:6
verses.text: Ask now, and see whether a man is giving birth? Why do I see every man with his hands on his loins, like a woman in labor, and all faces are turned into paleness?

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:7
verses.text: Alas! For that day <hi>is</hi> great, so that none <hi>is</hi> like it; it <hi>is</hi> even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:8
verses.text: For it shall be in that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will break his yoke from your neck and will burst your bonds. And strangers shall no longer enslave him,

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:9
verses.text: but they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:10
verses.text: And you, O My servant Jacob, do not fear, says the LORD. Do not be terrified, O Israel. For lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity. And Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make <hi>him</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:11
verses.text: For I <hi>am</hi> with you, says the LORD, to save you. Though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered you, yet I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you entirely unpunished.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:12
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Your break cannot be cured, and your wound <hi>is</hi> grievous.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:13
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> none to plead your cause; for <hi>your</hi> ulcer there are <hi>no</hi> healing medicines for you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:14
verses.text: All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity; <hi>because</hi> your sins are many.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:15
verses.text: Why do you cry over your crushing? Your pain <hi>is</hi> incurable, for the greatness of your iniquity; because your sins are many, I have done these things to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:16
verses.text: So all those who devour you shall be devoured; and all your enemies, every one of them, shall go into captivity. And they who rob you shall be robbed, and all who strip you I will strip.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:17
verses.text: For I will give health back to you, and will heal you of your wounds, says the LORD; because they called you an outcast, <hi>saying</hi>, This is Zion; no one is seeking for her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:18
verses.text: So says the LORD: Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and will have mercy on his dwelling places. And the city shall be built on her own hill, and the palace shall remain in its own place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:19
verses.text: And out of them shall come thanksgiving, and the voice of those who rejoice. And I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:20
verses.text: Also their sons shall be as they were before, and their congregation shall be established before Me, and I will punish all who ill-treat them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:21
verses.text: And their rulers shall be of themselves, and their governor shall come from among them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach Me. For who <hi>is</hi> this who pledged his heart to come near to Me? says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:22
verses.text: And you shall be My people, and I will be your God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:23
verses.text: Behold, the tempest of the LORD goes forth with fury, a never-ending tempest; it shall fall with pain on the head of the wicked.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:24
verses.text: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return until He has done <hi>it</hi>, and until He has fulfilled the intentions of His heart. In the latter days you shall understand it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:1
verses.text: At that time, says the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:2
verses.text: So says the LORD, The people <hi>who were</hi> left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I will go to give him rest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:3
verses.text: The LORD has appeared to me from afar, <hi>saying</hi>, Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with loving-kindness I have drawn you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:4
verses.text: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel. You shall again put on your tambourines, and shall go forth in the dances of those who rejoice.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:5
verses.text: You shall yet plant vines on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall eat <hi>them</hi> as common things.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:6
verses.text: For there shall be a day <hi>that</hi> the watchmen on Mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise and let us go up to Zion to the LORD our God!

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:7
verses.text: For so says the LORD, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations. Cry out, give praise and say, O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:8
verses.text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country and gather them from the corners of the earth, and with <hi>them</hi> the blind and the lame, the woman with child and she who is in labor with child, together; a great company shall return there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:9
verses.text: They shall come with weeping, and with prayers I will lead them. I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way; they shall not stumble in it, for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim <hi>is</hi> My firstborn.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:10
verses.text: Hear the word of the LORD, O nations, and declare <hi>it</hi> in the coastlands afar off. And say, He who scattered Israel will gather him and keep him, as a shepherd <hi>keeps</hi> his flock.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:11
verses.text: For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of the one stronger than he.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:12
verses.text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the sons of the flock and the herd. And their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not pine away any more at all.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:13
verses.text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them and make them rejoice from their affliction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:14
verses.text: And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness, and My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:15
verses.text: So says the LORD: A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing <hi>and</hi> bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her sons; she refuses to be comforted for her sons, because they <hi>are</hi> not.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:16
verses.text: So says the LORD: Hold back your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, says the LORD. And they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:17
verses.text: And there is hope for your future, says the LORD, that <hi>your</hi> sons shall come again to their own border.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:18
verses.text: I have surely heard Ephraim mourning to himself, <hi>saying</hi>, You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bull not broken in; turn me, and I shall be turned. For You <hi>are</hi> the LORD my God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:19
verses.text: Surely after I was turned, I repented; and after I was taught, I struck on <hi>my</hi> thigh. I was ashamed, yea, I even blushed, because I bore the disgrace of my youth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:20
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> Ephraim My dear son? <hi>Is he</hi> a delightful child? For as often as I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still. Therefore My bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:21
verses.text: Set up waymarks, make sign posts for yourself. Set your heart toward the highway, the way you went. Turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these your cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:22
verses.text: How long will you turn to and fro, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land; a woman shall enclose a man.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:23
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Again they shall speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall again bring their captivity: The LORD bless you, O home of justice <hi>and</hi> mountain of holiness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:24
verses.text: And farmers, and those going forth with flocks, shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities of it together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:25
verses.text: For I satisfy the weary soul, and I fill every sorrowful soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:26
verses.text: On this I awoke and looked up; and my sleep was sweet to me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:27
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:28
verses.text: And it shall be, as I have watched over them to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so I will watch over them to build, and to plant, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:29
verses.text: In those days they shall not say any more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the sons are dull.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:30
verses.text: But every man shall die in his iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be dull.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:31
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will cut a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:32
verses.text: not according to the covenant that I cut with their fathers in the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which covenant of Mine they broke, although I was a husband to them, says the LORD;

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:33
verses.text: but this <hi>shall be</hi> the covenant that I will cut with the house of Israel: After those days, says the LORD, I will put My law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:34
verses.text: And they shall no more teach each man his neighbor and each man his brother, saying, Know the LORD; for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sins no more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:35
verses.text: So says the LORD, who gives the sun for a light by day and the laws of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who divides the sea when its waves roar; the LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name;

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:36
verses.text: if those ordinances depart from Me, says the LORD, the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before Me forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:37
verses.text: So says the LORD, If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be searched out, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:38
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the Tower of Hananeel to the Corner Gate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:39
verses.text: And the measuring line shall yet go before it to the hill Gareb, and shall go around to Goath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:40
verses.text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook of Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, <hi>shall be</hi> holy to the LORD. It shall not be plucked up nor thrown down any more forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which <hi>was</hi> the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:2
verses.text: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem. And Jeremiah the prophet was shut in the court of the guard, which <hi>was</hi> in the king of Judah's house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:3
verses.text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy and say, So says the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:4
verses.text: and Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:5
verses.text: and he shall lead Zedekiah into Babylon, and there he shall be until I visit him, says the LORD; though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not be blessed?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:6
verses.text: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:7
verses.text: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come to you, saying, Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth; for the right to redeem it <hi>is</hi> yours, to buy <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:8
verses.text: So Hanameel my uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD and said to me, Please buy my field in Anathoth, which <hi>is</hi> in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance <hi>is</hi> yours, and the right to redeem <hi>is</hi> yours. Buy <hi>it</hi> for yourself. Then I knew that this <hi>was</hi> the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:9
verses.text: And I bought the field in Anathoth, of Hanameel my uncle's son, and weighed him the silver, seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:10
verses.text: And I wrote it in the document, and sealed <hi>it</hi>, and called witnesses, and weighed the silver in the scales.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:11
verses.text: So I took the document of the purchase, that which was sealed <hi>according</hi> to the law and custom, and the open copy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:12
verses.text: And I gave the document of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, before the eyes of Hanameel my uncle's <hi>son</hi>, and before the eyes of the witnesses who wrote in the purchase document, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:13
verses.text: And I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:14
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these books, the purchase document, the one sealed and the open book, and put them in an earthen vessel so that they may stand many days.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:15
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall be owned again in this land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:16
verses.text: And after I gave the purchase document to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:17
verses.text: Ah, Lord Jehovah! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and stretched out arm. Nothing is too great for You.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:18
verses.text: You show loving-kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their sons after them. The great, the mighty God, the LORD of hosts, <hi>is</hi> His name,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:19
verses.text: great in wisdom and mighty in work; for Your eyes <hi>are</hi> open on all the ways of the sons of men, to give every one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his doings.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:20
verses.text: For You have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, until this day, and in Israel, and among men; and have made You a name, as at this day;

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:21
verses.text: and have brought forth Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:22
verses.text: And You have given them this land, which You swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:23
verses.text: And they came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice, nor did they walk in Your law. They have done nothing of all that You commanded them to do; therefore You have caused all this evil to come on them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:24
verses.text: Behold, the siege mounds have come to the city to take it; and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the plague. And what You have spoken has happened; and, behold, You saw <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:25
verses.text: And You have said to me, O Lord Jehovah, Buy the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:26
verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:27
verses.text: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for Me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:28
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:29
verses.text: And the Chaldeans who fight against this city shall come up and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke Me to anger.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:30
verses.text: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have only done evil before Me from their youth. For the sons of Israel have only provoked Me to anger with the work of their hands, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:31
verses.text: For this city has been to Me as a cause of My anger and of My fury from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from before My face

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:32
verses.text: because of all the evil of the sons of Israel and of the sons of Judah, which they have done to provoke Me to anger, they, their kings, their rulers, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:33
verses.text: And they have turned the back to Me, and not the face; though I taught them, rising up early and teaching <hi>them</hi>, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:34
verses.text: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:35
verses.text: And they built the high places of Baal, in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire to Molech; which I did not command them, nor did it come into My mind that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:36
verses.text: And now therefore, so says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you say, It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague:

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:37
verses.text: Behold, I will gather them out of all the lands where I have driven them in My anger, and in My fury, and in great wrath. And I will bring them again to this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:38
verses.text: And they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:39
verses.text: And I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear Me forever, for their good and for the good of their sons after them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:40
verses.text: And I will cut an everlasting covenant with them that I will not turn away from them, to do them good. But I will put My fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:41
verses.text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will truly plant them in this land with all My heart and all My whole soul.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:42
verses.text: For so says the LORD: As I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:43
verses.text: And fields shall be bought in this land of which you say, <hi>It is</hi> a desert without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:44
verses.text: Men shall buy fields for silver, and write it in a book, and seal <hi>it</hi>, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south. For I will cause their captivity to return, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:2
verses.text: So says the LORD the Maker of it, the LORD who formed it in order to establish it; the LORD <hi>is</hi> His name:

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:3
verses.text: Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and inscrutable things which you do not know.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:4
verses.text: For so says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down <hi>to defend</hi> against the siege-mounds and against the sword:

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:5
verses.text: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men whom I have slain in My anger and in My fury, and for all whose evil I have hidden My face from this city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:6
verses.text: Behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will heal them and will show them the riches of peace and truth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:7
verses.text: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:8
verses.text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against Me; and I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned, and by which they have transgressed against Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:9
verses.text: And it shall be to Me a name of joy, a praise and an honor before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do to them. And they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the riches that I bring to it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:10
verses.text: So says the LORD: Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say <hi>is</hi> a waste without man and without beast, <hi>even</hi> in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast;

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:11
verses.text: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts, for the LORD <hi>is</hi> good, for His mercy <hi>endures</hi> forever; and the voice of those who shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause the captivity of the land to return, as at the first, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:12
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts: Again in this place which is a desert without man and without beast, and in all its cities, there <hi>shall be</hi> a home of shepherds causing <hi>their</hi> flocks to lie down.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:13
verses.text: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him who tallies, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:14
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will establish the good thing which I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:15
verses.text: In those days, and at that time, I will cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. And He shall do judgment and righteousness in the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:16
verses.text: In those days Judah shall be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely. And this <hi>is the name</hi> with which she shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:17
verses.text: For so says the LORD, David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:18
verses.text: nor shall the priests the Levites lack a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle grain offerings, and to do sacrifice forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:19
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:20
verses.text: So says the LORD: If you can break My covenant of the day and My covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:21
verses.text: <hi> then</hi> also may My covenant with David My servant be broken, that he should not have a son to reign on his throne, and <hi>My covenant</hi> with the Levites the priests, My ministers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:22
verses.text: As the host of the heavens cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so I will multiply the seed of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:23
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:24
verses.text: Do you not consider what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD has chosen, He has even cast them off? So they have despised My people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:25
verses.text: So says the LORD: If My covenant <hi>is</hi> not with day and night, <hi>and if</hi> I have not given the ordinances of the heavens and the earth,

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:26
verses.text: then I will cast away the seed of Jacob, and David My servant, <hi>so</hi> that I will not take <hi>any</hi> of his seed <hi>to be</hi> rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will bring back their captivity, and have mercy on them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:1
verses.text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth (because his hand rules) and all the peoples, fought against Jerusalem and against all its cities; saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:2
verses.text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, So says the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:3
verses.text: And you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be captured and delivered into his hand. And your eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:4
verses.text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah: So says the LORD of you, You shall not die by the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:5
verses.text: You shall die in peace; and as the burnings of spices <hi>for</hi> your fathers, the former kings which were before you, so they shall burn <hi>spices</hi> for you. And they will mourn you, saying, Ah, lord! For I have spoken the word, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:6
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:7
verses.text: when the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem and against all the remaining cities of Judah; against Lachish, and against Azekah; for these fortified cities remained of the cities of Judah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:8
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after king Zedekiah had cut a covenant with all the people at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:9
verses.text: that each man should let his male slave, and each man his female slave, <hi>if</hi> a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, to go free, that none should enslave a Jew, his brother among them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:10
verses.text: And all the rulers obeyed, and all the people who had entered into the covenant allowed them to go free, each man his male slave, and each man his female slave, so that not any should enslave among them any more; and they obeyed and let <hi>them</hi> go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:11
verses.text: But afterward they turned and caused the slaves and slave women whom they had let go free, to return! And they subjected them for slaves and slave women.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:12
verses.text: So the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:13
verses.text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: I cut a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out from the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:14
verses.text: At the end of seven years each man should let go his brother, a Hebrew, and who has been sold to him. And when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you. But your fathers did not listen to me, nor bow down their ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:15
verses.text: And you had turned today, and had done right in My sight to call for liberty, each man to his neighbor. And you had cut a covenant before Me in the house which is called by My name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:16
verses.text: But you turned and defiled My name, and each man caused his slave, and each man caused his slave woman, whom you had set free to do as they pleased, to return. And you brought them into service to be slaves and slave women to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:17
verses.text: So the LORD says this: You have not listened to Me to proclaim liberty each man to his brother, and each man to his neighbor! Behold, I call for freedom for you, says the LORD, to the sword, to the plague, and to the famine. And I will cause you to be a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:18
verses.text: And I will give the men who have sinned against My covenant, who have not done the words of the covenant which they cut before Me <hi>when they</hi> cut the calf in two and passed between its parts;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:19
verses.text: the rulers of Judah, and the rulers of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf;

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:20
verses.text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. And their dead bodies shall be for food to the birds of the heavens and to the beasts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:21
verses.text: And I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, and his rulers, into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, who have withdrawn from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:22
verses.text: Behold, I will command, says the LORD, and cause them to return to this city. And they shall fight against it and capture it, and burn it with fire. And I will make the cities of Judah a desert without a soul to live in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:1
verses.text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the sons of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:2
verses.text: Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the rooms. And give them wine to drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:3
verses.text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:4
verses.text: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which <hi>was</hi> near the room of the rulers, above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:5
verses.text: And I set pots full of wine, and cups, before the sons of the house of the Rechabites. And I said to them, Drink wine!

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:6
verses.text: But they said, We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, <hi>you</hi> nor your sons forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:7
verses.text: Nor shall you build houses, nor sow seed, nor plant a vineyard, nor have <hi>anything</hi>; but all your days you shall live in tents, so that you may live many days in the land where you are strangers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:8
verses.text: So we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:9
verses.text: nor to build houses for us to live in. Nor do we have vineyard, nor field, nor seed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:10
verses.text: But we have lived in tents, and have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:11
verses.text: But it happened when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, Come and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the Chaldean army, and for fear of the Syrian army. So we are living at Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:12
verses.text: Then came the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:13
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and tell the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to My words? says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:14
verses.text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, which he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are done. For to this day they do not drink, but obey their father's commandment. But I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not listen to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:15
verses.text: I have also sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending, saying, Return now each man from his evil way, and make your doings good, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers. But you have not bowed down your ear, nor listened to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:16
verses.text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have done the commandment of their father, which He commanded them; but this people has not listened to Me;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:17
verses.text: therefore so says the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem all the evil that I have spoken against them. Because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:18
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, and have kept all his precepts, and have done according to all that he has commanded you;

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:19
verses.text: therefore so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not lack a man to stand before Me forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:1
verses.text: And it happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:2
verses.text: Take for yourself a roll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:3
verses.text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I plan to do to them, that they may each man turn from his evil way, so that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:4
verses.text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah. And Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which He had spoken to him, on a roll of a book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:5
verses.text: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I <hi>am</hi> shut up. I cannot go into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:6
verses.text: Therefore you go, and read in the roll which you have written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the <hi>in</hi> the LORD's house on the fasting day. And also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:7
verses.text: It may be they will present their prayer before the LORD, and will return, each one from his evil way. For great <hi>is</hi> the anger and the fury that the LORD has spoken against this people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:8
verses.text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book, the words of the LORD in the LORD's house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:9
verses.text: And it happened in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, they called a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:10
verses.text: And Baruch read in the book, the words of Jeremiah <hi>in</hi> the house of the LORD, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entrance to the New Gate of the LORD's house, in the ears of all the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:11
verses.text: When Michaiah, the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD out of the book,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:12
verses.text: then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's room. And, lo, all the rulers sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the rulers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:13
verses.text: Then Michaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:14
verses.text: Therefore all the rulers sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, Take the roll in your hand in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand and came to them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:15
verses.text: And they said to him, Sit down now, and read <hi>it</hi> in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:16
verses.text: And it happened when they had heard all the words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:17
verses.text: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:18
verses.text: Then Baruch answered them, He spoke all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote <hi>them</hi> with ink on the book.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:19
verses.text: And the rulers said to Baruch, Go hide yourselves, you and Jeremiah; and let no man know where you are.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:20
verses.text: And they went in to the king into the court. But they laid up the roll in the room of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:21
verses.text: So the king sent Jehudi to bring the roll. And he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the rulers who stood beside the king.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:22
verses.text: And the king sat in the winter house in the ninth month; also with the burning fire-pan before him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:23
verses.text: And it happened when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the scribe's knife and threw <hi>it</hi> into the fire in the fire-pan, until all the scroll was burned up in the fire-pan.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:24
verses.text: Yet the king and all his servants who heard these words were not afraid, <hi>nor</hi> did they tear their garments.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:25
verses.text: But Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had pleaded with the king that he should not burn the scroll, but he would not hear them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:26
verses.text: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD hid them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:27
verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:28
verses.text: Take for yourself another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:29
verses.text: And you shall say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, So says the LORD: You have burned this scroll, saying, Why have you written in it, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause man and beast to cease from there?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:30
verses.text: Therefore so says the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah: He shall have no one to sit on the throne of David. And his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:31
verses.text: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity. And I will bring on them, and on the people of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evils that I have spoken against them; but they did not listen.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:32
verses.text: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote in it from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many words like them were added to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:1
verses.text: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:2
verses.text: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to the words of the LORD which He spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:3
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now to the LORD our God for us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:4
verses.text: And Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:5
verses.text: And Pharaoh's army had come out from Egypt. And when the Chaldeans who besieged Jerusalem heard news of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:6
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:7
verses.text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: You shall say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to Me to inquire of Me: Behold, Pharaoh's army, which has come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:8
verses.text: And the Chaldeans shall come again and fight against this city, and capture it, and burn it with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:9
verses.text: So says the LORD: Do not deceive yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us. For they shall not depart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:10
verses.text: For though you had stricken the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and there remained <hi>only</hi> wounded men among them, they would rise up, each man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:11
verses.text: And it happened when the army of Chaldeans was made to go up from Jerusalem because of fear of Pharaoh's army,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:12
verses.text: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive a portion from there in the midst of the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:13
verses.text: And it happened, he <hi>being</hi> in the gate of Benjamin, a commander of the guard named Irijah <hi>was</hi> there, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah. And he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You are falling away to the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:14
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said, A lie! I am not falling away to the Chaldeans. But he did not listen to him; so Irijah took Jeremiah and brought him to the rulers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:15
verses.text: And the rulers were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison, the house of Jonathan the scribe. For they had made that the prison.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:16
verses.text: When Jeremiah had entered into the house of the pit, and into the cells, then Jeremiah remained there many days.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:17
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king sent and took him out. And the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there <hi>any</hi> word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is. For, He said, you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:18
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:19
verses.text: Where now <hi>are</hi> your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you nor against this land?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:20
verses.text: And please hear now, O my lord the king; I beg you, let my cry be pleasing to you, so that you cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:21
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king commanded that they should put Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him a piece of bread out of the bakers' street daily, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:1
verses.text: And Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken to all the people, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:2
verses.text: So says the LORD, He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague. But he who goes out to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life as a prize, and shall live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:3
verses.text: So says the LORD: This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, and he shall capture it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:4
verses.text: And the rulers said to the king, Please let this man be put to death. For in this way he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them. For this man does not seek the good of this people, but the hurt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:5
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he <hi>is</hi> in your hand. For the king cannot do a thing against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:6
verses.text: And they took Jeremiah and threw him into the pit of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, which <hi>was</hi> in the court of the prison. And they let Jeremiah down with ropes. And there was no water in the pit, only mud. So Jeremiah sank into the mud.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:7
verses.text: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, of the eunuchs in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the pit (the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin),

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:8
verses.text: Ebed-melech went out of the king's house and spoke to the king, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:9
verses.text: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have thrown into the pit. And he is likely to die of hunger in the place where he is, for <hi>there is</hi> no more bread in the city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:10
verses.text: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take in your hand thirty men with you from here, and lift Jeremiah the prophet up out of the pit before he dies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:11
verses.text: So Ebed-melech took the men in his hand and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took worn out clothes and worn out rags from there, and let them down by ropes into the pit to Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:12
verses.text: And Ebed-melech, the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, Now put the worn out clothes and rags under your armpits, under the ropes. And Jeremiah did so.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:13
verses.text: So they drew up Jeremiah with ropes and took him up out of the pit. And Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:14
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to him, into the third gate in the house of the LORD. And the king said to Jeremiah, I will ask you a thing. Do not hide anything from me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:15
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I declare <hi>it</hi> to you, will you not surely put me to death? And if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:16
verses.text: Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives, who made us this soul, I will not put you to death, nor will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:17
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, So says the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel: If you will surely go forth to the king of Babylon's rulers, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire. And you shall live, and your house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:18
verses.text: But if you will not go forth to the king of Babylon's rulers, then this city shall be given into the hands of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape out of their hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:19
verses.text: And Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews who have fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and lest they hurt me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:20
verses.text: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver <hi>you</hi>. I beg you, obey the voice of the LORD which I speak to you; so it shall be well to you, and your soul shall live.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:21
verses.text: But if you refuse to go out, this <hi>is</hi> the word that the LORD has shown to me:

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:22
verses.text: And, behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah's house <hi>shall be</hi> brought out to the king of Babylon's rulers, and they shall say, Your friends have urged you on, and have prevailed against you. Your feet have sunk in the mire, and they have turned away.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:23
verses.text: So they shall bring out all your wives and your sons to the Chaldeans. And you shall not escape out of their hand, but shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. And you shall cause this city to be burned with fire.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:24
verses.text: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall not die.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:25
verses.text: But if the rulers hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you and say to you, Declare to us now what you have said to the king; do not hide <hi>it</hi> from us, and we will not put you to death; also what the king said to you;

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:26
verses.text: then you shall say to them, I presented my cry before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:27
verses.text: Then all the rulers came to Jeremiah and asked him. And he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they quit speaking with him; for the matter was not known.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:28
verses.text: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was captured. And he was <hi>there</hi> when Jerusalem was captured.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:1
verses.text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, came against Jerusalem. And they besieged it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:2
verses.text: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth of the month, the city was broken up.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:3
verses.text: And all the rulers of the king of Babylon came in and sat in the middle gate: Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, chief of the eunuchs, Nergal-sharezer, chief soothsayer, and all the rest of the rulers of the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:4
verses.text: And it happened when Zedekiah, the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled, and went out from the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate between the two walls. And he went out the way of the plain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:5
verses.text: But the Chaldean army pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. And they took him, and made him go up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment on him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:6
verses.text: Then the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes in Riblah. Also the king of Babylon killed all the rulers of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:7
verses.text: And he blinded Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:8
verses.text: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house and the houses of the people, with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:9
verses.text: Then Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners exiled <hi>to</hi> Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, and those who fell away, who fell to him with the rest of the people that remained.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:10
verses.text: But Nebu-zaradan, the chief of the executioners, left <hi>some</hi> of the poor people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields on that day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:11
verses.text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon gave command concerning Jeremiah to Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:12
verses.text: Take him, and set your eyes on him, and do him no evil. But do with him even as he shall say to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:13
verses.text: So Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners sent, and Nebu-shasban chief of the eunuchs, and Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, and all the king of Babylon's rulers,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:14
verses.text: even they sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and entrusted him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, to take him to the house. So he lived among the people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:15
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:16
verses.text: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring My words on this city for evil and not for good. And they shall be <hi>done</hi> in that day before you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:17
verses.text: But I will deliver you in that day, says the LORD. And you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you <hi>are</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:18
verses.text: For I will surely deliver you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be as a prize to you, because you have put your trust in Me, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:1
verses.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him, being bound in chains, among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah, who were being exiled to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:2
verses.text: And the chief of the executioners took Jeremiah and said to him, The LORD your God has spoken this evil against this place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:3
verses.text: And the LORD has brought <hi>it</hi>, and has done according as He has said, Because you have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:4
verses.text: And now, behold, I set you free today from the chains on your hand. If <hi>it seems</hi> good to you to come with me into Babylon, come. And I will keep my eye on you. But if <hi>it seems</hi> evil to you to come with me into Babylon, stay. Behold, all the land <hi>is</hi> before you. Wherever it seems good and pleasing for you to go, go there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:5
verses.text: And while he had not yet gone back, <hi>he said</hi>, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and live with him among the people. Or go wherever it seems right to you to go. So the chief of the executioners gave him food and a reward, and let him go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:6
verses.text: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam at Mizpah. And <hi>he</hi> lived with him among the people who were left in the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:7
verses.text: And when all the commanders of the forces who <hi>were</hi> in the fields, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had entrusted to him men, and women, and children, and <hi>many</hi> of the poor of the land, of those who <hi>were</hi> not exiled to Babylon;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:8
verses.text: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai of Netopha, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:9
verses.text: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, Do not fear to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:10
verses.text: <hi> As for</hi> me, behold, I will live at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, who have come to us. But you go gather wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put <hi>them</hi> in your vessels, and live in your cities that you have taken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:11
verses.text: Also when all the Jews in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan;

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:12
verses.text: even all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits in abundance.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:13
verses.text: And Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces that <hi>were</hi> in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:14
verses.text: And they said to him, You certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to kill you. But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam did not believe them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:15
verses.text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Please let me go. And I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know. Why should he kill you so that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:16
verses.text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing. For you speak falsely of Ishmael.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:1
verses.text: And it happened in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the son of Elishama, of the royal seed, and the rulers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah. And there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:2
verses.text: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and killed him whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:3
verses.text: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with him, with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:4
verses.text: And it happened the second day after he had killed Gedaliah (and no one knew <hi>it</hi>),

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:5
verses.text: some men from Shechem came from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, with their beards shaved, and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring <hi>them</hi> to the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:6
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he walked. And it happened as he met them, he said to them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:7
verses.text: And it happened when they came into the middle of the city, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, he and the men with him, and they <hi>threw them</hi> into the middle of the pit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:8
verses.text: But ten men were found among them who said to Ishmael, Do not kill us, for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he held back and did not kill them among their brothers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:9
verses.text: And the pit in which Ishmael had thrown all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had killed because of Gedaliah, <hi>was</hi> the one which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel. And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:10
verses.text: Then Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who <hi>were</hi> in Mizpah, even the king's daughters and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners had entrusted to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took captive and left to go over to the Ammonites.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:11
verses.text: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:12
verses.text: then they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah. And they found him by the great waters that <hi>are</hi> in Gibeon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:13
verses.text: And it happened when all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces with him, then they were glad.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:14
verses.text: So all the people that Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:15
verses.text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:16
verses.text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. They took mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:17
verses.text: And they departed and lived in the inn of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:18
verses.text: because of the Chaldeans. For they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:1
verses.text: Then came near all the commanders of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:2
verses.text: And they said to Jeremiah the prophet, Please let our cry be pleasing to you, and pray for us to the LORD your God, even for all this remnant, (for we are left <hi>but</hi> a few of many, as your eyes behold us,)

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:3
verses.text: that the LORD your God may show us the way in which we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:4
verses.text: And Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard. Behold, I will pray to the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall be, all the word the LORD shall answer, I will declare <hi>it</hi> to you. I will keep nothing back from you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:5
verses.text: And they said to Jeremiah, Let the LORD be a true and faithful witness between us if we do not do even according to all things for which the LORD your God shall send you to us.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:6
verses.text: Whether <hi>it is</hi> good, or whether it is evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send you; so that it may be well with us when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:7
verses.text: And it happened after ten days, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:8
verses.text: And he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:9
verses.text: And he said to them, So says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your cry before Him:

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:10
verses.text: If you will still remain in this land, then I will build you and will not pull <hi>you</hi> down. And I will plant you and will not pluck <hi>you</hi> up. For I repent of the evil that I have done to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:11
verses.text: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Do not be afraid of him, says the LORD. For I <hi>am</hi> with you to save you and to deliver you from his hand.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:12
verses.text: And I will show mercies to you, so that he may have mercy on you and cause you to return to your own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:13
verses.text: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, nor obey the voice of the LORD your God,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:14
verses.text: saying, No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger for bread; and there we will dwell;

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:15
verses.text: then now hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah. So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: If you surely set your faces to go into Egypt, and go to live there,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:16
verses.text: then it will happen, the sword which you feared shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt. And the famine of which you were anxious about shall cling to you there <hi>in</hi> Egypt; and you shall die there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:17
verses.text: So <hi>it</hi> shall be to all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague. And none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:18
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: As My anger and My fury has been poured forth on the people of Jerusalem, so shall My fury be poured forth on you when you shall enter into Egypt. And you shall be a curse, and a wonder, and a shame, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:19
verses.text: The LORD has said concerning you, O remnant of Judah, Do not go into Egypt. Know certainly that I have warned you this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:20
verses.text: For you used deceit against your souls when you sent me to the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us to the LORD our God; and according to all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare to us, and we will do <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:21
verses.text: And I have declared <hi>it</hi> to you today; but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor anything for which He has sent me to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:22
verses.text: And therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, in the place where you desire to go to live.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:1
verses.text: And it happened when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking to all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, all these words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:2
verses.text: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, spoke then, saying to Jeremiah, You speak falsely! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, Do not go to Egypt to live there.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:3
verses.text: But Baruch the son of Neriah <hi>is</hi> inciting you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death and to exile us to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:4
verses.text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces, and all the people, did not obey the voice of the LORD to live in the land of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:5
verses.text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah who had returned from all the nations (where they had been driven) to dwell in the land of Judah;

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:6
verses.text: men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:7
verses.text: So they came into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of the LORD. So they came to Tahpanhes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:8
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:9
verses.text: Take great stones to your hand, and hide them in the clay in the brick-kiln which <hi>is</hi> at the entrance to Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:10
verses.text: And say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden. And he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:11
verses.text: And when he comes, he shall strike the land of Egypt. And whoever <hi>is</hi> for death <hi>shall go</hi> to death; and whoever for captivity, into captivity; and whoever for the sword, to the sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:12
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. And he shall burn them and exile them. And he shall adorn himself with the land of Egypt, like a shepherd puts on his robe; and he shall go out from there in peace.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:13
