verses.text: He shall also break the obelisks of The House of the Sun which <hi>is</hi> in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians he shall burn with fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:1
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who live in the land of Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:2
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. And, behold, today <hi>they are</hi> a ruin, and no one lives there

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:3
verses.text: because of their evil which they have committed to provoke Me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods whom they knew not, they, you, nor your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:4
verses.text: But I sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying, Oh, do not do this abominable thing which I hate!

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:5
verses.text: But they did not listen, nor bow down their ear to turn from their evil, to burn no incense to other gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:6
verses.text: Therefore My fury and My anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. And they are wasted, deserted as at this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:7
verses.text: And now so says the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel: Why do you commit <hi>this</hi> great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and babe, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:8
verses.text: in that you provoke Me to wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you might cut yourselves off and that you might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:9
verses.text: Have you forgotten the evilness of your fathers, and the evilness of the kings of Judah, and the evilness of their wives, and your own evilness, and the evilness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:10
verses.text: They are not humbled to this day, nor have they feared, nor walked in My law, nor in My statutes which I have set before you and before your fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:11
verses.text: So the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says this: Behold, I will set My face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:12
verses.text: And I will take the remnant of Judah, who have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there; and they shall all be consumed, <hi>and</hi> fall in the land of Egypt. They shall be destroyed by the sword and by the famine. They shall die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine; and they shall be a curse, a wonder, and a shame, and a reproach.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:13
verses.text: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:14
verses.text: So that none of the remnant of Judah who has gone into the land of Egypt to live there shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah to which they have a desire to return to live there. For none shall return except those who escape.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:15
verses.text: And all the men who knew that their wives had burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great multitude, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah. And they said,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:16
verses.text: <hi> As for</hi> the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we will not listen to you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:17
verses.text: But we will certainly do whatever thing goes forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our rulers, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem. <hi>For</hi> then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:18
verses.text: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all <hi>things</hi>, and have been devoured by the sword and by the famine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:19
verses.text: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make our cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her without our men?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:20
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men and to the women, and to all the people who had given him <hi>that</hi> answer:

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:21
verses.text: The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you, and your fathers, your kings, and your rulers, and the people of the land; did not the LORD remember them? Yea, it came into His mind.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:22
verses.text: Yea, so that the LORD could no longer hold back because of the evil of your doings, because of the abominations which you have committed! So your land is a waste, and a wonder, and a curse, without anyone in it, as <hi>it is</hi> today.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:23
verses.text: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, <hi>nor walked</hi> in His law, nor in His statutes, nor did you walk in His testimonies, therefore this evil has happened to you, as at this day.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:24
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that <hi>is</hi> in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:25
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hands, saying, We will surely fulfil our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings to her. You will surely fulfil your vows and surely carry out your vows.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:26
verses.text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that lives in the land of Egypt. Behold, I have sworn by My great name, says the LORD, that My name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord Jehovah lives.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:27
verses.text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good. And all the men of Judah in the land of Egypt shall be destroyed by the sword and by the famine, until there is an end of them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:28
verses.text: Yet the small number that escapes the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah; and all the remnant of Judah (who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there) shall know whose word shall stand, Mine or theirs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:29
verses.text: And this <hi>shall be</hi> a sign to you, says the LORD, that I will punish you in this place so that you may know that My words shall surely stand against you for evil.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:30
verses.text: So says the LORD, Behold, I am giving Pharaoh-hophra, king of Egypt, into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life, as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy that sought his life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:1
verses.text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:2
verses.text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel, to you, O Baruch:

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:3
verses.text: You said, Woe is me now, for the LORD has added grief to my sorrow. I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:4
verses.text: So you shall say to him, The LORD says this: Behold, what I have built I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even all the land itself to Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:5
verses.text: And do you seek great things for yourself? Do not seek <hi>them</hi>; for behold, I will bring evil on all flesh, says the LORD. But I will give your life to you as a prize, in all places where you go.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the nations;

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:2
verses.text: against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:3
verses.text: Set in order the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:4
verses.text: Harness the horses, and horsemen get up. Yea, stand with helmets, polish the spears; put on body armor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:5
verses.text: Why have I seen? They are afraid, turned backward. And their mighty ones are beaten down and have fled <hi>for</hi> refuge, and they do not look back. Terror <hi>is</hi> all around, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:6
verses.text: Do not let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. They stumbled and fell toward the north, by the side of the river Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:7
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> this rising up like the Nile, whose waters are moved like the rivers?

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:8
verses.text: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and <hi>his</hi> waters surge about like the rivers. And he says, I will go up <hi>and</hi> will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and its people.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:9
verses.text: Come up, horses; and rage chariots! And let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans who handle the shield, and the Lydians who handle <hi>and</hi> bend the bow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:10
verses.text: For this <hi>is</hi> the day of the Lord Jehovah of hosts, a day of vengeance, that He may avenge Himself of His foes. And the sword shall devour, and it shall be filled and made drunk with their blood, for the Lord Jehovah of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:11
verses.text: Go up into Gilead and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt. In vain shall you use many medicines, <hi>for</hi> you shall not be cured.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:12
verses.text: The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the land. For the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, <hi>and</hi> they have both fallen together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:13
verses.text: The word spoken by the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, of the coming of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to strike the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:14
verses.text: Declare <hi>it</hi> in Egypt, and cry <hi>it</hi> in Migdol, and make <hi>it</hi> heard in Noph and in Tahpanhes. Say, Stand fast and get ready, the sword shall devour all around you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:15
verses.text: Why is your mighty one swept away? They did not stand, because the LORD thrust him down.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:16
verses.text: He made many fall; yea, one fell on another. And they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people and to the land of our birth, away from the oppressing sword.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:17
verses.text: They cried there, Pharaoh king of Egypt <hi>is</hi> a noise; he has passed the chosen time.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:18
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the King whose name <hi>is</hi> the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor <hi>is</hi> among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so he shall come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:19
verses.text: O daughter dwelling in Egypt, get ready to go into captivity. For Noph shall be waste and a desert without inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:20
verses.text: Egypt <hi>is</hi> a beautiful heifer, but a stinger from the north surely comes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:21
verses.text: Also her hired ones <hi>are</hi> in her midst like calves of the stall; for they also have turned back, fleeing together. They did not stand, because the day of their calamity had come on them, the time of their visitation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:22
verses.text: Its sound <hi>is</hi> like a serpent's going, for they shall go in force and come against her with axes like woodcutters.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:23
verses.text: They shall cut down her forest, says the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the locusts and cannot be counted.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:24
verses.text: The daughter of Egypt shall be ashamed. She shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:25
verses.text: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods and their kings; even Pharaoh and all who trust in him;

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:26
verses.text: and I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. And afterward it will be inhabited, as in the days of old, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:27
verses.text: But you do not fear, O My servant Jacob, and be not afraid, O Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity. And Jacob shall return and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make <hi>him</hi> afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:28
verses.text: Do not fear, O Jacob My servant, says the LORD, for I <hi>am</hi> with you. For I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you. But I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in measure; yet I will not leave you wholly unpunished.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:2
verses.text: So says the LORD: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land and all its fullness; the city and those who dwell in it. And the men shall cry, and all the people of the land shall howl.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:3
verses.text: At the noise of the stamping of the hooves of his strong <hi>horses</hi>, at the rushing of his chariots, the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their sons because of feebleness of hands;

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:4
verses.text: because of the day that comes to plunder all the Philistines <hi>and</hi> to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every survivor who helps. For the LORD will plunder the Philistines, the rest of the country of Caphtor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:5
verses.text: Baldness has come on Gaza. Ashkelon is cut off <hi>with</hi> the rest of their valley. How long will you cut yourself?

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:6
verses.text: O sword of the LORD, how long <hi>will it be</hi> before you are quiet? Put yourself into your sheath; rest and be still.

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:7
verses.text: How can it be quiet, since the LORD has given it a command? He has set it there against Ashkelon, and against the seashore.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:1
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, against Moab: Woe to Nebo, for it is ravaged! Kiriathaim <hi>is</hi> shamed <hi>and</hi> captured. The Fortress is shamed and razed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:2
verses.text: <hi> There shall be</hi> no more praise of Moab. In Heshbon they have plotted evil against it, saying, Come and let us cut it off <hi>from being</hi> a nation. Also you shall be silenced, O madmen; the sword shall pursue you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:3
verses.text: A voice of crying <hi>shall be</hi> heard from Horonaim, plundering and great ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:4
verses.text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:5
verses.text: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:6
verses.text: Flee, save your lives, and be like a naked thing in the wilderness.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:7
verses.text: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you shall also be captured. And Chemosh shall go into exile <hi>with</hi> his priests and his rulers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:8
verses.text: And the robber shall come on every city, and no city shall escape. Also the valley shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:9
verses.text: Give wings to Moab so that it may flee and get away; for its cities shall be a desert, without an inhabitant in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:10
verses.text: Cursed <hi>is</hi> he who does the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed <hi>is</hi> he who keeps back his sword from blood.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:11
verses.text: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile. Therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:12
verses.text: Therefore behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will send pourers to him, who shall pour him off, and his vessels shall empty, and shatter their jars.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:13
verses.text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their hope.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:14
verses.text: How do you say, We <hi>are</hi> mighty and strong men for war?

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:15
verses.text: Moab is plundered and has come up out of her cities. And his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter, says the King whose name <hi>is</hi> the LORD of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:16
verses.text: The calamity of Moab <hi>is</hi> near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:17
verses.text: All you who are around him, mourn him. And all you who know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, <hi>and</hi> the beautiful rod!

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:18
verses.text: O dweller, daughter of Dibon, come down from <hi>your</hi> glory and sit in thirst. For the ravager of Moab shall come on you; he shall destroy your strongholds.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:19
verses.text: O dweller of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees and her who escapes; say, What is happening?

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:20
verses.text: Moab is put to shame, for it is broken down. Howl and cry! Tell it in Arnon that Moab is stripped.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:21
verses.text: And judgment has come on the plain country; on Holon, and on Jahazah, and on Mephaath,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:22
verses.text: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth-diblathaim,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:23
verses.text: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth-gamul, and on Beth-meon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:24
verses.text: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:25
verses.text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:26
verses.text: Make him drunk, for he magnified <hi>himself</hi> against the LORD. Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be a mockery.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:27
verses.text: For was not Israel a mockery to you? Was he found among thieves? For ever since you spoke of him, you skipped for joy.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:28
verses.text: O you who dwell in Moab, leave the cities and live in the rock, and be like the dove making her nest in the sides of the mouth of the pit.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:29
verses.text: We have heard the pride of Moab (he is exceedingly proud), his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and his elevated heart.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:30
verses.text: I know his wrath, says the LORD, <hi>it is</hi> not so; his boast, but they have not done so.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:31
verses.text: So I will wail for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab, and shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:32
verses.text: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer. Your plants have gone over the sea; they reach to the sea of Jazer. A ravager has fallen on your summer fruits and on your grape crop.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:33
verses.text: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab. And I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses; none shall tread <hi>the grapes</hi> with shouting; <hi>their</hi> shouting <hi>shall be</hi> no shouting.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:34
verses.text: From the cry of Heshbon to Elealeh, and to Jahaz, they have uttered their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, <hi>like</hi> a heifer three years old. For the waters of Nimrim also shall be deserted.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:35
verses.text: And, I will cause him who offers in the high places to cease in Moab, says the LORD, and him who burns incense to his gods.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:36
verses.text: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like flutes, and my heart shall sound like flutes for the men of Kirheres, because the riches <hi>that</hi> he has gotten have perished.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:37
verses.text: For every head <hi>shall be</hi> bald, and every beard clipped. On all the hands <hi>shall be</hi> cuttings, and on the loins sackcloth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:38
verses.text: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there <hi>is</hi> weeping for all. For I have broken Moab like a vessel in which <hi>is</hi> no pleasure, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:39
verses.text: They shall howl, <hi>saying</hi>, How is it broken down! How has Moab turned the back <hi>with</hi> shame! So Moab shall be a cause of scorn, and he shall be a terror to all those around him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:40
verses.text: For so says the LORD: Behold, he shall fly like an eagle and shall spread his wings over Moab.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:41
verses.text: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized; and the mighty men's hearts in Moab shall be at that day like the heart of a woman in <hi>her</hi> pangs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:42
verses.text: And Moab shall be destroyed from <hi>being</hi> a people, because he has magnified <hi>himself</hi> against the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:43
verses.text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, <hi>shall be</hi> on you, O Moabite, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:44
verses.text: He who flees from the terror shall fall into the pit; and he who goes up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare. For I will bring on it, even on Moab, the year of their judgment, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:45
verses.text: Those who fled stood powerless in the shadow of Heshbon, for a fire shall come out from Heshbon, and a flame out of the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab and the crown of the head of the sons of desolation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:46
verses.text: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh perish; for your sons are taken away into exile, and your daughters into exile.

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:47
verses.text: But I will restore the prisoners of Moab in the latter days, says the LORD. So far <hi>is</hi> the judgment of Moab.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:1
verses.text: So says the LORD to the sons of Ammon: Has Israel no sons? Or has he no heir? Why does their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:2
verses.text: So, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will cause a shout of war to be heard in Rabbah of the sons of Ammon. And it shall be a heap of ruins, and her daughter-villages shall be burned with fire. Then Israel shall inherit his inheritance, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:3
verses.text: Wail, O Heshbon; Ai is spoiled! Cry, daughters of Rabbah; clothe yourselves with sackcloth, mourn, and run to and fro by the hedges! For their king shall go into exile; his priests and his rulers together.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:4
verses.text: Why do you glory in your valley, your flowing valleys, O backsliding daughter? she trusted in her treasures, <hi>saying</hi>, Who shall come to me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:5
verses.text: Behold, I will bring a fear on you, says the Lord Jehovah of hosts, from all those who are around you. And you shall be driven out, each man straight forward; and there shall be none to gather up the runaways.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:6
verses.text: And afterward I will bring again the exile of the sons of Ammon, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:7
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts to Edom: <hi>Is</hi> wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:8
verses.text: Flee, turn back, dwell deep, O people of Dedan. For I will bring the calamity of Esau on him <hi>in</hi> the time <hi>that</hi> I will visit him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:9
verses.text: If the gatherers of grapes come to you, would they not leave <hi>some</hi> gleaning grapes? If thieves <hi>come</hi> by night, they will destroy until they have enough.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:10
verses.text: But I have made Esau bare; I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself. His seed is ravaged, and his brothers, and his neighbors, and he <hi>is</hi> gone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:11
verses.text: Leave your orphans; I will <hi>keep</hi> them alive; and let your widows trust in Me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:12
verses.text: For so says the LORD: Behold, those whose judgment <hi>was</hi> not to drink of the cup have surely drunk. And are you to be entirely acquitted? You shall not be acquitted, but you shall surely drink.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:13
verses.text: For I have sworn by Myself, says the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a ruin, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. And all its cities shall be wastes forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:14
verses.text: I have heard a message from the LORD, and a herald is sent to the nations, <hi>saying</hi>, Gather together and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:15
verses.text: For lo, I will make you small among the nations, despised among men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:16
verses.text: Your fearfulness has deceived you, <hi>and</hi> the pride of your heart, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill. Though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:17
verses.text: Also Edom shall be a ruin. Everyone who goes by it shall be amazed and shall hiss at all its plagues.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:18
verses.text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor, says the LORD, no man shall remain there, nor shall a son of man live in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:19
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the home of the strong. But I will suddenly make him run away from her. And who <hi>is</hi> a chosen one I may appoint over it? For who <hi>is</hi> like Me? And who will summon Me? And who <hi>is</hi> that shepherd who will stand before Me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:20
verses.text: So then hear the counsel of the LORD which He has taken against Edom, and His purposes which He has purposed against the people of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall drag them away. Surely He shall make their homes a ruin over them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:21
verses.text: The earth is shaken at the noise of their fall; when they cried, its noise was heard in the Red Sea.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:22
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up and fly like the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah. And at that day the heart of the mighty men of Edom shall be like the heart of a woman in her pangs.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:23
verses.text: Concerning Damascus: Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard bad news. They are melted; anxiety is in the sea; it cannot be quiet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:24
verses.text: Damascus has become feeble; she has turned to flee, and trembling has seized <hi>her</hi>. Anguish and sorrows have taken her like a woman in labor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:25
verses.text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:26
verses.text: So her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be silenced in that day, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:27
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall burn up the palaces of Ben-hadad.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:28
verses.text: So says the LORD concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon shall strike: Arise, go up to Kedar, and strip the men of the east.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:29
verses.text: They shall take away their tents and their flocks. They shall take their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels to themselves. And they shall cry to them, Fear <hi>is</hi> on every side.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:30
verses.text: Flee, go far away, go deep to dwell; O people of Hazor, says the LORD; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has plotted a plan against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:31
verses.text: Arise, go up to the nation that is at ease, who dwells securely, says the LORD, which has neither gates nor bars, <hi>which</hi> dwells alone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:32
verses.text: And their camels shall be a prize, and the multitude of their cattle a prey. And I will scatter them to all winds, those who cut the corners. And I will bring their calamity from all sides of it, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:33
verses.text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for jackals <hi>and</hi> a ruin forever. No man shall live there, nor <hi>any</hi> son of man dwell in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:34
verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:35
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:36
verses.text: And I will bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven on Elam, and will scatter them toward all these winds. And there shall be no nation where the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:37
verses.text: For I will cause Elam to be afraid before their enemies and before those who seek their life. And I will bring evil on them, even My fierce anger, says the LORD. And I will send the sword after them until I have destroyed them;

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:38
verses.text: and I will set My throne in Elam, and will destroy the king and the rulers from there, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:39
verses.text: But it shall be in the latter days, I will bring again the exile of Elam, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:1
verses.text: The word that the LORD spoke against Babylon, against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:2
verses.text: Declare among the nations, and cause them to hear, and lift up a banner. Cause them to hear, do not hide it; say, Babylon is captured, Bel is ashamed, Merodach is broken in pieces; her images are shamed, her idols are broken in pieces.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:3
verses.text: For out of the north a nation comes up against her, which shall make her land a desert, and none shall dwell in it. They shall flee, they shall depart, both man and beast.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:4
verses.text: In those days, and at that time, says the LORD, the sons of Israel shall come, they and the sons of Judah together, going and weeping. They shall go and seek the LORD their God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:5
verses.text: They shall ask the way <hi>to</hi> Zion with their faces there, <hi>saying</hi>, Come and let us join ourselves to the LORD <hi>in</hi> an everlasting covenant never <hi>to be</hi> forgotten.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:6
verses.text: My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have caused them to go astray; they have turned them away <hi>on</hi> the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:7
verses.text: All who have found them have devoured them. And their enemies said, We do not offend, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of righteousness, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:8
verses.text: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he-goats before the flocks.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:9
verses.text: For, lo, I am stirring up and bringing up against Babylon a company of great nations from a northern land. And they shall array themselves against her. She shall be captured there. Their arrows <hi>shall be</hi> as <hi>those</hi> of a skillful, mighty man; none shall return in vain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:10
verses.text: And Chaldea shall be a prize; all who plunder her shall be satisfied, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:11
verses.text: Because you were glad, because you rejoiced, O destroyers of My inheritance; because you are fat like the heifer in grass, and bellow like bulls;

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:12
verses.text: your mother shall be deeply ashamed; she who bore you shall turn pale. Behold, the last of the nations <hi>shall be</hi> a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:13
verses.text: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly a waste. Everyone who goes by Babylon shall be amazed and hiss at all her plagues.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:14
verses.text: Put yourselves in order against Babylon all around; all you who bend the bow, shoot at her. Hold back no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:15
verses.text: Shout against her all around. She has given her hand; her foundations have fallen, her walls have been thrown down; for it <hi>is</hi> the vengeance of the LORD. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:16
verses.text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the pressing sword they shall turn, each one to his people; and they shall flee, each one to his own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:17
verses.text: Israel <hi>is</hi> a scattered sheep, driven away by lions. First the king of Assyria devoured him, and last this Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon crunched <hi>his bones</hi>.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:18
verses.text: So Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, says this: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:19
verses.text: And I will again bring Israel to his home, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied on Mount Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:20
verses.text: In those days, and at that time, says the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and it <hi>shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> found; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found; for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:21
verses.text: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it and against the people of Pekod. Waste and destroy after them, says the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:22
verses.text: A sound of battle <hi>is</hi> in the land, and of great ruin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:23
verses.text: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut off and broken! How Babylon has become a ruin among the nations!

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:24
verses.text: I have laid a trap for you, and you are also captured, O Babylon, and you did not know. You were found and also caught, because you have fought against the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:25
verses.text: The LORD has opened His armory, and has brought forth the weapons of His fury. For this <hi>is</hi> the work of the Lord Jehovah of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:26
verses.text: Come against her from the border; open her storehouses; cast her up as heaps, and destroy her completely. Let nothing of her be left.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:27
verses.text: Kill all her bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their punishment.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:28
verses.text: The voice of those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of His temple.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:29
verses.text: Make the archers hear against Babylon. All you who tread a bow, camp against it all around; let none of them escape. Repay her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do to her. For she has been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:30
verses.text: So her young men shall fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be silenced in that day, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:31
verses.text: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O proud ones, says the Lord Jehovah of hosts; for your day has come, the time that I will judge you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:32
verses.text: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up. And I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall burn up everything all around him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:33
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts: The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah <hi>were</hi> oppressed together. And all who captured them held them fast; they refused to let them go.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:34
verses.text: Their Redeemer <hi>is</hi> strong; the LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name. He shall thoroughly plead their cause, so that he may give rest to the land, and give trouble to the people of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:35
verses.text: A sword <hi>is</hi> on the Chaldeans, says the LORD, and on the people of Babylon, and on her rulers, and on her wise men.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:36
verses.text: A sword <hi>is</hi> on the liars, and they shall become fools. A sword <hi>is</hi> on her mighty men, and they shall be afraid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:37
verses.text: A sword <hi>is</hi> on their horses and their chariots, and on all the mixed people in her midst; and they shall become as women. A sword <hi>is</hi> to her treasuries, and they shall be robbed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:38
verses.text: A drought <hi>is</hi> on her waters; and they shall be dried up. For it <hi>is</hi> the land of idols, and they act madly <hi>with</hi> idols.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:39
verses.text: So the beasts of the desert shall dwell there with jackals. And the daughters of the ostrich shall dwell in her again. And it shall not again have anyone <hi>in it</hi> forever; it shall not be lived in until generation and generation.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:40
verses.text: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, says the LORD, no man shall live there; nor shall any son of man live in it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:41
verses.text: Behold, a people shall come from the north, even a great nation; and many kings shall be stirred up from the farthest parts of the earth.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:42
verses.text: They lay hold on a bow and spear; they <hi>are</hi> cruel and will not show mercy. Their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride on horses arrayed like a man for the battle against you, O daughter of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:43
verses.text: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands became feeble. Anguish took hold of him, <hi>and</hi> pangs like <hi>those of</hi> a woman in labor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:44
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan to the home of the strong. But I will make them suddenly run away from her, and who <hi>is</hi> a chosen <hi>one</hi> who I may set over her? For who <hi>is</hi> like Me? And who will set Me the time? And who <hi>is</hi> that shepherd who will stand before Me?

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:45
verses.text: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that He has taken against Babylon; and His purposes which He has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans. Surely the least of the flock shall drag them; surely He shall make <hi>their</hi> dwelling a desert with them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:46
verses.text: At the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth shall tremble, and a cry is heard among the nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:1
verses.text: So says the LORD: Behold, I will raise up a destroying wind against Babylon, and against those dwelling in the heart of My foes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:2
verses.text: And I will send aliens to Babylon who will sift her and will empty her land. For in the day of trouble they shall be against her all around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:3
verses.text: Do not let the treader fully tread his bow; nor lift himself up in his armor. And do not spare her young men; utterly destroy all her army.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:4
verses.text: So the dead shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, <hi>those</hi> thrust through in her streets.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:5
verses.text: For neither Israel nor Judah <hi>has been</hi> forsaken by his God, by the LORD of hosts, though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:6
verses.text: Flee out of the middle of Babylon, and each man deliver his soul. Be not cut off in her iniquity, for this <hi>is</hi> the time of the LORD's vengeance; He will give to her a just reward.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:7
verses.text: Babylon <hi>has been</hi> a golden cup in the LORD's hand, which made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations are insane.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:8
verses.text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed. Wail for her; take balm for her pain, if perhaps she may be healed.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:9
verses.text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her and let us go, each one into his own country; for her judgment reaches to the heavens and is lifted up to the skies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:10
verses.text: The LORD has brought forth our righteousness; come and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:11
verses.text: Sharpen the arrows; gather the shields; the LORD has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes. For His plan <hi>is</hi> against Babylon, to destroy <hi>it</hi>; because it <hi>is</hi> the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of His temple.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:12
verses.text: Set up the banner on the walls of Babylon; make the watch strong; set up the watchmen; prepare the ambushes. For the LORD has both planned and done that which He spoke against the people of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:13
verses.text: O you who live on many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come, <hi>and</hi> the measure of your unjust gain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:14
verses.text: The LORD of hosts has sworn by Himself, <hi>saying</hi>, Surely I will fill you with men as with locusts; and they shall lift up a shout against you.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:15
verses.text: He has made the earth by His power; He has established the world by His wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:16
verses.text: When He utters <hi>His</hi> voice, <hi>there is</hi> a multitude of waters in the heavens; and He causes the mists to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with rain and brings forth the wind out of His treasures.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:17
verses.text: Every man is brutish in knowledge; every refiner is put to shame by idols. For his molded image <hi>is</hi> a lie, and no breath <hi>is</hi> in them.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:18
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> vanity, the work of errors; in the time of their judgment they shall perish.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:19
verses.text: The Portion of Jacob <hi>is</hi> not like them; for He <hi>is</hi> the Former of all things, and <hi>Israel is</hi> the rod of His inheritance. The LORD of hosts <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:20
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> My war-club <hi>and</hi> weapons of war; for with you I will shatter nations; and with you I will destroy kingdoms.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:21
verses.text: And with you I will shatter the horse and his rider; and with you I will shatter the chariot and his rider.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:22
verses.text: Also with you I will shatter man and woman; and with you I will shatter old and young; and with you I will shatter the young man and the girl.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:23
verses.text: I will also shatter the shepherd and his flock with you. And with you I will shatter the farmer and his team; and with you I will shatter heads and rulers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:24
verses.text: And I will give to Babylon, and to all the people of Chaldea, all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:25
verses.text: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O destroying mountain, says the LORD, who destroys all the earth. And I will stretch out My hand on you and roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:26
verses.text: And they shall not take a stone from you for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be a waste forever, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:27
verses.text: Set up a banner in the land; blow a trumpet among the nations; prepare the nations against her. Call the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz together against her; set a commander against her. Cause the horses to come up as the rough locusts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:28
verses.text: Consecrate nations against her, with the kings of the Medes, her governors and all her rulers, and all the land of his kingdom.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:29
verses.text: And the land shall tremble and writhe. For every purpose of the LORD shall be done against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desert without inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:30
verses.text: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting; they have remained in strongholds; their might has failed. They became like women; they have burned her houses; her bars are broken.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:31
verses.text: A runner shall run to meet a runner, and a herald to a herald, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city is captured from end <hi>to end</hi>;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:32
verses.text: and that the fords are stopped. And they have burned the reeds with fire, and the men of war are frightened.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:33
verses.text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon <hi>is</hi> like a threshing floor; <hi>it is</hi> time to thresh her. Yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:34
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me; he has crushed me; he has made me an empty vessel. He has swallowed me up like a jackal; he has filled his belly with good things; he has thrown me out;

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:35
verses.text: the violence done to me and to my flesh <hi>shall be</hi> on Babylon; the dweller in Zion shall say. And, My blood <hi>shall be</hi> on the people of Chaldea, Jerusalem shall say.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:36
verses.text: So the LORD says this: Behold, I will plead your cause and take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:37
verses.text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a home for jackals, a horror and a hissing, without an inhabitant.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:38
verses.text: They shall roar together like lions; they shall growl like lions' cubs.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:39
verses.text: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunk so that they may rejoice and sleep a never-ending sleep, and never awaken, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:40
verses.text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he-goats.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:41
verses.text: How Sheshach is captured! And how the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:42
verses.text: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered with the multitude of its waves.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:43
verses.text: Her cities are a desert, a dry land and a wilderness, a land in which no man dwells, nor does <hi>any</hi> son of man pass by it.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:44
verses.text: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. And the nations shall not flow together any more to him; yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:45
verses.text: My people, go out of her midst; and let each man deliver his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:46
verses.text: And let not your heart faint, nor fear the rumor that shall be heard in the land. The report <hi>shall come</hi> in a year. And after that a report <hi>shall come</hi> in <hi>another</hi> year; and violence <hi>shall be</hi> in the land, ruler against ruler.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:47
verses.text: So, behold, the days come that I will punish the idols of Babylon. And all her land shall be put to shame, and all her slain shall fall in her midst.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:48
verses.text: And the heavens and the earth, and all that <hi>is</hi> in them, shall shout for Babylon; for the plunderers shall come to her from the north, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:49
verses.text: As Babylon is to fall for the dead of Israel, so at Babylon the dead of all the earth shall fall.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:50
verses.text: You who have escaped the sword, go away; do not stand still. Remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:51
verses.text: We have turned pale because we have heard reproach; shame has covered our faces, for foreigners have come into the holy places of the LORD's house.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:52
verses.text: So, behold, the days are coming, says the LORD, that I will punish her idols, and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:53
verses.text: Though Babylon should mount up to the heavens, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, <hi>yet</hi> plunderers shall come to her from Me, says the LORD.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:54
verses.text: A sound of a cry <hi>comes</hi> from Babylon, and great ruin from the land of the Chaldeans,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:55
verses.text: because the LORD is stripping Babylon, and the great voice will perish out of her. And her waves will roar like great waters; the noise of their voice is given,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:56
verses.text: because the ravager has come on her, even on Babylon, and her mighty men are captured. Every one of their bows is broken, for the LORD God of vengeance shall surely repay.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:57
verses.text: And I will make her rulers drunk, also her wise ones, her governors, and her rulers, and her mighty men. And they shall sleep a never-ending sleep and not awaken, says the King whose name <hi>is</hi> the LORD of hosts.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:58
verses.text: So says the LORD of hosts: The broad walls of Babylon shall be completely broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labor in vain, and the people shall be in the fire, and they shall be weary.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:59
verses.text: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah <hi>into</hi> Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And Seraiah <hi>was</hi> a quiet prince.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:60
verses.text: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:61
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, and shall see and shall read all these words,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:62
verses.text: then you shall say, O LORD, You have spoken against this place to cut it off, so that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be a ruin forever.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:63
verses.text: And it shall be, when you have made an end of reading this book, you shall tie a stone to it and throw it into the middle of Euphrates.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:64
verses.text: And you shall say, In this way shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring on her. And they shall be weary. So far <hi>are</hi> the words of Jeremiah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:1
verses.text: Zedekiah <hi>was</hi> twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:2
verses.text: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:3
verses.text: For it was because of the anger of the LORD in Jerusalem and Judah (until He had cast them out from His presence) that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:4
verses.text: And it happened in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth <hi>day</hi> of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it and built forts against it all around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:5
verses.text: So the city was under attack until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:6
verses.text: And in the fourth month, in the ninth of the month, the famine was very grievous in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:7
verses.text: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which <hi>was</hi> by the king's garden. (And the Chaldeans <hi>were</hi> beside the city all around.) And they went by the way of the plain.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:8
verses.text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. And all his army was scattered from him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:9
verses.text: And they took the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon, to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgments against him.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:10
verses.text: And the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the rulers of Judah in Riblah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:11
verses.text: And he blinded the eyes of Zedekiah. And the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:12
verses.text: And in the fifth month, in the tenth of the month, which <hi>was</hi> the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebu-zaradan, chief of the executioners, <hi>who</hi> served the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:13
verses.text: And he burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house. And he burned with fire all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great ones.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:14
verses.text: And all the army of the Chaldeans with the chief of the executioners broke down all Jerusalem's walls all around.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:15
verses.text: And Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners exiled <hi>some</hi> of the poor of the people, and the rest of the people who remained in the city, and those who fell away, who fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:16
verses.text: But Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners left <hi>some</hi> of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for farmers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:17
verses.text: Also the Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that <hi>were</hi> in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the bronze sea in the house of the LORD, and carried all the bronze of them to Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:18
verses.text: They also took away the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they served.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:19
verses.text: And the chief of the executioners took away the basins, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the pots, and the lampstands, and the spoons, and the cups; what <hi>was</hi> gold, <hi>in</hi> gold; and what <hi>was</hi> silver, <hi>in</hi> silver.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:20
verses.text: the two pillars, one sea, and twelve bronze bulls that <hi>were</hi> under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD; the bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:21
verses.text: And the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits. And a line of twelve cubits went around it, and the thickness of it <hi>was</hi> four fingers. <hi>It was</hi> hollow.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:22
verses.text: And a capital of bronze <hi>was</hi> on it. And the height of one capital <hi>was</hi> five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capitals all around, all <hi>of</hi> bronze. The second pillar also, and the pomegranates, <hi>were</hi> like these.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:23
verses.text: And there were ninety-six pomegranates on a side; all the pomegranates on the network <hi>were</hi> a hundred all around.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:24
verses.text: And the chief of the executioners took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:25
verses.text: He also took out of the city a eunuch who was in charge of the men of war; and seven men from those who were near the king's person, who were found in the city; and the chief scribe of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:26
verses.text: And Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners took them and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:27
verses.text: And the king of Babylon struck them and slaughtered them in Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was exiled out of his own land.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:28
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the people whom Nebuchadnezzar exiled: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews;

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:29
verses.text: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he exiled from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty-two persons;

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:30
verses.text: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners exiled seven hundred and forty-five persons of the Jews. All the persons <hi>were</hi> four thousand and six hundred.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:31
verses.text: And it happened in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth of the month, Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the <hi>first</hi> year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him out from prison,

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:32
verses.text: and spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who <hi>were</hi> with him in Babylon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:33
verses.text: And he changed his prison garments, and he ate bread before him all the days of his life.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:34
verses.text: And his allowance in continual allowance was given him from the king of Babylon, the matter of a day in its day, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:1
verses.text: How alone sits the city <hi>that was</hi> full of people! She has become like a widow, <hi>once</hi> great among the nations, a noblewoman among the nations, <hi>but now</hi> has become a tribute-payer.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:2
verses.text: She bitterly weeps in the night, and her tears <hi>are</hi> on her cheeks; among all her lovers, she has none to comfort her. All her friends have dealt deceitfully with her; they became her enemies.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:3
verses.text: Judah went into captivity because of affliction, and from great slavery. She dwells among the nations; she finds no rest; all her pursuers have overtaken her between the narrows.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:4
verses.text: The roads of Zion mourn without <hi>any</hi> going to the appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests sigh; her virgins are afflicted, and she <hi>is</hi> in bitterness.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:5
verses.text: Her enemies have become as chief; her haters are at ease; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her sins. Her children have gone, captive before the enemy.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:6
verses.text: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty has departed. Her rulers have become like bucks: they find no pasture, and they have gone without strength before the pursuer.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:7
verses.text: <hi> In the</hi> days of her affliction and her wandering Jerusalem remembered all her desirable things from previous days; when her people fell into the hand of the foe; and there is no ally for her. The foes saw her; they laughed at her annihilation.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:8
verses.text: Jerusalem has grievously sinned, therefore she has been removed. All knowing her despise her because they saw her nakedness; yea, she sighs and turns backward.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:9
verses.text: Her uncleanness <hi>is</hi> in her skirts; she did not remember her end, and has gone down astoundingly. There is no comforter for her. O LORD, behold my affliction, for the enemy has magnified <hi>himself</hi>.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:10
verses.text: The enemy has spread out his hand upon all her desirable things; for she has seen the nations enter her holy place, whom You commanded that they should not enter into Your congregation.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:11
verses.text: All her people sigh; they seek bread. They have given their desirable things for food to relieve the soul. See, O LORD, and look on <hi>me</hi>, for I have become vile.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:12
verses.text: <hi> Is it</hi> nothing to you, all you who pass by? Behold and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow which is done to me, with which the LORD has afflicted <hi>me</hi> in the day of His fierce anger.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:13
verses.text: From above He has sent fire into my bones and it has laid them low. He has spread a net for my feet; He has turned me back; He has made me amazed <hi>and</hi> faint all the day.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:14
verses.text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by His hand; they intertwine; they rise on my neck. He has made my strength to falter; the LORD has delivered me into <hi>their</hi> hands. I am not able to rise up.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:15
verses.text: The LORD has trampled all my mighty ones in my midst; He has called a gathering against me to crush my young men. The LORD has trod the virgin daughter of Judah, <hi>as</hi> in a winepress.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:16
verses.text: For these I weep; my eye, my eye runs down <hi>with</hi> water, because the comforter who could refresh my soul is far from me. My sons are desolated because the enemy prevails.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:17
verses.text: Zion spreads forth her hands; none <hi>is</hi> comforting to me; the LORD has commanded concerning Jacob that his enemies <hi>should be</hi> all around him; Jerusalem has become as an impure thing among them.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:18
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. I beseech you, all peoples, hear and behold my sorrow. My virgins and my young men went into exile.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:19
verses.text: I called for my lovers, <hi>but</hi> they deceived me; my priests and my elders expired in the city while they sought food for them to bring back their life.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:20
verses.text: Behold, O LORD, for I <hi>am</hi> in trouble; my inward parts ferment; my heart is turned within me, for I have grievously rebelled. On the outside the sword bereaves; in the house <hi>it is</hi> as death.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:21
verses.text: They hear that I sigh; <hi>there is</hi> none to comfort me. All my enemies have heard my evil; they are glad that You have done <hi>it</hi>. You will bring the day <hi>that</hi> You have called, and they shall be like me.

verses.name: Lamentations 1:22
verses.text: Let all their wickedness come before You; and do to them as You have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs <hi>are</hi> many, and my heart <hi>is</hi> faint.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:1
verses.text: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in His anger! He cast down the beauty of Israel from the heavens to the earth and remembered not His footstool in the day of His anger.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:2
verses.text: The Lord swallowed up all the dwelling-places of Jacob <hi>and</hi> has not pitied. In His wrath He has thrown down the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought <hi>them</hi> down to the ground. He has defiled the kingdom and its rulers.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:3
verses.text: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in <hi>His</hi> fierce anger; He has drawn back His right hand from before the enemy, and He burned against Jacob like flaming fire <hi>which</hi> devours all around.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:4
verses.text: He has bent His bow like an enemy; <hi>He stood with</hi> His right hand like an adversary, and killed all <hi>who were</hi> desirable to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion. He poured out His fury like fire.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:5
verses.text: The LORD was like an enemy; He swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all her palaces, <hi>and</hi> destroyed His strongholds. And <hi>He</hi> has increased mourning and weeping in the daughter of Judah.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:6
verses.text: And He violated His booth like a garden, <hi>and</hi> destroyed His meeting places. The LORD caused the meeting places and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and He despised the king and the priest in the fury of His anger.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:7
verses.text: The LORD has cast off His altar; He rejected His sanctuary; He has given up the walls of her palaces into the hater's hand. They gave a noise in the house of the LORD, as a day of meeting.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:8
verses.text: The LORD purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He has stretched out a line; He has not withdrawn His hand from swallowing, and He made rampart and wall lament; they languish together.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:9
verses.text: Her gates have sunk in the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her kings and her rulers <hi>are</hi> among the nations. The law is no more; also her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:10
verses.text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground and <hi>are</hi> silent; they send up dust on their heads; they gird on sackclothes. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:11
verses.text: My eyes fail with tears; my inward parts ferment; my liver is poured on the ground for the ruin of the daughter of my people, in that the children and the babies faint in the streets of the city.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:12
verses.text: They say to their mothers, Where <hi>are</hi> grain and wine? In their fainting <hi>they are</hi> like the wounded in the streets of the city, in their pouring out their lives to their mothers' bosom.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:13
verses.text: What can I testify for you? What thing shall I compare to you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to you, so that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your break <hi>is</hi> great like the sea! Who can heal you?

verses.name: Lamentations 2:14
verses.text: Your prophets have seen false and foolish things for you, and they have not uncovered your iniquity, to turn away your captivity; but they have seen false oracles and seductions for you.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:15
verses.text: All who pass by clap <hi>their</hi> hands at you; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, <hi>saying</hi>, Is this the city which they called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?

verses.name: Lamentations 2:16
verses.text: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you; they hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed <hi>her</hi> up. Certainly this <hi>is</hi> the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:17
verses.text: The LORD has done <hi>what</hi> He has purposed; He has fulfilled His word which He commanded from the days of old. He has thrown down and not pitied. And He caused your hater to rejoice over you; He has set up the horn of your foes.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:18
verses.text: Their heart cried to the LORD. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a torrent day and night; give yourself no rest. Let not the daughter of your eye cease.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:19
verses.text: Arise, cry out in the night. At the beginning of the watches, pour out your heart like water before the face of the LORD. Lift up your hands toward Him for the life of your children who are faint for hunger in the head of every street.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:20
verses.text: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom You have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, children of tender care? Shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the holy place of the Lord?

verses.name: Lamentations 2:21
verses.text: Young and old lie on the ground in the streets; my virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed <hi>them</hi> in the day of Your anger; You have killed and not pitied.

verses.name: Lamentations 2:22
verses.text: You have called as in a solemn day my terrors all around, and here was not an escaped one or a survivor in the day of the LORD's anger. Those whom I have nursed and multiplied, my enemy has consumed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:1
verses.text: I the man have seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:2
verses.text: He has led me and made <hi>me</hi> go in darkness and not into light.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:3
verses.text: Surely He turned <hi>against me</hi>; He turns His hand all the day.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:4
verses.text: He has wasted my flesh and my skin; He has broken my bones.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:5
verses.text: He built against me and has circled <hi>me</hi> with bitterness and hardship.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:6
verses.text: He has made me live in dark places, like the dead of old.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:7
verses.text: He has set a fence around me and I cannot go out; He has made my bronze <hi>chain</hi> heavy.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:8
verses.text: Also when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:9
verses.text: He walled up my ways with cut stone; my paths are crooked.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:10
verses.text: He <hi>was</hi> a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in secret places.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:11
verses.text: He has turned my ways aside and torn me in pieces. He made me desolate.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:12
verses.text: He has bent His bow and set me as a mark for the arrow.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:13
verses.text: He has caused the arrows of His quiver to enter into my inward parts.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:14
verses.text: I was a mockery to all my people, their song all the day.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:15
verses.text: He has filled me with bitterness <hi>and</hi> made me drunk <hi>with</hi> wormwood.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:16
verses.text: He also broke my teeth with gravel; He has covered me in the ashes.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:17
verses.text: And You cast off my soul from peace; I have forgotten blessedness.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:18
verses.text: And I said, My strength and my hope from the LORD <hi>are</hi> gone.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:19
verses.text: Remember my affliction and my wandering, <hi>as</hi> wormwood and bitterness.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:20
verses.text: My soul vividly remembers and bows down on me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:21
verses.text: I recall this to my mind; therefore I hope.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:22
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> by the LORD's kindnesses that we are not destroyed, because His mercies never fail.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:23
verses.text: <hi> They are</hi> new every morning; great <hi>is</hi> Your faithfulness.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:24
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> my portion, says my soul; therefore I will hope in Him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:25
verses.text: The LORD <hi>is</hi> good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:26
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> good that one should hope for the salvation of the LORD, even in silence.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:27
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:28
verses.text: He sits alone and keeps silence because He laid <hi>it</hi> on him.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:29
verses.text: He puts his mouth in the dust, if perhaps there may be hope.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:30
verses.text: He gives <hi>his</hi> cheek to Him who strikes him; he is filled with reproach.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:31
verses.text: For the Lord will not cast off forever;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:32
verses.text: for though He causes grief, yet He will have pity according to the multitude of His kindnesses.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:33
verses.text: For He does not afflict from His heart, nor does He grieve the sons of men;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:34
verses.text: to crush all the prisoners of the earth under his feet;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:35
verses.text: to turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:36
verses.text: to pervert a man in his cause-- <hi>this</hi> the LORD does not see.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:37
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> this <hi>who</hi> speaks, and it occurs, <hi>when</hi> the Lord does not command it?

verses.name: Lamentations 3:38
verses.text: From the mouth of the Most High does not go out the evil and the good.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:39
verses.text: What? Should mankind complain, a living man, because of his sins?

verses.name: Lamentations 3:40
verses.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:41
verses.text: Let us lift up our heart <hi>and</hi> hands to God in Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:42
verses.text: We have sinned and have rebelled; You have not forgiven.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:43
verses.text: You have wrapped Yourself with anger and pursued us; You have slain; You have not pitied.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:44
verses.text: You have wrapped Yourself with a cloud from <hi>any</hi> prayer passing through.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:45
verses.text: You have made us <hi>as</hi> the sweepings and garbage in the midst of the peoples.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:46
verses.text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:47
verses.text: Fear and a pit have come to us, shame and ruin.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:48
verses.text: Streams of water run down my eye for the ruin of the daughter of my people.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:49
verses.text: My eye flows out and does not cease, from there being no intermission,

verses.name: Lamentations 3:50
verses.text: until the LORD shall look down and behold from Heaven.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:51
verses.text: My eye pains my soul because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:52
verses.text: My haters have hunted me, like a bird, without cause.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:53
verses.text: They have cut off my life in the pit, and cast a stone at me.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:54
verses.text: Waters flowed over my head; <hi>then</hi> I said, I am cut off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:55
verses.text: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the lowest pit.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:56
verses.text: You have heard my voice; do not hide Your ear at my relief, at my cry for help.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:57
verses.text: You drew near in the day <hi>that</hi> I called on You; You said, Fear not.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:58
verses.text: O LORD, You strove for the causes of my soul; You redeemed my life.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:59
verses.text: O Lord, You have seen my wrong; judge my cause.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:60
