verses.text: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:61
verses.text: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, all their plots against me;

verses.name: Lamentations 3:62
verses.text: the lips of those who rose up against me, and their scheming against me all the day.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:63
verses.text: Behold their sitting down and their rising up; I <hi>am</hi> their song.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:64
verses.text: You will return to them a recompense, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:65
verses.text: You will give them dullness of heart, Your curse on them.

verses.name: Lamentations 3:66
verses.text: Pursue and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:1
verses.text: How the gold has become dim; the fine gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:2
verses.text: The precious sons of Zion are weighed against pure gold; how they are counted as earthen vessels, the work of a potter's hand!

verses.name: Lamentations 4:3
verses.text: Even the jackals draw out the breast; they suckle their young ones. The daughter of my people <hi>is</hi> cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:4
verses.text: The suckling's tongue cleaves to his palate in thirst; the young children ask bread; there is no breaking to them.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:5
verses.text: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets; those reared in scarlet embrace dunghills.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:6
verses.text: And the iniquity of the daughter of my people is heaped more than the sin of Sodom, overthrown as <hi>in</hi> a moment, and no hands spun on her.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:7
verses.text: Her Nazarites <hi>were</hi> purer than snow, whiter than milk; they <hi>were</hi> redder <hi>of</hi> bone than corals; their cuttings <hi>as</hi> lapis lazuli, <hi>azure blue</hi>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:8
verses.text: Their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets; their skin has shriveled on their bones; it is dried up; it has become like wood.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:9
verses.text: Better <hi>are</hi> the ones slain by the sword than the ones slain by hunger; those who pine away, pierced because the fruits of my fields <hi>failed</hi>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:10
verses.text: The hands of the pitying women have boiled their own children; they became their food in the ruin of the daughter of my people.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:11
verses.text: The LORD has fulfilled His fury; He has poured out His fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has devoured its foundations.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:12
verses.text: The kings of the earth, and all the people of the world, would not have believed that the foe and the hater would go into Jerusalem's gates.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:13
verses.text: For the sins of her prophets <hi>and</hi> the iniquities of her priests, shedding the blood of the just in her midst,

verses.name: Lamentations 4:14
verses.text: they reeled blind in the streets; they are defiled with blood, so that not <hi>any</hi> can touch their clothes.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:15
verses.text: They cried to them, Depart! Unclean! Depart, depart! Touch not! Indeed they fled and reeled; they said among the nations, They will not continue to live <hi>there</hi>.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:16
verses.text: The face of the LORD has shared them out; He will no longer look on them; they did not respect the persons of the priests; they did not favor the elders.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:17
verses.text: While we are, our eyes fail, for our help is vain; in our watching we have watched for a nation; it does not save.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:18
verses.text: They hunted our steps from going in our streets; our end was near, our days were fulfilled, for our end has come.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:19
verses.text: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens; they pursued us on the mountains, they lay in wait for us in the wilderness.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:20
verses.text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed <hi>of</hi> the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, In his shadow we shall live among the nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:21
verses.text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, who lives in the land of Uz. The cup also shall pass through unto you; you shall be drunken and stripped naked.

verses.name: Lamentations 4:22
verses.text: The punishment of your iniquity <hi>is</hi> fulfilled, O daughter of Zion; He will exile you no more. He will visit your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:1
verses.text: Remember, O LORD, what has been to us; look down and see our shame.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:2
verses.text: Our inheritance has turned to aliens, our houses to foreigners.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:3
verses.text: We are orphans and fatherless; our mothers <hi>are</hi> as widows.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:4
verses.text: We have drunk our water for silver; our wood comes for a price.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:5
verses.text: We <hi>are</hi> pursued on our necks; we grow weary; rest is not given to us.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:6
verses.text: We have given the hand <hi>to</hi> Egypt, to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:7
verses.text: Our fathers have sinned <hi>and are</hi> not; we have borne their iniquities.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:8
verses.text: Servants rule over us; <hi>there is</hi> no rescuer out of their hand.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:9
verses.text: We bring in our bread with our souls, because of the sword of the wilderness.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:10
verses.text: Our skin <hi>is</hi> hot like an oven because of the fever heat of famine.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:11
verses.text: They raped the women in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:12
verses.text: Rulers were hanged by the hand; the faces of elders were not honored.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:13
verses.text: They took the young men <hi>to</hi> grind, and the youths stumbled at the wood.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:14
verses.text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:15
verses.text: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance has turned into mourning.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:16
verses.text: The crown has fallen <hi>from</hi> our head. Woe now to us! For we have sinned.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:17
verses.text: Our heart is faint for this; our eyes are dim for these <hi>things</hi>.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:18
verses.text: On the mountain of Zion <hi>is</hi> laid waste, the foxes walk on it.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:19
verses.text: You, O LORD, remain forever; Your throne to generation and generation.

verses.name: Lamentations 5:20
verses.text: Why do You forget us forever <hi>and</hi> forsake us the length of days?

verses.name: Lamentations 5:21
verses.text: Return us to You, O LORD, and we will turn; renew our days as of old,

verses.name: Lamentations 5:22
verses.text: unless You have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:1
verses.text: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth <hi>month</hi>, in the fifth of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:2
verses.text: On the fifth of the month, the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:3
verses.text: the word of the LORD coming became the word of the LORD to Ezekiel, the son of Buzi, the priest in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar. And the hand of the LORD was on him there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:4
verses.text: And I looked, and behold, a windstorm came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire flashing itself, and a brightness to it all around, and out of its midst, like the color of polished bronze out of the middle of the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:5
verses.text: Also out of its midst <hi>came</hi> the likeness of four living creatures. And this <hi>was</hi> how they looked; they had the likeness of a man.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:6
verses.text: And four faces <hi>were</hi> to each, and four wings to each.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:7
verses.text: And their feet <hi>were</hi> straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot. And they sparkled like the color of burnished copper.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:8
verses.text: And the <hi>hands</hi> of a man <hi>extended</hi> from under their wings on their four sides; and the four of them <hi>had</hi> their faces and their wings,

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:9
verses.text: joining each one to the other <hi>by</hi> their wings. They did not turn in their going; each one went toward the front of their face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:10
verses.text: And the likeness of their faces: the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right <hi>side</hi> to the four of them; and the face of an ox on the left side to the four of them; and the face of an eagle to the four of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:11
verses.text: So their faces <hi>were</hi>. And their wings <hi>were</hi> stretched upward; to each, the two <hi>wings</hi> of each one were joined; and two <hi>wings</hi> covered their bodies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:12
verses.text: And each went toward the front of their faces. To where the spirit was to go, there they went; they did not turn in their going.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:13
verses.text: And the likeness of the living creatures: they looked like burning coals of fire; like the appearance of torches. It was continually circling among the living creatures. And the fire <hi>was</hi> bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:14
verses.text: And the living creatures kept running and returning, like the appearance of a flash of lightning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:15
verses.text: And as I looked at the living creatures, behold, one wheel <hi>was</hi> on the earth by the living creatures, with its four faces.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:16
verses.text: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship <hi>was</hi> the color of beryl, and the four of them had one likeness. And their appearance and their workmanship <hi>was</hi> like a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:17
verses.text: When they went, they went on their four sides; <hi>and</hi> they did not turn when they went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:18
verses.text: And their rims: they <hi>were</hi> even high; they were even awesome. And their rims <hi>were</hi> full of eyes all around the four of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:19
verses.text: And in the going of the living creatures, the wheels went beside them; and in the lifting up of the living creatures from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:20
verses.text: Wherever the spirit was to go, there they went; there the spirit <hi>was</hi> to go, and the wheels were lifted up along with them. For the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:21
verses.text: In their going, <hi>these</hi> went; and in their standing still, these stood still. And in their lifting up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up along with them. For the spirit of the living creature <hi>was</hi> in the wheels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:22
verses.text: And there <hi>was</hi> a likeness over the heads of the living creature; an expanse, like the color of awesome crystal stretched out over their heads from above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:23
verses.text: And under the expanse their wings <hi>were</hi> straight, the one toward the other. Each one had two <hi>wings</hi> covering on this <hi>side</hi>, and to each two covering on that <hi>side of</hi> their bodies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:24
verses.text: And I heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, in their going <hi>was</hi> the sound of tumult, like the sound of an army. In their standing still, they let down their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:25
verses.text: And there was a voice from the expanse which <hi>was</hi> over their heads, in their standing still, and they let down their wings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:26
verses.text: And from above the expanse that <hi>was</hi> over their heads <hi>was</hi> a likeness like a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne. And on the likeness of the throne <hi>was</hi> a likeness looking like a man on it from above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:27
verses.text: And I saw <hi>Him</hi> looking like the color of polished bronze, looking like fire all around within it. From the likeness of His loins even upward, and from the likeness of His loins even downward, I saw <hi>Him</hi>, looking like fire, and it had brightness all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:28
verses.text: As the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain looks, so the brightness all around looked. This was how the likeness of the glory of the LORD looked. And I saw. And I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:1
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:2
verses.text: And the Spirit entered into me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet, so that I heard Him who spoke to me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:3
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to the nations, the rebelling ones who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have sinned against Me, to this day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:4
verses.text: And the sons <hi>are</hi> stiff of face, and hard of heart. I am sending you to them; and you shall say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:5
verses.text: And they, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear; for they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house. Yea, they shall know that there has been a prophet among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:6
verses.text: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them, and of their words, though briers and thorns <hi>are</hi> with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words, nor frightened by their faces, though they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:7
verses.text: And you shall speak My words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear, for they <hi>are</hi> rebellious.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:8
verses.text: But you, son of man, hear what I am saying to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:9
verses.text: And I looked, and behold! A hand <hi>was</hi> extended to me; and lo, a roll of a book <hi>was</hi> in it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:10
verses.text: And He spread it before me; and it <hi>was</hi> written on the face and the back. And written on it <hi>were</hi> weepings, and mourning, and woe.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:1
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this roll, and go speak to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:2
verses.text: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that roll.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:3
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, cause your belly to eat, and fill your belly with this roll that I give you. Then I ate <hi>it</hi>; and in my mouth it was like honey for sweetness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:4
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, go! Go up to the house of Israel and speak to them with My words.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:5
verses.text: For you <hi>are</hi> not sent to a people of a deep lip and of a difficult language, <hi>but</hi> to the house of Israel;

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:6
verses.text: not to many people of a deep lip and of a difficult language, whose words you cannot hear. Surely, if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:7
verses.text: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to Me; for all the house of Israel <hi>are</hi> strong of forehead and hard of heart.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:8
verses.text: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces and your forehead strong against their foreheads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:9
verses.text: I have made your forehead as an adamant harder than flint. Do not be bowed down by their faces, though they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:10
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, receive all My words which I shall speak to you in your heart, and hear with your ears.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:11
verses.text: And go! Go to those of the captivity, to the sons of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, So says the Lord God; whether they will hear or whether they will forbear.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:12
verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a sound of a great rushing, <hi>saying</hi>, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the glory of the LORD from His place.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:13
verses.text: <hi> I</hi> also <hi>heard</hi> the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching one another, and the sound of the wheels along with them, and a sound of a great rushing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:14
verses.text: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong on me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:15
verses.text: Then I came to the exiles at Tel-at-abib, who lived by the river Chebar. And I sat <hi>where</hi> they sat; and I also dwelt seven days, being stricken dumb among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:16
verses.text: And it happened at the end of seven days, even it happened <hi>that</hi> the word of the LORD <hi>came</hi> to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:17
verses.text: Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word of My mouth, and give them warning from Me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:18
verses.text: When I say to the wicked, You shall surely die; and you do not give him warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked one shall die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:19
verses.text: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:20
verses.text: And when the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and when I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die. Because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require at your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:21
verses.text: But if you warn the righteous so that the righteous does not sin, and if he does not sin, he shall surely live because he is warned; also you have delivered your soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:22
verses.text: And the hand of the LORD was on me there. And He said to me, Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:23
verses.text: Then I arose and went out into the plain; and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. And I fell on my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:24
verses.text: And the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet; and spoke with me, and said to me, Go, shut yourself inside your house!

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:25
verses.text: But you, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands on you and shall bind you with them, and you shall not go out among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:26
verses.text: And I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be dumb and shall not be one who warns them. For they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:27
verses.text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, So says the Lord God: He who hears, let him hear; and he who stops his ears, let him stop; for they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:1
verses.text: And you, son of man, take a tile to yourself, and lay it before you, and portray on it the city Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:2
verses.text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mound against it. Also set the camp against it, and set <hi>battering</hi> rams against it all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:3
verses.text: And take an iron griddle to yourself, and set it <hi>for</hi> a wall of iron between you and the city. And set your face against it, and it shall be under attack. And you shall set a battle against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:4
verses.text: Also lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it; <hi>according</hi> to the number of days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:5
verses.text: For I have laid on you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:6
verses.text: And when you have fulfilled them, lie again on your right side, and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days; a day for a year; a day for a year, I have set for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:7
verses.text: And you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and your arm <hi>shall be</hi> uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:8
verses.text: And, behold, I will lay bands on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to <hi>another</hi> until you have ended the days of your siege.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:9
verses.text: Take also to yourself wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make bread of them for yourself. <hi>According</hi> to the number of the days that you shall lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:10
verses.text: And your food which you shall eat <hi>shall be</hi> by weight twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:11
verses.text: You shall also drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:12
verses.text: And you shall eat it <hi>as</hi> barley cakes, and you shall bake it with dung of the excrement of man, in their sight.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:13
verses.text: And the LORD said, Even so shall the sons of Israel eat their defiled bread among the nations, where I will drive them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:14
verses.text: Then I said, Ah Lord God! Behold, my soul has not been defiled. For from my youth up, even till now, I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither did there come any unclean flesh into my mouth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:15
verses.text: Then He said to me, Lo, I have given you cow's dung for man's dung, and you shall prepare your bread with it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:16
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. And they shall eat bread by weight, and with care. And they shall drink water by measure, and in silence,

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:17
verses.text: so that they may lack bread and water, and be stricken dumb with one another, and waste away in their iniquity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:1
verses.text: And you, son of man, take a sharp sword to yourself, take a barber's razor also, and cause <hi>it</hi> to pass on your head and on your beard. Then take scales to weigh, and divide the <hi>hair</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:2
verses.text: You shall burn a third part with fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled; and you shall take a third part <hi>and</hi> beat around it with a sword; and you shall scatter a third part in the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:3
verses.text: Also you shall take a few of them in number, and tie them up in your skirts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:4
verses.text: Then take of them again, and throw them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for a fire shall come forth from them into all the house of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:5
verses.text: So says the Lord God: This <hi>is</hi> Jerusalem. I have set it in the middle of the nations, and all around her <hi>are</hi> the lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:6
verses.text: And she has changed My judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and <hi>defiled</hi> My laws more than the countries that <hi>are</hi> all around her; for they have rejected My judgments and My laws; they have not walked in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:7
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord God: Because you multiplied more than the nations that <hi>are</hi> all around you, <hi>and</hi> have not walked in My laws, neither have kept My judgments, nor have done according to the judgments of the nations all around you;

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:8
verses.text: therefore so says the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, <hi>am</hi> against you, and will carry out judgments in your midst before the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:9
verses.text: And I will do in you that which I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again, because of all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:10
verses.text: So the fathers shall eat the sons in your midst, and the sons shall eat their fathers. And I will execute judgments in you, and I will scatter the whole remnant of you into all the winds.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:11
verses.text: Therefore, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also withdraw; nor shall My eye spare you, nor will I have any pity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:12
verses.text: A third part of you shall die with the plague, and shall be consumed with the famine in your midst. And a third part shall fall by the sword all around you; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:13
verses.text: So My anger shall be fulfilled, and I will cause My fury to rest on them, and I will be comforted. And they shall know that I the LORD have spoken <hi>it</hi> in My zeal, when I have fulfilled My fury in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:14
verses.text: And I will make you a waste and a curse among the nations that <hi>are</hi> all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:15
verses.text: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an example and a wonder to the nations which <hi>are</hi> all around you, when I shall execute judgments against you in anger and in fury and in rebukes <hi>among them</hi>. I the LORD have spoken it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:16
verses.text: When I shall send on them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for <hi>their</hi> ruin, which I will send to destroy you; even I will increase the famine on you, and break your staff of bread;

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:17
verses.text: yea, I will send on you famine and evil beasts, and you will be bereaved. And pestilence and blood shall pass among you; and I shall bring a sword on you. I the LORD have spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:1
verses.text: And it happened, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:3
verses.text: And say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. So says the Lord Jehovah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:4
verses.text: And your altars shall be wasted, and your pillars shall be broken. And I will make fall your slain before your idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:5
verses.text: And I will put the dead bodies of the sons of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:6
verses.text: In all the places where you live, cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be deserted; so that your altars may be laid waste and become guilty, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your pillars may be cut down, and your works wiped out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:7
verses.text: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:8
verses.text: Yet I will leave a reminder that may be <hi>left</hi> to you <hi>some</hi> who escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:9
verses.text: And those of you who escape shall remember Me among the nations where they shall be exiled, because I was broken <hi>by</hi> their whoring heart which has departed from Me, and with their whoring eyes which go after their idols. And they shall despise themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:10
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, <hi>and that</hi> I have not said in vain to do this evil to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:11
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Strike with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas, for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! For they shall fall by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:12
verses.text: He who is afar off shall die of the plague; and he who is near shall fall by the sword; and he who remains and is under siege shall die by the famine. So I will fulfill My fury on them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:13
verses.text: Then you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when their dead shall be among their idols all around their altars, on every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every leafy oak, the place where they offered sweet aroma to all their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:14
verses.text: And I will stretch out My hand on them and make the land a waste, even more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all the places where they live; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:1
verses.text: And it happened, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:2
verses.text: And you, son of man, so says the Lord Jehovah to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:3
verses.text: Now the end <hi>is</hi> on you, and I will send My anger on you and will judge you according to your ways, and will lay on you all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:4
verses.text: And My eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity. But I will repay your ways on you, and your abominations shall be in your midst; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:5
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: An evil: Behold, an only evil has come!

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:6
verses.text: An end has come, the end has come. It awakes against you; behold, it has come.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:7
verses.text: The encirclement has come to you, O dwellers of the land. The time has come, the day of tumult <hi>is</hi> near, and not a shout of the mountains.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:8
verses.text: And I will soon pour out My fury on you, and fulfill My anger on you. And I will judge you according to your ways, and will repay you for all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:9
verses.text: And My eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; I will repay you according to your ways and your abominations <hi>that</hi> are in your midst. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who strikes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:10
verses.text: Behold the day! Behold, it has come; the encirclement has gone out; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:11
verses.text: Violence has risen up for a rod of wickedness. None of them <hi>shall remain</hi>, nor of their multitude, nor of any of their riches; nor <hi>shall</hi> there <hi>be</hi> wailing for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:12
verses.text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath <hi>is</hi> on all her multitude.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:13
verses.text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision to all her multitude shall not return, and a man shall not hold his life strong in iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:14
verses.text: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goes to the battle, for My wrath <hi>is</hi> on all her multitude.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:15
verses.text: The sword <hi>is</hi> outside, and the plague and the famine inside. He who <hi>is</hi> in the field shall die with the sword; and he in the city shall be devoured by famine and plague.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:16
verses.text: But <hi>if</hi> their fugitives shall escape, then they shall be like doves of the valleys on the mountains, all of them mourning, each one for his iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:17
verses.text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall go <hi>weak as</hi> water.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:18
verses.text: They shall also gird <hi>on</hi> sackcloth, and trembling shall cover them; and shame <hi>shall be</hi> on all faces, and baldness on all heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:19
verses.text: They shall throw their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be an impure thing. Their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because their iniquity has become a stumbling-block for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:20
verses.text: And the beauty of His ornament, He set it in majesty. But they made the images of their abominations <hi>and</hi> of their hateful things in it; therefore I have put it to them as an impure thing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:21
verses.text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prize, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall defile it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:22
verses.text: I will also turn My face from them, and they shall defile My secret <hi>place</hi>; and violent ones shall enter into it and defile it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:23
verses.text: Make a chain; for the land is full of bloody judgments, and the city is full of violence.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:24
verses.text: And I will bring the most evil of the nations, and they shall possess their houses. I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:25
verses.text: Ruin comes; and they shall seek peace, but none <hi>shall be</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:26
verses.text: Disaster on disaster shall come, and rumor to rumor shall be. And they shall seek a vision from the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and wisdom from the elders.

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:27
verses.text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled. I will do to them according to their way, and according to their judgments I will judge them; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:1
verses.text: And it was in the sixth year, in the sixth <hi>month</hi>, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me. And the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell on me there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:2
verses.text: And I looked, and behold! A likeness as the look of fire; from the appearance of His loins and downward, <hi>like</hi> fire. And from his loins and upward as the look of brightness, like the color of polished bronze.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:3
verses.text: And He put out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head. And the Spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heavens, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the opening of the inner gate facing north, where there <hi>was</hi> a seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:4
verses.text: And, behold! The glory of the God of Israel <hi>was</hi> there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:5
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, lift up your eyes now to the way of the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold, northward at the gate of the altar the image of jealousy <hi>was</hi> at the entrance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:6
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, do you see what they do; even the great abominations which the house of Israel is doing here, that I should go far off from My sanctuary? But turn again, <hi>and</hi> you shall see greater abominations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:7
verses.text: And He brought me to the opening of the court; and I looked, and behold, a hole in the wall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:8
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, dig in the wall now. And I dug in the wall, and, behold, an opening.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:9
verses.text: And he said to me. Go in and see the evil abominations that they do here.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:10
verses.text: And I went in and saw. And behold, every kind of creeping thing, and hateful beast, and all the idols of the house of Israel, were carved on the wall all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:11
verses.text: And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, standing among them, these were before them, and each man with his censor in his hand. And the odor of the cloud of incense was rising.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:12
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, each man in his image room? For they are saying, The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:13
verses.text: He also said to me, You turn again, <hi>and</hi> you shall see greater evils that they are doing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:14
verses.text: And He brought me to the opening of the gate of the LORD's house, toward the north. And behold, women were sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:15
verses.text: And He said to me, Have you seen, O son of man? Turn yet again, <hi>and</hi> you shall see greater evils than these.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:16
verses.text: And He brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and behold, at the opening of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, <hi>were</hi> about twenty-five men with their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they bowed themselves eastward to the sun.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:17
verses.text: And He said to me, Have you seen, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they do the hateful things which they do here? For they have filled the land with violence and have turned to provoke Me to anger. And lo, they put the branch to their nose.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:18
verses.text: And I will also deal with fury; My eye shall not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in My ears <hi>with</hi> a loud voice, I will not hear them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:1
verses.text: And He cried in my ears <hi>with</hi> a loud voice, saying, Let the overseers of the city draw near, even each <hi>with</hi> his destroying weapon in his hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:2
verses.text: And behold, six men came from the way of the Upper Gate which faces north, and each had his shattering weapon in his hand. And one man among them <hi>was</hi> clothed with linen, and a writer's inkhorn by his side. And they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:3
verses.text: And the glory of the God of Israel had gone on from the cherub, where it was on it, to the threshold of the house. And He called to the man clothed in linen, <hi>with</hi> the writer's inkhorn by his side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Go through in the midst of the city, in the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men who are groaning and are mourning because of all the abominations that are done in her midst.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:5
verses.text: And He said to those in my hearing, Go over in the city after him, and strike. Let not your eye spare, nor have pity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:6
verses.text: Fully destroy old <hi>men</hi>, young men and virgins, and little children and women. But do not come near any man on whom <hi>is</hi> the mark. And begin at My sanctuary. And they began at the old men who <hi>were</hi> before the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:7
verses.text: And He said to them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out! And they went out and killed in the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:8
verses.text: And it happened as they were slaying them, and I remained, then I fell on my face and cried, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! Will You destroy all the remnant of Israel in Your pouring out of Your fury on Jerusalem?

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:9
verses.text: And He said to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah <hi>is</hi> great, and the land is full of blood, and the city is full of perversity. For they say, The LORD has forsaken the land; and, the LORD does not see.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:10
verses.text: And even I, My eye shall not spare, nor will I have pity, <hi>but</hi> I will put their way on their head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:11
verses.text: And behold, the man clothed with linen, <hi>with</hi> the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as You have commanded me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:1
verses.text: And I looked, and behold! In the expanse over the head of the cherubs appeared the look of the form of a throne, like a sapphire stone, above them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:2
verses.text: And He spoke to the man clothed <hi>with</hi> linen, and said, Go in among the wheels, under the cherub, and fill your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubs, and scatter <hi>them</hi> on the city. And he went in before me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:3
verses.text: And the cherubs were standing on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:4
verses.text: And the glory of the LORD rose from the cherub, over the threshold of the house. And the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:5
verses.text: And the sound of the cherubs' wings was heard over the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when He speaks.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:6
verses.text: And it happened when He had commanded the man clothed <hi>with</hi> linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubs; he went in then and stood beside the wheels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:7
verses.text: And a cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubs to the fire between the cherubs, and he lifted it and put <hi>it</hi> into the hands of the one clothed with linen. And he took <hi>it</hi> and went out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:8
verses.text: And the form of a man's hand was seen under the wings of the cherubs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:9
verses.text: And I looked, and behold, the four wheels <hi>were</hi> beside the cherubs, one wheel was by one cherub, and another wheel by one cherub; and the wheels looked like the color of a stone of Tarshish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:10
verses.text: And their appearance was as one, the four of them, as if the wheel were in the midst of the wheel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:11
verses.text: When they went, they went on their four sides. They did not turn as they went, for to the place where the head faces, after it they went. They did not turn as they went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:12
verses.text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels <hi>were</hi> full of eyes all around, <hi>even</hi> their wheels that the four of them had.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:13
verses.text: As for the wheels, it was cried to them in my hearing, Whirling wheel!

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:14
verses.text: And four faces were to each one. The first face <hi>was</hi> the face of a cherub, and the second face <hi>was</hi> the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:15
verses.text: And the cherubs rose up. This <hi>is</hi> the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:16
verses.text: And when the cherubs went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubs lifted their wings to soar from the earth, the wheels did not turn from beside them, even they.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:17
verses.text: When they stood still, <hi>these</hi> stood still, and when they rose up, <hi>these</hi> lifted up. For the spirit of the living creature <hi>was</hi> in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:18
verses.text: And the glory of the LORD went from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:19
verses.text: And the cherubs lifted up their wings and rose up from the earth in my sight. When they went out, the wheels also <hi>were</hi> beside them. And he stood at the door of the eastern gate of the LORD's house. And the glory of the God of Israel <hi>was</hi> over them from above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:20
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they <hi>were</hi> cherubs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:21
verses.text: Four, <hi>even</hi> four faces <hi>are</hi> to each; and four wings to each. And the form of a man's hands <hi>was</hi> under their wings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:22
verses.text: And the form of their faces, they <hi>are</hi> the faces that I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances even theirs. They each went straight forward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:1
verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the eastern gate of the LORD's house, which faces eastward. And behold, twenty-five men were at the opening of the gate; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, rulers of the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:2
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, these <hi>are</hi> the men who plot evil and give wicked advice in this city;

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:3
verses.text: who say, <hi>It is</hi> not near; let us build houses; this <hi>city is</hi> the pot, and we <hi>are</hi> the flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:4
verses.text: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, O son of man!

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:5
verses.text: And the Spirit of the LORD fell on me, and said to me, Speak: So says the LORD: So you have said, O house of Israel, for I Myself know the elevations of your spirit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:6
verses.text: You have multiplied your dead in this city, and you have filled its streets with the dead.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:7
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Your slain whom you have laid in her midst, they <hi>are</hi> the flesh, and this <hi>city is</hi> the pot. But I will bring you out of her midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:8
verses.text: You have feared the sword, and I will bring a sword on you, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:9
verses.text: And I will bring you out of her midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments on you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:10
verses.text: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:11
verses.text: This <hi>city</hi> shall not be your pot, nor shall you be the flesh in her midst. But I will judge you in the border of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:12
verses.text: and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD. For you have not walked in My statutes, nor have you done My judgments, but have done after the customs of the nations all around you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:13
verses.text: And it happened when I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! Will You make a full end <hi>of</hi> the remnant of Israel?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:14
verses.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:15
verses.text: Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your redemption, and all the house of Israel, of all that have heard the inhabitants of Jerusalem saying to all of them, Go far away from Jehovah; this land is given to us for a possession.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:16
verses.text: Therefore say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Though I have sent them far off among the nations, and though I scattered them among the lands, yet I will be to them as a little sanctuary in the lands where they had gone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:17
verses.text: Therefore say, So says the Lord Jehovah: I will even gather you from the people and assemble you out of the lands, in those where you were scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:18
verses.text: And they shall come there, and they shall take away all its hateful things and all its abominations from it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:19
verses.text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. And I will remove the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:20
verses.text: so that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances, and do them. And they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:21
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> to <hi>those whose</hi> heart is going <hi>after</hi> their hateful things, and <hi>also</hi> their heart <hi>is after</hi> their disgusting idols, I will give their way on their own heads, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:22
verses.text: And the cherubs lifted up their wings, and the wheels beside them. And the glory of the God of Israel <hi>was</hi> over them above.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:23
verses.text: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain which <hi>is</hi> on the east side of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:24
verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the exiles. And the vision that I had seen went up from me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:25
verses.text: And I spoke to the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:2
verses.text: Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see and see not. They have ears to hear and hear not, for they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:3
verses.text: Therefore, son of man, prepare for yourself vessels for exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes. And you shall be exiled from your place to another place before their eyes. It may be they will consider, though they <hi>are</hi> a rebellious house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:4
verses.text: And you shall bring out your vessels, as vessels for exile, by day before their eyes. And you shall go out at evening before their eyes, as those going into exile.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:5
verses.text: Dig through the wall before their eyes, and carry out through it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:6
verses.text: Before their eyes you shall carry <hi>it</hi> on <hi>your</hi> shoulders, carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face so that you do not see the ground, for I have set you as a sign to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:7
verses.text: And I did as I was commanded. By day I brought out my vessels, as vessels for exile. And in the evening I dug by hand through the wall. I brought <hi>it</hi> out in the dark, and I carried it on <hi>my</hi> shoulder before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:8
verses.text: And in the morning the word of the LORD <hi>came</hi> to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:9
verses.text: Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, What are you doing?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:10
verses.text: Say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: This burden <hi>concerns</hi> the king in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:11
verses.text: Say, I <hi>am</hi> your sign: As I have done, so it shall be done to them. They shall go into exile, into captivity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:12
verses.text: And the king who <hi>is</hi> among them shall carry <hi>burdens</hi> on <hi>his</hi> shoulder in the dark, and shall go out. They shall dig through the wall to carry out by it. He shall hide his face so that he does not see the ground with <hi>his</hi> eye.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:13
verses.text: I will also spread My net on him, and He shall be taken in My snare. And I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans. Yet he shall not see it, though he shall die there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:14
verses.text: And I will scatter to every wind all who <hi>are</hi> around him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:15
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations and scatter them in the countries.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:16
verses.text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the plague, so that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:17
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:18
verses.text: Son of man, eat your bread with quaking and drink your water with trembling and anxiety.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:19
verses.text: And say to the people of the land: So says the Lord Jehovah of the people of Jerusalem <hi>and</hi> of the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, so that her land may be desolated of her fullness, because of the violence of all those who dwell in it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:20
verses.text: And the cities that have people shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:21
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:22
verses.text: Son of man, what <hi>is</hi> this proverb <hi>that</hi> you have in the land of Israel, saying, The days will go on and every vision shall fail?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:23
verses.text: Therefore tell them, So says the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel. But say to them, The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:24
verses.text: For there shall never again be any vain vision nor slippery divination within the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:25
verses.text: For I, the LORD, will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be done. It shall no more be delayed; for in your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and will do it, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:26
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:27
verses.text: Son of man, behold, the house of Israel says, The vision that he sees <hi>is</hi> for many days to come, and he prophesies of the times that are far off.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:28
verses.text: Therefore say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be delayed any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy. And say to those who prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear the word of the Lord:

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:3
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah, Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:4
verses.text: O Israel, your prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:5
verses.text: You have not gone up into the breaks, nor built the wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:6
verses.text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD says. And the LORD has not sent them; but they hoped to confirm <hi>their</hi> word.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:7
verses.text: Did you not see a vain vision, and speak a lying divination? Yet you say, The LORD says; although I have not spoken?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:8
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have spoken vanity and seen a lie, therefore, behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:9
verses.text: And My hand shall be against the prophets who see vanity and who divine a lie. They shall not be in the council of My people, nor shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:10
verses.text: Because, even because they made My people go astray, saying, Peace; and <hi>there was</hi> no peace; and he builds a wall, and lo, <hi>others</hi> daubed it with lime.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:11
verses.text: Say to those who daub <hi>with</hi> lime, yes, it shall fall; <hi>there</hi> will be a flooding rain; and you, O hailstones, shall fall, and a stormy wind will break.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:12
verses.text: And, behold, when the wall has fallen, shall it not be said to you, Where <hi>is</hi> the daubing with which you have daubed?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:13
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I will even break <hi>it with</hi> a stormy wind in My fury. And there shall be an flooding rain in My anger, and hailstones in fury to destroy it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:14
verses.text: And I will break down the wall that you have daubed <hi>with</hi> lime, and touch it to the ground; yea, I will bare its base. And it shall fall, and you shall be destroyed in her midst; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:15
verses.text: And I will fulfill My wrath on the wall and on those who daubed it <hi>with</hi> lime. And I will say to you, The wall <hi>is</hi> no more; and, Those who daubed <hi>are</hi> no more;

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:16
verses.text: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and <hi>there is</hi> no peace, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:17
verses.text: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart. And prophesy against them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:18
verses.text: and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Woe to those sewing bands to all joints of my hands, and make long veils for the head of every <hi>man</hi> of stature, to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of My people, and will you save alive the souls for yourselves?

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:19
verses.text: And will you profane Me among My people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls that should not die; and to save alive the souls that should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:20
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against your bands with which you are hunting the souls there, to make them fly. And I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, the souls which you are hunting, to make them fly.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:21
verses.text: Also I will tear your long veils and deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall no more be in your hand to be hunted. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:22
verses.text: Because with lies you have saddened the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and have made the hands of the wicked strong, so that he should not turn from his wicked way, by promising him life;

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:23
verses.text: therefore you shall not see vanity, and you shall not divine any divination. and I will deliver My people out of your hands; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:1
verses.text: And some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:2
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:3
verses.text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts, and put the stumbling-block of their iniquity before their face. Should I at all be inquired of by them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:4
verses.text: Therefore speak to them, and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumbling-block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him in it by the host of his idols;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:5
verses.text: so that I may capture the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are estranged from Me by their idols, all of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:6
verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: Repent and turn from your idols, and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:7
verses.text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger who lives in Israel, who separates himself from Me and sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumbling-block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to a prophet to ask of him concerning Me; I the LORD will answer him Myself.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:8
verses.text: And I will set My face against that man, and I will make him desolate for a sign and for proverbs. And I will cut him off from the midst of My people; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:9
verses.text: And the prophet, if he is deceived, and he speaks a word, I the LORD have deceived that prophet. And I will stretch out My hand on him and will destroy him in the midst of My people Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:10
verses.text: And they shall bear their iniquity. As the iniquity of the inquirer, so the iniquity of the prophet shall be.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:11
verses.text: So that the house of Israel may never again go astray from Me, nor be defiled again with all their transgressions, but they are to Me My people, and I will be to them for God, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:12
verses.text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:13
verses.text: Son of man, when a land sins against Me by traitorous betraying, then I will stretch out My hand on it, and will break the staff of its bread, and will send famine on it, and will cut off man and beast from it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:14
verses.text: And <hi>though</hi> these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver <hi>only</hi> their own souls by their righteousness, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:15
verses.text: If I cause destroying beasts to come through the land, and they spoil it so that it is deserted, so that no one may pass through because of the beasts,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:16
verses.text: <hi> though</hi> these three men were in its midst, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only shall be delivered, but the land shall be deserted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:17
verses.text: Or <hi>if</hi> I bring a sword on that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:18
verses.text: though these three men <hi>were</hi> in it, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they <hi>only</hi> shall be delivered themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:19
verses.text: Or <hi>if</hi> I send a plague into that land, and pour out My fury on it in blood, to cut off man and beast from it;

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:20
verses.text: though Noah, Daniel, and Job <hi>were</hi> in it, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter. They shall <hi>only</hi> deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:21
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send My four evil judgments on Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the destroying beast, and the plague, to cut off man and beast from it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:22
verses.text: Yet, behold, there shall be left a remnant in it that shall be brought out, sons and daughters. Behold, they shall come out to you, and you shall see their way and their doings. And you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I brought on Jerusalem, <hi>for</hi> all that I have brought on it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:23
verses.text: And they shall comfort you when you see their way and their doings. And you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:2
verses.text: Son of man, how is the vine tree more than any other tree, <hi>or than</hi> a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:3
verses.text: Shall wood be taken from it to do work? Or will <hi>men</hi> take from it <hi>for</hi> a peg to hang any vessel on it?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:4
verses.text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both its ends, and its middle is charred. Is it fit for <hi>any</hi> work?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:5
verses.text: Behold, when it was whole, it was not made for work. How much less when the fire has devoured it, and it is charred? Shall it yet be made to work?

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:6
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah, As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the people of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:7
verses.text: And I will set My face against them; they shall go out from the fire, and the fire shall devour them. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD when I set My face against them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:8
verses.text: And I will make the land <hi>to be</hi> desolate, because they have committed a treacherous act, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:1
verses.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:2
verses.text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:3
verses.text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah to Jerusalem, Your origin and your birth <hi>is</hi> of the land of Canaan. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Hittite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:4
verses.text: And <hi>as for</hi> your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut, nor were you washed with water to cleanse <hi>you</hi>. And you were not salted, nor swaddled at all.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:5
verses.text: No eye pitied you, to do any of these to you, to have compassion on you. But you were thrown out into the open field, because your life was despised in the day that you were born.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:6
verses.text: And when I passed by you and saw you squirming in your blood, I said to you in your blood, Live! Yes, I said to you in your blood, Live!

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:7
verses.text: I have caused you to multiply like the bud of the field, and you are grown, and you are great; and you come <hi>in</hi> the finest ornaments. <hi>Your</hi> breasts are formed, and hair is grown, yet you <hi>were</hi> naked and bare.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:8
verses.text: And I passed by you and looked on you, and, behold, your time <hi>was</hi> the time of love. And I spread my skirt over you and covered your nakedness. And I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord Jehovah. And you became Mine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:9
verses.text: And I washed you with water; I washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:10
verses.text: I also clothed you <hi>with</hi> embroidered work, and I shod you <hi>with</hi> dugong <hi>sandals</hi>. And I wrapped you in fine linen, and I covered you <hi>with</hi> silk.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:11
verses.text: And I adorned you <hi>with</hi> ornaments, and I put bracelets on your hands and a chain on your neck.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:12
verses.text: And I put a ring on your nose, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:13
verses.text: And you were adorned with gold and silver; and your clothing <hi>was of</hi> fine linen and silk and embroidered work. You ate fine flour and honey and oil; and you were exceedingly beautiful. And you advanced to regal estate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:14
verses.text: And your name went out among the nations, because of your beauty; for it <hi>was</hi> perfect in My beauty, which I had put on you, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:15
verses.text: But you trusted in your beauty, and played the harlot because of your name, and poured out your fornications on all who passed by; it was his.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:16
verses.text: And you took from your clothes and adorned your high places with different colors, and fornicated on them, <hi>such as</hi> had not come, nor shall be.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:17
verses.text: And you have taken beautiful things of My gold and of My silver, which I had given you, and made images of males, and fornicated with them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:18
verses.text: And <hi>you</hi> took your embroidered dresses and covered them, and you have given to their face My oil and My incense.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:19
verses.text: Also My food which I gave you, fine flour and oil and honey <hi>with which</hi> I fed you, you have given it to their face for a soothing aroma. And it happened, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:20
verses.text: And you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to Me, and you gave these to them for food. <hi>Are</hi> your fornications small?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:21
verses.text: You have slaughtered My sons and gave them to cause these to pass through <hi>the fire</hi> for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:22
verses.text: And in all your hateful deeds and your fornications you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, <hi>and</hi> squirming in your blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:23
verses.text: Woe, woe to you says the Lord Jehovah! <hi>For</hi> it happened after all your evil,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:24
verses.text: <hi> that</hi> you have also built yourself a mound, and you have made yourself a high place in every street.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:25
verses.text: You have built your high place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty to be despised, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and have multiplied your fornications.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:26
verses.text: You have also whored with the Egyptians, your neighbors great of flesh, and have multiplied your fornications to provoke Me to anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:27
verses.text: And, behold, therefore I have stretched out My hand over you, and drew back your portion. And I gave you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your wicked way.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:28
verses.text: You have whored with the Assyrians, without your being satisfied; yea, you whored and yet you were not satisfied.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:29
verses.text: And your whoredom is idolatry in the land of Canaan, <hi>to the</hi> Chaldean, and yet you were not satisfied with this.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:30
verses.text: How weak is your heart, says the Lord Jehovah, since you do all these, the work of a woman, an overbearing harlot;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:31
verses.text: in that you build your mound at the head of every way, and make your high place in every street. Yet you have not been as a harlot, scorning wages.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:32
verses.text: <hi> Like</hi> the adulterous wife, instead of her husband, she takes strangers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:33
verses.text: They give a gift to all harlots, but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them to come to you from all around, for your fornication.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:34
verses.text: And in you was the opposite from <hi>those</hi> women in your fornications, since no one whores after you, and in your giving wages, and hire is not given to you. <hi>In</hi> this you are opposite.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:35
verses.text: Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:36
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because your lewdness was poured out and your nakedness was bared in your fornications with your lovers, and with all the idols of your abominations, and by the blood of your sons whom you gave to them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:37
verses.text: behold, therefore I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have been pleased, even all <hi>whom</hi> you loved, with all whom you have hated; I will even gather them against you from all around, and will uncover your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:38
verses.text: And I will judge you with judgments of adulteresses, and with shedders of blood. And I will give you blood and fury and jealousy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:39
verses.text: And I will also give you into their hand, and they will tear down your mound, and will demolish your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, and shall take your beautiful things, and leave you naked and bare.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:40
verses.text: They shall also raise a company against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and cut you with their swords.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:41
verses.text: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. And I will make you stop whoring; and also, you shall not give hire again.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:42
verses.text: And I will make My fury to rest against you, and My jealousy shall depart from you, and I will be quiet and will be angry no more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:43
verses.text: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have troubled Me in all these <hi>things</hi>; so, behold, I will also repay your way on <hi>your</hi> head, says the Lord Jehovah. And you shall not commit this wickedness above all your abominations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:44
verses.text: Behold, all who use proverbs shall use <hi>this</hi> proverb against you, saying, As the mother, <hi>so is</hi> her daughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:45
verses.text: You <hi>are</hi> your mother's daughter, who despises her husband and her sons. And you <hi>are</hi> the sister of your sisters, who despise their husbands and their sons. Your mother <hi>was</hi> a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:46
verses.text: And your older sister <hi>is</hi> Samaria, she and her daughters who dwell at your left hand. And your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, <hi>is</hi> Sodom and her daughters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:47
verses.text: Yet you have not walked according to their ways, nor done according to their hateful deeds; but, as <hi>if it were</hi> a very little <hi>thing</hi>, you were corrupted more than they were in all your ways.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:48
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, Sodom your sister, she nor her daughters, has not done as you have done, you and your daughters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:49
verses.text: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom; pride. Fullness of bread and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters. Nor did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:50
verses.text: And they were haughty and did abominable things before Me, so I turned away as I saw <hi>fit</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:51
verses.text: Nor has Samaria sinned <hi>as much</hi> as half your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters in all your abominations which you have done.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:52
