verses.text: You also, who have judged your sisters, bear your own shame for your sins which you have committed more abominable than they. They are more righteous than you! Yes, blush and bear your shame, since you have justified your sisters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:53
verses.text: When I shall return their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then <hi>also</hi> the captivity of your captivity in their midst;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:54
verses.text: that you may bear your shame, and blush in all that you have done, since you are a comfort to them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:55
verses.text: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former state, then you and your daughters shall return to your former state.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:56
verses.text: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:57
verses.text: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of <hi>your</hi> reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all her neighbors, the daughters of the Philistines who hated you from all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:58
verses.text: You are bearing your wickedness and your abominations, says the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:59
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: I will even deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:60
verses.text: But I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish to you an everlasting covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:61
verses.text: And you shall remember your ways and be ashamed, when you shall receive your sisters, your older and your younger. And I will give them to you for daughters, but not by <hi>your</hi> covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:62
verses.text: And I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD;

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:63
verses.text: so that you may remember and be ashamed; and it will not be <hi>possible</hi> to open <hi>your</hi> mouth any more because of your shame; in that I am propitiated for all that you have done, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:2
verses.text: Son of man, put out a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:3
verses.text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings, long of pinion, full of feathers, who had different colors, came to Lebanon and took the highest branch of the cedar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:4
verses.text: He plucked off the top of its young twigs and carried it into a land of traders. He set it in a city of merchants.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:5
verses.text: He also took of the seed of the land and planted it in a fruitful field. He placed <hi>it</hi> by great waters and set <hi>it</hi> as a willow tree.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:6
verses.text: And it grew and became a spreading low vine, whose branches turned toward him. And its roots were under him. So it became a vine and brought out branches and shot out boughs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:7
verses.text: There was also another great eagle <hi>with</hi> great wings and many feathers. And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him and shot out its branches toward him, that he might water it, away from the beds of its planting.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:8
verses.text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring out branches, and that it might bear fruit, to be a splendid vine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:9
verses.text: Say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? Shall he not pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, and wither it? All the leaves of its sprouting shall wither, and not with great arm, nor by many people <hi>shall any</hi> raise it by its roots.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:10
verses.text: And behold, <hi>being</hi> planted, shall it prosper? Shall it not utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It shall wither in the beds <hi>where</hi> it sprouted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:11
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:12
verses.text: Say now to the rebellious house: Do you not know what these <hi>things mean</hi>? Tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon has come to Jerusalem and has taken its king and its rulers, and brings them to himself to Babylon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:13
verses.text: And he has taken of the king's seed and has made a covenant with him, and has taken an oath from him. He has also taken the mighty of the land,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:14
verses.text: so that the kingdom might be low, that it might not lift itself up, <hi>but</hi> that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:15
verses.text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, to give him horses and many people. Shall he be blessed? Shall he who does such <hi>things</hi> escape? Or shall he break the covenant and be delivered?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:16
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:17
verses.text: Nor shall Pharaoh with <hi>his</hi> mighty army and great company work for him in the war, by pouring out siege mounds and building forts, to cut off many persons.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:18
verses.text: And he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant. And, behold, he had given his hand, and has done all these, he shall not escape.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:19
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: <hi>As</hi> I live, surely My oath that he has despised, and My covenant that he has broken, I will even repay it on his own head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:20
verses.text: And I will spread My net on him, and he shall be taken in My snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and I will judge him there with his sin which he has sinned against Me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:21
verses.text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered toward all winds. And you shall know that I the LORD have spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:22
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I, <hi>even</hi> I, will also take of the top of the highest cedar and will set <hi>it</hi>; I will crop off from the first of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:23
verses.text: In a mountain, in a high place of Israel, I will plant it. And it shall bear boughs, and bear fruit, and be a majestic cedar. And under it shall dwell every bird of every wing; in the shadow of its branches they shall dwell.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:24
verses.text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish. I the LORD have spoken and acted.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:2
verses.text: What is it to you that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the teeth of the sons <hi>are</hi> dull?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:3
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, to you there is no longer any <hi>occasion</hi> to use this proverb in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:4
verses.text: Behold, all souls <hi>are</hi> Mine. As the soul of the father, also the soul of the son, they <hi>are</hi> Mine. The soul that sins, it shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:5
verses.text: But a man that is just and does what just is and right,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:6
verses.text: and has not eaten on the mountains, nor has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, nor has defiled his neighbor's wife, nor has come near a menstruating woman,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:7
verses.text: and has not ill-treated any man, <hi>but</hi> has given the debtor's pledge back to him, has robbed none by violence, has given his bread to the hungry and has covered the naked with a garment;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:8
verses.text: he has not given out on usury, nor has taken any increase, he has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has done judgment between man and man,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:9
verses.text: has walked in My statutes, and has kept My judgments to deal truly, he <hi>is</hi> righteous, he shall surely live, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:10
verses.text: And if he fathers a son <hi>who is</hi> violent, who sheds blood, and who does to a brother <hi>any</hi> of these;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:11
verses.text: even he does not any of these; but has even eaten on the mountains, and has defiled his neighbor's wife;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:12
verses.text: has ill-treated the poor and needy; thieving, he stole; has not given back the pledge; and has lifted up his eyes to the idols; has committed abomination;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:13
verses.text: has loaned on usury; and has taken increase; shall he then live? He shall not live! He has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be on him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:14
verses.text: And, lo, <hi>if</hi> he fathers a son who sees all his father's sins which he has done, and fears, and does not do like him;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:15
verses.text: <hi> who</hi> has not eaten on the mountains; nor has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; has not defiled his neighbor's wife;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:16
verses.text: nor has ill-treated any man; has not withheld the pledge; nor has robbed by violence; <hi>but</hi> has given his bread to the hungry; and has covered the naked <hi>with</hi> clothes;

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:17
verses.text: has withdrawn his hand from the poor; has not received usury nor increase; has done My judgments; has walked in My statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father; he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:18
verses.text: His father, because he extorted, robbed <hi>his</hi> brother by robbery, and did <hi>what is</hi> not good among his people; lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:19
verses.text: Yet you say, Why? Does not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son has done justice and right, has kept all My statutes, and has done them, he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:20
verses.text: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:21
verses.text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins which he has committed, and keep all My statutes, and do justice and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:22
verses.text: All his transgressions that he has done, they shall not be mentioned to him; in his righteousness that he has done he shall live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:23
verses.text: Do I actually delight in the death of the wicked? says the Lord Jehovah. Is it not that he should turn from his ways and live?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:24
verses.text: But when the righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, <hi>and</hi> does according to all the abominations that the wicked do, shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be remembered; in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:25
verses.text: Yet you say, The way of the LORD is not fair. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not My way fair? Are your ways not unfair?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:26
verses.text: When a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity and dies in them; for his iniquity that he has done, he shall die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:27
verses.text: Again, when the wicked turns away from his wickedness that he has committed and does that which is lawful and righteous, he shall save his soul alive.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:28
verses.text: Because he looks carefully, and turns away from all his sins that he has committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:29
verses.text: Yet says the house of Israel: The way of the LORD is not fair. O house of Israel, are not My ways fair? Are not your ways unfair?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:30
verses.text: So I will judge you, O house of Israel, each one of you according to his ways, says the Lord Jehovah. Turn and be made to turn from all your sins; and iniquity shall not be your stumbling-block.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:31
verses.text: Cast away from you all your sins by which you have sinned; and make you a new heart and a new spirit; for why will you die, O house of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:32
verses.text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies, says the Lord Jehovah. Therefore turn and live.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:1
verses.text: And take up a weeping for the rulers of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:2
verses.text: and say: What <hi>is</hi> your mother? A lioness. She lay down among lions; she multiplied her cubs among young lions.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:3
verses.text: And she brought up one of her cubs; it became a strong lion and learned to tear the prey. It ate men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:4
verses.text: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:5
verses.text: And when she saw that she had waited <hi>and</hi> that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:6
verses.text: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion and learned to tear the prey, <hi>and</hi> ate men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:7
verses.text: And he knew his widows, and he laid their cities waste, and the land and its fullness was desolated, from the sound of his roaring.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:8
verses.text: And the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:9
verses.text: And they put him in a cage in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into hunting nets, so that his voice should never again be heard on the mountains of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:10
verses.text: Your mother <hi>is</hi> like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters; she was fruitful and full of branches because of many waters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:11
verses.text: And she <hi>had</hi> strong rods for the scepters of those who bore rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches; and it was seen in her height, with the multitude of her branches.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:12
verses.text: But she was plucked up in fury; she was thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit. Her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire burned them up.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:13
verses.text: And now she <hi>is</hi> planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:14
verses.text: And fire has gone out from a rod of her branches, <hi>which</hi> has licked up her fruit so that there is no strong rod in her to be a scepter to rule. This is a mourning and <hi>shall be</hi> for a mourning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:1
verses.text: And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth <hi>month</hi>, the tenth of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to ask of the LORD, and sat before me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:2
verses.text: And came the word of the LORD to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:3
verses.text: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Have you come to ask of Me? <hi>As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:4
verses.text: Will you judge <hi>them</hi>, son of man, will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:5
verses.text: And say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I chose Israel, and lifted up My hand to the seed of the house of Jacob, and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt; when I lifted up My hand to them, saying, I <hi> am</hi> the LORD your God;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:6
verses.text: in the day <hi>that</hi> I lifted up My hand to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing <hi>with</hi> milk and honey, which <hi>is</hi> the glory of all lands;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:7
verses.text: then I said to them, Let each man throw away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:8
verses.text: But they rebelled against Me and would not listen to Me. They did not each man throw away the abominations of their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said, I will pour out My fury against them to fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:9
verses.text: But I worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned before the nations among whom they <hi>were, for</hi> I made Myself known to them in their eyes, by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:10
verses.text: And I caused them to go out from the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:11
verses.text: And I gave them My statutes and showed them My judgments, which <hi>if</hi> a man do, he shall even live in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:12
verses.text: And also I gave them My sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, that <hi>they</hi> might know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD who sets them apart.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:13
verses.text: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes, and they despised My judgments, which <hi>if</hi> a man does, he shall even live in them. And they greatly profaned My sabbaths. And I said, <hi>I</hi> will pour out My fury on them in the wilderness to destroy them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:14
verses.text: But I worked for My name's sake, so that it should not be profaned before the nations in whose sight I brought them out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:15
verses.text: And also I lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that <hi>I</hi> would not bring them into the land which I had given <hi>them</hi>, flowing <hi>with</hi> milk and honey; it <hi>is</hi> the glory of all lands;

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:16
verses.text: because they despised My judgments and walked not in My sabbaths; and they profaned My sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:17
verses.text: But My eye spared them from destroying them, nor did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:18
verses.text: But I said to their sons in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, nor observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:19
verses.text: I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God. Walk in My statutes, and keep My judgments, and do them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:20
verses.text: and keep My sabbaths holy; and they shall be a sign between Me and you, that you may know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:21
verses.text: But the sons rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes, nor kept My judgments to do them; the judgments which, <hi>if</hi> a man do, he shall even live in them; they profaned My sabbaths and I said <hi>I</hi> would pour out My fury on them, to fulfill My anger against them in the wilderness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:22
verses.text: But I withdrew My hand and worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, from whom I brought them out in their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:23
verses.text: I also lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and scatter them through the lands,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:24
verses.text: because they had not done My judgments, but had despised My sabbaths and had profaned My sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:25
verses.text: Also I gave them statutes not good, and judgments by which they should not live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:26
verses.text: And I defiled them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that open the womb to pass through <hi>the fire</hi>, that I might waste them, to the end that they might know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:27
verses.text: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed Me, in that they have committed a sin against Me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:28
verses.text: When I had brought them into the land <hi>for</hi> which I lifted up My hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered their sacrifices there. And there they offered their provoking gifts. There also they made their sweet aroma, and poured out their drink offerings there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:29
verses.text: And I said to them, What <hi>is</hi> the high place to which you go? And the name of it is called High Place to this day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:30
verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: Are you defiled in the same way as your fathers? And do you go whoring after their abominations?

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:31
verses.text: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols, even to <hi>this</hi> day. And shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? <hi>As</hi> I Live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:32
verses.text: And what comes up on your spirit shall not happen at all, that you say, We will be like the nations, like the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:33
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:34
verses.text: And I will bring you out from the people, and I will gather you out of the lands in which you are scattered among them, with a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm and with fury poured out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:35
verses.text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:36
verses.text: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:37
verses.text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:38
verses.text: And I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who sin against Me. I will bring them out from the land where they reside, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:39
verses.text: And you, O house of Israel, so says the Lord Jehovah: <hi>Every</hi> man go and serve his idols, and do so from now on if you will not listen to Me. But never again defile My holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:40
verses.text: For in My holy mountain, in the mountain height <hi>of</hi> Israel, says the Lord Jehovah, there all the house of Israel, all of those in the land, shall serve Me. There will I receive them, and there will I ask for your offerings and the firstfruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:41
verses.text: I will receive you with your sweet aroma when I bring you out from the people and gather you out of the lands into which you have been scattered among them. And I will be sanctified in you in the eyes of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:42
verses.text: And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the land <hi>for</hi> which I lifted up My hand, to give it to your fathers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:43
verses.text: And there you shall remember your ways and all your doings in which you have been defiled. And you shall despise yourselves in your own sight for all your evils which you have committed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:44
verses.text: And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD when I have worked with you for My name's sake, not according to your wicked ways nor according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:45
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:46
verses.text: Son of man, set your face toward the south, and drop a <hi>word</hi> toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:47
verses.text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD. So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall burn up every green tree in you, and every dry tree among you. The flaming flame shall not be put out, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned in it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:48
verses.text: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it. It shall not be put out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:49
verses.text: And I said, Ah Lord Jehovah! They say of me, Does he not speak parables?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop <hi>a word</hi> toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:3
verses.text: And say to the land of Israel, So says the LORD: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, and will draw out My sword out of its sheath and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:4
verses.text: Since then I will cut off the righteous and the wicked from you, therefore My sword shall be drawn from its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:5
verses.text: so that all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn out My sword from its sheath. It shall not return any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:6
verses.text: And you, son of man, groan with the breaking of <hi>your</hi> loins; and grown with bitterness before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:7
verses.text: And it will be when they say to you, Why do you groan? You shall answer, Because of the news <hi>that</hi> it is coming; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak <hi>as</hi> water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:8
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:9
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy and say, So says the LORD. Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:10
verses.text: It is sharpened in order to slaughter; it is polished so that there may be a flash to it. Or shall we rejoice? You are despising the rod of My son, <hi>as if it were</hi> every tree.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:11
verses.text: And He has given it to be polished, to be taken by the hand. The sword, it is sharpened, and it it polished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:12
verses.text: Cry and howl, son of man; for it <hi>shall be</hi> on My people; it <hi>shall be</hi> on all the rulers of Israel. They are thrown to the sword with My people; Therefore slap <hi>your</hi> thigh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:13
verses.text: Because <hi>it is</hi> a trial, and what if even the despising rod shall not be? says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:14
verses.text: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike <hi>your</hi> hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain. It <hi>is</hi> the sword of the slain, the great one that surrounds them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:15
verses.text: so that <hi>their</hi> heart may melt, and many stumble at all <hi>their</hi> gates. I have given the threatening sword. Ah! It is made like lightning; it is wrapped for a slaughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:16
verses.text: Sharpen yourself on the right! Set yourself on the left, wherever your face is set.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:17
verses.text: And also I, I will also strike My hands together, and I will cause My fury to rest. I the LORD have spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:18
verses.text: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:19
verses.text: And you, son of man, set for yourself two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. Both of them shall come out of one land. And create a hand at the head of the way to the city; create it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:20
verses.text: You shall set a way that the sword may enter <hi>into</hi> Rabbah of the Ammonites, and <hi>into</hi> Judah, into fortified Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:21
verses.text: For the king of Babylon shall stand at the parting of the way, at the head of the two highways, to practice divination. He shall shake arrows; he shall ask household idols; he shall look at the liver.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:22
verses.text: At his right shall be the divining <hi>for</hi> Jerusalem, to set <hi>battering</hi> rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering-rams against the gates, to pour out and to build a siege wall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:23
verses.text: And it shall be to them an empty divining before their eyes, those who have sworn oaths to them. But He will remember iniquity, that they may be taken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:24
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, in that your sins are revealed in all your deeds; because you have been remembered, you shall be taken with the hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:25
verses.text: And you, O slain, wicked king of Israel, of whom has come his day in the time of iniquity of the end.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:26
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Remove the diadem, and take off the crown. This <hi>shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> as it was. Lift up the low one, and put down the high one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:27
verses.text: Ruin, ruin, ruin, I will appoint it. Also this shall not be until the coming of Him whose is the right. And I will give it to Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:28
verses.text: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their shame. Even say: The sword, the sword <hi>is</hi> drawn, polished for slaughter to make an end, that <hi>it may be</hi> like lightning;

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:29
verses.text: while they see false visions for you, while they divine a lie to you, to put you on the necks of the slain of the wicked whose day has come in the day of iniquity; <hi>it shall have</hi> an end.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:30
verses.text: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:31
verses.text: And I will pour out My disgust on you; with the fire of My wrath I will blow against you, and give you into the hand of burning men, able to destroy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:32
verses.text: You shall be for food to the fire. Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall be remembered no <hi>more</hi>; for I the LORD have spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:2
verses.text: And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? And you shall make her know all her abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:3
verses.text: And you shall say, So says the Lord Jehovah: The city sheds blood in her midst that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile <hi>herself</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:4
verses.text: You are guilty in your blood that you have shed; and you have defiled yourself in your idols you have made. And your days <hi>are</hi> brought near, and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:5
verses.text: <hi> Those who are</hi> near and <hi>those</hi> far from you shall mock against you, O defiled of name, abounding in tumult.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:6
verses.text: Behold, the rulers of Israel, each man by his might, have been in you in order to shed blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:7
verses.text: In you they have despised father and mother. In your midst they have dealt with the stranger by oppression. In you they oppressed the orphan and the widow.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:8
verses.text: You have despised My holy things, and have profaned My sabbaths.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:9
verses.text: In you are men of slander to shed blood; and in you they eat on the mountains; in your midst they do unchaste acts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:10
verses.text: In you they have uncovered their fathers' nakedness; in you they have humbled her defiled by impurity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:11
verses.text: And a man has done abomination with his neighbor's wife; and a man has defiled his daughter-in-law in unchaste acts; and a man has humbled within you his sister, his father's daughter.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:12
verses.text: In you they have taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken usury and increase, and you gained by extortion of your neighbors, and you have forgotten Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:13
verses.text: And behold, I have struck My palm against your unjust gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in your midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:14
verses.text: Can your heart stand, or can your hands be strong, in the day that I shall deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and <hi>I</hi> will act.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:15
verses.text: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the lands, and will destroy your uncleanness out of you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:16
verses.text: And you will be profaned in you before the eyes of the nations, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:17
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:18
verses.text: Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them <hi>are</hi> bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the middle of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:19
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:20
verses.text: <hi> As they</hi> gather silver, and bronze, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it to melt <hi>it</hi>, so I will gather <hi>you</hi> in My anger and in My fury, and I will leave <hi>you there</hi> and melt you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:21
verses.text: And I will gather you and blow on you in the fire of My wrath, and you shall be melted in the middle of it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:22
verses.text: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you shall be melted in the middle of it; and you shall know that I the LORD have poured out My fury on you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:23
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:24
verses.text: Son of man, say to her: You <hi>are</hi> a land not being cleansed, nor rained on in the day of disgust.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:25
verses.text: A plot <hi>by</hi> her prophets <hi>is</hi> in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing the prey. They have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they multiplied her many widows in her midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:26
verses.text: Her priests have broken My law and have defiled My holy things. They have put no difference between the holy and the common, and have not taught between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from My sabbaths, and I am defiled among them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:27
verses.text: Her rulers in her midst <hi>are</hi> like wolves tearing the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, to get unjust gain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:28
verses.text: And her prophets have daubed themselves <hi>with</hi> lime, seeing vanity and divining lies to them, saying, So says the Lord Jehovah; when the LORD has not spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:29
verses.text: The people of the land have used oppression and practiced robbery, and they have troubled the poor and needy. Yea, <hi>they</hi> have oppressed the stranger without right.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:30
verses.text: And I sought for a man among them who should wall up a wall for the land, and stand in the break before me, that I should not destroy it. But I did not find one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:31
verses.text: Therefore I have poured out My fury on them. I have burned them up with the fire of My wrath. I have given their way on their heads, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD came again to me,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:2
verses.text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:3
verses.text: And they fornicated in Egypt; they whored in their youth, their breasts were handled, and there their virgin nipples were worked.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:4
verses.text: And their names <hi>were</hi> Oholah, the oldest, and Oholibah, her sister. And they were Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria <hi>is</hi> Oholah, and Jerusalem <hi>is</hi> Oholibah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:5
verses.text: And Oholah whored under Me. And she lusted after her lovers, to <hi>her</hi> Assyrian neighbors,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:6
verses.text: clothed with purple, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:7
verses.text: So she bestowed her harlotries on them, the choice sons of Assyria; <hi>with</hi> all of them, and with all whom she lusted after; she defiled herself with all their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:8
verses.text: Nor did she leave her fornications from Egypt. For in her youth they lay with her, and they worked her virgin nipples, and poured their fornications on her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:9
verses.text: Therefore I have given her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she lusted.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:10
verses.text: They uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters and killed her with the sword. And she became notorious among women, and they executed judgment on her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:11
verses.text: And her sister Oholibah saw, she was more corrupt in her lust than she, and her fornications were greater than her sister's whoredom.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:12
verses.text: She lusted to the sons of Assyria, governors and rulers nearby, clothed most perfectly; horsemen riding horses, all of them desirable young men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:13
verses.text: And I saw that she was defiled, one way <hi>was</hi> to both of them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:14
verses.text: And she added to her fornications. And she saw men carved on the wall; images of the Chaldeans engraved with vermilion,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:15
verses.text: girded with girdles on their loins, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the sons of Babylon <hi>in</hi> Chaldea, the land of their birth;

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:16
verses.text: and she lusted after them, to the look of her eyes, and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:17
verses.text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with fornications. And she was defiled with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:18
verses.text: So she uncovered her fornications and uncovered her nakedness. And My soul was alienated from her just as My soul was alienated from her sister.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:19
verses.text: Yet she multiplied her fornications to recall the days of her youth, in which she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:20
verses.text: And she lusted on her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose issue <hi>is like</hi> the issue of horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:21
verses.text: So you longed for the wickedness of your youth, when the Egyptians worked your nipples, for the sake of the breasts of your youth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:22
verses.text: So, O Aholibah, the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will raise up against you your lovers, from whom your soul is alienated; and I will bring them against you from all around;

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:23
verses.text: the Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, <hi>and</hi> all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, all of them, third heads and called ones; all of them riding on horses.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:24
verses.text: And they shall come against you <hi>with</hi> weapons, chariots, and wheels, and with an assembly of peoples; buckler and shield and helmet shall set against you all around. And I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you by their judgments.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:25
verses.text: And I will set My jealousy against you, and they shall deal with you in fury. They shall take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you shall fall by the sword. They shall take away your sons and your daughters, and the rest of you shall be devoured by the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:26
verses.text: They shall also strip you <hi>of</hi> your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:27
verses.text: So I will make your wickedness to cease from you, and your fornication from the land of Egypt. And you shall not lift up your eyes to them, nor shall you remember Egypt any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:28
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give you into the hand of <hi>those</hi> whom you hate, into the hand of whom your soul was alienated, from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:29
verses.text: And they shall deal with you in hatred, and shall take away all your labor, and shall leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your fornications shall be uncovered, both your wickedness and your fornications.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:30
verses.text: These <hi>things</hi> will be done to you because you have whored after the nations, and because you are defiled with their idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:31
verses.text: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:32
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: You shall drink of your sister's cup deep and large; you shall be laughed to scorn and mocked; for it holds much.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:33
verses.text: <hi> In</hi> drunkenness and sorrow you are filled, the cup of horror and ruin, the cup of your sister Samaria.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:34
verses.text: You shall even drink it and empty it. And you shall break its pieces, and tear off your own breasts. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:35
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, therefore bear also your wickedness and your adulteries.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:36
verses.text: And the LORD said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah, and declare to them their abominations,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:37
verses.text: that they have committed adultery, and blood <hi>is</hi> on their hands? And they have committed adultery with their idols and have also caused their sons whom they bore to Me to pass through the fire to them, to devour them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:38
verses.text: And yet they have done this to Me: They have defiled My sanctuary in that day, and have profaned My sabbaths.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:39
verses.text: And when they had slain their sons to their idols, then they came into My sanctuary in that day to profane it. And lo, this they have done in the midst of My house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:40
verses.text: And they have even sent for men to come from far, to whom a messenger <hi>was</hi> sent. And lo, they came. You washed yourself for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments,

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:41
verses.text: and sat on a stately bed with a table prepared before it, on which you set My incense and My oil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:42
verses.text: And the sound of a crowd <hi>was</hi> at ease with her; and drunkards from the wilderness were brought with the men of the host of mankind; and they put bracelets on their hands, and crowns of beauty on their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:43
verses.text: And I said about the one worn <hi>in</hi> adulteries, Will they now whore with her, and she <hi>with them</hi>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:44
verses.text: And they went in to her, as <hi>they</hi> go in to a woman of harlotry; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the wicked women.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:45
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> righteous men, they shall judge them <hi>with</hi> the judgment of adulteresses, and the judgment of women who shed blood; because they <hi>are</hi> adulteresses, and blood <hi>is</hi> in their hands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:46
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company on them, and will give them to be removed and stripped.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:47
verses.text: And the company shall stone them <hi>with</hi> stones, and cut them down with their swords. They shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:48
verses.text: So I will cause wickedness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught, even not to go after your wickedness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:49
verses.text: And they shall put your wickedness on you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:1
verses.text: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:2
verses.text: Son of man, write for yourself the name of the day, even of this same day. The king of Babylon has leaned toward Jerusalem this same day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:3
verses.text: And speak a parable to the rebellious house, and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Set on a pot; set <hi>it</hi> on, and also pour water into it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:4
verses.text: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder. Fill <hi>it with</hi> the choice bones.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:5
verses.text: Take the choice of the flock, and also burn the bones under it; make it boil high, and let them boil its bones in it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:6
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum <hi>is</hi> in it, and whose scum has not gone out of it! Bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall on it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:7
verses.text: For her blood is in her midst; she set it on the top of a rock. She did not pour it on the ground, to cover it <hi>with</hi> dust,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:8
verses.text: that it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance. I have set her blood on a shining rock, that it should not be covered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:9
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Woe to the bloody city! I will even heap on the pile.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:10
verses.text: And kindle the fire on wood, consume the flesh, and mix in the spice, and let the bones be burned.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:11
verses.text: And set it empty on its coals, so that its bronze may be hot and may glow, and <hi>that</hi> its uncleanness may be melted in it, <hi>that</hi> the scum of it may be burned away.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:12
verses.text: She has wearied <hi>herself</hi> with lies, and her great scum did not go out from her. Her scum <hi>shall be</hi> in the fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:13
verses.text: In your defilement <hi>is</hi> wickedness. Because I have purged you and you were not purged, you shall not be purged from your defilement any more, until I have caused My fury to cease on you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:14
verses.text: I the LORD have spoken. It shall come, and I will do <hi>it</hi>. I will not let go, nor will I spare, nor will I repent. According to your ways, and according to your doings, they shall judge you, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:15
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:16
verses.text: Son of man, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke. Yet neither shall you mourn nor weep, nor shall your tears run down.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:17
verses.text: Groan <hi>but</hi> be silent; make no mourning <hi>for</hi> the dead; tie your turban on you, and put your sandals on your feet, and do not cover <hi>your</hi> lips, and do not eat the bread of men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:18
verses.text: So I spoke to the people in the morning. And in the evening my wife died, and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:19
verses.text: And the people said to me, Will you not tell us what these <hi>things mean</hi> to us, that you do so?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:20
verses.text: And I answered them, The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:21
verses.text: Speak to the house of Israel. So says the Lord Jehovah: behold, I will defile My sanctuary, the glory of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities. And your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:22
verses.text: And you shall do as I have done. You shall not cover your lips nor eat the bread of men.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:23
verses.text: And your turbans <hi>shall be</hi> on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You shall not mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away for your iniquities and mourn to one another.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:24
verses.text: So Ezekiel is a sign to you. According to all that he has done, you shall do. And when this comes, you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:25
verses.text: Also, son of man, <hi>will it</hi> not <hi>be</hi> in the day <hi>when</hi> I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:26
verses.text: <hi> that</hi> he who escapes in that day shall come to you to cause <hi>you</hi> to hear it <hi>with your</hi> ears?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:27
verses.text: In that day your mouth shall be open to him who has escaped, and you shall speak and be no more dumb. And you shall be a sign to them, and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:3
verses.text: And say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. So says the Lord Jehovah: Because you said, Aha, against My sanctuary when it was defiled, and against the land of Israel when it was ruined, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:4
verses.text: therefore, behold, I will give you to the sons of the east for a possession. And they shall set their camp sites among you, and put among you their dwellings. They shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:5
verses.text: And I will make Rabbah a pasture <hi>for</hi> camels, and the Ammonites a crouching-place <hi>for</hi> flocks. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:6
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have clapped <hi>your</hi> hands and stamped the foot, and rejoiced in heart with all your spite against the land of Israel;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:7
verses.text: behold, therefore I will stretch out My hand on you, and will give you as a prize to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the lands. I will destroy you, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:8
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Moab and Seir say, Behold, the house of Judah <hi>is</hi> like all the nations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:9
verses.text: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities, from his borders, the glory of the land, even Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:10
verses.text: to the men of the east with the Ammonites. And I will give them in possession so that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:11
verses.text: And I will execute judgments on Moab; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:12
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended and revenged himself on them;

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:13
verses.text: therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I will also stretch out My hand on Edom, and will cut man and beast off from it; and I will make it a waste from Teman, even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:14
verses.text: And I will lay My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel. And they shall do in Edom according to My anger and according to My fury. And they shall know My vengeance, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:15
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have taken vengeance; yes, have taken vengeance with spite in <hi>their</hi> soul, to destroy <hi>with</hi> never-ending enmity,

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:16
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will stretch out My hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and will destroy the rest of the sea coast.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:17
verses.text: And I will execute great vengeance on them with rebukes; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I shall lay My vengeance on them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:1
verses.text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:2
verses.text: Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, Aha! She is shattered, the doors of the peoples, she has turned to me; I shall be filled; she is laid waste.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:3
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, <hi>as</hi> the sea causes its waves to come up.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:4
verses.text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her and make her like a shining rock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:5
verses.text: It shall be a spreading place of nets in the middle of the sea. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah. And it shall become a spoil to the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:6
verses.text: And her daughters who <hi>are</hi> in the field shall be killed by the sword; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:7
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon on Tyre, a king of kings from the north, with horses and with chariots and with a company of horsemen, and many people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:8
verses.text: He shall kill your daughters with the sword in the field. And he shall make siege walls against you, and pour out a siege mound against you, and lift up the shield against you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:9
verses.text: And he shall set engines of war against your walls, and with his axes he shall break down your towers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:10
verses.text: Because of his many horses, their dust shall cover you. Your walls shall shake at the sound of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into your gates, as <hi>men</hi> enter a city that is breached.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:11
verses.text: With the hoofs of his horses he shall trample all your streets. He shall kill your people by the sword, and your pillars of your strength shall go down to the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:12
verses.text: And they shall plunder your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise. And they shall break down your walls and destroy your desirable houses. And they shall lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the water.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:13
verses.text: And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease; and the sound of your harps shall be heard no more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:14
verses.text: And I will make you like a shining rock. You shall be <hi>a place</hi> to spread nets on; you shall be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:15
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: Shall not the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the slain groan, when the slaughter is made in your midst?

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:16
verses.text: And all the rulers of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their embroidered garments. They shall clothe themselves <hi>with</hi> trembling; they shall sit on the ground and tremble at <hi> every</hi> moment, and be amazed at you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:17
verses.text: And they shall take up a mourning for you, and say to you, How you who lived by the sea are destroyed, the famous city which was strong in the sea, she and her people who caused their terror <hi>to be</hi> on all who lived in it!

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:18
verses.text: And the coastlands shall tremble in the day of your fall; yea, the coastlands by the sea shall be troubled at your going.

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:19
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make you a ruined city, like the cities that have no inhabitants; when I shall bring up the deep on you, and great waters shall cover you;

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:20
verses.text: when I shall bring you down with those who go down into the Pit, with the people of old time, and shall set you in the low parts of the earth, in places ruined in days of old, with those who go down to the Pit, so that you have no inhabitants (but I gave glory in the land of the living)

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:21
verses.text: I will give you terrors, and you <hi>will</hi> not <hi>be</hi>. Though you are sought, yet you shall never be found forever says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:2
verses.text: And you, son of man, take up a mourning for Tyre.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:3
verses.text: And say to Tyre, O you who are placed at the entrance of the sea, a merchant of the peoples for many coastlands, so says the Lord Jehovah: O Tyre, you have said, I <hi>am</hi> of perfect beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:4
verses.text: Your borders <hi>are</hi> in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:5
verses.text: They have made all your <hi>ship</hi> boards of fir trees of Senir; they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:6
verses.text: They have made the oaks <hi>of</hi> Bashan your oars; the daughter of Assyria has made your deck of ivory from the coasts of Kittim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:7
verses.text: Your sale was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, an ensign for you; violet and purple from the coasts of Elishah was your covering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:8
verses.text: The residents of Sidon and Arvad were your seamen. Your wise ones, O Tyre, were in you, they <hi>were</hi> your sailors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:9
verses.text: The elders of Gebal and her wise <hi>men</hi> were with you, reinforcing your seams. All the ships of the sea with their seamen were with you, to exchange your merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:10
verses.text: Persia and Lud and Lydia were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you; they set your splendor.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:11
verses.text: The sons of Arvad and your army <hi>were</hi> on your walls all around, and warriors <hi>were</hi> in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they have made your beauty perfect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:12
verses.text: Tarshish <hi>was</hi> your merchant because of the multitude of <hi>your</hi> wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they gave for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:13
verses.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech <hi>were</hi> your merchants. They traded the souls of men and vessels of bronze for your goods.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:14
verses.text: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses and war-horses and mules for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:15
verses.text: The sons of Dedan <hi>were</hi> your merchants; many coastlands <hi>were</hi> the traffic of your hand. They brought as your gift tusks of ivory and ebony.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:16
verses.text: Syria <hi>was</hi> your merchant because of the multitude of your works; with emeralds, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies they gave for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:17
verses.text: Judah and the land of Israel <hi>were</hi> your merchants with wheat <hi>from</hi> Minnith and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm, they gave for your goods.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:18
verses.text: Damascus <hi>was</hi> your merchant in the multitude of your works, from the multitude of all riches, in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:19
verses.text: Dan and Javan also, going about, gave for your wares; smooth iron, cassia, and cane were among your goods.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:20
verses.text: Dedan <hi>was</hi> your merchant in loose cloths for riding.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:21
verses.text: Arabia, and all the rulers of Kedar <hi>were</hi> traders of your hand, in lambs, and rams, and goats; in them <hi>was</hi> your trade.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:22
verses.text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah <hi>were</hi> your merchants, with the chief of all the spices, and with every precious stone, and gold they gave for your wares.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:23
verses.text: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, Chilmad <hi>were</hi> your merchants.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:24
verses.text: They <hi>were</hi> your merchants in perfect things, in violet cloth, and embroidered work, and in carpets of many colors, with tightly bound cords, and cedars among your merchandise.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:25
verses.text: The ships of Tarshish <hi>were</hi> the travelers of your goods. And you were filled and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:26
verses.text: Your rowers have made you come into great waters; the east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:27
verses.text: Your riches, and your wares, your goods, your seamen, and your sailors reinforcing your seams, and the traders of your goods, and all your men of war, who <hi>are</hi> in you, and all your company which <hi>is</hi> in your midst, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:28
verses.text: At the sound of the cry of your sailors the open lands will shake.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:29
verses.text: And all who handle the oar, the mariners, all the sailors of the sea, shall come down from their ships. They shall stand on the land,

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:30
verses.text: and shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall throw dust on their heads. They shall wallow themselves in the ashes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:31
verses.text: And they will be bald for you, and gird with sackcloth. And they shall weep for you with bitterness of soul, a bitter wailing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:32
verses.text: And in their wailing they shall lift up a lamentation <hi>and</hi> lament over you, <hi>saying</hi>, Who <hi>is</hi> like Tyre; as she who is quiet in the midst of the sea?

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:33
verses.text: When your goods went out from the seas, you filled many people. With the plenty of your riches and your goods you enriched the kings of the earth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:34
verses.text: At <hi>this time</hi> you are broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your goods and all your company in your midst have fallen.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:35
verses.text: All the residents of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings are horribly terrified; <hi>their</hi> faces tremble.

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:36
verses.text: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become terrors. And you <hi>shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:2
verses.text: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre. So says the Lord Jehovah: Because your heart <hi>is</hi> lifted up, and you have said, I <hi>am</hi> a god, I sit <hi>in</hi> the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet you <hi>are</hi> a man and not God, though you set your heart as the heart of gods;

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:3
verses.text: Behold, you <hi>are</hi> wiser than Daniel; all secret things are not hidden from you!

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:4
verses.text: With your wisdom and with your understanding you have made riches for yourselves, and have worked gold and silver into your treasures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:5
verses.text: By your great wisdom <hi>and</hi> by your trade you have multiplied your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:6
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have set your heart as the heart of gods,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:7
verses.text: behold, therefore I will bring awesome strangers <hi>of</hi> the nations. And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:8
verses.text: They shall bring you down to the Pit, and you shall die the deaths of those slain in the heart of the seas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:9
verses.text: Will you yet say before him who kills you, I <hi>am of the</hi> gods? But you <hi>are</hi> a man, and not God, in the hand of him who kills you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:10
verses.text: You shall die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:11
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:12
verses.text: Son of man, lift up a lament over the king of Tyre, and say to him, So says the Lord Jehovah: You seal the measure, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:13
verses.text: You have been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone <hi>was</hi> your covering, the ruby, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the turquoise, and the emerald, and gold. The workmanship of your tambourines and of your flutes was prepared in you in the day that you were created.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:14
verses.text: You <hi>were</hi> the anointed cherub that covers, and I had put you in the holy height of God <hi>where</hi> you were.; you have walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:15
verses.text: You <hi>were</hi> perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until iniquity was found in you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:16
verses.text: By the multitude of your goods they have filled your midst <hi>with</hi> violence, and you have sinned. So I cast you profaned from the height of God, and I destroy you, O covering cherub, from among the stones of fire.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:17
verses.text: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; you have spoiled your wisdom because of your brightness. I will cast you to the ground; I will put you before kings, that they may behold you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:18
verses.text: By the host of your iniquities, by the iniquity of your trade, you have profaned your holy places; so I brought a fire from your midst; it shall devour you, and I will give you for ashes on the earth, before the eyes of all who see you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:19
verses.text: All who know you among the peoples shall be astonished at you; you shall be terrors, and you <hi>will</hi> not <hi>be</hi> forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:20
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:21
verses.text: Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and prophesy against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:22
verses.text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I have executed judgments in her and have revealed My holiness in her.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:23
verses.text: For I will send a plague into her, and blood into her streets. And the wounded shall fall in her midst by the sword on her on every side. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:24
verses.text: And there will not be a pricking brier, or a painful thorn to the house of Israel any more, from all who surround them, <hi>those</hi> who hate them. And they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:25
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among <hi>whom</hi> they are scattered, and have been sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then they shall dwell in their land that I have given to My servant Jacob.

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:26
verses.text: And they shall dwell safely in it, and shall build houses and plant vineyards. Yea, they shall dwell safely when I have executed judgments on all those who despise them all around them; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD their God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:1
verses.text: In the tenth year, in the tenth <hi>month</hi>, in the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:3
verses.text: Speak and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon who lies in the midst of his rivers, who has said, My river <hi>is</hi> mine, and I have made it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:4
verses.text: But I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick to your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers shall stick to your scales.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:5
verses.text: And I will leave you <hi>to</hi> the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You shall fall on the open fields; you shall not be removed nor gathered. I have given you for food to the beasts of the field and to the birds of the heavens.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:6
verses.text: And all the people of Egypt shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:7
verses.text: When they took you by your hand, you broke and tore off all their shoulder. And when they leaned on you, you shattered and made all their loins stand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:8
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and cut off man and beast from you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:9
verses.text: And the land of Egypt shall be a desert and waste; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, because he has said, The river <hi>is</hi> mine, and I have made it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:10
verses.text: Behold, and therefore I <hi>am</hi> against you and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt a complete waste, a ruin, from Migdol <hi>to</hi> Syene, even to the border of Ethiopia.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:11
verses.text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, and you shall not live in it forty years.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:12
verses.text: And I will make the land of Egypt a ruin in the midst of the ruined lands; and her cities shall be deserted forty years among the cities <hi>that are</hi> laid waste. And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will scatter them through the lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:13
verses.text: Yet so says the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:14
verses.text: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return <hi>to</hi> the land of Pathros, into their homeland. And they shall be a low kingdom there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:15
verses.text: It shall be the lowest of the kingdoms, and shall no more exalt itself above the nations. For I will make them so few, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:16
verses.text: And it shall never again be the hope of the house of Israel, recalling the iniquity of their turning after them. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:17
verses.text: And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, in the first <hi>month</hi>, in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:18
verses.text: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head <hi>was</hi> made bald, and every shoulder was peeled. Yet neither he nor his army had any pay for Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:19
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And he shall take her host, and take her spoil, and seize her plunder. And it shall be the wages for his army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:20
verses.text: I have given him the land of Egypt <hi>for</hi> his labor with which he served against it, because they worked for Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:21
verses.text: In that day I will cause a horn bud to the house of Israel, and I will give you the opening of the mouth in their midst. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Howl, Woe is the day!

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:3
verses.text: For the day <hi>is</hi> near, even the day of the LORD <hi>is</hi> near, a cloudy day. It shall be the time of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:4
verses.text: And the sword shall come on Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:5
verses.text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mixed people; and Chub, and the men of the land <hi>who are in</hi> covenant with them shall fall by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:6
verses.text: So says the LORD: Those who uphold Egypt shall also fall, and the pride of her power shall come down. From Migdol to Syene they shall fall in it by the sword, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:7
verses.text: And they shall be ruined in the midst of the wasted lands, and her cities shall be in the midst of the wasted cities.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:8
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt and all her helpers shall be destroyed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:9
verses.text: In that day messengers shall go out from Me in ships to terrify the confident Ethiopians, and anguish shall be on them, as in the day of Egypt; for lo, it is coming.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:10
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:11
