verses.text: He and his people with them, the fearful of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land. And they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land <hi>with</hi> the slain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:12
verses.text: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked. And I will waste the land, and her fullness, by the hand of strangers. I the LORD have spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:13
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph. And there shall no more be a ruler of the land in Egypt; and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:14
verses.text: And I will make Pathros a ruin, and will set fire in Zoan, and will do judgments in No.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:15
verses.text: And I will pour My fury on Sin, the strength of Egypt. And I will cut off the multitude of No.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:16
verses.text: And I will set fire in Egypt; Sin shall greatly anguish, and No shall be torn in pieces, and Noph <hi>shall have</hi> daily woes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:17
verses.text: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and these <hi>cities</hi> shall go into exile.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:18
verses.text: And at Tahpanhes also the day shall be held back, when I shatter the yokes of Egypt there. And the pride of her strength shall cease in her; as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into exile.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:19
verses.text: So I will do judgments in Egypt; and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:20
verses.text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first <hi>month</hi>, in the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:21
verses.text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And lo, it shall not lie bound up to give healing, to put a bandage to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:22
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one. And I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:23
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will scatter them through the lands.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:24
verses.text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put My sword in his hand. But I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of one who is stabbed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:25
verses.text: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I shall put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it on the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:26
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and scatter them among the lands. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:1
verses.text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third <hi>month</hi>, in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:2
verses.text: Son of man, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: To whom are you like in your greatness?

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:3
verses.text: Behold, Assyria <hi>was like</hi> a cedar in Lebanon, <hi>with</hi> fair branches and forest shade, and of great height. And his top was among the thick boughs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:4
verses.text: The waters made him great; the deep set him up on high with her rivers running all around his plants, and sent out her little channels to all the trees of the field.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:5
verses.text: So his height was lifted up above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the many waters, when he sent out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:6
verses.text: All the birds of the heavens nested in his boughs, and under his branches all the beasts of the field bore their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:7
verses.text: So he was beautiful in his greatness, in the length of his branches. For his root was by great waters.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:8
verses.text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him; the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches. Nor was any tree in the garden of God like him in his beauty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:9
verses.text: I have made him beautiful by his many branches, so that all the trees of Eden in the garden of God envied him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:10
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have lifted yourself up in height, and he set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:11
verses.text: so I have given him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He shall surely deal with him; I have expelled him for his evil.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:12
verses.text: And strangers have cut him off, the fearful of the nations, and have left him. On the mountains and in all the valleys his branches have fallen, and his boughs have been broken by all the rivers of the land. And all the people of the earth have gone from his shadow, and have left him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:13
verses.text: On his ruin shall all the birds of the heavens remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be on his branches,

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:14
verses.text: to the end that none of all the trees <hi>by</hi> the waters shall be exalted in their height, nor give their top among the thick boughs, nor should their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water. For all of them are given to death, to the lower parts of the earth, in the midst of the sons of men, with those who go down into the Pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:15
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to the grave, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I held back its floods, and the great waters were held back. And I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted because of him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:16
verses.text: I made the nations shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with those who go down in the Pit. And all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:17
verses.text: They also went down into hell with him to <hi>those who are</hi> slain with the sword, even his arm, who lived under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:18
verses.text: To whom are you like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you shall be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with <hi>those</hi> slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all <hi>his</hi> multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:1
verses.text: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth <hi>month</hi>, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:2
verses.text: Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him, You were like a young lion of the nations, but you <hi>were</hi> like a sea-monster. And you came out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:3
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will therefore spread out My net over you with an assembly of many peoples; and they shall lift you up in My net.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:4
verses.text: And I will leave you on the land; I will cast you on the face of the field, and cause all the birds of the heavens to remain on you, and I will fill the beasts of all the earth with you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:5
verses.text: And I will put your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:6
verses.text: I will also water with your blood the land in which you swim, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:7
verses.text: And when I put you out, I will cover the heaven and make its stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:8
verses.text: I will make all the bright lights of the heavens dark over you, and will set darkness on your land, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:9
verses.text: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your breaking among the nations, into the lands which you have not known.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:10
verses.text: Yea, I will make many people amazed at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish My sword before them; and they shall tremble at <hi>every</hi> moment, <hi>each</hi> man for his own life, in the day of your fall.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:11
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come on you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:12
verses.text: By the swords of the mighty, I will cause your host fall, the fearful of the nations, all of them. And they shall spoil the pride of Egypt, and all its host shall be destroyed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:13
verses.text: I will also destroy all its beasts from beside the great waters. Nor shall the foot of man stir them any more, nor shall the hoofs of beasts stir them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:14
verses.text: And I will make their waters sink, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:15
verses.text: When I shall make the land of Egypt a ruin, and the land shall be stripped of its fullness; when I shall strike all those who dwell in it; then they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:16
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the mourning with which they shall mourn her. The daughters of the nations shall mourn her; they shall mourn for her, for Egypt and for all her multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:17
verses.text: It was also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth of the month, <hi>that</hi> the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:18
verses.text: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and bring it down, her and the daughters of the majestic nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down <hi>into</hi> the Pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:19
verses.text: Than whom are you more lovely? Go down and be laid with the uncircumcised.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:20
verses.text: They shall fall in the midst of <hi>those</hi> slain by the sword; she is delivered to the sword; they draw her and all her multitudes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:21
verses.text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with those who help him. They have gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:22
verses.text: Assyria <hi>is</hi> there and all her company. His graves <hi>are</hi> around him; all of them are slain, fallen by the sword;

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:23
verses.text: their graves are set in the sides of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword, those who caused terror in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:24
verses.text: There <hi>is</hi> Elam and her multitude all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living. Yet they have borne their shame with those who go down to the Pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:25
verses.text: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude. Her graves <hi>are</hi> all around him; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; though their terror was given in the land of the living, yet they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among the slain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:26
verses.text: There <hi>is</hi> Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude. Her graves <hi>are</hi> all around him. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they gave their terror in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:27
verses.text: And they shall not lie with the mighty <hi>that are</hi> fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to hell with their weapons of war. And they have put their swords under their heads, but their sins shall be on their bones, though they <hi>were</hi> the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:28
verses.text: Yea, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall lie with <hi>those</hi> slain with the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:29
verses.text: There <hi>is</hi> Edom, her kings, and all her rulers, who with their might are laid by <hi>those</hi> slain by the sword. They shall be with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the Pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:30
verses.text: There <hi>are</hi> the rulers of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain in their terror. They are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:31
verses.text: Pharaoh shall see them and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army killed by the sword, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:32
verses.text: For I had put his terror in the land of the living. And he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with <hi>those</hi> slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:2
verses.text: Son of man, speak to the sons of your people, and say to them: When I bring the sword on it, on a land, and take one man from the people of the land, of their borders, and set him for their watchman;

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:3
verses.text: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:4
verses.text: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, if the sword does come and take him away, his blood shall be on his own head.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:5
verses.text: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning. His blood shall be on himself. But he who takes warning shall deliver his soul.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:6
verses.text: But if the watchman sees the sword coming, and does not blow the trumpet and the people are not warned; if the sword comes and takes <hi>any</hi> person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity. But I will require his blood at the watchman's hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:7
verses.text: And you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore you shall hear the word from My mouth, and warn them from Me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:8
verses.text: When I say to the wicked, O wicked one, you shall surely die; if you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked one shall die in his iniquity. But I will require his blood at your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:9
verses.text: But, if you warn the wicked of his way, to turn from it; if he does not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity. But you have delivered your soul.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:10
verses.text: And you, son of man, speak to the house of Israel. So you have spoken, saying, When our transgressions and our sins <hi>are</hi> on us, and we are wasting away in them, How then shall we live?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:11
verses.text: Say to them: <hi>As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Israel?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:12
verses.text: Therefore, son of man, say to the sons of your people: The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression. As for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall by it in the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor shall the righteous be able to live for his <hi>righteousness</hi> in the day that he sins.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:13
verses.text: When I shall say to the righteous <hi>that</hi> he shall surely live; if he trusts in his own righteousness and commits iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he has committed, he shall die for it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:14
verses.text: Again, when I say to the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turns from his sin and does justice and right;

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:15
verses.text: <hi> if</hi> the wicked gives back the pledge, gives again what he had robbed, walks in the statutes of life without committing iniquity, then he shall surely live; he shall not die.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:16
verses.text: None of his sins that he has committed shall be called to his memory. He has done justice and right; he shall surely live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:17
verses.text: Yet the sons of your people say, The way of the Lord is not fair. But as for them, their way is not fair.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:18
verses.text: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall even die by it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:19
verses.text: But if the wicked turns from his wickedness and does justice and right, he shall live by it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:20
verses.text: Yet you say, The way of the Lord is not fair. O house of Israel, I will judge you, each one according to his ways.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:21
verses.text: And it was in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth <hi>month</hi>, on the fifth of the month, one who escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, The city is stricken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:22
verses.text: And the LORD's hand was on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came. And He had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was dumb no more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:23
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:24
verses.text: Son of man, those who live in those wastes of the land of Israel are speaking, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land. But we <hi>are</hi> many; the land is given to us for inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:25
verses.text: So say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood; and shall you possess the land?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:26
verses.text: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, each defiling his neighbor's wife. And shall you possess the land?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:27
verses.text: Speak to them in this way, So says the Lord Jehovah: <hi>As</hi> I live, surely those who <hi>are</hi> in the ruins shall fall by the sword, and I will give him who <hi>is</hi> in the open field to the beasts to be eaten up, and those in the forts and in the caves shall die of the plague.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:28
verses.text: For I have made the land a ruin, and the pride of her strength has ceased. And the mountains of Israel shall be a waste, so that none shall pass through.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:29
verses.text: And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I have made the land a ruin because of all their abominations which they have committed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:30
verses.text: And you, son of man, the sons of your people are still talking about you by the walls, and in the doors of the houses, and speaking to one another, each man to his brother, saying, I pray you, come and hear what is the word which comes from the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:31
verses.text: And they come to you as the people come, and they sit before you <hi>as</hi> My people, and they hear your words. But they will not do them. For with their mouth they show much love, <hi>but</hi> their heart goes after their unjust gain.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:32
verses.text: And lo, you <hi>are</hi> to them as a singer of very lovely songs <hi>with</hi> a beautiful voice and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:33
verses.text: And when this happens; lo, it will come; then they shall know that a prophet has been among them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:2
verses.text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah to the shepherds: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:3
verses.text: You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool; you kill the fat ones, <hi>but</hi> you do not feed the flock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:4
verses.text: You have not made the weak strong, nor have you healed the sick, nor have you bound up the broken. You have not brought again those driven away, nor have you sought that which was lost; but you have ruled them with force and with cruelty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:5
verses.text: And they were scattered for lack of a shepherd. And they became food to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:6
verses.text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yea, My flock was scattered on all the face of the earth, and none searched nor sought for them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:7
verses.text: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:8
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely because My flock became a prey, and My flock became food to every beast of the field, because <hi>there was</hi> no shepherd. Nor did My shepherds search <hi>for</hi> My flock, but the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My flock;

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:9
verses.text: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:10
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against the shepherds, and I will require My flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock. Nor shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver My flock from their mouth, and they will not be food to devour.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:11
verses.text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I Myself will search for My sheep and seek them out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:12
verses.text: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his scattered sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:13
verses.text: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the lands, and will bring them to their own land and feed them on the mountain of Israel by the rivers, and in all the places of the land where people live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:14
verses.text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and their fold shall be on the high mountains of Israel. There they shall lie in a good fold, and <hi>in</hi> a fat pasture they shall feed on the mountains of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:15
verses.text: I will feed My flock, and I will cause them to lie down, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:16
verses.text: I will seek the lost, and bring again those driven away, and will bind up the broken, and will strengthen the sick. But I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:17
verses.text: And you, My flock, says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between lamb and lamb, <hi>between</hi> rams and he-goats.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:18
verses.text: Is it a small thing to you to have eaten up the good pasture, but you must trample the rest of your pastures with your feet? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but you must foul the rest with your feet?

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:19
verses.text: And My flock, they eat <hi>what</hi> your feet have trampled, and they drink <hi>what</hi> your feet have fouled.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:20
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this to them: Behold I Myself will even judge between the fat lamb and the lean lamb.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:21
verses.text: Because you have thrust with side and with shoulder, and have pushed all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them to the outside,

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:22
verses.text: therefore I will save My flock, and they shall no more be a prey. And I will judge between lamb and lamb.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:23
verses.text: And I will set up one Shepherd over them, and He shall feed them, My servant David. He shall feed them, and He shall be their Shepherd.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:24
verses.text: And I the LORD will be their God, and My servant David a ruler among them. I the LORD have spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:25
verses.text: And I will make a covenant of peace with them, and will send the evil beasts out of the land. And they shall dwell safely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:26
verses.text: And I will make them, and the places around My hill, a blessing; and I will bring down the shower in its season. There shall be showers of blessing.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:27
verses.text: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase. And they shall be safe in their land, and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hands of those who enslaved them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:28
verses.text: And no more shall they be a prey to the nations, nor shall the beast of the land eat them. But they shall dwell safely, and none shall terrify <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:29
verses.text: And I will raise up for them a <hi>noted</hi> planting place, and they shall never again <hi>be of</hi> those gathered by famine in the land, nor shall they bear the shame of the nations any more.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:30
verses.text: And they shall know that I, the LORD their God, <hi>am</hi> with them, and they, the house of Israel, <hi>are</hi> My people, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:31
verses.text: And you My sheep, the sheep of My pasture, <hi>are</hi> men, and I <hi>am</hi> your God, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:3
verses.text: And say to it, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, O Mount Seir, I <hi>am</hi> against you, and I will stretch out My hand against you, and I will make you a ruin and a waste.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:4
verses.text: I will raze your cities, and you shall be ruined, and you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:5
verses.text: Because you have had a never-ending hatred, and have shed <hi>the blood of</hi> the sons of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time <hi>that</hi> iniquity <hi>had</hi> an end,

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:6
verses.text: therefore, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will yield you up to blood, and blood shall pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, even blood shall pursue you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:7
verses.text: So I will make mount Seir a ruin, and cut off from it the one passing through, and the one returning.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:8
verses.text: And I will fill his mountains <hi>with</hi> his dead. <hi>In</hi> your hills, and your valleys, and all your rivers, those slain with the sword shall fall in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:9
verses.text: I will make you ruins forever, and your cities shall not be inhabited. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:10
verses.text: Because you have said, These two nations and these two lands shall be mine, and we shall possess it; yet the LORD was there;

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:11
verses.text: therefore, <hi>as</hi> I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will act by your anger and by your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them. And I will make Myself known among them when I have judged you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:12
verses.text: And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD. I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, Desolation! They are given to us for food.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:13
verses.text: So with your mouth you have boasted against Me, and have multiplied your words against Me. I have heard <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:14
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you a ruin.

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:15
verses.text: As you rejoiced at the inheritance of the house of Israel because of desolation, so I will do to you. You shall be a desolation, O mount Seir and all Idumea, even all of it. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:1
verses.text: Also, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:2
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy has said against you, Aha! Even the old high places have become a possession to us.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:3
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Because of the wasting and crushing of you from all around, that you might be a possession to the rest of the nations, and you were lifted up on the tip of the tongue, and the talking of the people;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:4
verses.text: so, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. So says the Lord Jehovah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the deserted wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and a mockery to the rest of the nations all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:5
verses.text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Surely in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Idumea, who have given My land to themselves for a possession with all joy of heart, with scorning of soul, to make it open land for a prey.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:6
verses.text: So prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My fury, because you have borne the shame of the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:7
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I have lifted up My hand; surely the nations around you shall bear their shame.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:8
verses.text: But you, O mountains of Israel, you shall put out your branches and yield your fruit to My people Israel; for they have drawn near to come.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:9
verses.text: For, behold, I <hi>am</hi> for you, and I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:10
verses.text: And I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, all of it. And the cities shall have people, and the wastes shall be built.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:11
verses.text: And I will multiply men and beast on you, and they shall increase and be fruitful. And I will make you dwell as before, and I will do better <hi>to you</hi> than at your beginnings. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:12
verses.text: Yea, I will cause men to walk on you, even My people Israel. And they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and not any more will increase their bereavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:13
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because they say to you, You <hi>are</hi> a devourer of men, and you have bereaved your nations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:14
verses.text: so you shall devour men no more, nor shall you bereave your nations any more, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:15
verses.text: Nor will I allow you to hear the shame of the nations any more, nor shall you bear the shame of the peoples any more, nor shall you cause your nations to fall any more, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:16
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:17
verses.text: Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings, even as the defilement of woman's impurity, their way was before Me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:18
verses.text: So I poured My fury on them, because of the blood that they had shed on the land, and for their idols <hi>by which</hi> they defiled it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:19
verses.text: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were scattered through the lands. I judged them according to their way and according to their doings.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:20
verses.text: And when they entered the nations where they went, they even profaned My holy name by saying to them, These <hi>are</hi> the people of the Jehovah, and they are gone out of His land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:21
verses.text: But I had pity for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:22
verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: I do not do <hi>this</hi> for your sake, O house of Israel, but for My holy name's sake, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:23
verses.text: And I will sanctify My great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst. And the nations shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, says the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:24
verses.text: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all lands, and will gather you into your own land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:25
verses.text: And I will sprinkle clean waters on you, and you shall be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from your idols.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:26
verses.text: And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. And I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:27
verses.text: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you shall keep My judgments and do <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:28
verses.text: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. And you shall be My people, and I will be your God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:29
verses.text: I will also save you from all your defilements, and I will call for the grain, and will increase it, and will lay no famine on you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:30
verses.text: And I will multiply the fruits of the tree and the increase of the field, so that you shall never again receive the curse of famine among the nations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:31
verses.text: And you shall remember your own evil ways, and your doings that <hi>were</hi> not good, and shall despise yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:32
verses.text: I do not do <hi>this</hi> for your sake, says the Lord Jehovah, be it known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:33
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will also cause <hi>you</hi> to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be built.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:34
verses.text: And the waste land shall be tilled, instead of being a ruin before all passing by.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:35
verses.text: And they shall say, This land that was wasted has become like the garden of Eden. And the wasted, deserted and ruined cities now <hi>are</hi> fortified and inhabited.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:36
verses.text: And the nations that are left all around you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined <hi>places and</hi> plant that which was wasted. I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:37
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will yet <hi>for</hi> this be inquired by the house of Israel to act for them. I will increase them with men like a flock.

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:38
verses.text: As a holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:1
verses.text: The hand of the LORD was on me, and brought me by the Spirit of the LORD, and made me rest in the midst of a valley, and it <hi>was</hi> full of bones.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:2
verses.text: And He made me pass among them all around. And behold, very many <hi>were</hi> on the face of the valley. And lo, <hi>they were</hi> very dry.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:3
verses.text: And he said to me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, You know.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:4
verses.text: Again He said to me, Prophesy to these bones, and say to them, O dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:5
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah to these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:6
verses.text: And I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live. And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:7
verses.text: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I prophesied, there was a noise. And behold, a shaking! And the bones came near, a bone to its bone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:8
verses.text: And I watched. And behold! The sinews and the flesh came up on them, and the skin covered them above. But <hi>there was</hi> no breath in them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:9
verses.text: And He said to me, Prophesy to the Spirit, prophesy, son of man, and say to the Spirit, So says the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O Spirit, and breathe on these dead ones so that they may live.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:10
verses.text: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the Spirit came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:11
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, Our bones <hi>are</hi> dried and our hope is lost; we are cut off by ourselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:12
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, O My people, I will open your graves and cause you to come up out of your graves, and will bring you into the land of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:13
verses.text: And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O My people, and have brought you up out of your graves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:14
verses.text: And I shall put My Spirit in you, and you shall live, and I will place you in your own land. And you shall know that I the LORD have spoken and have done it, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:15
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:16
verses.text: And you, son of man, take a stick and write on it, For Judah and for his companions, the sons of Israel. And take another stick and write on it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companions.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:17
verses.text: And join them to one another into one stick. And they shall become one in your hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:18
verses.text: And when the sons of your people shall speak to you, saying, Will you not declare to us what these <hi>mean</hi> to you?

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:19
verses.text: Say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which <hi>is</hi> in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions, and I will put them with him, with the stick of Judah, and will make them one stick, and they shall be one in My hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:20
verses.text: And the sticks <hi>on</hi> which you write shall be in your hand before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:21
verses.text: And say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and will bring them into their own land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:22
verses.text: And I will make them one nation in the land on the mountains of Israel, and one King shall be king to them all. And they shall not still be two nations, nor shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:23
verses.text: Nor shall they be defiled with their idols, even with their filthy idols, nor with all of their transgressions. But I will save them out of all their dwelling places, in them where they sinned, and will cleanse them. And they shall be to Me for a people, and I will be to them for God.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:24
verses.text: And David My servant <hi>shall be</hi> King over them. And there shall be one Shepherd to all of them. And they shall walk in My judgments, and obey My laws, and do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:25
verses.text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob My servant, the land in which your fathers have lived. And they shall dwell in it, even they and their sons, and the sons of their sons for ever. And My servant David <hi>shall be</hi> their ruler forever.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:26
verses.text: And I will cut a covenant of peace with them. It shall be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will place them, and multiply them, and will set My sanctuary in their midst forever.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:27
verses.text: And My tabernacle shall be with them. Yea, I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:28
verses.text: And the nations shall know that I the LORD sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary shall be in their midst forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:1
verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:2
verses.text: Son of man, set your face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:3
verses.text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O Gog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:4
verses.text: And I will turn you back, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed most perfectly, a great assembly <hi>with</hi> buckler and shield, all of them swordsmen;

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:5
verses.text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them, all of them <hi>with</hi> shield and helmet;

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:6
verses.text: Gomer and all his bands; the house of Togarmah <hi>from</hi> the recesses of the north, and all his bands; <hi>and</hi> many peoples with you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:7
verses.text: Be prepared; yea, prepare for yourself, you and all your assembly that are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:8
verses.text: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you shall come into the land turned back from the sword, gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have always been waste. (But he has been brought out of the peoples, and they shall dwell securely, all of them.)

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:9
verses.text: And you shall go up, coming like a storm. You shall be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your bands, and many peoples with you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:10
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: And it shall be in that day that things shall come into your heart, and you shall devise an evil plan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:11
verses.text: And you shall say, I will go up to the land of open spaces. I will go <hi>to</hi> those at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and there are no bars nor gates to them,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:12
verses.text: in order to take a spoil, and to steal a prize; to turn your hand on the inhabited waste places, and on the people gathered out of the nations, who have gotten cattle and goods, who dwell in the midst of the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:13
verses.text: Sheba and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all their young lions, shall say to you, Have you come to take a spoil? Have you gathered your company to steal a prize, to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:14
verses.text: So, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, So says the Lord Jehovah: In that day when My people of Israel dwells securely, shall you not know <hi>it</hi>?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:15
verses.text: And you shall come from your place out of the recesses of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:16
verses.text: And you shall come up on My people Israel like a cloud, to cover the land. It shall be in the last days, and I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I shall be sanctified in you, O Gog, before their eyes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:17
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: <hi>Are</hi> you he of whom I have spoken in former days, by the hand of My servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days <hi>and</hi> years that I would bring you against them?

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:18
verses.text: And it shall be on that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah, My fury shall come up in My face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:19
verses.text: For in My jealousy <hi>and</hi> in the fire of My wrath I have spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great quaking in the land of Israel,

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:20
verses.text: so that the fish of the sea, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep on the earth, and all the men on the face of the earth, shall quake at My presence. And the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:21
verses.text: And I will call for a sword against him on all My mountains, says the Lord Jehovah. <hi>Each</hi> man's sword shall be against his brother.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:22
verses.text: And I will judge him with a plague and with blood. And I will rain on him, and on his bands, and on the many peoples with him, an overflowing shower, and great hailstones, fire and brimstone.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:23
verses.text: So I will magnify Myself and sanctify Myself. And I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:1
verses.text: Therefore, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> against you, O Gog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:2
verses.text: And I will turn you back, and lead you on. And I will bring you on the mountains of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:3
verses.text: And I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:4
verses.text: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your bands, and the people with you. I will give you for food to the birds of prey of every kind, and <hi>to</hi> the beasts of the field.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:5
verses.text: You shall fall on the face of the field, for I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:6
verses.text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on the secure inhabitants of the coasts. And they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:7
verses.text: And I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel. And I will not <hi>let them</hi> profane My holy name any more. And the nations shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:8
verses.text: Behold, it is coming, and it will be done, says the Lord Jehovah. This <hi>is</hi> the day of which I have spoken.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:9
verses.text: And the inhabitants of the cities of Israel shall go out and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the javelins, and the spears. And they shall burn them with fire seven years,

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:10
verses.text: so that they shall take no wood out of the field, nor cut down <hi>any</hi> out of the forests for they shall burn the weapons for fire. And they shall plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:11
verses.text: And it will be in that day I will give to Gog a place there, a grave in Israel, the valley of those who pass by, east of the sea. And it shall stop the <hi>noses</hi> of those who pass by. And there they shall bury Gog and all his multitude. And <hi>they</hi> shall call <hi>it</hi>, The Valley of the Multitude of Gog.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:12
verses.text: And the house of Israel shall bury them, to cleanse the land, seven months.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:13
verses.text: And all the people of the land shall bury. And it shall be a name to them, the day when I am glorified, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:14
verses.text: And men shall separate those who continually pass through the land, burying those who passed through, who remain on the face of the earth, to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they shall search.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:15
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> they pass, those who pass through the land, and <hi>any</hi> man sees a bone, then he shall build a post beside it, until the buriers have buried it in The Valley of the Multitude of Gog.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:16
verses.text: And also the name of the city <hi>is</hi> The Multitude. And they shall cleanse the land.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:17
verses.text: And you, son of man, So says the Lord Jehovah. Speak to the bird of every wing, and to every beast of the field: Gather yourselves and come; gather yourselves from all around to My sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, so that you may eat flesh and drink blood.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:18
verses.text: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the rulers of the earth, of rams, lambs, goats, <hi>and</hi> bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:19
verses.text: And you shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of My sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:20
verses.text: And you shall be filled at My table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, all the men of war, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:21
verses.text: And I will set My glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see My judgments which I have done, and My hand that I have laid on them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:22
verses.text: So the house of Israel shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD their God from that day and forward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:23
verses.text: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel was exiled for their iniquity. Because they sinned against Me, therefore I hid My face from them and gave them into the hand of their enemies. So they all fell by the sword.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:24
verses.text: According to their uncleanness and according to their sins I have done to them, and have hidden My face from them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:25
verses.text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: And I will return the captivity of Jacob, and will have mercy on the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for My holy name;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:26
verses.text: <hi> after</hi> they have borne their shame and all their sins by which they have sinned against Me, when they dwell securely in their land and no one terrifies;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:27
verses.text: when I have brought them again from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:28
verses.text: then they shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD their God who exiled them among the nations. But I have gathered them to their own land, and have not left any of them there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:29
verses.text: Nor will I hide My face from them any more, for I have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:1
verses.text: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was stricken, in the same day the hand of the LORD was on me, and brought me there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:2
verses.text: In the visions of God He brought me into the land of Israel, and made me rest on a very high mountain. And it went up, as the structure of the city on the south.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:3
verses.text: And He brought me there, and behold, a man whose appearance <hi>was</hi> like the look of bronze, and a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed. And he stood in the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:4
verses.text: And the man said to me, Son of man, behold with your eyes and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I shall show you. For you are brought here so that I might show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:5
verses.text: And behold, a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man's hand <hi>was</hi> a measuring reed, six cubits <hi>long</hi>, with a cubit and a span. And he measured the building's breadth, one reed; and the height, one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:6
verses.text: And he came to the gate which faced eastward, and went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide, even the one threshold, one reed wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:7
verses.text: And a room <hi>was</hi> one reed long and one reed wide. And between the rooms <hi>were</hi> five cubits. And the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate from the house, one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:8
verses.text: He also measured the porch of the gate inside, one reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:9
verses.text: And he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its pillars, two cubits; also the porch of the gate from the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:10
verses.text: And the gate rooms eastward <hi>were</hi> three from here, and three from there; one measure to the three of them; and one measure <hi>was</hi> to the pillars from here and from there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:11
verses.text: And he measured the breadth of the gate-opening, ten cubits. The length of the gate <hi>was</hi> thirteen cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:12
verses.text: And the border in front of the rooms <hi>was</hi> one cubit from here, and the space <hi>was</hi> one cubit from there. And the room <hi>was</hi> six cubits from here and six cubits from there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:13
verses.text: And he measured the gate of the room from the roof to roof, twenty-five cubits wide, door to door.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:14
verses.text: He also made the pillars, sixty cubits, even to the court-pillar, <hi>from</hi> the gate all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:15
verses.text: And on the face of the entrance gate to the face of the porch of the inner gate <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:16
verses.text: and latticed windows <hi>were</hi> to the rooms and to their pillars inside the gate all around. And so for the porches; and windows <hi>were</hi> all around inside; and to each pillar <hi>were</hi> palm trees.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:17
verses.text: And he brought me into the outer court, and lo, chambers, and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms <hi>were</hi> on the pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:18
verses.text: And the pavement by the side of the gates to equal the length of the gates <hi>was</hi> the lower pavement.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:19
verses.text: And he measured the breadth from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court on the outside, a hundred cubits eastward and northward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:20
verses.text: And the gate which faces the way of the north of the outer court, he measured its length and its breadth.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:21
verses.text: And its rooms <hi>were</hi> three from here and three from there. And its pillars and its porches were according to the first measure. Its length <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits, and its breadth, twenty-five cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:22
verses.text: And their windows, and their porches, and their palm trees, <hi>were</hi> according to the measure of the gate facing the east. And they went up to it by seven steps; and its porches <hi>were</hi> before them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:23
verses.text: And the gate of the inner court <hi>was</hi> across from the gate toward the north and toward the east. And he measured from gate to gate, a hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:24
verses.text: And he led me southward, and behold a gate southward. And he measured its pillars and its porches according to these measures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:25
verses.text: And <hi>there were</hi> windows in it and in its porches all around, like those windows. The length <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits, and the breadth, twenty-five cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:26
verses.text: And seven steps <hi>were</hi> going up to it, and its porches <hi>were</hi> before them. And <hi>it had</hi> palm trees, one from here and another from there, on its pillars.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:27
verses.text: And <hi>there was</hi> a gate in the inner court southward. And he measured from gate to gate southward, a hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:28
verses.text: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. And he measured the south gate according to these measures,

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:29
verses.text: and its rooms and its pillars and its porches according to these measures. And <hi>there were</hi> windows in it and in its porches all around. It <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:30
verses.text: And the porches all around <hi>were</hi> twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:31
verses.text: And its porches <hi>were</hi> toward the outer court; and palm trees on its pillars. And its stairway <hi>had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:32
verses.text: And he brought me into the inner court eastward. And he measured the gate according to these measures.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:33
verses.text: And its rooms, and its pillars, and its porches, <hi>were</hi> measured according to these measures. And there <hi>were</hi> windows in it and in its porches all around. It <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:34
verses.text: And its porches <hi>were</hi> toward the outer court. And palm trees <hi>were</hi> on its pillars, from here, and from there. And its stairway <hi>had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:35
verses.text: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured <hi>it</hi> according to these measures;

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:36
verses.text: its rooms, its pillars, and its porches, and its windows all around. The length <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:37
verses.text: And its pillars <hi>were</hi> toward the outer court. And palm trees <hi>were</hi> on its pillars, from here and from there. And its stairway <hi>had</hi> eight steps.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:38
verses.text: And the chamber and its door <hi>was</hi> by the pillars of the gates; they washed the burnt offering there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:39
verses.text: And in the porch of the gate <hi>were</hi> two tables from here and two tables from there, for the slaughtering of the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:40
verses.text: And to the side outside, as one goes up to the door of the gate northward <hi>were</hi> two tables; and on the other side at the porch of the gate, two tables.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:41
verses.text: Four tables <hi>were</hi> from here, and four tables <hi>were</hi> from there, by the side of the gate: eight tables; they slaughter on them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:42
verses.text: And the four tables for burnt offering <hi>were</hi> of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They also rested on them the instruments with which they slaughtered the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:43
verses.text: And the double hooks of one span <hi>were</hi> fastened in the house all around, and on the tables the flesh of the offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:44
verses.text: And from the outside to the inner court <hi>were</hi> the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which <hi>was</hi> at the side of the north gate. And their face <hi>was</hi> southward: one at the side of the east gate looked the way of the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:45
verses.text: And he said to me, This chamber facing southward <hi>is</hi> for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:46
verses.text: And the chamber facing northward <hi>is</hi> for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar. They are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, who come near the LORD to minister to Him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:47
verses.text: And he measured the court, a square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide; and the altar <hi>was</hi> before the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:48
verses.text: And he brought me to the porch of the house and measured <hi>each</hi> pillar of the porch, five cubits from here and five cubits from there. And the gate <hi>was</hi> three cubits wide from here and three cubits from there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:49
verses.text: The porch <hi>was</hi> twenty cubits long, and eleven cubits wide. And <hi>he brought me</hi> by the steps by which they went up to it. And columns <hi>were</hi> by the pillars, one from here and another from there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:1
verses.text: And he brought me to the temple and measured the pillars, six cubits wide from here and six cubits wide from there, which <hi>was</hi> the breadth of the tabernacle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:2
verses.text: And the breadth of the door <hi>was</hi> ten cubits; and the sides of the door, five cubits from here, and five cubits from there. And he measured its length, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:3
verses.text: And he went inside and measured the pillar of the door, two cubits; and the door <hi>was</hi> six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:4
verses.text: And he measured its length, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple. And he said to me, This <hi>is</hi> the Holy of Holies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:5
verses.text: And he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of each side room <hi>was</hi> four cubits, all around the house on <hi>every</hi> side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:6
verses.text: And the side chambers <hi>were</hi> a side chamber over a side chamber, three stories, and thirty times. And <hi>they</hi> entered the wall of the house for the side chambers all around, that they might be fastened, for they <hi>were</hi> not fastened to the wall of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:7
verses.text: And there <hi>was</hi> a widening, and a winding upwards <hi>and</hi> upwards to the side chambers. For the winding around of the house went upward <hi>and</hi> upward, all around the house. On account of this the width of the house went upward, and so from the lowest it went up to the highest by the middle <hi>story</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:8
verses.text: I also saw the height of the house all around. The foundations of the side rooms <hi>were</hi> a full reed, six large cubits by joining.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:9
verses.text: The width of the wall, which <hi>was</hi> for the side chamber to the outside, <hi>was</hi> five cubits, and what <hi>was</hi> left between the side chambers that <hi>were</hi> of the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:10
verses.text: And between the chambers <hi>was</hi> the width of twenty cubits, circling the house all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:11
verses.text: And the door of the side chamber <hi>was</hi> toward the open space, one door northward and one door southward. And the width of the place of the open space <hi>was</hi> five cubits all around.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:12
verses.text: And the building that <hi>was</hi> before the separate place at the end of the way of the west <hi>was</hi> seventy cubits wide. And the wall of the building <hi>was</hi> five cubits wide all around, and its length, ninety cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:13
verses.text: And he measured the house, a hundred cubits long. And the separate place, and the building, and its wall, <hi>were</hi> a hundred cubits long.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:14
verses.text: And the width of the front of the house and of the separate place eastward <hi>was</hi> a hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:15
verses.text: And he measured the length of the building to the front of the separate place which <hi>was</hi> behind it; and its gallery from here and from there, a hundred cubits, with the inner temple and the porches of the court,

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:16
verses.text: the thresholds, and the latticed narrow windows, and the galleries all around, their three stories across from the threshold, with wood panelings all around, and <hi>from</hi> the ground up to the windows; and the windows <hi>were</hi> covered;

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:17
verses.text: to that above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall around inside and outside, by measure.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:18
verses.text: And it <hi>was</hi> made with cherubs and palm trees, and a palm tree <hi>was</hi> between cherub and cherub. And each cherub had two faces,

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:19
verses.text: the face of a man <hi>was</hi> toward the palm tree from here, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree from there. It <hi>was</hi> made through all the house all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:20
verses.text: From the ground to above the door <hi>were</hi> cherubs and palm trees made, and <hi>on</hi> the wall of the temple.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:21
verses.text: The temple doorposts <hi>were</hi> squared, and the face of the sanctuary. The looks of the one was like the looks of the other.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:22
verses.text: The altar of wood <hi>was</hi> three cubits high, and its length two cubits. And its corners, and its length, and its walls, <hi>were</hi> of wood. And he said to me, This is the table that is before the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:23
verses.text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:24
verses.text: And two doors <hi>leaves</hi> <hi>were</hi> to <hi>each</hi> of the doors, two turning doors, two for the one door, and two for the other door.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:25
verses.text: And on them, on the temple doors, <hi>were</hi> made cherubs and palm trees like those made on the walls, and thick wood on the face of the porch outside.

verses.name: Ezekiel 41:26
verses.text: And latticed windows, and palm trees, <hi>were</hi> from here and from there, on the sides of the porch, and on the side chambers of the house, and wooden <hi>canopies</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:1
verses.text: And he brought me out into the outer court, the way northward. And he brought me into the chamber that <hi>was</hi> across from the separate place and which <hi>was</hi> in front of the building to the north.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:2
verses.text: Before the length of a hundred cubits <hi>was</hi> the north door, and the width <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:3
verses.text: Across from the twenty cubits which <hi>were</hi> for the inner court, and across from the pavement which <hi>was</hi> for the outer court, gallery <hi>was</hi> on gallery in three stories.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:4
verses.text: And before the chambers <hi>was</hi> a walk of ten cubits width inward, a way of one cubit. And their doors <hi>were</hi> northward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:5
verses.text: And the upper chambers <hi>were</hi> shorter; for the galleries used up more space than the lower and middle ones in the building.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:6
verses.text: For they <hi>were</hi> in three <hi>stories</hi>, but there <hi>were</hi> no columns to them like the columns of the courts. So <hi>the third</hi> story was made narrower than the lower and the middle stories from the ground.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:7
verses.text: And the wall that <hi>was</hi> outside near the chambers, toward the outer court on the front of the chambers, its length <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:8
verses.text: For the length of the chambers that <hi>were</hi> in the outer court <hi>was</hi> fifty cubits. And lo, in front of the temple <hi>was</hi> a hundred cubits.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:9
verses.text: And under these chambers <hi>was</hi> the entrance on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court,

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:10
verses.text: in the width of the wall of the court eastward, to the front of the separate area, and to the front of the building <hi>were</hi> chambers.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:11
verses.text: And the way in front of them looked like the chambers which <hi>were</hi> northward, as their length, so their width. And all their exits <hi>were</hi> as their patterns, and as their doors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:12
verses.text: And as the doors of the chambers that <hi>were</hi> southward <hi>was</hi> a door in the head of the way, <hi>even</hi> the way directly in front of the wall eastward, as one enters them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:13
verses.text: And he said to me, The north chambers <hi>and</hi> the south chambers which <hi>are</hi> in front of the separate place, they <hi>are</hi> holy chambers, where the priests shall eat, <hi>those</hi> who approach to the LORD shall eat the most holy <hi>things</hi>. There they shall lay the most holy things, and the food offering, and the sin offering, and the guilt offering. For the place <hi>is</hi> holy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:14
verses.text: When the priests enter, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court, but they shall lay their clothes there by which they minister in them, for they are holy. And they shall put on other clothes, and shall approach that which is for the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:15
verses.text: And he finished measuring the inner house; he brought me out the way of the gate whose view is eastward, and measured all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:16
verses.text: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds with the measuring reed, all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:17
verses.text: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:18
verses.text: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:19
verses.text: He turned to the west side, measuring five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 42:20
verses.text: He measured it by the four sides. It had a wall all around, five hundred long, and five hundred wide, to make a separation between the holy place and the common place.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:1
verses.text: And he led me to the gate, the gate that faces eastward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:2
verses.text: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. And His voice <hi>was</hi> like the sound of many waters. And the earth shone with His glory.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:3
verses.text: And it looked the same as the vision which I saw, even according to the vision which I saw when I came to destroy the city. And the visions <hi>were</hi> like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar. And I fell on my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:4
verses.text: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose view is eastward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:5
verses.text: And the Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner chamber. And behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:6
verses.text: And I heard <hi>Him</hi> speaking to me from the house. And standing by me <hi>was</hi> a Man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:7
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, the house of Israel shall no more defile the place of My throne, and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel forever; neither they, nor their kings, by their fornication, nor by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:8
verses.text: In their setting of their doorstep by My threshold, and their doorpost by My doorpost; and the wall between Me and them, they have even defiled My holy name by their abominations which they have done. And I have consumed them in My anger.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:9
verses.text: Now <hi>let</hi> them put away their fornication, and the dead bodies of their kings from Me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:10
verses.text: You, son of man, declare the house <hi>to</hi> the house of Israel, the <hi>temple</hi> house, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. And let them measure <hi>its</hi> size.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:11
verses.text: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, the form of the house, and its arrangement, and its exits, and its entrances, and all its forms, and all its statutes, and all its forms, and all its laws, make known to them. And write them before their eyes, so that they may observe all its form, and all its statutes, and do them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:12
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the law of the house. On the top of the mountain <hi>is</hi> all its border, all around, most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:13
verses.text: And these are the measures of the altar by the cubit. The cubit <hi>is</hi> a cubit and a span; even the base <hi>shall be</hi> a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border by its edge all around <hi>shall be</hi> a span. And this <hi> is</hi> the upper part of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:14
verses.text: And from the base on the ground even to the lower ledge <hi>shall be</hi> two cubits, and the width one cubit. And from the smaller ledge even to the greater ledge <hi>shall be</hi> four cubits, and the width one cubit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:15
verses.text: And the altar hearth <hi>shall be</hi> four cubits, and from the altar hearth and upward <hi>shall be</hi> four horns.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:16
verses.text: And the altar hearth <hi>shall be</hi> twelve cubits long, twelve wide, square in its four sides.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:17
verses.text: And the ledge <hi>shall be</hi> fourteen long and fourteen wide in its four sides. And the border around it <hi>shall be</hi> half a cubit, and its base a cubit around. And its steps shall face eastward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:18
verses.text: And He said to me, Son of man, so says the Lord Jehovah: These <hi>are</hi> the statutes of the altar in the day of its being made to offer on it burnt offerings, and to sprinkle blood on it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:19
verses.text: And you shall give a young bull for a sin offering to the priests the Levites, who <hi>are</hi> of the seed of Zadok, who approach Me to minister to Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:20
verses.text: And you shall take of its blood and put <hi>it</hi> on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. So you shall cleanse and purge it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:21
verses.text: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and he shall burn <hi>it</hi> in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:22
verses.text: And on the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering. And they shall cleanse the altar as they cleansed it with the bull.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:23
verses.text: And when you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without blemish and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:24
verses.text: And you shall offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:25
verses.text: Every day <hi>for</hi> seven days you shall prepare a goat <hi>for</hi> a sin offering. They also shall prepare a young bull, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
