verses.name: Ezekiel 43:26
verses.text: Seven days they shall purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate <hi>themselves</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 43:27
verses.text: And when these days are expired, it shall be that on the eighth day, and forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings before the altar, and your peace offerings. And I will accept you, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:1
verses.text: And he brought me back by the way of the gate of the outer sanctuary which looks eastward. And it <hi>was</hi> shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:2
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it. Because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:3
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> for the ruler; the ruler shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD. He shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the same way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:4
verses.text: And He brought me by the way of the north gate before the house. And I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD. And I fell on my face.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:5
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Son of man, note carefully: see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I say to you concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all its laws. And set your heart to the entrance of the house, with all the exits of the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:6
verses.text: And you shall say to the rebellious, to the house of Israel, This says the Lord Jehovah: O house of Israel, let it be more than enough for you, of all your hateful deeds,

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:7
verses.text: that you have brought strangers, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary, to profane it, <hi>even</hi> My house, when you offer My bread, the fat and the blood. And they have broken My covenant because of all your abominations.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:8
verses.text: And you have not kept the charge of My holy things, but you have set keepers of My charge in My sanctuary for themselves.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:9
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: No son of an alien, uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh, shall not enter into My sanctuary, or any son of an alien among the sons of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:10
verses.text: But the Levites who have gone far away from Me, when Israel went astray; those who went astray from Me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:11
verses.text: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, overseers at the gates of the house and ministering to the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:12
verses.text: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity, therefore I have lifted up My hand against them, says the Lord Jehovah, and they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:13
verses.text: And they shall not come near Me, to do the office of a priest to Me, nor to come near any of My holy things, in the most holy place; but they shall bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:14
verses.text: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house for all its service, and for all that shall be done in it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:15
verses.text: But the priests, the Levites, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge of My sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from Me, they shall come near Me to minister to Me, and they shall stand before Me to offer to Me the fat and the blood, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:16
verses.text: They shall enter My sanctuary, and they shall come near My table, to minister to Me, and they shall keep My charge.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:17
verses.text: And it shall be, when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with bleached <hi>linen</hi> clothing. And no wool shall come on them while they serve in the gates of the inner court, and inside.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:18
verses.text: Turbans of bleached <hi>linen</hi> shall be on their heads, and shall have bleached <hi>linen</hi> undergarments on their loins. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that causes sweat.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:19
verses.text: And when they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court of the people, they shall put off their clothes in which they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers. And they shall put on other clothes, so that they shall not sanctify the people with their own clothes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:20
verses.text: Nor shall they shave their heads nor allow their hair to grow long; they shall only trim their heads.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:21
verses.text: Nor shall any priest drink wine when they enter the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:22
verses.text: Nor shall they take for their wives a widow nor her who is put away. But they shall take virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow who had a priest before.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:23
verses.text: And they shall teach My people to discern between the holy and common, and between the unclean and the clean.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:24
verses.text: And in a dispute they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to My judgments. And they shall keep My laws and My statutes in all My assemblies, and they shall keep My sabbaths holy.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:25
verses.text: And he shall not come near any dead person to defile <hi>himself;</hi> but he may defile themselves for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:26
verses.text: And after he is cleansed, they shall count seven days for him.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:27
verses.text: And in the day that he goes into the sanctuary, to the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:28
verses.text: And it shall be to them for an inheritance. I <hi>am</hi> their inheritance. And you shall give them no possession in Israel; I <hi>am</hi> their possession.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:29
verses.text: They shall eat the food offering, and the sin offering, and the guilt offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:30
verses.text: And the first of all the firstfruits of all, and every offering of all, of every <hi>kind</hi> of your sacrifices, shall be the priest's. You shall also give the priest the first of your dough, so that he may cause the blessing to rest in your house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 44:31
verses.text: The priests shall not eat of anything that died of itself, or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:1
verses.text: And, when you make fall the land by lot for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to the LORD, a holy <hi>portion</hi> of the land. The length <hi>shall be</hi> twenty-five thousand <hi>cubits</hi> long, and the width ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its borders all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:2
verses.text: Of this there shall be five hundred by five hundred cubits for the sanctuary, square all around; and fifty cubits around shall be for its open space.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:3
verses.text: And from this measure you shall measure the length of twenty-five thousand, and the width of ten thousand. And in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:4
verses.text: It is the holy <hi>portion</hi> of the land for the priests, it shall be for the ministers of the sanctuary who come near to minister to the LORD. And it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:5
verses.text: And the twenty-five thousand cubits in length, and the ten thousand in width, shall also be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, for themselves for a possession, twenty rooms.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:6
verses.text: And you shall give the possession of the city, five thousand <hi>cubits</hi> wide, and twenty-five thousand long, beside the offering of the holy <hi>portion</hi>. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:7
verses.text: And a <hi>portion shall be</hi> for the ruler from here and from there, for <hi>the</hi> heave offering of the holy place, and of the possession of the city, in front of the heave offering of the holy place, and to the front of the city's possession, from the west side westward and from the east side eastward. And the length <hi>shall be</hi> alongside one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:8
verses.text: It shall be for a land to him, for a possession in Israel; and My rulers shall never again oppress My people. And they shall give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:9
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Enough for you, O rulers of Israel. Remove violence and spoil, and do judgment and justice. Take away your demands on My people, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:10
verses.text: You shall have a just balance, a just ephah and a just bath.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:11
verses.text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth <hi>part</hi> of a homer, and the ephah the tenth <hi>part</hi> of a homer. Its measure shall be according to the homer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:12
verses.text: And the shekel <hi>shall be</hi> twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:13
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the heave offering that you shall offer: the sixth of an ephah of a homer of wheat, and the sixth of an ephah of a homer of barley.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:14
verses.text: And as to the statute of oil, the bath of oil, you shall offer the tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is a homer of ten baths; for ten baths <hi>are</hi> a homer;

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:15
verses.text: and one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the watered <hi>pasture</hi> of Israel; for a food offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:16
verses.text: All the people of the land shall be at the heave offering for the ruler in Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:17
verses.text: And it shall be the ruler's <hi>part</hi> to give burnt offerings and food offerings and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering and the food offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:18
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: In the first <hi>month</hi>, in the first of the month, you shall take a perfect bull a son of the herd, and cleanse the sanctuary.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:19
verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put <hi>it</hi> on the doorposts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the gateposts of the inner court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:20
verses.text: And so you shall do on the seventh of the month for each man who goes astray, and for the simple. So you shall atone for the house.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:21
verses.text: In the first <hi>month</hi>, on the fourteenth of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days. Unleavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:22
verses.text: And on that day the ruler shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull <hi>for</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:23
verses.text: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams, perfect ones, daily <hi>for</hi> the seven days, and a kid of the goats daily <hi>for</hi> a sin offering.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:24
verses.text: And he shall prepare a food offering of an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil for an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 45:25
verses.text: In the seventh <hi>month</hi>, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast he shall prepare like these seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the food offering, and according to the oil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:1
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: The gate of the inner court that faces eastward shall be shut the six working days. But on the Sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:2
verses.text: And the ruler shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate outside, and shall stand by the gatepost. And the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. And he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:3
verses.text: And the people of the land shall worship <hi>at</hi> the door of that gate before the LORD on the sabbaths and in the new moons.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:4
verses.text: And the burnt offering that the ruler shall offer to the LORD in the sabbath day <hi>shall be</hi> six perfect lambs and a perfect ram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:5
verses.text: And the food offering <hi>shall be</hi> an ephah for a ram, and the food offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:6
verses.text: And in the day of the new moon <hi>it shall be</hi> a perfect bull, and six lambs, and a ram. They shall be perfect.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:7
verses.text: And he shall prepare a food offering, an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as his hand shall be able to get, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:8
verses.text: And when the ruler shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and by its way he shall go out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:9
verses.text: But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate. And he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall leave opposite it.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:10
verses.text: And the ruler shall go in among them when they go in. And when they go out, he shall go out.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:11
verses.text: And in the feasts and in the appointed feasts the food offering shall be an ephah to a bull, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:12
verses.text: And when the ruler shall prepare a free-will burnt offering or peace offerings willingly to the LORD, <hi>one</hi> shall then open to him the gate that faces eastward, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the Sabbath day. And he shall go out. And after his going out, one shall shut the gate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:13
verses.text: You shall daily prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, a perfect lamb of the first year. You shall prepare it every morning.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:14
verses.text: And you shall prepare a food offering for it every morning, the sixth of an ephah, and the third of a hin of oil, to make the fine flour moist; a food offering every day by an ordinance forever to the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:15
verses.text: So they shall prepare the lamb, and the food offering, and the oil, every morning for a burnt offering continually.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:16
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: If the ruler gives a gift to any of his sons, the inheritance of it shall be his sons'; it <hi>shall be</hi> their possession by inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:17
verses.text: But if he gives a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty. Afterwards. it shall return to the ruler, but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:18
verses.text: And the ruler shall not take of the people's inheritance, oppressing them out of their possession. But he shall give his sons their inheritance out of his own possession; so that My people may not be scattered, each man from his possession.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:19
verses.text: And he brought me through the entry which <hi>was</hi> at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, facing north. And behold, there <hi>was</hi> a place on the two sides westward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:20
verses.text: And he said to me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the food offering, so that they may not bear <hi>them</hi> out into the outer court to sanctify the people.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:21
verses.text: And he led me out into the outer court and he made me pass by the four corners of the court. And behold, in every corner of the court there <hi>was</hi> a court.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:22
verses.text: In the four corners of the court <hi>were</hi> enclosed courts, forty <hi>cubits</hi> long and thirty wide, one measure to the four of them, being made in corners.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:23
verses.text: And a row <hi>was</hi> all around in them, all around the four of them. And boiling water <hi>was</hi> made under the rows all around.

verses.name: Ezekiel 46:24
verses.text: And he said to me, These <hi>are</hi> the places of those who boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:1
verses.text: And he led me again to the door of the house. And behold, water came out from under the threshold of the house eastward. For the front of the house <hi>is</hi> east, and the water came down from under the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:2
verses.text: And he led me out by the way of the north gate, and led me around the way outside to the outer gate, by the way facing the east. And behold, water <hi>was</hi> trickling out of the right side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:3
verses.text: When the man went out eastward, and a line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits. And he passed me through the water. The water <hi>was to</hi> the ankles.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:4
verses.text: And he measured a thousand cubits, and passed me through the water, water <hi>to</hi> the knees. And he measured a thousand, and passed me through water <hi>to</hi> the loins.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:5
verses.text: And he measured a thousand; and there was a torrent which I <hi>was</hi> not able to pass; for the water had risen, water to swim <hi>in</hi>, a torrent that could not be passed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:6
verses.text: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen? And he led me, and caused me to return to the bank of the torrent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:7
verses.text: When I returned, then behold, on the edge of the torrent <hi>were</hi> very many trees, from here and from there.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:8
verses.text: And he said to me, These waters go out toward the eastern circuit, and go down into the Arabah, and go into the sea. They are brought out into the sea, and the waters shall be healed.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:9
verses.text: And it shall be that every living soul which swarms in every <hi>place</hi>, there where the two torrents go, <hi>that soul</hi> shall live. And there shall be very many fish, because these waters shall come there. And they shall be healed. And all shall live where the torrent goes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:10
verses.text: And it will be, the fishermen shall stand on it from En-gedi even to En-eglaim, a spreading place for nets shall be there. Their fish shall be according to their kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea, very many.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:11
verses.text: Its swamps and its marshes shall not even be healed; they shall be given to salt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:12
verses.text: And all trees <hi>for</hi> food shall go up by the torrent, on its bank on this <hi>side</hi>, and on that <hi>side</hi>. Its leaf shall not fade, nor its fruit fail. It will bear by its months, because its waters come out from the sanctuary. And its fruit shall be for food, and its leaf for healing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:13
verses.text: So says the Lord Jehovah: This <hi>shall be</hi> the border by which you shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph <hi>shall have two</hi> parts.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:14
verses.text: And you shall inherit it, each man like his brother, that I lifted up My hand to give to your fathers; even this land shall fall to you for an inheritance.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:15
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the border of the land to the north side, from the Great Sea, the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:16
verses.text: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which <hi>is</hi> between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer-hatticon, which <hi>is</hi> by the border of Hauran.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:17
verses.text: And the border shall be from the sea to Hazar-enan, at the border of Damascus and the north northward, even the border of Hamath. And <hi>this is</hi> the north side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:18
verses.text: And you shall measure the east side from between Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and the land of Israel, <hi>shall be</hi> the Jordan, from the border to the Eastern Sea. And <hi>this is</hi> the east side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:19
verses.text: And the south side, southward from Tamar, to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, the torrent to the Great Sea. And <hi>this is</hi> the south side southward.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:20
verses.text: And the west side <hi>is</hi> the Great Sea from the border until one is beside the entrance of Hamath. <hi>This is</hi> the west side.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:21
verses.text: And you shall divide this land for yourselves by the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:22
verses.text: And it will be, you shall make it fall by lot for an inheritance to yourselves, and to the strangers who live among you, who shall father sons among you. And they shall be to you as native-born among the sons of Israel. They shall be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 47:23
verses.text: And it shall be, in the tribe in which the stranger resides, there you shall give his inheritance, says the Lord Jehovah.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:1
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the names of the tribes. From the north end, at the hand of the way of Hethlon <hi>to</hi> the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, at the hand of Hamath. And there shall be to it an east side and a west: one <hi>part</hi> for Dan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:2
verses.text: And by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Asher.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:3
verses.text: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Naphtali.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:4
verses.text: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Manasseh.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:5
verses.text: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Ephraim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:6
verses.text: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Reuben.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:7
verses.text: And by the border of Reuben from the east side to the west side, one <hi>part</hi> for Judah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:8
verses.text: And by the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the heave offering which you shall offer: twenty-five thousand <hi>cubits</hi> wide and long, as one of the <hi>parts</hi>, from the east side to the west side. And the sanctuary shall be in its middle.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:9
verses.text: The heave offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand cubits long, and ten thousand cubits wide.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:10
verses.text: And for these shall be the holy heave offering for the priests; northward, twenty-five thousand; and westward ten thousand wide; and eastward ten thousand wide, and southward twenty-five thousand long. And the sanctuary of the LORD <hi> shall be</hi> in the middle of it,

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:11
verses.text: for the priests who are sanctified, of the sons of Zadok, who have kept My charge, who did not go astray when the sons of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:12
verses.text: And the heave offering shall be theirs, from the heave offering of the land, the holiest of the holy places, by the border of the Levites.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:13
verses.text: And the Levites <hi>shall have</hi> alongside the border of the priests twenty-five thousand <hi>cubits</hi> long, and ten thousand wide. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:14
verses.text: And they shall not sell any of it, nor trade it, nor cause the first-fruits of the land to pass away. For <hi>it is</hi> holy to the LORD.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:15
verses.text: And the five thousand that are left in the width in front of the twenty-five thousand <hi>shall be</hi> common for the city, for dwelling and for open land. And the city shall be in her midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:16
verses.text: And these shall be its measures: the north side, four thousand and five hundred; and the south side, four thousand and five hundred; and on the east side, four thousand and five hundred; and the west side, four thousand and five hundred.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:17
verses.text: And the open land of the city shall be northward two hundred and fifty, and southward two hundred and fifty; and eastward, two hundred and fifty; and westward, two hundred and fifty.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:18
verses.text: And the rest in length alongside the heave offering of the holy <hi>parts shall be</hi> ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward. And it shall be alongside the heave offering of the holy <hi>part</hi>. And its produce shall be for bread to those who serve the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:19
verses.text: And he who serves the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:20
verses.text: All the heave offering <hi>shall be</hi> twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand, four-square. You shall offer the holy heave offering to the possession of the city.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:21
verses.text: And the rest <hi>shall be</hi> for the ruler, on this <hi>side</hi>, and on that <hi>side</hi> of the holy heave offering, and of the possession of the city, in the front of the twenty-five thousand of the heave offering to the east border, and westward in the front of the twenty-five thousand to the west border, alongside the <hi>lots</hi> for the ruler. And it shall be the holy heave offering. And the sanctuary of the house <hi>shall be</hi> in her midst.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:22
verses.text: And to the ruler shall be from the possessions of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, amidst <hi>that</hi> for the ruler; between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the ruler.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:23
verses.text: And the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one <hi>part</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:24
verses.text: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one <hi>part</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:25
verses.text: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one <hi>part</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:26
verses.text: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one <hi>part</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:27
verses.text: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one <hi>part</hi>.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:28
verses.text: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, and to the torrent toward the Great Sea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:29
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these <hi>are</hi> their parts, says the Lord Jehovah.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:30
verses.text: And these <hi>are</hi> the exits of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:31
verses.text: And the gates of the city <hi>shall be</hi> by the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward, one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:32
verses.text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred, and three gates: and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:33
verses.text: And the south side, four thousand and five hundred measures, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:34
verses.text: The west side, four thousand and five hundred, their gates three: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

verses.name: Ezekiel 48:35
verses.text: All around <hi>it shall be</hi> eighteen thousand <hi>cubits</hi>. And the name of the city from <hi>that</hi> day <hi>is</hi> JEHOVAH IS THERE.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:1
verses.text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and lay siege to it.

verses.name: Daniel 1:2
verses.text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God, which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. And he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

verses.name: Daniel 1:3
verses.text: And the king spoke to Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs that he should bring <hi>some</hi> of the sons of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the rulers;

verses.name: Daniel 1:4
verses.text: sons <hi>in</hi> whom was no blemish, but who were handsome and skillful in all wisdom; and who had knowledge and understanding, even those who were able to stand in the king's palace, and to whom they might teach the writing and the language of the Chaldeans.

verses.name: Daniel 1:5
verses.text: And the king gave them the portion of a day in its day from the king's food, and the wine which he drank, even to rear them three years, so that at their end they might stand before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:6
verses.text: And among them were <hi>four</hi> of the sons of Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.name: Daniel 1:7
verses.text: to whom the ruler of the eunuchs gave names. For he called Daniel, Belteshazzar; and Hananiah, Shadrach; and Mishael, Meshach; and Azariah, Abednego.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:8
verses.text: But Daniel laid on his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's food, nor with the wine which he drank. So he asked permission of the chief of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

verses.name: Daniel 1:9
verses.text: And God had given Daniel kindness and compassion before the chief of the eunuchs.

verses.name: Daniel 1:10
verses.text: And the chief of the eunuchs said to Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who has chosen your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the boys who <hi>are</hi> of your kind? Then you would forfeit my head to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:11
verses.text: And Daniel said to Melzar, whom the chief of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.name: Daniel 1:12
verses.text: I beg you, try your servants ten days. And let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

verses.name: Daniel 1:13
verses.text: Then let our look be seen before you, and the look of the boys who eat of the king's food. And as you see, deal with your servants.

verses.name: Daniel 1:14
verses.text: So he listened to them in this matter, and tried them for ten days.

verses.name: Daniel 1:15
verses.text: And at the end of ten days their faces looked fairer and fatter in flesh than all the boys who had eaten the king's food.

verses.name: Daniel 1:16
verses.text: So Melzar took away their part of the food, and the wine that they were to drink, and gave them vegetables.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 1:17
verses.text: As for these four boys, God gave them knowledge and skill in all writing and wisdom. And Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

verses.name: Daniel 1:18
verses.text: And at the end of the days that the king had said he would bring them in, the chief of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Daniel 1:19
verses.text: And the king talked with them. And among them all were found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they stood before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 1:20
verses.text: And <hi>in</hi> any matters of wisdom <hi>and</hi> understanding that the king asked them, he found them ten times better than all the horoscopists <hi>and</hi> conjurers who were in all his kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 1:21
verses.text: And Daniel continued to the first year of king Cyrus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:1
verses.text: And in the second year of the reign of king Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, with which his spirit was troubled and his sleep left him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:2
verses.text: And the king commanded to call to the horoscopists, and to the conjurers, and to the sorcerers, and to the Chaldeans, to tell to the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:3
verses.text: And the king said to them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

verses.name: Daniel 2:4
verses.text: And the Chaldeans spoke to the king <hi>in</hi> Aramaic, O king, live forever. Tell your servants the dream, and we will reveal the meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 2:5
verses.text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing has gone from me. If you will not make known to me the dream, with its meaning, you will be made into <hi>mere</hi> members, and your houses shall be made an outhouse.

verses.name: Daniel 2:6
verses.text: But if you make known the dream and its meaning, you shall receive gifts and a present and great honor from me. Therefore reveal to me the dream and its meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 2:7
verses.text: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will reveal its meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 2:8
verses.text: The king answered and said, For I know that you surely want to gain time, because you see the thing is gone from me.

verses.name: Daniel 2:9
verses.text: But if you will not make the dream known to me, <hi>there is</hi> only one judgment for you. For you have prepared lying and deceiving words to speak before me, until the time has changed. Therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can reveal to me its meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 2:10
verses.text: The Chaldeans answered before the king and said, There is not a man on the earth who can reveal the king's matter, because not any king, lord, nor ruler has asked such a thing from any horoscopist or conjurer or Chaldean.

verses.name: Daniel 2:11
verses.text: And <hi>it is</hi> a rare thing that the king asks, and there is no other who can reveal it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

verses.name: Daniel 2:12
verses.text: For this cause the king was enraged and angered, and commanded all the wise men of Babylon to be destroyed.

verses.name: Daniel 2:13
verses.text: And the law went out that the wise men should be killed. And they sought Daniel and his fellows to be killed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:14
verses.text: Then Daniel answered <hi>with</hi> counsel and insight to Arioch the chief of the king's executioners, who had gone forth to kill the wise men of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:15
verses.text: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

verses.name: Daniel 2:16
verses.text: Then Daniel went in and asked of the king that he would give him time, and that he would make known the meaning to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:17
verses.text: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions,

verses.name: Daniel 2:18
verses.text: that they might pray for the mercies of God in Heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:19
verses.text: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. And Daniel blessed the God of Heaven.

verses.name: Daniel 2:20
verses.text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, for wisdom and might are His.

verses.name: Daniel 2:21
verses.text: And He changes the times and the seasons; He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who have understanding.

verses.name: Daniel 2:22
verses.text: He reveals the deep and secret things; He knows what <hi>is</hi> in the darkness, and the light dwells with Him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:23
verses.text: I thank You, and praise You, O God of my fathers, who has given me wisdom and might, and have made known to me now what we asked of You. For You have now made known to us the king's matter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:24
verses.text: Then Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had chosen to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him; Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will declare the meaning to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:25
verses.text: Then Arioch quickly brought Daniel in before the king, and said this to him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah who will make the meaning known to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:26
verses.text: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name <hi>was</hi> Belteshazzar, Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its meaning?

verses.name: Daniel 2:27
verses.text: Daniel answered before the king and said, The secret which the king has demanded cannot be shown to the king by the wise men, the conjurers, the horoscopists, or the fortune-tellers.

verses.name: Daniel 2:28
verses.text: But there is a God in Heaven who reveals secrets and makes known to king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head upon your bed <hi>are</hi> these.

verses.name: Daniel 2:29
verses.text: As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen after this. And He who reveals secrets makes known to you what shall happen.

verses.name: Daniel 2:30
verses.text: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for <hi>any</hi> wisdom that I have more than any living man, but so that the meaning might be known to the king, and that you might know the thoughts of your heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:31
verses.text: You, O king, were seeing. And, behold! A great image! That great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before you. And its form <hi>was</hi> dreadful.

verses.name: Daniel 2:32
verses.text: This image's head <hi>was</hi> of fine gold; his breast and his arms <hi>were</hi> of silver; his belly and his thighs <hi>were</hi> of bronze;

verses.name: Daniel 2:33
verses.text: his legs <hi>were</hi> of iron; his feet <hi>were</hi> part of iron and part of clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:34
verses.text: You watched until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image upon its feet <hi>which were</hi> of iron and clay, and broke them to pieces.

verses.name: Daniel 2:35
verses.text: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken to pieces together. And they became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. And the wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. And the stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

verses.name: Daniel 2:36
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the dream. And we will tell its meaning before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 2:37
verses.text: You, O king, <hi>are</hi> a king of kings. For the God of Heaven has given you a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

verses.name: Daniel 2:38
verses.text: And wherever the sons of men, the beasts of the field, and the birds of the heavens live, He has given <hi>them</hi> into your hand, and has made you ruler over them all. You are this head of gold.

verses.name: Daniel 2:39
verses.text: And after you shall arise another kingdom lower than you, and another third kingdom of bronze, which shall rule over all the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 2:40
verses.text: And the fourth kingdom shall be <hi>as</hi> strong as iron. Since iron crushes and smashes all things; and as the iron that shatters all these, it will crush and shatter.

verses.name: Daniel 2:41
verses.text: And as to that which you saw: the feet and toes, part of potters' clay and part of iron; <hi>the</hi> kingdom shall be divided. But there shall be in it the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:42
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> the toes of the feet <hi>were</hi> part of iron and part of clay, <hi>so</hi> the kingdom shall be partly strong and partly brittle.

verses.name: Daniel 2:43
verses.text: And as you saw iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mix themselves with the seed of men. But they shall not cling to one another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

verses.name: Daniel 2:44
verses.text: And in the days of these kings, the God of Heaven shall set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed. And the kingdom shall not be left to other peoples, but it shall crush and destroy all these kingdoms, and it shall stand forever.

verses.name: Daniel 2:45
verses.text: Because you saw that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it crushes the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what shall occur after this. And the dream <hi>is</hi> certain, and its meaning is sure.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 2:46
verses.text: Then king Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face and worshiped Daniel, and he commanded to offer an offering and incense to him.

verses.name: Daniel 2:47
verses.text: The king answered Daniel and said, It is true that your God <hi>is</hi> a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you could reveal this secret.

verses.name: Daniel 2:48
verses.text: Then the king made Daniel great, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over all the province of Babylon, and chief of the prefects over all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 2:49
verses.text: And Daniel asked the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon. But Daniel <hi>sat</hi> in the gate of the king.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:1
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height <hi>was</hi> sixty cubits, and its breadth six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 3:2
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the satraps, the prefects, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the justices, and all the officials of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:3
verses.text: Then were gathered the satraps, the prefects, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the justices, and all the officials of the provinces, to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up. And they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:4
verses.text: Then a herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

verses.name: Daniel 3:5
verses.text: at the time you hear the sound of the horn, the pipe, zither, the lyre, harp, bagpipe, and all kinds of music, you shall fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:6
verses.text: And whoever does not fall down and worship, at that moment they will be thrown into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:7
verses.text: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the horn, the pipe, zither, the lyre, harp, and all kinds of music, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:8
verses.text: Then at that time certain Chaldeans came near and accused the Jews.

verses.name: Daniel 3:9
verses.text: They spoke and said to king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live forever.

verses.name: Daniel 3:10
verses.text: You, O king, have made a decree that every man who shall hear the sound of the horn, the pipe, zither, the lyre, harp, and the bagpipe, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image.

verses.name: Daniel 3:11
verses.text: And whoever does not fall down and worship, he should be thrown into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:12
verses.text: There are men, Jews, whom you have set over the business of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, do not heed you. They do not serve your gods nor worship the golden image which you have set up.

verses.name: Daniel 3:13
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar in anger and wrath commanded them to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:14
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said to them, <hi>Is it</hi> true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego? Do you not serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

verses.name: Daniel 3:15
verses.text: Now if you are ready, at the time you hear the sound of the horn, the pipe, zither, the lyre, harp, and bagpipe, and all kinds of music, fall down and worship the image which I have made. But if you do not worship, in that moment you shall be thrown into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. And who is that god who shall deliver you out of my hand?

verses.name: Daniel 3:16
verses.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we <hi>have</hi> no need to return a word to you on this matter.

verses.name: Daniel 3:17
verses.text: If it is <hi>so that</hi> our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, then He will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:18
verses.text: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods nor worship the golden image which you have set up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:19
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with wrath, and the form of his face was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.

verses.name: Daniel 3:20
verses.text: And he commanded mighty men in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to throw <hi>them</hi> into the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:21
verses.text: Then these men were tied up in their slippers, their tunics, and their mantles, and their <hi>other</hi> clothes, and were thrown into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:22
verses.text: Then because the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

verses.name: Daniel 3:23
verses.text: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.name: Daniel 3:24
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was amazed. And he rose up in haste and spoke and said to his advisers, Did we not throw three men bound into the middle of the fire? They answered and said to the king, True, O king.

verses.name: Daniel 3:25
verses.text: He answered and said, Behold! I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and there is no harm among them. And the form of the fourth is like a son of <hi>the</hi> gods.

verses.name: Daniel 3:26
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near the door of the burning fiery furnace. He answered and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the most high God, come forth and come <hi>here</hi>. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth from the middle of the fire.

verses.name: Daniel 3:27
verses.text: And the satraps, the prefects, the governors, and the king's advisers gathered and saw these men <hi>on whose</hi> bodies the fire had no power (and the hair of their head was not scorched, nor were their slippers changed, nor had the smell of fire clung on them).  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 3:28
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, Blessed <hi>be</hi> the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent His Angel and has delivered His servants who trusted in Him, and have changed the king's words and has given their bodies that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God.

verses.name: Daniel 3:29
verses.text: And a decree is given by me, that every people, nation, and language, who speak anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be made into mere members, and his house shall be made an outhouse. Because there is no other God who can deliver in this way.

verses.name: Daniel 3:30
verses.text: Then the king made Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego prosper in the province of Babylon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:1
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.

verses.name: Daniel 4:2
verses.text: It seemed good before me to declare the signs and wonders that the Most High God has done with me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:3
verses.text: How great <hi>are</hi> His signs! And how mighty <hi>are</hi> His wonders! His kingdom <hi>is</hi> an everlasting kingdom, and His rule <hi>is</hi> from generation to generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:4
verses.text: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house and flourishing in my palace.

verses.name: Daniel 4:5
verses.text: I saw a dream and it terrified me, and <hi>the</hi> thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:6
verses.text: So I made a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the meaning of the dream.

verses.name: Daniel 4:7
verses.text: Then the horoscopists, the conjurers, the Chaldeans, and the fortune-tellers came in. And I told the dream before them, but they did not make its meaning known to me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:8
verses.text: But at last Daniel came in before me, whose name <hi>was</hi> Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom <hi>is</hi> the spirit of the holy gods. And I told the dream before him, <hi>saying</hi>,

verses.name: Daniel 4:9
verses.text: O Belteshazzar, master of the horoscopists, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods <hi>is</hi> in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 4:10
verses.text: As to the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and its height <hi>was</hi> great.

verses.name: Daniel 4:11
verses.text: The tree grew and was strong, and its height reached to the heavens; and the sight of it reached to the end of all the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 4:12
verses.text: Its leaves <hi>were</hi> beautiful, and its fruit plentiful, and in it <hi>was</hi> food for all. The animals of the field sought shade under it, and the birds of the heavens lived in its boughs, and all flesh was fed by it.

verses.name: Daniel 4:13
verses.text: I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a watcher and a holy one came down from Heaven.

verses.name: Daniel 4:14
verses.text: He cried aloud and said this, Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches; shake off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the animals get away from under it, and the birds from its branches.

verses.name: Daniel 4:15
verses.text: But leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field. And let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let its portion <hi>be</hi> with the animals in the grass of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 4:16
verses.text: Let his heart be changed from man's, and let the heart of an animal be given to him. And let seven times pass over him.

verses.name: Daniel 4:17
verses.text: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones, so that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.

verses.name: Daniel 4:18
verses.text: I, king Nebuchadnezzar, have seen this dream. Now you, O Belteshazzar, declare its meaning, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make the meaning known to me. But you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods <hi>is</hi> in you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:19
verses.text: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stunned for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spoke and said, Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its meaning trouble you. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream <hi>is</hi> to those who hate you, and its meaning to your foes.

verses.name: Daniel 4:20
verses.text: The tree that you saw, which became great and strong, whose height reached to the heaven, and the sight of it to all the earth;

verses.name: Daniel 4:21
verses.text: whose leaves were fair, and its fruit plentiful, and in it <hi>was</hi> food for all, under which the animals of the field dwelt, and on whose branches the birds of the heavens had their home;

verses.name: Daniel 4:22
verses.text: it <hi>is</hi> you, O king, for you have become great and strong, for your greatness has grown and reached to the heaven, and your rule to the end of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 4:23
verses.text: And as the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from Heaven, and saying, Cut the tree down and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots of it in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and <hi>let</hi> his portion <hi>be</hi> with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him;

verses.name: Daniel 4:24
verses.text: this <hi>is</hi> the meaning, O king, and this the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king.

verses.name: Daniel 4:25
verses.text: They shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field, and they shall make you eat grass like oxen. And they shall wet you <hi>with</hi> the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He will.

verses.name: Daniel 4:26
verses.text: And in that they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; your kingdom <hi>shall be</hi> sure to you after you have known that Heaven rules.

verses.name: Daniel 4:27
verses.text: Therefore, O king, let my advice be pleasing to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor, whether there will be duration to your prosperity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:28
verses.text: All this came on the king Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.name: Daniel 4:29
verses.text: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

verses.name: Daniel 4:30
verses.text: The king spoke and said, <hi>Is</hi> this not great Babylon that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power and for the honor of my majesty?

verses.name: Daniel 4:31
verses.text: While the word <hi>was</hi> in the king's mouth, a voice fell from Heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken. The kingdom has departed from you.

verses.name: Daniel 4:32
verses.text: And they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. They shall make you eat grass like oxen, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He will.

verses.name: Daniel 4:33
verses.text: The same hour the thing was fulfilled on Nebuchadnezzar. And he was driven from men, and ate grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the heavens, until his hair had grown like eagles' <hi>feathers</hi>, and his nails like birds' <hi>claws</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 4:34
verses.text: And at the end of days, I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up my eyes to Heaven, and my understanding returned to me, and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored Him who lives forever, whose kingdom <hi>is</hi> an everlasting kingdom, and His rule is from generation to generation.

verses.name: Daniel 4:35
verses.text: And all the people of the earth are counted as nothing; and He does according to His will in the army of heaven, and <hi>among</hi> the people of the earth. And none can strike His hand, or say to Him, What are You doing?

verses.name: Daniel 4:36
verses.text: At that time my reason returned to me. And the glory of my kingdom, my honor and brightness returned to me. And my advisers and my lords came for me, and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added to me.

verses.name: Daniel 4:37
verses.text: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and exalt and honor the King of heaven, all whose works are truth and His ways judgment. And those who walk in pride He is able to humble.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:1
verses.text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

verses.name: Daniel 5:2
verses.text: When tasting the wine, Belshazzar commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple in Jerusalem, that the king and his rulers, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:3
verses.text: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God in Jerusalem. And the king, and his rulers, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

verses.name: Daniel 5:4
verses.text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, and of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

verses.name: Daniel 5:5
verses.text: At that moment fingers of a man's hand came out and wrote on the plaster of the wall of the king's palace across from the lampstand. And the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

verses.name: Daniel 5:6
verses.text: Then the king's face was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosened, and his knees knocked against one another.

verses.name: Daniel 5:7
verses.text: The king cried aloud to bring in the conjurers, the Chaldeans, and the fortune-tellers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whoever shall read this writing, and show me its meaning, shall be clothed with scarlet, and <hi> have</hi> a chain of gold around his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:8
verses.text: Then all the king's wise men came in. But they could not read the writing, nor make the meaning known to the king.

verses.name: Daniel 5:9
verses.text: Then king Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changing in him, and his lords were perplexed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:10
verses.text: The queen came into the banquet house because of the king's words, and his nobles. And the queen spoke and said, O king, live forever. Do not let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

verses.name: Daniel 5:11
verses.text: There <hi>is</hi> a man in your kingdom, in whom <hi>is</hi> the spirit of the holy gods. And in the days of your father there was found in him light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods. Your father, king Nebuchadnezzar, your father the king, appointed him master of the horoscopists, conjurers, Chaldeans, <hi>and</hi> fortune-tellers,

verses.name: Daniel 5:12
verses.text: because an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, explaining of dreams, and revealing of hard sentences, and the unraveling of knots, were found in this Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will reveal the meaning.

verses.name: Daniel 5:13
verses.text: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, Are you that Daniel who <hi>is</hi> of the exiled sons of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

verses.name: Daniel 5:14
verses.text: I have even heard of you, that the spirit of the gods <hi>is</hi> in you, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom are found in you.

verses.name: Daniel 5:15
verses.text: And now the wise men and the conjurers have been brought in before me, that they might read this writing and make the meaning known to me. But they could not declare the meaning of the thing.

verses.name: Daniel 5:16
verses.text: And I have heard of you that you can interpret meanings and unravel knots. Now if you can read the writing, and reveal its meaning to me, you shall be clothed with scarlet and <hi>have</hi> a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 5:17
verses.text: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Yet I will read the writing to the king, and make the meaning known to him.

verses.name: Daniel 5:18
verses.text: O king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honor.

verses.name: Daniel 5:19
verses.text: And for the majesty that He gave him, all people, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he would, and whom he would he kept alive. And whom he would, he set up; and whom he would, he put down.

verses.name: Daniel 5:20
verses.text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was put down from the throne of his kingdom, and they took his glory from him.

verses.name: Daniel 5:21
verses.text: And he was driven from the sons of men. And his heart was made like the animals, and his dwelling <hi>was</hi> with the wild asses. They fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the heavens, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that He appoints over it whomever He will.

verses.name: Daniel 5:22
verses.text: And you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this.

verses.name: Daniel 5:23
verses.text: But you have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven. And they have brought the vessels of His house before you; and you, and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. And you have praised the gods of silver, and gold, or bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which do not see, nor hear, nor know. And you have not glorified the God in whose hand <hi>is</hi> your breath and all your ways.

verses.name: Daniel 5:24
verses.text: Then the part of the hand was sent from Him. And this writing was written.

verses.name: Daniel 5:25
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> the writing that was written, A MINA, A MINA, A SHEKEL, AND HALF-MINAS.

verses.name: Daniel 5:26
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the meaning of the thing: A MINA, God has numbered your kingdom and finished it.

verses.name: Daniel 5:27
verses.text: A SHEKEL, You are weighed in the balances and found wanting.

verses.name: Daniel 5:28
verses.text: HALF-MINAS, Your kingdom is divided and given to <hi>the</hi> Medes and Persians.

verses.name: Daniel 5:29
verses.text: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet and a golden chain around his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 5:30
verses.text: In that night Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans was killed.

verses.name: Daniel 5:31
verses.text: And Darius the Mede took the kingdom, being a son of sixty-two years <hi>of age</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:1
verses.text: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom a hundred and twenty satraps, that they might be over the whole kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 6:2
verses.text: And over them <hi>were</hi> three presidents (Daniel was one of them), so that these satraps might give account to them, and the king should have no loss.

verses.name: Daniel 6:3
verses.text: Then this Daniel was made overseer of the presidents and satraps, because an excellent spirit <hi>was</hi> in him. And the king was planning to set him over all the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 6:4
verses.text: Then the presidents and rulers sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom. But they could find no occasion or fault, because he <hi>was</hi> faithful. Neither <hi>was</hi> there any error or fault found in him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:5
verses.text: Then these men said, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:6
verses.text: Then these presidents and rulers assembled to the king, and said this to him: King Darius, live forever.

verses.name: Daniel 6:7
verses.text: All the presidents of the kingdom, the prefects, and the satraps, and the officials and governors, have planned together to establish a royal law, and to make a strong ban that whoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except from you, O king, he shall be thrown into the den of lions.

verses.name: Daniel 6:8
verses.text: Now, O king, establish the ban and sign the writing, so that it may not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians which cannot be changed.

verses.name: Daniel 6:9
verses.text: Therefore king Darius signed the writing and the ban.

verses.name: Daniel 6:10
verses.text: And when he had learned that the document was signed, Daniel went to his house. And his windows were open in his roof room toward Jerusalem; and he kneeled on his knees three times a day and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:11
verses.text: Then these men assembled and found Daniel praying and confessing before his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:12
verses.text: Then they came near and spoke before the king concerning the king's ban. Have you not signed a ban that every man who shall ask a petition of any god or man within thirty days, except of you, O king, shall be thrown into the lion's den? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be changed.

verses.name: Daniel 6:13
verses.text: Then they answered and said before the king, Daniel, who <hi>is</hi> of the exiled sons of Judah, has not respected you, O king, nor the ban that you have signed, but makes his prayer three times a day.

verses.name: Daniel 6:14
verses.text: Then the king, when he heard the word, was very much displeased with himself. And he set <hi>his</hi> heart on Daniel to deliver him. And he labored until sundown to deliver him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:15
verses.text: Then these men met before the king and said to the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians <hi>is</hi> that no ban nor law which the king establishes may be changed.

verses.name: Daniel 6:16
verses.text: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel and threw him into the lions' den. The king answered and said to Daniel, Your God, whom you always serve, will deliver you.

verses.name: Daniel 6:17
verses.text: And a stone was brought and laid on the mouth of the den. And the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords, that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:18
verses.text: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting. And diversions were not brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.

verses.name: Daniel 6:19
verses.text: Then the king arose very early in the morning and hurried to the lions' den.

verses.name: Daniel 6:20
verses.text: And when he came to the den, he cried with a grieved voice to Daniel. The king spoke and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God whom you always serve able to deliver you from the lions?

verses.name: Daniel 6:21
verses.text: Then Daniel said to the king, O king, live forever.

verses.name: Daniel 6:22
verses.text: My God has sent His Angel, and has shut the lions' mouths, and they have not hurt me, because before Him purity was found in me. And also before you, O king, I have done no harm.

verses.name: Daniel 6:23
verses.text: Then the king was exceedingly glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of hurt was found on him, because he trusted in his God.

verses.name: Daniel 6:24
verses.text: And the king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they threw <hi>them</hi> into the lions' den; them, their sons, and their wives. And the lions overpowered them and broke all their bones in pieces before they came to the bottom of the den.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 6:25
verses.text: Then king Darius wrote to all people, nations, and languages who dwell in all the earth. Peace be multiplied to you.

verses.name: Daniel 6:26
verses.text: I make a decree that in all the domain of my kingdom, <hi>there</hi> shall be trembling and fear before the God of Daniel. For He <hi>is</hi> the living God, and endures forever, and His kingdom is that which shall not be destroyed, and His rule <hi>shall be</hi> to the end.

verses.name: Daniel 6:27
verses.text: He delivers and rescues, and He works signs and wonders in the heavens and in earth, He who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

verses.name: Daniel 6:28
verses.text: And this Daniel was blessed in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:1
verses.text: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and gave the sum of the matters.

verses.name: Daniel 7:2
verses.text: Daniel spoke and said, In my vision by night I was looking: and behold, the four winds of the heavens were stirring up the Great Sea.

verses.name: Daniel 7:3
verses.text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, different from one another.

verses.name: Daniel 7:4
verses.text: The first was like a lion and had eagle's wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on its feet like a man. And a man's heart was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:5
verses.text: And behold another beast, a second, like a bear. And it raised itself up on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. And they said this to it: Arise, eat up much flesh.

verses.name: Daniel 7:6
verses.text: After this I saw, and lo, another, like a leopard, which <hi>had</hi> four wings of a bird on its back. The beast also <hi>had</hi> four heads; and rulership was given to it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:7
verses.text: After this I looked in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, fearful and terrible, and very strong. And it <hi>had</hi> great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the rest with its feet. And it <hi>was</hi> different from all the beasts before it; and it had ten horns.

verses.name: Daniel 7:8
verses.text: I was thinking about the horns, and behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom three of the first horns were uprooted. And behold, in this horn <hi>were</hi> eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:9
verses.text: I watched until the thrones were thrown up, and the Ancient of Days sat, whose robe <hi>was</hi> white as snow, and the hair of His head like the pure wool. His throne <hi>was</hi> like flames of fire, and His wheels <hi>like</hi> burning fire.

verses.name: Daniel 7:10
verses.text: A stream of fire went out and came out from before Him. A thousand thousands served Him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before Him. The judgment was set, and the books were opened.

verses.name: Daniel 7:11
verses.text: Then I was looking because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke. I watched until the beast was slain, and his body was destroyed and given to the burning flame.

verses.name: Daniel 7:12
verses.text: And the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away. Yet their lives were made longer for a season and time.

verses.name: Daniel 7:13
verses.text: I saw in the night visions, and behold, <hi>One</hi> like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of Days, and they brought Him near before Him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:14
verses.text: And dominion and glory was given Him, and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations and languages, should serve Him. His dominion <hi>is</hi> an everlasting dominion which shall not pass away, and His kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 7:15
verses.text: I Daniel was distressed in My spirit in its sheath, and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.name: Daniel 7:16
verses.text: And I came near one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the meaning of the things.

verses.name: Daniel 7:17
verses.text: These four great beasts <hi>are</hi> four kings; they shall arise out of the earth.

verses.name: Daniel 7:18
verses.text: But the saints of the Most High shall take the kingdom and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.

verses.name: Daniel 7:19
verses.text: Then I wanted to know the truth of the fourth beast, which <hi>was</hi> different from all the others, very frightening, whose teeth <hi>were of</hi> iron, and his nails of bronze; <hi>who</hi> devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the rest with his feet;

verses.name: Daniel 7:20
verses.text: and of the ten horns that were in his head, and <hi>of</hi> the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even <hi>of</hi> that horn that had eyes, and a mouth speaking very great things, whose look <hi>was</hi> greater than his fellows.

verses.name: Daniel 7:21
verses.text: I watched, and that horn made war with the saints and overcame them

verses.name: Daniel 7:22
verses.text: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High. And the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 7:23
verses.text: And he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom on earth, which shall be different from all kingdoms and shall devour the whole earth, and shall trample it and crush it.

verses.name: Daniel 7:24
verses.text: And the ten horns out of this kingdom <hi>are</hi> ten kings that shall arise. And another shall arise after them. And he shall be different from the first, and he shall humble three kings.

verses.name: Daniel 7:25
verses.text: And he shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High, and plot to change times and laws. And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and one-half time.

verses.name: Daniel 7:26
verses.text: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his rulership, to cut off and to destroy until the end.

verses.name: Daniel 7:27
verses.text: And the kingdom and rulership, and the greatness of the kingdom under all the heavens, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High, whose kingdom <hi>is</hi> an everlasting kingdom. And all kingdoms shall serve and obey Him.

verses.name: Daniel 7:28
verses.text: Here <hi>is</hi> the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my thoughts troubled me much, and my face changed on me. But I kept the matter in my heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:1
verses.text: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, <hi>to</hi> me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

verses.name: Daniel 8:2
verses.text: And in a vision I looked. And it happened when I looked, I <hi>was</hi> at Shushan the palace, which <hi>is</hi> in the province of Elam. And in a vision I looked, and I was by the Ulai Canal.

verses.name: Daniel 8:3
