verses.text: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked. And behold, a ram with <hi>two</hi> horns stood before the Canal <hi>having</hi> two horns, and the <hi>two</hi> horns were high, but one <hi>was</hi> higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

verses.name: Daniel 8:4
verses.text: I saw the ram pushing westward and northward and southward; so that no beasts could stand before him, nor any that could deliver out of his hand. But he did according to his will, and became great.

verses.name: Daniel 8:5
verses.text: And as I was watching, behold, a he-goat came from the west, over the face of the all earth, and did not touch the ground. And the he goat <hi>had</hi> an outstanding horn between his eyes.

verses.name: Daniel 8:6
verses.text: And he came to the ram that <hi>had two</hi> horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran to him in the fury of his power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:7
verses.text: And I saw him come close beside the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram and shattered his two horns. And there was no power in the ram to stand before him. But he threw him down to the ground and stamped on him. And none could deliver the ram out of his hand.

verses.name: Daniel 8:8
verses.text: Then the he-goat became very great. And when he was strong, the great horn was broken. And in its place came up four outstanding <hi>ones</hi> towards the four winds of the heavens.

verses.name: Daniel 8:9
verses.text: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which became very great, toward the south and toward the east and toward the bountiful <hi>land</hi>.

verses.name: Daniel 8:10
verses.text: And it became great, <hi>even</hi> to the host of heaven. And it made fall some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and trampled them.

verses.name: Daniel 8:11
verses.text: Yea, he magnified himself, even to the ruler of the host, and the daily <hi>sacrifice</hi> was taken away by him, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

verses.name: Daniel 8:12
verses.text: And an army was given <hi>to him</hi> against the daily <hi>sacrifice</hi> because of transgression, and it cast the truth to the ground. And it worked and succeeded.

verses.name: Daniel 8:13
verses.text: Then I heard a certain holy one speaking, and another holy one said to that one who spoke, Until when shall the vision last, concerning the daily <hi>sacrifice</hi> and the transgression that astounds, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled?

verses.name: Daniel 8:14
verses.text: And he said to me, For two thousand, three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary shall be vindicated.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 8:15
verses.text: And it happened when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me the form of a man.

verses.name: Daniel 8:16
verses.text: And I heard a man's voice between <hi>the banks of</hi> Ulai, which called and said, Gabriel, make this one understand the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 8:17
verses.text: So he came near beside my place. And when he came, I was afraid and fell on my face. But he said to me, Understand, O son of man, for the vision <hi>is</hi> for the time of the end.

verses.name: Daniel 8:18
verses.text: And as he was speaking with me, I was stunned, on my face toward the ground. But he touched me and set me upright.

verses.name: Daniel 8:19
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I will make you know what shall happen in the last end of the indignation. For <hi>it is</hi> for the time appointed for the end.

verses.name: Daniel 8:20
verses.text: The ram which you saw having two horns <hi>are</hi> the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.name: Daniel 8:21
verses.text: And the shaggy goat <hi>is</hi> the king of Greece. And the great horn between his eyes is the first king.

verses.name: Daniel 8:22
verses.text: And as for that being broken, and four stood up in its place; four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in its power.

verses.name: Daniel 8:23
verses.text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king, fierce of face, and skilled at intrigues, shall stand up.

verses.name: Daniel 8:24
verses.text: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power. And he shall destroy marvelously, and shall prosper and work, and destroy the mighty and the holy people.

verses.name: Daniel 8:25
verses.text: And also through his understanding, he shall cause deceit to succeed in his hand. And he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many. He also shall stand up against the Ruler of rulers. But he shall be broken without a hand.

verses.name: Daniel 8:26
verses.text: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told <hi>is</hi> true. But you shall shut up the vision; for it <hi>shall be</hi> for many days.

verses.name: Daniel 8:27
verses.text: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick <hi>for</hi> days. Afterward I rose up, and did the king's business. And I was amazed at the vision, but there was no understanding.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:1
verses.text: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans,

verses.name: Daniel 9:2
verses.text: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood the number of the years by books, which came of the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Daniel 9:3
verses.text: And I set my face toward the Lord God, to seek by prayer and holy desires, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:4
verses.text: And I prayed to the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and awesome God, keeping the covenant and mercy to those who love Him, and to those who keep His commandments,

verses.name: Daniel 9:5
verses.text: we have sinned and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from Your commandments and from Your judgments.

verses.name: Daniel 9:6
verses.text: Neither have we listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, our rulers, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

verses.name: Daniel 9:7
verses.text: O Lord, righteousness <hi>belongs</hi> to You, but to us the shame of <hi>our</hi> faces, as <hi>it is</hi> today to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem, and to all Israel who are near and who are afar off, through all the countries where You have driven them because of their sin which they have sinned against You.

verses.name: Daniel 9:8
verses.text: O Lord, shame of face <hi>belongs</hi> to us, to our kings, to our rulers, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against You.

verses.name: Daniel 9:9
verses.text: To the Lord our God <hi>belong</hi> mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against Him.

verses.name: Daniel 9:10
verses.text: We have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in His laws which He set before us by His servants the prophets.

verses.name: Daniel 9:11
verses.text: Yea, all Israel has transgressed Your law, and turned aside, that they might not obey Your voice. Therefore the curse has been poured out on us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against Him.

verses.name: Daniel 9:12
verses.text: And He has confirmed His words which He spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil. For under all the heavens <hi>it</hi> has not been done as <hi>it</hi> has been done to Jerusalem.

verses.name: Daniel 9:13
verses.text: As <hi>it is</hi> written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we did not make our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand Your truth.

verses.name: Daniel 9:14
verses.text: Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and has brought it on us. For the LORD our God <hi>is</hi> righteous in all His works which He does; for we did not obey His voice.

verses.name: Daniel 9:15
verses.text: And now, O Lord our God, who have brought Your people out from the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have brought fame to Yourself, as it is today, we have sinned, we have done wrong.

verses.name: Daniel 9:16
verses.text: O Lord, I pray You, according to all Your righteousness let Your anger and Your fury be turned away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain. Because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people <hi>have become</hi> a curse to all those who are around us.

verses.name: Daniel 9:17
verses.text: And now, O our God, hear the prayer of Your servant, and his holy desires, and cause Your face to shine on Your sanctuary that <hi>is</hi> desolate, for the Lord's sake.

verses.name: Daniel 9:18
verses.text: O my God, bow down Your ear and hear. Open Your eyes and behold our ruins, and the city which is called by Your name. For we do not present our prayers before You on account of our righteousnesses, but because of Your great mercies.

verses.name: Daniel 9:19
verses.text: O LORD, hear; O LORD, forgive; O LORD, listen and do. Do not delay, for Your own sake, O my God; for Your city and Your people are called by Your name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 9:20
verses.text: And while I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin, and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my cry before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

verses.name: Daniel 9:21
verses.text: yes, while I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, touched me in <hi>my</hi> severe exhaustion, about the time of the evening sacrifice.

verses.name: Daniel 9:22
verses.text: And he enlightened me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I have now come out to give you skill and understanding.

verses.name: Daniel 9:23
verses.text: At the beginning of your prayers the commandment came out, and I have come to explain. For you are greatly beloved; therefore understand the matter, and attend to the vision:

verses.name: Daniel 9:24
verses.text: Seventy weeks are decreed as to your people and as to your holy city, to finish the transgression and to make an end of sins, and to make atonement for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy.

verses.name: Daniel 9:25
verses.text: Know therefore and understand, <hi>that</hi> from the going out of the command to restore and to build Jerusalem, to Messiah <hi>the</hi> Prince, shall be seven weeks, and sixty-two weeks. The street shall be built again, and the wall, even in times of affliction.

verses.name: Daniel 9:26
verses.text: And after sixty-two weeks Messiah shall be cut off, but not <hi>for</hi> Himself. And the people of the ruler who shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary. And the end of it <hi>shall be</hi> with the flood, and ruins are determined, until <hi>the</hi> end <hi>shall be</hi> war.

verses.name: Daniel 9:27
verses.text: And he shall confirm a covenant with many <hi>for</hi> one week. And in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease, and on a corner <hi>of the altar</hi> desolating abominations, even until <hi>the</hi> end. And that which was decreed shall be poured on the desolator.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:1
verses.text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar. And the thing was true, and a great conflict. And he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

verses.name: Daniel 10:2
verses.text: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three full weeks.

verses.name: Daniel 10:3
verses.text: I ate no food for delight, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

verses.name: Daniel 10:4
verses.text: And in the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which <hi>is</hi> Tigris,

verses.name: Daniel 10:5
verses.text: then I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, a certain man was clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz.

verses.name: Daniel 10:6
verses.text: His body also <hi>was</hi> like the beryl, and his face looked like lightning. And his eyes <hi>were</hi> like lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet in color were like polished bronze, and the voice of his words like the sound of a multitude.

verses.name: Daniel 10:7
verses.text: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision. For the men who were with me did not see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

verses.name: Daniel 10:8
verses.text: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me. For my beauty was turned within me to corruption, and I kept no strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:9
verses.text: Yet I heard the voice of his words. And when I heard the voice of his words, then I was in a deep sleep on my face, and my face <hi>was</hi> toward the ground.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 10:10
verses.text: And behold, a hand touched me, which set me shaking on my knees and the palms of my hands.

verses.name: Daniel 10:11
verses.text: And he said to me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright. For to you I am now sent. And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

verses.name: Daniel 10:12
verses.text: Then he said to me, Do not fear, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand and to chasten yourself before your God, your words were heard. And I have come for your words.

verses.name: Daniel 10:13
verses.text: But the ruler of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days. But lo, Michael, one of the chief rulers, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

verses.name: Daniel 10:14
verses.text: Now I have come to make you understand what shall happen to your people in the latter days. For the vision is yet for <hi>many</hi> days.

verses.name: Daniel 10:15
verses.text: And when he had spoken such words to me, I bowed my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

verses.name: Daniel 10:16
verses.text: And behold, one looking like the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth and spoke and said to him who stood before me, O lord, my sorrows are turned on me by the vision, and I have kept no strength.

verses.name: Daniel 10:17
verses.text: For how can the servant of my lord talk with my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me, nor is there breath left in me.

verses.name: Daniel 10:18
verses.text: Then again <hi>one</hi> like a man in form came and touched me, and he made me stronger

verses.name: Daniel 10:19
verses.text: and said, O man greatly beloved, do not fear. Peace to you; be strong; yes, be strong. And when he had spoken to me, I was made stronger, and <hi>I</hi> said, Speak my lord, for you have made me stronger.

verses.name: Daniel 10:20
verses.text: Then he said, Do you know why I come to you? And now I will return to fight with the ruler of Persia. And when I have gone out, lo, the ruler of Greece shall come.

verses.name: Daniel 10:21
verses.text: But I will show you that which is written in the Scripture of Truth. And there is none who holds strongly with me in these things, but Michael your ruler.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:1
verses.text: And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I was standing for a supporter and for a fortress for him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:2
verses.text: And now I will declare to you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia. And the fourth shall be far richer than all of them. And by his strength, through his riches, he shall stir up all against the kingdom of Greece.

verses.name: Daniel 11:3
verses.text: And a mighty king shall stand up, one who shall rule with great power and do according to his will.

verses.name: Daniel 11:4
verses.text: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken and shall be divided toward the four winds of the heavens. And it shall not be given to his sons, nor according to his power with which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be pulled up, even for others besides these.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:5
verses.text: And the king of the south shall be strong. And <hi>one</hi> of his rulers, even he shall overcome him and have power. His kingdom <hi>shall be</hi> a great kingdom.

verses.name: Daniel 11:6
verses.text: And in the end of years they shall join together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make a treaty. But she shall not keep the power of the arm. Nor shall he stand, nor his arm. But she <hi>shall be</hi> given up, and those who brought her in, and her begetter, and he who made her strong in <hi>these</hi> times.

verses.name: Daniel 11:7
verses.text: But out of a branch of her roots, one shall stand up <hi>in</hi> his place, who shall come with an army and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north. And he shall act against them, and show himself strong.

verses.name: Daniel 11:8
verses.text: And he shall also carry their gods captives with their molten images into Egypt, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold. And he shall stand <hi>for</hi> years away from the king of the north.

verses.name: Daniel 11:9
verses.text: So the king of the south shall come into <hi>his</hi> kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

verses.name: Daniel 11:10
verses.text: But his sons shall be stirred up and shall gather a multitude of great forces. And <hi>one</hi> shall certainly come and overflow, and pass through. Then he shall return and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

verses.name: Daniel 11:11
verses.text: And the king of the south shall be bitter, and shall come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. And he shall send out a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

verses.name: Daniel 11:12
verses.text: And when he has taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up. And he shall cast down many ten thousands, but he shall not be made stronger.

verses.name: Daniel 11:13
verses.text: For the king of the north shall return, and shall send out a multitude greater than the former, and at the end of times, years, shall come with a great army and with much equipment.

verses.name: Daniel 11:14
verses.text: And in those times there shall stand up many against the king of the south. Also the robbers of your people shall rise up to establish <hi>the</hi> vision, but they shall fall.

verses.name: Daniel 11:15
verses.text: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a siege mound, and take a fortified city. And the arms of the south shall not hold out, nor his chosen people, nor <hi>will be</hi> any strength to hold out.

verses.name: Daniel 11:16
verses.text: But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him. And he shall stand in the glorious land, which <hi>shall be</hi> destroyed by his hand.

verses.name: Daniel 11:17
verses.text: He also shall set his face to enter with the strength of all his kingdom, and upright ones with him. So he shall do. And <hi>he</hi> shall give the daughter of women to him, to destroy it; but she shall not stand, nor be for him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:18
verses.text: And he shall turn his face to the coastlands, and shall capture many. But a ruler shall make cease his reproach for him, but his reproach will return to him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:19
verses.text: And he shall turn his face to the fortresses of his land. But he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.

verses.name: Daniel 11:20
verses.text: And one who sends an exacter shall stand in his place, <hi>for</hi> the glory of <hi>the</hi> kingdom. But within few days he shall be broken, not in anger nor in battle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 11:21
verses.text: And a despised one shall stand up in his place, and they shall not give to him the honor of the king; but he will enter while at ease and seize <hi>the</hi> kingdom by intrigues.

verses.name: Daniel 11:22
verses.text: And the forces of the overflow will be swept from before him, and they will be broken, and also the ruler of a covenant.

verses.name: Daniel 11:23
verses.text: And after they join him, he will practice deceit. For he will come and be strong with a few people.

verses.name: Daniel 11:24
verses.text: He shall enter safely, even into the rich places of <hi>the</hi> province. And he shall do what his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers. He shall plunder, and spoil, and scatter goods among them. And he shall devise his plots against the strongholds, even for a time.

verses.name: Daniel 11:25
verses.text: And he shall stir up his power and his heart against the king of the south with a great army. And the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army, but he shall not stand. For they shall devise plots against him.

verses.name: Daniel 11:26
verses.text: Yea, those who eat his food shall break him, and his army shall overflow. And many shall fall down slain.

verses.name: Daniel 11:27
verses.text: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do evil, and they shall speak lies at one table. But it shall not succeed. For still <hi>the</hi> end <hi>comes</hi> at the time appointed.

verses.name: Daniel 11:28
verses.text: And he shall return to his land with great riches. And his heart <hi>shall be</hi> against <hi>the</hi> holy covenant. And he will act, and he shall return to his land.

verses.name: Daniel 11:29
verses.text: At the time appointed he shall return and come against the south. But it shall not be as the former or as the latter.

verses.name: Daniel 11:30
verses.text: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him. And he shall be grieved and return, and have fury against the holy covenant. So he shall do; he shall even return and give heed to those who forsake the holy covenant.

verses.name: Daniel 11:31
verses.text: And forces will stand from him, and they will profane the sanctuary, the fortress, and shall remove the daily <hi>sacrifice</hi>, and they shall place the desolating abomination.

verses.name: Daniel 11:32
verses.text: And he will ruin by flattery those who do evil against <hi>the</hi> covenant. But the people who know their God will be strong and will work.

verses.name: Daniel 11:33
verses.text: And those who understand among <hi>the</hi> people shall teach many; yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by exile, and spoil, for days.

verses.name: Daniel 11:34
verses.text: And when they stumble, they shall be helped with a little help, but many will join them, with hypocrisy.

verses.name: Daniel 11:35
verses.text: And <hi>many</hi> of those who understand shall stumble, to refine and purge them, and <hi>to</hi> make white, to the time of <hi>the</hi> end. Because <hi>it is</hi> still for the appointed time.

verses.name: Daniel 11:36
verses.text: And the king shall do according to his will. And he shall exalt and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvelous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper until the fury is fulfilled. For that which is decreed shall be done.

verses.name: Daniel 11:37
verses.text: He will not regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god. For he shall magnify himself above all.

verses.name: Daniel 11:38
verses.text: But in his place he shall honor the god of forces; and a god whom his fathers did not know, he shall honor with gold and silver, and with precious stones and desirable things.

verses.name: Daniel 11:39
verses.text: So he shall act in the fortresses of <hi>the</hi> strongholds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge. He shall multiply in glory, and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for a price.

verses.name: Daniel 11:40
verses.text: And at the end-time, the king of the south shall butt at him. And the king of the north shall come against him like a tempest, with chariots and with horsemen and with many ships.

verses.name: Daniel 11:41
verses.text: And he shall enter into the countries and shall overflow and pass over. He shall also enter into the glorious land, and many shall be stumbled. But these shall escape out of his hand: Edom and Moab, and the chief of the sons of Ammon.

verses.name: Daniel 11:42
verses.text: And he shall stretch out his hand on the lands. And the land of Egypt shall not escape.

verses.name: Daniel 11:43
verses.text: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. And the Libyans and the Ethiopians <hi>shall be</hi> at his steps.

verses.name: Daniel 11:44
verses.text: But news out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him. Then he will go out with great fury to destroy, and to devote many to destruction.

verses.name: Daniel 11:45
verses.text: And he shall plant his palace tents between <hi>the</hi> seas in the glorious holy mountain. Yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:1
verses.text: And at that time Michael shall stand up, the great ruler who stands for the sons of your people. And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation; until that time. And at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

verses.name: Daniel 12:2
verses.text: And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame <hi>and</hi> everlasting contempt.

verses.name: Daniel 12:3
verses.text: And those who are wise shall shine as the brightness of the sky; and those who turn many to righteousness shall shine as the stars forever and ever.

verses.name: Daniel 12:4
verses.text: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Daniel 12:5
verses.text: Then I Daniel looked, and behold, there stood another two, the one on this <hi>side</hi>, and the one on that <hi>side</hi> of the bank of the river.

verses.name: Daniel 12:6
verses.text: And <hi>one</hi> said to the man clothed in linen on the waters of the river: Until when <hi>shall be</hi> the end of these wonders?

verses.name: Daniel 12:7
verses.text: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who <hi>was</hi> on the waters of the river, when he held up his right and his left <hi>hand</hi> to Heaven, and swore by Him who lives forever that it <hi>shall be</hi> for a time, times, and a half. And when they have made an end of scattering the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

verses.name: Daniel 12:8
verses.text: And I heard, but I did not understand. Then I said, O my lord, what <hi>shall be</hi> the end of these things?

verses.name: Daniel 12:9
verses.text: And He said, Go, Daniel! For the words <hi>are</hi> closed up and sealed until the end-time.

verses.name: Daniel 12:10
verses.text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried. But the wicked shall do wickedly. And none of the wicked shall understand, but the wise shall understand.

verses.name: Daniel 12:11
verses.text: And from the time that the daily <hi>sacrifice</hi> shall be taken away, and the desolating abomination set up, a thousand two hundred and ninety days <hi>shall occur</hi>.

verses.name: Daniel 12:12
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who waits and comes to the thousand three hundred and thirty-five days.

verses.name: Daniel 12:13
verses.text: But you go on to the end, for you shall rest and stand in your lot at the end of the days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz <hi>and</hi> Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:2
verses.text: The beginning of the LORD speaking by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take to yourself a wife of adultery and children of adultery. For the land has utterly gone lusting away from the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 1:3
verses.text: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, who conceived and bore him a son.

verses.name: Hosea 1:4
verses.text: And the LORD said to him, Call his name God Will Sow. For still <hi>in</hi> a little <hi>while</hi>, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

verses.name: Hosea 1:5
verses.text: And it shall be, at that day I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.name: Hosea 1:6
verses.text: And she conceived again and bore a daughter. And <hi>God</hi> said to him, Call her name No-mercy, for I will no more have mercy <hi>on</hi> the house of Israel. But I will utterly take them away.

verses.name: Hosea 1:7
verses.text: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 1:8
verses.text: And when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived and bore a son.

verses.name: Hosea 1:9
verses.text: And He said, Call his name Not-my-people. For you <hi>are</hi> not My people, and I will not be for you.

verses.name: Hosea 1:10
verses.text: Yet the number of the sons of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered. And it shall be, in the place where it was said to them, You <hi>are</hi> not My people, there it shall be said to them, <hi> You are</hi> the sons of the living God.

verses.name: Hosea 1:11
verses.text: Then the sons of Judah and the sons of Israel shall be gathered together, and shall set over themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land. For great <hi>shall be</hi> the day of Jezreel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:1
verses.text: Say to your brothers, A People; and to your sisters, Mercy.

verses.name: Hosea 2:2
verses.text: Contend! Contend with your mother, for she <hi>is</hi> not my wife, nor am I her husband. Let her therefore put away her fornications out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts,

verses.name: Hosea 2:3
verses.text: lest I strip her naked and set her out as in the day that she was born; and lest I make her as the wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

verses.name: Hosea 2:4
verses.text: And I will not have mercy on her sons, for they <hi>are</hi> the sons of adulteries.

verses.name: Hosea 2:5
verses.text: For their mother has prostituted <hi>herself</hi>. She who conceived them has done shamefully. For she said, I will go after my lovers who give my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:6
verses.text: Therefore behold, I will hedge your way with thorns, and wall up her wall, that she shall not find her paths.

verses.name: Hosea 2:7
verses.text: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them. She shall seek them, but shall not find <hi>them</hi>. Then she shall say, I will go and return to my first husband, for then <hi>it was</hi> better with me than now.

verses.name: Hosea 2:8
verses.text: For she did not know that I gave her grain, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, <hi>which</hi> they prepared for Baal.

verses.name: Hosea 2:9
verses.text: So I will return and take away My grain in its time, and my wine in its season, and will recover my wool and my flax <hi>given</hi> to cover her nakedness.

verses.name: Hosea 2:10
verses.text: And now I will uncover her shamefulness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.

verses.name: Hosea 2:11
verses.text: I will also cause all her joy to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her appointed feasts.

verses.name: Hosea 2:12
verses.text: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, of which she has said, They <hi>are</hi> my rewards that my lovers have given me. And I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

verses.name: Hosea 2:13
verses.text: And I will visit on her the days of the Baals, in which she burned incense to them, and she adorned herself with her nose-rings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers and forgot Me, says the LORD.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:14
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will lure her and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably to her.

verses.name: Hosea 2:15
verses.text: And I will give her vineyards to her from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope. And she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.name: Hosea 2:16
verses.text: And it shall be at that day, says the LORD, you shall call Me, My Husband, and shall no more call Me, My Baal.

verses.name: Hosea 2:17
verses.text: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no more be remembered by their name.

verses.name: Hosea 2:18
verses.text: And in that day I will cut a covenant for them, with the beasts of the field, and with the birds of the heavens, and <hi>with</hi> the creeping things of the ground. And I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

verses.name: Hosea 2:19
verses.text: And I will betroth you to Me forever. Yea, I will betroth you to Me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loving-kindness, and in mercies.

verses.name: Hosea 2:20
verses.text: I will even betroth you to Me in faithfulness. And you shall know the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 2:21
verses.text: And it will be, in that day I will answer, says the LORD. I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth,

verses.name: Hosea 2:22
verses.text: and the earth shall hear the grain and the wine and the oil. And they shall hear Jezreel.

verses.name: Hosea 2:23
verses.text: And I will sow her to Me in the earth. And I will have mercy on No-mercy. And I will say to Not-my-people, You are My people. And they shall say, My God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:1
verses.text: And the LORD said to me, Go again. Love a woman beloved by a friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the sons of Israel, who turn to other gods, and love raisin-cakes of grapes.

verses.name: Hosea 3:2
verses.text: So I bought her to me for fifteen <hi>pieces of</hi> silver, and <hi>for</hi> a homer of barley and a half homer of barley.

verses.name: Hosea 3:3
verses.text: And I said to her, You shall abide for me many days. You shall not be a harlot, nor be for a man. And I also <hi>will be</hi> for you.

verses.name: Hosea 3:4
verses.text: For the sons of Israel shall live many days <hi>with</hi> no king, and no ruler, and with no sacrifice, and no pillars, and no ephod, or teraphim.

verses.name: Hosea 3:5
verses.text: Afterward the sons of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. And they shall fear the LORD and His goodness in the ends of the days.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:1
verses.text: Hear the word of the LORD, sons of Israel. For the LORD <hi>has</hi> a quarrel with the people of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

verses.name: Hosea 4:2
verses.text: There is lying, and swearing, and killing, and stealing, and the committing of adultery; and blood touches blood.

verses.name: Hosea 4:3
verses.text: Therefore the land shall mourn, and everyone who dwells in it shall droop, with the beasts of the field and with the birds of the heavens. Yes, the fish of the sea shall also be taken away.

verses.name: Hosea 4:4
verses.text: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another. For your people <hi>are</hi> as those who strive with the priest.

verses.name: Hosea 4:5
verses.text: And you shall stumble in the day, and the prophet also shall stumble with you <hi>in the</hi> night, and I will cut off your mother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:6
verses.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you from being priest to Me. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your sons, even I.

verses.name: Hosea 4:7
verses.text: As they were increased, so they sinned against Me. I will change their glory into shame.

verses.name: Hosea 4:8
verses.text: They eat up the sin of My people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

verses.name: Hosea 4:9
verses.text: And it has become, Like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them for their doings.

verses.name: Hosea 4:10
verses.text: For they shall eat and not have enough. They shall fornicate and not increase, because they have stopped taking heed to the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 4:11
verses.text: Fornication and wine and new wine take away the heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:12
verses.text: My people seek advice from their wooden <hi>idols</hi>, and their rod declares to them. For the spirit of harlotry has caused them to go astray, and they have gone lusting away from under their God.

verses.name: Hosea 4:13
verses.text: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because its shade is good. So your daughters shall be harlots, and your brides shall commit adultery.

verses.name: Hosea 4:14
verses.text: I will not punish your daughters when they fornicate, nor your wives when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go aside with harlots, and they sacrifice with temple prostitutes. The people <hi>who</hi> do not understand are thrown down.

verses.name: Hosea 4:15
verses.text: Though you, Israel, fornicate, yet do not let Judah become guilty. And do not come <hi>to</hi> Gilgal, nor go up to Beth-aven, nor swear, <hi>As</hi> the LORD lives.

verses.name: Hosea 4:16
verses.text: For Israel slides back like a backsliding heifer. Now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

verses.name: Hosea 4:17
verses.text: Ephraim <hi>is</hi> joined to idols; let him alone.

verses.name: Hosea 4:18
verses.text: Their drink is sour; they are continually fornicating; her rulers dearly love shame.

verses.name: Hosea 4:19
verses.text: The wind has bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:1
verses.text: Hear this, O priests, and listen, house of Israel. And give ear, house of the king. For judgment <hi>is</hi> toward you, because you have been a snare on Mizpah and a net spread on Tabor.

verses.name: Hosea 5:2
verses.text: And revolters have gone deep <hi>in</hi> slaughtering, and I chasten all of them.

verses.name: Hosea 5:3
verses.text: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me. For now, O Ephraim, you have fornicated; Israel is defiled.

verses.name: Hosea 5:4
verses.text: Their doings will not allow <hi>them</hi> to turn to their God; for the spirit of fornication <hi>is</hi> in their midst, and they have not known the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 5:5
verses.text: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face. So Israel and Ephraim shall fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

verses.name: Hosea 5:6
verses.text: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find Him. He has withdrawn Himself from them.

verses.name: Hosea 5:7
verses.text: They have acted treacherously against the LORD, for they have brought out strange sons. Now a new moon shall devour them with their portions.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:8
verses.text: Blow the horn in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah; cry aloud at Beth-aven, after you, O Benjamin.

verses.name: Hosea 5:9
verses.text: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I have made known that which is confirmed.

verses.name: Hosea 5:10
verses.text: The rulers of Judah were like movers of a border; I will pour out My wrath on them like water.

verses.name: Hosea 5:11
verses.text: Ephraim <hi>is</hi> crushed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

verses.name: Hosea 5:12
verses.text: Therefore I <hi>am</hi> as a moth to Ephraim, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

verses.name: Hosea 5:13
verses.text: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then Ephraim went to the Assyrian and sent to king Jareb. Yet he could not heal you nor cure you of your wound.

verses.name: Hosea 5:14
verses.text: For I <hi>will be</hi> to Ephraim as a lion, and as a strong lion to the house of Judah. I, <hi>even</hi> I, will tear and go away. I will take away, and none shall rescue him.

verses.name: Hosea 5:15
verses.text: I will go; I will return to My place until they confess their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will seek Me diligently.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:1
verses.text: Come and let us return to the LORD. For He has torn, and He will heal us; He has stricken, and He will bind us up.

verses.name: Hosea 6:2
verses.text: After two days He will bring us to life; in the third day He will raise us up, and we shall live in His sight.

verses.name: Hosea 6:3
verses.text: Then we shall know, <hi>if</hi> we follow on to know the LORD. His going out is prepared as the morning; and He shall come to us as the rain, as the latter <hi>and</hi> former rain to the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:4
verses.text: O Ephraim, what shall I do to you? O Judah, what shall I do to you? For your goodness <hi>is</hi> like a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goes away.

verses.name: Hosea 6:5
verses.text: So I have cut <hi>them</hi> down by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth. And your judgments <hi>were as</hi> the light that goes out.

verses.name: Hosea 6:6
verses.text: For I desired mercy and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

verses.name: Hosea 6:7
verses.text: But, like Adam, they have broken the covenant. They have acted like traitors against Me there.

verses.name: Hosea 6:8
verses.text: Gilead <hi>is</hi> a city of trouble-makers, slippery with blood marks.

verses.name: Hosea 6:9
verses.text: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, the company of priests murder <hi>in</hi> the way of Shechem; for they committed wickedness.

verses.name: Hosea 6:10
verses.text: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel; the harlotry of Ephraim <hi>is</hi> there; Israel is defiled.

verses.name: Hosea 6:11
verses.text: Also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed to you, when I return the captivity of My people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:1
verses.text: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was uncovered, and the wickedness of Samaria. For they have worked falsehood. And the thief comes in, the troop of robbers plunders outside.

verses.name: Hosea 7:2
verses.text: And they do not say within their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their own doings have hemmed them in; they are before My face.

verses.name: Hosea 7:3
verses.text: They make the king glad with their evil, and the rulers with their lies.

verses.name: Hosea 7:4
verses.text: They <hi>are</hi> all adulterers, like an oven heated by the baker; he stops stirring, from kneading the dough, while it is leavened.

verses.name: Hosea 7:5
verses.text: <hi> In</hi> the day of our king, the rulers have sickened themselves <hi>with</hi> the heat of wine. He stretches out his hand with scorners.

verses.name: Hosea 7:6
verses.text: For they have brought their heart near like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps at night; in the morning it burns like a flaming fire.

verses.name: Hosea 7:7
verses.text: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen; there is none among them who calls to Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:8
verses.text: Ephraim mixed himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

verses.name: Hosea 7:9
verses.text: Strangers have eaten up his strength, and he does not know. Yea, gray hairs are here and there on him, yet he knows it not.

verses.name: Hosea 7:10
verses.text: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face. And they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek Him in all this.

verses.name: Hosea 7:11
verses.text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart; they call <hi>to</hi> Egypt; they go <hi>to</hi> Assyria.

verses.name: Hosea 7:12
verses.text: When they go, I will spread My net on them; I will bring them down like the birds of the heavens; I will chastise them, as a report to their congregation.

verses.name: Hosea 7:13
verses.text: Woe to them! For they have fled from Me. Ruin to them! Because they have sinned against Me. Though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against Me.

verses.name: Hosea 7:14
verses.text: And they have not cried to Me with their heart, when they howled on their beds; they gather themselves for grain and wine, and they rebel against Me.

verses.name: Hosea 7:15
verses.text: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet they think evil against Me.

verses.name: Hosea 7:16
verses.text: They return, but not to the <hi>Most</hi> High. They are like a deceitful bow; their rulers shall fall by the sword from the rage of their tongue. This <hi>shall be</hi> their scorn in the land of Egypt.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:1
verses.text: Put a trumpet to your mouth. <hi>He comes</hi> like an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have broken My covenant and have sinned against My law.

verses.name: Hosea 8:2
verses.text: Israel shall cry to Me, My God, we know You.

verses.name: Hosea 8:3
verses.text: Israel has thrown off good; the enemy shall pursue him.

verses.name: Hosea 8:4
verses.text: They have set up kings, but not by Me; they have made rulers, and I knew it not. They have made themselves idols <hi>with</hi> their silver and their gold, so that they may be cut off.

verses.name: Hosea 8:5
verses.text: Your calf, O Samaria, has cast <hi>you</hi> off. My anger is kindled against them. Until when will they not attain purity?

verses.name: Hosea 8:6
verses.text: For from Israel it <hi>came</hi> also. The craftsman made it, but <hi>it is</hi> not God. For the calf of Samaria shall be splinters.

verses.name: Hosea 8:7
verses.text: For they sow the wind, and they reap the whirlwind. It has no stalk; the bud shall yield no meal; if it does yield, strangers shall swallow it up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:8
verses.text: Israel is swallowed up; now they shall be among the nations as a vessel in which there is no pleasure.

verses.name: Hosea 8:9
verses.text: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself. Ephraim has hired lovers.

verses.name: Hosea 8:10
verses.text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now I will gather them. And they began to be few, from the burden of the king of rulers.

verses.name: Hosea 8:11
verses.text: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin, altars shall be to him to sin.

verses.name: Hosea 8:12
verses.text: I have written to him the great things of My law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

verses.name: Hosea 8:13
verses.text: They sacrifice flesh <hi>for</hi> the sacrifices of My offerings, and eat it; but the LORD does not receive them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins. They shall return <hi>to</hi> Egypt.

verses.name: Hosea 8:14
verses.text: For Israel has forgotten his Maker, and builds temples. And Judah has multiplied cities. But I will send a fire on his cities, and it shall burn up her palaces.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:1
verses.text: O Israel, rejoice not for joy, like the peoples. For you have gone lusting away from your God; you have loved a reward on every grain floor.

verses.name: Hosea 9:2
verses.text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

verses.name: Hosea 9:3
verses.text: They shall not dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

verses.name: Hosea 9:4
verses.text: They shall not pour wine to the LORD, nor shall they be pleasing to Him. Their sacrifices <hi>shall be</hi> like the bread of sorrows to them; all who eat of them shall be defiled. For their bread is for their soul, it shall not come into the house of the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 9:5
verses.text: What will you do in the day of meeting, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?

verses.name: Hosea 9:6
verses.text: For lo, they have left because of destruction. Egypt shall gather them up; Memphis shall bury them. Nettles shall possess the desirable things of their silver; thorns <hi>shall be</hi> in their tents.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:7
verses.text: The days of her judgment have come; the days of vengeance have come; Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool, the spiritual man <hi>is</hi> insane, because of the greatness of your iniquity and the great hatred.

verses.name: Hosea 9:8
verses.text: The watchman of Ephraim <hi>was</hi> with my God. The prophet <hi>is</hi> a snare of a fowler in all his ways, <hi>and</hi> hatred in the house of his God.

verses.name: Hosea 9:9
verses.text: They have deeply corrupted, as <hi>in</hi> days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity; He will punish their sins.

verses.name: Hosea 9:10
verses.text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first-fruit in the fig tree at her first time. But they went <hi>to</hi> Baal-peor and set themselves apart to a shameful thing; and they became abominable like that which they loved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:11
verses.text: Ephraim is like a bird; their glory shall fly away from birth, and from the womb, and from conception.

verses.name: Hosea 9:12
verses.text: Though they bring up their sons, yet I will make them childless, without a man. Yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

verses.name: Hosea 9:13
verses.text: Ephraim, when I looked toward Tyre, was planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim shall bring out his sons to the murderer.

verses.name: Hosea 9:14
verses.text: Give them, O Lord; what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

verses.name: Hosea 9:15
verses.text: All their wickedness <hi>is</hi> in Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them out of My house for the wickedness of their doings. I will love them no more; all their rulers <hi>are</hi> revolters.

verses.name: Hosea 9:16
verses.text: Ephraim is stricken; their root is dried up; they shall bear no fruit. Yea, though they bear, yet I will slay the beloved ones of their womb.

verses.name: Hosea 9:17
verses.text: My God shall cast them away because they did not listen to Him. And they shall be wanderers among the nations.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:1
verses.text: Israel <hi>is</hi> an luxuriant vine; he brings out fruit to himself. According to the multitude of his fruit, he has increased the altars. They have made beautiful images according to the goodness of his land.

verses.name: Hosea 10:2
verses.text: Their heart is divided; now they shall be guilty. He shall break down their altars, and He shall spoil their images.

verses.name: Hosea 10:3
verses.text: For now they shall say, We have no king because we did not fear the LORD; what then should a king do to us?

verses.name: Hosea 10:4
verses.text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant. So judgment springs up like hemlock in the furrows of the field.

verses.name: Hosea 10:5
verses.text: Because of the calves of Beth-aven, the people of Samaria shall dread. For its people shall mourn over it, and its priest rejoiced on it for its glory, because it has departed from it.

verses.name: Hosea 10:6
verses.text: It shall also be carried to Assyria for a present to king Jareb. Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

verses.name: Hosea 10:7
verses.text: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as a bough on the water.

verses.name: Hosea 10:8
verses.text: Also the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us, and to the hills, Fall on us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:9
verses.text: O Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they stood; the battle against the sons of iniquity did not overtake them in Gibeah.

verses.name: Hosea 10:10
verses.text: When I desire, I shall bind them; and the peoples shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves to their two perversities.

verses.name: Hosea 10:11
verses.text: And Ephraim <hi>is</hi> like a trained heifer, trying to tread out. But I passed over on the goodness of her neck. I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

verses.name: Hosea 10:12
verses.text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground. For <hi>it is</hi> time to seek the LORD, until He comes and rains righteousness on you.

verses.name: Hosea 10:13
verses.text: You have plowed wickedness; you have reaped iniquity; you have eaten the fruit of lies, because you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

verses.name: Hosea 10:14
verses.text: And an uproar shall arise among your peoples, and all your fortresses shall be spoiled, as the ruin <hi>of</hi> Beth-arbel by Shalman in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces on <hi>her</hi> sons.

verses.name: Hosea 10:15
verses.text: So He does to you, Bethel, because of your great evil. In a morning the king of Israel shall be utterly cut off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:1
verses.text: When Israel <hi>was</hi> a child, then I loved him and called My son out of Egypt.

verses.name: Hosea 11:2
verses.text: As they called them, so they went from them. They sacrifice to the Baals, and burn incense to graven images.

verses.name: Hosea 11:3
verses.text: I also taught Ephraim to go; He took them on His arm. But they did not know that I healed them.

verses.name: Hosea 11:4
verses.text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as those who take off the yoke on their jaws, and I gently give food to him.

verses.name: Hosea 11:5
verses.text: He shall not return to the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian <hi>shall be</hi> his king, because they refused to return.

verses.name: Hosea 11:6
verses.text: And the sword shall remain on his cities, and shall destroy his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

verses.name: Hosea 11:7
verses.text: And My people are bent on backsliding from Me. Though they called them to the Most High, none at all would exalt <hi>Him</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:8
verses.text: How shall I give you up, Ephraim? How shall I deliver you, Israel? How shall I make you like Admah? How shall I set you as Zeboim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassions are kindled together.

verses.name: Hosea 11:9
verses.text: I will not carry out the heat of My anger; I will not return to destroy Ephraim. For I <hi>am</hi> God and not man, the Holy One in your midst; and I will not enter into the city.

verses.name: Hosea 11:10
verses.text: They shall walk after the LORD; He shall roar like a lion. When He shall roar, then the sons shall tremble from the west.

verses.name: Hosea 11:11
verses.text: They shall tremble like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria. And I will place them in their houses, says the LORD.

verses.name: Hosea 11:12
verses.text: Ephraim <hi>circles</hi> around Me with lying, and the house of Israel with deceit. But Judah still rules with God, and is faithful with the saints.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:1
verses.text: Ephraim feeds on wind and follows after the east wind. He daily multiplies lies and cruelty. And they make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

verses.name: Hosea 12:2
verses.text: The LORD also has a quarrel with Judah and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings He will repay him.

verses.name: Hosea 12:3
verses.text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God.

verses.name: Hosea 12:4
verses.text: Yes, he wept and cried to Him, and he had power over the Angel and overcame. He found him <hi>in</hi> Bethel, and there He spoke with us,

verses.name: Hosea 12:5
verses.text: even the LORD God of hosts. Jehovah <hi>is</hi> his memorial.

verses.name: Hosea 12:6
verses.text: Therefore turn to your God; keep mercy and judgment, and wait on your God forever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:7
verses.text: He <hi>is</hi> a merchant; the scales of deceit <hi>are</hi> in his hand; he loves to oppress.

verses.name: Hosea 12:8
verses.text: And Ephraim said, Yet I have become rich, I have found much wealth for myself. <hi>In</hi> all my labors they shall find in me no iniquity that is sin.

verses.name: Hosea 12:9
verses.text: And I the LORD, who have been your God from the land of Egypt, will yet make you to dwell in tents as in the days of the appointed feast.

verses.name: Hosea 12:10
verses.text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions and have used parables by the hand of the prophets.

verses.name: Hosea 12:11
verses.text: <hi> Is there</hi> iniquity in Gilead? Surely they are vanity; they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal. Yes, their altars <hi>are</hi> as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

verses.name: Hosea 12:12
verses.text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept watch.

verses.name: Hosea 12:13
verses.text: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept safe.

verses.name: Hosea 12:14
verses.text: Ephraim provoked <hi>Me</hi> to anger most bitterly; therefore he shall leave his blood on him, and his Lord shall turn his reproach to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:1
verses.text: When Ephraim spoke trembling, he was lifted up in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

verses.name: Hosea 13:2
verses.text: And now they sin more and more, and have made themselves a molten image of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, Let the men who sacrifice kiss the calves.

verses.name: Hosea 13:3
verses.text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud and as the early dew that passes away, as the chaff storm-driven out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

verses.name: Hosea 13:4
verses.text: Yet I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God from the land of Egypt, and you shall know no God but Me. For there is no Savior besides Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:5
verses.text: I have known you in the wilderness, in the land of great dryness.

verses.name: Hosea 13:6
verses.text: According to their pasture, so were they filled. They were filled and their heart was lifted up. Therefore they have forgotten Me.

verses.name: Hosea 13:7
verses.text: Therefore I will be as a lion to them; as a leopard by the way I will watch them.

verses.name: Hosea 13:8
verses.text: I will meet them like a bereaved bear, and will tear the lining of their heart. And there I will devour them like a lion; the wild beast shall tear them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:9
verses.text: O Israel, you have destroyed yourself; but in Me <hi>is</hi> your help.

verses.name: Hosea 13:10
verses.text: Where <hi>is</hi> your king now, that he may save you in all your cities; and your judges of whom you said, Give me a king and rulers?

verses.name: Hosea 13:11
verses.text: I gave you a king in My anger, and took <hi>him</hi> away in My wrath.

verses.name: Hosea 13:12
verses.text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin hidden.

verses.name: Hosea 13:13
verses.text: The pains of a woman in travail shall come to him. He <hi>is</hi> an unwise son; for he cannot stand still in the time of the breaking forth of sons.

verses.name: Hosea 13:14
verses.text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. O Death, where <hi>are</hi> your plagues; O Grave, where <hi>is</hi> your ruin! Repentance shall be hidden from My eyes.

verses.name: Hosea 13:15
verses.text: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind shall come. The wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall be ashamed, and his fountain shall be dried up. He shall plunder the treasure of all desirable vessels.

verses.name: Hosea 13:16
verses.text: Samaria shall become a waste, for she has rebelled against her God. They shall fall by the sword. Their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women shall be ripped up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:1
verses.text: O Israel, return to the LORD your God, for you have fallen by your iniquity.

verses.name: Hosea 14:2
verses.text: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD. Say to Him, Take away all iniquity, and receive <hi>us</hi> graciously, that we may repay <hi>with</hi> the calves of our lips.

verses.name: Hosea 14:3
verses.text: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride on horses. Nor shall we say any more to the work of our hands, Our gods, for in You the fatherless finds mercy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:4
verses.text: I will heal their backslidings; I will love them freely; for My anger has turned away from him.

verses.name: Hosea 14:5
verses.text: I will be as the dew to Israel; he shall grow as the lily and cast out his roots like Lebanon.

verses.name: Hosea 14:6
verses.text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

verses.name: Hosea 14:7
verses.text: They who dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive like the grain, and grow like the vine. Their scent <hi>shall be</hi> as the wine of Lebanon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:8
verses.text: Ephraim <hi>shall say</hi>, What <hi>have</hi> I to do any more with idols? I have heard <hi>him</hi> and watched him; I <hi>am</hi> like a green fir tree. Your fruit is found from Me.

verses.name: Hosea 14:9
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> wise, and he shall understand these things? Understanding, and he shall know them? For the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them; but sinners shall fall in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:1
verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

verses.name: Joel 1:2
verses.text: Hear this, you old men, and give ear, all dwellers of the land. Has this been in your days or even in the days of your fathers?

verses.name: Joel 1:3
verses.text: Tell your sons of it, and let your sons tell their sons, and their sons another generation.

verses.name: Joel 1:4
verses.text: That which the creeping locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten. And that which the swarming locust has left, the locust larvae has eaten. And that which the locust larvae has left, the stripping locust has eaten.

verses.name: Joel 1:5
verses.text: Awake, drunkards, and weep; and howl, all drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

verses.name: Joel 1:6
verses.text: For a nation has come up on My land, strong and without number, whose teeth <hi>are</hi> the teeth of a lion, and he has the jaw teeth of a lioness.

verses.name: Joel 1:7
verses.text: He has laid My vine waste and splintered My fig tree. He has stripped it and cast <hi>it</hi> away; its branches grow white.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:8
verses.text: Weep like a virgin clothed with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

verses.name: Joel 1:9
verses.text: The food offering and the drink offering are cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn.

verses.name: Joel 1:10
verses.text: The field is wasted; the land mourns, for the grain is wasted. The new wine is dried up; the oil tree droops.

verses.name: Joel 1:11
verses.text: Be ashamed, husbandmen; howl, vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field has perished.

verses.name: Joel 1:12
verses.text: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree droops, <hi>the</hi> pomegranate and the palm tree, and the apple tree; all the trees of the field are dried up, because joy has dried up from the sons of men.

verses.name: Joel 1:13
verses.text: Gird up and lament, priests; howl, ministers of the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, ministers of my God. For the food offering and the drink offering are held back from the house of your God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:14
verses.text: Set apart a fast; call a solemn gathering; gather the elders and all the people of the land <hi>into</hi> the house of the LORD your God, and cry to the Lord,

verses.name: Joel 1:15
verses.text: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD <hi>is</hi> at hand, and it shall come as a ruin from the Almighty.

verses.name: Joel 1:16
verses.text: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, and joy and gladness from the house of our God?

verses.name: Joel 1:17
verses.text: The seed is rotten under their clods; the storage bins are laid waste; the barns are broken down, for the grain has dried up.

verses.name: Joel 1:18
verses.text: How the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are troubled because they <hi>have</hi> no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are destroyed.

verses.name: Joel 1:19
verses.text: O LORD, to You will I cry; for the fire has burned up the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

verses.name: Joel 1:20
verses.text: The beasts of the field also cry to You; for the rivers of water are dried up, and the fire has burned up the pastures of the wilderness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:1
verses.text: Blow a ram's horn in Zion, and sound an alarm in My holy mountain; let all the inhabitants of the land tremble. For the day of the LORD comes, for <hi>it is</hi> near at hand;

verses.name: Joel 2:2
verses.text: a day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread on the mountains; a great people and a strong people; there has not been ever the like, nor shall there ever be again, even to the years of many generations.

verses.name: Joel 2:3
verses.text: A fire devours before them, and behind them a flame burns. The land <hi>is</hi> as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness. Yes, and nothing shall escape them.

verses.name: Joel 2:4
verses.text: As the appearance of horses <hi>is</hi> its appearance; and as war horses, so they run.

verses.name: Joel 2:5
verses.text: They shall leap like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle order.

verses.name: Joel 2:6
verses.text: Before their face the people shall be much pained; all faces shall gather blackness.

verses.name: Joel 2:7
verses.text: They shall run like mighty ones. They shall climb the wall like men of war, and they shall march each one on his way, and they shall not break their ranks.

verses.name: Joel 2:8
verses.text: And each one shall not press his brother; they <hi>each</hi> go in his paths. And <hi>if</hi> they fall behind their weapons, they shall not be cut off.

verses.name: Joel 2:9
verses.text: They shall rush on the city; they shall run on the wall; they shall climb up on the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

verses.name: Joel 2:10
verses.text: The earth shall tremble before them; the heavens shall shake. The sun and the moon shall grow dark, and the stars shall gather in their light.

verses.name: Joel 2:11
verses.text: And the LORD shall utter His voice before His army; for His camp <hi>is</hi> very great; for strong <hi>is He</hi> who does His word. For the day of the LORD <hi>is</hi> great and very terrible; and who can stand it?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:12
verses.text: Yet even now, says the LORD, turn to Me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.

verses.name: Joel 2:13
verses.text: Yes, tear your heart and not your robes, and turn to the LORD your God: for He <hi>is</hi> gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and He pities because of the evil.

verses.name: Joel 2:14
verses.text: Who knows <hi>if</hi> He will turn and have pity and leave a blessing behind Him, a food offering and a drink offering to the LORD your God?

verses.name: Joel 2:15
verses.text: Blow a trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn gathering.

verses.name: Joel 2:16
verses.text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, gather the elders, gather the children and those who suck the breasts. Let the bridegroom go forth out of his chamber, and the bride out of her room.

verses.name: Joel 2:17
verses.text: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Have pity on Your people, O LORD, and give not Your inheritance to shame, for a proverb among those of the nations. Why should they say among the people, Where <hi>is</hi> their God?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:18
verses.text: Then the LORD will be jealous for His land and pity His people.

verses.name: Joel 2:19
verses.text: Yes, the LORD will answer and say to His people, Behold, I will send you grain, and wine, and oil, and you shall be satisfied with it. And I will no more make you a curse among the nations.

verses.name: Joel 2:20
verses.text: But I will remove the northern army far from you, and will drive him into a barren and deserted land, with his face toward the eastern sea and his rear toward the western sea. And his stench shall come up, and his ill odor shall come up, because he was doing great things.

verses.name: Joel 2:21
verses.text: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice. For the LORD will do great things.

verses.name: Joel 2:22
verses.text: Do not be afraid, beasts of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness grow green; for the tree bears its fruit, and the fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

verses.name: Joel 2:23
verses.text: Be glad then, sons of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God. For He has given you the former rain according to righteousness, and He will cause the rain to come down for you, the former rain and the latter rain in the first <hi>month</hi>.

verses.name: Joel 2:24
verses.text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

verses.name: Joel 2:25
verses.text: And I will restore to you the years which the swarming locust has eaten, the locust larvae, and the stripping locust, and the cutting locust, My great army which I sent among you.

verses.name: Joel 2:26
verses.text: And you shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, who has dealt with you wonderfully; and My people shall never be ashamed.

verses.name: Joel 2:27
verses.text: And you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> in the midst of Israel, and that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God, and no one else; and My people shall never be ashamed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:28
verses.text: And it shall be afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh. And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy; your old men shall dream dreams; your young men shall see visions.

verses.name: Joel 2:29
verses.text: And also I will pour out My Spirit on the slaves and on the slave women in those days.

verses.name: Joel 2:30
verses.text: And I will show wonders in the heavens, and in the earth, blood and fire and pillars of smoke.

verses.name: Joel 2:31
verses.text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the coming of the great and awesome day of the LORD.

verses.name: Joel 2:32
verses.text: And it shall be, whoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be saved; for salvation shall be in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, as the LORD has said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:1
verses.text: For, behold, in those days and in that time, <hi>when</hi> I will bring again the exiles of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.name: Joel 3:2
verses.text: I will also gather all nations and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat. And I will fight with them there for My people and for My inheritance Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and divided My land.

verses.name: Joel 3:3
verses.text: And they have cast lots for My people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, so that they might drink.

verses.name: Joel 3:4
verses.text: Yea, and what <hi>have</hi> you to do with Me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the borders of Philistia? <hi>Will you</hi> give Me a reward? And if you reward Me, swiftly and speedily I will turn your reward on your own head,

verses.name: Joel 3:5
verses.text: because you have taken My silver and My gold, and have carried My good treasures into your temples.

verses.name: Joel 3:6
verses.text: You have also sold the sons of Judah and the sons of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you might remove them far from their border.

verses.name: Joel 3:7
verses.text: Behold, I <hi>am</hi> rising them out of the place where you have sold them, and will turn your reward on your own head.

verses.name: Joel 3:8
verses.text: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off; for the LORD has spoken it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:9
verses.text: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up.

verses.name: Joel 3:10
verses.text: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, I <hi>am</hi> strong.

verses.name: Joel 3:11
verses.text: Gather yourselves and come, all you nations, and gather yourselves together all around; cause Your mighty ones to come down there, O LORD.

verses.name: Joel 3:12
verses.text: Let the nations be awakened and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the nations all around.

verses.name: Joel 3:13
verses.text: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, come down; for the press is full; the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.

verses.name: Joel 3:14
verses.text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision; for the day of the LORD <hi>is</hi> near in the valley of decision!

verses.name: Joel 3:15
verses.text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall gather in their light.

verses.name: Joel 3:16
verses.text: The LORD shall also roar out of Zion and utter His voice from Jerusalem. And the heavens and the earth shall shake. But the LORD <hi>will be</hi> the hope of His people and the strength of the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Joel 3:17
verses.text: So you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, My holy mountain. And Jerusalem shall be a holy thing, and no aliens shall pass through her any more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:18
verses.text: And it shall be, in that day the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow <hi>with</hi> milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow <hi>with</hi> waters; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

verses.name: Joel 3:19
verses.text: Egypt shall be a ruin, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, from violence <hi>done</hi> to the sons of Judah, whose innocent blood they poured out in their land.

verses.name: Joel 3:20
verses.text: But Judah will dwell forever, and Jerusalem to generation and generation.

verses.name: Joel 3:21
verses.text: And I will cleanse their blood <hi>which</hi> I did not cleanse; and the LORD is dwelling in Zion.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:1
verses.text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa; the word which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

verses.name: Amos 1:2
verses.text: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion and utter His voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall dry up.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:3
verses.text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Damascus, yea for four, I will not turn away <hi>from</hi> it; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron.

verses.name: Amos 1:4
verses.text: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.name: Amos 1:5
verses.text: I will also break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the dweller from the Valley of Aven, and from him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden. And the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir, says the LORD.

verses.name: Amos 1:6
verses.text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Gaza, yea for four, I will not turn away <hi>from</hi> it; because they deported <hi>as</hi> exiles to deliver up a complete <hi>population</hi> to Edom.

verses.name: Amos 1:7
