verses.text: And seeing the star, they rejoiced <hi>with</hi> exceedingly great joy.

verses.name: Matthew 2:11
verses.text: And coming into the house, they saw the child with Mary His mother. And they fell down and worshiped Him. And opening their treasures, they presented gifts to Him, gold and frankincense and myrrh.

verses.name: Matthew 2:12
verses.text: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:13
verses.text: And when they had departed, behold, the angel of <hi>the</hi> Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and His mother and flee into Egypt. And be there until I bring you word, for Herod is about to seek the child to destroy Him.

verses.name: Matthew 2:14
verses.text: And he arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt.

verses.name: Matthew 2:15
verses.text: And he was there until the death of Herod; so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the LORD through the prophet, "Out of Egypt I have called My Son."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:16
verses.text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was greatly enraged. And he sent and killed all the boys in Bethlehem, and in all its districts, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had carefully inquired of the wise men.

verses.name: Matthew 2:17
verses.text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 2:18
verses.text: "A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping <hi>for</hi> her children, and would not be comforted, because they are <hi>not</hi>."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:19
verses.text: But Herod having expired, behold, an angel of <hi>the</hi> Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

verses.name: Matthew 2:20
verses.text: saying, Arise, and take the child and His mother. And go into <hi>the</hi> land of Israel. For the ones who sought the child's life are dead.

verses.name: Matthew 2:21
verses.text: And he arose and took the child and His mother and came into <hi>the</hi> land of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 2:22
verses.text: But when he heard that Archelaus reigned in Judea in his father Herod's place, he was afraid to go there. And being warned by God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 2:23
verses.text: And he came and lived in a city called Nazareth, so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, "He shall be called a Nazarene."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:1
verses.text: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea,

verses.name: Matthew 3:2
verses.text: and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

verses.name: Matthew 3:3
verses.text: For this is he who was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying, "The voice of <hi>one</hi> crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of <hi>the</hi> Lord, make His path straight."

verses.name: Matthew 3:4
verses.text: And the same John had his clothing of camel's hair and a leather girdle about his loins. And his food was locusts and wild honey.

verses.name: Matthew 3:5
verses.text: Then Jerusalem and all Judea went out to him, and all the region round about Jordan.

verses.name: Matthew 3:6
verses.text: And they were baptized by him in Jordan, confessing their sins.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:7
verses.text: But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said to them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.name: Matthew 3:8
verses.text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance;

verses.name: Matthew 3:9
verses.text: and do not think to say within yourselves, We have Abraham as <hi>our</hi> father. For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

verses.name: Matthew 3:10
verses.text: And now also, the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

verses.name: Matthew 3:11
verses.text: I indeed baptize you with water to repentance. But He who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He shall baptize you with <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit and <hi>with</hi> fire;

verses.name: Matthew 3:12
verses.text: whose fan <hi>is</hi> in His hand, and He will cleanse His floor and gather His wheat into the storehouse; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:13
verses.text: Then Jesus came from Galilee to Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

verses.name: Matthew 3:14
verses.text: But John restrained Him, saying, I have need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?

verses.name: Matthew 3:15
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to him, Allow <hi>it</hi> now, for it is becoming to us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he allowed Him.

verses.name: Matthew 3:16
verses.text: And Jesus, when He had been baptized, went up immediately out of the water. And lo, the heavens were opened to Him, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and lighting upon Him.

verses.name: Matthew 3:17
verses.text: And lo, a voice from Heaven, saying, This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:1
verses.text: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit up into the wilderness, to be tempted by the Devil.

verses.name: Matthew 4:2
verses.text: And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, He was afterwards hungry.

verses.name: Matthew 4:3
verses.text: And when the tempter came to Him, he said, If You are <hi>the</hi> Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

verses.name: Matthew 4:4
verses.text: But He answered and said, It is written, "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of <hi>the</hi> mouth of God."

verses.name: Matthew 4:5
verses.text: Then the Devil took Him up into the holy city and set Him upon a pinnacle of the Temple.

verses.name: Matthew 4:6
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> said to Him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down. For it is written, "He shall give His angels charge concerning You, and in <hi>their</hi> hands they shall bear You up, lest at any time You dash Your foot against a stone."

verses.name: Matthew 4:7
verses.text: Jesus said to him, It is written again, "You shall not tempt <hi>the</hi> Lord your God."

verses.name: Matthew 4:8
verses.text: Again, the Devil took Him up into a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

verses.name: Matthew 4:9
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> said to Him, All these things I will give You if You will fall down and worship me.

verses.name: Matthew 4:10
verses.text: Then Jesus said to him, Go, Satan! For it is written, "You shall worship <hi>the</hi> Lord your God, and Him only you shall serve."

verses.name: Matthew 4:11
verses.text: Then the Devil left him. And behold, angels came and ministered to Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:12
verses.text: But when Jesus heard that John was thrown into prison, He withdrew into Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 4:13
verses.text: And leaving Nazareth, He came and lived in Capernaum, which is on the seacoast, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali,

verses.name: Matthew 4:14
verses.text: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 4:15
verses.text: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, <hi>by</hi> way of <hi>the</hi> sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the nations!

verses.name: Matthew 4:16
verses.text: The people who sat in darkness saw a great Light; and Light has sprung up to those who sat in <hi>the</hi> region and shadow of death."

verses.name: Matthew 4:17
verses.text: From that time Jesus began to preach and to say, Repent! For the kingdom of Heaven is at hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:18
verses.text: And walking by the Sea of Galilee, Jesus saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea. For they were fishermen.

verses.name: Matthew 4:19
verses.text: And He said to them, Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.name: Matthew 4:20
verses.text: And they immediately left their nets and followed him.

verses.name: Matthew 4:21
verses.text: And going on from there, he saw another two brothers, James <hi>the son</hi> of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. And He called them;

verses.name: Matthew 4:22
verses.text: and they immediately left the boat and their father and followed Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:23
verses.text: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease among the people.

verses.name: Matthew 4:24
verses.text: And His fame went throughout all Syria. And they brought to Him all sick people who were pressed down by different kinds of diseases and torments, and <hi>those</hi> who had been possessed with demons, and those who had been moonstruck, and <hi>those</hi> paralyzed. And He healed them.

verses.name: Matthew 4:25
verses.text: And great multitudes of people followed Him, from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judea and beyond Jordan.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:1
verses.text: And seeing the multitudes, He went up into a mountain. And when He had sat down, His disciples came to Him.

verses.name: Matthew 5:2
verses.text: And He opened His mouth and taught them, saying,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:3
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the poor in spirit! For theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 5:4
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they that mourn! For they shall be comforted.

verses.name: Matthew 5:5
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the meek! For they shall inherit the earth.

verses.name: Matthew 5:6
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who hunger and thirst after righteousness! For they shall be filled.

verses.name: Matthew 5:7
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the merciful! For they shall obtain mercy.

verses.name: Matthew 5:8
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the pure in heart! For they shall see God.

verses.name: Matthew 5:9
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> the peacemakers! For they shall be called the sons of God.

verses.name: Matthew 5:10
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who have been persecuted for righteousness sake! For theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 5:11
verses.text: Blessed are you when <hi>men</hi> shall revile you and persecute <hi>you</hi>, and shall say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for My sake.

verses.name: Matthew 5:12
verses.text: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for your reward in Heaven <hi>is</hi> great. For so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:13
verses.text: You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt loses its savor, with what shall it be salted? It is no longer good for anything, but to be thrown out and to be trodden underfoot by men.

verses.name: Matthew 5:14
verses.text: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden.

verses.name: Matthew 5:15
verses.text: Nor do men light a lamp and put it under the grain-measure, but on a lampstand. And it gives light to all who are in the house.

verses.name: Matthew 5:16
verses.text: Let your light so shine before men that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:17
verses.text: Do not think that I have come to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to destroy but to fulfill.

verses.name: Matthew 5:18
verses.text: For truly I say to you, Till the heaven and the earth pass away, not one jot or one tittle shall in any way pass from the law until all is fulfilled.

verses.name: Matthew 5:19
verses.text: Therefore whoever shall break one of these commandments, the least, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of Heaven. But whoever shall do and teach <hi>them</hi>, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 5:20
verses.text: For I say to you that unless your righteousness shall exceed <hi>that</hi> of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall in no case enter into the kingdom of Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:21
verses.text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, "You shall not kill" --and, "Whoever shall kill shall be liable to the judgment."

verses.name: Matthew 5:22
verses.text: But I say to you that whoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be liable to the judgment. And whoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be liable to the sanhedrin; but whoever shall say, Fool! shall be liable <hi>to be thrown</hi> into the fire of hell.

verses.name: Matthew 5:23
verses.text: Therefore if you offer your gift on the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

verses.name: Matthew 5:24
verses.text: leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

verses.name: Matthew 5:25
verses.text: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are in the way with him; that the opponent not deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be thrown into prison.

verses.name: Matthew 5:26
verses.text: Truly I say to you, You shall by no means come out from there until you have paid the last kodrantes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:27
verses.text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, "You shall not commit adultery."

verses.name: Matthew 5:28
verses.text: But I say to you that whoever looks on a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

verses.name: Matthew 5:29
verses.text: And if your right eye offends you, pluck it out and throw <hi>it</hi> from you. For it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not <hi>that</hi> your whole body should be thrown into hell.

verses.name: Matthew 5:30
verses.text: And if your right hand offends you, cut it off and throw <hi>it</hi> from you. For it is profitable for you <hi>that</hi> one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be thrown into hell.

verses.name: Matthew 5:31
verses.text: It was also said, Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a bill of divorce.

verses.name: Matthew 5:32
verses.text: But I say to you that whoever shall put away his wife, except for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery. And whoever shall marry her who is put away commits adultery.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:33
verses.text: Again, you have heard that it has been said to the ancients, "You shall not swear falsely, but you shall perform your oaths to the Lord."

verses.name: Matthew 5:34
verses.text: But I say to you, Do not swear at all! Not by Heaven, because it is God's throne;

verses.name: Matthew 5:35
verses.text: not by the earth, for it is the footstool of His feet; not by Jerusalem, because it is <hi>the</hi> city of the great King;

verses.name: Matthew 5:36
verses.text: nor shall you swear by your head, because you cannot make one hair white or black.

verses.name: Matthew 5:37
verses.text: But let your word be, Yes, yes; No, no. For whatever is more than these comes from evil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:38
verses.text: You have heard that it was said, "An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth."

verses.name: Matthew 5:39
verses.text: But I say to you, Do not resist evil. But whoever shall strike you on your right cheek, turn the other to him also.

verses.name: Matthew 5:40
verses.text: And to him desiring to sue you, and to take away your tunic, let him have <hi>your</hi> coat also.

verses.name: Matthew 5:41
verses.text: And whoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him two.

verses.name: Matthew 5:42
verses.text: Give to him who asks of you, and you shall not turn away from him who would borrow from you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:43
verses.text: You have heard that it was said, "You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy."

verses.name: Matthew 5:44
verses.text: But I say to you, Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who despitefully use you and persecute you,

verses.name: Matthew 5:45
verses.text: so that you may become sons of your Father in Heaven. For He makes His sun to rise on <hi>the</hi> evil and on <hi>the</hi> good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.

verses.name: Matthew 5:46
verses.text: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not even the tax-collectors do the same?

verses.name: Matthew 5:47
verses.text: And if you greet your brothers only, what do you do more than others? Do not even the tax-collectors do so?

verses.name: Matthew 5:48
verses.text: Therefore be perfect, even as your Father in Heaven is perfect.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:1
verses.text: Take heed that you do not do your merciful deeds before men, to be seen by them. Otherwise you have no reward with your Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 6:2
verses.text: Therefore when you do <hi>your</hi> merciful deeds, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

verses.name: Matthew 6:3
verses.text: But when you do merciful deeds, do not let your left hand know what your right hand does,

verses.name: Matthew 6:4
verses.text: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret. And your Father who sees in secret Himself shall reward you openly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:5
verses.text: And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

verses.name: Matthew 6:6
verses.text: But you, when you pray, enter into your room. And shutting your door, pray to your Father in secret; and your Father who sees in secret shall reward you openly.

verses.name: Matthew 6:7
verses.text: But when you pray, do not babble vain words, as the nations. For they think that in their much speaking they shall be heard.

verses.name: Matthew 6:8
verses.text: Therefore do not be like them, for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:9
verses.text: Therefore pray in this way: Our Father, who is in Heaven, Hallowed be Your name.

verses.name: Matthew 6:10
verses.text: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as <hi>it is</hi> in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 6:11
verses.text: Give us this day our daily bread;

verses.name: Matthew 6:12
verses.text: and forgive us our debts as we also forgive our debtors.

verses.name: Matthew 6:13
verses.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil. For Yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever. Amen.

verses.name: Matthew 6:14
verses.text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you;

verses.name: Matthew 6:15
verses.text: but if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:16
verses.text: And when you fast, do not be like the hypocrites, of a sad face. For they disfigure their faces so that they may appear to men to fast. Truly I say to you, they have their reward.

verses.name: Matthew 6:17
verses.text: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

verses.name: Matthew 6:18
verses.text: so that you do not appear to men to fast, but to your Father in secret. And your Father who sees in secret shall reward you openly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:19
verses.text: Do not lay up treasures on earth for yourselves, where moth and rust corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal.

verses.name: Matthew 6:20
verses.text: But lay up treasures in Heaven for yourselves, where neither moth nor rust corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal.

verses.name: Matthew 6:21
verses.text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

verses.name: Matthew 6:22
verses.text: The light of the body is the eye. Therefore if your eye is sound, your whole body shall be full of light.

verses.name: Matthew 6:23
verses.text: But if your eye is evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light <hi>that is</hi> in you is darkness, how great <hi>is</hi> that darkness!

verses.name: Matthew 6:24
verses.text: No one can serve two masters. For either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will hold to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:25
verses.text: Therefore I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor for your body, what you shall put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

verses.name: Matthew 6:26
verses.text: Behold the birds of the air; for they sow not, nor do they reap, nor gather into barns. Yet your heavenly Father feeds them; are you not much better than they are?

verses.name: Matthew 6:27
verses.text: Which of you <hi>by</hi> being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

verses.name: Matthew 6:28
verses.text: And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They do not toil, nor do they spin,

verses.name: Matthew 6:29
verses.text: but I say to you that even Solomon in his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

verses.name: Matthew 6:30
verses.text: Therefore if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, <hi>will He</hi> not much rather <hi>clothe</hi> you, little-faiths?

verses.name: Matthew 6:31
verses.text: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?

verses.name: Matthew 6:32
verses.text: For the nations seek after all these things. For your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.

verses.name: Matthew 6:33
verses.text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness; and all these things shall be added to you.

verses.name: Matthew 6:34
verses.text: Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow; for tomorrow shall be anxious for its own things. Sufficient to the day <hi>is</hi> the evil of it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:1
verses.text: Judge not, that you may not be judged.

verses.name: Matthew 7:2
verses.text: For with whatever judgment you judge, you shall be judged; and with whatever measure you measure out, it shall be measured to you again.

verses.name: Matthew 7:3
verses.text: And why do you look on the splinter that is in your brother's eye, but do not consider the beam that is in your own eye?

verses.name: Matthew 7:4
verses.text: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me pull the splinter out of your eye; and, behold, a beam <hi>is</hi> in your own eye?

verses.name: Matthew 7:5
verses.text: Hypocrite! First cast the beam out of your own eye, and then you shall see clearly to cast the splinter out of your brother's eye.

verses.name: Matthew 7:6
verses.text: Do not give that which <hi>is</hi> holy to the dogs; nor cast your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet and turn again and tear you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:7
verses.text: Ask and it shall be given to you; seek and you shall find; knock and it shall be opened to you.

verses.name: Matthew 7:8
verses.text: For each one who asks receives; and he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, it shall be opened.

verses.name: Matthew 7:9
verses.text: Or what man is there of you, if his son asks a loaf, will he give him a stone?

verses.name: Matthew 7:10
verses.text: Or if he asks a fish, will he give him a snake?

verses.name: Matthew 7:11
verses.text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more shall your Father in Heaven give good things to those who ask Him?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:12
verses.text: Therefore all things, whatever you desire that men should do to you, do even so to them; for this is the Law and the Prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 7:13
verses.text: Go in through the narrow gate, for wide <hi>is</hi> the gate and broad <hi>is</hi> the way that leads to destruction, and many there are who go in through it.

verses.name: Matthew 7:14
verses.text: Because narrow <hi>is</hi> the gate and constricted <hi>is</hi> the way which leads to life, and there are few who find it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:15
verses.text: Beware of false prophets who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

verses.name: Matthew 7:16
verses.text: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

verses.name: Matthew 7:17
verses.text: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.

verses.name: Matthew 7:18
verses.text: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruits, nor <hi>can</hi> a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

verses.name: Matthew 7:19
verses.text: Every tree that does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.name: Matthew 7:20
verses.text: Therefore by their fruits you shall know them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:21
verses.text: Not everyone who says to Me, Lord! Lord! shall enter the kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of My Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 7:22
verses.text: Many will say to Me in that day, Lord! Lord! Did we not prophesy in Your name, and through Your name throw out demons, and through Your name do many wonderful works?

verses.name: Matthew 7:23
verses.text: And then I will say to them I never knew you! Depart from Me, those working lawlessness!

verses.name: Matthew 7:24
verses.text: Therefore whoever hears these sayings of Mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on a rock.

verses.name: Matthew 7:25
verses.text: And the rain came down, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house. And it did not fall, for it was founded on a rock.

verses.name: Matthew 7:26
verses.text: And everyone who hears these sayings of Mine and does not do them shall be compared to a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

verses.name: Matthew 7:27
verses.text: And the rain came down, and the floods came, and the wind blew and beat on that house. And it fell, and great was its fall.

verses.name: Matthew 7:28
verses.text: And it happened, when Jesus had ended these sayings, that the people were astonished at His doctrine.

verses.name: Matthew 7:29
verses.text: For He taught them as <hi>one</hi> having authority, and not as the scribes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:1
verses.text: When He had come down from the mountain, great crowds followed him.

verses.name: Matthew 8:2
verses.text: And behold, a leper came and worshiped him, saying, Lord, if You will, You can make me clean.

verses.name: Matthew 8:3
verses.text: And Jesus put <hi>out</hi> His hand and touched him, saying, I will; be clean! And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

verses.name: Matthew 8:4
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest. And offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:5
verses.text: And when Jesus had entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, beseeching Him,

verses.name: Matthew 8:6
verses.text: and saying, Lord, my son lies at home paralyzed and grievously tormented.

verses.name: Matthew 8:7
verses.text: And Jesus says to him, I will come and heal him.

verses.name: Matthew 8:8
verses.text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that You should come under my roof; but only speak the word, and my boy will be healed.

verses.name: Matthew 8:9
verses.text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one, Go! And he goes; and to another, Come! And he comes; and to my servant, Do this! And he does <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:10
verses.text: When Jesus heard, He marvelled and said to those who followed, Truly I say to you, I have not found such <hi>great</hi> faith, no, not in Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 8:11
verses.text: And I say to you that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 8:12
verses.text: But the sons of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 8:13
verses.text: And Jesus said to the centurion, Go. And as you have believed, <hi>so</hi> let it be to you. And his boy was healed in that hour.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:14
verses.text: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, He saw his wife's mother laid out and in a fever.

verses.name: Matthew 8:15
verses.text: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her. And she arose and served them.

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: And evening coming on, they brought to Him many who had been possessed with demons. And He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, "He took <hi>on Himself</hi> our weaknesses and bore <hi>our</hi> sicknesses."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: And seeing great crowds, Jesus gave orders to depart to the other side.

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: And a certain scribe came and said to him, Master, I will follow You wherever You go.

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air <hi>have</hi> nests, but the Son of man has nowhere to lay <hi>His</hi> head.

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: And another of His disciples said to him, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: But Jesus said to him, Follow Me, and let the dead bury their dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: And He entering into a boat, His disciples followed Him.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: And behold, a great tempest arose in the sea, so much so that the boat was covered with the waves. But He was asleep.

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: And His disciples came to <hi>Him</hi> and awakened Him, saying, Lord, save us! We perish!

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: And He said to them, Why are you afraid, little-faiths? Then He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: But the men marveled, saying, What kind <hi>of man</hi> is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
verses.text: And when He had come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, two demon-possessed ones met Him, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that no one might pass by that way.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: And behold, they cried out, saying, What <hi>have</hi> we to do with You, Jesus, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the time?

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: And there was a good way off from them a herd of many swine, feeding.

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: And the demons begged Him, saying, If You cast us out, allow us to go away into the herd of swine.

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: And He said to them, Go! And when they had come out, they went into the herd of swine. And behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea and perished in the waters.

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: And those who fed <hi>them</hi> fled. And going into the city, <hi>they</hi> told everything, and what had happened to the ones who had been possessed of demons.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged that He would depart out of their borders.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: And He entered into a boat, and passed over, and came to His own city.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: And behold, they brought to Him a paralytic, lying on a bed. And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Child, be of good cheer. Your sins are forgiven you.

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: And lo, some of the scribes said within themselves, This one blasphemes.

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why do you think evil in your hearts?

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: For which is easier? To say, <hi>Your</hi> sins are forgiven you, or to say, Arise and walk!

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: But so that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins, then He said to the paralytic, Arise, take up your bed and go to your house.

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: And he arose and departed to his house.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: But when the crowds saw, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: And as Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax-office. And He said to him, Follow Me! And he arose and followed Him.

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: And it happened as Jesus reclined in the house, behold, many tax-collectors and sinners came and were reclining with Him and His disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: And when the Pharisees saw, they said to His disciples, Why does your master eat with tax-collectors and sinners?

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: But when Jesus heard, He said to them, The ones who are whole do not need a physician, but the ones who are sick.

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: But go and learn what <hi>this is</hi>, I will have mercy and not sacrifice. For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: Then the disciples of John came to Him saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but Your disciples do not fast?

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Can the sons of the bridechamber mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast.

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: No one puts a piece of new cloth onto an old garment; for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the tear is made worse.

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: Nor do men put new wine into old wineskins; else the wineskins burst, and the wine runs out, and the wineskins perish. But they put new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved together.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: While He spoke these things to them, behold, a certain ruler came and worshiped Him, saying, My daughter has just now died. But come and lay Your hand on her and she will live.

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: And Jesus arose and followed him. And <hi>so did</hi> His disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: And behold, a woman, who had a flow of blood for twelve years, came up behind <hi>Him</hi> and touched the hem of His garment.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21
verses.text: For she said within herself, If only I shall touch His robe, I will be whole.

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
verses.text: But turning and seeing her, Jesus said, Daughter, be comforted; your faith has saved you. And the woman was saved from that hour.

verses.name: Matthew 9:23
verses.text: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: He said to them, Go back, for the little girl is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed Him to scorn.

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: But when the people were put out, He went in and took her by the hand, and the little girl arose.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: And this report went out into all that land.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: And when Jesus passed on from there, two blind ones followed Him, crying and saying, Son of David, have mercy on us.

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: And when He had come into the house, the blind men came to Him. And Jesus said to them, Do you believe that I am able to do this? They said to Him, Yes, Lord.

verses.name: Matthew 9:29
verses.text: Then He touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith let it be to you.

verses.name: Matthew 9:30
verses.text: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus strictly charged them, saying, See, let no one know.

verses.name: Matthew 9:31
verses.text: But going out, they made Him known in all that land.

verses.name: Matthew 9:32
verses.text: As they went out, behold, they brought to Him a dumb man, who had been demon-possessed.

verses.name: Matthew 9:33
verses.text: And when the demon had been cast out, the dumb one spoke. And multitudes marveled, saying, Never was it seen like this in Israel!

verses.name: Matthew 9:34
verses.text: But the Pharisees said, He throws out demons by the ruler of the demons.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:35
verses.text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

verses.name: Matthew 9:36
verses.text: But seeing the crowds, He was moved with compassion on them, because they were tired and scattered like sheep having no shepherd.

verses.name: Matthew 9:37
verses.text: Then He said to His disciples, The harvest truly <hi>is</hi> plenteous, but the laborers are few.

verses.name: Matthew 9:38
verses.text: Therefore pray to the Lord of the harvest that He will send out laborers into His harvest.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:1
verses.text: And when He had called to <hi>Him</hi> His twelve disciples, He gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2
verses.text: And the names of the twelve apostles are these: First, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James <hi>the son</hi> of Zebedee and John his brother;

verses.name: Matthew 10:3
verses.text: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax-collector; James <hi>the son</hi> of Alpheus, and Lebbeus, whose surname was Thaddeus;

verses.name: Matthew 10:4
verses.text: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:5
verses.text: Jesus sent out these twelve, commanding them, saying, Do not go into the way of the nations, and do not enter into <hi>any</hi> city of <hi>the</hi> Samaritans.

verses.name: Matthew 10:6
verses.text: But rather go to the lost sheep of <hi>the</hi> house of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 10:7
verses.text: And as you go, proclaim, saying, The kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

verses.name: Matthew 10:8
verses.text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. You have received freely, freely give.

verses.name: Matthew 10:9
verses.text: Do not provide gold nor silver, nor copper in your purses,

verses.name: Matthew 10:10
verses.text: nor a bag for <hi>the</hi> journey, nor two coats, nor sandals, nor staves. For the workman is worthy of his food.

verses.name: Matthew 10:11
verses.text: And into whatever city or village you enter, inquire who within it is worthy. And there abide until you go away from there.

verses.name: Matthew 10:12
verses.text: And when you come into a house, greet it.

verses.name: Matthew 10:13
verses.text: And if the house is worthy, let your peace come on it. But if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.

verses.name: Matthew 10:14
verses.text: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

verses.name: Matthew 10:15
verses.text: Truly I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:16
verses.text: Behold, I send you out as sheep in <hi>the</hi> midst of wolves. Therefore be as wise as serpents and as harmless as doves.

verses.name: Matthew 10:17
verses.text: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to the sanhedrins, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.

verses.name: Matthew 10:18
verses.text: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for My sake, for a testimony against them and the nations.

verses.name: Matthew 10:19
verses.text: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak; for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.

verses.name: Matthew 10:20
verses.text: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

verses.name: Matthew 10:21
verses.text: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and <hi>the</hi> father <hi>his</hi> child. And the children shall rise up against <hi>their</hi> parents and cause them to be put to death.

verses.name: Matthew 10:22
verses.text: And you will be hated of all <hi>men</hi> for My name's sake, but the <hi>one</hi> who endures to <hi>the</hi> end shall be kept safe.

verses.name: Matthew 10:23
verses.text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into another; for truly I say to you, In no way shall you have finished the cities of Israel until the Son of Man comes.

verses.name: Matthew 10:24
verses.text: A disciple is not above <hi>his</hi> master, nor the servant above his lord.

verses.name: Matthew 10:25
verses.text: It is enough for the disciple that he is like his master, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more those of his household?

verses.name: Matthew 10:26
verses.text: Therefore do not fear them, for there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, and nothing hidden which shall not be known.

verses.name: Matthew 10:27
verses.text: What I tell you in darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear, proclaim on the housetops.

verses.name: Matthew 10:28
verses.text: And do not fear those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. But rather fear Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.name: Matthew 10:29
verses.text: Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? And one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

verses.name: Matthew 10:30
verses.text: But even the hairs of your head are all numbered.

verses.name: Matthew 10:31
verses.text: Therefore do not fear, you are of more value than many sparrows.

verses.name: Matthew 10:32
verses.text: Then everyone who shall confess Me before men, I will confess him before My Father who is in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 10:33
verses.text: But whoever shall deny Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 10:34
verses.text: Do not think that I have come to bring peace on earth. I did not come to send peace, but a sword.

verses.name: Matthew 10:35
verses.text: For I have come to set a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

verses.name: Matthew 10:36
verses.text: And a man's foes <hi>shall be</hi> those of his <hi>own</hi> household.

verses.name: Matthew 10:37
verses.text: He who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me. And he who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.

verses.name: Matthew 10:38
verses.text: And he who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

verses.name: Matthew 10:39
verses.text: He who finds his life shall lose it. And he who loses his life for My sake shall find it.

verses.name: Matthew 10:40
verses.text: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me.

verses.name: Matthew 10:41
verses.text: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward. And he who receives a just <hi>one</hi> in the name of a just one will receive a just <hi>one's</hi> reward.

verses.name: Matthew 10:42
verses.text: And whoever shall give to one of these little ones a cup of cold <hi>water</hi> to drink, only in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, He shall in no way lose his reward.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: And it happened, when Jesus had finished commanding His twelve disciples, He left there to teach and to proclaim in their cities.

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: But when John heard in the prison of the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: And they said to Him, Are You he who should come, or do we look for another?

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, Go and tell John again those things which you hear and see:

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk; the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear; the dead are raised, and the poor have the gospel proclaimed to them.

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: And blessed is <hi>he</hi>, whoever shall not be offended in Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: And as they departed, Jesus began to say to the crowds concerning John, What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft <hi>clothing</hi>? Behold, they who wear soft <hi>clothing</hi> are in kings' houses.

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yea, I say to you, and <hi>one</hi> more excellent than a prophet.

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: For this is <hi>the one</hi> of whom it is written, "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who shall prepare Your way before You."

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: Truly I say to you, Among <hi>those</hi> who have been born of women there has not risen a greater one than John the Baptist. But the least in the kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of Heaven is taken by violence, and the violent take it by force.

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: And if you will receive <hi>it</hi>, this is Elijah who is to come.

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: But to what shall I compare to this generation? It is like little children sitting in <hi>the</hi> markets and calling to their playmates,

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: saying, We played the flute to you, and you did not dance! We mourned to you, but you did not wail!

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a demon.

verses.name: Matthew 11:19
verses.text: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man who is a glutton and a winebibber, a friend of tax-collectors and sinners. But wisdom was justified by her children.

verses.name: Matthew 11:20
verses.text: Then He began to upbraid the cities in which most of His mighty works were done, because they did not repent.

verses.name: Matthew 11:21
verses.text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the powerful acts which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes!

verses.name: Matthew 11:22
verses.text: But I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judgment than for you.

verses.name: Matthew 11:23
verses.text: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to the heaven, shall be brought down to hell. For if the mighty works which have been done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

verses.name: Matthew 11:24
verses.text: But I say to you, it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:25
verses.text: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank You, O Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from <hi>the</hi> sophisticated and cunning, and revealed them to babes.

verses.name: Matthew 11:26
verses.text: Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.

verses.name: Matthew 11:27
verses.text: All things are delivered to Me by My Father. And no one knows the Son except the Father. Nor does anyone know the Father except the Son, and the one to whom the Son will reveal Him.

verses.name: Matthew 11:28
verses.text: Come to Me all <hi>you</hi> who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

verses.name: Matthew 11:29
verses.text: Take My yoke on you and learn of Me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and you shall find rest to your souls.

verses.name: Matthew 11:30
verses.text: For My yoke <hi>is</hi> easy, and My burden is light.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:1
verses.text: At that time Jesus went through the grain fields on the sabbath day. And His disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the heads <hi>of grain</hi> and to eat.

verses.name: Matthew 12:2
verses.text: But when the Pharisees saw, they said to Him, Behold, your disciples do that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath day.

verses.name: Matthew 12:3
verses.text: But He said to them, Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him,

verses.name: Matthew 12:4
verses.text: how he entered into the house of God and ate the showbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

verses.name: Matthew 12:5
verses.text: Or have you not read in the Law that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath and are blameless?

verses.name: Matthew 12:6
verses.text: But I say to you that <hi>One</hi> greater than the temple is in this place.

verses.name: Matthew 12:7
verses.text: But if you had known what <hi>this</hi> is, "I desire mercy and not sacrifice," you would not have condemned those who are not guilty.

verses.name: Matthew 12:8
verses.text: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath.

verses.name: Matthew 12:9
verses.text: And when He had departed from there, He went into their synagogue.

verses.name: Matthew 12:10
verses.text: And behold, a man having <hi>a</hi> withered hand. And they asked Him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbaths? This so that they might accuse Him.

verses.name: Matthew 12:11
verses.text: And He said to them, What man among you will be, who will have one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the sabbaths, will he not lay hold on it and lift <hi>it</hi> out?

verses.name: Matthew 12:12
verses.text: How much better is a man then than a sheep? Therefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

verses.name: Matthew 12:13
verses.text: Then He said to the man, Stretch out your hand. And he stretched <hi>it</hi> out, and it was restored whole like the other.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:14
verses.text: Then the Pharisees went out and held council against Him, as to how they might destroy Him.

verses.name: Matthew 12:15
verses.text: But when Jesus knew <hi>it</hi>, He withdrew Himself from there. And great crowds followed Him, and He healed them all.

verses.name: Matthew 12:16
verses.text: And He warned them that they not make Him known,

verses.name: Matthew 12:17
verses.text: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 12:18
verses.text: "Behold My Child whom I have chosen; My Beloved, in whom My soul is well pleased. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He shall declare judgment to the nations.

verses.name: Matthew 12:19
verses.text: He shall not strive, nor cry, nor shall any one hear His voice in the streets.

verses.name: Matthew 12:20
verses.text: He will not break a bruised reed, and He will not quench a smoking wick, until He sends out judgment to victory.

verses.name: Matthew 12:21
verses.text: And in His name the nations shall trust."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:22
verses.text: Then one who had been demon-possessed was brought to Him, blind and dumb. And He healed him, so much so that the blind and dumb one both spoke and saw.

verses.name: Matthew 12:23
verses.text: And all the people were amazed and said, Is not this the son of David?

verses.name: Matthew 12:24
verses.text: But when the Pharisees heard, they said, This <hi>one</hi> does not cast out demons except by Beelzebub the ruler of the demons.

verses.name: Matthew 12:25
verses.text: And Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. And every city or house divided against itself shall not stand.

verses.name: Matthew 12:26
verses.text: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?

verses.name: Matthew 12:27
verses.text: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast <hi>them</hi> out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

verses.name: Matthew 12:28
verses.text: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.

verses.name: Matthew 12:29
verses.text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house and spoil his goods, unless first he binds the strong one, and then he will plunder his house.

verses.name: Matthew 12:30
verses.text: The <hi>one</hi> who is not with Me is against Me, and the <hi>one</hi> who does not gather with Me scatters.

verses.name: Matthew 12:31
verses.text: Therefore I say to you, All kinds of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men, but the blasphemy <hi>against</hi> the Holy Spirit shall not be forgiven to men.

verses.name: Matthew 12:32
verses.text: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, either in this world or in the <hi>world</hi> to come.

verses.name: Matthew 12:33
verses.text: Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or else make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by <hi>its</hi> fruit.

verses.name: Matthew 12:34
verses.text: Offspring of vipers! How can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

verses.name: Matthew 12:35
verses.text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings out good things; and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings out evil things.

verses.name: Matthew 12:36
verses.text: But I say to you that every idle word, whatever men may speak, they shall give account of it in the day of judgment.

verses.name: Matthew 12:37
verses.text: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:38
verses.text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we want to see a sign from you.

verses.name: Matthew 12:39
verses.text: But He answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign. And there shall be no sign given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

verses.name: Matthew 12:40
verses.text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so the Son of man shall be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

verses.name: Matthew 12:41
verses.text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it, because they repented at the proclaiming of Jonah, and behold, <hi>One</hi> greater than Jonah <hi>is</hi> here.

verses.name: Matthew 12:42
verses.text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the Judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it, for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, <hi>One</hi> greater than Solomon <hi>is</hi> here.

verses.name: Matthew 12:43
verses.text: When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he walks through dry places seeking rest, and finds none.

verses.name: Matthew 12:44
verses.text: Then he said, I will return into my house from where I came out. And when he has come, he finds <hi>it</hi> empty, swept, and decorated.

verses.name: Matthew 12:45
verses.text: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and live there. And the last <hi>state</hi> of that man is worse than the first. Even so it also shall be to this evil generation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:46
verses.text: But while He yet talked with the people, behold, <hi>His</hi> mother and His brothers stood outside, desiring to speak with Him.

verses.name: Matthew 12:47
verses.text: Then one said to Him, Behold, Your mother and Your brothers stand outside, desiring to speak with You.

verses.name: Matthew 12:48
verses.text: And He answered and said to him who told Him, Who is My mother? And who are My brothers?

verses.name: Matthew 12:49
verses.text: And He stretched out His hand toward His disciples and said, Behold, My mother and My brothers!

verses.name: Matthew 12:50
verses.text: For whoever shall do the will of My Father in Heaven, the same is My brother and sister and mother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:1
verses.text: In that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

verses.name: Matthew 13:2
verses.text: And great crowds were gathered to Him, so that He went into a boat and sat. And all the crowd stood on the shore.

verses.name: Matthew 13:3
verses.text: And He spoke many things to them in parables, saying, Behold, the sower went out to sow.

verses.name: Matthew 13:4
verses.text: And as he sowed, some <hi>seeds</hi> fell by the wayside, and the birds came and devoured them.

verses.name: Matthew 13:5
verses.text: Some fell on stony places, where they did not have much earth. And they sprang up immediately, because they <hi>had</hi> no deepness of earth.

verses.name: Matthew 13:6
verses.text: And <hi>the</hi> sun rising, they were scorched, and because they had no root, they withered away.

verses.name: Matthew 13:7
verses.text: And some fell among thorns. And the thorns sprung up and choked them.

verses.name: Matthew 13:8
verses.text: And some fell on the good ground and yielded fruit, indeed one a hundredfold, and one sixty, and one thirty.

verses.name: Matthew 13:9
verses.text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.name: Matthew 13:10
verses.text: And the disciples said to Him, Why do You speak to them in parables?

verses.name: Matthew 13:11
verses.text: He answered and said to them, Because it is given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

verses.name: Matthew 13:12
verses.text: For whoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance. But whoever does not have, from him shall be taken away even that which he has.

verses.name: Matthew 13:13
verses.text: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they see not, and hearing they hear not; nor do they understand.

verses.name: Matthew 13:14
verses.text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah which said, "By hearing you shall hear and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see and shall not perceive;

verses.name: Matthew 13:15
verses.text: for this people's heart has become gross, and <hi>their</hi> ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes, lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with <hi>their</hi> ears and should understand with <hi> their</hi> heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them."

verses.name: Matthew 13:16
verses.text: But blessed <hi>are</hi> your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

verses.name: Matthew 13:17
verses.text: For truly I say to you that many prophets and righteous <hi>men</hi> have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear what you hear, and have not heard them.

verses.name: Matthew 13:18
verses.text: Therefore hear the parable of the sower.

verses.name: Matthew 13:19
verses.text: When anyone hears the Word of the kingdom and does not understand <hi>it,</hi> then the wicked one comes and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown by the wayside.

verses.name: Matthew 13:20
verses.text: But that which was sown on the stony places is this: he who hears the Word and immediately receives it with joy.

verses.name: Matthew 13:21
verses.text: But he has no root in himself, and is temporary. For when tribulation or persecution arises on account of the word, he immediately stumbles.

verses.name: Matthew 13:22
verses.text: And that sown into the thorns is this: he who hears the word; and the anxiety of this world, and the deceit of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

verses.name: Matthew 13:23
verses.text: But that sown on the good ground is this: "he who hears the Word and understands; who also bears fruit and produces" one truly a hundredfold; and one sixty; and one thirty.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:24
verses.text: He put out another parable to them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is compared to a man who sowed good seed in his field.

verses.name: Matthew 13:25
verses.text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel among the wheat and went his way.

verses.name: Matthew 13:26
verses.text: But when the blade had sprung up and had produced fruit, then the darnel also appeared.

verses.name: Matthew 13:27
verses.text: So the servants of the householder came and said to him, Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? Then where have the darnel come from?

verses.name: Matthew 13:28
verses.text: He said to them, An enemy has done this. The servants said to him, Then do you want us to go and gather them up?

verses.name: Matthew 13:29
verses.text: But he said, No, lest while you gather up the darnel you also root up the wheat with them.

verses.name: Matthew 13:30
verses.text: Let both grow together until the harvest. And in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, First gather together the darnel and bind them in bundles to burn them, but gather the wheat into my granary.

verses.name: Matthew 13:31
verses.text: He put out another parable to them, saying, The kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field;

verses.name: Matthew 13:32
verses.text: which indeed is the least of all seeds, but when it is grown it is the greatest among herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.

verses.name: Matthew 13:33
verses.text: He spoke another parable to them: The kingdom of Heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal until the whole was leavened.

verses.name: Matthew 13:34
verses.text: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables, and He did not speak to them without a parable,

verses.name: Matthew 13:35
verses.text: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, "I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world."

verses.name: Matthew 13:36
verses.text: Then sending the crowds away, Jesus went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, Explain to us the parable of the darnel of the field.

verses.name: Matthew 13:37
verses.text: He answered and said to them, He who sows the good seed is the Son of man;

verses.name: Matthew 13:38
verses.text: the field is the world; the good seed are the sons of the kingdom; but the darnel are the sons of the evil <hi>one</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:39
verses.text: The enemy who sowed them is the Devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

verses.name: Matthew 13:40
verses.text: Therefore as the darnel are gathered and burned in the fire, so it shall be in the end of this world.

verses.name: Matthew 13:41
verses.text: The Son of man shall send out His angels, and they shall gather out of His kingdom all things that offend, and those who do iniquity,

verses.name: Matthew 13:42
verses.text: and shall cast them into a furnace of fire. There shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 13:43
verses.text: Then the righteous shall shine out like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:44
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in a field, which when a man has found it, he hides it, and for the joy of it goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

verses.name: Matthew 13:45
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of Heaven is like a merchant seeking beautiful pearls;

verses.name: Matthew 13:46
verses.text: who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

verses.name: Matthew 13:47
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of Heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea, and gathered some of every kind;

verses.name: Matthew 13:48
verses.text: which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down and gathered the good into vessels, but threw the bad away.

verses.name: Matthew 13:49
verses.text: So it shall be at the end of the world. The angels shall come out and separate the wicked from among the just,

verses.name: Matthew 13:50
verses.text: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire. There shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 13:51
verses.text: Jesus said to them, Have you understood all these things? They said to Him, Yes, Lord.

verses.name: Matthew 13:52
verses.text: Then He said to them, Therefore every scribe <hi>who is</hi> instructed to the kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out <hi>things</hi> new and old out of his treasure.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:53
verses.text: And it happened when Jesus finished these parables, He departed from there.

verses.name: Matthew 13:54
verses.text: And when He had come into His own country, He taught them in their synagogue, so much so that they were astonished and said, From where does this <hi>man have</hi> this wisdom and these mighty works?

verses.name: Matthew 13:55
verses.text: Is not this the carpenter's son? <hi>Is</hi> not his mother called Mary? And his brothers, James and Joses and Simon and Judas,

verses.name: Matthew 13:56
verses.text: and his sisters, are they not all with us? Then from where does this <hi>man have</hi> all these things?

verses.name: Matthew 13:57
verses.text: And they were offended in Him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.

verses.name: Matthew 13:58
verses.text: And He did not do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:1
verses.text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus

verses.name: Matthew 14:2
verses.text: and said to his servants, This is John the Baptist. He has risen from the dead, and therefore the powerful works <hi>are</hi> working in him.

verses.name: Matthew 14:3
verses.text: For Herod had laid hold on John, and had bound him, and had put <hi>him</hi> in prison because of Herodias his brother Philip's wife.

verses.name: Matthew 14:4
verses.text: For John said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

verses.name: Matthew 14:5
verses.text: And when he desired to put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

verses.name: Matthew 14:6
verses.text: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod.

verses.name: Matthew 14:7
verses.text: So he promised with an oath to give her whatever she would ask.

verses.name: Matthew 14:8
verses.text: And she, being instructed before by her mother, said, Give me John the Baptist's head here on a platter.

verses.name: Matthew 14:9
verses.text: And the king was sorry. But for the oath's sake, and those reclining with <hi>him</hi>, he commanded <hi>it</hi> to be given.

verses.name: Matthew 14:10
verses.text: And he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

verses.name: Matthew 14:11
verses.text: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl. And she brought <hi>it</hi> to her mother.

verses.name: Matthew 14:12
verses.text: And his disciples came and took up the body and buried it, and went and told Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:13
verses.text: When Jesus heard, He departed from there by boat into a deserted place apart. And hearing, the crowds followed Him on foot out of the cities.

verses.name: Matthew 14:14
verses.text: And Jesus went out and saw a great crowd, and He was moved with compassion toward them. And He healed their sick.

verses.name: Matthew 14:15
verses.text: And evening coming on, His disciples came to Him, saying, The place is deserted and the time has already gone by. Send the crowd away so that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves.

verses.name: Matthew 14:16
verses.text: But Jesus said to them, They do not need to leave, you give them <hi>something</hi> to eat.

verses.name: Matthew 14:17
verses.text: And they said to Him, We have here only five loaves and two fish.

verses.name: Matthew 14:18
verses.text: And He said, Bring them here to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 14:19
verses.text: And He commanded the crowd to recline on the grass. And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to Heaven He blessed and broke, and gave the loaves to <hi>His</hi> disciples. And the disciples <hi>gave</hi> to the crowd.

verses.name: Matthew 14:20
verses.text: And they all ate and were filled. And they took up twelve hand baskets full from the fragments that remained.

verses.name: Matthew 14:21
verses.text: And they who had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:22
verses.text: And immediately Jesus constrained His disciples to get into a boat and to go before Him to the other side, while He sent the crowds away.

verses.name: Matthew 14:23
verses.text: And when He had sent the crowds away, He went up into a mountain apart to pray. And when evening had come, He was there alone.

verses.name: Matthew 14:24
verses.text: But the boat was now in <hi>the</hi> midst of the sea, tossed with waves; for the wind was against them.

verses.name: Matthew 14:25
verses.text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.

verses.name: Matthew 14:26
verses.text: And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a phantom! And they cried out for fear.

verses.name: Matthew 14:27
verses.text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, Be of good cheer, I AM! Do not fear.

verses.name: Matthew 14:28
verses.text: And Peter answered Him and said, LORD, if it is You, tell me to come to You on the water.

verses.name: Matthew 14:29
verses.text: And He said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus.

verses.name: Matthew 14:30
verses.text: But seeing that the wind was strong, he was afraid. And beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me!

verses.name: Matthew 14:31
verses.text: And immediately Jesus stretched out <hi>His</hi> hand and caught him; and said to him, Little-faith! Why did you doubt?

verses.name: Matthew 14:32
verses.text: And when they had come into the boat, the wind ceased.

verses.name: Matthew 14:33
verses.text: And those in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, Truly You are the Son of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:34
verses.text: And when they had passed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

verses.name: Matthew 14:35
verses.text: And recognizing Him, the men of that place sent to all that neighborhood, and brought to Him all who were diseased.

verses.name: Matthew 14:36
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> begged Him that they might only touch the hem of His robe. And as many as touched were made perfectly whole.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:1
verses.text: Then the scribes and Pharisees who were from Jerusalem came to Jesus, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 15:2
verses.text: Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread.

verses.name: Matthew 15:3
verses.text: But He answered and said to them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

verses.name: Matthew 15:4
verses.text: For God commanded, saying, "Honor your father and mother"; and, "He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him die by death."

verses.name: Matthew 15:5
verses.text: But you say, Whoever says to <hi>his</hi> father or mother, Whatever you would gain from me, <hi>It is</hi> a gift to God;

verses.name: Matthew 15:6
verses.text: and in no way he honors his father or his mother. And you voided the commandment of God by your tradition.

verses.name: Matthew 15:7
verses.text: Hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 15:8
verses.text: "This people draws near to Me with their mouth, and honors Me with <hi>their</hi> lips, but their heart is far from Me.

verses.name: Matthew 15:9
verses.text: But in vain they worship Me, teaching <hi>for</hi> doctrines <hi>the</hi> commandments of men."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:10
verses.text: And He called the crowd and said to them, Hear and understand.

verses.name: Matthew 15:11
verses.text: Not that which goes into the mouth defiles a man; but that which comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man.

verses.name: Matthew 15:12
verses.text: Then His disciples came and said to Him, Do You know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?

verses.name: Matthew 15:13
verses.text: But He answered and said, Every plant which My heavenly Father has not planted shall be rooted up.

verses.name: Matthew 15:14
verses.text: Let them alone. They are blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

verses.name: Matthew 15:15
verses.text: Then Peter answered and said to Him, Explain this parable to us.

verses.name: Matthew 15:16
verses.text: And Jesus said, Are you also still without understanding?

verses.name: Matthew 15:17
verses.text: Do you not yet understand that whatever enters in at the mouth goes into the belly, and is cast out into <hi>the</hi> waste-bowl?

verses.name: Matthew 15:18
verses.text: But the things which come out of the mouth come from the heart, and they defile the man.

verses.name: Matthew 15:19
verses.text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies;

verses.name: Matthew 15:20
verses.text: these are <hi>the things</hi> which defile a man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:21
verses.text: And going out from there, Jesus withdrew to the parts of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:22
verses.text: And behold, a woman of Canaan coming out of these borders cried to Him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David! My daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:23
verses.text: But He did not answer her a word. And His disciples came and begged Him, saying, Send her away, for she cries after us.

verses.name: Matthew 15:24
verses.text: But He answered and said, I am not sent except to the lost sheep of <hi>the</hi> house of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:25
verses.text: Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, Lord, help me!

verses.name: Matthew 15:26
verses.text: But He answered and said, It is not good to take the children's bread and to throw <hi>it</hi> to dogs.

verses.name: Matthew 15:27
verses.text: And she said, True, O Lord; but even the little dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' tables.

verses.name: Matthew 15:28
verses.text: Then Jesus answered and said to her, O woman, great <hi>is</hi> your faith! So be it to you even as you wish. And her daughter was healed from that very hour.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:29
verses.text: And moving from there Jesus came beside the Sea of Galilee. And He went up into a mountain and sat there.

verses.name: Matthew 15:30
