verses.text: And great crowds came to Him, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others. And they cast them down at Jesus' feet. And He healed them,

verses.name: Matthew 15:31
verses.text: so much so that the crowd wondered when they saw the dumb speak, the maimed sound, the lame walk, and the blind see. And they glorified the God of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:32
verses.text: Then Jesus called His disciples and said, I have compassion on the crowd because they continue with Me for three days now and have nothing to eat. And I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

verses.name: Matthew 15:33
verses.text: And His disciples said to Him, From where should we <hi>get</hi> so many loaves in the wilderness, so as to fill so great a crowd?

verses.name: Matthew 15:34
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, How many loaves do you have? And they said, Seven, and a few little fish.

verses.name: Matthew 15:35
verses.text: And He commanded the crowd to sit on the ground.

verses.name: Matthew 15:36
verses.text: And He took the seven loaves and the fish, and gave thanks, and broke, and gave to His disciples. And the disciples gave to the crowd.

verses.name: Matthew 15:37
verses.text: And they all ate, and were filled; and they took up seven lunch baskets full of the pieces that was left.

verses.name: Matthew 15:38
verses.text: And those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.name: Matthew 15:39
verses.text: And sending the crowd away, He went into the boat and came into the borders of Magdala.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:1
verses.text: The Pharisees and the Sadducees came to Him, tempting Him. And they asked Him that He would show them a sign from Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:2
verses.text: He answered and said to them, When it is evening, you say, Fair weather; for the sky is red.

verses.name: Matthew 16:3
verses.text: And in the morning, Foul weather today; for the sky is red and gloomy. Hypocrites! You can discern the face of the sky, but you cannot <hi>see</hi> the signs of the times!

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign. And there shall no sign be given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah. And He left them and went away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: And when His disciples had come to the other side, they forgot to take loaves.

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Take heed, and beware the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.name: Matthew 16:7
verses.text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, <hi>It is</hi> because we have taken no loaves.

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: And knowing Jesus said to them, Why do you reason among yourselves because you took no loaves, little-faiths?

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: Do you not yet understand, nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many hand baskets you took up;

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many lunch baskets you took up?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: How is it that you do not understand that I did not speak to you about loaves, but to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

verses.name: Matthew 16:12
verses.text: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: And coming into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asked His disciples, saying, Who do men say Me to be, the Son of man?

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: And they said, Some <hi>say</hi>, John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 16:15
verses.text: He said to them, But who do you say I am?

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, You are blessed, Simon, son of Jonah, for flesh and blood did not reveal <hi>it</hi> to you, but My Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:18
verses.text: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and <hi>the</hi> gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.name: Matthew 16:19
verses.text: And I will give the keys of the kingdom of Heaven to you. And whatever you may bind on earth shall occur, having been bound in Heaven, and whatever you may loose on earth shall occur, having been loosed in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 16:20
verses.text: Then He warned His disciples that they should tell no one that He was Jesus the Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
verses.text: From that time Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

verses.name: Matthew 16:22
verses.text: Then Peter took Him and began to rebuke Him, saying, <hi>God be</hi> gracious to You, Lord! This shall never be to You.

verses.name: Matthew 16:23
verses.text: But He turned and said to Peter, Go, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you do not savor the things that are of God, but those that are of men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:24
verses.text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

verses.name: Matthew 16:25
verses.text: For whoever desires to save his life shall lose it, and whoever desires to lose his life for My sake shall find it.

verses.name: Matthew 16:26
verses.text: For what is a man profited if he shall gain the whole world and lose his own soul? Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.name: Matthew 16:27
verses.text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He shall reward each one according to his works.

verses.name: Matthew 16:28
verses.text: Truly I say to you, There are some standing here who shall not taste of death until they see the Son of man coming in His kingdom.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:1
verses.text: And after six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain apart.

verses.name: Matthew 17:2
verses.text: And He was transfigured before them. And His face shone as the sun, and His clothing was white as the light.

verses.name: Matthew 17:3
verses.text: And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah talking with Him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:4
verses.text: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You will, let us make here three tabernacles; one for You, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

verses.name: Matthew 17:5
verses.text: While he yet spoke, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. And behold a voice out of the cloud which said, This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased, hear Him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:6
verses.text: And when the disciples heard, they fell on their face and were greatly terrified.

verses.name: Matthew 17:7
verses.text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise and do not be terrified.

verses.name: Matthew 17:8
verses.text: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus alone.

verses.name: Matthew 17:9
verses.text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Tell the vision to no one until the Son of man has risen from the dead.

verses.name: Matthew 17:10
verses.text: And His disciples asked Him, saying, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

verses.name: Matthew 17:11
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to them, Elijah truly shall come first and restore all things.

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: But I say to you that Elijah has come already, and they did not know him, but have done to him whatever they desired. Likewise also the Son of man shall suffer from them.

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: Then His disciples understood that He spoke to them about John the Baptist.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: And when they came to the crowd, a man came to Him, kneeling down to Him and saying,

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is a lunatic and grievously vexed; for oftentimes he falls into the fire, and often into the water.

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: And I brought him to Your disciples, and they could not cure him.

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I suffer you? Bring him here to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: And Jesus rebuked the demon, and he departed out of him. And the child was cured from that very hour.

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: Then the disciples came to Jesus apart, and said, Why could we not cast him out?

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Because of your unbelief. For truly I say to you, If you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you shall say to this mountain, Move from here to there. And it shall move. And nothing shall be impossible to you.

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: However, this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: And while they stayed in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men.

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: And they will kill Him, and the third day He will be raised again. And they grieved exceedingly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who received the didrachmas came to Peter and said, Does your master not pay the didrachmas?

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: He said, Yes. And when he had come into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? From their sons, or from strangers?

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: Peter said to Him, From strangers. Jesus said to him, Then truly the sons are free.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: But lest we should offend them, go to the sea and cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. And when you have opened its mouth, you shall find a stater; take that, and give it to them for Me and you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: At that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is the greater in the kingdom of Heaven?

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: And Jesus called a little child to Him and set him in their midst,

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: and said, Truly I say to you, Unless you are converted and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: Therefore whoever shall humble himself like this little child, this one is the greater in the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5
verses.text: And whoever shall receive one such little child in My name receives Me.

verses.name: Matthew 18:6
verses.text: But whoever shall offend one of these little <hi>ones</hi> who believes in Me, it would be better for him that an ass's millstone were hung around his neck, and he be sunk in the depth of the sea.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:7
verses.text: Woe to the world because of offenses! For it is necessary that offenses come; but woe to that man by whom the offense comes!

verses.name: Matthew 18:8
verses.text: And if your hand or your foot causes you to offend, cut them off and throw <hi>them</hi> from you. It is better for you to enter into life lame or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

verses.name: Matthew 18:9
verses.text: And if your eye offends you, pluck it out and throw <hi>it</hi> from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire.

verses.name: Matthew 18:10
verses.text: Take heed <hi>that</hi> you do not despise one of these little <hi>ones</hi>. For I say to you that in Heaven their angels always behold the face of My Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:11
verses.text: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.

verses.name: Matthew 18:12
verses.text: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them strays, does he not leave the ninety and nine <hi>and</hi> go into the mountains and seek the straying one?

verses.name: Matthew 18:13
verses.text: And if it happens that he finds it, truly I say to you, he rejoices more over it than over the ninety and nine which did not stray.

verses.name: Matthew 18:14
verses.text: Even so it is not <hi>the</hi> will of your Father in Heaven that one of these little <hi>ones</hi> should perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:15
verses.text: But if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.

verses.name: Matthew 18:16
verses.text: But if he will not hear <hi>you</hi>, take one or two more with you, so that in <hi>the</hi> mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

verses.name: Matthew 18:17
verses.text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell <hi>it</hi> to the church. But if he neglects to hear the church, let him be to you as a heathen and a tax-collector.

verses.name: Matthew 18:18
verses.text: Truly I say to you, Whatever you shall bind on earth shall occur, having been bound in Heaven; and whatever you shall loose on earth shall occur, having been loosed in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:19
verses.text: Again I say to you that if two of you shall agree on earth as regarding anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them by My Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:20
verses.text: For where two or three are gathered together in My name, there I am in their midst.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:21
verses.text: Then Peter came to Him and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me and I forgive him? Until seven times?

verses.name: Matthew 18:22
verses.text: Jesus said to him, I do not say to you, Until seven times; but, Until seventy times seven.

verses.name: Matthew 18:23
verses.text: Therefore the kingdom of Heaven has been compared to a certain king who desired to make an accounting with his servants.

verses.name: Matthew 18:24
verses.text: And when he had begun to count, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

verses.name: Matthew 18:25
verses.text: But as he had nothing to pay, his lord commanded that he, and his wife and children, and all that he had, be sold, and payment be made.

verses.name: Matthew 18:26
verses.text: Then the servant fell down and worshiped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me and I will pay you all.

verses.name: Matthew 18:27
verses.text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion and released him and forgave him the debt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:28
verses.text: But the same servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. And he laid hands on him and took <hi>him</hi> by the throat, saying, Pay me what you owe.

verses.name: Matthew 18:29
verses.text: And his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, Have patience with me and I will pay you all.

verses.name: Matthew 18:30
verses.text: And he would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay the debt.

verses.name: Matthew 18:31
verses.text: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were very sorry. And they came and told their lord all that was done.

verses.name: Matthew 18:32
verses.text: Then his lord, after he had called him, said to him, O wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

verses.name: Matthew 18:33
verses.text: Should you not also have pitied your fellow servant, even as I had pity on you?

verses.name: Matthew 18:34
verses.text: And his lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

verses.name: Matthew 18:35
verses.text: So likewise shall My heavenly Father do also to you, unless each one of you from your hearts forgive his brother their trespasses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:1
verses.text: And it happened, when Jesus had finished these sayings, that He departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond Jordan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:2
verses.text: And great crowds followed Him. And He healed them there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:3
verses.text: And the Pharisees came to Him, tempting Him and saying to Him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

verses.name: Matthew 19:4
verses.text: And He answered and said to them, Have you not read that He who made <hi>them</hi> at the beginning "made them male and female",

verses.name: Matthew 19:5
verses.text: and said, "For this cause a man shall leave father and mother and shall cling to his wife, and the two of them shall be one flesh?"

verses.name: Matthew 19:6
verses.text: "Therefore they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: They said to Him, Why did Moses then command to give a bill of divorce and to put her away?

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: He said to them, Because of your hard-heartedness Moses allowed you to put away your wives; but from the beginning it was not so.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: And I say to you, Whoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery; and whoever marries her <hi>who is</hi> put away commits adultery.

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: His disciples said to Him, If this is the case of the man with <hi>his</hi> wife, it is not good to marry.

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: But He said to them, Not all receive this word, except <hi>those</hi> to whom it is given.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: For there are some eunuchs who were born so from <hi>their</hi> mother's womb; and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive <hi>it</hi>, let him receive it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: Then little children were brought to Him, that He should put <hi>His</hi> hands on them and pray. And the disciples rebuked them.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: But Jesus said, Allow the little children to come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: And He laid <hi>His</hi> hands on them, and departed from there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: And behold, one came and said to Him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: And He said to him, Why do you call Me good? <hi>There is</hi> none good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: He said to Him, Which? Jesus said, You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness,

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: honor your father and mother, and, you shall love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: The young man said to Him, I have kept all these things from my youth up; what do I lack yet?

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to <hi>the</hi> poor, and you shall have treasure in Heaven. And come, follow Me.

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful; for he had great possessions.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:23
verses.text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, Truly I say to you that a rich man will with great difficulty enter into the kingdom of Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 19:24
verses.text: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Matthew 19:25
verses.text: When His disciples heard, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

verses.name: Matthew 19:26
verses.text: But Jesus looked on <hi>them</hi> and said to them, With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

verses.name: Matthew 19:27
verses.text: Then answering Peter said to Him, Behold, we have forsaken all and have followed You. Therefore what shall we have?

verses.name: Matthew 19:28
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that you who have followed Me, in the regeneration, when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of His glory, you also shall sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 19:29
verses.text: And everyone who left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for My name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

verses.name: Matthew 19:30
verses.text: But many <hi>who are</hi> first shall be last; and the last <hi>shall be</hi> first.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:1
verses.text: For the kingdom of Heaven is like a man, a housemaster, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers into his vineyard.

verses.name: Matthew 20:2
verses.text: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

verses.name: Matthew 20:3
verses.text: And he went out about the third hour and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

verses.name: Matthew 20:4
verses.text: And he said to them, You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you. And they went.

verses.name: Matthew 20:5
verses.text: And he went out about <hi>the</hi> sixth and ninth hour and did likewise.

verses.name: Matthew 20:6
verses.text: And about the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle, and said to them, Why do you stand here all day idle?

verses.name: Matthew 20:7
verses.text: They said to him, Because no one has hired us. He said to them, You also go into the vineyard, and you shall receive whatever is right.

verses.name: Matthew 20:8
verses.text: So when evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his steward, Call the laborers and pay them <hi>their</hi> wage, beginning from the last to the first.

verses.name: Matthew 20:9
verses.text: And when they <hi>who were hired about</hi> the eleventh hour came, they each one received a denarius.

verses.name: Matthew 20:10
verses.text: But when the first came, they supposed that they would received more; and they also each one received a denarius.

verses.name: Matthew 20:11
verses.text: And receiving <hi>it</hi> they murmured against the master of the house,

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: saying, These last have worked <hi>only</hi> one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and heat of the day.

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: But he answered one of them and said, Friend, I do you no wrong. Did you not agree with me for a denarius?

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: Take yours, and go; I will give to this last one the same as to you.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I want with my own? Is your eye evil because I am good?

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: So the last shall be first, and the first last, for many are called, but few are chosen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: And going up to Jerusalem, Jesus took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said to them,

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem. And the Son of man shall be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes, and they shall condemn Him to death.

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: And they shall deliver Him to the nations to mock and to scourge and to crucify. And the third day He shall rise again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: Then the mother of Zebedee's children came to Him with her sons, worshiping and desiring a certain thing from Him.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: And He said to her, What do you desire? She said to Him, Grant that these my two sons may sit in Your kingdom, the one on Your right hand and the other on the left.

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: But Jesus answered and said, You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They said to Him, We are able.

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: And He said to them, You shall indeed drink of My cup and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but <hi>to those</hi> for whom it has been prepared by My Father.

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: And when the ten heard <hi>it</hi>, they were indignant concerning the two brothers.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: But Jesus called them and said, You know that the rulers of the nations exercise dominion over them, and they who are great exercise authority over them.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: However, it shall not be so among you. But whoever desires to be great among you, let him be your servant.

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: And whoever desires to be chief among you, let him be your servant;

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: even as the Son of man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: And as they departed from Jericho, a great crowd followed Him.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: And behold, two blind men were sitting by the wayside. When they heard that Jesus passed by, they cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: And the crowd rebuked them, saying that they should be silent. But they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David!

verses.name: Matthew 20:32
verses.text: And Jesus stood still and called them, and said, What do you desire that I should do to you?

verses.name: Matthew 20:33
verses.text: They said to Him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: So Jesus had compassion <hi>on them</hi> and touched their eyes. And immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:1
verses.text: And when they drew near Jerusalem, and had come to Bethphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 21:2
verses.text: saying to them, Go into the village across from you. And immediately you will find an ass tied, and a colt with her. Untie <hi>them</hi> and bring <hi>them</hi> to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, The Lord has need of them, and immediately He will send them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:4
verses.text: All this was done so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 21:5
verses.text: "Tell the daughter of Zion, Behold, your King comes to you, meek, and sitting on an ass, even a colt the foal of an ass."

verses.name: Matthew 21:6
verses.text: And the disciples went and did as Jesus commanded them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:7
verses.text: And they brought the ass, even the colt, and put their clothes on them, and He sat on them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:8
verses.text: And a very great crowd spread their garments in the way. Others cut down branches from the trees and spread <hi>them</hi> in the way.

verses.name: Matthew 21:9
verses.text: And the crowds who went before, and those who followed, cried out, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed <hi>is</hi> He who comes in <hi>the</hi> name of <hi>the</hi> Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

verses.name: Matthew 21:10
verses.text: And when He had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

verses.name: Matthew 21:11
verses.text: And the crowd said, This is Jesus the prophet, from Nazareth of Galilee.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:12
verses.text: And Jesus went into the temple of God and cast out all those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of those who sold doves.

verses.name: Matthew 21:13
verses.text: And He said to them, It is written, "My house shall be called the house of prayer"; but you have made it a den of thieves.

verses.name: Matthew 21:14
verses.text: And the blind and the lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:15
verses.text: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things which He did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David, they were angry.

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: And they said to Him, Do you hear what these say? And Jesus said to them, Yes, have you never read, "Out of <hi>the</hi> mouth of babes and sucklings You have perfected praise?"

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: And leaving them, He went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: And returning early to the city, He hungered.

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: And seeing a fig tree in the way, He came <hi>to</hi> it and found nothing on it except leaves only. And He said to it, let no fruit grow on you forever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: And when the disciples saw, they marveled, saying, How quickly the fig tree has withered away!

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith and do not doubt, you shall not only do <hi>this miracle</hi> of the fig tree, but also; if you shall say to this mountain, Be moved and be thrown into the sea; it shall be done.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: And all things, whatever you shall ask in prayer, believing, you shall receive.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: And when He had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to Him <hi>as He was</hi> teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? And who gave you this authority?

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask you one thing; which if you tell Me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: The baptism of John, where was it from? From Heaven or from men? And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say to us, Why then did you not believe him?

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: But if we shall say From men, we fear the people; for all consider John as a prophet.

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: And they answered Jesus and said, We cannot tell. And He said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: But what do you think? A man had two sons; and he came to the first and said, Son, go work in my vineyard today.

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: He answered and said, I will not. But afterwards he repented and went.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: And he came to the second and said likewise. And he answered and said, I <hi>go</hi>, sir; and did not go.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: Which of the two did the will of <hi>his</hi> father? They said to Him, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that the tax-collectors and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: For John came to you in <hi>the</hi> way of righteousness, and you did not believe him. But the tax-collectors and the harlots believed him. And when you had seen <hi>it</hi>, you did not repent afterwards so that you might believe him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:33
verses.text: Hear another parable. There was a certain housemaster who planted a vineyard and hedged it round about, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower, and rented it to vinedressers, and went into a far country.

verses.name: Matthew 21:34
verses.text: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers to receive its fruits.

verses.name: Matthew 21:35
verses.text: And the vinedressers took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

verses.name: Matthew 21:36
verses.text: Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did the same to them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:37
verses.text: But last of all he sent his son to them, saying, They will respect my son.

verses.name: Matthew 21:38
verses.text: But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and get hold of his inheritance.

verses.name: Matthew 21:39
verses.text: And taking him, they threw <hi>him</hi> out of the vineyard and killed <hi>him</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:40
verses.text: Therefore when the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vinedressers?

verses.name: Matthew 21:41
verses.text: They said to Him, Bad men! He will miserably destroy them and will rent out <hi>his</hi> vineyard to other vinedressers who will give him the fruits in their seasons.

verses.name: Matthew 21:42
verses.text: Jesus said to them, Did you never read in the Scriptures, "The stone which the builders rejected, this One has become the head of <hi>the</hi> corner; this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?"

verses.name: Matthew 21:43
verses.text: Therefore I say to you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you and given to a nation bringing out its fruits.

verses.name: Matthew 21:44
verses.text: And he who falls on this Stone shall be broken, but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

verses.name: Matthew 21:45
verses.text: And when the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that He spoke of them.

verses.name: Matthew 21:46
verses.text: But seeking to lay hands on Him, they feared the crowd, because they held Him for a prophet.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:1
verses.text: And Jesus answered and spoke to them again by parables, and said,

verses.name: Matthew 22:2
verses.text: The kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who made a marriage for his son.

verses.name: Matthew 22:3
verses.text: And he sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding; and they would not come.

verses.name: Matthew 22:4
verses.text: Again he sent out other servants, saying, Tell those who are invited, Behold, I have prepared my dinner; my oxen and fatlings <hi>are</hi> killed, and all things <hi>are</hi> ready. Come to the marriage.

verses.name: Matthew 22:5
verses.text: But not caring, they went their ways, one to <hi>his</hi> field, another to <hi>his</hi> trading.

verses.name: Matthew 22:6
verses.text: And the rest took his servants and treated <hi>them</hi> spitefully, and killed <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: But when the king heard, he was angry. And he sent out his armies and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: Then he said to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they who were invited were not worthy.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: Therefore go into the exits of the highways, and as many as you shall find, invite them to the marriage.

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: So the servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. And the wedding was filled with reclining guests.

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: And the king coming in to look over the guests, he saw a man there who did not have on a wedding garment.

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: And he said to him, Friend, how did you come in here without having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: Then the king said to the servants, Bind him hand and foot and take him away, and cast <hi>him</hi> into outer darkness. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: For many are called, but few chosen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: Then the Pharisees left and took counsel that they might entangle Him in words.

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: And they sent their disciples out to Him along with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that you are true, and that you teach the way of God in truth. Nor do you care for anyone, for you do not regard <hi>the</hi> person of men.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: Therefore tell us; what do you think? Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar or not?

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why do you tempt Me, hypocrites?

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: Show Me the tribute money. And they brought a denarius to Him.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: And He said to them, Whose image and inscription <hi>is</hi> this?

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
verses.text: They said to Him, Caesar's. Then He said to them, Therefore render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: When they heard <hi>these words</hi>, they marveled, and they left Him and went away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: On that day the Sadducees came to Him, who say that there is no resurrection. And they asked Him,

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: saying, Master, Moses said, If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up seed to his brother.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: Now there were with us seven brothers. And the first, when he had married a wife, died. And, having no issue, he left his wife to his brother.

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: The second also did likewise, and the third, to the seventh.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: And last of all the woman also died.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: Therefore in the resurrection, whose wife shall she be, of the seven? For they all had her.

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, You err, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31
verses.text: But regarding the resurrection of the dead, have you not read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:32
verses.text: "I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?" God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

verses.name: Matthew 22:33
verses.text: And when the crowd heard <hi>this</hi>, they were astonished at His doctrine.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:34
verses.text: But hearing that He had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees were gathered together.

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked, tempting Him and saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: Master, which <hi>is</hi> the great commandment in the Law?

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
verses.text: Jesus said to him, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: This is the first and great commandment.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: And the second <hi>is</hi> like it, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.name: Matthew 22:40
verses.text: On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: While the Pharisees were gathered, Jesus asked them,

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: saying, What do you think of Christ? Whose son is he? They say to Him, David's.

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: He said to them, How then does David by the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: "the LORD said to my Lord, Sit on My right until I make Your enemies Your footstool for Your feet?"

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: If David then calls Him Lord, how is He his son?

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: And no one was able to answer Him a word, nor did anyone dare from that day to question Him any more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: Then Jesus spoke to the crowd and to His disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat.

verses.name: Matthew 23:3
verses.text: Therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do. But do not do according to their works; for they say, and do not do.

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: For they bind heavy and hard-to-carry burdens and lay <hi>them</hi> on men's shoulders. But they will not move them with one of their finger.

verses.name: Matthew 23:5
verses.text: But they do all their works in order to be seen of men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the borders of their garments.

verses.name: Matthew 23:6
verses.text: And they love the first couch at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: and greetings in the market-places, and to be called, Rabbi! Rabbi! by men.

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: But you must not be called Rabbi, for One is your teacher, Christ, and you are all brothers.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: And call no one your father on the earth, for One is your Father in Heaven.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: Nor be called teachers, for One is your Teacher, even Christ.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: And whoever shall exalt himself shall be abased, and he who shall humble himself shall be exalted.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you shut up the kingdom of Heaven against men. For you neither go in, nor do you allow those entering to go in.

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows' houses, and pray at length as a pretense. Therefore you shall receive the greater condemnation.

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you compass sea and the dry <hi>land</hi> to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: Woe to you, blind guides, saying, Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: Fools and blind! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: And, Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, <hi>he is</hi> a debtor!

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: Fools and blind! For which <hi>is</hi> greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: Therefore whoever shall swear by the altar swears by it, and by all things on it.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: And whoever shall swear by the temple, swears by it and by Him who dwells in it.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: And he who shall swear by Heaven swears by the throne of God, and by Him who sits on it.

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you pay tithes of mint and dill and cummin, and you have left undone the weightier <hi>matters</hi> of the Law, judgment, mercy, and faith. You ought to have done these and not to leave the other undone.

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: Blind guides who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel!

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you cleanse the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside they are full of extortion and excess.

verses.name: Matthew 23:26
verses.text: Blind Pharisee! First cleanse the inside of the cup and of the dish, so that the outside of them may be clean also.

verses.name: Matthew 23:27
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs, which indeed appear beautiful outside, but inside they are full of dead <hi>men's</hi> bones, and of all uncleanness.

verses.name: Matthew 23:28
verses.text: Even so you also appear righteous to men outwardly, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

verses.name: Matthew 23:29
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

verses.name: Matthew 23:30
verses.text: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

verses.name: Matthew 23:31
verses.text: Therefore you are witnesses to yourselves, that you are the sons of those who killed the prophets;

verses.name: Matthew 23:32
verses.text: and you fill up the measure of your fathers.

verses.name: Matthew 23:33
verses.text: Serpents! Offspring of vipers! How can you escape the condemnation of hell?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:34
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I send prophets and wise men and scribes to you. And you will kill and crucify <hi>some</hi> of them. And some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city;

verses.name: Matthew 23:35
verses.text: so that on you may come all <hi>the</hi> righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah the son of Berachiah, whom you killed between the temple and the altar.

verses.name: Matthew 23:36
verses.text: Truly I say to you, All these things shall come on this generation.

verses.name: Matthew 23:37
verses.text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the <hi>one</hi> killing the prophets and stoning those who are sent to her, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under <hi>her</hi> wings, and you would not!

verses.name: Matthew 23:38
verses.text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

verses.name: Matthew 23:39
verses.text: For I say to you, You shall not see Me from now on until you say, "Blessed <hi>is</hi> He who comes in <hi>the</hi> name of the Lord."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:1
verses.text: And Jesus went out and departed from the temple. And His disciples came to <hi>Him</hi> to show Him the buildings of the temple.

verses.name: Matthew 24:2
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Do you not see all these things? Truly I say to you, There shall not be left here one stone on another that shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Matthew 24:3
verses.text: And as He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? And what <hi>shall be</hi> the sign of Your coming, and of the end of the world?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:4
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

verses.name: Matthew 24:5
verses.text: For many will come in My name, saying, I am Christ, and will deceive many.

verses.name: Matthew 24:6
verses.text: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not troubled, for all <hi>these things</hi> must occur; but the end is not yet.

verses.name: Matthew 24:7
verses.text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be famines and pestilences and earthquakes in different places.

verses.name: Matthew 24:8
verses.text: All these <hi>are</hi> the beginning of sorrows.

verses.name: Matthew 24:9
verses.text: Then they will deliver you up to be afflicted and will kill you. And you will be hated of all nations for My name's sake.

verses.name: Matthew 24:10
verses.text: And then many will be offended, and will betray one another, and will hate one another.

verses.name: Matthew 24:11
verses.text: And many false prophets will rise and deceive many.

verses.name: Matthew 24:12
verses.text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many will become cold.

verses.name: Matthew 24:13
verses.text: But he who endures to <hi>the</hi> end, the same shall be kept safe.

verses.name: Matthew 24:14
verses.text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be proclaimed in all the world as a witness to all nations. And then the end shall come.

verses.name: Matthew 24:15
verses.text: Therefore when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place (whoever reads, let him understand).

verses.name: Matthew 24:16
verses.text: Then let those in Judea flee into the mountains.

verses.name: Matthew 24:17
verses.text: Let him on the housetop not come down to take anything out of his house;

verses.name: Matthew 24:18
verses.text: nor let him in the field turn back to take his clothes.

verses.name: Matthew 24:19
verses.text: And woe to those who are with child, and to those who give suck in those days!

verses.name: Matthew 24:20
verses.text: But pray that your flight is not in the winter, nor on the sabbath day;

verses.name: Matthew 24:21
verses.text: for then shall be great tribulation, such as has not been since <hi>the</hi> beginning of <hi>the</hi> world to this time; no, nor ever shall be.

verses.name: Matthew 24:22
verses.text: And unless those days should be shortened, no flesh would be saved. But for the elect's sake, those days shall be shortened.

verses.name: Matthew 24:23
verses.text: Then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here <hi>is</hi> Christ! Or, There! Do not believe it.

verses.name: Matthew 24:24
verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and show great signs and wonders; so much so that, if <hi>it were</hi> possible, they would deceive even the elect.

verses.name: Matthew 24:25
verses.text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

verses.name: Matthew 24:26
verses.text: Therefore if they shall say to you, Behold, <hi>He is</hi> in the desert! Do not go out. Behold, <hi>He is</hi> in the secret rooms! Do not believe it.

verses.name: Matthew 24:27
verses.text: For as the lightning comes out of <hi>the</hi> east and shines even to <hi>the</hi> west, so also will be the coming of the Son of man.

verses.name: Matthew 24:28
verses.text: For wherever the carcass is, there the eagles will be gathered.

verses.name: Matthew 24:29
verses.text: And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun shall be darkened and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from the heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

verses.name: Matthew 24:30
verses.text: And then the sign of the Son of man shall appear in the heavens. And then all the tribes of the earth shall mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of the heaven with power and great glory.

verses.name: Matthew 24:31
verses.text: And He shall send His angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of <hi>the</hi> heavens to the other.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:32
verses.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree. When its branch is still tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer <hi>is</hi> near.

verses.name: Matthew 24:33
verses.text: So you, likewise, when you see all these things, shall know that it is near, <hi>at</hi> the doors.

verses.name: Matthew 24:34
verses.text: Truly I say to you, This generation shall not pass until all these things are fulfilled.

verses.name: Matthew 24:35
verses.text: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Matthew 24:36
verses.text: But of that day and hour no one knows, no, not the angels of Heaven, but only My Father.

verses.name: Matthew 24:37
verses.text: But as the days of Noah <hi>were</hi>, so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

verses.name: Matthew 24:38
verses.text: For as in the days before the flood, they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until <hi>the</hi> day Noah entered into the ark.

verses.name: Matthew 24:39
verses.text: And they did not know until the flood came and took them all away. So also will be the coming of the Son of man.

verses.name: Matthew 24:40
verses.text: Then two shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Matthew 24:41
verses.text: Two shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Matthew 24:42
verses.text: Therefore watch; for you do not know what hour your Lord comes.

verses.name: Matthew 24:43
verses.text: But know this, that if the steward of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be dug through.

verses.name: Matthew 24:44
verses.text: Therefore you also be ready, for in that hour you think not, the Son of man comes.

verses.name: Matthew 24:45
verses.text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his Lord has made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season?

verses.name: Matthew 24:46
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> that servant whom his lord shall find him doing so when he comes.

verses.name: Matthew 24:47
verses.text: Truly I say to you that he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

verses.name: Matthew 24:48
verses.text: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delays his coming,

verses.name: Matthew 24:49
verses.text: and shall begin to strike <hi>his</hi> fellow servants, and to eat and drink with the drunken,

verses.name: Matthew 24:50
verses.text: the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he does not look for <hi>him</hi>, and in an hour which he does not know.

verses.name: Matthew 24:51
verses.text: And he shall cut him apart and appoint <hi>him</hi> his portion with the hypocrites. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:1
verses.text: Then shall the kingdom of Heaven be likened to ten virgins, who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

verses.name: Matthew 25:2
verses.text: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

verses.name: Matthew 25:3
verses.text: The foolish ones took their lamps, but took no oil with them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:4
verses.text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

verses.name: Matthew 25:5
verses.text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

verses.name: Matthew 25:6
verses.text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom comes! Go out to meet him.

verses.name: Matthew 25:7
verses.text: Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps.

verses.name: Matthew 25:8
verses.text: And the foolish said to the wise, Give us <hi>some</hi> of your oil, for our lamps have gone out.

verses.name: Matthew 25:9
verses.text: But the wise answered, saying, <hi>No</hi>, lest there be not enough for us and you. But rather go to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.

verses.name: Matthew 25:10
verses.text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came. And they who were ready went in with him to the marriage, and the door was shut.

verses.name: Matthew 25:11
verses.text: Afterwards the other virgins came also, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

verses.name: Matthew 25:12
verses.text: But he answered and said, Truly I say to you, I do not know you.

verses.name: Matthew 25:13
verses.text: Therefore watch, for you do not know either the day or the hour in which the Son of man comes.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:14
verses.text: For <hi>it is</hi> as if a man going abroad called <hi>his</hi> own servants and gave them his goods.

verses.name: Matthew 25:15
verses.text: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to each according to his ability. And he went abroad at once.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: And going he who had received the five talents traded with them, and made another five talents.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: And likewise he who <hi>had received</hi> two, he also gained another two.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: But he who had received the one talent went and dug in the earth and hid his lord's silver.

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: After a long time the lord of those servants came and took account with them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: And so he who had received five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, Lord, you delivered five talents to me. Behold, I have gained five talents above them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: His lord said to him, Well <hi>done</hi>, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful over a few things; I will <hi>make</hi> you <hi>ruler</hi> over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: He also who had received two talents came and said, Lord, you delivered two talents to me. Behold, I have gained two other talents above them.

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: His lord said to him, Well <hi>done</hi>, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful over a few things, I will <hi>make</hi> you <hi>ruler</hi> over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: And he who had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew that you were a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: And I was afraid and went and hid your talent in the earth. Lo, you have yours.

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: His lord answered and said to him, Evil and slothful servant! You knew that I reaped where I did not sow, and gathered where I did not scatter,

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: then you should have put my money to the exchangers, and coming I would have received my own with interest.

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: Therefore take the talent from him and give <hi>it</hi> to him who has ten talents.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: For to everyone who has, <hi>more</hi> shall be given, and he will abound. But from him who has not, even that which he has shall be taken away from him.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: And throw the unprofitable servant into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: But when the Son of man comes in His glory, and all the holy angels with Him, then He shall sit on the throne of His glory.

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: And all nations shall be gathered before Him. And He shall separate them from one another, as a shepherd divides the sheep from the goats.

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: And indeed <hi>He</hi> shall set the sheep on His right hand, but the goats off the left.

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: Then the King shall say to those on His right <hi>hand</hi>, Come, blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from <hi>the</hi> foundation of <hi>the</hi> world.

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: For I was hungry, and you gave me food; I was thirsty, and you gave Me drink; I was a stranger, and you took Me in;

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: I was naked, and you clothed Me; I was sick, and you visited Me; I was in prison, and you came to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: Then the righteous shall answer Him, saying, Lord, when did we see You hungry, and fed <hi>You</hi>? Or thirsty, and gave <hi>You</hi> drink?

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: When did we see You a stranger, and took <hi>You</hi> in? Or naked, and clothed <hi>You</hi>?

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: Or when did we see You sick, or in prison, and came to You?

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: And the King shall answer and say to them, Truly I say to you, Inasmuch as you did <hi>it</hi> to one of the least of these My brothers, you have done <hi>it</hi> to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: Then He also shall say to those on <hi>the</hi> left <hi>hand</hi>, Depart from Me, you cursed, into everlasting fire prepared for the Devil and his angels.

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: For I was hungry, and you gave Me no food; I was thirsty, and you gave Me no drink;

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in; I was naked, and you did not clothe Me; I was sick, and in prison, and you did not visit me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: Then they will also answer Him, saying, Lord, when did we see You hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to You?

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: Then He shall answer them, saying, Truly I say to you, Inasmuch as you did not do <hi>it</hi> to one of the least of these, you did not do <hi>it</hi> to Me.

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment, but the righteous into everlasting life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: And it happened when Jesus finished all these sayings, He said to His disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: You know that after two days the Passover comes, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: Then the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, assembled together to the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> consulted so that they might take Jesus by guile and kill <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: But they said, Not on the feast <hi>day</hi>, lest there be an uproar among the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: And when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: a woman came to Him, having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured <hi>it</hi> on His head as He reclined.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: But when His disciples saw <hi>it</hi>, they were indignant, saying, To what purpose <hi>is</hi> this waste?

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: For this ointment might have been sold for very much and given to <hi>the</hi> poor.

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: When Jesus understood <hi>it</hi>, He said to them, Why do you trouble the woman? For she has done a good work on Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:11
verses.text: For you have the poor with you always, but you do not always have Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: For in putting ointment on My body, she did <hi>it</hi> for My burial.

verses.name: Matthew 26:13
verses.text: Truly I say to you, Wherever this gospel shall be proclaimed in the whole world, that which this woman has done shall be spoken of also, for a memorial of her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests.

verses.name: Matthew 26:15
verses.text: And he said <hi>to them</hi>, What will you give me, and I will betray Him to you? And they appointed to him thirty pieces of silver.

verses.name: Matthew 26:16
verses.text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:17
verses.text: And on the first <hi>day</hi> of the <hi>Feast of</hi> Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to Him, Where do You desire that we prepare for You to eat the Passover?

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: And He said, Go into the city to such a man, and say to him, The Master said, My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with My disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 26:19
verses.text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them. And they made the passover ready.

verses.name: Matthew 26:20
verses.text: And when evening had come, He sat down with the Twelve.

verses.name: Matthew 26:21
verses.text: And as they ate, He said, Truly I say to you that one of you will betray Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: And grieving sorrowfully, they began to say, each one of them, Lord, not I am <hi>the one</hi>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:23
verses.text: And He answered and said, He who dips <hi>his</hi> hand with Me in the dish, the same shall betray Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:24
verses.text: The Son of man goes, as it has been written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had not been born.

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: And answering, the <hi>one</hi> betraying Him, Judas, said, Master, Not am I <hi>the one</hi>? He said to him, You said <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:26
verses.text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread and blessed <hi>it</hi>, and broke <hi>it</hi>, and gave <hi>it</hi> to the disciples, and said, Take, eat, this is My body.

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: And He took the cup and gave thanks, and gave <hi>it</hi> to them, saying, Drink all of it.

verses.name: Matthew 26:28
verses.text: For this is My blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: But I say to you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it new with you in My Father's kingdom.

verses.name: Matthew 26:30
verses.text: And singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:31
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, All of you will be offended because of Me this night. For it is written, "I will smite the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad."

verses.name: Matthew 26:32
verses.text: But after I have risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:33
verses.text: Peter answered and said to Him, though all shall be offended because of You, I will never be offended.

verses.name: Matthew 26:34
verses.text: Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that this night, before the cock crows, you shall deny Me three times.

verses.name: Matthew 26:35
verses.text: Peter said to Him, though I should die with You, yet I will not deny You. All the disciples also said the same.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:36
verses.text: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane. And He said to the disciples, Sit here while I go and pray there.

verses.name: Matthew 26:37
verses.text: And He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with Him, and He began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

verses.name: Matthew 26:38
verses.text: Then He said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Wait here and watch with Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:39
verses.text: And He went a little further and fell on His face, and prayed, saying, O My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You <hi>will</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:40
verses.text: And He came to the disciples and found them asleep. And <hi>He</hi> said to Peter, What! Could you not watch with Me one hour?

verses.name: Matthew 26:41
verses.text: Watch and pray that you enter not into temptation. The spirit indeed <hi>is</hi> willing, but the flesh <hi>is</hi> weak.

verses.name: Matthew 26:42
verses.text: He went away again the second time and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cup may not pass away from Me unless I drink it, Your will be done.

verses.name: Matthew 26:43
verses.text: And He came and found them asleep again, for their eyes were heavy.

verses.name: Matthew 26:44
verses.text: And He left them and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same word.

verses.name: Matthew 26:45
verses.text: Then He came to His disciples and said to them, Sleep on now and take <hi>your</hi> rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into <hi>the</hi> hands of sinners.

verses.name: Matthew 26:46
verses.text: Rise, let us be going; behold, he who is betraying Me is at hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:47
verses.text: And as He was yet speaking, behold, Judas came, one of the Twelve. And with him came a great crowd with swords and clubs, being sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.

verses.name: Matthew 26:48
verses.text: And he who betrayed Him gave them a sign, saying, Whomever I shall kiss, He is the one, lay hold on Him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:49
verses.text: And coming up to Jesus immediately, he said, Hail, Master! And <hi>he</hi> kissed Him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:50
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Friend, why are you here? Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and took Him.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: And, behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out <hi>his</hi> hand and drew his sword, and he struck a servant of the high priest and <hi>cut</hi> off his ear.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: Then Jesus said to him, put up your sword again into its place; for all who take <hi>the</hi> sword shall perish with a sword.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: Do you think that I cannot now pray to My Father, and He shall presently give Me more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: But how then shall the Scriptures be fulfilled, that it must be so?

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: In that hour Jesus said to the crowds, Have you come out in order to take Me with swords and clubs, as against a thief? I sat daily with you, teaching in the temple, and you did not lay hands on Me.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: But all this happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples fled, forsaking Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: And they who had seized Jesus led <hi>Him</hi> away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had assembled.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: But Peter followed Him afar off to the high priest's court, and he went in and sat with the servants to see the end.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: And the chief priests and the elders and all the sanhedrin sought false witness against Jesus, in order to put Him to death.

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: But they found none; yea, though many false witnesses came, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came up

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: and said, This one said, I am able to destroy the temple of God and to build it in three days.

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: And standing up, the high priest said to Him, Do you answer nothing? What <hi>is it that</hi> these witness against you?

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: But Jesus was silent. And the high priest answered and said to Him, I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
verses.text: Jesus said to him, You said <hi>it</hi>. I tell you more. From this time you shall see the Son of man sitting on <hi>the</hi> right <hi>hand</hi> of power, and coming on the clouds of the heavens.

verses.name: Matthew 26:65
verses.text: Then the high priest tore his clothes, saying, He has spoken blasphemy! What further need do we have of witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

verses.name: Matthew 26:66
verses.text: What do you think? They answered and said, He is worthy of death.

verses.name: Matthew 26:67
verses.text: Then they spat in His face and beat Him with the fist. And others struck <hi>Him</hi> with the palms of their hands,

verses.name: Matthew 26:68
verses.text: saying, Prophesy to us, Christ; who is the <hi>one</hi> who struck you?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:69
verses.text: And Peter sat outside in the court. And a girl came to him, saying, You also were with Jesus of Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 26:70
verses.text: But he denied all before <hi>them</hi>, saying, I do not know what you say.

verses.name: Matthew 26:71
verses.text: And when he had gone out into the porch, another saw him and said to those there, This one was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

verses.name: Matthew 26:72
verses.text: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

verses.name: Matthew 26:73
verses.text: And after a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, Surely you also are <hi>one</hi> of them, for your speech betrays you.

verses.name: Matthew 26:74
verses.text: Then he began to curse and to swear, I do not know the man. And immediately the cock crowed.

verses.name: Matthew 26:75
verses.text: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, Who said to him, Before the cock crows, you shall deny Me three times. And he went out and wept bitterly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:1
verses.text: And <hi>it</hi> becoming early morning, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put Him to death.

verses.name: Matthew 27:2
verses.text: And when they had bound Him, they led <hi>Him</hi> away and delivered Him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

verses.name: Matthew 27:3
verses.text: Then he who had betrayed Him, seeing that He was condemned, sorrowing, Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver again to the chief priests and elders,

verses.name: Matthew 27:4
verses.text: saying, I have sinned, betraying innocent blood. And they said, What <hi>is that</hi> to us? You see <hi>to that</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:5
verses.text: And he threw the pieces of silver down in the temple and departed. And he went and hanged himself.

verses.name: Matthew 27:6
verses.text: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because it is <hi>the</hi> price of blood.

verses.name: Matthew 27:7
verses.text: And they took counsel and bought the potter's field with them, to bury strangers in.

verses.name: Matthew 27:8
verses.text: Therefore that field was called, The Field of Blood, to this day.

verses.name: Matthew 27:9
verses.text: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, "And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of Him who had been priced, whom they of the children of Israel valued,

verses.name: Matthew 27:10
verses.text: and gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:11
verses.text: And Jesus stood before the governor. And the governor asked Him, saying, Are you the king of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:12
verses.text: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing.

verses.name: Matthew 27:13
verses.text: Then Pilate said to Him, Do you not hear how many things they witness against you?

verses.name: Matthew 27:14
verses.text: And He did not answer him a word, so that the governor greatly marveled.

verses.name: Matthew 27:15
verses.text: Now at <hi>that</hi> feast the governor was accustomed to release to the people a prisoner, whomever they desired.

verses.name: Matthew 27:16
verses.text: And they then had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:17
verses.text: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom do you desire that I release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus <hi>who is</hi> called Christ?

verses.name: Matthew 27:18
verses.text: For he knew they had delivered Him because of envy.

verses.name: Matthew 27:19
verses.text: But as he was sitting down on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that just man, for today because of Him I have suffered many things in a dream.

verses.name: Matthew 27:20
verses.text: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowd that they should ask <hi>for</hi> Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

verses.name: Matthew 27:21
verses.text: The governor answered and said to them, Which of the two do you desire that I release <hi>to</hi> you? They said, Barabbas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:22
verses.text: Pilate said to them, What then shall I do with Jesus, who is called Christ? <hi>They</hi> all said to him, Let Him be crucified.

verses.name: Matthew 27:23
verses.text: And the governor said, Why? What evil has He done? But they cried out the more, saying, let Him be crucified!

verses.name: Matthew 27:24
verses.text: But when Pilate saw that it gained nothing, but rather <hi>that</hi> a tumult was made, he took water and washed <hi>his</hi> hands before the crowd, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person. You see to it.

verses.name: Matthew 27:25
