verses.name: Mark 11:20
verses.text: And passing on early, they saw the fig-tree dried up from <hi>the</hi> roots.

verses.name: Mark 11:21
verses.text: And Peter, remembering, said to Him, Rabbi, behold, the fig tree which You cursed has withered away.

verses.name: Mark 11:22
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to them, Have faith of God.

verses.name: Mark 11:23
verses.text: For truly I say to you that whoever shall say to this mountain, Be moved and be cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that what he said shall occur, he shall have whatever he said.

verses.name: Mark 11:24
verses.text: Therefore I say to you, All things, whatever you ask, praying, believe that you shall receive <hi>them</hi>, and it will be to you.

verses.name: Mark 11:25
verses.text: And when you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive <hi>it</hi> so that also your Father in Heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

verses.name: Mark 11:26
verses.text: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in Heaven forgive your trespasses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:27
verses.text: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to Him

verses.name: Mark 11:28
verses.text: and said to Him, By what authority do you do these things? And who gave you this authority to do these things?

verses.name: Mark 11:29
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask of you one thing, and answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.name: Mark 11:30
verses.text: The baptism of John, was <hi>it</hi> from Heaven, or from men? Answer Me.

verses.name: Mark 11:31
verses.text: And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say, Why then did you not believe him?

verses.name: Mark 11:32
verses.text: But if we shall say, From men, they feared the people, for all held John to be a prophet indeed.

verses.name: Mark 11:33
verses.text: And they answered and said to Jesus, We cannot tell. And answering Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:1
verses.text: And He began to speak to them by parables. A man planted a vineyard, and set a fence about <hi>it</hi>, and dug a wine-vat, and built a tower, and <hi>he</hi> let it out to vinedressers, and went away.

verses.name: Mark 12:2
verses.text: And at the season he sent a servant to the vinedressers, so that he might receive from the vinedressers the fruit of the vineyard.

verses.name: Mark 12:3
verses.text: And taking <hi>him</hi>, they beat him and sent <hi>him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Mark 12:4
verses.text: And again he sent to them another servant. And stoning that one, they struck <hi>him</hi> in the head, and sent <hi>him</hi> away, insulting him.

verses.name: Mark 12:5
verses.text: And again he sent another. And they killed him, and many others, beating some and killing some.

verses.name: Mark 12:6
verses.text: Therefore, still having one son, his own beloved, he also sent him to them last of all, saying, They will respect my son.

verses.name: Mark 12:7
verses.text: But those vinedressers said among themselves, This is the heir! Come, let us kill him and the inheritance shall be ours.

verses.name: Mark 12:8
verses.text: And they took him and killed <hi>him</hi> and cast <hi>him</hi> out of the vineyard.

verses.name: Mark 12:9
verses.text: Therefore what will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the vinedressers and will give the vineyard to others.

verses.name: Mark 12:10
verses.text: And have you not read this scripture "<hi> The</hi> Stone which the builders rejected has become the Head of <hi>the</hi> corner:

verses.name: Mark 12:11
verses.text: this was from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes"?

verses.name: Mark 12:12
verses.text: And they sought to seize him, but feared the crowd. For they knew that He spoke the parable against them. And leaving Him, they went away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:13
verses.text: And they sent certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to Him, to catch Him in <hi>His</hi> words.

verses.name: Mark 12:14
verses.text: And coming, they said to Him, Teacher, we know that you are true and you care about no one. For you do not look to <hi>the</hi> face of men, but teach the way of God <hi>in</hi> truth. Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

verses.name: Mark 12:15
verses.text: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But knowing their hypocrisy, He said to them, Why do you tempt Me? Bring me a denarius so that I may see.

verses.name: Mark 12:16
verses.text: And they brought <hi>it</hi>. And He said to them, Whose image and inscription is this? And they said to Him, Caesar's.

verses.name: Mark 12:17
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:18
verses.text: Then the Sadducees came to Him, who say there is no resurrection. And they asked Him, saying,

verses.name: Mark 12:19
verses.text: Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If a man's brother die and leaves <hi>his</hi> wife, and leaves no children, his brother should take his wife and raise up seed to his brother.

verses.name: Mark 12:20
verses.text: And there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

verses.name: Mark 12:21
verses.text: And the second took her, and died; neither did he leave any seed. And the third likewise.

verses.name: Mark 12:22
verses.text: And the seven had her, and left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.

verses.name: Mark 12:23
verses.text: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.

verses.name: Mark 12:24
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to them, Do you not err because of this, not knowing Scriptures, nor the power of God?

verses.name: Mark 12:25
verses.text: For when they shall rise from <hi>the</hi> dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but they are as the angels in Heaven.

verses.name: Mark 12:26
verses.text: And as regards the dead, that they rise, have you not read in the book of Moses how God spoke to him in the Bush, saying, "I <hi>am</hi> the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob?"

verses.name: Mark 12:27
verses.text: He is not the God of <hi>the</hi> dead, but the God of <hi>the</hi> living. Therefore you greatly err.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:28
verses.text: And coming up one of the scribes heard them reasoning, knowing that He had answered them well, he asked Him, Which is <hi>the</hi> first commandment of all?

verses.name: Mark 12:29
verses.text: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments <hi>is</hi>, "Hear, O Israel, <hi>the</hi> Lord our God is one Lord;

verses.name: Mark 12:30
verses.text: and you shall love <hi>the</hi> Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength." This <hi>is</hi> the first commandment.

verses.name: Mark 12:31
verses.text: And <hi>the</hi> second <hi>is</hi> like this: You shall love your neighbor as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these.

verses.name: Mark 12:32
verses.text: And the scribe said to Him, Right, Teacher, according to truth You have spoken, that God is one, and there is no other besides Him.

verses.name: Mark 12:33
verses.text: And to love Him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love the neighbor as himself, is more than all the burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.name: Mark 12:34
verses.text: And seeing that he had answered intelligently, Jesus said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And no one dared to question Him any more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:35
verses.text: And answering, teaching in the temple, Jesus said, How do the scribes say that Christ is the Son of David?

verses.name: Mark 12:36
verses.text: For David himself said by the Holy Spirit: "The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as Your footstool."

verses.name: Mark 12:37
verses.text: David therefore himself calls Him Lord, and why <hi>then</hi> is He his son? And the great crowd heard Him gladly.

verses.name: Mark 12:38
verses.text: And He said to them in His teaching, Beware of the scribes, who love to walk about in robes, and <hi>love</hi> greetings in the markets,

verses.name: Mark 12:39
verses.text: and the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost places at feasts

verses.name: Mark 12:40
verses.text: who devour widows' houses, and as a pretense make long prayers. These shall receive greater condemnation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:41
verses.text: And sitting down opposite the treasury, Jesus watched how the people threw copper coins into the treasury. And many rich ones threw in much.

verses.name: Mark 12:42
verses.text: And a certain poor widow came, and she threw in two lepta, which is a kodrantes.

verses.name: Mark 12:43
verses.text: And He called His disciples and said to them, Truly I say to you that this poor widow has cast <hi>in</hi> more than all those who have cast into the treasury.

verses.name: Mark 12:44
verses.text: For all cast in from their abundance. But she, out of her poverty, has cast <hi>in</hi> all that she had, all her livelihood.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:1
verses.text: And as He went out of the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, Master, see! What stones and what buildings!

verses.name: Mark 13:2
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? There shall not be one stone left on another that shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Mark 13:3
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> He sat on the Mount of Olives, across from the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked Him privately,

verses.name: Mark 13:4
verses.text: Tell us, When shall all these things be? And what <hi>shall be</hi> the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:5
verses.text: And Jesus answering them began to say, Beware that no one deceive you.

verses.name: Mark 13:6
verses.text: For many shall come in My name, saying, I AM, and shall deceive many.

verses.name: Mark 13:7
verses.text: And when you shall hear <hi>of</hi> wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled. For it must happen, but the end <hi>shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> yet.

verses.name: Mark 13:8
verses.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there shall be earthquakes in different places, and there shall be famines and troubles. These things <hi>are</hi> the beginnings of sorrows.

verses.name: Mark 13:9
verses.text: But take heed to yourselves. For they shall deliver you up to sanhedrins, and in the synagogues you shall be beaten. And you shall be brought before rulers and kings for My sake, for a testimony against them.

verses.name: Mark 13:10
verses.text: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all nations.

verses.name: Mark 13:11
verses.text: But whenever they lead <hi>you</hi> away and deliver <hi>you</hi> up, take no thought beforehand what you should speak or think. But speak whatever shall be given to you in that hour. For it is not you who speaks, but the Holy Spirit.

verses.name: Mark 13:12
verses.text: And a brother will betray a brother to death, and a father his son. And children will rise up against <hi>their</hi> parents and will cause them to be put to death.

verses.name: Mark 13:13
verses.text: And you will be hated by all for My name's sake, but he enduring to the end, that <hi>one</hi> will be kept safe.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:14
verses.text: But when you see the abomination of desolation, that spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let him who reads understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

verses.name: Mark 13:15
verses.text: And let him who is on the housetop not go down into the house, nor enter to take anything out of his house.

verses.name: Mark 13:16
verses.text: And let him who is in the field not turn back again in order to take up his garment.

verses.name: Mark 13:17
verses.text: But woe to those with <hi>babe</hi> in womb, and to those who give suck in those days!

verses.name: Mark 13:18
verses.text: And pray that your flight is not in the winter.

verses.name: Mark 13:19
verses.text: For <hi>in</hi> those days shall be affliction, such as has not been from <hi>the</hi> beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never <hi>shall</hi> be.

verses.name: Mark 13:20
verses.text: And unless the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh would be saved. But for the elect's sake, whom He has chosen, He has shortened the days.

verses.name: Mark 13:21
verses.text: And then if anyone shall say to you, Lo, here <hi>is</hi> Christ! Or, lo, there! Do not believe him.

verses.name: Mark 13:22
verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will give signs and wonders in order to seduce, if possible, even the elect.

verses.name: Mark 13:23
verses.text: But take heed; behold, I have told you all things beforehand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:24
verses.text: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

verses.name: Mark 13:25
verses.text: and the stars of Heaven shall fall, and the powers in the heavens shall be shaken.

verses.name: Mark 13:26
verses.text: And then they will see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.name: Mark 13:27
verses.text: And then He shall send His angels and shall gather His elect from the four winds, from <hi>the</hi> end of <hi>the</hi> earth to <hi>the</hi> end of heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:28
verses.text: And learn the parable of the fig-tree: when her branch is still tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer is near.

verses.name: Mark 13:29
verses.text: So you also, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, at <hi>the</hi> doors.

verses.name: Mark 13:30
verses.text: Truly I say to you that this generation shall not pass away until all these things occur.

verses.name: Mark 13:31
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Mark 13:32
verses.text: But of that day and hour no one knows, no, not the angels in Heaven, nor the Son, but the Father.

verses.name: Mark 13:33
verses.text: Take heed, watch and pray, for you do not know when the time is.

verses.name: Mark 13:34
verses.text: As a man going away, leaving his house, and giving authority to his servants, and each man's work to him, and commanded the doorkeeper to watch.

verses.name: Mark 13:35
verses.text: Then you watch, for you do not know when the lord of the house is coming, <hi>at</hi> evening, or at midnight, or at cockcrowing, or early;

verses.name: Mark 13:36
verses.text: lest he come suddenly <hi>and</hi> find you sleeping.

verses.name: Mark 13:37
verses.text: And what I say to you, I say to all. Watch.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:1
verses.text: And after two days it was the Passover and <hi>the Feast of</hi> Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>. And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take Him by craft and kill <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 14:2
verses.text: But they said, Not during the Feast, lest there be an uproar of the people.

verses.name: Mark 14:3
verses.text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as He reclined, a woman came with an alabaster vial of pure, costly ointment of spikenard. And she broke the vial and poured <hi>it</hi> on His head.

verses.name: Mark 14:4
verses.text: And some were indignant to themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

verses.name: Mark 14:5
verses.text: For it might have been sold <hi>for</hi> more than three hundred denarii, and be given to the poor. And they were incensed with her.

verses.name: Mark 14:6
verses.text: And Jesus said, Let her alone! Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work towards Me.

verses.name: Mark 14:7
verses.text: For you have the poor with you always, and whenever you desire you may do them good. But you do not have Me always.

verses.name: Mark 14:8
verses.text: She has done what she could. She has come beforehand to anoint My body for the burying.

verses.name: Mark 14:9
verses.text: Truly I say to you, Wherever this gospel shall be proclaimed in all the world, <hi>this</hi> also that she has done will be spoken of for a memorial of her.

verses.name: Mark 14:10
verses.text: And Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray Him to them.

verses.name: Mark 14:11
verses.text: And when they heard, they were glad and promised to give him silver. And he sought how he might conveniently betray Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:12
verses.text: And the first day of Unleavened <hi>Bread</hi>, when they killed the passover, His disciples said to Him, Where do You desire that we go and prepare that You may eat the passover?

verses.name: Mark 14:13
verses.text: And He sent out two of His disciples and said to them, Go into the city, and there you shall meet a man bearing a pitcher of water. Follow him.

verses.name: Mark 14:14
verses.text: And wherever he may go in, you say to the housemaster, The Teacher says, Where is the guest room where I shall eat the passover with My disciples?

verses.name: Mark 14:15
verses.text: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished <hi>and</hi> prepared. Prepare there for us.

verses.name: Mark 14:16
verses.text: And His disciples went out and came into the city and found <hi>it</hi> as He had said to them. And they made the passover ready.

verses.name: Mark 14:17
verses.text: And in the evening He came with the Twelve.

verses.name: Mark 14:18
verses.text: And as they reclined and ate, Jesus said, Truly I say to you, One of you will betray Me, the <hi>one</hi> eating with Me.

verses.name: Mark 14:19
verses.text: And they began to be grieved, and to say to Him one by one, Not at all I, <hi>is it</hi>? And another said, Not at all I, <hi>is it</hi>?

verses.name: Mark 14:20
verses.text: And answering He said to them, <hi>It is</hi> one of the Twelve, the <hi>one</hi> dipping with Me in the dish.

verses.name: Mark 14:21
verses.text: The Son of man indeed goes, as it has been written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! It were good for that man if he had never been born.

verses.name: Mark 14:22
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> they ate, Jesus took a loaf and blessed and broke <hi>it</hi>, and He gave to them and said, Take, eat; this is My body.

verses.name: Mark 14:23
verses.text: And taking the cup, giving thanks, He gave to them. And they all drank out of it.

verses.name: Mark 14:24
verses.text: And He said to them, This is My blood of the New Covenant, which is poured out for many.

verses.name: Mark 14:25
verses.text: Truly I say to you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Mark 14:26
verses.text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.name: Mark 14:27
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, All of you will be offended because of Me this night. For it is written, "I will smite the Shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered."

verses.name: Mark 14:28
verses.text: But after I am raised, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.name: Mark 14:29
verses.text: But Peter said to Him, Although all shall be offended, yet I <hi>will</hi> not.

verses.name: Mark 14:30
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that today, in this night, before the cock crows twice, you shall deny Me three times.

verses.name: Mark 14:31
verses.text: But he spoke the more fervently, If I should die with You, I will not deny You in any way. Also they all said likewise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:32
verses.text: And they came to a place named Gethsemane. And He said to His disciples, Sit here while I pray.

verses.name: Mark 14:33
verses.text: And He took with Him Peter and James and John. And He began to be greatly amazed, and to be very heavy.

verses.name: Mark 14:34
verses.text: And He said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful to death. Stay here and watch.

verses.name: Mark 14:35
verses.text: And He went forward a little and fell on the ground. And He prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from Him.

verses.name: Mark 14:36
verses.text: And He said, Abba, Father, all things <hi>are</hi> possible to You. Take away this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You <hi>will</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 14:37
verses.text: And He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, do you sleep? Could you not watch one hour?

verses.name: Mark 14:38
verses.text: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. Truly the spirit <hi>is</hi> willing, but the flesh <hi>is</hi> weak.

verses.name: Mark 14:39
verses.text: And again He went away and prayed and spoke the same words.

verses.name: Mark 14:40
verses.text: And when He returned, He found them asleep again (for their eyes were heavy), neither did they know what to answer Him.

verses.name: Mark 14:41
verses.text: And He came the third time and said to them, Sleep on now and take <hi>your</hi> rest. It is enough, the hour has come. Behold, the Son of man has been betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.name: Mark 14:42
verses.text: Rise up, let us go. Lo, he who betrays Me is at hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:43
verses.text: And immediately, while He still spoke, Judas, being one of the Twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

verses.name: Mark 14:44
verses.text: And he who betrayed Him had given them a sign, saying, Whomever I shall kiss, <hi>it</hi> is He. Take Him and lead <hi>Him</hi> away safely.

verses.name: Mark 14:45
verses.text: And coming, at once drawing near to Him, he said, Rabbi, Rabbi! And <hi>he</hi> ardently kissed Him.

verses.name: Mark 14:46
verses.text: And they laid their hands on Him and seized Him.

verses.name: Mark 14:47
verses.text: And one of those standing by, drawing a sword, struck a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

verses.name: Mark 14:48
verses.text: And answering Jesus said to them, Have you come out with swords and clubs, as against a robber, to take Me?

verses.name: Mark 14:49
verses.text: I was with you daily in the temple teaching, and you did not seize Me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.

verses.name: Mark 14:50
verses.text: And leaving Him, all fled.

verses.name: Mark 14:51
verses.text: And one, a certain young man, followed Him, having thrown a linen cloth around <hi>his</hi> naked <hi>body</hi>. And the young men caught him.

verses.name: Mark 14:52
verses.text: And he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:53
verses.text: And they led Jesus away to the high priest. And with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

verses.name: Mark 14:54
verses.text: And Peter followed Him from a distance to the inside of the court of the high priest. And he sat with the servants and warmed himself at the fire.

verses.name: Mark 14:55
verses.text: And the chief priests and all the sanhedrin sought for witness against Jesus, to put Him to death. And <hi>they</hi> found none.

verses.name: Mark 14:56
verses.text: For many testified falsely against Him, but the testimonies were not identical.

verses.name: Mark 14:57
verses.text: And certain ones rose up and bore false witness against Him, saying,

verses.name: Mark 14:58
verses.text: We heard Him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

verses.name: Mark 14:59
verses.text: But neither was their testimony identical.

verses.name: Mark 14:60
verses.text: And standing up in the middle, the high priest questioned Jesus, saying, Do you answer nothing? What <hi>do</hi> these witness against you?

verses.name: Mark 14:61
verses.text: But He was silent and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked Him, saying to Him, Are you the Christ, the son of the Blessed?

verses.name: Mark 14:62
verses.text: And Jesus said, I AM! And you will see the Son of man sitting on the right <hi>hand</hi> of power and coming in the clouds of the heaven.

verses.name: Mark 14:63
verses.text: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, What further need do we have of witnesses?

verses.name: Mark 14:64
verses.text: You have heard the blasphemy; what do you think? And they all condemned Him to be guilty of death.

verses.name: Mark 14:65
verses.text: And some began to spit on Him, and to cover His face and to beat Him, and to say to Him, Prophesy! And the under-officers struck Him with slaps.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:66
verses.text: And as Peter was below in the palace, one of the servant women of the high priest came.

verses.name: Mark 14:67
verses.text: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked on him and said, And you also were with Jesus the Nazarene.

verses.name: Mark 14:68
verses.text: But he denied, saying, I do not know nor even understand what you are saying. And he went out into the forecourt. And a cock crowed.

verses.name: Mark 14:69
verses.text: And a servant woman saw him again and began to say to those who stood by, This <hi>one</hi> is of them.

verses.name: Mark 14:70
verses.text: And he denied it again. And a little after, those who stood by said again to Peter, Surely you are <hi>one</hi> of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech agrees.

verses.name: Mark 14:71
verses.text: But he began to curse and to swear, <hi>saying</hi>, I do not know this man of whom you speak.

verses.name: Mark 14:72
verses.text: And the second time a cock crowed. And Peter remembered the word that Jesus said to him, Before a cock crows twice, you will deny Me three times. And thinking on <hi>it</hi>, he wept.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:1
verses.text: And immediately in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council. And they bound Jesus and led <hi>Him</hi> away and delivered <hi>Him</hi> to Pilate.

verses.name: Mark 15:2
verses.text: And Pilate asked Him, Are you the king of the Jews? And answering He said to him, You say <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 15:3
verses.text: And the chief priests accused Him <hi>of</hi> many things, but He answered nothing.

verses.name: Mark 15:4
verses.text: And Pilate asked Him again, saying, Do you answer nothing? Behold how many things they witness against you?

verses.name: Mark 15:5
verses.text: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate marveled.

verses.name: Mark 15:6
verses.text: And at <hi>that</hi> feast he released to them one prisoner, whomever they desired.

verses.name: Mark 15:7
verses.text: And there was <hi>one</hi> named Barabbas, bound with the insurgents, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

verses.name: Mark 15:8
verses.text: And the crowd, crying aloud, began to beg <hi>him to do</hi> as he had always done to them.

verses.name: Mark 15:9
verses.text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Do you desire that I release to you the King of the Jews?

verses.name: Mark 15:10
verses.text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered Him because of envy.

verses.name: Mark 15:11
verses.text: But the chief priests moved the people that he should rather release Barabbas to them.

verses.name: Mark 15:12
verses.text: And Pilate answered and said again to them, What then do you desire that I should do <hi>to him</hi> whom you call the King of the Jews?

verses.name: Mark 15:13
verses.text: And they cried out again, Crucify him!

verses.name: Mark 15:14
verses.text: Then Pilate said to them, Why? What evil has he done? And they much more cried out, Crucify him!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:15
verses.text: And deciding to do the easiest <hi>to</hi> the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them, and having scourged <hi>Him</hi>, delivered up Jesus to be crucified.

verses.name: Mark 15:16
verses.text: And the soldiers led Him away inside the court, which is <hi>the</hi> praetorium. And they called together all the cohort.

verses.name: Mark 15:17
verses.text: And they clothed Him with purple and plaited a crown of thorns and put it around His <hi>head</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 15:18
verses.text: And they began to salute Him, Hail, King of the Jews!

verses.name: Mark 15:19
verses.text: And they struck Him on the head with a reed, and spat on Him, and placing the knees, <hi>they</hi> bowed to Him.

verses.name: Mark 15:20
verses.text: And when they had mocked Him, they took the purple off Him and put His own clothes on Him and led Him out to crucify Him.

verses.name: Mark 15:21
verses.text: And they made one who was passing by, Simon a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear His cross.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:22
verses.text: And they brought Him to Golgotha Place (which translated is, Place of a Skull).

verses.name: Mark 15:23
verses.text: And they gave Him wine mixed with myrrh to drink. But He did not take <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Mark 15:24
verses.text: And when they had crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots on them, as, to what <hi>each</hi> should take.

verses.name: Mark 15:25
verses.text: And it was <hi>the</hi> third hour, and they crucified Him.

verses.name: Mark 15:26
verses.text: And the inscription of His accusation was written over <hi>Him</hi>, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.name: Mark 15:27
verses.text: And with Him they crucified two thieves, the one off <hi>the</hi> right, and one off <hi>the</hi> left.

verses.name: Mark 15:28
verses.text: And the Scripture was fulfilled which said, "And he was numbered with <hi>the</hi> lawless."

verses.name: Mark 15:29
verses.text: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads and saying, Aha! You <hi>razing</hi> the temple and building <hi>it</hi> in three days,

verses.name: Mark 15:30
verses.text: save yourself and come down from the cross!

verses.name: Mark 15:31
verses.text: And also the chief priests mocking, with the scribes, said to one another, He saved others but he cannot save himself.

verses.name: Mark 15:32
verses.text: Let Christ the King of Israel now come down from the cross, so that we may see and believe. And they who were crucified with Him insulted Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:33
verses.text: And <hi>it</hi> being <hi>the</hi> sixth hour, darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.

verses.name: Mark 15:34
verses.text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? (which being translated is, My God, My God, why did You forsake Me?)

verses.name: Mark 15:35
verses.text: And hearing, some of those standing by said, Behold, he calls Elijah.

verses.name: Mark 15:36
verses.text: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar and put <hi>it</hi> on a reed and gave <hi>it</hi> to him to drink. <hi>But they said</hi>, Let alone, let us see if Elijah comes to take him down.

verses.name: Mark 15:37
verses.text: And letting out a loud voice, Jesus expired.

verses.name: Mark 15:38
verses.text: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

verses.name: Mark 15:39
verses.text: And when the centurion, who stood across from him, saw that He cried out so, <hi>and</hi> expired, he said, Truly this man was Son of God.

verses.name: Mark 15:40
verses.text: And also women were watching from a distance, among whom also was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less, and of Joses, and Salome,

verses.name: Mark 15:41
verses.text: (who also, when He was in Galilee, followed Him and ministered to Him), and many <hi>other</hi> women who came up with Him to Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:42
verses.text: And it, becoming evening already, since it was <hi>the</hi> Preparation, that is, <hi>the</hi> day before sabbath,

verses.name: Mark 15:43
verses.text: Joseph of Arimathea, an honorable counsellor, who also waited for the kingdom of God, came and went in boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

verses.name: Mark 15:44
verses.text: And Pilate wondered if He were already dead. And calling the centurion, he asked him whether He had died already.

verses.name: Mark 15:45
verses.text: And when he knew <hi>it</hi> from the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

verses.name: Mark 15:46
verses.text: And he bought a linen cloth, and took Him down, and wrapped <hi>Him</hi> in the linen, and laid Him in a tomb which was cut out of a rock, and rolled a stone to the door of the tomb.

verses.name: Mark 15:47
verses.text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary <hi>the mother</hi> of Joses saw where He was laid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:1
verses.text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, <hi>the mother</hi> of James and Salome, had bought sweet spices so that they might come and anoint Him.

verses.name: Mark 16:2
verses.text: And very early in the morning, the first <hi>day</hi> of the week, they came upon the tomb, the sun having risen.

verses.name: Mark 16:3
verses.text: And they said among themselves, Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?

verses.name: Mark 16:4
verses.text: And looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled back, for it was very great.

verses.name: Mark 16:5
verses.text: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right, clothed <hi>in</hi> a long white garment. And they were frightened.

verses.name: Mark 16:6
verses.text: And he said to them, Do not be frightened. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen, He is not here. Behold the place where they laid Him.

verses.name: Mark 16:7
verses.text: But go tell His disciples and Peter that He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see Him, as He said to you.

verses.name: Mark 16:8
verses.text: And they went out quickly and fled from the tomb. For they trembled and were amazed. Neither did they say anything to anyone, for they were afraid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:9
verses.text: And when <hi>Jesus</hi> had risen early the first <hi>day</hi> of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven demons.

verses.name: Mark 16:10
verses.text: She went <hi>and</hi> told those who had been with Him, as they mourned and wept.

verses.name: Mark 16:11
verses.text: And those hearing that He lives, and was seen by her, they did not believe.

verses.name: Mark 16:12
verses.text: After that He appeared in another form to two of them, walking <hi>and</hi> going into the country.

verses.name: Mark 16:13
verses.text: And they went and told <hi>it</hi> to the rest. Neither did they believe those.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:14
verses.text: Afterward He appeared to the Eleven as they reclined. And <hi>He</hi> reproached their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.

verses.name: Mark 16:15
verses.text: And He said to them, Go into all the world, proclaim the gospel to all the creation.

verses.name: Mark 16:16
verses.text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved, but he who does not believe will be condemned.

verses.name: Mark 16:17
verses.text: And signs will follow to those believing these things: in My name they will cast out demons; they will speak new tongues;

verses.name: Mark 16:18
verses.text: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will not hurt them. They will lay hands on <hi>the</hi> sick, and they will be well.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:19
verses.text: Then indeed, after speaking to them, the Lord was taken up into Heaven, and sat on <hi>the</hi> right hand of God.

verses.name: Mark 16:20
verses.text: And going out, they proclaimed everywhere, the Lord working with <hi>them</hi> and confirming the word by signs following.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:1
verses.text: Since many took in hand to draw up an account concerning the matters which have been borne out among us,

verses.name: Luke 1:2
verses.text: even as those who from <hi>the</hi> beginning delivered to us, becoming eye-witnesses and ministers of the word,

verses.name: Luke 1:3
verses.text: it seemed good to me also, following all things accurately from the very first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.name: Luke 1:4
verses.text: so that you might know the certainty of those things in which you have been instructed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:5
verses.text: In the days of Herod, the king of Judea, there was a certain priest named Zacharias, of <hi>the</hi> course of Abijah. And his wife <hi>was</hi> of the daughters of Aaron, and her name <hi>was</hi> Elizabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:6
verses.text: And they were both righteous before God, walking blameless in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:7
verses.text: And they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren. And both were advanced in their days.

verses.name: Luke 1:8
verses.text: And it happened in his serving in the order of his course, before God,

verses.name: Luke 1:9
verses.text: according to the custom of the priests, it was his lot to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:10
verses.text: And all the multitude of the people were praying outside at the time of incense.

verses.name: Luke 1:11
verses.text: And an angel <hi>of the</hi> Lord appeared to him as he was standing on <hi>the</hi> right of the altar of incense.

verses.name: Luke 1:12
verses.text: And seeing <hi>this</hi>, Zacharias was troubled, and fear fell on him.

verses.name: Luke 1:13
verses.text: But the angel said to him, Do not fear, Zacharias. For your prayer is heard, and your wife Elizabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

verses.name: Luke 1:14
verses.text: And you shall have joy and gladness, and many shall rejoice at his birth.

verses.name: Luke 1:15
verses.text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall neither drink wine nor strong drink. And he shall be filled with <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

verses.name: Luke 1:16
verses.text: And he shall turn many of the sons of Israel to <hi>the</hi> Lord their God.

verses.name: Luke 1:17
verses.text: And he shall go before Him in <hi>the</hi> spirit and power of Elijah, to turn <hi>the</hi> hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to <hi>the</hi> wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:18
verses.text: And Zacharias said to the angel, By what shall I know this? For I am old, and my wife is advanced in her days.

verses.name: Luke 1:19
verses.text: And answering, the angel said to him, I am Gabriel, who stands before God. And I am sent to speak to you and to show you these glad tidings.

verses.name: Luke 1:20
verses.text: And behold, you shall be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things shall be performed, because you did not believe my words which shall be fulfilled in their time.

verses.name: Luke 1:21
verses.text: And the people waited for Zacharias and marveled that he stayed so long in the temple.

verses.name: Luke 1:22
verses.text: And when he came out, he could not speak to them. And they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. And he was making signs to them, and remained speechless.

verses.name: Luke 1:23
verses.text: And as soon as the days of his service were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

verses.name: Luke 1:24
verses.text: And after those days his wife Elizabeth conceived and hid herself five months, saying,

verses.name: Luke 1:25
verses.text: So the Lord has dealt with me in the days in which He looked on <hi>me</hi>, to take away my reproach among men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:26
verses.text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

verses.name: Luke 1:27
verses.text: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of <hi>the</hi> house of David. And the virgin's name <hi>was</hi> Mary.

verses.name: Luke 1:28
verses.text: And the angel came in to her and said, Hail, <hi>one</hi> receiving grace, the Lord <hi>is</hi> with you. Blessed <hi>are</hi> you among women.

verses.name: Luke 1:29
verses.text: And when she saw <hi>him</hi>, she was troubled at his saying, and considered what kind of greeting this might be.

verses.name: Luke 1:30
verses.text: And the angel said to her, Do not fear, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

verses.name: Luke 1:31
verses.text: And behold! You shall conceive in <hi>your</hi> womb and bear a son, and you shall call His name JESUS.

verses.name: Luke 1:32
verses.text: He shall be great and shall be called the Son of <hi>the</hi> Highest. And the Lord God shall give Him the throne of His father David.

verses.name: Luke 1:33
verses.text: And He shall reign over the house of David forever, and of His kingdom there shall be no end.

verses.name: Luke 1:34
verses.text: Then Mary said to the angel, How shall this be, since I do not know a man?

verses.name: Luke 1:35
verses.text: And the angel answered and said to her, The Holy Spirit shall come on you, and <hi>the</hi> power of <hi>the</hi> Highest shall overshadow you. Therefore also that Holy <hi>One</hi> which will be born of you shall be called Son of God.

verses.name: Luke 1:36
verses.text: And behold, your cousin Elizabeth also conceived a son in her old age. And this <hi>is</hi> the sixth month with her who <hi>was</hi> called barren.

verses.name: Luke 1:37
verses.text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

verses.name: Luke 1:38
verses.text: And Mary said, Behold the servant of <hi>the</hi> Lord. Let it be to me according to your word. And the angel departed from her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:39
verses.text: And Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, to a city of Judah.

verses.name: Luke 1:40
verses.text: And <hi>she</hi> entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

verses.name: Luke 1:41
verses.text: And it happened as Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Luke 1:42
verses.text: and cried out with a loud voice and said, Blessed <hi>are</hi> you among women, and blessed <hi>is</hi> the fruit of your womb.

verses.name: Luke 1:43
verses.text: And from where <hi>is</hi> this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

verses.name: Luke 1:44
verses.text: For lo, as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

verses.name: Luke 1:45
verses.text: And blessed <hi>is</hi> she who believes, for there shall be a perfecting of those things which were told her from <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Luke 1:46
verses.text: And Mary said, My soul magnifies the Lord,

verses.name: Luke 1:47
verses.text: and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.

verses.name: Luke 1:48
verses.text: For He looked on the humiliation of His slave woman. For, behold, from now on all generations shall count me blessed.

verses.name: Luke 1:49
verses.text: For the Mighty One has done great things for me; and holy <hi>is</hi> His name.

verses.name: Luke 1:50
verses.text: And His mercy <hi>is</hi> on those who fear Him from generation to generation.

verses.name: Luke 1:51
verses.text: He has worked power with His arm, He has scattered the proud in <hi>the</hi> imagination of their heart.

verses.name: Luke 1:52
verses.text: He has put down rulers from <hi>their</hi> seats and exalted the lowly,

verses.name: Luke 1:53
verses.text: He has filled <hi>the</hi> hungry with good things, and He has sent away <hi>the</hi> rich empty.

verses.name: Luke 1:54
verses.text: He has helped His servant Israel, in remembrance of <hi>His</hi> mercy,

verses.name: Luke 1:55
verses.text: as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever.

verses.name: Luke 1:56
verses.text: And Mary stayed with her about three months, and returned to her own house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:57
verses.text: And the time was fulfilled to Elizabeth <hi>for</hi> her to bear. And she bore a son.

verses.name: Luke 1:58
verses.text: And her neighbors and her kinsfolk heard how <hi>the</hi> Lord had magnified His mercy with her, and they rejoiced with her.

verses.name: Luke 1:59
verses.text: And it happened that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and were calling it Zacharias, after his father's name.

verses.name: Luke 1:60
verses.text: And his mother answered and said, No, but he shall be called John.

verses.name: Luke 1:61
verses.text: And they said to her, There is none of your kindred that is called by this name.

verses.name: Luke 1:62
verses.text: And they made signs to his father as to how he would have him called.

verses.name: Luke 1:63
verses.text: And he asked for a writing tablet and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they all marveled.

verses.name: Luke 1:64
verses.text: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue <hi>loosened</hi>. And he spoke and praised God.

verses.name: Luke 1:65
verses.text: And fear came on all who lived all around them. And all these things were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

verses.name: Luke 1:66
verses.text: And all those who heard laid <hi>them</hi> up in their hearts, saying, What kind of child shall this be! And the hand of <hi>the</hi> Lord was with him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:67
verses.text: And his father Zacharias was filled with <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

verses.name: Luke 1:68
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is the</hi> Lord, the God of Israel, for He has visited and redeemed His people

verses.name: Luke 1:69
verses.text: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,

verses.name: Luke 1:70
verses.text: as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from eternity;

verses.name: Luke 1:71
verses.text: that we should be saved from our enemies and from <hi>the</hi> hand of all who hate us,

verses.name: Luke 1:72
verses.text: to perform the mercy <hi>promised</hi> to our fathers, and to remember His holy covenant,

verses.name: Luke 1:73
verses.text: <hi> the</hi> oath which He swore to our father Abraham,

verses.name: Luke 1:74
verses.text: that He would grant to us, <hi>that we</hi>, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, might serve Him without fear

verses.name: Luke 1:75
verses.text: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our life.

verses.name: Luke 1:76
verses.text: And you, child, will be called the prophet of <hi>the</hi> Highest, for you shall go before <hi>the</hi> face of <hi>the</hi> Lord to prepare His ways,

verses.name: Luke 1:77
verses.text: to give knowledge of salvation to His people by the remission of their sins,

verses.name: Luke 1:78
verses.text: through <hi>the</hi> tender mercy of our God; by which <hi>the</hi> Dayspring from on high has visited us,

verses.name: Luke 1:79
verses.text: to give light to those who sit in darkness and <hi>in</hi> the shadow of death, to guide our feet into <hi>the</hi> way of peace.

verses.name: Luke 1:80
verses.text: And the child grew and became strong in spirit and was in the deserts until <hi>the</hi> day of his showing to Israel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:1
verses.text: And it happened in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.

verses.name: Luke 2:2
verses.text: (This taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

verses.name: Luke 2:3
verses.text: And all went to be registered, each to <hi>his</hi> own city.

verses.name: Luke 2:4
verses.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee to be taxed (out of <hi>the</hi> city of Nazareth, into Judea, to <hi>the</hi> city of David which is called Bethlehem, because he was of <hi>the</hi> house and family line of David).

verses.name: Luke 2:5
verses.text: And he took Mary his betrothed wife, being with child.

verses.name: Luke 2:6
verses.text: And while they were there, the days <hi>for</hi> her deliverance were fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 2:7
verses.text: And she brought forth her son, the First-born, and wrapped Him, and laid Him in a manger-- because there was no room for them in the inn.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:8
verses.text: And in the same country there were shepherds living in the field, keeping watch over their flock <hi>by</hi> night.

verses.name: Luke 2:9
verses.text: And lo, the angel of <hi>the</hi> Lord came on them, and <hi>the</hi> glory of <hi>the</hi> Lord shone around them. And they were grievously afraid.

verses.name: Luke 2:10
verses.text: And the angel said to them, Do not fear. For behold, I give to you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

verses.name: Luke 2:11
verses.text: For to you is born today, in <hi>the</hi> city of David, a Savior, who is Christ <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Luke 2:12
verses.text: And this <hi>is</hi> a sign to you. You will find the babe wrapped, lying in a manger.

verses.name: Luke 2:13
verses.text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of <hi>the</hi> heavenly host, praising God and saying,

verses.name: Luke 2:14
verses.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

verses.name: Luke 2:15
verses.text: And it happened as the angels departed from them into Heaven, the shepherds said to one another, Indeed, let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing which has happened, which the Lord made known to us.

verses.name: Luke 2:16
verses.text: And hurrying they came and sought out both Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.

verses.name: Luke 2:17
verses.text: And seeing, they publicly told about the word spoken to them concerning this Child.

verses.name: Luke 2:18
verses.text: And all those who heard marveled about the things spoken to them by the shepherds.

verses.name: Luke 2:19
verses.text: But Mary kept all these sayings, meditating in her heart.

verses.name: Luke 2:20
verses.text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as was spoken to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:21
verses.text: And when eight days were fulfilled to circumcise the child, His name was called JESUS, <hi>the name</hi> called by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.

verses.name: Luke 2:22
verses.text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought Him to Jerusalem, to present <hi>Him</hi> to the Lord

verses.name: Luke 2:23
verses.text: (as it is written in <hi>the</hi> Law of the Lord, Every male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord)

verses.name: Luke 2:24
verses.text: and to offer a sacrifice according to that said in the Law of <hi>the</hi> Lord, A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:25
verses.text: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name <hi>was</hi> Simeon. And this man <hi>was</hi> just and devout, waiting for <hi>the</hi> Consolation of Israel. And <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit was on him.

verses.name: Luke 2:26
verses.text: And it happened to him, being instructed by the Holy Spirit, he was not to see death before he would see <hi>the</hi> Christ of <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Luke 2:27
verses.text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple. And <hi>as</hi> the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do according to the custom of the law concerning Him,

verses.name: Luke 2:28
verses.text: even he received Him in his arms and blessed God, and said,

verses.name: Luke 2:29
verses.text: Lord, now You will let Your servant depart in peace, according to Your word.

verses.name: Luke 2:30
verses.text: For my eyes have seen Your Salvation

verses.name: Luke 2:31
verses.text: which You have prepared before <hi>the</hi> face of all the peoples,

verses.name: Luke 2:32
verses.text: a light for revelation <hi>to the</hi> nations, and the glory of Your people Israel.

verses.name: Luke 2:33
verses.text: And Joseph and His mother marveled at those things which were spoken by him.

verses.name: Luke 2:34
verses.text: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary His mother, Behold, this One is set for <hi>the</hi> fall and rising again of many in Israel, and for a sign spoken against

verses.name: Luke 2:35
verses.text: (yea, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also), so that <hi>the</hi> thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

verses.name: Luke 2:36
verses.text: And there was a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of <hi>the</hi> tribe of Asher. She was advanced in many days, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity.

verses.name: Luke 2:37
verses.text: And she <hi>was</hi> a widow <hi>of</hi> eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day.

verses.name: Luke 2:38
verses.text: And she coming in at that instant gave thanks to the Lord and spoke of Him to all those in Jerusalem eagerly expecting redemption.

verses.name: Luke 2:39
verses.text: And when they had finished all things according to <hi>the</hi> Law of <hi>the</hi> Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

verses.name: Luke 2:40
verses.text: And the Child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom. And the grace of God was on Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:41
verses.text: And His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.

verses.name: Luke 2:42
verses.text: And when He was twelve years <hi>old</hi>, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the Feast.

verses.name: Luke 2:43
verses.text: And fulfilling the days, as they returned, the boy Jesus stayed in Jerusalem. And Joseph and His mother did not know.

verses.name: Luke 2:44
verses.text: But they, supposing Him to have been in the company, went a day's journey. And they looked for Him among the kinsfolk and acquaintances.

verses.name: Luke 2:45
verses.text: And when they did not find Him, they turned back to Jerusalem, seeking Him.

verses.name: Luke 2:46
verses.text: And it happened that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them and questioning them.

verses.name: Luke 2:47
verses.text: And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.

verses.name: Luke 2:48
verses.text: And seeing Him, they were amazed. And His mother said to Him, Child, why have you done so to us? Behold, your father and I have looked for you, greatly distressed.

verses.name: Luke 2:49
verses.text: And He said to them, Why did you look for Me? Do you not know that I must be about My Father's <hi>business</hi>?

verses.name: Luke 2:50
verses.text: And they did not understand the word which He spoke to them.

verses.name: Luke 2:51
verses.text: And He went with them and came to Nazareth, and He was subject to them. But His mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

verses.name: Luke 2:52
verses.text: And Jesus increased <hi>in</hi> wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:1
verses.text: And in <hi>the</hi> fifteenth year of the government of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and <hi>the</hi> Trachonitus country, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene--

verses.name: Luke 3:2
verses.text: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests-- the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

verses.name: Luke 3:3
verses.text: And he came into all the country around Jordan, proclaiming the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,

verses.name: Luke 3:4
verses.text: as it is written in <hi>the</hi> book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying, "<hi> The</hi> voice of one crying in the wilderness, prepare the way of <hi>the</hi> Lord, make His paths straight.

verses.name: Luke 3:5
verses.text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low, and the crooked shall be straight, and the rough ways <hi>shall be</hi> made smooth.

verses.name: Luke 3:6
verses.text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God."

verses.name: Luke 3:7
verses.text: Then he said to the crowd that came forth to be baptized by him, O generation of vipers! Who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.name: Luke 3:8
verses.text: Therefore bring forth fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for <hi>our</hi> father. For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

verses.name: Luke 3:9
verses.text: And now also the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

verses.name: Luke 3:10
verses.text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

verses.name: Luke 3:11
verses.text: He answered and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. And he who has food, let him do likewise.

verses.name: Luke 3:12
verses.text: And tax-collectors also came to be baptized and said to him, Teacher, what shall we do?

verses.name: Luke 3:13
verses.text: And he said to them, Continue to do no more than that commanded to you.

verses.name: Luke 3:14
verses.text: And the soldiers also asked of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said to them, Do not oppress anyone, nor accuse <hi>any</hi> falsely. And be content with your wages.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:15
verses.text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts concerning John, lest perhaps he was the Christ,

verses.name: Luke 3:16
verses.text: John answered all, saying, I indeed baptize you with water, but He who is mightier than I comes, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to loose. He shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire,

verses.name: Luke 3:17
verses.text: whose fan <hi>is</hi> in His hand, and He will thoroughly purge His floor and will gather the wheat into His storehouse. But He will burn the chaff with unquenchable fire.

verses.name: Luke 3:18
verses.text: And then indeed exhorting many things, he proclaimed the gospel to the people.

verses.name: Luke 3:19
verses.text: But Herod the tetrarch (being reproved by him on account of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, and for all <hi>the</hi> evils which Herod had done)

verses.name: Luke 3:20
verses.text: added still this above all, that he even shut John up in prison.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:21
verses.text: And it happened in the baptizing of all the people, Jesus also being baptized, and praying, and the heaven was opened.

verses.name: Luke 3:22
verses.text: And the Holy Spirit came down in a bodily shape, like a dove on Him. And a voice came from Heaven, which said, You are My Son, the Beloved; I am delighted in You.

verses.name: Luke 3:23
verses.text: And Jesus Himself was beginning to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) son of Joseph, <hi>son of</hi> of Heli,

verses.name: Luke 3:24
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Matthat, <hi>son of</hi> of Levi, <hi>son of</hi> of Melchi, <hi>son of</hi> of Janna, <hi>son of</hi> of Joseph,

verses.name: Luke 3:25
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Mattathias, <hi>son of</hi> of Amos, <hi>son of</hi> of Nahum, <hi>son of</hi> of Esli, <hi>son of</hi> of Naggai,

verses.name: Luke 3:26
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Maath, <hi>son of</hi> of Mattathias, <hi>son of</hi> of Semei, <hi>son of</hi> of Joseph, <hi>son of</hi> of Juda,

verses.name: Luke 3:27
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Joanna, <hi>son of</hi> of Rhesa, <hi>son of</hi> of Zerubbabel, <hi>son of</hi> of Shealtiel, <hi>son of</hi> of Neri,

verses.name: Luke 3:28
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Melchi, <hi>son of</hi> of Addi, <hi>son of</hi> of Cosam, <hi>son of</hi> of Elmodam, <hi>son of</hi> of Er,

verses.name: Luke 3:29
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Joses, <hi>son of</hi> of Eliezer, <hi>son of</hi> of Jorum, <hi>son of</hi> of Matthat, <hi>son of</hi> of Levi,

verses.name: Luke 3:30
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Simeon, <hi>son of</hi> of Juda, <hi>son of</hi> of Joseph, <hi>son of</hi> of Jonan, <hi>son of</hi> of Eliakim,

verses.name: Luke 3:31
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Melea, the son of Menan, <hi>son of</hi> of Mattatha, <hi>son of</hi> of Nathan, <hi>son of</hi> of David,

verses.name: Luke 3:32
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Jesse, <hi>son of</hi> of Obed, <hi>son of</hi> of Boaz, <hi>son of</hi> of Salma, <hi>son of</hi> of Nahshon,

verses.name: Luke 3:33
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Amminadab, <hi>son of</hi> of Ram, <hi>son of</hi> of Hezron, <hi>son of</hi> of Pharez, <hi>son of</hi> of Judah,

verses.name: Luke 3:34
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Jacob, <hi>son of</hi> of Isaac, <hi>son of</hi> of Abraham, <hi>son of</hi> of Terah, <hi>son of</hi> of Nahor,

verses.name: Luke 3:35
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Serug, <hi>son of</hi> of Reu, <hi>son of</hi> of Peleg, <hi>son of</hi> of Eber, <hi>son of</hi> of Shelah,

verses.name: Luke 3:36
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Cainan, <hi>son of</hi> of Arphaxad, <hi>son of</hi> of Shem, <hi>son of</hi> of Noah, <hi>son of</hi> of Lamech,

verses.name: Luke 3:37
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Methuselah, <hi>son of</hi> of Enoch, <hi>son of</hi> of Jared, <hi>son of</hi> of Mahalaleel, <hi>son of</hi> of Cainan,

verses.name: Luke 3:38
verses.text: <hi> son of</hi> of Enos, <hi>son of</hi> of Seth, <hi>son of</hi> of Adam, <hi>son of</hi> of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:1
verses.text: And Jesus, full of <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, returned from Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

verses.name: Luke 4:2
verses.text: forty days, being tempted by the Devil. And in those days He ate nothing. And they being ended, He afterward was hungry.

verses.name: Luke 4:3
verses.text: And the Devil said to Him, If you are the Son of God, speak to this stone that it might become bread.

verses.name: Luke 4:4
verses.text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written that "man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God."

verses.name: Luke 4:5
verses.text: And the Devil, leading Him up into a high mountain, showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.name: Luke 4:6
verses.text: And the Devil said to Him, All this power I will give you, and the glory of them; for it has been delivered to me. And I give it to whomever I will.

verses.name: Luke 4:7
verses.text: Therefore if you will worship me, all shall be yours.

verses.name: Luke 4:8
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to him, Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, "You shall worship <hi>the</hi> Lord your God, and Him only shall you serve."

verses.name: Luke 4:9
verses.text: And he brought Him to Jerusalem and sat Him on a pinnacle of the temple and said to Him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here.

verses.name: Luke 4:10
verses.text: For it is written, "He shall give His angels charge over You, to keep You;

verses.name: Luke 4:11
verses.text: and in <hi>their</hi> hands they shall bear You up, lest at any time You dash Your foot against a stone."

verses.name: Luke 4:12
verses.text: And Jesus answering said to him, It has been said, "You shall not tempt <hi>the</hi> Lord your God."

verses.name: Luke 4:13
verses.text: And when the Devil had ended every temptation, he departed from Him for a time.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:14
verses.text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee. And a report went out throughout all the neighborhood concerning Him.

verses.name: Luke 4:15
verses.text: And He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

verses.name: Luke 4:16
verses.text: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. And, as His custom was, He went in to the synagogue on the Sabbath day and stood up to read.

verses.name: Luke 4:17
verses.text: And <hi>the</hi> book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. And unrolling the book, He found the place where it was written,

verses.name: Luke 4:18
verses.text: "The Spirit of <hi>the</hi> Lord <hi>is</hi> on Me; because of this He has anointed Me to proclaim the Gospel to <hi>the</hi> poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim deliverance to the captives, and new sight to <hi> the</hi> blind, to set at liberty those having been crushed,

verses.name: Luke 4:19
verses.text: to proclaim the acceptable year of <hi>the</hi> Lord."

verses.name: Luke 4:20
verses.text: And rolling up the book, returning <hi>it</hi> to the attendant, He sat down. And the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on Him.

verses.name: Luke 4:21
verses.text: And He began to say to them, Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your ears.

verses.name: Luke 4:22
verses.text: And all bore witness to Him and wondered at the gracious words which came out of His mouth. And they said, Is this not Joseph's son?

verses.name: Luke 4:23
verses.text: And He said to them, You will surely say this proverb to Me, Physician, heal yourself. Whatever <hi>we</hi> have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your native-place.

verses.name: Luke 4:24
verses.text: And He said, Truly I say to you, No prophet is accepted in his native-place.

verses.name: Luke 4:25
verses.text: But I tell you truly, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land.

verses.name: Luke 4:26
verses.text: But Elijah was not sent to any of them, except to Zarephath, <hi>a city</hi> of Sidon, to a woman, a widow.

verses.name: Luke 4:27
verses.text: And many lepers were in Israel in the <hi>time</hi> of Elisha the prophet, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian.

verses.name: Luke 4:28
verses.text: And hearing these things, all in the synagogue were filled <hi>with</hi> wrath.

verses.name: Luke 4:29
verses.text: And they rose up and thrust Him outside the city, and led Him up to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, in order to throw Him down.

verses.name: Luke 4:30
verses.text: But passing through the midst of them, He went away.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:31
verses.text: And He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them <hi>on</hi> the sabbath days.

verses.name: Luke 4:32
verses.text: And they were astonished at His doctrine, for His word was with authority.

verses.name: Luke 4:33
verses.text: And in the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon and cried out with a loud voice,

verses.name: Luke 4:34
verses.text: saying, Let <hi>us</hi> alone! What is to us and to You, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know You, who You are, the Holy One of God.

verses.name: Luke 4:35
verses.text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be quiet and come out of him! And when the demon had thrown him into the midst, he came out of him, not harming him.

verses.name: Luke 4:36
verses.text: And they were all amazed and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word <hi>is</hi> this! For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.

verses.name: Luke 4:37
verses.text: And a report about Him went out into every place of the neighborhood.

verses.name: Luke 4:38
verses.text: And rising up from the synagogue, He entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was being seized with a great fever. And they asked Him for her.

verses.name: Luke 4:39
verses.text: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever. And it left her. And immediately she arose and served them.

verses.name: Luke 4:40
verses.text: And the sun sinking, all, as many as had sick ones with different kinds of diseases brought them to Him. And laying hands on each of them, He healed them.

verses.name: Luke 4:41
verses.text: And also demons came out of many, crying out and saying, You are the Christ, the Son of God! And rebuking <hi>them</hi>, He did not allow them to speak; for they knew Him to be the Christ.

verses.name: Luke 4:42
verses.text: And day coming on, going out, He went into a deserted place. And the crowds looked for Him and came to Him, and held Him fast, not to pass away from them.

verses.name: Luke 4:43
verses.text: And He said to them, I must proclaim the gospel, the kingdom of God, to other cities, because I was sent on this <hi>mission</hi>,

verses.name: Luke 4:44
verses.text: And He proclaimed in the synagogues of Galilee.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:1
verses.text: And it happened that the crowd pressed on Him to hear the word of God, He stood by the lake of Gennesaret.

verses.name: Luke 5:2
verses.text: And He saw two boats standing by the lake. But the fishermen had left them and were washing <hi>their</hi> nets.

verses.name: Luke 5:3
verses.text: And He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, He asked him to thrust out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the people out of the boat.

verses.name: Luke 5:4
verses.text: And as He stopped speaking, He said to Simon, Launch out into the deep and let your nets down for a haul.

verses.name: Luke 5:5
verses.text: And answering, Simon said to Him, Master, we have toiled all the night and have taken nothing. Yet at Your word I will let down the net.

verses.name: Luke 5:6
verses.text: And doing this, they enclosed a great multitude of fish. And their net was being torn.

verses.name: Luke 5:7
verses.text: And they signaled the partners, those in the other boat, to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.

verses.name: Luke 5:8
verses.text: And seeing, Simon Peter fell at the knees of Jesus, saying, Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.

verses.name: Luke 5:9
verses.text: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the haul of fish which they had taken,

verses.name: Luke 5:10
verses.text: and so also <hi>were</hi> James and John, <hi>the</hi> sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Do not fear, from now on you will be taking men alive.

verses.name: Luke 5:11
verses.text: And bringing their boats onto land, forsaking all things, they followed Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:12
verses.text: And it happened, as He was in a certain city, behold, a man full of leprosy! And seeing Jesus, he fell on <hi>his</hi> face and begged Him, saying, Lord, if You will, You can cleanse me.

verses.name: Luke 5:13
verses.text: And stretching out the hand, He touched him, saying, I will! Be clean! And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

verses.name: Luke 5:14
verses.text: And He commanded him, Tell no one, but go and show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing, as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

verses.name: Luke 5:15
verses.text: But the word about Him spread even more. And great crowds were coming to hear, and to be healed from their infirmities by Him.

verses.name: Luke 5:16
verses.text: But He was drawing back in the wilderness, and praying.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:17
verses.text: And it happened on one of the days, even He was teaching. And Pharisees and teachers of <hi>the</hi> Law were sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem. And <hi>the</hi> power of <hi>the</hi> Lord was there, for the curing <hi>of</hi> them.

verses.name: Luke 5:18
verses.text: And behold, men carrying, on a cot, a man who was paralyzed. And they sought to bring him in and to lay <hi>him</hi> before Him.

verses.name: Luke 5:19
verses.text: And not finding a way by <hi>which</hi> they might bring him in through the crowd, going up on the housetop, they let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst, before Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 5:20
verses.text: And seeing their faith, He said to him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

verses.name: Luke 5:21
verses.text: And the scribes and Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, except God alone?

verses.name: Luke 5:22
verses.text: But knowing their thoughts, answering, Jesus said to them, Why do you reason in your hearts?

verses.name: Luke 5:23
verses.text: Which is easier, to say, Your sins are forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk?

verses.name: Luke 5:24
verses.text: But so that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins, He said to the paralytic, I say to you, Arise, and take up your cot <hi>and</hi> go to your house.

verses.name: Luke 5:25
verses.text: And immediately he rose up before them and took up <hi>that</hi> on which he lay. And he departed to his own house, glorifying God.

verses.name: Luke 5:26
verses.text: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled <hi>with</hi> fear, saying, We saw wonderful things today.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:27
verses.text: And after these things He went out and saw a tax-collector named Levi, sitting at the tax-office. And <hi>He</hi> said to him, Follow Me.

verses.name: Luke 5:28
verses.text: And leaving all, he rose up and followed Him.

verses.name: Luke 5:29
verses.text: And Levi made a great feast in his own house for Him. And there was a great company of tax-collectors and of others who were reclining with them.

verses.name: Luke 5:30
verses.text: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against His disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with tax-collectors and sinners?

verses.name: Luke 5:31
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to them, Those who are sound do not need a physician, but those who are sick.

verses.name: Luke 5:32
verses.text: I did not come to call the righteous to repentance, but sinners.

verses.name: Luke 5:33
verses.text: And they said to Him, Why do John's disciples fast often and make prayers, and also <hi>the disciples</hi> of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?

verses.name: Luke 5:34
verses.text: But He said to them, Can you make the sons of the bridechamber fast while the bridegroom is with them?

verses.name: Luke 5:35
verses.text: But the days will come when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast in those days.

verses.name: Luke 5:36
verses.text: And He also spoke a parable to them: No one puts a piece of a new garment on an old garment. Otherwise, both the new will tear, and <hi>the old</hi> does not match <hi>the</hi> piece from the new.

verses.name: Luke 5:37
verses.text: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Else the new wine will burst the wineskins and be spilled, and the wineskin will perish.

verses.name: Luke 5:38
verses.text: But new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved together.

verses.name: Luke 5:39
verses.text: Also no one having drunk old <hi>wine</hi> immediately desires new, for he says, The old is better.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:1
verses.text: And it happened on the second chief sabbath, He went through the grain fields. And His disciples plucked the heads <hi>of grain</hi> and ate, rubbing <hi>them</hi> in their hands.

verses.name: Luke 6:2
verses.text: And certain of the Pharisees said to them, Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

verses.name: Luke 6:3
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Have you not read this, what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

verses.name: Luke 6:4
verses.text: how he went into the house of God and took the showbread, and ate (and also gave to those who were with him) which it is not lawful to eat, except for the priests alone?

verses.name: Luke 6:5
verses.text: And He said to them, The Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

verses.name: Luke 6:6
verses.text: And it happened, also on another sabbath, that He entered into the synagogue and taught. And there was a man whose right hand was withered.

verses.name: Luke 6:7
verses.text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him <hi>to see</hi> if He would heal on the sabbath day, so that they might find an accusation against Him.

verses.name: Luke 6:8
verses.text: But He knew their thoughts and said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise up and stand in the middle. And he arose and stood.

verses.name: Luke 6:9
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, I will ask you one thing: Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil, to save life, or to destroy <hi>it</hi>?

verses.name: Luke 6:10
verses.text: And looking around on them all, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand! And he did so. And his hand was restored whole like the other.

verses.name: Luke 6:11
verses.text: And they were filled <hi>with</hi> madness, and talked with one another <hi>as to</hi> what they might do to Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:12
verses.text: And it happened in those days that He went out into a mountain to pray, and He was spending the night in prayer to God.

verses.name: Luke 6:13
verses.text: And when it was day, He called His disciples. And He chose twelve of them, whom He also named apostles:

verses.name: Luke 6:14
