verses.text: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;

verses.name: Luke 6:15
verses.text: Matthew and Thomas; James <hi>the son</hi> of Alpheus, and Simon who was called Zelotes;

verses.name: Luke 6:16
verses.text: Judas <hi>the brother</hi> of James, and Judas Iscariot, who also became <hi>the</hi> betrayer.

verses.name: Luke 6:17
verses.text: And coming down with them, He stood on a level place. And a crowd of His disciples, and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon (who came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases) were there;

verses.name: Luke 6:18
verses.text: also those tormented by unclean spirits; and they were healed.

verses.name: Luke 6:19
verses.text: And all the crowd sought to touch Him, for power went out of Him and healed <hi>them</hi> all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:20
verses.text: And lifting up His eyes to His disciples, He said, Blessed <hi>are</hi> the poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 6:21
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> you who hunger now, for you shall be filled. Blessed <hi>are you</hi> who weep now, for you shall laugh.

verses.name: Luke 6:22
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> you when men shall hate you, and when they shall cut you off, and when they shall reproach <hi>you</hi> and shall cast out your name as evil, for the sake of the Son of man.

verses.name: Luke 6:23
verses.text: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy. For behold, your reward <hi>is</hi> great in Heaven. For so their fathers did according to these things to the prophets.

verses.name: Luke 6:24
verses.text: But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

verses.name: Luke 6:25
verses.text: Woe to you who are full! For you shall hunger. Woe to you who laugh now! For you shall mourn and weep.

verses.name: Luke 6:26
verses.text: Woe to you when all men shall speak well <hi>of</hi> you! For so their fathers did to the false prophets.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:27
verses.text: But I say to you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

verses.name: Luke 6:28
verses.text: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who despitefully use you.

verses.name: Luke 6:29
verses.text: And to him who strikes you on the <hi>one</hi> cheek, also offer the other. And to him who takes away your garment, do not forbid your tunic also.

verses.name: Luke 6:30
verses.text: Give to everyone who asks of you, and from him who takes away your goods, do not ask <hi>them</hi> again.

verses.name: Luke 6:31
verses.text: And as you desire that men should do to you, you do also to them likewise.

verses.name: Luke 6:32
verses.text: For if you love those who love you, what thanks do you have? For sinners also love those who love them.

verses.name: Luke 6:33
verses.text: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what thanks do you have? For sinners also do the same.

verses.name: Luke 6:34
verses.text: And if you lend <hi>to those</hi> of whom you hope to receive, what thanks do you have? For sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

verses.name: Luke 6:35
verses.text: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing <hi>in return</hi>. And your reward shall be great, and you shall be the sons of the Highest. For He is kind to the unthankful and <hi>to</hi> the evil.

verses.name: Luke 6:36
verses.text: Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is merciful.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:37
verses.text: Judge not, and you shall not be judged. Condemn not, and you shall not be condemned. Forgive, and you shall be forgiven.

verses.name: Luke 6:38
verses.text: Give, and it shall be given to you, good measure pressed down and shaken together and running over, they shall give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you measure, it shall be measured to you again.

verses.name: Luke 6:39
verses.text: And He spoke a parable to them: Can the blind lead the blind? Shall they not both fall into the ditch?

verses.name: Luke 6:40
verses.text: The disciple is not above his master, but everyone who is perfect shall be like his master.

verses.name: Luke 6:41
verses.text: And why do you look at the splinter that is in your brother's eye, but do not see the beam that is in <hi>your</hi> own eye?

verses.name: Luke 6:42
verses.text: Or how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the splinter in your eye, when you yourself do not see the beam that is in your own eye? Hypocrite! First cast out the beam out of your own eye, and then you shall see clearly to pull out the splinter that is in your brother's eye.

verses.name: Luke 6:43
verses.text: For a good tree does not bring forth corrupt fruit, neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

verses.name: Luke 6:44
verses.text: For every tree is known by <hi>its</hi> own fruit. For men do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

verses.name: Luke 6:45
verses.text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth the good. And an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth the evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.

verses.name: Luke 6:46
verses.text: And why do you call Me Lord, Lord, and do not do what I say?

verses.name: Luke 6:47
verses.text: Whoever comes to Me and hears My words, and does them, I will show you to whom he is like.

verses.name: Luke 6:48
verses.text: He is like a man who built a house and dug deep and laid the foundation on a rock; and a flood occurring, the stream burst against that house and could not shake it; for it was founded on a rock.

verses.name: Luke 6:49
verses.text: But he who hears and does not perform, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, on which the stream burst, and immediately it fell. And the ruin of that house was great.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:1
verses.text: And when He had ended all His words in the ears of the people, He entered into Capernaum.

verses.name: Luke 7:2
verses.text: And a certain servant of a centurion who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.

verses.name: Luke 7:3
verses.text: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent the elders of the Jews to Him, begging Him that He would come and heal his servant.

verses.name: Luke 7:4
verses.text: And coming to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that he was worthy, he for whom You give this;

verses.name: Luke 7:5
verses.text: for, <hi>they said</hi>, He loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.

verses.name: Luke 7:6
verses.text: Then Jesus went with them. But He being yet not far off from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, Lord, do not trouble Yourself. For I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.

verses.name: Luke 7:7
verses.text: Therefore neither did I think myself worthy to come to You; but say a word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.name: Luke 7:8
verses.text: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers. And I say to one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 7:9
verses.text: And hearing these things, Jesus marveled at him. And turning to the crowd following Him, He said, I say to you, I have not found such faith, no, not in Israel.

verses.name: Luke 7:10
verses.text: And they who were sent, returning to the house, found the sick servant well.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:11
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, He went into a city called Nain. And many of His disciples and a great crowd went with Him.

verses.name: Luke 7:12
verses.text: And drawing near the gate of the city, even behold, one having died was being carried out, an only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a considerable crowd of the city was with her.

verses.name: Luke 7:13
verses.text: And when the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said to her, Do not weep.

verses.name: Luke 7:14
verses.text: And He came and touched the bier. And the ones who bore <hi>him</hi> stood still. And He said, Young man, I say to you, Arise!

verses.name: Luke 7:15
verses.text: And the one who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He delivered him to his mother.

verses.name: Luke 7:16
verses.text: And fear came on all. And they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has risen up among us; and, God has visited His people.

verses.name: Luke 7:17
verses.text: And this report of Him went out in all Judea, and in all the neighborhood.

verses.name: Luke 7:18
verses.text: And his disciples reported all these things to John.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:19
verses.text: And John, calling near a certain two of his disciples, sent <hi>them</hi> to Jesus, saying, Are You He that should come, or do we look for another?

verses.name: Luke 7:20
verses.text: And coming to Him, the men said, John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, Are You He who should come, or do we look for another?

verses.name: Luke 7:21
verses.text: And in the same hour He cured many of infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits. And He gave sight to many who were blind.

verses.name: Luke 7:22
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Go and tell John what you have seen and heard; that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the gospel is proclaimed to the poor.

verses.name: Luke 7:23
verses.text: And blessed is <hi>he</hi> who shall not be offended in Me.

verses.name: Luke 7:24
verses.text: And when the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the people concerning John. What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

verses.name: Luke 7:25
verses.text: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed with soft clothing? Behold, those in splendid clothing and being in luxury are in kings' palaces.

verses.name: Luke 7:26
verses.text: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and much more than a prophet.

verses.name: Luke 7:27
verses.text: This is <hi>he</hi> of whom it is written, "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who shall prepare Your way before You."

verses.name: Luke 7:28
verses.text: For I say to you, Among <hi>those</hi> who are born of woman there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist. But he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

verses.name: Luke 7:29
verses.text: And all the people and the tax-collectors who heard <hi>Him</hi> justified God, being baptized <hi>with</hi> the baptism of John.

verses.name: Luke 7:30
verses.text: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, not being baptized by him.

verses.name: Luke 7:31
verses.text: And the Lord said, To what then shall I compare the men of this generation? And to what are they like?

verses.name: Luke 7:32
verses.text: They are like children sitting in a market and calling to one another, and saying, We have played the flute to you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you did not weep.

verses.name: Luke 7:33
verses.text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, He has a demon.

verses.name: Luke 7:34
verses.text: The Son of man has come eating and drinking, and you say, Behold a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of tax-collectors and sinners!

verses.name: Luke 7:35
verses.text: But wisdom has been justified by all her children.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:36
verses.text: And one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And going into the Pharisee's house, He reclined.

verses.name: Luke 7:37
verses.text: And behold, a woman, a sinner in the city, knowing that He reclined in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster vial of ointment.

verses.name: Luke 7:38
verses.text: And she stood behind <hi>Him</hi>, weeping at His feet, and she began to wash His feet with tears and wipe them with the hair of her head. And <hi>she</hi> ardently kissed His feet and anointed <hi>them</hi> with the ointment.

verses.name: Luke 7:39
verses.text: But seeing this, the Pharisee who had invited Him, spoke within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what kind of woman <hi>this is</hi> who touches him, for she is a sinner.

verses.name: Luke 7:40
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said to him, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Teacher, speak.

verses.name: Luke 7:41
verses.text: There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and <hi>the</hi> other fifty.

verses.name: Luke 7:42
verses.text: And they having nothing to pay, he freely forgave both. Then which of them do <hi>you</hi> say will love him most?

verses.name: Luke 7:43
verses.text: And answering, Simon said, I suppose that one to whom he forgave most. And He said to him, You have judged rightly.

verses.name: Luke 7:44
verses.text: And He turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, yet you gave Me no water for My feet. But she has washed My feet with tears, and has wiped <hi>them</hi> with the hair of her head.

verses.name: Luke 7:45
verses.text: You gave Me no kiss, but this woman, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss My feet.

verses.name: Luke 7:46
verses.text: You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with ointment.

verses.name: Luke 7:47
verses.text: Therefore I say to you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, he loves little.

verses.name: Luke 7:48
verses.text: And He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

verses.name: Luke 7:49
verses.text: And those reclining with <hi>Him</hi> began to say within themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

verses.name: Luke 7:50
verses.text: And He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you, go in peace.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:1
verses.text: And it happened afterwards, He traveled in every city and village, proclaiming and announcing the gospel of the kingdom of God. And the Twelve <hi>were</hi> with Him,

verses.name: Luke 8:2
verses.text: and also certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities; Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven demons,

verses.name: Luke 8:3
verses.text: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered to Him of their possessions.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:4
verses.text: And a great crowd coming together, and those in each city coming to Him, He spoke by a parable:

verses.name: Luke 8:5
verses.text: A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, the one fell by the roadside and was trampled; and the birds of the air devoured it.

verses.name: Luke 8:6
verses.text: And other fell on a rock, and sprouting, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

verses.name: Luke 8:7
verses.text: And other fell amidst thorns, and springing up with the thorns, <hi>they</hi> choked it.

verses.name: Luke 8:8
verses.text: And other fell on good ground and sprang up, and bore fruit a hundredfold. And when He had said these things, He cried, He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.name: Luke 8:9
verses.text: And His disciples asked Him, saying, What might this parable be?

verses.name: Luke 8:10
verses.text: And He said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God. But to others I speak in parables, so that seeing they might not see and hearing they might not understand.

verses.name: Luke 8:11
verses.text: And the parable is this: The seed is the Word of God.

verses.name: Luke 8:12
verses.text: Those by the roadside are the ones who hear; then the Devil comes and takes the Word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

verses.name: Luke 8:13
verses.text: Those on the rock <hi>are</hi> the ones who, when they hear, receive the Word with joy. And these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

verses.name: Luke 8:14
verses.text: And those which fell among thorns are the ones who, when they have heard, go forth and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of life, and do not bear to maturity.

verses.name: Luke 8:15
verses.text: But those on the good ground are the ones who, in an honest and good heart, having heard the Word, keep <hi>it</hi> and bring forth fruit with patience.

verses.name: Luke 8:16
verses.text: And no one lighting a lamp covers it with a vessel or puts <hi>it</hi> under a couch; but he sets <hi>it</hi> on a lampstand so that those who enter in may see the light.

verses.name: Luke 8:17
verses.text: For nothing is secret that shall not be revealed; nor secret which shall not be known and come to be revealed.

verses.name: Luke 8:18
verses.text: Therefore be careful how you hear. For whoever has, to him shall be given; and whoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.

verses.name: Luke 8:19
verses.text: And His mother and <hi>His</hi> brothers came to Him. And they could not come near Him because of the crowd.

verses.name: Luke 8:20
verses.text: And it was told to Him <hi>by some</hi>, who said, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside desiring to see You.

verses.name: Luke 8:21
verses.text: And He answered and said to them, My mother and My brothers are those who hear the Word of God and do it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:22
verses.text: And it happened on a certain day that He went into a boat with His disciples. And He said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they put out to sea.

verses.name: Luke 8:23
verses.text: But as they sailed, He fell asleep. And a storm of wind came onto the lake. And they were being filled <hi>with water</hi> and were in jeopardy.

verses.name: Luke 8:24
verses.text: And they came to Him and awakened Him, saying, Master, Master, we are perishing! Then being aroused, He rebuked the wind and the raging of the water. And they ceased, and there was a calm.

verses.name: Luke 8:25
verses.text: And He said to them, Where is your faith? And being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, Who then is this One? For He commands even the winds and water, and they obey Him!

verses.name: Luke 8:26
verses.text: And they sailed down to the country of the Gadarenes, which is across from Galilee.

verses.name: Luke 8:27
verses.text: And He going out onto land, He met a certain man out of the city, who had had demons a long time, and put on no clothes, nor stayed in a house, but among the tombs.

verses.name: Luke 8:28
verses.text: And seeing Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him and said with a loud voice, What is to me and to You, Jesus, Son of God the Most High? I beseech You, Do not torment me!

verses.name: Luke 8:29
verses.text: (For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had seized him. And he had been kept bound in chains and in fetters, and he broke the bands and was driven into the deserted <hi>places</hi> by the demons.)

verses.name: Luke 8:30
verses.text: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion; because many demons had entered into him.

verses.name: Luke 8:31
verses.text: And they begged Him that He would not command them to go out into the abyss.

verses.name: Luke 8:32
verses.text: And there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain. And they begged Him that He would allow them to enter into them. And He allowed them.

verses.name: Luke 8:33
verses.text: And coming out of the man, the demons entered into the pigs. And the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake and were choked.

verses.name: Luke 8:34
verses.text: And those feeding <hi>the pigs</hi>, and seeing the thing, fled. And leaving, <hi>they</hi> reported to the city and to the farms.

verses.name: Luke 8:35
verses.text: And they went out to see what had been done. And they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had departed sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.

verses.name: Luke 8:36
verses.text: Also those who saw <hi>it</hi> told them how the demon-possessed one was healed.

verses.name: Luke 8:37
verses.text: And all the multitude of the neighborhood of the Gadarenes were seized with a great fear, and asked Him to depart from them. And entering into the boat, He returned.

verses.name: Luke 8:38
verses.text: And the man out of whom the demons had gone out begged Him, <hi>desiring</hi> to be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,

verses.name: Luke 8:39
verses.text: Return to your own house and declare what God has done to you. And he went his way and proclaimed throughout all the city what <hi>great</hi> things Jesus had done to him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:40
verses.text: And it happened when Jesus had returned, the people received Him. For they were all waiting for Him.

verses.name: Luke 8:41
verses.text: And behold, a man named Jairus came, and he was a synagogue-ruler. And he fell down at Jesus' feet and begged Him that He would come into his house.

verses.name: Luke 8:42
verses.text: For he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay dying. But as He went, the people thronged Him.

verses.name: Luke 8:43
verses.text: And a woman who had a flow of blood twelve years (who had spent all her living on physicians, <hi>and</hi> could not be healed by any)

verses.name: Luke 8:44
verses.text: came behind <hi>Him</hi> and touched the border of His garment. And instantly her flow of blood was staunched.

verses.name: Luke 8:45
verses.text: And Jesus said, Who touched Me? And all having denied, Peter and those with Him said, Master, the crowd presses and jostles You, and You say, Who touched Me?

verses.name: Luke 8:46
verses.text: And Jesus said, Someone has touched Me, for I know that power has gone out of Me.

verses.name: Luke 8:47
verses.text: And seeing that she was not hidden, the woman came trembling. And falling down before Him, she declared to Him before all the people why she had touched Him, and how she was instantly healed.

verses.name: Luke 8:48
verses.text: And He said to her, Daughter, be comforted. Your faith has saved you; go in peace.

verses.name: Luke 8:49
verses.text: He was still speaking when someone came from the synagogue-ruler, saying to him, Your daughter is dead, do not trouble the Teacher.

verses.name: Luke 8:50
verses.text: But when Jesus heard, He answered Him, saying, Do not fear, only believe and she shall be healed.

verses.name: Luke 8:51
verses.text: And coming into the house, He allowed no one to go in, except Peter and James and John, and the father and the mother of the girl.

verses.name: Luke 8:52
verses.text: And all were weeping and bewailing her. But He said, Do not weep; she has not died, but sleeps.

verses.name: Luke 8:53
verses.text: And they ridiculed, knowing that she was dead.

verses.name: Luke 8:54
verses.text: And He put them all out. And He took her by the hand and called, saying, Little girl, arise!

verses.name: Luke 8:55
verses.text: And her spirit came again, and she arose immediately. And He commanded that <hi>food</hi> be given her to eat.

verses.name: Luke 8:56
verses.text: And her parents were astonished. But He charged them to tell no one the thing that happened.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:1
verses.text: And He called His twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases.

verses.name: Luke 9:2
verses.text: And <hi>He</hi> sent them to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

verses.name: Luke 9:3
verses.text: And He said to them, Take nothing for <hi>your</hi> journey, neither staffs, nor a bag, nor bread, nor money, nor each to have two tunics.

verses.name: Luke 9:4
verses.text: And whatever house you enter into, abide there and depart from there.

verses.name: Luke 9:5
verses.text: And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

verses.name: Luke 9:6
verses.text: And they departed and went through the towns, proclaiming the gospel and healing everywhere.

verses.name: Luke 9:7
verses.text: And Herod the tetrarch heard of all the things happening by Him. And he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from <hi>the</hi> dead;

verses.name: Luke 9:8
verses.text: and by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets had risen again.

verses.name: Luke 9:9
verses.text: And Herod said, John I have beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:10
verses.text: And returning, the apostles told Him all that they had done. And He took them and went aside privately into a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

verses.name: Luke 9:11
verses.text: But knowing <hi>this</hi>, the crowds followed Him. And He received them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God, and He healed those who had need of healing.

verses.name: Luke 9:12
verses.text: But the day began to wear away, and coming up the Twelve said to Him, Send the crowd away so that they may go into the villages and farms all around, and lodge, and get food. For we are here in a deserted place.

verses.name: Luke 9:13
verses.text: But He said to them, You give them <hi>something</hi> to eat. And they said, We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people.

verses.name: Luke 9:14
verses.text: (For they were about five thousand men.) And He said to His disciples, Make them recline by fifties in a company.

verses.name: Luke 9:15
verses.text: And they did so, and made them all recline.

verses.name: Luke 9:16
verses.text: And He took the five loaves and the two fish. And looking up to Heaven, He blessed them and broke, and He gave to the disciples to set before the crowd.

verses.name: Luke 9:17
verses.text: And they ate and were all filled. And there was taken up twelve hand baskets full of fragments of that left over to them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:18
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> He was alone praying, the disciples were with Him. And He asked them, saying, Whom do the crowds say that I am?

verses.name: Luke 9:19
verses.text: Answering, they said, John the Baptist; but some <hi>say</hi>, Elijah, and others say that one of the old prophets has risen again.

verses.name: Luke 9:20
verses.text: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Answering, Peter said, The Christ of God.

verses.name: Luke 9:21
verses.text: And He strictly charged them and commanded to tell no one this,

verses.name: Luke 9:22
verses.text: saying, The Son of man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

verses.name: Luke 9:23
verses.text: And He said to all, If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.

verses.name: Luke 9:24
verses.text: For whoever will save his life shall lose it, but whoever will lose his life for My sake, he shall save it.

verses.name: Luke 9:25
verses.text: For what is a man profited if he gains the whole world and loses himself, or is cast away?

verses.name: Luke 9:26
verses.text: For whoever shall be ashamed of Me and of My words, the Son of man shall be ashamed of him when He shall come in His own and <hi>in His</hi> Father's glory, and that of the holy angels.

verses.name: Luke 9:27
verses.text: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste of death until they see the kingdom of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:28
verses.text: And about eight days after these sayings, He took Peter and John and James and went up into a mountain to pray.

verses.name: Luke 9:29
verses.text: And as He prayed, the appearance of His countenance was altered, and His clothing <hi>was</hi> dazzling white.

verses.name: Luke 9:30
verses.text: And behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,

verses.name: Luke 9:31
verses.text: who appeared in glory and spoke of His exodus, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:32
verses.text: But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep. But fully awakening, they saw His glory, and the two men who stood with Him.

verses.name: Luke 9:33
verses.text: And in their parting from Him, it happened that Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for <hi>us</hi> to be here. And let us make three tabernacles, one for You and one for Moses and one for Elijah; not knowing what he said.

verses.name: Luke 9:34
verses.text: And as he was saying these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them. And they feared <hi>as</hi> they entered into the cloud.

verses.name: Luke 9:35
verses.text: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is My Son, the Beloved, hear Him.

verses.name: Luke 9:36
verses.text: And when the voice occurred, Jesus was found alone. And they were silent, and told no one in those days anything which they had seen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:37
verses.text: And it happened on the next day, they coming down from the mountain, a huge crowd met Him.

verses.name: Luke 9:38
verses.text: And behold, a man cried aloud from the crowd, saying, Teacher, I beseech You, look on my son, for he is my only-born son.

verses.name: Luke 9:39
verses.text: And lo, a spirit takes him, and <hi>he</hi> suddenly cries out. And <hi>it</hi> throws him into convulsions, with foaming, and with pain departs from him, bruising him.

verses.name: Luke 9:40
verses.text: And I begged Your disciples to cast him out, and they could not.

verses.name: Luke 9:41
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said, O unbelieving generation, <hi>one</hi> having been perverted, how long shall I be with you and endure you? Bring your son here.

verses.name: Luke 9:42
verses.text: And as <hi>he</hi> was still coming, the demon violently convulsed and tore <hi>him</hi>. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit and healed the child and delivered him again to his father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:43
verses.text: And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. But as all were marveling at all things which Jesus did, He said to His disciples,

verses.name: Luke 9:44
verses.text: Let these words sink down into your ears. For the Son of man shall be betrayed into <hi>the</hi> hands of men.

verses.name: Luke 9:45
verses.text: But they did not understand this thing, and it was hidden from them so that they did not perceive it. And they feared to ask Him of this word.

verses.name: Luke 9:46
verses.text: And an argument came in among them, who might be <hi>the</hi> greater of them.

verses.name: Luke 9:47
verses.text: And seeing the argument of their heart, Jesus took a child and set him beside Him.

verses.name: Luke 9:48
verses.text: And He said to them, Whoever shall receive this child in My name receives Me. And whoever shall receive Me receives Him who sent Me. For he who is least among you all, he shall be great.

verses.name: Luke 9:49
verses.text: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in Your name. And we prevented him, because he does not follow us.

verses.name: Luke 9:50
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Do not prevent <hi>him</hi>, for he who is not against us is for us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:51
verses.text: And it happened in the fulfilling <hi>of</hi> the days of His taking up, He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:52
verses.text: And <hi>He</hi> sent messengers before His face. And they went and entered into a village of the Samaritans to make ready for Him.

verses.name: Luke 9:53
verses.text: And they did not receive Him, because His face was going toward Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:54
verses.text: And seeing, His disciples James and John said, Lord, do You desire <hi>that</hi> we command fire to come down from Heaven and consume them, even as Elijah did?

verses.name: Luke 9:55
verses.text: But He turned and rebuked them and said, You do not know of what spirit you are.

verses.name: Luke 9:56
verses.text: For the Son of man has not come to destroy men's lives, but to save. And they went to another village.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:57
verses.text: And it happened as they were going in the way, one said to Him, Lord, I will follow You wherever You go.

verses.name: Luke 9:58
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air <hi>have</hi> nests, but the Son of man has nowhere to lay <hi>His</hi> head.

verses.name: Luke 9:59
verses.text: And He said to another, Follow Me! But he said, Lord, first allow me to go and bury my father.

verses.name: Luke 9:60
verses.text: Jesus said to him, Let the dead bury their dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 9:61
verses.text: And another also said, Lord, I will follow You, but first allow me to take leave of those in my house.

verses.name: Luke 9:62
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:1
verses.text: And after these things the Lord appointed seventy others, And He sent them two and two before His face into every city and place where He was about to come.

verses.name: Luke 10:2
verses.text: Then He said to them, The harvest truly <hi>is</hi> great, but the laborers <hi>are</hi> few. Therefore pray <hi>to</hi> the Lord of the harvest that He may send forth laborers into His harvest.

verses.name: Luke 10:3
verses.text: Go! Behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

verses.name: Luke 10:4
verses.text: Carry neither purse nor bag nor sandals. And greet no one by the way.

verses.name: Luke 10:5
verses.text: And into whatever house you enter, first say, Peace to this house.

verses.name: Luke 10:6
verses.text: And if a son of peace is there, your peace shall rest on it. If not, it shall return to you,

verses.name: Luke 10:7
verses.text: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking the things <hi>shared</hi> by them; for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Do not move from house to house.

verses.name: Luke 10:8
verses.text: And into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.

verses.name: Luke 10:9
verses.text: And heal the sick that are in it, and say to them, The kingdom of God has come near you!

verses.name: Luke 10:10
verses.text: And into whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, going out into the streets say,

verses.name: Luke 10:11
verses.text: Even the dust of your city which clings to us, we wipe off against you. Yet be sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.

verses.name: Luke 10:12
verses.text: But I say to you that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

verses.name: Luke 10:13
verses.text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which have been done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented a long while ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.name: Luke 10:14
verses.text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the Judgment than for you.

verses.name: Luke 10:15
verses.text: And you, Capernaum, which has been lifted up to Heaven, you shall be thrust down into hell.

verses.name: Luke 10:16
verses.text: The one hearing you hears Me, and he who despises you despises Me; he who rejects you <hi>also</hi> rejects Him who sent Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:17
verses.text: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us through Your name.

verses.name: Luke 10:18
verses.text: And He said to them, I saw Satan fall from Heaven like lightning.

verses.name: Luke 10:19
verses.text: Behold, I give to you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the authority of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you.

verses.name: Luke 10:20
verses.text: Yet do not rejoice in this, that the <hi>evil</hi> spirits are subject to you, rather rejoice because your names are written in Heaven.

verses.name: Luke 10:21
verses.text: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in Spirit and said, I thank You, Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from <hi>the</hi> sophisticated and cunning, and have revealed them to babes. Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing before You.

verses.name: Luke 10:22
verses.text: All things are delivered to Me by My Father; and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son will reveal <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 10:23
verses.text: And He turned to <hi>His</hi> disciples and said privately, Blessed <hi>are</hi> the eyes which see the things that you see.

verses.name: Luke 10:24
verses.text: For I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen <hi>them</hi>, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard <hi>them</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:25
verses.text: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tempted Him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.name: Luke 10:26
verses.text: He said to him, What is written in the law? How do you read it?

verses.name: Luke 10:27
verses.text: And answering, he said, You shall love <hi>the</hi> Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself.

verses.name: Luke 10:28
verses.text: And He said to him, You have answered right, do this and you shall live.

verses.name: Luke 10:29
verses.text: But he, willing to justify himself, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbor?

verses.name: Luke 10:30
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said, A certain <hi>man</hi> went down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who stripped him of his clothing and wounded him, and departed, leaving <hi>him</hi> half dead.

verses.name: Luke 10:31
verses.text: And by coincidence a certain priest came down that way and seeing him, he passed by on the opposite <hi>side</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 10:32
verses.text: And in the same way a Levite, also being at the place, coming and seeing <hi>him</hi>, he passed on the opposite <hi>side</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 10:33
verses.text: But a certain traveling Samaritan came upon him, and seeing him, he was filled with pity.

verses.name: Luke 10:34
verses.text: And coming near, <hi>he</hi> bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine, and set him on his own animal and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

verses.name: Luke 10:35
verses.text: And going on the next day, he took out two denarii and gave <hi>them</hi> to the innkeeper, and said to him, Take care of him. And whatever more you spend, when I come again I will repay you.

verses.name: Luke 10:36
verses.text: Then which of these three, do you think, was neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?

verses.name: Luke 10:37
verses.text: And he said, The <hi>one</hi> doing the <hi>deed of</hi> mercy to him. And Jesus said to him, Go and do likewise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:38
verses.text: And as they went, it happened that He entered into a certain village. And a certain woman named Martha received Him into her house.

verses.name: Luke 10:39
verses.text: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet <hi>and</hi> heard His word.

verses.name: Luke 10:40
verses.text: But Martha was distracted with much serving. And she came to Him and said, Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me.

verses.name: Luke 10:41
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said to her, Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things.

verses.name: Luke 10:42
verses.text: But one thing is needful, and Mary has chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:1
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, one of His disciples said to Him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught His disciples.

verses.name: Luke 11:2
verses.text: And He said to them, When you pray, say: Our Father, who <hi>is</hi> in Heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come, Your will be done, as in Heaven, so also on the earth.

verses.name: Luke 11:3
verses.text: Give us day by day our daily bread,

verses.name: Luke 11:4
verses.text: and forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

verses.name: Luke 11:5
verses.text: And He said to them, which of you shall have a friend and shall go to him at midnight and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves,

verses.name: Luke 11:6
verses.text: for a friend of mine has come from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him?

verses.name: Luke 11:7
verses.text: And he answering from inside may say, Do not trouble me. The door is now shut and my children are in bed with me. I cannot rise and give to you.

verses.name: Luke 11:8
verses.text: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needs.

verses.name: Luke 11:9
verses.text: And I say to you, Ask and it shall be given you. Seek and you shall find. Knock and it shall be opened to you.

verses.name: Luke 11:10
verses.text: For everyone who asks receives. And he who seeks finds. And to him who knocks it shall be opened.

verses.name: Luke 11:11
verses.text: For what father of you, <hi>if</hi> the son asks <hi>for</hi> bread, will he give him a stone? Or if <hi>he asks</hi> for a fish, will he give him a snake for a fish?

verses.name: Luke 11:12
verses.text: Or if he shall ask for an egg, will he give him a scorpion?

verses.name: Luke 11:13
verses.text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more shall <hi>your</hi> heavenly Father give <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:14
verses.text: And He was casting out a demon, and it was dumb. And it happened as the demon <hi>was</hi> going out, the dumb one spoke. And the people marveled.

verses.name: Luke 11:15
verses.text: But some of them said, He casts out demons through Beelzebub the chief of the demons.

verses.name: Luke 11:16
verses.text: And others, tempting <hi>Him</hi>, sought a sign from Heaven from him.

verses.name: Luke 11:17
verses.text: But knowing their thoughts, He said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. And a house <hi>divided</hi> against a house falls.

verses.name: Luke 11:18
verses.text: If Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons through Beelzebub.

verses.name: Luke 11:19
verses.text: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast <hi>them</hi> out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

verses.name: Luke 11:20
verses.text: But if I cast out demons with <hi>the</hi> finger of God, no doubt the kingdom of God has come on you.

verses.name: Luke 11:21
verses.text: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his dwelling, his goods are in peace.

verses.name: Luke 11:22
verses.text: But when one stronger than he comes, he overcomes him. He takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and he distributes his arms.

verses.name: Luke 11:23
verses.text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

verses.name: Luke 11:24
verses.text: When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he walks through dry places seeking rest. And finding none, he says, I will return to my house from which I came out.

verses.name: Luke 11:25
verses.text: And when he comes, he finds <hi>it</hi> swept and decorated.

verses.name: Luke 11:26
verses.text: And he goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and entering in, they dwell there. And the last state of that man is worse than the first.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:27
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> He spoke these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice <hi>and</hi> said to Him, Blessed <hi>is</hi> the womb that bore You, and <hi>the</hi> breasts which You have sucked.

verses.name: Luke 11:28
verses.text: But He said, No; rather, blessed <hi>are</hi> they who hear the Word of God and keep it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:29
verses.text: But the crowds pressing on <hi>Him</hi>, He began to say, This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it, except the sign of Jonah the prophet.

verses.name: Luke 11:30
verses.text: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also shall the Son of man be to this generation.

verses.name: Luke 11:31
verses.text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the Judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them. For she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon. And behold, One greater than Solomon <hi>is</hi> here.

verses.name: Luke 11:32
verses.text: The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the Judgment with this generation and shall condemn it. For they repented at the preaching of Jonah. And behold, One greater than Jonah <hi>is</hi> here.

verses.name: Luke 11:33
verses.text: No one, when he has lighted a lamp, puts <hi>it</hi> in a secret place, or under a grain-measure, but on a lampstand, so that they who come in may see the light.

verses.name: Luke 11:34
verses.text: The light of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is sound, your whole body also is <hi>full of</hi> light. But when <hi>your eye</hi> is evil, your body also <hi>is full of</hi> darkness.

verses.name: Luke 11:35
verses.text: Therefore take heed that the light in you is not darkness.

verses.name: Luke 11:36
verses.text: Therefore if your whole body <hi>is</hi> full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be <hi>full of</hi> light, as when the shining of a lamp enlightens you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:37
verses.text: And <hi>as He spoke</hi>, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. And He went in and reclined.

verses.name: Luke 11:38
verses.text: And when the Pharisee saw <hi>it</hi>, he was amazed that He had not first washed before dinner.

verses.name: Luke 11:39
verses.text: And the Lord said to him, Now you Pharisees make the outside of the cup and the platter clean, but your inward part is full of plunder and wickedness.

verses.name: Luke 11:40
verses.text: Fools! Did not He who made the outside also make the inside?

verses.name: Luke 11:41
verses.text: But give alms <hi>of</hi> such things as you have, and behold, all things <hi>are</hi> clean to you.

verses.name: Luke 11:42
verses.text: But woe to you, Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over judgment and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to leave the other undone.

verses.name: Luke 11:43
verses.text: Woe to you, Pharisees! For you love the chief seats in the synagogues and greetings in the markets.

verses.name: Luke 11:44
verses.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like unseen tombs and the men walking above are not aware of them.

verses.name: Luke 11:45
verses.text: And one of the lawyers answered and said to Him, Master, you reproach us also when you say this.

verses.name: Luke 11:46
verses.text: And He said, Woe to you also, lawyers! For you load men with burdens grievous to be carried, and <hi>you</hi> yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.

verses.name: Luke 11:47
verses.text: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

verses.name: Luke 11:48
verses.text: Truly you bear witness that you consent to the deeds of your fathers. For they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.

verses.name: Luke 11:49
verses.text: Therefore the wisdom of God also said, I will send them prophets and apostles, and <hi>some</hi> of them they shall slay and persecute,

verses.name: Luke 11:50
verses.text: so that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from <hi>the</hi> foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

verses.name: Luke 11:51
verses.text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, <hi>who</hi> perished between the altar and the temple. Truly I say to you, It shall be required of this generation.

verses.name: Luke 11:52
verses.text: Woe to you, lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter in yourselves, and you have hindered those who were entering in.

verses.name: Luke 11:53
verses.text: And as He said these things to them, the scribes and Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw <hi>Him</hi> out concerning many things,

verses.name: Luke 11:54
verses.text: lying in ambush for Him, and seeking to catch something out of His mouth, so that they might accuse Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:1
verses.text: In the meantime, when there had gathered together an innumerable crowd of people, so as to trample on one another, He began to say to His disciples first, Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

verses.name: Luke 12:2
verses.text: For there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, nor anything hidden that shall not be known.

verses.name: Luke 12:3
verses.text: Therefore whatever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light. And that which you have spoken in the ear in secret rooms shall be proclaimed on the housetops.

verses.name: Luke 12:4
verses.text: And I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

verses.name: Luke 12:5
verses.text: But I will warn you of whom you shall fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has authority to cast into hell. Yea, I say to you, fear Him.

verses.name: Luke 12:6
verses.text: Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria? And not one of them is forgotten before God.

verses.name: Luke 12:7
verses.text: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore do not fear, you are of more value than many sparrows.

verses.name: Luke 12:8
verses.text: Also I say to you, Whoever shall confess Me before men, the Son of man also shall confess him before the angels of God.

verses.name: Luke 12:9
verses.text: But he who denies Me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

verses.name: Luke 12:10
verses.text: And whoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him. But to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, <hi>it</hi> shall not be forgiven.

verses.name: Luke 12:11
verses.text: And when they bring you into the synagogues, and <hi>to</hi> rulers and authorities, take no thought as to how or what thing you shall answer, or what you shall say.

verses.name: Luke 12:12
verses.text: For the Holy Spirit shall teach you in the same hour what you ought to say.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:13
verses.text: And one of the company said to Him, Master, speak to my brother to divide the inheritance with me.

verses.name: Luke 12:14
verses.text: And He said to him, Man, who made Me a judge or a divider over you?

verses.name: Luke 12:15
verses.text: And He said to them, Watch and keep yourselves from covetousness. For a man's life is not in the abundance of the things which he possesses.

verses.name: Luke 12:16
verses.text: And He spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully.

verses.name: Luke 12:17
verses.text: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room in which to store my fruits?

verses.name: Luke 12:18
verses.text: And he said, I will do this. I will pull down my barns and build bigger ones, and I will store all my fruits and my goods there.

verses.name: Luke 12:19
verses.text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have many goods laid <hi>up</hi> for many years. Take your ease, eat drink <hi>and</hi> be merry.

verses.name: Luke 12:20
verses.text: But God said to him, Fool! This night your soul shall be required of you, then whose shall be those things which you have prepared?

verses.name: Luke 12:21
verses.text: So <hi>is</hi> he who lays up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:22
verses.text: And He said to His disciples, Therefore I say to you, Be not anxious as to your life, what you shall eat; nor for the body, what you shall put on.

verses.name: Luke 12:23
verses.text: Life is more than food, and the body <hi>is more</hi> than clothing.

verses.name: Luke 12:24
verses.text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap, having neither storehouse nor barn, and God feeds them. How much more are you better than the birds?

verses.name: Luke 12:25
verses.text: And which of you <hi>by</hi> being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

verses.name: Luke 12:26
verses.text: If then you are not able to do even the least, why are you anxious about the rest?

verses.name: Luke 12:27
verses.text: Consider the lilies, how they grow; they do not toil, they do not spin. And yet I say to you that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

verses.name: Luke 12:28
verses.text: If then God so clothes the grass (which today <hi>is</hi> in the field, and tomorrow is cast into the oven) how much more <hi>will He clothe</hi> you, O little-faiths?

verses.name: Luke 12:29
verses.text: And do not seek what you shall eat, nor what you shall drink, and stop being in anxiety.

verses.name: Luke 12:30
verses.text: For all these things the nations of the world seek after, and your Father knows that you have need of these things.

verses.name: Luke 12:31
verses.text: But rather seek the kingdom of God, and all these things shall be added to you.

verses.name: Luke 12:32
verses.text: Do not fear, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

verses.name: Luke 12:33
verses.text: Sell what you have and give alms. Make for yourselves purses which do not become old, an unfailing treasure in Heaven, where no thief comes nor moth corrupts.

verses.name: Luke 12:34
verses.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

verses.name: Luke 12:35
verses.text: Let your loins be girded about, and <hi>your</hi> lights burning.

verses.name: Luke 12:36
verses.text: And you yourselves be like men who wait for their lord, whenever he shall return from the wedding, so that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately.

verses.name: Luke 12:37
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> those servants whom the lord will find watching when <hi>he</hi> comes. Truly I say to you that he shall gird himself and make them recline; and coming up he will serve them.

verses.name: Luke 12:38
verses.text: And if he comes in the second watch, or comes in the third watch, and find <hi>it</hi> so, blessed are those servants.

verses.name: Luke 12:39
verses.text: And know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be dug through.

verses.name: Luke 12:40
verses.text: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of man comes at an hour when you think not.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:41
verses.text: And Peter said to Him, Lord, do You speak this parable to us or also to all?

verses.name: Luke 12:42
verses.text: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward whom <hi>his</hi> lord shall set over his houseservants, to give <hi>them their</hi> portion of food in season?

verses.name: Luke 12:43
verses.text: Blessed <hi>is</hi> that servant <hi>when</hi> his lord comes <hi>and</hi> finds him so doing.

verses.name: Luke 12:44
verses.text: Truly I say to you that he will set him over all his possessions.

verses.name: Luke 12:45
verses.text: But if that servant says in his heart, My lord delays his coming, and shall begin to beat the male servants and women servants, and to eat and drink and to be drunk,

verses.name: Luke 12:46
verses.text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he does not expect, and at an hour when he does not know. And he will cut him apart, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

verses.name: Luke 12:47
verses.text: And that servant who knew his lord's will and did not prepare, nor did according to His will, shall be beaten with many <hi>stripes</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 12:48
verses.text: But he not knowing, and doing <hi>things</hi> worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few <hi>stripes</hi>. For to whomever much is given, of him much shall be required. And to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

verses.name: Luke 12:49
verses.text: I have come to send fire on the earth. And what will I do if it is already kindled?

verses.name: Luke 12:50
verses.text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how I am pressed down until it is accomplished!

verses.name: Luke 12:51
verses.text: Do you suppose that I have come to give peace on earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

verses.name: Luke 12:52
verses.text: For from now on, there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

verses.name: Luke 12:53
verses.text: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:54
verses.text: And He also said to the crowd, When you see a cloud rise out of the west, immediately you say, There is a shower coming. And so it is.

verses.name: Luke 12:55
verses.text: And when <hi>you see</hi> the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it occurs.

verses.name: Luke 12:56
verses.text: Hypocrites! You know to discern the face of the heaven and the earth, but how <hi>is it</hi> that you do not discern this time?

verses.name: Luke 12:57
verses.text: And why, even of yourselves, do you not judge what is right?

verses.name: Luke 12:58
verses.text: For as you go with your adversary to the judge, give pains in the way to be set free from him, lest he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into the prison.

verses.name: Luke 12:59
verses.text: I tell you, you shall not depart from there until you have paid the very last lepton.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:1
verses.text: And some were present at the same time reporting to Him of the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

verses.name: Luke 13:2
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Do you suppose that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans because they suffered such things?

verses.name: Luke 13:3
verses.text: I tell you, No. But unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.

verses.name: Luke 13:4
verses.text: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you think that they were sinners above all men who lived in Jerusalem?

verses.name: Luke 13:5
verses.text: I tell you, No. But unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:6
verses.text: He also spoke this parable: A certain <hi>man</hi> had a fig-tree planted in his vineyard. And he came and sought fruit on it, and found none.

verses.name: Luke 13:7
verses.text: And he said to the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig-tree, and find none. Cut it down, why does it encumber the ground?

verses.name: Luke 13:8
verses.text: And answering, he said to him, Lord, let it alone this year also, until I dig around it and throw manure.

verses.name: Luke 13:9
verses.text: And if it bears fruit, <hi>well</hi>; and if not, then after that you shall cut it down.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:10
verses.text: And He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

verses.name: Luke 13:11
verses.text: And behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bowed together and was not able to be completely erect.

verses.name: Luke 13:12
verses.text: And when Jesus saw her, He called and said to her, Woman, you are delivered from your infirmity.

verses.name: Luke 13:13
verses.text: And He laid <hi>His</hi> hands on her. And instantly she was made erect, and she glorified God.

verses.name: Luke 13:14
verses.text: And answering, the synagogue ruler, being angry because Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, said to the crowd, There are six days in which it is right to work. Therefore in them come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

verses.name: Luke 13:15
verses.text: And the Lord answered him and said, Hypocrite! Does not each one of you on the sabbath loosen his ox or ass from the stall and lead <hi>it</hi> away, to give <hi>it</hi> drink?

verses.name: Luke 13:16
verses.text: And ought not this <hi>woman</hi>, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan has bound, lo these eighteen years, be loosened from this bond on the Sabbath day?

verses.name: Luke 13:17
verses.text: And when He had said these things, all His adversaries were ashamed. And all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:18
verses.text: And He said, What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?

verses.name: Luke 13:19
verses.text: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and threw into his garden. And it grew and became a great tree, and the birds of the air lodged in its branches.

verses.name: Luke 13:20
verses.text: And again He said, To what shall I compare the kingdom of God?

verses.name: Luke 13:21
verses.text: It is like leaven which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until the whole was leavened.

verses.name: Luke 13:22
verses.text: And He went through the cities and villages, teaching and progressing toward Jerusalem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:23
verses.text: And one said to Him, Lord, <hi>are</hi> the ones being saved few? And He said to them,

verses.name: Luke 13:24
verses.text: Strive to enter in at the narrow gate. For I say to you, many will seek to enter in and shall not be able.

verses.name: Luke 13:25
verses.text: And once the Master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us, and He shall answer and say to you, I do not know you; from where are you;

verses.name: Luke 13:26
verses.text: then you shall begin to say, We ate and drank in Your presence, and You have taught in our streets.

verses.name: Luke 13:27
verses.text: But He shall say, I tell you, I do not know you; from where you are. Depart from Me, all workers of unrighteousness!

verses.name: Luke 13:28
verses.text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you will see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and yourselves being thrust out.

verses.name: Luke 13:29
verses.text: And they will come from the east and the west, and from the north and the south, and will recline in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 13:30
verses.text: And behold, there are last ones which will be first, and there are first ones which will be last.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:31
verses.text: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying to Him, Go out and depart from here, for Herod will kill you.

verses.name: Luke 13:32
verses.text: And He said to them, You go and tell that fox, Behold, today and tomorrow, I cast out demons and I complete cures, and the third <hi>day</hi> I will be finished.

verses.name: Luke 13:33
verses.text: Yet I must walk today and tomorrow and the <hi>day</hi> following. For it cannot be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 13:34
verses.text: Jerusalem! Jerusalem! the <hi>one</hi> killing the prophets, and stoning those having been sent to her; how often I desired to gather your children in the way a hen <hi>gathers</hi> her brood under the wings, and you did not desire <hi> it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 13:35
verses.text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. And truly I say to you, You will not see Me until it come when you say, Blessed <hi>is</hi> He who comes in <hi>the</hi> name of <hi>the</hi> Lord.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:1
verses.text: And as He went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, it happened that they watched Him.

verses.name: Luke 14:2
verses.text: And behold, a certain man was dropsical before Him.

verses.name: Luke 14:3
verses.text: And answering, Jesus spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath <hi>day</hi>?

verses.name: Luke 14:4
verses.text: And they were silent. And taking <hi>him</hi>, He healed him and let him go.

verses.name: Luke 14:5
verses.text: And He answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fall into a pit and will not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?

verses.name: Luke 14:6
verses.text: And they could not answer Him again as to these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:7
verses.text: And He put forth a parable to those who were invited, when He noted how they chose out the chief places, saying to them,

verses.name: Luke 14:8
verses.text: When you are invited by anyone to a wedding, do not recline in the chief seat, lest a more honorable <hi>man</hi> than you may be invited by him.

verses.name: Luke 14:9
verses.text: And he who invited you and him shall come and say to you, Give place to this man; and then you begin with shame to take the last place.

verses.name: Luke 14:10
verses.text: But when you are invited, go and recline in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may say to you, Friend, go up higher. Then glory shall be to you before those reclining with you.

verses.name: Luke 14:11
verses.text: For whoever exalts himself shall be abased, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

verses.name: Luke 14:12
verses.text: And He also said to him who invited Him, When you make a dinner or a supper, do not call your friends or your brothers, or your kinsmen, or <hi>your</hi> rich neighbors; lest they also invite you again, and a recompense be made to you.

verses.name: Luke 14:13
verses.text: But when you make a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind,

verses.name: Luke 14:14
verses.text: and you shall be blessed, for they cannot repay you; for you shall be repaid at the resurrection of the just.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:15
verses.text: And one of those who reclined with <hi>Him</hi> heard these things, and <hi>he</hi> said to Him, Blessed <hi>are</hi> those eating bread in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 14:16
verses.text: And He said to him, A certain man made a great supper and invited many.

verses.name: Luke 14:17
verses.text: And he sent his servant at supper time to say to those who were invited, Come, for all things are now ready.

verses.name: Luke 14:18
verses.text: And all with one <hi>consent</hi> began to make excuse. The first said to him, I have bought a piece of ground, I must go and see it. I beg you, have me excused.

verses.name: Luke 14:19
verses.text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to test them. I beg you, have me excused.

verses.name: Luke 14:20
verses.text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

verses.name: Luke 14:21
verses.text: And coming up that servant reported these things to his lord. And the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city and bring in here the poor and the maimed, and the lame and the blind.

verses.name: Luke 14:22
verses.text: And the servant said, Lord, <hi>it</hi> is done as you have commanded, and still there is room.

verses.name: Luke 14:23
verses.text: And the lord said to the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges and compel <hi>them</hi> to come in, so that my house may be filled.

verses.name: Luke 14:24
verses.text: For I say to you that none of these men who were invited shall taste of my supper.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:25
verses.text: And great crowds went with Him. And He turned and said to them,

verses.name: Luke 14:26
verses.text: If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, yes, and his <hi>own</hi> life also, he cannot be My disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:27
verses.text: And whoever does not bear his cross and come after Me, he cannot be My disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:28
verses.text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, does not sit down first <hi>and</hi> count the cost, whether he may have <hi>enough</hi> to finish it;

verses.name: Luke 14:29
verses.text: lest perhaps, after he has laid the foundation and is not able to finish, all those seeing begin to mock him,

verses.name: Luke 14:30
verses.text: saying, This man began to build and was not able to finish.

verses.name: Luke 14:31
verses.text: Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not first sit down <hi>and</hi> consult whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

verses.name: Luke 14:32
verses.text: Or else, while the other is still a great way off, he sends a delegation and asks <hi>conditions</hi> of peace.

verses.name: Luke 14:33
verses.text: So then, everyone of you who does not forsake all his possessions, he cannot be My disciple.

verses.name: Luke 14:34
verses.text: Salt <hi>is</hi> good, but if the salt has become tasteless, with what shall it be seasoned?

verses.name: Luke 14:35
verses.text: It is not fit for the land, nor for manure, <hi>but men</hi> throw it out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:1
verses.text: And all the tax-collectors and sinners drew near to Him in order to hear Him.

verses.name: Luke 15:2
verses.text: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receives sinners and eats with them.

verses.name: Luke 15:3
verses.text: And He spoke this parable to them, saying,

verses.name: Luke 15:4
verses.text: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after that which is lost until he finds it?

verses.name: Luke 15:5
verses.text: And when he has found <hi>it</hi>, he lays <hi>it</hi> on his shoulders, rejoicing.

verses.name: Luke 15:6
verses.text: And when he comes home, he calls together <hi>his</hi> friends and neighbors, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.

verses.name: Luke 15:7
verses.text: I say to you that likewise joy shall be in Heaven over one sinner who repents, more than over ninety-nine just persons who need no repentance.

verses.name: Luke 15:8
verses.text: Or what woman having ten drachmas, if she loses one drachma, does she not light a lamp and sweep the house, and seek carefully until she finds <hi>it</hi>?

verses.name: Luke 15:9
verses.text: And when she has found <hi>it</hi>, she calls <hi>her</hi> friends and her neighbors together, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.

verses.name: Luke 15:10
verses.text: Likewise I say to you, there is joy before the angels of God over one sinner who repents.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:11
verses.text: And He said, A certain man had two sons.

verses.name: Luke 15:12
verses.text: And the younger of them said to <hi>his</hi> father, Father, give me the portion of goods that is coming <hi>to me</hi>. And he divided <hi>his</hi> living to them.

verses.name: Luke 15:13
verses.text: And not many days afterward, the younger son gathered all together and went away into a far country. And there he wasted his property, living dissolutely.

verses.name: Luke 15:14
verses.text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land. And he began to be in want.

verses.name: Luke 15:15
verses.text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country. And he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

verses.name: Luke 15:16
verses.text: And he was longing to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, and no one gave to him.

verses.name: Luke 15:17
verses.text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father abound in loaves, and I perish with hunger!

verses.name: Luke 15:18
verses.text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you

verses.name: Luke 15:19
verses.text: and am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.

verses.name: Luke 15:20
verses.text: And he arose and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

verses.name: Luke 15:21
verses.text: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you, and am no more worthy to be called your son.

verses.name: Luke 15:22
verses.text: But the father said to his servants, Bring the best robe and put <hi>it</hi> on him. And put a ring on his hand and shoes on <hi>his</hi> feet.

verses.name: Luke 15:23
verses.text: And bring the fattened calf here and kill <hi>it</hi>. And let us eat and be merry,

verses.name: Luke 15:24
verses.text: for this my son was dead and is alive again, he was lost and is found. And they began to be merry.

verses.name: Luke 15:25
verses.text: And his elder son was in the field. And as he came and drew near the house, he heard music and dancing.

verses.name: Luke 15:26
verses.text: And he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.

verses.name: Luke 15:27
verses.text: And he said to him, Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has received him safe and sound.

verses.name: Luke 15:28
verses.text: And he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and entreated him.

verses.name: Luke 15:29
verses.text: And answering he said to <hi>his</hi> father, Lo, these many years I have served you, neither did I transgress your commandment at any time. And yet you never gave <hi>me</hi> a kid so that I might make merry with my friends.

verses.name: Luke 15:30
verses.text: But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your living with harlots, you have killed for him the fattened calf.

verses.name: Luke 15:31
verses.text: And he said to him, Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.

verses.name: Luke 15:32
verses.text: It was right that we should make merry and be glad, for this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:1
verses.text: And He also said to His disciples, There was a certain rich man who had a steward. And he was accused to him, that he had wasted his goods.

verses.name: Luke 16:2
verses.text: And he called him and said to him, What <hi>is</hi> this I hear about you? Give an account of your stewardship, for you may no longer be steward.

verses.name: Luke 16:3
verses.text: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do? For my lord is taking the stewardship away from me. I cannot dig; I am ashamed to beg.

verses.name: Luke 16:4
verses.text: I know what I will do, so that when I am put out of the stewardship they may receive me into their houses.

verses.name: Luke 16:5
verses.text: So he called every one of his lord's debtors and said; to the first, How much do you owe my lord?

verses.name: Luke 16:6
verses.text: And he said, A hundred baths of oil. And he said to him, Take your bill and sit down quickly and write fifty.

verses.name: Luke 16:7
verses.text: And he said to another, And how much do you owe? And he said, A hundred cors of wheat. And he said to him, Take your bill and write eighty.

verses.name: Luke 16:8
verses.text: And the unjust steward's lord commended him because he had done wisely. For the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

verses.name: Luke 16:9
verses.text: And I say to you, Make friends by the mammon of unrighteousness for yourselves, so that when you fail, they may receive you into everlasting dwellings.

verses.name: Luke 16:10
verses.text: He who is faithful in <hi>the</hi> least is also faithful in much. And he who is unjust in the least is also unjust in much.

verses.name: Luke 16:11
verses.text: Therefore if you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will entrust the true <hi>riches</hi> to you?

verses.name: Luke 16:12
verses.text: And if you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who shall give you that which is your own?

verses.name: Luke 16:13
verses.text: No servant can serve two masters. For either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will hold to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.name: Luke 16:14
verses.text: And being money-lovers, all the Pharisees also heard all these things. And they derided Him.

verses.name: Luke 16:15
verses.text: And He said to them, You are those who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

verses.name: Luke 16:16
verses.text: The law and the prophets <hi>were</hi> until John. Since that time the kingdom of God is proclaimed, and everyone is pressing into it.

verses.name: Luke 16:17
