verses.text: And it is easier <hi>for</hi> the heaven and earth to pass than for one tittle of the law to fail.

verses.name: Luke 16:18
verses.text: Everyone putting away his wife and marrying another commits adultery; and everyone marrying her who is put away from <hi>her</hi> husband commits adultery.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:19
verses.text: There was a certain rich man who <hi>was</hi> customarily clothed in purple and fine linen and making merry in luxury every day.

verses.name: Luke 16:20
verses.text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, who was laid at his gate, full of sores

verses.name: Luke 16:21
verses.text: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table. But even the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.name: Luke 16:22
verses.text: And it happened that the beggar died and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom. The rich one also died and was buried.

verses.name: Luke 16:23
verses.text: And in hell he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and saw Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

verses.name: Luke 16:24
verses.text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus so that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am tormented in this flame.

verses.name: Luke 16:25
verses.text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that you in your lifetime received your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things. But now he is comforted and you are tormented.

verses.name: Luke 16:26
verses.text: And besides all this, there is a great chasm fixed between you and us; so that they desiring to pass from here to you cannot, nor can they pass over to us from there.

verses.name: Luke 16:27
verses.text: And he said, I beg you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house,

verses.name: Luke 16:28
verses.text: for I have five brothers, so that he may testify to them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

verses.name: Luke 16:29
verses.text: Abraham said to him, They have Moses and the prophets, let them hear them.

verses.name: Luke 16:30
verses.text: And he said, No, father Abraham, but if one should go to them from <hi>the</hi> dead, they would repent.

verses.name: Luke 16:31
verses.text: And he said to him, If they do not hear Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded, even though one rose from <hi>the</hi> dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:1
verses.text: And He said to the disciples, It is impossible but that offenses will come. But woe <hi>to him</hi> through whom they come!

verses.name: Luke 17:2
verses.text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged around his neck and he were cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

verses.name: Luke 17:3
verses.text: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother trespasses against you, rebuke him. And if he repents, forgive him.

verses.name: Luke 17:4
verses.text: And if he trespasses against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turns again to you, saying, I repent, you shall forgive him.

verses.name: Luke 17:5
verses.text: And the apostles said to the Lord, Give us more faith.

verses.name: Luke 17:6
verses.text: And the Lord said, If you had faith as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this sycamine tree, Be rooted up and be planted in the sea! And it would obey you.

verses.name: Luke 17:7
verses.text: But which of you who has a servant plowing or feeding will say <hi>to him</hi> immediately after he has come from the field, Come, recline?

verses.name: Luke 17:8
verses.text: Will <hi>he</hi> not say to him, Prepare something <hi>so that</hi> I may eat, and gird yourself and serve me until I eat and drink. And afterward you shall eat and drink.

verses.name: Luke 17:9
verses.text: <hi> Does</hi> he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.

verses.name: Luke 17:10
verses.text: So likewise you, when you shall have done all the things commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants, for we have done what we ought to do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:11
verses.text: And as He went to Jerusalem, it happened that he went through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

verses.name: Luke 17:12
verses.text: And as He entered into a certain village, ten leprous men met Him, who stood afar off.

verses.name: Luke 17:13
verses.text: And they lifted voice and said, Jesus, Master, pity us!

verses.name: Luke 17:14
verses.text: And seeing <hi>them</hi>, He said to them, Go show yourselves to the priests. And it happened, as they went, that they were cleansed.

verses.name: Luke 17:15
verses.text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back and glorified God with a loud voice.

verses.name: Luke 17:16
verses.text: And he fell down on <hi>his</hi> face at His feet, thanking Him. And he was a Samaritan.

verses.name: Luke 17:17
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said, Were there not ten cleansed? But where <hi>are</hi> the nine?

verses.name: Luke 17:18
verses.text: Were none found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?

verses.name: Luke 17:19
verses.text: And He said to him, Rise and go, your faith has cured you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:20
verses.text: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered and said, The kingdom of God does not come with observation.

verses.name: Luke 17:21
verses.text: Nor shall they say, Lo here! or, behold, there! For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst.

verses.name: Luke 17:22
verses.text: And He said to the disciples, The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and you shall not see <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 17:23
verses.text: And they shall say to you, Lo, here! or, behold, there! Do not go away, nor follow.

verses.name: Luke 17:24
verses.text: For as the lightning which lights up, flashing from the <hi>one part</hi> under heaven, <hi>and</hi> shines to the <hi>other part</hi> under heaven, so also shall the Son of man be in His day.

verses.name: Luke 17:25
verses.text: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.

verses.name: Luke 17:26
verses.text: And as it was in the days of Noah, so it also shall be in the days of the Son of man.

verses.name: Luke 17:27
verses.text: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until <hi>the</hi> day that Noah entered into the ark; and the flood came and destroyed <hi>them</hi> all.

verses.name: Luke 17:28
verses.text: So also as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

verses.name: Luke 17:29
verses.text: but the day Lot went out of Sodom, it rained fire and brimstone from the heaven and destroyed <hi>them</hi> all.

verses.name: Luke 17:30
verses.text: Even so it shall be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

verses.name: Luke 17:31
verses.text: In that day he who shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise, he who is in the field, let him not return to the things behind.

verses.name: Luke 17:32
verses.text: Remember Lot's wife.

verses.name: Luke 17:33
verses.text: Whoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it, and whoever shall lose <hi>his life</hi> shall preserve it.

verses.name: Luke 17:34
verses.text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two in one bed, the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

verses.name: Luke 17:35
verses.text: Two shall be grinding together, one will be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Luke 17:36
verses.text: Two shall be in the field, one will be taken, and the other left.

verses.name: Luke 17:37
verses.text: And they answered and said to Him, Where, Lord? And He said to them, Wherever the body <hi>is</hi>, there the eagles will be gathered together.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:1
verses.text: And He also spoke a parable to them to <hi>teach</hi> it is always right to pray, and not to faint,

verses.name: Luke 18:2
verses.text: saying, A certain judge was in a certain city, not fearing God, nor respecting man.

verses.name: Luke 18:3
verses.text: And a widow was in that city. And she came to Him, saying, Avenge me of my adversary.

verses.name: Luke 18:4
verses.text: And he would not do so for a time. But afterward he said within himself, Though I do not fear God nor regard man,

verses.name: Luke 18:5
verses.text: yet because this widow troubles me, I will avenge her, that she not wear me down in <hi>the</hi> end.

verses.name: Luke 18:6
verses.text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

verses.name: Luke 18:7
verses.text: And shall not God avenge His own elect who cry day and night to Him, though He has been long-suffering over them?

verses.name: Luke 18:8
verses.text: I say to you that He will avenge them speedily. Yet when the Son of man comes, shall He find faith on the earth?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:9
verses.text: And He spoke this parable to certain ones who trusted in themselves, that they were righteous, and despised others:

verses.name: Luke 18:10
verses.text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-collector.

verses.name: Luke 18:11
verses.text: The Pharisee stood and prayed within himself in this way: God, I thank You that I am not as other men <hi>are</hi>, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even like this tax-collector.

verses.name: Luke 18:12
verses.text: I fast twice <hi>in</hi> the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

verses.name: Luke 18:13
verses.text: And standing afar off, the tax-collector would not even lift up <hi>his</hi> eyes to Heaven, but struck on his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner!

verses.name: Luke 18:14
verses.text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified <hi>rather</hi> than the other. For everyone who exalts himself shall be abased, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:15
verses.text: And they also brought infants to Him, that He might touch them. But when the disciples saw, they, rebuked them.

verses.name: Luke 18:16
verses.text: But Jesus called them and said, Allow the little children to come to Me, and forbid them not. For of such is the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 18:17
verses.text: Truly I say to you, Whoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no way enter into it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:18
verses.text: And a certain ruler asked Him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.name: Luke 18:19
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Why do you call Me good? None <hi>is</hi> good except One, God.

verses.name: Luke 18:20
verses.text: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery, do not kill, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and your mother.

verses.name: Luke 18:21
verses.text: And he said, I have kept all these from my youth up.

verses.name: Luke 18:22
verses.text: And when Jesus heard these things, He said to him, Yet you lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute to <hi>the</hi> poor, and you shall have treasure in Heaven. And come, follow Me.

verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful, for he was very rich.

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, He said, How hardly those having riches shall enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: For it is easier <hi>for</hi> a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich one to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: And the ones who heard said, And who can be saved?

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: And He said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: And Peter said, Lo, we have left all and have followed You.

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: And He said to them, Truly I say to you, There is no one who has left house, or parents, or brothers, or wife, or children for the sake of the kingdom of God,

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: who shall not receive many times more in this present time, and in the world to come everlasting life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: And He took the Twelve and said to them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man will be accomplished.

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: For He will be delivered to the nations and will be mocked and insulted and spat on.

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: And they will scourge <hi>Him</hi> and put Him to death, and the third day He will rise again.

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: And they did not understand any of these things. And this saying was hidden from them, nor did they know the things which were spoken.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: And as He came near Jericho, it happened that a certain blind man sat by the roadside begging.

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: And hearing the crowd pass by, he asked what it meant.

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: And they told him that Jesus of Nazareth passed by.

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, Son of David! Have mercy on me.

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: And they who were in front rebuked him that he should be quiet. But he cried so much the more, Son of David! Have mercy on me.

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: And Jesus stood and commanded him to be brought to Him. And when he had come near, He asked him,

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: saying, What do you desire that I should do to you? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Receive your sight! Your faith has saved you.

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: And immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. And when they saw, all the people gave praise to God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: And going in, He passed through Jericho.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: And behold, <hi>there was</hi> a man named Zaccheus, who was a chief tax-collector. And he was rich.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: And he sought to see Jesus, to see who He was. And he could not because of the press, because he was little in stature.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: And he ran in front and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him. For He was to pass through that <hi>way</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and saw him. And He said to him, Zaccheus! Hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: And hurrying he came down, and received Him joyfully.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: And seeing, they all murmured, saying, He has gone in to stay with a sinful man.

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: And Zaccheus stood and said to the Lord, Behold, Lord, I give half of my goods to the poor. And <hi>in</hi> anything I accused anyone falsely, I restore <hi>it</hi> fourfold.

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, This day salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: For the Son of man has come to seek and to save that which was lost.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: And as they heard these things, He added and spoke a parable, because He was near Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God was about to appear immediately.

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: Therefore He said, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive a kingdom for himself, and to return.

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: And He called his ten servants and delivered ten minas, and said to them, Trade until I come back.

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: But his citizens hated him. And they sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this one to reign over us.

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: And when he had received his kingdom and had returned, then it happened that he commanded these servants to be called to him; the ones to whom he had given the silver; so that he might know what each had gained by trading.

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: And came the first, saying, Lord, your mina has gained ten minas.

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: And he said to him, Well <hi>done</hi>, good servant, because you have been faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: And the second came, saying, Lord, your mina has made five minas.

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: And he said the same to him, You be over five cities.

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, <hi>here is</hi> your mina, which I have kept in a handkerchief.

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: For I feared you, because you are a harsh man. You take up what you did not lay down, and you reap what you did not sow.

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: And he said to him, I will judge you out of your own mouth, wicked servant! You knew that I was a harsh man, taking up what I had not laid down and reaping what I did not sow.

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: And why did you not give my silver on the <hi>bank</hi> table, and coming I might have exacted it with interest?

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: And he said to those who stood by, Take the mina from him and give <hi>it</hi> to him who has ten minas.

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: And they said to him, Lord, he has ten minas.

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: For I say to you that to everyone who has, more will be given. And from him who has not, even that which he has will be taken from him.

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: But those who are my enemies, who did not desire that I should reign over them, bring them here and slay <hi>them</hi> before me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: And saying these things, He went in front, going up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: And it happened as He drew near Bethphage and Bethany, toward the mount called Mount of Olives, He sent two of the disciples,

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: saying, Go into the village across <hi>from you</hi>, and having entered, you will find a colt tied up, on which no one of men has yet sat. Untie it and bring <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: And if anyone asks you, Why are you untying <hi>it</hi>? You will say this to him, Because the Lord has need of it.

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: And going, those who were sent found as He had said to them.

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying the colt?

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: And they said, The Lord has need of him.

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: And they brought him to Jesus. And they threw their garments on the colt. And they set Jesus on <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: And as He went, they spread their clothes in the way.

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: And when He had come near, even now at the descent of the Mount of Olives, all the multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all <hi>the</hi> mighty works which they had seen,

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: saying, Blessed <hi>is</hi> the King coming in the name of the Lord! Peace in Heaven and glory in <hi>the</hi> highest!

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Him, Teacher, rebuke your disciples.

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: And He answered and said to them, I tell you that if these should be silent, the stones would cry out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: And as He drew near, He beheld the city and wept over it,

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: saying, If you had known, even you, even at least in this day of yours, the things for your peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: For the days will come on you that your enemies will raise up a rampart to you, and will surround you, and will keep you in on every side.

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: And they will tear you down, and your children within you, and will not leave a stone on a stone because you did not know the time of your visitation.

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: And entering into the temple, He began to cast out those selling and buying in it,

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: saying to them, It is written, "My house is a house of prayer," but you have made it a den of thieves.

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: And He taught in the temple daily. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy Him.

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: And <hi>they</hi> could not find what they might do, for all the people were hanging on Him, listening.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: And on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and proclaimed the gospel, it happened that the chief priests and the scribes along with the elders came on <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: And they spoke to Him, saying, Tell us, by what authority do you do these things? Or who is he who gave you this authority?

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: And He answered and said to them, I will also ask you one thing, and you answer me:

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: The baptism of John, was it from Heaven or from men?

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say, Why then did you not believe him?

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: But if we say, From men, then all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: And they answered that they could not tell from where <hi>it was</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: And He began to speak to the people this parable: A certain man planted a vineyard and let it out to vinedressers. And <hi>he</hi> went into a far country for a long time.

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: And in season he sent a servant to the vinedressers, so that they should give him the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent <hi>him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: And again he sent another servant. And they also beat him and treated <hi>him</hi> shamefully, and sent <hi>him</hi> away empty.

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: And again he sent a third. And they also wounded him and cast <hi>him</hi> out.

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that they will respect <hi>him</hi> when they see him.

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir! Come, let us kill him so that the inheritance may be ours.

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed <hi>him</hi>. What then shall the lord of the vineyard do to them?

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: He shall come and destroy these vinedressers and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard this, they said, Let it not be!

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: And He looked at them and said, What then is this which is written, "<hi> The</hi> Stone which the builders rejected, the same has become <hi>the</hi> Head of <hi>the</hi> corner?

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: Whoever shall fall on that Stone shall be broken, but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder."

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: And the chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on Him the same hour. And <hi>they</hi> feared the people, for they perceived that He had spoken this parable against them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: And they watched and sent forth spies, pretending themselves to be righteous men, so that they might seize upon a word of His, that they might deliver Him in this way to the power and authority of the governor.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: And they asked Him, saying, Teacher, we know that you say and teach rightly, and do not accept the person of anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar or not?

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: But He perceived their craftiness and said to them, Why do you tempt Me?

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: Show Me a coin. Whose image and inscription does it have? They answered and said, Caesar's.

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: And He said to them, Therefore render to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: And they could not take hold of His words before the people. And they marveled at His answer and were silent.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: And certain of the Sadducees came, those speaking against a resurrection, <hi>that it was</hi> not to be. And they asked Him,

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: saying, Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If anyone's brother dies, having a wife, and if he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up seed to his brother.

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: Therefore there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife and died without children.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: And the second took her as a wife, and he died childless.

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: And the third took her. And likewise the seven left no children and died.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: Last of all the woman also died.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be? For the seven had her <hi>as</hi> a wife.

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: And answering, Jesus said to them, The sons of this world marry and are given in marriage,

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: but they who shall be counted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from <hi>the</hi> dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage.

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: Nor can they die <hi>any</hi> more, for they are equal to the angels, and are the sons of God, being the sons of the resurrection.

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: But that the dead are raised, even Moses pointed out at the Bush, when he called <hi>the</hi> Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: For He is not God of <hi>the</hi> dead, but of the living. For all live to Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: And answering, certain of the scribes said, Teacher, you have spoken well.

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: And after that they did not dare ask Him anything.

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: And He said to them, How do they say that Christ is the Son of David?

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: Even David himself says in <hi>the</hi> Book of Psalms, "The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: until I place Your enemies as Your footstool."

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: David then calls Him Lord; how then is He his son?

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: And as all the people were listening, He said to the disciples,

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: Beware of the scribes who desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the first seats in the synagogues, and the chief places at the feasts;

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: who devour widows' houses, and make long prayers for a show; the same shall receive a more severe condemnation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: And looking up, He saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: And He also saw a certain poor widow casting two lepta in there.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: And He said, Truly I say to you that this poor widow has cast <hi>in</hi> more than all of them.

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: For all these have cast in to the offerings of God from their abundance, but out of her poverty she has cast <hi>in</hi> all the living she had.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: And as some spoke of the temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and gifts, He said,

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: <hi> As to</hi> these things which you see, days will come in which there shall not be left a stone on a stone, which shall not be thrown down.

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: And they asked Him, saying, Teacher, but when shall these things be? And what <hi>shall be</hi> the sign when these things are about to take place?

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: And He said, Take heed that you are not deceived, for many shall come in My name, saying, I AM! Also, The time has come! Do not go after them.

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: But when you hear of wars and disturbances, do not be terrified, for all these things must first occur, but the end <hi>is</hi> not at once.

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: And He said to them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: And great earthquakes shall be in different places, and famines and plagues. And there shall be terrors and great signs from Heaven.

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you and persecute <hi>you</hi>, delivering <hi>you</hi> up to the synagogues and prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for My name's sake.

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: And it shall return to you for a testimony.

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: Therefore settle <hi>it</hi> in your hearts not to meditate beforehand what you shall answer.

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: And you shall be betrayed also by parents and brothers and kinsmen and friends. And they will cause <hi>some</hi> of you to be put to death.

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: And you shall be hated by all for My name's sake.

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: But there shall not a hair of your head perish.

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: By your patience you will gain your souls.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: And when you see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that its destruction has come.

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: And let those in Judea flee to the mountains. And those in its midst, let them go out. And those in the open spaces, let them not go into her.

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: But woe to those who are with child, and to those suckling in those days! For there shall be great distress in the land and wrath on this people.

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: And they shall fall by <hi>the</hi> sword's edge. And shall be led away captive into all nations. And Jerusalem shall be trodden down by the nations until <hi>the</hi> times of <hi>the</hi> nations is fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars. And on the earth <hi>will be</hi> anxiety of nations with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: men fainting from fear, and expecting those things which have come on the earth. For the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: And then they shall see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: And when these things begin to happen, then look up and lift up your heads, for your redemption draws near.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: And He spoke a parable to them: Behold the fig-tree and all the trees.

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: Now when they sprout leaves, seeing <hi>it</hi> you will know that summer is now near.

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: Truly I say to you, This generation shall not pass away until all <hi>these</hi> things are fulfilled.

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away.

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: And take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts are weighed down with headaches and drinking and anxieties of this life; and that day should suddenly come on you;

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: for it shall come as a snare on all those sitting on <hi>the</hi> face of the whole earth.

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: Watch therefore, praying in every season that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things which shall occur, and to stand before the Son of man.

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: And <hi>in</hi> the days He was teaching in the temple. And <hi>in</hi> the nights He went out, and lodged in the mount called <hi>the Mount</hi> of Olives.

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: And all the people came early in the morning to Him in the temple, in order to hear Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: And the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: And Satan entered into Judas, surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the Twelve.

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: And going, he talked with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: And they were glad and they agreed to give him silver.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: And he fully consented, and he sought opportunity to betray Him to them, away from <hi>the</hi> crowd.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: And the day of the Unleavened Bread came, when the passover must be killed.

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: And He sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the passover for us, so that we may eat.

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: And they said to Him. Where do You desire that we prepare?

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: And He said to them, Behold, when you have entered into the city, you will meet a man bearing a pitcher of water. Follow him into the house where he enters.

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: And you shall say to the master of the house, The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room where I shall eat the passover with My disciples?

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: And he shall show you a large, furnished upper room. Prepare there.

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: And they went and found it as He had said to them. And they prepared the passover.

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: And when the hour came, He and the twelve apostles with Him reclined.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: And He said to them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer.

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: For I say to you, I will not any more eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: And He took the cup and gave thanks and said, Take this and divide <hi>it</hi> among yourselves.

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: For I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God shall come.

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: And He took bread and gave thanks, and He broke <hi>it</hi> and gave <hi>it</hi> to them, saying, This is My body which is given for you, this do in remembrance of Me.

verses.name: Luke 22:20
verses.text: In the same way also the cup, after having dined, saying, This cup <hi>is</hi> the new covenant in My blood, which is being poured out for you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: But, behold, the hand of My betrayer <hi>is</hi> with Me on the table.

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: And truly the Son of man goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: And they began to inquire among themselves which of them it was that should do this thing.

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: And there was also a dispute among them as to which of them seems to be greater.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: And He said to them, The kings of the nations exercise lordship over them. And they who exercise authority on them are called benefactors.

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: But you <hi>shall</hi> not <hi>be</hi> so: but the greater among you, let him be as the lesser, and he who governs, as <hi>one</hi> who serves.

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: For which <hi>is</hi> the greater; he who reclines, or he who serves? <hi>Is</hi> it not he who reclines? But I am among you as He who serves.

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: You are those who have continued with Me in My trials.

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: And I appoint a kingdom to you, as My Father has appointed to Me,

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired you, that he may sift <hi>you</hi> as wheat.

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not. And when you are converted, strengthen your brothers.

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: And he said to Him, Lord, I am ready to go with You, both into prison and into death.

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: And He said, I say to you, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day before you shall deny knowing Me three times.

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: And He said to them, When I sent you without purse and wallet and sandals, did you lack anything? And they said, Nothing.

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: And He said to them, But now, he who has a purse, let him take <hi>it</hi>, and likewise <hi>his</hi> wallet. And he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one.

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: For I say to you that this which is written must yet be accomplished in Me, "And he was reckoned among the transgressors"; for the things concerning Me have an end.

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: And they said, Lord, behold, here <hi>are</hi> two swords. And He said to them, It is enough.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: And going out, according to <hi>His</hi> custom, He went to the Mount of Olives. And His disciples also followed Him.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: And when He was at the place, He said to them, Pray that you do not enter into temptation.

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw. And He kneeled down and prayed,

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: saying, Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: And an angel appeared to Him from Heaven, strengthening Him.

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: And being in an agony He prayed more earnestly. And His sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: And when He rose up from prayer and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping because of sorrow.

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: And <hi>He</hi> said to them, Why do you sleep? Rise and pray lest you enter into temptation.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> He <hi>was</hi> yet speaking, behold a crowd! And he who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, went before them. And he drew near Jesus to kiss Him.

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: But Jesus said to him, Judas, do you betray the Son of man with a kiss?

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: And those around Him seeing what was about to occur, <hi>they</hi> said to him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: And Jesus answered and said, Let <hi>it</hi> go until now. And touching his ear, He healed him.

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: And Jesus said to the chief priests and commanders of the temple, and the elders, who had come to Him, Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and staves?

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: When I was with you in the temple daily, you did not stretch out your hand on Me. But this is your hour, and the authority of the darkness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: And laying hold on Him, they led <hi>Him</hi> away and brought Him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: And lighting a fire in <hi>the</hi> middle of the court, and they sitting down, Peter sat in their midst.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: But a certain slave-girl saw him as he sat by the fire and earnestly looked on him and said, This <hi>man</hi> was with him also.

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: And he denied Him, saying, Woman, I do not know Him.

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: And after a little while another saw him and said, You also are of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not!

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: And about an hour afterward, another confidently affirmed, saying, Truly this one was also with him, for he is a Galilean.

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: And Peter said, Man, I do not know what you say. And immediately, while he still spoke, the cock crowed.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: And the Lord turned and looked on Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, Before the cock crows, you shall deny Me three times.

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: And Peter went out and wept bitterly.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: And the men who held Jesus mocked Him, beating <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: And blindfolding Him, <hi>they</hi> struck Him on His face. And they asked Him, saying, Prophesy! Who is it who struck you?

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: And they spoke many other things blasphemously against Him.

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: And when day came, the body of elders of the people, and the chief priests and the scribes, came together. And they led Him to the sanhedrin, saying,

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: Are you the Christ? Tell us. And He said to them, If I tell you, you will not believe.

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: Also if I ask <hi>you</hi>, you will not answer Me nor let Me go.

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: From now on the Son of man shall sit at the right <hi>hand</hi> of the power of God.

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? And He said to them, You say <hi>it</hi>, because I AM!

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: And they said, What need do we have for any witness? For we ourselves have heard it from his own mouth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: And rising up, all the multitude of them led Him before Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: And they began to accuse Him, saying, We have found this one perverting the nation and forbidding them to give tribute to Caesar, saying himself to be a king, Christ.

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: And Pilate asked Him, saying, Are you the king of the Jews? And He answered him and said, You say <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: And Pilate said to the chief priests and <hi>to</hi> the people, I find no fault in this man.

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place.

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: And hearing Galilee, Pilate asked if the man is a Galilean.

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: And knowing that He belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was also at Jerusalem at that time.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: And seeing Jesus, Herod greatly rejoiced, for he had desired to see Him <hi>for</hi> a long <hi>time</hi>, because he had heard many things about Him. And he hoped to see some miracle done by Him.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: And he questioned Him in many words, but He answered him nothing.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: And humiliating Him with his guardsmen, and mocking <hi>Him</hi> by putting luxurious clothing around Him, Herod sent Him again to Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: And that same day Pilate and Herod became friends with one another, for before they were at enmity <hi>between</hi> themselves.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: And when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: Pilate said to them, You have brought this Man to me as perverting the people. And behold, having examined <hi>Him</hi> before you, I have found no fault in this Man <hi>regarding those things</hi> of which you accuse Him;

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: no, nor even Herod, for I sent you to him, and lo, nothing worthy of death has been done by Him.

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: Therefore I will chastise Him and release <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: Luke 23:17
verses.text: (For it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast.)

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: And they all cried out at once, saying, Away with this One! And release to us Barabbas

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: (who was thrown into prison because of a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder).

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: And Pilate, willing to release Jesus, spoke again to them.

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: But they cried, saying, Crucify! Crucify Him!

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: And he said to them the third <hi>time</hi>, Why? What evil has He done? I have found no cause of death in Him, therefore I will chastise Him and let <hi>Him</hi> go.

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: But they pressed <hi>on him</hi>, with loud voices, requesting that He might be crucified. And their voices and those of the chief priests prevailed.

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: And Pilate gave judgment that their request should be granted.

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: And he released to them <hi>the one</hi> who had been thrown into prison for sedition and murder, for whom they had asked. But he delivered up Jesus to their will.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: And as they led Him away, they laid hold on one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country. And they laid the cross on him, that he might carry <hi>it</hi> after Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: And a great multitude of people were following Him, and of women who also were bewailing and lamenting Him.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: But turning to them, Jesus said, Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: For behold, the days are coming in which they shall say, Blessed <hi>are</hi> the barren, and the wombs that never bore, and the breasts which did not suckle.

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: And they shall begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us! And to the hills, Cover us!

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: And two others, two criminals, were led with Him to be put to death.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: And when they came to the place which is called Calvary, they crucified Him and the criminals there, one on <hi>the</hi> right, and one on <hi>the</hi> left.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do. And parting His clothing, they cast lots.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: And the people stood watching. And also the rulers with them, scoffing, saying, He saved others, let Him save Himself, if He is the Christ, the chosen of God.

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: And coming near, the soldiers also mocked Him, and offering Him sour wine,

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: and saying, If You are the king of the Jews, save Yourself.

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek and Latin and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: And one of the hanged criminals blasphemed Him, saying, If you are Christ, save Yourself and us.

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: But answering, the other rebuked him, saying, Do you not fear God, since <hi>you</hi> are in the same condemnation.

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: And we indeed justly so, for we receive the due reward of our deeds, but this Man has done nothing amiss.

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: And he said to Jesus, Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom.

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you shall be with Me in Paradise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: And it was about <hi>the</hi> sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until <hi>the</hi> ninth hour.

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in the middle.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: And crying with a loud voice, Jesus said, Father, into Your hands I commit My spirit. And when He had said this, He breathed out the spirit.

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: And when the centurion saw what had been done, he glorified God, saying, Truly this Man was righteous.

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: And all the crowd arriving together at this sight, beholding the things happening, struck their breasts and returned.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: And all those known to Him stood at a distance; and <hi>the</hi> women, those accompanying Him from Galilee, <hi>were</hi> seeing these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: And behold, a man named Joseph, a councillor, a good man and a just one,

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: this one was not assenting to their counsel and deed. <hi>He was</hi> from Arimathea, a city of the Jews; and he also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: This <hi>man</hi> went to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: And he took it down and wrapped it in linen. And he laid it in a tomb that had been cut in the stone, in which no man had before been laid.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: And that day was the Preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: And also women <hi>were</hi> following, who were accompanying Him out of Galilee, who watched the tomb, and how His body was placed.

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: And they returned and <hi>they</hi> prepared spices and ointment. And they rested <hi>on</hi> the sabbath day according to the commandment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: And <hi>on</hi> the first of the sabbaths, while still very early, they came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: And going in, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: And as they were much perplexed about it, it happened that, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: And as they were afraid, and bowed <hi>their</hi> faces down to the earth, they said to them, Why do you seek the living among the dead?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: He is not here, but has risen. Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: saying, The Son of man must be delivered into <hi>the</hi> hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: And they remembered His words

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: and returned from the tomb and told all these things to the Eleven and to the rest.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary <hi>the mother</hi> of James, and the rest with them, who told these things to the apostles.

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: And their words seemed to them like foolishness, and they did not believe them.

verses.name: Luke 24:12
verses.text: And Peter arose and ran to the tomb, and stooping down he saw the linens lying alone. And he went away wondering to himself at what had happened.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: And behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, it being <hi>about</hi> sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: And they talked to each other of all these things which had happened.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: And while they talked and reasoned, it happened that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: But their eyes were held <hi>so that</hi> they could not know Him.

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: And He said to them, What words <hi>are</hi> these that you have with one another <hi>as</hi> you walk, and are so sad.

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered and said to Him, <hi>Are</hi> you only a stranger in Jerusalem and have not known the things which have occurred there in these days?

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: And He said to them, What things? And they said to Him, The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a man, prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to <hi>the</hi> judgement of death, and have crucified Him.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
verses.text: But we had trusted that He was the One who was about to redeem Israel. And besides all this, today is the third day since these things were done.

verses.name: Luke 24:22
verses.text: Yes, and also some of our women astounded us, having been early at the tomb;

verses.name: Luke 24:23
verses.text: and when they did not find His body, <hi>they</hi> came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that He was alive.

verses.name: Luke 24:24
verses.text: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found <hi>it</hi> even as the women had said. But they did not see Him.

verses.name: Luke 24:25
verses.text: And He said to them, O fools and slow of heart to believe all things that the prophets spoke!

verses.name: Luke 24:26
verses.text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and to enter into His glory?

verses.name: Luke 24:27
verses.text: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

verses.name: Luke 24:28
verses.text: And they drew near the village where they were going. And He appeared to be going further.

verses.name: Luke 24:29
verses.text: But they constrained Him, saying, Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is far spent. And He went in to stay with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:30
verses.text: And it happened <hi>as</hi> He reclined with them, taking the loaf, He blessed <hi>it</hi>, and breaking it, He gave to them.

verses.name: Luke 24:31
verses.text: And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him. And He became invisible to them.

verses.name: Luke 24:32
verses.text: And they said to one another, Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us by the way and while He opened the Scriptures to us?

verses.name: Luke 24:33
verses.text: And they rose up the same hour and returned to Jerusalem and found assembled the Eleven and those with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:34
verses.text: And they said, the Lord has indeed risen, and has appeared to Simon.

verses.name: Luke 24:35
verses.text: And they told what things <hi>had happened</hi> in the way, and how He had been known by them in breaking of the loaf.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:36
verses.text: And as they spoke this, Jesus Himself stood in their midst, and said to them, Peace to you!

verses.name: Luke 24:37
verses.text: But they were terrified and filled with fear, for they thought they saw a spirit.

verses.name: Luke 24:38
verses.text: And He said to them, Why are you troubled, and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

verses.name: Luke 24:39
verses.text: Behold My hands and My feet, that I am He! Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see Me have.

verses.name: Luke 24:40
verses.text: And when He had spoken this, He showed them <hi>His</hi> hands and feet.

verses.name: Luke 24:41
verses.text: And while they still did not believe for joy, and wondered, He said to them, Have you any food here?

verses.name: Luke 24:42
verses.text: And they handed to Him a piece of a broiled fish and of a honeycomb.

verses.name: Luke 24:43
verses.text: And He took <hi>it</hi> and ate before them.

verses.name: Luke 24:44
verses.text: And He said to them, These <hi>are</hi> the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the law of Moses and in the Prophets and <hi>in</hi> the Psalms about Me.

verses.name: Luke 24:45
verses.text: And He opened their mind to understand the Scriptures.

verses.name: Luke 24:46
verses.text: And He said to them, So it is written, and so it behoved Christ to suffer and to rise from <hi>the</hi> dead the third day,

verses.name: Luke 24:47
verses.text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be proclaimed in His name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

verses.name: Luke 24:48
verses.text: And you are witnesses of these things.

verses.name: Luke 24:49
verses.text: And behold, I send the promise of My father on you. But you sit in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:50
verses.text: And He led them out as far as Bethany. And lifting up His hands, He blessed them.

verses.name: Luke 24:51
verses.text: And it happened as He blessed them, He withdrew from them and was carried up into Heaven.

verses.name: Luke 24:52
verses.text: And worshiping Him, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

verses.name: Luke 24:53
verses.text: And they were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:1
verses.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.name: John 1:2
verses.text: He was in <hi>the</hi> beginning with God.

verses.name: John 1:3
verses.text: All things came into being through Him, and without Him not even one <hi>thing</hi> came into being that has come into being.

verses.name: John 1:4
verses.text: In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:5
verses.text: And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overtake it.

verses.name: John 1:6
verses.text: There was a man sent from God; his name <hi>was</hi> John.

verses.name: John 1:7
verses.text: This one came as a witness, to bear witness concerning the Light, so that all might believe through him.

verses.name: John 1:8
verses.text: He was not that Light, but <hi>was sent</hi> to bear witness of that Light.

verses.name: John 1:9
verses.text: He was the true Light; <hi>He</hi> enlightens every man coming into the world.

verses.name: John 1:10
verses.text: He was in the world, and the world came into being through Him, and the world did not know Him.

verses.name: John 1:11
verses.text: He came to <hi>His</hi> own, and <hi>His</hi> own received Him not.

verses.name: John 1:12
verses.text: But as many as received Him, He gave to them authority to become the children of God, to those who believe on His name,

verses.name: John 1:13
verses.text: who were born, not of bloods, nor of <hi>the</hi> will of <hi>the</hi> flesh, nor of <hi>the</hi> will of man, but <hi>were born</hi> of God.

verses.name: John 1:14
verses.text: And the Word became flesh, and tabernacled among us. And we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of <hi>the</hi> Father, full of grace and of truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:15
verses.text: John bore witness of Him and cried out, saying, This was <hi>He</hi> of whom I spoke: He who comes after me has been before me, for He was preceding me.

verses.name: John 1:16
verses.text: And out of His fullness we all have received, and grace for grace.

verses.name: John 1:17
verses.text: For the law came through Moses, <hi>but</hi> grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

verses.name: John 1:18
verses.text: No one has seen God at any time; the Only-begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared <hi>Him</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:19
verses.text: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?

verses.name: John 1:20
verses.text: And he confessed and did not deny, but confessed, I am not the Christ.

verses.name: John 1:21
verses.text: And they asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he says, I am not. Are you that prophet? And he answered, No.

verses.name: John 1:22
verses.text: Then they said to him, Who are you so that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say of yourself?

verses.name: John 1:23
verses.text: He said, I <hi>am</hi> "the voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord," as the prophet Isaiah said.

verses.name: John 1:24
verses.text: And they who were sent were from the Pharisees.

verses.name: John 1:25
verses.text: And they asked him and said, Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor that Prophet?

verses.name: John 1:26
verses.text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water, but One stands among you whom you do not know.

verses.name: John 1:27
verses.text: He it is who, coming after me, who has been before me; of whom I am not worthy to loosen the thong of His sandal.

verses.name: John 1:28
verses.text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:29
verses.text: The next day John sees Jesus coming to him and says, Behold the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.name: John 1:30
verses.text: This is He of whom I said, After me comes a Man who has been before me, for He preceded me.

verses.name: John 1:31
verses.text: And I did not know Him, but that He be revealed to Israel, therefore I have come baptizing with water.

verses.name: John 1:32
verses.text: And John bore record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from Heaven like a dove, and He abode on Him.

verses.name: John 1:33
verses.text: And I did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water, that One said to me, Upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending, and remaining upon Him, He is the One who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.

verses.name: John 1:34
verses.text: And I saw and bore record that this is the Son of God.

verses.name: John 1:35
verses.text: Again, the next day afterward, John stood with two of his disciples.

verses.name: John 1:36
verses.text: And looking upon Jesus as He walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of God!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:37
verses.text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

verses.name: John 1:38
verses.text: Then Jesus turned and saw them following and said to them, What do you seek? They said to Him, Rabbi (which is called, being translated Teacher), where do you live?

verses.name: John 1:39
verses.text: He says to them, Come and see. They came and saw where He lived, and stayed with Him that day, for it was about the tenth hour.

verses.name: John 1:40
verses.text: One of the two who heard John and followed Him was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

verses.name: John 1:41
verses.text: He first found <hi>his</hi> own brother Simon and said to him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being translated, the Christ).

verses.name: John 1:42
verses.text: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, He said, You are Simon the son of Jonah; you shall be called Cephas (which translated is, A stone).  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:43
verses.text: The day after, Jesus desired to go forth into Galilee. And He found Philip and said to him, Follow Me.

verses.name: John 1:44
verses.text: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.name: John 1:45
verses.text: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, We have found Him of whom Moses wrote in the law and the prophets, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

verses.name: John 1:46
verses.text: And Nathanael said to him, Can there be any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

verses.name: John 1:47
verses.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to Him and said of him, Behold an Israelite indeed in whom is no guile!

verses.name: John 1:48
verses.text: Nathanael said to Him, From where do You know me? Jesus answered and said to him, Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.

verses.name: John 1:49
verses.text: Nathanael answered and said to Him, Rabbi, You are the Son of God. You are the King of Israel!

verses.name: John 1:50
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, Because I said to you, I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? You shall see greater <hi>things</hi> than these.

verses.name: John 1:51
verses.text: And He said to him, Truly, truly, I say to you, Hereafter you shall see Heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:1
verses.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. And the mother of Jesus was there.

verses.name: John 2:2
verses.text: And Jesus and His disciples were both invited to the marriage.

verses.name: John 2:3
verses.text: And when they lacked wine, the mother of Jesus said to Him, They have no wine.

verses.name: John 2:4
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Woman, what do I have to do with you? My hour has not yet come.

verses.name: John 2:5
verses.text: His mother said to the servants, Whatever He says to you, do <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: John 2:6
verses.text: And there were six stone waterpots there, according to the purification of the Jews, each containing two or three measures.

verses.name: John 2:7
verses.text: Jesus said to them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to <hi>the</hi> brim.

verses.name: John 2:8
verses.text: And He said to them, Now draw out and carry it to the master of the feast. And they carried <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: John 2:9
verses.text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water which was made wine (and did not know where it was from, but the servants who drew the water knew), the master of the feast called the bridegroom.

verses.name: John 2:10
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> said to him, Every man at the beginning sets forth good wine, and when men have drunk well, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now.

verses.name: John 2:11
verses.text: This beginning of miracles Jesus did in Cana of Galilee. And <hi>it</hi> revealed His glory. And His disciples believed on Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:12
verses.text: After this He went down to Capernaum, He and His mother and His brothers and His disciples. And they did not stay there many days.

verses.name: John 2:13
verses.text: And the Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 2:14
verses.text: And He found in the temple those who sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the money-changers sitting.

verses.name: John 2:15
verses.text: And when He had made a scourge of small cords, He drove them all out of the temple, also the sheep and the oxen. And He poured out the money-changers' money and overthrew the tables.

verses.name: John 2:16
verses.text: And He said to those who sold doves, Take these things away from here. Do not make My Father's house a house of merchandise.

verses.name: John 2:17
verses.text: And His disciples remembered that it was written, "The zeal of Your house has eaten Me up."

verses.name: John 2:18
verses.text: Then the Jews answered and said to Him, What sign do you show us, since you do these things?

verses.name: John 2:19
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, Destroy this temple and in three days I will raise it up.

verses.name: John 2:20
verses.text: Then the Jews said, This temple was forty-six years building, and will you rear it up in three days?

verses.name: John 2:21
verses.text: But He spoke of the temple of His body.

verses.name: John 2:22
verses.text: Therefore when He had risen from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this to them, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:23
verses.text: And as He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, at the feast, many believed in His name when they saw the miracles which He did.

verses.name: John 2:24
verses.text: But Jesus did not commit Himself to them, because He knew all men

verses.name: John 2:25
verses.text: and did not need that anyone should testify of man. For He knew what was in man.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:1
verses.text: And there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

verses.name: John 3:2
verses.text: He came to Jesus by night and said to Him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God; for no <hi>man</hi> can do these miracles which you do unless God is with him.

verses.name: John 3:3
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless a man is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

verses.name: John 3:4
verses.text: Nicodemus said to Him, How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter the second <hi>time</hi> into his mother's womb and be born?

verses.name: John 3:5
verses.text: Jesus answered, Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless a man is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.name: John 3:6
verses.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.name: John 3:7
verses.text: Do not marvel that I said to you, You must be born again.

verses.name: John 3:8
verses.text: The Spirit breathes where He desires, and you hear His voice, but you do not know from where He comes, and where He goes; so is everyone who is born of the Spirit.

verses.name: John 3:9
verses.text: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, How can these things be?

verses.name: John 3:10
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, Are you the teacher of Israel and do not know these things?

verses.name: John 3:11
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, We speak what we know and testify what we have seen. And you do not receive our witness.

verses.name: John 3:12
verses.text: If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how shall you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

verses.name: John 3:13
verses.text: And no one has ascended up to Heaven except He who came down from Heaven, the Son of man who is in Heaven.

verses.name: John 3:14
verses.text: But even as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up,

verses.name: John 3:15
verses.text: so that whosoever believes in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.name: John 3:16
verses.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His only-begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

verses.name: John 3:17
verses.text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.

verses.name: John 3:18
verses.text: He who believes on Him is not condemned, but he who does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only-begotten Son of God.

verses.name: John 3:19
verses.text: And this is the condemnation, that the Light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than the Light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.name: John 3:20
verses.text: For everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come to the Light, lest his deeds should be exposed.

verses.name: John 3:21
verses.text: But he who practices truth comes to the Light so that his deeds may be made known, that they have been worked in God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:22
verses.text: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea. And <hi>He</hi> stayed there with them and baptized.

verses.name: John 3:23
verses.text: And John was also baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. And they came and were baptized.

verses.name: John 3:24
verses.text: For John had not yet been cast into prison.

verses.name: John 3:25
verses.text: Then a question from John's disciples arose with the Jews about purifying.

verses.name: John 3:26
verses.text: And they came to John and said to him, Rabbi, He who was with you beyond Jordan, to whom you bore witness, behold, He baptizes, and all come to Him!

verses.name: John 3:27
verses.text: And John answered and said, A man can receive nothing unless it is given to him from Heaven.

verses.name: John 3:28
verses.text: You yourselves bear witness to me that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before Him.

verses.name: John 3:29
verses.text: He who has the bride is <hi>the</hi> bridegroom, but the friend of the bridegroom who stands and hears him rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. Then my joy is fulfilled.

verses.name: John 3:30
verses.text: He must increase, but I <hi>must</hi> decrease.

verses.name: John 3:31
verses.text: He who comes from above is above all; he who is from the earth is earthly and speaks from the earth. He who comes from Heaven is above all,

verses.name: John 3:32
verses.text: and what He has seen and heard, that He testifies, and no one receives His testimony.

verses.name: John 3:33
verses.text: He who has received His testimony has set his seal to this, that God is true.

verses.name: John 3:34
verses.text: For He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure.

verses.name: John 3:35
verses.text: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hand.

verses.name: John 3:36
verses.text: He who believes on the Son has everlasting life, and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides upon him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:1
verses.text: Therefore when the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John

verses.name: John 4:2
verses.text: (though Jesus Himself did not baptize, but His disciples),

verses.name: John 4:3
verses.text: He left Judea and went away again into Galilee.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:4
verses.text: And it was necessary for Him to go through Samaria,

verses.name: John 4:5
verses.text: Then He came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.name: John 4:6
verses.text: And Jacob's well was there. Jesus, therefore, being wearied with <hi>His</hi> journey, sat thus upon the well. <hi>It</hi> was about <hi>the</hi> sixth hour.

verses.name: John 4:7
verses.text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, Give me to drink.

verses.name: John 4:8
verses.text: (For His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.)

verses.name: John 4:9
verses.text: Then the woman of Samaria said to Him, How do you, being a Jew, ask a drink of me, who am a woman of Samaria? For the Jews do not associate with Samaritans.

verses.name: John 4:10
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to her, If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that says to you, Give Me to drink, you would have asked of Him, and He would have given you living water.

verses.name: John 4:11
