verses.text: The woman said to Him, Sir, you have no vessel, and the well is deep. From where then do you have that living water?

verses.name: John 4:12
verses.text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, and his children and his cattle?

verses.name: John 4:13
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to her, Whoever drinks of this water shall thirst again,

verses.name: John 4:14
verses.text: but whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst, but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.name: John 4:15
verses.text: The woman said to Him, Sir, give me this water, so that I may not thirst nor come here to draw.

verses.name: John 4:16
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Go, call your husband and come here.

verses.name: John 4:17
verses.text: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You have well said, I have no husband

verses.name: John 4:18
verses.text: for you have had five husbands, and <hi>he</hi> whom you now have is not your husband. In that you spoke truly.

verses.name: John 4:19
verses.text: The woman said to Him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

verses.name: John 4:20
verses.text: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

verses.name: John 4:21
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when you shall neither worship the Father in this mountain nor yet at Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 4:22
verses.text: You worship what you do not know, we know what we worship, for salvation is of the Jews.

verses.name: John 4:23
verses.text: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to worship Him.

verses.name: John 4:24
verses.text: God <hi>is</hi> a spirit, and they who worship Him must worship in spirit and in truth.

verses.name: John 4:25
verses.text: The woman said to Him, I know that Messiah is coming, who is called Christ. When He has come, He will tell us all things.

verses.name: John 4:26
verses.text: Jesus said to her, I AM, He speaking to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:27
verses.text: And upon this His disciples came and marveled that He talked with the woman. However, no one said, What do You seek, or why do You talk with her?

verses.name: John 4:28
verses.text: The woman then left her waterpot and went into the city and said to the men,

verses.name: John 4:29
verses.text: Come see a man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?

verses.name: John 4:30
verses.text: And they went out of the city and came to Him.

verses.name: John 4:31
verses.text: In the meantime His disciples were asking Him, saying, Master, eat.

verses.name: John 4:32
verses.text: But He said to them, I have food to eat which you do not know.

verses.name: John 4:33
verses.text: Therefore the disciples said to one another, No one brought Him <hi>anything</hi> to eat?

verses.name: John 4:34
verses.text: Jesus said to them, My food is to do the will of <hi>Him</hi> who sent Me and to finish His work.

verses.name: John 4:35
verses.text: Do you not say, There are still four months and then the harvest comes? Behold, I say to you, Lift up your eyes and look on the fields, for they are white to harvest already.

verses.name: John 4:36
verses.text: And he who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to life eternal, so that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

verses.name: John 4:37
verses.text: And in this is the saying true, One sows and another reaps.

verses.name: John 4:38
verses.text: I sent you to reap that on which you bestowed no labor. Other men labored, and you have entered into their labor.

verses.name: John 4:39
verses.text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed upon Him because of the saying of the woman, who testified, He told me all that I ever did.

verses.name: John 4:40
verses.text: Then as the Samaritans had come to Him, they begged Him that He would stay with them. And He stayed there two days.

verses.name: John 4:41
verses.text: And many more believed because of His own word.

verses.name: John 4:42
verses.text: And they said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying, for we have heard <hi>Him</hi> ourselves and know that this is truly the Christ, the Savior of the world.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:43
verses.text: And after two days He departed from there and went into Galilee.

verses.name: John 4:44
verses.text: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in <hi>his</hi> own native-place.

verses.name: John 4:45
verses.text: Then when He had come into Galilee, the Galileans received Him, having seen all the things that He did at Jerusalem at the feast; for they also went to the feast.

verses.name: John 4:46
verses.text: Then Jesus came again to Cana of Galilee, where He made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

verses.name: John 4:47
verses.text: When He heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and begged Him that He would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

verses.name: John 4:48
verses.text: Then Jesus said to him, Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe.

verses.name: John 4:49
verses.text: The nobleman said to Him, Sir, come down before my child dies.

verses.name: John 4:50
verses.text: Jesus said to him, Go, your son lives. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken to him, and he went away.

verses.name: John 4:51
verses.text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him and told <hi>him</hi>, saying, Your son lives.

verses.name: John 4:52
verses.text: Then he asked of them the hour when he began to get better. And they said to him, Yesterday <hi>at the</hi> seventh hour the fever left him.

verses.name: John 4:53
verses.text: So the father knew that <hi>it was</hi> at the same hour in which Jesus said to him, Your son lives. And he himself believed, and his whole house.

verses.name: John 4:54
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> the second miracle Jesus did, when He had come out of Judea into Galilee.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:1
verses.text: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 5:2
verses.text: Now there is a pool at the Sheep Gate at Jerusalem, which <hi>is</hi> called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches.

verses.name: John 5:3
verses.text: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, of blind, lame, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

verses.name: John 5:4
verses.text: For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and troubled the water. Then whoever first stepped in after the troubling of the water was made whole of whatever disease he had.

verses.name: John 5:5
verses.text: And a certain man was there, who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.

verses.name: John 5:6
verses.text: When Jesus saw him lying, and knowing that he had spent much time, He said to him, Do you desire to be made whole?

verses.name: John 5:7
verses.text: The infirm man answered Him, Sir, when the water is troubled, I have no one to put me into the pool. But while I am coming, another steps down before me.

verses.name: John 5:8
verses.text: Jesus says to him, Rise, take up your bed and walk.

verses.name: John 5:9
verses.text: And immediately the man was made whole and took up his bed and walked. And it was a sabbath on that day.

verses.name: John 5:10
verses.text: Therefore the Jews said to him who had been healed, It is the sabbath. It is not lawful for you to take up the bed.

verses.name: John 5:11
verses.text: He answered them, He who made me whole said to me, Take up your bed and walk.

verses.name: John 5:12
verses.text: Then they asked him, Who is the man who said to you, Take up your bed and walk?

verses.name: John 5:13
verses.text: And he did not know Him who had cured him, for Jesus had moved away, a crowd being in the place.

verses.name: John 5:14
verses.text: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, Behold, you are made whole. Sin no more lest a worse thing come to you.

verses.name: John 5:15
verses.text: The man departed and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.

verses.name: John 5:16
verses.text: And therefore the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the sabbath day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:17
verses.text: But Jesus answered them, My Father works until now, and I work.

verses.name: John 5:18
verses.text: Then, because of this, the Jews sought the more to kill Him, because He not only had broken the sabbath, but also said that God was His father, making Himself equal with God.

verses.name: John 5:19
verses.text: Then Jesus answered and said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself but what He sees the Father do. For whatever things He does, these also the Son does likewise.

verses.name: John 5:20
verses.text: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him all the things that He Himself does. And He will show Him greater works than these, so that you may marvel.

verses.name: John 5:21
verses.text: For as the Father raises the dead and makes alive, even so the Son of man makes alive whomever He will.

verses.name: John 5:22
verses.text: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment to the Son,

verses.name: John 5:23
verses.text: so that all should honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.

verses.name: John 5:24
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes on Him who sent Me has everlasting life and shall not come into condemnation, but has passed from death to life.

verses.name: John 5:25
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, the hour is coming and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and they who hear shall live.

verses.name: John 5:26
verses.text: For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has given to the Son to have life within Himself,

verses.name: John 5:27
verses.text: and has given Him authority to execute judgment also, because He is <hi>the</hi> Son of man.

verses.name: John 5:28
verses.text: Do not marvel at this, for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves shall hear His voice,

verses.name: John 5:29
verses.text: and shall come forth, those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have practiced evil to the resurrection of condemnation.

verses.name: John 5:30
verses.text: I can do nothing of My own self. As I hear, I judge, and My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of <hi>the</hi> Father who has sent Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:31
verses.text: If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.

verses.name: John 5:32
verses.text: There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which He witnesses of Me is true.

verses.name: John 5:33
verses.text: You sent to John, and he bore witness to the truth.

verses.name: John 5:34
verses.text: But I do not receive testimony from man, but these things I say so that you might be saved.

verses.name: John 5:35
verses.text: He was a burning and shining light, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.

verses.name: John 5:36
verses.text: But I have greater witness than that of John, for the works which the Father has given Me that I should finish them, the works which I do themselves witness of Me, that the Father has sent Me.

verses.name: John 5:37
verses.text: And He sending Me, the Father Himself, has borne witness of Me. Neither have you heard His voice at any time nor seen His shape.

verses.name: John 5:38
verses.text: And you do not have His word abiding in you, for you do not believe Him whom He has sent.

verses.name: John 5:39
verses.text: You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life. And they are the ones witnessing of Me,

verses.name: John 5:40
verses.text: and you will not come to Me that you might have life.

verses.name: John 5:41
verses.text: I do not receive honor from men.

verses.name: John 5:42
verses.text: But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in you.

verses.name: John 5:43
verses.text: I have come in My Father's name, and you do not receive Me. If another shall come in <hi>his</hi> own name, him you will receive.

verses.name: John 5:44
verses.text: How can you believe, <hi>you who</hi> receive honor from one another and do not seek the honor that <hi>comes</hi> from God only?

verses.name: John 5:45
verses.text: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father; there is <hi>one</hi> who accuses you, Moses, in whom you trust.

verses.name: John 5:46
verses.text: For if you had believed Moses, you would have believed Me, for he wrote of Me.

verses.name: John 5:47
verses.text: But if you do not believe his writings, how shall you believe My words?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:1
verses.text: After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, <hi>the Sea</hi> of Tiberias.

verses.name: John 6:2
verses.text: And a great multitude followed Him, because they saw His miracles which He did on the sick ones.

verses.name: John 6:3
verses.text: And Jesus went up into a mountain and sat there with His disciples.

verses.name: John 6:4
verses.text: And the Passover was near, a feast of the Jews.

verses.name: John 6:5
verses.text: Then Jesus lifted up <hi>His</hi> eyes and saw a great crowd come to Him. He said to Philip, Where shall we buy loaves so that these may eat?

verses.name: John 6:6
verses.text: And He said this to test him, for He Himself knew what He would do.

verses.name: John 6:7
verses.text: Philip answered Him, Loaves for two hundred denarii are not enough for them, that every one may take a little.

verses.name: John 6:8
verses.text: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to Him,

verses.name: John 6:9
verses.text: There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are these among so many?

verses.name: John 6:10
verses.text: And Jesus said, Make the men recline. And there was much grass in the place. So the men reclined, about five thousand in number.

verses.name: John 6:11
verses.text: And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks, He distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who had reclined; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted.

verses.name: John 6:12
verses.text: And when they were filled, He said to His disciples, Gather up the fragments left over, so that nothing is lost.

verses.name: John 6:13
verses.text: Therefore they gathered and filled twelve handbaskets with fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over to those who had eaten.

verses.name: John 6:14
verses.text: Then seeing the miracle that Jesus did, those men said, This is truly the Prophet, the <hi>One</hi> coming into the world.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:15
verses.text: Therefore when Jesus perceived that they would come and take Him by force, that they might make Him a king, Jesus withdrew again to the mountain alone <hi>by</hi> Himself.

verses.name: John 6:16
verses.text: And when evening had come, the disciples went down to the sea

verses.name: John 6:17
verses.text: and entered into a boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

verses.name: John 6:18
verses.text: And the sea rose up because of a great wind that blew.

verses.name: John 6:19
verses.text: Then having rowed about twenty-five or thirty furlongs, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near the ship. And they were afraid.

verses.name: John 6:20
verses.text: But He said to them, I AM! Do not be afraid.

verses.name: John 6:21
verses.text: Then they willingly received Him into the boat. And immediately the ship was at the land where they were going.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:22
verses.text: The following day, the crowd standing on the other side of the sea had seen that there was no other little boat there except that one into which His disciples had entered, and when they saw that Jesus did not go with His disciples into the little boat, but <hi>that</hi> His disciples had gone away alone,

verses.name: John 6:23
verses.text: (however, other boats from Tiberias came near the place where they ate the loaves, the Lord having given thanks),

verses.name: John 6:24
verses.text: therefore, when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they themselves also entered into the boats and came to Capernaum seeking Jesus.

verses.name: John 6:25
verses.text: And when they had found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, Rabbi, when did you come here?

verses.name: John 6:26
verses.text: Jesus answered them and said, Truly, truly, I say to you, You seek Me not because you saw the miracles, but because you ate the loaves and were filled.

verses.name: John 6:27
verses.text: Do not labor <hi>for</hi> the food that perishes, but for that food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of man will give you. For God the Father sealed Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:28
verses.text: Then they said to Him, What shall we do that we might work the works of God?

verses.name: John 6:29
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, This is the work of God, that you believe on <hi>Him</hi> whom He has sent.

verses.name: John 6:30
verses.text: Therefore they said to Him, What sign do you show then, so that we may see and believe you? What do you work?

verses.name: John 6:31
verses.text: Our fathers ate the manna in the desert, as it is written, "He gave them bread from Heaven to eat."

verses.name: John 6:32
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Moses did not give you that bread from Heaven, but My Father gives you the true bread from Heaven.

verses.name: John 6:33
verses.text: For the bread of God is He who comes down from Heaven and gives life to the world.

verses.name: John 6:34
verses.text: Then they said to him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

verses.name: John 6:35
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes on Me shall never thirst.

verses.name: John 6:36
verses.text: But I said to you that you also have seen Me and do not believe.

verses.name: John 6:37
verses.text: All that the Father gives Me shall come to Me, and the <hi>one</hi> who comes to Me I will in no way cast out.

verses.name: John 6:38
verses.text: For I came down from Heaven, not to do My own will but the will of Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 6:39
verses.text: And this is the will of the Father who sent Me, that of all which He has given Me I should lose nothing but should raise it up again at the last day.

verses.name: John 6:40
verses.text: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes on Him should have everlasting life. And I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.name: John 6:41
verses.text: Then the Jews murmured about Him, because He said, I am the bread which came down from Heaven.

verses.name: John 6:42
verses.text: And they said, Is this not Jesus the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How now does this One say, I have come down from Heaven?

verses.name: John 6:43
verses.text: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, Do not murmur with one another.

verses.name: John 6:44
verses.text: No one can come to Me unless the Father who has sent Me draw him, and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.name: John 6:45
verses.text: It is written in the prophets, "And they shall all be taught of God." Therefore everyone who hears and learns from the Father comes to Me.

verses.name: John 6:46
verses.text: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except He who is from God, He has seen the Father.

verses.name: John 6:47
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who believes on Me has everlasting life.

verses.name: John 6:48
verses.text: I am the Bread of life.

verses.name: John 6:49
verses.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and died.

verses.name: John 6:50
verses.text: This is the Bread which comes down from Heaven, so that a man may eat of it and not die.

verses.name: John 6:51
verses.text: I am the Living Bread which came down from Heaven. If anyone eats of this Bread, he shall live forever. And truly the bread that I will give is My flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.name: John 6:52
verses.text: Then the Jews argued with one another, saying, How can this man give us <hi>his</hi> flesh to eat?

verses.name: John 6:53
verses.text: Then Jesus says to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink His blood, you do not have life in yourselves.

verses.name: John 6:54
verses.text: Whoever partakes of My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.name: John 6:55
verses.text: For My flesh is food indeed, and My blood is drink indeed.

verses.name: John 6:56
verses.text: He who partakes of My flesh and drinks My blood dwells in Me, and I in him.

verses.name: John 6:57
verses.text: As the living Father has sent Me, and I live through the Father, so he who partakes of Me, even he shall live by Me.

verses.name: John 6:58
verses.text: This is the Bread which came down from Heaven, not as your fathers ate the manna, and died; he who partakes of this Bread shall live forever.

verses.name: John 6:59
verses.text: He said these things in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:60
verses.text: Then when they had heard, many of His disciples said, This is a hard saying, who can hear it?

verses.name: John 6:61
verses.text: But knowing in Himself that His disciples murmured about it, Jesus said to them, Does this offend you?

verses.name: John 6:62
verses.text: Then <hi>what</hi> if you should see the Son of man going up where He was before?

verses.name: John 6:63
verses.text: It is the Spirit that makes alive, the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit and are life.

verses.name: John 6:64
verses.text: But there are some of you who do not believe. For Jesus knew from <hi>the</hi> beginning who they were who did not believe, and who was to betray Him.

verses.name: John 6:65
verses.text: And He said, Because of this I said to you that no one can come to Me unless it was given to him from My Father.

verses.name: John 6:66
verses.text: From this <hi>time</hi> many of His disciples went back into the things behind, and walked no more with Him.

verses.name: John 6:67
verses.text: Then Jesus said to the Twelve, Do you also wish to go away?

verses.name: John 6:68
verses.text: Then Simon Peter answered Him, Lord, to whom shall we go? You have <hi>the</hi> words of eternal life.

verses.name: John 6:69
verses.text: And we have believed and have known that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.name: John 6:70
verses.text: Jesus answered them, Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? And one <hi>of</hi> you is a devil?

verses.name: John 6:71
verses.text: But he spoke <hi>of</hi> Judas Iscariot, <hi>the son</hi> of Simon; for it was he who was about to betray Him, being one of the Twelve.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:1
verses.text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee, for He did not desire to walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill Him.

verses.name: John 7:2
verses.text: And the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.

verses.name: John 7:3
verses.text: Therefore His brothers said to Him, Move away from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples also may see the works that You do.

verses.name: John 7:4
verses.text: For no one does anything in secret, while he himself seeks to be in public. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.

verses.name: John 7:5
verses.text: For His brothers did not believe in Him.

verses.name: John 7:6
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

verses.name: John 7:7
verses.text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify of it, that its works are evil.

verses.name: John 7:8
verses.text: You go up to this feast; I am not yet going up to this feast; for My time is not yet fulfilled.

verses.name: John 7:9
verses.text: And saying He these things to them, He remained in Galilee.

verses.name: John 7:10
verses.text: But when His brothers had gone up, then He also went up to the feast, not openly, but as in secret.

verses.name: John 7:11
verses.text: Then the Jews sought Him at the feast and said, Where is He?

verses.name: John 7:12
verses.text: And there was much murmuring among the crowd concerning Him, for some said, He is a good man; others said, No, but he deceives the crowd.

verses.name: John 7:13
verses.text: However, no one spoke openly of Him, because of the fear of the Jews.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:14
verses.text: Now about the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

verses.name: John 7:15
verses.text: And the Jews marveled, saying, How does this man know letters, not being taught?

verses.name: John 7:16
verses.text: Jesus answered them and said, My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me.

verses.name: John 7:17
verses.text: If anyone desires to do His will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it is of God, or I speak from Myself.

verses.name: John 7:18
verses.text: He who speaks of himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of Him who sent Him is true, and no unrighteousness is in Him.

verses.name: John 7:19
verses.text: Did not Moses give you the law? And <hi>yet</hi> not one of you keeps the law! Why do you seek to kill Me?

verses.name: John 7:20
verses.text: The crowd answered and said, You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?

verses.name: John 7:21
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, I have done one work, and you all marvel.

verses.name: John 7:22
verses.text: Because of this Moses gave you circumcision (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers,) and you circumcise a man on the sabbath day.

verses.name: John 7:23
verses.text: If a man receives circumcision on the sabbath day so that the law of Moses should not be broken, are you angry at Me because I have made a man entirely sound on the sabbath day?

verses.name: John 7:24
verses.text: Do not judge according to sight, but judge righteous judgment.

verses.name: John 7:25
verses.text: Then some of those from Jerusalem said, Is this not the one they seek to kill?

verses.name: John 7:26
verses.text: But lo, he speaks publicly, and they say nothing to him. Perhaps the rulers truly know that this is the Christ indeed?

verses.name: John 7:27
verses.text: However, we know this one, from where he is; but when Christ comes, no one knows from where He is.

verses.name: John 7:28
verses.text: Then Jesus cried in the temple as He taught, saying, You both know Me, and you know from where I come. And I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.

verses.name: John 7:29
verses.text: But I know Him, for I am from Him, and He has sent Me.

verses.name: John 7:30
verses.text: Then they sought to seize Him, but no one laid <hi>a</hi> hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.

verses.name: John 7:31
verses.text: And many of the crowd believed on Him, and said, When the Christ comes, will He do more miracles than these which this One has done?

verses.name: John 7:32
verses.text: The Pharisees heard that the crowd murmured such things concerning Him. And the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to seize Him.

verses.name: John 7:33
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, Yet a little while I am with you, and <hi>then</hi> I go to Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 7:34
verses.text: You shall seek Me and shall not find <hi>Me</hi>. And where I am, you cannot come.

verses.name: John 7:35
verses.text: Then the Jews said among themselves, Where is he about to go that we shall not find him? Is he about to go to the Dispersion of the Greeks, and to teach the Greeks?

verses.name: John 7:36
verses.text: What saying is this that He said, You shall seek Me and shall not find <hi>Me</hi>, and where I am, you cannot come?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:37
verses.text: And in the last day of the great feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, If anyone thirsts, let him come to Me and drink.

verses.name: John 7:38
verses.text: He who believes on Me, as the Scripture has said, "Out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water."

verses.name: John 7:39
verses.text: (But He spoke this about the Spirit, which they who believed on Him should receive; for <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit was not yet <hi>given</hi>, because Jesus was not yet glorified.)

verses.name: John 7:40
verses.text: Then when they heard the Word, many of the people said, Truly this is the Prophet.

verses.name: John 7:41
verses.text: Others said, This is the Christ. But others said, Does the Christ come out of Galilee?

verses.name: John 7:42
verses.text: Has the Scripture not said that Christ comes from the seed of David and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

verses.name: John 7:43
verses.text: So a division occurred in the crowd because of Him.

verses.name: John 7:44
verses.text: And some of them desired to seize Him, but no one laid hands on Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:45
verses.text: Then the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees. And they said to them, Why have you not brought him?

verses.name: John 7:46
verses.text: The officers answered, Never did any man speak as does this Man.

verses.name: John 7:47
verses.text: Then the Pharisees answered them, Are you not also deceived?

verses.name: John 7:48
verses.text: Not any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

verses.name: John 7:49
verses.text: But this crowd, not knowing the law, is cursed.

verses.name: John 7:50
verses.text: Nicodemus said to them, (he who came to Jesus <hi>by</hi> night, being one of them),

verses.name: John 7:51
verses.text: Does our law judge the Man before it hears Him and knows what He does?

verses.name: John 7:52
verses.text: They answered and said to him, Are you also from Galilee? Search the scriptures and see that a prophet has not been raised out of Galilee.

verses.name: John 7:53
verses.text: And they each went to his own house.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:1
verses.text: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

verses.name: John 8:2
verses.text: And early in the morning He came again into the temple, and all the people came to Him. And He sat down and taught them.

verses.name: John 8:3
verses.text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought to Him a woman taken in adultery. And standing her in the midst,

verses.name: John 8:4
verses.text: they said to Him, Teacher, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

verses.name: John 8:5
verses.text: Now Moses in the law commanded us that such should be stoned. You, then, what do you say?

verses.name: John 8:6
verses.text: They said this, tempting Him so that they might have <hi>reason</hi> to accuse Him. But bending down, Jesus wrote on the ground with <hi>His</hi> finger, not appearing <hi>to hear</hi>.

verses.name: John 8:7
verses.text: But as they continued to ask Him, He lifted Himself up and said to them, He who is without sin among you, let him cast the first stone at her.

verses.name: John 8:8
verses.text: And again bending down, He wrote on the ground.

verses.name: John 8:9
verses.text: And hearing, and being convicted by conscience, they went out one by one, beginning at the oldest, until the last. And Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

verses.name: John 8:10
verses.text: And bending back up, and seeing no one but the woman, Jesus said to her, Woman, where are the ones who accused you? Did not one give judgment against you?

verses.name: John 8:11
verses.text: And she said, No one, Lord. And Jesus said to her, Neither do I give judgment. Go, and sin no more.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:12
verses.text: Then Jesus spoke again to them, saying, I am the Light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.name: John 8:13
verses.text: Therefore the Pharisees said to Him, You bear record concerning yourself, your witness is not true.

verses.name: John 8:14
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, Though I bear record concerning Myself, My witness is true. For I know from where I came, and where I go. But you do not know from where I came, and where I go.

verses.name: John 8:15
verses.text: You judge after the flesh, I judge no one.

verses.name: John 8:16
verses.text: And yet if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I and <hi>the</hi> Father who sent Me.

verses.name: John 8:17
verses.text: It is also written in your law that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.name: John 8:18
verses.text: I am one who bears witness of Myself, and the Father who sent Me bears witness concerning Me.

verses.name: John 8:19
verses.text: Then they said to Him, Where is your father? Jesus said to them, You neither know Me nor My Father. If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also.

verses.name: John 8:20
verses.text: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as He taught in the temple. And no man laid hands upon Him, for His hour had not yet come.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:21
verses.text: Then Jesus said again to them, I go away, and you shall seek Me and shall die in your sins. Where I go, you cannot come.

verses.name: John 8:22
verses.text: Then the Jews said, Will he kill himself? Because he says, Where I go you cannot come.

verses.name: John 8:23
verses.text: And He said to them, You are from beneath; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.name: John 8:24
verses.text: Therefore I said to you that you shall die in your sins, for if you do not believe that I AM, you shall die in your sins.

verses.name: John 8:25
verses.text: Then they said to Him, Who are you? And Jesus said to them, Even <hi>the same</hi> which I also say to you.

verses.name: John 8:26
verses.text: I have many things to say and to judge of you, but He who sent Me is true, and I speak to the world those things what I heard of Him.

verses.name: John 8:27
verses.text: They did not understand that He spoke to them <hi>of</hi> the Father.

verses.name: John 8:28
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, When you have lifted up the Son of man, then you shall know that I AM, and that I do nothing of Myself, but as My Father has taught Me, I speak these things.

verses.name: John 8:29
verses.text: And He who sent Me is with Me. The Father has not left Me alone, for I always do those things which please Him.

verses.name: John 8:30
verses.text: <hi> As</hi> He spoke these words, many believed upon Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:31
verses.text: Then Jesus said to the Jews who believed on Him, If you continue in My word, you are My disciples indeed.

verses.name: John 8:32
verses.text: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

verses.name: John 8:33
verses.text: They answered Him, We are Abraham's seed and were never in bondage to anyone. How do you say, You will be made free?

verses.name: John 8:34
verses.text: Jesus answered them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Whoever practices sin is the slave of sin.

verses.name: John 8:35
verses.text: And the slave does not abide in the house forever, <hi>but</hi> the Son abides forever.

verses.name: John 8:36
verses.text: Therefore if the Son shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.

verses.name: John 8:37
verses.text: I know that you are Abraham's seed, but you seek to kill Me because My Word has no place in you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:38
verses.text: I speak what I have seen with My Father, and you, then, do what you have seen with your father.

verses.name: John 8:39
verses.text: They answered and said to Him, Abraham is our father. Jesus answered them, If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.

verses.name: John 8:40
verses.text: But now you seek to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth which I have heard beside God; this Abraham did not do.

verses.name: John 8:41
verses.text: You do the deeds of your father. Then they said to Him, We are not born of fornication; we have one father, <hi>even</hi> God.

verses.name: John 8:42
verses.text: Jesus said to them, If God were your father, you would love Me, for I went forth and came from God; for I did not come of Myself, but He sent Me.

verses.name: John 8:43
verses.text: Why do you not know My speech? Because you cannot hear My word.

verses.name: John 8:44
verses.text: You are of the Devil as father, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from <hi>the</hi> beginning, and did not abide in the truth because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own, for he is a liar and the father of it.

verses.name: John 8:45
verses.text: And because I tell <hi>you</hi> the truth, you do not believe Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:46
verses.text: Which of you convicts Me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do you not believe Me?

verses.name: John 8:47
verses.text: He who is of God hears God's words. Therefore you do not hear <hi>them</hi> because you are not of God.

verses.name: John 8:48
verses.text: Then the Jews answered and said to Him, Do we not say well that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?

verses.name: John 8:49
verses.text: Jesus answered, I do not have a demon, but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.

verses.name: John 8:50
verses.text: And I do not seek My own glory, but there is One who seeks and judges.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:51
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, If a man keeps My Word, he shall never see death.

verses.name: John 8:52
verses.text: Then the Jews said to Him, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham and the prophets are dead, and you say, If a man keeps my Word, he shall never taste of death.

verses.name: John 8:53
verses.text: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets are dead; whom do you make yourself?

verses.name: John 8:54
verses.text: Jesus answered, If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; it is My Father who glorifies Me, of whom you say that He is your God.

verses.name: John 8:55
verses.text: Yet you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I should say I do not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I know Him and I keep His Word.

verses.name: John 8:56
verses.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and He saw and was glad.

verses.name: John 8:57
verses.text: Then the Jews said to Him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?

verses.name: John 8:58
verses.text: Jesus said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Before Abraham came into being, I AM!

verses.name: John 8:59
verses.text: Then they took up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus hid Himself and went forth out of the temple, going through <hi>the</hi> midst of them, and passed on by.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:1
verses.text: And passing by, He saw a man who was blind from birth.

verses.name: John 9:2
verses.text: And His disciples asked Him, saying, Master, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?

verses.name: John 9:3
verses.text: Jesus answered, Neither has this man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

verses.name: John 9:4
verses.text: I must work the works of Him who sent Me, while it is day. Night comes when no man can work.

verses.name: John 9:5
verses.text: As long as I am in the world, I am <hi>the</hi> Light of the world.

verses.name: John 9:6
verses.text: And when He had spoken these things, He spat on the ground and made clay from the spittle. And He anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay.

verses.name: John 9:7
verses.text: And He said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam (which translated is Sent). Therefore he went and washed and came seeing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:8
verses.text: Then the neighbors and those who had seen him before, that he was blind, said, Is this not he who was sitting and begging?

verses.name: John 9:9
verses.text: Some said, This is he. Others <hi>said</hi>, He is like him. He said, I am he.

verses.name: John 9:10
verses.text: Then they said to him, How were your eyes opened?

verses.name: John 9:11
verses.text: He answered and said, A man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me, Go to the pool of Siloam and wash. And going and washing, I received sight.

verses.name: John 9:12
verses.text: Then they said to him, Where is he? He said, I do not know.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:13
verses.text: They brought him who once was blind to the Pharisees.

verses.name: John 9:14
verses.text: And it was a sabbath when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.

verses.name: John 9:15
verses.text: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said to them, He put clay upon my eyes, and I washed, and I see.

verses.name: John 9:16
verses.text: Therefore some of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he does not keep the sabbath. Others said, How can a man, a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

verses.name: John 9:17
verses.text: They said to the blind man again, What do you say about him, for he has opened your eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

verses.name: John 9:18
verses.text: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him having received sight.

verses.name: John 9:19
verses.text: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?

verses.name: John 9:20
verses.text: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind.

verses.name: John 9:21
verses.text: But by what means he now sees, we do not know. Or who has opened his eyes, we do not know. He is of age, ask him. He will speak for himself.

verses.name: John 9:22
verses.text: His parents spoke these things because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if anyone confessed that He was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

verses.name: John 9:23
verses.text: Therefore his parents said, He is of age, ask him.

verses.name: John 9:24
verses.text: Then a second time they called the man who was blind and said to him, Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.

verses.name: John 9:25
verses.text: He answered and said, Whether He is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I do know, that being blind, now I see.

verses.name: John 9:26
verses.text: Then they said to him again, What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?

verses.name: John 9:27
verses.text: He answered them, I have told you already, and you did not hear. Why do you want to hear <hi>it</hi> again? Do you also desire to be His disciples?

verses.name: John 9:28
verses.text: Then they reviled him and said, You are his disciple, but we are Moses' disciples.

verses.name: John 9:29
verses.text: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know from where this man is.

verses.name: John 9:30
verses.text: The man answered and said to them, Why, this is a marvelous thing, that you do not know from where He is, and He has opened my eyes.

verses.name: John 9:31
verses.text: But we know that God does not hear sinners, but if anyone is God-fearing and does His will, He hears him.

verses.name: John 9:32
verses.text: From everlasting it was not heard that anyone opened the eyes of one who was born blind.

verses.name: John 9:33
verses.text: If this One were not of God, He could do nothing.

verses.name: John 9:34
verses.text: They answered and said to him, You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? And they cast him out.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:35
verses.text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and finding him, He said to him, Do you believe on the Son of God?

verses.name: John 9:36
verses.text: And he answered and said, Who is He, Lord, that I might believe on Him?

verses.name: John 9:37
verses.text: And Jesus said to him, You have both seen Him, and it is He who is speaking with you.

verses.name: John 9:38
verses.text: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshiped Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:39
verses.text: And Jesus said, I have come into this world for judgment, that they who do not see might see, and that they who see might be made blind.

verses.name: John 9:40
verses.text: And <hi>those</hi> of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these words, and said to Him, Are we also blind?

verses.name: John 9:41
verses.text: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would have no sin. But now you say, We see. Therefore your sin remains.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:1
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter into the sheepfold by the door, but going up by another way, that one is a thief and a robber.

verses.name: John 10:2
verses.text: But he who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:3
verses.text: The doorkeeper opens to him, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls <hi>his</hi> own sheep by name and leads them out.

verses.name: John 10:4
verses.text: And when he puts forth his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him. For they know his voice.

verses.name: John 10:5
verses.text: And they will not follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers.

verses.name: John 10:6
verses.text: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they did not understand what it was which He spoke to them.

verses.name: John 10:7
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them again, Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:8
verses.text: All who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.

verses.name: John 10:9
verses.text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by Me, he shall be saved and shall go in and out and find pasture.

verses.name: John 10:10
verses.text: The thief does not come except to steal and to kill and to destroy. I have come so that they might have life, and that they might have <hi>it</hi> more abundantly.

verses.name: John 10:11
verses.text: I am the Good Shepherd. The Good Shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:12
verses.text: But he who is a hireling and not the shepherd, who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and runs away. And the wolf catches them and scatters the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:13
verses.text: The hireling flees, because he is a hireling and does not care for the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:14
verses.text: I am the Good Shepherd, and I know those that <hi>are</hi> Mine, and I am known by those who are Mine.

verses.name: John 10:15
verses.text: Even as the Father knows Me, I also know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.

verses.name: John 10:16
verses.text: And I have other sheep who are not of this fold. I must also lead those, and they shall hear My voice, and there shall be one flock, one Shepherd.

verses.name: John 10:17
verses.text: Therefore My Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I might take it again.

verses.name: John 10:18
verses.text: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down from Myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. I have received this commandment from My Father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:19
verses.text: Then a division occurred again among the Jews because of these words.

verses.name: John 10:20
verses.text: And many of them said, He has a demon and is insane. Why do you hear him?

verses.name: John 10:21
verses.text: Others said, These are not words of one who has been possessed by a demon. A demon is not able to open <hi>the</hi> eyes of blind ones.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:22
verses.text: And <hi>the Feast</hi> of Dedication took place at Jerusalem, and it was winter.

verses.name: John 10:23
verses.text: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's Porch.

verses.name: John 10:24
verses.text: Then the Jews encircled Him and said to Him, How long do you make us doubt? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.

verses.name: John 10:25
verses.text: Jesus answered them, I told you and you did not believe. The works that I do in My Father's name, they bear witness of Me.

verses.name: John 10:26
verses.text: But you did not believe because you are not of My sheep. As I said to you,

verses.name: John 10:27
verses.text: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

verses.name: John 10:28
verses.text: And I give to them eternal life, and they shall never ever perish, and not anyone shall pluck them out of My hand.

verses.name: John 10:29
verses.text: My Father who gave <hi>them</hi> to me is greater than all, and no one is able to pluck <hi>them</hi> out of My Father's hand.

verses.name: John 10:30
verses.text: I and the Father are one!

verses.name: John 10:31
verses.text: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone Him.

verses.name: John 10:32
verses.text: Jesus answered them, I have shown you many good works from My Father; for which of these do you stone Me?

verses.name: John 10:33
verses.text: The Jews answered Him, saying, We do not stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, and because you, being a man, make yourself God.

verses.name: John 10:34
verses.text: Jesus answered them, Has it not written in your law, "I said, You are gods?"

verses.name: John 10:35
verses.text: If He called those gods with whom the Word of God was, and the Scripture cannot be broken,

verses.name: John 10:36
verses.text: do you say <hi>of Him</hi> whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world, You blaspheme, because I said, I am the Son of God?

verses.name: John 10:37
verses.text: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me.

verses.name: John 10:38
verses.text: But if I do, though you do not believe Me, believe the works so that you may know and believe that the Father <hi>is</hi> in Me, and I in Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:39
verses.text: Then they again sought to seize Him, but He went forth out of their hand.

verses.name: John 10:40
verses.text: And He went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John baptized at the first, and He stayed there.

verses.name: John 10:41
verses.text: And many came to Him and said, John indeed did no miracle, but all things that John said concerning this One were true.

verses.name: John 10:42
verses.text: And many believed on Him there.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:1
verses.text: And there was a certain sick one, Lazarus of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.name: John 11:2
verses.text: (And it was <hi>that</hi> Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

verses.name: John 11:3
verses.text: Then his sisters sent to Him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom You love is sick.

verses.name: John 11:4
verses.text: When Jesus heard, He said, This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, so that the Son of God might be glorified by it.

verses.name: John 11:5
verses.text: And Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

verses.name: John 11:6
verses.text: Therefore, when He had heard that he was sick, then indeed He remained two days in the place where He was.

verses.name: John 11:7
verses.text: Then after that He said to the disciples, Let us go into Judea again.

verses.name: John 11:8
verses.text: The disciples said to Him, Rabbi, the Jews lately have sought to stone You, and do You go there again?

verses.name: John 11:9
verses.text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble because he sees the light of the world.

verses.name: John 11:10
verses.text: But if anyone walks in the night, he stumbles because there is no light in him.

verses.name: John 11:11
verses.text: He said these things; and after that He said to them, Our friend Lazarus sleeps. But I go so that I may awaken him out of sleep.

verses.name: John 11:12
verses.text: Then His disciples said, Lord, if he sleeps, he will get well.

verses.name: John 11:13
verses.text: But Jesus spoke of his death, but they thought that He had spoken of taking rest in sleep.

verses.name: John 11:14
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

verses.name: John 11:15
verses.text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, in order that you may believe. But let us go to him.

verses.name: John 11:16
verses.text: Then Thomas (he being called Twin) said to his fellow disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:17
verses.text: Then when Jesus came, He found him already being held in the tomb four days.

verses.name: John 11:18
verses.text: And Bethany was near Jerusalem, fifteen stadia away.

verses.name: John 11:19
verses.text: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary in order to comfort them concerning their brother.

verses.name: John 11:20
verses.text: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she met Him. But Mary was sitting in the house.

verses.name: John 11:21
verses.text: Then Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.

verses.name: John 11:22
verses.text: But I know that even now, whatever You will ask of God, God will give You.

verses.name: John 11:23
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Your brother shall rise again.

verses.name: John 11:24
verses.text: Martha said to Him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

verses.name: John 11:25
verses.text: Jesus said to her, I am the Resurrection and the Life! He who believes in Me, though he die, yet he shall live.

verses.name: John 11:26
verses.text: And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do you believe this?

verses.name: John 11:27
verses.text: She said to Him, Yes, Lord, I have believed that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who has come into the world.

verses.name: John 11:28
verses.text: And saying these things, she went away and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Teacher has come and calls you.

verses.name: John 11:29
verses.text: As soon as she heard, she arose quickly and came to him.

verses.name: John 11:30
verses.text: Now Jesus had not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met Him.

verses.name: John 11:31
verses.text: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw that Mary rose up hastily and went out, <hi>they</hi> followed her, saying, She is going to the tomb to weep there.

verses.name: John 11:32
verses.text: Then when Mary had come where Jesus was, seeing Him, Mary fell down at His feet, saying to Him, Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:33
verses.text: Then when He saw her weeping, and also the Jews who came with her weeping, Jesus groaned in the spirit and troubled Himself.

verses.name: John 11:34
verses.text: And <hi>He</hi> said, Where have you laid him? They said to Him, Lord, come and see.

verses.name: John 11:35
verses.text: Jesus wept.

verses.name: John 11:36
verses.text: Then the Jews said, Behold how He loved him!

verses.name: John 11:37
verses.text: And some of them said, Was not this Man who opened the eyes of the blind able also to cause that even this one should not have died?

verses.name: John 11:38
verses.text: Then Jesus, groaning in Himself again, came to the tomb. And it was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

verses.name: John 11:39
verses.text: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who died, said to Him, Lord, by this time he stinks. For it is <hi>the</hi> fourth <hi>day</hi>.

verses.name: John 11:40
verses.text: Jesus answered her, Did I not say to you that if you would believe you would see the glory of God?

verses.name: John 11:41
verses.text: Then they took away the stone where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up <hi>His</hi> eyes and said, Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.

verses.name: John 11:42
verses.text: And I know that You hear Me always, but because of the people who stand by I said <hi>it</hi>, so that they may believe that You have sent Me.

verses.name: John 11:43
verses.text: And saying these things, He cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, Here! Outside!

verses.name: John 11:44
verses.text: And he who had died came out, bound hand and foot with sheets, and his face was bound with a cloth. Jesus said to them, Untie him and let <hi>him</hi> go!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:45
verses.text: Then many of the Jews who came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on Him.

verses.name: John 11:46
verses.text: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

verses.name: John 11:47
verses.text: Then the chief priests and Pharisees gathered a sanhedrin, and said, What can we do? For this man does many miracles.

verses.name: John 11:48
verses.text: If we let him alone this way, all will believe on him. And the Romans will come and take away both our place and nation.

verses.name: John 11:49
verses.text: And one of them, Caiaphas, being the high priest of that year, said to them, You do not know anything at all,

verses.name: John 11:50
verses.text: nor do you consider that it is expedient for us that one man should die for the people, and not that the whole nation perish.

verses.name: John 11:51
verses.text: And he did not speak this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation;

verses.name: John 11:52
verses.text: and not for that nation only, but also that He should gather together in one the children of God who were scattered abroad.

verses.name: John 11:53
verses.text: Then from that day they took counsel together that they might kill Him.

verses.name: John 11:54
verses.text: Therefore Jesus walked no more openly among the Jews; but He went away from there to a country near the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and continued there with His disciples.

verses.name: John 11:55
verses.text: And the Jews' Passover was near. And many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the Passover in order to purify themselves.

verses.name: John 11:56
verses.text: Then they sought Jesus, and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, What does it seem to you, that He will not at all come to the feast?

verses.name: John 11:57
verses.text: And all the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commands, that if anyone knew where He was, he should make <hi>it</hi> known so that they might seize Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:1
verses.text: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was (who had died, whom He raised from <hi>the</hi> dead).

verses.name: John 12:2
verses.text: Then they made a supper there for Him. And Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those reclining with Him.

verses.name: John 12:3
verses.text: Then Mary took a pound of ointment of pure spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped His feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.

verses.name: John 12:4
verses.text: Then said one of His disciples (Judas Iscariot, Simon's <hi>son</hi>, who was to betray Him)

verses.name: John 12:5
verses.text: Why was this ointment not sold <hi>for</hi> three hundred denarii and given to <hi>the</hi> poor?

verses.name: John 12:6
verses.text: He said this, not that he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief and held the moneybag and carried the things put <hi>in</hi>.

verses.name: John 12:7
verses.text: Then Jesus said, Let her alone. She has kept this for the day of My burial.

verses.name: John 12:8
verses.text: For you have the poor with you always; but you do not always have Me.

verses.name: John 12:9
verses.text: Then a great crowd of the Jews learned that He was there. And they did not come for Jesus' sake only, but also that they might see Lazarus, whom He had raised from <hi>the</hi> dead.

verses.name: John 12:10
verses.text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus to death also,

verses.name: John 12:11
verses.text: because many of the Jews went away and believed on Jesus because of him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:12
verses.text: On the next day, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem, a great crowd who had come to the Feast

verses.name: John 12:13
verses.text: took branches of palm trees and went out to meet Him. And <hi>they</hi> cried, Hosanna! "Blessed <hi>is</hi> the King of Israel who comes in <hi>the</hi> name of <hi>the</hi> Lord!"

verses.name: John 12:14
verses.text: And finding an ass colt, Jesus sat on it; as it is written,

verses.name: John 12:15
verses.text: "Fear not, daughter of Zion; behold, your King comes sitting on the foal of an ass."

verses.name: John 12:16
verses.text: But His disciples did not know these things at the first. But when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written of Him, and <hi>that</hi> they had done these things to Him.

verses.name: John 12:17
verses.text: Then the crowd witnessed, those who were with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from <hi>the</hi> dead.

verses.name: John 12:18
verses.text: Because of this the crowd also met Him, because they heard that He had done this miracle.

verses.name: John 12:19
verses.text: Then the Pharisees said among themselves, Do you see how you gain nothing? Behold, the world has gone after Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:20
verses.text: And there were certain Greeks among those who came up to worship at the Feast.

verses.name: John 12:21
verses.text: Then these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we want to see Jesus.

verses.name: John 12:22
verses.text: Philip came and told Andrew. And again Andrew and Philip told Jesus.

verses.name: John 12:23
verses.text: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour has come that the Son of man should be glorified.

verses.name: John 12:24
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, Unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it abides alone; but if it dies, it brings forth much fruit.

verses.name: John 12:25
verses.text: He who loves his life shall lose it. And he who hates his life in this world shall keep it to life eternal.

verses.name: John 12:26
verses.text: If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there also My servant shall be. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:27
verses.text: And My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? Father, save Me from this hour? But for this cause I came to this hour.

verses.name: John 12:28
verses.text: Father, glorify Your name! Then there came a voice from the heaven <hi>saying</hi>, I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.

verses.name: John 12:29
verses.text: Then the crowd who stood by and heard said that it thundered. Others said, An angel spoke to Him.

verses.name: John 12:30
verses.text: Jesus answered and said, This voice did not come because of Me, but for your sakes.

verses.name: John 12:31
verses.text: Now is <hi>the</hi> judgment of this world. Now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

verses.name: John 12:32
verses.text: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw all to Myself.

verses.name: John 12:33
verses.text: But He said this, signifying what kind <hi>of</hi> death He was about to die.

verses.name: John 12:34
verses.text: The crowd answered Him, We have heard out of the law that Christ lives forever. How do you say, The Son of man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?

verses.name: John 12:35
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, Yet a little while the Light is with you. Walk while you have the Light, lest darkness come upon you. For he who walks in darkness does not know where he goes.

verses.name: John 12:36
verses.text: While you have the Light, believe in the Light so that you may become sons of Light. Jesus spoke these things and departed and was hidden from them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:37
verses.text: But <hi>though</hi> He had done so many miracles before them, yet they did not believe on Him,

verses.name: John 12:38
verses.text: so that the saying of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, "Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

verses.name: John 12:39
verses.text: Therefore they could not believe, because Isaiah said again,

verses.name: John 12:40
verses.text: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they should not see with <hi>their</hi> eyes nor understand with <hi>their</hi> heart, and be converted, and I should heal them."

verses.name: John 12:41
verses.text: Isaiah said these things when he saw His glory and spoke of Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:42
verses.text: Still, however, even out of the rulers, many did believe on Him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess, lest they should be put out of the synagogue;

verses.name: John 12:43
verses.text: for they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:44
verses.text: But Jesus cried out and said, He who believes on Me does not believe on Me but on Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 12:45
verses.text: And he who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 12:46
verses.text: I have come <hi>as</hi> a Light into the world, so that whoever believes on Me should not remain in darkness.

verses.name: John 12:47
verses.text: And if any one hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge him, for I do not come to judge the world, but to save the world.

verses.name: John 12:48
verses.text: He who rejects Me and does not receive My words has one who judges him; the Word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

verses.name: John 12:49
verses.text: For I have not spoken of Myself, but <hi>the</hi> Father who sent Me gave Me a command, what I should say, and what I should speak.

verses.name: John 12:50
verses.text: And I know that His command is life everlasting. Therefore whatever I speak, even as the Father said to Me, so I speak.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:1
verses.text: And before the feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that His hour had come when He should depart out of this world to the Father, having loved <hi>His</hi> own in the world, He loved them to <hi>the</hi> end.

verses.name: John 13:2
verses.text: And when supper had ended, the Devil now having put into the heart of Judas Iscariot <hi>the son</hi> of Simon to betray Him,

verses.name: John 13:3
verses.text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into <hi>His</hi> hands, and that He had come from God and went to God,

verses.name: John 13:4
verses.text: He rose up from supper and laid aside <hi>His</hi> garments. And He took a towel and girded Himself.

verses.name: John 13:5
verses.text: After that He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe <hi>them</hi> with the towel with which He was girded.

verses.name: John 13:6
verses.text: Then He came to Simon Peter. And Peter said to Him, Lord, do You wash my feet?

verses.name: John 13:7
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, You do not know what I do now, but you shall know hereafter.

verses.name: John 13:8
verses.text: Peter said to Him, You shall never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.

verses.name: John 13:9
verses.text: Simon Peter said to Him, Lord, not my feet only, but also <hi>my</hi> hands and head.

verses.name: John 13:10
verses.text: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has no need except to wash <hi>his</hi> feet, but is clean every whit. And you are clean, but not all.

verses.name: John 13:11
verses.text: For He knew who would betray Him. Therefore He said, You are not all clean.

verses.name: John 13:12
verses.text: So after He had washed their feet and had taken His garments and had reclined again, He said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?

verses.name: John 13:13
verses.text: You call Me the Teacher, and Lord, and you say well, for I AM.

verses.name: John 13:14
verses.text: If then I, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

verses.name: John 13:15
verses.text: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.

verses.name: John 13:16
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, A servant is not greater than his master, neither is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.

verses.name: John 13:17
verses.text: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:18
verses.text: I do not speak of you all; I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture might be fulfilled, "He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me."

verses.name: John 13:19
verses.text: From now I tell you before <hi>it</hi> comes, so that when it happens you may believe that I AM.

verses.name: John 13:20
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, He who receives whomever I send receives Me. And he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 13:21
verses.text: When Jesus had said this, He was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, Truly, truly, I say to you that one of you shall betray Me.

verses.name: John 13:22
verses.text: Then the disciples looked upon one another, wondering of whom He spoke.

verses.name: John 13:23
verses.text: But there was one of His disciples leaning upon Jesus' bosom, the one whom Jesus loved.

verses.name: John 13:24
verses.text: Simon Peter therefore signaled to him to ask whom it might be of whom He spoke.

verses.name: John 13:25
verses.text: And lying on Jesus' breast, he said to him, Lord, who is it?

verses.name: John 13:26
verses.text: Jesus answered, It is he to whom I shall give the morsel when I have dipped <hi>it</hi>. And dipping the morsel, He gave <hi>it</hi> to Judas Iscariot, the <hi>son</hi> of Simon.

verses.name: John 13:27
verses.text: And after the morsel, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, What you do, do quickly.

verses.name: John 13:28
verses.text: But no one reclining knew for what <hi>reason</hi> He spoke this to him.

verses.name: John 13:29
verses.text: For some thought, because Judas had the moneybag, that Jesus had said to him, Buy what we have need <hi>of</hi> for the feast; or that he should give something to the poor.

verses.name: John 13:30
verses.text: He then, having received the morsel, went out immediately. And it was night.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:31
verses.text: Then when he had left, Jesus said, Now the Son of man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.

verses.name: John 13:32
verses.text: If God is glorified in Him, God shall also glorify Him in Himself, and shall immediately glorify Him.

verses.name: John 13:33
verses.text: Little children, I am with you yet a little while. You shall seek Me; and as I said to the Jews, Where I go, you cannot come, so I now say to you.

verses.name: John 13:34
verses.text: I give you a new commandment, that you love one another. As I have loved you, you should also love one another.

verses.name: John 13:35
verses.text: By this all shall know that you are My disciples, if you have love toward one another.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:36
verses.text: Simon Peter said to Him, Lord, where do You go? Jesus answered him, Where I go you cannot now follow Me, but you shall follow Me afterward.

verses.name: John 13:37
verses.text: Peter said to Him, Lord, why cannot I follow You now? I will lay down my life for Your sake.

verses.name: John 13:38
verses.text: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for My sake? Truly, truly, I say to you, The cock shall not crow until you have denied Me three times.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:1
verses.text: Let not your heart be troubled. You believe in God, believe also in Me.

verses.name: John 14:2
verses.text: In My Father's house are many mansions; if <hi>it were</hi> not <hi>so</hi>, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

verses.name: John 14:3
verses.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself, so that where I am, you may be also.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:4
verses.text: And where I go you know, and the way you know.

verses.name: John 14:5
verses.text: Thomas said to Him, Lord, we do not know where You go, and how can we know the way?

verses.name: John 14:6
verses.text: Jesus said to him, I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life; no one comes to the Father but by Me.

verses.name: John 14:7
verses.text: If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also. And from now on you know Him and have seen Him.

verses.name: John 14:8
verses.text: Philip said to Him, Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.

verses.name: John 14:9
verses.text: Jesus said to him, Have I been with you such a long time and yet you have not known Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father. And how do you say, Show us the Father?

verses.name: John 14:10
verses.text: Do you not believe that I <hi>am</hi> in the Father and the Father in Me? The words that I speak to you I do not speak of Myself, but the Father who dwells in Me, He does the works.

verses.name: John 14:11
verses.text: Believe Me that I <hi>am</hi> in the Father and the Father in Me, or else believe Me for the very works themselves.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:12
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, He who believes on Me, the works that I do he shall do also, and greater <hi>works</hi> than these he shall do, because I go to My Father.

verses.name: John 14:13
verses.text: And whatever you may ask in My name, that I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.name: John 14:14
verses.text: If you ask anything in My name, I will do <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:15
verses.text: If you love Me, keep My commandments.

verses.name: John 14:16
verses.text: And I will pray the Father, and He shall give you another Comforter, so that He may be with you forever,

verses.name: John 14:17
verses.text: the Spirit of Truth, whom the world cannot receive because it does not see Him nor know Him. But you know Him, for He dwells with you and shall be in you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:18
verses.text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

verses.name: John 14:19
verses.text: Yet a little <hi>while</hi> and the world does not see Me any more. But you see Me. Because I live, you shall live also.

verses.name: John 14:20
verses.text: At that day you shall know that I <hi>am</hi> in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.

verses.name: John 14:21
verses.text: He who has My commandments and keeps them, he it is who loves Me. And he who loves Me shall be loved by My Father, and I will love him and will reveal Myself to him.

verses.name: John 14:22
verses.text: Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, Lord, how is it that You will reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?

verses.name: John 14:23
verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, If a man loves Me, he will keep My Word. And My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our abode with him.

verses.name: John 14:24
verses.text: He who does not love Me does not keep My words, and the Word which you hear is not Mine, but the Father's who sent Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:25
verses.text: I have spoken these things to you, being present with you.

verses.name: John 14:26
verses.text: But the Comforter, the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in My name, He shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance, whatever I have said to you.

verses.name: John 14:27
verses.text: Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:28
verses.text: You have heard how I said to you, I go away and I am coming to you <hi>again</hi>. If you loved Me, you would rejoice because I said, I go to the Father, for My Father is greater than I.

verses.name: John 14:29
verses.text: And now I have told you before <hi>it</hi> happens, so that when it happens you might believe.

verses.name: John 14:30
verses.text: I shall no longer speak many things with you, for the ruler of this world comes, and he has nothing in Me.

verses.name: John 14:31
verses.text: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father has given Me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go away from here.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:1
verses.text: I am the True Vine, and My Father is the Vinedresser.

verses.name: John 15:2
