verses.text: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away. And every one that bears fruit, He prunes it so that it may bring forth more fruit.

verses.name: John 15:3
verses.text: Now you are clean through the Word which I have spoken to you.

verses.name: John 15:4
verses.text: Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither <hi>can</hi> you unless you abide in Me.

verses.name: John 15:5
verses.text: I am the Vine, you <hi>are</hi> the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.

verses.name: John 15:6
verses.text: If anyone does not abide in Me, he is cast out as a branch and is withered. And they gather and cast <hi>them</hi> into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.name: John 15:7
verses.text: If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done to you.

verses.name: John 15:8
verses.text: In this My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit, so you shall be My disciples.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:9
verses.text: As the Father has loved Me, so I have loved you; continue in My love.

verses.name: John 15:10
verses.text: If you keep My commandments, you shall abide in My love, even as I have kept My Father's commandments and abide in His love.

verses.name: John 15:11
verses.text: I have spoken these things to you so that My joy might remain in you and your joy might be full.

verses.name: John 15:12
verses.text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

verses.name: John 15:13
verses.text: No one has greater love than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

verses.name: John 15:14
verses.text: You are My friends if you do whatever I command you.

verses.name: John 15:15
verses.text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master does. But I have called you friends, for all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.

verses.name: John 15:16
verses.text: You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and ordained you that you should go and bring forth fruit, and <hi>that</hi> your fruit should remain; that whatever you shall ask of the Father in My name, He may give it to you.

verses.name: John 15:17
verses.text: These things I command you, that you love one another.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:18
verses.text: If the world hates you, you know that it hated Me before <hi>it hated</hi> you.

verses.name: John 15:19
verses.text: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

verses.name: John 15:20
verses.text: Remember the word that I said to you, The servant is not greater than his master. If they have persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they have kept My saying, they will also keep yours.

verses.name: John 15:21
verses.text: But all these things they will do to you for My name's sake, because they do not know Him who sent Me.

verses.name: John 15:22
verses.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.name: John 15:23
verses.text: He who hates Me hates My Father also.

verses.name: John 15:24
verses.text: If I had not done among them the works which no other did, they would not have had sin. But now they have both seen and hated Me and My Father.

verses.name: John 15:25
verses.text: But that the Word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, "They hated Me without a cause."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:26
verses.text: And when the Comforter has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He shall testify of Me.

verses.name: John 15:27
verses.text: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with Me from <hi>the</hi> beginning.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:1
verses.text: I have spoken these things to you so that you should not be offended.

verses.name: John 16:2
verses.text: They shall put you out of <hi>the</hi> synagogue. But an hour is coming that everyone who kills you will think that he bears God service.

verses.name: John 16:3
verses.text: And they will do these things to you because they have not known the Father nor Me.

verses.name: John 16:4
verses.text: But I have told you these things so that when the hour shall come you may remember that I told you of them. And I did not say these things to you at the beginning because I was with you.

verses.name: John 16:5
verses.text: But now I go to Him who sent Me, and none of you asks Me, Where do You go?

verses.name: John 16:6
verses.text: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:7
verses.text: But I tell you the truth, it is expedient for you that I go away; for if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to you. But if I depart, I will send Him to you.

verses.name: John 16:8
verses.text: And when that One comes, He will convict the world concerning sin, and concerning righteousness, and concerning judgment.

verses.name: John 16:9
verses.text: Concerning sin, because they do not believe on Me;

verses.name: John 16:10
verses.text: concerning righteousness, because I go to My Father and you see Me no more;

verses.name: John 16:11
verses.text: concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.

verses.name: John 16:12
verses.text: I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear <hi>them</hi> now.

verses.name: John 16:13
verses.text: However, when He, the Spirit of Truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth. For He shall not speak of Himself, but whatever He hears, He shall speak. And He will announce to you things to come.

verses.name: John 16:14
verses.text: He will glorify Me, for He will receive of Mine and will announce <hi>it</hi> to you.

verses.name: John 16:15
verses.text: All things that the Father has are Mine. Therefore I said that He will take of Mine and will announce <hi>it</hi> to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:16
verses.text: A little <hi>while</hi> and you will not see Me; and again a little <hi>while</hi>, and you will see Me, because I go to the Father.

verses.name: John 16:17
verses.text: Then His disciples said to one another, What is this that He says to us, A little <hi>while</hi> and you will not see Me, and again a little and you will see Me? And, Because I go to the Father?

verses.name: John 16:18
verses.text: Therefore they said, What is this that He says, A little <hi>while</hi>? We do not know what He is saying.

verses.name: John 16:19
verses.text: Then Jesus knew that they desired to ask Him, and said to them, Do you seek answers with one another concerning this, because I said, A little <hi>while</hi> and you shall not see Me; and again a little while, and you shall see Me?

verses.name: John 16:20
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. And you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

verses.name: John 16:21
verses.text: The woman has grief when she bears, because her hour has come. But when she brings forth the child, she no longer remembers the anguish, because of the joy that a man is born into the world.

verses.name: John 16:22
verses.text: And therefore you now have sorrow. But I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:23
verses.text: And in that day you shall ask Me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you, Whatever you shall ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

verses.name: John 16:24
verses.text: Before now you have asked nothing in My name; ask and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.

verses.name: John 16:25
verses.text: I have spoken these things to you in parables, but the time is coming when I shall no more speak to you in parables, but I will show you plainly of the Father.

verses.name: John 16:26
verses.text: At that day you will ask in My name; and I do not say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

verses.name: John 16:27
verses.text: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came out from God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:28
verses.text: I came forth from the Father, and have come into the world. Again I leave the world and go to the Father.

verses.name: John 16:29
verses.text: The disciples said to Him, Lo, now You speak plainly and speak no parable.

verses.name: John 16:30
verses.text: Now we know that You know all things and do not need that anyone should ask You. By this we believe that You have come forth from God.

verses.name: John 16:31
verses.text: Jesus answered them, Do you now believe?

verses.name: John 16:32
verses.text: Behold, the hour comes, yea, has now come, that you will be scattered, each man to <hi>his</hi> own things, and you will leave Me alone. And yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

verses.name: John 16:33
verses.text: I have spoken these things to you so that you might have peace in Me. In the world you shall have tribulation, but be of good cheer. I have overcome the world.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:1
verses.text: Jesus spoke these words and lifted up His eyes to Heaven and said, Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son so that Your Son also may glorify You,

verses.name: John 17:2
verses.text: even as You have given Him authority over all flesh so that He should give eternal life to all You have given Him.

verses.name: John 17:3
verses.text: And this is life eternal, that they might know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

verses.name: John 17:4
verses.text: I have glorified You upon the earth. I have finished the work which You have given Me to do.

verses.name: John 17:5
verses.text: And now Father, glorify Me with Yourself with the glory which I had with You before the world was.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:6
verses.text: I have revealed Your name to the men whom You gave to Me out of the world. They were Yours, and You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

verses.name: John 17:7
verses.text: Now they have known that all things, whatever You have given Me, are from You.

verses.name: John 17:8
verses.text: For I have given to them the words which You gave Me, and they have received <hi>them</hi> and have known surely that I came out from You. And they have believed that You sent Me.

verses.name: John 17:9
verses.text: I pray for them. I do not pray for the world, but for those whom You have given Me, for they are Yours.

verses.name: John 17:10
verses.text: And all Mine are Yours, and Yours <hi>are</hi> Mine; and I am glorified in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:11
verses.text: And now I am in the world no longer, but these are in the world, and I come to You, Holy Father. Keep them in Your name, those whom You have given Me, so that <hi>they</hi> may be one as We <hi>are</hi>.

verses.name: John 17:12
verses.text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in Your name. Those that You have given Me I have kept, and none of them is lost, except the son of perdition, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.name: John 17:13
verses.text: And now I come to You, and these things I speak in the world that they might have My joy fulfilled in them.

verses.name: John 17:14
verses.text: I have given them Your Word, and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

verses.name: John 17:15
verses.text: I do not pray for You to take them out of the world, but for You to keep them from the evil.

verses.name: John 17:16
verses.text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:17
verses.text: Sanctify them through Your truth. Your Word is truth.

verses.name: John 17:18
verses.text: As You have sent Me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

verses.name: John 17:19
verses.text: And I sanctify Myself for their sakes, so that they also might be sanctified in truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:20
verses.text: And I do not pray for these alone, but for those also who shall believe on Me through their word,

verses.name: John 17:21
verses.text: that they all may be one, as You, Father, <hi>are</hi> in Me, and I in You, that they also may be one in Us, so that the world may believe that You have sent Me.

verses.name: John 17:22
verses.text: And I have given them the glory which You have given Me, that they may be one, even as We are one,

verses.name: John 17:23
verses.text: I in them, and You in Me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that You have sent Me and have loved them as You have loved Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:24
verses.text: Father, I desire that <hi>those</hi> whom You have given Me, that they may be with Me where I am, that they may behold My glory which You have given Me, for You have loved Me before <hi>the</hi> foundation of <hi>the</hi> world.

verses.name: John 17:25
verses.text: O righteous Father, indeed the world has not known You; but I have known You, and these have known that You have sent me.

verses.name: John 17:26
verses.text: And I made known to them Your name, and will make <hi>it</hi> known, so that the love <hi>with</hi> which You have loved Me may be in them, and I in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:1
verses.text: Having spoken these words, Jesus went out with His disciples over the winter stream Kidron, where there was a garden. He and His disciples entered into it.

verses.name: John 18:2
verses.text: And Judas who betrayed Him also knew the place. For Jesus oftentimes went there with His disciples.

verses.name: John 18:3
verses.text: Then Judas, having received a band and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, came there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

verses.name: John 18:4
verses.text: Then Jesus, knowing all things that were coming upon Him, went out and said to them, Whom do you seek?

verses.name: John 18:5
verses.text: They answered Him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus said to them, I AM! And Judas who betrayed Him also stood with them.

verses.name: John 18:6
verses.text: Then as soon as He had said to them, I AM, they went backward and fell to the ground.

verses.name: John 18:7
verses.text: Then He asked them again, Whom do you seek? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

verses.name: John 18:8
verses.text: Jesus answered, I have told you that I AM. Therefore if you seek Me, let these go away;

verses.name: John 18:9
verses.text: (that the word might be fulfilled which He spoke, "<hi> Of</hi> those whom You have given Me, I have lost not one of them").

verses.name: John 18:10
verses.text: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant and cut off his right ear. And the servant's name <hi>was</hi> Malchus.

verses.name: John 18:11
verses.text: Then Jesus said to Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath. The cup which My Father has given Me, shall I not drink it?

verses.name: John 18:12
verses.text: Then the band, and the captain, and under-officers of the Jews together seized Jesus and bound Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:13
verses.text: And they led Him away to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was the high priest that year.

verses.name: John 18:14
verses.text: And Caiaphas was he who gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

verses.name: John 18:15
verses.text: And Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. That disciple was known to the high priest, and he went in with Jesus into the court of the high priest.

verses.name: John 18:16
verses.text: But Peter stood at the door outside. Then the other disciple went out, the one who was known to the high priest, and spoke to her who kept the door and brought Peter in.

verses.name: John 18:17
verses.text: Then the girl who kept the door said to Peter, Are you not also <hi>one</hi> of this man's disciples? He said, I am not.

verses.name: John 18:18
verses.text: And the servants and officers who had made a fire of coals stood there, for it was cold. And they warmed <hi>themselves</hi>. And Peter stood with them and warmed himself.

verses.name: John 18:19
verses.text: Then the high priest asked Jesus of His disciples and of His teaching.

verses.name: John 18:20
verses.text: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in the synagogue and in the temple, where the Jews always resort, and I have said nothing in secret.

verses.name: John 18:21
verses.text: Why do you ask Me? Ask those who heard me what I have said to them. Behold, they know what I said.

verses.name: John 18:22
verses.text: And when He had spoken this way, one of the officers who stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Do you answer the high priest so?

verses.name: John 18:23
verses.text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil; but if well, why do you strike Me?

verses.name: John 18:24
verses.text: Then Annas had sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.name: John 18:25
verses.text: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. Then they said to him, Are you not also <hi>one</hi> of his disciples? He denied and said, I am not.

verses.name: John 18:26
verses.text: One of the servants of the high priest, being kinsman to him whose ear Peter cut off, said, Did I not see you in the garden with him?

verses.name: John 18:27
verses.text: Peter then denied again. And immediately a cock crowed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:28
verses.text: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas into the praetorium. And it was early. And they did not go into the praetorium, that they should not be defiled, and that they might eat the Passover.

verses.name: John 18:29
verses.text: Then Pilate went out to them and said, What charge do you bring against this man?

verses.name: John 18:30
verses.text: They answered and said to him, If he were not an evildoer, then we would not have delivered him up to you.

verses.name: John 18:31
verses.text: Then Pilate said to them, You take him and judge him according to your law. Then the Jews said to him, It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death

verses.name: John 18:32
verses.text: (that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which He spoke signifying what death He was about to die).

verses.name: John 18:33
verses.text: Then Pilate entered into the praetorium again and called Jesus and said to him, Are you the king of the Jews?

verses.name: John 18:34
verses.text: Jesus answered him, Do you say this thing of yourself, or did others say it to you about Me?

verses.name: John 18:35
verses.text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you to me. What have you done?

verses.name: John 18:36
verses.text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, then My servants would fight so that I might not be delivered to the Jews. But now My kingdom is not from here.

verses.name: John 18:37
verses.text: Pilate then said to Him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You say <hi>it</hi> that I am a king. To this <hi>end</hi> I was born, and for this cause I came into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth hears My voice.

verses.name: John 18:38
verses.text: Pilate said to Him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews and said to them, I find no fault in him.

verses.name: John 18:39
verses.text: But you have a custom that I should release one to you at the Passover. Then do you desire that I release to you the king of the Jews?

verses.name: John 18:40
verses.text: Then they all cried again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas! But Barabbas was a robber.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:1
verses.text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus and flogged <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: John 19:2
verses.text: And the soldiers plaited a crown of thorns and put <hi>it</hi> on His head. And they put a purple robe on Him,

verses.name: John 19:3
verses.text: and said, Hail, King of the Jews! And they struck Him with their hands.

verses.name: John 19:4
verses.text: Then Pilate went out again and said to them, Behold, I bring him out to you so that you may know that I find no fault in him.

verses.name: John 19:5
verses.text: Then Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And <hi>Pilate</hi> said to them, Behold the man!

verses.name: John 19:6
verses.text: Then when the chief priests and under-officers saw Him, they cried out, saying, Crucify! Crucify <hi>Him</hi>! Pilate said to them, You take Him and crucify Him, for I find no fault in him.

verses.name: John 19:7
verses.text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

verses.name: John 19:8
verses.text: Then when Pilate heard that saying, he was the more afraid.

verses.name: John 19:9
verses.text: And <hi>he</hi> went again into the praetorium and said to Jesus, Where are you from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

verses.name: John 19:10
verses.text: Then Pilate said to him, Do you not speak to me? Do you not know that I have authority to crucify you, and I have authority to release you?

verses.name: John 19:11
verses.text: Jesus answered, You could have no authority against Me unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered Me to you has the greater sin.

verses.name: John 19:12
verses.text: From this <hi>time</hi>, Pilate sought to release Him. But the Jews cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar's friend. Whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar.

verses.name: John 19:13
verses.text: Then when Pilate heard that saying, he brought Jesus out and sat down in the judgment seat at a place called the Pavement (but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha).

verses.name: John 19:14
verses.text: And it was <hi>the</hi> preparation of the Passover, and about <hi>the</hi> sixth hour. And he said to the Jews, Behold your king!

verses.name: John 19:15
verses.text: But they cried out, Away with <hi>him</hi>! Away with <hi>him</hi>! Crucify him! Pilate said to them, Shall I crucify your king? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:16
verses.text: Then he delivered Him up to them that He might be crucified. And they took Jesus and led <hi>Him</hi> away.

verses.name: John 19:17
verses.text: And bearing His cross, He went out to a place called, <hi>The Place</hi> of a Skull (which is called in the Hebrew, Golgotha)

verses.name: John 19:18
verses.text: where they crucified Him, and two others with Him, one on either side, and Jesus in the middle.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:19
verses.text: And Pilate wrote a title and put <hi>it</hi> on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.name: John 19:20
verses.text: Then many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.

verses.name: John 19:21
verses.text: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, Do not write, the king of the Jews, but that he said, I am king of the Jews.

verses.name: John 19:22
verses.text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

verses.name: John 19:23
verses.text: Then when they had crucified Jesus, the soldiers took His garments and made four parts, one part to each soldier; and also <hi>His</hi> tunic. And the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

verses.name: John 19:24
verses.text: Therefore they said among themselves, Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to find whose it shall be (that the Scripture might be fulfilled which says, "They parted my garments among them, and <hi>for</hi> my garment they cast lots"). Therefore the soldiers did these things.

verses.name: John 19:25
verses.text: And His mother stood by the cross of Jesus, and His mother's sister, Mary the <hi>wife</hi> of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.name: John 19:26
verses.text: Then when Jesus saw <hi>His</hi> mother and the disciple whom He loved standing by, He said to His mother, Woman, behold your son!

verses.name: John 19:27
verses.text: Then He said to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her into <hi>his</hi> own <hi>home</hi>.

verses.name: John 19:28
verses.text: After this, knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, Jesus said, I thirst.

verses.name: John 19:29
verses.text: Then a vessel full of sour wine was set. And they filled a sponge with sour wine and put <hi>it</hi> upon hyssop, and put <hi>it</hi> to His mouth.

verses.name: John 19:30
verses.text: Then when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, It is finished! And He bowed <hi>His</hi> head and gave up the spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:31
verses.text: Then the Jews, because it was Preparation, begged Pilate that their legs might be broken, and <hi>that</hi> they might be taken away, so that the bodies should not remain on the cross on the sabbath. For that sabbath was a high day.

verses.name: John 19:32
verses.text: Then the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with Him.

verses.name: John 19:33
verses.text: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.

verses.name: John 19:34
verses.text: But one of the soldiers pierced His side <hi>with</hi> a lance, and instantly there came out blood and water.

verses.name: John 19:35
verses.text: And he who saw bore record, and his record is true. And he knows that he speaks true, so that you might believe.

verses.name: John 19:36
verses.text: For these things were done so that the Scripture might be fulfilled, "Not a bone of Him shall be broken."

verses.name: John 19:37
verses.text: And again another Scripture says, "They shall look upon <hi>Him</hi> whom they pierced."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:38
verses.text: And after these things, Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews) begged of Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus. And Pilate gave permission. Then he came and took the body of Jesus.

verses.name: John 19:39
verses.text: And Nicodemus also came, who at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.

verses.name: John 19:40
verses.text: Then they took the body of Jesus and wound it with linens with the spices, as is the custom of the Jews to bury.

verses.name: John 19:41
verses.text: And in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one yet had been placed.

verses.name: John 19:42
verses.text: There, then, because of the Preparation of the Jews, because the tomb was near, they laid Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:1
verses.text: The first <hi>day</hi> of the week Mary Magdalene came early to the tomb, darkness still being <hi>on it</hi>, and <hi>she</hi> saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

verses.name: John 20:2
verses.text: Then she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him.

verses.name: John 20:3
verses.text: Therefore Peter and that other disciple went forth and came to the tomb.

verses.name: John 20:4
verses.text: So they both ran together. And the other disciple outran Peter and came first to the tomb.

verses.name: John 20:5
verses.text: And stooping down he saw the linens lying, yet he did not go in.

verses.name: John 20:6
verses.text: Then Simon Peter came following him and went into the tomb. And he saw the linens lying <hi>there</hi>.

verses.name: John 20:7
verses.text: And the grave-cloth that was on His head <hi>was</hi> not lying with the linens, but was wrapped up in one place by itself.

verses.name: John 20:8
verses.text: Therefore, then, that other disciple also went in, the <hi>one</hi> who came first to the tomb. And he saw and believed.

verses.name: John 20:9
verses.text: For as yet they did not know the Scripture that He must rise again from <hi>the</hi> dead.

verses.name: John 20:10
verses.text: Then the disciples went away again to themselves.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:11
verses.text: But Mary stood outside of the tomb, weeping. And as she wept, she stooped down into the tomb.

verses.name: John 20:12
verses.text: And <hi>she</hi> saw two angels in white sitting there, the one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

verses.name: John 20:13
verses.text: And they said to her, Woman, why do you weep? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him.

verses.name: John 20:14
verses.text: And when she had said this, she turned backward and saw Jesus standing, but she did not know that it was Jesus.

verses.name: John 20:15
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Woman, why do you weep? Whom do you seek? Supposing Him to be the gardener, she said to Him, Sir, if you have carried Him away from here, tell me where you have laid Him and I will take Him away.

verses.name: John 20:16
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Mary! She turned herself and said to Him, Rabboni! (which is to say, Master!)

verses.name: John 20:17
verses.text: Jesus said to her, Do not touch Me, for I have not yet ascended to My Father. But go to My brothers and say to them, I ascend to My Father and Your Father, and <hi>to</hi> My God and your God.

verses.name: John 20:18
verses.text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord and that He had spoken these things to her.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:19
verses.text: Then the same day at evening, being the first <hi>day</hi> of the sabbaths, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, Peace to you!

verses.name: John 20:20
verses.text: And when He had said this, He showed them <hi>His</hi> hands and His side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.

verses.name: John 20:21
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them again, Peace to you. As <hi>My</hi> Father has sent Me, even so I send you.

verses.name: John 20:22
verses.text: And when He had said this, He breathed on <hi>them</hi> and said to them, Receive <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit.

verses.name: John 20:23
verses.text: Of whomever sins you remit, they are remitted to them. Of whomever <hi>sins</hi> you retain, they are retained.

verses.name: John 20:24
verses.text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called the Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.

verses.name: John 20:25
verses.text: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, Unless I shall see the print of the nails in His hands, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into His side, I will not believe.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:26
verses.text: And after eight days the disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst and said, Peace to you!

verses.name: John 20:27
verses.text: Then He said to Thomas, Reach your finger here and behold My hands; and reach your hand here and thrust <hi>it</hi> into My side; and do not be unbelieving, but believing.

verses.name: John 20:28
verses.text: And Thomas answered and said to Him, My Lord and my God!

verses.name: John 20:29
verses.text: Jesus said to him, Thomas, because you have seen Me you have believed. Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who have not seen and have believed.

verses.name: John 20:30
verses.text: And truly Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.

verses.name: John 20:31
verses.text: But these are written so that you might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you might have life in His name.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:1
verses.text: After these things Jesus revealed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. And He revealed <hi>Himself</hi> this way:

verses.name: John 21:2
verses.text: Simon Peter, and Thomas called <hi>the</hi> Twin, and Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the <hi>sons</hi> of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.

verses.name: John 21:3
verses.text: Simon Peter said to them, I am going out to fish. They said to him, We will go with you also. They went out and entered into a boat immediately. And that night they caught nothing.

verses.name: John 21:4
verses.text: But when the morning had come, Jesus stood on the shore. But the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.

verses.name: John 21:5
verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, Children, Do you have anything to eat? They answered Him, No.

verses.name: John 21:6
verses.text: And He said to them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat and you will find. Therefore they cast, and now they no longer had <hi>the</hi> strength to draw, from the multitude of fish.

verses.name: John 21:7
verses.text: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loves said to Peter, It is the Lord! Then hearing that it is the Lord, Simon Peter girded on <hi>his</hi> coat (for he was naked), and cast himself into the sea.

verses.name: John 21:8
verses.text: And the other disciples came in a little boat (for they were not far from land, only about two hundred cubits), dragging the net of fish.

verses.name: John 21:9
verses.text: Then when they went up on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and a fish lying on <hi>it</hi>, and bread.

verses.name: John 21:10
verses.text: And Jesus said to them, Bring from the fish which you have now caught.

verses.name: John 21:11
verses.text: Simon Peter went up and drew the net to land, full of big fish, a hundred and fifty-three. And <hi>though</hi> there were so many, the net was not torn.

verses.name: John 21:12
verses.text: Jesus said to them, Come, break fast. And none of the disciples dared to ask Him, Who are You? knowing that it was the Lord.

verses.name: John 21:13
verses.text: Then Jesus came and took the bread and gave to them, and in the same way the little fish.

verses.name: John 21:14
verses.text: This <hi>is</hi> now the three times Jesus was revealed to His disciples, <hi>He</hi> being risen from <hi>the</hi> dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:15
verses.text: Then when they broke fast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, <hi>son</hi> of Jonah, do you love Me more than these? He said to Him, Yes, Lord, You know that I love You. He said to him, Feed My lambs.

verses.name: John 21:16
verses.text: He said to him the second time, Simon, <hi>son</hi> of Jonah, do you love Me? He said to Him, Yes, Lord, You know that I love You. He said to him, Feed My sheep.

verses.name: John 21:17
verses.text: He said to him the third time, Simon, <hi>son</hi> of Jonah, do you love Me? Peter was grieved because He said to him a third <hi>time</hi>, Do you love Me? And he said to Him, Lord, You know all things, You know that I love You. Jesus said to him, Feed My sheep.

verses.name: John 21:18
verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, When you were young, you girded yourself and walked where you wished. But when you grow old, you shall stretch forth your hands and another shall gird you and carry <hi>you</hi> where <hi>you</hi> do not wish.

verses.name: John 21:19
verses.text: He spoke this signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when He had spoken this, He said to him, Follow Me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:20
verses.text: Then Peter, turning around, saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following (the one who also leaned on His breast at supper, and said, Lord, who is he who betrays You?)

verses.name: John 21:21
verses.text: Seeing him, Peter said to Jesus, Lord, and what <hi>of</hi> this one?

verses.name: John 21:22
verses.text: Jesus said to him, If I desire that he remain until I come, what <hi>is that</hi> to you? You follow Me.

verses.name: John 21:23
verses.text: Then this saying went abroad among the brothers, that that disciple should not die. Yet Jesus did not say to him, He shall not die, but, If I desire that he remain until I come, what <hi>is that</hi> to you?

verses.name: John 21:24
verses.text: This is the disciple who testifies of these things and wrote these things. And we know that his testimony is true.

verses.name: John 21:25
verses.text: And there are also many things, whatever Jesus did, which, if they should be written singly, I suppose the world itself <hi>could</hi> not contain the books that would be written. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:1
verses.text: Truly, O Theophilus, I made the first report as to all things that Jesus began both to do and teach

verses.name: Acts 1:2
verses.text: until the day He was taken up, having given directions to the apostles whom He chose, through <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit;

verses.name: Acts 1:3
verses.text: to whom He also presented Himself living after His suffering by many infallible proofs, being seen by them through forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Acts 1:4
verses.text: And having met with <hi>them</hi>, He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to await the promise of the Father which you heard from Me.

verses.name: Acts 1:5
verses.text: For John truly baptized with water, but you shall be baptized in <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit not many days from now.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:6
verses.text: Then, indeed, these coming together, they asked Him, saying, Lord, do You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?

verses.name: Acts 1:7
verses.text: And He said to them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father has put in His own authority.

verses.name: Acts 1:8
verses.text: But you shall receive power, the Holy Spirit coming upon you. And you shall be witnesses to Me both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and to <hi>the</hi> end of the earth.

verses.name: Acts 1:9
verses.text: And saying these things, <hi>as</hi> they watched, He was taken up. And a cloud received Him out of their sight.

verses.name: Acts 1:10
verses.text: And while they were looking intently into the heaven, He having gone, even behold, two men in white clothing stood beside them,

verses.name: Acts 1:11
verses.text: who also said, Men of Galilee, why do you stand gazing up into the heaven? This same Jesus who is taken up from you into Heaven, will come in the way you have seen Him going into Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:12
verses.text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from <hi>the</hi> mount Of Olive Grove, which is a sabbath day's <hi>journey</hi> from Jerusalem.

verses.name: Acts 1:13
verses.text: And when they had come in, they went up into an upper room, where Peter and James, and John and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James <hi>the son</hi> of Alpheus and Simon Zelotes, and Judas <hi>the brother</hi> of James;

verses.name: Acts 1:14
verses.text: these all were continuing with one accord in prayer and supplication, with <hi>the</hi> women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:15
verses.text: And in those days Peter stood up in <hi>the</hi> midst of the disciples and said, (<hi> the</hi> number of names together <hi>was</hi> about a hundred and twenty,)

verses.name: Acts 1:16
verses.text: Men, brothers, this Scripture must have been fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit by the mouth of David spoke before concerning Judas, who became guide to those who seized Jesus.

verses.name: Acts 1:17
verses.text: For he was numbered with us and had obtained part of this ministry.

verses.name: Acts 1:18
verses.text: Indeed, then, this one purchased a field with the reward of unrighteousness. And falling headlong, he burst apart in <hi>the</hi> middle, and all his bowels gushed out.

verses.name: Acts 1:19
verses.text: And it was known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem, so much so that that field is called in their own dialect, Akeldama, that is to say, Field of Blood.

verses.name: Acts 1:20
verses.text: For it is written in <hi>the</hi> Book of Psalms, "Let his estate become forsaken, and he not be living in it." And, "Let another take his overseership."

verses.name: Acts 1:21
verses.text: Therefore, it is right that one of these men who have companied with us all <hi>the</hi> time that the Lord Jesus came in and went out among us,

verses.name: Acts 1:22
verses.text: beginning from the baptism of John to that same day that He was taken up from us, to become a witness with us of His resurrection.

verses.name: Acts 1:23
verses.text: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

verses.name: Acts 1:24
verses.text: And they prayed and said, You, Lord, knower of all hearts, show which one You chose from these two,

verses.name: Acts 1:25
verses.text: to take the share of this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell, to go to <hi>his</hi> own place.

verses.name: Acts 1:26
verses.text: And they gave forth their lots. And the lot fell upon Matthias. And he was numbered with the eleven apostles.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:1
verses.text: And in the fulfilling of the day of Pentecost, they were all with one accord in one place.

verses.name: Acts 2:2
verses.text: And suddenly a sound came out of the heaven as borne along by the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

verses.name: Acts 2:3
verses.text: And tongues as of fire appeared to them, being distributed; and it sat upon each of them.

verses.name: Acts 2:4
verses.text: And they were all filled of the Holy Spirit, and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them utterance.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:5
verses.text: And dwelling at Jerusalem there were Jews, devout men out of every nation under heaven.

verses.name: Acts 2:6
verses.text: But this sound occurring, the multitude came together and were confounded, because they each heard them speaking in his own dialect.

verses.name: Acts 2:7
verses.text: And they were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, Behold, are not these who speak all Galileans?

verses.name: Acts 2:8
verses.text: And how do we each hear in our own dialect in which we were born?

verses.name: Acts 2:9
verses.text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

verses.name: Acts 2:10
verses.text: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya around Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

verses.name: Acts 2:11
verses.text: Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking the great things of God in our own languages.

verses.name: Acts 2:12
verses.text: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying to one another, What does this mean?

verses.name: Acts 2:13
verses.text: But others mocking said, These men are full of sweet wine.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:14
verses.text: But Peter, standing up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice and said to them, Men, Jews, and all who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

verses.name: Acts 2:15
verses.text: For these are not drunk as you suppose, for it is <hi>the</hi> third hour of the day.

verses.name: Acts 2:16
verses.text: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel:

verses.name: Acts 2:17
verses.text: "And it shall be in the last days, says God, I will pour out of My Spirit upon all flesh. And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams.

verses.name: Acts 2:18
verses.text: And in those days I will pour out My Spirit upon My slaves and My slave women, and they shall prophesy.

verses.name: Acts 2:19
verses.text: And I will give wonders in the heaven above, and miracles on the earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.

verses.name: Acts 2:20
verses.text: The sun shall be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before that great and glorious Day of the Lord.

verses.name: Acts 2:21
verses.text: And it shall be <hi>that</hi> everyone who shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved."

verses.name: Acts 2:22
verses.text: Men, Israelites, hear these words. Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by powerful works, and wonders and miracles, which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves also know,

verses.name: Acts 2:23
verses.text: this One given <hi>to you</hi> by the before-determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, <hi>you</hi> have taken and by lawless hands, crucifying <hi>Him</hi>, you put Him to death;

verses.name: Acts 2:24
verses.text: whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible that He should be held by it.

verses.name: Acts 2:25
verses.text: For David speaks concerning Him, "I foresaw the Lord always before me, because He is at my right hand, that I should not be moved.

verses.name: Acts 2:26
verses.text: Therefore my heart rejoiced and my tongue was glad; and also My flesh shall rest in hope,

verses.name: Acts 2:27
verses.text: because You will not leave My soul in Hades, nor will You allow Your holy One to see corruption.

verses.name: Acts 2:28
verses.text: You revealed to Me the ways of life. You will fill Me with joy with Your countenance."

verses.name: Acts 2:29
verses.text: Men, brothers, it is permitted to say to you with plainness as to the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

verses.name: Acts 2:30
verses.text: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of <hi>the</hi> fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, He would raise up Christ to sit upon his throne,

verses.name: Acts 2:31
verses.text: seeing this beforehand, he spoke of the resurrection of Christ, that His soul was not left in Hades, nor would His flesh see corruption,

verses.name: Acts 2:32
verses.text: God raised up this Jesus, of which we all are witnesses.

verses.name: Acts 2:33
verses.text: Therefore being exalted to the right of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, He has poured out this which you now see and hear.

verses.name: Acts 2:34
verses.text: For David has not ascended into the heavens, but he says himself, "The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right <hi>hand</hi>

verses.name: Acts 2:35
verses.text: until I place Your enemies <hi>as</hi> a footstool to Your feet."

verses.name: Acts 2:36
verses.text: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God made this same Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:37
verses.text: And hearing <hi>this</hi>, they were stabbed in the heart, and said to Peter and to the other apostles, Men, brothers, what shall we do?

verses.name: Acts 2:38
verses.text: Then Peter said to them, Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ to remission of sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

verses.name: Acts 2:39
verses.text: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all those afar off, as many as <hi>the</hi> Lord our God shall call.

verses.name: Acts 2:40
verses.text: And with many other words he earnestly testified and exhorted, saying, Be saved from this perverse generation.

verses.name: Acts 2:41
verses.text: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. And the same day there were added about three thousand souls.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:42
verses.text: And they were continuing steadfastly in the apostles' doctrine, and in fellowship and in the breaking of the loaves, and in prayers.

verses.name: Acts 2:43
verses.text: And fear came on every soul. And many wonders and miracles took place through the apostles.

verses.name: Acts 2:44
verses.text: And all who believed were together and had all things common.

verses.name: Acts 2:45
verses.text: And they sold their possessions and goods and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

verses.name: Acts 2:46
verses.text: And continuing with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they shared food with gladness and simplicity of heart,

verses.name: Acts 2:47
verses.text: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:1
verses.text: And on the same <hi>day</hi> Peter and John went up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth <hi>hour</hi>.

verses.name: Acts 3:2
verses.text: And a certain man, who was lame from his mother's womb, was being carried. And they laid him daily at that temple gate which is called Beautiful, to ask alms from those who entered into the temple.

verses.name: Acts 3:3
verses.text: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked <hi>to receive</hi> alms.

verses.name: Acts 3:4
verses.text: And fastening his eyes on him, Peter with John said, Look on us!

verses.name: Acts 3:5
verses.text: And he paid heed to them, expecting to receive something from them.

verses.name: Acts 3:6
verses.text: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!

verses.name: Acts 3:7
verses.text: And taking him by the right hand, he lifted <hi>him</hi> up. And immediately his feet and ankle-bones received strength.

verses.name: Acts 3:8
verses.text: And leaping up, he stood and walked and entered with them into the temple, walking and leaping and praising God.

verses.name: Acts 3:9
verses.text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God.

verses.name: Acts 3:10
verses.text: And they recognized him, that it was him who sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. And they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

verses.name: Acts 3:11
verses.text: And as the lame one who was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:12
verses.text: And seeing <hi>this</hi>, Peter answered the people, Men, Israelites, why do you marvel at this? Or why do you stare at us, as <hi>though</hi> we had made this man to walk by our own power or holiness?

verses.name: Acts 3:13
verses.text: The God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His son Jesus, whom you delivered up, denying Him in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to let <hi>Him</hi> go.

verses.name: Acts 3:14
verses.text: But you denied the Holy and Just <hi>One</hi> and desired a murderer to be given to you.

verses.name: Acts 3:15
verses.text: And you killed the Prince of Life, whom God has raised from <hi>the</hi> dead, of which we are witnesses.

verses.name: Acts 3:16
verses.text: And His name, through faith in His name, has made this man strong, this one whom you see and know, His name made firm. And the faith which came through Him has given him this perfect soundness before you.

verses.name: Acts 3:17
verses.text: And now, brothers, I know that you did <hi>it</hi> through ignorance, as also your rulers <hi>did</hi>.

verses.name: Acts 3:18
verses.text: But those things which God before had shown by the mouth of all His prophets, <hi>that</hi> Christ should suffer, He fulfilled in this manner.

verses.name: Acts 3:19
verses.text: Therefore repent and convert so that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from <hi>the</hi> presence of the Lord.

verses.name: Acts 3:20
verses.text: And He shall send Jesus Christ, who before was proclaimed to you,

verses.name: Acts 3:21
verses.text: whom Heaven truly needs to receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by <hi>the</hi> mouth of His holy prophets since the world began.

verses.name: Acts 3:22
verses.text: For Moses truly said to the fathers, "<hi> The</hi> Lord your God shall raise up a Prophet to you from your brothers, <hi>One</hi> like me. You shall hear Him in all things, whatever He may say to you.

verses.name: Acts 3:23
verses.text: And it shall be <hi>that</hi> every soul who will not hear that Prophet shall be destroyed from among the people."

verses.name: Acts 3:24
verses.text: And also all the prophets from Samuel and those following after, as many as spoke, have likewise foretold of these days.

verses.name: Acts 3:25
verses.text: You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, "And in your Seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed."

verses.name: Acts 3:26
verses.text: Having raised up His son Jesus, God sent Him to you first, to bless you in turning every one of you away from his iniquities.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:1
verses.text: And <hi>as</hi> they spoke to the people, the priests, and the temple commander, and the Sadducees came on them,

verses.name: Acts 4:2
verses.text: being grieved that they taught the people, even to announce through Jesus the resurrection from <hi>the</hi> dead.

verses.name: Acts 4:3
verses.text: <hi> And they</hi> laid hands on <hi>them</hi> and put <hi>them</hi> under guard until the next day, for it was already evening.

verses.name: Acts 4:4
verses.text: But many of those who heard the Word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:5
verses.text: And it happened on the next day that their rulers and elders and scribes, gathered to Jerusalem,

verses.name: Acts 4:6
verses.text: and Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.

verses.name: Acts 4:7
verses.text: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name have you done this?

verses.name: Acts 4:8
verses.text: Then Peter, filled with <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, said to them, Rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

verses.name: Acts 4:9
verses.text: if we are examined today on a good work for an infirm man, by what this one has been healed,

verses.name: Acts 4:10
verses.text: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from <hi>the</hi> dead, in this <hi>name</hi> does this man stand before you whole.

verses.name: Acts 4:11
verses.text: This is the Stone which you builders have counted worthless, and He has become the Head of <hi>the</hi> Corner.

verses.name: Acts 4:12
verses.text: And there is salvation in no other One; for there is no other name under Heaven given among men by which we must be saved.

verses.name: Acts 4:13
verses.text: But seeing the boldness of Peter and John, and perceiving that they were unlearned and uneducated men, they marveled. And they recognized them, that they had been with Jesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:14
verses.text: And beholding the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against <hi>it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:15
verses.text: And when they had commanded them to go aside out of the sanhedrin, they conferred among themselves,

verses.name: Acts 4:16
verses.text: saying, What shall we do to these men? For that indeed a notable miracle has been done by them is plain to all those dwelling in Jerusalem. And we cannot deny <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Acts 4:17
verses.text: But, so that it spread no further among the people, let us strictly threaten them, <hi>that</hi> they speak to no man in this name from now on.

verses.name: Acts 4:18
verses.text: And they called them and commanded them not to speak at all, nor to teach in the name of Jesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:19
verses.text: But Peter and John answered and said to them, Whether it is right before God to listen to you more than to God, you judge.

verses.name: Acts 4:20
verses.text: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

verses.name: Acts 4:21
verses.text: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way <hi>as to</hi> how they might punish them, because of the people. For all glorified God for that which was done.

verses.name: Acts 4:22
verses.text: For the man on whom this miracle of healing occurred was more than forty years <hi>old</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:23
verses.text: And being let go, they went to their own company and reported what the chief priests and elders had said <hi>to them</hi>.

verses.name: Acts 4:24
verses.text: And having heard, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, Lord, You <hi>are</hi> the God who made the heaven and earth, and the sea, and all that is in them;

verses.name: Acts 4:25
verses.text: who by the mouth of Your servant David has said, "Why did the nations rage and the people imagine vain things?

verses.name: Acts 4:26
verses.text: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against His Christ."

verses.name: Acts 4:27
verses.text: For truly, against Your holy child Jesus, whom You have anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the nations, and <hi>the</hi> people of Israel, were gathered together

verses.name: Acts 4:28
verses.text: in order to do whatever Your hand and Your counsel determined before to be done.

verses.name: Acts 4:29
verses.text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings, and grant to Your servants that with all boldness they may speak Your Word,

verses.name: Acts 4:30
verses.text: by stretching forth of Your hand for healing, and miracles, and wonders may be done by the name of Your holy child Jesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:31
verses.text: And when they had prayed, the place where they were assembled was shaken. And they were all filled with <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, and they spoke the Word of God with boldness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:32
verses.text: And the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and one soul. And not one said that any of the things which he possessed was his own. But they had all things common.

verses.name: Acts 4:33
verses.text: And the apostles gave witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus with great power. And great grace was on them all.

verses.name: Acts 4:34
verses.text: For neither was anyone needy among them, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold <hi>them</hi> and brought the prices of the <hi>things</hi> that were sold,

verses.name: Acts 4:35
verses.text: and they laid <hi>them</hi> down at the apostles' feet. And distribution was made to every man according as he had need.

verses.name: Acts 4:36
verses.text: And Joses, who was surnamed Barnabas by the apostles (which is, being translated, The son of consolation), a Levite, a Cypriot by race,

verses.name: Acts 4:37
verses.text: a field being his, selling <hi>it</hi>, he bore the proceeds and placed <hi>them</hi> at the apostles' feet.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:1
verses.text: And a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession.

verses.name: Acts 5:2
verses.text: And he kept back <hi>part</hi> of the price, his wife also knowing, and brought a certain part and laid <hi>it</hi> at the apostles' feet.

verses.name: Acts 5:3
verses.text: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart <hi>for</hi> you to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back <hi>part</hi> of the price of the land?

verses.name: Acts 5:4
verses.text: While it remained, was it not your own? And after it was sold, was it <hi>not</hi> in your own authority? Why have you conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God.

verses.name: Acts 5:5
verses.text: And hearing these words, Ananias fell down <hi>and</hi> expired. And great fear came on all those who heard these things.

verses.name: Acts 5:6
verses.text: And the younger ones arose, wound him up, and carrying <hi>him</hi> out, <hi>they</hi> buried <hi>him</hi>.

verses.name: Acts 5:7
verses.text: And it was about the space of three hours afterward, when his wife (not knowing what was done) came in.

verses.name: Acts 5:8
verses.text: And Peter answered her, Tell me whether you sold the land <hi>for</hi> so much? And she said, Yes, <hi>for</hi> so much.

verses.name: Acts 5:9
verses.text: Then Peter said to her, How <hi>is it</hi> that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of <hi>the</hi> Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband <hi>are</hi> at the door and they will carry you out.

verses.name: Acts 5:10
verses.text: Then at once she fell down at his feet and expired. And the younger ones found her dead, and, carrying <hi>her</hi> out, buried her beside her husband.

verses.name: Acts 5:11
verses.text: And great fear came on all the church and on as many as heard these things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:12
verses.text: And many miracles and wonders were done among the people by the hands of the apostles; and they were all with one accord in Solomon's Porch.

verses.name: Acts 5:13
verses.text: And of the rest no one dared to join himself to them, but the people magnified them;

verses.name: Acts 5:14
verses.text: and more believing ones were added to <hi>the</hi> Lord, multitudes both of men and women;

verses.name: Acts 5:15
verses.text: So as to carry out the sick into the streets and place <hi>them</hi> on cots and mattresses, so that at least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

verses.name: Acts 5:16
verses.text: And also a multitude came <hi>from</hi> the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick ones, and those being tormented by unclean spirits, who were all healed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:17
verses.text: And rising up, the high priest, and all those who were with him (which is the <hi>sect</hi> of the Sadducees) were filled with anger,

verses.name: Acts 5:18
verses.text: And laid their hands on the apostles and put them in the public custody.

verses.name: Acts 5:19
verses.text: But the angel of <hi>the</hi> Lord opened the prison doors by night and brought them out, and said,

verses.name: Acts 5:20
verses.text: Go! Stand and speak all the words of this Life to the people in the temple.

verses.name: Acts 5:21
verses.text: And hearing, they went into the temple about dawn, and taught. But the high priest came, and those with him. And they called the sanhedrin together, and all the elderhood of the sons of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

verses.name: Acts 5:22
verses.text: But having come near, the officers did not find them in the prison. And returning, reported,

verses.name: Acts 5:23
verses.text: saying, We indeed found the prison shut with all safety, and the keepers standing outside in front of the doors. But having opened it, we found no one inside.

verses.name: Acts 5:24
verses.text: And when the high priest and the temple commander and the chief priests heard these things, they were bewildered about them, what this might be.

verses.name: Acts 5:25
verses.text: But one came, reporting to them, saying, Behold, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:26
verses.text: Then the commander went with the officers <hi>and</hi> brought them, not with force, for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.

verses.name: Acts 5:27
verses.text: And bringing them, they stood in the sanhedrin. And the high priest asked them,

verses.name: Acts 5:28
verses.text: saying, Did we not strictly command you <hi>that</hi> you not teach in this name? And behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine and intend to bring this man's blood on us.

verses.name: Acts 5:29
verses.text: And Peter and the apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

verses.name: Acts 5:30
verses.text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed and hanged on a tree.

verses.name: Acts 5:31
verses.text: This One God <hi>has</hi> exalted <hi>to be</hi> a Ruler and Savior to His right <hi>hand</hi> in order to give repentance and remission of sins to Israel.

verses.name: Acts 5:32
verses.text: And we are His witnesses of these things. And <hi>so</hi> also <hi>is</hi> the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.

verses.name: Acts 5:33
verses.text: But those hearing were cut <hi>to the heart</hi>, and they took counsel to kill them.

verses.name: Acts 5:34
verses.text: Then there stood up one in the sanhedrin, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law honored among all the people. And he commanded the apostles to be put outside a little space.

verses.name: Acts 5:35
verses.text: And he said to them, Men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what you intend to do <hi>regarding</hi> these men.

verses.name: Acts 5:36
verses.text: For before these days Theudas rose up, boasting himself to be somebody; a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves to him; who was slain. And all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered and brought to nothing.

verses.name: Acts 5:37
verses.text: After this one, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the Registration, and drew away considerable people after him. Yet that one perished; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered.

verses.name: Acts 5:38
verses.text: And now I say to you, withdraw from these men and let them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will come to nothing.

verses.name: Acts 5:39
verses.text: But if it is of God, you cannot overthrow it, lest perhaps you be found even to fight against God.

verses.name: Acts 5:40
verses.text: And they obeyed him. And calling the apostles, beating <hi>them</hi>, they commanded not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

verses.name: Acts 5:41
verses.text: Then indeed they departed from <hi>the</hi> presence of the sanhedrin, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to be shamed for His name.

verses.name: Acts 5:42
verses.text: And every day in the temple, and from house to house, they did not cease teaching and preaching the gospel: Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:1
verses.text: And in those days, the disciples having multiplied, a murmuring of the Hellenists against the Hebrews occurred, because their widows were overlooked in the daily serving.

verses.name: Acts 6:2
verses.text: And the Twelve called near the multitude of the disciples and said, It is not pleasing to us, leaving the Word of God, to serve tables.

verses.name: Acts 6:3
verses.text: Therefore, brothers, look out among you seven <hi>men</hi> being witnessed to, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this duty.

verses.name: Acts 6:4
verses.text: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the Word.

verses.name: Acts 6:5
verses.text: And the saying pleased all the multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicholas, a proselyte of Antioch.

verses.name: Acts 6:6
verses.text: They set these before the apostles. And having prayed, they laid hands on them.

verses.name: Acts 6:7
verses.text: And the word of God was increasing. And the number of the disciples in Jerusalem was multiplying exceedingly; even a great crowd of the priests obeyed the faith.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:8
verses.text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

verses.name: Acts 6:9
verses.text: Then there arose certain of the synagogue which is called <hi>the synagogue</hi> of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of those from Cilicia and from Asia, disputing with Stephen.

verses.name: Acts 6:10
verses.text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

verses.name: Acts 6:11
verses.text: And they induced men <hi>to be</hi> saying, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.

verses.name: Acts 6:12
verses.text: And they stirred up the people and the elders and the scribes. And coming on, they seized him and brought him to the sanhedrin.

verses.name: Acts 6:13
verses.text: And they set up false witnesses, who said, This man does not cease speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the Law.

verses.name: Acts 6:14
verses.text: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered to us.

verses.name: Acts 6:15
verses.text: And looking intently at him. all those sitting in the sanhedrin saw his face as if <hi>it were the</hi> face of an angel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:1
verses.text: Then the high priest said, Then do you so hold these things?

verses.name: Acts 7:2
verses.text: And he said, Men, brothers, and fathers, listen: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran.

verses.name: Acts 7:3
verses.text: And He said to him, "Go out from your land and from your kindred, and come into a land which I shall show you."

verses.name: Acts 7:4
verses.text: Then he came out of <hi>the</hi> land of the Chaldeans and lived in Haran. And from there, when his father was dead, he moved into this land in which you now dwell.

verses.name: Acts 7:5
verses.text: And He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not <hi>even</hi> a foot-breadth. And <hi>He</hi> promised that He would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, there being no child to him.

verses.name: Acts 7:6
verses.text: And God spoke in this way, that his seed would be a tenant in another land, and that they would enslave it and oppress <hi>it</hi> four hundred years.

verses.name: Acts 7:7
verses.text: And God said, "I will judge the nation to whom they shall be in bondage," and "after these things they will come out and will serve Me in this place."

verses.name: Acts 7:8
verses.text: And He gave him the covenant of circumcision. And so <hi>Abraham</hi> fathered Isaac and circumcised him the eighth day. And Isaac <hi>fathered</hi> Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.

verses.name: Acts 7:9
verses.text: And being jealous of Joseph, the patriarchs sold <hi>Joseph</hi> into Egypt. But God was with him

verses.name: Acts 7:10
verses.text: and plucked him out from all his afflictions, and He gave him favor and wisdom over against Pharaoh king of Egypt. And he appointed him governor over Egypt and all his household.

verses.name: Acts 7:11
verses.text: But a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and a great affliction. And our fathers found no food.

verses.name: Acts 7:12
verses.text: But hearing grain was in Egypt, Jacob sent out our fathers first.

verses.name: Acts 7:13
verses.text: And at the second <hi>time</hi> Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph's race was made known to Pharaoh.

verses.name: Acts 7:14
verses.text: And seeing, Joseph called his father Jacob, and all his kindred, seventy-five souls.

verses.name: Acts 7:15
verses.text: And Jacob went down into Egypt and died, he and our fathers,

verses.name: Acts 7:16
verses.text: and were carried over into Shechem. And they were laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price of silver from the sons of Emmor <hi>the father</hi> of Shechem.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:17
verses.text: But as the time was drawing near, of the promise which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

verses.name: Acts 7:18
verses.text: until another king arose who did not know Joseph.

verses.name: Acts 7:19
verses.text: Dealing subtly with our race, this one oppressed our fathers, causing their infants <hi>to be</hi> exposed, <hi>so as</hi> not to be left alive.

verses.name: Acts 7:20
verses.text: In this time Moses was born, and was beautiful to God, who was brought up three months in his father's house.

verses.name: Acts 7:21
verses.text: And he being cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up and reared him for a son to her.

verses.name: Acts 7:22
verses.text: And Moses was learned in all <hi>the</hi> wisdom of the Egyptians and was mighty in words and in deeds.

verses.name: Acts 7:23
verses.text: And when a period of forty years was fulfilled to him, it arose in his heart to look upon his brothers, the sons of Israel.

verses.name: Acts 7:24
verses.text: And seeing one being wronged, he defended <hi>him</hi>. and avenged him who was oppressed and struck the Egyptian.

verses.name: Acts 7:25
verses.text: For he thought his brothers <hi>would</hi> understand that God would give them deliverance by his hand. But they did not understand.

verses.name: Acts 7:26
verses.text: And the next day he appeared to them <hi>while</hi> fighting. And he urged them to peace, saying, Men, you are brothers, why do you wrong one another?

verses.name: Acts 7:27
verses.text: But he who wronged his neighbor thrust him away, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

verses.name: Acts 7:28
verses.text: Will you not kill me as you did the Egyptian yesterday?

verses.name: Acts 7:29
verses.text: And Moses fled at this word, and became a temporary resident in the land of Midian, where he fathered two sons.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:30
verses.text: And forty years being fulfilled to him, <hi>the</hi> Angel of <hi>the</hi> Lord appeared to him in the desert of Mount Sinai in a flame of fire in a bush.

verses.name: Acts 7:31
verses.text: And seeing <hi>it</hi>, Moses marveled at the sight. And as he drew near to see, the voice of <hi>the</hi> Lord came to him:

verses.name: Acts 7:32
verses.text: <hi> saying</hi>, "I <hi>am</hi> the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." But Moses trembled and dared not look.

verses.name: Acts 7:33
verses.text: Then the Lord said to him, "Loosen the sandal on your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground."

verses.name: Acts 7:34
verses.text: "I have seen, the affliction of My people in Egypt, and I have heard their groan; and I came down to pluck them out. And now come, I will send you into Egypt."

verses.name: Acts 7:35
verses.text: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? God has sent this one <hi>to be</hi> a ruler and a redeemer by <hi>the</hi> hand of <hi>the</hi> Angel who appeared to him in the Bush.

verses.name: Acts 7:36
verses.text: He brought them out after he had worked wonders and miracles in <hi>the</hi> land of Egypt and in <hi>the</hi> Red Sea and in the wilderness forty years.

verses.name: Acts 7:37
verses.text: This is that Moses who said to the sons of Israel, "<hi> The</hi> Lord your God shall raise up a Prophet to you from your brothers, <hi>One</hi> like me; you shall hear Him."

verses.name: Acts 7:38
verses.text: This is he who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the Angel who spoke to him in Mount Sinai, and <hi>with</hi> our fathers, who received the living words to give to us,

verses.name: Acts 7:39
verses.text: to whom our fathers would not be obedient, but thrust <hi>him</hi> away and turned back again to Egypt in their hearts,

verses.name: Acts 7:40
verses.text: saying to Aaron, "Make us gods to go before us, for <hi>as for</hi> this Moses who brought us out of <hi>the</hi> land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him."

verses.name: Acts 7:41
verses.text: And they made a calf in those days and offered sacrifice to the idol and rejoiced in the work of their own hands.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:42
verses.text: Then God turned and gave them over to serve the host of the heavens, as it is written in <hi>the</hi> book of the Prophets: "O house of Israel, have you offered to Me slain beasts and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness?

verses.name: Acts 7:43
verses.text: Yea, you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, images which you made in order to worship them; and I will remove you beyond Babylon."

verses.name: Acts 7:44
verses.text: The tabernacle of witness was among our fathers in the wilderness, as commanded <hi>by God</hi>, speaking to Moses to make it according to the pattern that he had seen.

verses.name: Acts 7:45
verses.text: Which also having received it by inheritance with Joshua, our fathers, with Joshua, in taking possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers until the days of David,

verses.name: Acts 7:46
verses.text: who found favor with God and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob;

verses.name: Acts 7:47
verses.text: but Solomon built Him a house.

verses.name: Acts 7:48
verses.text: But, the Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

verses.name: Acts 7:49
verses.text: "Heaven <hi>is</hi> My throne and earth <hi>is</hi> My footstool. What house will you build Me, says <hi>the</hi> Lord, or what <hi>is</hi> the place of My rest?

verses.name: Acts 7:50
verses.text: Has not My hand made all these things?"  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:51
