verses.name: Romans 7:10
verses.text: And the commandment, which <hi>was</hi> to life, was found <hi>to be</hi> death to me.

verses.name: Romans 7:11
verses.text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it killed <hi>me</hi>.

verses.name: Romans 7:12
verses.text: So indeed the Law <hi>is</hi> holy, and the commandment is holy and just and good.

verses.name: Romans 7:13
verses.text: Then has that <hi>which is</hi> good become death to me? Let it not be! But sin, that it might appear <hi>to be</hi> sin, working death in me by <hi>that which is</hi> good; in order that sin might become exceedingly sinful by the commandment.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:14
verses.text: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am carnal, sold under sin.

verses.name: Romans 7:15
verses.text: For that which I do, I know not. For what I desire, that I do not do; but what I hate, that I do.

verses.name: Romans 7:16
verses.text: If then I do that which I do not desire, I consent to the law that <hi>it is</hi> good.

verses.name: Romans 7:17
verses.text: But now it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.

verses.name: Romans 7:18
verses.text: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh) dwells no good thing. For to will is present with me, but <hi>how</hi> to perform <hi>that which is</hi> good I do not find.

verses.name: Romans 7:19
verses.text: For I do not do the good that I desire; but the evil which I do not will, that I do.

verses.name: Romans 7:20
verses.text: But if I do what I do not desire, <hi>it is</hi> no more I working it out, but sin dwelling in me.

verses.name: Romans 7:21
verses.text: I find then a law: when I will to do the right, evil is present with me.

verses.name: Romans 7:22
verses.text: For I delight in the law of God according to the inward man;

verses.name: Romans 7:23
verses.text: but I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin being in my members.

verses.name: Romans 7:24
verses.text: O wretched man <hi>that</hi> I <hi>am</hi>! Who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

verses.name: Romans 7:25
verses.text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God, but with the flesh the law of sin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:1
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> therefore now no condemnation to those <hi>who are</hi> in Christ Jesus, who walk not according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:2
verses.text: But the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.name: Romans 8:3
verses.text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh;

verses.name: Romans 8:4
verses.text: so that the righteousness of the Law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:5
verses.text: For they who are according to the flesh mind the things of flesh, but they who are according to the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:6
verses.text: For to be carnally minded <hi>is</hi> death, but to be spiritually minded <hi>is</hi> life and peace

verses.name: Romans 8:7
verses.text: because the carnal mind <hi>is</hi> enmity against God, for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can <hi>it be</hi>.

verses.name: Romans 8:8
verses.text: So then they who are in the flesh cannot please God.

verses.name: Romans 8:9
verses.text: But you are not in the flesh, but in <hi>the</hi> Spirit, if <hi>the</hi> Spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone has not <hi>the</hi> Spirit of Christ, he is none of His.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:10
verses.text: And if Christ <hi>is</hi> in you, indeed the body <hi>is</hi> dead because of sin, but the Spirit <hi>is</hi> life because of righteousness.

verses.name: Romans 8:11
verses.text: But if the Spirit of the <hi>One</hi> who raised up Jesus from <hi>the</hi> dead dwells in you, the <hi>One</hi> who raised up Christ from <hi>the</hi> dead shall also make your mortal bodies alive by His Spirit who dwells in you.

verses.name: Romans 8:12
verses.text: Therefore, brothers, we are not debtors to the flesh, to live according to the flesh.

verses.name: Romans 8:13
verses.text: For if you live according to the flesh, you shall die. But if you through <hi>the</hi> Spirit mortify the deeds of the body, you shall live.

verses.name: Romans 8:14
verses.text: For as many as are led by <hi>the</hi> Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:15
verses.text: For you have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption by which we cry, Abba, Father!

verses.name: Romans 8:16
verses.text: The Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are the children of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:17
verses.text: And if we are children, then we are heirs; heirs of God and joint-heirs with Christ; so that if we suffer with <hi>Him</hi>, we may also be glorified together.

verses.name: Romans 8:18
verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time <hi>are</hi> not worthy <hi>to be compared</hi> with the coming glory to be revealed in us.

verses.name: Romans 8:19
verses.text: For the earnest expectation of the creation waits for the manifestation of the sons of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:20
verses.text: For the creation was not willingly subjected to vanity, but because of Him who subjected <hi>it</hi> on hope

verses.name: Romans 8:21
verses.text: that the creation itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:22
verses.text: And we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

verses.name: Romans 8:23
verses.text: And not only <hi>so</hi>, but ourselves also, who have the firstfruit of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, awaiting adoption, the redemption of our body.

verses.name: Romans 8:24
verses.text: For we are saved by hope. But hope that is seen is not hope; for what anyone sees, why does he also hope <hi>for it</hi>?

verses.name: Romans 8:25
verses.text: But if we hope for that which we do not see, <hi>then</hi> we wait for it with patience.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:26
verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helps our infirmities. For we do not know what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.name: Romans 8:27
verses.text: And He searching the hearts knows what <hi>is</hi> the mind of the Spirit, because He makes intercession for the saints according to <hi>the will of</hi> God.

verses.name: Romans 8:28
verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to <hi>His</hi> purpose.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:29
verses.text: For whom He foreknew, He also predestinated <hi>to be</hi> conformed to the image of His Son, for Him to be <hi>the</hi> First-born among many brothers.

verses.name: Romans 8:30
verses.text: But whom He predestinated, these He also called; and whom He called, those He also justified. And whom He justified, these He also glorified.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:31
verses.text: What then shall we say to these things? If God <hi>is</hi> for us, who <hi>can be</hi> against us?

verses.name: Romans 8:32
verses.text: Truly <hi>He</hi> who did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all, how shall He not with Him also freely give us all things?

verses.name: Romans 8:33
verses.text: Who shall lay anything to the charge of God's elect? <hi>It is</hi> God who justifies.

verses.name: Romans 8:34
verses.text: Who <hi>is</hi> he condemning? <hi>It is</hi> Christ who has died, but rather also <hi>who is</hi> raised, who is also at <hi>the</hi> right <hi>hand</hi> of God, who also intercedes for us.

verses.name: Romans 8:35
verses.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? <hi>Shall</hi> tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

verses.name: Romans 8:36
verses.text: As it is written, "For Your sake we are killed all the day long. We are counted as sheep of slaughter."

verses.name: Romans 8:37
verses.text: But in all these things we more than conquer through Him who loved us.

verses.name: Romans 8:38
verses.text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

verses.name: Romans 8:39
verses.text: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:1
verses.text: I tell <hi>the</hi> truth in Christ, I do not lie, my conscience also bearing me witness in <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Romans 9:2
verses.text: that I have great heaviness and continual pain in my heart.

verses.name: Romans 9:3
verses.text: For I myself was wishing to be accursed from Christ for my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh,

verses.name: Romans 9:4
verses.text: who are Israelites; to whom <hi>belong</hi> the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the Law, and the service <hi>of God</hi>, and the promises;

verses.name: Romans 9:5
verses.text: whose <hi>are</hi> the fathers, and of whom <hi>is</hi> the Christ according to flesh, He being God over all, blessed forever. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:6
verses.text: Not however that the word of God has failed, for not all those of Israel <hi>are</hi> Israel;

verses.name: Romans 9:7
verses.text: nor because they are the seed of Abraham <hi>are they</hi> all children. But, "In Isaac shall your Seed be called."

verses.name: Romans 9:8
verses.text: That is, not the children of the flesh <hi>are</hi> children of God; but the children of the promise <hi>are</hi> counted for a seed.

verses.name: Romans 9:9
verses.text: For this <hi>is</hi> the word of promise: "At this time I will come and Sarah shall have a son."

verses.name: Romans 9:10
verses.text: And not only <hi>this</hi>, but when Rebekah also had conceived by one, by our father Isaac

verses.name: Romans 9:11
verses.text: (for <hi>the children</hi> had not yet been born, neither had done any good or evil; but that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works but of Him who called,)

verses.name: Romans 9:12
verses.text: it was said to her, "The elder shall serve the younger."

verses.name: Romans 9:13
verses.text: As it is written, "Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:14
verses.text: What shall we say then? <hi>Is there</hi> not unrighteousness with God? Let it not be!

verses.name: Romans 9:15
verses.text: For He said to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion."

verses.name: Romans 9:16
verses.text: So then <hi>it is</hi> not of the <hi>one</hi> willing, nor of the <hi>one</hi> running, but of God, the <hi>One</hi> showing mercy.

verses.name: Romans 9:17
verses.text: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "Even for this same purpose I have raised you up, that I might show My power in you, and that My name might be declared throughout all the earth."

verses.name: Romans 9:18
verses.text: Therefore He has mercy on whom He will <hi>have mercy</hi>, and whom He will, He hardens.

verses.name: Romans 9:19
verses.text: You will then say to me, Why does He yet find fault? For who has resisted His will?

verses.name: Romans 9:20
verses.text: No, but, O man, who are you who replies against God? Shall the thing formed say to Him who formed <hi>it</hi>, Why have you made me this way?

verses.name: Romans 9:21
verses.text: Does not the potter have power over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel to honor and another to dishonor?

verses.name: Romans 9:22
verses.text: <hi> What</hi> if God, willing to show His wrath and to make His power known, endured with much long-suffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction;

verses.name: Romans 9:23
verses.text: and that He might make known the riches of His glory on the vessels of mercy which He had before prepared to glory;

verses.name: Romans 9:24
verses.text: whom He also called, not only us, of Jews, but also of the nations?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:25
verses.text: As He also says in Hosea, "I will call those not My people, My people; and those not beloved, Beloved."

verses.name: Romans 9:26
verses.text: And it shall be, in the place where it was said to them. "You <hi>are</hi> not My people; there they shall be called sons of the living God."

verses.name: Romans 9:27
verses.text: Isaiah also cries concerning Israel, "Though the number of the sons of Israel is as the sands of the sea, a remnant shall be saved.

verses.name: Romans 9:28
verses.text: For <hi>He is</hi> bringing <hi>the</hi> matter to an end, and cutting short in righteousness, because <hi>the</hi> Lord will make a short work on the earth."

verses.name: Romans 9:29
verses.text: And as Isaiah said before, "Unless the Lord of hosts had left us a seed, we would have been as Sodom, and would have been like Gomorrah."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:30
verses.text: What shall we say then? That the nations, who did not follow after righteousness have taken on righteousness, but a righteousness of faith.

verses.name: Romans 9:31
verses.text: But Israel, who followed after a law of righteousness did not arrive at a law of righteousness.

verses.name: Romans 9:32
verses.text: Why? Because <hi>it was</hi> not of faith, but as it were by the works of the Law. For they stumbled at that Stumbling-stone;

verses.name: Romans 9:33
verses.text: as it is written, "Behold, I lay in Zion a Stumbling-stone and a Rock-of-offense, and everyone believing on Him shall not be put to shame."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:1
verses.text: Brothers, truly my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is for <hi>it</hi> to be saved.

verses.name: Romans 10:2
verses.text: For I bear record to them that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

verses.name: Romans 10:3
verses.text: For they, being ignorant of God's righteousness and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves to the righteousness of God.

verses.name: Romans 10:4
verses.text: For Christ <hi>is</hi> the end of the law for righteousness for everyone who believes.

verses.name: Romans 10:5
verses.text: For Moses writes <hi>of</hi> the righteousness <hi>which</hi> is of the Law, "The man who does those things shall live by them."

verses.name: Romans 10:6
verses.text: But the righteousness of faith says this: "Do not say in your heart, Who shall ascend into Heaven?" that is, to bring Christ down;

verses.name: Romans 10:7
verses.text: or "Who shall descend into the deep?"; that is, to bring up Christ again from <hi>the</hi> dead.

verses.name: Romans 10:8
verses.text: But what does it say? "The word is near you, <hi>even</hi> in your mouth and in your heart"; that is, the word of faith which we proclaim;

verses.name: Romans 10:9
verses.text: Because if you confess the Lord Jesus, and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from <hi>the</hi> dead, you shall be saved.

verses.name: Romans 10:10
verses.text: For with <hi>the</hi> heart <hi>one</hi> believes unto righteousness, and with <hi>the</hi> mouth <hi>one</hi> confesses unto salvation.

verses.name: Romans 10:11
verses.text: For the Scripture says, "Everyone believing on Him shall not be put to shame."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:12
verses.text: For there is no difference both of Jew and of Greek, for the same Lord over all is rich to all who call on Him.

verses.name: Romans 10:13
verses.text: For everyone, "whoever shall call on the name of <hi>the</hi> Lord will be saved."

verses.name: Romans 10:14
verses.text: How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without preaching?

verses.name: Romans 10:15
verses.text: And how shall they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful <hi>are</hi> the feet of those who preach the gospel of peace and bring glad tidings of good things!"

verses.name: Romans 10:16
verses.text: But <hi>they have</hi> not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"

verses.name: Romans 10:17
verses.text: Then faith <hi>is</hi> of hearing, and hearing by the Word of God.

verses.name: Romans 10:18
verses.text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes indeed, their voice went out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world.

verses.name: Romans 10:19
verses.text: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses says, "I will provoke you to jealousy by <hi>those who are</hi> no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you."

verses.name: Romans 10:20
verses.text: But Isaiah <hi>is</hi> very bold and says, "I was found by those who did not seek Me, I became known to those who did not ask after Me."

verses.name: Romans 10:21
verses.text: But to Israel He says, "All day long I have stretched forth My hands to a disobeying and gainsaying people."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:1
verses.text: I say then, Did not God put away His people? Let it not be <hi>said</hi>! For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of <hi>the</hi> tribe of Benjamin.

verses.name: Romans 11:2
verses.text: God did not thrust out His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture said in Elijah, how he pleaded with God against Israel, saying,

verses.name: Romans 11:3
verses.text: "Lord, they killed Your prophets and dug down Your altars, and I am left alone, and they seek my life."

verses.name: Romans 11:4
verses.text: But what does the Divine answer say to him? "I have reserved to Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

verses.name: Romans 11:5
verses.text: Even so then, also in this present time a remnant according to the election of grace has come into being.

verses.name: Romans 11:6
verses.text: But if by grace, then <hi>it is</hi> no more of works; otherwise grace is no more grace. But if <hi>it is</hi> of works, then it is no more of grace; otherwise work is no more work.

verses.name: Romans 11:7
verses.text: What then? Israel has not obtained that which it seeks, but the election obtained <hi>it</hi>, and the rest were hardened

verses.name: Romans 11:8
verses.text: even as it is written, "God gave to them a spirit of slumber, eyes not seeing, and ears not hearing" until this day.

verses.name: Romans 11:9
verses.text: And David said, "Let their table become for a snare and a trap and a stumbling block and a recompense to them.

verses.name: Romans 11:10
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened so that they may not see, and their back always bowing."

verses.name: Romans 11:11
verses.text: I say then, Did they not stumble that they fall? Let it not be! But by their slipping away came salvation to the nations, to provoke them to jealousy.

verses.name: Romans 11:12
verses.text: But if their slipping away <hi>is</hi> the riches of <hi>the</hi> world, and their default is <hi>the</hi> riches of <hi>the</hi> nations, how much more their fullness?

verses.name: Romans 11:13
verses.text: For I speak to you, the nations; since I am the apostle of the nations, I glorify my ministry;

verses.name: Romans 11:14
verses.text: if by any means I may provoke <hi>those who are</hi> my flesh to jealousy, and might save some of them.

verses.name: Romans 11:15
verses.text: For if their casting away <hi>is the</hi> reconciling of <hi>the</hi> world, what <hi>is</hi> the reception except life from <hi>the</hi> dead?

verses.name: Romans 11:16
verses.text: For if the firstfruit <hi>is</hi> holy, the lump <hi>is</hi> also <hi>holy</hi>; and if the root <hi>is</hi> holy, also the branches.

verses.name: Romans 11:17
verses.text: And if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them, and became a sharer of the root and the fatness of the olive tree with them,

verses.name: Romans 11:18
verses.text: do not boast against the branches. But if you boast, <hi>it is</hi> not you <hi>that</hi> bears the root, but the root bears you.

verses.name: Romans 11:19
verses.text: You will say then, The branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.

verses.name: Romans 11:20
verses.text: Well, because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Do not <hi>be</hi> high-minded, but fear.

verses.name: Romans 11:21
verses.text: For if God did not spare the natural branches, <hi>fear</hi> lest He also may not spare you either!

verses.name: Romans 11:22
verses.text: Behold then <hi>the</hi> kindness, and <hi>the</hi> severity of God; on those having fallen, severity; but on you, kindness, if you continue in the kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.

verses.name: Romans 11:23
verses.text: And those also, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in. For God is able to graft them in again.

verses.name: Romans 11:24
verses.text: For if you were cut out of the natural wild olive <hi>tree</hi>, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive <hi>tree</hi>; how much more these <hi>being</hi> according to nature will be grafted into <hi>their</hi> own olive-tree?

verses.name: Romans 11:25
verses.text: For I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, lest you should be wise within yourselves; that blindness in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the nations has comes in.

verses.name: Romans 11:26
verses.text: And so all Israel shall be saved; as it is written, "There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer, and He will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

verses.name: Romans 11:27
verses.text: For this <hi>is</hi> My covenant with them, when I have taken away their sins."

verses.name: Romans 11:28
verses.text: Indeed as regards the gospel, <hi>they are</hi> enemies for your sakes. But as regards the election, <hi>they are</hi> beloved for the fathers' sakes.

verses.name: Romans 11:29
verses.text: For the free gifts and calling of God <hi>are</hi> without repentance.

verses.name: Romans 11:30
verses.text: For as you also then disbelieved God, but now have been shown mercy through their disbelief,

verses.name: Romans 11:31
verses.text: even so these also have not believed now, so that through your mercy they may also obtain mercy.

verses.name: Romans 11:32
verses.text: For God has shut up all in unbelief, so that He might show mercy to all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:33
verses.text: O <hi>the</hi> depth of <hi>the</hi> riches both of <hi>the</hi> wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable <hi>are</hi> His judgments, and His ways past finding out!

verses.name: Romans 11:34
verses.text: For who has known the mind of <hi>the</hi> Lord, or who became His counselor?

verses.name: Romans 11:35
verses.text: Or who first gave to Him, and it will be repaid to him?

verses.name: Romans 11:36
verses.text: For of Him and through Him and to Him <hi>are</hi> all things; to Him be glory forever! Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:1
verses.text: I beseech you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God, <hi>which is</hi> your reasonable service.

verses.name: Romans 12:2
verses.text: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, in order to prove by you what <hi>is</hi> that good and pleasing and perfect will of God.

verses.name: Romans 12:3
verses.text: For I say, through the grace given to me, to every one who is among you, not to think <hi>of himself</hi> more highly than he ought to think. But set your mind to be right-minded, even as God has dealt to every man the measure of faith.

verses.name: Romans 12:4
verses.text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all members do not have the same function,

verses.name: Romans 12:5
verses.text: so we the many are one body in Christ, and each one members of one another.

verses.name: Romans 12:6
verses.text: Then having gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;

verses.name: Romans 12:7
verses.text: or ministry, in the ministry; or <hi>he who</hi> teaches, in the teaching;

verses.name: Romans 12:8
verses.text: or he who exhorts, in the encouragement; or he who shares, in simplicity; or he who takes the lead, in diligence; or he who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.

verses.name: Romans 12:9
verses.text: <hi> Let</hi> love <hi>be</hi> without hypocrisy, shrinking from evil, cleaving to good;

verses.name: Romans 12:10
verses.text: in brotherly love to one another, loving fervently, having led one another in honor.

verses.name: Romans 12:11
verses.text: As to diligence, not slothful, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

verses.name: Romans 12:12
verses.text: rejoicing in hope, patient in affliction, steadfastly continuing in prayer,

verses.name: Romans 12:13
verses.text: distributing to the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.

verses.name: Romans 12:14
verses.text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and do not curse.

verses.name: Romans 12:15
verses.text: Rejoice with rejoicing ones, and weep with weeping ones;

verses.name: Romans 12:16
verses.text: minding the same thing toward one another, not minding high things, but yielding to the lowly. Do not be wise within yourselves.

verses.name: Romans 12:17
verses.text: Repay no one evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

verses.name: Romans 12:18
verses.text: If <hi>it is</hi> possible, as far as <hi>is</hi> in you, seeking peace with all men.

verses.name: Romans 12:19
verses.text: not avenging yourselves, beloved, but giving place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance <hi>is</hi> Mine, I will repay, says <hi>the</hi> Lord."

verses.name: Romans 12:20
verses.text: Therefore if your enemy hungers, feed him. If he thirsts, give him drink. For <hi>in so</hi> doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.

verses.name: Romans 12:21
verses.text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:1
verses.text: Let every soul be subject to the higher authorities. For there is no authority but of God; the authorities that exist are ordained by God.

verses.name: Romans 13:2
verses.text: So that the one resisting the authority resists the ordinance of God; and the ones who resist will receive judgment to themselves.

verses.name: Romans 13:3
verses.text: For the rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the bad. And do you desire to be not afraid of the authority? Do the good, and you shall have praise from it.

verses.name: Romans 13:4
verses.text: For it is a servant of God to you for good. For if you practice evil, be afraid, for it does not bear the sword in vain; for it is a servant of God, a revenger for wrath on him who does evil.

verses.name: Romans 13:5
verses.text: Therefore <hi>you</hi> must be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

verses.name: Romans 13:6
verses.text: For because of this you also pay taxes. For they are God's servants, always giving attention to this very thing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:7
verses.text: Therefore give to all <hi>their</hi> dues; to the <hi>one due</hi> tax, the tax; tribute to whom tribute <hi>is due</hi>, fear to whom fear <hi>is due</hi>, and honor to whom honor <hi>is due</hi>.

verses.name: Romans 13:8
verses.text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves another has fulfilled the law.

verses.name: Romans 13:9
verses.text: For: "Do not commit adultery; do not murder; do not steal; do not bear false witness; do not lust;" and if <hi>there is</hi> any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.name: Romans 13:10
verses.text: Love works no ill to its neighbor, therefore love <hi>is</hi> the fulfilling of the law.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:11
verses.text: This also, knowing the time, that <hi>it is</hi> already time to awake out of sleep; for now our salvation <hi>is</hi> nearer than when we believed.

verses.name: Romans 13:12
verses.text: The night <hi>is</hi> far spent, the day is at hand; therefore let us cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.

verses.name: Romans 13:13
verses.text: Let us walk becomingly, as in <hi>the</hi> day; not in carousings and drinking; not in co-habitation and lustful acts; not in strife and envy.

verses.name: Romans 13:14
verses.text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not take thought beforehand for the lusts of the flesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:1
verses.text: And receive him who is weak in the faith, <hi>but</hi> not to judgments of <hi>your</hi> thoughts.

verses.name: Romans 14:2
verses.text: For indeed one believes to eat all things; but being weak, <hi>another</hi> eats vegetables.

verses.name: Romans 14:3
verses.text: Do not let him who eats despise him who does not eat; and do not let him who does not eat judge him who eats, for God has received him.

verses.name: Romans 14:4
verses.text: Who are you that judges another's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. But he will stand, for God is able to make him stand.

verses.name: Romans 14:5
verses.text: One indeed esteems a day above <hi>another</hi> day; and <hi>another</hi> esteems every day <hi>alike</hi>. Let each one be fully assured in his own mind.

verses.name: Romans 14:6
verses.text: He who regards the day regards <hi>it</hi> to the Lord; and he not regarding the day, does not regard <hi>it</hi> to the Lord. He who eats, eats to <hi>the</hi> Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he who does not eat, does not eat to <hi> the</hi> Lord, and gives God thanks.

verses.name: Romans 14:7
verses.text: For none of us lives to himself, and no one dies to himself.

verses.name: Romans 14:8
verses.text: For both if we live, we live to <hi>the</hi> Lord; and if we die, we die to <hi>the</hi> Lord. Therefore both if we live, and if we die, we are the Lord's.

verses.name: Romans 14:9
verses.text: For this Christ both died and rose and lived again, that He might be Lord both of <hi>the</hi> dead and living.

verses.name: Romans 14:10
verses.text: But why do you judge your brother? Or also why do you despise your brother? For all shall stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

verses.name: Romans 14:11
verses.text: For it is written, "<hi> As</hi> I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to Me, and every tongue shall confess to God."

verses.name: Romans 14:12
verses.text: So then each one of us will give account concerning himself to God.

verses.name: Romans 14:13
verses.text: Then let us not judge one another any more, but rather judge this, not to put a stumbling-block or an offense toward his brother.

verses.name: Romans 14:14
verses.text: I know and am persuaded in <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus, that nothing by itself <hi>is</hi> common; except to him who esteems anything to be common, <hi>it is</hi> common.

verses.name: Romans 14:15
verses.text: But if your brother is grieved with <hi>your</hi> food, you no longer walk according to love. Do not with your food destroy him for whom Christ died.

verses.name: Romans 14:16
verses.text: Then do not let your good be spoken evil of,

verses.name: Romans 14:17
verses.text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 14:18
verses.text: For he who serves Christ in these things <hi>is</hi> well-pleasing to God, and approved by men.

verses.name: Romans 14:19
verses.text: So then let us pursue the things of peace, and the things for building up one another.

verses.name: Romans 14:20
verses.text: Do not undo the work of God for food. Truly, all things indeed <hi>are</hi> clean, but <hi>it is</hi> bad to the man eating because of a stumbling-block.

verses.name: Romans 14:21
verses.text: <hi> It is</hi> good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor <hi>anything</hi> by which your brother stumbles, or is offended, or is made weak.

verses.name: Romans 14:22
verses.text: Do you have faith? Have <hi>it</hi> to yourself before God. Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who does not condemn himself in what he approves.

verses.name: Romans 14:23
verses.text: But, the one doubting, if he eats, <hi>he</hi> has been condemned, because it is not of faith; and all that <hi>is</hi> not of faith is sin.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:1
verses.text: Then we who are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

verses.name: Romans 15:2
verses.text: Let every one of us please <hi>his</hi> neighbor for <hi>his</hi> good, to building up.

verses.name: Romans 15:3
verses.text: For even Christ did not please Himself; but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me."

verses.name: Romans 15:4
verses.text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, so that we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:5
verses.text: And may the God of patience and consolation grant you to be like minded toward one another according to Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Romans 15:6
verses.text: so that with one mind <hi>and</hi> one mouth you may glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:7
verses.text: Therefore receive one another as Christ also received us, to <hi>the</hi> glory of God.

verses.name: Romans 15:8
verses.text: And I say, Jesus Christ has become a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises <hi>made</hi> to the fathers,

verses.name: Romans 15:9
verses.text: and that the nations might glorify God for <hi>His</hi> mercy, as it is written, "For this cause I will confess to You in the nations, and I will praise Your name."

verses.name: Romans 15:10
verses.text: And again He says, "Rejoice, O nations, with His people."

verses.name: Romans 15:11
verses.text: And again, "Praise the Lord, all the nations, and praise Him, all the peoples."

verses.name: Romans 15:12
verses.text: And again Isaiah says, "There shall be a root of Jesse, and He who shall rise to reign over the nations, in Him shall the nations trust."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:13
verses.text: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope through the power of <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:14
verses.text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brothers, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

verses.name: Romans 15:15
verses.text: But, brothers, I wrote to you boldly, as reminding you in part, because of the grace that is given to me by God,

verses.name: Romans 15:16
verses.text: that I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the nations, ministering the gospel of God, so that the offering up of the nations might be acceptable, being sanctified by <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:17
verses.text: Therefore I have boasting in Christ Jesus <hi>as to</hi> the things pertaining to God.

verses.name: Romans 15:18
verses.text: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ did not work out by me for <hi>the</hi> obedience of the nations in word and deed,

verses.name: Romans 15:19
verses.text: in power of miracles and wonders, in power of <hi>the</hi> Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem, and all around to Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

verses.name: Romans 15:20
verses.text: Yea, so I have been eager to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build on another man's foundation;

verses.name: Romans 15:21
verses.text: but as it is written, "To whom nothing was said about Him, they shall see. And they who have not heard shall understand."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:22
verses.text: For this cause I also have been greatly hindered from coming to you.

verses.name: Romans 15:23
verses.text: But now, having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come to you,

verses.name: Romans 15:24
verses.text: whenever I may go into Spain, I will come to you. For <hi>in</hi> traveling through I hope to see you, and to be set forward there by you, if first I may be filled of you in part.

verses.name: Romans 15:25
verses.text: But now I am going to Jerusalem to minister to the saints.

verses.name: Romans 15:26
verses.text: For it has pleased those of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Romans 15:27
verses.text: Truly it has pleased them, and they are their debtors. For if the nations have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in carnal things.

verses.name: Romans 15:28
verses.text: Therefore when I have completed this, and have sealed this fruit to them, I will come by you into Spain.

verses.name: Romans 15:29
verses.text: And I am sure that when I come to you, I shall come in the fullness of <hi>the</hi> blessing of the gospel of Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:30
verses.text: But I exhort you, brothers, for the sake of the Lord Jesus Christ and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in <hi>your</hi> prayers to God for me,

verses.name: Romans 15:31
verses.text: that I may be delivered from those disbelieving in Judea, and that my service which <hi>I have</hi> for Jerusalem may be accepted by the saints;

verses.name: Romans 15:32
verses.text: so that <hi>I may</hi> come to you with joy by <hi>the</hi> will of God, and may be refreshed with you.

verses.name: Romans 15:33
verses.text: Now may the God of peace <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:1
verses.text: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church in Cenchrea,

verses.name: Romans 16:2
verses.text: that you receive her in <hi>the</hi> Lord, <hi>as</hi> becomes saints, and that you may assist her in whatever business she has need of you. For she has been a helper of many, and of myself also.

verses.name: Romans 16:3
verses.text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my helpers in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Romans 16:4
verses.text: who have laid down their own necks for my life; to whom not only I give thanks, but also the churches of the nations.

verses.name: Romans 16:5
verses.text: Likewise <hi>greet</hi> the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who is the first-fruits of Achaia to Christ.

verses.name: Romans 16:6
verses.text: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labor on us.

verses.name: Romans 16:7
verses.text: Greet Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

verses.name: Romans 16:8
verses.text: Greet Amplias my beloved in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Romans 16:9
verses.text: Greet Urbanus, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

verses.name: Romans 16:10
verses.text: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of Aristobulus' <hi>household</hi>.

verses.name: Romans 16:11
verses.text: Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet those who are of the <hi>household</hi> of Narcissus, who are in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Romans 16:12
verses.text: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labor in <hi>the</hi> Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who labored much in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Romans 16:13
verses.text: Greet Rufus, chosen in <hi>the</hi> Lord, and his mother and mine.

verses.name: Romans 16:14
verses.text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers with them.

verses.name: Romans 16:15
verses.text: Greet Philologus and Julias, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

verses.name: Romans 16:16
verses.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ greet you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:17
verses.text: And I exhort you, brothers, to watch those making divisions and offenses contrary to the doctrine which you have learned, and avoid them.

verses.name: Romans 16:18
verses.text: For they who are such do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches <hi>they</hi> deceive the hearts of the simple.

verses.name: Romans 16:19
verses.text: For your obedience reached to all. Therefore I am glad on your behalf, But I would have you truly wise <hi>as</hi> to good, and simple toward evil.

verses.name: Romans 16:20
verses.text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:21
verses.text: Timothy my fellow worker, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater my kinsmen, greet you.

verses.name: Romans 16:22
verses.text: I, Tertius, who wrote <hi>this</hi> epistle, greet you in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Romans 16:23
verses.text: Gaius my host, and the host of me and the whole church, greets you. Erastus the steward of the city greets you, and Quartus a brother.

verses.name: Romans 16:24
verses.text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:25
verses.text: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ according to the revelation of <hi>the</hi> mystery, having been unvoiced during eternal times;

verses.name: Romans 16:26
verses.text: but now has been made plain, and by the prophetic Scriptures, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith;

verses.name: Romans 16:27
verses.text: to God only wise <hi>be</hi> glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: Paul, a called apostle of Jesus Christ through <hi>the</hi> will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: to the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called-out saints, with all those in every place who call on the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:3
verses.text: Grace <hi>be</hi> to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:4
verses.text: I thank my God always on your behalf <hi>for</hi> the grace of God given you in Jesus Christ,

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:5
verses.text: that in everything you are enriched by Him, <hi>in</hi> all speech and in all knowledge;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: He shall also confirm you to <hi>the</hi> end, <hi>that you may be</hi> blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:9
verses.text: God <hi>is</hi> faithful, by whom you were called to <hi>the</hi> fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:10
verses.text: But I exhort you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, <hi>that</hi> you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you; but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:11
verses.text: For it has been declared to me concerning you, my brothers, by those of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:12
verses.text: But I say this, that every one of you says, I am of Paul, and I of Apollos, and I of Cephas, and I of Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you, or were you baptized in the name of Paul?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:14
verses.text: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: lest any should say that I had baptized in my own name.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: And I also baptized the household of Stephanas. Besides these, I do not know if I baptized any other.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel; not in wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of no effect.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: For the preaching of the cross is foolishness to those being lost, but to us being saved, <hi>it is</hi> the power of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: For it is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will set aside the understanding of the perceiving ones."

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: Where <hi>is the</hi> wise? Where <hi>is</hi> the scribe? Where <hi>is</hi> the lawyer of this world? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world <hi>by</hi> wisdom did not know God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save those who believe.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: For the Jews ask for a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block, and to the Greeks foolishness.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:25
verses.text: Because the foolish thing of God is wiser <hi>than</hi> men, and the weak thing of God is stronger than men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:26
verses.text: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many wise men according to the flesh <hi>are called</hi>, not many mighty, not many noble.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:27
verses.text: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God has chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:28
verses.text: and God has chosen the base things of the world, and things which are despised, and things which are not, in order to bring to nothing things that are;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:29
verses.text: so that no flesh should glory in His presence.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:30
verses.text: But of Him you are in Christ Jesus, who of God is made to us wisdom and righteousness and sanctification and redemption;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:31
verses.text: so that, according as it is written, "He who glories, let him glory in <hi>the</hi> Lord."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: And I, brothers, when I came to you, did not come with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring to you the testimony of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: And I was with you in weakness and in fear, and in much trembling.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: And my speech and my preaching <hi>was</hi> not with enticing words of men's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: so that your faith should not stand in <hi>the</hi> wisdom of men, but in <hi>the</hi> power of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: But, we speak wisdom among those who are perfect; yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, that come to nothing.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: But we speak <hi>the</hi> wisdom of God in a mystery, which God has hidden, predetermining it before the world for our glory;

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:8
verses.text: which none of the rulers of this world knew (for if they had known, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory).

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:9
verses.text: But as it is written, "Eye has not seen, nor ear heard," nor has it entered into the heart of man, "the things which God has prepared for those who love Him."

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:10
verses.text: But God has revealed <hi>them</hi> to us by His Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, yea, the deep things of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:11
verses.text: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of man within him? So also no one knows the things of God except the Spirit of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:12
verses.text: But we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit from God, so that we might know the things that are freely given to us by God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:13
verses.text: These things we also speak, not in words which man's wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:14
verses.text: But the natural man does not receive the things of <hi>the</hi> Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him; neither can he know <hi>them</hi>, because they are spiritually discerned.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:15
verses.text: But he who is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is judged by no man.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:16
verses.text: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct Him? But we have the mind of Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: And I, brothers, could not speak to you as to spiritual ones, but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:2
verses.text: I have fed you with milk and not with solid food, for you were not yet able <hi>to bear it</hi>; nor are you able even now.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:3
verses.text: For you are yet carnal. For in that <hi>there is</hi> among you envyings and strife and divisions, are you not carnal, and <hi>do you not</hi> walk according to men?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:4
verses.text: For while one says, I am of Paul; and another, I <hi>am</hi> of Apollos; are you not carnal?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:5
verses.text: Who then is Paul, and who <hi>is</hi> Apollos, but ministers by whom you believed, even to each the Lord gave?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:6
verses.text: I have planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:7
verses.text: So then neither is he who plants anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:8
verses.text: So he planting, and he watering, are one, and each one shall receive <hi>his</hi> own reward according to <hi>his</hi> own labor.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:9
verses.text: For we are fellow-workers of God, a field of God, and you are a building of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:10
verses.text: According to the grace of God which is given to me, as a wise master builder, I have laid the foundation, and another builds <hi>on it</hi>. But let every man be careful how he builds <hi>on it</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:11
verses.text: For any other foundation can no one lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:12
verses.text: And if anyone builds on this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble,

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:13
verses.text: each one's work shall be revealed. For the Day shall declare <hi>it</hi>, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try each one's work as to what kind it is.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: If anyone's work which he built remains, he shall receive a reward.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:15
verses.text: If anyone's work shall be burned up, he shall suffer loss. But he shall be saved, yet so as by fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: Do you not know that you are a temple of God, and <hi>that</hi> the Spirit of God dwells in you?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:17
verses.text: If anyone defiles the temple of God, God shall destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which you are.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this world, let him become a fool so that he may be wise.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:19
verses.text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God; for it is written, "He takes the wise in their own craftiness."

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:20
verses.text: And again, "<hi> The</hi> Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:21
verses.text: Therefore let no one glory in men. For all things are yours,

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:22
verses.text: whether it is Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or <hi>the</hi> world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours,

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:23
verses.text: and you are Christ's, and Christ <hi>is</hi> God's.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: So let a man think of us as ministers of Christ and stewards of <hi>the</hi> mysteries of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: And the rest, it is sought among stewards that a one be found faithful.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: But to me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a man's day; yea, I do not judge my own self,

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: for I know nothing by myself. Yet I have not been justified by this, but He who judges me is <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts. And then shall each one have praise of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: And these things, brothers, I have <hi>in a figure</hi> transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, so that you might learn in us not to think <hi>of men</hi> above that which is written, so that no one of you may <hi>be</hi> puffed up against one another.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: For who makes you to differ <hi>from another</hi>? And what do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive <hi>it</hi>, why do you boast as <hi>if you</hi> had not received it?

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: Already you are full! Already you are rich! You have reigned <hi>as kings</hi> without us! And I would to God that indeed you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: For I think that God has set forth us last, the apostles, as it were appointed to death; for we have become a spectacle to the world and to angels and to men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: We <hi>are</hi> fools for Christ's sake, but you <hi>are</hi> wise in Christ. We <hi>are</hi> weak, but you <hi>are</hi> strong. You <hi>are</hi> honorable, but we <hi>are</hi> despised.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: Even until this present hour we both hunger and thirst and are naked and are buffeted and have no certain dwelling place.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: And we labor, working with our own hands. Being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it;

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all <hi>things</hi> until now.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: I do not write these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn <hi>you</hi>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:15
verses.text: For though you have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet <hi>you do</hi> not <hi>have</hi> many fathers; for I have begotten you in Christ Jesus through the gospel.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: Therefore I beseech you, be imitators of me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: For this cause I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved son and faithful in <hi>the</hi> Lord, who shall remind you <hi>of</hi> my ways which are in Christ, as I teach everywhere in every church.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: As to my not coming to you now, some are puffed up.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:19
verses.text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord wills. And I will not know the speech of those who are puffed up, but the power.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:20
verses.text: For the kingdom of God <hi>is</hi> not in word, but in power.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:21
verses.text: What do you desire? Shall I come to you with a rod, or <hi>in</hi> love and the spirit of meekness?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: Everywhere <hi>it is</hi> reported <hi>that there is</hi> fornication among you, and such fornication as is not named among the nations, so as one to have <hi>his</hi> father's wife.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, so that he who has done this deed may be taken from your midst.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:3
verses.text: For as being absent in body but present in spirit, I indeed have judged already <hi>as though I were</hi> present <hi>concerning</hi> him who worked out this thing;

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together, with my spirit; also, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:6
verses.text: Your boasting <hi>is</hi> not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:7
verses.text: Therefore purge out the old leaven so that you may be a new lump, as you are unleavened. For also Christ our Passover is sacrificed for us.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:8
verses.text: Therefore let us keep <hi>the</hi> feast; not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened <hi>bread</hi> of sincerity and truth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: I wrote to you in the letter not to associate intimately with fornicators;

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then you must go out of the world.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: But now I have written to you not to associate intimately, if any man called a brother <hi>and is</hi> either a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such a one not to eat.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: For what <hi>is it</hi> to me to also judge those who are outside? Do you not judge those who are inside?

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: But God judges those who are outside. Therefore put out from you the evil one.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: Do any of you dare, when you have a matter against another, to go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: Do you not know that the saints shall judge the world? And if the world shall be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: Do you not know that we shall judge angels, not to speak of this life?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: If, then, you truly have judgments of <hi>the things</hi> of this life, set those who are least esteemed in the church <hi>to judge</hi>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: For I speak to your shame. <hi>Is it</hi> so <hi>that</hi> there is not a wise one among you, not even one in your midst who shall be able to judge between his brother?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:6
verses.text: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: Indeed then there is already a failure with you all, that you have lawsuits with yourselves. Why not instead be wronged? Why not instead be defrauded?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: But you do wrong and defraud, and these things to brothers.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: Do you not know that the unrighteous shall not inherit <hi>the</hi> kingdom of God? Do not be deceived; neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor abusers, nor homosexuals,

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit <hi>the</hi> kingdom of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: And such were some of you. But you are washed, but you are sanctified, but you are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: All things are lawful to me, but not all things profit. All things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: Meats for the belly and the belly for meats, but God shall destroy both it and them. But the body <hi>is</hi> not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord is for the body.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: And God has both raised up the Lord, and also will raise us up by His own power.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: Do you not know that your bodies are the members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make <hi>them</hi> the members of a harlot? Let it not be!

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: Or do you not know that he being joined to a harlot is one body? For He says, The two shall be one flesh.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: But he being joined to the Lord is one spirit.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits fornication sins against <hi>his</hi> own body.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:19
verses.text: Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit in you, whom you have of God? And you are not your own,

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:20
verses.text: for you are bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: Now concerning what you wrote to me: <hi>It is</hi> good for a man not to touch a woman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: But, <hi>to avoid</hi> fornication, let each have his <hi>own</hi> wife, and let each have her own husband.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: Let the husband give to the wife proper kindness, and likewise the wife also to the husband.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: The wife does not have authority over <hi>her</hi> own body, but the husband. And likewise also the husband does not have power <hi>over his</hi> own body, but the wife.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: Do not deprive one another, unless <hi>it is</hi> with consent for a time, so that you may <hi>give yourselves to</hi> fasting and prayer. And come together again so that Satan does not tempt you for your incontinence.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: But I speak this by permission, not of commandment.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: For I would that all men were even as I myself am. But each has his proper gift from God, one according to this manner and another according to that.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: I say therefore to the unmarried and the widows, It is good for them if they remain even as I.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: But if they do not have self-control, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: And to the married I command (not I, but the Lord), a woman not to be separated from <hi>her</hi> husband.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: But if she is indeed separated, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to <hi>her</hi> husband. And a husband is not to leave <hi>his</hi> wife.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: But to the rest I speak, not the Lord, If any brother has a wife who does not believe, and she is pleased to dwell with him, do not let him put her away.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: And the woman who has a husband who does not believe, if he is pleased to dwell with her, do not let her leave him.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband; else your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: But if the unbelieving one separates, let <hi>them</hi> be separated. A brother or a sister is not in bondage in such <hi>cases</hi>, but God has called us in peace.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: For what do you know, O wife, whether you shall save <hi>your</hi> husband? Or what do you know, O man, whether you shall save <hi>your</hi> wife?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:17
verses.text: But as God has distributed to each one, as the Lord has called each one, so let him walk. And so I ordain in all churches.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:18
verses.text: <hi> Was</hi> any called having been circumcised? Do not be uncircumcised. Was anyone called in uncircumcision? Do not be circumcised.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:19
verses.text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:20
verses.text: Let each one remain in the calling in which he was called.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:21
verses.text: Were you called as a slave? It does not matter to you, but if you are able to become free, use <hi>it</hi> rather.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:22
verses.text: For he who is called a slave in <hi>the</hi> Lord is a freed man of <hi>the</hi> Lord. And likewise, he who is called a free man is a slave of Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:23
verses.text: You are bought with a price, do not be the slaves of men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:24
verses.text: Each in whatever way he was called, brothers, in this remain with God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:25
verses.text: But concerning virgins, I have no commandment from <hi>the</hi> Lord. Yet I give my judgment, as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be faithful.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:26
verses.text: Then I think this is good, because of the present necessity; that <hi>it is</hi> good for a man to be so.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:27
verses.text: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be free. Are you freed from a wife? Do not seek a wife.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:28
verses.text: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But such shall have trouble in the flesh, but I spare you.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:29
verses.text: But this I say, brothers, The time <hi>is</hi> short. It remains that both those who have wives should be as not having one.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:30
verses.text: And they who weep are as <hi>though they did</hi> not weep. And they who rejoice are as <hi>though they did</hi> not rejoice. And they who buy are as though they did not possess.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:31
verses.text: And they who use this world are as not abusing <hi>it</hi>, for the fashion of this world is passing away.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:32
verses.text: But I desire you to be without anxiety. The <hi>one</hi> who is unmarried cares for the things that belong to <hi>the</hi> Lord, how to please the Lord.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:33
verses.text: But the <hi>one</hi> who is married cares for the things of the world, how to please <hi>his</hi> wife.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:34
verses.text: The wife and the virgin <hi>are</hi> different. The unmarried woman cares for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares for the things of the world, how she may please <hi>her</hi> husband.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:35
verses.text: And this I speak for your own profit, not that I may cast a snare on you, but for that which is right, and that you may attend on the Lord without distraction.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:36
verses.text: But if anyone thinks <hi>it</hi> behaving himself indecently toward his virginity (if he is past <hi>his</hi> prime, and so it ought to be) let him do what he will; he does not sin; let them marry.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:37
verses.text: But <hi>he</hi> who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but who has authority over <hi>his</hi> own will (and has so judged in his heart that he will keep his virginity) he does well.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:38
verses.text: So then he who gives in marriage does well. But he who does not give in marriage does better.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:39
verses.text: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband lives, but if her husband is dead, she is at liberty to be remarried to whom she will, only in the Lord.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:40
verses.text: But she is happier if she so remains, according to my judgment. And I also think that I have <hi>the</hi> Spirit of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:1
verses.text: But concerning the sacrifices to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love edifies.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:2
verses.text: And if any man thinks that he knows anything, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:3
verses.text: But if any one loves God, he has been known of him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:4
verses.text: Then concerning the eating of the things sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol <hi>is</hi> nothing in <hi>the</hi> world, and that <hi>there</hi> is no other God except one.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:5
verses.text: For though there are those who are called gods, whether in Heaven or in earth (as there are many gods and many lords),

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:6
verses.text: <hi> there is</hi> to us <hi>only</hi> one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in Him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we by Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:7
verses.text: But this knowledge <hi>is</hi> not in all. But some being aware of the idol eat as an idolatrous sacrifice until now, and their conscience being weak is defiled.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:8
verses.text: But food does not commend us to God. For neither if we eat are we the better, nor if we do not eat are we the worse.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:9
verses.text: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours becomes a stumbling block to those who are weak.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:10
verses.text: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol temple, will not the weak one's conscience be lifted up so as to eat things sacrificed to idols?

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:11
verses.text: And on your knowledge the weak brother will fall, he for whom Christ died.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:12
verses.text: And sinning in this way against <hi>your</hi> brothers, and wounding their conscience, being weak, you sin against Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:13
verses.text: Therefore, if food offends my brother, I will eat no flesh forever, that I do not offend my brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:1
verses.text: Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in <hi>the</hi> Lord?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:2
verses.text: If I am not an apostle to others, yet doubtless I am to you, for you are the seal of my apostleship in <hi>the</hi> Lord.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:3
verses.text: My answer to those who examine me is this:

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:4
verses.text: Do we not have authority to eat and to drink?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:5
verses.text: Do we not have authority to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and <hi>as</hi> the brothers of the Lord do, and Cephas?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:6
verses.text: Or <hi>is it</hi> only Barnabas and I <hi>who</hi> have no authority to cease working?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:7
verses.text: Who serves as a soldier at his own wages at any time? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock and does not partake of the milk of the flock?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:8
verses.text: Do I say these things according to man? Or does not the Law say the same also?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:9
verses.text: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle the mouth of the ox treading out grain." Does God take care for oxen?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:10
verses.text: Or does He say <hi>it</hi> altogether for our sakes? It was written for us, so that he who plows should plow <hi>in</hi> hope, and so that he who threshes <hi>in</hi> hope should be partaker of his hope.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:11
verses.text: If we have sown to you spiritual things, <hi>is it</hi> a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:12
verses.text: If others have a share of <hi>this</hi> authority <hi>over</hi> you, rather <hi>should</hi> not we? But we have not used this authority, but we endured all things lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: Do you not know that those who minister about holy things live <hi>of the things</hi> of the temple? And those attending the altar are partakers with the altar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: Even so, the Lord ordained those announcing the gospel to live from the gospel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: But I have used none of these things, nor have I written these things that it should be done so to me; for <hi>it is</hi> good for me rather to die than that anyone nullify my glorying.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:16
verses.text: For though I preach the gospel, no glory is to me. For necessity is laid on me; yea, woe is to me if I do not preach the gospel!

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:17
verses.text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward; but if against my will, I am entrusted with a stewardship.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:18
verses.text: What then is my reward? That when I preach the gospel I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I may not abuse my authority in the gospel.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:19
verses.text: For though I am free from all, yet I have made myself servant to all, so that I might gain the more.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:20
verses.text: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might gain the Jews. To those who are under the Law, <hi>I became</hi> as under the Law, so that I might gain those who are under the Law.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:21
verses.text: To those who are outside Law, <hi>I became</hi> as outside Law (not being outside law to God, but under <hi>the</hi> law to Christ), so that I might gain those who are outside Law.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:22
verses.text: To the weak I became as the weak, so that I might gain the weak. I am made all things to all <hi>men</hi>, so that I might by all means save some.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:23
verses.text: And this I do for the sake of the gospel, so that I might be partaker of it <hi>with you</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:24
verses.text: Do you not know that those running in a race all run, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:25
verses.text: And everyone who strives for the mastery is temperate in all things. Then those truly that they may receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:26
