verses.text: and by the surpassing revelations, lest I not be made haughty, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be made haughty.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: For this thing I besought the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: And He said to me, My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may overshadow me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: Therefore I am pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake; for when I am weak, then I am powerful.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: I have become foolish boasting. You compelled me. For I ought to be commended by you. For I lacked nothing of the highest apostles, though I am nothing.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: Truly the signs of the apostles were worked out among you in all patience, in miracles and in wonders, and by works of power.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: For what is it in which you were inferior to the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: Behold, a third <hi>time</hi> I am ready to come to you. And I will not burden you, for I do not seek your things, but you. For the children ought not to lay up treasure for the parents, but the parents for the children.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for your souls, even if loving you more and more, I am loved <hi>the</hi> less.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: But let it be so, I did not burden you. But being crafty, I caught you with bait.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: By any whom I have sent to you, did I overreach you by him?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: I begged Titus and sent with <hi>him</hi> the brother. Did Titus overreach you? Did we not walk in the same spirit? Did we not walk in the same steps?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: Again, do you think we are defending to you? We speak before God in Christ, but <hi>we do</hi> all things, dearly beloved, for your building up.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: For I fear, lest somehow coming I might not find you as I wish, and <hi>that</hi> I shall be found by you such as you might not wish; lest somehow <hi>there be</hi> strifes, envyings, angers, contentions, backbitings, whisperings, proud thoughts, tumults;

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: lest in my coming again my God will humble me with you; and I shall mourn many who have already sinned, and not repenting over the uncleanness, and fornication, and lustfulness which they have practiced.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: I am coming to you this third <hi>time</hi>. In the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: I told you before, and I say beforehand, as being present the second <hi>time</hi> and being absent now. I write to those who sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again, I will not spare.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: Since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me (who is not weak toward you, but is powerful in you;

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: for even if He was crucified out of weakness, yet He lives by <hi>the</hi> power of God. For indeed even we are weak in Him, but we shall live with Him by <hi>the</hi> power of God toward you),

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: examine yourselves, whether you are in the faith, prove your own selves. Do you not know your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, unless you are reprobates?

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: But I trust that you will know that we are not reprobates.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: But I pray to God <hi>for</hi> you not to do evil, none. And not that we may appear approved, but that you should do the good things, though we are deemed to be reprobates.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: For we have no power against the truth, but for the truth.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: For we are glad when we are weak, and you are powerful. But we pray also for this, your perfection.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: Therefore I write these things while absent, lest being present I may not deal sharply <hi>with you</hi> according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for pulling down.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Perfect yourselves; encourage yourselves; mind the same thing; be at peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: All the saints greet you.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:14
verses.text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:1
verses.text: Paul, an apostle (not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),

verses.name: Galatians 1:2
verses.text: and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia.

verses.name: Galatians 1:3
verses.text: Grace <hi>be</hi> to you, and peace from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Galatians 1:4
verses.text: who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil world according to the will of God and our Father,

verses.name: Galatians 1:5
verses.text: to whom <hi>be</hi> glory forever and ever. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:6
verses.text: I marvel that you so soon are being moved away from Him who called you into <hi>the</hi> grace of Christ, to another gospel,

verses.name: Galatians 1:7
verses.text: which is not another, but some are troubling you, and desiring to pervert the gospel of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:8
verses.text: But even if we or an angel from Heaven preach a gospel to you beside what we preached to you, let him be accursed.

verses.name: Galatians 1:9
verses.text: As we said before, and now I say again, If anyone preaches a gospel to you beside what you have received, let him be accursed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:10
verses.text: For now do I persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I yet pleased men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:11
verses.text: And, brothers, I make known to you the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

verses.name: Galatians 1:12
verses.text: For I did not receive it from man, nor was I taught <hi>it</hi> except by a revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:13
verses.text: For you heard my manner of life when <hi>I was</hi> in Judaism, that I persecuted the church of God with surpassing <hi>zeal</hi>, and ravaged it.

verses.name: Galatians 1:14
verses.text: And I progressed in Judaism beyond many contemporaries in my race, being much more a zealot of the traditions of my fathers.

verses.name: Galatians 1:15
verses.text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and having called <hi>me</hi> by His grace,

verses.name: Galatians 1:16
verses.text: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the nations, immediately I did not confer with flesh and blood;

verses.name: Galatians 1:17
verses.text: Nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those apostles before me, but I went into Arabia and returned again to Damascus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:18
verses.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

verses.name: Galatians 1:19
verses.text: But I saw no other of the apostles, except James the Lord's brother.

verses.name: Galatians 1:20
verses.text: And what I write to you, behold, before God, I do not lie.

verses.name: Galatians 1:21
verses.text: Then I went into the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,

verses.name: Galatians 1:22
verses.text: and was unknown by face to the churches of Judea in Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 1:23
verses.text: But only they were hearing that he who then persecuted us, now preaches the faith which he once ravaged.

verses.name: Galatians 1:24
verses.text: And they glorified God in me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:1
verses.text: Then through fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with <hi>me</hi> also.

verses.name: Galatians 2:2
verses.text: And I went up by revelation. And I put before them the gospel which I proclaim in the nations, but privately to those <hi>seeming to be</hi> pillars, lest I run, or I ran, into vanity.

verses.name: Galatians 2:3
verses.text: (But not even Titus, the <hi>one</hi> with me, a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.)

verses.name: Galatians 2:4
verses.text: But because of those false brothers stealing in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus; they desiring to enslave us;

verses.name: Galatians 2:5
verses.text: to whom not even for an hour did we yield in subjection, that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

verses.name: Galatians 2:6
verses.text: But from those who seemed to be something (what kind they were then does not matter to me; God does not accept the face of man), for those seeming <hi>important</hi> conferred nothing to me.

verses.name: Galatians 2:7
verses.text: But on the contrary, seeing that I have been entrusted <hi>with</hi> the gospel of the uncircumcision, as Peter to the circumcision;

verses.name: Galatians 2:8
verses.text: for He working in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision also worked in me to the nations.

verses.name: Galatians 2:9
verses.text: and knowing the grace given to me, James, and Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, gave right hands of fellowship to Barnabas and me, that we <hi>go</hi> to the nations, but they to the circumcision.

verses.name: Galatians 2:10
verses.text: Only <hi>they asked</hi> that we remember the poor, which very thing I was eager to do.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:11
verses.text: But when Peter came to Antioch, I opposed <hi>him</hi> to his face, because he was to be blamed.

verses.name: Galatians 2:12
verses.text: For before some came from James, he ate with the nations. But when they came, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing those of the circumcision.

verses.name: Galatians 2:13
verses.text: And the rest of the Jews also dissembled with him, so as even Barnabas was led away with their dissembling.

verses.name: Galatians 2:14
verses.text: But when I saw that they did not walk uprightly with the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter before all, If you, being a Jew, live as a Gentile, and not as the Jews, why do you compel <hi>the</hi> nations to judaize?

verses.name: Galatians 2:15
verses.text: We Jews by nature, and not sinners of the nations,

verses.name: Galatians 2:16
verses.text: knowing that a man is not justified by works of the Law, but through faith <hi>in</hi> Jesus Christ; even we believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith in Christ, and not by works of the Law. For all flesh will not be justified by works of law.

verses.name: Galatians 2:17
verses.text: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we also were found <hi>to be</hi> sinners, <hi>is</hi> Christ therefore a minister of sin? Let it not be <hi>said</hi>!

verses.name: Galatians 2:18
verses.text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I confirm myself <hi>as</hi> a transgressor.

verses.name: Galatians 2:19
verses.text: For through the Law I died to the law, that I might live to God.

verses.name: Galatians 2:20
verses.text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I live; <hi>yet</hi> no longer I, but Christ lives in me. And <hi>that</hi> life I now live in the flesh, I live by faith toward the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself on my behalf.

verses.name: Galatians 2:21
verses.text: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness <hi>is</hi> through law, then Christ died without cause.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:1
verses.text: O foolish Galatians, who bewitched you not to obey the truth, to whom before <hi>your</hi> eyes Jesus Christ was written among you crucified?

verses.name: Galatians 3:2
verses.text: This only I would learn from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of <hi>the</hi> law, or by hearing of faith?

verses.name: Galatians 3:3
verses.text: Are you so foolish? Having begun in <hi>the</hi> Spirit, do you now perfect <hi>yourself</hi> in the flesh?

verses.name: Galatians 3:4
verses.text: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if indeed <hi>it is</hi> even in vain?

verses.name: Galatians 3:5
verses.text: Then He supplying the Spirit to you and working powerful works in you, <hi>is it</hi> by works of <hi>the</hi> law, or by hearing of faith?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:6
verses.text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

verses.name: Galatians 3:7
verses.text: Therefore know that those of faith, these are the sons of Abraham.

verses.name: Galatians 3:8
verses.text: And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the nations through faith, preached the gospel before to Abraham, <hi>saying</hi>, "In you shall all nations be blessed."

verses.name: Galatians 3:9
verses.text: So then those of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

verses.name: Galatians 3:10
verses.text: For as many as are out of works of the Law, these are under a curse; for it is written, "Cursed <hi>is</hi> everyone who does not continue in all things which are written in the Book of the Law, to do them."

verses.name: Galatians 3:11
verses.text: But that no one is justified by the Law in the sight of God <hi>is</hi> clear, for, "The just shall live by faith."

verses.name: Galatians 3:12
verses.text: But the Law is not of faith; but, "The man who does these things shall live in them."

verses.name: Galatians 3:13
verses.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the Law, being made a curse for us (for it is written, "Cursed <hi>is</hi> everyone having been hanged on a tree");

verses.name: Galatians 3:14
verses.text: so that the blessing of Abraham might be to the nations in Jesus Christ, and that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

verses.name: Galatians 3:15
verses.text: Brothers, I speak according to man, a covenant having been ratified, even <hi>among</hi> mankind, no one sets aside or adds to <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: Galatians 3:16
verses.text: And to Abraham and to his Seed the promises were spoken. It does not say, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, "And to your Seed," which is Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 3:17
verses.text: And I say this, A covenant having been ratified to Christ by God in Christ, the Law (coming into being four hundred and thirty years after) does not annul the promise, so as to abolish it.

verses.name: Galatians 3:18
verses.text: For if the inheritance <hi>is</hi> of Law, <hi>it is</hi> no more of promise; but God gave <hi>it</hi> to Abraham by way of promise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:19
verses.text: Why then the Law? It was added because of transgressions, until the Seed should come <hi>to those</hi> to whom it had been promised, being ordained through angels in the Mediator's hand.

verses.name: Galatians 3:20
verses.text: But the Mediator is not <hi>a mediator</hi> of one, but God is one.

verses.name: Galatians 3:21
verses.text: <hi> Is</hi> the Law then against the promises of God? Let it not be <hi>said</hi>! For if a law had been given which could have given life, indeed righteousness would have been out of Law.

verses.name: Galatians 3:22
verses.text: But the Scripture shut up all under sin, so that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

verses.name: Galatians 3:23
verses.text: But before faith came, we were kept under Law, having been shut up to the faith about to be revealed.

verses.name: Galatians 3:24
verses.text: So that the Law has become a trainer of us until Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

verses.name: Galatians 3:25
verses.text: But faith coming, we are no longer under a trainer.

verses.name: Galatians 3:26
verses.text: For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:27
verses.text: For as many as were baptized into Christ, you put on Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 3:28
verses.text: There cannot be Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is no male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:29
verses.text: And if you <hi>are</hi> Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:1
verses.text: But I say, Over so long a time the heir is an infant, he does not differ from a slave, though being lord of all;

verses.name: Galatians 4:2
verses.text: but he is under guardians and housemasters until the term appointed before by the father.

verses.name: Galatians 4:3
verses.text: Even so we, when we were infants, were in bondage under the elements of the world.

verses.name: Galatians 4:4
verses.text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent forth His Son, coming into being out of a woman, having come under Law,

verses.name: Galatians 4:5
verses.text: that He might redeem those under Law, so that we might receive the adoption of sons.

verses.name: Galatians 4:6
verses.text: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

verses.name: Galatians 4:7
verses.text: So that you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, also an heir of God through Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:8
verses.text: But then, indeed, not knowing God, you served as slaves <hi>to</hi> those not by nature being gods.

verses.name: Galatians 4:9
verses.text: But now, knowing God, but rather are known by God, how do you turn again to the weak and beggarly elements to which you desire to slave anew?

verses.name: Galatians 4:10
verses.text: You observe days and months and times and years.

verses.name: Galatians 4:11
verses.text: I fear <hi>for</hi> you, lest somehow I have labored among you in vain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:12
verses.text: Brothers, I beseech you, be as I <hi>am</hi>; for I <hi>am</hi> as you. You have not injured me at all.

verses.name: Galatians 4:13
verses.text: But you know that through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel to you before,

verses.name: Galatians 4:14
verses.text: and you did not despise my temptation in my flesh, nor did you spurn <hi>it</hi>. But you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 4:15
verses.text: What then was your blessedness? For I bear you record that, if you were able, plucking out your eyes, <hi>you</hi> would have given <hi>them</hi> to me.

verses.name: Galatians 4:16
verses.text: So then did I become your enemy speaking to you the truth?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:17
verses.text: They are zealous for you, <hi>but</hi> not well. But they <hi>only</hi> desire to shut you out, that you be zealous to them.

verses.name: Galatians 4:18
verses.text: But <hi>it is</hi> good to be zealous always in <hi>a</hi> good <hi>thing</hi>, and not only in my being present with you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:19
verses.text: My children, <hi>for</hi> whom I again travail until Christ should be formed in you,

verses.name: Galatians 4:20
verses.text: even now I desired to be present with you, and to change my voice; for I am in doubt <hi>as</hi> to you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:21
verses.text: Tell me, those desiring to be under Law, do you not hear the Law?

verses.name: Galatians 4:22
verses.text: For it is written: Abraham had two sons, the one out of the slave-woman, and one out of the free woman.

verses.name: Galatians 4:23
verses.text: But, indeed, he out of the slave-woman has been born according to flesh, and he out of the free woman through the promise;

verses.name: Galatians 4:24
verses.text: which things are being allegorized; for these are the two covenants, one indeed from Mount Sinai bringing forth to slavery, which is Hagar.

verses.name: Galatians 4:25
verses.text: For Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in slavery with her children.

verses.name: Galatians 4:26
verses.text: But the Jerusalem <hi>from</hi> above is free, who is the mother of us all.

verses.name: Galatians 4:27
verses.text: For it is written, "Rejoice, barren one not bearing; break forth and shout, you not travailing; for more are the children of the desolate than she having the husband."

verses.name: Galatians 4:28
verses.text: But brothers, we, like Isaac, are children of promise.

verses.name: Galatians 4:29
verses.text: But then even as he born according to flesh persecuted him <hi>born</hi> according to the Spirit, so also now.

verses.name: Galatians 4:30
verses.text: But what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the slave-woman and her son; for in no way shall the son of the slave-woman inherit with the son of the free woman."

verses.name: Galatians 4:31
verses.text: Then, brothers, we are not children of a slave-woman, but of the free woman.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:1
verses.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ has made us free, and do not again be held with the yoke of bondage.

verses.name: Galatians 5:2
verses.text: Behold, I, Paul, say to you that if you are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

verses.name: Galatians 5:3
verses.text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do all the Law,

verses.name: Galatians 5:4
verses.text: you who are justified by Law are deprived of all effect from Christ; you fell from grace.

verses.name: Galatians 5:5
verses.text: For we through <hi>the</hi> Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness out of faith.

verses.name: Galatians 5:6
verses.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any strength, but faith working through love.

verses.name: Galatians 5:7
verses.text: You were running well. Who hindered you <hi>that</hi> you do not obey the truth?

verses.name: Galatians 5:8
verses.text: <hi> This</hi> persuasion <hi>is</hi> not from Him who calls you.

verses.name: Galatians 5:9
verses.text: A little leaven leavens all the lump.

verses.name: Galatians 5:10
verses.text: I have confidence in you in the Lord, that you will think nothing else, but that he troubling you shall bear the judgment, whoever he may be.

verses.name: Galatians 5:11
verses.text: And I, brothers, if I yet proclaim circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the offense of the Cross has ceased.

verses.name: Galatians 5:12
verses.text: I wish that those causing you to doubt will cut themselves off.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:13
verses.text: For, brothers, you were called to liberty. Only do not <hi>use</hi> the liberty for <hi>an</hi> opening to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

verses.name: Galatians 5:14
verses.text: For all the Law is fulfilled in one word, <hi>even</hi> in this, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.name: Galatians 5:15
verses.text: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you are not consumed by one another.

verses.name: Galatians 5:16
verses.text: I say, then, Walk in <hi>the</hi> Spirit and you shall not fulfill <hi>the</hi> lusts of <hi>the</hi> flesh.

verses.name: Galatians 5:17
verses.text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. And these are contrary to one another; lest whatever you may will, these things you do.

verses.name: Galatians 5:18
verses.text: But if you are led by <hi>the</hi> Spirit, you are not under law.

verses.name: Galatians 5:19
verses.text: Now the works of the flesh are clearly revealed, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lustfulness,

verses.name: Galatians 5:20
verses.text: idolatry, sorcery, hatreds, fightings, jealousies, angers, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

verses.name: Galatians 5:21
verses.text: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revelings, and things like these; of which I tell you before, as I also said before, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Galatians 5:22
verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is: love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith,

verses.name: Galatians 5:23
verses.text: meekness, self-control; against such things there is no law.

verses.name: Galatians 5:24
verses.text: But those belonging to Christ have crucified the flesh with <hi>its</hi> passions and lusts.

verses.name: Galatians 5:25
verses.text: If we live in <hi>the</hi> Spirit, let us also walk in <hi>the</hi> Spirit.

verses.name: Galatians 5:26
verses.text: Let us not become glory-seeking, provoking one another, envying one another.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:1
verses.text: Brothers, if a man is overtaken in a fault, you the spiritual ones restore such a one in the spirit of meekness, considering yourself, lest you also be tempted.

verses.name: Galatians 6:2
verses.text: Bear one another's burdens, and so you will fulfill the law of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 6:3
verses.text: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself.

verses.name: Galatians 6:4
verses.text: But let each one prove his own work, and then he alone will have a boast in himself, and not in another.

verses.name: Galatians 6:5
verses.text: For each one will bear <hi>his</hi> own load.

verses.name: Galatians 6:6
verses.text: But let him who is taught in the Word share with the <hi>one</hi> teaching in all good things.

verses.name: Galatians 6:7
verses.text: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows, that he also will reap.

verses.name: Galatians 6:8
verses.text: For he sowing to his flesh will reap corruption from the flesh. But he sowing to the Spirit will reap life everlasting from the Spirit.

verses.name: Galatians 6:9
verses.text: But we should not lose heart in well-doing, for in due season we shall reap, if <hi>we</hi> do not faint.

verses.name: Galatians 6:10
verses.text: So then as we have time, let us work good toward all, especially toward those of the household of faith.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:11
verses.text: See in what large letters I write to you with my hand.

verses.name: Galatians 6:12
verses.text: As many as desire to look well in <hi>the</hi> flesh, these compel you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

verses.name: Galatians 6:13
verses.text: For they themselves, having been circumcised, do not even keep the Law, but they desire you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.

verses.name: Galatians 6:14
verses.text: But may it never be for me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.

verses.name: Galatians 6:15
verses.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision <hi>has</hi> any strength, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

verses.name: Galatians 6:16
verses.text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace and mercy <hi>be</hi> upon them and upon the Israel of God.

verses.name: Galatians 6:17
verses.text: For the rest, let no one give troubles to me, for I bear in my body the brands of the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: Galatians 6:18
verses.text: Brothers, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with your spirit. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:1
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus, and faithful in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:2
verses.text: Grace <hi>be</hi> to you, and peace from God our Father and <hi>from the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:3
verses.text: Blessed <hi>be</hi> the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 1:4
verses.text: according as He chose us in Him before <hi>the</hi> foundation of <hi>the</hi> world, that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:5
verses.text: having predestined us to the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:6
verses.text: to <hi>the</hi> praise of <hi>the</hi> glory of His grace, in which He has made us accepted in the <hi>One</hi> having been loved.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:7
verses.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of His grace,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:8
verses.text: which He caused to abound toward us in all wisdom and understanding;

verses.name: Ephesians 1:9
verses.text: having made known to us the mystery of His will, according to His good pleasure which He purposed in Himself,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:10
verses.text: for an administration of the fullness of times, to head up all things in Christ, both the things in Heaven, and the things on earth, <hi>even</hi> in Him,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:11
verses.text: in whom also we have been chosen to an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of Him who works all things according to the counsel of His own will,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:12
verses.text: for us to be to <hi>the</hi> praise of His glory, who previously had trusted in Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 1:13
verses.text: in whom also you, hearing the word of truth, the gospel of our salvation, in whom also believing, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:14
verses.text: who is the earnest of our inheritance, to <hi>the</hi> redemption of the purchased possession, to <hi>the</hi> praise of His glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:15
verses.text: Therefore I also, hearing of your faith in the Lord Jesus and love to all the saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:16
verses.text: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:17
verses.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in <hi>the</hi> knowledge of Him,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:18
verses.text: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of His calling, and what is the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:19
verses.text: and what <hi>is</hi> the surpassing greatness of His power toward us, the ones believing according to the working of His mighty strength

verses.name: Ephesians 1:20
verses.text: which He worked <hi>in</hi> Christ in raising Him from <hi>the</hi> dead, and He seated <hi>Him</hi> at His right hand in the heavenlies,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:21
verses.text: far above all principality and authority and power and dominion, and every name being named, not only in this world, but also in the coming age.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:22
verses.text: And He has put all <hi>things</hi> under His feet and gave Him <hi>to be</hi> Head over all <hi>things</hi> to the church,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:23
verses.text: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:1
verses.text: And He <hi>has made you alive</hi>, who were once dead in trespasses and sins,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:2
verses.text: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience;

verses.name: Ephesians 2:3
verses.text: among whom we also had our way of life in times past, in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the thoughts, and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:4
verses.text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for His great love <hi>with</hi> which He loved us

verses.name: Ephesians 2:5
verses.text: (even when we were dead in sins) has made us alive together with Christ (by grace you are saved),

verses.name: Ephesians 2:6
verses.text: and has raised <hi>us</hi> up together and made <hi>us</hi> sit together in the heavenlies in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:7
verses.text: so that in the ages to come He might show the exceeding riches of His grace in <hi>His</hi> kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:8
verses.text: For by grace you are saved through faith, and that not of yourselves, <hi>it is</hi> the gift of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:9
verses.text: not of works, lest anyone should boast.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:10
verses.text: For we are <hi>His</hi> workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:11
verses.text: Therefore remember that you, the nations, in time past <hi>were</hi> in <hi>the</hi> flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

verses.name: Ephesians 2:12
verses.text: and that at that time you were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:13
verses.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who were once afar off are made near by the blood of Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:14
verses.text: For He is our peace, He making us both one, and <hi>He</hi> has broken down the middle wall of partition <hi>between us</hi>,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:15
verses.text: having abolished in His flesh the enmity (the Law of commandments <hi>contained</hi> in ordinances) so that in Himself He might make the two into one new man, making peace <hi>between them</hi>;

verses.name: Ephesians 2:16
verses.text: and so that He might reconcile both to God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity in Himself.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:17
verses.text: And He came and preached peace to you who were afar off, and to those who were near.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:18
verses.text: For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to the Father.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:19
verses.text: Now therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:20
verses.text: and are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ Himself being <hi>the</hi> chief cornerstone,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:21
verses.text: in whom every building having been fitly framed together, grows into a holy sanctuary in the Lord;

verses.name: Ephesians 2:22
verses.text: in whom you also are built together for a dwelling place of God through <hi>the</hi> Spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:1
verses.text: For this cause, I, Paul, am the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you nations,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:2
verses.text: if you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given to me toward you,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:3
verses.text: that by revelation He made known to me the mystery (as I wrote before in few words,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:4
verses.text: by which, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

verses.name: Ephesians 3:5
verses.text: which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:6
verses.text: that the nations should be fellow heirs, and of the same body, and partaker of His promise in Christ through the gospel.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:7
verses.text: Of this <hi>gospel</hi> I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effectual working of His power.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:8
verses.text: This grace is given to me (<hi> who am</hi> less than the least of all saints) to preach the gospel of the unsearchable riches of Christ among the nations,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:9
verses.text: and to bring to light what <hi>is</hi> the fellowship of the mystery which from eternity has been hidden in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 3:10
verses.text: so that now to the rulers and powers in the heavenlies might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:11
verses.text: according to the eternal purpose which He purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

verses.name: Ephesians 3:12
verses.text: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through His faith.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:13
verses.text: For this reason I desire that you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:14
verses.text: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:15
verses.text: of whom the whole family in Heaven and earth is named,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:16
verses.text: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man;

verses.name: Ephesians 3:17
verses.text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:18
verses.text: may be able to comprehend with all saints what <hi>is</hi> the breadth and length and depth and height,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:19
verses.text: and to know the love of Christ which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fullness of God.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:20
verses.text: Now to Him who is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:21
verses.text: to Him <hi>be</hi> glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, forever. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:1
verses.text: I therefore, the prisoner in <hi>the</hi> Lord, beseech you that you walk worthy of the calling with which you are called,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:2
verses.text: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:3
verses.text: endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:4
verses.text: <hi> There is</hi> one body and one Spirit, even as you are called in one hope of your calling,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:5
verses.text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:6
verses.text: one God and Father of all, who <hi>is</hi> above all and through all and in you all.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:7
verses.text: But to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:8
verses.text: Therefore He says, "When He ascended up on high, He led captivity captive and gave gifts to men."

verses.name: Ephesians 4:9
verses.text: (Now that He ascended, what is it but that He also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

verses.name: Ephesians 4:10
verses.text: He who descended is the same also as He who ascended up far above all heavens, that He might fill all things.)

verses.name: Ephesians 4:11
verses.text: And truly He gave some <hi>to be</hi> apostles, and some <hi>to be</hi> prophets, and some <hi>to be</hi> evangelists, and some <hi>to be</hi> pastors and teachers,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:12
verses.text: for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:13
verses.text: And this until we all come into the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full-grown man, to <hi>the</hi> measure of <hi>the</hi> stature of the fullness of Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 4:14
verses.text: so that we no longer may be infants, tossed to and fro and carried about by every wind of doctrine, in the dishonesty of men, in cunning craftiness, to the wiles of deceit.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:15
verses.text: But that you, speaking the truth in love, may in all things grow up to Him who is the Head, <hi>even</hi> Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 4:16
verses.text: from whom the whole body, fitted together and compacted by that which every joint supplies, according to <hi>the</hi> effectual working in the measure of each part, producing the growth of the body to the edifying of itself in love.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:17
verses.text: This I say therefore, and testify in <hi>the</hi> Lord, that you should not walk from now on as other nations walk, in <hi>the</hi> vanity of their mind,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:18
verses.text: having the understanding darkened, being alienated <hi>from</hi> the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:19
verses.text: For they, being past feeling, have given themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:20
verses.text: But you have not so learned Christ,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:21
verses.text: if indeed you have heard Him and were taught by Him, as <hi>the</hi> truth is in Jesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:22
verses.text: For you ought to put off the old man (according to your way of living before) who is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:23
verses.text: and be renewed in the spirit of your mind.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:24
verses.text: And you should put on the new man, who according to God <hi>was</hi> created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:25
verses.text: Therefore putting away lying, let each man speak truth with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:26
verses.text: Be angry, and do not sin. Do not let the sun go down upon your wrath,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:27
verses.text: neither give place to the Devil.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:28
verses.text: Let him who stole steal no more, but rather let him labor, working with <hi>his</hi> hands the thing which <hi>is</hi> good, so that he may have <hi>something</hi> to give to him who needs.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:29
verses.text: Let not any filthy word go out of your mouth, but if any <hi>is</hi> good to building up <hi>in respect of</hi> need, that it may give grace to the ones hearing.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:30
verses.text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you are sealed until <hi>the</hi> day of redemption.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:31
verses.text: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and tumult and evil speaking be put away from you, with all malice.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:32
verses.text: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:1
verses.text: Therefore be followers of God, as dear children.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:2
verses.text: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savor.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:3
verses.text: For let fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness not be once named among you, as becomes saints,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:4
verses.text: neither baseness, foolish talking, jesting, which are not becoming, but rather giving of thanks.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:5
verses.text: For you know this, that no fornicator, or unclean person, or covetous <hi>one</hi> (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:6
verses.text: Let no man deceive you with vain words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:7
verses.text: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:8
verses.text: For you were once darkness, but now <hi>you are</hi> light in <hi>the</hi> Lord; walk as children of light

verses.name: Ephesians 5:9
verses.text: (for the fruit of the Spirit <hi>is</hi> in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

verses.name: Ephesians 5:10
verses.text: proving what is acceptable to the Lord.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:11
verses.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove <hi>them</hi>.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:12
verses.text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:13
verses.text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light, for whatever makes manifest <hi>is</hi> light.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:14
verses.text: Therefore he says, "Awake, sleeping ones! And arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light."

verses.name: Ephesians 5:15
verses.text: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:16
verses.text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:17
verses.text: Therefore do not be unwise, but understand what the will of the Lord <hi>is</hi>.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:18
verses.text: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess, but be filled with the Spirit,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:19
verses.text: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

verses.name: Ephesians 5:20
verses.text: always giving thanks for all things to God <hi>the</hi> Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:21
verses.text: submitting yourselves to one another in the fear of God.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:22
verses.text: Wives, submit yourselves to <hi>your</hi> own husbands, as to the Lord.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:23
verses.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ <hi>is</hi> the head of the church; and He is the Savior of the body.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:24
verses.text: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so <hi>let</hi> the wives <hi>be</hi> to their own husbands in everything.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:25
verses.text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself for it,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:26
verses.text: that He might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the Word,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:27
verses.text: that He might present it to Himself <hi>as</hi> the glorious church, without spot or wrinkle or any such things, but that it should be holy and without blemish.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:28
verses.text: So men ought to love their wives as their <hi>own</hi> bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:29
verses.text: For no man ever yet hated his <hi>own</hi> flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord loves the church.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:30
verses.text: For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:31
verses.text: "For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother and shall be joined to his wife, and the two of them shall be one flesh."

verses.name: Ephesians 5:32
verses.text: This is a great mystery, but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:33
verses.text: But also let everyone of you in particular so love his wife even as himself, and the wife that she defers to her husband.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:1
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:2
verses.text: Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise),

verses.name: Ephesians 6:3
verses.text: so that it may be well with you, and that you may live long on the earth.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:4
verses.text: And fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:5
verses.text: Slaves, obey <hi>your</hi> masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

verses.name: Ephesians 6:6
verses.text: not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from <hi>the</hi> heart,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:7
verses.text: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men

verses.name: Ephesians 6:8
verses.text: (knowing that whatever good thing he does, he shall receive the same from the Lord, whether <hi>he is</hi> a slave or a freeman).

verses.name: Ephesians 6:9
verses.text: And masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening, knowing that your Master also is in Heaven. There is no respect of persons with Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:10
verses.text: Finally, my brothers, be strong in <hi>the</hi> Lord and in the power of His might.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:11
verses.text: Put on the whole armor of God so that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:12
verses.text: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the world's rulers, of the darkness of this age, against spiritual wickedness in high <hi>places</hi>.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:13
verses.text: Therefore take to yourselves the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:14
verses.text: Therefore stand, having your loins girded about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness

verses.name: Ephesians 6:15
verses.text: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:16
verses.text: Above all, take the shield of faith, with which you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:17
verses.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:18
verses.text: praying always with all prayer and supplication in <hi>the</hi> Spirit, and watching to this very thing with all perseverance and supplication for all saints.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:19
verses.text: And pray for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:20
verses.text: for which I am an ambassador in bonds; so that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:21
verses.text: But, so that you also may know my affairs <hi>and</hi> how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in <hi>the</hi> Lord, shall make known to you all things,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:22
verses.text: whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs and <hi>that</hi> he might comfort your hearts.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:23
verses.text: Peace to the brothers, and love with faith, from God <hi>the</hi> Father and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:24
verses.text: Grace <hi>be</hi> with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:1
verses.text: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.

verses.name: Philippians 1:2
verses.text: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and from <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:3
verses.text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

verses.name: Philippians 1:4
verses.text: always in every prayer of mine making <hi>my</hi> request for you all with joy

verses.name: Philippians 1:5
verses.text: for your fellowship in the gospel from <hi>the</hi> first day until now;

verses.name: Philippians 1:6
verses.text: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will perform <hi>it</hi> until the day of Jesus Christ,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:7
verses.text: even as it is righteous for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partakers of my grace.

verses.name: Philippians 1:8
verses.text: For God is my witness how greatly I long after you all in <hi>the</hi> bowels of Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:9
verses.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in full knowledge and <hi>in</hi> all perception;

verses.name: Philippians 1:10
verses.text: that you may distinguish <hi>between</hi> things that differ, that you may be sincere and without offense until the day of Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 1:11
verses.text: being filled <hi>with the</hi> fruits of righteousness through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:12
verses.text: But I desire that you should understand, brothers, that the things <hi>which happened</hi> to me have fallen out rather to <hi>the</hi> furtherance of the gospel;

verses.name: Philippians 1:13
verses.text: so that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other <hi>places</hi>.

verses.name: Philippians 1:14
verses.text: And most of the brothers in <hi>the</hi> Lord, becoming confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

verses.name: Philippians 1:15
verses.text: Some indeed even preach Christ because of envy and strife, and some also of good will.

verses.name: Philippians 1:16
verses.text: Those, indeed, preach Christ out of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds.

verses.name: Philippians 1:17
verses.text: But these <hi>others</hi> preach in love, knowing that I am set for the defense of the gospel.

verses.name: Philippians 1:18
verses.text: What then? Nevertheless, in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached. And I rejoice in this. Yet, also I will rejoice.

verses.name: Philippians 1:19
verses.text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer and <hi>the</hi> supply of <hi>the</hi> Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 1:20
verses.text: according to my earnest expectation and hope that I shall be ashamed in nothing, but as always now Christ shall be magnified in my body with all boldness, whether it is by life or by death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:21
verses.text: For to me to live <hi>is</hi> Christ, and to die <hi>is</hi> gain.

verses.name: Philippians 1:22
verses.text: But if <hi>I</hi> live in <hi>the</hi> flesh, this <hi>is</hi> the fruit of <hi>my</hi> labor. Yet I do not know what I shall choose.

verses.name: Philippians 1:23
verses.text: For I am pressed together by the two: having a desire to depart and to be with Christ, which is far better.

verses.name: Philippians 1:24
verses.text: But to remain in the flesh <hi>is</hi> more needful for you.

verses.name: Philippians 1:25
verses.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all, for your advancement and joy of faith,

verses.name: Philippians 1:26
verses.text: so that your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:27
verses.text: Only let your conduct be as becomes the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you, or else am absent, I may hear of your <hi>affairs</hi>, that you stand fast in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

verses.name: Philippians 1:28
verses.text: and terrified in nothing by your adversaries. <hi>For this is</hi> to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

verses.name: Philippians 1:29
verses.text: For to you it is given on behalf of Christ not only to believe on Him, but also to suffer for His sake,

verses.name: Philippians 1:30
verses.text: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear <hi>to be</hi> in me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:1
verses.text: If <hi>there is</hi> therefore any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of <hi>the</hi> Spirit, if any tendernesses and mercies,

verses.name: Philippians 2:2
verses.text: then fulfill my joy, that you may be like-minded, having the same love, <hi>being</hi> of one accord and of one mind.

verses.name: Philippians 2:3
verses.text: <hi> Let</hi> nothing <hi>be done</hi> through strife or vainglory, but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than themselves.

verses.name: Philippians 2:4
verses.text: Do not let each man look upon his own things, but each man also <hi>on</hi> the things of others.

verses.name: Philippians 2:5
verses.text: For let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: Philippians 2:6
verses.text: who, being in the form of God, thought <hi>it</hi> not robbery to be equal with God,

verses.name: Philippians 2:7
verses.text: but made Himself of no reputation, and took <hi>upon Himself</hi> the form of a servant, and was made in <hi>the</hi> likeness of men.

verses.name: Philippians 2:8
verses.text: And being found in fashion as a man, He humbled Himself <hi>and</hi> became obedient unto death, even <hi>the</hi> death of the cross.

verses.name: Philippians 2:9
verses.text: Therefore God has highly exalted Him, and has given Him a name <hi>which is</hi> above every name,

verses.name: Philippians 2:10
verses.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of heavenly ones, and of earthly ones, and of ones under <hi>the</hi> earth;

verses.name: Philippians 2:11
verses.text: and <hi>that</hi> every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ <hi>is</hi> Lord, to <hi>the</hi> glory of God <hi>the</hi> Father.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:12
verses.text: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, cultivate your own salvation with fear and trembling.

verses.name: Philippians 2:13
verses.text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to do of <hi>His</hi> good pleasure.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:14
verses.text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings,

verses.name: Philippians 2:15
verses.text: so that you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation. Among these you shine as lights in the world,

verses.name: Philippians 2:16
verses.text: holding forth the word of life, so that I may rejoice with you in <hi>the</hi> day of Christ, that I have not run in vain nor labored in vain.

verses.name: Philippians 2:17
verses.text: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy and rejoice with you all.

verses.name: Philippians 2:18
verses.text: And you also rejoice <hi>in</hi> the same, and rejoice with me.

verses.name: Philippians 2:19
verses.text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you, so that I also may be of good comfort when I know <hi>your state</hi>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:20
verses.text: For I have no one who is like-minded, who will naturally care for <hi>your state</hi>.

verses.name: Philippians 2:21
verses.text: For all seek their own, not the things which are of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philippians 2:22
verses.text: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.

verses.name: Philippians 2:23
verses.text: Therefore I hope to send him presently, as soon as I shall see the things about me.

verses.name: Philippians 2:24
verses.text: But I trust in <hi>the</hi> Lord that I myself shall also come shortly.

verses.name: Philippians 2:25
verses.text: Yet I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker, and fellow-soldier, but your messenger and he who ministered to my wants.

verses.name: Philippians 2:26
verses.text: For he longed after you all and was full of heaviness, because you had heard that he had been sick.

verses.name: Philippians 2:27
verses.text: For indeed he was sick, coming near death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

verses.name: Philippians 2:28
verses.text: Therefore I sent him the more eagerly, so that you may rejoice when you see him again, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

verses.name: Philippians 2:29
verses.text: Therefore receive him in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such in honor,

verses.name: Philippians 2:30
verses.text: because for the work of Christ he was near death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:1
verses.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in <hi>the</hi> Lord. To write the same things to you is indeed not grievous to me, but for you <hi>it is</hi> safe.

verses.name: Philippians 3:2
verses.text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision party.

verses.name: Philippians 3:3
verses.text: For we are the circumcision who worship God in the spirit and rejoice in Christ Jesus and have no confidence in the flesh;  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:4
verses.text: though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other thinks that he has reason to trust in the flesh, I more.

verses.name: Philippians 3:5
verses.text: I was circumcised <hi>the</hi> eighth day, of <hi>the</hi> stock of Israel, <hi>of the</hi> tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of the Hebrews. As regards the Law, <hi>I was</hi> a Pharisee;

verses.name: Philippians 3:6
verses.text: concerning zeal, persecuting the church; regarding the righteousness in the Law, blameless.

verses.name: Philippians 3:7
verses.text: But whatever things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

verses.name: Philippians 3:8
verses.text: But no, rather, I also count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them <hi>to be</hi> dung, so that I may win Christ  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:9
verses.text: and be found in Him; not having my own righteousness, which is of the Law, but through <hi>the</hi> faith of Christ, the righteousness of God by faith,

verses.name: Philippians 3:10
verses.text: that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being made conformable to His death;

verses.name: Philippians 3:11
verses.text: if by any means I might attain to the resurrection of the dead.

verses.name: Philippians 3:12
verses.text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect, but I am pressing on, if I may lay hold of that for which I also was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philippians 3:13
verses.text: My brothers, I do not count myself to have taken possession, but one <hi>thing I do</hi>, forgetting the things behind and reaching forward to the things before,

verses.name: Philippians 3:14
verses.text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:15
verses.text: Let us therefore, as many as <hi>are</hi> perfect, be of this mind. And if in anything you are otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this to you.

verses.name: Philippians 3:16
verses.text: Yet, as to what we have already attained, let us walk in the same rule, let us mind the same thing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:17
verses.text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and mark those who walk this way, for you have us <hi>for</hi> a pattern.

verses.name: Philippians 3:18
verses.text: (For many are walking, of whom I have told you often and now tell you even weeping, <hi>as</hi> the enemies of the cross of Christ;

verses.name: Philippians 3:19
verses.text: whose end <hi>is</hi> destruction, whose god <hi>is their</hi> belly, and <hi>whose</hi> glory <hi>is</hi> in their shame, <hi>those</hi> who mind earthly things.)

verses.name: Philippians 3:20
verses.text: For our citizenship is in Heaven, from which also we are looking for the Savior, <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Philippians 3:21
verses.text: who shall change our body of humiliation so that it may be fashioned like His glorious body, according to the working of His power, even to subdue all things to Himself.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:1
verses.text: Therefore, my brothers, ones loved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand fast in this way in <hi>the</hi> Lord, beloved ones.

verses.name: Philippians 4:2
verses.text: I beg Euodia and Syntyche that they be of the same mind in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Philippians 4:3
verses.text: And I also beg you, true yoke-fellow, help those women who labored in the gospel with me and with Clement, and others of my fellow-laborers, whose names <hi>are</hi> in the Book of Life.

verses.name: Philippians 4:4
verses.text: Rejoice in <hi>the</hi> Lord always. Again I say, Rejoice!

verses.name: Philippians 4:5
verses.text: Let your moderation be known to all men. The Lord <hi>is</hi> at hand.

verses.name: Philippians 4:6
verses.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

verses.name: Philippians 4:7
verses.text: And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philippians 4:8
verses.text: Finally, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things <hi>are</hi> honest, whatever <hi>things are</hi> right, whatever <hi>things are</hi> pure, whatever <hi>things are</hi> lovely, whatever <hi>things are</hi> of good report; if <hi>there is</hi> any virtue and if <hi>there is</hi> any praise, think on these things.

verses.name: Philippians 4:9
verses.text: Do those things which you have also learned and received and heard and seen in me. And the God of peace shall be with you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:10
verses.text: But I rejoiced in <hi>the</hi> Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again. Although you indeed did think, but you lacked opportunity.

verses.name: Philippians 4:11
verses.text: Not that I speak according to need, for I have learned to be content in whatever state I am.

verses.name: Philippians 4:12
verses.text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound. In everything and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

verses.name: Philippians 4:13
verses.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

verses.name: Philippians 4:14
verses.text: Yet you did well in sharing my troubles.

verses.name: Philippians 4:15
verses.text: Now you Philippians know also that in <hi>the</hi> beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as regards giving and receiving, except you alone.

verses.name: Philippians 4:16
verses.text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity.

verses.name: Philippians 4:17
verses.text: I do not say this because I desire a gift, but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

verses.name: Philippians 4:18
verses.text: But I have all, and abound. I have been filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things <hi>which you sent</hi>, an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing to God.

verses.name: Philippians 4:19
verses.text: But my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:20
verses.text: Now unto God and our Father <hi>be</hi> glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.name: Philippians 4:21
verses.text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

verses.name: Philippians 4:22
verses.text: All the saints greet you, most of all those who are of Caesar's household.

verses.name: Philippians 4:23
verses.text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:1
verses.text: Paul, <hi>an</hi> apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy <hi>our</hi> brother,

verses.name: Colossians 1:2
verses.text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colosse. Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and from <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:3
verses.text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

verses.name: Colossians 1:4
verses.text: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love <hi>you have</hi> to all the saints,

verses.name: Colossians 1:5
verses.text: for the hope which is laid up for you in Heaven, of which you heard before in the Word of the truth of the gospel,

verses.name: Colossians 1:6
verses.text: which has come to you as <hi>it has</hi> also in all the world, and it is bearing fruit, even also among you, since the day you heard and fully knew the grace of God in truth,

verses.name: Colossians 1:7
verses.text: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow-servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ for you,

verses.name: Colossians 1:8
verses.text: he also having shown your love in <hi>the</hi> Spirit to us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:9
verses.text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled <hi>with</hi> the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding,

verses.name: Colossians 1:10
verses.text: that you might walk worthy of the Lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

verses.name: Colossians 1:11
verses.text: being empowered with all power, according to the might of His glory, to all patience and long-suffering with joyfulness,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:12
verses.text: giving thanks to the Father, who has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light.

verses.name: Colossians 1:13
verses.text: <hi> For He</hi> has delivered us from the power of darkness and has translated <hi>us</hi> into the kingdom of His dear Son;

verses.name: Colossians 1:14
verses.text: in whom we have redemption through His blood, the remission of sins.

verses.name: Colossians 1:15
verses.text: who is <hi>the</hi> image of the invisible God, <hi>the</hi> First-born of all creation.

verses.name: Colossians 1:16
verses.text: For all things were created by Him, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers, all things were created through Him and for Him.

verses.name: Colossians 1:17
verses.text: And He is before all things, and by Him all things consist.

verses.name: Colossians 1:18
verses.text: And He is <hi>the</hi> Head of the body, the church, who is <hi>the</hi> Beginning, the First-born from the dead, that He may be pre-eminent in all things.

verses.name: Colossians 1:19
verses.text: For it pleased <hi>the Father</hi> that in Him all fullness should dwell.

verses.name: Colossians 1:20
verses.text: And through Him having made peace through the blood of His cross, it pleased the Father to reconcile all things to Himself through Him, whether the things on earth or the things in Heaven.

verses.name: Colossians 1:21
verses.text: And you, who were once alienated and enemies in <hi>your</hi> mind by wicked works, yet now He has reconciled

verses.name: Colossians 1:22
verses.text: in the body of His flesh through death, to present you holy and without blame, and without charge in His sight,

verses.name: Colossians 1:23
verses.text: if indeed you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and <hi>are</hi> not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which you have heard <hi>and</hi> which was proclaimed in all the creation under Heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister,

verses.name: Colossians 1:24
verses.text: who now rejoice in my sufferings on your behalf, and I fill up the things lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh, on behalf of His body, which <hi>is</hi> the church;

verses.name: Colossians 1:25
verses.text: of which I became a minister, according to the administration of God given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;

verses.name: Colossians 1:26
verses.text: the mystery which has been hidden from ages and from generations, but now has been revealed to His saints.

verses.name: Colossians 1:27
verses.text: <hi> For to them</hi> God would make known what <hi>are</hi> the riches of the glory of this mystery among the nations, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory,

verses.name: Colossians 1:28
verses.text: whom we preach, warning every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Colossians 1:29
verses.text: For which I also labor, striving according to the working of Him who works in me in power.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:1
verses.text: For I want you to know what a great conflict I have for you and those at Laodicea, and <hi>for</hi> as many as have not seen my face in <hi>the</hi> flesh,

verses.name: Colossians 2:2
verses.text: that their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of the understanding, to <hi>the</hi> full knowledge of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

verses.name: Colossians 2:3
verses.text: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:4
verses.text: And I say this that not anyone should beguile you with enticing words.

verses.name: Colossians 2:5
verses.text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 2:6
verses.text: Therefore as you have received Christ Jesus the Lord, <hi>so</hi> walk in Him,

verses.name: Colossians 2:7
verses.text: rooted and built up in Him, and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.

verses.name: Colossians 2:8
verses.text: Beware lest anyone rob you through philosophy and vain deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the elements of the world, and not according to Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 2:9
verses.text: For in Him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.

verses.name: Colossians 2:10
verses.text: And you are complete in Him, who is the Head of all principality and power,

verses.name: Colossians 2:11
verses.text: in whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ,

verses.name: Colossians 2:12
verses.text: buried with Him in baptism, in whom also you were raised through the faith of the working of God, raising Him from the dead.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:13
verses.text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, He has made alive together with Him, having forgiven you all trespasses,

verses.name: Colossians 2:14
verses.text: blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

verses.name: Colossians 2:15
verses.text: Having stripped rulers and authorities, He made a show of them publicly, triumphing <hi>over</hi> them in it.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:16
verses.text: Therefore let no one judge you in food or in drink, or in respect of a holy day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbaths.

verses.name: Colossians 2:17
verses.text: For these are a shadow of things to come, but the body <hi>is</hi> of Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 2:18
verses.text: Let no one defraud you, delighting in humility and worship of the angels, intruding into things which he has not seen, without a cause <hi>being</hi> vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

verses.name: Colossians 2:19
verses.text: and not holding the Head, from whom all the body, having been supplied with the joints and bands, and having been joined together, will grow with the growth of God.

verses.name: Colossians 2:20
verses.text: If then you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as <hi>though</hi> living in <hi>the</hi> world, are you subject to <hi>its</hi> ordinances:

verses.name: Colossians 2:21
verses.text: touch not, taste not, handle not;

verses.name: Colossians 2:22
