verses.text: which things are all for corruption in the using, according to the commands and doctrines of men?

verses.name: Colossians 2:23
verses.text: <hi> These</hi> things indeed have a reputation of wisdom in self-imposed worship and humility, and unsparing severity the body, not in any honor for the satisfying of the flesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:1
verses.text: If then you were raised with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ is sitting at <hi>the</hi> right hand of God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:2
verses.text: Be mindful of things above, not on things on the earth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:3
verses.text: For you died, and your life has been hidden with Christ in God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:4
verses.text: When Christ our Life <hi>is</hi> revealed, then you also will be revealed with Him in glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:5
verses.text: Therefore put to death your members which are on the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness (which is idolatry),

verses.name: Colossians 3:6
verses.text: on account of which things' sake the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience,

verses.name: Colossians 3:7
verses.text: among whom you also once walked, when you lived in these.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:8
verses.text: But now also put off all <hi>these</hi> things: anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, shameful speech out of your mouth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:9
verses.text: Do not lie to one another, having put off the old man with his deeds

verses.name: Colossians 3:10
verses.text: and having put on the new, having been renewed in knowledge according to <hi>the</hi> image of Him who created him,

verses.name: Colossians 3:11
verses.text: where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, foreigner, Scythian, slave <hi>or</hi> freeman, but Christ <hi>is</hi> all things in all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:12
verses.text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, put on tender feelings of mercy, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, long-suffering,

verses.name: Colossians 3:13
verses.text: forbearing one another and forgiving yourselves, if anyone has a complaint against any. As Christ forgave you, so also you <hi>do</hi>.

verses.name: Colossians 3:14
verses.text: And above all these things <hi>put on</hi> love, which is <hi>the</hi> bond of perfectness.

verses.name: Colossians 3:15
verses.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which you also are called in one body, and be thankful.

verses.name: Colossians 3:16
verses.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:17
verses.text: And everything, whatever you do in word or deed, <hi>do</hi> all in the name of <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and <hi>the</hi> Father by Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:18
verses.text: Wives, be subject to <hi>your</hi> own husbands, as is becoming in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:19
verses.text: Husbands, love <hi>your</hi> wives, and do not be bitter against them.

verses.name: Colossians 3:20
verses.text: Children, obey <hi>your</hi> parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing to the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:21
verses.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they be discouraged.

verses.name: Colossians 3:22
verses.text: Slaves, obey <hi>your</hi> masters according to the flesh in all things; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:23
verses.text: And whatever you do, do <hi>it</hi> heartily, as to the Lord and not to men;

verses.name: Colossians 3:24
verses.text: knowing that from the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance. For you serve <hi>the</hi> Lord Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 3:25
verses.text: But he who does wrong shall receive <hi>justice</hi> for the wrong which he did, and there is no respect of persons.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:1
verses.text: Masters, give to <hi>your</hi> slaves what <hi>is</hi> just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:2
verses.text: Continue in prayer and watch in it with thanksgiving,

verses.name: Colossians 4:3
verses.text: praying together about us also, that God may open to us a door of the Word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I also have been bound,

verses.name: Colossians 4:4
verses.text: that I may make it clear, as I ought to speak.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:5
verses.text: Walk in wisdom toward those on the outside, redeeming the time.

verses.name: Colossians 4:6
verses.text: Let your speech <hi>be</hi> always with grace, having been seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:7
verses.text: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in <hi>the</hi> Lord, will make known to you all things about me.

verses.name: Colossians 4:8
verses.text: I sent <hi>him</hi> to you for this very purpose, that he might know the things about you, and that he might comfort your hearts,

verses.name: Colossians 4:9
verses.text: along with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is <hi>one</hi> of you. They shall make known to you all things here.

verses.name: Colossians 4:10
verses.text: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (regarding whom you received commandments; if he comes to you, receive him),

verses.name: Colossians 4:11
verses.text: and <hi>greetings from</hi> Jesus, who is called Justus, those being of the circumcision. These alone <hi>are my</hi> fellow-workers for the kingdom of God, who became a comfort to me.

verses.name: Colossians 4:12
verses.text: Epaphras greets you, he being of you, a servant of Christ, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

verses.name: Colossians 4:13
verses.text: For I bear him record that he has a great zeal for you and for those <hi>who are</hi> in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

verses.name: Colossians 4:14
verses.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

verses.name: Colossians 4:15
verses.text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church in his house.

verses.name: Colossians 4:16
verses.text: And when this letter is read before you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the <hi>letter</hi> of Laodicea.

verses.name: Colossians 4:17
verses.text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in <hi>the</hi> Lord, that you fulfill it.

verses.name: Colossians 4:18
verses.text: The salutation of Paul, by my own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace <hi>be</hi> with you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians, in God <hi>the</hi> Father and in <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ. Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: We give thanks to God for you always, making mention of you in our prayers,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: knowing, beloved brothers, your election of God.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: For our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit, and in much assurance, as you know what kind <hi>of men</hi> we were among you for your sake.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, welcoming the word in much affliction, with joy of <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: so that you were examples to all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: For from you the Word of the Lord sounded out, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we do not need to speak anything.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: For they themselves witness what kind of entrance we had to you, even how you turned from idols to God in order to serve the living and true God,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: and to wait for His Son from Heaven (whom He raised from <hi>the</hi> dead), Jesus, who delivered us from the wrath to come.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: For, my brothers, you yourselves know our coming in to you, that it was not in vain.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: But also suffering before, being insulted in Philippi, as you know, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God in much agony.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: For our exhortation <hi>to you was</hi> not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: but as we have been approved by God to be entrusted <hi>with</hi> the gospel, even so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God, who tries our hearts.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: For neither at any time did we use flattering words, as you know, nor with pretense of covetousness; God <hi>is</hi> witness.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: Nor did we seek glory from men, neither from you nor from others, being able to be <hi>so</hi> with heaviness, as apostles of Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse warmly cherishes her children.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: So affectionately longing for you, we were willing to have imparted to you, not only the gospel of God, but also our own souls, because you have become beloved to us.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: For, brothers, you remember our labor and toil. <hi>For</hi> laboring night and day in order not to put a burden on any one of you, we preached the gospel of God to you.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: You and God <hi>are</hi> witnesses how holily and justly and blamelessly we were to you who believe,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: even as you know how we exhorted and comforted and testified to each one of you, as a father to his children,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: that you should walk worthy of God, who has called you to His kingdom and glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: And for this cause we thank God without ceasing, that when you received <hi>the</hi> Word of hearing, of God, you welcomed <hi>it as</hi> the Word of God, not as a word of men, but <hi>as</hi> it is, truly <hi>the</hi> Word of God, which also effectually works in you who believe.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus. For you also have suffered these things by <hi>your</hi> own countrymen, even as they also by the Jews;

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: who both killed the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, also driving us out and they do not please God and <hi>being</hi> contrary to all men,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: forbidding us to speak to the nations that they might be saved, to fill up their sins always; but the wrath has come upon them to <hi>the</hi> uttermost.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: But, my brothers, when we were taken away from you for an hour's time (in presence, not in heart), we were much more eager with much desire to see your face.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:18
verses.text: Therefore we desired to come to you, truly I, Paul, both once and twice; but Satan hindered us.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:19
verses.text: For what <hi>is</hi> our hope or joy, or crown of rejoicing? <hi>Are</hi> you not even <hi>to be</hi> in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:20
verses.text: For you are our glory and joy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: Therefore when we could no longer endure, we were pleased to be left at Athens alone.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: And we sent Timothy, our brother and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: so that no one should be drawn aside by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to them.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: For truly, when we were with you, we told you before that we were going to suffer affliction, as it also happened, even you know.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: For this cause, when I could no longer endure, I also sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter may have tempted you and our labor may have been in vain.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: But now when Timothy came from you to us and brought us good news <hi>of</hi> your faith and love, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring to see us (as we also you),

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: then, my brothers, we were comforted over you, through your faith, even in all our affliction and needs;

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: for now we live, if you stand fast in <hi>the</hi> Lord.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy <hi>with</hi> which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: night and day praying exceedingly for <hi>me</hi> to see your face and to perfect the things lacking in your faith?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: And may God Himself and our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ direct our way to you.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: And may the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all, even as we do toward you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: in order to establish your hearts blameless in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:1
verses.text: For the rest, then, my brothers, we beseech you and exhort <hi>you</hi> in <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus, that, as you have received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, so you would abound more <hi>and more</hi>.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:2
verses.text: For we know what commands we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:3
verses.text: For this is the will of God, your sanctification, for you to abstain from fornication,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:4
verses.text: each one of you to know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honor

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:5
verses.text: (not in the passion of lust, even as the nations who do not know God),

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:6
verses.text: not to go beyond and defraud his brother in this matter (because the Lord <hi>is the</hi> avenger concerning all these, as we also have forewarned you and testified).

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:7
verses.text: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but in sanctification.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:8
verses.text: Therefore he who despises does not despise man, but God, who also has given us His Holy Spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:9
verses.text: But regarding brotherly love, you do not need that I write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:10
verses.text: And indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we beseech you, brothers, that you abound more <hi>and more</hi>,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:11
verses.text: and that you try earnestly to be quiet and to do <hi>your</hi> own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:12
verses.text: so that you may walk becomingly toward those outside, and that you may lack nothing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:13
verses.text: But I would not have you ignorant, brothers, concerning those who are asleep, that you be not grieved, even as others who have no hope.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:14
verses.text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will also bring with Him all those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:15
verses.text: For we say this to you by the Word of <hi>the</hi> Lord, that we who are alive <hi>and</hi> remain until the coming of the Lord shall not go before those who are asleep.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:16
verses.text: For the Lord Himself shall descend from Heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ shall rise first.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:17
verses.text: Then we who are alive <hi>and</hi> remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. And so we shall ever be with the Lord.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:18
verses.text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:1
verses.text: But of the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that I write to you.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:2
verses.text: For you yourselves know accurately that the day of <hi>the</hi> Lord comes like a thief in the night.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:3
verses.text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety! Then sudden destruction comes on them, as travail upon a woman with child. And they shall not escape.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:4
verses.text: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the Day should overtake you like a thief.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:5
verses.text: You are all the sons of light and the sons of the day. We are not of the night, or of darkness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:6
verses.text: Therefore let us not sleep as the rest <hi>do</hi>, but let us watch and be calm.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:7
verses.text: For those sleeping sleep in the night, and those being drunken are drunken in the night.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:8
verses.text: But let us, who are of the day, be calm, having put on <hi>the</hi> breastplate of faith and love and <hi>the</hi> hope of salvation <hi>for</hi> a helmet.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:9
verses.text: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:10
verses.text: who died for us, so that whether we watch or sleep we should live together with Him.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:11
verses.text: Therefore comfort one another, and edify one another, even as you also do.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:12
verses.text: And, brothers, we beseech you to know those who labor among you, and are over you in <hi>the</hi> Lord, and who admonish you,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:13
verses.text: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:14
verses.text: Now we exhort you, brothers, warn those who are unruly, comfort the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:15
verses.text: See <hi>that</hi> none gives evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue the good, both towards one another and towards all.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:16
verses.text: Rejoice evermore.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:17
verses.text: Pray without ceasing.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:18
verses.text: In everything give thanks, for this <hi>is the</hi> will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:19
verses.text: Do not quench the Spirit.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:20
verses.text: Do not despise prophesying.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:21
verses.text: Prove all things, hold fast to the good.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:22
verses.text: Abstain from every appearance of evil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:23
verses.text: And may the God of peace Himself sanctify you, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:24
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> He who called you, who also will do <hi>it</hi>.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:25
verses.text: Brothers, pray for us.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:26
verses.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:27
verses.text: I charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:28
verses.text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: We are bound to thank God always for you, my brothers, as it is right, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each one of you abounds toward one another;

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: so much so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God, for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations which you endure.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: For <hi>this is</hi> a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God for which you also suffer,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: since <hi>it is</hi> a righteous thing with God to repay tribulation to those who trouble you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: and to give rest with us to you who are troubled, at the revealing of the Lord Jesus from Heaven with the angels of His power,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: in flaming fire taking vengeance on those who do not know God and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: when He shall come to be glorified in His saints and to be admired in all those who believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that Day.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:11
verses.text: Therefore we also pray always for you that our God would count you worthy of <hi>this</hi> calling and fulfill all the good pleasure of His goodness and the work of faith with power,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:12
verses.text: that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: Now we beseech you, my brothers, with regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: that you should not be soon shaken <hi>in</hi> mind or troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word or letter, as through us, as <hi>if</hi> the Day of Christ is at hand.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Let not anyone deceive you by any means. For <hi>that Day shall not come</hi> unless there first comes a falling away, and the man of sin shall be revealed, the son of perdition,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God, or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself forth, that he is God.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: Do you not remember that I told you these things when I was still with you?

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: And now you know what holds him back, for him to might be revealed in his own time.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: For the mystery of lawlessness is already working, only he <hi>is</hi> now holding back until it comes out of the midst.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the breath of His mouth and shall destroy with the brightness of His coming,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: and with all deceit of unrighteousness in those who perish, because they did not receive the love of the truth, so that they might be saved.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: so that all those who do not believe the truth, but delight in unrighteousness, might be condemned.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of <hi>the</hi> Spirit and belief of <hi>the</hi> truth,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: to which He called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: Therefore, my brothers, stand fast and hold the teachings which you have been taught, whether by word or by our letter.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God, even our Father, who has loved us and has given <hi>us</hi> everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good word and work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: Finally, my brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have <hi>free</hi> course and be glorified, even as <hi>it is</hi> with you.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: And pray that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men; for all <hi>do not have</hi> faith.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you and keep <hi>you</hi> from evil.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: And we have confidence in <hi>the</hi> Lord regarding you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: And may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks disorderly, and not after the teaching which he received from us.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow us. For we did not behave ourselves disorderly among you,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: neither did we eat any man's bread <hi>for nothing</hi>, but we worked with labor and travail night and day, so that we might not be heavy on any of you

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: (not because we do not have power, but to make ourselves an example to you, to imitate us).

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this, that if anyone would not work, neither should he eat.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: For we hear that there are some who walk disorderly among you, not working at all, but being busybodies.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: Now we command and exhort those who are such, by our Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: But you, brothers, do not be weary in well doing.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:14
verses.text: And if anyone does not obey our word by this letter, mark that one and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:15
verses.text: Yet do not count <hi>him</hi> as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:16
verses.text: And may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord <hi>be</hi> with you all.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:17
verses.text: The greeting of Paul by my own hand which is <hi>the</hi> sign in every letter, so I write.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:18
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:1
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the command of God our Savior, and of <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ, our hope,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:2
verses.text: to Timothy, <hi>my</hi> own son in <hi>the</hi> faith. Grace, mercy and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:3
verses.text: Even as I begged you to remain at Ephesus, when I was going to Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:4
verses.text: nor to give heed to fables and endless genealogies (which provide doubts rather than a stewardship of God in faith).  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:5
verses.text: But the end of the commandment is love out of a pure heart, and a good conscience, and faith unfeigned,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:6
verses.text: from which some, having swerved, have turned aside to foolish talking,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:7
verses.text: desiring to be teachers of the law, neither understanding what they say nor that which they affirm.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:8
verses.text: But we know that the law <hi>is</hi> good if a man uses it lawfully,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:9
verses.text: knowing this, that the law <hi>is</hi> not made for a righteous one, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:10
verses.text: for fornicators, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and anything else that is contrary to sound doctrine,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:11
verses.text: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:12
verses.text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who strengthened me, because He counted me faithful, putting <hi>me</hi> into the ministry--

verses.name: I Timothy 1:13
verses.text: the <hi>one</hi> who before was a blasphemer and a persecutor and insolent. But I obtained mercy, because being ignorant, I did <hi>it</hi> in unbelief.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:14
verses.text: <hi> And</hi> the grace of our Lord was exceedingly abundant, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:15
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> the Word and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:16
verses.text: But for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all long-suffering, as a pattern to those being about to believe on Him to life everlasting.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:17
verses.text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, <hi>the</hi> only wise God, <hi>be</hi> honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:18
verses.text: This charge I commit to you, <hi>my</hi> son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before <hi>about</hi> you, in order that you might war a good warfare by them,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:19
verses.text: holding faith and a good conscience, which some have put away and made shipwreck as to faith.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:20
verses.text: Among these are Hymeneus and Alexander, whom I have delivered to Satan so that they may learn not to blaspheme.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:1
verses.text: First of all, then, I exhort <hi>that</hi> supplications, prayers, intercessions, <hi>and</hi> giving of thanks be made for all men,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:2
verses.text: for kings and all who are in authority, so that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:3
verses.text: For this <hi>is</hi> good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:4
verses.text: who will have all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:5
verses.text: For God <hi>is</hi> one, and <hi>there is</hi> one Mediator between God and man, <hi>the</hi> Man Christ Jesus,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:6
verses.text: who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:7
verses.text: To this I am ordained a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth in Christ, I do not lie), a teacher of <hi>the</hi> nations, in faith and truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:8
verses.text: Therefore, I desire that men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:9
verses.text: In the same way also, I desire that women adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and sensibleness, not <hi>adorned</hi> with braiding, or gold, or pearls, or costly clothing,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:10
verses.text: but with good works, which becomes women professing godliness.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:11
verses.text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:12
verses.text: But I do not allow a woman to teach, or to exercise authority <hi>over</hi> a man, but to be in silence.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:13
verses.text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:14
verses.text: And Adam was not deceived, but <hi>the</hi> woman being deceived was in the transgression.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:15
verses.text: But she will be kept safe through childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with sensibleness.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:1
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> the word: If anyone reaches out to overseership, he desires a good work.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:2
verses.text: Then it behooves the overseer to be without reproach, husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, well-ordered, hospitable, apt at teaching,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:3
verses.text: not a drinker, not quarrelsome, not greedy of ill gain, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:4
verses.text: ruling his own house well, having children in subjection with all honor.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:5
verses.text: (For if a man does not know to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

verses.name: I Timothy 3:6
verses.text: not a novice, lest being puffed up he may fall into the condemnation of the Devil.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:7
verses.text: But he must also have a good report from those on the outside, lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the Devil.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:8
verses.text: Likewise the deacons <hi>are to be</hi> reverent, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of ill gain,

verses.name: I Timothy 3:9
verses.text: having the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:10
verses.text: And let these also first be tested, then let them <hi>use the office of a deacon</hi>, being blameless.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:11
verses.text: Even so <hi>their</hi> wives are to <hi>be</hi> reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling <hi>their</hi> children and households well.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:13
verses.text: For they having served well gain a good grade for themselves, and much boldness in the faith, those in Christ Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:14
verses.text: I write these things to you, hoping to come to you shortly.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:15
verses.text: But if I should delay, that you may know how you ought to behave in the house of God, which is <hi>the</hi> church of the living God, <hi>the</hi> pillar and foundation of the truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:16
verses.text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen by angels, preached among nations, believed on in <hi>the</hi> world, and received up into glory.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:1
verses.text: But the Spirit expressly says that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and teachings of demons,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:2
verses.text: speaking lies in hypocrisy, being seared in <hi>their</hi> own conscience,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:3
verses.text: forbidding to marry, <hi>saying</hi> to abstain from foods which God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:4
verses.text: For every creation of God <hi>is</hi> good, and nothing to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:5
verses.text: For it is sanctified through the Word of God and prayer.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:6
verses.text: Having suggested these things to the brothers, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and by the good doctrine which you have followed.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:7
verses.text: But refuse profane and old-womanish tales, and exercise yourself to godliness.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:8
verses.text: For bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the present life, and of that which is to come.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:9
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> the Word, and worthy of all acceptance.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:10
verses.text: For to this we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the preserver of all men, especially of those who believe.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Command and teach these things.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:12
verses.text: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example of the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:13
verses.text: Until I come, attend to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the body of elders.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Meditate on these things; be in these things in order that your improvement may appear to all.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:16
verses.text: Hold on to yourself and to the doctrine; continue in them, for doing this you shall both save yourself and those who hear you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:1
verses.text: Do not sharply rebuke an elder, but exhort as a father, <hi>and</hi> the younger ones as brothers,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:2
verses.text: older women as mothers, the younger as sisters in all purity.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:3
verses.text: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:4
verses.text: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to be godly to their own house, and give back to <hi>their</hi> forebears what is due them; for that is good and pleasing before God.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:5
verses.text: But she being really a widow, and having been left alone, trusts on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:6
verses.text: But she who lives in self-pleasure has died while living.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:7
verses.text: And command these things so that they may be blameless.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:8
verses.text: But if anyone does not provide for <hi>his</hi> own, and especially <hi>his</hi> family, he has denied the faith and is worse than an infidel.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:9
verses.text: Do not let a widow be enrolled under sixty years old, <hi>the</hi> wife of one man,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:10
verses.text: well reported of for good works: if she brought up children, if she lodged strangers, if she washed the feet of the saints, if she relieved the afflicted, if she followed after every good work.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:11
verses.text: But refuse younger widows, for whenever they grow lustful against Christ, they desire to marry;

verses.name: I Timothy 5:12
verses.text: having guilt because they have cast off the first faith.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:13
verses.text: And with it all they also learn <hi>to be</hi> idle, going around the houses; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things they ought not.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:14
verses.text: Therefore I want the younger ones to marry, bear children, guide the house, giving no occasion to the adversary because of reproach.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:15
verses.text: For some have already turned aside after Satan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:16
verses.text: If any believing man or believing woman has widows, let them relieve them, and do not let the church be charged, so that it may relieve those who are widows indeed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:17
verses.text: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and doctrine.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:18
verses.text: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle the ox treading out grain," and, "The laborer <hi>is</hi> worthy of his reward."

verses.name: I Timothy 5:19
verses.text: Do not receive an accusation against an elder except before two or three witnesses.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:20
verses.text: Those who sin, rebuke before all, so that the rest also may fear.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:21
verses.text: I charge <hi>you</hi> before God and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that you guard these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:22
verses.text: Do not lay hands quickly on anyone, neither be partaker of <hi>the</hi> sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:23
verses.text: Drink water no longer, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake, and for your many infirmities.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:24
verses.text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment. And some follow after.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:25
verses.text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand, and those otherwise cannot be hidden.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:1
verses.text: Let as many slaves as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name and doctrine of God may not be blasphemed.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:2
verses.text: And those who have believing masters, let them not despise <hi>them</hi> because they are brothers. But rather let them serve, because they are faithful and beloved, those of the good service receiving in return. Teach and exhort these things.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:3
verses.text: If anyone teaches otherwise, and does not consent to wholesome words (those of our Lord Jesus Christ), and to the doctrine according to godliness,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:4
verses.text: he is proud, knowing nothing. <hi>He is</hi> sick concerning doubts and arguments, from which comes envy, strife, evil speakings, evil suspicions,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:5
verses.text: meddling, of men whose minds have been corrupted and deprived of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness. Withdraw from such.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:6
verses.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:7
verses.text: For we brought nothing into the world, <hi>and it is</hi> clear that we can carry nothing out.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:8
verses.text: But having food and clothing, we will be content.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:9
verses.text: But they who will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and <hi>into</hi> many foolish and hurtful lusts which plunge men into death and destruction.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:10
verses.text: For the love of money is a root of all evils, of which some having lusted after, they were seduced from the faith and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:11
verses.text: But you, O man of God, flee these things and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and meekness.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:12
verses.text: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold on eternal life, to which you are also called and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:13
verses.text: I charge you before God (who makes all things alive) and <hi>in the sight of</hi> Christ Jesus (who witnessed the good confession <hi>before</hi> Pontius Pilate),

verses.name: I Timothy 6:14
verses.text: that you keep the commandment without spot and without blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:15
verses.text: For He in His own time will reveal <hi>who is</hi> the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:16
verses.text: who alone has immortality, dwelling in light which cannot be approached, whom no one of men have seen, nor can see; to whom be honor and power everlasting. Amen.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:17
verses.text: Charge the rich in this world that they be not high-minded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, He offering to us richly all things to enjoy,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:18
verses.text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to share, to be generous,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:19
verses.text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:20
verses.text: O Timothy, guard the Deposit, avoiding profane <hi>and</hi> vain babblings, and opposing the theories of falsely-named science,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:21
verses.text: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace <hi>be</hi> with you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:1
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which <hi>is</hi> in Christ Jesus,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:2
verses.text: to Timothy, <hi>my</hi> dearly beloved child. Grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:3
verses.text: I thank God, whom I serve from <hi>my</hi> forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I remember you in my prayers night and day,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:4
verses.text: greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:5
verses.text: taking recollection of the unfeigned faith that is in you, which first dwelt <hi>in</hi> your grandmother Lois, and in your mother Eunice. And I am persuaded that it is in you also.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:6
verses.text: Therefore I remind you to inflame anew the gift of God, which is in you by the putting on of my hands.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:7
verses.text: For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:8
verses.text: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor <hi>of</hi> me His prisoner. But be partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to <hi>the</hi> power of God,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:9
verses.text: who has saved us and called <hi>us</hi> with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace which was given us in Christ Jesus before the eternal times.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:10
verses.text: But it is now made manifest by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who has made death of no effect, bringing life and immortality to light through the gospel;

verses.name: II Timothy 1:11
verses.text: to which I am appointed a preacher and an apostle and a teacher of the nations.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:12
verses.text: For this cause I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I have committed to Him against that Day.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:13
verses.text: Hold fast the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love <hi>which is</hi> in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:14
verses.text: Guard the good Deposit <hi>given</hi> through <hi>the</hi> Holy Spirit indwelling in us.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:15
verses.text: This you know, that all those in Asia have turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:16
verses.text: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed <hi>of</hi> my chain.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:17
verses.text: But when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently and found <hi>me</hi>.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:18
verses.text: May the Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from <hi>the</hi> Lord in that Day. And in what things he ministered <hi>to me</hi> at Ephesus, you know very well.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:1
verses.text: Therefore, my son, be strong in the grace <hi>that is</hi> in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:2
verses.text: And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:4
verses.text: No one who wars tangles with the affairs of <hi>this</hi> life, that he may please him who chose <hi>him</hi> to be a soldier.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:5
verses.text: And also if anyone competes, he is not crowned unless he competes lawfully.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:6
verses.text: It is right for the laboring farmer to partake first of the fruits.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Consider what I say, and the Lord will give you understanding in all things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:8
verses.text: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from <hi>the</hi> dead according to my gospel,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:9
verses.text: in which I suffer ill as an evildoer, <hi>even</hi> to bonds. But the Word of God is not chained.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:11
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> the word, for if we are dead with <hi>Him</hi>, we shall also live with <hi>Him</hi>.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:12
verses.text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with <hi>Him</hi>. If we deny <hi>Him</hi>, He also will deny us.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:13
verses.text: If we do not believe <hi>Him</hi>, <hi>yet</hi> He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:14
verses.text: Put <hi>them</hi> in memory of these things, charging them before the Lord not to dispute about words to no profit, to the subverting of the hearers.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:15
verses.text: <hi> Study</hi> earnestly to present yourself approved to God, a workman that does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the Word of Truth.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:16
verses.text: But shun profane, vain babblings, for they will increase to more ungodliness.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:17
verses.text: And their word will eat like a gangrene; among whom <hi>are</hi> Hymeneus and Philetus,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:18
verses.text: who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and who overthrow the faith of some.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:19
verses.text: Nevertheless the foundation of God stands sure, having this seal: "<hi> The</hi> Lord knew those who are His." And, "Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity!"

verses.name: II Timothy 2:20
verses.text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honor, and some to dishonor.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:21
verses.text: Therefore if anyone purges himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honor, sanctified and useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:22
verses.text: But flee youthful lusts, and follow righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:23
verses.text: But avoid foolish and unlearned questions, knowing that they give birth to strifes.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:24
verses.text: But the servant of <hi>the</hi> Lord must not strive, but to be gentle to all, apt to teach, patient,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:25
verses.text: in meekness instructing those who oppose, if perhaps God will give them repentance to the acknowledging of <hi>the</hi> truth,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:26
verses.text: and <hi>that</hi> they awake out of the snare of the Devil, having been taken captive by him, so as to do the will of that one.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:1
verses.text: Know this also, that in <hi>the</hi> last days grievous times will be <hi>on us</hi>.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:2
verses.text: For men will be self-lovers, money-lovers, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:3
verses.text: without natural affection, unyielding, false accusers, without self-control, savage, despisers of good,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:4
verses.text: traitors, reckless, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:5
verses.text: having a form of godliness, but denying the power of it; even turn away from these.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:6
verses.text: For of these are those who creep into houses and lead captive silly women loaded with sins, led away with different kinds of lusts,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:7
verses.text: ever learning and never able to come to the full knowledge of <hi>the</hi> truth.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:8
verses.text: But as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so these also resist the truth, men of corrupt mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:9
verses.text: But they shall proceed no further. For their foolishness shall be plain to all, as theirs also became.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:10
verses.text: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, love, patience,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:11
verses.text: persecutions, afflictions, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra. What persecutions I endured! But the Lord delivered me out of all.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Yea, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:13
verses.text: But evil men and seducers will go forward to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:14
verses.text: But continue in the things that you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned <hi>them</hi>,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:15
verses.text: and that from a babe you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:16
verses.text: All Scripture <hi>is</hi> God-breathed, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:17
verses.text: that the man of God may be perfected, thoroughly furnished to every good work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:1
verses.text: Therefore I solemnly witness before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who is going to judge <hi>the</hi> living and <hi>the</hi> dead according to His appearance and His kingdom,

verses.name: II Timothy 4:2
verses.text: preach the Word, be instant in season and out of season, reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and doctrine.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:3
verses.text: For the time will be when they will not endure sound doctrine, but they will heap up teachers to themselves according to their own lusts, tickling the ear.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:4
verses.text: And they will turn away <hi>their</hi> ears from the truth and will be turned to myths.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:5
verses.text: But you watch in all things, endure afflictions, do <hi>the</hi> work of an evangelist, fully carry out your ministry."

verses.name: II Timothy 4:6
verses.text: For I am already being poured out, and the time of my release is here.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:7
verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Now there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, shall give me at that Day; and not to me only, but also to all those who love His appearing.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:9
verses.text: Make haste to come to me quickly.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:10
verses.text: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and <hi>he</hi> has departed to Thessalonica. Crescens <hi>went</hi> to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark <hi>and</hi> bring <hi>him</hi> with you, for he is profitable to me for <hi>the</hi> ministry.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:12
verses.text: And I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:13
verses.text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Alexander the coppersmith showed many evil things to me. The Lord will give to him according to his works.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:15
verses.text: You also should beware of <hi>him</hi>, for he has greatly withstood our words.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:16
verses.text: At my first answer no one was beside me, but all deserted me. May it not be laid to their charge.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:17
verses.text: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, that through me the preaching might be fully known, and <hi>that</hi> all the nations might hear. And I was delivered out of <hi>the</hi> mouth of the lion.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:18
verses.text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work and will preserve <hi>me</hi> for His heavenly kingdom, to whom <hi>be</hi> glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:19
verses.text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:20
verses.text: Erastus stayed at Corinth, but Trophimus I left sick at Miletus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:21
verses.text: Try to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:22
verses.text: May the Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with your spirit. Grace <hi>be</hi> with you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:1
verses.text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ (according to <hi>the</hi> faith of God's elect, in the acknowledging of <hi>the</hi> truth which is according to godliness

verses.name: Titus 1:2
verses.text: on hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before <hi>the</hi> eternal times,

verses.name: Titus 1:3
verses.text: but revealed in its own times in a proclamation of His word, with which I was entrusted by <hi>the</hi> command of God our Savior,)

verses.name: Titus 1:4
verses.text: to Titus, a true child according to <hi>our</hi> common faith. Grace mercy and peace from God <hi>the</hi> Father and <hi>the</hi> Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:5
verses.text: For this cause I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:6
verses.text: if anyone is blameless, husband of one wife, having believing children, not accused of loose behavior, or disobedient.

verses.name: Titus 1:7
verses.text: For an overseer must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not full of passion, not given to wine, not quarrelsome, not greedy for ill gain;

verses.name: Titus 1:8
verses.text: but hospitable, a lover of good, discreet, just, holy, temperate

verses.name: Titus 1:9
verses.text: holding fast the faithful word according to the doctrine, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and to convict the gainsayers.

verses.name: Titus 1:10
verses.text: For there are indeed many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of <hi>the</hi> circumcision,

verses.name: Titus 1:11
verses.text: whose mouth <hi>you</hi> must stop, who subvert whole houses, teaching things not right for the sake of ill gain.

verses.name: Titus 1:12
verses.text: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans <hi>are</hi> always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.

verses.name: Titus 1:13
verses.text: This witness is true; for which cause convict them sharply, so that they may be sound in the faith,

verses.name: Titus 1:14
verses.text: not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men, turning away from the truth.

verses.name: Titus 1:15
verses.text: To the pure all things <hi>are</hi> pure. But to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing <hi>is</hi> pure, but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.name: Titus 1:16
verses.text: They profess that they know God, but in <hi>their</hi> works they deny <hi>Him</hi>, being abominable and disobedient and reprobate to every good work.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:1
verses.text: But you speak <hi>the</hi> things which become sound doctrine:

verses.name: Titus 2:2
verses.text: aged men to be temperate, sensible, discreet, sound in faith, in love, in patience.

verses.name: Titus 2:3
verses.text: Let the aged women likewise <hi>be</hi> in reverent behavior, not slanderers, not enslaved by much wine, teachers of good;

verses.name: Titus 2:4
verses.text: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

verses.name: Titus 2:5
verses.text: <hi> to be</hi> discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, subject to <hi>their</hi> own husbands, that the Word of God may not be blasphemed.

verses.name: Titus 2:6
verses.text: Likewise exhort the young men to be discreet;

verses.name: Titus 2:7
verses.text: In all things having shown yourself a pattern of good works: in doctrine, purity, sensibleness, without corruption,

verses.name: Titus 2:8
verses.text: <hi> in</hi> sound speech that cannot be condemned, that he who is opposed may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

verses.name: Titus 2:9
verses.text: Slaves <hi>are</hi> to be obedient to <hi>their</hi> masters, to please them well in all <hi>things</hi>, not talking back,

verses.name: Titus 2:10
verses.text: not stealing, but showing all good faith, so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:11
verses.text: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

verses.name: Titus 2:12
verses.text: teaching us that having denied ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live discreetly, righteously and godly, in this present world,

verses.name: Titus 2:13
verses.text: looking for the blessed hope, and the glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,

verses.name: Titus 2:14
verses.text: who gave Himself for us that He might redeem us from all iniquity and purify to Himself a special people, zealous of good works.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:15
verses.text: Speak these things, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:1
verses.text: Put them in mind to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to every good work,

verses.name: Titus 3:2
verses.text: to speak evil of no one, not being quarrelsome, <hi>but</hi> forbearing, showing all meekness to all men.

verses.name: Titus 3:3
verses.text: For we ourselves also were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, slaving for various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

verses.name: Titus 3:4
verses.text: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior toward man appeared,

verses.name: Titus 3:5
verses.text: not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Titus 3:6
verses.text: whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

verses.name: Titus 3:7
verses.text: that being justified by His grace, we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.name: Titus 3:8
verses.text: Faithful <hi>is</hi> the Word, and as to these things, I desire that you strongly affirm that those believing God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:9
verses.text: But avoid foolish questions and genealogies and contentions, and strivings about the Law, for they are unprofitable and vain.

verses.name: Titus 3:10
verses.text: After the first and second warning, reject a man of heresy,

verses.name: Titus 3:11
verses.text: knowing that he who is such has been perverted, and sins, being self-condemned.

verses.name: Titus 3:12
verses.text: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, hasten to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

verses.name: Titus 3:13
verses.text: Diligently set forward Zenas the lawyer, and Apollos, that nothing may be lacking to them.

verses.name: Titus 3:14
verses.text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, so that they may not be unfruitful.

verses.name: Titus 3:15
verses.text: All those with me greet you. Greet those who love us in <hi>the</hi> faith. May grace <hi>be</hi> with you all. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:1
verses.text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy <hi>our</hi> brother, to Philemon the beloved and fellow laborer,

verses.name: Philemon 1:2
verses.text: and to Apphia the beloved, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house.

verses.name: Philemon 1:3
verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philemon 1:4
verses.text: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,

verses.name: Philemon 1:5
verses.text: hearing of your love and faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all saints,

verses.name: Philemon 1:6
verses.text: that the fellowship of your faith may operate in a full knowledge of every good thing in you in Christ Jesus.

verses.name: Philemon 1:7
verses.text: For we have great joy and consolation over your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:8
verses.text: Therefore, having much boldness in Christ to enjoin you to do the fitting thing;

verses.name: Philemon 1:9
verses.text: rather through love I entreat, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Philemon 1:10
verses.text: I entreat you for my child Onesimus, whom I have fathered in my bonds,

verses.name: Philemon 1:11
verses.text: he once worthless to you, but now useful to you and to me; whom I sent back to you.

verses.name: Philemon 1:12
verses.text: Even receive him, that is, my own heart,

verses.name: Philemon 1:13
verses.text: whom I resolved to retain with me, so that for you he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the gospel.

verses.name: Philemon 1:14
verses.text: But without your consent I was willing to do nothing, that your good should not be of necessity, but willingly.

verses.name: Philemon 1:15
verses.text: For perhaps because of this he was separated from you for an hour, that you should receive him eternally,

verses.name: Philemon 1:16
verses.text: not now as a slave, but beyond a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

verses.name: Philemon 1:17
verses.text: If then you have me as a partner, receive him as me.

verses.name: Philemon 1:18
verses.text: If he has wronged you or owes <hi>you</hi> in anything, put that on my account.

verses.name: Philemon 1:19
verses.text: I, Paul, wrote it with my own hand; I will repay, that I do not say to you that you owe even yourself to me also.

verses.name: Philemon 1:20
verses.text: Yes, brother, that I may have your help in the Lord, refresh my heart in the Lord.

verses.name: Philemon 1:21
verses.text: Trusting to your obedience, I wrote to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

verses.name: Philemon 1:22
verses.text: But at once prepare lodging for me, for I hope that through your prayers I shall be given to you.

verses.name: Philemon 1:23
verses.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

verses.name: Philemon 1:24
verses.text: and also Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-laborers.

verses.name: Philemon 1:25
verses.text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with your spirit.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:1
verses.text: God, who at many times and in many ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:2
verses.text: has in these last days spoken to us by His Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things, by whom also He made the worlds,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:3
verses.text: who being the shining splendor of <hi>His</hi> glory, and the express image of His essence, and upholding all things by the word of His power, having made purification of our sins, <hi>He</hi> sat down on <hi>the</hi> right of the Majesty on high,  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:4
verses.text: being made so much better than the angels, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:5
verses.text: For to which of the angels did He say at any time, "You are My Son, this day I have begotten Thee?" And again, "I will be to Him a Father, and He shall be to Me a Son?"

verses.name: Hebrews 1:6
verses.text: And again, when He brings in the First-born into the world, He says, "And let all <hi>the</hi> angels of God worship Him."

verses.name: Hebrews 1:7
verses.text: And of the angels He says, "Who makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire."

verses.name: Hebrews 1:8
verses.text: But to the Son <hi>He says</hi>, "Your throne, O God, <hi>is</hi> forever and ever. A scepter of righteousness <hi>is</hi> the scepter of Your kingdom.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:9
verses.text: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity, therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows."

verses.name: Hebrews 1:10
verses.text: And, "You, Lord, have laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the works of Your hands.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:11
verses.text: They shall perish, but You will remain. And <hi>they</hi> shall all become old as a garment,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:12
verses.text: and as a covering You shall fold them up, and <hi>they</hi> shall be changed. But You are the same, and Your years shall not fail."

verses.name: Hebrews 1:13
verses.text: But to which of the angels, did He say at any time, "Sit on My right hand until I make Your enemies Your footstool?"

verses.name: Hebrews 1:14
verses.text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for those who shall be heirs of salvation?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:1
verses.text: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let <hi>them</hi> slip.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:2
verses.text: For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and if every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:3
verses.text: how shall we escape <hi>if</hi> we neglect so great a salvation, which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by those who heard <hi>Him</hi>;

verses.name: Hebrews 2:4
verses.text: God <hi>also</hi> bearing <hi>them</hi> witness, both with signs and wonders, and with different kinds of miracles and gifts <hi>of the</hi> Holy Spirit, according to His own will?  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:5
verses.text: For He has not put in subjection to the angels the world to come, of which we speak.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:6
verses.text: But one testified in a certain place, saying, "What is man, that You are mindful of him; or the son of man, that You visit him?

verses.name: Hebrews 2:7
verses.text: You have made him a little lower than <hi>the</hi> angels. You crowned him with glory and honor and set him over the works of Your hands.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:8
verses.text: You have subjected all things under his feet." For in order that He put all things under him, He did not leave anything not subjected. But now we do not see all things having been put under him.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:9
verses.text: But we see Jesus, who <hi>was</hi> made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor, that He by <hi>the</hi> grace of God should taste death for every <hi>son</hi>.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:10
verses.text: For it became Him, for whom <hi>are</hi> all things and by whom <hi>are</hi> all things, in bringing many sons into glory, to perfect the Captain of their salvation through sufferings.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:11
verses.text: For both He who sanctifies and they who are sanctified <hi>are</hi> all of One, for which cause He is not ashamed to call them brothers,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:12
verses.text: saying, "I will declare Your name to My brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to You."

verses.name: Hebrews 2:13
verses.text: And again, "I will put My trust in Him." And again, "Behold Me and the children whom God has given Me."  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:14
verses.text: Since then the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He also Himself likewise partook of the same; that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death (that is, the Devil),

verses.name: Hebrews 2:15
verses.text: and deliver those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:16
verses.text: For truly He did not take <hi>the nature of</hi> angels, but He took hold of <hi>the</hi> seed of Abraham.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:17
verses.text: Therefore <hi>in all things</hi> it behoved him to be made like <hi>His</hi> brothers, that He might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of <hi>His</hi> people.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:18
verses.text: For in that He Himself has suffered, having been tempted, He is able to rescue those who have been tempted.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:1
verses.text: Therefore, holy brothers, called <hi>to be</hi> partakers of the heavenly <hi>calling</hi>, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus,
