verses.text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he will begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as He has declared to His servants the prophets.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: And the voice which I heard from Heaven spoke to me again, and said, Go, take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: And I went to the angel and said to him, Give me the little book. And he said to me, Take <hi>it</hi> and eat it up, and it will make your belly bitter, but it will be sweet as honey in your mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand and ate it up. And it was sweet as honey in my mouth, and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was made bitter.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: And he said to me, You must prophesy again before many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: And a reed like a rod was given to me. And the angel stood, saying, Rise up and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: But leave out the court which is outside the temple, and do not measure it, for it was given to the nations. And they will trample the holy city forty-two months.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: And I will give <hi>power</hi> to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy a thousand, two hundred and sixty days, clothed <hi>in</hi> sackcloth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: And if anyone will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. And if anyone will hurt them, so it is right for him to be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: These have authority to shut up the heaven, that it may not rain in the days of their prophecy. And they have authority over waters to turn them to blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: And when they complete their testimony, the beast coming up out of the abyss will make war against them and will overcome them and kill them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: And their bodies <hi>will lie</hi> in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
verses.text: And many of the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will see their dead bodies three days and a half, and they will not allow their dead bodies to be put in tombs.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: And the ones who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and will make merry, and will send one another gifts, because these two prophets tormented those living on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: And after three days and a half, a spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. And great fear fell on those seeing them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: And they heard a great voice from Heaven saying to them, Come up here. And they went up to Heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: And in that hour a great earthquake occurred, and the tenth <hi>part</hi> of the city fell. And seven thousand names of men were slain in the earthquake. And the rest were frightened and gave glory to the God of Heaven.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: The second woe passed away. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: And the seventh angel sounded. And there were great voices in Heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world have become <hi>the kingdoms</hi> of our Lord, and of His Christ. And He will reign forever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: And the twenty-four elders sitting before God on their thrones, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: saying, We thank You, O Lord God Almighty, who are, and who was, and who is coming, because You took Your great power and reigned.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: And the nations were full of wrath, and Your wrath came, and the time of the judging of the dead, and to give the reward to Your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to the ones fearing Your name, to the small and to the great, and to destroy those destroying the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: And the temple of God was opened in Heaven, and there was seen in His temple the ark of His covenant, and occurred lightnings and voices, and thunders and an earthquake, and a great hail.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: And there appeared a great sign in the heavens, a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon was under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: and having <hi>a babe</hi> in womb, she cries, being in travail, having been distressed to bear.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: And another sign was seen in the heavens. And behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on his heads!

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: And his tail drew the third <hi>part</hi> of the stars of heaven, and cast them onto the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman being about to bear, so that when she bears he might devour her child.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: And she bore a son, a male, who is going to rule all nations with a rod of iron. And her child was caught up to God and <hi>to</hi> His throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she had a place prepared by God, so that they might nourish her there a thousand, two hundred <hi>and</hi> sixty days.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: And there was war in Heaven. Michael and his angels warring against the dragon. And the dragon and his angels warred,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: but did not prevail. Nor was place found for them in Heaven any more.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: And the great dragon was cast out, the old serpent called Devil, and Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: And I heard a great voice saying in Heaven, Now has come the salvation and power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers is cast down, who accused them before our God day and night.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb, and because of the word of their testimony. And they did not love their soul to the death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and those tabernacling in them. Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and in the sea! For the Devil came down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a little time.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman who bore the man <hi>child</hi>.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: And two wings of a great eagle were given to the woman, so that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, from the serpent's face.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water like a flood after the woman, so that he might cause her to be carried away by the river.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: And the earth helped the woman. And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: And the dragon was enraged over the woman, and went to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: And I stood on the sand of the sea, and I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns. And on its horns were ten crowns, and on its heads was the name of blasphemy.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like <hi>those</hi> of a bear, and its mouth like the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave him its power and its seat and great authority.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: And I saw one of its heads as having been slain to death, and its deadly wound was healed. And all the earth marveled after the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: And they worshiped the dragon who gave authority to the beast. And they worshiped the beast, saying, Who <hi>is</hi> like the beast? Who is able to make war with it?

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: And a mouth speaking great things was given to it, and blasphemies. And authority was given to it to continue forty-two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: And it opened its mouth in blasphemy toward God, to blaspheme His name and His tabernacle, and those dwelling in Heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: And it was given to it to war with the saints and to overcome them. And authority was given to it over every tribe and tongues and nation.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: And all dwelling on the earth will worship it, those whose names have not been written in the Book of Life of the Lamb slain, from the foundation of the world.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: If any man has an ear, let him hear.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: He who leads into captivity will go into captivity. If anyone will kill with the sword, he must be killed by a sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. And it had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: And it exercises all the authority of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and those dwelling in it to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: And it does great wonders, so that it makes fire come down from the heaven onto the earth in the sight of men.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: And it deceives those dwelling on the earth, because of the miracles which were given to it to do before the beast, saying to those dwelling on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the wound by a sword and lived.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: And there was given to it to give a spirit to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might both speak, and might cause as many as would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: And it causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark on their right hand, or in their foreheads,

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: even that not any might buy or sell except those having the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of its name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: Here is wisdom. Let him having reason count the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. And its number <hi>is</hi> six hundred <hi>and</hi> sixty-six.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: And I looked, and lo, the Lamb stood on Mount Zion. And with Him were a hundred <hi>and</hi> forty-four. thousands, having His Father's name written in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: And I heard a voice from Heaven, like the voice of many waters and like the voice of a great thunder. And I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: And they sang as it were a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn that song except the hundred <hi>and</hi> forty-four thousands who were redeemed from the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: These are those who were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were redeemed from among men, <hi>as a</hi> firstfruit to God and to the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: And in their mouth was found no guile, for they were without blemish before the throne of God.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: And I saw another angel flying in mid-heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to those dwelling on the earth, even to every nation and kindred and tongue and people,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: saying with a great voice, Fear God and give glory to Him! For the hour of His judgment has come. And worship Him who made the heaven and the earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: And another angel followed, saying, The great city, Babylon, has fallen, has fallen; because of the wine of the anger of her fornication; she has made all nations to drink.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: And a third angel followed them, saying with a great voice, If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives a mark in his forehead or in his hand,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: he also will drink of the wine of the anger of God, having been mixed undiluted in the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented by fire and brimstone before the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. And they have no rest day or night, those who worship the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: Here is the patience of the saints. Here <hi>are</hi> the ones who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: And I heard a voice from Heaven saying to me, Write, Blessed <hi>are</hi> the dead who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, they shall rest from their labors, and their works follow them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: And I looked, and behold, a white cloud. And on the cloud sat one like the Son of man, having a golden crown on His head, and a sharp sickle in His hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple, crying in a great voice to Him sitting on the cloud, Thrust in Your sickle and reap, for the time has come for You to reap, for the harvest of the earth was dried.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: And He sitting on the cloud thrust in His sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple in Heaven, also having a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: And another angel came out from the altar, who had authority over fire. And he spoke with a great cry to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for her grapes are fully ripe.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast <hi>it</hi> into the great winepress of the anger of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even to the bridles of the horses, for the space of a thousand, six hundred stadia.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: And I saw another sign in Heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels with the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire. And those who had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, <hi>and</hi> over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvelous <hi>are</hi> Your works, Lord God Almighty, just and true <hi>are</hi> Your ways, O King of saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: Who shall not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You only <hi>are</hi> holy. For all nations shall come and worship before You, for Your righteousnesses were made known.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: And after these things I looked, and behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony was opened in Heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and were tied at the breasts with golden bands.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from His authority. And no one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go and pour out the vials of the anger of God on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: And the first went and poured out his vial on the earth. And a bad and grievous sore fell on the men who had the mark of the beast, and <hi>on</hi> those who worshiped his image.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: And the second angel poured out his vial on the sea. And it became like the blood of a dead one, and every living soul died in the sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: And the third angel poured out his vial on the rivers and fountains of waters, and they became blood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Righteous is the Lord, who is, and was, and who will be, because You have judged these things,

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: since they have poured out the blood of the saints and prophets; and You gave them blood to drink, for they were deserving.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: And I heard another out of the altar saying, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous <hi>are</hi> Your judgments.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: And the fourth angel poured out his vial onto the sun. And it was given to him to burn men with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: And men were burned with great heat. And they blasphemed the name of God, He having authority over these plagues. And they did not repent in order to give Him glory.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: And the fifth angel poured out his vial on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkened. And they gnawed their tongues from the pain.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: And they blasphemed the God of Heaven because of their pains and their sores. And they did not repent of their deeds.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: And the sixth angel poured out his vial on the great river Euphrates. And its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from <hi>the</hi> rising of <hi>the</hi> sun might be prepared.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs <hi>come</hi> out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: For they are spirits of demons, working miracles, <hi>which</hi> go forth to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that day, the great day of God Almighty.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: Behold, I am coming as a thief. Blessed <hi>is</hi> the <hi>one</hi> who watches and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked and they see his shame.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: And he gathered them into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
verses.text: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air. And a great voice came out of the temple of Heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done!

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: And voices and thunders and lightnings occurred. And there was a great earthquake, such as has not been since men were on the earth, so mighty <hi>and</hi> so great an earthquake.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: And the great city came to be into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And great Babylon was remembered before God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the anger of His wrath.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: And every island fled away, and mountains were not found.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: And a great hail, as the size of a talent, came down out of the heaven on men. And men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague of it was exceedingly great.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vials came and talked with me, saying to me, Come here, I will show you the judgment of the great harlot sitting on many waters,

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and became drunk with the wine of her fornication, those inhabiting the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: And he carried me away into a desert by <hi>the</hi> Spirit. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, filled with names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet. And she was gilded with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: And on her forehead <hi>was</hi> a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. And when I saw her, I marveled with a great marveling.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: And the angel said to me, Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, that has the seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to ascend out of the abyss and go into perdition. And those dwelling on the earth will marvel, those whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: <hi> And</hi> here <hi>is</hi> the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: And there are seven kings; five have fallen, and one is, <hi>and</hi> the other has not yet come. And when he comes, he must continue a short time.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, who have received no kingdom yet, but will receive authority as kings one hour with the beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: These have one mind, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them. For He is Lord of lords and King of kings. And those with Him <hi>are</hi> the called and elect and faithful ones.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: And he says to me, The waters which you saw, where the harlot sits are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues,

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: and the ten horns which you saw on the beast, these will hate the harlot and will make her desolate and naked. And they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: For God gave into their hearts to do His mind, and to act with one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast until the words of God will be fulfilled.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: And the woman whom you saw is the great city which has a kingdom over the kings of the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: And after these things I saw another angel come down from Heaven, having great authority. And the earth was lighted up from his glory.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great has fallen, has fallen! And it has become the dwelling-place of demons, and a prison of every unclean spirit, and a cage of every unclean bird which has been hated,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: because of the wine of the anger of her fornication which all the nations have drunk. And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her. And the merchants of the earth became rich from the power of her luxury.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: And I heard another voice from Heaven, saying, Come out of her, My people, that you may not be partakers of her sins, and that you may not receive of her plagues.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: For her sins joined together, even up to Heaven, and God has remembered her unjust deeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: Reward her as she has rewarded you, and double to her double, according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix double to her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: As much as she has glorified herself and has lived in luxury, so much torment and sorrow give her. For she says in her heart, I sit as a queen, and I am not a widow; and I do not see mourning at all.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: Therefore her plagues will come in one day, death and mourning and famine. And she will be consumed with fire, for the Lord God who judges her <hi>is</hi> strong.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: And the kings of the earth who have committed fornication and lived in luxury with her will weep for her, and will wail over her when they see the smoke of her burning;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: standing afar off for fear of her torment, saying, Woe! Woe to the great city, Babylon, that strong city! For in one hour your judgment came.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their cargo any more;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: the cargo of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and every ivory vessel, and every vessel of very precious wood, and of bronze, and of iron, and of marble,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: and cinnamon, and incenses, and ointment, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: And the fruits of the lust of your soul have departed from you, and all the fat things and the bright things departed from you, and you will find them no more, not at all.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand afar off because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: and saying, Woe! Woe to the great city which was clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: For in one hour such great riches was desolated. And every ship-pilot, and all the company on the ships, and sailors, and as many as work the sea, stood afar off.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: And they cried out, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying, What <hi>is</hi> like the great city?

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: And they threw dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, Woe! Woe to the great city, by which all who had ships in the sea were rich out of her costliness! For in one hour she was ruined.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: Rejoice over her, Heaven, and the holy apostles, and the prophets, since God judged your judgment on her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: And one strong angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw <hi>it</hi> into the sea, saying, So on an impulse the great city, Babylon, will be thrown down and not at all will be found any more.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: And the voice of harpers, and of musicians. and flutists, and of trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. And every craftsman of any craft will not be found any more in you. And the sound of a mill will never more be heard at all in you.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: And the light of a lamp will never more shine at all in you. And the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will never more be heard at all in you. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth; for by your sorceries all nations were deceived.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all those who were slain on the earth.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: And after these things I heard a great sound of a numerous crowd in Heaven, saying, Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and honor and the power of the Lord our God!

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: For true and righteous <hi>are</hi> His judgments. For He has judged the great harlot who defiled the earth with her fornication, and He has avenged the blood of His servants out of her hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: And secondly they said, Hallelujah! And her smoke rose up forever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God sitting on the throne, saying, Amen! Hallelujah!  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all His servants, and the ones fearing Him, the small and great.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: And I heard as the sound of a great multitude, and as the sound of many waters, and as the sound of strong thunders, saying, Hallelujah! For the Lord God omnipotent reigns!

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: Let us be glad and rejoice and we will give glory to Him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His wife has prepared herself.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white. For the fine linen is the righteousness of the saints.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: And he said to me, Write, Blessed <hi>are</hi> those who have been called to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true sayings of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said to me, Stop! I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers who have the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: And I saw Heaven opened. And behold, a white horse! And He sitting on him <hi>was</hi> called Faithful and True. And in righteousness He judges and makes war.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: And His eyes <hi>were</hi> like a flame of fire, and on His head many crowns. And He had a name written, one that no one knew except Himself.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: And He had been clothed <hi>in</hi> a garment dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: And the armies in Heaven followed Him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: And out of His mouth goes a sharp sword, so that with it He should strike the nations. And He will shepherd them with a rod of iron. And He treads the winepress of the wine of the anger and of the wrath of Almighty God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: And He has on <hi>His</hi> garment, and on His thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
verses.text: And I saw one angel standing in the sun. And he cried with a great voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid-heaven, Come and gather together to the supper of the great God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, and <hi>the</hi> flesh of commanders, and <hi>the</hi> flesh of strong ones, and <hi>the</hi> flesh of horses, and those sitting on them, and <hi>the</hi> flesh of all, both free and slave, both small and great.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth and their armies, being gathered to make war against Him who sat on the horse, and against His army.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet doing signs before it, (by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast), and those who had worshiped his image. The two were thrown alive into the Lake of Fire burning with brimstone.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: And the rest were slain by the sword of Him who sat on the horse, it proceeding out of His mouth. And all the birds were filled from their flesh.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: And I saw an angel come down from Heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: And he cast him into the abyss and shut him up and set a seal on him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years should be fulfilled. And after that he must be loosed a little time.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. And <hi>I saw</hi> the souls of those who had been beheaded for the witness of Jesus and for the Word of God, and who had not worshiped the beast nor his image, nor had received <hi>his</hi> mark on their foreheads, nor in their hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: But the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years were finished. This <hi>is</hi> the first resurrection.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: Blessed and holy <hi>is</hi> he who has part in the first resurrection. The second death has no authority over these, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: And when the thousand years have expired, Satan will be loosed out of his prison.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: And he will go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle. The number of them <hi>is</hi> as the sand of the sea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: And they went up over the breadth of the earth and circled around the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of Heaven and devoured them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: And the Devil who deceived them was cast into the Lake of Fire and Brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet <hi>were</hi>. And he will be tormented day and night forever and ever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: And I saw a great white throne, and Him sitting on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. And a place was not found for them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: And I saw the dead, the small and the great, stand before God. And the books were opened, and another book was opened, <hi>which is</hi> the Book of Life. And the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: And the sea gave up the dead in it. And death and hell delivered up the dead in them. And each one of them was judged according to their works.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: And death and hell were cast into the Lake of Fire. This is the second death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: And if anyone was not found having been written in the Book of Life, he was cast into the Lake of Fire.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth. For the first heaven and the first earth had passed away. And the sea no longer is.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: And I, John, saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of Heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her Husband.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: And I heard a great voice out of Heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God <hi>is</hi> with men, and He will dwell with them, and they will be His people, and God Himself will be with them and be their God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: And God will wipe away all tears from their eyes. And there will be no more death, nor mourning, nor crying out, nor will there be any more pain; for the first things passed away.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: And He sitting on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And He said to me, Write, for these words are true and faithful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: And He said to me, It is done. I am the Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the End. To him who thirsts I will give of the fountain of the water of life freely.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: He who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: But the fearful, and the unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, will have their part in the Lake burning with fire and brimstone, which is the second death.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues came to me and talked with me, saying, Come here, I will show you the bride, the Lamb's wife.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain and showed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of Heaven from God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: having the glory of God. And its light <hi>was</hi> like a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: And it had a great and high wall, with twelve gates. And at the gates ware twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel:

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: From the east three gates, from the north three gates, from the south three gates, and from the west three gates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: And he who talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city and its gates and its wall.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: And the city lies four-square, and the length is as large as the breadth. And he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand stadia. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: And he measured its wall, a hundred <hi>and</hi> forty-four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: And the foundation of its wall was jasper; and the city <hi>was</hi> pure gold, like clear glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: And the foundations of the wall of the city had been adorned with every precious stone. The first foundation, jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, hyacinch; the twelfth, amethyst.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: And the twelve gates <hi>were</hi> twelve pearls. Respectively, each one of the gates was one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, as transparent glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: And I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, even the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: And the city had no need of the sun, nor of the moon, that they might shine in it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp <hi>is</hi> the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: And the nations of those who are saved will walk in the light of it; and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honor into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: And its gates may not be shut at all by day, for there shall be no night there.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: And they shall bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: And there shall in no way enter into it anything that defiles, or any making an abomination or a lie; but only those who are written in the Lamb's Book of Life.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: In the midst of its street, and of the river, from here and from there, <hi>was</hi> the Tree of Life, which bore twelve fruits, each yielding its fruit according to one month. And the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: And every curse will no longer be; but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His servants will serve Him.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: And they will see His face, and His name <hi>will be</hi> in their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: And there will be no night there. And they need no lamp, or light of the sun; for the Lord God gives them light. And they will reign forever and ever.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: And he said to me, These sayings <hi>are</hi> faithful and true. And the Lord God of the holy prophets sent His angel to show to His servants the things which must shortly be done.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: Behold, I come quickly. Blessed <hi>is</hi> he who keeps the sayings of the prophecy of this Book.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: And I, John, saw and heard these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: Then he said to me, Behold! Stop! For I am your fellow-servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who keep the sayings of this Book. Do worship to God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: And he said to me, Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this Book; for the time is at hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: He acting unjustly, let him still act unjustly. And the filthy, let him be filthy still. And the righteous, let him be righteous still. And the holy, let him be holy still.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: And behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward <hi>is</hi> with Me, to give to each according as his work is.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: Blessed <hi>are</hi> they who do His commandments, that their authority will be over the Tree of Life, and they may enter in by the gates into the city.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: But outside <hi>are</hi> the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and everyone who loves and makes a lie.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify these things to you over the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright and Morning Star.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come! And let the <hi>one</hi> hearing say, Come! And let him who is thirsty come. And he willing, let him take of the water of life freely.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: For I testify together <hi>to</hi> everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this Book: If anyone adds to these things, God will add on him the plagues that have been written in this Book.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: And if anyone takes away from the words of the Book of this prophecy, God will take away his part out of the Book of Life, and out of the holy city, and <hi>from</hi> the things which have been written in this Book.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/> <lb type="x-begin-paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: He who testifies these things says, Yes, I am coming quickly, Amen. Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ <hi>be</hi> with all of you. Amen.  <lb type="x-end-paragraph"/>
